vulgate_text: tasya taccintitaṃ jñātvā ṛṣerdvaipāyanasya ca / tatrājagāma bhagavānbrahmā lokaguruḥ svayam

sthitaḥ / āsanaṃ kalpayām āsa sarvadevagaṇair yutam / hiraṇyagarbham āsīnaṃ tasmiṃs tu paramāsane / parivṛtyāsanābhyāśe vāsaveyaḥ sthito nataḥ / anujñāto 'tha kṛṣṇas tu brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā / niṣasādāsanābhyāśe prīyamāṇaḥ suvismitaḥ / uvāca sa mahātejā brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam / kṛtaṃ mayedaṃ bhagavan kāvyaṃ paramapūjitam / brahman vedarahasyaṃ ca yac cānyat khyāpitaṃ mayā / sāṅgopaniṣadānāṃ ca vedānāṃ vistarakriyā / itihāsapurāṇānām unmeṣaṃ nimiṣaṃ ca yat / bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyac ca trividhaṃ kālasaṃjñitam / jarāmṛtyubhayavyādhibhāvābhāvaviniścayam / vividhasya ca ce_text: idaṃ dvaipāyanaḥ pūrvaṃ putram adhyāpayac chukam / tato 'nyebhyo 'nurūpebhyaḥ śiṣyebhyaḥ pradadau prabhuḥ

vulgate_text: mātrorabhyupapattiśca dharmopaniṣadaṃ prati / dharmānilendrāṃstābhiḥ sā''juhāva sutavāñchayā

vulgate_text: yadā'śrauṣaṃ draupadīṃ raṅgamadhye lakṣyaṃ bhittvā nirjitāmarjunena / śūrānpañcālānpāṇḍaveyāṃśca yuktāṃ- stadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
ce_text: yadāśrauṣaṃ droṇaputrādibhis tair; hatān pāñcālān draupadeyāṃś ca suptān / kṛtaṃ bībhatsam ayaśasyaṃ ca karma; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya

vulgate_text: yadā'śrauṣaṃ māgadhānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ jarāsandhaṃ kṣvamadhye jvalantam / dorbhyāṃ hataṃ bhīmasenena gatvā tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
ce_text: yadāśrauṣaṃ bhīmasenānuyātena; aśvatthāmnā paramāstraṃ prayuktam / kruddhenaiṣīkam avadhīd yena garbhaṃ; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya

vulgate_text: yadā'śrauṣaṃ vāsasāṃ tatra rāśiṃ samākṣipatkitavo mandabuddhiḥ / duḥśāsano gatavānnaivaṃ cāntaṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
ce_text: yadāśrauṣaṃ droṇaputraṃ kṛpaṃ ca; duḥśāsanaṃ kṛtavarmāṇam ugram / yudhiṣṭhiraṃ śūnyam adharṣayantaṃ; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya

vulgate_text: yadā'śrauṣaṃ na vidurmāmakāstān pracchannarūpānvasataḥ pāṇḍaveyān / virāṭarāṣṭre saha kṛṣṇayā ca tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
ce_text: yadāśrauṣaṃ māmakānāṃ variṣṭhān; dhanaṃjayenaikarathena bhagnān / virāṭarāṣṭre vasatā mahātmanā; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya

vulgate_text: yadā'śrauṣaṃ lokahitāya kṛṣṇaṃ śamārthinamupayātaṃ kurūṇām / śamaṃ kurvāṇamakṛtārthaṃ ca yātaṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
ce_text: yadāśrauṣaṃ karṇaduryodhanābhyāṃ; buddhiṃ kṛtāṃ nigrahe keśavasya / taṃ cātmānaṃ bahudhā darśayānaṃ; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya

vulgate_text: yadā'śrauṣaṃ bhīmasenena pītaṃ raktaṃ bhrāturyudhi duḥśāsanasya / nivāritaṃ nānyatamena bhīmaṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
ce_text: yadābhimanyuṃ parivārya bālaṃ; sarve hatvā hṛṣṭarūpā babhūvuḥ / mahārathāḥ pārtham aśaknuvantas; tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya

vulgate_text: yadā'śrauṣaṃ droṇaputreṇa garbhe vairāṭyā vai pātyamāne mahāstraiḥ / saṃjīvayāmīti hareḥ pratijñāṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya

sthitaḥ / āsanaṃ kalpayām āsa sarvadevagaṇair yutam / hiraṇyagarbham āsīnaṃ tasmiṃs tu paramāsane / parivṛtyāsanābhyāśe vāsaveyaḥ sthito nataḥ / anujñāto 'tha kṛṣṇas tu brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā / niṣasādāsanābhyāśe prīyamāṇaḥ suvismitaḥ / uvāca sa mahātejā brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam / kṛtaṃ mayedaṃ bhagavan kāvyaṃ paramapūjitam / brahman vedarahasyaṃ ca yac cānyat khyāpitaṃ mayā / sāṅgopaniṣadānāṃ ca vedānāṃ vistarakriyā / itihāsapurāṇānām unmeṣaṃ nimiṣaṃ ca yat / bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyac ca trividhaṃ kālasaṃjñitam / jarāmṛtyubhayavyādhibhāvābhāvaviniścayam / vividhasya ca dharmasya hy āśramāṇāṃ ca lakṣaṇam / cāturvarṇyavidhānaṃ ca purāṇārthaṃ ca kṛtsnaśaḥ / tapaso brahmacaryasya pṛthivyāś candrasūryayoḥ / grahanakṣatratārāṇāṃ pramāṇaṃ ca yugaiḥ saha / ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni vedādhyātmaṃ tathaiva ca / nyāyaḥ śikṣā cikitsā ca jñānaṃ pāśupataṃ tathā / iti naikāśrayaṃ janma divyamānuṣasaṃśritam / tīrthānāṃ caiva puṇyānāṃ deśānāṃ caiva kīrtanam / nadīnāṃ parvatānāṃ ca vanānāṃ sāgarasya ca / purāṇāṃ caiva divyānāṃ kalpānāṃ yuddhakauśalam / vākyajātiviśeṣāṃś ca lokayātrākramaś ca yaḥ / yac cāpi sarvagaṃ vastu tat prabho kṣantum arhasi / tapoviśiṣṭād api vai vasiṣṭhān munipuṃgavāt / manye śreṣṭhatamaṃ tvādya rahasyajñānavedanāt / janmaprabhṛti satyāṃ te vidma gāṃ brahmavādinīm / tvayā ca kāvyam ity uktaṃ tasmāt kāvyaṃ bhaviṣyati / asya kāvyasya kavayo na samarthā viśeṣaṇe / viśeṣaṇe gṛhasthasya śeṣās traya ivāśramāḥ / jaḍāndhabadhironmattaṃ tamobhūtaṃ jagad bhavet / yadi jñānahutāśena tvayā nojjvalitaṃ bhavet / tamasāndhasya lokasya veṣṭitasya svakarmabhiḥ / jñānāñjanaśalākābhir buddhinetrotsavaḥ kṛtaḥ / dharmārthakāmamokṣārthaiḥ samāsavyāsakīrtanaiḥ / tvayā bhāratasūryeṇa nṛṇāṃ vinihataṃ tamaḥ / purāṇapūrṇacandreṇa śrutijyotsnāprakāśinā / nṛṇāṃ kumudasaumyānāṃ kṛtaṃ buddhiprabodhanam / itihāsapradīpena mohāvaraṇaghātinā / lokagarbhagṛhaṃ kṛtsnaṃ yathāvat saṃprakāśitam / saṃgrahādhyāyabījo vai paulomāstīkamūlavān / saṃbhavaskandhavistāraḥ sabhāraṇyaviṭaṅkavān / araṇīparvarūpāḍhyo virāṭodyogasāravān / bhīṣmaparvamahāśākho droṇaparvapalāśavān / karṇaparvacitaiḥ puṣpaiḥ śalyaparvasugandhibhiḥ / strīparvaiṣīkaviśrāmaḥ śāntiparvabṛhatphalaḥ / aśvamedhāmṛtarasas tvāśramasthānasaṃśrayaḥ / mausalaśrutisaṃkṣepaḥ śiṣṭadvijaniṣevitaḥ / sarveṣāṃ kavimukhyānām upajīvyo bhaviṣyati / parjanya iva bhūtānām akṣayo bhāratadrumaḥ / evam ābhāṣya taṃ brahmā jagāma svaṃ niveśanam / bhagavān sa jagatsraṣṭā ṛṣidevagaṇaiḥ saha / tasya vṛkṣasya vakṣyāmi śaśvat puṣpaphalodayam / svādumedhyarasopetam acchedyam amarair api

vulgate_text: evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyevaṃ pitarastamathābruvan / taṃ kṣamasveti niṣiṣidhustataḥ sa virarāma ha
ce_text: atharcīkādayo 'bhyetya pitaro brāhmaṇarṣabham / taṃ kṣamasveti siṣidhus tataḥ sa virarāma ha

vulgate_text: sametya taṃ dvijāstāśca tatraiva nidhaṃ gatāḥ / etannāmābhinirvṛttaṃ tasya deśasya vai dvijāḥ
ce_text: evaṃ nāmābhinirvṛttaṃ tasya deśasya vai dvijāḥ / puṇyaś ca ramaṇīyaś ca sa deśo vaḥ prakīrtitaḥ

vulgate_text: yattu śaunaka satre te bhāratākhyānamuttamam / janamejayasya tatsatre vyāsaśiṣyeṇa dhīmatā
ce_text: yat tu śaunakasatre te bhāratākhyānavistaram / ākhyāsye tatra paulomam ākhyānaṃ cāditaḥ param

vulgate_text: tadetadbhārataṃ nāma kavibhistūpajīvyate / udayatepsubhirbhṛtyairabhijāta iveśvaraḥ
ce_text: idaṃ sarvaiḥ kavivarair ākhyānam upajīvyate / udayaprepsubhir bhṛtyair abhijāta iveśvaraḥ

vulgate_text: pauṣyaṃ paulomamāstīkamādiraṃśāvatāraṇam / tataḥ saṃbhavaparvoktamadbhutaṃ romaharṣaṇam
ce_text: parvānukramaṇī pūrvaṃ dvitīyaṃ parvasaṃgrahaḥ / pauṣyaṃ paulomam āstīkam ādivaṃśāvatāraṇam

vulgate_text: nivātakavacairyuddhaṃ parva cājagaraṃ tataḥ / mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyā ca parvānantaramucyate
ce_text: mārkaṇḍeyasamasyā ca parvoktaṃ tadanantaram / saṃvādaś ca tataḥ parva draupadīsatyabhāmayoḥ

vulgate_text: vrīhidrauṇikamākhyānamaindradyumnaṃ tathaiva ca / draupadīharaṇaṃ parva jayadrathavimokṣaṇam
ce_text: saṃdarśanaṃ ca kṛṣṇasya saṃvādaś caiva satyayā / vrīhidrauṇikam ākhyānam aindradyumnaṃ tathaiva ca

vulgate_text: rāmopākhyānamatraiva parva jñeyamataḥ param / pativratāyā māhātmyaṃ sāvitryāścaivamadbhutam
ce_text: ambopākhyānam api ca parva jñeyam ataḥ param / bhīṣmābhiṣecanaṃ parva jñeyam adbhutakāraṇam

vulgate_text: kuṇḍalāharaṇaṃ parva tataḥ paramihocyate / āraṇeyaṃ tataḥ parva vairāṭaṃ tadanantaram / pāṇḍavānāṃ praveśaśca samayasya ca pālanam
ce_text: draupadīharaṇaṃ parva saindhavena vanāt tataḥ / kuṇḍalāharaṇaṃ parva tataḥ param ihocyate

vulgate_text: yānasandhistataḥ parva bhagavadyānameva ca / mātalīyamupākhyānaṃ caritaṃ gālavasya ca
ce_text: parva sānatsujātaṃ ca guhyam adhyātmadarśanam / yānasaṃdhis tataḥ parva bhagavad yānam eva ca

vulgate_text: sāvitraṃ vāmadevyaṃ ca vainyopākhyānameva ca / jāmadagnyamupākhyānaṃ parva ṣoḍaśarājakam
ce_text: sāvitryauddālakīyaṃ ca vainyopākhyānam eva ca / rāmāyaṇam upākhyānam atraiva bahuvistaram

vulgate_text: jñeyaṃ vivādaparvātra karṇasyāpi mahātmanaḥ / mantrasya niścayaṃ kṛtvā kāryasya samanantaram
ce_text: jñeyaṃ vivādaparvātra karṇasyāpi mahātmanaḥ / niryāṇaṃ parva ca tataḥ kurupāṇḍavasenayoḥ

vulgate_text: ambopākhyānamatraiva parva jñeyamataḥ param / bhīṣmābhiṣecanaṃ parva tataścādbhutamucyate
ce_text: ambopākhyānam api ca parva jñeyam ataḥ param / bhīṣmābhiṣecanaṃ parva jñeyam adbhutakāraṇam

vulgate_text: divyaṃ cakṣurdadau yatra saṃjayāya mahāmuniḥ parvoktaṃ bhagavadgītā parva bhīṣmavadhastataḥ / droṇābhiṣecanaṃ parva saṃśaptakavadhastataḥ
ce_text: parvoktaṃ bhagavadgītā parva bhīṣmavadhas tataḥ / droṇābhiṣekaḥ parvoktaṃ saṃśaptakavadhas tataḥ

vulgate_text: harivaṃśastataḥ parva purāṇaṃ khilasaṃjñitam / viṣṇuparva śiśoścaryā viṣṇoḥ kaṃsavadhastathā
ce_text: harivaṃśas tataḥ parva purāṇaṃ khilasaṃjñitam / bhaviṣyatparva cāpy uktaṃ khileṣv evādbhutaṃ mahat

vulgate_text: saṃbhavo jatuveśmākhyaṃ hiḍimbabakayorvadhaḥ / tathā caitrarathaṃ devyāḥ pāñcālyāśca svayaṃvaraḥ
ce_text: tato bakavadhaḥ parva parva caitrarathaṃ tataḥ / tataḥ svayaṃvaraṃ devyāḥ pāñcālyāḥ parva cocyate

vulgate_text: vanavāso'rjunasyāpi subhadrāharaṇaṃ tataḥ / haraṇāharaṇaṃ caiva dahanaṃ khāṇḍavasya ca
ce_text: arjunasya vane vāsaḥ subhadrāharaṇaṃ tataḥ / subhadrāharaṇād ūrdhvaṃ jñeyaṃ haraṇahārikam

vulgate_text: mayasya darśanaṃ caiva ādiparvaṇi kathyate / pauṣye parvaṇi māhātmyamuttaṅkasyopavarṇitam
ce_text: pauṣye parvaṇi māhātmyam uttaṅkasyopavarṇitam / paulome bhṛguvaṃśasya vistāraḥ parikīrtitaḥ

vulgate_text: anyeṣāṃ caiva bhūtānāṃ vividhānāṃ samudbhavaḥ / maharṣerāśramapade kaṇvasya ca tapasvinaḥ
ce_text: nāgānām atha sarpāṇāṃ gandharvāṇāṃ patatriṇām / anyeṣāṃ caiva bhūtānāṃ vividhānāṃ samudbhavaḥ

vulgate_text: vāraṇāvatayātrā ca mantro duryodhanasya ca / kūṭasya dhārtarāṣṭreṇa preṣaṇaṃ pāṇḍavānprati
ce_text: vāraṇāvatayātrā ca mantro duryodhanasya ca / vidurasya ca vākyena suruṅgopakramakriyā

vulgate_text: vidurasya ca vākyena suruṅgopakramakriyā / niṣādyāḥ pañcaputrāyāḥ suptāyā jatuveśmani
ce_text: vāraṇāvatayātrā ca mantro duryodhanasya ca / vidurasya ca vākyena suruṅgopakramakriyā

vulgate_text: purocanasya cātraiva dahanaṃ saṃprakīrtitam / pāṇḍavānāṃ vane ghore hiḍimbāyāśca darśanam
ce_text: pāṇḍavānāṃ vane ghore hiḍimbāyāś ca darśanam / ghaṭotkacasya cotpattir atraiva parikīrtitā

vulgate_text: tatraiva ca hiḍimbasya vadho bhīmānmahābalāt / ghaṭotkacasya cotpattiṃratraiva parikīrtitā
ce_text: pāṇḍavānāṃ vane ghore hiḍimbāyāś ca darśanam / ghaṭotkacasya cotpattir atraiva parikīrtitā

vulgate_text: ajñātacaryayā vāso yatra teṣāṃ prakīrtitaḥ / bakasya nidhanaṃ caiva nāgarāṇāṃ ca vismayaḥ
ce_text: ajñātacaryā pāṇḍūnāṃ vāso brāhmaṇaveśmani / bakasya nidhanaṃ caiva nāgarāṇāṃ ca vismayaḥ

vulgate_text: aṅgāraparṇaṃ nirjitya gaṅgākūle'rjunastadā / sakhyaṃ kṛtvā tatastena tasmādeva ca śuśruve
ce_text: aṅgāraparṇaṃ nirjitya gaṅgākūle 'rjunas tadā / bhrātṛbhiḥ sahitaḥ sarvaiḥ pāñcālān abhito yayau

vulgate_text: jagmatustaiḥ samāgantuṃ śālāṃ bhārgavaveśmani / pañcānāmekapatnītve vimarśo drupadasya ca
ce_text: pañcānām ekapatnītve vimarśo drupadasya ca / draupadyā devavihito vivāhaś cāpy amānuṣaḥ

vulgate_text: kṣattuśca dhārtarāṣṭreṇa preṣaṇaṃ pāṇḍavānprati / vidurasya ca saṃprāptirdarśanaṃ keśavasya ca
ce_text: vidurasya ca saṃprāptir darśanaṃ keśavasya ca / khāṇḍavaprasthavāsaś ca tathā rājyārdhaśāsanam

vulgate_text: sundopasundayostadvadākhyānaṃ parikīrtitam / anantaraṃ ca draupadyā sahāsīnaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram
ce_text: nāradasyājñayā caiva draupadyāḥ samayakriyā / sundopasundayos tatra upākhyānaṃ prakīrtitam

vulgate_text: samayaṃ pālayanvīro vanaṃ yatra jagāma ha / pārthasya vanavāse ca ulūpyā pathi saṅgamaḥ
ce_text: pārthasya vanavāsaś ca ulūpyā pathi saṃgamaḥ / puṇyatīrthānusaṃyānaṃ babhruvāhanajanma ca

vulgate_text: puṇyatīrthānusaṃyānaṃ babhruvāhanajanma ca / tatraiva mokṣayāmāsa pañca so'psarasaḥ śubhāḥ
ce_text: pārthasya vanavāsaś ca ulūpyā pathi saṃgamaḥ / puṇyatīrthānusaṃyānaṃ babhruvāhanajanma ca

vulgate_text: adhyāyānāṃ śate dve tu saṃkhyāte paramarṣiṇā / saptaviṃśatiradhyāyā vyāsenottamatejasā
ce_text: ity etad ādhiparvoktaṃ prathamaṃ bahuvistaram / adhyāyānāṃ śate dve tu saṃkhyāte paramarṣiṇā / aṣṭādaśaiva cādhyāyā vyāsenottamatejasā

vulgate_text: aṣṭau ślokasahasrāṇi aṣṭau ślokaśatāni ca / ślokāśca caturāśītirmuninoktā mahātmanā
ce_text: adhyāyānāṃ śataṃ proktam adhyāyāḥ saptatis tathā / aṣṭau ślokasahasrāṇi tathā nava śatāni ca

vulgate_text: girivraje niruddhānāṃ rājñāṃ kṛṣṇena mokṣaṇam / tathā digvijayo'traiva pāmḍavānāṃ prakīrtitaḥ
ce_text: girivraje niruddhānāṃ rājñāṃ kṛṣṇena mokṣaṇam / rājasūye 'rghasaṃvāde śiśupālavadhas tathā

vulgate_text: rājñāmāgamanaṃ caiva sārhaṇānāṃ mahakratau / rājasūye'rghasaṃvāde śiśupālavadhastathā
ce_text: girivraje niruddhānāṃ rājñāṃ kṛṣṇena mokṣaṇam / rājasūye 'rghasaṃvāde śiśupālavadhas tathā

vulgate_text: yatra dyūtārṇave magnāṃ draupadīṃ naurivārṇavāt / dhṛtarāṣṭro mahāprājñaḥ snuṣāṃ paramaduḥkhitām
ce_text: yatra dyūtārṇave magnān draupadī naur ivārṇavāt / tārayām āsa tāṃs tīrṇāñ jñātvā duryodhano nṛpaḥ / punar eva tato dyūte samāhvayata pāṇḍavān

vulgate_text: jitvā sa vanavāsāya preṣayāmāsa tāṃstataḥ / etatsarvaṃ sabhāparva samākhyātaṃ mahātmanā
ce_text: etat sarvaṃ sabhāparva samākhyātaṃ mahātmanā / adhyāyāḥ saptatir jñeyās tathā dvau cātra saṃkhyayā

vulgate_text: vanavāsaṃ prayāteṣu pāṇḍaveṣu mahātmasu / paurānugamanaṃ caiva dharmaputrasya dhīmataḥ
ce_text: ataḥ paraṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu jñeyam āraṇyakaṃ mahat / paurānugamanaṃ caiva dharmaputrasya dhīmataḥ

vulgate_text: kirmīrasya vadhaścātra bhīmasenena saṃyuge / vṛṣṇīnāmāgamaścātra pāñcālānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ
ce_text: vṛṣṇīnām āgamo yatra pāñcālānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ / yatra saubhavadhākhyānaṃ kirmīravadha eva ca / astrahetor vivāsaś ca pārthasyāmitatejasaḥ

vulgate_text: gamanaṃ kāmyake cāpi vyāse pratigate tataḥ / astrahetorvivāsaśca pārthasyāmitatejasaḥ
ce_text: vṛṣṇīnām āgamo yatra pāñcālānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ / yatra saubhavadhākhyānaṃ kirmīravadha eva ca / astrahetor vivāsaś ca pārthasyāmitatejasaḥ

vulgate_text: pulastyatīrthayātrā ca nāradena maharṣiṇā / tīrthayātrā ca tatraiva pāṇḍavānāṃ mahātmanāṃ
ce_text: tīrthayātrā tathaivātra pāṇḍavānāṃ mahātmanām / jaṭāsurasya tatraiva vadhaḥ samupavarṇyate

vulgate_text: kārtavīryavadho yatra haihayānāṃ ca varṇyate / prabhāsatīrthe pāṇḍūnāṃ vṛṣṇibhiśca samāgamaḥ
ce_text: kārtavīryavadho yatra haihayānāṃ ca varṇyate / saukanyam api cākhyānaṃ cyavano yatra bhārgavaḥ

vulgate_text: tābhyāṃ ca yatra sa muniryauvanaṃ pratipāditaḥ / māndhātuścāpyupākhyānaṃ rājño'traivaprakīrtitaṃ
ce_text: śaryātiyajñe nāsatyau kṛtavān somapīthinau / tābhyāṃ ca yatra sa munir yauvanaṃ pratipāditaḥ

vulgate_text: aṣṭāvakrīyamatraiva vivādo yatra bandinā / aṣṭāvakrasya viprarṣerjanakasyādhvare'bhavat
ce_text: aṣṭāvakrīyam atraiva vivāde yatra bandinam / vijitya sāgaraṃ prāptaṃ pitaraṃ labdhavān ṛṣiḥ

vulgate_text: vijitya sāgaraṃ prāptaṃ pitaraṃ labdhavānṛṣiḥ yavakrītasya cākhyānaṃ raibhyasya ca mahātmanaḥ / gandhamādanayātrā ca vāso nārāyaṇāśrame
ce_text: aṣṭāvakrīyam atraiva vivāde yatra bandinam / vijitya sāgaraṃ prāptaṃ pitaraṃ labdhavān ṛṣiḥ

vulgate_text: niyukto bhīmasenaśca draupadyā gandhamādane / vrajanpathi mahābāhurdṛṣṭavānpavanātmajam
ce_text: niyukto bhīmasenaś ca draupadyā gandhamādane / yatra mandārapuṣpārthaṃ nalinīṃ tām adharṣayat

vulgate_text: kadalīṣaṇḍamadhyasthaṃ hanūmantaṃ mahābalam / yatra mandārapuṣpārthe nalinīṃ tāmadharṣayat
ce_text: niyukto bhīmasenaś ca draupadyā gandhamādane / yatra mandārapuṣpārthaṃ nalinīṃ tām adharṣayat

vulgate_text: mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāyāmupākhyānāni sarvaśaḥ / pṛthorvainyasya yatroktamākhyānaṃ paramarṣiṇā
ce_text: yatrainam anvayād bhīmo vāyuvegasamo jave / mārkaṇḍeyasamasyāyām upākhyānāni bhāgaśaḥ

vulgate_text: punardvaitavanaṃ caiva pāṇḍavāḥ samupāgatāḥ / ghoṣayātrā ca gandharvairyatra baddhaḥ suyodhanaḥ
ce_text: samāgamaś ca pārthasya bhrātṛbhir gandhamādane / ghoṣayātrā ca gandharvair yatra yuddhaṃ kirīṭinaḥ

vulgate_text: durvāsaso'pyupākhyānamatraiva parikīrtitam / jayadrathenāpahāro draupadyāścāśramāntarāt
ce_text: punarāgamanaṃ caiva teṣāṃ dvaitavanaṃ saraḥ / jayadrathenāpahāro draupadyāś cāśramāntarāt

vulgate_text: yatrainamanvayādbhīmo vāyuvegasamo jave / cakre cainaṃ pañcaśikhaṃ yatra bhīmo mahābalaḥ
ce_text: yatrainam anvayād bhīmo vāyuvegasamo jave / mārkaṇḍeyasamasyāyām upākhyānāni bhāgaśaḥ

vulgate_text: rāmāyaṇamupākhyānamatraiva bahuvistaram / yatra rāmeṇa vikramya nihato rāvaṇo yudhi
ce_text: sāvitryauddālakīyaṃ ca vainyopākhyānam eva ca / rāmāyaṇam upākhyānam atraiva bahuvistaram

vulgate_text: sāvitryāścāpyupākhyānamatraiva parikīrtitam / karṇasya parimokṣo'tra kuṇḍalābhyāṃ puraṃdarāt
ce_text: karṇasya parimoṣo 'tra kuṇḍalābhyāṃ puraṃdarāt / āraṇeyam upākhyānaṃ yatra dharmo 'nvaśāt sutam / jagmur labdhavarā yatra pāṇḍavāḥ paścimāṃ diśam

ce_text: gograhe yatra pārthena nirjitāḥ kuravo yudhi / godhanaṃ ca virāṭasya mokṣitaṃ yatra pāṇḍavaiḥ

vulgate_text: samastā yatra pārthena nirjitāḥ kuravo yudhi / pratyāhṛtaṃ godhanaṃ ca vikrameṇa kirīṭinā
ce_text: gograhe yatra pārthena nirjitāḥ kuravo yudhi / godhanaṃ ca virāṭasya mokṣitaṃ yatra pāṇḍavaiḥ

vulgate_text: uktāni vedaviduṣā parvaṇyasminmaharṣiṇā / udyogaparva vijñeyaṃ pañcamaṃ śṛṇvataḥ param
ce_text: udyogaparva vijñeyaṃ pañcamaṃ śṛṇv ataḥ param / upaplavye niviṣṭeṣu pāṇḍaveṣu jigīṣayā / duryodhano 'rjunaś caiva vāsudevam upasthitau

vulgate_text: tato yuddhāya niryātā narāśvarathadantinaḥ / nagarāddhāstinapurādvalasaṃkhyānamevaca
ce_text: tataś cāpy abhiniryātrā rathāśvanaradantinām / nagarād dhāstinapurād balasaṃkhyānam eva ca

vulgate_text: udyogaparva nirdiṣṭaṃ sandhivigrahamiśritam / adhyāyānāṃ śataṃ proktaṃ ṣaḍaśītirmaharṣiṇā
ce_text: etat subahuvṛttāntaṃ pañcamaṃ parva bhārate / udyogaparva nirdiṣṭaṃ saṃdhivigrahasaṃśritam

vulgate_text: mohajaṃ nāśayāmāsa hetubhirmokṣadarśibhiḥ / samīkṣyādokṣajaḥ kṣipraṃ yudhiṣṭhirahite rataḥ
ce_text: kaśmalaṃ yatra pārthasya vāsudevo mahāmatiḥ / mohajaṃ nāśayām āsa hetubhir mokṣadarśanaiḥ

vulgate_text: droṇaparva tataścitraṃ bahuvṛttāntamucyate / saināpatye'bhiṣikto'tha yatrācāryaḥ pratāpavān
ce_text: droṇaparva tataś citraṃ bahuvṛttāntam ucyate / yatra saṃśaptakāḥ pārtham apaninyū raṇājirāt

vulgate_text: akṣauhiṇīḥ sapta hatvā hato rājā jayadrathaḥ / yatra bhīmo mahābāhuḥ sātyakiśca mahārathaḥ
ce_text: hate 'bhimanyau kruddhena yatra pārthena saṃyuge / akṣauhiṇīḥ sapta hatvā hato rājā jayadrathaḥ / saṃśaptakāvaśeṣaṃ ca kṛtaṃ niḥśeṣam āhave

vulgate_text: saṃśaptakāvaśeṣaṃ ca kṛtaṃ niḥśeṣamāhave / saṃśaptakānāṃ vīrāṇāṃ koṭyo nava mahātmanām

vulgate_text: nārāyaṇāśca gopālāḥ samare citrayodhinaḥ / alambuṣaḥ śrutāyuśca jalasandhaśca vīryavān
ce_text: alambusaḥ śrutāyuś ca jalasaṃdhaś ca vīryavān / saumadattir virāṭaś ca drupadaś ca mahārathaḥ / ghaṭotkacādayaś cānye nihatā droṇaparvaṇi

vulgate_text: anyonyaṃ prati ca krodho yudhiṣṭhirakirīṭinoḥ / yatraivānunayaḥ prokto mādhavenārjunasya hi
ce_text: anyonyaṃ prati ca krodho yudhiṣṭhirakirīṭinoḥ / dvairathe yatra pārthena hataḥ karṇo mahārathaḥ

vulgate_text: hatapravīre sainye tu netā madreśvaro'bhavat / yatra kaumāramākhyānamabhiṣekasya karma ca
ce_text: ataḥ paraṃ vicitrārthaṃ śalyaparva prakīrtitam / hatapravīre sainye tu netā madreśvaro 'bhavat

vulgate_text: śalyasya nidhanaṃ cātra dharmarājānmahātmanaḥ / śakuneśca vadho'traiva sahadevena saṃyuge
ce_text: śalyasya nidhanaṃ cātra dharmarājān mahārathāt / gadāyuddhaṃ tu tumulam atraiva parikīrtitam / sarasvatyāś ca tīrthānāṃ puṇyatā parikīrtitā

vulgate_text: samavāye ca yuddhasya rāmasyāgamanaṃ smṛtam / sarasvatyāśca tīrthānāṃ puṇyatā parikīrtitā
ce_text: śalyasya nidhanaṃ cātra dharmarājān mahārathāt / gadāyuddhaṃ tu tumulam atraiva parikīrtitam / sarasvatyāś ca tīrthānāṃ puṇyatā parikīrtitā

vulgate_text: gadāyuddhaṃ ca tumulamatraiva parikīrtitam / duryodhanasya rājño'tha yatra bhīmena saṃyuge
ce_text: śalyasya nidhanaṃ cātra dharmarājān mahārathāt / gadāyuddhaṃ tu tumulam atraiva parikīrtitam / sarasvatyāś ca tīrthānāṃ puṇyatā parikīrtitā

vulgate_text: ūrū bhagnau prasahyājau gadayā bhīmavegayā / navamaṃ parva nirdiṣṭametadadbhutamarthavat
ce_text: navamaṃ parva nirdiṣṭam etad adbhutam arthavat / ekonaṣaṣṭir adhyāyās tatra saṃkhyāviśāradaiḥ

vulgate_text: ekonapaṣṭiradhyāyāḥ parvaṇyatra prakīrtitāḥ / saṃkhyātā bahuvṛttāntāḥ ślokasaṃkhyā'tra kathyate
ce_text: saṃkhyātā bahuvṛttāntāḥ ślokāgraṃ cātra śasyate / trīṇi ślokasahasrāṇi dve śate viṃśatis tathā / muninā saṃpraṇītāni kauravāṇāṃ yaśobhṛtām

vulgate_text: sametya dadṛśurbhūmau patitaṃ raṇamūrdhani / pratijajñe dṛḍhakrodho drauṇiryatra mahārathaḥ
ce_text: pratijajñe dṛḍhakrodho drauṇir yatra mahārathaḥ / ahatvā sarvapāñcālān dhṛṣṭadyumnapurogamān / pāṇḍavāṃś ca sahāmātyān na vimokṣyāmi daṃśanam

vulgate_text: prasuptānniśi viśvastāndhṛṣṭadyumnapurogamān / pāñcālānsaparīvārāndraupadeyāṃśca sarvaśaḥ
ce_text: prasuptān niśi viśvastān yatra te puruṣarṣabhāḥ / pāñcālān saparīvārāñ jaghnur drauṇipurogamāḥ

vulgate_text: kṛtavarmaṇā ca sahitaḥ kṛpeṇa ca nijaghnivān / yatrāmucyanta te pārthāḥ pañca kṛṣṇabalāśrayāt
ce_text: yatrāmucyanta pārthās te pañca kṛṣṇabalāśrayāt / sātyakiś ca maheṣvāsaḥ śeṣāś ca nidhanaṃ gatāḥ

vulgate_text: sātyakiśca maheṣvāsaḥ śeṣāśca nidhanaṃ gatāḥ / pāñcālānāṃ prasuptānāṃ yatra droṇasutādvadhaḥ
ce_text: yatrāmucyanta pārthās te pañca kṛṣṇabalāśrayāt / sātyakiś ca maheṣvāsaḥ śeṣāś ca nidhanaṃ gatāḥ

vulgate_text: dhṛṣṭadyumnasya sūtena pāṇḍaveṣu niveditaḥ / draupadī putraśokārtā pitṛbhrātṛvadhārditā
ce_text: draupadī putraśokārtā pitṛbhrātṛvadhārditā / kṛtānaśanasaṃkalpā yatra bhartṝn upāviśat

vulgate_text: priyaṃ tasyāścikīrṣanvai gadāmādāya vīryavān / anvadhāvatsusaṃkruddho bhāradvājaṃ guroḥ sutam
ce_text: draupadīvacanād yatra bhīmo bhīmaparākramaḥ / anvadhāvata saṃkruddho bhāradvājaṃ guroḥ sutam

vulgate_text: drauṇeśca drohabuddhitvaṃ vīkṣya pāpātmanastadā / drauṇidvaipāyanādīnāṃ śāpāścānyonyakāritāḥ
ce_text: drauṇidvaipāyanādīnāṃ śāpāś cānyonyakāritāḥ / toyakarmaṇi sarveṣāṃ rājñām udakadānike

vulgate_text: etadvai daśamaṃ parva sauptikaṃ samudāhṛtam / aṣṭādaśāsminnadyāyāḥ parvamyuktā mahātmanā
ce_text: gūḍhotpannasya cākhyānaṃ karṇasya pṛthayātmanaḥ / sutasyaitad iha proktaṃ daśamaṃ parva sauptikam

vulgate_text: sauptikaiṣīkasaṃbandhe parvaṇyuttamatejasī / ata ūrdhvamidaṃ prāhuḥ strīparva karuṇodayam
ce_text: ata ūrdhvam idaṃ prāhuḥ strīparva karuṇodayam / vilāpo vīrapatnīnāṃ yatrātikaruṇaḥ smṛtaḥ / krodhāveśaḥ prasādaś ca gāndhārīdhṛtarāṣṭrayoḥ

vulgate_text: ślokasaptaśatī cāpi pañcasaptatisaṃyutā / saṃkhyayā bhāratākhyānamuktaṃ vyāsena dhīmatā
ce_text: ślokāḥ saptaśataṃ cātra pañcasaptatir ucyate / saṃkhyayā bhāratākhyānaṃ kartrā hy atra mahātmanā / praṇītaṃ sajjanamanovaiklavyāśrupravartakam

vulgate_text: saptaślokāstathaivātra pañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyayā / ata ūrdhvaṃ ca vijñeyamanuśāsanamuttamam
ce_text: ata ūrdhvaṃ tu vijñeyam ānuśāsanam uttamam / yatra prakṛtim āpannaḥ śrutvā dharmaviniścayam / bhīṣmād bhāgīrathīputrāt kururājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ

vulgate_text: ślokānāṃ tu sahasrāṇi proktānyaṣṭau prasaṃkhyayā / tato'śvamedhikaṃ nāma parva proktaṃ caturdaśam
ce_text: tato 'śvamedhikaṃ nāma parva proktaṃ caturdaśam / tat saṃvartamaruttīyaṃ yatrākhyānam anuttamam

vulgate_text: saṅgrāme babhruvāhena saṃśayaṃ cātra jagmivān sudarśanaṃ tathā''khyānaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ dharmameva ca / aśvamedhe mahāyajñe nakulākhyānameva ca
ce_text: citrāṅgadāyāḥ putreṇa putrikāyā dhanaṃjayaḥ / saṃgrāme babhruvāhena saṃśayaṃ cātra darśitaḥ / aśvamedhe mahāyajñe nakulākhyānam eva ca

vulgate_text: yatra rājyaṃ parityajya pāṇḍavāḥ puruṣarṣabhāḥ / draupadyā sahitā devyā mahāprasthānamāsthitāḥ
ce_text: mahāprasthānikaṃ tasmād ūrdhvaṃ saptadaśaṃ smṛtam / yatra rājyaṃ parityajya pāṇḍavāḥ puruṣarṣabhāḥ / draupadyā sahitā devyā siddhiṃ paramikāṃ gatāḥ

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvā hitvā jagāmaiva sarvānanavalokayan / etatsaptadaśaṃ parva mahāprasthānikaṃ smṛtam
ce_text: mahāprasthānikaṃ tasmād ūrdhvaṃ saptadaśaṃ smṛtam / yatra rājyaṃ parityajya pāṇḍavāḥ puruṣarṣabhāḥ / draupadyā sahitā devyā siddhiṃ paramikāṃ gatāḥ

vulgate_text: svargaparva tato jñeyaṃ divyaṃ yattadamānuṣam / prāptaṃ daivarathaṃ svargānneṣṭavānyatra dharmarāṭ
ce_text: svargaparva tato jñeyaṃ divyaṃ yat tad amānuṣam / adhyāyāḥ pañca saṃkhyātāḥ parvaitad abhisaṃkhyayā / ślokānāṃ dve śate caiva prasaṃkhyāte tapodhanāḥ

vulgate_text: adhyāyāḥ pañca saṃkhyātāḥ parvamyasminmahātmanā / ślokānāṃ dve śate caiva prasaṃkhyāte tapodhāḥ
ce_text: svargaparva tato jñeyaṃ divyaṃ yat tad amānuṣam / adhyāyāḥ pañca saṃkhyātāḥ parvaitad abhisaṃkhyayā / ślokānāṃ dve śate caiva prasaṃkhyāte tapodhanāḥ

vulgate_text: nava ślokāstathaivānye saṃkhyātāḥ paramarṣiṇā / aṣṭādaśaivametāni parvāṇyetānyaśeṣataḥ
ce_text: aṣṭādaśaivam etāni parvāṇy uktāny aśeṣataḥ / khileṣu harivaṃśaś ca bhaviṣyac ca prakīrtitam / adhyāyās tv ekam ekānāṃ saptāśītir udāhṛtā / ślokānāṃ ca sahasrāṇi daśa trīṇi śatāni ca / paulomādīni sarvāṇi daśāṣṭau ca mahān ṛṣiḥ / uktavān sapurāṇāni rahasyaṃ cāvasānikam / evam aṣṭādaśaitāni parvāṇy uktāni dhīmatā / adhyāyānāṃ sahasre dve parvaṇāṃ śatam eva ca / ślokānāṃ ca sahasrāṇi navatir daśa eva ca / eṣā vai parvaṇāṃ saṃkhyā ślokā granthe yathākramam / yad uktam ṛṣiṇā tena vyāsenottamatejasā / janamejayasyāśvamedhaṃ draṣṭukāmasya dhīmataḥ / saṃpravṛtto 'śvamedhaś ca yatra śakreṇa dharṣitaḥ / virodhaś cābhavad rājño brāhmaṇais tasya ṛtvijaiḥ / viśvāvasupurānīto rājā rājyam acīkarat / eṣā vai parvaṇāṃ saṃkhyā khilāny āha tataḥ param

vulgate_text: khileṣu harivaṃśe ca saṃkhyātāni maharṣiṇā / etatsarvaṃ samākhyātaṃ bhārate parvasaṃgrahaḥ
ce_text: etad akhilam ākhyātaṃ bhārataṃ parvasaṃgrahāt / aṣṭādaśa samājagmur akṣauhiṇyo yuyutsayā / tan mahad dāruṇaṃ yuddham ahāny aṣṭādaśābhavat

vulgate_text: na kiṃciduktavantaste sā tānuvāca yasmādayamabhihato'napakārī tasmādadṛṣṭaṃ tvāṃ bhayamāgamiṣyatīti
ce_text: sa tayā kruddhayā tatroktaḥ / ayaṃ me putro na kiṃ cid aparādhyati / kimartham abhihata iti / yasmāc cāyam abhihato 'napakārī tasmād adṛṣṭaṃ tvāṃ bhayam āgamiṣyatīti

vulgate_text: sa taṃ purohitamupādāyopāvṛtto bhrātṛnuvāca mayā'yaṃ vṛta upādhyāyo yadayaṃ brūyāttatkāryamavicārayadbhirbhavadbhiriti tenaivamuktā bhrātarastasya tathā cakruḥ / sa tathā bhrātṝnsaṃdiśya takṣaśilāṃ pratyabhipratasthe taṃ ca deśaṃ vaśe sthāpayāmāsa
ce_text: tenaivam uktā bhrātaras tasya tathā cakruḥ / sa tathā bhrātṝn saṃdiśya takṣaśilāṃ pratyabhipratasthe / taṃ ca deśaṃ vaśe sthāpayām āsa

vulgate_text: tau taṃ pratyūcaturbhagavaṃstvayaiva preṣito gaccha kedārakhaṇḍaṃ badhāneti / sa evamuktastau śiṣyau pratyuvāca tasmāttatra sarve gacchāmo yatra sa gata iti
ce_text: te pratyūcuḥ / bhagavataiva preṣito gaccha kedārakhaṇḍaṃ badhāneti

vulgate_text: sa evamukta upādhyāyaḥ pratyuvāca yasmādbhavānkedārakhaṇḍaṃ vidāryotthitastasmāduddālaka evanāmnā bhavānbhaviṣyatītyupādhyāyenānugṛhītaḥ
ce_text: tam upādhyāyo 'bravīt / yasmād bhavān kedārakhaṇḍam avadāryotthitas tasmād bhavān uddālaka eva nāmnā bhaviṣyatīti

vulgate_text: mayyanivedya baikṣyaṃ nīpayoktavyamiti / sa tathetyukto bhaikṣyaṃ caritvoṇadhyāyanyavedayat
ce_text: tam upādhyāyaḥ pratyuvāca / mamānivedya bhaikṣaṃ nopayoktavyam iti

vulgate_text: naiṣā nyāyyā guruvṛttiranyeṣāmapi bhaikṣyopajīvināṃ vṛttyuparodhaṃ karoṣi ityevaṃ vartamāno lubdho'sīti
ce_text: tam upādhyāyaḥ pratyuvāca / naiṣā nyāyyā guruvṛttiḥ / anyeṣām api vṛttyuparodhaṃ karoṣy evaṃ vartamānaḥ / lubdho 'sīti

vulgate_text: tamupādhyāyaḥ pīvānameva dṛṣṭvovāca / vatsopamanyo bhaikṣyaṃ nāśnāsi na cānyaccarasi payo na pibasi pīvānasi bhṛśaṃ kenedānīṃ vṛttiṃ kalpayasīti
ce_text: tam upādhyāyas tathāpi pīvānam eva dṛṣṭvovāca / vatsopamanyo sarvam aśeṣatas te bhaikṣaṃ gṛhṇāmi / kenedānīṃ vṛttiṃ kalpayasīti

vulgate_text: tathā pratiṣiddho bhaikṣyaṃ nāśnāti nacānyaccarati payo na pibati phenaṃ nopayuhkte sa kadācidaraṇye kṣudhārto'rkapatrāṇyabhakṣayat
ce_text: sa tatheti pratijñāya nirāhāras tā gā arakṣat / tathā pratiṣiddho bhaikṣaṃ nāśnāti na cānyac carati / payo na pibati / phenaṃ nopayuṅkte

vulgate_text: atha tasminnanāgacchati sūrye cāstācalāvalambini upādhyāyaḥ śiṣyānavocat
ce_text: atha tasminn anāgacchaty upādhyāyaḥ śiṣyān avocat / mayopamanyuḥ sarvataḥ pratiṣiddhaḥ / sa niyataṃ kupitaḥ / tato nāgacchati ciragataś ceti

vulgate_text: sa upādhyāyasya āhvānavacanaṃ śrutvā pratyuvācoccairayamasminkūpe patito'hamiti / tamupādhyāyaḥ pratyuvāca kathaṃ tvamasminkūpe patita iti
ce_text: tam upādhyāyaḥ pratyuvāca / katham asi kūpe patita iti

vulgate_text: sa upādhyāyaṃ pratyuvāca arkapatrāṇi bhakṣayitvāndhībhūtosmyataścaṅkramyamāṇaḥ kūpe patita iti / tamupādhyāyaḥ pratyuvāca
ce_text: sa taṃ pratyuvāca / arkapatrāṇi bhakṣayitvāndhībhūto 'smi / ataḥ kūpe patita iti

vulgate_text: athāparaḥ śiṣyastasyaivāpodasya dhaumyasya baido nāma tamupādhyāyaḥ samādideśa vatsa baida ihāsyatāṃ tāvanmama gṛhe kaṃcitkālaṃ śuśrūṣuṇā ca bhavitavyaṃ śreyaste bhaviṣyatīti
ce_text: tam upādhyāyaḥ saṃdideśa / vatsa veda ihāsyatām / bhavatā madgṛhe kaṃ cit kālaṃ śuśrūṣamāṇena bhavitavyam / śreyas te bhaviṣyatīti

vulgate_text: sa upādhyāyenānujñātaḥ samāvṛttastasmādgurukulavāsādgṛhāśramaṃ pratyapadyata tasyāpi svagṛhe vasatastrayaḥ śiṣyā babhūvuḥ sa śiṣyānna kiṃciduvāca karma vā kriyatāṃ guruśuśrūṣā veti / duḥkhābhijño hi gurukulavāsasya śiṣyānparikleśena yojayituṃ neyeṣa
ce_text: sa śiṣyān na kiṃ cid uvāca / karma vā kriyatāṃ guruśuśrūṣā veti / duḥkhābhijño hi gurukulavāsasya śiṣyān parikleśena yojayituṃ neyeṣa

vulgate_text: bhoyatkiṃcidasmadgṛhe parihīyate tadicchāmyahamaparihīyamānaṃ bhavatā kriyamāṇamiti sa evaṃ pratisaṃdiśyottaṅkaṃ baidaḥ pravāsaṃ jagāma
ce_text: sa kadā cid yājyakāryeṇābhiprasthita uttaṅkaṃ nāma śiṣyaṃ niyojayām āsa / bho uttaṅka yat kiṃ cid asmadgṛhe parihīyate tad icchāmy aham aparihīṇaṃ bhavatā kriyamāṇam iti

vulgate_text: upādhyāyānī te ṛtumatī upādhyāyaśca proṣito'syā yathā'yamṛturvandhyo na bhavati tathā kriyatāmeṣā viṣīdatīti
ce_text: sa vasaṃs tatropādhyāyastrībhiḥ sahitābhir āhūyoktaḥ / upādhyāyinī te ṛtumatī / upādhyāyaś ca proṣitaḥ / asyā yathāyam ṛtur vandhyo na bhavati tathā kriyatām / etad viṣīdatīti

vulgate_text: ānayasvetaścaturthe'hani puṇyakarma bhavitā tābhyāmābaddhābhyāṃ śobhamānā brāhmaṇānpariveṣṭumicchāmi / tatsaṃpādayasva evaṃ hi kurvataḥ śreyo bhavitā'nyathā kutaḥ śreya iti
ce_text: saivam uktopādhyāyiny uttaṅkaṃ pratyuvāca / gaccha pauṣyaṃ rājānam / bhikṣasva tasya kṣatriyayā pinaddhe kuṇḍale / te ānayasva / itaś caturthe 'hani puṇyakaṃ bhavitā / tābhyām ābaddhābhyāṃ brāhmaṇān pariveṣṭum icchāmi / śobhamānā yathā tābhyāṃ kuṇḍalābhyāṃ tasminn ahani saṃpādayasva / śreyo hi te syāt kṣaṇaṃ kurvata iti

vulgate_text: bhouttaṅkaitatpurīṣamasya ṛṣabhasya bhakṣayasveti sa evamukto naicchat
ce_text: sa puruṣa uttaṅkam abhyabhāṣata / uttaṅkaitat purīṣam asya ṛṣabhasya bhakṣayasveti

vulgate_text: sa evamukto bāḍhamityuktvā tadā tadvṛpabhasya mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ ca bhakṣayitvottaṅkaḥ saṃbhramāḍhutthita evāpo'nuspṛśya pratasthe
ce_text: sa evam ukto bāḍham ity uktvā tadā tad ṛṣabhasya purīṣaṃ mūtraṃ ca bhakṣayitvottaṅkaḥ pratasthe yatra sa kṣatriyaḥ pauṣyaḥ

vulgate_text: yatra sa kṣatriyaḥ pauṣyastamupetyāsīnamapaśyaduttaṅkaḥ / sa uttaṅkastamupetyāśīrbhirabhinandyovāca
ce_text: tam upetyāpaśyad uttaṅka āsīnam / sa tam upetyāśīrbhir abhinandyovāca / arthī bhavantam upagato 'smīti

vulgate_text: athaivamukta uttaṅkaḥ smṛtvovācāsti khalu mayā tu bhakṣitaṃ nopaspṛṣṭamāgacchateti / taṃ pauṣyaḥ pratyuvāca eṣa te vyatikramo notthitenopaspṛṣṭaṃ bhavati śīghramāgacchateti
ce_text: athaivam ukta uttaṅkaḥ smṛtvovāca / asti khalu mayocchiṣṭenopaspṛṣṭaṃ śīghraṃ gacchatā ceti

vulgate_text: sa tāmuvācaite kuṇḍale gurvarthaṃ me bhikṣite dātumarhasīti / sā prītā tena tasya sadbhāvena pātramayamanatikramaṇīyaśceti matvā te kuṇḍale avamucyāsmai prāyacchadāha cainamete kuṇḍale takṣako nāgarājaḥ subhṛśaṃ prārthayatyapramatto netumarhasīti
ce_text: sā prītā tena tasya sadbhāvena pātram ayam anatikramaṇīyaś ceti matvā te kuṇḍale avamucyāsmai prāyacchat

vulgate_text: sa evamuktvā tāṃ kṣatriyāmāmantrya pauṣyasakāśamāgacchat / āha cainaṃ bhoḥ pauṣya prīto'smīti tamuttaṅkaṃ pauṣyaḥ pratyuvāca
ce_text: sa evam uktvā tāṃ kṣatriyām āmantrya pauṣyasakāśam āgacchat

vulgate_text: bhagavaṃścireṇa pātramāsādyate bhavāśca guṇavānatithistadicche śrāddhaṃ kartuṃ kriyatāṃ kṣaṇa iti
ce_text: taṃ pauṣyaḥ pratyuvāca / bhagavaṃś cirasya pātram āsādyate / bhavāṃś ca guṇavān atithiḥ / tat kariṣye śrāddham / kṣaṇaḥ kriyatām iti

vulgate_text: na yuktaṃ bhavatā'nnamaśuci dattvā pratiśāpaṃ dātuṃ tasmādannameva pratyakṣīkuru / tataḥ pauṣyastadannamaśuci dṛṣṭvā tasyāśucibhāvamaparokṣayāmāsa
ce_text: so 'tha pauṣyas tasyāśucibhāvam annasyāgamayām āsa

vulgate_text: tasya takṣako dṛḍhamāsannaḥ sataṃ jagrāha / gṛhītamātraḥ sa tadrūpaṃ vihāya takṣakasvarūpaṃ kṛtvā sahasā dharaṇyāṃ vivṛtaṃ mahābilaṃ praviveśa
ce_text: etasminn antare sa śramaṇas tvaramāṇa upasṛtya te kuṇḍale gṛhītvā prādravat / tam uttaṅko 'bhisṛtya jagrāha / sa tad rūpaṃ vihāya takṣakarūpaṃ kṛtvā sahasā dharaṇyāṃ vivṛtaṃ mahābilaṃ viveśa

vulgate_text: praviśya ca nāgalokaṃ svabhavanamagacchat / athottaṅkastasyāḥ kṣatriyāyā vacaḥ smṛtvā taṃ takṣakamanvagacchat
ce_text: praviśya ca nāgalokaṃ svabhavanam agacchat / tam uttaṅko 'nvāviveśa tenaiva bilena / praviśya ca nāgān astuvad ebhiḥ ślokaiḥ

vulgate_text: tamuttaṅko'nuviveśa tenaiva bilena praviśya ca taṃ nāgalokamaparyantamanekavidhaprāsādaharmyavalabhīniryūhaśatasaṃkulamuccāvacakrīḍāścaryasthānāvakīrṇamapaśyat
ce_text: praviśya ca nāgalokaṃ svabhavanam agacchat / tam uttaṅko 'nvāviveśa tenaiva bilena / praviśya ca nāgān astuvad ebhiḥ ślokaiḥ

vulgate_text: sa tatra nāgāṃstānastuvadebhiḥ ślokaiḥ ya airāvatarājānaḥ sarpāḥ samitiśobhāḥ / kṣaranta iva jīmūtāḥ savidyutpavaneritāḥ
ce_text: ya airāvatarājānaḥ sarpāḥ samitiśobhanāḥ / varṣanta iva jīmūtāḥ savidyutpavaneritāḥ

vulgate_text: bahūni nāgaveśmāni gaṅgāyāstīra uttare / tatrasthānapi saṃstaumi mahataḥ pannagānaham
ce_text: bahūni nāgavartmāni gaṅgāyās tīra uttare / icchet ko 'rkāṃśusenāyāṃ cartum airāvataṃ vinā

vulgate_text: evaṃ stuvannapi nāgānyadā te kuṇḍale nālabhattadā'paśyatstriyau tantre adhiropya suveme paṭaṃ vayantyau / tasmiṃstantre kṛṣṇāḥ sitāśca tantavaścakraṃ cāpaśyaddvādaśāraṃ ṣaḍbhiḥ kumāraiḥ parivartyamānaṃ puruṣaṃ cāpaśyadaśvaṃ ca darśanīyam
ce_text: tasmiṃś ca tantre kṛṣṇāḥ sitāś ca tantavaḥ / cakraṃ cāpaśyat ṣaḍbhiḥ kumāraiḥ parivartyamānam / puruṣaṃ cāpaśyad darśanīyam

vulgate_text: tābhirnāgaloka upadhūpite'tha saṃbhrāntastakṣako'gnestejobhayādviṣaṇṇaḥ kuṇḍale gṛhītvā sahasā bhavanānniṣkramyottaṅkamuvāca
ce_text: atha sasaṃbhramas takṣako 'gnitejobhayaviṣaṇṇas te kuṇḍale gṛhītvā sahasā svabhavanān niṣkramyottaṅkam uvāca / ete kuṇḍale pratigṛhṇātu bhavān iti

vulgate_text: adya tatpuṇyakamupādhyāyānyā dūraṃ cāhamabhyāgataḥ sa kathaṃ saṃbhāvayeyamiti
ce_text: sa te pratijagrāhottaṅkaḥ / kuṇḍale pratigṛhyācintayat / adya tat puṇyakam upādhyāyinyāḥ / dūraṃ cāham abhyāgataḥ / kathaṃ nu khalu saṃbhāvayeyam iti

vulgate_text: athaitasminnantare sa uttaṅkaḥ praviśya upādhyāyakulaṃ upādhyāyānīmabhyavādayatte cāsyai kuṇḍale prāyacchatsā cainaṃ pratyuvāca
ce_text: athottaṅkaḥ praviśya upādhyāyinīm abhyavādayat / te cāsyai kuṇḍale prāyacchat

vulgate_text: uttaṅka deśe kāle'bhyāgataḥ svāgataṃ te vatsa idānīṃ yadyanāgatosi kopitayā mayā śapto bhaviṣyasi śreyastavopasthitaṃ siddhimāpnuhīti
ce_text: sā cainaṃ pratyuvāca / uttaṅka deśe kāle 'bhyāgataḥ / svāgataṃ te vatsa / manāg asi mayā na śaptaḥ / śreyas tavopasthitam / siddhim āpnuhīti

vulgate_text: tatastasya vacanānmayā tadṛṣabhasya purīṣamupayuktaṃ sa cāpi kaḥ tadetadbhavatopadiṣṭamiccheyaṃ śrotuṃ kiṃ taditi / sa tenaivamukta upādhyāyaḥ pratyuvāca
ce_text: tenaivam ukta upādhyāyaḥ pratyuvāca / vatsottaṅka uṣyatāṃ tāvad iti

vulgate_text: yaścainamadhirūḍhaḥ puruṣaḥ sa cendraḥ yadapi te bhakṣitaṃ tasya ṛṣabhasya purīṣaṃ tadamṛtaṃ tena khalvasi tasminnāgabhavane na vyāpannastvam
ce_text: ya ṛṣabhas tvayā pathi gacchatā dṛṣṭaḥ sa airāvato nāgarājaḥ / yaś cainam adhirūḍhaḥ sa indraḥ / yad api te purīṣaṃ bhakṣitaṃ tasya ṛṣabhasya tad amṛtam

vulgate_text: sa hi bhagavānindro mama sakhā tvadanukrośādimamanugrahaṃ kṛtavān / tasmātkuṇḍale gṛhītvā punarāgato'si
ce_text: tadanugrahāt kuṇḍale gṛhītvā punar abhyāgato 'si / tat saumya gamyatām / anujāne bhavantam / śreyo 'vāpsyasīti

vulgate_text: tatsaumya gamyatāmanujāne bhavantaṃ śreyo'vāpsyasīti / sa upādhyāyenānujñāto bhagavānuttaṅkaḥ kruddhastakṣakaṃ praticikīrṣamāṇo hāstinapuraṃ pratasthe
ce_text: sa upādhyāyenānujñāta uttaṅkaḥ kruddhas takṣakasya praticikīrṣamāṇo hāstinapuraṃ pratasthe

vulgate_text: anyasminkaraṇīye tu kārye pārthivasattama / arcayitvā yathānyāyaṃ pratyuvāca dvijottamam / sautiruvāca
ce_text: anyasmin karaṇīye tvaṃ kārye pārthivasattama / bālyād ivānyad eva tvaṃ kuruṣe nṛpasattama

vulgate_text: evamuktastu vipreṇa sa rājā janamejayaḥ / arcayitvā yathānyāyaṃ pratyuvāca dvijottamam / janamejaya uvāca
ce_text: sūta uvāca / janamejayaḥ pārikṣitaḥ saha bhrātṛbhiḥ kurukṣetre dīrghasatram upāste / tasya bhrātaras trayaḥ śrutasena ugraseno bhīmasena iti

vulgate_text: āsāṃ prajānāṃ paripālanena svaṃ kṣatradharmaṃ paripālayāmi / pravrūhi me kiṃ karaṇīyamadya yenāsi kāryeṇa samāgatastvam / sautiruvāca
ce_text: āsāṃ prajānāṃ paripālanena; svaṃ kṣatradharmaṃ paripālayāmi / prabrūhi vā kiṃ kriyatāṃ dvijendra; śuśrūṣur asmy adya vacas tvadīyam

vulgate_text: paurāṇikaḥ purāṇe kṛtaśramaḥ sa kṛtāñjalistānuvāca mayottaṅkasya caritamaśeṣamuktaṃ janamejayasya sārpasatre nimittāntaramidamapi / kiṃ bhavantaḥ śrotumicchanti kimahaṃ bravāṇīti / tamṛṣaya ūcuḥ
ce_text: paurāṇikaḥ purāṇe kṛtaśramaḥ sa tān kṛtāñjalir uvāca / kiṃ bhavantaḥ śrotum icchanti / kim ahaṃ bruvāṇīti

vulgate_text: nigadāmi yathāyuktaṃ purāṇāśrayasaṃyutam / bhṛgurmaharṣirbhagavānbrahmaṇā vai svayaṃbhuvā
ce_text: imaṃ vaṃśam ahaṃ brahman bhārgavaṃ te mahāmune / nigadāmi kathāyuktaṃ purāṇāśrayasaṃyutam / bhṛgor babhūvuḥ ṣaṭ putrās tapasā bhāvitātmanaḥ / kaviś ca cyavanaś caiva śaṅkhalaś ca mahātapāḥ / suraśmiḥ saptaraśmiś ca vitathaś ca mahātapāḥ / vītahavyasya tanayaḥ smṛto gṛtsamadaḥ prabhuḥ / gṛtsasyāpi sutas tv asya brahman sāvedaso 'bhavat / sāvedasya tu putro 'bhūd ūrvaḥ śrutavatāṃ varaḥ / ūrvasya tu vihavyo 'bhūd brahmasūnur mahātmanaḥ / vihavyasya tu dāyādo viharaḥ kīrtimān smṛtaḥ / viharasyātmavān putro vatsaś cādhirathaḥ smṛtaḥ / vatsasyāpi vinindas tu sūnur āsīn mahātapāḥ / bhṛgor vinindasya sutaḥ sadyo nāma babhūva ha / sadyasyāpy ātmajo brahman vitto nāma suvīryavān / vittasya tu mahātejā babhūva ca śrutaśravāḥ / śrutaśravasas tu sūnur babhūva tapavān prabho / tapasas tu mahātejāḥ prakāśas tanayo 'bhavat / ūrdhvaḥ prakāśasya suto brahmarṣir brahmavittamaḥ / brahmasṛṣṭo mato yena yena pūrvaṃ mahātmanā / ūrdhvasya caiva vāgindro vāgindro brahmavādinaḥ / ṛcīkas tasya tanayo brahmasūnur mahātapāḥ / jamadagniḥ sutas tasya jajñe janakasaṃnibhaḥ / jamadagnes tu vai pañca āsan putrā mahātmanaḥ / rumaṇvāṃś ca suṣeṇaś ca vasur viśvāvasus tathā / rāmas tasya jaghanyo 'bhūn mahāstro reṇukāsutaḥ / triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ pṛthivī yena niḥkṣatriyā kṛtā

vulgate_text: varuṇasya kratau jātaḥ pāvakāditi naḥ śrutam / bhṛgoḥ sudayitaḥ putraścyavano nāma bhārgavaḥ
ce_text: bhṛgoḥ sudayitaḥ putraś cyavano nāma bhārgavaḥ / cyavanasyāpi dāyādaḥ pramatir nāma dhārmikaḥ / pramater apy abhūt putro ghṛtācyāṃ rurur ity uta

vulgate_text: idamantaramityevaṃ hartuṃ cakre manastadā / athāgniśaraṇe'paśyajjvalantaṃ jātavedasam
ce_text: athāgniśaraṇe 'paśyaj jvalitaṃ jātavedasam / tam apṛcchat tato rakṣaḥ pāvakaṃ jvalitaṃ tadā

vulgate_text: mukhaṃ tvamasi devānāṃ vada pāvaka pṛcchate / mayā hīyaṃ vṛtā pūrvaṃ bhāryārthe varavarṇinī
ce_text: mayā hīyaṃ pūrvavṛtā bhāryārthe varavarṇinī / paścāt tv imāṃ pitā prādād bhṛgave 'nṛtakāriṇe

vulgate_text: matpūrvabhāryāṃ yadimāṃ bhṛgurāpa sumadhyamām / asaṃmatamidaṃ me'dya hariṣyāmyāśramādimām / sautiruvāca
ce_text: manyur hi hṛdayaṃ me 'dya pradahann iva tiṣṭhati / matpurvabhāryāṃ yad imāṃ bhṛguḥ prāpa sumadhyamām

vulgate_text: tasyaitadvacanaṃ śrutvā saptārcirduḥkhito'bhavat / satyaṃ vadāmi yadi me śāpaḥ syādbrahmavittamāt
ce_text: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā saptārcir duḥkhito bhṛśam / bhīto 'nṛtāc ca śāpāc ca bhṛgor ity abravīc chanaiḥ

vulgate_text: asatyaṃ cedahaṃ brūyāṃ patiṣye narakāndhruvam bhīto'nṛtācca śāpācca bhṛgorityabravīcchanaiḥ
ce_text: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā saptārcir duḥkhito bhṛśam / bhīto 'nṛtāc ca śāpāc ca bhṛgor ity abravīc chanaiḥ

vulgate_text: devatāḥ pitaraścaiva bhuñjate mayi yadbhutam / devatānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca mukhametadahaṃ smṛtam
ce_text: devatāḥ pitaraś caiva juhvate mayi yat sadā / tridaśānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca mukham evam ahaṃ smṛtaḥ

vulgate_text: sarvabhakṣaḥ kathaṃ tveṣāṃ bhaviṣyāmi mukhaṃ tvaham / sautiruvāca / cintayitvā tato vahniścake saṃhāramātmanaḥ
ce_text: amāvāsyāṃ ca pitaraḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ ca devatāḥ / manmukhenaiva hūyante bhuñjate ca hutaṃ haviḥ / sarvabhakṣaḥ kathaṃ teṣāṃ bhaviṣyāmi mukhaṃ tv aham

vulgate_text: hutabhuksarvalokeṣu sarvabhakṣatvameṣyati / sautiruvāca / śrutvā tu tadvacasteṣāmagnimāhūya viśvakṛt
ce_text: bhṛguṇā vai mahābhāga śapto 'gniḥ kāraṇāntare / kathaṃ devamukho bhūtvā yajñabhāgāgrabhuk tathā / hutabhuk sarvalokeṣu sarvabhakṣatvam eṣyati

vulgate_text: kravyādā ca tanuryā te sā sarvaṃ bhakṣayiṣyati / yathā sūryāṃśubhiḥ spṛṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ śuci vibhāvyate
ce_text: yathā sūryāṃśubhiḥ spṛṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ śuci vibhāvyate / tathā tvadarcirnirdagdhaṃ sarvaṃ śuci bhaviṣyati

vulgate_text: evaṃ sa bhagavāñchāpaṃ lebhe'gnirbhṛgutaḥ purā evameṣa purā vṛtta hatihāso'gniśāpajaḥ / pulomnaśca vināśo'yaṃ cyavanasya ca saṃbhavaḥ
ce_text: evam eṣa purāvṛtta itihāso 'gniśāpajaḥ / pulomasya vināśaś ca cyavanasya ca saṃbhavaḥ

vulgate_text: utsṛjya caiva taṃ garbhaṃ nadyāstīre jagāma sā / apsarā menakā brahmannirdayā nirapatrapā
ce_text: utsṛjya caiva taṃ garbhaṃ nadyās tīre jagāma ha / kanyām amaragarbhābhāṃ jvalantīm iva ca śriyā

vulgate_text: nirānandakarī teṣāṃ bandhūnāṃ muktamūrdhajā / vyasuraprekṣaṇīyā sā prekṣaṇīyatamā'bhavat
ce_text: sā daṣṭā sahasā bhūmau patitā gatacetanā / vyasur aprekṣaṇīyāpi prekṣaṇīyatamākṛtiḥ

vulgate_text: uddālakaḥ kaṭhaścaiva śvetaścaiva mahāyaśāḥ / bharadvājaḥ kauṇakṛtsya ārṣṭiṣeṇo'tha gautamaḥ
ce_text: bhāradvājaḥ kauṇakutsa ārṣṭiṣeṇo 'tha gautamaḥ / pramatiḥ saha putreṇa tathānye vanavāsinaḥ

vulgate_text: ruruduḥ kṛpayā'viṣṭā rurustvārto bahiryayau / te ca sarve dvijaśreṣṭhāstatraivopāviśaṃstadā
ce_text: tāṃ te kanyāṃ vyasuṃ dṛṣṭvā bhujagasya viṣārditām / ruruduḥ kṛpayāviṣṭā rurus tv ārto bahir yayau

vulgate_text: śete sā bhuvi tanvaṅgī mama śokavivardhinī / prāṇānapaharantīva pūrṇacandranibhānanā
ce_text: śete sā bhuvi tanvaṅgī mama śokavivardhinī / bāndhavānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ kiṃ nu duḥkham ataḥ param

vulgate_text: pitṛmātṛsakhīnāṃ ca luptapiṇḍasya tasya me bāndhavānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ kiṃ nu duḥkhamataḥparam
ce_text: śete sā bhuvi tanvaṅgī mama śokavivardhinī / bāndhavānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ kiṃ nu duḥkham ataḥ param

vulgate_text: idaṃ covāca vacanaṃ rurumapratimaujasam / ahiṃsā paramo dharmaḥ sarvaprāṇabhṛtāṃ vara
ce_text: ahiṃsā paramo dharmaḥ sarvaprāṇabhṛtāṃ smṛtaḥ / tasmāt prāṇabhṛtaḥ sarvān na hiṃsyād brāhmaṇaḥ kva cit

vulgate_text: balaṃ paramamāsthāya paryadhāvatsamantataḥ / tamṛṣiṃ naṣṭamanvicchansaṃśrānto nyapatadbhuvi
ce_text: sūta uvāca / ruruś cāpi vanaṃ sarvaṃ paryadhāvat samantataḥ / tam ṛṣiṃ draṣṭum anvicchan saṃśrānto nyapatad bhuvi

vulgate_text: labdhasaṃjño ruruścāyāttadācakhyau pitustadā / pitre tu sarvamākhyāya ḍuṇḍubhasya vaco'rthavat

vulgate_text: tamevaṃ vādinaṃ śeṣaṃ pitāmaha uvāca ha / jānāmi śeṣa sarveṣāṃ bhrātṝṇāṃ te viceṣṭitam
ce_text: brahmovāca / jānāmi śeṣa sarveṣāṃ bhrātṝṇāṃ te viceṣṭitam / mātuś cāpy aparādhād vai bhrātṝṇāṃ te mahad bhayam

vulgate_text: dāsyāmi hi varaṃ te'dya prītirme paramā tvayi diṣṭyā buddhiśca te dharme niviṣṭā pannagottama / bhūyo bhūyaśca te buddhirdharme bhavatu susthirā / śeṣa uvāca
ce_text: śeṣa uvāca / sodaryā mama sarve hi bhrātaro mandacetasaḥ / saha tair notsahe vastuṃ tad bhavān anumanyatām

vulgate_text: nūnaṃ sarvavināśo'yamasmākaṃ samupāgataḥ śāpaḥ sṛṣṭo mahāghoro mātrā khalvavinītayā / na hyetāṃ so'vyayo devaḥ śapatnīṃ pratyaṣedhayat
ce_text: nūnaṃ sarvavināśo 'yam asmākaṃ samudāhṛtaḥ / na hy enāṃ so 'vyayo devaḥ śapantīṃ pratyaṣedhayat

vulgate_text: sarva eva hi nastāvadbuddhimanto vicakṣaṇāḥ / api mantrayamāṇā hi hetuṃ paśyāma mokṣaṇe
ce_text: api mantrayamāṇā hi hetuṃ paśyāma mokṣaṇe / yathā naṣṭaṃ purā devā gūḍham agniṃ guhāgatam

vulgate_text: yathā naṣṭaṃ purā devā gūḍhamagniṃ guhāgatam yathā sa yajño na bhavedyathā vā'pi parābhavaḥ / janamejayasya sarpāṇāṃ vināśakaraṇāya vai / sautiruvāca
ce_text: yathā sa yajño na bhaved yathā vāpi parābhavet / janamejayasya sarpāṇāṃ vināśakaraṇāya hi

vulgate_text: apare tvabruvannāgā dharmātmāno dayālavaḥ / abuddhireṣā bhavatāṃ brahmahatyā na śobhanam
ce_text: tatrāpare 'mantrayanta dharmātmāno bhujaṃgamāḥ / abuddhir eṣā yuṣmākaṃ brahmahatyā na śobhanā

vulgate_text: eṣā no naiṣṭhikī buddhiḥ sarveṣāmīkṣaṇaśravaḥ / atha yanmanyase rājandrutaṃ tatsaṃvidhīyatām
ce_text: eṣā vai naiṣṭhikī buddhiḥ sarveṣām eva saṃmatā / yathā vā manyase rājaṃs tat kṣipraṃ saṃvidhīyatām

vulgate_text: kiṃ tatra saṃvidhātavyaṃ bhavatāṃ syāddhitaṃ tu yat / śreyaḥ prasādanaṃ manye kaśyapaśya mahātmanaḥ
ce_text: kiṃ tv atra saṃvidhātavyaṃ bhavatāṃ yad bhaved dhitam / anenāhaṃ bhṛśaṃ tapye guṇadoṣau madāśrayau

vulgate_text: tasyāṃ janayitā putraṃ vedavedāṅgapāragam sanāmāyāṃ sanāmā sa kanyāyāṃ dvijasattamaḥ / elāpatra uvāca
ce_text: elāpatra uvāca / evam astv iti taṃ devāḥ pitāmaham athābruvan / uktvā caivaṃ gatā devāḥ sa ca devaḥ pitāmahaḥ

vulgate_text: evamastviti taṃ devāḥ pitāmahamathābruvan / utkvaivaṃ vacanaṃ devānviriñcistridivaṃ yayau
ce_text: elāpatra uvāca / evam astv iti taṃ devāḥ pitāmaham athābruvan / uktvā caivaṃ gatā devāḥ sa ca devaḥ pitāmahaḥ

vulgate_text: etacchrutvā tu nāgendraḥ pitāmahavacastadā / saṃdiśya pannagānsarvānvāsukiḥ śāpamohitaḥ
ce_text: sūta uvāca / etac chrutvā sa nāgendraḥ pitāmahavacas tadā / sarpān bahūñ jaratkārau nityayuktān samādadhat

vulgate_text: svasāramudyamya tadā jaratkārumṛṣiṃ prati / sarpānbahūñjaratkārau nityayuktānsamādadhat
ce_text: sūta uvāca / etac chrutvā sa nāgendraḥ pitāmahavacas tadā / sarpān bahūñ jaratkārau nityayuktān samādadhat

vulgate_text: parikṣito narendrasya viddho yannaṣṭavānmṛgaḥ / dūraṃ cāpahṛtastena mṛgeṇa sa mahīpatiḥ
ce_text: dūraṃ cāpahṛtas tena mṛgeṇa sa mahīpatiḥ / pariśrāntaḥ pipāsārta āsasāda muniṃ vane

vulgate_text: saṃrambhātkopano'tīva viṣakalpo muneḥ sutaḥ uddiśya pitaraṃ tasya yacchrutvā roṣamāharat / ṛṣiputreṇa narmārthe kṛśena dvijasattama / kṛśa uvāca
ce_text: sakhyoktaḥ krīḍamānena sa tatra hasatā kila / saṃrambhī kopano 'tīva viṣakalpa ṛṣeḥ sutaḥ / ṛṣiputreṇa narmārthaṃ kṛśena dvijasattama

vulgate_text: sa ta kṛśamakṣiprekṣya sūnṛtāṃ vācamutsṛjan / apṛcchattaṃ kathaṃ tātaḥ sarvabhūtahite rataḥ
ce_text: sa taṃ kṛśam abhipreṣkya sūnṛtāṃ vācam utsṛjan / apṛcchata kathaṃ tātaḥ sa me 'dya mṛtadhārakaḥ

vulgate_text: ananyacetāḥ satataṃ viṣṇuṃ davematoṣayat vanyānnabhojī satataṃ munirmaunavrate sthitaḥ / evaṃbhūtaḥ sa tejasvī sa me'dya mṛtadhārakaḥ / kṛśa uvāca
ce_text: kṛśa uvāca / rājñā parikṣitā tāta mṛgayāṃ paridhāvatā / avasaktaḥ pitus te 'dya mṛtaḥ skandhe bhujaṃgamaḥ

vulgate_text: śrutvaivamṛṣiputrastu śavaṃ skandhe pratiṣṭhitam / kopasaṃraktanayanaḥ prajvalanniva manyunā
ce_text: sūta uvāca / śrutvaivam ṛṣiputras tu divaṃ stabdhveva viṣṭhitaḥ / kopasaṃraktanayanaḥ prajvalann iva manyunā

vulgate_text: vaivasvatasya sadanaṃ netā paramadāruṇam / sautiruvāca / tamabravītpitā brahmaṃstathā kopasamanvitam / śamīka uvāca
ce_text: saptame 'hani taṃ pāpaṃ takṣakaḥ pannagottamaḥ / vaivasvatasya bhavanaṃ netā paramadāruṇam

vulgate_text: teneha kṣudhitenaitya śrāntena mṛgalipsunā / ajānatā kṛtaṃ manye vratametadidaṃ mama
ce_text: teneha kṣudhitenādya śrāntena ca tapasvinā / ajānatā vratam idaṃ kṛtam etad asaṃśayam

vulgate_text: vijñātaviṣavidyo'haṃ brāhmaṇo lokapūjitaḥ asmadgurukaṭākṣeṇa kalyo'haṃ viṣanāśane / takṣaka uvāca
ce_text: takṣaka uvāca / ahaṃ sa takṣako brahmaṃs taṃ dhakṣyāmi mahīpatim / nivartasva na śaktas tvaṃ mayā daṣṭaṃ cikitsitum

vulgate_text: dhanārthī yāmyahaṃ tatra tanme dehi bhujaṃgama / tato'haṃ vinivartiṣye svāpateyaṃ pragṛhya vai / takṣaka uvāca
ce_text: takṣaka uvāca / ahaṃ sa takṣako brahmaṃs taṃ dhakṣyāmi mahīpatim / nivartasva na śaktas tvaṃ mayā daṣṭaṃ cikitsitum

vulgate_text: yāvaddhanaṃ prārthayase tasmādrājñastato'dhikam / ahameva pradāsyāmi nivartasva dvijottama / sautiruvāca
ce_text: takṣaka uvāca / yāvad dhanaṃ prārthayase tasmād rājñas tato 'dhikam / ahaṃ te 'dya pradāsyāmi nivartasva dvijottama / tad dhanaṃ tasya vo rājā na grahīṣyati kiṃ cana / ime nāgā vahiṣyanti dattaṃ hema mayā bahu

vulgate_text: mantrairviṣaharairdivyai rakṣyamāṇaṃ prayatnataḥ / sautiruvāca / sa cintayāmāsa tadā māyāyogena pārthivaḥ
ce_text: atha śuśrāva gacchan sa takṣako jagatīpatim / mantrāgadair viṣaharai rakṣyamāṇaṃ prayatnataḥ

vulgate_text: phalapatrodakaṃ nāgāḥ pratigrāhayituṃ nṛpam / sautiruvāca / te takṣakasamādiṣṭāstathā cakrurbhujaṅgamāḥ
ce_text: takṣaka uvāca / gacchadhvaṃ yūyam avyagrā rājānaṃ kāryavattayā / phalapatrodakaṃ nāma pratigrāhayituṃ nṛpam

vulgate_text: tato bhakṣayatastasya phalātkṛmirabhūdaṇuḥ / hrasvakaḥ kṛṣṇanayanastāmravarṇo'tha śaunaka
ce_text: tato rājā sasacivaḥ phalāny ādātum aicchata / yad gṛhītaṃ phalaṃ rājñā tatra kṛmir abhūd aṇuḥ / hrasvakaḥ kṛṣṇanayanas tāmro varṇena śaunaka

vulgate_text: tasmātphalādviniṣkramya yattadrājñe niveditam veṣṭayitvā ca bhogena vinadya ca mahāsvanam / adaśatpṛthivīpālaṃ takṣakaḥ pannageśvaraḥ
ce_text: hasann eva ca bhogena takṣakeṇābhiveṣṭitaḥ / tasmāt phalād viniṣkramya yat tad rājñe niveditam

vulgate_text: santānaṃ hi paro dharmaṃ evamāha pitāmahaḥ / lambatāmiha nastāta na jñānaṃ pratibhāti vai
ce_text: lambatām iha nas tāta na jñānaṃ pratibhāti vai / yena tvāṃ nābhijānīmo loke vikhyātapauruṣam

vulgate_text: astitveko'dya nastantuḥ so'pi nāsti yathā tathā / mandabhāgyo'lpabhāgyānāṃ tapa ekaṃ samāsthitaḥ
ce_text: pranaṣṭaṃ nas tapaḥ puṇyaṃ na hi nas tantur asti vai / asti tv eko 'dya nas tantuḥ so 'pi nāsti yathā tathā

vulgate_text: adhaḥ praviṣṭānpaśyāsmānyathā duṣkṛtinastathā / asmāsu patiteṣvatra saha sarvaiḥ sabāndhavaiḥ
ce_text: na hi nas tat tapas tasya tārayiṣyati sattama / chinnamūlān paribhraṣṭān kālopahatacetasaḥ / narakapratiṣṭhān paśyāsmān yathā duṣkṛtinas tathā

vulgate_text: vā brahmaṃstvayā vācyaḥ so'smākaṃ nāthavattayā / bāndhavānāṃ hitasyeha yathā cātmakulaṃ tathā
ce_text: yathā dārān prakuryāt sa putrāṃś cotpādayed yathā / tathā brahmaṃs tvayā vācyaḥ so 'smākaṃ nāthavattayā

vulgate_text: na dārānvai kariṣye'hamiti me bhāvitaṃ manaḥ / evaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu bhavataḥ śakuntāniva lambataḥ
ce_text: evaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu bhavataḥ śakuntān iva lambataḥ / mayā nivartitā buddhir brahmacaryāt pitāmahāḥ

vulgate_text: lokasya caiva sarvasya priya āsīnmahāyaśāḥ / parikṣīṇeṣu kuruṣu sottarāyāmajījanat
ce_text: govindasya priyaś cāsīt pitā te janamejaya / lokasya caiva sarvasya priya āsīn mahāyaśāḥ

vulgate_text: prajā imāstava pitā ṣaṣṭivarṣāṇyapālayat / tato diṣṭāntamāpannaḥ sarveṣāṃ duḥkhamāvahan
ce_text: ṣaḍvargavin mahābuddhir nītidharmavid uttamaḥ / prajā imās tava pitā ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣāṇy apālayat / tato diṣṭāntam āpannaḥ sarpeṇānativartitam

vulgate_text: sa rājā pṛthivīpālaḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / babhūva mṛgayāśīlastava rājanpitā sadā
ce_text: babhūva mṛgayāśīlas tava rājan pitā sadā / yathā pāṇḍur mahābhāgo dhanurdharavaro yudhi / asmāsv āsajya sarvāṇi rājakāryāṇy aśeṣataḥ

vulgate_text: sakhyuḥ sakāśātpitaraṃ pitrā te dharṣitaṃ purā / mṛtaṃ sarpaṃ samāsaktaṃ sthāṇubhūtasya tasya tam
ce_text: brahmāṇaṃ so 'bhyupāgamya muniḥ pūjāṃ cakāra ha / anujñāto gatas tatra śṛṅgī śuśrāva taṃ tadā / sakhyuḥ sakāśāt pitaraṃ pitrā te dharṣitaṃ tathā

vulgate_text: āśīviṣastigmatejā madvākyabalacoditaḥ / saptarātrāditaḥ pāpaṃ paśya me tapaso balam
ce_text: anāgasi gurau yo me mṛtaṃ sarpam avāsṛjat / taṃ nāgas takṣakaḥ kruddhas tejasā sādayiṣyati / saptarātrād itaḥ pāpaṃ paśya me tapaso balam

vulgate_text: sa cāpi muniśārdūlaḥ prerayāmāsa te pituḥ / śiṣyaṃ gauramukhaṃ nāma śīlavantaṃ guṇānvitam
ce_text: sa cāpi muniśārdūlaḥ preṣayām āsa te pituḥ / śapto 'si mama putreṇa yatto bhava mahīpate / takṣakas tvāṃ mahārāja tejasā sādayiṣyati

vulgate_text: ācakhyauṃ sattva viśrānto rājñaḥ sarvamaśeṣataḥ / śapto'si mama putreṇa yatto bhava mahīpate
ce_text: sa cāpi muniśārdūlaḥ preṣayām āsa te pituḥ / śapto 'si mama putreṇa yatto bhava mahīpate / takṣakas tvāṃ mahārāja tejasā sādayiṣyati

vulgate_text: kimarthaṃ taṃ mayā daṣṭaṃ saṃjīvayitumicchasi / ahaṃ ta takṣako brahmanpaśya me vīryamadbhutam
ce_text: takṣaka uvāca / kimarthaṃ taṃ mayā daṣṭaṃ saṃjīvayitum icchasi / brūhi kāmam ahaṃ te 'dya dadmi svaṃ veśma gamyatām

vulgate_text: na śaktastvaṃ mayā daṣṭaṃ taṃ saṃjīvayituṃ nṛpam / mantriṇa ūcuḥ / ityuktvā takṣakastatra so'daśadvai vanaspatim
ce_text: mantriṇa ūcuḥ / tataḥ sa rājā rājendra skandhe tasya bhujaṃgamam / muneḥ kṣutkṣāma āsajya svapuraṃ punar āyayau

vulgate_text: etasminneva kāle tu sa rājā janamejayaḥ / uvāca mantriṇaḥ sarvānidaṃ vākyamaridamaḥ / janamejaya uvāca
ce_text: janamejaya uvāca / jānanti tu bhavantas tad yathāvṛttaḥ pitā mama / āsīd yathā ca nidhanaṃ gataḥ kāle mahāyaśāḥ

vulgate_text: bhaviṣyati hyupāyena yasya dāsyāmi yātanām / ekaṃ tu śrotumicchāmi tadvṛttaṃ nirjane vane
ce_text: janamejaya uvāca / etat tu śrotum icchāmi aṭavyāṃ nirjane vane / saṃvādaṃ pannagendrasya kāśyapasya ca yat tadā

vulgate_text: saṃvādaṃ pannagendrasya kāśyapasya ca kastadā śrutavāndṛṣṭavāṃścāpi bhavatsu kathamāgatam / śrutvā tasya vidhāsye'haṃ pannagāntakarīṃ matim / mantriṇa ūcuḥ
ce_text: mantriṇa ūcuḥ / tataḥ sa rājā rājendra skandhe tasya bhujaṃgamam / muneḥ kṣutkṣāma āsajya svapuraṃ punar āyayau

vulgate_text: na budhyetāmubhau tau ca nagasthaṃ pannagadvijau / saha tenaiva vṛkṣeṇa bhasmībhūto'bhavannṛpa
ce_text: sa tu tenaiva vṛkṣeṇa bhasmībhūto 'bhavat tadā / dvijaprabhāvād rājendra jīvitaḥ savanaspatiḥ

vulgate_text: dvijaprabhāvādrājendra vyajīvatsa vanaspatiḥ / tenāgamya dvijaśreṣṭha puṃsā'smāsu niveditam
ce_text: sa tu tenaiva vṛkṣeṇa bhasmībhūto 'bhavat tadā / dvijaprabhāvād rājendra jīvitaḥ savanaspatiḥ

vulgate_text: yathā vṛttaṃ tu tatsarvaṃ takṣakasya dvijasya ca etatte kathitaṃ rājanyathādṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ ca yat / śrutvā ca nṛpaśārdūla vidhatsva yadanantaram / sautiruvāca
ce_text: etat te kathitaṃ rājan yathāvṛttaṃ yathāśrutam / śrutvā tu nṛpaśārdūla prakuruṣva yathepsitam

vulgate_text: uvāca ca mahīpālo duḥkhaśokasamanvitaḥ / durdharaṃ bāṣpamutsṛjya spṛṣṭvā cāpo yathāvidhi
ce_text: niḥśvāsam uṣṇam asakṛd dīrghaṃ rājīvalocanaḥ / mumocāśrūṇi ca tadā netrābhyāṃ pratataṃ nṛpaḥ / uvāca ca mahīpālo duḥkhaśokasamanvitaḥ

vulgate_text: muhūrtamiva ca dhyātvā niścitya manasā nṛpaḥ / amarṣī mantriṇaḥ sarvānidaṃ vacanamabravīt / janamejaya uvāca
ce_text: janamejaya uvāca / jānanti tu bhavantas tad yathāvṛttaḥ pitā mama / āsīd yathā ca nidhanaṃ gataḥ kāle mahāyaśāḥ

vulgate_text: pratikartavyamityevaṃ yena me hiṃsitaḥ pitā / śṛṅgiṇaṃ hetumātraṃ yaḥ kṛtvā dagdhvā ca pārthivam
ce_text: anantaram ahaṃ manye takṣakāya durātmane / pratikartavyam ity eva yena me hiṃsitaḥ pitā

vulgate_text: yathāvadvedavidvāṃsaḥ sarve buddheḥ paraṃgatāḥ / ṛddhyā paramayā yuktamiṣṭaṃ dvijagaṇairyutam
ce_text: ṛddhyā paramayā yuktam iṣṭaṃ dvijagaṇāyutam / prabhūtadhanadhānyāḍhyam ṛtvigbhiḥ suniveśitam

vulgate_text: bhrātaraṃ cāpi me tasmāttrātumarhasi pāvakāt na moghaṃ tu kṛtaṃ tatsyādyadahaṃ tava dhīmate / pitre dattā vimokṣārthaṃ kathaṃ vā putra manyase / sautiruvāca
ce_text: amoghaṃ naḥ kṛtaṃ tat syād yad ahaṃ tava dhīmate / pitre dattā vimokṣārthaṃ kathaṃ vā putra manyase

vulgate_text: bālo'pi vipro mānya eveha rājñā yaścāvidvānyaśca vidvānyathāvat / prasādayainaṃ tvarito narendra dvijātivaryaṃ sakalārthasiddhaye sarvānkāmāṃstvatta evārhate'dya yathā ca nastakṣaka eti śīghram / sautiruvāca
ce_text: sadasyā ūcuḥ / bālo 'pi vipro mānya eveha rājñāṃ; yaś cāvidvān yaś ca vidvān yathāvat / sarvān kāmāṃs tvatta eṣo 'rhate 'dya; yathā ca nas takṣaka eti śīghram

vulgate_text: etacchrutvā dīkṣitastapyamāna āste hotāraṃ codayankarma kāle / indreṇa sārdhaṃ takṣakaṃ pātayadhvaṃ vibhāvasau na vimucyeta nāgaḥ hotā ca yatto'syājuhāvātha mantrai- ratho mahendraḥ svayamājagāma
ce_text: etac chrutvā dīkṣitas tapyamāna; āste hotāraṃ codayan karmakāle / hotā ca yattaḥ sa juhāva mantrair; atho indraḥ svayam evājagāma

vulgate_text: indre gate tu rājendra takṣako bhayamohitaḥ mantraśaktyā pāvakārcissamīpamavaśo gataḥ / taṃ dṛṣṭvā ṛtvijastatra vacanaṃ cedamabruvan / ṛtvija ūcuḥ
ce_text: ṛtvija ūcuḥ / yathā śāstrāṇi naḥ prāhur yathā śaṃsati pāvakaḥ / indrasya bhavane rājaṃs takṣako bhayapīḍitaḥ

vulgate_text: ete vāsukijā nāgāḥ praviṣṭā havyavāhane anye ca bahavo vipra tathā vai kulasaṃbhavāḥ / pradīptāgnau hutāḥsarve ghorarūpā mahābalāḥ
ce_text: hiraṇyavāhaḥ śaraṇaḥ kakṣakaḥ kāladantakaḥ / ete vāsukijā nāgāḥ praviṣṭā havyavāhanam

vulgate_text: ucchikhaḥ śarabho bhaṅgo bilvatejā virohaṇaḥ / śilī śalakaro mūkaḥ sukumāraḥ pravepanaḥ
ce_text: ucchikhaḥ suraso draṅgo balaheḍo virohaṇaḥ / śilīśalakaro mūkaḥ sukumāraḥ pravepanaḥ

vulgate_text: pūrṇāṅgadaḥ pūrṇamukhaḥ prahāsaḥ śakunirdariḥ / amāhaṭhaḥ kāmaṭhakaḥ suṣeṇo mānaso'vyayaḥ
ce_text: śaṅkukarṇaḥ piṅgalakaḥ kuṭhāramukhamecakau / pūrṇāṅgadaḥ pūrṇamukhaḥ prahasaḥ śakunir hariḥ

vulgate_text: aṣṭāvakraḥ komalakaḥ śvasano maunavepagaḥ bhairavo muṇḍavedāṅgaḥ piśaṅgaścodapārakaḥ / ṛṣabho vegavānnāgaḥ piṇḍārakamahāhanū
ce_text: āmāhaṭhaḥ komaṭhakaḥ śvasano mānavo vaṭaḥ / bhairavo muṇḍavedāṅgaḥ piśaṅgaś codrapāragaḥ

ce_text: eteṣāṃ putrapautrās tu prasavasya ca saṃtatiḥ / na śakyāḥ parisaṃkhyātuṃ ye dīptaṃ pāvakaṃ gatāḥ

vulgate_text: manaḥsāgarasaṃbhūtāṃ maharṣerbhāvitātmanaḥ / kathayasva satāṃ śreṣṭha sarvaratnamayīmimām / sautiruvāca
ce_text: manaḥsāgarasaṃbhūtāṃ maharṣeḥ puṇyakarmaṇaḥ / kathayasva satāṃ śreṣṭha na hi tṛpyāmi sūtaja

ce_text: pitāmahānāṃ sarveṣāṃ daivenāviṣṭacetasām / kārtsnyenaitat samācakṣva bhagavan kuśalo hy asi

vulgate_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / śṛṇu rājanyathā vīrā bhrātaraḥ pañca pāṇḍavāḥ virodhamanvagacchanta dhārtarāṣṭrairdurātmabhiḥ
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / gurave prāṅ namaskṛtya manobuddhisamādhibhiḥ / saṃpūjya ca dvijān sarvāṃs tathānyān viduṣo janān

ce_text: sa vai saṃvatsaraṃ pūrṇaṃ māsaṃ caikaṃ vane 'vasat / tato 'gacchad dhṛṣīkeśaṃ dvāravatyāṃ kadā cana

vulgate_text: rājyaṃ vihatabhūyiṣṭhaṃ pratyapadyanta pāṇḍavāḥ / iṣṭvā kratūṃśca vividhānaśvamedhādikānbahūn
ce_text: tatas te sarvam utsādya hatvā duryodhanaṃ nṛpam / rājyaṃ vidrutabhūyiṣṭhaṃ pratyapadyanta pāṇḍavāḥ

vulgate_text: kathaṃ vyasaninaṃ dyūte pārthau mādrīsutau tadā / anvayuste naravyāghrā bādhyamānā durātmabhiḥ
ce_text: kathaṃ vyatikraman dyūte pārthau mādrīsutau tathā / anuvrajan naravyāghraṃ vañcyamānaṃ durātmabhiḥ

vulgate_text: mucyate sarvapāpebhyo rāhuṇā candramā yathā / jayo nāmetihāso'yaṃ śrotavyo vijigīṣuṇā
ce_text: jayo nāmetihāso 'yaṃ śrotavyo vijigīṣuṇā / mahīṃ vijayate sarvāṃ śatrūṃś cāpi parājayet

vulgate_text: mahiṣīyuvarājābhyāṃ śrotavyaṃ bahuśastathā / vīraṃ janayate putraṃ kanyāṃ vā rājyabhāginīm
ce_text: idaṃ puṃsavanaṃ śreṣṭham idaṃ svastyayanaṃ mahat / mahiṣīyuvarājābhyāṃ śrotavyaṃ bahuśas tathā

vulgate_text: dharme cārthe ca kāme ca mokṣe ca bharatarṣabha yadihāsti tadanyatra yannehāsti na kutracit / idaṃ hi brāhmaṇairloke ākhyātaṃ brāhmaṇeṣviha
ce_text: dharme cārthe ca kāme ca mokṣe ca bharatarṣabha / yad ihāsti tad anyatra yan nehāsti na tat kva cit / dātuṃ bhoktuṃ tathā śrotuṃ prahartum aribhiḥ saha / sa kiṃ jānāti puruṣo bhārataṃ yena na śrutam / ya idaṃ bhārataṃ rājan vācakāya prayacchati / tena sarvā mahī dattā bhavet sāgaramekhalā / parvāṇy aṣṭādaśemāni vyāsena kathitāni vai / yady ekam api yo dadyāt tena sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet

vulgate_text: śrāvayedbrāhmaṇāñśrāddhe yaścemaṃ pādamantataḥ / akṣayyaṃ tasya tacchrāddhamupāvartetpitṝniha

vulgate_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / pūrorvaṃśamahaṃ dhanyaṃ rājñāmamitatejasām / pravakṣyāmi pitṝṇāṃ te teṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛmu
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / hanta te kathayiṣyāmi yan māṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi / pūror vaṃśadharān vīrāñ śakrapratimatejasaḥ

vulgate_text: adityāṃ kaśyapādvivasthān / vivasvato manurmanorilā
ce_text: dakṣasyāditiḥ / aditer vivasvān / vivasvato manuḥ / manor ilā / ilāyāḥ purūravāḥ / purūravasa āyuḥ / āyuṣo nahuṣaḥ / nahuṣasya yayātiḥ

vulgate_text: janamejayastu sunandāṃ nāmopayeme māgadhīṃ / tasyāmasya jajñe prācīnvān
ce_text: janamejayaḥ khalv anantāṃ nāmopayeme mādhavīm / tasyām asya jajñe prācinvān / yaḥ prācīṃ diśaṃ jigāya yāvat sūryodayāt / tatas tasya prācinvatvam

vulgate_text: arihaḥ khalvāṅgīmupeyeme / tasyāmasya jajñe mahābhaumaḥ
ce_text: arācīno 'pi vaidarbhīm evāparām upayeme maryādāṃ nāma / tasyām asya jajñe mahābhaumaḥ

vulgate_text: ṛcastu khalu vāmadevyāmaṅgarājakanyāyāmṛkṣaṃ putramajījanat
ce_text: ṛcaḥ khalv āṅgeyīm upayeme sudevāṃ nāma / tasyāṃ putram ajanayad ṛkṣam

vulgate_text: tatremau ślokau bhavataḥ mātā bhastrā pituḥ putro yasmājjātaḥ sa eva saḥ / bharasva putraṃ dauṣyantiṃ satyamāha śakuntalā
ce_text: mātā bhastrā pituḥ putro yena jātaḥ sa eva saḥ / bharasva putraṃ duḥṣanta māvamaṃsthāḥ śakuntalām

vulgate_text: suhotrastu khalvaikṣvākīmupayeme jayantīṃ nāma tasyāmasya jajñe hastī / ya idaṃ puraṃ nirmāpayāmāsa
ce_text: suhotraḥ khalv ikṣvākukanyām upayeme suvarṇāṃ nāma / tasyām asya jajñe hastī / ya idaṃ hāstinapuraṃ māpayām āsa / etad asya hāstinapuratvam

vulgate_text: pṛthagvaṃśakartāro nṛpatayaḥ / tatra ajamīḍhādṛkṣāyāṃ saṃvaraṇo jajñe sa vaṃśakaraḥ
ce_text: ajamīḍhasya caturviṃśaṃ putraśataṃ babhūva kaikeyyāṃ nāgāyāṃ gāndhāryāṃ vimalāyām ṛkṣāyāṃ ceti / pṛthak pṛthag vaṃśakarā nṛpatayaḥ / tatra vaṃśakaraḥ saṃvaraṇaḥ

vulgate_text: citrāṅgadastu prāptarājya eva gandharveṇa nihṛtaḥ / tato vicitravīryo rājā babhūva
ce_text: tayor aprāptayauvana eva citrāṅgado gandharveṇa hataḥ / vicitravīryas tu rājā samabhavat

vulgate_text: vicitravīryastu khalukāśirājasya sute ambikāmbālike udavahat / vicitravīryo'nutpannāpatya eva videhatvaṃ prāptaḥ
ce_text: vicitravīryas tv anapatya eva videhatvaṃ prāptaḥ

vulgate_text: dhṛtarāṣṭrātputraśataṃ babhūva gāndhāryāṃ varadānāddvaipāyanasya teṣāṃ ca dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ catvāraḥ pradhānāḥ duryodhano duśśāsano vikarṇaścitrasenaśceti
ce_text: teṣāṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putrāṇāṃ catvāraḥ pradhānā babhūvur duryodhano duḥśāsano vikarṇaś citrasena iti

vulgate_text: sa bāṇaviddha uvāca pāṇḍum / atra śloko bhavati

vulgate_text: iti mṛgavratacāriṇā ṛṣiṇā śaptaḥ / sa viṣaṇṇarūpaḥ pāṇḍustaṃ śāpaṃ pariharannopasarpati bhārye
ce_text: sa vivarṇarūpaḥ pāṇḍuḥ śāpaṃ pariharamāṇo nopāsarpata bhārye

vulgate_text: kadācitsa āha svacāpalyādidaṃ prāptavānaham / purāṇeṣu paṭhyamānaṃ śṛṇomi nānapatyasya lokāḥ santīti
ce_text: vākyaṃ covāca / svacāpalyād idaṃ prāptavān aham / śṛṇomi ca nānapatyasya lokā santīti

vulgate_text: sā kuntī putrānutpādayāmāsa dharmādyudhiṣṭhiraṃ mārutādbhīmasenamindrādarjunamiti sa hṛṣṭarūpaḥ pāṇḍuruvāca / iyaṃ te sapatnī bhavati mādryanapatyā vrīḍitā sādhvī asyāmapatyamutpādyatāmiti
ce_text: sa tāṃ hṛṣṭarūpaḥ pāṇḍur uvāca / iyaṃ te sapatnyanapatyā / sādhv asyām apatyam utpādyatām iti

vulgate_text: sā kuntī tasyai mādryai tatheti vratamādideśa / tatastasyāṃ nakulasahadevau yamāvaśvibhyāṃ jajñāte
ce_text: tato mādryām aśvibhyāṃ nakulasahadevāv utpāditau

vulgate_text: tatastena saha citāmanvāruroha mādrī / kuntīṃ covāca yamayorāryayā'pramattayā bhavitavyamiti

vulgate_text: tatra bhīṣmāya dhṛtarāṣṭravidurayoḥ pāṇḍoḥ svargagamanaṃ yāthātathyaṃ nivedayantisma tapasvinaḥ
ce_text: tatas te pañca pāṇḍavāḥ kuntyā sahitā hāstinapuram ānīya tāpasair bhīṣmasya vidurasya ca niveditāḥ

vulgate_text: śaivyasya kanyāṃ devakīṃ nāmopayeme yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / tasyāṃ putraṃ janayāmāsa yaudheyaṃ nāma
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhiras tu govāsanasya śaibyasya devikāṃ nāma kanyāṃ svayaṃvare lebhe / tasyāṃ putraṃ janayām āsa yaudheyaṃ nāma

ce_text: ahaṃpātis tu khalu kṛtavīryaduhitaram upayeme bhānumatīṃ nāma / tasyām asya jajñe sārvabhaumaḥ

vulgate_text: nakulastu khalu caidyāṃ reṇumatīṃ nāmodavahat / tasyāṃ putraṃ janayāmāsa niramitraṃ nāma
ce_text: nakulas tu caidyāṃ kareṇuvatīṃ nāma bhāryām udavahat / tasyāṃ putraṃ niramitraṃ nāmājanayat

vulgate_text: sahadevastu khalu mādrīmeva svayaṃvare vijayāṃ nāmodavahadbhāryām / tasyāṃ putraṃ janayāmāsa suhotraṃ nāma
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhiras tu govāsanasya śaibyasya devikāṃ nāma kanyāṃ svayaṃvare lebhe / tasyāṃ putraṃ janayām āsa yaudheyaṃ nāma

vulgate_text: bhīmasenaśca pūrvameva hiḍimbāyāṃ rākṣasyāṃ putramutpādayāmāsa ghaṭotkacaṃ nāma / arjunastu nāgakanyāyāmulūpyāmirāvantaṃ nāma putraṃ janayāmāsa

vulgate_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / rājoparicaro nāma dharmanityo mahīpatiḥ / babhūva mṛgayāśīlaḥ śaśvatsvādhyāyavāñchuciḥ

vulgate_text: tamāśrame nyastaśastraṃ nivasantaṃ taponidhim / devāḥ śakrapurogā vai rājānamupatasthire
ce_text: tam āśrame nyastaśastraṃ nivasantaṃ taporatim / devaḥ sākṣāt svayaṃ vajrī samupāyān mahīpatim

vulgate_text: evaṃ saṃsāntvya nṛpatiṃ tapasaḥ saṃnyavartayat / prayayau daivataiḥ sārdhaṃ kṛtvā kāryaṃ divaukasām
ce_text: indratvam arho rājāyaṃ tapasety anucintya vai / taṃ sāntvena nṛpaṃ sākṣāt tapasaḥ saṃnyavartayat

vulgate_text: alaṅkṛtāyā piṭakairgandhamālyaiśca bhūṣaṇaiḥ / mālyadāmaparikṣiptāṃ dvātriṃśatkiṣkusaṃmitām
ce_text: aparedyus tathā cāsyāḥ kriyate ucchrayo nṛpaiḥ / alaṃkṛtāyāḥ piṭakair gandhair mālyaiś ca bhūṣaṇaiḥ / mālyadāmaparikṣiptā vidhivat kriyate 'pi ca

vulgate_text: śaṅkhabherīmṛdaṅgaiśca saṃnādaḥ kriyate tadā / bhagavānpūjyate cātra yaṣṭirūpeṇa vāsavaḥ
ce_text: bhagavān pūjyate cātra hāsyarūpeṇa śaṃkaraḥ / svayam eva gṛhītena vasoḥ prītyā mahātmanaḥ

ce_text: bhagavān pūjyate cātra hāsyarūpeṇa śaṃkaraḥ / svayam eva gṛhītena vasoḥ prītyā mahātmanaḥ

ce_text: etāṃ pūjāṃ mahendras tu dṛṣṭvā deva kṛtāṃ śubhām / vasunā rājamukhyena prītimān abravīd vibhuḥ

ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / maharṣeḥ sarvalokeṣu pūjitasya mahātmanaḥ / pravakṣyāmi mataṃ kṛtsnaṃ vyāsasyāmitatejasaḥ

ce_text: tasya retaḥ pracaskanda carato rucire vane / skannamātraṃ ca tad reto vṛkṣapatreṇa bhūmipaḥ

vulgate_text: idaṃ mithyā pariskannaṃ reto me na bhavediti / ṛtuśca tasyāḥ patnyā me na moghaḥ syāditi prabhuḥ

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvaiva sa ca tāṃ dhīmāṃścakame cāruhāsinīm / divyāṃ tāṃ vāsavīṃ kanyāṃ rambhorūṃ munipuṅgavaḥ
ce_text: atīva rūpasaṃpannāṃ siddhānām api kāṅkṣitām / dṛṣṭvaiva ca sa tāṃ dhīmāṃś cakame cārudarśanām / vidvāṃs tāṃ vāsavīṃ kanyāṃ kāryavān munipuṃgavaḥ / saṃbhavaṃ cintayitvā tāṃ jñātvā provāca śaktijaḥ / matsyagandhā / kva karṇadhāro naur yena nīyate brūhi bhāmini / anapatyasya dāśasya sutā tatpriyakāmyayā / sahasrajanasaṃpūrṇā naur mayā vāhyate dvija / parāśaraḥ / śobhanaṃ vāsavi śubhe kiṃ cirāyasi vāhyatām / kalaśaṃ bhavitā bhadre sahasrārdhena saṃmitam / ahaṃ śeṣo bhaviṣyāmi nīyatām acireṇa nauḥ / vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ / matsyagandhā tathety uktvā nāvaṃ vāhayatī jale / matsyagandhā / vīkṣamāṇaṃ muniṃ dṛṣṭvā provācedaṃ vacas tadā / matsyagandheti mām āhur dāśarājasutāṃ janāḥ / parāśaraḥ / janma śokābhitaptāyāḥ kathaṃ jñāsyasi kathyatām / divyajñānena dṛṣṭaṃ hi dṛṣṭamātreṇa te vapuḥ / praṇayagrahaṇārthāya vakṣye vāsavi tac chṛṇu / barhiṣada iti khyātāḥ pitaraḥ somapās tu te / teṣāṃ tvaṃ mānasī kanyā acchodā nāma viśrutā / acchodaṃ nāma tad divyaṃ saro yasmāt samutthitam / tvayā na dṛṣṭapūrvās tu pitaras te kadā cana / saṃbhūtā manasā teṣāṃ pitṝn svān nābhijānatī / sā tv anyaṃ pitaraṃ vavre svān atikramya tān pitṝn / nāmnā vasur iti khyātaṃ manuputraṃ mahīśvaram / adrikāpsarasā yuktaṃ vimāne divi viṣṭhitam / sā tena vyabhicāreṇa manasā kāmacāriṇī / pitaraṃ prārthayitvānyaṃ yogād bhraṣṭā papāta sā / apaśyat patamānā sā vimānatrayam antikāt / trasareṇupramāṇāṃs tāṃs tatrāpaśyat svakān pitṝn / susūkṣmān aparivyaktān aṅgair aṅgeṣv ivāhitān / trāteti tān uvācārtā patantī sā hy adhomukhī / tair uktā sā tu mā bhaiṣīs tena sā saṃsthitā divi / tataḥ prasādayām āsa vulgate_text: jarāsandho dṛḍhasandhaḥ satyasandhaḥ sahasravāk / ugraśravā ugrasenaḥ kṣemamūrtistathaiva ca

vulgate_text: draupadeyāśca ye pañca babhūvurbharatarṣabha / viśvāndevagaṇānviddhi saṃjātānbharatarṣabha
ce_text: draupadeyāś ca ye pañca babhūvur bharatarṣabha / viśvedevagaṇān rājaṃs tān viddhi bharatarṣabha / prativindhyaḥ sutasomaḥ śrutakīrtis tathāparaḥ / nākuliś ca śatānīkaḥ śrutasenaś ca vīryavān / śūro nāma yaduśreṣṭho vasudevapitābhavat / tasya kanyā pṛthā nāma rūpeṇāsadṛśī bhuvi / pituḥ svasrīyaputrāya so 'napatyāya vīryavān / agram agre pratijñāya svasyāpatyasya vai tadā / agrajāteti tāṃ kanyāṃ śūro 'nugrahakāṅkṣayā / adadat kuntibhojāya sa tāṃ duhitaraṃ tadā / sā niyuktā pitur gehe brāhmaṇātithipūjane / ugraṃ paryacarad ghoraṃ brāhmaṇaṃ saṃśitavratam / nigūḍhaniścayaṃ dharme yaṃ taṃ durvāsasaṃ viduḥ / tam ugraṃ śaṃsitātmānaṃ sarvayatnair atoṣayat / tuṣṭo 'bhicārasaṃyuktam ācacakṣe yathāvidhi / uvāca caināṃ bhagavān prīto 'smi subhage tava / yaṃ yaṃ devaṃ tvam etena mantreṇāvāhayiṣyasi / tasya tasya prasādāt tvaṃ devi putrāñ janiṣyasi / evam uktā ca sā bālā tadā kautūhalānvitā / kanyā satī devam arkam ājuhāva yaśasvinī / prakāśakarmā tapanas tasyāṃ garbhaṃ dadhau tadā / ajījanat sutaṃ cāsyāṃ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varam / sakuṇḍalaṃ sakavacaṃ devagarbhaṃ śriyānvitam / divākarasamaṃ dīptyā cārusarvāṅgabhūṣaṇam / nigūhayantī jātaṃ vai bandhupakṣabhayāt tadā / utsasarja jale kuntī taṃ kumāraṃ yaśasvinam / tam utsṛṣṭaṃ jale garbhaṃ rādhābhartā mahāyaśāḥ / rādhāyāḥ kalpayām āsa putraṃ so 'dhirathas tadā / cakratur nāmadheyaṃ ca tasya bālasya tāv ubhau / dampatī vasuṣeṇeti dikṣu sarvāsu viśrutam / sa vardhamāno balavān sarvāstreṣūttamo 'bhavat / ā pṛṣṭhatāpāc ca tadā jajāpa japatāṃ varaḥ / yasmin kāle japann āste dhīmān satyaparākramaḥ / nādeyaṃ brāhmaṇeṣv āsīt tasmin kāle mahātmanaḥ / tam indro brāhmaṇo bhūtvā putrārthe bhūtabhāvanaḥ / yayāce kuṇḍale vīraṃ kavacaṃ ca sahāṅgajam / utkṛtya karṇo hy adadat kuṇḍale kavacaṃ ca tat / śaktiṃ śakro 'dadat tasmai vismitaś cedam abravīt / devāsuramanuṣyāṇāṃ gandharvoragarakṣasām / yasmin kṣepsyasi durdharṣa sa eko na bhaviṣyati / purā nāma tu tasyāsīd vasuṣeṇeti viśrutam / tato vaikartanaḥ karṇaḥ karmaṇā tena so 'bhavat

ce_text: āmuktakavacaḥ karṇo yas tu jajñe mahārathaḥ / divākarasya taṃ viddhi devasyāṃśam anuttamam

ce_text: śriyas tu bhāgaḥ saṃjajñe ratyarthaṃ pṛthivītale / drupadasya kule kanyā vedimadhyād aninditā

ce_text: dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ putrīyam āyuṣyaṃ vijayāvaham / idam aṃśāvataraṇaṃ śrotavyam anasūyatā

ce_text: mārtaṇḍasya manur dhīmān ajāyata sutaḥ prabhuḥ / manor vaṃśo mānavānāṃ tato 'yaṃ prathito 'bhavat / brahmakṣatrādayas tasmān manor jātās tu mānavāḥ

vulgate_text: sādhubhiḥ saṃgatiṃ labdhvā punaḥ svargamupeyivān / janamejaya uvāca / svargataśca punarbrahmannivasandevaveśmani / kālena nātimahatā kathaṃ śakreṇa pātitaḥ
ce_text: janamejaya uvāca / karmaṇā kena sa divaṃ punaḥ prāpto mahīpatiḥ / sarvam etad aśeṣeṇa śrotum icchāmi tattvataḥ / kathyamānaṃ tvayā vipra viprarṣigaṇasaṃnidhau

vulgate_text: antyādhipatayaḥ sarve hyabhavanguruśāsanāt / indra uvāca / tvaṃ hi dharmavido rājankatthase dharmasuttamam / kathayasva punarme'dya lokavṛttāntamuttamam / yayātiruvāca
ce_text: yayātir uvāca / gaṅgāyamunayor madhye kṛtsno 'yaṃ viṣayas tava / madhye pṛthivyās tvaṃ rājā bhrātaro 'ntyādhipās tava

vulgate_text: avādīstvaṃ vayasā yaḥ pravṛddhaḥ sa vai rājannābhyadhikaḥ kathyate ca / yo vidyayā tapasā saṃpravṛddhaḥ sa eva pūjyo bhavati dvijānām / yayātiruvāca
ce_text: yayātir uvāca / nāhaṃ devamanuṣyeṣu na gandharvamaharṣiṣu / ātmanas tapasā tulyaṃ kaṃ cit paśyāmi vāsava

ce_text: aṣṭaka uvāca / avādīś ced vayasā yaḥ sa vṛddha; iti rājan nābhyavadaḥ kathaṃ cit / yo vai vidvān vayasā san sma vṛddhaḥ; sa eva pūjyo bhavati dvijānām

ce_text: duḥṣantaṃ śūrabhīmau ca prapūrvaṃ vasum eva ca / teṣāṃ jyeṣṭho 'bhavad rājā duḥṣanto janamejaya

ce_text: janamejaya uvāca / devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca yakṣāṇām atha rakṣasām / anyeṣāṃ caiva bhūtānāṃ sarveṣāṃ bhagavann aham

bruvantas te sarve maharṣīn idam abruvan / abhivādayantaḥ sahitā maharṣīn devavarcasaḥ / adya naḥ saphalaṃ janma kṛtārthāś ca tato vayam / evaṃ ye sma prapaśyāmo maharṣīn sūryavarcasaḥ / ity uktvā sahitāḥ ke cid anvagacchanta pauravam / haimavatyāḥ sutam iva kumāraṃ puṣkarekṣaṇam / ye ke cid abruvan mūḍhāḥ śākuntaladidṛkṣavaḥ / kṛṣṇājinena saṃchannān draṣṭuṃ necchanti tāpasān / piśācā iva dṛśyante nāgarāṇāṃ virūpiṇaḥ / vinā saṃdhyāṃ piśācās te praviśanti purottamam / kṣutpipāsārditān dīnān valkalājinavāsasaḥ / tvagasthibhūtān nirmāṃsān dhamanīsaṃtatān api / piṅgalākṣān piṅgajaṭān dīrghadantān nirūdarān / viśīrṣakān ūrdhvahastān dṛṣṭvā hāsyanti nāgarāḥ / evam uktavatāṃ teṣāṃ giraṃ śrutvā maharṣayaḥ / anyonyaṃ te samāhūya idaṃ vacanam abruvan / uktaṃ bhagavatā vākyaṃ na kṛtaṃ satyavādinā / purapraveśanaṃ nātra kartavyam iti śāsanam / kiṃ kāraṇaṃ pravekṣyāmo nagaraṃ durjanair vṛtam / tyaktasaṃgasya ca muner nagare kiṃ prayojanam / tasmād gamiṣyāma vayaṃ gaṅgāyāmunasaṃgamam / evam uktvā munigaṇāḥ pratijagmur yathāgatam / gatān munigaṇān dṛṣṭvā putraṃ saṃgṛhya pāṇinā / mātāpitṛbhyāṃ virahād yathā śocanti dārakāḥ / tathā śokaparītāṅgī dhṛtim ālambya duḥkhitā / gateṣu teṣu vipreṣu rājamārgeṇa bhāminī / putreṇaiva sahāyena sā jagāma śanaiḥ śanaiḥ / adṛṣṭapūrvān paśyan vai rājamārgeṇa pauravaḥ / harmyaprāsādacaityāṃś ca sabhā divyā vicitritāḥ / kautūhalasamāviṣṭo dṛṣṭvā vismayam āgataḥ / sarve bruvanti tāṃ dṛṣṭvā padmahīnām iva śriyam / gatena haṃsīsadṛśīṃ kokilena svare samām / mukhena candrasadṛśīṃ śriyā padmālayāsamām / smitena kundasadṛśīṃ padmagarbhasamatvacam / padmapatraviśālākṣīṃ taptajāmbūnadaprabhām / karāntamitamadhyāṃ tāṃ sukeśīṃ saṃhatastanīm / jaghanaṃ suviśālaṃ vai ūrū karikaropamau / raktatuṅganakhau pādau dharaṇyāṃ supratiṣṭhitau / evaṃrūpasamāyuktā svargalokād ihāgatā / iti sma sarve 'manyanta duḥṣantanagare janāḥ / punaḥ punar avocaṃs te śākuntalaguṇān api / siṃhekṣaṇaḥ siṃhadaṃṣṭraḥ siṃhaskandho mahābhujaḥ / siṃhoraskaḥ siṃhabalaḥ siṃhavikrāntagāmy ayam / pṛthvaṃsaḥ pṛthuvakṣāś ca chatrākāraśirā mahān / pāṇipādatale rakto raktāsyo dundubhisvanaḥ / rājalakṣaṇayuktaś ca rājaśrīś cāsya dṛśyate / ākāreṇa ca rūpeṇa śarīreṇāpi tejasā / duḥṣantena samo hy eṣa kasya putro bhaviṣyati / evaṃ bruvantas te sarve praśaśaṃsuḥ sahasraśaḥ / yuktivādān avocanta sarvāḥ prāṇabhṛtaḥ striyaḥ / bāndhavā iva sasnehā anujagmuḥ kiṃ nu vakṣyāmi duḥṣantaṃ mama kāraṇāt / evam uktvā tu kṛpaṇā cintayantī śakuntalā
