vulgate_text: dagdhānevaṃ svake gehe dāhitāḥ pāṇḍavā iti / na garhayeyurasmānvai pāṇḍavārthāya karhicit
ce_text: dagdhān evaṃ svake gehe dagdhā iti tato janāḥ / jñātayo vā vadiṣyanti pāṇḍavārthāya karhi cit

vulgate_text: tatra kecidbruvanti sma brāhmaṇā nirbhayāstadā / dīnāndṛṣṭvā pāṇḍusutānatīva bhṛśaduḥkhitāḥ
ce_text: tatra kec cid bruvanti sma brāhmaṇā nirbhayās tadā / śocamānāḥ pāṇḍuputrān atīva bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: adharmyamidamatyantaṃ kathaṃ bhīṣmo'numanyate / vivāsyamānānasthāne nagare yo'bhimanyate
ce_text: tad rājyaṃ pitṛtaḥ prāptaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭro na mṛṣyate / adharmam akhilaṃ kiṃ nu bhīṣmo 'yam anumanyate / vivāsyamānān asthāne kaunteyān bharatarṣabhān

vulgate_text: evamuktāstadā paurāḥ kṛtvā cāpi pradakṣiṇam / āśīrbhiścābhinandyaitāñjagmurnagarameva hi
ce_text: te tatheti pratijñāya kṛtvā caitān pradakṣiṇam / āśīrbhir abhinandyaināñ jagmur nagaram eva hi

vulgate_text: prājñaḥ prājñaṃ pralāpajñaḥ pralāpajñamidaṃ vacaḥ yo jānāti paraprajñāṃ nītiśāstrānusāriṇīm / vijñāyeha tathā kuryādāpadaṃ nistaredyathā
ce_text: vijñāyedaṃ tathā kuryād āpadaṃ nistared yathā / alohaṃ niśitaṃ śastraṃ śarīraparikartanam / yo vetti na tam āghnanti pratighātavidaṃ dviṣaḥ

vulgate_text: viṣādagneśca boddhavyamiti māṃ viduro'bravīt panthāno veditavyāśca nakṣatraiśca tathā diśaḥ / kuḍyāścaviditāḥkāryāḥsyācchuddhiriticābravīt
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca / viṣād agneś ca boddhavyam iti māṃ viduro 'bravīt / panthāś ca vo nāviditaḥ kaś cit syād iti cābravīt

vulgate_text: tṛṇabalvajakārpāsavaṃśadārukaṭānyapi āgneyānyatra kṣiptāni parito veśmanastathā
ce_text: kṛtaṃ hi vyaktam āgneyam idaṃ veśma paraṃtapa / śaṇasarjarasaṃ vyaktam ānītaṃ gṛhakarmaṇi / muñjabalvajavaṃśādi dravyaṃ sarvaṃ ghṛtokṣitam

vulgate_text: āpadaṃ tena māṃ pārtha sa saṃbodhitavānpurā / te vayaṃ bodhitāstena nityamasmaddhitaiṣiṇā
ce_text: imāṃ tu tāṃ mahābuddhir viduro dṛṣṭavāṃs tadā / āpadaṃ tena māṃ pārtha sa saṃbodhitavān purā

vulgate_text: pitrā kanīyasā snehādbuddhimanto śivaṃ gṛham / anāryaiḥ sukṛtaṃ gūḍhairduryodhanavaśānugaiḥ / bhīmasena uvāca
ce_text: tat tv agāram abhiprekṣya sarvadharmaviśāradaḥ / uvācāgneyam ity evaṃ bhīmasenaṃ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / jighran somya vasāgandhaṃ sarpir jatuvimiśritam

vulgate_text: tadīyaṃ tu bhavedrājyaṃ tadīyāśca janā ime / tasmātsahaiva vatsyāmo galanyastapadā vayam
ce_text: bhīma uvāca / yad idaṃ gṛham āgneyaṃ vihitaṃ manyate bhavān / tatraiva sādhu gacchāmo yatra pūrvoṣitā vayam / darśayitvā pṛthag gantuṃ na kāryaṃ pratibhāti me / aśubhaṃ vā śubhaṃ vāpi tair vasāma sahaiva tu / adya prabhṛti cāsmāsu gateṣu bhayavihvalaḥ / rūḍhamūlo bhaved rājye dhārtarāṣṭro janeśvaraḥ / tadīyaṃ ca bhaved rājyaṃ tadīyāḥ syuḥ prajā imāḥ / tasmāt sahaiva vatsyāmo galanyastapadā vayam / asmākaṃ kālam āsādya rājyam ācchidya śatrutaḥ / ardhaṃ paitṛkam asmākaṃ sukhaṃ bhokṣyāma śāśvatam / dhṛtarāṣṭravaco 'smābhiḥ kimartham anumanyate / tebhyo bhītyānyathā gantuṃ daurbalyaṃ te kuto nṛpa / āpatsu rakṣitāsmākaṃ viduro 'sti mahāmatiḥ / madhyastha eva gāṅgeyo rājyabhogaparāṅmukhaḥ / bāhlikapramukhā vṛddhā madhyasthā eva sarvadā / asmadīyo bhaved droṇaḥ phalgunapremasaṃyutaḥ / tasmāt sahaiva vastavyaṃ na gantavyaṃ pṛthaṅ nṛpa / athavāsmāsu te kuryuḥ kim aśaktāḥ parākramaiḥ / kṣudrāḥ kapaṭino dhūrtā jāgratsu manujeśvara / kiṃ na kuryuḥ purā mahyaṃ kiṃ na dattaṃ purā viṣam / āśīviṣair mahāghoraiḥ sarpais taiḥ kiṃ na daṃśitaḥ / pramāṇakoṭyāṃ saṃnahya nidrāparavaśe mayi / sarpair dṛṣṭiviṣair ghorair gaṅgāyāṃ śūlasaṃtatau / kiṃ tair na pātito bhūpa tadā kiṃ mṛtavāhanam / āpatsu ca sughorāsu duṣprayuktāsu pāpibhiḥ / asmān arakṣad yo devo jagad yasya vaśe sthitam / carācarātmakaṃ so 'dya yātaḥ kva nu nṛpottama / yāvat soḍhavyam asmābhis tāvat soḍhāsmi yatnataḥ / yadā na rakṣyate 'smābhis tadā paśyāma no hitam / kiṃ draṣṭavyaṃ tadāsmābhir vigṛhya tarasā balāt / sāntvavādena dānena bhedenāpi yatāmahe / ardharājyasya saṃprāptyai tato daṇḍaḥ praśasyate / tasmāt sahaiva vastavyaṃ tanmanorpitaśalyavat / darśayitvā pṛthag vāpi na gantavyaṃ subhītavat

vulgate_text: athavāpīha dagdheṣu bhīṣmo'smākaṃ pitāmahaḥ / dharma ityeva kupyeranye cānye kurupuṅgavāḥ
ce_text: api ceha pradagdheṣu bhīṣmo 'smāsu pitāmahaḥ / kopaṃ kuryāt kimarthaṃ vā kauravān kopayeta saḥ / dharma ity eva kupyeta tathānye kurupuṃgavāḥ

vulgate_text: pracchannaṃ vidureṇoktaṃ priyaṃ yanmlecchabhāṣayā / tvayā ca tattathetyuktametadviśvāsakāraṇam
ce_text: kiṃ cic ca vidureṇokto mlecchavācāsi pāṇḍava / tvayā ca tat tathety uktam etad viśvāsakāraṇam

vulgate_text: niṣādī pañcaputrā sā tasminbhojye yadṛcchayā / purābhyāsakṛtasnehā sakhī kuntyāḥ sutaiḥ saha
ce_text: niṣādī pañcaputrā tu tasmin bhojye yadṛcchayā / annārthinī samabhyāgāt saputrā kālacoditā

vulgate_text: ānīya madhumūlāni phalāni vividhāni ca annārthinī samabhyāgātsaputrā kālacoditā / supāpā pañcaputrā ca sā pṛthāyāḥ sakhī matā
ce_text: niṣādī pañcaputrā tu tasmin bhojye yadṛcchayā / annārthinī samabhyāgāt saputrā kālacoditā

vulgate_text: tadupādīpayadbhīmaḥ śete yatra purocanaḥ / tato jatugṛhadvāraṃ dīpayāmāsa pāṇḍavaḥ
ce_text: atha pravāte tumule niśi supte jane vibho / tad upādīpayad bhīmaḥ śete yatra purocanaḥ

vulgate_text: suraṅgāṃ viviśustūrṇaṃ mātrā sārdhamarindamāḥ / tataḥ pratāpaḥ sumahāñchabdaścaiva vibhāvasoḥ
ce_text: tataḥ pratāpaḥ sumahāñ śabdaś caiva vibhāvasoḥ / prādurāsīt tadā tena bubudhe sa janavrajaḥ

vulgate_text: prādurāsīttadā tena bubudhe sa janavrajaḥ / tadavekṣya gṛhaṃ dīptamāhuḥ paurāḥ kṛśānanāḥ
ce_text: tataḥ pratāpaḥ sumahāñ śabdaś caiva vibhāvasoḥ / prādurāsīt tadā tena bubudhe sa janavrajaḥ

vulgate_text: diṣṭyā tvidānīṃ pāpātmādagdhvā dagdhaḥ purocanaḥ / anāgasaḥ suviśvastānyo dadāha narottamān / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / vidurasya suhṛt kaś cit khanakaḥ kuśalaḥ kva cit / vivikte pāṇḍavān rājann idaṃ vacanam abravīt

vulgate_text: sa gatvā tu yathoddeśaṃ pāṇḍavāndadṛśe vane / jananyā saha kauravyānanayajjāhnavītaṭam
ce_text: tarasā pādapān bhañjan mahīṃ padbhyāṃ vidārayan / sa jagāmāśu tejasvī vātaraṃhā vṛkodaraḥ / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / etasminn eva kāle tu yathāsaṃpraty ayaṃ kaviḥ / viduraḥ preṣayām āsa tadvanaṃ puruṣaṃ śucim / sa gatvā tu yathoddeśaṃ pāṇḍavān dadṛśe vane / jananyā saha kauravya māpayānān nadījalam / viditaṃ tan mahābuddher vidurasya mahātmanaḥ / tatas tasyāpi cāreṇa ceṣṭitaṃ pāpacetasaḥ / tataḥ saṃpreṣito vidvān vidureṇa naras tadā / pārthānāṃ darśayām āsa manomārutagāminīm / sarvavātasahāṃ nāvaṃ yantrayuktāṃ patākinīm / śive bhāgīrathītīre narair visrambhibhiḥ kṛtām / tataḥ punar athovāca jñāpakaṃ pūrvacoditam / yudhiṣṭhira nibodhedaṃ saṃjñārthaṃ vacanaṃ kaveḥ / kakṣaghnaḥ śiśiraghnaś ca mahākakṣe bilaukasaḥ / na hantīty evam ātmānaṃ yo rakṣati sa jīvati / tena māṃ preṣitaṃ viddhi viśvastaṃ saṃjñayānayā / bhūyaś caivāha māṃ kṣattā viduraḥ sarvato 'rthavit / karṇaṃ duryodhanaṃ caiva bhrātṛbhiḥ sahitaṃ raṇe / śakuniṃ caiva kaunteya vijetāsi na saṃśayaḥ / iyaṃ vāripathe yuktā naur apsu sukhagāminī / mocayiṣyati vaḥ sarvān asmād deśān na saṃśayaḥ / atha tān vyathitān dṛṣṭvā saha mātrā narottamān / nāvam āropya gaṅgāyāṃ prasthitān abravīt punaḥ / viduro mūrdhny upāghrāya pariṣvajya ca vo muhuḥ / ariṣṭaṃ gacchatāvyagrāḥ panthānam iti cābravīt / ity uktvā sa tu tān vīrān pumān viduracoditaḥ / tārayām āsa rājendra gaṅgāṃ nāvā nararṣabhān / tārayitvā tato gaṅgāṃ pāraṃ prāptāṃś ca sarvaśaḥ / jayāśiṣaḥ prayujyātha yathāgatam agād dhi saḥ / pāṇḍavāś ca mahātmānaḥ pratisaṃdiśya vai kaveḥ / gaṅgām uttīrya vegena jagmur gūḍham alakṣitāḥ

vulgate_text: niṣādastatra kaunteyānabhijñānaṃ nyavedayat / vidurasya mahābuddhermlecchabhāṣādi yattadā / nāvika uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tena vikramatā tūrṇam ūruvegasamīritam / pravavāv anilo rājañ śuciśukrāgame yathā

vulgate_text: pāṇḍavāśca mahātmānaḥ pratisandiśya vai kaveḥ / gaṅgāmuttīrya vegena jagmurgūḍhamalakṣitāḥ
ce_text: pāṇḍavāś cāpi te rājan mātrā saha suduḥkhitāḥ / bilena tena nirgatya jagmur gūḍham alakṣitāḥ

vulgate_text: tataste tatra tīrtvā tu gaṅgāmuttuṅgavīcikām / javena prayayurvīrā dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāsthitāḥ
ce_text: pāṇḍavāś cāpi nirgatya nagarād vāraṇāvatāt / javena prayayū rājan dakṣiṇāṃ diśam āśritāḥ

vulgate_text: śrāntāstataḥ pipāsārtāḥ kṣudhitā bhayakātarāḥ / punarūcurmahāvīryaṃ bhīmasenamidaṃ vacaḥ
ce_text: tataḥ śrāntāḥ pipāsārtā nidrāndhāḥ pāṇḍunandanāḥ / punar ūcur mahāvīryaṃ bhīmasenam idaṃ vacaḥ

vulgate_text: antarhṛṣṭamanāścāsau bahirduḥkhasamanvitaḥ / antaḥśīto bahiścoṣṇo grīṣme'gādhahvadoyathā / dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca
ce_text: cukruśuḥ kauravāḥ sarve bhṛśaṃ śokaparāyaṇāḥ / viduras tv alpaśaś cakre śokaṃ veda paraṃ hi saḥ / vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ / bhīṣmaḥ / vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ / viduraḥ / tataḥ pravyathito bhīṣmaḥ pāṇḍurājasutān mṛtān / mātrā saheti tāñ śrutvā vilalāpa ruroda ca / hā yudhiṣṭhira hā bhīma hā dhanaṃjaya hā yamau / hā pṛthe saha putrais tvam ekarātreṇa svargatā / mātrā saha kumārās te sarve tatraiva saṃsthitāḥ / na hi tau notsaheyātāṃ bhīmasenadhanaṃjayau / tarasā vegitātmānau nirbhettum api mandiram / parāsutvaṃ na paśyāmi pṛthāyāḥ saha pāṇḍavaiḥ / sarvathā vikṛtaṃ tat tu yadi te nidhanaṃ gatāḥ / dharmarājaḥ sa nirdiṣṭo nanu viprair yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / pṛthivyāṃ caratāṃ śreṣṭho bhavitā sa dhanaṃjayaḥ / satyavrato dharmadattaḥ satyavāk śubhalakṣaṇaḥ / kathaṃ kālavaśaṃ prāptaḥ pāṇḍaveyo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / ātmānam upamāṃ kṛtvā pareṣāṃ vartate tu yaḥ / saha mātrā tu kauravyaḥ kathaṃ kālavaśaṃ gataḥ / paripālitaś ciraṃ kālaṃ phalakāle yathā drumaḥ / bhagnaḥ syād vāyuvegena tathā rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / yauvarājyābhiṣiktena pitur yenāhṛtaṃ yaśaḥ / ātmanaś ca pituś caiva satyadharmāryavṛttibhiḥ / sa brahmaṇyaḥ paraprekṣī hṛdi śokaṃ nidhāya me / kālena sa hi saṃbhagno dhik kṛtāntam anarthadam / yac ca sā vanavāsena kleśitā duḥkhabhāginī / putragṛdhnutayā kuntī na bhartāraṃ mṛtā tv anu / alpakālaṃ kule jātā bhartuḥ prītim avāpa yā / dagdhādya saha putraiḥ sā asaṃpūrṇamanorathā / etac ca cintayānasya vulgate_text: tato dvādaśame varṣe sa jajñe puraṣarṣabhaḥ / aśmako nāma rājarṣiḥ paudanyaṃ yo nyaveśayat
ce_text: dvādaśe 'tha tato varṣe sa jajñe manujarṣabha / aśmako nāma rājarṣiḥ potanaṃ yo nyaveśayat

vulgate_text: mā tāta tātatāteti brūhyenaṃ pitaraṃ pituḥ / rakṣasā bhakṣitastāta tava tāto vanāntare
ce_text: mā tāta tāta tāteti na te tāto mahāmuniḥ / rakṣasā bhakṣitas tāta tava tāto vanāntare

vulgate_text: taṃ tathā niścitātmānaṃ sa mahātmā mahātapāḥ / ṛṣirbrahmavidāṃ śraṣṭho maitrāvaruṇirantyadhīḥ
ce_text: taṃ tathā niścitātmānaṃ mahātmānaṃ mahātapāḥ / vasiṣṭho vārayām āsa hetunā yena tac chṛṇu

vulgate_text: ūruṇaikena vābhorūrbhartuḥ kulavivṛddhaye / taṃ garbhamupalabhyāśu brāhmaṇyekā bhayārditā
ce_text: tāsām anyatamā garbhaṃ bhayād dādhāra taijasam / ūruṇaikena vāmorūr bhartuḥ kulavivṛddhaye / dadṛśur brāhmaṇīṃ tāṃ te dīpyamānāṃ svatejasā

vulgate_text: tameva yūyaṃ yācadhvamaurvaṃ mama sutottamam / ayaṃ vaḥ praṇipātena tuṣṭo dṛṣṭīḥ pradāsyati / vasiṣṭha uvāca
ce_text: vasiṣṭha uvāca / kṛtavīrya iti khyāto babhūva nṛpatiḥ kṣitau / yājyo vedavidāṃ loke bhṛgūṇāṃ pārthivarṣabhaḥ

vulgate_text: kiṃ hi vittena naḥ kāryaṃ svargepsūnāṃ dvijottama / yadasmākaṃ dhanādhyakṣaḥ prabhūtaṃ dhanamāharat
ce_text: nikhātaṃ tad dhi vai vittaṃ kena cid bhṛguveśmani / vairāyaiva tadā nyastaṃ kṣatriyān kopayiṣṇubhiḥ / kiṃ hi vittena naḥ kāryaṃ svargepsūnāṃ dvijarṣabha

vulgate_text: śama eva paro dharmastamācara parāśara / adharmiṣṭhaṃ variṣṭhaḥ sankuruṣe tvaṃ parāśara
ce_text: prajocchedam imaṃ mahyaṃ sarvaṃ somapasattama / adharmiṣṭhaṃ variṣṭhaḥ san kuruṣe tvaṃ parāśara / rājā kalmāṣapādaś ca divam āroḍhum icchati

vulgate_text: nimittabhūtastatrāsīdviśvāmitraḥ parāśara / rājā kalmāṣapādaśca divamāruhya modate
ce_text: prajocchedam imaṃ mahyaṃ sarvaṃ somapasattama / adharmiṣṭhaṃ variṣṭhaḥ san kuruṣe tvaṃ parāśara / rājā kalmāṣapādaś ca divam āroḍhum icchati

vulgate_text: gandharva uvāca / punaścaiva mahātejā viśvāmitrajighāṃsayā / agniṃ saṃbhṛtavānghoraṃ śākteyaḥ sumahātapāḥ
ce_text: gandharva uvāca / evam uktaḥ sa viprarṣir vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā / nyayacchad ātmanaḥ kopaṃ sarvalokaparābhavāt

vulgate_text: vāsiṣṭhasaṃbhṛtaścāgnirviśvāmitrahitaiṣiṇā tejasā vahnitulyena grastaḥ skandena dhīmatā / arjuna uvāca
ce_text: arjuna uvāca / rājñā kalmāṣapādena gurau brahmavidāṃ vare / kāraṇaṃ kiṃ puraskṛtya bhāryā vai saṃniyojitā

vulgate_text: adharmiṣṭhaṃ vasiṣṭhena kṛtaṃ cāpi purā sakhe / etanme saṃśayaṃ sarvaṃ chettumarhasi pṛcchataḥ / gandharva uvāca
ce_text: gandharva uvāca / evam uktaḥ sa viprarṣir vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā / nyayacchad ātmanaḥ kopaṃ sarvalokaparābhavāt

vulgate_text: patnīmṛtāvanuprāpya sadyastyakṣyasi jīvitam tena prasādyamānā sā prasādamakarottadā / yasya carṣervasiṣṭhasya tvayā putrā vināśitāḥ
ce_text: tasmāt tvam api durbuddhe macchāpaparivikṣataḥ / patnīm ṛtāv anuprāpya sadyas tyakṣyasi jīvitam

vulgate_text: gṛhṇīṣva cākṣuṣīṃ vidyāmimāṃ bharatasattama / evamukto'rjunaḥ prīto vacanaṃ cedamabravīt
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tato 'rjuno 'stram āgneyaṃ pradadau tad yathāvidhi / gandharvāya tadā prīto vacanaṃ cedam abravīt

vulgate_text: sa hi vedārthatattvajñasteṣāṃ gururudāradhīḥ / vedaviccaiva vāgmī ca dhaumyaḥ śrīmāndvijottamaḥ
ce_text: sa hi vedārthatattvajñas teṣāṃ gurur udāradhīḥ / tena dharmavidā pārthā yājyāḥ sarvavidā kṛtāḥ

vulgate_text: sa cāpi viprastānmene svabhāvābhyadhikānbhuvi / tena dharmavidā pārthā yojyā sarvavidā vṛtāḥ
ce_text: sa hi vedārthatattvajñas teṣāṃ gurur udāradhīḥ / tena dharmavidā pārthā yājyāḥ sarvavidā kṛtāḥ

vulgate_text: menire sahitā vīrāḥ prāptaṃ rājyaṃ ca pāṇḍavāḥ / buddhivīryabalotsāhairyuktā devā ivāpare
ce_text: vīrāṃs tu sa hi tān mene prāptarājyān svadharmataḥ / buddhivīryabalotsāhair yuktān devān ivāparān

vulgate_text: kanyādānāttu śaraṇaṃ so'manyata mahīpatiḥ yajñasenasya kāmastu pāṇḍavāya kirīṭine
ce_text: yajñasenasya kāmas tu pāṇḍavāya kirīṭine / kṛṣṇāṃ dadyām iti sadā na caitad vivṛṇoti saḥ

vulgate_text: upopaviṣṭā mañceṣu draṣṭukāmāḥ svayaṃvaram / brāhmaṇāśca mahābhāgā deśebhyaḥ samupāgaman
ce_text: brāhmaṇāś ca mahābhāgā deśebhyaḥ samupāgaman / te 'bhyarcitā rājagaṇā drupadena mahātmanā

vulgate_text: brāhmaṇaireva sahitāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ samupāviśan / trayastriṃśatsurāḥ sarve vimānairvyomnyavasthitāḥ
ce_text: brāhmaṇais te ca sahitāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ samupāviśan / ṛddhiṃ pāñcālarājasya paśyantas tām anuttamām

vulgate_text: janāpasaraṇe vyagrāḥ pratihāryaḥ purā yayuḥ / kolāhalo mahānāsīttasminpuravare tadā
ce_text: vartamāne samāje tu ramaṇīye 'hni ṣoḍaśe / maitre muhūrte tat tasyā rājadārāḥ purāvidaḥ / putravatyaḥ suvasanāḥ pratikarmopacakramuḥ / svarṇapātraṃ ca kauśeyaṃ dūrvāsiddhyarthasaṃyutam / nidhāya tailaṃ snānārthaṃ ninyur bālā haripriyāḥ / lodhrakalkahṛtābhyaṅgatailaṃ kāleyacandanam / catuṣkābhimukhīṃ ninyur abhiṣekāya yoṣitaḥ / vaiḍūryamaṇipīṭheṣu niviṣṭāṃ draupadīṃ tadā / satūryaṃ snāpayāṃ cakruḥ svarṇakumbhasthitair jalaiḥ / tāṃ nivṛttābhiṣekāṃ ca dukūladvayadhāriṇīm / ninyur maṇistambhayutāṃ vedīṃ vai supariṣkṛtām / niveśya prāṅmukhīṃ hṛṣṭāṃ vismitākṣāḥ prasādhikāḥ / kenānukāraṇenemām ity anyonyaṃ vyalokayan / dhūpoṣmaṇā ca keśānām ārdrabhāvaṃ vyapohayan / babandhur asyā dhammillaṃ mālyaiḥ surabhigandhibhiḥ / dūrvāmadhūkaracitaṃ mālyaṃ tasyā daduḥ kare / cakruś ca kṛṣṇāgaruṇā patrabhaṅgaṃ kucadvaye / reje sā cakravākāṅkā svarṇadīrghasaridvarā / alakaiḥ kuṭilais tasyā mukhaṃ vikasitaṃ babhau / āsaktabhṛṅgaṃ kusumaṃ śaśibimbaṃ jigāya tat / kālāñjanaṃ nayanayor ācārārthaṃ samādadhuḥ / bhūṣaṇai ratnakhacitair alaṃcakrur yathocitam / mātā ca tasyāḥ pṛṣatī haritālamanaḥśilām / aṅgulībhyām upādāya tilakaṃ vidadhe mukhe / alaṃkṛtāṃ vadhūṃ dṛṣṭvā yoṣito mudam āyayuḥ / mātā na mumude tasyāḥ patiḥ kīdṛg bhaviṣyati / sauvidallāḥ samāgamya drupadasyājñayā tataḥ / enām āropayām āsuḥ kariṇīṃ kuthabhūṣitām / tato 'vādyanta vādyāni maṅgalāni divi spṛśan / vilāsinījanaś cāpi pravaraṃ kariṇīśatam / māṅgalyagītaṃ gāyantyaḥ pārśvayor ubhayor yayuḥ / janāpaharaṇe yattāḥ pratihāryaḥ puro yayuḥ / kolāhalo mahān āsīt tasmin puravare tadā / dhṛṣṭadyumno yayāv agre hayam āruhya bhārata / drupado raṅgadeśe tu balena mahatā yutaḥ / tasthau vyūhya mahānīkaṃ pālitaṃ dṛḍhadhanvibhiḥ / tasyāṃ varāṅgyām āyantyāṃ mañcasthā nṛpasattamāḥ / tāṃ dṛṣṭvā manmathāviṣṭā vilāsān vidadhuḥ kila / kaś cid abhrāmayad bhūyaḥ kamalaṃ sumanoharam / lolapatraṃ calad bhṛṅgaṃ pariveṣṭitakesaram / kaś cid vilāsī galitaṃ lagnam aṅgadakoṭibhiḥ / prālambam akarod aṃse sācīkṛtamukhāmbujam / lilekha pīṭhaṃ pādena haimaṃ tiryaṅ mukhatviṣā / ketakīdalam anyo 'pi priyaṃ karṇavibhūṣaṇam / nakhāgraiḥ pāṭayām āsa kuśālekhaviśāradaiḥ / kaś cit kamalaśoṇena nakhena svastipāṇinā / ratnāṅgulīyaprabhayā vidvān akṣān avāsṛjat / yathābhā tasya vimalā svasthānāc calitā tathā / kaś cid vyāpārayām āsa kararatnāṅgulīyakam / bhūyān evaṃvidhāṃs tatra draupadī kamalekṣaṇā / nīlotpalamayaṃ deśaṃ kurvāṇevāvalokayat / āplutāṅgī suvasanā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā

vulgate_text: niḥśabde tu kṛte tasmindhṛṣṭadyumno viśāṃpate / kṛṣṇāmādāya vidhivanmeghadundubhiniḥsvanaḥ
ce_text: niḥśabde tu kṛte tasmin dhṛṣṭadyumno viśāṃ pate / raṅgamadhyagatas tatra meghagambhīrayā girā / vākyam uccair jagādedaṃ ślakṣṇam arthavad uttamam

vulgate_text: idaṃ dhanurlakṣyamime ca bāṇāḥ śṛṇvantu me bhūpatayaḥ sametāḥ / chidreṇa yantrasya masarpayadhvaṃ śaraiḥ śitairvyomacarairdaśārdhaiḥ
ce_text: idaṃ dhanur lakṣyam ime ca bāṇāḥ; śṛṇvantu me pārthivāḥ sarva eva / yantracchidreṇābhyatikramya lakṣyaṃ; samarpayadhvaṃ khagamair daśārdhaiḥ

vulgate_text: sahadevajayatsenau meghasandhiśca pārthivaḥ / virāṭaḥ saha putrābhyāṃ śaṅkhenaivottareṇa ca
ce_text: virāṭaḥ saha putrābhyāṃ śaṅkhenaivottareṇa ca / vārdhakṣemiḥ suvarcāś ca senābinduś ca pārthivaḥ

vulgate_text: bṛhadbalaḥ suṣeṇaśca śibirauśīnastathā / paṭaccaranihantā ca kārūṣādhipatistathā
ce_text: sudakṣiṇaś ca kāmbojo dṛḍhadhanvā ca kauravaḥ / bṛhadbalaḥ suṣeṇaś ca śibir auśīnaras tathā

vulgate_text: śiśupālakhca vikrānto jarāsandhastathaiva ca / ete cānye ca bahavo nānājanapadeśvarāḥ
ce_text: ete cānye ca bahavo nānājanapadeśvarāḥ / tvadartham āgatā bhadre kṣatriyāḥ prathitā bhuvi

vulgate_text: tvadarthamāgatā bhadre kṣatriyāḥ prathitā bhuvi ete bhetsyanti vikrāntāstvadarthe lakṣyamuttamam / vidhyate ya idaṃ lakṣyaṃ varayethāḥ śubhe'dya tam
ce_text: ete vetsyanti vikrāntās tvadarthaṃ lakṣyam uttamam / vidhyeta ya imaṃ lakṣyaṃ varayethāḥ śubhe 'dya tam

vulgate_text: viceṣṭamānā dharaṇītalasthā yathābalaṃ śaikṣyaguṇakramāśca / gataujasaḥ snastakirīṭahārā viniḥśvasantaḥ śamayāṃbabhūvuḥ
ce_text: te vikramantaḥ sphuratā dṛḍhena; niṣkṛṣyamāṇā dhanuṣā narendrāḥ / viceṣṭamānā dharaṇītalasthā; dīnā adṛśyanta vibhagnacittāḥ

vulgate_text: dhanuṣo'bhyāśamāgatya tasthau giririvācalaḥ / dhanurāropyamāṇaṃ tu sarṣamātre'bhyatāḍayat
ce_text: evaṃ teṣāṃ vilapatāṃ viprāṇāṃ vividhā giraḥ / arjuno dhanuṣo 'bhyāśe tasthau girir ivācalaḥ

vulgate_text: siṃhakhelagatiḥ śrīmānmattanāgendravikramaḥ / saṃbhāvyamasminkarmedamutsāhāccānumīyate
ce_text: saṃbhāvyam asmin karmedam utsāhāc cānumīyate / śaktir asya mahotsāhā na hy aśaktaḥ svayaṃ vrajet

vulgate_text: durbalā api viprā hi balīyāṃsaḥ svetajasā / brāhmaṇo nāvamantavyaḥ sadasadvā samācaran
ce_text: abbhakṣā vāyubhakṣāś ca phalāhārā dṛḍhavratāḥ / durbalā hi balīyāṃso viprā hi brahmatejasā

vulgate_text: sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ mahaddhrasvaṃ karma yatsamupāgatam / jāmadagnyena rāmeṇa nirjitāḥ kṣatriyā yudhi
ce_text: brāhmaṇo nāvamantavyaḥ sad vāsad vā samācaran / sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ mahad dhrasvaṃ karma yat samupāgatam

vulgate_text: āropayatu śīghraṃ vai tathetyūcurdvijarṣabhāḥ / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / evaṃ teṣāṃ vilapatāṃ viprāṇāṃ vividhā giraḥ
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / te 'laṃkṛtāḥ kuṇḍalino yuvānaḥ; parasparaṃ spardhamānāḥ sametāḥ / astraṃ balaṃ cātmani manyamānāḥ; sarve samutpetur ahaṃkṛtena

vulgate_text: arjuno dhanuṣo'bhyāśe tasthau giririvācalaḥ / arjunaḥ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭho dhṛṣṭadyumnamathābravīt
ce_text: evaṃ teṣāṃ vilapatāṃ viprāṇāṃ vividhā giraḥ / arjuno dhanuṣo 'bhyāśe tasthau girir ivācalaḥ

vulgate_text: etaddhanurbrāhmaṇānāṃ sajyaṃ kartumalaṃ tu kim / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dhṛṣṭadyumno'bravīdvacaḥ
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / te 'laṃkṛtāḥ kuṇḍalino yuvānaḥ; parasparaṃ spardhamānāḥ sametāḥ / astraṃ balaṃ cātmani manyamānāḥ; sarve samutpetur ahaṃkṛtena

vulgate_text: tasmai pradeyā bhaginī satyamuktaṃ mayā vacaḥ / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / te 'laṃkṛtāḥ kuṇḍalino yuvānaḥ; parasparaṃ spardhamānāḥ sametāḥ / astraṃ balaṃ cātmani manyamānāḥ; sarve samutpetur ahaṃkṛtena

vulgate_text: praṇamya śirasā devamīnaṃ varadaṃ prabhum / kṛṣṇaṃ ca manasā kṛtvā jagṛhe cārjuno dhanuḥ
ce_text: sa tad dhanuḥ parikramya pradakṣiṇam athākarot / praṇamya śirasā hṛṣṭo jagṛhe ca paraṃtapaḥ

vulgate_text: tadarjuno vīryavatāṃ sadarpa- stadaindririndrāvarajaprabhāvaḥ / sajyaṃ ca cakre nimiṣāntareṇa śarāṃśca jagrāha daśārdasaṅkhyān
ce_text: sajyaṃ ca cakre nimiṣāntareṇa; śarāṃś ca jagrāha daśārdhasaṃkhyān / vivyādha lakṣyaṃ nipapāta tac ca; chidreṇa bhūmau sahasātividdham

vulgate_text: viddhaṃ tu lakṣyaṃ prasamīkṣya kṛṣṇā pārthaṃ ca śakrapratimaṃ nirīkṣya / svabhyastarūpāpi naveva nityaṃ vināpi hāsaṃ hasatīva kanyā
ce_text: viddhaṃ tu lakṣyaṃ prasamīkṣya kṛṣṇā; pārthaṃ ca śakrapratimaṃ nirīkṣya / ādāya śuklaṃ varamālyadāma; jagāma kuntīsutam utsmayantī

vulgate_text: madādṛte'pi skhalatīva bhāvai- rvācā vinā vyāharatīva dṛṣṭyā / ādāya śuklaṃ varamālyadāma jagāma kuntīsutamutsmayantī
ce_text: viddhaṃ tu lakṣyaṃ prasamīkṣya kṛṣṇā; pārthaṃ ca śakrapratimaṃ nirīkṣya / ādāya śuklaṃ varamālyadāma; jagāma kuntīsutam utsmayantī

vulgate_text: avaropyeha vṛkṣastu phalakāle nipātyate / nihanmainaṃ durātmānaṃ yoyamasmānna manyate
ce_text: nihanmainaṃ durātmānaṃ yo 'yam asmān na manyate / na hy arhaty eṣa satkāraṃ nāpi vṛddhakramaṃ guṇaiḥ

vulgate_text: tatprekṣya karmātimanuṣyabuddhi- rjiṣṇuḥ sa hi bhrāturacintyakarmā / visiṣmiye cāpi bhayaṃ vihāya tasthau dhanurgṛhya mahendrakarmā
ce_text: tat prekṣya karmātimanuṣyabuddher; jiṣṇoḥ sahabhrātur acintyakarmā / dāmodaro bhrātaram ugravīryaṃ; halāyudhaṃ vākyam idaṃ babhāṣe

vulgate_text: yastveṣa vṛkṣaṃ tarasā'vabhajya rājñāṃ nikāre sahasā pravṛttaḥ / vṛkodarānnānya ihaitadadya kartuṃ samarthaḥ samare pṛthivyām
ce_text: ya eṣa vṛkṣaṃ tarasāvarujya; rājñāṃ vikāre sahasā nivṛttaḥ / vṛkodaro nānya ihaitad adya; kartuṃ samartho bhuvi martyadharmā

vulgate_text: tataḥ karṇamukhāndṛṣṭvā kṣatriyānyuddhadurmadān / saṃpetaturabhītau tau gajau pratigajāniva
ce_text: tataḥ karṇamukhān kruddhān kṣatriyāṃs tān ruṣotthitān / saṃpetatur abhītau tau gajau pratigajān iva

vulgate_text: sthito'smyadya raṇe jetuṃ tvāṃ vai vīra sthiro bhava / nirjito'smīti vā brūhi tato vraja yathāsukham / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tasmai ditsati kanyāṃ tu brāhmaṇāya mahātmane / kopa āsīn mahīpānām ālokyānyonyam antikāt

vulgate_text: brāhmaṃ tejastadā'jayyaṃ manyamāno mahārathaḥ / aparasminvanoddeśe vīrau śalyavṛkodarau
ce_text: evam uktas tu rādheyo yuddhāt karṇo nyavartata / brahmaṃ tejas tadājayyaṃ manyamāno mahārathaḥ

vulgate_text: balinau yuddhasaṃpannau vidyayā ca balena ca / anyonyamāhvayantau tu mattāviva mahāgajau
ce_text: anyonyam āhvayantau tau mattāv iva mahāgajau / muṣṭibhir jānubhiś caiva nighnantāv itaretaram / muhūrtaṃ tau tathānyonyaṃ samare paryakarṣatām

vulgate_text: muṣṭibhirjānubhiścaiva nighnantāvitaretaram / prakarṣaṇākarṣaṇayorabhyākarṣavikarṣaṇaiḥ

vulgate_text: pāṣāṇasaṃpātanibhaiḥ prahārairabhijaghnatuḥ / muhūrtaṃ tau tadā'nyonyaṃ samare paryakarṣatām

vulgate_text: nāyodhayattadā tena balavānvai suyodhanaḥ / etasminnantare'vidhyadbāṇenānataparvaṇā
ce_text: tatrāścaryaṃ bhīmasenaś cakāra puruṣarṣabhaḥ / yac chalyaṃ patitaṃ bhūmau nāhanad balinaṃ balī / tato rājasamūhasya paśyato vṛkṣam ārujat / tatas tu bhīmaṃ saṃjñābhir vārayām āsa dharmarāṭ / ākārajñas tato bhrātuḥ pāṇḍavo 'pi nyavartata / dharmarājaś ca kauravyaṃ duryodhanam amarṣaṇam / etasmin nantare 'vidhyad bāṇena nataparvaṇā / duryodhanam amitraghnaṃ dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / tato duryodhanaḥ kruddho daṇḍāhata ivoragaḥ / pratyayudhyata rājānaṃ yatnaṃ paramam āsthitaḥ / chittvā rājā dhanuḥ sajyaṃ dhārtarāṣṭrasya saṃyuge / abhyavarṣac charoghais taṃ sa hitvā prādravad raṇam / duḥśāsanas tu saṃkruddhaḥ sahadevena pārthiva / yuddhvā ca suciraṃ kālaṃ dhanuṣā sa mahārathaḥ / visṛjya ca dhanuḥ saṃkhye varma cādāya bhāsvaram / asim ākāśasaṃkāśam abhidudrāva pāṇḍavam / vikarṇacitrasenābhyāṃ nigṛhītaś ca kauravaḥ / duḥṣaho nakulāc cāpi apakṛṣṭaś ca kauravaiḥ / nivartantāṃ bhavanto vai kuto vipreṣu vigrahaḥ / na ceme kevalaṃ viprā na caiṣāṃ mānuṣaṃ balam / dvāv atra brāhmaṇau krūrau dvāv indrasadṛśau bale / ye vā ke vā namas tebhyo gacchāmaḥ svapuraṃ vayam / evaṃ saṃbhāṣya te vīrā vinivartanta kauravāḥ / prajahur brāhmaṇās tatra sametaṃ rājamaṇḍalam / prayātās te tatas tatra kṣatriyā raṇamūrdhani / brāhmaṇāś ca jayaṃ prāptāḥ kanyām ādāya niryayuḥ

vulgate_text: brāhmaṇā hi sadā rakṣyāḥ sāparādhā'pinityadā / athainānupalabhyeha punaryotsyāma hṛṣṭavat / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tasmai ditsati kanyāṃ tu brāhmaṇāya mahātmane / kopa āsīn mahīpānām ālokyānyonyam antikāt

vulgate_text: paurṇamāsyāṃ ghanairmuktau candrasūryāvivoditau / teṣāṃ mātā bahuvidhaṃ vināśaṃ paryacintayat
ce_text: teṣāṃ mātā bahuvidhaṃ vināśaṃ paryacintayat / anāgacchatsu putreṣu bhaikṣakāle 'tigacchati

vulgate_text: ityevaṃ cintayāmāsaṃ sutasnehāvṛtā pṛthā / tataḥ suptajanaprāye durdine meghasaṃplute
ce_text: viparītaṃ mataṃ jātaṃ vyāsasyāpi mahātmanaḥ / ity evaṃ cintayām āsa sutasnehānvitā pṛthā

vulgate_text: ahaṃ tato nakulo'nantaraṃ me paścādayaṃ sahadevastarasvī / vṛkodaro'haṃ ca yamau ca rāja- nniyaṃ ca kanyā bhavato niyojyāḥ
ce_text: ahaṃ tato nakulo 'nantaraṃ me; mādrīsutaḥ sahadevo jaghanyaḥ / vṛkodaro 'haṃ ca yamau ca rājann; iyaṃ ca kanyā bhavataḥ sma sarve

vulgate_text: satā'pi śaktena ca keśavena sajyaṃ dhanustanna kṛtaṃ kimartham / viddhaṃ ca lakṣyaṃ na ca kasya heto- rācakṣva tanme dvipadāṃ variṣṭha / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / ajināni vidhunvantaḥ karakāṃś ca dvijarṣabhāḥ / ūcus taṃ bhīr na kartavyā vayaṃ yotsyāmahe parān

vulgate_text: kṛṣmā pragṛhyājinamanvayāttaṃ nāgaṃ yathā nāgavadhūḥ prahṛṣṭā / śyāmo yuvā vāraṇamattagāmī kṛtvā mahatkarma suduṣkaraṃ tat
ce_text: kṛṣṇā ca gṛhyājinam anvayāt taṃ; nāgaṃ yathā nāgavadhūḥ prahṛṣṭā / amṛṣyamāṇeṣu narādhipeṣu; kruddheṣu taṃ tatra samāpatatsu

vulgate_text: yaḥ sūtaputreṇa cakāra yuddhaṃ śaṅke'rjunaṃ taṃ tridaśeśavīryam / amṛṣyamāṇeṣu narādhipeṣu kruddheṣu vai tatra samāpatatsu
ce_text: kṛṣṇā ca gṛhyājinam anvayāt taṃ; nāgaṃ yathā nāgavadhūḥ prahṛṣṭā / amṛṣyamāṇeṣu narādhipeṣu; kruddheṣu taṃ tatra samāpatatsu

vulgate_text: kṛtaṃ hi tatsyātsukṛtaṃ mamedaṃ yaśaśca puṇyaṃ ca hitaṃ tadetat / athoktavākyaṃ hi purohitaṃ sthitaṃ tato vinītaṃ samudīkṣya rājā
ce_text: tathoktavākyaṃ tu purohitaṃ taṃ; sthitaṃ vinītaṃ samudīkṣya rājā / samīpasthaṃ bhīmam idaṃ śaśāsa; pradīyatāṃ pādyam arghyaṃ tathāsmai

vulgate_text: ābhyāṃ tava sutā rājannirjitā rājasaṃsadi / yamau ca tatra kuntī ca yatra kṛṣmā vyavasthitā
ce_text: vayaṃ hi kṣatriyā rājan pāṇḍoḥ putrā mahātmanaḥ / jyeṣṭhaṃ māṃ viddhi kaunteyaṃ bhīmasenārjunāv imau / yābhyāṃ tava sutā rājan nirjitā rājasaṃsadi

vulgate_text: ekasya bahvyo vihitā mahiṣyaḥ kurunandana / naikasyā bahavaḥ puṃsaḥ śrūyante patayaḥ kvacit
ce_text: drupada uvāca / ekasya bahvyo vihitā mahiṣyaḥ kurunandana / naikasyā bahavaḥ puṃso vidhīyante kadā cana

vulgate_text: so'yaṃ na loke vede vā jātu dharmaḥ praśaste lokavedaviruddhaṃ tvaṃ nādharmaṃ dharmavicchuciḥ / kartumarhasi kaunteya kasmātte buddhirīdṛśī / yudhiṣṭhira uvāca
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca / mā rājan vimanā bhūs tvaṃ pāñcālya prītir astu te / īpsitas te dhruvaḥ kāmaḥ saṃvṛtto 'yam asaṃśayam

vulgate_text: āśrame rudranirdiṣṭādvyāsādetanmayā śrutam eṣa dharmo dhruvo rājaṃścarainamavicārayan / mā ca śaṅkā tatra te syātkathaṃcidapi pārthiva / drupada uvāca
ce_text: drupada uvāca / bhavān vā vidhivat pāṇiṃ gṛhṇātu duhitur mama / yasya vā manyase vīra tasya kṛṣṇām upādiśa

vulgate_text: na cāpyācaritaḥ pūrvairayaṃ dharmo mahātmabhiḥ / na cāpyadharmo vidvadbhiścaritavyaḥ kathaṃcana
ce_text: na cāpy ācaritaḥ pūrvair ayaṃ dharmo mahātmabhiḥ / na ca dharmo 'py anekasthaś caritavyaḥ sanātanaḥ

vulgate_text: tato'haṃ na karomyenaṃ vyavasāyaṃ kriyāṃ prati / dharmaḥ sadaiva saṃdigdhaḥ pratibhāti hi me tvayam / dhṛṣṭadyumna uvāca
ce_text: ato nāhaṃ karomy evaṃ vyavasāyaṃ kriyāṃ prati / dharmasaṃdehasaṃdigdhaṃ pratibhāti hi mām idam

vulgate_text: etametadyathā prāha dharmacārī yudhiṣṭhiraḥ bhujyatāṃ bhrātṛbhiḥ sārdhamityarjunamacodayam / anṛtānme bhayaṃ tīvraṃ mucye'hamanṛtātkatham / vyāsa uvāca
ce_text: vyāsa uvāca / asmin dharme vipralambhe lokavedavirodhake / yasya yasya mataṃ yad yac chrotum icchāmi tasya tat

vulgate_text: drupada uvāca / brūhi tatkāraṇaṃ yena brahmannālāyanī śubhā / jātā mamādhvare kṛṣmā sarvavedavidāṃ vara / vyāsa uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / etac chrutvā tu kaunteyāḥ śalyaviddhā ivābhavan / sarve cāsvasthamanaso babhūvus te mahārathāḥ

vulgate_text: bhavitārastatra tava patayaḥ pañca viplutāḥ / taiḥ sārdhaṃ madhurākāraiściraṃ ratimavāpsyasi / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / etac chrutvā tu kaunteyāḥ śalyaviddhā ivābhavan / sarve cāsvasthamanaso babhūvus te mahārathāḥ

vulgate_text: pañcakṛtvastvayā coktaḥ patiṃ dehītyahaṃ punaḥ / pañcate patayo bhadre bhaviṣyanti sukhāvahāḥ / stryuvāca
ce_text: tām atha pratyuvācedam īśāno vadatāṃ varaḥ / pañca te patayo bhadre bhaviṣyantīti śaṃkaraḥ

vulgate_text: astrairdivyairmānuṣānyodhayitvā śūrānsarvānāhave saṃvijitya / āgantāraḥ punarevendravalokaṃ svakarmaṇā pūrvacitaṃ mahārham sarvaṃ mayā bhāṣitametadevaṃ kartavyamanyadvividhārthayuktam / pūrvendrā ūcuḥ
ce_text: āgantāraḥ punar evendralokaṃ; svakarmaṇā pūrvajitaṃ mahārham / sarvaṃ mayā bhāṣitam etad evaṃ; kartavyam anyad vividhārthavac ca

vulgate_text: taireva sārdhaṃ tu tataḥ sa devo jagāma nārāyaṇamaprameyam / anantamavyaktamajaṃ purāṇaṃ sanātanaṃ viśvamanantarūpam
ce_text: tair eva sārdhaṃ tu tataḥ sa devo; jagāma nārāyaṇam aprameyam / sa cāpi tad vyadadhāt sarvam eva; tataḥ sarve saṃbabhūvur dharaṇyām

vulgate_text: sa cāpi tadvyadadhātsarvameva tataḥ sarve saṃbabhūvurdharaṇyamām / naraṃ tu devaṃ vibudhapradhāna- mindrājjiṣṇuṃ pañcamaṃ kalpayitvā sa cāpi keśau harirudbabarha śuklamekamaparaṃ cāpi kṛṣṇam
ce_text: tair eva sārdhaṃ tu tataḥ sa devo; jagāma nārāyaṇam aprameyam / sa cāpi tad vyadadhāt sarvam eva; tataḥ sarve saṃbabhūvur dharaṇyām

vulgate_text: tau cāpi keśau viśatāṃ yadūnāṃ kule striyau devakīṃ rohiṇīṃ ca / tayoreko baladevo babhūva yo'sau śvetasya devasya keśaḥ kṛṣṇo dvitīyaḥ keśavaḥ saṃbabhūva keśo yo'sau varṇataḥ kṛṣṇa uktaḥ
ce_text: sa cāpi keśau harir udbabarha; śuklam ekam aparaṃ cāpi kṛṣṇam / tau cāpi keśau viśatāṃ yadūnāṃ; kule striyau rohiṇīṃ devakīṃ ca / tayor eko baladevo babhūva; kṛṣṇo dvitīyaḥ keśavaḥ saṃbabhūva

vulgate_text: tānpūrvendrānabhivīkṣyābhirūpā- trśakrātmajaṃ cendrarūpaṃ niśamya / prīto rājā drupado vismitaśca divyāṃ māyāṃ tāmavekṣyāprameyām
ce_text: divyair vastrair arajobhiḥ suvarṇair; mālyaiś cāgryaiḥ śobhamānān atīva / sākṣāt tryakṣān vasavo vātha divyān; ādityān vā sarvaguṇopapannān / tān pūrvendrān evam īkṣyābhirūpān; prīto rājā drupado vismitaś ca

vulgate_text: tāṃ caivāgryāṃ striyamatirūpayuktāṃ divyāṃ sākṣātsomavahniprakāśām / yogyāṃ teṣāṃ rūpatejoyaśobhiḥ patnī matvā hṛṣṭavānpārthivendraḥ

divyacchatreṇa śobhitaḥ / rājñām anugato rājā mahendra iva daivataiḥ / tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya nagaraṃ nāgasāhvayam / praviveśa tadā rājā nāgaraiḥ pūjito bhṛśam / mūrdhāvasiktaṃ pāṇḍusutam abhyanandanta vulgate_text: dvaipāyanaṃ puraskṛtya dhaumyasyābhimate sthitaḥ / bhrātṛbhiḥ sahito rājā rājamārgamatītya ca

vulgate_text: tavaiva tu prasādena rājyasthāśca bhavāmahe / gatistvamāpatkāle'pi pāṇḍavānāṃ ca mādhava
ce_text: pañcabhis tair maheṣvāsair indrakalpaiḥ samanvitam / śuśubhe tat puraśreṣṭhaṃ nāgair bhogavatī yathā / śrīvāsudevaḥ / vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ / kuntī / vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ / tatas tu viśvakarmāṇaṃ pūjayitvā visṛjya ca / dvaipāyanaṃ ca saṃpūjya visṛjya ca narādhipa / vārṣṇeyam abravīd rājā gantukāmaṃ kṛtakṣaṇam / tava prasādād vārṣṇeya rājyaṃ prāptaṃ mayānagha / prasādād eva te vīra śūnyaṃ rāṣṭraṃ sudurgamam / tavaiva tatprasādena rājyasthās tu bhavāmahe / gatis tvam antakāle ca pāṇḍavānāṃ tu mādhava / mātāsmākaṃ pitā devo na pāṇḍuṃ vidmahe vayam / jñātvā tu kṛtyaṃ kartavyaṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ tvayānagha / tvatprabhāvān mahābhāga rājyaṃ prāptaṃ svadharmataḥ / pitṛpaitāmahaṃ rājyaṃ kathaṃ na syāt tava prabho / dhārtarāṣṭrā durācārāḥ kiṃ kariṣyanti pāṇḍavān / yatheṣṭaṃ pālaya mahīṃ sadā dharmadhuraṃ vaha / dharmopadeśaḥ saṃkṣepād brāhmaṇān bhara kaurava / adyaiva nāradaḥ śrīmān āgamiṣyati satvaraḥ / ādṛtya tasya vākyāni śāsanaṃ kuru tasya vai / evam uktvā tataḥ kuntīm abhivādya janārdanaḥ / uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā gamiṣyāmi namo 'stu te / jātuṣaṃ gṛham āsādya mayā prāptaṃ ca keśava / āryeṇāpi tava jñātaṃ kuntibhojena cānagha / tvayā nāthena govinda duḥkhaṃ prāptaṃ mahattaram / kiṃ punas tvam anāthānāṃ daridrāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ / sarvaduḥkhāni śāmyanti tava saṃdarśanān mama / smarasvaitān mahāprājña tena jīvanti pāṇḍavāḥ / kariṣyāmīti cāmantrya abhivādya pitṛṣvasām / gamanāya matiṃ cakre vāsudevaḥ sahānugaḥ

vulgate_text: teṣu tatropaviṣṭeṣu pāṇḍaveṣu mahātmasu / āyayau dharmarājaṃ tu draṣṭukāmo'tha nāradaḥ

nabhaḥsthalena divyena durlabhenātapasvinām / bhūtārcito bhūtadharāṃ rāṣṭraṃ nagaramālinīm / avekṣamāṇo dyutimān ājagāma mahātapāḥ / sarvavedāntago vipraḥ sarvavidyāsu pāragaḥ / pareṇa tapasā yukto devadānavamānavaiḥ / kṣīṇakarmasu pāpeṣu bhūteṣu vividheṣu ca / sarvathā kṛtamaryādo deveṣu vividheṣu ca / śataśaḥ somapā yajñe puṇyakarmakṛd agnicit / ṛksāmayajuṣāṃ vettā nyāyavṛttāntakovidaḥ / ṛjur ārohavāñ śuklo bhūyiṣṭhapathiko 'naghaḥ / ślakṣṇayā śikhayopetaḥ saṃpannaḥ paramatviṣā / avadāte ca sūkṣme ca divye ca rucire śubhe / mahendradatte mahatī bibhrat paramavāsasī / jāmbūnadamaye divye gaṇḍūpadamukhena vai / agnyarkasadṛśe divye dhārayan kuṇḍale śubhe / rājatacchatram ucchritya citraṃ paramavarcasam / prāpya duṣprāpam anyena brahmavarcasam uttamam / bhavane bhūmipālasya bṛhaspatir ivāplutaḥ / saṃhitāyāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ sthitasyopasthitasya ca / dvipadasya ca dharmasya kramadharmasya pāragaḥ / gāthāsāmānusāmajñaḥ sāmnāṃ paramavalgunām / ātmanā sarvamokṣibhyaḥ kṛtimān kṛtyavit tathā / yoktā dharme bahuvidhe mano matimatāṃ varaḥ / viditārthaḥ svasamayacchettā nigamasaṃśayān / arthanirvacane nityaṃ saṃśayacchid asaṃśayaḥ / prakṛtyā dharmakuśalo nānādharmaviśāradaḥ / lopenāgamadharmeṇa saṃkrameṇa ca vṛttiṣu / ekaśabdāṃś ca nānārthān ekārthāṃś ca pṛthak śrutīn / pṛthag arthābhidhānaṃ ca prayogāṇām avekṣitā / pramāṇabhūto lokasya sarvādhikaraṇeṣu ca / sarvavarṇavikāreṣu nityaṃ sakalapūjitaḥ / svare svare ca vividhe vṛtteṣu vividheṣu ca / samasthāneṣu sarveṣu samāmnāyeṣu dhātuṣu / uddeśyānāṃ samākhyātā sarvam ākhyātam uddiśan / abhisaṃdhiṣu tattvajñaḥ padāny aṅgāny anusmaran / kāladharmeṇa nirdiṣṭaṃ yathārthaṃ ca vicārayan / cikīrṣitaṃ ca yo vettā yathā lokena saṃvṛtam / vibhāṣitaṃ ca samayaṃ bhāṣitaṃ hṛdayaṃgamam / ātmane ca parasmai ca svarasaṃskārayogavān / eṣāṃ svarāṇāṃ jñātā ca boddhā pravacanasvarān / vijñātā uktavākyānāṃ ekatāṃ bahutāṃ tathā / boddhā ca paramārthāṃś ca vividhāṃś ca vyatikramān / abhedataś ca bahuśo bahuśaś cāpi bhedataḥ / vacanānāṃ ca vividhān ādeśāṃś ca samīkṣitā / nānārthakuśalas tatra taddhiteṣu ca kṛtsnaśaḥ / paribhūṣayitā vācāṃ varṇataḥ svarato 'rthataḥ / pratyayāṃś ca samākhyātā niyataṃ pratidhātukam / pañca cākṣarajātāni svarasaṃjñāni yāni ca / nāradas tv atha devarṣir ājagāma yadṛcchayā / āsanaṃ ruciraṃ tasmai pradadau svaṃ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ

vulgate_text: citrāṅgadāṃ punarvākyamabravītpāṇḍunandanaḥ / ihaiva bhava bhadraṃ te vardhethā babhruvāhanam
ce_text: tasyām ajanayat putraṃ rājānaṃ babhruvāhanam / taṃ dṛṣṭvā pāṇḍavo rājan gokarṇam abhito 'gamat / citravāhanam abravīt / citrāṅgadāyāḥ śulkaṃ ca gṛhṇemaṃ babhruvāhanam / anena tu bhaviṣyāmi ṛṇān mukto janādhipa / citrāṅgadāṃ punar vākyam abravīt pākaśāsaniḥ / ihaiva bhava bhadre tvaṃ babhruvāhanavardhanā / indraprasthanivāsaṃ me āgatā tatra raṃsyase / kuntīṃ yudhiṣṭhiraṃ bhīmaṃ bhrātarau me kanīyasau / āgatā tatra paśyethā anyān api ca bāndhavān / bāndhavaiḥ sahitā bhadre nandase tvam anindite / dharme sthitaḥ satyadhṛtiḥ kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / jitvā tu pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ rājasūyaṃ kariṣyati / tatrāgacchanti rājānaḥ pṛthivyāṃ nṛpasaṃjñitāḥ / bahūni ratnāny ādāya āgamiṣyati te pitā / ekasārthaṃ prayātāsi citravāhanasenayā / drakṣyāmi rājasūye tvāṃ putraṃ pālaya mā śucaḥ / babhruvāhananāmā tu mama prāṇo bahiścaraḥ / tasmād bharasva putraṃ vai pūruvaṃśavivardhanam / citravāhanadāyādaṃ dharmāt pauravanandanam / pāṇḍavānāṃ priyaṃ putraṃ tasmāt pālaya sarvadā / viprayogena saṃtāpaṃ mā kṛthās tvam anindite / citrāṅgadām evam uktvā

vulgate_text: śrotavyaṃ yadi vā kṛṣṇa prasādo yadi te mayi / vaktumarhasi deveśa tacchrotuṃ kāmayāmyaham / śrībhagavānuvāca
ce_text: samudre paścime yāni tīrthāny āyatanāni ca / tāni sarvāṇi gatvā sa prabhāsam upajagmivān / satyabhāmā / śrībhagavān / vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ / cintayām āsa rātrau tu gadena kathitāṃ kathām / subhadrāyāś ca mādhuryaṃ rūpasaṃpadguṇāni ca / prāptuṃ tāṃ cintayām āsa ka upāyo bhaved iti / veṣavaikṛtam āpannaḥ parivrājakarūpadhṛk / kukurāndhakavṛṣṇīnām ajñāto veṣadhāraṇāt / bhramamāṇaś caran bhaikṣaṃ parivrājakaveṣavān / yena kenāpy upāyena praviśya ca gṛhaṃ mahat / dṛṣṭvā subhadrāṃ kṛṣṇasya bhaginīm ekasundarīm / vāsudevamataṃ jñātvā kariṣyāmi hitaṃ śubham / evaṃ viniścayaṃ kṛtvā dīkṣitas tu tadābhavat / tridaṇḍī muṇḍitaḥ kuṇḍī akṣamālāṅgulīyakaḥ / yogabhāraṃ vahan pārtho vaṭavṛkṣasya koṭaram / praviśann eva bībhatsur vṛṣṭiṃ varṣati vāsave / cintayām āsa deveśaṃ keśavaṃ kleśanāśanam / praṇatārtiharaṃ śaṃbhuṃ māyārūpeṇa vañcakam / keśavaś cintitaṃ jñātvā divyajñānena dṛṣṭavān / śayānaḥ śayane dhanye satyabhāmāsahāyavān / keśavaḥ sahasā rājañ jahāsa ca nananda ca / punaḥ punaḥ satyabhāmā cābravīt puruṣottamam / bhagavaṃś cintayāviṣṭaḥ śayane śayitaḥ sukham / bhavān bahuprakāreṇa jahāsa ca punaḥ punaḥ / śrotavyaṃ yadi vā kṛṣṇa prasādo yadi cen mayi / vaktum arhasi lokeśa tac chrotuṃ kāmaye hy aham / pitṛṣvasāyāḥ putro me bhīmasenānujo 'rjunaḥ / tīrthayātrāṃ gataḥ pārthaḥ kāraṇāt samayāt tadā / tīrthayātrāsamāptau tu nivṛtto niśi bhārataḥ / subhadrāṃ cintayānas tu tadarthe cāpi māṃ punaḥ / cintayann eva tāṃ bhadrāṃ yatirūpadharo 'bhavat / yatirūpapraticchanno dvārakāṃ prāpya mādhavīm / yena kenāpy upāyena dṛṣṭvā tu varavarṇinīm / vāsudevamataṃ jñātvā prayatiṣye manoratham / evaṃ vyavasitaḥ pārtho yatiliṅgena pāṇḍavaḥ / chāyāyāṃ vaṭavṛkṣasya vṛṣṭiṃ varṣati vāsave / yogabhāraṃ vahann eva mānasaṃ duḥkham āptavān / īdṛśaṃ māṃ vijānāti mādhavo yadi māṃ smaran / bhrātaraṃ tava paśyeti satyabhāmām adarśayat / tata utthāya śayanāt prasthito madhusūdanaḥ

vacaḥ śrutvā cintayantī janārdanam / novāca kiṃ cid vacanaṃ bāṣpadūṣitalocanā / rāgonmādapralāpī syād arjuno jayatāṃ varaḥ / cintayām āsa pitaraṃ praviśya ca latāgṛham / cintayānaṃ tu kaunteyaṃ jñātvā śacyā śacīpatiḥ / sahito nāradādyais tu munisiddhāpsarogaṇaiḥ / arundhatyā vasiṣṭhena ājagāma kuśasthalīm / cintitaṃ ca subhadrāyāś cintayitvā janārdanaḥ / nidrayāpahṛtajñānaṃ rauhiṇeyaṃ vinā tadā / sahākrūreṇa śininā satyakena gadena ca / vasudevena devakyā āhukena ca dhīmatā / ājagāma purīṃ rātrau dvārakāṃ svajanair vṛtaḥ / pūjayitvā tu deveśaṃ nāradādyair maharṣibhiḥ / kuśalapraśnam uktvā tu devendreṇābhiyācitaḥ / vaivāhikakriyāṃ kṛṣṇas tathety evam uvāca ha / āhuko vasudevaś ca sahākrūraḥ sasātyakiḥ / abhipraṇamya śirasā pākaśāsanam abruvan / devadeva namas te 'stu lokanātha jagatpate / vayaṃ dhanyāḥ sma lokeṣu bāndhavaiḥ sahitā vibho / kṛtaprasādās tu vayaṃ tava vākyena viśvajit / evam uktvā prasādyainaṃ pūjayitvā prayatnataḥ / mahendraśāsanāt sarve sahitāś ca maharṣibhiḥ / vivāhaṃ kārayām āsuḥ śakraputrasya śāstrataḥ / arundhatī śacī devī rukmiṇī devakī tathā / divyastrībhiś ca sahitāḥ kriyāṃ bhadrāṃ prayojayan / maharṣiḥ kāśyapo hotā sadasyā nāradādayaḥ / puṇyāśiṣaḥ prayoktāraḥ sarve hy āsaṃs tadārjune / abhiṣekaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā mahendraḥ pākaśāsanim / lokapālais tu sahitaḥ sarvair devair abhiṣṭutaḥ / kirīṭāṅgadahārādyair hastābharaṇakuṇḍalaiḥ / bhūṣayitvā tu taṃ pārthaṃ dvitīyam iva vāsavam / putraṃ pariṣvajya tadā prītim āpa puraṃdaraḥ / śacī devī tathā bhadrām arundhatyādibhis tadā / kārayām āsa vaivāhyaṃ maṅgalyaṃ yādavastriyaḥ / sahāpsarobhir muditā bhūṣaṇaiś cābhyapūjayan / paulomīm iva manyante subhadrāṃ devayoṣitaḥ / tato vivāho vavṛdhe kṛtaḥ sarvaguṇānvitaḥ / tasyāḥ pāṇiṃ gṛhītvā tu mantrahomapuraskṛtam / yathā tasyaiva hi pitā śacyā iva śatakratuḥ / sā jiṣṇum adhikaṃ bheje subhadrā cārudarśanā / pārthasya sadṛśī bhadrā rūpeṇa vayasā tathā / subhadrāyāś ca pārtho 'pi sadṛśo rūpalakṣaṇaiḥ / ity ūcuś ca tadā devāḥ prītāḥ sendrapurogamāḥ / evaṃ niveśya devās tu gandharvaiḥ sāpsarogaṇaiḥ / āmantrya yādavān sarve viprajagmur yathāgatam / yādavāḥ pārtham āmantrya antardvīpaṃ gatās tadā / vāsudevas tadā pārtham uvāca yadunandanaḥ / dvāviṃśad divasān pārtha ihoṣya bharatarṣabha / māmakaṃ ratham āruhya sainyasugrīvayojitam / subhadrayā sukhaṃ pārtha khāṇḍavaprastham āviśa / yādavaiḥ sahitaḥ paścād āgamiṣyāmi bhārata / yativeṣeṇa nirato vasa tvaṃ rukmiṇīgṛhe / evam uktvā pracakrāma antardvīpaṃ janārdanaḥ / kṛtodvāhas tadā pārthaḥ kṛtakāryo 'bhavat tadā / tasyāṃ copagato bhāvaḥ pārthasya sahasāgataḥ / sa tayā yuyuje vīro bhadrayā bharatarṣabhaḥ / abhiniṣpannayā rāmaḥ sītayeva samanvitaḥ / sa hi jiṣṇur vijajñe tāṃ hrīṃ śriyaṃ saṃnatikriyām / dvādaśānāṃ varastrīṇāṃ rūpeṇāsadṛśīṃ satīm / sa prakṛtyā śriyā dīptaḥ saṃdidīpe tayādhikam / udyatsahasradīptāṃśuḥ śaradīva divākaraḥ / sā tu taṃ manujavyāghram anuraktā manasvinī / kanyāpuragatā bhūtvā tatparā samapadyata / vṛṣṇyandhakapurāt tatra apayānaṃ dhanaṃjayaḥ / viniścitya tayā pārthaḥ subhadrām idam abravīt / dvijānāṃ gaṇamukhyānāṃ yathārhaṃ pratipādaya / bhakṣyair bhojyaiś ca kāmaiś ca prayaccha pratiyāsyatām / ātmanaś ca samuddiśya mahāvratasamāpanam / gaccha bhadre svayaṃ tūrṇaṃ mahārājaniveśanam / tejobalajavopetai ratnair hayavarottamaiḥ / sainyasugrīvasaṃyuktaṃ rathaṃ tūrṇam ihānaya / krīḍārtham iti bhāṣitvā sakhībhiḥ subhage saha / kṣipram ādāya paryehi rathaṃ sarvāyudhāni ca / anukarṣān patākāś ca tūṇīrāṃś ca dhanūṃṣi ca / sarvān rathavare kuryāḥ sotsedhāś ca mahāgadāḥ / arjunenaivam uktā tu subhadrā bhadrabhāṣiṇī / jagāma nṛpater veśma sakhībhis tvaritā saha / krīḍārtham iva tatrasthān rakṣiṇo vākyam abravīt / rathenānena yāsyāmi mahāvratasamāpanam / sainyasugrīvayuktena sāyudhena ca śārṅgiṇaḥ / subhadrayaivam ukte tu janāḥ prāñjalayo 'bruvan / rathenānena bhadre tvaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ kriyatām iti / yojayitvā rathavaraṃ kalyāṇair abhibhāṣya tām / yathoktaṃ sarvam āropya sakhībhiḥ saha bhāminī / kṣipram ādāya kalyāṇī subhadrārjunam abravīt / ratho 'yaṃ rathināṃ śreṣṭha ānītas tava śāsanāt / svasti yāhi yathākāmaṃ kurūn kauravanandana / nivedya taṃ rathaṃ bhartuḥ subhadrā bhadrasaṃmatā / brāhmaṇebhyo dadau hṛṣṭā tadā sā vividhaṃ vasu / snehavanti ca bhojyāni pradadāv īpsitāni ca / yathākāmaṃ yathāśraddhaṃ vastrāṇi vividhāni ca / tarpitā vividhair bhakṣyais tāny avāpya vasūni ca / brāhmaṇāḥ svagṛhaṃ jagmuḥ prayujya paramāśiṣaḥ / subhadrayā tu vijñaptaḥ pūrvam eva dhanaṃjayaḥ / raśmipragrahaṇe pārtha na me 'sti sadṛśo bhuvi / tasmāt sā pūrvam āruhya raśmīñ jagrāha mādhavī / sodarā vāsudevasya kṛtasvastyayanā hayān / varjayitvā tu tal liṅgaṃ samucchritamahādhanuḥ / āruroha rathaśreṣṭhaṃ śuklavāsā dhanaṃjayaḥ / mahendradattamukuṭaṃ tathā hy ābharaṇāni ca / alaṃkṛtya tu kaunteyaḥ prayātum upacakrame / tataḥ kanyāpure ghoṣas tumulaḥ samapadyata / dṛṣṭvā rathagataṃ pārthaṃ khaḍgapāṇiṃ dhanurdharam / abhīśuhastāṃ suśroṇīṃ arjunena rathe sthitām / ūcuḥ kanyāpure kanyā vāsudevasahodarām / sarve kāmāḥ samṛddhās te subhadre bhadrabhāṣiṇi / vāsudevapriyaṃ labdhvā bhartāraṃ vīram arjunam / sarvasīmantinīnāṃ tvaṃ śreṣṭhā kṛṣṇasahodare / yasmāt sarvamanuṣyāṇāṃ śreṣṭho bhartā tavārjunaḥ / upapannas tvayā vīraḥ sarvalokamahārathaḥ / svasti yāhi gṛhaṃ bhadre suhṛdbhiḥ saṃgamo 'stu te / evam uktā prahṛṣṭābhiḥ sakhībhiḥ parinanditā / bhadrā bhadrajavopetān punar aśvān acodayat / tataś cāmarahastā sā sakhī kubjāṅganābhavat / tataḥ kanyāpuradvārāt saghoṣam abhiniḥsṛtam / dadṛśus taṃ rathaśreṣṭhaṃ janā jīmūtaniḥsvanam / subhadrāsaṃgṛhītasya rathasya mahato ravam / meghasvanam ivākāśe śuśruvuḥ puravāsinaḥ / subhadrayā ca saṃpanne tiṣṭhan rathavare 'rjunaḥ / prababhau parayopetaḥ kailāsa iva gaṅgayā / pārthaḥ subhadrāsahito virarāja mahārathaḥ / pārthasyeva pitā śakro yathā śacyā samanvitaḥ / subhadrāṃ prekṣya dharmeṇa hriyamāṇāṃ yaśasvinīm / cakruḥ kilakilāśabdam āsādya bahavo janāḥ / dāśārhāṇāṃ kulasya śrīḥ subhadrā bhadrabhāṣiṇī / abhikāmā sakāmena pārthena saha gacchati / athāpare hi saṃkruddhā gṛhṇīta ghnata māciram / iti saṃvāryamāṇānāṃ sa nādaḥ sumahān abhūt / sa tena janaghoṣeṇa vīro gaja ivārditaḥ / vavarṣa śaravarṣāṇi na tu kaṃ cana roṣayat / mumoca niśitān bāṇān dīpyamānān svatejasā / prāsādavarasaṃgheṣu harmyeṣu bhavaneṣu ca / prāsādapaṅktistambheṣu vedikāsu dhvajeṣu ca / mumoca niśitān bāṇān na ca kaṃ cana roṣayat / kṣobhayitvā puraśreṣṭhaṃ garutmān iva sāgaram / prekṣan raivatakadvāraṃ niryayau bharatarṣabhaḥ / śāsanāt puruṣendrasya balena mahatā balī / girau raivatake nityaṃ babhūva vipṛthuśravāḥ / pravāse vāsudevasya tasmin haladharopamaḥ / saṃbabhūva tadā goptā purasya puravardhanaḥ / prāpya pāṇḍavaniryāṇaṃ niryayau vipṛthuśravāḥ / niśamya puranirghoṣaṃ svam anīkam acodayat / so 'bhipatya tadādhvānaṃ dadarśa puruṣarṣabham / niḥsṛtaṃ dvārakādvārād aṃśumantam ivāmbudāt / savidyutam ivāmbhodaṃ prekṣya bāṇadhanurdharam / pārtham āsādya yodhānāṃ vismayaḥ samapadyata / udīrṇarathanāgāśvam anīkam abhivīkṣya tat / uvāca paramaprītā subhadrā bhadrabhāṣiṇī / saṃgrahītum abhiprāyo dīrghakālakṛto mama / yudhyamānasya saṃgrāme rathaṃ tava nararṣabha / ojastejodyutibalair ācitasya mahātmanaḥ / pārthasya vai sārathitve bhavethā ity aśikṣayan / evam uktaḥ priyāṃ prītaḥ pratyuvāca nararṣabhaḥ / codayāśvān asaṃsaktān viśantu vipṛthor balam / bahubhir yudhyamānasya tāvakānāṃ jighāṃsataḥ / paśya bāhubalaṃ bhadre śarān vikṣipato mama / evam uktā tato bhadrā pārthena bharatarṣabha / cucoda cāśvān visrabdhā tatas te viviśur balam / tadāhatamahāvādyaṃ samudagradhvajāyutam / anīkaṃ vipṛthor hṛṣṭaṃ pārtham evānvavartata / rathair bahuvidhair hṛṣṭāḥ sadaśvaiś ca mahājavaiḥ / kirantaḥ śaravarṣāṇi parivavrur dhanaṃjayam / teṣām astrāṇi saṃvārya divyair astrair mahāstravit / āvṛṇon mahad ākāśaṃ śaraiḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ / teṣāṃ bāṇān mahābāhur makuṭāny aṅgadāny api / ciccheda niśitair bāṇaiḥ śarāṃś caiva dhanūṃṣi ca / yugānīṣā varūthāni yantrāṇi vividhāni ca / ajighāṃsan parān pārthaś ciccheda niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ / nirdhanuṣkān vikavacān virathāṃś ca mahārathān / kṛtvā pārthaḥ priyāṃ prītaḥ prekṣyatām ity adarśayat / sā dṛṣṭvā mahad āścaryaṃ subhadrā pārtham abravīt / avāptārthāsmi bhadraṃ te yāhi pārtha yathāsukham / saṃsaktaṃ pāṇḍuputreṇa samīkṣya vipṛthur balam / tvaramāṇo 'bhisaṃkramya sthīyatām ity abhāṣata / tat tu senāpater vākyaṃ nātyavartanta yādavāḥ / sāgare mārutoddhūtā velām iva mahormayaḥ / tato rathavarāt tūrṇam avaruhya nararṣabhaḥ / abhigamya naravyāghraṃ prahṛṣṭaḥ pariṣasvaje / so 'bravīt pārtham āsādya dīrghakālam idaṃ tava / nivāsam abhijānāmi śaṅkhacakragadādharāt / na me 'sty aviditaṃ kiṃ cid yad yad ācaritaṃ tvayā / subhadrāsaṃprayogena prītas tava janārdanaḥ / prāptasya yatiliṅgena dvārakāṃ tu dhanaṃjaya / visṛṣṭā sarvavṛṣṇīnām ṛṣabheṇa ca sodarā / tvam imāṃ vīra dāśārhāṃ śacīm iva śacīpatiḥ / bhaktāṃ guṇavatīṃ bhadrāṃ sadā satkartum arhasi / bandhur bhava subhadrāyā gatiś ca tvaṃ dhanaṃjaya / bandhumān asi rāmeṇa mahendrāvarajena ca / mām eva hi sadākārṣīn mantriṇaṃ madhusūdanaḥ / antareṇa subhadrāṃ ca tvāṃ ca tāta dhanaṃjaya / imaṃ rathavaraṃ divyaṃ sarvaśastrasamanvitam / idam evānuyātraṃ ca nirdiśya gadapūrvajaḥ / antardvīpaṃ tadā vīra yāto vṛṣṇisukhāvahaḥ / dīrghakālāvaruddhaṃ tvāṃ saṃprāptaṃ priyayā saha / paśyantu bhrātaras tatra vajrapāṇim ivāmarāḥ / āgate tu daśārhāṇām ṛṣabhe śārṅgadhanvani / bhadrām anugamiṣyanti ratnāni ca vasūni ca / ariṣṭaṃ gaccha panthānaṃ sukhī bhava dhanaṃjaya / naṣṭaśokair viśokasya suhṛdbhiḥ saṃgamo 'stu te / tato vipṛthum āmantrya pārthaḥ prīto 'bhivādya ca / kṛṣṇasya matam āsthāya kṛṣṇasya ratham āsthitaḥ / pūrvam eva tu pārthāya kṛṣṇena viniyojitam / sarvaratnasusaṃpūrṇaṃ sarvabhogasamanvitam

vulgate_text: sannaddhaḥ kavacī khaḍgī baddhagodhāṅgulitravān yuktaḥ senānuyātreṇa rathaṇāropya mādhavīm / rathenākāśagenaiva payayau *svapuraṃ prati
ce_text: saṃnaddhaḥ kavacī khaḍgī baddhagodhāṅgulitravān / mṛgayāvyapadeśena yaugapadyena bhārata

vulgate_text: tato'bravīdvāsudevaṃ vaco rāmaḥ parantapaḥ trailokyanātha he kṛṣṇa bhūtabhavyabhaviṣyakṛt / kimavāgupaviṣṭo'si prekṣamāṇo janārdana
ce_text: tato 'bravīt kāmapālo vāsudevaṃ paraṃtapam / kim avāg upaviṣṭo 'si prekṣamāṇo janārdana

vulgate_text: etāndoṣāṃstu kaunteyo dṛṣṭavāniti me matiḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ tu vīryeṇa praśastaṃ haraṇaṃ balāt / ataḥ prasahya hṛtavānkanyāṃ dharmeṇa pāṇḍavaḥ
ce_text: etān doṣāṃś ca kaunteyo dṛṣṭavān iti me matiḥ / ataḥ prasahya hṛtavān kanyāṃ dharmeṇa pāṇḍavaḥ

vulgate_text: mama śastraṃ viśeṣeṇa tūṇau cākṣayasāyakau yoddhā pārthaśca śīghrāstraḥ ko nu tena samo bhavet / tamabhidrutya sāntvena parameṇa dhanañjayam
ce_text: sa ca nāma rathas tādṛṅ madīyās te ca vājinaḥ / yoddhā pārthaś ca śīghrāstraḥ ko nu tena samo bhavet

vulgate_text: praṇaśyedvo yaśaḥ sadyo na tu sāntve parājayaḥ pitṛṣvasāyāḥ putro me saṃbandhaṃ nārhati dviṣām / tacchrutvā vāsudevasya tathā kartuṃ janādhipa
ce_text: yadi nirjitya vaḥ pārtho balād gacchet svakaṃ puram / praṇaśyed vo yaśaḥ sadyo na tu sāntve parājayaḥ

vulgate_text: vamanaṃ pānaśīlāṃstānkariṣyāmi śarottamaiḥ / utāho vā madonmattānnayiṣyāmi yamakṣayam
ce_text: tac chrutvā vāsudevasya tathā cakrur janādhipa / vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ / udyogaṃ kṛtavantas te bherīṃ saṃnādya yādavāḥ / arjunas tu tadā śrutvā bherīsaṃnādanaṃ mahat / kaunteyas tvaramāṇas tu subhadrām abhyabhāṣata / āyānti vṛṣṇayaḥ sarve sasuhṛjjanabāndhavāḥ / tvadarthaṃ yoddhukāmās te madaraktāntalocanāḥ / pramattān aśucīn mūḍhān surāmattān narādhamān / vāmino vāśinādīṃs tu kariṣyāmi śarottamaiḥ / utāho vā madonmattān nayiṣyāmi yamakṣayam / evam uktvā priyāṃ pārtho nyavartata mahābalaḥ / nivartamānaṃ dṛṣṭvaiva subhadrā trastatāṃ gatā / evaṃ mā vada pārtheti pādayoḥ patitā tadā / subhadrā nu kalir jātā vṛṣṇīnāṃ nidhanāya ca / evaṃ bruvantaḥ paurās te janavādaṃ janāḥ prabho / mama śokaṃ vivardhanti tasmāt pāpaṃ na cintaya / parivādabhayān muktā tvatprasādād bhavāmy aham / evam uktas tataḥ pārthaḥ priyayā bhadrayā tadā / gamanāya matiṃ cakre pārthaḥ satyaparākramaḥ / smitapūrvaṃ tadābhāṣya pariṣvajya priyāṃ tadā / utthāpya ca punaḥ pārtho yāhi yāhīti so 'bravīt / tataḥ subhadrā tvaritā raśmīn saṃgṛhya pāṇinā / codayām āsa javanāñ śīghram aśvān kṛtatvarā / tatas tu kṛtasaṃnāhā vṛṣṇivīrāḥ samāhitāḥ / pratyānayārthaṃ pārthasya javanais turagottamaiḥ / rājamārgam anuprāptā dṛṣṭvā pārthasya vikramam / prāsādapaṅktistambheṣu vedikāsu dhvajeṣu ca / arjunasya śarān dṛṣṭvā vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ / keśavasya vacas tathyaṃ manyamānās tu yādavāḥ / atītya śailaṃ raivatakaṃ śrutvā tu vipṛthor vacaḥ / arjunena kṛtaṃ śrutvā gantukāmās tu vṛṣṇayaḥ / śrutvā dūraṃ gataṃ pārthaṃ nyavartanta narādhipāḥ / purodyānāny atikramya viśālaṃ ca girivrajam / sānuṃ muñjāvataṃ caiva vanāny upavanāni ca / puṇyeṣv ānartarāṣṭreṣu vāpīpadmasarāṃsi ca / prāpya dhenumatītīrtham aśvarodhasaraḥ prati / prekṣyāvartaṃ tataḥ śailam arbudaṃ ca nagottamam / ārāc chṛṅgam upasthāya tīrtvā kāravatīṃ nadīm / prāpya sālveyarāṣṭrāṇi niṣadhān abhyatītya ca / devāpṛthupuraṃ paśyan sarvataḥ susamāhitaḥ / tam atītya mahābāhur devāraṇyam apaśyata / pūjayām āsur āyāntaṃ devāraṇyamaharṣayaḥ / sa vanāni nadīḥ śailān giriprasravaṇāni ca / atītya ca tathā pārthaḥ subhadrāsārathis tadā / kauravaṃ viṣayaṃ prāpya viśaṅkaḥ samapadyata / sodaryāṇāṃ mahābāhuḥ siṃhāśayam ivāśayam / dūrād upavanopetāṃ etad vistaraśo brahmañ śrotum icchāmi tattvataḥ / khāṇḍavasya yathā dāhaḥ purā samabhavan mune / hanta te kathayiṣyāmi purāṇam ṛṣisaṃstutam / kathām imāṃ naraśreṣṭha khāṇḍavasya vināśinīm / paurāṇaḥ śrūyate tāta rājā harihayopamaḥ / śvetakir nāma vikhyāto balavikramasaṃyutaḥ / yajvā dānapatir dhīmān yathā nānyo 'sti kaś cana / īje sa ca mahāsatraiḥ kratubhiś cāptadakṣiṇaiḥ / tasya nānyābhavad buddhir divase divase nṛpa / satre kriyāsamārambhe dāneṣu vividheṣu ca / tasyaivaṃ vartamānasya kadā cit kālaparyaye / satram āhartukāmasya saṃvatsaraśataṃ kila / ṛtvijo nābhyapadyanta samāhartuṃ mahātmanaḥ / sa tu rājākarod yatnaṃ mahāntaṃ sasuhṛjjanaḥ / praṇipātena sāntvena dānena ca mahāyaśāḥ / ṛtvijo 'nunayām āsa bhūyo bhūyas tv atandritaḥ / te cāsya tam abhiprāyaṃ na cakrur amitaujasaḥ / sa cāśramasthān rājarṣis tān uvāca ruṣānvitaḥ / yady ahaṃ patito viprāḥ śuśrūṣāyāṃ na ca sthitaḥ / āśu tyājyo 'smi yuṣmābhir brāhmaṇaiś ca jugupsitaḥ / tan nārhatha kratuśraddhāṃ vyāghātayitum uttamām / asthāne vā parityāgaṃ kartuṃ me dvijasattamāḥ / prapanna eva vo viprāḥ prasādaṃ kartum arhatha / sāntvadānādibhir vākyais tattvataḥ kāryavattayā / prasādayitvā vakṣyāmi yan naḥ kāryaṃ dvijottamāḥ / athavāhaṃ parityakto bhavadbhir dveṣakāraṇāt / ṛtvijo 'nyān gamiṣyāmi yājanārthaṃ tapodhanāḥ / etāvad uktvā vacanaṃ virarāma sa pārthivaḥ / yadā na śekū rājānaṃ yājanārthaṃ paraṃtapa / tatas te yājakāḥ kruddhās tam ūcur nṛpasattamam / tava karmāṇy ajasraṃ vai vartante pārthivottama / tato vayaṃ pariśrāntāḥ satataṃ karmavāhinaḥ / śramād asmāt pariśrāntān sa tvaṃ nas tyaktum arhasi / buddhimohaṃ samāsthāya tvarāsaṃbhāvito 'nagha / gaccha rudrasakāśaṃ tvaṃ sa hi tvāṃ yājayiṣyati / sādhikṣepaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā saṃkruddhaḥ śvetakir nṛpaḥ / kailāsaṃ parvataṃ gatvā tapa ugraṃ samāsthitaḥ / ārādhayan mahādevaṃ niyataḥ saṃśitavrataḥ / upavāsaparo rājā dīrghakālam atiṣṭhata / kadā cid dvādaśe kāle kadā cid api ṣoḍaśe / āhāram akarod rājā mūlāni ca phalāni ca / ūrdhvabāhus tv animiṣas tiṣṭhan sthāṇur ivācalaḥ / ṣaṇmāsān abhavad rājā śvetakiḥ susamāhitaḥ / taṃ tathā nṛpaśārdūlaṃ tapyamānaṃ mahat tapaḥ / śaṃkaraḥ parayā prītyā darśayām āsa bhārata / uvāca cainaṃ bhagavān snigdhagambhīrayā girā / prīto 'smi rājaśārdūla tapasā te paraṃtapa / varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te yaṃ tvam icchasi pārthiva / etac chrutvā tu vacanaṃ rudrasyāmitatejasaḥ / praṇipatya mahātmānaṃ rājarṣiḥ pratyabhāṣata / yadi me bhagavān prītaḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ / svayaṃ māṃ devadeveśa yājayasva sureśvara / etac chrutvā tu vacanaṃ rājñā tena prabhāṣitam / uvāca bhagavān prītaḥ smitapūrvam idaṃ vacaḥ / nāsmākam etadviṣaye vartate yājanaṃ prati / tvayā ca sumahat taptaṃ tapo rājan varārthinā / yājayiṣyāmi rājaṃs tvāṃ samayena paraṃtapa / samā dvādaśa rājendra brahmacārī samāhitaḥ / satataṃ tv ājyadhārābhir yadi tarpayase 'nalam / kāmaṃ prārthayase yaṃ tvaṃ mattaḥ prāpsyasi taṃ nṛpa / evam uktas tu rudreṇa śvetakir manujādhipaḥ / tathā cakāra tat sarvaṃ yathoktaṃ śūlapāṇinā / pūrṇe tu dvādaśe varṣe punar āyān maheśvaram / dṛṣṭvaiva ca sa rājānaṃ śaṃkaro lokabhāvanaḥ / uvāca paramaprītaḥ śvetakiṃ nṛpasattamam / toṣito 'haṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha tvayeha svena karmaṇā / yājanaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tu vidhidṛṣṭaṃ paraṃtapa / ato 'haṃ tvāṃ svayaṃ nādya yājayāmi paraṃtapa / mamāṃśas tu kṣititale mahābhāgo dvijottamaḥ / durvāsā iti vikhyātaḥ sa hi tvāṃ yājayiṣyati / manniyogān mahātejāḥ saṃbhārāḥ saṃbhriyantu te / etac chrutvā tu vacanaṃ rudreṇa samudāhṛtam / svapuraṃ punar āgamya saṃbhārān punar ārjayat / tataḥ saṃbhṛtasaṃbhāro bhūyo rudram upāgamat / saṃbhṛtā mama saṃbhārāḥ sarvopakaraṇāni ca / tvatprasādān mahādeva śvo me dīkṣā bhaved iti / etac chrutvā tu vacanaṃ tasya rājño mahātmanaḥ / durvāsasaṃ samāhūya rudro vacanam abravīt / eṣa rājā mahābhāgaḥ śvetakir dvijasattama / enaṃ yājaya viprendra manniyogena bhūmipam / bāḍham ity eva vacanaṃ rudram ṛṣir uvāca ha / tataḥ satraṃ samabhavat tasya rājño mahātmanaḥ / yathāvidhi yathākālaṃ yathoktaṃ bahudakṣiṇam / tasmin parisamāpte tu rājñaḥ satre mahātmanaḥ / durvāsasābhyanujñātā vipratasthuḥ sma yājakāḥ / ye tatra dīkṣitāḥ sarve sadasyāś ca mahaujasaḥ / so 'pi rājā mahābhāgaḥ svapuraṃ prāviśat tadā / tato bhagavato vahner vikāraḥ samajāyata / tejasā viprahīṇaś ca glāniś cainaṃ samāviśat / sa lakṣayitvā cātmānaṃ tejohīnaṃ hutāśanaḥ / jagāma sadanaṃ puṇyaṃ brahmaṇo lokapūjitam / tatra brāhmaṇam āsīnam idaṃ vacanam abravīt / tejasā viprahīṇo 'smi balena ca jagatpate / iccheyaṃ tvatprasādena svātmanaḥ prakṛtiṃ sthirām / etac chrutvā tu vacanaṃ bhagavān sarvalokakṛt / havyavāham idaṃ vākyam uvāca prahasann iva / tvayā dvādaśa varṣāṇi vasor dhārāhutaṃ haviḥ / upayuktaṃ mahābhāga tena tvāṃ glānir āviśat / tejasā viprahīṇatvāt sahasā havyavāhana / mā gamas tvaṃ vyathāṃ vahne prakṛtistho bhaviṣyasi / purā devaniyogena yat tvayā bhasmasāt kṛtam / ālayaṃ devaśatrūṇāṃ sughoraṃ khāṇḍavaṃ vanam / tatra sarvāṇi sattvāni nivasanti vibhāvaso / teṣāṃ tvaṃ medasā tṛptaḥ prakṛtistho bhaviṣyasi / gaccha śīghraṃ pradagdhuṃ tvaṃ tato mokṣyasi kilbiṣāt / etac chrutvā tu vacanaṃ parameṣṭhimukhāc cyutam / uttamaṃ javam āsthāya pradudrāva hutāśanaḥ / āgamya khāṇḍavaṃ dāvam uttamaṃ javam āsthitaḥ / sahasā prajvalaty agniḥ kruddho vāyusamīritaḥ / pradīptaṃ khāṇḍavaṃ dṛṣṭvā ye sma tatra nivāsinaḥ / paramaṃ yatnam ātiṣṭhan pāvakasya praśāntaye / karais tu kariṇaḥ śīghraṃ jalam ādāya satvarāḥ / siṣicuḥ pāvakaṃ kruddhāḥ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ / bahuśīrṣās tathā nāgāḥ śirobhir jalavṛṣṭayaḥ / mumucuḥ pāvakābhyāśe satvarāḥ krodhamūrcchitāḥ / tathaivānyāni sattvāni nānāpraharaṇodyamaiḥ / vilayaṃ pāvakaṃ śīghram anayan bharatottama / anena tu prakāreṇa bhūyo bhūyaś ca prajvalan / saptakṛtvaḥ praśamitaḥ khāṇḍave havyavāhanaḥ / sa tu nairāśyam āpannaḥ sadā glānisamanvitaḥ / pitāmaham upāgacchat saṃkruddho havyavāhanaḥ / tac ca sarvaṃ yathāvṛttaṃ brahmaṇe saṃnyavedayat / uvāca cainaṃ bhagavān muhūrtaṃ sa vicintya tu / upāyaḥ paridṛṣṭo me yathā tvaṃ dhakṣyase 'nala / khāṇḍavaṃ dāvam adyaiva miṣato 'sya śatakratoḥ / naranārāyaṇau yau tau pūrvadevau vibhāvaso / saṃprāptau mānuṣaṃ lokaṃ kāryārthaṃ hi divaukasām / arjunaṃ vāsudevaṃ ca yau tau loko 'bhimanyate / tāv etau sahitau vahne khāṇḍavasya samīpataḥ / tau tvaṃ yācasva sāhāyye dāhārthaṃ khāṇḍavasya ca / tato dhakṣyasi taṃ dāvaṃ rakṣitaṃ tridaśair api / tau tu sattvāni sarvāṇi yatnato vārayiṣyataḥ / devarājaṃ ca sahitau tatra me nāsti saṃśayaḥ / etac chrutvā tu vacanaṃ tvarito havyavāhanaḥ / kṛṣṇapārthāv upāgamya yam arthaṃ tv abhyabhāṣata / taṃ te kathitavān asmi pūrvam eva nṛpottama

vulgate_text: abravīnnṛpaśārdūla tatkālasadṛśaṃ vacaḥ / didhakṣuṃ khāṇḍavaṃ dāvamakāmasya śatakratoḥ / arjuna uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / so 'bravīd arjunaṃ caiva vāsudevaṃ ca sātvatam / lokapravīrau tiṣṭhantau khāṇḍavasya samīpataḥ

vulgate_text: tamabravīdbhamaketuḥ pratigṛhya jaleśvaram / caturthaṃ lokapālānāṃ devadevaṃ sanātanam
ce_text: sa ca tac cintitaṃ jñātvā darśayām āsa pāvakam / tam abravīd dhūmaketuḥ pratipūjya jaleśvaram / caturthaṃ lokapālānāṃ rakṣitāraṃ maheśvaram

vulgate_text: bhāvumantaṃ mahāghoṣaṃ sarvaratnamanoramam / sasarja yaṃ sutapasā bhaumano bhuvanaprabhuḥ
ce_text: sarvopakaraṇair yuktam ajayyaṃ devadānavaiḥ / bhānumantaṃ mahāghoṣaṃ sarvabhūtamanoharam

vulgate_text: hanūmānnāma tejasvī kāmarūpī mahābalaḥ didhakṣanniva tatra sma saṃsthito mūrdhnyaśobhata / dhvaje bhūtāni tatrāsanvividhāni mahānti ca
ce_text: dhvaje bhūtāni tatrāsan vividhāni mahānti ca / nādena ripusainyānāṃ yeṣāṃ saṃjñā praṇaśyati

vulgate_text: cakrapāṇirhṛṣīkeśo vicaranyudhi vīryavān cakreṇa bhasmasātsarvaṃ visṛṣṭena tu vīryavān / triṣu lokeṣu tannāsti yanna kuryājjanārdanaḥ
ce_text: arjuna uvāca / cakram astraṃ ca vārṣṇeyo visṛjan yudhi vīryavān / triṣu lokeṣu tan nāsti yan na jīyāj janārdanaḥ

vulgate_text: yadi khāṇḍavameṣyati pramādā- tsagaṇo vā parirakṣituṃ mahendraḥ / śaratāḍitagātrakuṇḍalānāṃ kadanaṃ drakṣyati devavāhinīnām / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / so 'bravīd arjunaṃ caiva vāsudevaṃ ca sātvatam / lokapravīrau tiṣṭhantau khāṇḍavasya samīpataḥ

vulgate_text: dahyatastasya ca babhau rūpaṃ dāvasya bhārata / meroriva nagendrasya kīrṇasyāṃśumatoṃśubhiḥ
ce_text: dahyatas tasya vibabhau rūpaṃ dāvasya bhārata / meror iva nagendrasya kāñcanasya mahādyuteḥ

vulgate_text: sandaṣṭadaśanāścānye samutpeturanekaśaḥ / tataste'tīva ghūrṇantaḥ punaragnau prapedire
ce_text: vikṛtair darśanair anye samutpetuḥ sahasraśaḥ / tatra tatra vighūrṇantaḥ punar agnau prapedire

vulgate_text: jalāśayeṣu tapteṣu kvāthyamāneṣu vahninā / gatasatvāḥ sma dṛśyante kūrmamatsyāḥ samantataḥ
ce_text: jalasthāneṣu sarveṣu kvāthyamāneṣu bhārata / gatasattvāḥ sma dṛśyante kūrmamatsyāḥ sahasraśaḥ

vulgate_text: kāṃścidutpatataḥ pārthaḥ śaraiḥ saṃchidya khaṇḍaśaḥ / pātayāmāsa vihagānpradīpte vasuretasi
ce_text: tāṃs tathotpatataḥ pārthaḥ śaraiḥ saṃchidya khaṇḍaśaḥ / dīpyamāne tataḥ prāsyat prahasan kṛṣṇavartmani

vulgate_text: tenārciṣā susantaptā devāḥ sarṣipurogamāḥ tato jagmurmahātmānaḥ sarva eva divaukasaḥ / śatakratuṃ sahasrākṣaṃ deveśamasurārdanam / devā ūcuḥ
ce_text: tato jagmur mahātmānaḥ sarva eva divaukasaḥ / śaraṇaṃ devarājānaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ puraṃdaram

vulgate_text: kiṃ nvime mānavāḥ sarve dahyante citrabhānunā / kaccinna saṃkṣayaḥ prāpto lokānāmamareśvara / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / evam uktas tu bhagavān dhūmaketur hutāśanaḥ / cintayām āsa varuṇaṃ lokapālaṃ didṛkṣayā / ādityam udake devaṃ nivasantaṃ jaleśvaram

vulgate_text: tato'kṣamātrā vyasṛjandhārāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ / coditā devarājena jaladāḥ khāṇḍavaṃ prati
ce_text: tato 'kṣamātrā visṛjan dhārāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ / abhyavarṣat sahasrākṣaḥ pāvakaṃ khāṇḍavaṃ prati

vulgate_text: tato namucihā kruddho bhṛśamarciṣmatastadā / punareva mahāmeghairambhāṃsi vyasṛjadbahu
ce_text: tato namucihā kruddho bhṛśam arciṣmatas tadā / punar evābhyavarṣat tam ambhaḥ pravisṛjan bahu

vulgate_text: aśvaseno'bhavattatra takṣakasya suto balī / sa yatnamakarottīvraṃ mokṣārthaṃ jātavedasaḥ
ce_text: aśvasenas tu tatrāsīt takṣakasya suto balī / sa yatnam akarot tīvraṃ mokṣārthaṃ havyavāhanāt

vulgate_text: na śaśāka sa nirgantuṃ niruddho'rjunapatribhiḥ / mokṣayāmāsa taṃ mātā nigīrya bhujagātmajā
ce_text: na śaśāka vinirgantuṃ kaunteyaśarapīḍitaḥ / mokṣayām āsa taṃ mātā nigīrya bhujagātmajā

vulgate_text: tasya pūrvaṃ śiro grastaṃ pucchamasya nigīryate / nigīrya sordhvamakrāmatsutaṃ nāgī mumukṣayā
ce_text: tasya pūrvaṃ śiro grastaṃ puccham asya nigīryate / ūrdhvam ācakrame sā tu pannagī putragṛddhinī

vulgate_text: tāṃ ca māyāṃ tadā dṛṣṭā ghorāṃ nāgena vañcitaḥ / dvidhā tridhā ca khagatānprāṇinaḥ pāṇḍavocchinat
ce_text: tāṃ ca māyāṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā ghorāṃ nāgena vañcitaḥ / dvidhā tridhā ca ciccheda khagatān eva bhārata

vulgate_text: devarājo'pi taṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃrabdhaṃ samare'rjunam / svamastramasṛjattīvraṃ chādayitvā'khilaṃ nabhaḥ
ce_text: devarāḍ api taṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃrabdham iva phalgunam / svam astram asṛjad dīptaṃ yat tatānākhilaṃ nabhaḥ

vulgate_text: tato'śanimuco ghorāṃstaḍitstanitaniḥsvanān / tadvighātārthamasṛjadarjuno'pyastramuttamam
ce_text: tadvighātārtham asṛjad arjuno 'py astram uttamam / vāyavyam evābhimantrya pratipattiviśāradaḥ

vulgate_text: sicyamāno vasaughaistaiḥ prāṇināṃ dehaniḥsṛtaiḥ / prajajvālātha so'rciṣmānsvanādaiḥ pūrayañjagat
ce_text: niṣpratīkārahṛṣṭaś ca hutabhug vividhākṛtiḥ / prajajvālātulārciṣmān svanādaiḥ pūrayañ jagat

vulgate_text: tāṃścakarta śaraiḥ pārthaḥ saroṣāgnisamukṣitaiḥ / viviśuścāpi taṃ dīptaṃ dehābhāvāya pāvakam
ce_text: tāṃś cakarta śaraiḥ pārthaḥ saroṣān dṛśya khecarān / vivaśāś cāpatan dīptaṃ dehābhāvāya pāvakam

vulgate_text: vegenāśanimādāya vajramastraṃ ca so'sṛjat / hatāvetāviti prāha surānasurasūdanaḥ
ce_text: aśaniṃ gṛhya tarasā vajram astram avāsṛjat / hatāv etāv iti prāha surān asurasūdanaḥ

vulgate_text: kāladaṇḍaṃ yamo rājan gadāṃ caiva dhaneśvaraḥ / pāśāṃśca tatra varuṇo vicitrāṃ ca tathā'śanim
ce_text: kāladaṇḍaṃ yamo rājā śibikāṃ ca dhaneśvaraḥ / pāśaṃ ca varuṇas tatra vicakraṃ ca tathā śivaḥ

vulgate_text: skandaḥ śaktiṃ samādāya tasthau merurivācalaḥ / oṣadhīrdīpyamānāśca jagṛhāte'svināvapi
ce_text: oṣadhīr dīpyamānāś ca jagṛhāte 'śvināv api / jagṛhe ca dhanur dhātā musalaṃ ca jayas tathā

vulgate_text: abhītau yudhi durdharṣau tasthatuḥ sajjakārmukau / āgacchatastato devānubhau yuddhaviśāradau
ce_text: tathā tu dṛṣṭvā saṃrabdhaṃ śakraṃ devaiḥ sahācyutau / abhītau yudhi durdharṣau tasthatuḥ sajjakārmukau

vulgate_text: utpātanādaśabdena trāsitā iva cābhavan / te vanaṃ prasamīkṣyātha dahyamānamanekadhā
ce_text: taṃ dāvaṃ samudīkṣantaḥ kṛṣṇau cābhyudyatāyudhau / utpātanādaśabdena saṃtrāsita ivābhavan

vulgate_text: cakraṃ vyasṛjadatyugraṃ teṣāṃ nāśāya keśavaḥ / tenārtā jātayaḥ kṣudrāḥ sadānavaniśācarāḥ
ce_text: svatejobhāsvaraṃ cakram utsasarja janārdanaḥ / tena tā jātayaḥ kṣudrāḥ sadānavaniśācarāḥ / nikṛttāḥ śataśaḥ sarvā nipetur analaṃ kṣaṇāt

vulgate_text: nikṛttāḥ śataśaḥ sarvā nipeturanalaṃ kṣaṇāt / tatrādṛśyanta te daityāḥ kṛṣṇacakravidāritāḥ
ce_text: svatejobhāsvaraṃ cakram utsasarja janārdanaḥ / tena tā jātayaḥ kṣudrāḥ sadānavaniśācarāḥ / nikṛttāḥ śataśaḥ sarvā nipetur analaṃ kṣaṇāt

vulgate_text: chittvānekāni satvāni pāṇimeti punaḥ punaḥ / tathā tu nighnatastasya piśācoragarākṣasān
ce_text: kṣiptaṃ kṣiptaṃ hi tac cakraṃ kṛṣṇasyāmitraghātinaḥ / hatvānekāni sattvāni pāṇim eti punaḥ punaḥ

vulgate_text: nāśaknuvañśamayituṃ tadā'bhūvanparāṅmukhāḥ / śatakratustu saṃprekṣya vimukhānamarāṃstathā

ce_text: tataḥ sabhāṃ kariṣyāmi pāṇḍavāya yaśasvine / manaḥprahlādinīṃ citrāṃ sarvaratnavibhūṣitām

ce_text: tatra gatvā sa jagrāha gadāṃ śaṅkhaṃ ca bhārata / sphāṭikaṃ ca sabhādravyaṃ yad āsīd vṛṣaparvaṇaḥ / kiṃkaraiḥ saha rakṣobhir agṛhṇāt sarvam eva tat

ce_text: sabhā tu sā mahārāja śātakumbhamayadrumā / daśa kiṣkusahasrāṇi samantād āyatābhavat

vulgate_text: prababhau jvalamāneva divyā divyena varcasā navameghapratīkāśā divamākṛtya viṣṭhitā / āyatā vipulā ramyā vipāpmā vigataklamā
ce_text: nagameghapratīkāśā divam āvṛtya viṣṭhitā / āyatā vipulā ślakṣṇā vipāpmā vigataklamā

vulgate_text: dhvajotkaṭaṃ hyanavamaṃ yuddhe drakṣyasi viṣṭhitam / eva vīraḥ savyasācindhvajasyānte bhaviṣyati / vaiśampāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / athābravīn mayaḥ pārtham arjunaṃ jayatāṃ varam / āpṛcche tvāṃ gamiṣyāmi kṣipram eṣyāmi cāpy aham

vulgate_text: ahataiścaiva vāsobhirmālyairuccāvacairapi / tarpayāmāsa viprendrānnānādigbhyaḥ samāgatān
ce_text: ghṛtapāyasena madhunā bhakṣyair mūlaphalais tathā / ahataiś caiva vāsobhir mālyair uccāvacair api

vulgate_text: śrīmānmahātmā dharmātmā muñjaketurvivardhanaḥ saṅgrāmajiddurmukhaśca ugrasenaśca vīryavān
ce_text: tathaiva kṣatriyaśreṣṭhā dharmarājam upāsate / śrīmān mahātmā dharmātmā muñjaketur vivardhanaḥ

vulgate_text: aṅgo vaṅgaḥ sumitraśca śaibyaścāmitrakarśanaḥ / kirātarājaḥ sumanā yavanādhipatistathā
ce_text: kirātarājaḥ sumanā yavanādhipatis tathā / cāṇūro devarātaś ca bhojo bhīmarathaś ca yaḥ

vulgate_text: upāsate sabhāyāṃ sma kuntīputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram / arjunaṃ ye va saṃśritya rājaputrā mahābalāḥ
ce_text: arjunaṃ cāpi saṃśritya rājaputrā mahābalāḥ / aśikṣanta dhanurvedaṃ rauravājinavāsasaḥ

vulgate_text: raukmiṇeyaśca sāmbaśca yuyudhānaśca sātyakiḥ / sudharmā cāniruddhaśca śaivyaśca narapuṅgavaḥ
ce_text: tatraiva śikṣitā rājan kumārā vṛṣṇinandanāḥ / raukmiṇeyaś ca sāmbaś ca yuyudhānaś ca sātyakiḥ

vulgate_text: upāsate mahātmānamāsīnaṃ saptaviṃśatiḥ / citrasenaḥ sahāmātyo gandharvāpsarasastathā
ce_text: citrasenaḥ sahāmātyo gandharvāpsarasas tathā / gītavāditrakuśalāḥ śamyātālaviśāradāḥ

vulgate_text: nṛttagāndharvasevī ca sarvatrāpratimastathā / aṣṭādaśānāṃ vidyānāṃ kośabhūto mahādyutiḥ
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tathā tatropaviṣṭeṣu pāṇḍaveṣu mahātmasu / mahatsu copaviṣṭeṣu gandharveṣu ca bhārata / vedopaniṣadāṃ vettā ṛṣiḥ suragaṇārcitaḥ / itihāsapurāṇajñaḥ purākalpaviśeṣavit / nyāyavid dharmatattvajñaḥ ṣaḍaṅgavid anuttamaḥ / aikyasaṃyoganānātvasamavāyaviśāradaḥ / vaktā pragalbho medhāvī smṛtimān nayavit kaviḥ / parāparavibhāgajñaḥ pramāṇakṛtaniścayaḥ / pañcāvayavayuktasya vākyasya guṇadoṣavit / uttarottaravaktā ca vadato 'pi bṛhaspateḥ / dharmakāmārthamokṣeṣu yathāvat kṛtaniścayaḥ / tathā bhuvanakośasya sarvasyāsya mahāmatiḥ / pratyakṣadarśī lokasya tiryag ūrdhvam adhas tathā / sāṃkhyayogavibhāgajño nirvivitsuḥ surāsurān / saṃdhivigrahatattvajñas tv anumānavibhāgavit / ṣāḍguṇyavidhiyuktaś ca sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ / yuddhagāndharvasevī ca sarvatrāpratighas tathā / etaiś cānyaiś ca bahubhir yukto guṇagaṇair muniḥ

vulgate_text: sabhāsthānpāṇḍavāndraṣṭuṃ prīyamāṇo manojavaḥ / jayāśīrbhistu taṃ vipro dharmarājānamārcayat

vulgate_text: mandārāṇāmudārāṇāṃ vanāni pariloḍayan / saugandhīkavanānāṃ ca gandhaṃ gandhavaho vahan
ce_text: mandārāṇām udārāṇāṃ vanāni surabhīṇi ca / saugandhikānāṃ cādāya gandhān gandhavahaḥ śuciḥ

vulgate_text: tatra devāḥ sagandharvā gaṇairapsarasāṃ vṛtāḥ / divyatānairmahārāja gāyantisma sabhāgatāḥ
ce_text: tatra devāḥ sagandharvā gaṇair apsarasāṃ vṛtāḥ / divyatānena gītāni gānti divyāni bhārata

vulgate_text: brahmarṣayo bhavantyatra tathā devarṣayo'pare / kravyādāśca tathaivānye gandharvāśca mahābalāḥ
ce_text: ahaṃ ca bahuśas tasyāṃ bhavanty anye ca madvidhāḥ / ācāryāś cābhavaṃs tatra tathā devarṣayo 'pare

vulgate_text: vāmanairvikaṭaiḥ kubjaiḥ kṣatajākṣairmahāravaiḥ / medomāṃsāśanairugrairugradhanvā mahābalaḥ
ce_text: tryambako rājaśārdūla devī ca vigataklamā / vāmanair vikaṭaiḥ kubjaiḥ kṣatajākṣair manojavaiḥ

vulgate_text: upācarati tatra sma dhanānāmīśvaraṃ prabhum / kinnarāḥ śataśastatra dhanānāmīśvaraṃ prabhum
ce_text: māṃsamedovasāhārair ugraśravaṇadarśanaiḥ / nānāpraharaṇair ghorair vātair iva mahājavaiḥ / vṛtaḥ sakhāyam anvāste sadaiva dhanadaṃ nṛpa / prahṛṣṭāḥ śataśaś cānye bahuśaḥ saparicchadāḥ / gandharvāṇāṃ ca patayo viśvāvasur hahāhuhūḥ / tumburuḥ parvataś caiva śailūṣas tv atha nāradaḥ / citrasenaś ca gītajñas tathā citraratho 'pi ca / ete cānye ca gandharvā dhaneśvaram upāsate / vidyādharādhipaś caiva candrāpīḍaḥ sahānujaiḥ / upāsate mahātmānaṃ dhanānām īśvaraṃ prabhum / kiṃnarāḥ śataśas tatra dhanānām īśvaraṃ prabhum / āsate cāpi rājāno bhagadattapurogamāḥ / drumaḥ kiṃpuruṣeśaś ca upāste dhanadeśvaram / rākṣasānāṃ patiś caiva mahendro gandhamādanaḥ / saha yakṣaiḥ sagandharvaiḥ saha sarvair niśācaraiḥ / vibhīṣaṇaś ca dharmiṣṭha upāste bhrātaraṃ prabhum / himavān pāriyātraś ca vindhyakailāsamandarāḥ / malayo darduraś caiva mahendro gandhamādanaḥ / indranīlaḥ sunābhaś ca tathā divyau ca parvatau / ete cānye ca bahavaḥ sarve merupurogamāḥ / upāsate mahātmānaṃ dhanānām īśvaraṃ prabhum / nandīśvaraś ca bhagavān mahākālas tathaiva ca / śaṅkukarṇamukhāḥ sarve divyāḥ pāriṣadās tathā / kāṣṭhakūṭaḥ somanandī vijayaś ca tapodhikaḥ / śvetaś ca vṛṣabhas tatra nanarda sumahāravaḥ / dhanadaṃ rākṣasāś cānye gandharvāś ca samāsate / pariṣadgaṇaiḥ parivṛtam upayātaṃ maheśvaram / taṃ dṛṣṭvā devadeveśaṃ śivaṃ trailokyabhāvanam / praṇamya mūrdhnā paulastyo bahurūpam umāpatim / tato 'bhyanujñāṃ saṃprāpya mahādevād dhaneśvaraḥ / āste kadācid bhagavān bhavo dhanapateḥ sakhā / nidhīnāṃ pravarau mukhyau śaṅkhapadmau dhaneśvarau / sarvān nidhīn pragṛhyātha upāstāṃ vai dhaneśvaram

vulgate_text: pitāmahasabhāṃ tāta kathyamānāṃ nibodha me / śakyate yā na nirdeṣṭumevaṃrūpeti bhārata
ce_text: evaṃrūpeti sā śakyā na nirdeṣṭuṃ janādhipa / kṣaṇena hi bibharty anyad anirdeśyaṃ vapus tathā

vulgate_text: atharvāṅgirasaścaiva vālakhilyā sarīcipāḥ / mano'ntarikṣaṃ vidyāśca vāyustejo jalaṃ mahī
ce_text: bhṛgur atrir vasiṣṭhaś ca gautamaś ca tathāṅgirāḥ / mano 'ntarikṣaṃ vidyāś ca vāyus tejo jalaṃ mahī

vulgate_text: āyurvedastathā'ṣṭāṅgo dehavāṃstatra bhārata / candramāḥ saha nakṣatrairādityaśca gabhastimān
ce_text: candramāḥ saha nakṣatrair ādityaś ca gabhastimān / vāyavaḥ kratavaś caiva saṃkalpaḥ prāṇa eva ca

vulgate_text: vāyavaḥ kratavaścaiva saṅkalpaḥ prāṇa eva ca / mūrtimanto mahātmāno mahāvrataparāyaṇāḥ
ce_text: candramāḥ saha nakṣatrair ādityaś ca gabhastimān / vāyavaḥ kratavaś caiva saṃkalpaḥ prāṇa eva ca

vulgate_text: dharmacakraṃ tathā cāpi nityamāste yudhiṣṭhira / aditirditirdanuścaiva surasā vinatā irā
ce_text: aditir ditir danuś caiva surasā vinatā irā / kālakā surabhir devī saramā cātha gautamī

vulgate_text: upāsate ca saṃhṛṣṭā brahmāṇamamitaujasam / rākṣasāśca piśācāśca dānavā guhyakāstathā
ce_text: rākṣasāś ca piśācāś ca dānavā guhyakās tathā / suparṇanāgapaśavaḥ pitāmaham upāsate

vulgate_text: nāgāḥ suparṇāḥ paśavaḥ pitāmahamupāsate / sthāvarā jaṅgamāścaiva mahābhūtāstathā'pare
ce_text: rākṣasāś ca piśācāś ca dānavā guhyakās tathā / suparṇanāgapaśavaḥ pitāmaham upāsate

vulgate_text: mahāsenaśca rājendra sadopāste pitāmaham / devo nārāyaṇastasyāṃ tathā devarṣayaśca ye
ce_text: devo nārāyaṇas tasyāṃ tathā devarṣayaś ca ye / ṛṣayo vālakhilyāś ca yonijāyonijās tathā

vulgate_text: ṛṣayo vālakhilyāśca yonijāyonijāstathā yacca kiñcitriloke'smindṛśyate sthāṇu jaṅgamam / sarvaṃ tasyāṃ mayā dṛṣṭamiti viddhi narādhipa
ce_text: yac ca kiṃ cit triloke 'smin dṛśyate sthāṇujaṅgamam / sarvaṃ tasyāṃ mayā dṛṣṭaṃ tad viddhi manujādhipa

vulgate_text: kimuktavāṃśca bhagavaṃstanmamācakṣva suvrata / tvattaḥ śrotuṃ sarvamidaṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me / nārada uvāca
ce_text: nārada uvāca / sabhā vaiśravaṇī rājañ śatayojanam āyatā / vistīrṇā saptatiś caiva yojanāni sitaprabhā

vulgate_text: samāptayajño vidhivaddhariścandraḥ pratāpavān / abhiṣiktaśca śuśubhe sāmrājyena narādhipaḥ
ce_text: samāpya ca hariścandro mahāyajñaṃ pratāpavān / abhiṣiktaḥ sa śuśubhe sāmrājyena narādhipa

vulgate_text: balīnāṃ samyagutthānānnakulasya yaśasvinaḥ / dhīmataḥ sahadevasya dharmāṇāmanuśāsanāt
ce_text: evaṃ gate tatas tasmin pitarīvāśvasañ janāḥ / na tasya vidyate dveṣṭā tato 'syājātaśatrutā / parigrahān narendrasya bhīmasya paripālanāt / śatrūṇāṃ kṣapaṇāc caiva bībhatsoḥ savyasācinaḥ / dhīmataḥ sahadevasya dharmāṇām anuśāsanāt / avigrahā vītabhayāḥ svakarmaniratāḥ sadā / nikāmavarṣāḥ sphītāś ca āsañ janapadās tathā / vārdhuṣī yajñasattvāni gorakṣaṃ karṣaṇaṃ vaṇik / viśeṣāt sarvam evaitat saṃjajñe rājakarmaṇā / anukarṣaṃ ca niṣkarṣaṃ vyādhipāvakamūrchanam / sarvam eva na tatrāsīd dharmanitye yudhiṣṭhire / dasyubhyo vañcakebhyaś ca rājñaḥ prati parasparam / rājavallabhataś caiva nāśrūyata mṛṣākṛtam / priyaṃ kartum upasthātuṃ balikarma svakarmajam / abhihartuṃ nṛpāḥ ṣaṭsu pṛthak jātyaiś ca naigamaiḥ / vavṛdhe viṣayas tatra dharmanitye yudhiṣṭhire / kāmato 'py upayuñjānai rājasair lobhajair janaiḥ / sarvavyāpī sarvaguṇī sarvasāhaḥ sa sarvarāṭ / yasminn adhikṛtaḥ samrāḍ bhrājamāno mahāyaśāḥ / yatra rājan daśa diśaḥ pitṛto mātṛtas tathā / anuraktāḥ prajā āsann āgopālā dvijātayaḥ

vulgate_text: vainatyātsarvataścaiva nakulasya svabhāvataḥ / avigrahā vītabhayāḥ svakarmaniratāḥ sadā
