daśānanaḥ / nityaṃ krodhaparo vīro varadānena mohitaḥ / abhyadhāvat susaṃkruddho mahendraṃ śambaro yathā / arjuno 'py atha taṃ dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇaṃ pratyavārayat / tatas tau cakratur yuddhaṃ rāvaṇaś cārjunaś ca vai / tatas tu durjayaṃ vīraṃ varadānena darpitam / rākṣasendraṃ manuṣyendro yuddhvā jitvā raṇe balāt / baddhvā dhanur jyayā rājan viveśātha purīṃ svakām / sa tu taṃ bandhitaṃ śrutvā pulastyo rāvaṇaṃ tadā / mokṣayām āsa dṛṣṭvātha pure 'dṛṣṭvārjunaṃ tadā / tataḥ kadā cit tejasvī kārtavīryārjuno balī / samudratīraṃ gatvātha vicaran darpamohitaḥ / avākirac charaśataiḥ samudraṃ sa tu bhārata / taṃ samudro namaskṛtya kṛtāñjalir abhāṣata / āśugān vīra mā muñca brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te / madāśrayāṇi bhūtāni tvannisṛṣṭair maheṣubhiḥ / arjunaḥ / bādhyante rājaśārdūla tebhyo dehy abhayaṃ vibho / dehi sindhupate yuddham adyaiva tvarayā mama / samudraḥ / atha vā pīḍayāmi tvāṃ tasmāt tvaṃ kuru mā ciram / loke rājan mahāvīryā bahavo nivasanti ye / teṣām ekena rājendra kuru yuddhaṃ mahābala / arjunaḥ / matsamo yadi saṃgrāme varāyudhadharaḥ kva cit / samudraḥ / vidyate taṃ mamācakṣva yaḥ saheta mahāmṛdhe / maharṣir jamadagnis tu yadi rājan pariśrutaḥ / duryodhanaḥ / tasya putro raṇaṃ dātuṃ yathāvad vai tavārhati / samudrasya vacaḥ śrutvā rājā māhiṣmatīpatiḥ / nanāda sacivaiḥ pūrvaṃ krodhena mahatā vṛtaḥ / tataḥ pratiyayau śīghraṃ krodhena saha bhārata / sa tam āśramam āgamya rāmam evānvapadyata / sa rāmapratikūlāni cakāra saha bandhubhiḥ / āyāsaṃ janayām āsa rāmasya sa mahātmanaḥ / tatas tejaḥ prajajvāla rāmasyāmitatejasaḥ / pradahann iva sainyāni raśmimān iva tejasā / atha tau cakratur yuddhaṃ vṛtravāsavayor iva / tataḥ paraśum ādāya nṛpaṃ bāhusahasriṇam / ciccheda sahasā rāmo bahuśākham iva drumam / taṃ hataṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā sametāḥ sarvabāndhavāḥ / asīn ādāya śaktīś ca rāmaṃ te pratyavārayan / rāmo 'pi ratham āsthāya dhanur āyamya satvaraḥ / visṛjan paramāstrāṇi vyadhamat pārthivaṃ balam / tatas tu kṣatriyā rājañ jāmadagnyabhayārditāḥ / viviśur giridurgāṇi mṛgāḥ siṃhabhayād iva / teṣāṃ svavihitaṃ karma tadbhayān nānutiṣṭhatām / prajā vṛṣalatāṃ prāptā brāhmaṇānām adarśanāt / tathā te draviḍāḥ kāśāḥ puṇḍrāś ca śabaraiḥ saha / vṛṣalatvaṃ parigatā hy ucchinnāḥ kṣatrakarmaṇaḥ / tatas tu hatavīrāsu kṣatriyāsu punaḥ punaḥ / dvijair abhyuditaṃ kṣatraṃ tāni rāmo nihatya ca / tatas triḥsaptamaṃ vāraṃ rāmaṃ vāg aśarīriṇī / divyā provāca madhurā sarvalokapariśrutā / rāma rāma nivartasva guṇāṃś cātha prapaśyasi / kṣatrabandhūn imān prāṇair viprayujya punaḥ punaḥ / tathaiva taṃ mahātmānam ṛcīkapramukhās tathā / rāma rāma mahāvīra nivartasvety athābruvan / pitur vadham amṛṣyaṃs tu rāmaḥ provāca tān ṛṣīn / pitaraḥ / nārhā hanta bhavanto māṃ nivārayitum ity uta / nārhasi kṣatrabandhūṃs tvaṃ nihantuṃ jayatāṃ vara / duryodhanaḥ / na hi yuktas tathāghāto brāhmaṇena satā tvayā / pitṝṇāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā krodhaṃ tyaktvā sa bhārgavaḥ / aśvamedhasahasrāṇi naramedhaśatāni ca / iṣṭvā sāgaraparyantāṃ kāśyapāya mahīṃ dadau / tena rāmeṇa saṃgrāme tulyas tāta dhanaṃjayaḥ / kārtavīryeṇa ca raṇe tulyaḥ pārtho na saṃśayaḥ / raṇe vikramya rājendra pārthaṃ jetuṃ na śakyate / duryodhanaḥ / śṛṇu rājan purācintyān arjunasya ca sāhasān / arjuno dhanvināṃ śreṣṭho duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtavān purā / drupadasya pure rājan draupadyāś ca svayaṃvare / ābālavṛddhasaṃghoṣe sarvakṣatrasamāgame / kṣiprakārī jale matsyaṃ durnirīkṣyaṃ sasarja ha / sarvair nṛpair asādhyaṃ tat kārmukapravaraṃ ca vai / kṣaṇena sajyam akarot sarvakṣatrasya paśyataḥ / tato yantramayaṃ viddhvā vivāhaṃ phalguno balī / kṛṣṇayā hemamālyena skandhe sa pariveṣṭitaḥ / tatas tayā vṛtaṃ pārthaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve nṛpās tadā / roṣāt sarvāyudhān gṛhya kruddhā vīrā mahābalāḥ / vaikartanaṃ puraskṛtya sarve pārtham upādravan / sa dṛṣṭvā pārthivān sarvān kruddhān pārtho mahābalaḥ / vārayitvā śarais tīkṣṇair ajayat tatra sa svayam / jitvā tu tān mahīpālān sarvān karṇapurogamān / lebhe kṛṣṇāṃ śubhāṃ pārtho yuddhvā vīryabalāt tadā / sarvakṣatrasamūheṣu ambāṃ bhīṣmo yathā purā / tataḥ kadā cid bībhatsus tīrthayātrāṃ yayau svayam / atholūpīṃ śubhāṃ jātāṃ nāgarājasutāṃ tadā / nāgeṣv avāpa cāgryeṣu prārthito 'tha yathātatham / tato godāvarīṃ baṇṇāṃ kāverīṃ cāvagāhata / tataḥ pāṇḍyaṃ samāsādya tasya kanyām avāpa saḥ / labdhvā jiṣṇur mudaṃ tatra tato yāmyāṃ yayau diśam / sa dakṣiṇaṃ samudrāntaṃ gatvā cāpsarasāṃ ca vai / kumārītīrtham āsādya mokṣayām āsa cārjunaḥ / grāharūpānvitāḥ pañca atiśauryeṇa vai balāt / kanyātīrthaṃ samabhyetya tato dvāravatīṃ yayau / tatra kṛṣṇanideśāt sa subhadrāṃ prāpya phalgunaḥ / tām āropya rathopasthe prayayau svapurīṃ prati / athādāya gate pārthe te śrutvā sarvayādavāḥ / tam abhyadhāvan saṃkruddhāḥ siṃhaṃ vyāghragaṇā iva / pradyumnaḥ kṛtavarmā ca gadaḥ sāraṇasātyakī / āhukaś caiva sāmbaś ca cārudeṣṇo viḍūrathaḥ / anye ca yādavāḥ sarve baladevapurogamāḥ / ekam eva ṛte kṛṣṇaṃ gajavājirathair yutāḥ / athāsādya vane yāntaṃ parivārya dhanaṃjayam / cakrur yuddhaṃ susaṃkruddhā bahukoṭyaś ca yādavāḥ / eka eva tu pārthas tair yuddhaṃ cakre sudāruṇam / tena teṣāṃ samaṃ yuddhaṃ muhūrtaṃ prababhūva ha / tataḥ pārtho raṇe sarvān vārayitvā śitaiḥ śaraiḥ / balād vijitya rājendra vīras tān sarvayādavān / duryodhanaḥ / tāṃ subhadrāṃ samādāya śakraprasthaṃ viveśa ha / bhūyaḥ śṛṇu mahārāja phalgunasya tu sāhasam / dadau ca vahner bībhatsuḥ prārthitaṃ khāṇḍavaṃ vanam / labdhamātre tu tenātha bhagavān havyavāhanaḥ / bhakṣituṃ khāṇḍavaṃ rājaṃs tataḥ samupacakrame / tatas taṃ bhakṣayantaṃ vai savyasācī vibhāvasum / rathī dhanvī śarān gṛhya sa kalāpayutaḥ prabhuḥ / pālayām āsa rājendra svavīryeṇa mahābalaḥ / tataḥ śrutvā mahendras taṃ meghāṃs tān saṃdideśa ha / tenoktā meghasaṃghās te vavarṣur ativṛṣṭibhiḥ / tato meghagaṇān pārthaḥ śaravrātaiḥ samantataḥ / khagamair vārayām āsa tad āścaryam ivābhavat / vāritān meghasaṃghāṃś ca śrutvā kruddhaḥ puraṃdaraḥ / pāṇḍaraṃ gajam āsthāya sarvadevagaṇair vṛtaḥ / yayau pārthena saṃyoddhuṃ rakṣārthaṃ khāṇḍavasya ca / rudrāś ca marutaś caiva vasavaś cāśvinau tadā / ādityāś caiva sādhyāś ca viśvedevāś ca bhārata / gandharvāś caiva sahitā anye suragaṇāś ca ye / te sarve śastrasaṃpannā dīpyamānāḥ svatejasā / dhanaṃjayaṃ jighāṃsantaḥ prapetur vibudhādhipāḥ / yugānte yāni dṛśyante nimittāni mahānty api / sarvāṇi tatra dṛśyante sughorāṇi mahīpate / tato devagaṇāḥ sarve pārthaṃ samabhidudruvuḥ / asaṃbhrāntas tu tān dṛṣṭvā sa tāṃ devamayīṃ camūm / tvaritaḥ phalguno gṛhya tīkṣṇāgrān āśugāṃs tadā / śakra devāṃś ca saṃprekṣya tasthau kāla ivātyaye / tato devagaṇāḥ sarve bībhatsuṃ sapuraṃdarāḥ / avākirañ śaravrātair mānuṣaṃ taṃ mahīpate / tataḥ pārtho mahātejā gāṇḍīvaṃ gṛhya satvaraḥ / vārayām āsa devānāṃ śaravrātaiḥ śarāṃs tadā / punaḥ kruddhāḥ surāḥ sarve martyaṃ saṃkhye mahābalāḥ / nānāśastrair vavarṣus taṃ savyasāciṃ mahīpate / tān pārthaḥ śastravarṣān vai visṛṣṭān vibudhais tadā / dvidhā tridhā ca ciccheda kha eva niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ / punaś ca pārthaḥ saṃkruddho maṇḍalīkṛtakārmukaḥ / devasaṃghāñ śarais tīkṣṇair arpayad vai samantataḥ / tato devagaṇāḥ sarve yuddhvā pārthena vai muhuḥ / raṇe jetum aśakyaṃ taṃ jñātvā te bharatarṣabha / śāntās te vibudhāḥ sarve pārthabāṇābhipīḍitāḥ / sadvipaṃ vāsavaṃ tyaktvā dudruvuḥ sarvatodiśam / prācīṃ rudrāḥ sagandharvā dakṣiṇāṃ maruto yudhi / diśaṃ pratīcīṃ bhītās te vasavaś ca tathāśvinau / ādityāś caiva viśve ca dudruvur vā udaṅmukhāḥ / sādhyāś cordhvamukhā bhītāś cintayan pārthasāyakān / evaṃ suragaṇāḥ sarve prādravan sarvatodiśam / muhur muhuḥ prekṣamāṇāḥ pārtham eva sakārmukam / vidrutān devasaṃghāṃs tān raṇe dṛṣṭvā puraṃdaraḥ / tataḥ kruddho mahātejāḥ pārthaṃ bāṇair avākirat / pārtho 'pi śakraṃ vivyādha mānuṣo vibudhādhipam / tataḥ so 'śmamayaṃ varṣaṃ vyasṛjad vibudhādhipaḥ / tac charair arjuno varṣaṃ pratijaghne 'tyamarṣaṇaḥ / atha saṃvardhayām āsa tad varṣaṃ devarāḍ api / bhūya eva tadā vīryaṃ jijñāsuḥ savyasācinaḥ / so 'śmavarṣaṃ mahāvegam iṣubhiḥ pāṇḍavo 'pi ca / vilayaṃ gamayām āsa harṣayan pākaśāsanam / upādāya tu pāṇibhyām aṅgadaṃ nāma parvatam / sadrumaṃ vyasṛjac chakro jighāṃsuḥ śvetavāhanam / tato 'rjuno vegavadbhir jvalamānair ajihmagaiḥ / bāṇair vidhvaṃsayām āsa girirājaṃ sahasraśaḥ / śakraṃ ca vārayām āsa śaraiḥ pārtho balād yudhi / tataḥ śakro mahārāja raṇe vīraṃ dhanaṃjayam / jñātvā jetum aśakyaṃ taṃ tejobalasamanvitam / parāṃ prītiṃ yayau tatra putraśauryeṇa vāsavaḥ / tadā tatra na tasyāsīd divi kaś cin mahāyaśāḥ / samartho nirjaye rājann api sākṣāt prajāpatiḥ / tataḥ pārthaḥ śarair hatvā yakṣarākṣasapannagān / dīpte cāgnau mahātejāḥ pātayām āsa saṃtatam / pratiṣedhayituṃ pārthaṃ na śekus tatra ke cana / dṛṣṭvā nivāritaṃ śakraṃ divi devagaṇaiḥ saha / yathā suparṇaḥ somārthaṃ vibudhān ajayat purā / tathā jitvā surān pārthas tarpayām āsa pāvakam / tato 'rjunaḥ svavīryeṇa tarpayitvā vibhāvasum / rathaṃ dhvajaṃ hayāṃś caiva divyāstrāṇi sabhāṃ ca vai / gāṇḍīvaṃ ca dhanuḥśreṣṭhaṃ tūṇī cākṣayasāyakau / duryodhanaḥ / etāny avāpa bībhatsur lebhe kīrtiṃ ca bhārata / bhūyo 'pi śṛṇu rājendra pārtho gatvottarāṃ diśam / vijitya nava varṣāṃś ca sapurāṃś ca saparvatān / jambūdvīpaṃ vaśe kṛtvā sarvaṃ tad bharatarṣabha / balāj jitvā nṛpān sarvān kare ca viniveśya ca / ratnāny ādāya sarvāṇi gatvā caiva punaḥ purīm / tato jyeṣṭhaṃ mahātmānaṃ dharmarājaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram / rājasūyaṃ kratuśreṣṭhaṃ kārayām āsa bhārata / etāny anyāni karmāṇi kṛtavān arjunaḥ purā / arjunena samo vīrye nāsti loke pumān kva cit / devadānavayakṣāś ca piśācoragarākṣasāḥ / bhīṣmadroṇādayaḥ sarve kuravaś ca mahārathāḥ / loke sarvanṛpāś caiva vīrāś cānye dhanurdharāḥ / ete cānye ca bahavaḥ parivārya mahīpate / ekaṃ pārthaṃ raṇe yattāḥ pratiyoddhuṃ na śaknuvan / ahaṃ hi nityaṃ kauravya phalgunaṃ pratisattamam / apaśyaṃ cintayitvā taṃ samudvigno 'smi tadbhayāt / gṛhe gṛhe ca paśyāmi tāta pārtham ahaṃ sadā / śaragāṇḍīvasaṃyuktaṃ pāśahastam ivāntakam / api pārthasahasrāṇi bhītaḥ paśyāmi bhārata / pārthabhūtam idaṃ sarvaṃ nagaraṃ pratibhāti me / pārtham eva hi paśyāmi rahite tāta bhārata / dṛṣṭvā svapnagataṃ pārtham udbhrāntam iva me manaḥ / akārādīni nāmāni arjunatrastacetasaḥ / aśvāś cārthā hy ajāś caiva trāsaṃ saṃjanayanti me / nāsti pārthād ṛte tāta paravīrād bhayaṃ mama / prahlādaṃ vā baliṃ vāpi hanyād dhi vijayo raṇe / tasmāt tena mahārāja yuddham asmajjanakṣayam / ahaṃ tasya prabhāvajño nityaṃ duḥkhaṃ vasāmi ca / purāpi daṇḍakāraṇye mārīcasya yathā bhayam / dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ / bhaved rāme mahāvīrye tathā pārthe bhayaṃ mama / jānāmy eva mahāvīryaṃ jiṣṇor etad durāsadam / tāta vīrasya pārthasya mā kārṣīs tvaṃ tu vipriyam / dyūtaṃ vā śastrayuddhaṃ vā durvākyaṃ vā kadā cana / eteṣv evaṃ kṛte tasya vigrahaś caiva vo bhavet / tasmāt tvaṃ putra pārthena nityaṃ snehena vartaya / yaś ca pārthena saṃbandhād vartate ca naro bhuvi / tasya nāsti bhayaṃ kiñ cit triṣu lokeṣu bhārata / duryodhanaḥ / tasmāt tvaṃ jiṣṇunā vatsa nityaṃ snehena vartaya / dyūte pārthasya kauravya māyayā nikṛtiḥ kṛtā / dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ / tasmād dhi taṃ jahi tadā anyopāyo na no bhavet / upāyaś ca na kartavyaḥ pāṇḍavān prati bhārata / pārthān prati purā vatsa bahūpāyāḥ kṛtās tvayā / tāny apāyāni kaunteyā bahuśo vyaticakramuḥ / tasmād dhitaṃ jīvitāya naḥ kulasya janasya ca / tvaṃ cikīrṣasi ced vatsa samitraḥ sahabāndhavaḥ / sabhrātṛkas tvaṃ pārthena nityaṃ snehena vartaya / vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ / dhṛtarāṣṭravacaḥ śrutvā rājā duryodhanas tadā / cintayitvā muhūrtaṃ tu vidhinā codito 'bravīt

vulgate_text: sa tānyanyāni karmāṇi kṛtavānarjunaḥ purā / arjunena samo vīrye triṣu lokeṣu na kvacit
ce_text: saṃnaddho hy arjuno yāti vivṛtya parameṣudhī / gāṇḍīvaṃ muhur ādatte niḥśvasaṃś ca nirīkṣate / acireṇaiva kālena niḥśeṣaṃ naḥ kariṣyati / na paśyāmi raṇe kruddhaṃ bībhatsuṃ prativāraṇam / bhīṣmadroṇau ca karṇaś ca drauṇiś ca rathināṃ varaḥ / kṛpaś ca vṛṣasenaś ca vikarṇaś ca jayadrathaḥ / bāhlīkaḥ somadattaś ca bhūrir bhūriśravāḥ śalaḥ / śakuniḥ sasutaś caiva nṛpāś cānye ca kauravāḥ / ete sarve raṇe yattāḥ pārthaṃ soḍhuṃ na śaknuvan / arjunena samo vīrye nāsti loke dhanurdharaḥ / dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ / yo 'rjunenārjunas tulyo dvibāhur bahubāhunā / kas tvayoktaḥ pumān vīro bībhatsusamavikramaḥ / duryodhanaḥ / taṃ me brūhi mahāvīryaṃ śrotum icchāmi putraka / kārtavīryārjuno nāma rājā bāhusahasravān / hehayādhipatir vīraḥ pāñcadaśyaḥ pitāmahāt / dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ / gāndhārīputra sarvāṃs tān kārtavīryapitāmahān / duryodhanaḥ / ānupūrvyāc ca me śaṃsa tatas taṃ pārthivaṃ tathā / kārtavīryasya caritaṃ śṛṇu rājan mahātmanaḥ / avyaktaprabhavo brahmā sarvalokapitāmahaḥ / brahmaṇo 'triḥ suto vidvān atreḥ putro niśākaraḥ / somasya tu budhaḥ putro budhasya tu purūravāḥ / tasyāpy atha suto 'py āyur āyos tu nahuṣaḥ sutaḥ / nahuṣasya yayātis tu yayātes tanujo yaduḥ / yadoḥ putro mahārāja sahasraujeti viśrutaḥ / sahasraujaḥsuto rājaṃś cakradāseti viśrutaḥ / cakradāsasya dāyādo hehayo nāma pārthivaḥ / hehayasyābhavat putro dharmanetra iti śrutaḥ / dharmanetrasya kārtas tu kṛtavīryas tu kārtajaḥ / kṛtavīryasya tanayo arjuno balināṃ varaḥ / sa cārjuno mahārāja tapo ghoraṃ cakāra ha / sāgraṃ varṣāyutaṃ taptvā tapaḥ paramaduścaram / dattam ārādhayām āsa so 'rjuno 'trisutaṃ munim / tasya datto varān prādāc caturaḥ pārthivasya vai / pūrvaṃ bāhusahasraṃ tu prārthitaḥ prathamo varaḥ / adharme prīyamāṇasya sadbhis tatra nivāraṇam / dharmeṇa pṛthivīṃ jitvā dharmeṇaivānurañjayan / saṃgrāmān subahūñ jitvā hatvā cārīn sahasraśaḥ / saṃgrāme yatamānasya vadhaś caivādhikād raṇe / tasya bāhusahasraṃ tu yudhyataḥ kila bhārata / ratho dhvajaś ca saṃjajña ity evaṃ me śrutaṃ purā / tathaivaṃ pṛthivī rājan saptadvīpā sapattanā / sasamudrākarā tāta balinogreṇa vai jitā / sa cārjuno 'tha tejasvī saptadvīpeśvaro 'bhavat / sa ca rājā mahāyajñān ājahāra mahābalaḥ / duryodhanaḥ / mahīṃ ca sakalāṃ jitvā asakṛt sa samā bahūḥ / tato 'rjunaḥ kadā cid vai rājan māhiṣmatīpatiḥ / narmadāṃ bharataśreṣṭha snātuṃ dārair yayau saha / tatas tu sa nadīṃ gatvā vulgate_text: tataḥ samprasthite tatra dharmarāje tadā nṛpa / janāḥ samantāddraṣṭuṃ taṃ samāruruhurāturāḥ

rajasāpy avakīrṇāni parityaktāni daivataiḥ / mūṣakaiḥ paridhāvadbhir udbilair āvṛtāni ca / apetodakadhūmāni hīnasaṃmārjanāni ca / pranaṣṭabalikarmejyāmantrahomajapāni ca / duṣkāleneva bhagnāni bhinnabhājanavanti ca / asmattyaktāni veśmāni saubalaḥ pratipadyatām / vanaṃ nagaram adyās tu yatra gacchanti pāṇḍavāḥ / asmābhiś ca parityaktaṃ puraṃ saṃpadyatāṃ vanam / bilāni daṃṣṭriṇaḥ sarve sthānāni mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ / tyajantv asmadbhayād bhītā gajāḥ siṃhā vanāny api / anākrāntaṃ prapadyantu sevyamānaṃ tyajantu ca / tṛṇamāṃsaphalādānāṃ deśāṃs tu samṛgadvipān / vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ / vayaṃ pārthair vane samyak saha vatsyāma nirvṛtāḥ / ity evaṃ vividhā vāco nānājanasamīritāḥ / śuśrāva pārthaḥ śrutvā ca na vicakre 'sya mānasam / tataḥ prāsādasaṃsthās tu samantād vai gṛhe gṛhe / brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ caiva yoṣitaḥ / tataḥ prāsādajālāni utpāṭyāvaraṇāni ca / dadṛśuḥ pāṇḍavān dīnān valkalājinavāsasaḥ / kṛṣṇāṃ cādṛṣṭapūrvāṃ tāṃ vrajantīṃ padbhir eva ca / ekavastrāṃ rudantīṃ tāṃ muktakeśīṃ rajasvalām / dṛṣṭvā tadā striyaḥ sarvā vivarṇavadanā bhṛśam / vilapya bahudhā mohād duḥkhaśokena pīḍitāḥ / hā hā hā dhig dhig ity uktvā netrair aśrūṇy avartayan / janasyātha vulgate_text: kathaṃ gacchati kaunteyo dharmaputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / bhīmasenaḥ savyasācī mādrīputrī ca pāṇḍavau
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / kathaṃ gacchati kaunteyo dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / bhīmasenaḥ savyasācī mādrīputrau ca tāv ubhau

vulgate_text: bāhū viśālau kṛtvā'sau tena bhīmopi gacchati / bāhū vidarśayanrājanbāhudraviṇadarpitaḥ
ce_text: bāhū viśālau kṛtvā tu tena bhīmo 'pi gacchati / bāhū darśayamāno hi bāhudraviṇadarpitaḥ / cikīrṣan karma śatrubhyo bāhudravyānurūpataḥ

vulgate_text: prasthāpya pāṇḍavāñśeṣānniḥ śeṣaste bhaviṣyati / iti dhaumyo vyavasito raudrasāmāni gāyati / dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca

vulgate_text: kimabruvannaikṛtikaḥ kiṃ vā nāgarikā janāḥ / tathyena me samācakṣva kṣattaḥ sarvamaśeṣataḥ / vidura uvāca
ce_text: vidura uvāca / vastreṇa saṃvṛtya mukhaṃ kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / bāhū viśālau kṛtvā tu bhīmo gacchati pāṇḍavaḥ

vulgate_text: hāhā gacchanti no nāthāḥ samavekṣadhvamīdṛśam / aho dhikkuruvṛddhānāṃ bālānāmiva ceṣṭitam

vulgate_text: durvinīteṣu lubdheṣu kā prītiḥ kauraveṣu naḥ / iti paurāḥ suduḥ khārtāḥ krośanti sma punaḥ punaḥ

vulgate_text: evamete mahotpātāḥ prādurāsandurāsadāḥ / bharatānāmabhāvāya rājandurmantrite tava / vaiśampāyana uvāca

ce_text: bhāratānāṃ striyaḥ sarvā gāndhāryā saha saṃgatāḥ / prākrośan bhairavaṃ tatra dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇāṃ sabhāgatām

vulgate_text: prajābhiḥsaha saṅgamya hyanuśocanti nityaśaḥ / agnihotrāṇi sāyāhne ca cāhūyanta sarvaśaḥ
ce_text: agnihotrāṇi sāyāhne na cāhūyanta sarvaśaḥ / brāhmaṇāḥ kupitāś cāsan draupadyāḥ parikarṣaṇe

vulgate_text: evaṃ kṛte mahārāja paraṃ śreyastvamāpsyasi / evaṃ gāvalgaṇe kṣattā dharmārthasahitaṃ vacaḥ
ce_text: evaṃ gāvalgaṇe kṣattā dharmārthasahitaṃ vacaḥ / uktavān na gṛhītaṃ ca mayā putrahitepsayā

vulgate_text: śrīvedavyāsāya namaḥ / nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam / devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet / janamejaya uvāca / evaṃ dyūtajitāḥ pārthāḥ kopitāśca durātmabhiḥ dhārtarāṣṭraiḥ sahāmātyairnikṛtyā dvijasattama
ce_text: janamejaya uvāca / evaṃ dyūtajitāḥ pārthāḥ kopitāś ca durātmabhiḥ / dhārtarāṣṭraiḥ sahāmātyair nikṛtyā dvijasattama

vulgate_text: anīcairnāpyaviṣayairnādharmiṣṭhairviśeṣataḥ ye guṇāḥ kīrtitā loke dharmakāmārthasaṃbhavāḥ / lokācāreṣu saṃbhūtā vedoktāḥ śiṣṭasaṃmatāḥ
ce_text: ye guṇāḥ kīrtitā loke dharmakāmārthasaṃbhavāḥ / lokācārātmasaṃbhūtā vedoktāḥ śiṣṭasaṃmatāḥ

vulgate_text: cakṣurdadyānmano dadyādvācaṃ dadyācca sūnṛtām / anuvrajedupāsīta sa yajñaḥ pañcadakṣiṇaḥ
ce_text: cakṣur dadyān mano dadyād vācaṃ dadyāc ca sūnṛtām / pratyudgamyābhigamanaṃ kuryān nyāyena cārcanam

vulgate_text: parityaktuṃ na śaknomi dānaśaktiśca nāsti me / kathamatra mayā kāryaṃ tadbūhi bhagavanmama / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvaryāṃ teṣām akliṣṭakarmaṇām / vanaṃ yiyāsatāṃ viprās tasthur bhikṣābhujo 'grataḥ / tān uvāca tato rājā kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ

vulgate_text: [vipratyāgasamādhisthaḥ saṃyatātmā dṛḍhavrataḥ dharmarājo viśuddhātmā tapa ātiṣṭhaduttamam ]
ce_text: evam uktas tu dhaumyena tat kālasadṛśaṃ vacaḥ / dharmarājo viśuddhātmā tapa ātiṣṭhad uttamam

vulgate_text: puṣpopahārairbalibhirarcayitvā divākaram / so'vagāhya jalaṃ rājā devasyābhimukho'bhavat
ce_text: puṣpopahārair balibhir arcayitvā divākaram / yogam āsthāya dharmātmā vāyubhakṣo jitendriyaḥ / gāṅgeyaṃ vāry upaspṛṣya prāṇāyāmena tasthivān / śuciḥ prayatavāg bhūtvā stotram ārabdhavāṃs tataḥ / yudhiṣṭhira uvāca / tvaṃ bhāno jagataś cakṣus tvam ātmā sarvadehinām / tvaṃ yoniḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tvam ācāraḥ kriyāvatām / tvaṃ gatiḥ sarvasāṃkhyānāṃ yogināṃ tvaṃ parāyaṇam / anāvṛtārgaladvāraṃ tvaṃ gatis tvaṃ mumukṣatām / tvayā saṃdhāryate lokas tvayā lokaḥ prakāśyate / tvayā pavitrīkriyate nirvyājaṃ pālyate tvayā / tvām upasthāya kāle tu brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ / svaśākhāvihitair mantrair arcanty ṛṣigaṇārcitam / tava divyaṃ rathaṃ yāntam anuyānti varārthinaḥ / siddhacāraṇagandharvā yakṣaguhyakapannagāḥ / trayastriṃśac ca vai devās tathā vaimānikā gaṇāḥ / sopendrāḥ samahendrāś ca tvām iṣṭvā siddhim āgatāḥ / upayānty arcayitvā tu tvāṃ vai prāptamanorathāḥ / divyamandāramālābhis tūrṇaṃ vidyādharottamāḥ / guhyāḥ pitṛgaṇāḥ sapta ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ / te pūjayitvā tvām eva gacchantyāśu pradhānatām / vasavo maruto rudrā ye ca sādhyā marīcipāḥ / vālakhilyādayaḥ siddhāḥ śreṣṭhatvaṃ prāṇināṃ gatāḥ / sabrahmakeṣu lokeṣu saptasv apy akhileṣu ca / na tad bhūtam ahaṃ manye yad arkād atiricyate / santi cānyāni sattvāni vīryavanti mahānti ca / na tu teṣāṃ tathā dīptiḥ prabhāvo vā yathā tava / jyotīṃṣi tvayi sarvāṇi tvaṃ sarvajyotiṣāṃ patiḥ / tvayi satyaṃ ca sattvaṃ ca sarve bhāvāś ca sāttvikāḥ / tvattejasā kṛtaṃ cakraṃ sunābhaṃ viśvakarmaṇā / devārīṇāṃ mado yena nāśitaḥ śārṅgadhanvanā / tvam ādāyāṃśubhis tejo nidāghe sarvadehinām / sarvauṣadhirasānāṃ ca punar varṣāsu muñcasi / tapanty anye dahanty anye garjanty anye tathā ghanāḥ / vidyotante pravarṣanti tava prāvṛṣi raśmayaḥ / na tathā sukhayaty agnir na prāvārā na kambalāḥ / śītavātārditaṃ loke yathā tava marīcayaḥ / trayodaśadvīpavatīṃ gobhir bhāsayase mahīm / trayāṇām api lokānāṃ hitāyaikaḥ pravartase / tava yady udayo na syād andhaṃ jagad idaṃ bhavet / na ca dharmārthakāmeṣu pravarteran manīṣiṇaḥ / ādhānapaśubandheṣṭimantrayajñatapaḥkriyāḥ / tvatprasādād avāpyante brahmakṣatraviśāṃ gaṇaiḥ / yad ahar brahmaṇaḥ proktaṃ sahasrayugasaṃmitam / tasya tvam ādir antaś ca kālajñaiḥ parikīrtitaḥ / manūnāṃ manuputrāṇāṃ jagato 'mānavasya ca / manvantarāṇāṃ sarveṣām īśvarāṇāṃ tvam īśvaraḥ / saṃhārakāle saṃprāpte tava krodhaviniḥsṛtaḥ / saṃvartakāgnis trailokyaṃ bhasmīkṛtyāvatiṣṭhate / tvaddīdhitisamutpannā nānāvarṇā mahāghanāḥ / sairāvatāḥ sāśanayaḥ kurvanty ābhūtasaṃplavam / kṛtvā dvādaśadhātmānaṃ dvādaśādityatāṃ gataḥ / saṃhṛtyaikārṇavaṃ sarvaṃ tvaṃ śoṣayasi raśmibhiḥ / tvām indram āhus tvaṃ rudras tvaṃ viṣṇus tvaṃ prajāpatiḥ / tvam agnis tvaṃ manaḥ sūkṣmaṃ prabhus tvaṃ brahma śāśvatam / tvaṃ haṃsaḥ savitā bhānur aṃśumālī vṛṣākapiḥ / vivasvān mihiraḥ pūṣā mitro dharmas tathaiva ca / sahasraraśmir ādityas tapanas tvaṃ gavāṃ patiḥ / mārtaṇḍo 'rko raviḥ sūryaḥ śaraṇyo dinakṛt tathā / divākaraḥ saptasaptir dhāmakeśī virocanaḥ / āśugāmī tamoghnaś ca haritāśvaś ca kīrtyase / saptamyām atha vā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ bhaktyā pūjāṃ karoti yaḥ / anirviṇṇo 'nahaṃkārī taṃ lakṣmīr bhajate naram / na teṣām āpadaḥ santi nādhayo vyādhayas tathā / ye tavānanyamanasaḥ kurvanty arcanavandanam / sarvarogair virahitāḥ sarvapāpavivarjitāḥ / tvadbhāvabhaktāḥ sukhino bhavanti cirajīvinaḥ / tvaṃ mamāpy annakāmasya sarvātithyaṃ cikīrṣataḥ / annam annapate dātum abhitaḥ śraddhayārhasi / ye ca te 'nucarāḥ sarve pādopāntaṃ samāśritāḥ / māṭharāruṇadaṇḍādyās tāṃs tān vande 'śanikṣubhān / kṣubhayā sahitā maitrī yāś cānyā bhūtamātaraḥ / tāś ca sarvā namasyāmi pāntu māṃ śaraṇāgatam / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / evaṃ stuto mahārāja bhāskaro lokabhāvanaḥ

vulgate_text: stavena kena viprarṣe sa tu rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / viprārthamārādhitavānsūryamadbhutavikramam
ce_text: janamejaya uvāca / kathaṃ kurūṇām ṛṣabhaḥ sa tu rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / viprārtham ārādhitavān sūryam adbhutavikramam

vulgate_text: mayi sneho'sti cedbrahmanyadyanugrahabhāgaham bhagavannāsti cedgudyaṃ tacca me brūhi sāṃpratam / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca

vulgate_text: bhūtāśrayo bhūtapati- sarvabhūtaniṣevitaḥ maṇiḥ suvarṇo bhūtātmā kāmadaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ / [sraṣṭā saṃvartako vahniḥ sarvasyādiralolupaḥ
ce_text: bhūtāśrayo bhūtapatiḥ sarvabhūtaniṣevitaḥ / maṇiḥ suvarṇo bhūtādiḥ kāmadaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ

vulgate_text: nāsti dharme sahāyatvamiti me dīryate manaḥ / yatra pāṇḍusutāḥ sarve kliśyanti vānamāgatāḥ / vidura uvāca
ce_text: vidura uvāca / trivargo 'yaṃ dharmamūlo narendra; rājyaṃ cedaṃ dharmamūlaṃ vadanti / dharme rājan vartamānaḥ svaśaktyā; putrān sarvān pāhi kuntīsutāṃś ca

vulgate_text: [yaśo ne naśyejjñātibhedaśca na syā- ddharmo na syānnaiva caivaṃ kṛte tvām ] / etatkārye tava sarvapradhānaṃ teṣāṃ tuṣṭiḥ śakuneścāvamānaḥ
ce_text: etat kāryaṃ tava sarvapradhānaṃ; teṣāṃ tuṣṭiḥ śakuneś cāvamānaḥ / evaṃ śeṣaṃ yadi putreṣu te syād; etad rājaṃs tvaramāṇaḥ kuruṣva

vulgate_text: duryodhanaṃ tvahitaṃ vai nigṛhya pāṇḍoḥ putraṃ prakuruṣvādhipatye / dhruvaṃ vināśastava putreṇa dhīman sabandhuvargeṇa sahaiva rājabhiḥ
ce_text: yady etad evam anumantā sutas te; saṃprīyamāṇaḥ pāṇḍavair ekarājyam / tāpo na te vai bhavitā prītiyogāt; tvaṃ cen na gṛhṇāsi sutaṃ sahāyaiḥ / athāparo bhavati hi taṃ nigṛhya; pāṇḍoḥ putraṃ prakuruṣvādhipatye

vulgate_text: yudhiṣṭhiramupāgamya pūjayāmāsa saṃjayaḥ / bhīmārjunayamāścāpi tadyuktaṃ pratipedire
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhiram athābhyetya pūjayām āsa saṃjayaḥ / bhīmārjunayamāṃś cāpi tadarhaṃ pratyapadyata

vulgate_text: [nāgamiṣyanti te dhīrā akṛtvā kālasaṃvidam āgamiṣyanti cenmohātpunardyūtena tāñjaya ] / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / gate tu vidure rājann āśramaṃ pāṇḍavān prati / dhṛtarāṣṭro mahāprājñaḥ paryatapyata bhārata

vulgate_text: priyaṃ sarve kariṣyāmo rājñaḥ kiṃ karavāmahe / na cāsya śaknumaḥ sthātuṃ priye sarve hyatandritāḥ
ce_text: priyaṃ sarve cikīrṣāmo rājñaḥ kiṃkarapāṇayaḥ / na cāsya śaknumaḥ sarve priye sthātum atandritāḥ

vulgate_text: pāṇḍavānprāpya tānrātrau kirmīro nāma rākṣasaḥ / avṛtya mārgaṃ raudrātmā tasthau girivācalaḥ
ce_text: itaḥ pracyavatāṃ rātrau yaḥ sa teṣāṃ mahātmanām / āvṛtya mārgaṃ raudrātmā tasthau girir ivācalaḥ

vulgate_text: ākramya ca kaṭīdeśe jānunā rākṣasādhamam / pīḍayāmāsa pāṇibhyāṃ tasya kaṇṭhaṃvṛkodaraḥ
ce_text: ākramya sa kaṭīdeśe jānunā rākṣasādhamam / apīḍayata bāhubhyāṃ kaṇṭhaṃ tasya vṛkodaraḥ

vulgate_text: ātiṣṭhastvamathaikena pādena niyamasthitaḥ / lokapravṛttihetostvamiti vyāso mamābravīt
ce_text: prabhāsaṃ cāpy athāsādya tīrthaṃ puṇyajanocitam / tathā kṛṣṇa mahātejā divyaṃ varṣasahasrakam / ātiṣṭhas tapa ekena pādena niyame sthitaḥ

vulgate_text: tathā parjanyaghoṣeṇa rathenādityavarcasā / ahārṣī rukmiṇīṃ bhaiṣmīṃ raṇe nirjitya rukmiṇe
ce_text: tathā parjanyaghoṣeṇa rathenādityavarcasā / avākṣīr mahiṣīṃ bhojyāṃ raṇe nirjitya rukmiṇam

vulgate_text: tathā nārāyaṇa purā kratubhirbhūridakṣiṇaiḥ / iṣṭavāṃstvaṃ mahāsatraṃ kṛṣṇa caitrarathe vane
ce_text: turāyaṇādibhir deva kratubhir bhūridakṣiṇaiḥ / ayajo bhūritejā vai kṛṣṇa caitrarathe vane

vulgate_text: evamukte tu vacane keśevena mahātmanā / tasminvīrasamāvāye saṃrabdheṣvatha rājasu
ce_text: tasmin vīrasamāvāye saṃrabdheṣv atha rājasu / dhṛṣṭadyumnamukhair vīrair bhrātṛbhiḥ parivāritā

vulgate_text: dhṛṣṭadyumnamukhairvīrairbhrātṛbhiḥ parivāritā pāñcālī puṇḍarīkākṣamāsīnaṃ yādavaiḥ saha / abhigamyābravītkṛṣṇā śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaiṣiṇī / draupadyuvāca
ce_text: pāñcālī puṇḍarīkākṣam āsīnaṃ yādavaiḥ saha / abhigamyābravīt kṛṣṇā śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaiṣiṇī

vulgate_text: dyauśca te śirasā vyāptā padbhyāṃ ca pṛthivīprabho / jaṭhare khamime lokāḥ puruṣosi sanātanaḥ
ce_text: divaṃ te śirasā vyāptaṃ padbhyāṃ ca pṛthivī vibho / jaṭharaṃ te ime lokāḥ puruṣo 'si sanātanaḥ

vulgate_text: keśagrahamanuprāptā kā nu jīveta mādṛśī / pañcānāmindrakalpānāṃ prekṣatāṃ madhusūdana
ce_text: kacagraham anuprāptā sāsmi kṛṣṇa varā satī / pañcānām indrakalpānāṃ prekṣatāṃ madhusūdana

vulgate_text: caturbhiḥ kāraṇaiḥ kṛṣṇa tvayā rakṣyā'smi nityaśaḥ / saṃbandhādgauravātsakhyātprabhutvenaiva keśava / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / evaṃ vinihataṃ saṃkhye kirmīraṃ rākṣasottamam / śrutvā dhyānaparo rājā niśaśvāsārtavat tadā

vulgate_text: ābabhāṣe mahārāja draupadīmarjunastadā mā rodīḥ śubhatāmrākṣi yadāha madhusūdanaḥ / tathā tadbhavitā devi nānyathā varavarṇini / dhṛṣṭadyumna uvāca
ce_text: dhṛṣṭadyumna uvāca / ahaṃ droṇaṃ haniṣyāmi śikhaṇḍī tu pitāmaham / duryodhanaṃ bhīmasenaḥ karṇaṃ hantā dhanaṃjayaḥ

vulgate_text: putrāṇāṃ tava rājendra tvannimittamiti prabho / tatrācakṣamahaṃ doṣānyairbhavānvyatiropitaḥ
ce_text: vaicitravīryaṃ rājānam alaṃ dyūtena kaurava / putrāṇāṃ tava rājendra tvannimittam iti prabho

vulgate_text: athainamavinītena suhṛdo nāma durhṛdaḥ / sabhāsado'nuvarteraṃstāṃśca inyāṃ durodarān
ce_text: athainān abhinīyaivaṃ suhṛdo nāma durhṛdaḥ / sabhāsadaś ca tān sarvān bhedayeyaṃ durodarān

vulgate_text: atikhyātakulairvīrairdṛṣṭavīryaiśca saṃyuge madhyamena ca gulmena rakṣibhiḥ sā surakṣitā / utkṣiptagulmaiśca tathā hayaiśca sapatākibhiḥ
ce_text: madhyamena ca gulmena rakṣitā sārasaṃjñitā / utkṣiptagulmaiś ca tathā hayaiś caiva padātibhiḥ

vulgate_text: amṛṣyamāṇopasavyaṃ sālvaḥ samitidāruṇaḥ / yantāramasya sahasā tribhirbāṇaiḥ samārdayat
ce_text: amṛṣyamāṇo 'pasavyaṃ pradyumnena sa saubharāṭ / yantāram asya sahasā tribhir bāṇaiḥ samarpayat

vulgate_text: te hayāṃśca rathaṃ caiva dhvajaṃ dārukameva ca / chādayāmāsurasurāstairbāṇairmarmabhedibhiḥ
ce_text: te hayān me rathaṃ caiva tadā dārukam eva ca / chādayām āsur asurā bāṇair marmavibhedibhiḥ

vulgate_text: tato gadā halāḥ prāsāḥ śūlaśaktiparaścathāḥ asayaḥ śaktikuliśapāśarṣṭikanapāḥ śarāḥ / paṭṭasāśca bhuśuṇḍyaśca prapatantyaniśaṃ mayi
ce_text: tato huḍahuḍāḥ prāsāḥ śaktiśūlaparaśvadhāḥ / paṭṭiśāś ca bhuśuṇḍyaś ca prāpatann aniśaṃ mayi

vulgate_text: aṅgārapāṃsuvarṣaṃ ca śastravarṣaṃ ca bhārata / evaṃ māyāṃ prakurvāṇo yodhayāmāsa māṃ ripuḥ
ce_text: evaṃ māyāṃ vikurvāṇo yodhayām āsa māṃ ripuḥ / vijñāya tad ahaṃ sarvaṃ māyayaiva vyanāśayam / yathākālaṃ tu yuddhena vyadhamaṃ sarvataḥ śaraiḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ parvatabhārārtānmandaprāṇaviceṣṭitān / hayānsaṃdṛśya māṃ sūtaḥ prāha tātkālikaṃ vacaḥ
ce_text: tataḥ parvatabhārārtā mandaprāṇaviceṣṭitāḥ / hayā mama mahārāja vepamānā ivābhavan

vulgate_text: mayyāgate'thavā vīra dyūtaṃ na bhavitā tathā / adyāhaṃ kiṃ kariṣyāmi bhinnaseturivodakam / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / evam uktvā mahābāhuḥ kauravaṃ puruṣottamaḥ / āmantrya prayayau dhīmān pāṇḍavān madhusūdanaḥ

vulgate_text: yā tvā'haṃ kauśikairvastraiḥ śubhrairācchāditaṃ purā / dṛṣṭavatyasmirājenadra sā'dya paśyāmi cīriṇam
ce_text: yā vai tvā kauśikair vastraiḥ śubhrair bahudhanaiḥ purā / dṛṣṭavaty asmi rājendra sā tvāṃ paśyāmi cīriṇam

vulgate_text: satkṛtāni sahasrāṇi sarvakāmaiḥ purā gṛhe sarvakāmaiḥ suvihitairyadapūjayathā dvijān / tacca rājannapaśyantyāḥ kā śāntirhṛdayasya me
ce_text: yad apaśyaṃ sabhāyāṃ tvāṃ rājabhiḥ parivāritam / tac ca rājann apaśyantyāḥ kā śāntir hṛdayasya me

vulgate_text: drupadasya kule jātāṃ snuṣāṃ pāṇḍormahātmanaḥ dhṛṣṭadyumnasya bhaginīṃ vīrapatnīmanuvratām / māṃ vai vanagatāṃ dṛṣṭvā kasmātkṣamasi pārthiva
ce_text: drupadasya kule jātāṃ snuṣāṃ pāṇḍor mahātmanaḥ / māṃ te vanagatāṃ dṛṣṭvā kasmān manyur na vardhate

vulgate_text: tasmānnātyutsṛjettejo na ca nityaṃ mṛdurbhavet / kālekāle tu saṃprāpte mṛdustīkṣṇopi vā bhavet
ce_text: yasmād udvijate lokaḥ kathaṃ tasya bhavo bhavet / antaraṃ hy asya dṛṣṭvaiva loko vikurute dhruvam / tasmān nātyutsṛjet tejo na ca nityaṃ mṛdur bhavet

vulgate_text: kāraṇe bhavatī kruddhā dhārtarāṣṭrasya durmateḥ yena krodhaṃ mahāprajñe bahudhā bahumanyase / krodhamūlaṃ haraṃ śatruṃ kāraṇaiḥ śṛṇu taṃ mama / yudhiṣṭhira uvāca
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca / krodho hantā manuṣyāṇāṃ krodho bhāvayitā punaḥ / iti viddhi mahāprājñe krodhamūlau bhavābhavau

vulgate_text: yo hi saṃharate krodhaṃ bhāvastasya suśobhane yo na saṃharate krodhaṃ tasyābhāvo bhavatyuta / abhāvakāraṇaṃ tasmātkrodho bhavati śobhane
ce_text: yo hi saṃharate krodhaṃ bhāvas tasya suśobhane / yaḥ punaḥ puruṣaḥ krodhaṃ nityaṃ na sahate śubhe / tasyābhāvāya bhavati krodhaḥ paramadāruṇaḥ

vulgate_text: satyaṃcānṛtataḥ śreyo nṛśaṃsāccānṛśaṃsatā tamevaṃ bahudoṣaṃ ta krodhaṃ sadbhirvivarjitam / mādṛśo visṛjettasmātsarvalokavināśanam
ce_text: satyaṃ cānṛtataḥ śreyo nṛśaṃsāc cānṛśaṃsatā / tam evaṃ bahudoṣaṃ tu krodhaṃ sādhuvivarjitam / mādṛśaḥ prasṛjet kasmāt suyodhanavadhād api

vulgate_text: pitāmahaḥ śāntanavaḥ raśamaṃ saṃpūjayiṣyati / kṛṣṇaśca devakīputraḥ śamaṃ saṃpūjayiṣyati
ce_text: pitāmahaḥ śāṃtanavaḥ śamaṃ saṃpūjayiṣyati / ācāryo viduraḥ kṣattā śamam eva vadiṣyataḥ / kṛpaś ca saṃjayaś caiva śamam eva vadiṣyataḥ

vulgate_text: bhuñjate rukmapātrībhiryatrāhaṃ paricārikā āraṇyakebhyo vanyāni bhojanāni prayacchasi / nādeyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaste gṛhe kiṃcana vidyate
ce_text: āraṇyakebhyo lauhāni bhājanāni prayacchasi / nādeyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyas te gṛhe kiṃ cana vidyate

vulgate_text: aśvamedho rājasūyaḥ pauṇḍarīko'tha gosavaḥ / iṣṭāstvayā mahāyajñābahavo'nye sadakṣiṇāḥ
ce_text: aśvamedho rājasūyaḥ puṇḍarīko 'tha gosavaḥ / etair api mahāyajñair iṣṭaṃ te bhūridakṣiṇaiḥ

vulgate_text: rājanparītayā buddhyā viṣame'kṣaparājaye / pārtha mitrāṇi cāsmāṃśca vasūni ca parājitaḥ
ce_text: rājan parītayā buddhyā viṣame 'kṣaparājaye / rājyaṃ vasūny āyudhāni bhrātṝn māṃ cāsi nirjitaḥ

vulgate_text: atīva moha āyāti manaś paridūyate / niśāmya vyasanaṃ pārtha tavedamatiduḥsaham
ce_text: atīva moham āyāti manaś ca paridūyate / niśāmya te duḥkham idam imāṃ cāpadam īdṛśīm

vulgate_text: dharma eva manaḥ kṛṣṇe svabhāvāccaiva me dhṛtam [dharmavāṇijyako hīno jaghanyo dharmavādinām]
ce_text: dharmaṃ carāmi suśroṇi na dharmaphalakāraṇāt / āgamān anatikramya satāṃ vṛttam avekṣya ca / dharma eva manaḥ kṛṣṇe svabhāvāc caiva me dhṛtam

vulgate_text: unmattānmanyate bālaḥ sarvānāgataniścayān / dharmātiśaṅkī nānyasminpramāṇamadhigacchati
ce_text: dharmātiśaṅkī nānyasmin pramāṇam adhigacchati / ātmapramāṇa unnaddhaḥ śreyaso hy avamanyakaḥ

vulgate_text: naitāni veda yaḥ kaścinmuhyantyatra prajā imāḥ [api kalpasahasreṇa na ca śreyo'dhigacchati ]
ce_text: naitāni veda yaḥ kaś cin muhyanty atra prajā imāḥ / rakṣyāṇy etāni devānāṃ gūḍhamāyā hi devatāḥ

vulgate_text: sarvameva haṭhenaike daivenaike vadantyuta / puṃsaḥ prayatnajaṃ keciddaivametadviśiṣyate
ce_text: sarvam eva haṭhenaike diṣṭenaike vadanty uta / puruṣaprayatnajaṃ ke cit traidham etan nirucyate

vulgate_text: guṇābhāve phalaṃ nyūnaṃ bhavatyaphalameva ca / anārambhe hi na phalaṃ na guṇo dṛśyate kvacit
ce_text: bahūnāṃ samavāye hi bhāvānāṃ karma sidhyati / guṇābhāve phalaṃ nyūnaṃ bhavaty aphalam eva vā / anārambhe tu na phalaṃ na guṇo dṛśyate 'cyuta

vulgate_text: itiloke nirvacanaṃ puraścarati bhārata / api caitāḥ striyo bālāḥ svādhyāyamadhikurvate
ce_text: iti nirvacanaṃ loke ciraṃ carati bhārata / api caitat striyo bālāḥ svādhyāyam iva kurvate

vulgate_text: āśīviṣasamairvīrairmarudbhiriva vṛtrahā amitrāṃstejasā mṛdgannasurāniva vṛtrahā / śriyamādatsva kaunteya dhārtarāṣṭrānmahābala
ce_text: amitrāṃs tejasā mṛdnann asurebhya ivārihā / śriyam ādatsva kaunteya dhārtarāṣṭrān mahābala

vulgate_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / sa evamuktastu mahānubhāvaḥ satyavrato bhīmasenena rājā / ajātaśatrustadanantaraṃ vai dhairyānvito vākyamidaṃ babhāṣe
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / yājñasenyā vacaḥ śrutvā bhīmaseno 'tyamarṣaṇaḥ / niḥśvasann upasaṃgamya kruddho rājānam abravīt

vulgate_text: dhārtarāṣṭrānmahārāja kṣamase kiṃ durātmanaḥ / kartavye puruṣavyāghra kimāsse pīṭhasarpavat
ce_text: kartavye puruṣavyāghra kim āsse pīṭhasarpavat / buddhyā vīryeṇa saṃyuktaḥ śrutenābhijanena ca

vulgate_text: etadvacanamājñāya bhīmaseno'tyamarṣaṇaḥ / babhūva śāntisaṃyukto gurorvacanavāritaḥ
ce_text: etad vacanam ājñāya bhīmaseno 'tyamarṣaṇaḥ / babhūva vimanās trasto na caivovāca kiṃ cana

vulgate_text: bhīṣmāddroṇātkṛpātkarṇāddroṇaputrācca bhārata / duryodhanānnṛpasutāttathā duḥśāsanādapi
ce_text: bhīṣmād droṇāt kṛpāt karṇād droṇaputrāc ca bhārata / yat te bhayam amitraghna hṛdi saṃparivartate

vulgate_text: tacchrutvā dhṛtimāsthāya karmaṇā pratipādaya / pratipādya tu rājendra tataḥ kṣipraṃ jvaraṃ jahi
ce_text: tat te 'haṃ nāśayiṣyāmi vidhidṛṣṭena hetunā / tac chrutvā dhṛtim āsthāya karmaṇā pratipādaya

vulgate_text: ṛṣireṣa mehātejā nārāyaṇasahāyavān / purāṇaḥ śāsvato devastvajeyo jiṣṇuracyutaḥ
ce_text: ṛṣir eṣa mahātejā nārāyaṇasahāyavān / purāṇaḥ śāśvato devo viṣṇor aṃśaḥ sanātanaḥ

vulgate_text: ācāryā mānitāstuṣṭāḥ śāntiṃ vyavaharannyuta / śaktiṃ na hāpayiṣyanti te kāle pratipūjitāḥ
ce_text: sarvayodheṣu caivāsya sadā vṛttir anuttamā / śaktiṃ na hāpayiṣyanti te kāle pratipūjitāḥ

vulgate_text: adya ceyaṃ mahī kṛtsnā duryādhanavaśānugā sagrāmanagarā pārtha sasāgaravanākarā bhavāneva priyo'smākaṃ tvayi bhāraḥ samāhitaḥ
ce_text: adya ceyaṃ mahī kṛtsnā duryodhanavaśānugā / tvayi vyapāśrayo 'smākaṃ tvayi bhāraḥ samāhitaḥ / tatra kṛtyaṃ prapaśyāmi prāptakālam ariṃdama

vulgate_text: dhanuṣmānkavacī khaṅgī muniḥ sādhuvrate sthitaḥ / na kasyaciddadanmārgaṃ gaccha tātottarāṃ diśam
ce_text: dhanuṣmān kavacī khaḍgī muniḥ sārasamanvitaḥ / na kasya cid dadan mārgaṃ gaccha tātottarāṃ diśam / indre hy astrāṇi divyāni samastāni dhanaṃjaya

vulgate_text: tānyekasthāni sarvāṇi tatastvaṃ pratipatsyase anena brahmaṇā tāta sarvaṃ saṃpratipadyate
ce_text: vṛtrād bhītais tadā devair balam indre samarpitam / tāny ekasthāni sarvāṇi tatas tvaṃ pratipatsyase

vulgate_text: kṣipramāpnuhi kaunteya manasā yadyadicchasi / saṃsādhayasva kaunteya dhruvostu vijayastava
ce_text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā tatra kaunteyaṃ pragṛhītaśarāsanam / abruvan brāhmaṇāḥ siddhā bhūtāny antarhitāni ca / siddhacāraṇasaṃghāś ca gandharvāś ca tam abruvan / svasti vrataṃ samādhatsva saṃkalpas tava sidhyatām / manorathāś ca te sarve samṛdhyantāṃ mahāratha / evam ukto 'bhivādyaitān baddhāñjalipuṭas tathā / tapoyogamanāḥ pārthaḥ purohitam avandata / tataḥ prītamanā jiṣṇus tāv ubhāv abhyavandata / sahodarāv atirathau yudhiṣṭhiravṛkodarau / saṃklāntamanasau tūrṇam abhigamya mahārathau / yamau gāṇḍīvadhanvānam abhyavādayatām ubhau / abhivādya tu tau vīrāv ūcatuḥ pākaśāsanim / avāptavyāni sarvāṇi divyāny astrāṇi vāsavāt / astrāṇy āpnuhi kaunteya manasā yad yad icchasi / giro hy aśithilāḥ sarvā nirdoṣāḥ saṃmatāḥ satām / tvam ekaḥ pāṇḍaveṣv adya saṃprāpto 'si dhanaṃjaya / na cādharmavidaṃ devā nāsiddhaṃ nātapasvinam / draṣṭum icchanti kaunteya calacittaṃ śaṭhaṃ na ca / rorūyamāṇaḥ kaṭukam īrṣyakaḥ kaṭukākṣaraḥ / śaṭhakaḥ ślāghakaḥ kṣeptā hantā ca vicikitsitā / viśvastahantā māyāvī krodhano 'nṛtabhāṣitā / atyāśī nāstiko 'dātā mitradhṛk sarvaśaṅkitaḥ / ākroṣṭā cātimānī ca raudro lubdho 'tha lolupaḥ / stenaś ca madyapaś caiva bhrūṇahā gurutalpagaḥ / saṃbhāvitātmā cātyarthaṃ nṛśaṃsaḥ puruṣaś ca yaḥ / naite lokān āpnuvanti nirlokās te dhanaṃjaya / ānṛśaṃsyam anukrośaḥ satyaṃ karuṇaveditā / damaḥ sthitir dhṛtir dharmaḥ kṣamā rūpam anuttamam / dayā śamaś ca dharmaś ca gurupūjā kṛtajñatā / maitratā dvijabhaktiś ca vasanti tvayi phalguna / vyapekṣā sarvabhūteṣu kṛpā dānaṃ matiḥ smṛtiḥ / tasmāt kauravya śakreṇa sameṣyasi dhanaṃjaya / tvādṛśena hi devānāṃ ślāghanīyaḥ samāgamaḥ / suhṛdāṃ sodarāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ bharatarṣabha / tvaṃ gatiḥ paramā tāta vṛtrahā marutām iva / tasmiṃs trayodaśe varṣe bhrātaraḥ suhṛdaś ca te / sarve hi saṃśrayiṣyanti bāhuvīryaṃ mahābala / sa pārtha pitaraṃ gaccha sahasrākṣam ariṃdamam / muṣṭigrahaṇam ādatsva sarvāṇy astrāṇi vāsavāt / śataśṛṅge mahābāho maghavān idam abravīt / śṛṇvatāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ tvām upāghrāya mūrdhani / viditaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ divaṃ tāta gamiṣyasi / prāpya puṇyakṛtāṃ lokān raṃsyase jayatāṃ vara / mānitas tridaśaiḥ pārtha vihṛtya susukhaṃ divi / avāpya paramāstrāṇi pṛthivīṃ punar eṣyasi / guṇāṃs te vāsavas tāta khāṇḍavaṃ dahati tvayi / śṛṇvatāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ punaḥ punar abhāṣata / tāṃ pratijñāṃ naraśreṣṭha kartum arhasi vāsavīm / kaṃ cid deśam itaḥ prāpya tapoyogamanā bhava / kartum arhasi kauravya maghavadvacanaṃ hitam / dīkṣito 'dyaiva gaccha tvaṃ draṣṭāsi tvaṃ puraṃdaram / tau pariṣvajya bībhatsuḥ kṛṣṇām āmantrya cābhibho / abhyavādayata prītaḥ tapasvipravarān api / kṣipraṃ prāpnuhi kaunteya manasā yad yad icchasi

vulgate_text: abruvanbrāhmaṇāḥ pārthamiti kṛtvā jayāśiṣaḥ / siddhacāraṇasaṅghāśca gandharvāśca tamabruvan
ce_text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā tatra kaunteyaṃ pragṛhītaśarāsanam / abruvan brāhmaṇāḥ siddhā bhūtāny antarhitāni ca / siddhacāraṇasaṃghāś ca gandharvāś ca tam abruvan / svasti vrataṃ samādhatsva saṃkalpas tava sidhyatām / manorathāś ca te sarve samṛdhyantāṃ mahāratha / evam ukto 'bhivādyaitān baddhāñjalipuṭas tathā / tapoyogamanāḥ pārthaḥ purohitam avandata / tataḥ prītamanā jiṣṇus tāv ubhāv abhyavandata / sahodarāv atirathau yudhiṣṭhiravṛkodarau / saṃklāntamanasau tūrṇam abhigamya mahārathau / yamau gāṇḍīvadhanvānam abhyavādayatām ubhau / abhivādya tu tau vīrāv ūcatuḥ pākaśāsanim / avāptavyāni sarvāṇi divyāny astrāṇi vāsavāt / astrāṇy āpnuhi kaunteya manasā yad yad icchasi / giro hy aśithilāḥ sarvā nirdoṣāḥ saṃmatāḥ satām / tvam ekaḥ pāṇḍaveṣv adya saṃprāpto 'si dhanaṃjaya / na cādharmavidaṃ devā nāsiddhaṃ nātapasvinam / draṣṭum icchanti kaunteya calacittaṃ śaṭhaṃ na ca / rorūyamāṇaḥ kaṭukam īrṣyakaḥ kaṭukākṣaraḥ / śaṭhakaḥ ślāghakaḥ kṣeptā hantā ca vicikitsitā / viśvastahantā māyāvī krodhano 'nṛtabhāṣitā / atyāśī nāstiko 'dātā mitradhṛk sarvaśaṅkitaḥ / ākroṣṭā cātimānī ca raudro lubdho 'tha lolupaḥ / stenaś ca madyapaś caiva bhrūṇahā gurutalpagaḥ / saṃbhāvitātmā cātyarthaṃ nṛśaṃsaḥ puruṣaś ca yaḥ / naite lokān āpnuvanti nirlokās te dhanaṃjaya / ānṛśaṃsyam anukrośaḥ satyaṃ karuṇaveditā / damaḥ sthitir dhṛtir dharmaḥ kṣamā rūpam anuttamam / dayā śamaś ca dharmaś ca gurupūjā kṛtajñatā / maitratā dvijabhaktiś ca vasanti tvayi phalguna / vyapekṣā sarvabhūteṣu kṛpā dānaṃ matiḥ smṛtiḥ / tasmāt kauravya śakreṇa sameṣyasi dhanaṃjaya / tvādṛśena hi devānāṃ ślāghanīyaḥ samāgamaḥ / suhṛdāṃ sodarāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ bharatarṣabha / tvaṃ gatiḥ paramā tāta vṛtrahā marutām iva / tasmiṃs trayodaśe varṣe bhrātaraḥ suhṛdaś ca te / sarve hi saṃśrayiṣyanti bāhuvīryaṃ mahābala / sa pārtha pitaraṃ gaccha sahasrākṣam ariṃdamam / muṣṭigrahaṇam ādatsva sarvāṇy astrāṇi vāsavāt / śataśṛṅge mahābāho maghavān idam abravīt / śṛṇvatāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ tvām upāghrāya mūrdhani / viditaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ divaṃ tāta gamiṣyasi / prāpya puṇyakṛtāṃ lokān raṃsyase jayatāṃ vara / mānitas tridaśaiḥ pārtha vihṛtya susukhaṃ divi / avāpya paramāstrāṇi pṛthivīṃ punar eṣyasi / guṇāṃs te vāsavas tāta khāṇḍavaṃ dahati tvayi / śṛṇvatāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ punaḥ punar abhāṣata / tāṃ pratijñāṃ naraśreṣṭha kartum arhasi vāsavīm / kaṃ cid deśam itaḥ prāpya tapoyogamanā bhava / kartum arhasi kauravya maghavadvacanaṃ hitam / dīkṣito 'dyaiva gaccha tvaṃ draṣṭāsi tvaṃ puraṃdaram / tau pariṣvajya bībhatsuḥ kṛṣṇām āmantrya cābhibho / abhyavādayata prītaḥ tapasvipravarān api / kṣipraṃ prāpnuhi kaunteya manasā yad yad icchasi

vulgate_text: svasti testvāntarikṣebhyo divyebhyo bharatarṣabha / pārthivebhyaśca sarvebhyo ye kecitparipanthinaḥ
ce_text: namo dhātre vidhātre ca svasti gaccha hy anāmayam / svasti te 'stv āntarikṣebhyaḥ pārthivebhyaś ca bhārata / divyebhyaś caiva bhūtebhyo ye cānye paripanthinaḥ

vulgate_text: āpṛṣṭo nosi kaunteya svasti prāpnuhi pāṇḍava / kṛtāstraṃ svastimantaṃ tvāṃ drakṣyāmi punarāgatam
ce_text: tvayi naḥ pārtha sarveṣāṃ sukhaduḥkhe samāhite / jīvitaṃ maraṇaṃ caiva rājyam aiśvaryam eva ca / āpṛṣṭo me 'si kaunteya svasti prāpnuhi pāṇḍava

vulgate_text: hrīḥ śrīḥ kīrtirdhṛtiḥ puṣṭirumā lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī / imā vai tava pānthas pālayantu dhanañjaya / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / bhīmasenavacaḥ śrutvā kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / niḥśvasya puruṣavyāghraḥ saṃpradadhyau paraṃtapaḥ

ce_text: tato 'paśyat savyasācī vṛkṣamūle tapasvinam / brāhmyā śriyā dīpyamānaṃ piṅgalaṃ jaṭilaṃ kṛśam

ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / kasya cit tv atha kālasya dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / saṃsmṛtya munisaṃdeśam idaṃ vacanam abravīt

vulgate_text: evaṃ bruvantaṃ duḥkhārtamuvāca bhagavānṛṣiḥ / śokaṃ vyapanudanrājño dharmarājasya dhīmataḥ / bṛhadaśva uvāca

vulgate_text: athavā'raṇyanṛpate nalaṃ yadi na śaṃsasi / māṃ khādaya mṛgaśreṣṭha duḥkhādasmādvimocaya

vulgate_text: vaidarbhyehīti vispaṣṭāṃ śubhāṃ rājño mahātmanaḥ / ātmābhidhāyinīmṛddhāṃ mama śokavināśinīṃ

vulgate_text: vismayo naḥ samutpannaḥ samāśvasihi mā śucaḥ asyāraṇyasya devī tvamutāho'sya mahībhṛtaḥ / asyāśca nadyāḥ kalyāṇi vada satyamanindite

ce_text: ṛṣir uvāca / kiṃ na paśyasi me deva karāc chākarasaṃ srutam / yaṃ dṛṣṭvāhaṃ pranṛtto vai harṣeṇa mahatānvitaḥ

vulgate_text: tvameva sarvāngrasasi punareva yugakṣaye / devairapi na śakyastvaṃ parijñātuṃ kuto mayā
ce_text: devair api na śakyas tvaṃ parijñātuṃ kuto mayā / tvayi sarve ca dṛśyante surā brahmādayo 'nagha

vulgate_text: tvatprasādātsurāḥ sarve nivasantyakutobhayāḥ / evaṃ stutvā mahādevamṛṣirvacanamabravīt
ce_text: sarvas tvam asi lokānāṃ kartā kārayitā ca ha / tvatprasādāt surāḥ sarve modantīhākutobhayāḥ / evaṃ stutvā mahādevaṃ sa ṛṣiḥ praṇato 'bhavat

vulgate_text: sārasvataṃ ca te lokaṃ gamiṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ / evamuktvā mahādevastatraivāntaradhīyata / pulastya uvāca
ce_text: pulastya uvāca / anena tava dharmajña praśrayeṇa damena ca / satyena ca mahābhāga tuṣṭo 'smi tava sarvaśaḥ

vulgate_text: taijasaṃ vāruṇaṃ tīrthaṃ dīpyamānaṃ svatejasā / yatra rabrahmādibhirdairvairṛṣibhiśca tapodhanaiḥ
ce_text: aujasaṃ varuṇaṃ tīrthaṃ dīpyate svena tejasā / yatra brahmādibhir devair ṛṣibhiś ca tapodhanaiḥ / senāpatyena devānām abhiṣikto guhas tadā

vulgate_text: tataḥ svastipuraṃ gacchettīrthasevī narādhipa / pradakṣiṇamupāvṛtya gosahasraphalaṃ labhet
ce_text: tataḥ svastipuraṃ gacchet tīrthasevī narādhipa / pāvanaṃ tīrtham āsādya tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ / agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ

vulgate_text: tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca svargaloke mahīyate / amāvāsyāṃ tu tatraiva rāhugraste radivākare
ce_text: rudrāvartaṃ tato gacchet tīrthasevī narādhipa / tatra snātvā naro rājan svargaloke mahīyate

vulgate_text: snāta eva samāpnoti kṛtvā śrāddhaṃ ca mānavaḥ / yatkiṃcidduṣkṛtaṃkarma striyā vā puruṣeṇa vā
ce_text: yat kiṃ cid duṣkṛtaṃ karma striyā vā puruṣasya vā / snātamātrasya tat sarvaṃ naśyate nātra saṃśayaḥ / padmavarṇena yānena brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati

vulgate_text: pulastya uvāca / tato gacchenmahārāja dharmatīrthamanuttamam / [yatra dharmo mahābhāgastaptavānuttamaṃ tapaḥ / tena tīrthaṃ kṛtaṃpuṇyaṃ svena nāmnā ca viśrutam ]
ce_text: pulastya uvāca / tato gaccheta rājendra kurukṣetram abhiṣṭutam / pāpebhyo vipramucyante tadgatāḥ sarvajantavaḥ

vulgate_text: tataścāpi saricacchreṣṭhā nadīnāmuttamā nadī / plakṣā devī smṛtā rājanpuṇyā devī sarasvatī
ce_text: tato hi sā saricchreṣṭhā nadīnām uttamā nadī / plakṣād devī srutā rājan mahāpuṇyā sarasvatī

vulgate_text: bhadrakarṇaeśvaraṃ gatvā devamarcya yathāvidhi / na durgatimavāpnoti nākapṛṣṭhe ca pūjyate
ce_text: bhadrakarṇeśvaraṃ gatvā devam arcya yathāvidhi / na durgatim avāpnoti svargalokaṃ ca gacchati

vulgate_text: arundhatīvaṭaṃ gacchettīrthasevī narādhipa / sāmudrakamupaspṛśya brahmacārī samāhitaḥ
ce_text: arundhatīvaṭaṃ gacchet tīrthasevī narādhipa / sāmudrakam upaspṛśya trirātropoṣito naraḥ / gosahasraphalaṃ vindet kulaṃ caiva samuddharet

vulgate_text: ṛṣikulyāṃ samāsādya naraḥ snātvā vikalmaṣaḥ / devānpitṝṃścārcayitvā ṛṣilokaṃ prapadyate
ce_text: ṛṣikulyāṃ naraḥ snātvā ṛṣilokaṃ prapadyate / yadi tatra vasen māsaṃ śākāhāro narādhipa

vulgate_text: yadi tatravasenmāsaṃ śākāhāro narādhipa / dvādaśāhasya yajñasya phalaṃ sa labhate naraḥ
ce_text: ṛṣikulyāṃ naraḥ snātvā ṛṣilokaṃ prapadyate / yadi tatra vasen māsaṃ śākāhāro narādhipa

vulgate_text: tatra saṃdhyāṃ samāsādya vidyātīrthamanuttamam / upaspṛśya ca vai vidyāṃ yatra tatropapadyate
ce_text: tataḥ saṃdhyāṃ samāsādya vidyātīrtham anuttamam / upaspṛśya ca vidyānāṃ sarvāsāṃ pārago bhavet

vulgate_text: yastyajennaimiṣe prāṇānupavāsaparāyaṇaḥ / sa modetsarvalokeṣu evamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ
ce_text: yas tyajen naimiṣe prāṇān upavāsaparāyaṇaḥ / sa modet svargalokastha evam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ / nityaṃ puṇyaṃ ca medhyaṃ ca naimiṣaṃ nṛpasattama

vulgate_text: tataśca bāhudāṃ gacchedbrahmacārī samāhitaḥ tatroṣya rajanīmekāṃ svargaloke mahīyate / devasatrasya yajñasya phalaṃprāpnoti kaurava
ce_text: tataś ca bāhudāṃ gacched brahmacārī samāhitaḥ / devasatrasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ

vulgate_text: avimuktaṃ samāsādya tīrthasevī kurūdvaha / darśanāddevadevasya mucyate brahmahatyayā
ce_text: ekahaṃse naraḥ snātvā gosahasraphalaṃ labhet / kṛtaśaucaṃ samāsādya tīrthasevī kurūdvaha / puṇḍarīkam avāpnoti kṛtaśauco bhaven naraḥ

vulgate_text: prāṇānutsṛjyatatraiva mokṣaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ / mārkaṇḍeyasya rājendra tīrthamāsādya durlabham
ce_text: mārkaṇḍeyasya rājendra tīrtham āsādya durlabham / gomatīgaṅgayoś caiva saṃgame lokaviśrute / agniṣṭomam avāpnoti kulaṃ caiva samuddharet

vulgate_text: tatrākṣayavaṭo nāma triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ / tatra dattaṃ pitṛbhyastu bhavatyakṣayamucyate
ce_text: tatrākṣayavaṭo nāma triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ / pitṝṇāṃ tatra vai dattam akṣayaṃ bhavati prabho

vulgate_text: brahmaṇā tatra sarasi yūpaśreṣṭhaḥ samucchritaḥ / yūpaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet
ce_text: tasmin sarasi rājendra brahmaṇo yūpa ucchritaḥ / yūpaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet

vulgate_text: sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā somalokaṃ brajedbhuvam / tatra cihniṃ mahadrājannadyāpi sumahadbhṛśam
ce_text: tato gaccheta rājendra dhenukāṃ lokaviśrutām / ekarātroṣito rājan prayacchet tiladhenukām / sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā somalokaṃ vrajed dhruvam

vulgate_text: kapilāyāḥ savatsāyāścarantyāḥ parvate kṛtam / savatsāyāḥ padāni sma dṛśyante'dyāpi bhārata
ce_text: tatra cihnaṃ mahārāja adyāpi hi na saṃśayaḥ / kapilā saha vatsena parvate vicaraty uta / savatsāyāḥ padāni sma dṛśyante 'dyāpi bhārata

vulgate_text: taṃ praviśyāśramaṃ śrīmacchramaśokavināśanam / gavāmayanayajñasya phalaṃprāpnoti mānavaḥ
ce_text: kalaśyāṃ cāpy upaspṛśya śraddadhāno jitendriyaḥ / agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ

vulgate_text: tato gaccheta rājendra brahmasthānamanuttamam tatrābhigamya rājendra brahmāṇaṃ puruṣarṣabha / rājasūyāśvamedhābhyāṃ phalaṃ vindati mānavaḥ
ce_text: gaṅgāhradaś ca tatraiva tīrthaṃ bharatasattama / tatra snātas tu dharmajña brahmacārī samāhitaḥ / rājasūyāśvamedhābhyāṃ phalaṃ vindati śāśvatam

vulgate_text: tairthikaṃ bhuñjate yastu maṇināgas bhārata / daṣṭasyāśīviṣeṇāpi na tasya kramate vipam
ce_text: daṣṭasyāśīviṣeṇāpi na tasya kramate viṣam / tatroṣya rajanīm ekāṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate

vulgate_text: ādityā vasavo rudrā janārdanamupāsate / śālagrāma iti khyāto viṣṇuradbhutakarmakaḥ
ce_text: tato gaccheta rājendra sthānaṃ nārāyaṇasya tu / sadā saṃnihito yatra harir vasati bhārata / śālagrāma iti khyāto viṣṇor adbhutakarmaṇaḥ

vulgate_text: abhigamya trilokeśaṃ varadaṃ viṣṇumavyayam / virājati yathāsomo meghairmukto narādhipa
ce_text: abhigamya trilokeśaṃ varadaṃ viṣṇum avyayam / aśvamedham avāpnoti viṣṇulokaṃ ca gacchati

vulgate_text: atha jeṣṭhilamāsādya tīrdhaṃ paramadurlabham / tatroṣya rajanīmekāṃ gosahasraphalaṃ labhet
ce_text: atha jyeṣṭhilam āsādya tīrthaṃ paramasaṃmatam / upoṣya rajanīm ekām agniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet

vulgate_text: ye tvindhanaṃ prayacchanti nirvīrāsaṃgame narāḥ / te yānti naraśārdūla śakralokamanāmayam
ce_text: ye tu dānaṃ prayacchanti niścīrāsaṃgame narāḥ / te yānti naraśārdūla brahmalokaṃ na saṃśayaḥ

vulgate_text: abhigamya mahādevaṃ varadaṃ viṣṇumavyayam pitāmahasaro gatvā śailarājasamīpataḥ / tatrābhiṣekaṃ kurvāṇo hyagniṣṭomamavāpnuyāt
ce_text: pitāmahasaro gatvā śailarājapratiṣṭhitam / tatrābhiṣekaṃ kurvāṇo agniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet

vulgate_text: samāruhya naraśreṣṭha stanakuṇḍeṣu saṃviśet / stanakuṇḍamupaspṛśya vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet
ce_text: śikharaṃ vai mahādevyā gauryās trailokyaviśrutam / samāruhya naraḥ śrāddhaḥ stanakuṇḍeṣu saṃviśet

vulgate_text: nandinyāṃ ca samāsādya kūpaṃ devaniṣevitam / naramedhas yatpuṇyaṃ tadāptoti narādhipa
ce_text: nandinyāṃ ca samāsādya kūpaṃ tridaśasevitam / naramedhasya yat puṇyaṃ tat prāpnoti kurūdvaha

vulgate_text: lapeṭikāṃ tato gacchetpuṇyāṃ puṇyopaśobhitām / vājapeyamavāpnoti devaiḥ sarvaiśca pūjyate
ce_text: laveḍikāṃ tato gacchet puṇyāṃ puṇyopasevitām / vājapeyam avāpnoti vimānasthaś ca pūjyate

vulgate_text: tato devahrade'raṇye kṛṣṇaveṇājalodbhave jātismarahrade snātvā bhavejjātismaro naraḥ / yatra kratuśatairiṣṭvā devarājo divaṃ gataḥ
ce_text: tato devahrade ramye kṛṣṇaveṇṇājalodbhave / jātimātrahrade caiva tathā kanyāśrame nṛpa

vulgate_text: tatra vedeṣu naṣṭeṣu muneraṅgirasaḥ sutaḥ / ṛṣīṇaāmuttarīyeṣu sūpaviṣṭo yathāsukham
ce_text: tatra vedān pranaṣṭāṃs tu muner aṅgirasaḥ sutaḥ / upaviṣṭo maharṣīṇām uttarīyeṣu bhārata

vulgate_text: ājyabhāgena tatrāgnīṃ tarpayitvā yathāvidhi / devāḥ svabhavanaṃ yātā ṛṣayaśca yathākramam
ce_text: ājyabhāgena vai tatra tarpitās tu yathāvidhi / devās tribhuvaṇaṃ yātā ṛṣayaś ca yathāsukham

vulgate_text: tatropaspṛśya rājendra pitṛdevārcane rataḥ / niyatātmā naraḥ pūto gaccheta paramāṃ gatim
ce_text: tatropaspṛśya rājendra kṛtvā cāpi pradakṣiṇam / niyatātmā naraḥ pūto gaccheta paramāṃ gatim

vulgate_text: rakatasmiṃstīrthe mahābāho snātvā pāpaiḥ pramucyate / gaṅgāyāṃ tu naraḥ snātvā brahmacārī samāhitaḥ
ce_text: gaṅgāyāṃ tu naraḥ snātvā brahmacārī samāhitaḥ / vidhūtapāpmā bhavati vājapeyaṃ ca vindati

vulgate_text: tasmiṃstīrthe tu jāhnavyāṃ snātvā pāpaiḥ pramucyate / tato gaccheta rājendra prayāgamṛṣisaṃstutam
ce_text: tato gaccheta rājendra prayāgam ṛṣisaṃstutam / yatra brahmādayo devā diśaś ca sadigīśvarāḥ

vulgate_text: bhāṣitaiḥ karaṇaiḥ pūrvamāstikyācchrutidarśanāt prāpyante tāni tīrtāni sadbhiḥ śāstrārthadarśibhiḥ / sadbhiḥ śāstrārthatatvajñairbrāhmaṇaiḥ saha gamyatām
ce_text: bhāvitaiḥ kāraṇaiḥ pūrvam āstikyāc chrutidarśanāt / prāpyante tāni tīrthāni sadbhiḥ śiṣṭānudarśibhiḥ

vulgate_text: tataścāṣṭaguṇaṃ pārtha prāpsyase dharmamuttamam / bhīṣmaḥ kurūṇāṃ pravaro yathā pūrvamavāptavān
ce_text: ataś cāṣṭaguṇaṃ pārtha prāpsyase dharmam uttamam / netā ca tvam ṛṣīn yasmāt tena te 'ṣṭaguṇaṃ phalam

vulgate_text: netā ca tvamṛṣīnyasmāttena te'ṣṭaguṇaṃ phalam rakṣogaṇabikīrṇāni tīrthānyetāni bhārata / agamyāni manuṣyendraistvāmṛte kurunandana
ce_text: rakṣogaṇāvakīrṇāni tīrthāny etāni bhārata / na gatir vidyate 'nyasya tvām ṛte kurunandana

vulgate_text: idaṃ devarṣicaritaṃ sarvatīrtābhisaṃvṛtam / yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvā'pisarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
ce_text: idaṃ devarṣicaritaṃ sarvatīrthārthasaṃśritam / yaḥ paṭhet kalyam utthāya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate

vulgate_text: yathā ca vṛtrahā sarvānsapatnānnirdahanpurā / trailokyaṃ pālayāmāsa devarāḍvigatajvaraḥ
ce_text: yathā ca vṛtrahā sarvān sapatnān nirdahat purā / tathā śatrukṣayaṃ kṛtvā prajās tvaṃ pālayiṣyasi

vulgate_text: sarve vedavidaḥ śūrāḥ sarve'strakuśalāstathā sarve mahārathā mukhyāḥ sarve jitapariśramāḥ / yoddhukāmāśca pārthena satataṃ ye mahābalāḥ
ce_text: yoddhukāmaś ca pārthena satataṃ yo mahābalaḥ / sa ca divyāstravit karṇaḥ sūtaputro mahārathaḥ

vulgate_text: sa ca divyāstravitkarṇaḥ sūtaputro mahārathaḥ yo'stravegānilabalaḥ śarārcistalaniḥsvanaḥ / rajodhūmo'strasaṃpāto dhārtarāṣṭrāniloddhataḥ
ce_text: so 'śvavegānilabalaḥ śarārcis talanisvanaḥ / rajodhūmo 'strasaṃtāpo dhārtarāṣṭrāniloddhataḥ

vulgate_text: hiraṇyabinduḥ kathito girau kālañjare mahān / āgastyaparvatorabhyaḥ puṇyo girivaḥ śivaḥ
ce_text: agastyasya ca rājendra tatrāśramavaro mahān / hiraṇyabinduḥ kathito girau kālaṃjare nṛpa

vulgate_text: nṛgas yajamānasya pratyakṣamiti naḥ śrutam / marutaḥ pariveṣṭāraḥ sadasyāśca divaukasaḥ
ce_text: nṛgasya yajamānasya pratyakṣam iti naḥ śrutam / amādyad indraḥ somena dakṣiṇābhir dvijātayaḥ

vulgate_text: camasodbhedanaṃ viprāstatrāpi kathayantyuta / prabhāsaṃ codadhau tīrthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam
ce_text: camasonmajjanaṃ viprās tatrāpi kathayanty uta / prabhāsaṃ codadhau tīrthaṃ tridaśānāṃ yudhiṣṭhira

vulgate_text: avyayātmā vyayātmā ca kṣetrajñaḥ parameśvaraḥ āste hariracintyātmā tatraiva madhusūdanaḥ
ce_text: trailokyaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣo devadevaḥ sanātanaḥ / āste harir acintyātmā tatraiva madhusūdanaḥ

vulgate_text: tasya śailasya śikhare saraḥ puṇyaṃ mahīpate / phullapadmaṃ mahārāja devagandharvasevitam
ce_text: tasya śailasya śikhare saras tatra ca dhīmataḥ / praphullanalinaṃ rājan devagandharvasevitam

vulgate_text: hradinī puṇyatīrthā ca rājarṣestatra vai sarit / viścāmitreṇa tapasā nirmitā sarvapāvanī
ce_text: hradinī puṇyatīrthā ca rājarṣes tatra vai sarit / viśvāmitranadī pārā puṇyā parapuraṃjaya

vulgate_text: tatrapuṇyo hradaḥ khyāto mainākaścaiva parvataḥ / bahumūlaphalopetastvamito nāma parvataḥ
ce_text: tatra puṇyahradas tāta mainākaś caiva parvataḥ / bahumūlaphalo vīra asito nāma parvataḥ

vulgate_text: kaunteyānantayaśasaḥ suvratasyāmitaujasaḥ / āśramaḥ khyāyate puṇyastriṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ
ce_text: tasyātiyaśasaḥ puṇyāṃ viśālāṃ badarīm anu / āśramaḥ khyāyate puṇyas triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ

vulgate_text: etāvarṇāvavarṇau ca viśrutau manujādhipa / ījāte kratubhirmukhyaiḥ puṇyairbharatasattama
ce_text: dṛṣadvatī puṇyatamā tatra khyātā yudhiṣṭhira / tatra vaivarṇyavarṇau ca supuṇyau manujādhipa

vulgate_text: tatpuṇyaṃ paramaṃ brahma tattīrthaṃ ttapovanam / tatparaṃ paramaṃ devaṃ bhūtānāṃ parameśvaram
ce_text: tat puṇyaṃ tat paraṃ brahma tat tīrthaṃ tat tapovanam / tatra devarṣayaḥ siddhāḥ sarve caiva tapodhanāḥ

vulgate_text: ahaṃ ca karṇaṃ jānāmi yathāvadbharatarṣabha / satyasandhaṃ mahotsāhaṃ mahāvīryaṃ mahābalam
ce_text: ahaṃ ca karṇaṃ jānāmi yathāvad bharatarṣabha / na sa pārthasya saṃgrāme kalām arhati ṣoḍaśīm

vulgate_text: na harṣātsaṃprapaśyāmi vākyasyāsyottaraṃ kvacit / yanmāṃ smarati deveśaḥ kiṃ nāmābhyadhikaṃ tataḥ
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca / na harṣāt saṃprapaśyāmi vākyasyāsyottaraṃ kva cit / smared dhi devarājo yaṃ kiṃ nāmābhyadhikaṃ tataḥ

vulgate_text: ye cāpyanugatāḥ paurā rājabhaktipuraḥsarāḥ dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ mahārājamabhigacchantu te ca vai / sa dāsyati yathākālamucitā yasya yā bhṛtiḥ
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ mahārājam abhigacchantu caiva te / sa dāsyati yathākālam ucitā yasya yā bhṛtiḥ

vulgate_text: tvayā saha mahīpāla draṣṭumicchāmahe vayam / bhavadbhiḥ pālitāḥ śūraistīrthānyāyatanāni ca
ce_text: prabhāsādīni tīrthāni mahendrādīṃś ca parvatān / gaṅgādyāḥ saritaś caiva plakṣādīṃś ca vanaspatīn / tvayā saha mahīpāla draṣṭum icchāmahe vayam

vulgate_text: niryaśaskāstathā daityāḥ kṛtsnaśo vilayaṃ gatāḥ / adharmarucayorājannalakṣmyā samadhiṣṭhitāḥ
ce_text: mānābhibhūtān acirād vināśaḥ pratyapadyata / niryaśasyās tato daityāḥ kṛtsnaśo vilayaṃ gatāḥ

vulgate_text: nago gayaśiro yatra puṇyā caiva mahānadī / vānīramālinī ramyā nadī pulinaśobhitā
ce_text: saro gayaśiro yatra puṇyā caiva mahānadī / ṛṣijuṣṭaṃ supuṇyaṃ tat tīrthaṃ brahmasarottamam

vulgate_text: divyaṃ pavitrakūṭaṃ ca pavitradharaṇīdharam / ṛṣijuṣṭaṃ supuṇyaṃ tattīrthaṃ brahmasarotulam
ce_text: saro gayaśiro yatra puṇyā caiva mahānadī / ṛṣijuṣṭaṃ supuṇyaṃ tat tīrthaṃ brahmasarottamam

vulgate_text: ye tu tatropavāsāṃstu cakrurniścitamānasāḥ / brāhmaṇāstatraśataśaḥ samājagmustapodhanāḥ

agamat punaḥ / dhanur ādāya tad divyaṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ nibarhaṇam / jijñāsamāno rāmasya vīryaṃ dāśarathes tadā / taṃ vai daśarathaḥ śrutvā viṣayāntam upāgamat / preṣayām āsa rāmasya rāmaṃ putraṃ vulgate_text: sa hi śakto mahātejāḥ kṣaṇātpātuṃ mahodadhim / agastyena vinā ko hi śakto'nyo'rṇavaśopaṇe
ce_text: na tu śakyāḥ kṣayaṃ netuṃ samudrāśrayagā hi te / samudrasya kṣaye buddhir bhavadbhiḥ saṃpradhāryatām / agastyena vinā ko hi śakto 'nyo 'rṇavaśoṣaṇe

vulgate_text: evaṃ śrutvā vaco devā brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ / parameṣṭhinamājñāpyaagastyasyāśramaṃ yayuḥ
