vulgate_text: paṭhannākhyāyikāṃ nāma strībhāvena punaḥ punaḥ prajānāṃ samudācāraṃ bahunarmakṛtaṃ vadan / ramayiṣyāmi rājānamanyaṃ cāntaḥpure janam
ce_text: paṭhann ākhyāyikāṃ nāma strībhāvena punaḥ punaḥ / ramayiṣye mahīpālam anyāṃś cāntaḥpure janān

vulgate_text: strībhāvasamudācārānnṛttagītakathāśrayaiḥ / chādayiṣyāmi rājendra māyayā''tmānamātmanā
ce_text: prajānāṃ samudācāraṃ bahu karmakṛtaṃ vadan / chādayiṣyāmi kaunteya māyayātmānam ātmanā

vulgate_text: kiṃkarmā kiṃsamācāro nakuloyaṃ bhaviṣyati / sukumāraśca śūraśca darśanīyaḥ sukhocitaḥ
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca / kiṃ tvaṃ nakula kurvāṇas tatra tāta cariṣyasi / sukumāraś ca śūraś ca darśanīyaḥ sukhocitaḥ

vulgate_text: kiṃ tvaṃ nakula kurvāṇastasya tāta cariṣyasi / karma tattvaṃ samācakṣva rājye tasya mahīpateḥ / nakula uvāca
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca / kiṃ tvaṃ nakula kurvāṇas tatra tāta cariṣyasi / sukumāraś ca śūraś ca darśanīyaḥ sukhocitaḥ

vulgate_text: aśvādhyakṣo bhaviṣyāmi virāṭasyeti me matiḥ / dāmagranthīti nāmnā'haṃ karmaitatsupriyaṃ mama
ce_text: nakula uvāca / aśvabandho bhaviṣyāmi virāṭanṛpater aham / granthiko nāma nāmnāhaṃ karmaitat supriyaṃ mama

vulgate_text: pāṇḍavena hyahaṃ tāta aśveṣvadhikṛtaḥ purā iti tasya pure channaścariṣyāmi mahīpate / ityetadvaḥ pratijñātaṃ vihariṣyāmyahaṃ yathā / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / evam uktas tato rājñā dhaumyo 'tha dvijasattamaḥ / akarod vidhivat sarvaṃ prasthāne yad vidhīyate

vulgate_text: adhiko māturasmākaṃ kuntyāḥ priyatamaḥ sadā sahadeva kathaṃ karma tasya rājñaḥ kariṣyasi / kiṃ vā tvaṃ tāta kurvāṇaḥ pracchanno vicariṣyasi / sahadeva uvāca
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca / sahadeva kathaṃ tasya samīpe vihariṣyasi / kiṃ vā tvaṃ tāta kurvāṇaḥ pracchanno vicariṣyasi

vulgate_text: gosaṅkhyātā bhaviṣyāmi virāṭasyeti rocaye pratibhoktā ca dogdhā ca saṅkhyānakuśalo gavām / tantrīpāleti me nāma svayaṃ proktaṃ bhaviṣyati
ce_text: sahadeva uvāca / gosaṃkhyātā bhaviṣyāmi virāṭasya mahīpateḥ / pratiṣeddhā ca dogdhā ca saṃkhyāne kuśalo gavām

vulgate_text: bhaviṣyanti mayā guptā virāṭanagare tadā / nipuṇatvaṃ cariṣyāmi prītiratra parā hi me
ce_text: so 'ham evaṃ cariṣyāmi prītir atra hi me sadā / na ca māṃ vetsyati paras tat te rocatu pārthiva

vulgate_text: ahaṃ hi bhavatā goṣu prahitaḥ satata purā / tatra me kauśalaṃ sarvamanubaddhaṃ viśāṃpate
ce_text: ahaṃ hi bhavatā goṣu satataṃ prakṛtaḥ purā / tatra me kauśalaṃ karma avabuddhaṃ viśāṃ pate

vulgate_text: so'hamevaṃ cariṣyāmi prītiratra parā hi me / virāṭanagare gūḍho raṃsye'haṃ tena karmaṇā
ce_text: so 'ham evaṃ cariṣyāmi prītir atra hi me sadā / na ca māṃ vetsyati paras tat te rocatu pārthiva

vulgate_text: toṣayiṣye ca rājānāṃ mā bhūccintā tavānagha na ca māṃ vetsyati parastatte rocatu pārthiva / ityetadvaḥ pratijñātaṃ vicariṣyāmyahaṃ yathā / yudhiṣṭhira uvāca
ce_text: so 'ham evaṃ cariṣyāmi prītir atra hi me sadā / na ca māṃ vetsyati paras tat te rocatu pārthiva

vulgate_text: māteva paripālyā ca pūjyā jyeṣṭhā svaseva ca sukumārī suśīlā ca rājaputrī yaśasvinī / kathaṃ vatsyati kalyāṇī virāṭanagare satī / draupadyuvāca
ce_text: sukumārī ca bālā ca rājaputrī yaśasvinī / pativratā mahābhāgā kathaṃ nu vicariṣyati

vulgate_text: sairandhryo rakṣitāḥ strīṇāṃ bhujiṣyāḥ santi bhārata / ekapatnyaḥ striyaścaitā iti lokasya niścayaḥ
ce_text: draupady uvāca / sairandhryo 'rakṣitā loke bhujiṣyāḥ santi bhārata / naivam anyāḥ striyo yānti iti lokasya niścayaḥ

vulgate_text: sā'haṃ bruvāṇā sairandhrī kuśalā keśakarmaṇi / pramadāharikā loke puruṣāṇāṃ pravāsinām
ce_text: sāhaṃ bruvāṇā sairandhrī kuśalā keśakarmaṇi / ātmaguptā cariṣyāmi yan māṃ tvam anupṛcchasi

vulgate_text: atha guptā cariṣyāmi yuṣmābhistatra tasthuṣī / ityevaṃ vaḥ pratijñātaṃ vihariṣyāmyahaṃ yathā / yudhiṣṭhira uvāca
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca / yam agnir brāhmaṇo bhūtvā samāgacchan nṛṇāṃ varam / didhakṣuḥ khāṇḍavaṃ dāvaṃ dāśārhasahitaṃ purā

vulgate_text: sarvairapi ca vaktavyaṃ na prājñāyanta pāṇḍavāḥ ardharātre mahātmāno bhikṣādānbrāhmaṇānapi / gatā hyasmānapāhāya sarve dvaitavanāditi / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: sarvair api ca vaktavyaṃ na prajñāyanta pāṇḍavāḥ / gatā hy asmān apākīrya sarve dvaitavanād iti

vulgate_text: tānanvaśātsa dharmātmā sarvadharmaviśeṣavit / dhaumyaḥ purohito rājanpāṇḍavānpuruṣarṣabhān / dhaumya uvāca
ce_text: dhaumya uvāca / vidite cāpi vaktavyaṃ suhṛdbhir anurāgataḥ / ato 'ham api vakṣyāmi hetumātraṃ nibodhata

vulgate_text: viditaṃ vai yathā sarvaṃ loke vṛttamidaṃ nṛpa / vidite cāpi vaktavyaṃ suhṛdbhiranurāgataḥ
ce_text: dhaumya uvāca / vidite cāpi vaktavyaṃ suhṛdbhir anurāgataḥ / ato 'ham api vakṣyāmi hetumātraṃ nibodhata

vulgate_text: durvāsameva kauravya jātena kuruveśmani / amānitena mānārha gūḍhena parivatsaram
ce_text: durvasaṃ tv eva kauravyā jānatā rājaveśmani / amānitaiḥ sumānārhā ajñātaiḥ parivatsaram

vulgate_text: diṣṭadvāro labheddraṣṭuṃ rājasveṣu na viśvaset / na cānuśiṣyādrājānamapṛcchantaṃ kadācana
ce_text: na cānuśiṣyed rājānam apṛcchantaṃ kadā cana / tūṣṇīṃ tv enam upāsīta kāle samabhipūjayan

vulgate_text: dhṛṣṭo dvāraṃ sadā paśyanna ca rājasu viśvaset / tadevāsanamanvicchedyatra nābhilaṣetparaḥ
ce_text: diṣṭadvāro labhed dvāraṃ na ca rājasu viśvaset / tad evāsanam anvicched yatra nābhiṣajet paraḥ

vulgate_text: yathainaṃ yatra cāsīnaṃ śaṅkayedduṣṭacariṇam / na tatropaviśejjātu yo rājavasatiṃ vaset
ce_text: atha yatrainam āsīnaṃ śaṅkeran duṣṭacāriṇaḥ / na tatropaviśej jātu sa rājavasatiṃ vaset

vulgate_text: nityaṃ vipratiṣiddhaṃ tatpurastādāsanaṃ matam / arthārthaṃ hi yadā bhṛtyo rājānamupatiṣṭhate
ce_text: dakṣiṇaṃ vātha vāmaṃ vā pārśvam āsīta paṇḍitaḥ / rakṣiṇāṃ hy āttaśastrāṇāṃ sthānaṃ paścād vidhīyate / nityaṃ vipratiṣiddhaṃ tu purastād āsanaṃ mahat

vulgate_text: dakṣiṇaṃ vā'tha vāmaṃ vā bhāgamāśritya paṇḍitaḥ tiṣṭhedvinītavadrājanna purastānna pṛṣṭhataḥ / rākṣiṇāmāttaśastrāṇāṃ paścātsthānaṃ vidhīyate
ce_text: dakṣiṇaṃ vātha vāmaṃ vā pārśvam āsīta paṇḍitaḥ / rakṣiṇāṃ hy āttaśastrāṇāṃ sthānaṃ paścād vidhīyate / nityaṃ vipratiṣiddhaṃ tu purastād āsanaṃ mahat

vulgate_text: nāsya yugyaṃ na paryaṅkaṃ nāsanaṃ na rathaṃ tathā / ārohetsaṃmato'smīti yo rājavasatiṃ vaset
ce_text: nāsya yānaṃ na paryaṅkaṃ na pīṭhaṃ na gajaṃ ratham / ārohet saṃmato 'smīti sa rājavasatiṃ vaset

vulgate_text: yo vai gṛhebhyaḥ pravasankriyamāṇamanusmaran / utthāne nityasaṃkalpo nistandrīḥ saṃghatātmavān
ce_text: yo vai gṛhebhyaḥ pravasan priyāṇāṃ nānusaṃsmaret / duḥkhena sukham anvicchet sa rājavasatiṃ vaset

vulgate_text: parītaḥ kṣutpipāsābhyāṃ vihāya paridevanam / duḥkhena sukhamanvicchedyo rājavasatiṃ vaset
ce_text: yo vai gṛhebhyaḥ pravasan priyāṇāṃ nānusaṃsmaret / duḥkhena sukham anvicchet sa rājavasatiṃ vaset

vulgate_text: naiṣāṃ dāreṣu kurvīta prājño maitrīṃ kathaṃcana / rakṣaṇaṃ tu na seveta yo rājavasatiṃ vaset
ce_text: naiṣāṃ dāreṣu kurvīta maitrīṃ prājñaḥ kathaṃ cana / antaḥpuracarā ye ca dveṣṭi yānahitāś ca ye

vulgate_text: harṣavastuṣu cāpyatra vartamāneṣu keṣu cit / nātigāḍhaṃ prahṛṣyeta tānyevāsyānupūjayet
ce_text: hāsyavastuṣu cāpy asya vartamāneṣu keṣu cit / nātigāḍhaṃ prahṛṣyeta na cāpy unmattavad dhaset

vulgate_text: na ca saṃdarśane rājñāṃ prabandhamabhisaṃjapet / api caitaddaridrāṇāṃ vyalīkasthānamuttamam
ce_text: na ca saṃdarśane kiṃ cit pravṛddham api saṃjapet / api hy etad daridrāṇāṃ vyalīkasthānam uttamam

vulgate_text: tasmānnārīṃ na nidhyāyettathāyuktāṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ / tathā kṣutaṃ ca vātaṃ ca niṣṭhīvaṃ cācarecchanaiḥ
ce_text: na coṣṭhau nirbhujej jātu na ca vākyaṃ samākṣipet / sadā kṣutaṃ ca vātaṃ ca ṣṭhīvanaṃ cācarec chanaiḥ

vulgate_text: na narmasu hasejjātu mūḍhavṛttirhi sā smṛtā / smitaṃ tu mṛdupūrveṇa darśayīta prasādajam
ce_text: na cātidhairyeṇa cared gurutāṃ hi vrajet tathā / smitaṃ tu mṛdupūrveṇa darśayeta prasādajam

vulgate_text: na cākṣau na bhujau jātu na ca vākyaṃ samākṣipet / na ca tiryagavekṣeta cakṣurbhyāṃ samyagācaret
ce_text: na coṣṭhau nirbhujej jātu na ca vākyaṃ samākṣipet / sadā kṣutaṃ ca vātaṃ ca ṣṭhīvanaṃ cācarec chanaiḥ

vulgate_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / te'gniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇaṃ ca purohitam / abhivādya tataḥ sarve prasthātumupacakramuḥ / yudhiṣṭhira uvāca
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca / karmāṇy uktāni yuṣmābhir yāni tāni kariṣyatha / mama cāpi yathābuddhi rucitāni viniścayāt

vulgate_text: anuśiṣṭosmi bhadraṃ te naitadvaktā'sti kaścana / kuntīmṛte mātaraṃ naḥ pitaraṃ ca yaśasvinam
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca / anuśiṣṭāḥ sma bhadraṃ te naitad vaktāsti kaś cana / kuntīm ṛte mātaraṃ no viduraṃ ca mahāmatim

vulgate_text: yājñasenīṃ puraskṛtya sarva eva mahārathāḥ / prādravansaha dhaumyena baddhaśastrā vanādvanam
ce_text: agniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇāṃś ca tapodhanān / yājñasenīṃ puraskṛtya ṣaḍ evātha pravavrajuḥ

vulgate_text: te vīrā baddhanistriṃśā dhanurbāṇakalāpinaḥ / agacchanbhīmadhanvānaḥ kāmyakādyamunāṃ nadīm
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / te vīrā baddhanistriṃśās tatāyudhakalāpinaḥ / baddhagodhāṅgulitrāṇāḥ kālindīm abhito yayuḥ

vulgate_text: te tasyā dakṣiṇaṃ tīramanvagacchanpadātayaḥ / tataḥ pratyakprayātāste saṃkrāmanto vanādvanam
ce_text: tatas te dakṣiṇaṃ tīram anvagacchan padātayaḥ / vasanto giridurgeṣu vanadurgeṣu dhanvinaḥ

vulgate_text: vasānā vanadurgeṣu ramaṇīyeṣu dhanvinaḥ / palvaleṣu ca ramyeṣu nadīnāṃ saṃgameṣu ca
ce_text: tatas te dakṣiṇaṃ tīram anvagacchan padātayaḥ / vasanto giridurgeṣu vanadurgeṣu dhanvinaḥ

vulgate_text: vidhyanto mṛgajātāni mahepvāsā mahābalāḥ upitvā dvādaśasamā vane parapuraṃjayāḥ / lubdhānbruvāṇā mātsyasya vipayaṃ prāviśaṃstadā
ce_text: vidhyanto mṛgajātāni maheṣvāsā mahābalāḥ / uttareṇa daśārṇāṃs te pāñcālān dakṣiṇena tu

vulgate_text: paśyaikapadyo dṛśyante kṣetre goṣṭhaṃ samāśritāḥ / vṛkṣāṃścopavanopetāngrāmāṇāṃ nagarasya ca
ce_text: tato janapadaṃ prāpya kṛṣṇā rājānam abravīt / paśyaikapadyo dṛśyante kṣetrāṇi vividhāni ca

vulgate_text: viṣamā hyatidurgā ca vegavatparidhāvatā / sohaṃ dharmābhitapto vai naināmādātumutsahe / yudhiṣṭhira uvāca
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca / karmāṇy uktāni yuṣmābhir yāni tāni kariṣyatha / mama cāpi yathābuddhi rucitāni viniścayāt

vulgate_text: ahamapyasmi tṛṣitaḥ kṣudhayā paripīḍitaḥ / pariśrāntaśca bhadraṃ te naināmādātumutsahe / yudhiṣṭhira uvāca
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca / karmāṇy uktāni yuṣmābhir yāni tāni kariṣyatha / mama cāpi yathābuddhi rucitāni viniścayāt

vulgate_text: parigṛhya muhūrtaṃ tvaṃ bāhubhyāṃ kuśalaṃ vraja / rājadhānyāṃ nivatsyāmaḥ pramuktamiva no vanam / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / evam uktas tato rājñā dhaumyo 'tha dvijasattamaḥ / akarod vidhivat sarvaṃ prasthāne yad vidhīyate

vulgate_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / sa rājadhānīṃ saṃprāpya pārthivo'rjunamabravīt imāni puruṣavyāghra āyudhāni paraṃtapa / kasminnyāsayitavyāni guptiścaiṣāṃ kathaṃ bhavet
ce_text: sa rājadhānīṃ saṃprāpya kaunteyo 'rjunam abravīt / kvāyudhāni samāsajya pravekṣyāmaḥ puraṃ vayam

vulgate_text: ekasminnapi vijñāte samayaṃ no vyatītya ca / bhūyo dvādaśavarṣāṇi praviśema vanaṃ vayam
ce_text: tato dvādaśa varṣāṇi praveṣṭavyaṃ vanaṃ punaḥ / ekasminn api vijñāte pratijñātaṃ hi nas tathā

vulgate_text: tasmātsarvāṇi śastrāṇi pracchādyānyatra yatra vā / praviśema puraśreṣṭhaṃ tathā samyakkṛtaṃ bhavet / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / evam uktas tato rājñā dhaumyo 'tha dvijasattamaḥ / akarod vidhivat sarvaṃ prasthāne yad vidhīyate

vulgate_text: iyaṃ vane manuṣyendra mahatī dṛśyate śamī / bhīmaśākhā durārohā śmaśānasya samīpataḥ
ce_text: arjuna uvāca / iyaṃ kūṭe manuṣyendra gahanā mahatī śamī / bhīmaśākhā durārohā śmaśānasya samīpataḥ

vulgate_text: samīpe ca śmaśānasya gṛhaṃ nāsya viśeṣataḥ / samāsajyāyudhānyasyāṃ gacchāmo nagaraṃ nṛpa
ce_text: samāsajyāyudhāny asyāṃ gacchāmo nagaraṃ prati / evam atra yathājoṣaṃ vihariṣyāma bhārata / eṣā śamī pāpaharā sadaiva / yātrotsavānāṃ vijayāya hetuḥ / atrāyudhānāṃ kṛtasaṃniveśe / kṛtārthakāmā jayamaṅgalaṃ ca / pradakṣiṇīkṛtya śamīlatāṃ te / praṇamya cānarcur atha pravīrāḥ / mṛtpiṇḍam ādāya nijāñcalena / sūtiṃ cakāra prathamaṃ kirīṭī / śamī śamayate pāpaṃ śamī śamayate ripūn / śamī śamayate rogāñ chamī sarvārthasādhanā / rāmaḥ sītāṃ samādāya tvatprasādāc chamītale / kṛtakṛtyaḥ pure prāptaḥ prasādāt te tathāstu me

vulgate_text: dhanurbhiḥ puruṣaṃ kṛtvā carmakeśāsthisaṃvṛtam udbandhamiva kṛtvā ca dhanurjyāpāśasaṃvṛtam / asyāmāyudhamāsajya gacchāma nagaraṃ vayam
ce_text: samāsajyāyudhāny asyāṃ gacchāmo nagaraṃ prati / evam atra yathājoṣaṃ vihariṣyāma bhārata / eṣā śamī pāpaharā sadaiva / yātrotsavānāṃ vijayāya hetuḥ / atrāyudhānāṃ kṛtasaṃniveśe / kṛtārthakāmā jayamaṅgalaṃ ca / pradakṣiṇīkṛtya śamīlatāṃ te / praṇamya cānarcur atha pravīrāḥ / mṛtpiṇḍam ādāya nijāñcalena / sūtiṃ cakāra prathamaṃ kirīṭī / śamī śamayate pāpaṃ śamī śamayate ripūn / śamī śamayate rogāñ chamī sarvārthasādhanā / rāmaḥ sītāṃ samādāya tvatprasādāc chamītale / kṛtakṛtyaḥ pure prāptaḥ prasādāt te tathāstu me

vulgate_text: evaṃ parihariṣyanti manuṣyā vanacāriṇaḥ / atraivaṃ nāvabudhyante manuṣyāḥ kecidāyudham / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / evam uktas tato rājñā dhaumyo 'tha dvijasattamaḥ / akarod vidhivat sarvaṃ prasthāne yad vidhīyate

vulgate_text: iti saṃdiśya taṃ pārthaḥ punareva dhanañjayam / abravīdāyudhānīha nidhātuṃ bharatarṣabhaḥ / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / evam uktas tato rājñā dhaumyo 'tha dvijasattamaḥ / akarod vidhivat sarvaṃ prasthāne yad vidhīyate

varade kṛṣṇe kumāri brahmacāriṇi / bālārkasadṛśākāre pūrṇacandranibhānane / caturbhuje caturvaktre pīnaśroṇipayodhare / mayūrapicchavalaye keyūrāṅgadadhāriṇi / bhāsi devi yathā padmā nārāyaṇaparigrahaḥ / svarūpaṃ brahmacaryaṃ ca viśadaṃ tava khecari / kṛṣṇacchavisamā kṛṣṇā saṃkarṣaṇasamānanā / bibhratī vipulau bāhū śakradhvajasamucchrayau / pātrī ca paṅkajī ghaṇṭī strīviśuddhā ca bhujaṃgābhogavāsena śroṇisūtreṇa rājatā / vibhrājase cābaddhena bhogeneveha mandaraḥ / dhvajena śikhipicchānām ucchritena virājase / kaumāraṃ vratam āsthāya tridivaṃ pāvitaṃ tvayā / tena tvaṃ stūyase devi tridaśaiḥ pūjyase 'pi ca / trailokyarakṣaṇārthāya mahiṣāsuranāśini / prasannā me suraśreṣṭhe dayāṃ kuru śivā bhava / jayā tvaṃ vijayā caiva saṃgrāme ca jayapradā / mamāpi vijayaṃ dehi varadā tvaṃ vulgate_text: tamāvrajantaṃ sahadevamagraṇīrnṛpo virāṭo nacirātsamaikṣata praikṣanta taṃ tatra pṛthaksamāgatāḥ sabhāgatāḥ sarvamanoharaprabham / yuvānamāyāntamamitrakarśanaṃ pramuktamabhrādiva candramaṇḍalam
ce_text: sa prāpya rājānam amitratāpanas; tato 'bravīn meghamahaughaniḥsvanaḥ / vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ / athāparo 'dṛśyata vai śaśī yathā / huto havirbhir hi yathādhvare śikhī / tathā samālakṣyata cārudarśanaḥ / prakāśavān sūrya ivāciroditaḥ / tam āvrajantaṃ sahadevam agraṇīr / nṛpo virāṭo nacirāt samaikṣata / praikṣanta taṃ tatra pṛthak samāgatāḥ / sabhāsadaḥ sarvamanoharaprabham / yuvānam āyāntam amitrakarśanaṃ / pramuktam abhrād iva candramaṇḍalam / yaṣṭyā pramāṇānvitayā sudarśanaṃ / dāmāni pāśaṃ ca nibaddhya pṛṣṭhataḥ / mauñjīṃ ca tantrīṃ mahatīṃ susaṃhitāṃ / bālaiś ca dāmair bahubhiḥ samāvṛtām / sa cāpi rājānam uvāca vīryavān / kuruṣva māṃ pārthiva goṣv avasthitam / mayā hi guptāḥ paśavo bhavantu te / pranaṣṭanidrāḥ prabhavo 'smi ballavaḥ / na śvāpadebhyo na ca rogato bhayaṃ / na cāpi tāsām uta taskarād bhayam / payaḥprabhūtā bahulā nirāmayā / bhavanti gāvaḥ subhṛtā narādhipa / niśamya rājā sahadevabhāṣitaṃ / nirīkṣya mādrīsutam abhyanandata / uvāca tuṣṭo muditena cetasā / na ballavatvaṃ tvayi vīra lakṣaye / dhairyād vapuḥ kṣātram iveha te dṛḍhaṃ / prakāśate kauravavaṃśajasya vā / nāpaṇḍiteyaṃ tava dṛśyate tanur / bhaveha rājye mama mantradharmabhṛt / praśādhi matsyān saharājakān imān / bṛhaspatiḥ śakrayutān ivāmarān / balaṃ ca me rakṣa suveṣa sarvaśo / gṛhāṇa khaḍgaṃ pratirūpam ātmanaḥ / anīkakarṇāgradharo balasya me / prabhur bhavān astu gṛhāṇa kārmukam / virāṭarājñābhihitaḥ kurūttamaḥ / praśasya rājānam abhipraṇamya ca / uvāca matsyapravaraṃ mahāmatiḥ / śṛṇuṣva rājan mama vākyam uttamam / bālo hy ahaṃ jātiviśeṣadūṣitaḥ / kuto 'dya me nītiṣu yuktamantritā / svakarmatuṣṭāś ca vayaṃ narādhipa / praśādhi māṃ gāḥ parirakṣaṇe 'nagha / vaiśyo 'smi nāmnāham ariṣṭanemir; gosaṃkhya āsaṃ kurupuṃgavānām

vulgate_text: atha tvidānīṃ tava rocate vibho yatheṣṭato gavyamavekṣa māmakam / tvadarpaṇā me paśavo bhavantu vai paśūnsapālānbhavate dadāmyaham

ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tathā tau kathayitvā tu bāṣpam utsṛjya duḥkhitau / rātriśeṣaṃ tad atyugraṃ dhārayām āsatur hṛdā / atha jñātvā virāṭo 'pi kṛṣṇāsakhyaṃ tu kīcakam / abravīt sa pratīhāraṃ dvāḥstha ānaya kīcakam / prahitaḥ sa virāṭena dvāḥsthaḥ kīcakamandiram / gatvā tam abravīt sūtaṃ matsyas tvāṃ draṣṭum icchati / kīcako 'pi nṛpādeśān matsyasya bhavanaṃ yayau / uvāca matsyarājasya praṇipatya praviśya ca / āgato 'haṃ mahārāja virāṭa vacanāt tava / virāṭa uvāca / vadasva yadi vaktavyaṃ śrutvā yāsyāmi vai gṛham / kalatre vātha vā mitre bhṛtye rājñi yathāpi vā / nivedite sukhe duḥkhe sukhaṃ bhavati kīcaka / tvam eva śaraṇaṃ mahyaṃ rājyaṃ ca tvatprasādataḥ / sakhā vāpi mamaiva tvaṃ tena tvāṃ pratipedire / paśyāmy aharniśaṃ duḥkhaṃ viparītaṃ tu maṇḍalam / sadhūmaṃ jvalanaṃ manye vaimanasyaṃ ca vājinām / śṛṇomi ca śivāṃ ghorām aśivāṃ pratibhāṣiṇīm / rātrau balibhujaḥ saṃghāñ channaṃ sūryasya maṇḍalam / anyac ca saṃprabhāṣante daivajñā mama kīcaka / mama dvādaśagaḥ saurir janmarkṣe tava kīcaka / paśyāmi harmyapatanaṃ kīcaka prāvṛṣaṃ vinā / jānāmy etair mahotpātair yugāntapratimair alam / mṛtyus te bhavitā tathyam atha vā mama kīcaka / śṛṇomi vīra sairandhryāḥ śūrāḥ sāhasakāriṇaḥ / gandharvāḥ patayaḥ pañca santi devendravallabhāḥ / muninā kena cic chaptāś carantīmāṃ vasuṃdharām / rakṣamāṇāś ca sairandhrīṃ bhāryāṃ svīyāṃ pativratām / teṣāṃ nu bhāryā tvaṃ vatsa sairandhrīṃ kartum icchasi / na ca śaktā tvayā bhoktum eṣā gandharvarakṣitā / tvaṃ vātīva kāmārtaḥ kāryam etan na budhyase / vidyutpātair imaiḥ saumya martavyaṃ bhavatā dhruvam / kānyā caivaṃvidhā nārī cared vai kṣitimaṇḍale / vinā sairandhrīṃ bhadraṃ te svayaṃ gandharvarakṣitām / vṛddho vā yadi vā svāmī yadi vā bhaginīpatiḥ / rājā pūjyaḥ sadā mānyaḥ kartavyaṃ vacanaṃ mama / kaikeyaputra vulgate_text: bhayaṃ ca nāviśettatra niṣpratīpaṃ ca darśanam / bahukṣīrāstathā gāvaḥ supuṣṭāśca sudohanāḥ
ce_text: vāyuś ca sukhasaṃsparśo niṣpratīpaṃ ca darśanam / bhayaṃ nābhyāviśet tatra yatra rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ

vulgate_text: payāṃsi dadhisarpīṣi rasavanti hitāni ca / salilāni prasannāni sarve bhāvāśca śobhanāḥ
ce_text: gāvaś ca bahulās tatra na kṛśā na ca durduhāḥ / payāṃsi dadhisarpīṃṣi rasavanti hitāni ca

vulgate_text: dharmāśca tatra sarvaistu sevitāśca dvijātibhiḥ svaiḥsvairguṇaiśca saṃyuktā kasminvarṣe trayodaśe / deśe tasminbhaviṣyanti tata pāṇḍavasaṃśrite
ce_text: svaiḥ svair guṇaiḥ susaṃyuktās tasmin varṣe trayodaśe / deśe tasmin bhaviṣyanti tāta pāṇḍavasaṃyute

vulgate_text: śubhatviṣaḥ śubhecchāśca nityatuṣṭāḥ śriyā'nvitāḥ / bhaviṣyanti janāstatra yatra rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
ce_text: iṣṭadāno mahotsāhaḥ śaśvad dharmaparāyaṇaḥ / aśubhadviṭ śubhaprepsur nityayajñaḥ śubhavrataḥ / bhaviṣyati janas tatra yatra rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ

vulgate_text: dharmajñaḥ sa tu durjñeyaḥ sarvajñaiśca dvijātibhiḥ / kiṃpunaḥ prākṛtaistāta pārtho vijñāyate kvacit
ce_text: dharmātmā sa tadādṛśyaḥ so 'pi tāta dvijātibhiḥ / kiṃ punaḥ prākṛtaiḥ pārthaḥ śakyo vijñātum antataḥ

vulgate_text: tasmānnivāsaḥ pārthānāṃ cintyatāṃ yadbravīmi vaḥ / gatirvā paramā tatra notsahe vaktumanyathā
ce_text: tasmāt tatra nivāsaṃ tu channaṃ satreṇa dhīmataḥ / gatiṃ vā paramāṃ tasya notsahe vaktum anyathā

vulgate_text: evametattu saṃcintya yatkṛtyaṃ sādhu manyase tatkṣipraṃ kuru kauravya yadyetacchraddadhāsi me / kulasya hi kṣamaṃ tāta yadahaṃ prabravīmi te
ce_text: evam etat tu saṃcintya yatkṛtaṃ manyase hitam / tat kṣipraṃ kuru kauravya yady evaṃ śraddadhāsi me

vulgate_text: dharmārthasahitaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ sarvaṃ satyaṃ sahetukam / tatrānurūpaṃ bhīṣmasya mamāpi vacanaṃ śṛṇu
ce_text: dharmārthasahitaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ tattvataś ca sahetumat / tatrānurūpaṃ bhīṣmeṇa mamāpy atra giraṃ śṛṇu

vulgate_text: nāvajñeyo ripustāta prākṛto'pi bubhūṣatā / kiṃ punaḥ pāṇḍavāḥ śūrā vidvāṃso balinastathā
ce_text: nāvajñeyo ripus tāta prākṛto 'pi bubhūṣatā / kiṃ punaḥ pāṇḍavās tāta sarvāstrakuśalā raṇe

vulgate_text: bhīṣmādroṇakṛpairukte karṇaduḥśāsanādibhiḥ tato duryodhano vākyaṃ śrutvā teṣāṃ mahātmanām / muhūrtamanusaṃcintya sacivānidamabravīt
ce_text: evaṃ sarvaṃ viniścitya vyavasāyaṃ svadharmataḥ / yathākālaṃ manuṣyendra ciraṃ sukham avāpsyasi / vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ / tato duryodhano vākyaṃ śrutvā teṣāṃ mahātmanām / muhūrtam iva saṃcintya sacivān idam abravīt / śrutaṃ hy etan mayā pūrvaṃ kathāsu janasaṃsadi / dhīrāṇāṃ śāstraviduṣāṃ prājñānāṃ matiniścaye / kṛtīnāṃ sāraphalgutve jānāmi nayacakṣuṣā / sattve bāhubale dhairye prāṇe śārīrasaṃbhave / sāṃprataṃ mānuṣe loke sadaityanararākṣase / catvāras tu naravyāghrā bale śakropamā bhuvi / uttamāḥ prāṇināṃ teṣāṃ nāsti kaś cid bale samaḥ / samaprāṇabalā nityaṃ saṃpūrṇabalapauruṣāḥ / baladevaś ca bhīmaś ca madrarājaś ca vīryavān / caturthaḥ kīcakas teṣāṃ pañcamaṃ nānuśuśrumaḥ / anyonyānantarabalāḥ parasparajayaiṣiṇaḥ / bāhuyuddham abhīpsanto nityaṃ saṃrabdhamānasāḥ / tenāham avagacchāmi pratyayena vṛkodaram / manasy abhiniviṣṭaṃ me vyaktaṃ jīvanti pāṇḍavāḥ / tatrāhaṃ kīcakaṃ manye bhīmasenena māritam / sairandhrīṃ draupadīṃ manye nātra kāryā vicāraṇā / śaṅke kṛṣṇānimittaṃ tu bhīmasenena kīcakaḥ / gandharvavyapadeśena hato niśi mahābalaḥ / ko hi śakto 'paro bhīmāt kīcakaṃ hantum ojasā / śastraṃ vinā bāhuvīryāt tathā sarvāṅgacūrṇitam / mardituṃ vā tathā śīghraṃ carmamāṃsāsthicūrṇitam / rūpam anyat samāsthāya bhīmasyaitad viceṣṭitam / dhruvaṃ kṛṣṇānimittaṃ tu bhīmasenena sūtajaḥ / gandharvavyapadeśena hato niśi na saṃśayaḥ / pitāmahena ye coktā deśasya ca janasya ca / guṇās te matsyarāṣṭreṣu bahuśo 'pi mayā śrutāḥ / virāṭanagare manye pāṇḍavāś channacāriṇaḥ / nivasanti pure ramye tatra yātrā vidhīyatām / matsyarāṣṭraṃ gamiṣyāmo grahīṣyāmaś ca godhanam / gṛhīte godhane nūnaṃ te 'pi yotsyanti pāṇḍavāḥ / apūrṇe samaye cāpi yadi paśyāma pāṇḍavān / dvādaśānyāni varṣāṇi pravekṣyanti punar vanam / tasmād anyatareṇāpi lābho 'smākaṃ bhaviṣyati / kośavṛddhir ihāsmākaṃ śatrūṇāṃ nidhanaṃ bhavet / kathaṃ suyodhanaṃ gacched yudhiṣṭhirabhṛtaḥ purā / etac cāpi vadaty eṣa mātsyaḥ paribhavān mayi / tasmāt kartavyam etad vai tasmin yātrā vidhīyatām / etat sunītaṃ manye 'haṃ sarveṣāṃ yadi rocate

vulgate_text: tato rājā trigartānāṃ suśarmā rathayūthapaḥ pūrvamābhāṣya karṇena tathā duḥśāsanena ca / prāptakālamidaṃ vākyamuvāca tvarito balī
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / atha rājā trigartānāṃ suśarmā rathayūthapaḥ / prāptakālam idaṃ vākyam uvāca tvarito bhṛśam

vulgate_text: rāṣṭraṃ mamāsakṛdrājanrājñā mātsyena bādhitam
ce_text: asakṛn matsyarājñā me rāṣṭraṃ bādhitam ojasā / praṇetā kīcakaś cāsya balavān abhavat purā

vulgate_text: praṇetā kīcakastasya balotsikto'bhavanpurā amarṣī durjayo jetā prakhyātabalapauruṣaḥ / sa hatastatra gandharvaiḥ pāpakarmā nṛśaṃsakṛt
ce_text: krūro 'marṣī sa duṣṭātmā bhuvi prakhyātavikramaḥ / nihatas tatra gandharvaiḥ pāpakarmā nṛśaṃsavān

vulgate_text: prajñāvānkulavṛddhaśca sarveṣāṃ naḥ pitāmahaḥ / ācāryaśca kṛpo vidvāñśakuniścāpi saubalaḥ
ce_text: prajñāvān kuruvṛddho 'yaṃ sarveṣāṃ naḥ pitāmahaḥ / ācāryaś ca tathā droṇaḥ kṛpaḥ śāradvatas tathā

vulgate_text: tadbhavāṃścaturaṅgeṇa balena mahatā vṛtaḥ virāṭanagaraṃ yātu sarvasainyena bhārata / ādāsyāmo'tha gāstasya vividhāni vasūni ca / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tataḥ śāradvato vākyam ity uvāca kṛpas tadā / yuktaṃ prāptaṃ ca vṛddhena pāṇḍavān prati bhāṣitam

vulgate_text: suśarmā tu yathoddiṣṭaṃ deśaṃ yātu mahārathaḥ trigartaiḥ sahitaḥ sarvaiḥ prakhyātabalapauruṣaiḥ / prāgeva hi susaṃyatto virāṭanagaraṃ prati
ce_text: yathoddeśaṃ ca gacchāmaḥ sahitāḥ sarvakauravaiḥ / suśarmā tu yathoddiṣṭaṃ deśaṃ yātu mahārathaḥ

vulgate_text: tathā gatvā yathoddeśaṃ virāṭanagarāntike / kṣipraṃ goṣṭhaṃ samāsādya gṛhṇantu vipulaṃ dhanam
ce_text: te yātvā sahasā tatra virāṭanagaraṃ prati / kṣipraṃ gopān samāsādya gṛhṇantu vipulaṃ dhanam

vulgate_text: ādatta gāḥ suśarmā'tha kṛṣṇapakṣasya cāṣṭamīm
ce_text: sa sma gatvā yathoddiṣṭāṃ diśaṃ vahner mahīpatiḥ / ādatta gāḥ suśarmātha gharmapakṣasya saptamīm

vulgate_text: apare divase sarve rājansaṃbhūya kauravāḥ navamyāṃ te nyagṛhṇanta gokulāni sahasraśaḥ / kauravāstu mahāvīryā matsyānāṃ viṣayāntare
ce_text: aparaṃ divasaṃ sarve rājan saṃbhūya kauravāḥ / aṣṭamyāṃ tāny agṛhṇanta gokulāni sahasraśaḥ

vulgate_text: hanyamāneṣu gopeṣu vimukheṣu viśāṃpate / tato yuvānaḥ saṃbhītāḥ śvasanto reṇuguṇṭhitāḥ
ce_text: tatas trayodaśasyānte tasya varṣasya bhārata / suśarmaṇā gṛhītaṃ tu godhanaṃ tarasā bahu / tataḥ śabdo mahān āsīd reṇuś ca divam aspṛśat / śaṅkhadundubhinirghoṣo bherīṇāṃ ca mahāsvanaḥ / gavāśvarathanāgānāṃ narāṇāṃ ca padātinām / evaṃ tais tv abhiniryāya matsyarājasya godhane / trigartair gṛhyamāṇe tu gopālāḥ pratyaṣedhayan / atha trigartā bahavaḥ parigṛhya dhanaṃ bahu / parikṣipya hayaiḥ śīghrai rathavrātaiś ca bhārata / gopālān pratyayudhyanta raṇe kṛtvā jaye dhṛtim / te hanyamānā bahubhiḥ prāsatomarapāṇibhiḥ / gopālā gokule bhaktā vārayām āsur ojasā / paraśvadhaiś ca musalair bhiṇḍipālaiś ca mudgaraiḥ / gopālāḥ karpaṇaiś citrair jaghnur aśvān samantataḥ / te hanyamānāḥ saṃkruddhās trigartā rathayodhinaḥ / visṛjya śaravarṣāṇi gopān vyadrāvayan raṇe / tato yuvānaḥ saṃbhītāḥ śvasanto reṇuguṇṭhitāḥ

vulgate_text: javena mahatā caiva gopālāḥ puramāvrajan / virāṭanagaraṃ prāpya narā rājānamabruvan
ce_text: tato javena mahatā gopāḥ puram athāvrajat / apaśyan matsyarājaṃ ca rathāt praskandya kuṇḍalī

vulgate_text: sabhāyāṃ rājaśārdūlamāsīnaṃ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha / śūraiḥ parivṛtaṃ yodhaiḥ kuṇḍalāṅgadadhāribhiḥ
ce_text: śūraiḥ parivṛtaṃ yodhaiḥ kuṇḍalāṅgadadhāribhiḥ / sadbhiś ca mantribhiḥ sārdhaṃ pāṇḍavaiś ca nararṣabhaiḥ

vulgate_text: sadbhiśca paṇḍitaiḥ sārdhaṃ mantribhiścāpi saṃvṛtam / dṛṣṭvā śīghraṃ tu gopālā virāṭamidamabravan
ce_text: śūraiḥ parivṛtaṃ yodhaiḥ kuṇḍalāṅgadadhāribhiḥ / sadbhiś ca mantribhiḥ sārdhaṃ pāṇḍavaiś ca nararṣabhaiḥ

vulgate_text: śrutvā tu vacanaṃ teṣāṃ gopālānāmariṃdamaḥ sa rājā mahatīṃ senāṃ mātsyānāṃ samavāhayat / rathanāgāśvakalilāṃ pattidhvajasamākulām
ce_text: tac chrutvā nṛpatiḥ senāṃ matsyānāṃ samayojayat / rathanāgāśvakalilāṃ pattidhvajasamākulām

vulgate_text: pṛthakkāñcanasannāhānratheṣvaśvānayojayan / utkṛṣya pāśānmaurvīṇāṃ śūrāścāpeṣvayojayan
ce_text: sūpaskareṣu śubhreṣu mahatsu ca mahārathāḥ / pṛthak kāñcanasaṃnāhān ratheṣv aśvān ayojayan

vulgate_text: dṛḍhamāyasagarbhaṃ ca śvetaṃ rukmapariṣkṛtam / virāṭasya suto jyeṣṭho vīraḥ śaṅkho'bhyahārayat
ce_text: dṛḍham āyasagarbhaṃ tu śvetaṃ varma śatākṣimat / virāṭasya suto jyeṣṭho vīraḥ śaṅkho 'bhyahārayat

vulgate_text: dhvajānbahuvidhākārānsauvarṇānhemamālinaḥ / yathāsvaṃ kṣatriyāḥ śūrā ratheṣu samayojayan
ce_text: athānyān vividhākārān dhvajān hemavibhūṣitān / yathāsvaṃ kṣatriyāḥ śūrā ratheṣu samayojayan

vulgate_text: gosaṅkhyamaśvabandhaṃ ca saṃyojaya ratheṣu vaiḥ / naitena jātu yudhdyeyurgavārthamiti me matiḥ / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / atha rājā trigartānāṃ suśarmā rathayūthapaḥ / prāptakālam idaṃ vākyam uvāca tvarito bhṛśam

vulgate_text: atha mātsyo'bravīdrājā śatānīkaṃ jaghanyajam / kaṅkaśca valalaḥ sūdo dāmagranthiśca vīryavān
ce_text: atha matsyo 'bravīd rājā śatānīkaṃ jaghanyajam / kaṅkaballavagopālā dāmagranthiś ca vīryavān / yudhyeyur iti me buddhir vartate nātra saṃśayaḥ

vulgate_text: tantripālaśca gosaṅkhyo yathā te puruṣarṣabhāḥ śūrāḥ suvīrāḥ puruṣā nāgarājavaropamāḥ / yuddhyeyuriti me buddhirvartate nātra saṃśayaḥ
ce_text: atha matsyo 'bravīd rājā śatānīkaṃ jaghanyajam / kaṅkaballavagopālā dāmagranthiś ca vīryavān / yudhyeyur iti me buddhir vartate nātra saṃśayaḥ

vulgate_text: sahadevāya rājñe ca bhīmāya nakulāya ca / tāndṛṣṭvā sahasā sūtā rājabhaktipuraskṛtāḥ
ce_text: etac chrutvā tu nṛpater vākyaṃ tvaritamānasaḥ / śatānīkas tu pārthebhyo rathān rājan samādiśat / sahadevāya rājñe ca bhīmāya nakulāya ca

vulgate_text: bhīmarūpāśca mātaṅgāḥ prabhinnakaraṭāmukhāḥ / svārūḍhā yuddhakuśalairmahāmātrādhirohitāḥ
ce_text: bhīmāś ca mattamātaṅgāḥ prabhinnakaraṭāmukhāḥ / kṣaranta iva jīmūtāḥ sudantāḥ ṣaṣṭihāyanāḥ

vulgate_text: dṛḍhāyudhajanākīrṇaṃ rathāśvagajasaṃkulam / tadbalāgraṃ virāṭasya śakrasyeva tadā babhau
ce_text: tad balāgryaṃ virāṭasya saṃprasthitam aśobhata / dṛḍhāyudhajanākīrṇaṃ gajāśvarathasaṃkulam

vulgate_text: taṃ prayāntaṃ mahārāja ninīṣantaṃ gavāṃ padam / viśāradānāṃ vaiśyānāṃ prakṛṣṭānāṃ tadā nṛpa
ce_text: tad anīkaṃ virāṭasya śuśubhe bharatarṣabha / saṃprayātaṃ mahārāja ninīṣantaṃ gavāṃ padam

vulgate_text: viṃśatistu sahasrāṇi narāṇāmanuyāyinām aṣṭau rathasahasrāṇi daśa nāgaśatāni ca / viṃśaccāśvasahasrāṇi mātsyānāṃ tvaritaṃ yayuḥ
ce_text: viśāradānāṃ vaśyānāṃ hṛṣṭānāṃ cānuyāyinām / aṣṭau rathasahasrāṇi daśa nāgaśatāni ca / ṣaṣṭiś cāśvasahasrāṇi matsyānām abhiniryayuḥ

vulgate_text: tadanīkaṃ virāṭasya śuśubhe'tīva bhārata / vasante bahupuṣpāḍhyaṃ kānanaṃ citritaṃ yathā
ce_text: tad anīkaṃ virāṭasya śuśubhe bharatarṣabha / saṃprayātaṃ mahārāja ninīṣantaṃ gavāṃ padam

vulgate_text: teṣāṃ samāgamo ghorastumulo romaharṣaṇaḥ / ghnatāṃ parasparaṃ rājanyamarāṣṭravivardhanaḥ
ce_text: teṣāṃ samāgamo ghoras tumulo lomaharṣaṇaḥ / devāsurasamo rājann āsīt sūrye vilambati

vulgate_text: devāsurasamo rājannāsītsūrye'balambati / padātirathanāgendrahayārohabalaughavān
ce_text: teṣāṃ samāgamo ghoras tumulo lomaharṣaṇaḥ / devāsurasamo rājann āsīt sūrye vilambati

vulgate_text: anyonyamabhyāpatatāṃ nighnatāṃ cetaretaram / udatiṣṭhadrajo bhaumaṃ na prājñāyata kiṃcana
ce_text: udatiṣṭhad rajo bhaumaṃ na prajñāyata kiṃ cana / pakṣiṇaś cāpatan bhūmau sainyena rajasāvṛtāḥ

vulgate_text: rukmapṛṣṭhāni cāpāni vicerurvidyuto yathā / nardatāṃ lokavīrāṇāṃ savyaṃ dakṣiṇamasyatām
ce_text: rukmapṛṣṭhāni cāpāni vyatiṣaktāni dhanvinām / patatāṃ lokavīrāṇāṃ savyadakṣiṇam asyatām

vulgate_text: nighnantaḥ samare'nyonyaṃ hṛṣṭāḥ parighapāṇayaḥ / na śekuratisaṃkruddhāḥ śūrāḥ kartuṃ parāṅbhukham
ce_text: nighnantaḥ samare 'nyonyaṃ śūrāḥ parighabāhavaḥ / na śekur abhisaṃrabdhāḥ śūrān kartuṃ parāṅmukhān

vulgate_text: raktādharoṣṭhaṃ sunasaṃ klṛptaśmaśru svalaṃkṛtam / adṛśyata śiraśchinnaṃ rajovidhvastakuṇḍalam
ce_text: kḷptottaroṣṭhaṃ sunasaṃ kḷptakeśam alaṃkṛtam / adṛśyata śiraś chinnaṃ rajodhvastaṃ sakuṇḍalam

vulgate_text: virāṭastatra saṃgrāme hatvā pañcaśataṃ rathān / kuñjarāṇāṃ śataṃ caiva sahasraṃ vājināṃ tathā
ce_text: virāṭas tatra saṃgrāme hatvā pañcaśatān rathān / hayānāṃ ca śatāny atra hatvā pañca mahārathān

vulgate_text: tau tu prāharatāṃ tatra maheṣvāsau mahābalau / anyonyamabhinighnantau goṣu govṛṣabhāviva
ce_text: tau vyāvaharatāṃ tatra mahātmānau mahābalau / anyonyam abhigarjantau goṣṭhe govṛṣabhāv iva / ayudhyanta raṇe vīrāḥ śūrāḥ parighabāhavaḥ / kabandhāḥ samare hantuṃ mahāyodhāḥ pracakramuḥ / hanyatāṃ hanyatām eva śirāṃsi patitāny api / kabandhān prerayām āsur huṃkāroccāraṇādibhiḥ / virāṭaś ca mahāścaryaṃ dṛṣṭvā kautukam āgatam / harṣaṃ lebhe paraṃ rājā mamāpy evaṃvidhā narāḥ / kabandhena śataṃ yodhāḥ pātitā raṇamūrdhani / tataḥ kabandhaḥ patitaḥ puṣpavarṣaiḥ sahaiva tu / vimānaṃ preritaṃ devair apsarobhiḥ samāvṛtam / samakṣaṃ sarvayodhānāṃ tatrārūḍho divaṃ yayau / na śekur iti saṃkruddhāḥ śūrāḥ kartuṃ parāṅmukhān

vulgate_text: rājasiṃhau susaṃrabdhau virejaturamarṣaṇau / kṛtāsrau niśitairbāṇairasiśaktiparaśvathaiḥ
ce_text: anyonyaṃ cātisaṃrabdhau viceratur amarṣaṇau / kṛtāstrau niśitair bāṇair asiśaktigadābhṛtau

vulgate_text: anyonyamabhisaṃrabdhau dantābhyāmiva kuñjarau / kṛtāstrau niśitairbāṇairdārayāmāsatū raṇe

vulgate_text: strīṇāṃ madhye'hamajñānādvīryaśauryāṅkitāṃ giram ukto yauvanagarveṇa ko jetuṃ śaknuyātkurūn / amuktvā māṃ yadi nayermariṣyāmi tavāgrataḥ / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca

vulgate_text: ahaṃ taiḥ kurubhiryotsye pratyāneṣyāmi te paśūn / praviśaitadrathānīkamapradhṛṣyaṃ durāsadam
ce_text: praviśyaitad rathānīkam apradhṛṣyaṃ durāsadam / yantā bhūs tvaṃ naraśreṣṭha yotsye 'haṃ kurubhiḥ saha

vulgate_text: yantā bhava naraśreṣṭha yotsye'haṃ kurubhiḥ saha / śūrānsamaracaṇḍāṃśca nayiṣye yamasādanam / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca

vulgate_text: itastato viveṣṭantamakāmaṃ bhayapīḍitam / rathamāropamāyāsa pārthaḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ
ce_text: tata enaṃ viceṣṭantam akāmaṃ bhayapīḍitam / ratham āropayām āsa pārthaḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ

vulgate_text: yādṛśānyatra dṛśyante rūpāṇi vividhāni ca / yattā bhavantastiṣṭhantu yuddhaṃ syātsamupasthitam

vulgate_text: nadīja laṅkeśavanāriketurnagāhvayo nāma nagārisūnuḥ / gatyā sureśaḥ kvacidaṅganeva gururbabhāṣe vacanaṃ tadānīm / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca

vulgate_text: yasmiñjāte mahī kṛtsnā nirbharocchvāsitā'bhavat / yena me dakṣiṇā dattā baddhvā drupadamojasā
ce_text: sa eṣa pārtho vikrāntaḥ savyasācī paraṃtapaḥ / nāyuddhena nivarteta sarvair api marudgaṇaiḥ / ye jetāro mahīpānām amunā bahavo hatāḥ / yasmiṃs tejo mahat kṛtsnaṃ nirbharocchvasitaṃ bhavet / yena me dakṣiṇā dattā baddhvā drupadam ojasā / viddhvā viyadgataṃ lakṣyaṃ vinirjitya ca pārthivān / nirjitānena pāñcālī purānena svayaṃvare / khāṇḍave yena saṃtṛpto vahnir jitvā surāsurān / pariṇītā subhadrā ca yena nirjitya yādavān / nirjito yena yuddhena tripurāriḥ smarārdanaḥ / gatvā triviṣṭapaṃ yena jitendrā dānavā yudhi / nivātakavacā rājan dānavānāṃ trikoṭayaḥ / nirjitāḥ kālakeyāś ca hiraṇyapuravāsinaḥ / yena tvaṃ mocito baddhaś citrasenena tadvane / yena gatvottaraṃ meror ānināya mahad dhanam / yājito dharmasūnuś ca nṛpān sarvān vijitya ca / yasmiñ śauryaṃ ca vīryaṃ ca tejo dhairyaṃ parākramaḥ / audāryaṃ caiva gāmbhīryaṃ hrīḥ śrīr dharmo dayārjavam / evamādiguṇopetaḥ so 'yaṃ pārtho na saṃśayaḥ

vulgate_text: mahādevopi pārthena śrūyate yuddhatoṣitaḥ / kirātaveṣapracchanno girau himavati prabhuḥ
ce_text: nehāsya pratiyoddhāram ahaṃ paśyāmi kauravāḥ / mahādevo 'pi pārthena śrūyate yudhi toṣitaḥ

vulgate_text: athavā kaścidevānyaḥ klībarūpeṇa devarāṭ / śarairenaṃ suniśitaiḥ pātayiṣyāmi bhūtale / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca

vulgate_text: nemānīṣvāsanānīha soḍhuṃ śakṣyanti me balam / nālaṃ bhāraṃ guruṃ bhettuṃ kuñjaraṃ vā pramarditum
ce_text: samādiṣṭo mayā kṣipraṃ dhanūṃṣy avaharottara / nemāni hi tvadīyāni soḍhuṃ śakṣyanti me balam

vulgate_text: mama vā bāhuvikṣepaṃ śatrūniha vijeṣyataḥ / necchāmi tairahaṃ kartuṃ karma vaijayikaṃ tviha
ce_text: bhāraṃ vāpi guruṃ hartuṃ kuñjaraṃ vā pramarditum / mama vā bāhuvikṣepaṃ śatrūn iha vijeṣyataḥ

vulgate_text: tādṛśānyeva sarvāṇi balavanti dṛḍhāni ca yudhiṣṭhirasya bhīmasya bībhatsoryamayostathā / prathitāni viśiṣṭāni durdaśāni bhavantyuta / uttara uvāca

vulgate_text: śarīramiha cāsaktaṃ śamyāṃ śuṣkaṃ purā kila / tadahaṃ rājaputraḥ sanspṛśeyaṃ pāṇinā katham

vulgate_text: tamanvaśāsacchatrughno rathe tiṣṭhandhanañjayaḥ / avaropaya vṛkṣāgrāddhanūṃṣyetāni māciram
ce_text: tam anvaśāsac chatrughno rathe tiṣṭhan dhanaṃjayaḥ / pariveṣṭanam eteṣāṃ kṣipraṃ caiva vyapānuda

vulgate_text: pariveṣṭanameteṣāṃ sarvaṃ muñcasva māciram teṣāṃ saṃnahanīyāni parimucya parantapaḥ / apaśyattatra gāṇḍīvaṃ caturbhiraparaiḥ saha
ce_text: tathā saṃnahanāny eṣāṃ parimucya samantataḥ / apaśyad gāṇḍivaṃ tatra caturbhir aparaiḥ saha

vulgate_text: sa teṣāṃ rūpamālekya bhogināmiva dṛmbhatām / hṛṣṭaromā bhayodvigraḥ pravepitatanustadā
ce_text: sa teṣāṃ rūpam ālokya bhoginām iva jṛmbhatām / hṛṣṭaromā bhayodvignaḥ kṣaṇena samapadyata

vulgate_text: uttara uvāca / sārathe kimidaṃ divyaṃ nāgo vā yadi vā dhanuḥ sauvarṇānyatra padmāni śatapatrāṇi bhāgaśaḥ / kuśāgnipratitaptāni bhānumanti bṛhanti ca
ce_text: uttara uvāca / asmin vṛkṣe kilodbaddhaṃ śarīram iti naḥ śrutam / tad ahaṃ rājaputraḥ san spṛśeyaṃ pāṇinā katham

vulgate_text: vipāṭhāḥ pṛthavaḥ kasya gṛdhrapatrārdhavājitāḥ / varāhakarṇāstīkṣṇāgrāḥ kasyeme rucirāḥ śarāḥ
ce_text: vipāṭhāḥ pṛthavaḥ kasya gārdhrapatrāḥ śilāśitāḥ / hāridravarṇāḥ sunasāḥ pītāḥ sarvāyasāḥ śarāḥ

ce_text: sarvāyudhamahāmātraṃ śātakumbhapariṣkṛtam / etat tad arjunasyāsīd gāṇḍīvaṃ paramāyudham

vulgate_text: umāpatiścatuḥṣaṣṭiṃ śakro'śītiṃ ca pañca ca / somaḥ pañcasahasrāṇi tathā ca varuṇaḥ śatam
ce_text: somaḥ pañcaśataṃ rājā tathaiva varuṇaḥ śatam / pārthaḥ pañca ca ṣaṣṭiṃ ca varṣāṇi śvetavāhanaḥ

ce_text: aśvabandho 'tha nakulaḥ sahadevas tu gokule / sairandhrīṃ draupadīṃ viddhi yatkṛte kīcakā hatāḥ

vulgate_text: śrutvaitadvacanaṃ jiṣṇorvismayasphāritekṣaṇaḥ / paśyannanimiṣaḥ pārthaṃ śanairvācamuvāca ha / uttara uvāca

ce_text: arjuna uvāca / aham asmy arjunaḥ pārthaḥ sabhāstāro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / ballavo bhīmasenas tu pitus te rasapācakaḥ

vulgate_text: ahaṃ tarhi tavācakṣe daśa nāmāni tāni me vairāṭe śṛṇu tāni tvaṃ yāni pūrvaṃ śrutāni te / īśāno vidadhe devastridivasyeśvaro divi
ce_text: uttara uvāca / daśa pārthasya nāmāni yāni pūrvaṃ śrutāni me / prabrūyās tāni yadi me śraddadhyāṃ sarvam eva te

vulgate_text: arjunaḥ phalguno jiṣṇuḥ kirīṭī śvetavāhanaḥ bībhatsurvijayaḥ pārthaḥ savyasācī dhanañjayaḥ / etāni mama nāmāni sthāpitāni surottamaiḥ / uttara uvāca
ce_text: uttara uvāca / asmin vṛkṣe kilodbaddhaṃ śarīram iti naḥ śrutam / tad ahaṃ rājaputraḥ san spṛśeyaṃ pāṇinā katham

vulgate_text: kenāsi vijayo nāma kenāsi śvetavāhanaḥ / savyasācī ca kenāsi jiṣṇurbībhatsureva ca
ce_text: uttara uvāca / kenāsi vijayo nāma kenāsi śvetavāhanaḥ / kirīṭī nāma kenāsi savyasācī kathaṃ bhavān

vulgate_text: śrutā me tasya vīrasya kevalā nāmahetavaḥ itastataścalatyetanmano me cañcalaṃ tvayi / arjuno vā bhavānneti vada śīghraṃ bṛhannale / arjuna uvāca
ce_text: arjunaḥ phalguno jiṣṇuḥ kṛṣṇo bībhatsur eva ca / dhanaṃjayaś ca kenāsi prabrūhi mama tattvataḥ / śrutā me tasya vīrasya kevalā nāmahetavaḥ

vulgate_text: pṛthivyāṃ sāgarāntāyāṃ varṇo me durlabhaḥ samaḥ / śuddhatvādrupavattvācca tena māmārjunaṃ viduḥ
ce_text: pṛthivyāṃ caturantāyāṃ varṇo me durlabhaḥ samaḥ / karomi karma śuklaṃ ca tena mām arjunaṃ viduḥ

vulgate_text: yotsyāmi tairahaṃ sarvairna me tebhyaḥ parābhavaḥ / tena devamanuṣyeṣu jiṣṇurnāmāsmi viśrutaḥ

vulgate_text: dhārtarāṣṭropi durbuddhiḥ paśyannapi dhanañjayam / naiva paśyati nāghrāti mandaḥ krodhavaśaṃ gataḥ / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: yudhyatāṃ kāmam ācāryo nāhaṃ yotsye dhanaṃjayam / matsyo hy asmābhir āyodhyo yady āgacched gavāṃ padam / karṇa uvāca / sadaiva droṇaputro 'yaṃ pāpātmā pāpapauruṣaḥ / kim atra kāryaṃ pārthena kathaṃ vā sa praśasyate / anyatra kāmān mohād vā lobhād vāsmāsu kevalāt / praśaṃsati durātmānaṃ pāṇḍavaṃ pāpapauruṣam / māṃ cāpi nindate nityaṃ dviṣatasyaiva kāmyayā / tasmād ayaṃ sudurbuddhiḥ paśyatāṃ mama pauruṣam / aśvatthāmovāca / vākchūrā brāhmaṇāḥ proktā bāhuśūrāś ca kṣatriyāḥ / karṇa uvāca / dhanuṣā cārjunaḥ śūraḥ karṇaḥ śūro manorathaiḥ / sadā bhīṣayate sarvāṃ vāhinīṃ brāhmaṇo guruḥ / prītyā ca pāṇḍuputrāṇāṃ darśayann ahitaṃ tava / sadā ca vāyavo vānti nityaṃ varṣati vāsavaḥ / arjunaṃ samare jitvā labdhvā ca vijayaṃ mahat / tataś chetsyāmi khaḍgena śiras te brāhmaṇādhama / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / evam ukte tu vacane karṇenāmitrasūdana / aśvatthāmā tato rājan khaḍgaṃ jagrāha carma ca / gṛhītvā vimalaṃ khaḍgaṃ carma cādāya suprabham / dudrāva yoddhuṃ taṃ karṇaṃ siṃhaḥ kṣudramṛgaṃ yathā / tasmin gṛhīte khaḍge tu karṇo 'pi rathināṃ varaḥ / uttatāra rathāt tūrṇaṃ gṛhṇan khaḍgaṃ sa vīryavān / tatas tau tu mahāvīryau dhṛtāstrau yuddhadurmadau / anyonyasya vadhaṃ prepsū siṃhāv iva madotkaṭau / tau dṛṣṭvā sumahāvīryau yuddhāya samavasthitau / duryodhanas tatas tūrṇaṃ rathād uttīrya vegavān / abhigamya guroḥ putram aśvatthāmānam abravīt / aśvatthāman guroḥ putra kṣamyatāṃ dvijasattama / karṇo vaktuṃ na jānāti brāhmaṇāś cātikopanāḥ / tvayi saṃnihito bhāro yuddhasyaiṣa viniścayaḥ / sa tathābhihito rājan rājñā caiva nivāritaḥ / svarathaṃ prāpya tūrṇaṃ vai na ca kiṃ cid uvāca ha / karṇo 'pi svaṃ rathaṃ tūrṇam āruroha nṛpājñayā

vulgate_text: yathā duryodhanaṃ pārtho nopasarpati saṃgare / sāhasādyadi vā mohāttathā nītirvidhīyatām
ce_text: yathā duryodhane 'yatte nāgaḥ spṛśati sainikān / sāhasād yadi vā mohāt tathā nītir vidhīyatām

vulgate_text: tasmādyadatra kalyāṇaṃ loke sadbhiranuṣṭhitam / tatsaṃvidhīyatāṃ śīghraṃ mā vo hyartho'bhyagātparam
ce_text: pratiyudhyāma samare sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varam / tasmād yad atra kalyāṇaṃ loke sadbhir anuṣṭhitam / tat saṃvidhīyatāṃ kṣipraṃ mā no hy artho 'tigāt parān

vulgate_text: eko hi samare pārthaḥ pṛthivīṃ nirdaheccharaiḥ bhrātṛbhiḥ sahito bhūtvā kiṃ punaḥ kauravānraṇe / tasmātsandhiṃ kuruśreṣṭha kuruṣva yadi manyase / duryodhana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tato duryodhano droṇaṃ kṣamayām āsa bhārata / saha karṇena bhīṣmeṇa kṛpeṇa ca mahātmanā

vulgate_text: nāhaṃ rājyaṃ pradāsyāmi pāṇḍavebhyaḥ pitāmaha grāmaṃ senāṃ ca dāsāṃśca svalpaṃ dravyamapi prabho / yuddhopacārikaṃ yattu tatsarvaṃ saṃvidhīyatām / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tato duryodhano droṇaṃ kṣamayām āsa bhārata / saha karṇena bhīṣmeṇa kṛpeṇa ca mahātmanā

vulgate_text: atra yā māmikā buddhiḥ śrūyatāṃ yadi rocate / sarvathā hi mayā śreyo vaktavyaṃ kurunandana
ce_text: bhīṣma uvāca / atra yā māmakī buddhiḥ śrūyatāṃ yadi rocate / kṣipraṃ balacaturbhāgaṃ gṛhya gaccha puraṃ prati / tato 'paraś caturbhāgo gāḥ samādāya gacchatu

vulgate_text: ahaṃ bhīṣmaśca karṇaśca aśvatthāmā kṛpastathā / pratiyotsyāma bībhatsumāgataṃ kṛtaniścayam
ce_text: eṣa vyavasthito droṇo drauṇiś ca tadanantaram / bhīṣmaḥ kṛpaś ca karṇaś ca maheṣvāsā vyavasthitāḥ

vulgate_text: evaṃ rājā suguptaḥ syānna klaibyaṃ gantumarhati matsyaṃ vā punarāyātamathavāpi śatakratum / ahamāvārayiṣyāmi veleva makarālayam / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tato duryodhano droṇaṃ kṣamayām āsa bhārata / saha karṇena bhīṣmeṇa kṛpeṇa ca mahātmanā

vulgate_text: droṇasyoparate vākye bhīṣmaḥ provāca buddhimān ācārya madhye tiṣṭha tvamaśvatthāmā tu savyataḥ / kṛpaḥ śāradvato dhīmānpārśvaṃ rakṣatu dakṣiṇam
ce_text: ācāryo madhyatas tiṣṭhatv aśvatthāmā tu savyataḥ / kṛpaḥ śāradvato dhīmān pārśvaṃ rakṣatu dakṣiṇam

vulgate_text: sarve mahārathāḥ śūrā maheṣvāsā mahābalāḥ / yuddhyantu pāṇḍavaśreṣṭhamāgataṃ yatnato yudhi / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tato duryodhano droṇaṃ kṣamayām āsa bhārata / saha karṇena bhīṣmeṇa kṛpeṇa ca mahātmanā

vulgate_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tataḥ sudarśanaṃ nāma prāsādaṃ harivāhanaḥ / sarvāndevānsamāroṣya prayayo yatra pāṇḍavaḥ
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / apayāte tu rādheye duryodhanapurogamāḥ / anīkena yathāsvena śarair ārcchanta pāṇḍavam

vulgate_text: agnerindrasya somasya yamasya varuṇasya ca tathā dhāturvidhātuśca mitrasya dhanadasya ca / rudrasya viṣṇo savitustridaśānāṃ tathaiva ca
ce_text: agner īśasya somasya varuṇasya prajāpateḥ / tathā dhātur vidhātuś ca kuberasya yamasya ca

vulgate_text: divyaśca vāyuḥ pravavau gandhamādāya sarvaśaḥ / ṛtavaḥ puṣpamādāya samatiṣṭhanta bhārata
ce_text: divyānāṃ tatra mālyānāṃ gandhaḥ puṇyo 'tha sarvaśaḥ / prasasāra vasantāgre vanānām iva puṣpitām

vulgate_text: gavāgramabhito gatvā gāścaivāśu nivartaya yāvadete nivartante kuravo javamāsthitāḥ / tāvadeva paśūnsarvānnivartiṣye tavābhibho / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tathā vyūḍheṣv anīkeṣu kauraveyair mahārathaiḥ / upāyād arjunas tūrṇaṃ rathaghoṣeṇa nādayan

vulgate_text: droṇaṃ kṛpaṃ ca bhīṣmaṃ ca pṛṣatkairabhyavādayat / tatastatsarvamālokya droṇo vacanamabravīt
ce_text: tatas tat sarvam ālokya droṇo vacanam abravīt / mahāratham anuprāptaṃ dṛṣṭvā gāṇḍīvadhanvinam

vulgate_text: etaddhvajāgraṃ pārthasya dūrataḥ pratidṛśyate / meghaḥka savidyutstanito roravīti ca vānaraḥ
ce_text: etad dhvajāgraṃ pārthasya dūrataḥ saṃprakāśate / eṣa ghoṣaḥ sajalado roravīti ca vānaraḥ

vulgate_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tamadūramupāyāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā pāṇḍavamarjunam / nārayaḥ prekṣituṃ śekustapantaṃ hi yathā ravim
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tathā vyūḍheṣv anīkeṣu kauraveyair mahārathaiḥ / upāyād arjunas tūrṇaṃ rathaghoṣeṇa nādayan

vulgate_text: sarvānanyānanādṛtya dṛṣṭvā tamatimāninam / siṃhaḥ kṣudramṛgasyeva patiṣye tasya mūrdhani
ce_text: sarvān anyān anādṛtya dṛṣṭvā tam atimāninam / tasya mūrdhni patiṣyāmi tata ete parājitāḥ

vulgate_text: duryodhanaṃ na paśyāmi kva nu rājā sa tiṣṭhati / utsṛṃjyaitadrathānīkaṃ yāhi yatra suyodhanaḥ
ce_text: utsṛjyaitad rathānīkaṃ gaccha yatra suyodhanaḥ / tatraiva yotsye vairāṭe nāsti yuddhaṃ nirāmiṣam / taṃ jitvā vinivartiṣye gāḥ samādāya vai punaḥ

vulgate_text: taṃ hatvā saṃnivartiṣye gāḥ sa ādāya gacchati / gavāgramabhito yāhi yatra rājā bhaviṣyati / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tathā vyūḍheṣv anīkeṣu kauraveyair mahārathaiḥ / upāyād arjunas tūrṇaṃ rathaghoṣeṇa nādayan

vulgate_text: kiṃ no gāvaḥ kariṣyanti dravyaṃ vā vipulaṃ tathā / duryodhanaḥ pārthagataḥ purā prāṇānvimuñcati / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tathā vyūḍheṣv anīkeṣu kauraveyair mahārathaiḥ / upāyād arjunas tūrṇaṃ rathaghoṣeṇa nādayan

vulgate_text: ime tvatirathāḥ sarve mama vīryaparākramam / paśyantu kuravo yuddhe mahendrasyeva dānavāḥ / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tathā vyūḍheṣv anīkeṣu kauraveyair mahārathaiḥ / upāyād arjunas tūrṇaṃ rathaghoṣeṇa nādayan

vulgate_text: śalabhairiva cākāśaṃ dhārābhiriva parvatam / nirāvakāśamabhavaccharaiḥ kṣiptaiḥ kirīṭinā
ce_text: tathaiva gatvā bībhatsur nāma viśrāvya cātmanaḥ / śalabhair iva tāṃ senāṃ śaraiḥ śīghram avākirat

vulgate_text: sā cāpi bahulā senā pārthabāṇābhipīḍitā / nāpaśyadvivṛtāṃ bhūmiṃ nāntarikṣaṃ diśopi vā
ce_text: kīryamāṇāḥ śaraughais tu yodhās te pārthacoditaiḥ / nāpaśyan nāvṛtāṃ bhūmim antarikṣaṃ ca patribhiḥ

vulgate_text: teṣāṃ naivāpayāne ca nābhiyāne bhavanmatiḥ / śīghratāmeva pārthasya pūjayantastu vismitāḥ
ce_text: teṣāṃ nātmanino yuddhe nāpayāne 'bhavan matiḥ / śīghratvam eva pārthasya pūjayanti sma cetasā

vulgate_text: candrāvadātaṃ sāmudraṃ kurusainyabhayaṃkaram tataḥ śaṅkhamupādhmāsīddviṣatāṃ romaharṣaṇam / jyāghoṣaṃ talaghoṣaṃ ca kṛtvā bhūtānyamohayat
ce_text: tataḥ śaṅkhaṃ pradadhmau sa dviṣatāṃ lomaharṣaṇam / visphārya ca dhanuḥśreṣṭhaṃ dhvaje bhūtāny acodayat

vulgate_text: tasya śaṅkhasya śabdena dhanuṣo nisvanena ca śabdenāmānuṣāṇāṃ ca bhūtānāṃ dhvajavāsinām / viyadgatānāṃ devānāṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ raveṇa ca
ce_text: tasya śaṅkhasya śabdena rathanemisvanena ca / amānuṣāṇāṃ teṣāṃ ca bhūtānāṃ dhvajavāsinām

vulgate_text: ūrdhvaṃ pucchaṃ vidhūnvānā hemamāṇāḥ samantataḥ / gāvaḥ savatsāḥ saṃtrastā nivṛttā dakṣiṇāṃ diśaṃ
ce_text: ūrdhvaṃ pucchān vidhunvānā rebhamāṇāḥ samantataḥ / gāvaḥ pratinyavartanta diśam āsthāya dakṣiṇām / tataḥ sa samare vīro bībhatsuḥ śatrupūgahā / gopālāṃś codayām āsa gāś caitāś codayeti ca / uttaraṃ cāha bībhatsur harṣayan pāṇḍunandanaḥ / gavām agraṃ samīkṣasva gāś caivāśu nivartaya / yāvad ete nivartante kuravo javam āsthitāḥ / yāhy uttareṇa gāś caitāḥ sainyānāṃ ca nṛpātmaja / paśyantu kuravaḥ sarve mama vīryaparākramam / te lābham iva manvānāḥ kuravo 'rjunam āhave / dṛṣṭvā yāntam adūrasthaṃ kṣipram abhyapatan rathaiḥ / hastyaśvaparivāreṇa mahatābhivirājatā / yodhaiḥ prāsāsihastaiś ca cāpabāṇodyatāyudhaiḥ / tāny anīkāny aśobhanta kurūṇām ātatāyinām / saṃsarpanta ivākāśe vidyutvanto balāhakāḥ / tāni dṛṣṭvā hy anīkāni nivartitarathāni ca / pārtho 'pi vāyuvad ghoraṃ sainyāgraṃ vyadhunoc charaiḥ

vulgate_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tatastrīṇi sahasrāṇi rathānāṃ ca dhanuṣmatām / ghorāṇi kuruvīrāṇāṃ paryakīryanta bhārata
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / sa śatrusenāṃ tarasā praṇudya; gās tā vijityātha dhanurdharāgryaḥ / duryodhanāyābhimukhaṃ prayāto; bhūyo 'rjunaḥ priyam ājau cikīrṣan

vulgate_text: atiṣṭhannivakāśeṣu pādātāḥ saha vājibhiḥ / bhīmarūpāśca mātaṅgāstomarāṅkuśacoditāḥ
ce_text: abhyāśe vājinas tasthuḥ samārūḍhāḥ prahāribhiḥ / bhīmarūpāś ca mātaṅgās tomarāṅkuśacoditāḥ

vulgate_text: yadi me prahareddroṇaḥ śarīre me prahṛṣyataḥ / tato'sminprahariṣyāmi nānyathā buddhirasti me
ce_text: yadi me prathamaṃ droṇaḥ śarīre prahariṣyati / tato 'sya prahariṣyāmi nāsya kopo bhaviṣyati

vulgate_text: dhvajāgre govṛṣo yasya kāñcano'bhivirājate / ācāryavaramukhyastu kṛpa eṣa mahārathaḥ
ce_text: asyāvidūre tu dhanur dhvajāgre yasya dṛśyate / ācāryasyaiṣa putro vai aśvatthāmā mahārathaḥ

vulgate_text: yastu śvetāvadātena pañcatālena ketunā / vaiḍūryamayadaṇḍena tālavṛkṣeṇa rājate
ce_text: yas tu nīlānusāreṇa pañcatāreṇa ketunā / hastāvāpī bṛhaddhanvā rathe tiṣṭhati vīryavān

vulgate_text: śīghraśca laguvedhī ca laghuhastaḥ pratāpavān / eṣa śāntanavo bhīṣmaḥ sarveṣāṃ naḥ pitāmahaḥ
ce_text: eṣa śāṃtanavo bhīṣmaḥ sarveṣāṃ naḥ pitāmahaḥ / rājaśriyāvabaddhas tu duryodhanavaśānugaḥ

vulgate_text: kakudaḥ sarvasainyānāṃ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃvaraḥ jayaśriyā'vabaddhastu suyodhanavaśānugaḥ / paścādeṣa prayātavyo na me vighnakaro bhavet
ce_text: paścād eṣa prayātavyo na me vighnakaro bhavet / etena yudhyamānasya yattaḥ saṃyaccha me hayān

vulgate_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / aśvatthāmā tatastatra karṇaṃ saṃprekṣya vīryavān / uvāca smayamāno'sau sūtaputramarindamam
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / taṃ pārthaḥ pratijagrāha vāyuvegam ivoddhatam / śarajālena mahatā varṣamāṇam ivāmbudam

vulgate_text: karṇa yastvaṃ sabhāmadhye bahvabaddhaṃ vikatthase / na me yudhi samo'stīti tadidaṃ pratyupasthitam
ce_text: arjuna uvāca / karṇa yat te sabhāmadhye bahu vācā vikatthitam / na me yudhi samo 'stīti tad idaṃ pratyupasthitam

vulgate_text: yadyaśaktosi saṃgrāme pārthenādbhutakarmaṇā punareva sabhāṃ gatvā dhārtarāṣṭreṇa dhīmatā / mātulaṃ parigṛhyāśu mantrayasva yathāsukham / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / taṃ pārthaḥ pratijagrāha vāyuvegam ivoddhatam / śarajālena mahatā varṣamāṇam ivāmbudam

vulgate_text: paśyatvācāryaputro māmarjunenātiraṃhasā / yudhyamānaṃ susaṃyuktaṃ jayo vai mayyavasthitaḥ / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / taṃ pārthaḥ pratijagrāha vāyuvegam ivoddhatam / śarajālena mahatā varṣamāṇam ivāmbudam

vulgate_text: duḥsahaṃ daśabhirbāṇairarjunaḥ samavidhyata duśyāsanaṃ dvādaśabhiḥ kṛpaṃ śāradvataṃ tribhiḥ / bhīṣmaṃ śāntanavaṃ ṣaṣṭyā pratyavidhyatstanāntare
ce_text: duḥśāsanas tu bhallena viddhvā vairāṭim uttaram / dvitīyenārjunaṃ vīraḥ pratyavidhyat stanāntare

vulgate_text: teṣāmanīkāni kirīṭamālī vyūḍhāni dṛṣṭvā vipuladhvajāni / gāṇḍīvadhanvā dviṣatāṃ nihantā vairāṭimāmantrya tato'bhyuvāca
ce_text: teṣām anīkāni bahūni gāḍhaṃ; vyūḍhāni dṛṣṭvā bahuladhvajāni / matsyasya putraṃ dviṣatāṃ nihantā; vairāṭim āmantrya tato 'bhyuvāca

vulgate_text: etena śīghraṃ pratipādayemān śvetānhayānkāñcanajālakakṣyān / sarvaṃ javaṃ tatra vidarśayiṣye hyāsādayaitadrathavīravṛndam
ce_text: etena tūrṇaṃ pratipādayemāñ; śvetān hayān kāñcanaraśmiyoktrān / javena sarveṇa kuru prayatnam; āsādayaitad rathasiṃhavṛndam

vulgate_text: gajo gajaneva hi yoddhukāmo mayā sadā kāṅkṣati sūtaputraḥ tameva māṃ prāpaya sūtaputraṃ duryodhanopāśrayajātadarpam / taṃ pātayiṣyāmi rathasya madhye sahasranetro'śanineva vṛtram / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tathā vyūḍheṣv anīkeṣu kauraveyair mahārathaiḥ / upāyād arjunas tūrṇaṃ rathaghoṣeṇa nādayan

vulgate_text: taṃ pāṇḍavaḥ spaṣṭamudīrṇakopaṃ kṛtāgasaṃ karṇamudīkṣya kopāt / kṣaṇena sāśvaṃ sarathaṃ sasūtamantardadhe megha ivātivṛṣṭyā
ce_text: sa pāṇḍavaṃ dvādaśabhiḥ pṛṣatkair; vaikartanaḥ śīghram upājaghāna / vivyādha gātreṣu hayāṃś ca sarvān; virāṭaputraṃ ca śarair nijaghne / tam āpatantaṃ sahasā kirīṭī / vaikartanaṃ vai tarasābhipatya / pragṛhya vegaṃ nyapataj javena / nāgaṃ garutmān iva citrapakṣaḥ / tāv uttamau sarvadhanurdharāṇāṃ / mahābalau sarvasapatnasāhau / karṇasya pārthasya niśamya yuddhaṃ / didṛkṣamāṇāḥ kuravo 'bhitasthuḥ / sa pāṇḍavas tūrṇam udīrṇakopaḥ / kṛtāgasaṃ karṇam udīkṣya harṣāt / kṣaṇena sāśvaṃ sarathaṃ sasārathim / antardadhe ghoraśaraughavṛṣṭyā / tataḥ suviddhāḥ sarathāḥ sanāgā / yodhā vinedur bharatarṣabhāṇām / antarhitā bhīṣmamukhāḥ sahāśvāḥ / kirīṭinā kīrṇarathāḥ pṛṣatkaiḥ / sa cāpi tān arjunabāhumuktāñ / śarāñ śaraughaiḥ pratihatya karṇaḥ / tasthau mahātmā sadhanuḥ sabāṇaḥ / savisphuliṅgo 'gnir ivāśu karṇaḥ / tatas tu jajñe talatālaśabdaḥ / saśaṅkhabherīpraṇavapraṇādaḥ / prakṣveḍitajyātalanisvanaṃ taṃ / vaikartanaṃ pūjayatāṃ kurūṇām / uddhūtalāṅgūlamahāpatākaṃ / dhvajottamaṃ sākulabhīṣayantam / gāṇḍīvanirhrādakṛtapraṇādaṃ / kirīṭinaṃ prekṣya nanāda karṇaḥ / sa cāpi vaikartanam ardayitvā / sāśvaṃ sasūtaṃ sarathaṃ pṛṣatkaiḥ / tam āvavarṣa prasabhaṃ kirīṭī / pitāmahaṃ droṇakṛpau ca dṛṣṭvā / sa cāpi pārthaṃ bahubhiḥ pṛṣatkair / vaikartano megha ivābhyavarṣat / tathaiva karṇaṃ ca kirīṭamālī / saṃchādayām āsa śitaiḥ pṛṣatkaiḥ / tayoḥ sutīkṣṇān sṛjatoḥ śaraughān / mahāśaraughāstravivardhane raṇe / rathe vilagnāv iva candrasūryau / ghanāntareṇānudadarśa lokaḥ / athāśukārī caturo hayāṃś ca / vivyādha karṇo niśitaiḥ kirīṭinaḥ / tribhiś ca yantāram amṛṣyamāṇo / vivyādha tūrṇaṃ tribhir asya ketum / tenātividdhaḥ samarāvamardī / prabodhitaḥ siṃha iva prasuptaḥ / gāṇḍīvadhanvā ṛṣabhaḥ kurūṇām / ajihmagaiḥ karṇam iyāya jiṣṇuḥ / śarāstravṛṣṭyā nihato mahātmā / prāduścakārātimanuṣyakarma / prācchādayat karṇarathaṃ pṛṣatkair / lokān imān sūrya ivāṃśujālaiḥ

vulgate_text: hatāstu pārthena rathapravīrā bhūmau yuvānaḥ supupuḥ sukeśāḥ / suvarṇalohāyasavarmagātrā vṛkṣā yathā haimavate nikṛttāḥ
ce_text: hatās tu pārthena narapravīrā; bhūmau yuvānaḥ suṣupuḥ suveṣāḥ / vasupradā vāsavatulyavīryāḥ; parājitā vāsavajena saṃkhye / suvarṇakārṣṇāyasavarmanaddhā; nāgā yathā haimavatāḥ pravṛddhāḥ

vulgate_text: suśīrṇaparṇāni yathā vasante vidhūnayanvāyurivālpasārān / tathā sapatnānvidhamankirīṭī cacāra saṅkhye'tiratho rathena
ce_text: prakīrṇaparṇāni yathā vasante; viśātayitvātyanilo nudan khe / tathā sapatnān vikiran kirīṭī; cacāra saṃkhye 'tiratho rathena

vulgate_text: yo bhrātaraṃ pātayitvā kastyaktvā ca raṇājiram / tvadanyaḥ puruṣaḥ satsu brūyādevaṃ vyavasthitaḥ / karṇa uvāca
ce_text: tato 'bhyavahad avyagro vairāṭiḥ savyasācinam / yatrātiṣṭhat kṛpo rājan yotsyamāno dhanaṃjayam / vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ / aśvatthāmā tataḥ karṇaṃ tatra saṃprekṣya vīryavān / uvāca smayamāno vai sūtaputram ariṃdamam / karṇa yat tat sabhāmadhye bahvabaddhaṃ vikatthase / na me yudhi samo 'stīti tad idaṃ pratyupasthitam / eṣo 'ntaka iva kruddhaḥ sarvabhūtāvamardanaḥ / saṃgrāmaśiraso madhye jṛmbhate kesarī yathā / śūro 'si yadi saṃgrāme darśayasva sabhāṃ vinā / yady aśaktosi vīreṇa pārthenādbhutakarmaṇā / punar eva sabhāṃ gatvā dhārtarāṣṭreṇa dhīmatā / mātulaṃ pratigṛhyāśu mantrayasva yathāsukham / evam uktas tadā karṇaḥ krodhād udvṛtya locane / droṇaputram idaṃ vākyam uvāca kurusaṃnidhau / nāhaṃ bibhemi bībhatsor na kṛṣṇād devakīsutāt / pāṇḍavebhyo 'pi sarvebhyaḥ kṣatradharmam anuvrataḥ / sattvādhikānāṃ puṃsāṃ hi dhanurvedopajīvinām / garjatāṃ jāyate darpaḥ svaraś ca na viṣīdati / paśyatv ācāryaputro mām arjunena ciraṃ saha / yudhyamānaṃ susaṃyattaṃ jayo vai mayy avasthitaḥ / tataḥ prahasya bībhatsuḥ kaunteyaḥ śvetavāhanaḥ / divyam astraṃ vikurvāṇaḥ pratyayād rathasattamān / mahāmanā mandabuddhir niḥśvasan dhṛtarāṣṭrajaḥ / uvāca sa mahārāja rājā duryodhanas tadā / na vidma hy arjunaṃ tatra vasantaṃ mātsyaveśmani / tenedaṃ karṇa mātsyānām agrahīṣma dhanaṃ bahu / etac cet tarhi gacchāmo visṛjanto dhanaṃ bahu / ayaśo nātivarteta lokayor ubhayor api / na ca yuddhāt paraṃ nāsti kṣatriyāṇāṃ sukhāvaham / tasmāt pārthena saṃgrāmaṃ kurmahe na palāyanam / etāvad uktvā rājā vai abhiyānam iyeṣa saḥ / tāni pañca sahasrāṇi vīrāṇāṃ hi dhanuṣmatām / abhyadravaṃs tadā pārthaṃ śalabhā iva pāvakam / varmitā vājinas tatra saṃbhṛtāś ca padātibhiḥ / bhīmarūpāś ca mātaṅgās tomarāṅkuśapāṇibhiḥ / adhiṣṭhitāḥ susaṃyattair hastiśikṣāviśāradaiḥ / abhyadravanta saṃkruddhāś cāpahastodyatāyudhaiḥ / pañca cainaṃ rathodagrās tvaritāḥ paryavārayan / droṇo bhīṣmaś ca karṇaś ca kururājaś ca vīryavān / aśvatthāmā mahābāhur dhanurvedaparāyaṇaḥ / iṣūn vai samyag asyanto jīmūtā iva vārṣikāḥ / te lābham iva manvānāḥ pratyagṛhṇan dhanaṃjayam / śaraughān abhivarṣanto nādayanto diśo daśa

vulgate_text: ayaṃ kaunteyakāmaste nacirātsamupasthitaḥ / yotsyase hi mayā sārdhamatra paśyāmi te balam / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tathā vyūḍheṣv anīkeṣu kauraveyair mahārathaiḥ / upāyād arjunas tūrṇaṃ rathaghoṣeṇa nādayan

vulgate_text: taṃ śatrusenāṅganibarhaṇāni karmāṇi kurvāṇamamānuṣāṇi / vaikartanaḥ pūrvamamṛṣyamāṇaḥ samārpayallakṣyamivāśu pārtham
ce_text: taṃ śātravāṇāṃ gaṇabādhitāraṃ; karmāṇi kurvāṇam amānuṣāṇi / śatruṃtapaḥ kopam amṛṣyamāṇaḥ; samarpayat kūrmanakhena pārtham

vulgate_text: balaṃ satvaṃ ca tejaśca lāghavaṃ ca vyavardhata / taccādbhutamabhiprekṣya bhayamuttaramāviśat / uttara uvāca
ce_text: arjuna uvāca / yatraiṣā kāñcanī vedī pradīptāgniśikhopamā / ucchritā kāñcane daṇḍe patākābhir alaṃkṛtā / tatra māṃ vaha bhadraṃ te droṇānīkāya māriṣa / vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ / jitaṃ vaikartanaṃ dṛṣṭvā pārtho vairāṭim abravīt / sthiro bhava tvaṃ saṃgrāme jayo 'smākaṃ nṛpātmaja / yāvac chaṅkham upādhmāsye dviṣatāṃ romaharṣaṇam / aviklavam asaṃbhrāntam avyagrahṛdayekṣaṇam / yāhi śīghraṃ yato droṇo mamācāryo mahārathaḥ / tathā saṃkrīḍamānasya arjunasya raṇājire / balaṃ sattvaṃ ca tejaś ca lāghavaṃ cāpy avardhata / uttaraḥ / tac cādbhutam abhiprekṣya bhayam uttaram āviśat / astrāṇāṃ tava divyānāṃ śaraughān kṣipataś ca te / mano me muhyate 'tyarthaṃ tava dṛṣṭvā parākramam / dvaidhībhūtaṃ mano mahyaṃ bhayād bharatasattama / adṛṣṭapūrvaṃ paśyāmi tava gāṇḍīvanisvanam / tava bāhubalaṃ caiva dhanuḥ prākarṣato bahu / vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ / tava tejo durādharṣaṃ yathā viṣṇos trivikrame / tam uttaraś citram avekṣya gāṇḍivaṃ / śarāṃś ca muktān sahasā kirīṭinā / bhīto 'bravīd arjunam ājimadhye / nāhaṃ tavāśvān viṣahe niyantum / tam abravīd īṣad iva prahasya / gāṇḍīvadhanvā dviṣatāṃ nihantā / mayā sahāyena kuto 'sti te bhayaṃ / praihy uttarāśvān upamantrya vāhaya / āśvāsitas tena dhanaṃjayena / vairāṭir aśvān pratutoda śīghram / dhanaṃjayaś cāpi nikṛṣya cāpaṃ / viṣphārayām āsa mahendrakalpaḥ / uttaraṃ caiva bībhatsur abravīt punar arjunaḥ / na bhetavyaṃ mayā sārdhaṃ tāta saṃgrāmamūrdhani / rājaputro 'si bhadraṃ te kule mahati mātsyake / jātas tvaṃ kṣatriyakule na viṣīditum arhasi / dhṛtiṃ kṛtvā suvipulāṃ rājaputra rathaṃ mama / yudhyamānasya samare śatrubhiḥ saha vāhaya / uktvā tam evaṃ bībhatsur arjunaḥ punar abravīt / pāṇḍavo rathināṃ śreṣṭho bhāradvājaṃ samīkṣya tu

vulgate_text: tatra māṃ vaha bhadraṃ te droṇaṃ yotsyāmi sattamam / bhāradvājena yotsye'hamācāryeṇa mahātmanā

vulgate_text: amī śoṇāḥ prakāśante turagāḥ sādhuvāhinaḥ / muktā rathavare tasya sarvaśikṣāviśāradāḥ
ce_text: aśvāḥ śoṇāḥ prakāśante bṛhantaś cāruvāhinaḥ / snigdhavidrumasaṃkāśās tāmrāsyāḥ priyadarśanāḥ / yuktā rathavare yasya sarvaśikṣāviśāradāḥ

vulgate_text: yato rathavare śūraḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃvaraḥ / snigdhavaiḍūryasaṃkāśastāmrākṣaḥ priyadarśanaḥ
ce_text: aśvāḥ śoṇāḥ prakāśante bṛhantaś cāruvāhinaḥ / snigdhavidrumasaṃkāśās tāmrāsyāḥ priyadarśanāḥ / yuktā rathavare yasya sarvaśikṣāviśāradāḥ

vulgate_text: catvāro nikhilā vedāḥ sāṅgopāṅgāḥ salakṣaṇāḥ / dhanurvedaśca kārtsnyena brāhmaṃ cāstraṃ pratiṣṭhitam
ce_text: sasaṃhārāṇi divyāni sarvāṇy astrāṇi māriṣa / dhanurvedaś ca kārtsnyena yasmin nityaṃ pratiṣṭhitaḥ

vulgate_text: kṣamā damaśca satyaṃ ca tejo mārdavamārjavam / pratiṣṭhitā guṇā yasminbahavo dvijasattame
ce_text: kṣamā damaś ca satyaṃ ca ānṛśaṃsyam athārjavam / ete cānye ca bahavo guṇā yasmin dvijottame

vulgate_text: uttarastvevamukto'śvāṃścodayāmāsa taṃ prati / ājagāmārjunaratho bhāradvājarathaṃ prati
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / arjunenaivam uktas tu vairāṭir hemabhūṣitān / codayām āsa tān aśvān bhāradvājarathaṃ prati

vulgate_text: tamāpatantaṃ vegena pāṇḍavaṃ sarathaṃ raṇe / droṇopyabhyadravatpārthaṃ mato mattamiva dvipam
ce_text: tam āpatantaṃ vegena pāṇḍavaṃ rathināṃ varam / droṇaḥ pratyudyayau pārthaṃ matto mattam iva dvipam

vulgate_text: ahaṃ tu tāḍitaḥ pūrvaṃ prahareyaṃ tavānagha / iti me vartate buddhistadbhavānkṣantumarhati
ce_text: ahaṃ tu prahṛte pūrvaṃ prahariṣyāmi te 'nagha / iti me vartate buddhis tad bhavān kartum arhati

vulgate_text: tataḥ prādhmāpayacchaṅkhaṃ bherīpaṭahavāditam / vyakṣobhata balaṃ sarvamuddhūtamiva sāgaram / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / dṛṣṭvā vyūḍhāny anīkāni kurūṇāṃ kurunandanaḥ / tatra vairāṭim ābhāṣya pāṇḍavo 'thābravīd idam / jāmbūnadamayī vedī dhvaje yasya prakāśate / tasya dakṣiṇato yāhi kṛpaḥ śāradvato yataḥ / dhanaṃjayavacaḥ śrutvā vairāṭis tvaritas tadā / hayān rajatasaṃkāśān hemabhāṇḍān acodayat / ānupūrvyā nudañ śūra āsthāya javam uttamam / prāhiṇoc candrasaṃkāśān kupitān iva tān hayān / sa gatvā kurusenāyāḥ samīpaṃ hayakovidaḥ / punar āvartayām āsa tān hayān vātaraṃhasaḥ / pradakṣiṇam upāvṛtya maṇḍalaṃ savyam eva ca / kurūn saṃmohayām āsa matsyo yānena tattvavit / kṛpasya ratham āsthāya vairāṭir akutobhayaḥ / pradakṣiṇam upāvṛtya tasthau tasyāgrato balī / tato 'rjunaḥ śaṅkhavaraṃ devadattaṃ mahāravam / pradadhmau ratham āsthāya nāma viśrāvya cātmanaḥ / tasya śabdo mahān āsīd dhamyamānasya jiṣṇunā / tathā vīryavatā saṃkhye parvatasyeva dīryataḥ / pūjayāṃ cakrire śaṅkhaṃ kuravas te sasainikāḥ / arjunena tathā dhmātaḥ śatadhā yan na dīryate / divam āvṛtya śabdas tu nivṛttaḥ śuśruve punaḥ / sṛṣṭo maghavatā vajraḥ prapatann iva parvate / etasminn antare tatra mahāvīryaparākramaḥ / ājagāma mahāsattvaḥ kṛpaḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / arjunaṃ prati saṃyoddhuṃ yuddhārthī sa mahārathaḥ

vulgate_text: aśvāñśoṇānmahāvegānhaṃsavarṇaistu vājibhiḥ / miśritānsamare dṛṣṭvā vyasmayanta pṛthagjanāḥ
ce_text: atha śoṇān sadaśvāṃs tān haṃsavarṇair manojavaiḥ / miśritān samare dṛṣṭvā vyasmayanta raṇe janāḥ

vulgate_text: rathaṃ rathena pārthasya samāhatya paraṃtapaḥ / harṣayuktastadā''cāryaḥ pratyagṛhṇātsa pāṇḍavam
ce_text: harṣayuktas tathā pārthaḥ prahasann iva vīryavān / rathaṃ rathena droṇasya samāsādya mahārathaḥ

vulgate_text: samāśliṣṭāvivānyonyaṃ droṇapāṇḍavayordhvajau / dṛṣṭvā prākampata muhurbhāratānāṃ mahācamūḥ
ce_text: samāśliṣṭau tadānyonyaṃ droṇapārthau mahābalau / dṛṣṭvā prākampata muhur bharatānāṃ mahad balam

vulgate_text: tattu yuddhaṃ pravavṛte hyācāryasyārjunasya ca / vimuñcatoḥ śarānugrānviśikhāndīptatejasaḥ
ce_text: evaṃ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ bhāradvājakirīṭinoḥ / samaṃ vimuñcatoḥ saṃkhye viśikhān dīptatejasaḥ

vulgate_text: ubhau viśrutakarmāṇāvubhau śramagatau jaye ubhāvatirathau loke hyubhau parapuṃrajayau / kṣipantau śarajālāni kṣatriyānmoha āviśat
ce_text: tāv ubhau khyātakarmāṇāv ubhau vāyusamau jave / ubhau divyāstraviduṣāv ubhāv uttamatejasau / kṣipantau śarajālāni mohayām āsatur nṛpān

vulgate_text: chādyetāṃ śaraughaistāvanyonyamuparājitau / saṃyuge saṃcakāśetāṃ kālasūryāvivoditau
ce_text: vīrau tāv api saṃrabdhau saṃnikṛṣṭau mahārathau / chādayetāṃ śaravrātair anyonyam aparājitau

vulgate_text: arjunastu tadā droṇaṃ mahāvegairmahārathaḥ / vivyādha śataśo bāṇairdhārābhiriva parvatam
ce_text: pārthaṃ ca sa mahābāhur mahāvegair mahārathaḥ / vivyādha niśitair bāṇair megho vṛṣṭyeva parvatam

vulgate_text: śobhate sma mahāvāhurgāṇḍīvaṃ vikṣipandhanuḥ / śarāṃśca visṛjaṃścitrānsuvarṇavikṛtānbahūn
ce_text: tathaiva divyaṃ gāṇḍīvaṃ dhanur ādāya pāṇḍavaḥ / śatrughnaṃ vegavad dhṛṣṭo bhārasādhanam uttamam / visasarja śarāṃś citrān suvarṇavikṛtān bahūn

vulgate_text: saratho'pyacaratpārthaḥ prekṣaṇīyo mahārathaḥ / yugapaddikṣu sarvāsu sarvato'strāṇyavāsṛjam
ce_text: sa rathena caran pārthaḥ prekṣaṇīyo dhanaṃjayaḥ / yugapad dikṣu sarvāsu sarvaśastrāṇy adarśayat

vulgate_text: taptajāmbūnadamayairdīptairagnisamaiḥ śaraiḥ / prācchādayadameyātmā diśaḥ sūryasya ca prabhām
ce_text: jāmbūnadamayaiḥ puṅkhaiś citracāpavarātigaiḥ / prācchādayad ameyātmā diśaḥ sūryasya ca prabhām

vulgate_text: tataḥ kāñcanapaṅkhānāṃ śarāṇāṃ nataparvaṇām / viyadgatānāṃ caratāṃ dṛśyante bahavo vrajāḥ
ce_text: tataḥ kanakapuṅkhānāṃ śarāṇāṃ nataparvaṇām / viyaccarāṇāṃ viyati dṛśyante bahuśaḥ prajāḥ

vulgate_text: śarāsanāttu droṇasya prabhavanti sma sāyakāḥ eko dīrgha ivābhāntaḥ pradṛśyante mahāśarāḥ / ākāśe samadṛśyanta haṃsānāmiva paṅktayaḥ
ce_text: droṇasya puṅkhasaktāś ca prabhavantaḥ śarāsanāt / eko dīrgha ivādṛśyad ākāśe saṃhataḥ śaraḥ

vulgate_text: tattu yuddhaṃ mahāghoraṃ tayoḥ saṃrabdhayorabhūt / atyadbhutamacintyaṃ ca vṛtravāsavayoriva
ce_text: yuddhaṃ samabhavat tatra susaṃrabdhaṃ mahātmanoḥ / droṇapāṇḍavayor ghoraṃ vṛtravāsavayor iva

vulgate_text: jighāṃsantaṃ naravyāghramarjunaṃ bhīmadarśanam / vivyādha niśitairdroṇaḥ śaraiḥ sannataparvabhiḥ
ce_text: jighāṃsantaṃ naravyāghram arjunaṃ tigmatejasam / ācāryamukhyaḥ samare droṇaḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / arjunena sahākrīḍac charaiḥ saṃnataparvabhiḥ

vulgate_text: hṛṣṭaḥ samabhavaddroṇo raṇaśauṇḍaḥ pratāpavān / arjunena samaṃ krīḍañśaraiḥ sannataparvabhiḥ
ce_text: jighāṃsantaṃ naravyāghram arjunaṃ tigmatejasam / ācāryamukhyaḥ samare droṇaḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / arjunena sahākrīḍac charaiḥ saṃnataparvabhiḥ

vulgate_text: tayorāsītsaṃprahāraḥ kruddhayornarasiṃhayoḥ / amṛṣyamāṇayoḥ saṅkhye balivāsavayoriva
ce_text: tayor āsīt saṃprahāraḥ kruddhayor narasiṃhayoḥ / amarṣiṇos tadānyonyaṃ devadānavayor iva

vulgate_text: evaṃ śūrau maheṣvāsau visṛjantau śilāśitān / ekacchāyamakurvātāṃ gaganaṃ śaravṛṣṭibhiḥ
ce_text: evaṃ śūrau maheṣvāsau visṛjantau śitāñ śarān / ekacchāyaṃ cakratus tāv ākāśaṃ śaravṛṣṭibhiḥ

vulgate_text: droṇaṃ yuddhārṇave magnaṃ dṛṣṭvā putraḥ pratāpavān tato vṛndena mahatā rathināṃ rathiyūthapaḥ / ācāryaputrastu śaraiḥ pāṇḍavaṃ pratyavārayat
ce_text: tato vṛndena mahatā rathānāṃ rathayūthapaḥ / ācāryaputraḥ sahasā pāṇḍavaṃ pratyavārayat

vulgate_text: hayāṃstasyārjunaḥ saṅkhye kṛtavānalpatejasāḥ / te rājanna prajānanti diśaṃ kāṃcana mohitāḥ
ce_text: hayān asyārjunaḥ sarvān kṛtavān alpajīvitān / sa rājan na prajānāti diśaṃ kāṃ cana mohitaḥ

vulgate_text: tadasyāpūjayandevāḥ karma dṛṣṭvā'timānuṣam / na śakto'nyaḥ pumānsthātumṛte drauṇerdhanaṃjayam
ce_text: tato drauṇir mahāvīryaḥ pārthasya vicariṣyataḥ / vivaraṃ sūkṣmam ālokya jyāṃ ciccheda kṣureṇa ha / tad asyāpūjayan devāḥ karma dṛṣṭvātimānuṣam

vulgate_text: so'nyaṃ rathaṃ samāsthāya pratyāyādrathipuṅgavaḥ / vāraṇeneva mattena matto vāraṇayūthapaḥ
ce_text: tato 'rdhacandram āvṛtya tena pārthaḥ samāgamat / vāraṇeneva mattena matto vāraṇayūthapaḥ

vulgate_text: tau samājaghnaturvīrau parasparajayaiṣiṇau / śarai rāśīviṣākārairjvaladbhiriva pāvakaiḥ
ce_text: tau samājaghnatur vīrāv anyonyaṃ puruṣarṣabhau / śarair āśīviṣākārair jvaladbhir iva pannagaiḥ

vulgate_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / etasminnantare tatra mahāvīryaparākramaḥ ājagāma mahābāhuḥ kṛpaḥ śastrabhṛtāṃvaraḥ / arjunaṃ pratiyoddhuṃ vai yuddhakāmo mahārathaḥ
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tato vaikartanaṃ jitvā pārtho vairāṭim abravīt / etan māṃ prāpayānīkaṃ yatra tālo hiraṇmayaḥ

vulgate_text: samāgamya tataḥ sarve bhīṣmadroṇamukhā rathāḥ / arjunaṃ sahasā yuktāḥ pratyayudhyanta bhārata
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / atha saṃgamya sarve tu kauravāṇāṃ mahārathāḥ / arjunaṃ sahitā yattāḥ pratyayudhyanta bhārata

vulgate_text: nāgāśvakāyānnirbhidya lauhāni kavacāni ca / pārthasya śaravarṣāṇi nyapatañśataśaḥ kṣitau
ce_text: narāśvakāyān nirbhidya lohāni kavacāni ca / pārthasya śarajālāni viniṣpetuḥ sahasraśaḥ

vulgate_text: aviṣahya śarānsarve pārthacāpacyupānraṇe udakprayānti vidhvastā rathebhyo rathinastadā / sādinaścāśvapṛṣṭhebhyo bhūmau cāpi padātayaḥ
ce_text: upaplavanta vitrastā rathebhyo rathinas tadā / sādinaś cāśvapṛṣṭhebhyo bhūmau cāpi padātayaḥ

vulgate_text: channamāyodhanaṃ jajñe śarīrairgatacetasām / śrāntyā galitaśastrāṇāṃ patatāmaśvasādinām
ce_text: channam āyodhanaṃ sarvaṃ śarīrair gatacetasām / gajāśvasādibhis tatra śitabāṇāttajīvitaiḥ

vulgate_text: śūnyānkurvanrathopasthānmānavairāstṛṇonmahīm / pranṛtyanniva saṃgrāme cāpahaste dhanaṃjayaḥ
ce_text: rathopasthābhipatitair āstṛtā mānavair mahī / pranṛtyad iva saṃgrāme cāpahasto dhanaṃjayaḥ

vulgate_text: śirāṃsyapātayatsaṅkhye kṣatriyāṇāṃ nararṣabhaḥ śrutvā gāṇḍīvanirghoṣaṃ viṣṇūjitamivāśane / trastāni sarvasainyāni vyalīyanta ca bhāgaśa
ce_text: śrutvā gāṇḍīvanirghoṣaṃ visphūrjitam ivāśaneḥ / trastāni sarvabhūtāni vyagacchanta mahāhavāt

vulgate_text: darśayitvā tadā''tmānaṃ raudraṃ raudraparākramaḥ / jaghāna samare śūrāñchataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ
ce_text: darśayitvā tathātmānaṃ raudraṃ rudraparākramaḥ / avaruddhaś caran pārtho daśavarṣāṇi trīṇi ca / krodhāgnim utsṛjad ghoraṃ dhārtarāṣṭreṣu pāṇḍavaḥ

vulgate_text: tasya mārgānvicarato nighnataśca raṇājire / prāvartata nadī ghorā śoṇitāntrataraṅgiṇī
ce_text: prāvartayan nadīṃ ghorāṃ śoṇitaughataraṅgiṇīm / asthiśaivalasaṃbādhāṃ yugānte kālanirmitām

vulgate_text: prāvartayannadīṃ ghorāṃ piśācagaṇasevitām / apārāmanivāsāṃ ca raktodāṃ sarvato vṛtām
ce_text: prāvartayan nadīṃ ghorāṃ śoṇitaughataraṅgiṇīm / asthiśaivalasaṃbādhāṃ yugānte kālanirmitām

vulgate_text: abhīkṣṇamakarotpārtho nadīmuttamaśoṇitām / gajavarmamahādvīpāmaśvadehamahāśilām
ce_text: śaracāpaplavāṃ ghorāṃ māṃsaśoṇitakardamām / mahārathamahādvīpāṃ śaṅkhadundubhinisvanām / cakāra mahatīṃ pārtho nadīm uttaraśoṇitām

vulgate_text: tathā hi gupta eteṣāṃ durādharṣaḥ pitāmahaḥ / hanyamāneṣu yogheṣu dhanaṃjayamupādravat
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tataḥ śāṃtanavo bhīṣmo durādharṣaḥ pratāpavān / vadhyamāneṣu yodheṣu dhanaṃjayam upādravat / vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ / evaṃ vidrāvya tat sainyaṃ pārtho bhīṣmam upādravat / trasteṣu sarvasainyeṣu kauravyasya mahātmanaḥ / narasiṃham upāyāntaṃ jigīṣantaṃ parān raṇe / vṛṣaseno 'bhyayāt tūrṇaṃ yoddhukāmo dhanaṃjayam / tasya pārthas tadā kṣipraṃ kṣuradhāreṇa kārmukam / nyakṛntad gṛdhrapatreṇa jāmbūnadapariṣkṛtam / athainaṃ pañcabhir bhūyaḥ pratyavidhyat stanāntare / sa pārthabāṇābhihato rathāt praskandya prādravat / duḥśāsano vikarṇaś ca śakuniś ca viviṃśatiḥ / āyāntaṃ bhīmadhanvānaṃ paryakīryanta pāṇḍavam / teṣāṃ pārtho raṇe kruddhaḥ śaraiḥ saṃnataparvabhiḥ / yugaṃ dhvajam atheṣāṃ ca ciccheda tarasā raṇe / te nikṛttadhvajāḥ sarve chinnakārmukaveṣṭanāḥ / raṇamadhyād apayayuḥ pārthabāṇābhipīḍitāḥ / tataḥ prahasya bībhatsur vairāṭim idam abravīt / etaṃ me prāpayedānīṃ tālaṃ sauvarṇam ucchritam / meghamadhye yathā vidyud uccarantī punaḥ punaḥ / asau śāṃtanavo bhīṣmas tatra yāhi paraṃtapa / astrāṇi tasya divyāni darśayiṣyāmi saṃyuge / ghorarūpāṇi citrāṇi laghūni ca gurūṇi ca / tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā vairāṭiḥ pārthasārathiḥ / vāhayac coditas tena rathaṃ bhīṣmarathaṃ prati / atha taṃ coditaṃ dṛṣṭvā phalgunasya rathottamam / vāyuneva mahāmeghaṃ sahasābhisamīritam / taṃ pratyayāc ca gāṅgeyo rathenādityavarcasā / āyāntam arjunaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhīṣmaḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ / pratyujjagāma yuddhārthī maharṣabha ivarṣabham

vulgate_text: kuruśreṣṭhāvimau vīrau raṇe bhīṣmadhanaṃjayau / sarvāstrakuśalau vīrāvapramattau raṇe sadā
ce_text: tam udvīkṣya tathāyāntaṃ kaunteyaḥ paravīrahā / pratyagṛhṇāt prahṛṣṭātmā dhārādharam ivācalaḥ / antarikṣe prajalpanti sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ / yad arjunaḥ kurūn sarvān prākṛntac chastratejasā / kuruśreṣṭhāv imau vīrau raṇe bhīṣmadhanaṃjayau / sarvāstrakuśalau loke etāv atirathāv ubhau / ubhau devamanuṣyeṣu viśrutau svaparākramaiḥ / ubhau paramasaṃrabdhāv ubhau dīptadhanurdharau / samāgatau naravyāghrau vyāghrāv iva tarasvinau / ubhau sadṛśakarmāṇau sūryasyāgneś ca bhārata / vāsudevasya sadṛśau kārtavīryasamāv ubhau / ubhau viśrutakarmāṇāv ubhau śūrau mahābalau / sarvāstraviduṣāṃ śreṣṭhau sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varau / agner indrasya somasya yamasya dhanadasya ca / anayoḥ sadṛśaṃ vīryaṃ mitrasya varuṇasya ca / ko vā kuntīsutaṃ yuddhe dvairathenopayāsyati / ṛte śāṃtanavād anyaḥ kṣatriyo bhuvi vidyate / iti saṃpūjayām āsur bhīṣmaṃ dṛṣṭvārjunaṃ gatam / raṇe saṃprahariṣyantaṃ dṛṣṭvā devāḥ savāsavāḥ / atha bahuvidhaśaṅkhatūryaghoṣair / vividharavaiḥ saha siṃhanādamiśraiḥ / kuruvṛṣabham apūjayat kurūṇāṃ / balam amarādhiapasainyasaprabhaṃ tat

vulgate_text: vāsudevasya sadṛśau kārtavīryasamāvubhau ubhau viśrutakarmāṇāvubhau śūrau mahābalau / sarvāstraviduṣāṃ śreṣṭhau sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varau
ce_text: ubhau viśrutakarmāṇāv ubhau yuddhaviśāradau / ubhau sadṛśakarmāṇāv ubhau yudhi durāsadau

vulgate_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tato bhīṣmaḥ śarānaṣṭau dhvaje pārthasya vīryavān / samārpayanmahāvegājjvalataḥ pannagāniva
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / atha duryodhanaḥ karṇo duḥśāsanaviviṃśatī / droṇaś ca saha putreṇa kṛpaś cātiratho raṇe

vulgate_text: tadyuddhamabhavaddhoraṃ romaharṣaṇamadbhutam / bhīṣmasya saha pārthena balivāsavayoriva
ce_text: tayos tad abhavad yuddhaṃ tumulaṃ lomaharṣaṇam / bhīṣmasya saha pārthena balivāsavayor iva

vulgate_text: agnivakropamaṃ ghoraṃ maṇḍalīkṛtamāhave / gāṇḍīvamabhavañjiṣṇoḥ savyaṃ dakṣiṇamasyataḥ
ce_text: agnicakram ivāviddhaṃ savyadakṣiṇam asyataḥ / gāṇḍīvam abhavad rājan pārthasya sṛjataḥ śarān

vulgate_text: parvataṃ vāridhārābhiśchādayanniva toyadaḥ / arjunaśchādayadbhīṣmaṃ śaravarṣairanekaśaḥ
ce_text: sa taiḥ saṃchādayām āsa bhīṣmaṃ śaraśataiḥ śitaiḥ / parvataṃ vāridhārābhiś chādayann iva toyadaḥ

vulgate_text: tāṃ samudramivoddhūtāṃ śaravṛṣṭiṃ samudyatām / vyadhamatsāyakairbhīṣmaḥ sorjunaṃ ca nyavārayat
ce_text: tāṃ sa velām ivoddhūtāṃ śaravṛṣṭiṃ samutthitām / vyadhamat sāyakair bhīṣmo arjunaṃ saṃnivārayat

vulgate_text: tatastāni visṛṣṭāni śarajālāni saṅghaśaḥ / āhatāni vyaśīryantaṃ arjunasya rathaṃ prati
ce_text: tatas tāni nikṛttāni śarajālāni bhāgaśaḥ / samare 'bhivyaśīryanta phalgunasya rathaṃ prati

vulgate_text: tato devarṣigandharvāḥ sādhusādhvityapūjayan / duṣkaraṃ kṛtavānbhīṣmo yadarjunamavārayat
ce_text: tatas te kuravaḥ sarve sādhu sādhv iti cābruvan / duṣkaraṃ kṛtavān bhīṣmo yad arjunam ayodhayat

vulgate_text: naitadanyo manuṣyeṣu pradarśayitumāhave / mahāsrāṇāṃ saṃprayogaṃ samare bhīṣmapārthayoḥ
ce_text: nedaṃ yuktaṃ manuṣyeṣu yo 'yaṃ saṃdṛśyate mahān / mahāstrāṇāṃ saṃprayogaḥ samare bhīṣmapārthayoḥ

vulgate_text: śarāṃśca subahunkruddho mumocāśu dhanaṃjaye arjunopi śarāṃstīkṣṇānbhīṣmāya niśitānbahūn / cikṣepa ca mahātejāstathā bhīṣmaśca pāṇḍave
ce_text: arjuno 'pi śarāṃś citrān bhīṣmāya niśitān bahūn / cikṣepa sumahātejās tathā bhīṣmaś ca pāṇḍave

vulgate_text: ityukto devarājastu pārthabhīṣmasamāgamam pūjayāmāsa divyena puṣpavarṣeṇa bhārata - - a[aśvatthāmā tato'bhyetya drutaṃ karṇamabhāṣata ahameko haniṣyāmi sametānsarvapāṇḍavān
ce_text: ity ukto devarājas tu pārthabhīṣmasamāgamam / pūjayām āsa divyena puṣpavarṣeṇa bhārata

vulgate_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / bhīṣmaṃ vijitya saṃgrāme kurūṇāṃ miṣatāṃ raṇe / tato yuddhamanāḥ prāyātpārthaḥ pañca mahārathān
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / taṃ pārthaḥ pratijagrāha vāyuvegam ivoddhatam / śarajālena mahatā varṣamāṇam ivāmbudam

vulgate_text: karṇa yattatsabhāmadhye bahvabaddhaṃ prabhāṣase / na me yudhi samo'stīti tadidaṃ pratyupasthitam
ce_text: arjuna uvāca / karṇa yat te sabhāmadhye bahu vācā vikatthitam / na me yudhi samo 'stīti tad idaṃ pratyupasthitam

vulgate_text: eṣo'ntaka iva kruddhaḥ sarvabhūtāvamardanaḥ adūrātpratyupasthāya jṛmbhate kesarī yathā / na palāyasva śūraścetsthitvā yudhyasva phalgunam / karṇa uvāca
ce_text: arjuna uvāca / karṇa yat te sabhāmadhye bahu vācā vikatthitam / na me yudhi samo 'stīti tad idaṃ pratyupasthitam

vulgate_text: yuvyasva tvamabhīḥ pārthaṃ prapalāyasva mā raṇāt / uktaṃ vacaḥ smarankarṇa nāhamityādi saṃyuge / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / taṃ pārthaḥ pratijagrāha vāyuvegam ivoddhatam / śarajālena mahatā varṣamāṇam ivāmbudam

vulgate_text: virāṭaputro javanānbhṛśamaśvānacodayat / karṇa uvāca / eṣopayāti bībhatsurvyathito gāḍhavedanaḥ
ce_text: arjuna uvāca / karṇa yat te sabhāmadhye bahu vācā vikatthitam / na me yudhi samo 'stīti tad idaṃ pratyupasthitam

vulgate_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / karṇaṃ parājitaṃ dṛṣṭvā pārtho vairāṭimabravīt / etaṃ māṃ prāpayedānīṃ rathavṛndaṃ prahāriṇām
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / iti karṇaṃ bruvann eva bībhatsur aparājitaḥ / abhyayād visṛjan bāṇān kāyāvaraṇabhedinaḥ

vulgate_text: yatra śāntanavo bhīṣmaḥ sarveṣāṃ naḥ pitāmahaḥ / suyuddhaṃ kāṅkṣamāṇo vai rathe tiṣṭhati daṃśitaḥ
ce_text: atra śāṃtanavo bhīṣmo rathe 'smākaṃ pitāmahaḥ / kāṅkṣamāṇo mayā yuddhaṃ tiṣṭhaty amaradarśanaḥ / ādāsyāmy aham etasya dhanurjyām api cāhave / atha sainyaṃ mahad dṛṣṭvā rathanāgahayākulam / abravīd uttaraḥ pārthaṃ pratividdhaḥ śarair bhṛśam / nāhaṃ śakṣyāmi vīreha niyantuṃ te hayottamān / viṣīdanti mama prāṇā mano vihvalatīva me / astrāṇām iha divyānāṃ prabhāvāt saṃprayujyatām / tvayā ca kurubhiś caiva bhramantīva diśo daśa / gandhena mūrcchitaś cāsmi vasārudhiramedasām / dvaidhībhūtaṃ mano me 'dya trāsaṃ caiva prapaśyataḥ / adṛṣṭapūrvaḥ śūrāṇāṃ mahāsaṃkhye samāgamaḥ / godhāghātena mahatā śaṅkhānāṃ ninadena ca / siṃhanādaiś ca śūrāṇāṃ gajānāṃ bṛṃhitais tathā / gāṇḍīvaśabdena bhṛśam aśanipratimena ca / śrutiḥ smṛtiś ca me vīra pranaṣṭā mūḍhacetasaḥ / alātacakrapratimaṃ maṇḍalaṃ satataṃ tvayā / vyākṣipyamāṇaṃ samare gāṇḍīvaṃ ca prapaśyataḥ / dṛṣṭir vicalitā vīra hṛdayaṃ dīryatīva me / vapuś cograṃ tava raṇe kruddhasyeva pinākinaḥ / vyāyacchatas tava bhujaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhīr me bhavaty api / nādadānaṃ na saṃdhānaṃ na muñcantaṃ śarottamān / tvām ahaṃ saṃprapaśyāmi paśyann api vicetanaḥ / avasīdanti me prāṇā bhūr iyaṃ calatīva me / arjuna uvāca / na ca pratodaṃ nābhīṣūn saṃyantuṃ śaktir asti me / mā bhaiṣīḥ stambhayātmānaṃ tvayāpi narapuṃgava / atyadbhutāni karmāṇi kṛtāni raṇamūrdhani / rājaputro 'si bhadraṃ te kule matsyasya viśrute / jātas tvaṃ śatrudamane na viṣīditum arhasi / dhṛtiṃ kṛtvā suvipulāṃ rājaputra rathe mama / yudhyamānasya samare hayān saṃyaccha śatruhan / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / evam uktvā mahābāhur vairāṭiṃ rathasattamaḥ / arjuno rathināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ punar evedam abravīt / senāgram āśu bhīṣmasya prāpayasvaitad eva mām

vulgate_text: asyantaṃ divyamastrāṇi citramuttara paśyasi
ce_text: asyantaṃ divyam astraṃ māṃ citram adya niśāmaya / śatahradām ivāyāntīṃ stanayitnor ivāmbare

vulgate_text: śatahradāṃ jṛmbhamāṇāṃ meghasthāṃ prāvṛṣīva ca / suvarṇapṛṣṭhaṃ gāṇḍīvaṃ paśyantu kuravo mama
ce_text: suvarṇapṛṣṭhaṃ gāṇḍīvaṃ drakṣyanti kuravo mama / dakṣiṇenātha vāmena katareṇa svid asyati / iti māṃ saṃgatāḥ sarve tarkayiṣyanti śatravaḥ

vulgate_text: astrodakāṃ hayāvartāṃ nāganakrāṃ rathahradām / nadīṃ praskandayiṣyāmi paralokāpahāriṇīm
ce_text: śoṇitodāṃ rathāvartāṃ nāganakrāṃ duratyayām / nadīṃ prasyandayiṣyāmi paralokapravāhinīm

vulgate_text: dhvajavṛkṣaṃ śaratṛṇaṃ nāgāśvaśvāpadākulam rathasiṃhagaṇairyuktaṃ dhanurvallisamākulam / vanamādīpayiṣyāmi kurūṇāmastratejasā
ce_text: dhvajavṛkṣaṃ pattitṛṇaṃ rathasiṃhagaṇāyutam / vanam ādīpayiṣyāmi kurūṇām astratejasā

vulgate_text: jayato bhāratīṃ senāmekasya mama saṃyuge / śataṃ mārgā bhaviṣyanti pāvakasyeva kānane
ce_text: jayataḥ kauravīṃ senām ekasya mama dhanvinaḥ / śataṃ mārgā bhaviṣyanti pāvakasyeva kānane / mayā cakram ivāviddhaṃ sainyaṃ drakṣyasi kevalam

vulgate_text: mayā cakramivāviddhaṃ sainyaṃ drakṣyasi kevalam tānahaṃ rathanīḍebhyaḥ paralokāya śātravān / ekaḥ pradrāvayiṣyāmi cakrapāṇirivāsurān

rathān prati / ādadānaś ca nārācān vyāmṛśann iṣudhī api / aśvatthāmā / saṃspṛśānaś ca gāṇḍīvaṃ bhūyaḥ karṇaṃ samabhyayāt / karṇa yat tat sabhāmadhye bahv abaddhaṃ prabhāṣase / na me yudhi samo 'stīti divyam astraṃ vikurvāṇaḥ pratyayād rathasattamān / yathā raśmibhir ādityaḥ pracchādayati medinīm / evaṃ gāṇḍīvanirmuktaiḥ śaraiḥ prācchādayad diśaḥ / na rathānāṃ na nāgānāṃ na dhvajānāṃ na vājinām / samare śūram abhyabhāṣata vīryavān / saṃniyamya hayān etān mandaṃ vāhaya sārathe / ācāryaputraṃ samare yodhayiṣye 'parājitam / purā hy eṣa mayā muktaḥ sa me bhavati pṛṣṭhataḥ / evam ukto 'rjunenājāv mahātmā pākaśāsaniḥ / evaṃ bhītā nivartante na punar gāḍhavedanāḥ / yady enam abhisaṃrabdhaṃ punar evābhiyāsyasi / bahūny astrāṇi jānīte na punar mokṣyate bhavān / diṣṭyā duryodhano mukto diṣṭyā gāvaḥ palāyitāḥ / muktamuṣṭiṣu saṃgrāme kiṃ raṇena kariṣyasi / krośamātram atikramya balam anvānayāmahe / anvāgatabalāḥ pārthaṃ punar evābhiyāsyatha / arjunaḥ / dakṣiṇām eva tu diśaṃ hayān uttara vāhaya / dhanurghoṣeṇa pāṇḍavaḥ / prasavyaṃ caivam āvṛtya krośārdhaṃ prādravat tataḥ / yathā susaṃskṛto bāṇaḥ suparṇaś cāpi śīghragaḥ / tathā pārtharathaḥ śīghram ākāśe paryavartata / muhūrtoparate śabde
