vākyam / idaṃ tv idānīm anayaṃ kurūṇāṃ / śivaṃ dhanuḥ śatrunibarhaṇaṃ ca / atyāśugaṃ vegavad āśukartṛ / avāraṇīyaṃ mahate raṇāya / pradāraṇaṃ śatruvarūthinīnām / anīkabhit saṃyati vajrakalpam / prayāhi yatraiṣa suyodhano hi / taṃ pātayiṣyāmi śaraiḥ sutīkṣṇaiḥ / ācāryaputraṃ ca pitāmahaṃ ca / suyodhanaṃ sūtasutaṃ ca saṃkhye / droṇaṃ kṛpaṃ caiva nivārya yuddhe / śiro hariṣyāmi suyodhanasya / tam uttaraś citram udāravegaṃ / dhanuś ca dṛṣṭvā niśitāñ śarāṃś ca / bhīto 'bravīd arjunam ājimadhye / nāhaṃ tavāśvān viṣahe niyantum / tam abravīn mātsyasutaṃ prahasya / gāṇḍīvadhanvā dviṣatāṃ nihantā / mayā sahāyena kuto 'sti te bhayaṃ / praihy uttarāśvān upamantrayasva / āśvāsitas tena dhanaṃjayena / vairāṭir aśvān pratutoda śīghram / viṣphārayaṃs tad dhanur ugravegaṃ / yuyutsamānaḥ punar eva jiṣṇuḥ / gāṇḍīvaśabdena tu tatra yodhā / bhūmau nipetur bahavo 'tivelam / śaṅkhasya śabdena tu vānarasya / arjunaḥ / śabdena te yodhavarāḥ samantāt / eṣo 'timānī dhṛtarāṣṭrasūnuḥ / senāmukhe sarvasamṛddhatejāḥ / parājayaṃ nityam amṛṣyamāṇo / nivartate yuddhamanāḥ purastāt / tam eva yāhi prasamīkṣya yattaḥ / suyodhanaṃ tatra sahānujaṃ ca / vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ / tam āpatantaṃ prasamīkṣya sarve / kurupravīrāḥ sahasābhyagacchan / prahasya vīraḥ sa tu tān atītya / duryodhane dvau nicakhāna bāṇau / tenārdito nāga iva prabhinnaḥ / pārthena viddho dhṛtarāṣṭrasūnuḥ / yuyutsamāno 'tirathena saṃkhye / svayaṃ nigṛhyārjunam āsasāda

sarvebhyaḥ kṣatradharmam anuvrataḥ / sattvādhikānāṃ puṃsāṃ tu dhanurvedopajīvinām / darśanāj jāyate darpaḥ svaraś ca na viṣīdati / paśyatv ācāryaputro mām arjunena raṇe saha / vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ / yudhyamānaṃ susaṃyattaṃ daivaṃ tu duratikramam / taṃ samantād rathāḥ pañca parivārya dhanaṃjayam / ta iṣūn samyag asyanto mumukṣanto 'pi jīvitam / te lābham iva manvānāḥ kṣipram ārchan dhanaṃjayam / śaraughān samyag asyanto jīmūtā iva vārṣikāḥ / bahubhir vividhair bāṇair niśitair lomavāpibhiḥ / ādravan pratyavasthāya pratyavidhyan dhanaṃjayam / tataḥ prahasya bībhatsuḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / divyam astraṃ vikurvāṇaḥ pratyayād rathasattamān / yathā raśmibhir ādityaḥ pracchādayati medinīm / evaṃ gāṇḍīvanirmuktaiḥ śaraiḥ prācchādayad diśaḥ / na rathānāṃ na nāgānāṃ na dhvajānāṃ na vājinām / aviddhaṃ niśitair bāṇair āsīd dvyaṅgulam antaram / sarve śāntiparā yodhāḥ svacittaṃ nābhijajñire / hastino 'śvāś ca vitrastā vyavalīyanta sarvaśaḥ / yathā nalavanaṃ nāgaḥ prabhinnaḥ ṣāṣṭihāyanaḥ / evaṃ sarvān apāmṛdnād arjunaḥ śastratejasā / gāṇḍīvasya tu ghoṣeṇa pṛthivī samakampata / manāṃsi dhārtarāṣṭrāṇām abhyakṛntad dhanaṃjayaḥ / tato vigāhya sainyānāṃ madhyaṃ śastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / sārathiṃ samare śūram abhyabhāṣata vīryavān / saṃniyamya hayān etān mandaṃ vāhaya sārathe / ācāryaputraṃ samare yodhayiṣye 'parājitam / purā hy eṣa mayā muktaḥ sa me bhavati pṛṣṭhataḥ / evam ukto 'rjunenājāv aśvatthāmarathaṃ prati / karṇaḥ / virāṭaputro javanān bhṛśam aśvān acodayat / eṣopayāti bībhatsur vyathito gāḍhavedanaḥ / taṃ tu tatraiva yāsyāmi nāyaṃ mucyeta jīvitāt / droṇaḥ / naiṣo bhayena niryāto mahātmā pākaśāsaniḥ / evaṃ bhītā nivartante na punar gāḍhavedanāḥ / yady enam abhisaṃrabdhaṃ punar evābhiyāsyasi / bahūny astrāṇi jānīte na punar mokṣyate bhavān / diṣṭyā duryodhano mukto diṣṭyā gāvaḥ palāyitāḥ / muktamuṣṭiṣu saṃgrāme kiṃ raṇena kariṣyasi / krośamātram atikramya balam anvānayāmahe / anvāgatabalāḥ pārthaṃ punar evābhiyāsyatha / arjunaḥ / dakṣiṇām eva tu diśaṃ hayān uttara vāhaya / dhanurghoṣeṇa pāṇḍavaḥ / prasavyaṃ caivam āvṛtya krośārdhaṃ prādravat tataḥ / yathā susaṃskṛto bāṇaḥ suparṇaś cāpi śīghragaḥ / tathā pārtharathaḥ śīghram ākāśe paryavartata / muhūrtoparate śabde pratiyāte dhanaṃjaye / hastyaśvarathapādātaṃ puraskṛtya mahārathāḥ / droṇabhīṣmamukhāḥ sarve sainyānāṃ jaghane yayuḥ / sainikāḥ / yattāḥ pārtham apaśyantaḥ sahitāḥ śaravikṣatāḥ / diṣṭyā duryodhano prayāhi yatraiṣa suyodhano hi / taṃ pātayiṣyāmi śaraiḥ sutīkṣṇaiḥ / ācāryaputraṃ ca pitāmahaṃ ca / suyodhanaṃ sūtasutaṃ ca saṃkhye / droṇaṃ kṛpaṃ caiva nivārya yuddhe / śiro hariṣyāmi suyodhanasya / tam uttaraś citram udāravegaṃ / dhanuś ca dṛṣṭvā niśitāñ śarāṃś ca / bhīto 'bravīd arjunam ājimadhye / nāhaṃ tavāśvān viṣahe niyantum / tam abravīn mātsyasutaṃ prahasya / gāṇḍīvadhanvā dviṣatāṃ sarvasamṛddhatejāḥ / parājayaṃ nityam amṛṣyamāṇo / nivartate yuddhamanāḥ purastāt / tam eva yāhi prasamīkṣya yattaḥ / suyodhanaṃ tatra sahānujaṃ ca / vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ / tam āpatantaṃ prasamīkṣya sarve / svayaṃ nigṛhyārjunam āsasāda

vulgate_text: prayāhi yatraiṣa suyodhano hi taṃ pātayiṣyāmi śaraiḥ sutīkṣṇaiḥ ācāryaputraṃ ca suyodhanaṃ ca pitāmahaṃ sūtasutaṃ ca saṅkhye / droṇaṃ kṛpaṃ caiva nivārya sarvāñśiro hariṣyāmi suyodhanasya / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tataḥ śāṃtanavo bhīṣmo durādharṣaḥ pratāpavān / vadhyamāneṣu yodheṣu dhanaṃjayam upādravat / vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ / evaṃ vidrāvya tat sainyaṃ pārtho bhīṣmam upādravat / trasteṣu sarvasainyeṣu kauravyasya mahātmanaḥ / narasiṃham upāyāntaṃ jigīṣantaṃ parān raṇe / vṛṣaseno 'bhyayāt tūrṇaṃ yoddhukāmo dhanaṃjayam / tasya pārthas tadā kṣipraṃ kṣuradhāreṇa kārmukam / nyakṛntad gṛdhrapatreṇa jāmbūnadapariṣkṛtam / athainaṃ pañcabhir bhūyaḥ pratyavidhyat stanāntare / sa pārthabāṇābhihato rathāt praskandya prādravat / duḥśāsano vikarṇaś ca śakuniś ca viviṃśatiḥ / āyāntaṃ bhīmadhanvānaṃ paryakīryanta pāṇḍavam / teṣāṃ pārtho raṇe kruddhaḥ śaraiḥ saṃnataparvabhiḥ / yugaṃ dhvajam atheṣāṃ ca ciccheda tarasā raṇe / te nikṛttadhvajāḥ sarve chinnakārmukaveṣṭanāḥ / raṇamadhyād apayayuḥ pārthabāṇābhipīḍitāḥ / tataḥ prahasya bībhatsur vairāṭim idam abravīt / etaṃ me prāpayedānīṃ tālaṃ sauvarṇam ucchritam / meghamadhye yathā vidyud uccarantī punaḥ punaḥ / asau śāṃtanavo bhīṣmas tatra yāhi paraṃtapa / astrāṇi tasya divyāni darśayiṣyāmi saṃyuge / ghorarūpāṇi citrāṇi laghūni ca gurūṇi ca / tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā vairāṭiḥ pārthasārathiḥ / vāhayac coditas tena rathaṃ bhīṣmarathaṃ prati / atha taṃ coditaṃ dṛṣṭvā phalgunasya rathottamam / vāyuneva mahāmeghaṃ sahasābhisamīritam / taṃ pratyayāc ca gāṅgeyo rathenādityavarcasā / āyāntam arjunaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhīṣmaḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ / pratyujjagāma yuddhārthī maharṣabha ivarṣabham

ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / bhīṣme tu saṃgrāmaśiro vihāya; palāyamāne dhṛtarāṣṭraputraḥ / ucchritya ketuṃ vinadan mahātmā; svayaṃ vigṛhyārjunam āsasāda

vulgate_text: sa tena bāṇena samarpitena jāmbūnadābhena susaṃhitena / rarāja pārtho rudhiraṃ kṣaranvai yathaikaraśmirbhagavāndivārkaḥ
ce_text: sa tena bāṇena samarpitena; jāmbūnadābhena susaṃśitena / rarāja rājan mahanīyakarmā; yathaikaparvā ruciraikaśṛṅgaḥ

vulgate_text: vihāya kīrtiṃ ca yaśaśca loke yuddhātparāvṛtya palāyase kim / na nandayiṣyanti tavāhatāni tūryāṇi yuddhādavaropitasya
ce_text: arjuna uvāca / vihāya kīrtiṃ vipulaṃ yaśaś ca; yuddhāt parāvṛtya palāyase kim / na te 'dya tūryāṇi samāhatāni; yathāvad udyānti gatasya yuddhe

vulgate_text: moghaṃ tavaitadbhuvi nāmadheyaṃ duryodhanetīha kṛtaṃ purastāt duryodhanastvaṃ prathitosi nāmnā suyodhanaḥ sannikṛtipradhānaḥ

vulgate_text: sairandhri kimidaṃ raktamuttarīyeṇa gṛhyate / kotra heturviśālākṣi tanmaprācakṣva tatvataḥ / sairandhryuvāca
ce_text: pūrayitvā ca sauvarṇaṃ pātraṃ kāṃsyam aninditā / tac choṇitaṃ pratyagṛhṇād yat prasusrāva pāṇḍavāt / virāṭaḥ / sairandhri kim idaṃ raktam uttarīyeṇa gṛhyate / ko 'tra hetur viśālākṣi tan mamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ / sairandhrī / raktabindūni kaṅkasya yāvanti dharaṇīm iyuḥ / tāvad varṣāṇi rāṣṭre te anāvṛṣṭir bhaviṣyati / etan nimittaṃ rājendra kaṅkasya rudhiraṃ mayā / gṛhītam uttarīyeṇa yakṣagandharvasaṃghāś ca gaṇā hy apsarasāṃ tathā / yuddhaṃ tv amānuṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā kurūṇāṃ phalgunasya ca / ekasya ca bahūnāṃ ca raudram atyugradarśanam / astrāṇām atha divyānāṃ prayogān atha saṃgrahān / gajāśvarathasaṃkulāḥ / yodhaiḥ kṣatriyadāyādair balavadbhir adhiṣṭhitāḥ / virāṭaprahitā senā nagarāc chīghrayāyinī / uttaraṃ saha sūtena pratyayāt tam ariṃdamam / tasmiṃs tūryaśatākīrṇe hastyaśvarathasaṃkule / arjunaḥ / praharṣaḥ strīkumārāṇāṃ tumulaḥ samapadyata / nagare tumulaḥ śabdo reṇuś cākramate nabhaḥ / kiṃ nu khalv apayātās te kuravo nagaraṃ gatāḥ / te caiva nirjitāsmābhir maheṣvāsāḥ sacetasaḥ / āmuñca kavacaṃ vīra codayasva ca vājinaḥ / javenābhiprapadyasva virāṭanagaraṃ prati / na tāvat talanirghoṣaṃ gāṇḍīvasya ca nisvanam / uttaraḥ / dhvajaṃ vā darśayiṣyāmi kadā cit ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / avajitya dhanaṃ cāpi virāṭo vāhinīpatiḥ / prāviśan nagaraṃ hṛṣṭaś caturbhiḥ saha pāṇḍavaiḥ

vulgate_text: tato rājasuto jyeṣṭhaḥ prāviśatpṛthivīṃjayaḥ / vavande sa pituḥ pādau kaṅkaṃ cāpyupatiṣṭhata
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tato rājñaḥ suto jyeṣṭhaḥ prāviśat pṛthivīṃjayaḥ / so 'bhivādya pituḥ pādau dharmarājam apaśyata

vulgate_text: kenāyaṃ tāḍitaḥ kaṅkaḥ kena pāpamidaṃ kṛtam / ko vā jigamiṣurmṛtyuṃ kena spṛṣṭaḥ padoragaḥ
ce_text: tataḥ papraccha pitaraṃ tvaramāṇa ivottaraḥ / kenāyaṃ tāḍito rājan kena pāpam idaṃ kṛtam

vulgate_text: śrotriyo brāhmaṇaśreṣṭha indrāsanaratikṣamaḥ / pūjanīyo'bhivādyaśca na prabādhyo'yamīdṛśaḥ / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca

ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / sa putrasya vacaḥ śrutvā virāṭo rāṣṭravardhanaḥ / kṣamayām āsa kaunteyaṃ bhasmacchannam ivānalam

ce_text: ācāryo vṛṣṇivīrāṇāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ ca yo dvijaḥ / sarvakṣatrasya cācāryaḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / tena droṇena te tāta katham āsīt samāgamaḥ

vulgate_text: sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ sarvalokeṣu viśrutaḥ / tena droṇena te tāta kathamāsītsamāgamaḥ

vulgate_text: ācāryaputro yaḥ śūro droṇādanavamo raṇe / tena vīreṇa te tāta kathamāsītsamāgamaḥ

ce_text: na hāstinapure trāṇaṃ tava paśyāmi kiṃ cana / vyāyāmena parīpsasva jīvitaṃ kauravātmaja

vulgate_text: vyāyāmena parīpsasva jīvitaṃ kauravātmaja na mokṣyase palāyaṃstvaṃ loke yuddhamanā bhava / pṛthivīṃ bhokṣyase jitvā hato vā svargamāpsyasi
ce_text: na mokṣyase palāyaṃs tvaṃ rājan yuddhe manaḥ kuru / pṛthivīṃ bhokṣyase jitvā hato vā svargam āpsyasi

vulgate_text: yadabhūddhanasaṃkāśamanīkaṃ vyadhamaccharaiḥ tatprapudya rathānīkaṃ siṃhadarpasamo yuvā / tānkurundrāvayadrājanraṇe nāga iva śvasan
ce_text: tat praṇudya rathānīkaṃ siṃhasaṃhanano yuvā / kurūṃs tān prahasan rājan vāsāṃsy apaharad balī

vulgate_text: dvābhyāṃ śarābhyāṃ viddhvā'tha tathā''cāryasutaṃ raṇe / cāpaṃ chittvā vikarṇasya nīle cādatta vāsasī / virāṭa uvāca
ce_text: virāṭa uvāca / striyo gāvo hiraṇyaṃ ca yac cānyad vasu kiṃ cana / na me kiṃ cit tvayā rakṣyam antareṇāpi devitum

vulgate_text: kva sa vīro mahābāhurdevaputro mahāyaśāḥ / yo mamāmocayatputraṃ kurubhirgrastamāhave
ce_text: virāṭa uvāca / kva sa vīro mahābāhur devaputro mahāyaśāḥ / yo me dhanam avājaiṣīt kurubhir grastam āhave

vulgate_text: icchāmi tamamitraghnaṃ duṣṭumarcitumeva ca / yena me tvaṃ ca gāvaśca mokṣitā devasūnunā
ce_text: icchāmi tam ahaṃ draṣṭum arcituṃ ca mahābalam / yena me tvaṃ ca gāvaś ca rakṣitā devasūnunā

vulgate_text: tasmai dāsyāmi tāṃ putrīṃ grāmāṃścaiva tu hāṭakān / sphuritaṃ kaṭisūtraṃ ca strīsahasraśatāni ca / uttara uvāca
ce_text: uttara uvāca / akāryaṃ te kṛtaṃ rājan kṣipram eva prasādyatām / mā tvā brahmaviṣaṃ ghoraṃ samūlam api nirdahet

vulgate_text: tataḥ pārtho'bhyanujñāto virāṭena mahātmanā / saha putreṇa mātsyasya mantrayitvā dhanaṃjayaḥ
ce_text: tataḥ pārtho 'bhyanujñāto virāṭena mahātmanā / pradadau tāni vāsāṃsi virāṭaduhituḥ svayam

vulgate_text: ityevaṃ brūhi rājānaṃ virāṭaṃ samupasthitam ityuktvā sahasā pārthaḥ praviśyāntaḥpuraṃ śubham / dadau vastrāṇi rantāni virāṭaduhituḥ svayam
ce_text: tataḥ pārtho 'bhyanujñāto virāṭena mahātmanā / pradadau tāni vāsāṃsi virāṭaduhituḥ svayam

vulgate_text: uttarā tu mahārhāṇi vastrāṇyābharaṇāni ca / pragṛhya tāni sarvāṇi prītā sānucarā'bhavat
ce_text: uttarā tu mahārhāṇi vividhāni tanūni ca / pratigṛhyābhavat prītā tāni vāsāṃsi bhāminī / vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ / pradāya vastrāṇi kirīṭamālī / virāṭagehe muditaḥ sakhibhyaḥ / kṛtvā mahat karma tad ājimadhye / didṛkṣayā so 'bhijagāma pārtham / taṃ prekṣamāṇas tv atha dharmarājaṃ / papraccha pārtho 'tha sa bhīmasenam / kiṃ dharmarājo hi yathāpuraṃ māṃ / mukhaṃ praticchādya na cāha kiṃ cit / tam evam uktvā pariśaṅkamānaṃ / dṛṣṭvārjunaṃ bhīmasenaṃ ca rājā / tatrābravīt tāv abhivīkṣya vīrau / yudhiṣṭhiras tat parimṛjya raktam / durātmanā tvayy abhipūjyamāne / virāṭarājñābhihato 'smi pārtha / tasmāt prahārād rudhirasya bindūn / paśyan na ceme pṛthivīṃ spṛśeyuḥ / iti praticchādya mukhaṃ tato 'haṃ / manyuṃ niyacchann upaviṣṭa āsam / kruddhe tu vīre tvayi cāpratīte / rājā virāṭo na labheta śarma / ajānatā tena tavaiva vīryaṃ / channasya satreṇa balaṃ ca pārtha / idaṃ virāṭena mayi prayuktaṃ / tvāṃ vīkṣamāṇo na gato 'smi harṣam / tenāprameyena mahābalena / tasmiṃs tathokte śamam āśritena / taṃ bhīmaseno balavān amarṣī / dhanaṃjayaṃ kruddha uvāca vākyam / na pārtha nityaṃ kṣamakālam āha / bṛhaspatir jñānavatāṃ variṣṭhaḥ / kṣamī hi sarvaiḥ paribhūyate hi / yathā bhujaṃgo viṣavīryahīnaḥ / virāṭam adyaiva nihatya śīghraṃ / saputrapautraṃ sakulaṃ sasainyam / yokṣyāmahe dharmasutaṃ tu rājye / adyaiva śīghraṃ tv arir eṣa mātsyaḥ / anena pāñcālasutātha kṛṣṇā / upekṣitā kīcakenānuyātā / tasmād ayaṃ nārhati rājaśabdaṃ / rājā bhava tvaṃ tava pārtha vīryāt / rājā kurūṇāṃ ca yudhiṣṭhiro 'yaṃ / mātsyeṣu rājā bhavatu pratītaḥ / tasyādya dehaṃ śatadhā bhinadmi / arjunaḥ / kumbhaṃ ghaneneva yathāmbupūrṇam / bhavataḥ kṣamayā rājan sarve doṣāś ca no 'bhavan / tasmād enaṃ ca hatvā vai sabalaṃ sahabāndhavam / vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ / paścāc caiva kurūn sarvān haniṣyāmo na saṃśayaḥ / bhīmasenaś ca ye cānye tathaiveti tam abruvan / tam abravīd dharmasuto mahātmā / kṣamī vadānyaḥ kupitaṃ ca bhīmam / na pratyupasthāsyati cet sadāraḥ / prasādane samyag athāstu vadhyaḥ / na hantavyo durātmāyaṃ kuravaś cāpi te 'rjuna / śvaḥ prabhāte pravekṣyāmaḥ sabhāṃ siṃhāsaneṣv iha / rājaveṣeṇa saṃyuktān yadi tatra na maṃsyate / paścād vadhyāmahe sarvān virāṭena sabāndhavān

vulgate_text: teṣu tatropaviṣṭeṣu virāṭaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ / tasyāṃ rātryāṃ vyatītāyāṃ prātaḥkṛtyaṃ samāpya ca
ce_text: teṣu tatropaviṣṭeṣu virāṭaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ / ājagāma sabhāṃ kartuṃ rājakāryāṇi sarvaśaḥ

vulgate_text: parihāsecchayā rājño virāṭasya niśamya tat / smayamāno'bravīdvākyamarjunaḥ paravīrahā

vulgate_text: indrasyārdhāsanaṃ rājannayamāroḍhumarhati / brahmaṇyaḥ śrutavāṃstyāgī sarvalokābhipūjitaḥ
ce_text: indrasyāpy āsanaṃ rājann ayam āroḍhum arhati / brahmaṇyaḥ śrutavāṃs tyāgī yajñaśīlo dṛḍhavrataḥ

vulgate_text: vājināṃ ca śataṃ rājantsahasrāṇyayutāni ca imamaṣṭaśataṃ sūtāḥ sumṛṣṭamaṇikuṇḍalāḥ / tuṣṭuvurmāgadhaiḥ sārdhaṃ purā śakramivarṣayaḥ
ce_text: enam aṣṭaśatāḥ sūtāḥ sumṛṣṭamaṇikuṇḍalāḥ / astuvan māgadhaiḥ sārdhaṃ purā śakram ivarṣayaḥ

vulgate_text: imaṃ nityapumātiṣṭhankuravaḥ kiṃkarāstadā / sarve ca nṛpa rājānaṃ dhaneśvaramivāmarāḥ

vulgate_text: śrīmatsaṃpatprabhāvena tapyate yasya kauravaḥ / ragaṇaḥ saha karṇena saubalena ca vīryavān
ce_text: śrīpratāpena caitasya tapyate sa suyodhanaḥ / sagaṇaḥ saha karṇena saubalenāpi vā vibhuḥ

vulgate_text: guṇā na śakyāḥ saṃkhyātumetasyaiva nareśvara / eṣa dharmaparo nityamanṛśaṃsaḥ suśīlavān

vulgate_text: nakulaḥ sahadevo vā draupadī vā yaśasvinī / yadā hyakṣairjitā hyete nāntarā śrūyate kathā / arjuna uvāca
ce_text: nakulaḥ sahadevo vā draupadī vā yaśasvinī / yadā dyūte jitāḥ pārthā na prājñāyanta te kva cit

ce_text: arjuna uvāca / ya eṣa ballavo brūte sūdas tava narādhipa / eṣa bhīmo mahābāhur bhīmavegaparākramaḥ

ce_text: nātṛpyad darśane teṣāṃ virāṭo vāhinīpatiḥ / saṃprīyamāṇo rājānaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram athābravīt

vulgate_text: saṃprīyamāṇo rājānāṃ yudhiṣṭhiramathābravīt diṣṭyā bhavantaḥ saṃprāptāḥ sarve kuśalino vanāt / diṣṭyā vicaritaṃ kṛcchramajñātaṃ ca durātmabhiḥ idaṃ rājyaṃ ca vaḥ sarvaṃ yaccāpi vasu kiṃcana vibhaktametadbhavatāṃ notkaṇṭhāṃ kartumarhatha / avibhaktaṃ bhavadbhirme na sandeho narādhipāḥ

ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tatas tṛtīye divase bhrātaraḥ pañca pāṇḍavāḥ / snātāḥ śuklāmbaradharāḥ samaye caritavratāḥ

vulgate_text: prasādanaṃ prāptakālaṃ pāṇḍavasyābhirocaye / tejasvī balavāñśūro rājarājeśvaraḥ prabhuḥ
ce_text: prasādanaṃ pāṇḍavasya prāptakālaṃ hi rocaye / uttarāṃ ca prayacchāmi pārthāya yadi te matam

vulgate_text: vayaṃ ca sarve sāmātyāḥ kuntīputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram / prasādyābhyupatiṣṭhāmo rājankiṃ karavāgahe
ce_text: eteṣāṃ bāhuvīryeṇa yad asmākaṃ jayo mṛdhe / vayaṃ sarve sahāmātyāḥ kuntīputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram / prasādayāmo bhadraṃ te sānujaṃ pāṇḍavarṣabham

vulgate_text: pūjyatāṃ pūjanīyāśca mahābhāgāśca pāṇḍavāḥ / na hyete kupitā śeṣaṃ kuryurāśīviṣopamāḥ
ce_text: uttara uvāca / arcyāḥ pūjyāś ca mānyāś ca prāptakālaṃ ca me matam / pūjyantāṃ pūjanārhāś ca mahābhāgāś ca pāṇḍavāḥ

vulgate_text: tasmācchīghraṃ prapadyema kuntīputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram / prasādayāmyahaṃ tatra saha pārthermahātmabhiḥ

vulgate_text: yadidaṃ māmakaṃ rāṣṭraṃ puraṃ rājyaṃ ca pārthiva sadaṇḍakośaṃ visṛje tava vaśyosmi pārthiva / vayaṃ ca sarve sāmātyā bhavantaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca

vulgate_text: tasmādāmantraye tvā'dya putrārthaṃ me viśāṃpate / suddhaṃ jitendriyaṃ manye tasyāḥ śuddhiḥ kṛtā mayā
ce_text: tasmān nimantraye tvāhaṃ duhituḥ pṛthivīpate / śuddho jitendriyo dāntas tasyāḥ śuddhiḥ kṛtā mayā

vulgate_text: evaṃ bruvati rājendre kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / anvajānata saṃbandhaṃ samaye kṛṣṇamātsyayoḥ
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / evaṃ bruvati rājendre kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / anvajānāt sa saṃyogaṃ samaye matsyapārthayoḥ

vulgate_text: yuddhātprayātāḥ kuravo hi mārge sametya sarve hitameva tatra / ācāryaputraḥ śakuniśca rājā duryodhanaḥ sūtaputraśca karṇaḥ saṃmantrya rājansahitāḥ samarthāḥ samādiśandūtamatho samagrāḥ
ce_text: tato mitreṣu sarveṣu vāsudeve ca bhārata / preṣayām āsa kaunteyo virāṭaś ca mahīpatiḥ / pratigṛhya snuṣārthaṃ vai darśayan vṛttam ātmanaḥ / śīlaśaucasamācāraṃ lokasyāvedya phalgunaḥ / loke vikhyāpya māhātmyaṃ yaśaś ca sa paraṃtapaḥ / yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / kṛtārthaḥ śucir avyagras tuṣṭimān abhavat tadā / rājan prīto 'smi bhadraṃ te sakhā me 'si paraṃtapa / vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ / sukham adhyuṣitāḥ sarve ajñātās tvayi pārthiva / virāṭanagare rājā dharmātmā saṃśitavrataḥ / pūjitaś cābhiṣiktaś ca ratnaiś ca śataśaś citaḥ / tathā bruvantaṃ prasamīkṣya rājā / paraṃ prahṛṣṭaḥ svajanena tena / snehāt pariṣvajya nṛpo bhujābhyāṃ / dadau tam arthaṃ kurupuṃgavānām / yuddhāt prayātāḥ kuravo hi mārge / sametya sarve hitam eva tatra / ācāryaputraḥ śakuniś ca rājā / duryodhanaḥ sūtaputraś ca karṇaḥ / saṃmantrya rājan sahitāḥ samarthāḥ / samādiśan dūtam atho samagrāḥ / yudhiṣṭhiraś cāpi susaṃprahṛṣṭo / duryodhanād dūtam apaśyad āgatam / sa cābravīd dharmarājaṃ sametya / yudhiṣṭhiraṃ pāṇḍavam ugravīryam / dhanaṃjayenāsi punar vanāya / pravrājitaḥ samaye tiṣṭha pārtha / trayodaśe hy eṣa kirīṭamālī / saṃvatsare pāṇḍaveyo 'dya dṛṣṭaḥ / tato 'bravīd dharmasutaḥ prahasya / kṣipraṃ gatvā brūhi suyodhanaṃ tam / pitāmahaḥ śāṃtanavo bravītu / yady atra pūrṇo 'dya trayodaśo naḥ / saṃvatsarānte tu dhanaṃjayena / viṣphāritaṃ gāṇḍivam ājimadhye / pūrṇo na pūrṇo na iti bravītu / yad asya satyaṃ mama tat pramāṇam / tenaivam uktaḥ sa nivṛtya dūto / duryodhanaṃ prāpya śaśaṃsa tattvam / sametya dūtena sa rājaputro / duryodhano mantrayām āsa tatra / bhīṣmeṇa karṇena kṛpeṇa caiva / droṇena bhūriśravasā ca sārdham / saṃmantrya rātrau bahubhiḥ suhṛdbhir / bhīṣmo 'bravīd dhārtarāṣṭraṃ mahātmā / tīrṇapratijñena dhanaṃjayena / viṣphāritaṃ gāṇḍivam ājimadhye / te dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ samayaṃ niśamya / tīrṇapratijñasya dhanaṃjayasya / saṃcintya sarve sahitāḥ suhṛdbhiḥ / sapārthivāḥ svāni gṛhāṇi jagmuḥ

vulgate_text: āntaṃ na śakyaṃ kapaṭena bhoktuṃ rājyaṃ pareṣāṃ mahatāṃ balīnām / jitvā śatrūnbhuṅkṣva rājyaṃ samagraṃ hato bhavānbhokṣyati vajrilokam / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / yadārjunena te vīrāḥ kathitāḥ pañca pāṇḍavāḥ / tadārjunasya vairāṭiḥ kathayām āsa vikramam

vulgate_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tatastrayodaśe varṣe nivṛtte pañca pāṇḍavāḥ / upaplāvye virāṭasya vāsaṃ cakruḥ purottame

vulgate_text: abhimanyumupādāya saha mātrā parantapāḥ / kṛṣṇena sahitāḥ sarve pāṇḍavāndraṣṭumāgatāḥ
ce_text: anādhṛṣṭis tathākrūraḥ sāmbo niśaṭha eva ca / abhimanyum upādāya saha mātrā paraṃtapāḥ

vulgate_text: daśanāgasahasrāṇi hayānāṃ dviguṇaṃ tathā / rathānāṃ niyutaṃ pūrṇaṃ nikharvaṃ ca padātayaḥ
ce_text: daśa nāgasahasrāṇi hayānāṃ ca śatāyutam / rathānām arbudaṃ pūrṇaṃ nikharvaṃ ca padātinām

vulgate_text: vāsudevaṃ tathā''yāntaṃ śrutvā pāṇḍusutāstadā / mātsyena sahitāḥ sarve pratyudyātā janārdanam
ce_text: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā matsyarājaḥ pratāpavān / uttaraṃ pratyuvācedam abhipanno yudhiṣṭhire

vulgate_text: akṣauhiṇībhiḥ pāñcālastisṛbhiśca mahābalaḥ / draupadyāśca sutā vīrāḥ śikhaṇḍī cāparājitaḥ
ce_text: akṣauhiṇyā ca tejasvī yajñaseno mahābalaḥ / draupadyāś ca sutā vīrāḥ śikhaṇḍī cāparājitaḥ

vulgate_text: dhṛṣṭadyumnaśca durdharṣaḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃvaraḥ / upaplāvyaṃ yayuḥ śīghraṃ pāṇḍavārthe mahābalāḥ
ce_text: dhṛṣṭadyumnaś ca durdharṣaḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / samastākṣauhiṇīpālā yajvāno bhūridakṣiṇāḥ / sarve śastrāstrasaṃpannāḥ sarve śūrās tanutyajaḥ

vulgate_text: samudramiva dharmānte srotaḥśreṣṭhāḥ pṛthakpṛthak āpūrayanmahīpālā yajvāno bhūridakṣiṇaiḥ / vedāvabhṛthasaṃpannāḥ śūrāḥ sarve tanutyajaḥ
ce_text: dhṛṣṭadyumnaś ca durdharṣaḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / samastākṣauhiṇīpālā yajvāno bhūridakṣiṇāḥ / sarve śastrāstrasaṃpannāḥ sarve śūrās tanutyajaḥ

vulgate_text: tānāgatānabhiprekṣya pārtho jñānabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / pūjayāmāsa vidhivadyathārhaṃ rājasattamān
ce_text: tān āgatān abhiprekṣya matsyo dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / prīto 'bhavad duhitaraṃ dattvā tām abhimanyave

vulgate_text: tataḥ śaṅkhā mṛdaṅgāśca gomukhā ḍiṇḍimāstadā / abhimanyorvivāhe tu nedurmātsyasya veśmani
ce_text: tataḥ śaṅkhāś ca bheryaś ca gomukhāḍambarās tathā / pārthaiḥ saṃyujyamānasya nedur matsyasya veśmani

vulgate_text: tatrātiṣṭhadgṛhītvā tu rūpamindrāsya dhārayan / snuṣāṃ tāṃ parigṛhṇānaḥ kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
ce_text: tatrātiṣṭhan mahārājo rūpam indrasya dhārayan / snuṣāṃ tāṃ pratijagrāha kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ

vulgate_text: saptaite'kṣauhiṇīpālā yajvāno bhūridakṣiṇāḥ / pāṇḍavaṃ parivāryaite niveśaṃ cakrire tadā
ce_text: dhṛṣṭadyumnaś ca durdharṣaḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / samastākṣauhiṇīpālā yajvāno bhūridakṣiṇāḥ / sarve śastrāstrasaṃpannāḥ sarve śūrās tanutyajaḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ pārthāya saṃhṛṣṭo mātsyarājo dhanaṃ mahat / tasmai śatasahasrāṇi hayānāṃ vātaraṃhasām
ce_text: tasmai sapta sahasrāṇi hayānāṃ vātaraṃhasām / dve ca nāgaśate mukhye prādād bahu dhanaṃ tadā

vulgate_text: dve ca nāgaśate mukhye dhanaṃ bahuvidhaṃ tadā / prādānmātsyapatirhṛṣṭaḥ kanyādhanamanuttamam
ce_text: tasmai sapta sahasrāṇi hayānāṃ vātaraṃhasām / dve ca nāgaśate mukhye prādād bahu dhanaṃ tadā

vulgate_text: śrīvedavyāsāya namaḥ / nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam / devīṃ sarasvatīṃ caiva tato jayamudīrayet / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / kṛtvā vivāhaṃ tu kurupravīrā- stadā'bhimanyormuditāḥ sapakṣāḥ / viśramya rātrāvuṣasi pratītāḥ sabhāṃ virāṭasya tato'bhijagmuḥ
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / kṛtvā vivāhaṃ tu kurupravīrās; tadābhimanyor muditasvapakṣāḥ / viśramya catvāry uṣasaḥ pratītāḥ; sabhāṃ virāṭasya tato 'bhijagmuḥ

vulgate_text: trayodaśaścaiva sudustaro'ya- majñāyamānairbhavatāṃ samīpe / kleśānasahyānvividhānsahadbhi- rmahātmabhiścāpi vane niviṣṭam etaiḥ parapreṣyaniyogayuktai- ricchadbhirāptaṃ svakulena rājyam
ce_text: trayodaśaś caiva sudustaro 'yam; ajñāyamānair bhavatāṃ samīpe / kleśān asahyāṃś ca titikṣamāṇair; yathoṣitaṃ tad viditaṃ ca sarvam

vulgate_text: nivāryamāṇaśca kurupravīraḥ sarvaiḥ suhṛdbhirhyamapyatañjhaḥ / sa dīvyamānaḥ pratidīvya cainaṃ gāndhārarājasya sutaṃ matākṣam
ce_text: nivāryamāṇaś ca kurupravīraiḥ; sarvaiḥ suhṛdbhir hy ayam apy atajjñaḥ / gāndhārarājasya sutaṃ matākṣaṃ; samāhvayed devitum ājamīḍhaḥ

vulgate_text: hitvā hi karṇaṃ ca suyodhanaṃ ca samāhvayaddevitumājamīḍhaḥ / durodarāstatra sahasraśo'nye yudhiṣṭhiro yānviṣaheta jetum
ce_text: durodarās tatra sahasraśo 'nye; yudhiṣṭhiro yān viṣaheta jetum / utsṛjya tān saubalam eva cāyaṃ; samāhvayat tena jito 'kṣavatyām

vulgate_text: tathā hi śakyo dhṛtarāṣṭraputraḥ svārtheṃ niyoktuṃ puruṣeṇa tena / ayuddhamākāṅkṣata kauravāṇāṃ sāmnaiva duryodhanamāśvasadhvam
ce_text: tasmāt praṇamyaiva vaco bravītu; vaicitravīryaṃ bahusāmayuktam / tathā hi śakyo dhṛtarāṣṭraputraḥ; svārthe niyoktuṃ puruṣeṇa tena

vulgate_text: yamau ca dṛḍhadhanvānau yamakalpau mahādyutī / virāṭadrupadau vīrau yamakālopamadyutī
ce_text: yamau ca dṛḍhadhanvānau yamakalpau mahādyutī / ko jijīviṣur āsīded dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ ca pārṣatam

vulgate_text: śakānāṃ pahlavānāṃ karṇaveṣṭaśca pārthivaḥ / surāriśca nadījaśca karṇaveṣṭaśca pārthivaḥ
ce_text: adāriś ca nadījaś ca karṇaveṣṭaś ca pārthivaḥ / samarthaś ca suvīraś ca mārjāraḥ kanyakas tathā

vulgate_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / drupadenaivamukte tu vākye vākyavidāṃ varaḥ / vasudevasutastatra pṛṣṇisiṃho'bravīdidam
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tataḥ satkṛtya vārṣṇeyaṃ virāṭaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ / gṛhān prasthāpayām āsa sagaṇaṃ sahabāndhavam

vulgate_text: saṃkulā ca tadā bhūmiścaturaṅgavalānvitā / balāni teṣāṃ vīrāṇāmāgacchanti tatastataḥ
ce_text: balāni teṣāṃ vīrāṇām āgacchanti tatas tataḥ / cālayantīva gāṃ devīṃ saparvatavanām imām

vulgate_text: dvijeṣu vaidyāḥ śreyāṃso vaidyeṣu kṛtabuddhayaḥ / kṛtabuddhiṣu kartāraḥ kartṛṣu brahmavādinaḥ
ce_text: dvijeṣu vaidyāḥ śreyāṃso vaidyeṣu kṛtabuddhayaḥ / sa bhavān kṛtabuddhīnāṃ pradhāna iti me matiḥ

vulgate_text: sa bhavānkṛbuddhīnāṃ pradhāna iti me matiḥ kulena ca viśiṣṭo'si vayasā ca śrutena ca / prajñayā sadṛśaścāsi śukreṇāṅgirasena ca
ce_text: kulena ca viśiṣṭo 'si vayasā ca śrutena ca / prajñayānavamaś cāsi śukreṇāṅgirasena ca

vulgate_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / purohitaṃ te prasthāpya nagaraṃ nāgasāhvayam / dūtānprasthāpayāmāsuḥ pārthivebhyastatastataḥ
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tathānuśiṣṭaḥ prayayau drupadena mahātmanā / purodhā vṛttasaṃpanno nagaraṃ nāgasāhvayam

vulgate_text: duryodhanastu prathamaṃ vāsudevamupāśrayat / ucchīrṣataśca kṛṣṇasya niṣasāda varāsane
ce_text: tataḥ śayāne govinde praviveśa suyodhanaḥ / ucchīrṣataś ca kṛṣṇasya niṣasāda varāsane

vulgate_text: pratibuddhaḥ sa vārṣṇeyo dadarśāgre kirīṭinām / siṃhāsanagataṃ paścātparivṛtya ca dṛṣṭavān
ce_text: pratibuddhaḥ sa vārṣṇeyo dadarśāgre kirīṭinam / sa tayoḥ svāgataṃ kṛtvā yathārhaṃ pratipūjya ca / tadāgamanajaṃ hetuṃ papraccha madhusūdanaḥ

vulgate_text: ahaṃ cābhigataṃ santo bhajante pūrvasāriṇaḥ tvaṃ ca śreṣṭhatamo loke satāmadya janārdana
ce_text: ahaṃ cābhigataḥ pūrvaṃ tvām adya madhusūdana / pūrvaṃ cābhigataṃ santo bhajante pūrvasāriṇaḥ

vulgate_text: etadviditvā kaunteya vicārya ca punaḥ punaḥ tānvā varaya sāhāyye māṃ sācivye'thavā punaḥ / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tathānuśiṣṭaḥ prayayau drupadena mahātmanā / purodhā vṛttasaṃpanno nagaraṃ nāgasāhvayam

vulgate_text: ityevamuktastu tadā pariṣvajya halāyudham / kṛṣṇaṃ cāpi mahābāhumāmantrya bharatarṣabha
ce_text: ity evam uktaḥ sa tadā pariṣvajya halāyudham / kṛṣṇaṃ cāpahṛtaṃ jñātvā yuddhān mene jitaṃ jayam

vulgate_text: tataḥ pītāmbaradharo jagatsraṣṭā janārdanaḥ / gate duryodhane kṛṣṇaḥ kirīṭinamathābravīt
ce_text: gate duryodhane kṛṣṇaḥ kirīṭinam athābravīt / ayudhyamānaḥ kāṃ buddhim āsthāyāhaṃ tvayā vṛtaḥ

vulgate_text: akṣauhiṇīpatī rājanmahāvīryaparākramāḥ / vicitrakavacāḥ śūrā vicitradhvajakārmukāḥ
ce_text: vicitrakavacāḥ śūrā vicitradhvajakārmukāḥ / vicitrābharaṇāḥ sarve vicitrarathavāhanāḥ

vulgate_text: vicitrābharaṇāḥ sarve vicitrarathavāhanāḥ / vicitrasragdharāḥ sarve vivitrāmbarabhūṣaṇāḥ
ce_text: vicitrakavacāḥ śūrā vicitradhvajakārmukāḥ / vicitrābharaṇāḥ sarve vicitrarathavāhanāḥ

vulgate_text: saṃprahṛṣṭo yadā śalyo diditsurapi jīvitam / gūḍho duryodhanastatra darśayāmāsa mātulam
ce_text: gūḍho duryodhanas tatra darśayām āsa mātulam / taṃ dṛṣṭvā madrarājas tu jñātvā yatnaṃ ca tasya tam / pariṣvajyābravīt prīta iṣṭo 'rtho gṛhyatām iti

vulgate_text: yathaiva pāṇḍavāstubhyaṃ tathaiva bhavato hyaham / anumānyaṃ ca pālyaṃ ca bhaktaṃ ca bhaja māṃ vibho / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / gate dvāravatīṃ kṛṣṇe baladeve ca mādhave / saha vṛṣṇyandhakaiḥ sarvair bhojaiś ca śataśas tathā

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvā yudhiṣṭhiraṃ rājankṣiprameṣye narādhipa / avaśyaṃ cāpi draṣṭavyaḥ pāṇḍavaḥ puruṣarṣabhaḥ / duryodhana uvāca
ce_text: duryodhana uvāca / satyavāg bhava kalyāṇa varo vai mama dīyatām / sarvasenāpraṇetā me bhavān bhavitum arhati

vulgate_text: kṣiprāmāgamyatāṃ rājanpāṇḍavaṃ vīkṣya pārthiva / tvayyadhīnāḥ sma rājendra varadānaṃ smarasva naḥ / śalya uvāca
ce_text: śalya uvāca / śṛṇu pāṇḍava bhadraṃ te yad bravīṣi durātmanaḥ / tejovadhanimittaṃ māṃ sūtaputrasya saṃyuge

vulgate_text: kṣiprameṣyāmi bhadraṃ te gacchasva svapuraṃ nṛpa / dṛṣṭvā tu pāṇḍavānrājanna mithyā kartumutsahe / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / gate dvāravatīṃ kṛṣṇe baladeve ca mādhave / saha vṛṣṇyandhakaiḥ sarvair bhojaiś ca śataśas tathā

vulgate_text: tathā bhīmārjunau hṛṣṭau svastrīyau ca yamāvubhau / draupadī ca subhadrā ca abhimanyuśca bhārata
ce_text: tathā bhīmārjunau hṛṣṭau svasrīyau ca yamāv ubhau / āsane copaviṣṭas tu śalyaḥ pārtham uvāca ha

vulgate_text: sametya ca mahāpāhuṃ śalyaṃ pāṇḍusutastadā / pādyamarghyaṃ ca gāṃ caiva pratigrāhya purodhasā
ce_text: sametya tu mahābāhuḥ śalyaḥ pāṇḍusutais tadā / pādyam arghyaṃ ca gāṃ caiva pratyagṛhṇād yathāvidhi

vulgate_text: tato nyaṣīdacchalyaśca kāñcane paramāsane / tatra pādyathārghyaṃ ca nyavedayata pāṇḍavaḥ / śalya uvāca
ce_text: śalya uvāca / śṛṇu pāṇḍava bhadraṃ te yad bravīṣi durātmanaḥ / tejovadhanimittaṃ māṃ sūtaputrasya saṃyuge

vulgate_text: sa taiḥ parivṛtaḥ sarvaiḥ pāṇḍavairdharmacāribhiḥ / āsane copaviṣṭaḥ sa śalyaḥ pārthamathābravīt / śalya uvāca
ce_text: tathā bhīmārjunau hṛṣṭau svasrīyau ca yamāv ubhau / āsane copaviṣṭas tu śalyaḥ pārtham uvāca ha

vulgate_text: duṣkaraṃ te kṛtaṃ rājannirjane gahane vane / bhrātṛbhiḥ saha kaunteya kṛṣṇāyā cānayā'nagha
ce_text: suduṣkaraṃ kṛtaṃ rājan nirjane vasatā vane / bhrātṛbhiḥ saha rājendra kṛṣṇayā cānayā saha

vulgate_text: diṣṭyā paśyāmi rājendra dharmātmānaṃ sahānugam / nistīrṇaduṣkaraṃ rājaṃstvāṃ dharmanicayaṃ prabho / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / gate dvāravatīṃ kṛṣṇe baladeve ca mādhave / saha vṛṣṇyandhakaiḥ sarvair bhojaiś ca śataśas tathā

vulgate_text: ekaṃ tvicchāmi bhadraṃ te kriyamāṇaṃ mahīpate / rājannakartavyamapi kartumarhasi sattama
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca / sukṛtaṃ te kṛtaṃ rājan prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā / duryodhanasya yad vīra tvayā vācā pratiśrutam / ekaṃ tv icchāmi bhadraṃ te kriyamāṇaṃ mahīpate

vulgate_text: mama tvavekṣayā vīra śṛṇu vijñāpayāmi te / bhavāniha mahārāja vāsudevasamo yudhi
ce_text: bhavān iha mahārāja vāsudevasamo yudhi / karṇārjunābhyāṃ saṃprāpte dvairathe rājasattama / karṇasya bhavatā kāryaṃ sārathyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ

vulgate_text: śṛṅgāraveṣāḥ suśroṇyo hārairyuktā manoharaiḥ / hāvabhāvasamāyuktāḥ sarvāḥ saundaryaśobhitāḥ
ce_text: śṛṅgāraveṣāḥ suśroṇyo bhāvair yuktā manoharaiḥ / pralobhayata bhadraṃ vaḥ śamayadhvaṃ bhayaṃ mama

vulgate_text: nṛttaṃ saṃdarśayāmāsustathaivāṅgeṣu sauṣṭhavam / nābhyagacchatpraharṣaṃ tāḥ sa paśyansumahātapāḥ
ce_text: śalya uvāca / indreṇa tās tv anujñātā jagmus triśiraso 'ntikam / tatra tā vividhair bhāvair lobhayantyo varāṅganāḥ / nṛtyaṃ saṃdarśayantyaś ca tathaivāṅgeṣu sauṣṭhavam

vulgate_text: hato'pi dīptatejāḥ sa jīvanniva hi dṛśyate / ghātitasya śirāṃsyājau jīvantīvādbhutāni vai
ce_text: taṃ tu vajrahataṃ dṛṣṭvā śayānam acalopamam / na śarma lebhe devendro dīpitas tasya tejasā / hato 'pi dīptatejāḥ sa jīvann iva ca dṛśyate

vulgate_text: tadaraṇyaṃ mahārāja yatrāste'sau nipātitaḥ / sa bhītastatra takṣāṇaṃ ghaṭamānaṃ śacīpatiḥ
ce_text: abhitas tatra takṣāṇaṃ ghaṭamānaṃ śacīpatiḥ / apaśyad abravīc cainaṃ satvaraṃ pākaśāsanaḥ / kṣipraṃ chindhi śirāṃsy asya kuruṣva vacanaṃ mama

vulgate_text: mayā hi nihataḥ śete triśirāstvaṃ ca vidvi vai / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / sa prahvaḥ prāñjalirbhūtvā idaṃ vacanamabravīt
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / śalyaḥ śrutvā tu dūtānāṃ sainyena mahatā vṛtaḥ / abhyayāt pāṇḍavān rājan saha putrair mahārathaiḥ

vulgate_text: tatasteṣu nikṛtteṣu vijvaro maghavānatha takṣṇe tathā varaṃ dattvā prahṛṣṭastridaśeśvaraḥ
ce_text: tatas teṣu nikṛtteṣu vijvaro maghavān abhūt / jagāma tridivaṃ hṛṣṭas takṣāpi svagṛhān yayau

vulgate_text: jagāma tridivaṃ devastakṣā'pi svagṛhānyayau / mene kṛtārthamātmānaṃ hatvā śatruṃ surārihā
ce_text: tatas teṣu nikṛtteṣu vijvaro maghavān abhūt / jagāma tridivaṃ hṛṣṭas takṣāpi svagṛhān yayau

vulgate_text: yuktaḥ sadā'bhavaccāpi śakro harṣasamanvitaḥ vṛtrasya vadhasaṃyuktānupāyānanvacintayat - - a abhisandhirmahendrasya sandhikarmaṇi yaḥ kṛtaḥ ṛṣibhistvīritaṃ yacca mahendrastadanusmaran
ce_text: yattaḥ sadābhavac cāpi śakro 'marṣasamanvitaḥ / vṛtrasya vadhasaṃyuktān upāyān anucintayan / randhrānveṣī samudvignaḥ sadābhūd balavṛtrahā

vulgate_text: chidrānveṣī samudvignaḥ sadā vasati devarāṭ / sa kadācinsamudrānte samapaśyanmahāsuram
ce_text: sa kadā cit samudrānte tam apaśyan mahāsuram / saṃdhyākāla upāvṛtte muhūrte ramyadāruṇe

vulgate_text: tejasvī ca yaśasvī ca dhārmikaścaiva nityadā / te gatvā tvabruvansarve rājā no bhava pārthiva
ce_text: śalya uvāca / ṛṣayo 'thābruvan sarve devāś ca tridaśeśvarāḥ / ayaṃ vai nahuṣaḥ śrīmān devarājye 'bhiṣicyatām / te gatvāthābruvan sarve rājā no bhava pārthiva

vulgate_text: brahmarṣīścāpi devāṃśca gopāyasva triviṣṭape / śalya uvāca / abhiṣiktaḥ sa rājendra tato rājā triviṣṭape
ce_text: śalya uvāca / evam ukte maghavatā devāḥ sarṣigaṇās tadā / śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ devaṃ jagmur viṣṇuṃ mahābalam

vulgate_text: nāhamicchāmi nahuṣaṃ patiṃ devarṣisattama / śaraṇāgatāsmi te brahaṃstrāyasva mahato bhayāt / bṛhaspatiruvāca
ce_text: nāham icchāmi nahuṣaṃ patim anvāsya taṃ prabhum / śaraṇāgatāsmi te brahmaṃs trāhi māṃ mahato bhayāt

vulgate_text: atha devāḥ sagandharvā gurumāhuridaṃ vacaḥ / kathaṃ sunītaṃ nu bhavenmantrayasva bṛhaspate / bṛhaspatiruvāca
ce_text: bṛhaspatir uvāca / śaraṇāgatāṃ na tyajeyam indrāṇi mama niścitam / dharmajñāṃ dharmaśīlāṃ ca na tyaje tvām anindite

vulgate_text: prāvepata bhayodvignā pravāte kadalī yathā / praṇamya sā hi brahmāṇaṃ śirasā tu kṛtāñjaliḥ
ce_text: evam uktā tu sā devī nahuṣeṇa pativratā / prāvepata bhayodvignā pravāte kadalī yathā

vulgate_text: ahamindro'smi devānāṃ lokānāṃ ca maheśvaraḥ mayi havyaṃ ca kavyaṃ ca lokāścaiva sanātanāḥ / tasmātte vacanaṃ devi kariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ
ce_text: tasmāt te vacanaṃ devi kariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ / saptarṣayo māṃ vakṣyanti sarve brahmarṣayas tathā / paśya māhātmyam asmākam ṛddhiṃ ca varavarṇini

vulgate_text: sa tu darpeṇa mahatā paribhūya mahāmunīn vimāne yojayitvā ca ṛṣīnniyamāmāsthitān
ce_text: evam uktvā tu tāṃ devīṃ visṛjya ca varānanām / vimāne yojayitvā sa ṛṣīn niyamam āsthitān

vulgate_text: bṛhaspatirmahātejā devarājopalabdhaye / hutvā'gniṃ sobravīdrājañchakra anviṣyatāmiti
ce_text: tataḥ prajvālya vidhivaj juhāva paramaṃ haviḥ / bṛhaspatir mahātejā devarājopalabdhaye

vulgate_text: kiṃ kāryamavaśiṣṭaṃ vo hatastvāṣṭro mahāsuraḥ / vṛtraśca sumahākāyo yo vai lokānanāśayat / bṛhaspatiruvāca
ce_text: bāḍham ity eva bhagavān bṛhaspatir uvāca tām / na bhetavyaṃ tvayā devi nahuṣād duṣṭacetasaḥ

vulgate_text: sa tānyathāvacca hi lokapālā- nsametsa vai prītamanā mahendraḥ / uvāca cainānpratibhāṣya śakraḥ saṃcodayiṣyannahuṣasyāntareṇa
ce_text: sa tān yathāvat pratibhāṣya śakraḥ; saṃcodayan nahuṣasyāntareṇa / rājā devānāṃ nahuṣo ghorarūpas; tatra sāhyaṃ dīyatāṃ me bhavadbhiḥ

vulgate_text: paraśvathairbhiṇḍipālaiḥ śūlatomaramudgaraiḥ / parighairyaṣṭibhiḥ pāśaiḥ karavālaiśca nirmalaiḥ
ce_text: paraśvadhair bhiṇḍipālaiḥ śaktitomaramudgaraiḥ / śaktyṛṣṭiparaśuprāsaiḥ karavālaiś ca nirmalaiḥ

vulgate_text: babhūva kauraveyāṇāṃ balenātīva saṃvṛtaḥ / tatra sainyaṃ tathā yuktaṃ dadarśa sa purohitaḥ
ce_text: tatra sainyaṃ tathāyuktaṃ dadarśa sa purohitaḥ / yaḥ sa pāñcālarājena preṣitaḥ kauravān prati

vulgate_text: te sarvaṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā tatpūrvaṃ karma kilviṣam / sāmnaiva kurubhiḥ sandhimicchanti kurupuṅgavāḥ
ce_text: te sarve pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā tat sarvaṃ pūrvakilbiṣam / sāmaiva kurubhiḥ sārdham icchanti kurupuṃgavāḥ

vulgate_text: tato duryodhanasyāṅke vartantāmakutobhayāḥ / adhārmikīṃ tu mā buddhiṃ maurkhyātkurvantu kevalāt
ce_text: tato duryodhanasyāṅke vartantām akutobhayāḥ / adhārmikām imāṃ buddhiṃ kuryur maurkhyād dhi kevalam

vulgate_text: kiṃ nu rādheya vācā te karma tatsmartumarhasi eka eva yadā pārthaḥ ṣaḍrathāñjitavānyudhi - - a virāṭanagare dhīraḥ kiṃ tvaṃ tatraiva nāgataḥ bahuśo jīyamānasya karma dṛṣṭaṃ tadaiva te
ce_text: bhīṣma uvāca / kiṃ nu rādheya vācā te karma tat smartum arhasi / eka eva yadā pārthaḥ ṣaḍ rathāñ jitavān yudhi

vulgate_text: putro mahyaṃ mṛtyuvaśaṃ jagāma duryodhanaḥ sañjaya rāgabuddhiḥ / teṣāṃ hīmau hīnasukhapriyāṇāṃ mahātmanāṃ saṃjanayato hi tejaḥ
ce_text: anyatra pāpād viṣamān mandabuddher; duryodhanāt kṣudratarāc ca karṇāt / teṣāṃ hīme hīnasukhapriyāṇāṃ; mahātmanāṃ saṃjanayanti tejaḥ

vulgate_text: etadbalaṃ pūrṇamasmākamevaṃ yatsatyaṃ tānprāpya nāstīti manye / teṣāṃ madhye vartamānastarasvī dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ pāṇḍavānāmihaikaḥ
ce_text: teṣāṃ madhye vartamānas tarasvī; dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ pāṇḍavānām ihaikaḥ / sahāmātyaḥ somakānāṃ prabarhaḥ; saṃtyaktātmā pāṇḍavānāṃ jayāya

vulgate_text: na cedgacchetsaṅgaraṃ mandabuddhi- stābhyāṃ labheccharma tadā suto me / no cetkurūnsañjaya nirdahetā- mindrāviṣṇū daityasenāṃ yathaiva
ce_text: no ced gacchet saṃgaraṃ mandabuddhis; tābhyāṃ suto me viparītacetāḥ / no cet kurūn saṃjaya nirdahetām; indrāviṣṇū daityasenāṃ yathaiva / mato hi me śakrasamo dhanaṃjayaḥ; sanātano vṛṣṇivīraś ca viṣṇuḥ

vulgate_text: kaccinna pāpaṃ kathayanti tāta te pāṇḍavānāṃ kuravaḥ sarva eva / droṇaḥ saputraśca kṛpaśca vīro nāsmāsu pāpāni vadanti kaccit
ce_text: kaccin na pāpaṃ kathayanti tāta; te pāṇḍavānāṃ kuravaḥ sarva eva / kaccid dṛṣṭvā dasyusaṃghān sametān; smaranti pārthasya yudhāṃ praṇetuḥ

vulgate_text: kaccidrājye dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ saputraṃ sametyāhuḥ kuravaḥ sarva eva / kacciddṛṣṭvā dasyusaṅghānsametā- nsmaranti pārthasya yudhāṃ praṇetuḥ
ce_text: kaccin na pāpaṃ kathayanti tāta; te pāṇḍavānāṃ kuravaḥ sarva eva / kaccid dṛṣṭvā dasyusaṃghān sametān; smaranti pārthasya yudhāṃ praṇetuḥ

vulgate_text: dharmodayaṃ sukhamāśaṃsamānāḥ kṛcchropāyaṃ tattvataḥ karma duḥkham / sukhaṃ prepsurvijighāṃsuśca duḥkhaṃ karmārabhedyacca dharmānapetam
ce_text: karmodayaṃ sukham āśaṃsamānaḥ; kṛcchropāyaṃ tattvataḥ karma duḥkham / sukhaprepsur vijighāṃsuś ca duḥkhaṃ; ya indriyāṇāṃ prītivaśānugāmī / kāmābhidhyā svaśarīraṃ dunoti; yayā prayukto 'nukaroti duḥkham

vulgate_text: ka indriyāṇāṃ prītivaśānurānāṃ karmābhijñaḥ svaśarīraṃ dunoti / yayā pramukto na karoti duḥkhaṃ tṛṣṇāṃ tyajetsarvadharmādapetām
ce_text: karmodayaṃ sukham āśaṃsamānaḥ; kṛcchropāyaṃ tattvataḥ karma duḥkham / sukhaprepsur vijighāṃsuś ca duḥkhaṃ; ya indriyāṇāṃ prītivaśānugāmī / kāmābhidhyā svaśarīraṃ dunoti; yayā prayukto 'nukaroti duḥkham

vulgate_text: nāśreyānīśvaro vigrahāṇāṃ nāśreyānvai gītaśabdaṃ śrṛṇoti / nāśreyānvai sevate mālyagandhā- nna cāpyaśreyānanulepanāni nāśreyānvai prāvārānsaṃvivaste kathaṃ tvasmānsaṃpraṇudetkurubhyaḥ
ce_text: nāśreyasām īśvaro vigrahāṇāṃ; nāśreyasāṃ gītaśabdaṃ śṛṇoti / nāśreyasaḥ sevate mālyagandhān; na cāpy aśreyāṃsy anulepanāni

vulgate_text: gāṇḍīvaviṣphāritaśabdamātraṃ śrutvaiva te dhārtarāṣṭrā mriyante / kruddhaṃ na cedīkṣate bhīmasenaṃ suyodhano manyate siddhamartham
ce_text: gāṇḍīvavisphāritaśabdam ājāv; aśṛṇvānā dhārtarāṣṭrā dhriyante / kruddhasya ced bhīmasenasya vegāt; suyodhano manyate siddham artham

vulgate_text: yamo rājā vaiśravaṇaḥ kubero gandharvayakṣāpsarasaśca sūta / brahmavidyāṃ brahmacaryaṃ kriyāṃ ca nipevamāṇā ṛṣayo'mutra bhānti
ce_text: nakṣatrāṇi karmaṇāmutra bhānti; rudrādityā vasavo 'thāpi viśve / yamo rājā vaiśravaṇaḥ kubero; gandharvayakṣāpsarasaś ca śubhrāḥ / brahmacaryaṃ vedavidyāḥ kriyāś ca; niṣevamāṇā munayo 'mutra bhānti

vulgate_text: sa dharmātmā dharmamadhītya puṇyaṃ yadṛcchayā vrajati brahmalokam / vaiśyo'dhītya kṛṣigorakṣapaṇyai- rvittaṃ cinvanpālayannapramattaḥ
ce_text: vaiśyo 'dhītya kṛṣigorakṣapaṇyair; vittaṃ cinvan pālayann apramattaḥ / priyaṃ kurvan brāhmaṇakṣatriyāṇāṃ; dharmaśīlaḥ puṇyakṛd āvased gṛhān

vulgate_text: svayaṃ tvahaṃ prārthaye tatra gantuṃ samādhātuṃ kāryametadvipannam / jānāsi tvaṃ dhārtarāṣṭrasya mohaṃ durātmanaḥ pāpavaśānugasya
ce_text: jānāsi tvaṃ saṃjaya sarvam etad; dyūte 'vācyaṃ vākyam evaṃ yathoktam / svayaṃ tv ahaṃ prārthaye tatra gantuṃ; samādhātuṃ kāryam etad vipannam

vulgate_text: vanaṃ rājā dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ saputraḥ siṃhā vane sañjaya pāṇḍaveyāḥ / siṃhābhiguptaṃ na vanaṃ vinaśyet siṃho na naśyeta vanābhiguptaḥ
ce_text: vanaṃ rājā dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ saputro; vyāghrā vane saṃjaya pāṇḍaveyāḥ / mā vanaṃ chindhi savyāghraṃ mā vyāghrān nīnaśo vanāt

vulgate_text: ślāghasva māṃ kuśalinaṃ sma tebhyo hyanāmayaṃ tāta pṛccherjaghanyam / ye jīvti vyavahāreṇa rāṣṭre paśūṃśca ye pālayanto vasanti kṛṣīvalā bibhrati ye ca lokaṃ teṣāṃ sarvaṣāṃ kuśalaṃ sma pṛccheḥ
ce_text: dāsīputrā ye ca dāsāḥ kurūṇāṃ; tadāśrayā bahavaḥ kubjakhañjāḥ / ākhyāya māṃ kuśalinaṃ sma tebhyo; anāmayaṃ paripṛccher jaghanyam

vulgate_text: ye caivānye kurumukhyā yuvānaḥ putrāḥ pautrā bhrātaraścaiva ye naḥ / yaṃyameṣāṃ manyase yena yogyaṃ tattatprocyānāmayaṃ sūta vācyāḥ
ce_text: ye caivānye kurumukhyā yuvānaḥ; putrāḥ pautrā bhrātaraś caiva ye naḥ / yaṃ yam eṣāṃ yena yenābhigaccher; anāmayaṃ madvacanena vācyaḥ

vulgate_text: balaṃ jijñāsamānasya ācakṣīthā yathātatham / atha mantra mantrayitvā yāthātathyena hṛṣṭavat
ce_text: alaṃ vijñāpanāya syād ācakṣīthā yathātatham / atho mantraṃ mantrayitvā anyonyenātihṛṣṭavat

vulgate_text: apāpāṃ yadupaikṣastvaṃ kṛṣṇāmetāṃ sabhāgatām / tadduḥkhamatitikṣāma mā vadhīṣma kurūniti
ce_text: apaśyan mām upekṣantaṃ kṛṣṇām ekāṃ sabhāgatām / tadduḥkham atitikṣāma mā vadhīṣma kurūn iti

vulgate_text: ācakṣva dhṛtarāṣṭrāsya dvā'stha māṃ samupāgatam / sakāśātpāṇḍuputrāṇāṃ sañjayaṃ māciraṃ kṛthāḥ
ce_text: ācakṣva māṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrāya dvāḥstha; upāgataṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ sakāśāt / jāgarti ced abhivades tvaṃ hi kṣattaḥ; praviśeyaṃ vidito bhūmipasya

vulgate_text: .....rti cedabhivadestvaṃ hi dvāḥstha .....viśeyaṃ vidito bhūmipasya / .....dyamatrātyayikaṃ hi me'sti ..... stho'tha śrutvā nṛpatiṃ jagāda / dvāḥstha uvāca
ce_text: ācakṣva māṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrāya dvāḥstha; upāgataṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ sakāśāt / jāgarti ced abhivades tvaṃ hi kṣattaḥ; praviśeyaṃ vidito bhūmipasya

vulgate_text: anujñāto'syāvasathaṃ parehi prapadyasva śayanaṃ sūtaputra / prātaḥ śrotāraḥ kuravaḥ sabhāyā- majātaśatrorvacanaṃ tvayoktam
ce_text: anujñāto rathavegāvadhūtaḥ; śrānto nipadye śayanaṃ nṛsiṃha / prātaḥ śrotāraḥ kuravaḥ sabhāyām; ajātaśatror vacanaṃ sametāḥ

vulgate_text: kimasau ceṣṭate sūta yotsyamāno yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / ke vāsya bhrātṛputrāṇāṃ paśyantyājñepsavo sukham
ce_text: kim icchaty abhisaṃrambhād yotsyamāno yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / kasya svid bhrātṛputrāṇāṃ cintāsu mukham īkṣate

vulgate_text: sañjayācakṣva yenāsmānpāḍavā abhyayuñjata / dhṛṣṭadyumnasya sainyena somakānāṃ balena ca / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / samaveteṣu sarveṣu teṣu rājasu bhārata / duryodhanam idaṃ vākyaṃ bhīṣmaḥ śāṃtanavo 'bravīt

vulgate_text: śrṛṇu ryairhi mahārāja pāṇḍavā abhyayuñjata / dhṛṣṭadyumnena vīreṇa yuddhe vaste'bhyayuñjata
ce_text: dṛṣṭavān asmi rājendra kuntīputrān mahārathān / matsyarājagṛhāvāsād avarodhena karśitān / śṛṇu yair hi mahārāja pāṇḍavā abhyayuñjata

vulgate_text: tena vo bhīmasenena pāṇḍavā abhyayuñjata / yasya vīryeṇa sahasā catvāro bhuvi pāṇḍavāḥ
ce_text: yasya bāhubale tulyaḥ pṛthivyāṃ nāsti kaś cana / yo vai sarvān mahīpālān vaśe cakre dhanurdharaḥ / tena vo bhīmasenena pāṇḍavā abhyayuñjata

vulgate_text: tena vaḥ sahadevena yuddhaṃ rājanmahātyayamaa / yavīyasā nṛvīreṇa mādrīnandikareṇa ca
ce_text: tena vaḥ sahadevena pāṇḍavā abhyayuñjata / yavīyasā nṛvīreṇa mādrīnandikareṇa ca

vulgate_text: tena vaścedirājena pāṇḍavā abhyayuñjata / akṣauhiṇyā parivṛtaḥ pāṇḍavānyobhisaṃśritaḥ
ce_text: yaś caivāpratimo vīrye dhṛṣṭaketur mahāyaśāḥ / duḥsahaḥ samare kruddhaḥ śaiśupālir mahārathaḥ / tena vaś cedirājena pāṇḍavā abhyayuñjata

vulgate_text: tārāsandhiḥ sahadevo jayatsenaśca tāvubhau / yuddhe pratirathe vīrau pāṇḍavārthe vyavasthitau
ce_text: jārāsaṃdhiḥ sahadevo jayatsenaś ca tāv ubhau / drupadaś ca mahātejā balena mahatā vṛtaḥ / tyaktātmā pāṇḍavārthāya yotsyamāno vyavasthitaḥ

vulgate_text: astre droṇārjunasamaṃ vāyuvegasamaṃ jave / maheśvarasamaṃ krodhe ko hanyādbhīmamāhave
ce_text: astre droṇārjunasamaṃ vāyuvegasamaṃ jave / saṃjayācakṣva me śūraṃ bhīmasenam amarṣaṇam

vulgate_text: sañjayācakṣva me śūraṃ bhīmasenamamarṣaṇam - - b.......... ye'haṃ yattena ripughātinā / ..... sarve putrāḥ mama manasvinā
ce_text: astre droṇārjunasamaṃ vāyuvegasamaṃ jave / saṃjayācakṣva me śūraṃ bhīmasenam amarṣaṇam

vulgate_text: āyasena sa daṇḍena rathannāgānnarānhayān / haniṣyati raṇe kruddho raudraḥ krūraparākramaḥ
ce_text: āyasena sa daṇḍena rathān nāgān hayān narān / haniṣyati raṇe kruddho bhīmaḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ

vulgate_text: droṇākarṇau pratīyātāṃ yadi vīrau nararṣabhau / kṛtāstrau balināṃ śreṣṭhau samareṣvaparājitau
ce_text: droṇakarṇau pratīyātāṃ yadi vīrau nararṣabhau / māhātmyāt saṃśayo loke na tv asti vijayo mama

vulgate_text: pārthaṃ hyete gatāḥ sarve vīryajñāstasya dhīmataḥ / bhaktyā hyasya virudhyante tava putraiḥ sadaiva te
ce_text: matsyās tvām adya nārcanti pāñcālāś ca sakekayāḥ / śālveyāḥ śūrasenāś ca sarve tvām avajānate / pārthaṃ hy ete gatāḥ sarve vīryajñās tasya dhīmataḥ

vulgate_text: anarhāneva tu vadhe dharmayuktānvikarmaṇā / yo'kleśayatpāṇḍuputrānyo vidveṣṭyadhunāpi vai
ce_text: anarhān eva tu vadhe dharmayuktān vikarmaṇā / sarvopāyair niyantavyaḥ sānugaḥ pāpapūruṣaḥ / tava putro mahārāja nātra śocitum arhasi

vulgate_text: aparohaṃ mahārāja sākṣāccainaṃ bravīmyaham / dyūtakāle mayā coktaṃ vidureṇa ca dhīmatā
ce_text: dyūtakāle mayā coktaṃ vidureṇa ca dhīmatā / yad idaṃ te vilapitaṃ pāṇḍavān prati bhārata / anīśeneva rājendra sarvam etan nirarthakam

vulgate_text: praṇipāte na doṣosti sandhirnaḥ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ / pitaraṃ tveva śocāmi prajñānetraṃ janādhipam
ce_text: praṇipāte tu doṣo 'sti bandhūnāṃ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ / pitaraṃ tv eva śocāmi prajñānetraṃ janeśvaram / matkṛte duḥkham āpannaṃ kleśaṃ prāptam anantakam

vulgate_text: na hantā vidyate cāpi rājanbhīṣmasya kaścana / pitrā hyuktaḥ prasannena nākāmastvaṃ mariṣyasi
ce_text: pitāmaho hi gāṅgeyaḥ śaṃtanor adhi bhārata / brahmarṣisadṛśo jajñe devair api durutsahaḥ / pitrā hy uktaḥ prasannena nākāmas tvaṃ mariṣyasi

vulgate_text: saṃśaptakānāṃ vṛndāni kṣatriyāṇāṃ parantapa / arjunaṃ vayamasmānvā nihanyātkapiketanaḥ
ce_text: saṃśaptāni ca vṛndāni kṣatriyāṇāṃ paraṃtapa / arjunaṃ vayam asmān vā dhanaṃjaya iti sma ha

vulgate_text: sarve ca pṛthivīpālā madarthe tāta pāṇḍavān / āryāḥ śastrabhṛtaḥ śūrāḥ samarthāḥ pratibādhituṃ
ce_text: sarvā ca pṛthivī sṛṣṭā madarthe tāta pāṇḍavān / āryān dhṛtimataḥ śūrān agnikalpān prabādhitum

vulgate_text: samarthamekaṃ paryāptaṃ kauravāṇāṃ vinigrahe / purastādupayātānāṃ kauravāṇāṃ yuyutsatām
ce_text: jānāmi tvāṃ mahābāho kṣatradharme vyavasthitam / samartham ekaṃ paryāptaṃ kauravāṇāṃ yuyutsatām / bhavatā yad vidhātavyaṃ tan naḥ śreyaḥ paraṃtapa

vulgate_text: yudhiṣṭhiraḥ sādhunaivābhyupeyo mā vo'vadhīdarjuno devaguptaḥ / rājyaṃ daddhvaṃ dharmarājasya tūrṇaṃ yācadhvaṃ vai pāṇḍavaṃ lokavīram
ce_text: bhīṣmaṃ caiva brūhi gatvā tvam āśu; yudhiṣṭhiraṃ sādhunaivābhyupeta / mā vo vadhīd arjuno devaguptaḥ; kṣipraṃ yācadhvaṃ pāṇḍavaṃ lokavīram

vulgate_text: balābalaṃ viniścitya yāthātathyena buddhimān / yadā tu mene bhūyiṣṭhaṃ tadvaco guṇadoṣataḥ
ce_text: balābale viniścitya yāthātathyena buddhimān / śaktiṃ saṃkhyātum ārebhe tadā vai manujādhipaḥ

vulgate_text: punareva kurūṇāṃ ca pāṇḍavānāṃ ca buddhimān śaktiṃ śaṅkhyātumārebhe tadā vai manujādhipaḥ
ce_text: balābale viniścitya yāthātathyena buddhimān / śaktiṃ saṃkhyātum ārebhe tadā vai manujādhipaḥ

vulgate_text: astreṇa yodhayugyā ca śīghratve kauśale tathā / sarve sma samajātīyāḥ sarve mānuṣayonayaḥ
ce_text: sarve sma samajātīyāḥ sarve mānuṣayonayaḥ / pitāmaha vijānīṣe pārtheṣu vijayaṃ katham

vulgate_text: sukhānyavāpya sahitāḥ kṛtvā karma sudustaram / visrabdhāstu bhaviṣyāmaḥ prāpte kāle gatajvarāḥ / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tathā tu pṛcchantam atīva pārthān; vaicitravīryaṃ tam acintayitvā / uvāca karṇo dhṛtarāṣṭraputraṃ; praharṣayan saṃsadi kauravāṇām

vulgate_text: athābravīnmahārājo dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ sudurmanāḥ / viduraṃ viduṣāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvapārthivasaṃnidhau / dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / duryodhana vijānīhi yat tvāṃ vakṣyāmi putraka / utpathaṃ manyase mārgam anabhijña ivādhvagaḥ

vulgate_text: mohito mṛtyupāśena kālasya vaśamāgataḥ tāta karṇena sahitaḥ putro duryodhano mama / vidura uvāca
ce_text: tato rājan mahāyajñair vividhair bhūridakṣiṇaiḥ / brāhmaṇāṃs tarpayiṣyāmi gobhir aśvair dhanena ca / yadā parikariṣyanti aiṇeyān iva tantunā / ataritrān iva jale bāhubhir māmakā raṇe / paśyantas te parāṃs tatra rathanāgasamākulān / vidura uvāca / tadā darpaṃ vimokṣyanti pāṇḍavāḥ sa ca keśavaḥ / iha niḥśreyasaṃ prāhur vṛddhā niścitadarśinaḥ / brāhmaṇasya viśeṣeṇa damo dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ / tasya dānaṃ kṣamā siddhir yathāvad upapadyate / damo dānaṃ tapo jñānam adhītaṃ cānuvartate / damas tejo vardhayati pavitraṃ dama uttamam / vipāpmā vṛddhatejās tu puruṣo vindate mahat / kravyādbhya iva bhūtānām adāntebhyaḥ sadā bhayam / teṣāṃ ca pratiṣedhārthaṃ kṣatraṃ sṛṣṭaṃ svayaṃbhuvā / āśrameṣu caturṣv āhur damam evottamaṃ vratam / tasya liṅgaṃ pravakṣyāmi yeṣāṃ samudayo damaḥ / kṣamā dhṛtir ahiṃsā ca samatā satyam ārjavam / indriyābhijayo dhairyaṃ mārdavaṃ hrīr acāpalam / akārpaṇyam asaṃrambhaḥ saṃtoṣaḥ śraddadhānatā / etāni yasya rājendra sa dāntaḥ puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ / kāmo lobhaś ca darpaś ca manyur nidrā vikatthanam / māna īrṣyā ca śokaś ca naitad dānto niṣevate / ajihmam aśaṭhaṃ śuddham etad dāntasya lakṣaṇam / alolupas tathālpepsuḥ kāmānām avicintitā / samudrakalpaḥ puruṣaḥ sa dāntaḥ parikīrtitaḥ / suvṛttaḥ śīlasaṃpannaḥ prasannātmātmavid budhaḥ / prāpyeha loke saṃmānaṃ sugatiṃ pretya gacchati / abhayaṃ yasya bhūtebhyaḥ sarveṣām abhayaṃ yataḥ / sa vai pariṇataprajñaḥ prakhyāto manujottamaḥ / sarvabhūtahito maitras tasmān nodvijate janaḥ / samudra iva gambhīraḥ prajñātṛptaḥ praśāmyati / karmaṇācaritaṃ pūrvaṃ sadbhir ācaritaṃ ca yat / tad evāsthāya modante dāntāḥ śamaparāyaṇāḥ / naiṣkarmyaṃ vā samāsthāya jñānatṛpto jitendriyaḥ / kālākāṅkṣī caraṃl loke brahmabhūyāya kalpate / śakunīnām ivākāśe padaṃ naivopalabhyate / evaṃ prajñānatṛptasya muner vartma na dṛśyate / utsṛjya vā gṛhān yas tu mokṣam evābhimanyate / lokās tejomayās tasya kalpante śāśvatā divi

vulgate_text: ekena rathamāsthāya pṛthivī yena nirjitā / bhīṣmadroṇaprabhṛtayaḥ santrastāḥ sādhuyāyinaḥ
ce_text: ekena ratham āsthāya pṛthivī yena nirjitā / pratīkṣamāṇo yo vīraḥ kṣamate vīkṣitaṃ tava

vulgate_text: virāṭanagare bhagnāḥ kiṃ tatra tava dṛśyatām / pratīkṣamāṇo yo vīraḥ kṣamate vīkṣitaṃ tava
ce_text: ekena ratham āsthāya pṛthivī yena nirjitā / pratīkṣamāṇo yo vīraḥ kṣamate vīkṣitaṃ tava

vulgate_text: pañcānāṃ pāṇḍuputrāṇāṃ yattejaḥ prajihīrṣasi / pañcānāmiva bhūtānāṃ mahatāṃ lokadhāriṇām
ce_text: pañcānāṃ pāṇḍuputrāṇāṃ yat tejaḥ pramimīṣasi / pañcānām iva bhūtānāṃ mahatāṃ sumahātmanām

vulgate_text: sāpahnavaṃ kauraveṣu pāṇḍavānāṃ susaṃmatam / sārāsārabalaṃ jñātuṃ tejaḥpuñjāvabhāsitam
ce_text: sāpahnavaṃ pāṇḍaveṣu pāṇḍavānāṃ susaṃmatam / sārāsārabalaṃ jñātvā tat samāsena me śṛṇu

vulgate_text: etatsarvaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha vistaraṃ mama sattama / kathayasva prayatnena śrotumicchāmi paṇḍita / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / saṃjaye pratiyāte tu dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / abhyabhāṣata dāśārham ṛṣabhaṃ sarvasātvatām

vulgate_text: sañjaye pratiyāte tu dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / arjunaṃ bhīmasenaṃ ca mādrīputrau ca bhārata
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / saṃjaye pratiyāte tu dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / abhyabhāṣata dāśārham ṛṣabhaṃ sarvasātvatām

vulgate_text: śrutaṃ te dhṛtarāṣṭrasya saputrasya cikīrṣitam etaddhi sakalaṃ kṛṣṇa sañjayo māṃ yadabravīt - - a mṛdupūrvaṃ sāmamiśraṃ samamugraṃ ca mādhava na katṛṃ nyāyamāsthāya garhitāśca tato vayam
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca / śrutaṃ te dhṛtarāṣṭrasya saputrasya cikīrṣitam / etad dhi sakalaṃ kṛṣṇa saṃjayo māṃ yad abravīt

vulgate_text: antaraṃ lipsamānānāmayaṃ doṣo nirantaraḥ pauruṣe yo hi balavānādhirhṛdayabādhanaḥ / tasya tyāgena vā śāntirmaraṇenāpi vā bhavet
ce_text: pauruṣeyo hi balavān ādhir hṛdayabādhanaḥ / tasya tyāgena vā śāntir nivṛttyā manaso 'pi vā

vulgate_text: evamuktaḥ pratyuvāca dharmarājo janārdanam / bhātṝṇāṃ samavetānāṃ sakāśe puruṣottamam / yudhiṣṭhira uvāca
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca / śrutaṃ te dhṛtarāṣṭrasya saputrasya cikīrṣitam / etad dhi sakalaṃ kṛṣṇa saṃjayo māṃ yad abravīt

vulgate_text: etadeva nimittaṃ te dhārtarāṣṭro yathā tvayi / nānvatapyata kopena tava kṛtvā'pi duṣkaram
ce_text: etad eva nimittaṃ te pāṇḍavās tu yathā tvayi / nānvatapyanta kaupīnaṃ tāvat kṛtvāpi duṣkaram

vulgate_text: pitāmahasya droṇasya vidurasya ca dhīmataḥ / brāhmaṇānāṃ ca sādhūnāṃ rājñaśca nagarasya ca
ce_text: pitāmahasya droṇasya vidurasya ca dhīmataḥ / paśyatāṃ kurumukhyānāṃ sarveṣām eva tattvataḥ

vulgate_text: sahajaścedimatsyānāṃ pravīrāṇāṃ vṛṣadhvajaḥ / dhāraṇaścandravatsānāṃ mukuṭānāṃ vigāhanaḥ
ce_text: sahajaś cedimatsyānāṃ pracetānāṃ bṛhadbalaḥ / dhāraṇaś cendravatsānāṃ mukuṭānāṃ vigāhanaḥ

vulgate_text: aho yuddhābhikāṅkṣāṇāṃ yuddhakāla upasthite / cetāṃsi vipratīpāni yattvāṃ bhībhīma vindati
ce_text: aho yuddhapratīpāni yuddhakāla upasthite / paśyasīvāpratīpāni kiṃ tvāṃ bhīr bhīma vindati

vulgate_text: vigāḍhe yudhi saṃbādhe vetsyase māṃ janārdana / paruṣairākṣipasi kiṃ vraṇaṃ sūcyeva cānagha
ce_text: atha cen māṃ na jānāsi sūryasyevodyataḥ prabhām / vigāḍhe yudhi saṃbādhe vetsyase māṃ janārdana

vulgate_text: kathaṃ goharaṇe hyukto naitaccharma tathā hitam / yācyamāno hi bhīṣmeṇa saṃvatsaragate'dhvani
ce_text: kathaṃ goharaṇe brūyād icchañ śarma tathāvidham / yācyamāno 'pi bhīṣmeṇa saṃvatsaragate 'dhvani

vulgate_text: brūhi madvacanaṃ kṛṣṇa suyodhanamapaṇḍitam / kṛcchre vane vā vastavyaṃ pure vā nāgasāhvaye / sātyakiruvāca
ce_text: sātyakir uvāca / satyam āha mahābāho sahadevo mahāmatiḥ / duryodhanavadhe śāntis tasya kopasya me bhavet

vulgate_text: caleddhi himavāñśailo medinī śatadhā bhavet dyauḥ patecca sanakṣatrā na me moghaṃ vaco bhavet - - a śuṣyettoyanidhiḥ kṛṣṇe na me moghaṃ vaco bhavet satyaṃ te pratijānāmi kṛṣṇe bāṣpo nigṛhyatām / hatāmitrāñśriyā yuktānacidāddrakṣyase patīn
ce_text: satyaṃ te pratijānāmi kṛṣṇe bāṣpo nigṛhyatām / hatāmitrāñ śriyā yuktān acirād drakṣyase patīn

vulgate_text: yathāvayo yathāsthānaṃ prapadyasva janārdana viduraṃ ca mahāprājñaṃ kurūṇāṃ mantradhāriṇam / agādhabuddhiṃ marmajñaṃ svajethā madhusūdana / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / rājñas tu vacanaṃ śrutvā dharmārthasahitaṃ hitam / kṛṣṇā dāśārham āsīnam abravīc chokakarṣitā

vulgate_text: sabhāyāṃ madhurā vācaḥ śuśrūṣantastvayeritāḥ kurūṇāṃ prativācaśca śrotumicchāma mādhava
ce_text: dharmārthasahitā vācaḥ śrotum icchāma mādhava / tvayocyamānāḥ kuruṣu rājamadhye paraṃtapa

vulgate_text: yāhyavighnena vai vīra drakṣyāmastvāṃ sabhāgatam / āsīnamāsane divye balatejaḥsamāhitam / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / rājñas tu vacanaṃ śrutvā dharmārthasahitaṃ hitam / kṛṣṇā dāśārham āsīnam abravīc chokakarṣitā

vulgate_text: saṃstuto brāhmaṇairgīrbhistatratatra sahasraśaḥ / arcyate madhuparkaiśca vasubhiśca vasupradaḥ
ce_text: sa gacchan brāhmaṇai rājaṃs tatra tatra mahābhujaḥ / arcyate madhuparkaiś ca sumanobhir vasupradaḥ

vulgate_text: tato hyanucarānsarvānuvāca madhusūdanaḥ / yudhiṣṭhirasya kāryārthamiha vatsyāmahe vayam
ce_text: abhyatītya tu tat sarvam uvāca madhusūdanaḥ / yudhiṣṭhirasya kāryārtham iha vatsyāmahe kṣapām

vulgate_text: na paryāptosmi yadrājañśriyaṃ niṣkevalāmaham / taiḥ sahemāmupāśrīyāṃ yāvajjīvaṃ pitāmaha
ce_text: duryodhana uvāca / na paryāyo 'sti yad rājañ śriyaṃ niṣkevalām aham / taiḥ sahemām upāśnīyāṃ jīvañ jīvaiḥ pitāmaha

vulgate_text: rājamārge narāstasminsaṃstuvantyavaniṃ gatāḥ / tasminkāle mahārāja hṛṣīkeśapraveśane
ce_text: rājamārge narā na sma saṃbhavanty avaniṃ gatāḥ / tathā hi sumahad rājan hṛṣīkeśapraveśane

vulgate_text: apaśyantaśca pitarau kathamuṣūrmahāvane / śaṅkhadundubhinirghoṣairbhṛdaṅgairveṇunisvanaiḥ
ce_text: bālā vihīnāḥ pitrā te mayā satatalālitāḥ / apaśyantaḥ svapitarau katham ūṣur mahāvane

vulgate_text: tejorāśiṃ mahātmānaṃ variṣṭhamabhitaujasam / bhīmaṃ pradarśanenāpi bhīmasenaṃ janārdana
ce_text: tejorāśiṃ mahātmānaṃ balaugham amitaujasam / bhīmaṃ pradarśanenāpi bhīmasenaṃ janārdana / taṃ mamācakṣva vārṣṇeya katham adya vṛkodaraḥ

vulgate_text: na me viśepo jātvāsīddhārtarāṣṭreṣu pāṇḍavaiḥ tena satyena kṛṣṇa tvāṃ hatāmitraṃ śriyā vṛtam / asmādvimuktaṃ saṅgrāmātpaśyeyaṃ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha
ce_text: tena satyena kṛṣṇa tvāṃ hatāmitraṃ śriyā vṛtam / asmād vimuktaṃ saṃgrāmāt paśyeyaṃ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha / naiva śakyāḥ parājetuṃ sattvaṃ hy eṣāṃ tathāgatam

vulgate_text: kurūṇāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ ca lokānāṃ cāparājita sarvasyaitasya vārṣṇeya gatistvamasi mādhava / prabhāvo buddhivīryaṃ ca tādṛśaṃ tava keśava / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / prātar utthāya kṛṣṇas tu kṛtavān sarvam āhnikam / brāhmaṇair abhyanujñātaḥ prayayau nagaraṃ prati

vulgate_text: lakṣmyā paramayā yuktaṃ purandaragṛhopamam / vicitrairāsanairyuktaṃ praviveśa janārdanaḥ
ce_text: lakṣmyā paramayā yuktaṃ puraṃdaragṛhopamam / tasya kakṣyā vyatikramya tisro dvāḥsthair avāritaḥ

vulgate_text: nivedayāmāsa tadā gṛhānrājyaṃ ca kauravaḥ - - b āsanaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ sarvaratnavibhūṣitam
ce_text: tasmin gāṃ madhuparkaṃ ca upahṛtya janārdane / nivedayām āsa tadā gṛhān rājyaṃ ca kauravaḥ

vulgate_text: kṛṣṇārthamevaṃ saṃsiddhaṃ dhārtarāṣṭrasya śāsanāt tatra govindamāsīnaṃ prasannādityavarcasam
ce_text: tatra govindam āsīnaṃ prasannādityavarcasam / upāsāṃ cakrire sarve kuravo rājabhiḥ saha

vulgate_text: saṃbandhī dayitaścāsi dhṛtarāṣṭrasya mādhava tvaṃ hi govinda dharmārthau vettha tattvena sarvaśaḥ / tatra kāraṇamicchāmi śrotuṃ cakragadādhara / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / athopagamya viduram aparāhṇe janārdanaḥ / pitṛṣvasāraṃ govindaḥ so 'bhyagacchad ariṃdamaḥ

vulgate_text: śraddhayā parayā yukta idaṃ vacanamabravīt saṃvṛtaistuṣya govinda etannaḥ dhanam / anyathā hi viśeṣeṇa kastvāmarcitumarhati / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / athopagamya viduram aparāhṇe janārdanaḥ / pitṛṣvasāraṃ govindaḥ so 'bhyagacchad ariṃdamaḥ

vulgate_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / vidurasya vacaḥ śrutvā praśritaṃ puruṣottamaḥ idaṃ hovāca vacanaṃ madhuraṃ madhusūdanaḥ / śrībhagavānuvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / taṃ bhuktavantam āśvastaṃ niśāyāṃ viduro 'bravīt / mahātmāno yam icchanti tapaḥ kṛtvā tv anekadhā / sa devo 'sya samāyāto mama locanagocare / tavātithyaṃ jagannātha kiṃ karomy adya keśava / kṛṣṇa uvāca / aham asmi mahīpīṭhe nirdhanānāṃ śiromaṇiḥ / sādhu sādhu mahāprājña sarvaśāstraviśārada / yas tvaṃ vinayasaṃpanno vayas tvayy eva dṛśyate / tavādya vacasā tuṣye dadāmi kurunandana / vidura uvāca / varaṃ vṛṇīṣva dāsye 'haṃ yat te manasi rocate / acalā keśave bhaktir mānasaṃ tvadgataṃ sadā / dharme cintā kule janma dehi me madhusūdana / mā matiḥ paradravyeṣu paradāreṣu mā matiḥ / parāpavādinī jihvā mā bhūd deva kadā cana / āsanaṃ sutasaṃkīrṇaṃ viprasaṃkīrṇamandiram / hṛdayaṃ śāstrasaṃkīrṇaṃ dehi me madhusūdana / durbhikṣe cānnadātāhaṃ subhikṣe ca hiraṇyadaḥ / āture 'haṃ bhayatrātā trīṇi kṛṣṇa bhavantu me / satyaṃ śaucaṃ dayā dānaṃ bhaktiś caiva janārdane / etān varān ahaṃ yāce yadi tuṣṭo 'si mādhava / nedaṃ samyag vyavasitaṃ keśavāgamanaṃ tava

vulgate_text: vartāmahe tvayi ca tāṃ tvaṃ ca vartasva nastathā pitrā sthāpayitavyā hi vayamutpathamāsthitāḥ
ce_text: pitrā sthāpayitavyā hi vayam utpatham āsthitāḥ / saṃsthāpaya pathiṣv asmāṃs tiṣṭha rājan svavartmani

vulgate_text: saṃsthāpaya pathipvasmāṃstiṣṭha dharme suvartmani āhuścemāṃ pariṣadaṃ putrāste bharatarṣabha
ce_text: āhuś cemāṃ pariṣadaṃ putrās te bharatarṣabha / dharmajñeṣu sabhāsatsu neha yuktam asāṃpratam

vulgate_text: anekajayinau śaṅkhye yau vai puruṣasattamau / tayostvaṃ na samo rājanbhavitāsi kadācana
ce_text: anekajananaṃ sakhyaṃ yayoḥ puruṣasiṃhayoḥ / tayos tvaṃ na samo rājan bhavitāsi kadā cana

vulgate_text: nyamantrayetāṃ rājānaṃ kiṃ kāryaṃ kriyatāmiti / tatastāmānupūrvī sa punarevānvakīrtayat
ce_text: tam arcitvā mūlaphalair āsanenodakena ca / nyamantrayetāṃ rājānaṃ kiṃ kāryaṃ kriyatām iti

vulgate_text: ahaṃ hi te vineṣyāmi yuddhaśraddhāmitaḥ param yadāhvayasi darpeṇa brāhmaṇapramukhāñjanān / dambhodbhava uvāca
ce_text: sarvaśastrāṇi cādatsva yojayasva ca vāhinīm / ahaṃ hi te vineṣyāmi yuddhaśraddhām itaḥ param

ce_text: kṛtaprajño vītalobho nirahaṃkāra ātmavān / dāntaḥ kṣānto mṛduḥ kṣemaḥ prajāḥ pālaya pārthiva

ce_text: daṃṣṭriṇo bhīmarūpāś ca nivasanty ātmarakṣiṇaḥ / māyāvīryopasaṃpannā nivasanty ātmarakṣiṇaḥ

vulgate_text: śvetācalanibhākāro divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ / sahasraṃ dhārayanmūrdhnāṃ jvālājihvo mahābalaḥ

ce_text: kaṇva uvāca / mātalis tv ekam avyagraḥ satataṃ saṃnirīkṣya vai / papraccha nāradaṃ tatra prītimān iva cābhavat

vulgate_text: sumukhasya guṇaiścaiva śīlaśaucadamādibhiḥ abhigamya svayaṃ kanyāmayaṃ dātuṃ samudyataḥ / mātalistasya saṃmānaṃ kartumarho bhavānapi / kaṇva uvāca
ce_text: kaṇva uvāca / mātalis tv ekam avyagraḥ satataṃ saṃnirīkṣya vai / papraccha nāradaṃ tatra prītimān iva cābhavat

vulgate_text: bhagavankimavajñānādvṛttiḥ pratihatā mama / kāmakāravaraṃ dattvā punaścalitavānasi
ce_text: garuḍa uvāca / bhagavan kim avajñānāt kṣudhāṃ prati bhaye mama / kāmakāravaraṃ dattvā punaś calitavān asi

vulgate_text: evaṃ viṣṇubalākrānto garvanāśamupāgataḥ / garuḍo balavānrājanvainateyo mahāyaśāḥ / kaṇva uvāca
ce_text: kaṇva uvāca / sa tu dīnaḥ prahṛṣṭaś ca prāha nāradam āryakaḥ / vriyamāṇe tathā pautre putre ca nidhanaṃ gate

vulgate_text: dakṣiṇābhirupetaṃ hi karma siddhyati mānada / dakṣiṇānāṃ hi dātā vai apavargeṇa yujyate

vulgate_text: ekataḥśyāmakarṇānāṃ hayānāṃ candravarcasām / aṣṭau śatāni me dehi gaccha gālava mā ciram

vulgate_text: adhītya sakalānvedām̐llebhire mokṣamakṣayam / atra bhogavatī nāma purī vāsukipālitā
ce_text: atra bhogavatī nāma purī vāsukipālitā / takṣakeṇa ca nāgena tathaivairāvatena ca

vulgate_text: abhedyaṃ bhāskareṇāpi svayaṃ vā kṛṣṇavartmanā eṣa tasyāpi te mārgaḥ paricārasya gālava / brūhi me yadi gantavyaṃ pratīcīṃ śṛṇu cāparām
ce_text: eṣa tasyāpi te mārgaḥ paritāpasya gālava / brūhi me yadi gantavyaṃ pratīcīṃ śṛṇu vā mama

vulgate_text: atra vai himavatpṛṣṭhe nityamāste maheśvaraḥ / prakṛtyā puruṣaḥ sārdhaṃ yugāntāgnisamaprabhaḥ

ce_text: atra yajñaṃ samāruhya dhruvaṃ sthātā pitāmahaḥ / jyotīṃṣi candrasūryau ca parivartanti nityaśaḥ

vulgate_text: sa me nirvāpya sahasā cakṣuṣī śāmyate punaḥ / tanniyaccha mahāvegaṃ gamane vinatātmaja
ce_text: sa me nirvāpya sahasā cakṣuṣī śāmyate punaḥ / tan nivarta mahān kālo gacchato vinatātmaja

vulgate_text: na dvitīyāṃ pratijñāṃ hi pratijānāmi kaitava / satyaṃ bravīmyahaṃ hyetatsarvaṃ satyaṃ bhaviṣyati

vulgate_text: dhvajinyutsavasaṃketāstrigartāḥ sālvasenayaḥ / vyūkāḥ kokabakāḥ proṣṭhāḥ sarmavegavaśāstathā
ce_text: samaṅgāḥ kopanāś caiva kukurāṅgadamāriṣāḥ / dhvajiny utsavasaṃketās trigartāḥ sarvasenayaḥ

vulgate_text: kulindāḥ kāladāścaiva kuṇḍalāḥ karaṭāstathā / mūṣakāstanabālāśca sanīpā ghaṭasṛñjayāḥ
ce_text: mālakā mallakāś caiva tathaivāparavartakāḥ / kulindāḥ kulakāś caiva karaṇṭhāḥ kurakās tathā

vulgate_text: aṭhidāḥ pāśivāṭāśca tanayāḥ sunayāstathā / ṛṣikā vidabhāḥ kākāstaṅgaṇāḥ parataṅgaṇāḥ
ce_text: hṛṣīvidarbhāḥ kāntīkās taṅgaṇāḥ parataṅgaṇāḥ / uttarāś cāpare mlecchā janā bharatasattama

vulgate_text: sakṛdgrahāḥ kulatthāśca hūṇāḥ pārasikaiḥ saha / tathaiva ramaṇāścīnāstathaiva daśamālikāḥ
ce_text: tathaiva maradhāś cīnās tathaiva daśamālikāḥ / kṣatriyopaniveśāś ca vaiśyaśūdrakulāni ca

vulgate_text: khāśīrāścāntacārāśca pahlavā girigahvarāḥ / ātreyāḥ sabharadvājāstathaiva stanapoṣikāḥ
ce_text: śūdrābhīrātha daradāḥ kāśmīrāḥ paśubhiḥ saha / khaśikāś ca tukhārāś ca pallavā girigahvarāḥ

vulgate_text: ete cānye janapadāḥ prācyodīcyāstathaiva ca / uddeśamātreṇa mayā deśāḥ saṃkīrtitā vibho
ce_text: tāmarā haṃsamārgāś ca tathaiva karabhañjakāḥ / uddeśamātreṇa mayā deśāḥ saṃkīrtitāḥ prabho

vulgate_text: mahābalā mahāsatvāḥ prajñāguṇasamanvitāḥ / prajāyante ca jātāśca śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ
ce_text: mahābalā mahāsattvāḥ prajāguṇasamanvitāḥ / ajāyanta kṛte rājan munayaḥ sutapodhanāḥ

vulgate_text: jātāḥ kṛtayuge rājandhaninaḥ prayadarśanāḥ / prajāyante ca jātāśca munayo vai tapodhanāḥ
ce_text: mahotsāhā mahātmāno dhārmikāḥ satyavādinaḥ / jātāḥ kṛtayuge rājan dhaninaḥ priyadarśanāḥ

vulgate_text: mahotsāhā mahātmāno dhārmikāḥ satyavādinaḥ / priyadarśanā vapuṣmanto mahāvīryā dhanurdharāḥ
ce_text: mahotsāhā mahātmāno dhārmikāḥ satyavādinaḥ / jātāḥ kṛtayuge rājan dhaninaḥ priyadarśanāḥ

vulgate_text: varārhā yudhi jāyante kṣatriyāḥ śūrasattamāḥ / tretāyāṃ kṣatriyā rājansarve vai cakravartinaḥ
ce_text: āyuṣmanto mahāvīrā dhanurdharavarā yudhi / jāyante kṣatriyāḥ śūrās tretāyāṃ cakravartinaḥ

vulgate_text: sarvavarṇāśca jāyante sadā caiva ca dvāpare / mahotsāhā vīryavantaḥ parasparajayaiṣiṇaḥ
ce_text: sarvavarṇā mahārāja jāyante dvāpare sati / mahotsāhā mahāvīryāḥ parasparavadhaiṣiṇaḥ

vulgate_text: kṣīrodo bharataśreṣṭha yena saṃparivāritāḥ tatra puṇyā janapadāstatra na mriyate janaḥ / kuta eva hi durbhikṣaṃ kṣamātejoyutā hi te
ce_text: tatra puṇyā janapadā na tatra mriyate janaḥ / kuta eva hi durbhikṣaṃ kṣamātejoyutā hi te

vulgate_text: uttareṇa tu rājendra śyāmo nāma mahāgiriḥ navameghaprabhaḥ prāṃśuḥ śrīmānujjvalavigrahaḥ / yataḥ śyāmatvamāpannāḥ prajā janapadeśvara / dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / bhāratasyāsya varṣasya tathā haimavatasya ca / pramāṇam āyuṣaḥ sūta phalaṃ cāpi śubhāśubham

vulgate_text: śyāmo yasmātpravṛtto vai tasmācchyāmo giriḥsmṛtaḥ
ce_text: śyāmo yasmāt pravṛtto vai tat te vakṣyāmi bhārata / āste 'tra bhagavān kṛṣṇas tat kāntyā śyāmatāṃ gataḥ

vulgate_text: tatra ratnāni divyāni svayaṃ rakṣati keśavaḥ / prasannaścābhavattatra prajānāṃ vyadadhatsukham
ce_text: tatra ratnāni divyāni svayaṃ rakṣati keśavaḥ / prajāpatim upāsīnaḥ prajānāṃ vidadhe sukham

vulgate_text: akarodduṣkaraṃ karma raṇe pāṇḍusuteṣu yaḥ / grasamānamanīkāni ya enaṃ paryavārayan
ce_text: grasamānam anīkāni ya enaṃ paryavārayan / kṛtinaṃ taṃ durādharṣaṃ samyag yāsyantam antike / kathaṃ śāṃtanavaṃ yuddhe pāṇḍavāḥ pratyavārayan

vulgate_text: gadāsimakarāvāsaṃ hayāvarttaṃ gajākulam / padātimatsyakalilaṃ śaṅkhadundubhiniḥsvanam
