vulgate_text: yasmijjāte mahāvīrye śāntanurlokaviśrutaḥ / śokaṃ dainyaṃ ca duḥsvaṃ ca prājahātsa ca tatkṣaṇe
ce_text: yasmiñ jāte mahāvīrye śaṃtanur lokaśaṃkare / śokaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca dainyaṃ ca prājahāt putralakṣmaṇi

vulgate_text: prāṇadyūte pratibhaye ke'dīvyanta nararṣabhāḥ ke jīyante jitāstatra kṛtalakṣyā nipātitāḥ / anye bhīṣmāccāntanavāttanmamācakṣva sañjaya
ce_text: ke 'jayan ke jitās tatra hṛtalakṣā nipātitāḥ / anye bhīṣmāc chāṃtanavāt tan mamācakṣva saṃjaya

vulgate_text: na hi me śāntirastīha śrutvā devavrataṃ hatam / pitaraṃ bhīmakarmāṇaṃ bhīṣmamāhavaśobhinam
ce_text: na hi me śāntir astīha yudhi devavrataṃ hatam / pitaraṃ bhīmakarmāṇaṃ śrutvā me duḥkham āviśat

vulgate_text: rājendra tava putrāṇāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ tathaiva ca / duṣpradhṛṣyāṇi cāstrāṇi saśasrakavacāni ca
ce_text: udatiṣṭhan mahārāja sarvaṃ yuktam aśeṣataḥ / sūryodaye mahat sainyaṃ kurupāṇḍavasenayoḥ / tava rājendra putrāṇāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ tathaiva ca

vulgate_text: kṣemadhanvā ca śalyaśca tasthuḥ pramukhato rathāḥ syandanena mahārheṇa ketunā vṛṣabheṇa ca / prakarṣanneva senāgnaṃ māgadhasya kṛpo yayau
ce_text: syandanena mahārheṇa ketunā vṛṣabheṇa ca / prakarṣann iva senāgraṃ māgadhaś ca nṛpo yayau

vulgate_text: kuruyodhavarā rājanvicitrāyudhakārmukāḥ / udyatairāyuthaiścitraistalabaddhāḥ patākinaḥ
ce_text: udyatair āyudhaiś citrais talabaddhāḥ patākinaḥ / ṛṣabhākṣā maheṣvāsāś camūmukhagatā babhuḥ

vulgate_text: bhīmasenaṃ tadā rājandarśayasva mahābalam / kekayā dhṛṣṭaketuśca cekitānaśca vīryavān
ce_text: kekayā dhṛṣṭaketuś ca cekitānaś ca vīryavān / eta tiṣṭhanti sāmātyāḥ prekṣakās te nareśvara

vulgate_text: ete gacchantu sāmātyāḥ prakarṣanto janādhipa / dhṛtarāṣṭrasya dāyādāniti bībhatsurabravīt
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭrasya dāyādā iti bībhatsur abravīt / bruvāṇaṃ tu tathā pārthaṃ sarvasainyāni māriṣa / apūjayaṃs tadā vāgbhir anukūlābhir āhave

vulgate_text: pṛṣṭhato'pyarjunasyāsīdyuyudhāno mahābalaḥ / cakrarakṣau tu pāñcālyau yudhāmanyūttamojasau
ce_text: pṛṣṭhagopo 'rjunasyāpi yuyudhāno mahārathaḥ / cakrarakṣau tu pāñcālyau yudhāmanyūttamaujasau

vulgate_text: akṣauhiṇyātha pāñcālyo yajñaseno mahāmanāḥ virāṭamanvayātpaścātpāṇḍavārthaṃ parākramī - - ateṣāmādityacandrābhāḥ kanakottamabhūṣaṇāḥ nānācihnadharā rājanratheṣvāsanmahādhvajāḥ
ce_text: akṣauhiṇyā ca pāñcālyo yajñaseno mahāmanāḥ / virāṭam anvayāt paścāt pāṇḍavārthe parākramī

vulgate_text: kṣaranta iva jīmūtā mahārhāḥ padmagandhinaḥ / rājānamanvayuḥ yaścājjīmūtā iva vārṣikāḥ
ce_text: kṣaranta iva jīmūtā madārdrāḥ padmagandhinaḥ / rājānam anvayuḥ paścāc calanta iva parvatāḥ

vulgate_text: atha saṃnahyamāneṣu sainyeṣu bharatarṣabha / niṣprabho'bhyudyayau sūryaḥ saghoṣaṃ bhūścacāla ca
ce_text: atha sajjīyamāneṣu sainyeṣu bharatarṣabha / niṣprabho 'bhyudiyāt sūryaḥ saghoṣo bhūś cacāla ha / vyaśīryata sanādā ca tadā bharatasattama

vulgate_text: mahārathairvaṣṇibhojaiḥ suguptaṃ surāṣṭrakairviditairāttaśastraiḥ / bṛhadbalaṃ kṛtavarmābhiguptaṃ balaṃ tvadīyaṃ dakṣiṇenābhiyāti
ce_text: mahārathair andhakavṛṣṇibhojaiḥ; saurāṣṭrakair nairṛtair āttaśastraiḥ / bṛhadbalaḥ kṛtavarmābhigupto; balaṃ tvadīyaṃ dakṣiṇato 'bhipāti

vulgate_text: tvaktvā'dharmaṃ tathā sarve dharmaṃ cottamamāsthitāḥ / yudhyadhvamatahaṃkārā yato dharmastato jayaḥ
ce_text: tyaktvādharmaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca mohaṃ codyamam āsthitāḥ / yudhyadhvam anahaṃkārā yato dharmas tato jayaḥ

vulgate_text: vāditraśabdastumulaḥ śaṅkhabherīvimiśritaḥ / śūrāṇāṃ raṇaśūrāṇāṃ garjatāmitaretaram
ce_text: vāditraśabdas tumulaḥ śaṅkhabherīvimiśritaḥ / kuñjarāṇāṃ ca nadatāṃ sainyānāṃ ca prahṛṣyatām

vulgate_text: ubhayoḥ senayo rājanmahānvyatikaro'bhavat anyonyaṃ vīkṣamāṇānāṃ yodhānāṃ bharatarṣabha / kuñjarāṇāṃ ca nadatāṃ sainyānāṃ ca prahṛṣyatām
ce_text: vāditraśabdas tumulaḥ śaṅkhabherīvimiśritaḥ / kuñjarāṇāṃ ca nadatāṃ sainyānāṃ ca prahṛṣyatām

vulgate_text: arjuna uvāca / prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ caiva kṣetraṃ kṣetrajñameva ca / etadveditumicchāmi jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ ca keśava / śrībhagavānuvāca
ce_text: arjuna uvāca / evaṃ satatayuktā ye bhaktās tvāṃ paryupāsate / ye cāpy akṣaram avyaktaṃ teṣāṃ ke yogavittamāḥ

vulgate_text: anye tvevamajānantaḥ śrutvā'nyebhya upāsate te'pi cātitarantyeva mṛtyuṃ śrutiparāyaṇāḥ - - ayāvatsaṃjāyate kiṃcitsattvaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam kṣetrakṣetrajñasaṃyogāttadviddhi bharatarṣabha
ce_text: yāvat saṃjāyate kiṃ cit sattvaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam / kṣetrakṣetrajñasaṃyogāt tad viddhi bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / gītā sugītā kartavyā kimanyaiḥ śāstrasaṃgrahaiḥ / yā svayaṃ padmanābhasya sukhapadmādviniḥsṛtā
ce_text: yatra yogeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇo yatra pārtho dhanurdharaḥ / tatra śrīr vijayo bhūtir dhruvā nītir matir mama / arjuna uvāca / yad etan niṣkalaṃ brahma vyomātītaṃ nirañjanam | / kaivalyaṃ kevalaṃ śāntaṃ śuddham atyantanirmalam || (1) / apratarkyam avijñeyaṃ vināśotpattivarjitam | / śrībhagavān uvāca / jñānayogavinirmuktaṃ taj jñānaṃ brūhi keśava || (2) / sarvatojyotir ākāśaṃ sarvabhūtaguṇānvitam | / sarvataḥparamātmānam akṣayaṃ paramaṃ padam || (3) / anādinidhanaṃ devaṃ mahājyotir atidhruvam | / atyantaparamaṃ sthānaṃ śabdādiguṇavarjitam || (4) / yat tat parataraṃ jyotir dhruvāt parataraṃ sthitam | / ācaturyugam adyāpi kathitaṃ na hi kasya cit || (5) / ātmadehe mayā sṛṣṭā prakṛtiḥ kṣetram eva ca | / sakalaṃ tu bhavet kṣetraṃ niṣkalaṃ paramaṃ padam || (6) / arjuna tvatprasādena śṛṇvantu munisattamāḥ | / adya muktā mahābāho tvatprasādād dhanaṃjaya || (7) / pramāṇaṃ vedatattvānāṃ sāṃkhyādīny abhiyoginām | / teṣāṃ na vidyate niṣṭhā sarvaiḥ pāṣaṇḍibhiḥ saha || (8) / kathitaṃ ca mayā jñānaṃ devānām api durlabham | / viśvarūpamayaṃ divyaṃ bhairavagranthibindunā || (9) / suṣumṇā dakṣiṇe mārge darśitā viśvarūpiṇā | / aprakāśam idaṃ praśnaṃ yan mayā kathitaṃ tava || (10) / nāgnir vāyur na cākāśaṃ na kṣitir nāpi vā jalam | / na manobuddhyahaṃkāraṃ gūḍhārthaṃ kathitaṃ tava || (11) / anityo nityatāṃ yāti yadā bhāvaṃ na paśyati | / śūnyaṃ nirañjanākāraṃ nirvāṇaṃ dhruvam avyayam || (12) / puruṣaṃ nirguṇaṃ sākṣāt sarvataś caiva tiṣṭhati | / sarvaṃ tat syāt paraṃ brahma buddhiś cāsya na budhyati || (13) / pratibhāvaprayatnena hariṃ trailokyabāndhavam | / daśamaṃ cāṅgulaṃ vyāpya cāśābāhyaṃ vyavasthitam || (14) / jīvo yatra pralīyeta sā kalā ṣoḍaśī smṛtā | / tayā sarvam idaṃ vyāptaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || (15) / tac cintyaṃ tena vai jñānaṃ tad atrādyā upāsate | / brahmaṇaiva hi vikhyātaṃ vedānteṣu prakāśitam || (16) / vedeṣu vedam ity āhur vedadhāma paraṃ matam | / tat paraṃ viditaṃ yasya sa vipro vedapāragaḥ || (17) / āhutiḥ sā parā jñeyā sā ca saṃdhyā pratiṣṭhitā | / gāyatrī sā parā jñeyā ajapā nāma viśrutā || (18) / tapasy atha tathā vede munibhiḥ samupāsyate | / tāṃ kalāṃ yo 'bhijānāti sa kalājño 'bhidhīyate || (19) / yāṃ jñātvā mucyate jantur garbhajanmajarādibhiḥ | / parijñānena mucyante narāḥ pātakakilbiṣaiḥ || (20) / iḍā bhagavatī gaṅgā piṅgalā yamunā nadī | / tayor madhye tṛtīyā tu tat prayāgam anusmaret || (21) / iḍā vai vaiṣṇavī nāḍī brahmanāḍī tu piṅgalā | / suṣumṇā caiśvarī nāḍī tridhā prāṇavahā smṛtā | / brahmā viṣṇur mahādevo recakaḥ pūrakumbhakaḥ || (22) / sakrāntiviṣuvac caiva yo 'bhijānāti vigraham | / nityayuktaḥ sa yogīśo brahmavidyāṃ prapadyate || (23) / iḍā vai gārhapatyas tu piṅgalāhavanīyakaḥ | / suṣumṇā dakṣiṇāgnis tu hy etad agnitrayaṃ smṛtam || (24) / tasya madhye sthitaṃ jyotiḥ somamaṇḍalam eva ca | / somamaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ tanmadhye sūryamaṇḍalam || (25) / sūryamaṇḍalamadhyastho jvalat tejo hutāśanaḥ | / hutāśanasya madhye tu nirdhūmāṅgāravarcasam || (26) / tatrāsthito mahātmāsau yogibhis tu pragīyate | / sugītaṃ caiva kartavyaṃ mana ekāgracetasā || (27) / śivo binduḥ śivo devo ghargharāmṛtavarcasā | / nikhilaṃ pūrayed dehaṃ viṣadāhajvarāpaham || (28) / sarpavatkuṭilākārasuṣumṇāveṣṭitāṃ tanum | / makāraveṣṭitāṃ kṛtvā mātṛvat pariyojayet || (29) / tristhānaṃ ca trimātraṃ ca tribrahma ca trirakṣaram | / ardhamātraṃ ca yo vetti sa bhaved vedapāragaḥ || (30) / sarvataḥpāṇipādaṃ tat sarvatokṣiśiromukham | / arjuna uvāca / nirmalaṃ vimalākāraṃ śuddhasphaṭikasaṃnibham || (31) / jīvo jīvati jīvena nāsti jīvam ajīvitam | / śrībhagavān uvāca / nirgataḥ saha saṅgena sa jīvaḥ kena jīvati || (32) / mukhanāsikayor madhye prāṇaḥ saṃcarate sadā | / ākāśaṃ pibate nityaṃ sa jīvas tena jīvati || (33) / kākīmukhaṃ kakārāntaṃ makāraṃ cetanānugam | / akārasya tu luptasya ko 'rthaḥ saṃpratipadyate || (34) / tāvat paśyet khagākāraṃ khakāraṃ tu vicintayet | / khamadhye kuru cātmānam ātmamadhyaṃ ca khaṃ kuru || (35) / khamadhye ca praveṣṭavyaṃ khaṃ ca brahma sanātanam | / ātmānaṃ khamayaṃ kṛtvā na kiṃ cid api cintayet || (36) / ūrdhvaśūnyam adhaḥśūnyaṃ madhyeśūnyaṃ nirāmayam | / triśūnyaṃ yo 'bhijānāti sa bhavet kulanandanaḥ || (37) / tasya bhāvasya bhāvātmā bhāvanā naiva yujyate | / anāvṛttasya śabdasya tasya śabdasya yo gatiḥ || (38) / tat padaṃ viditaṃ yena sa yogī chinnasaṃśayaḥ | / puṇyapāpaharāś caiva ye cānye pañcadaivatāḥ || (39) / jīvinaḥ saha gacchanti yāvat tattvaṃ na vindati | / pāpaṃ dahati jñānāgniḥ puṇyena somasūryayoḥ || (40) / puṇyapāpavinirmuktir eṣa yogo 'bhidhīyate | / dhṛtirodhi manodhīti saṃtoṣaṃ samidhāmṛtam || (41) / indriyāṇi paśuṃ kṛtvā yo yajeta sa dīkṣitaḥ | / paraṃ brahmādhigacchanti śabdabrahmavicintanāt || (42) / sakale dṛṣṭapāro 'pi bhāvaṃ yuñjati yuñjati | / niṣkale darśanaṃ nāsti svabhāvo bhāvaṃ yuñjati || (43) / tālumūle ca lampāyāṃ trikūṭaṃ tripathāntaram | / ekaṃ tattvaṃ vijānīyād vighnasyāyatanaṃ mahat || (44) / .... / .... / .... / .... / .... / .... / .... / .... / .... / .... / .... / .... / chinnamūlasya vṛkṣasya yathā janma na vidyate | / jñānadagdhaśarīrasya punar deho na vidyate || (45) / gītāḥ sugītāḥ kartavyāḥ kim anyaiḥ śāstrasaṃgrahaiḥ | / yāḥ purā padmanābhasya mukhapadmād viniḥsṛtāḥ || (46) / gītāgāṅgodakaṃ pītvā punarjanma na vidyate | / sarvaśāstramayī gītā sarvadharmamayo hariḥ || (47) / sarvatīrthamayī gaṅgā sarvapāpakṣayaṃkarī | / sarvabhogamayaś cāyaṃ sarvamokṣamayo hy ayam || (48) / gītā gaṅgā ca gāyatrī govindo hṛdi saṃsthitāḥ | / caturgakārasmaraṇāt punarjanma na vidyate || (49) / gītāsāraṃ paṭhed yas tu hy acyutasya ca saṃnidhau | / tasmād guṇasahasreṇa viṣṇor nirvacanaṃ yathā || (50) / .... / .... / etat puṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ dhanyaṃ duḥsvapnanāśanam | / paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva viṣṇor māhātmyam uttamam || (51) / arjuna uvāca / yad etan niṣkalaṃ brahma vyomātītaṃ nirañjanam | / kaivalyaṃ kevalaṃ śāntaṃ śuddham atyantanirmalam || (1) / apratarkyam avijñeyaṃ vināśotpattivarjitam | / śrībhagavān uvāca / jñānayogavinirmuktaṃ taj jñānaṃ brūhi keśava || (2) / sarvatojyotir ākāśaṃ sarvabhūtaguṇānvitam | / sarvataḥparamātmānam akṣayaṃ paramaṃ padam || (3) / anādinidhanaṃ devaṃ mahājyotir atidhruvam | / atyantaparamaṃ sthānaṃ śabdādiguṇavarjitam || (4) / yat tat parataraṃ jyotir dhruvāt parataraṃ sthitam | / ācaturyugam adyāpi kathitaṃ na hi kasya cit || (5) / ātmadehe mayā sṛṣṭā prakṛtiḥ kṣetram eva ca | / sakalaṃ tu bhavet kṣetraṃ niṣkalaṃ paramaṃ padam || (6) / arjuna tvatprasādena śṛṇvantu munisattamāḥ | / adya muktā mahābāho tvatprasādād dhanaṃjaya || (7) / pramāṇaṃ vedatattvānāṃ sāṃkhyādīny abhiyoginām | / teṣāṃ na vidyate niṣṭhā sarvaiḥ pāṣaṇḍibhiḥ saha || (8) / kathitaṃ ca mayā jñānaṃ devānām api durlabham | / viśvarūpamayaṃ divyaṃ bhairavagranthibindunā || (9) / aprakāśam idaṃ praśnaṃ yan mayā kathitaṃ tava | / vāṅmayaṃ sarvaśāstrāṇām atisūkṣmaṃ carācaram || (10) / nāgnir vāyur na cākāśaṃ na kṣitir nāpi vā jalam | / na manobuddhyahaṃkāraṃ gūḍhārthaṃ kathitaṃ tava || (11) / anityo nityatāṃ yāti yadā bhāvaṃ na paśyati | / śūnyaṃ nirañjanākāraṃ nirvāṇaṃ dhruvam avyayam || (12) / puruṣaṃ nirguṇaṃ sākṣāt sarvataś caiva tiṣṭhati | / sarvaṃ tat syāt paraṃ brahma buddhiś cāsya na budhyati || (13) / pratibhāvaprayatnena hariṃ trailokyabāndhavam | / daśamaṃ cāṅgulaṃ vyāpya cāśābāhyaṃ vyavasthitam || (14) / jīvo yatra pralīyeta sā kalā ṣoḍaśī smṛtā | / tayā sarvam idaṃ vyāptaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || (15) / tac cintyaṃ tena vai jñānaṃ tad atrādyā upāsate | / brahmaṇaiva hi vikhyātaṃ vedānteṣu prakāśitam || (16) / vedeṣu vedam ity āhur vedadhāma paraṃ matam | / tat paraṃ viditaṃ yasya sa vipro vedapāragaḥ || (17) / āhutiḥ sā parā jñeyā sā ca saṃdhyā pratiṣṭhitā | / gāyatrī sā parā jñeyā ajapā nāma viśrutā || (18) / tapasy atha tathā vede munibhiḥ samupāsyate | / tāṃ kalāṃ yo 'bhijānāti sa kalājño 'bhidhīyate || (19) / yāṃ jñātvā mucyate jantur garbhajanmajarādibhiḥ | / parijñānena mucyante narāḥ pātakakilbiṣaiḥ || (20) / iḍā bhagavatī gaṅgā piṅgalā yamunā nadī | / tayor madhye tṛtīyā tu tat prayāgam anusmaret || (21) / iḍā vai vaiṣṇavī nāḍī brahmanāḍī tu piṅgalā | / suṣumṇā caiśvarī nāḍī tridhā prāṇavahā smṛtā | / brahmā viṣṇur mahādevo recakaḥ pūrakumbhakaḥ || (22) / sakrāntiviṣuvac caiva yo 'bhijānāti vigraham | / nityayuktaḥ sa yogīśo brahmavidyāṃ prapadyate || (23) / iḍā vai gārhapatyas tu piṅgalāhavanīyakaḥ | / suṣumṇā dakṣiṇāgnis tu hy etad agnitrayaṃ smṛtam || (24) / tasya madhye sthitaṃ jyotiḥ somamaṇḍalam eva ca | / somamaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ tanmadhye sūryamaṇḍalam || (25) / sūryamaṇḍalamadhyastho jvalat tejo hutāśanaḥ | / hutāśanasya madhye tu nirdhūmāṅgāravarcasam || (26) / tatrāsthito mahātmāsau yogibhis tu pragīyate | / sugītaṃ caiva kartavyaṃ mana ekāgracetasā || (27) / śivo binduḥ śivo devo ghargharāmṛtavarcasā | / nikhilaṃ pūrayed dehaṃ viṣadāhajvarāpaham || (28) / sarpavatkuṭilākārasuṣumṇāveṣṭitāṃ tanum | / makāraveṣṭitāṃ kṛtvā mātṛvat pariyojayet || (29) / tristhānaṃ ca trimātraṃ ca tribrahma ca trirakṣaram | / ardhamātraṃ ca yo vetti sa bhaved vedapāragaḥ || (30) / sarvataḥpāṇipādaṃ tat sarvatokṣiśiromukham | / arjuna uvāca / nirmalaṃ vimalākāraṃ śuddhasphaṭikasaṃnibham || (31) / sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ caiva yat kiṃ cit sacarācaram | / śrībhagavān uvāca / jīvo jīvati jīvena sa jīvaḥ kena jīvati || (32) / mukhanāsikayor madhye prāṇaḥ saṃcarate sadā | / ākāśaṃ pibate nityaṃ sa jīvas tena jīvati || (33) / kākīmukhaṃ kakārāntaṃ makāraṃ cetanānugam | / akārasya tu luptasya ko 'rthaḥ saṃpratipadyate || (34) / tāvat paśyet khagākāraṃ khakāraṃ tu vicintayet | / khamadhye kuru cātmānam ātmamadhyaṃ ca khaṃ kuru || (35) / khamadhye ca praveṣṭavyaṃ khaṃ ca brahma sanātanam | / ātmānaṃ khamayaṃ kṛtvā na kiṃ cid api cintayet || (36) / ūrdhvaśūnyam adhaḥśūnyaṃ madhyeśūnyaṃ nirāmayam | / triśūnyaṃ yo 'bhijānāti sa bhavet kulanandanaḥ || (37) / amātraśabdarahitaṃ svaravyañjanavarjitam | / bindunādakalātītaṃ yas taṃ veda sa vedavit || (38) / saṃprāpte jñānavijñāne jñeye ca hṛdi saṃsthite | / labdhaśāntapade bhāve na yogo na ca dhāraṇā || (39) / vedādau yaḥ suraḥ prokto vedānte ca pratiṣṭhitaḥ | / tasya prakṛtilīnasya yaḥ paraḥ sa maheśvaraḥ || (40) / nā nāvārthī bhavet tāvad yāvat pāraṃ na gacchati | / uttīrṇe tu pare pāre kiṃ nāvā vai prayojanam || (41) / dūrastho nāpi dūrasthaḥ piṇḍasthaḥ piṇḍavarjitaḥ | / arjuna uvāca / amalo nirmalaḥ sūkṣmaḥ sarvavyāpī nirañjanaḥ || (42) / akṣarāṇi samātrāṇi sarve bindusamāśritāḥ | / śrībhagavān uvāca / bindur bhidyati nādena sa nādaḥ kena bhidyate || (43) / oṃkāradhvaninādena vāyuḥ saṃharaṇāntikam | / nirālambhas tu nirdeho yatra nādo layaṃ gataḥ || (44) / arjuna uvāca / bāhyena vyāpitaṃ vyoma vyoma cānanunāsikam | / śrībhagavān uvāca / adhaś cordhvaṃ kathaṃ caiva kaṇṭhe caiva nirañjanaḥ || (45) / anūṣmam avyañjakam asvaraṃ yat / tat tālukaṇṭheṣv anunāsikaṃ ca | / arephajātaṃ śubham ūṣmavarjitaṃ / na duṣkarāṇāṃ kurute kadā cit || (46) / ākāśam apy anākāśaṃ puruṣatve pratiṣṭhitam | / śabdaṃ guṇam ivākāśaṃ niḥśabdaṃ brahma cocyate || (47) / sarvagaṃ sarvabodhādi vāsanājālavarjitam | / indriyāṇāṃ nirodhena dehe paśyanti mānavāḥ || (48) / dehe naṣṭe kuto buddhir jñānaṃ vijñānam eva ca | / jñānaṃ vijñānayuktaṃ ca rakṣaṇīyaṃ prayatnataḥ | (49) / chinnamūlasya vṛkṣasya yathā janma na vidyate | / jñānadagdhaśarīrasya punar deho na vidyate || (50) / gītāḥ sugītāḥ kartavyāḥ kim anyaiḥ śāstrasaṃgrahaiḥ | / yāḥ purā padmanābhasya mukhapadmaviniḥsṛtāḥ || (51) / gītāgaṅgodakaṃ pītvā punarjanma na vidyate | / sarvaśāstramayī gītā sarvadharmamayo hariḥ || (52) / sarvatīrthamayī gaṅgā sarvapāpakṣayaṃkarī | / sarvabhogamayaś cāyaṃ sarvamokṣamayo hy ayam || (53) / gakārapūrvāś catvāro rakṣanti mahato bhayāt | / gītā gaṅgā ca gāyatrī govindo hṛdi saṃsthitāḥ || (54) / snāto vā yadi vāsnātaḥ śucir vā yadi vāśuciḥ | / yaḥ smaret puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ sa bāhyābhyantare śuciḥ || (55) / sa gacchet tatkṣaṇāt prāyo brahmamūrte namo 'stu te | / gītāsāraṃ paṭhed yas tu viṣṇuloke mahīyate || (56) / etat puṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ dhanyaṃ duḥsvapnanāśanam | / paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva viṣṇor māhātmyam uttamam || (57)

vulgate_text: dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ ślokamekaṃ gītāyā mānamucyate bhāratāmṛtasarvasvagītāyā mathitasya ca / sāramuddhṛtya kṛṣṇena arjunasya mukhe hutam / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / ity ahaṃ vāsudevasya pārthasya ca mahātmanaḥ / saṃvādam imam aśrauṣam adbhutaṃ romaharṣaṇam

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvā yudhiṣṭhiraṃ dūrāddhārtarāṣṭrasya sainikāḥ mithaḥ saṃkathayāṃcakrureṣo hi kulapāṃsanaḥ - - avyaktaṃ bhīta ivābhyeti rājāsau bhīṣmamantikam yudhiṣṭhiraḥ sasodaryaḥ śaraṇārthaṃ prayācakaḥ
ce_text: vyaktaṃ bhīta ivābhyeti rājāsau bhīṣmam antikāt / yudhiṣṭhiraḥ sasodaryaḥ śaraṇārthaṃ prayācakaḥ

vulgate_text: anumānaye tvāṃ durdharṣa yotsye vigatakalmaṣaḥ / jayeyaṃ nu parānrājannanujñātastvayā ripūn / śalya uvāca
ce_text: anumānaye tvāṃ yotsyāmi guro vigatakalmaṣaḥ / jayeyaṃ ca mahārāja anujñātas tvayā ripūn

vulgate_text: kurūṇāṃ sṛñjayānāṃ ca jigīṣūṇāṃ parasparam / siṃhānāmiva saṃhrādo divamurvī ca nādayan
ce_text: kurūṇāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ ca saṃgrāme vijigīṣatām / siṃhānām iva saṃhrādo divam urvīṃ ca nādayan

vulgate_text: sahadevastato vīro durmukhasya mahāraṇe śareṇa bhṛtaśīkṣṇena pātayāmāsa sārathim - - atāvanyonyaṃ samāsādya samare yuddhadurmadau - - btrāsayetāṃ śarairghoraiḥ kṛtapratikṛtaiṣiṇau
ce_text: tāv anyonyaṃ samāsādya samare yuddhadurmadau / trāsayetāṃ śarair ghoraiḥ kṛtapratikṛtaiṣiṇau

vulgate_text: tridhā ciccheda samare pāñcālyasya tu kārmukam / śaraṃ caiva mahāghoraṃ kāladaṇḍamivāparam
ce_text: śaraṃ caiva mahāghoraṃ kāladaṇḍam ivāparam / preṣayām āsa samare so 'sya kāye nyamajjata

vulgate_text: tathaiva śaravarṣeṇa ulūkaṃ samaviddhyata / ulūkaścāpi taṃ bāṇairniśitairlomavāhibhiḥ
ce_text: cedirāṭ samare rājann ulūkaṃ samabhidravat / ulūkaś cāpi taṃ bāṇair niśitair lomavāhibhiḥ

vulgate_text: prabhinnairapi saṃsaktāḥ kecittatra mahāgajāḥ / krauñcavanninadaṃ kṛtvā dudruvuḥ sarvato diśam
ce_text: prabhinnair api saṃsaktāḥ ke cit tatra mahāgajāḥ / krauñcavan ninadaṃ muktvā prādravanta tatas tataḥ

vulgate_text: aśvārohaiśca samare hastisādibhireva ca pratimāneṣu gātreṣu pārśvaṣvabhi ca vāraṇān / āśugā vimalāstīkṣṇāḥ saṃpeturbhujagopamāḥ
ce_text: tair vimuktā mahāprāsā jāmbūnadavibhūṣaṇāḥ / āśugā vimalās tīkṣṇāḥ saṃpetur bhujagopamāḥ

vulgate_text: sa śirāṃsi raṇe'rīṇāṃ rathāṃśca sayugadhvajān / nicakarta mahāvegairbhallaiḥ sannataparvabhiḥ
ce_text: śirāṃsi ca tadā bhīṣmo bāhūṃś cāpi sahāyudhān / nicakarta mahāvegair bhallaiḥ saṃnataparvabhiḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ śarasahasreṇa saubhadraṃ pratitāmahaḥ / avākiradameyātmā tadadbhutamivābhavat
ce_text: tataḥ śatasahasreṇa saubhadraṃ prapitāmahaḥ / avākirad ameyātmā śarāṇāṃ nataparvaṇām

vulgate_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / evaṃ śvete maheṣvāse prāpte śalyarathaṃ prati / kuravaḥ pāṇḍaveyāśca kimakurvata sañjaya
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / kathaṃ droṇo maheṣvāsaḥ pāñcālyaś cāpi pārṣataḥ / raṇe samīyatur yattau tan mamācakṣva saṃjaya

vulgate_text: bhīṣmaḥ śāntanavaḥ kiṃ vā tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ / sañjaya uvāca / rājañśatasahasrāṇi tataḥ kṣatriyapuṅgavāḥ
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / śṛṇu rājan sthiro bhūtvā yuddham etat sudāruṇam / na śakyaḥ pāṇḍavo jetuṃ devair api savāsavaiḥ

vulgate_text: śikhaṇḍinaṃ puraskṛtya trātumaicchanmahārathāḥ / abhyavartanta bhīṣmasya rathaṃ hemapariṣkṛtam
ce_text: taṃ sātyakir bhīmaseno dhṛṣṭadyumnaś ca pārṣataḥ / abhyadravanta bhīṣmasya rathaṃ hemapariṣkṛtam

vulgate_text: tena tena sma dṛśyante dhāvamānāḥ samaṃtataḥ / gajo hataḥ śiraśchinnaṃ marma bhinnaṃ hayo hataḥ
ce_text: virathā rathinaś cānye dhāvamānāḥ samantataḥ / tatra tatraiva dṛśyante sāyudhāḥ sāṅgadair bhujaiḥ

vulgate_text: vyāghrāviva susaṃrabdhāvanyonyamabhijaghnatuḥ / astrairastrāṇi saṃvārya tatastau puruṣarṣabhau
ce_text: tau tatra samare hṛṣṭau kṛtapratikṛtaiṣiṇau / anyonyaṃ viśikhais tīkṣṇair jaghnatuḥ puruṣarṣabhau

vulgate_text: nigṛhya kārmukaṃ śveto bhīṣmaṃ vivyādha saptabhiḥ / parākramaṃ tatastasya parākramya parākramī
ce_text: amarṣitas tato rājan parākramya camūmukhe / droṇo drupadaputrasya punaś ciccheda kārmukam

vulgate_text: sahitāstvabhyavartanta parīpsanto mahārathāḥ / sātyakirbhīmasenaśca dhṛṣṭadyumnaśca pārṣataḥ
ce_text: taṃ sātyakir bhīmaseno dhṛṣṭadyumnaś ca pārṣataḥ / abhyadravanta bhīṣmasya rathaṃ hemapariṣkṛtam

vulgate_text: avahāraṃ śanaiścakrurnihate vāhinīpatau / tato'vahāraḥ sainyānāṃ tava teṣāṃ ca bhārata
ce_text: tato 'vahāraḥ sainyānāṃ tava teṣāṃ ca bhārata / astaṃ gacchati sūrye 'bhūt saṃdhyākāle ca vartati

vulgate_text: teṣāṃ krodhaṃ cintayaṃstu ahaḥsu ca niśāsu ca na śāntimadhigacchāmi duryodanakṛtena hi / kathaṃ cābhūnmahāyuddhaṃ sarvamācakṣva sañjaya / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / rājañ śatasahasrāṇi tatra tatra tadā tadā / nirmaryādaṃ prayuddhāni tat te vakṣyāmi bhārata

vulgate_text: abhyadhāvajjighāṃsanvai śalyaṃ madrādhipaṃ yudhi / mahatā rathasaṅghena samantātparirakṣitaḥ
ce_text: uttaraṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā vairāṭir bhrātaraṃ śubham / kṛtavarmaṇā ca sahitaṃ dṛṣṭvā śalyam avasthitam / śvetaḥ krodhāt prajajvāla haviṣā havyavāḍ iva / sa visphārya mahac cāpaṃ śakracāpopamaṃ balī / abhyadhāvaj jighāṃsan vai śalyaṃ madrādhipaṃ balī / mahatā rathavaṃśena samantāt parivāritaḥ / muñcan bāṇamayaṃ varṣaṃ prāyāc chalyarathaṃ prati / tam āpatantaṃ saṃprekṣya mattavāraṇavikramam / tāvakānāṃ rathāḥ sapta samantāt paryavārayan / madrarājam abhīpsanto mṛtyor daṃṣṭrāntaraṃ gatam / bṛhadbalaś ca kausalyo jayatsenaś ca māgadhaḥ / tathā rukmaratho rājañ śalyaputraḥ pratāpavān / vindānuvindāv āvantyau kāmbojaś ca sudakṣiṇaḥ / bṛhatkṣatrasya dāyādaḥ saindhavaś ca jayadrathaḥ / nānāvarṇavicitrāṇi dhanūṃṣi ca mahātmanām / visphāritāni dṛśyante toyadeṣv iva vidyutaḥ / te tu bāṇamayaṃ varṣaṃ śvetamūrdhany apātayan / nidāghānte 'niloddhūtā meghā iva nage jalam / tataḥ kruddho maheṣvāsaḥ saptabhallaiḥ sutejanaiḥ / dhanūṃṣi teṣām ācchidya mamarda pṛtanāpatiḥ / nikṛttāny eva tāni sma samadṛśyanta bhārata / tatas te tu nimeṣārdhāt pratyapadyan dhanūṃṣi ca / sapta caiva pṛṣatkāṃś ca śvetasyoparyapātayan / tataḥ punar ameyātmā bhallaiḥ saptabhir āśugaiḥ / nicakarta mahābāhus teṣāṃ cāpāni dhanvinām / te nikṛttamahācāpās tvaramāṇā mahārathāḥ / rathaśaktīḥ parāmṛśya vinedur bhairavān ravān / anvayur bharataśreṣṭha sapta śvetarathaṃ prati / tatas tā jvalitāḥ sapta mahendrāśaninisvanāḥ / aprāptāḥ saptabhir bhallaiś ciccheda paramāstravit / tataḥ samādāya śaraṃ sarvakāyavidāraṇam / prāhiṇod bharataśreṣṭha śveto rukmarathaṃ prati / tasya dehe nipatito bāṇo vajrātigo mahān / tato rukmaratho rājan sāyakena dṛḍhāhataḥ / niṣasāda rathopasthe kaśmalaṃ cāviśan mahat / taṃ visaṃjñaṃ vimanasaṃ tvaramāṇas tu sārathiḥ / apovāha susaṃbhrāntaḥ sarvalokasya paśyataḥ / tato 'nyān ṣaṭ samādāya śveto hemavibhūṣitān / teṣāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ mahābāhur dhvajaśīrṣāṇy apātayat / hayāṃś ca teṣāṃ nirbhidya sārathīṃś ca paraṃtapa / śaraiś caitān samākīrya prāyāc chalyarathaṃ prati / tato halahalāśabdas tava sainyeṣu bhārata / dṛṣṭvā senāpatiṃ tūrṇaṃ yāntaṃ śalyarathaṃ prati / tato bhīṣmaṃ puraskṛtya tava putro mahābalaḥ / vṛtas tu sarvasainyena prāyāc chvetarathaṃ prati / mṛtyor āsyam anuprāptaṃ madrarājam amocayat / tato yuddhaṃ samabhavat tumulaṃ lomaharṣaṇam / tāvakānāṃ pareṣāṃ ca vyatiṣiktarathadvipam / saubhadre bhīmasene ca sātyakau ca mahārathe / kaikeye ca virāṭe ca balī / abhyadhāvaj jighāṃsan vai śalyaṃ madrādhipaṃ balī / mahatā rathavaṃśena samantāt parivāritaḥ / muñcan bāṇamayaṃ varṣaṃ prāyāc chalyarathaṃ prati / tam āpatantaṃ saṃprekṣya mattavāraṇavikramam / tāvakānāṃ rathāḥ sapta samantāt paryavārayan / madrarājam abhīpsanto mṛtyor daṃṣṭrāntaraṃ gatam / bṛhadbalaś ca kausalyo jayatsenaś ca māgadhaḥ / tathā rukmaratho rājañ śalyaputraḥ pratāpavān / vindānuvindāv āvantyau kāmbojaś ca sudakṣiṇaḥ / bṛhatkṣatrasya dāyādaḥ saindhavaś ca jayadrathaḥ / nānāvarṇavicitrāṇi dhanūṃṣi ca mahātmanām / visphāritāni dṛśyante toyadeṣv iva vidyutaḥ / te tu bāṇamayaṃ varṣaṃ śvetamūrdhany apātayan / nidāghānte 'niloddhūtā meghā iva nage jalam / tataḥ kruddho maheṣvāsaḥ saptabhallaiḥ sutejanaiḥ / dhanūṃṣi teṣām ācchidya mamarda pṛtanāpatiḥ / nikṛttāny eva tāni sma samadṛśyanta bhārata / tatas te tu nimeṣārdhāt pratyapadyan dhanūṃṣi ca / sapta caiva pṛṣatkāṃś ca śvetasyoparyapātayan / tataḥ punar ameyātmā bhallaiḥ saptabhir āśugaiḥ / nicakarta mahābāhus teṣāṃ cāpāni dhanvinām / te nikṛttamahācāpās tvaramāṇā mahārathāḥ / rathaśaktīḥ parāmṛśya vinedur bhairavān ravān / anvayur bharataśreṣṭha sapta śvetarathaṃ prati / tatas tā jvalitāḥ sapta mahendrāśaninisvanāḥ / aprāptāḥ saptabhir bhallaiś ciccheda paramāstravit / tataḥ samādāya śaraṃ sarvakāyavidāraṇam / prāhiṇod bharataśreṣṭha śveto rukmarathaṃ prati / tasya dehe nipatito bāṇo vajrātigo mahān / tato rukmaratho rājan sāyakena dṛḍhāhataḥ / niṣasāda rathopasthe kaśmalaṃ cāviśan mahat / taṃ visaṃjñaṃ vimanasaṃ tvaramāṇas tu sārathiḥ / apovāha susaṃbhrāntaḥ sarvalokasya paśyataḥ / tato 'nyān ṣaṭ samādāya śveto hemavibhūṣitān / teṣāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ mahābāhur dhvajaśīrṣāṇy apātayat / hayāṃś ca teṣāṃ nirbhidya sārathīṃś ca paraṃtapa / śaraiś caitān samākīrya prāyāc chalyarathaṃ prati / tato halahalāśabdas tava sainyeṣu bhārata / dṛṣṭvā senāpatiṃ tūrṇaṃ yāntaṃ śalyarathaṃ prati / tato bhīṣmaṃ puraskṛtya tava putro mahābalaḥ / vṛtas tu sarvasainyena prāyāc chvetarathaṃ prati / mṛtyor vimanābhavat / tato duryodhanaḥ kruddhaḥ pārthivaiḥ parivāritaḥ / sasainyaḥ pāṇḍavānīkam abhyadravata saṃyuge / durmukhaḥ kṛtavarmā ca kṛpaḥ śalyo viśāṃ pate / bhīṣmaṃ jugupur āsādya tava putreṇa coditāḥ / dṛṣṭvā tu pārthivaiḥ sarvair duryodhanapurogamaiḥ / pāṇḍavānām anīkāni vadhyamānāni saṃyuge / śveto gāṅgeyam utsṛjya tava putrasya vāhinīm / nāśayām āsa vegena vāyur vṛkṣān ivaujasā / drāvayitvā camūṃ rājan vairāṭiḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ / āpatat sahasā bhūyo yatra bhīṣmo vyavasthitaḥ / tau tatropagatau rājañ śaradīptau mahābalau / ayudhyetāṃ mahātmānau yathobhau vṛtravāsavau / anyonyaṃ bhūyaḥ śaraiḥ saṃnataparvabhiḥ / vivyādha pañcaviṃśatyā tad adbhutam ivābhavat / taṃ pratyavidhyad daśabhir bhīṣmaḥ śāṃtanavas tadā / sa viddhas tena balavān nākampata yathācalaḥ / vairāṭiḥ samare kruddho bhṛśam āyamya kārmukam / ājaghāna tato bhīṣmaṃ śvetaḥ kṣatriyanandanaḥ / saṃprahasya tataḥ śvetaḥ sṛkkiṇī parisaṃlihan / dhanuś ciccheda bhīṣmasya navabhir daśadhā śaraiḥ / saṃdhāya viśikhaṃ caiva śaraṃ lomapravāhinam / unmamātha tatas tālaṃ dhvajaśīrṣaṃ mahātmanaḥ / ketuṃ nipatitaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhīṣmasya tanayās tava / hataṃ bhīṣmam amanyanta śvetasya vaśam āgatam / pāṇḍavāś cāpi saṃhṛṣṭā dadhmuḥ śaṅkhān mudā yutāḥ / bhīṣmasya patitaṃ ketuṃ dṛṣṭvā tālaṃ mahātmanaḥ / tato duryodhanaḥ krodhāt svam anīkam acodayat / yatnād bhīṣmaṃ parīpsadhvaṃ rakṣamāṇāḥ samantataḥ / mā naḥ bāṇais tvaramāṇo mahārathaḥ / avārayad ameyātmā darśayan pāṇilāghavam / sa nivārya tu tān sarvān kesarī kuñjarān iva / mahatā śaravarṣeṇa bhīṣmasya dhanur ācchinat / tato 'nyad dhanur ādāya bhīṣmaḥ śāṃtanavo yudhi / śvetaṃ vivyādha rājendra kaṅkapatraiḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ / tataḥ senāpatiḥ kruddho bhīṣmaṃ bahubhir āyasaiḥ / vivyādha samare rājan sarvalokasya paśyataḥ / tataḥ pravyathito rājā bhīṣmaṃ dṛṣṭvā nivāritam / pravīraṃ sarvalokasya śvetena yudhi vai tadā / niṣṭhānakaś ca sumahāṃs tava sainyasya cābhavat / taṃ vīraṃ vāritaṃ dṛṣṭvā śvetena śaravikṣatam / hataṃ śvetena manyante śvetasya vaśam āgatam / tataḥ krodhavaśaṃ prāptaḥ pitā devavratas tava / dhvajam unmathitaṃ dṛṣṭvā tāṃ ca senāṃ nivāritām / śvetaṃ prati mahārāja vyasṛjat sāyakān bahūn / tān āvārya raṇe śveto bhīṣmasya rathināṃ varaḥ / dhanuś ciccheda bhallena punar eva pitus tava / utsṛjya kārmukaṃ rājan gāṅgeyaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ / anyat kārmukam ādāya vipulaṃ balavattaram / tatra saṃdhāya vipulān bhallān sapta śilāśitān / caturbhiś ca jaghānāśvāñ śvetasya pṛtanāpateḥ / dhvajaṃ dvābhyāṃ tu ciccheda saptamena ca sāratheḥ / śiraś ciccheda bhallena saṃkruddho laghuvikramaḥ / hatāśvasūtāt sa rathād avaplutya mahābalaḥ / amarṣavaśam āpanno vyākulaḥ samapadyata / virathaṃ rathināṃ śreṣṭhaṃ śvetaṃ dṛṣṭvā pitāmahaḥ / tāḍayām āsa niśitaiḥ śarasaṃghaiḥ samantataḥ / sa tāḍyamānaḥ samare bhīṣmacāpacyutaiḥ śaraiḥ / svarathe dhanur utsṛjya śaktiṃ jagrāha kāñcanīm / tataḥ śaktiṃ raṇe śveto jagrāhogrāṃ mahābhayām / kāladaṇḍopamāṃ ghorāṃ mṛtyor iva svasāṃ śvasan / abravīc ca tadā śveto bhīṣmaṃ śāṃtanavaṃ raṇe / tiṣṭhedānīṃ susaṃrabdhaḥ paśya māṃ puruṣo bhava / evam uktvā maheṣvāso bhīṣmaṃ yudhi parākramī / tataḥ śaktim ameyātmā cikṣepa bhujagopamām / pāṇḍavārthe parākrāntas tavānarthaṃ cikīrṣati / hāhākāro mahān āsīt putrāṇāṃ te viśāṃ pate / dṛṣṭvā śaktiṃ mahāghorāṃ mṛtyor daṇḍasamaprabhām / śvetasya karanirmuktāṃ nirmuktoragasaṃnibhām / apatat sahasā rājan maholkeva nabhastalāt / jvalantīm antarikṣe tāṃ jvālābhir iva saṃvṛtām / asaṃbhrāntas tadā rājan pitā devavratas tava / aṣṭabhir navabhir bhīṣmaḥ śaktiṃ ciccheda patribhiḥ / utkṛṣṭahemavikṛtāṃ nikṛttāṃ niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ / uccukruśus tataḥ sarve tāvakā bharatarṣabha / śaktiṃ vinihatāṃ dṛṣṭvā vairāṭiḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ / kālopahatacetās tu kartavyaṃ nābhyajānata / krodhasaṃmūrchito rājan vairāṭiḥ prahasann iva / gadāṃ jagrāha saṃhṛṣṭo bhīṣmasya nidhanaṃ prati / krodhena raktanayano daṇḍapāṇir ivāntakaḥ / bhīṣmaṃ samabhidudrāva jalaugha iva parvatam / tasya vegam asaṃvārya matvā bhīṣmaḥ pratāpavān / prahāravipramokṣārthaṃ sahasā dharaṇīṃ gataḥ / śvetaḥ krodhasamāviṣṭo bhrāmayitvā tu tāṃ gadām / rathe bhīṣmasya cikṣepa yathā devo dhaneśvaraḥ / tayā bhīṣmanipātinyā sa ratho bhasmasāt kṛtaḥ / sadhvajaḥ saha sūtena sāśvaḥ sayugabandhuraḥ / virathaṃ rathināṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhīṣmaṃ dṛṣṭvā rathottamāḥ / abhyadhāvanta sahitāḥ śalyaprabhṛtayo rathāḥ / tato 'nyaṃ ratham āsthāya dhanur visphārya durmanāḥ / śanakair abhyayāc chvetaṃ gāṅgeyaḥ prahasann iva / etasminn antare bhīṣmaḥ śuśrāva vipulāṃ giram / ākāśād īritāṃ divyām ātmano hitasaṃbhavām / bhīṣma bhīṣma mahābāho śīghraṃ yatnaṃ kuruṣva vai / eṣa hy asya jaye kālo nirdiṣṭo viśvayoninā / etac chrutvā tu vacanaṃ devadūtena bhāṣitam / saṃprahṛṣṭamanā bhūtvā vadhe tasya mano dadhe / virathaṃ rathināṃ śreṣṭhaṃ śvetaṃ dṛṣṭvā padātinam / sahitās tv abhyavartanta parīpsanto mahārathāḥ / sātyakir bhīmasenaś ca dhṛṣṭadyumnaś ca pārṣataḥ / kaikeyo dhṛṣṭaketuś ca abhimanyuś ca vīryavān / etān āpatataḥ sarvān droṇaśalyakṛpaiḥ saha / avārayad ameyātmā vārivegān ivācalaḥ / sa niruddheṣu sarveṣu pāṇḍaveṣu mahātmasu / śvetaḥ khaḍgam athākṛṣya bhīṣmasya dhanur ācchinat / tad apāsya dhanuś chinnaṃ tvaramāṇaḥ pitāmahaḥ / devadūtavacaḥ śrutvā vadhe tasya mano dadhe / tataḥ pracāramāṇas tu pitā devavratas tava / anyat kārmukam ādāya tvaramāṇo mahārathaḥ / kṣaṇena sajyam akaroc chakracāpasamaprabham / pitā te bharataśreṣṭha śvetaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahārathaiḥ / vṛtaṃ taṃ manujavyāghrair bhīmasenapurogamaiḥ / abhyavartata gāṅgeyaḥ śvetaṃ senāpatiṃ drutam / āpatantaṃ tato bhīṣmo bhīmasenaṃ pratāpavān / ājaghne viśikhaiḥ ṣaṣṭyā senānyaṃ sa mahārathaḥ / abhimanyuṃ ca samare pitā devavratas tava / ājaghne bharataśreṣṭhas tribhiḥ saṃnataparvabhiḥ / sātyakiṃ ca śatenājau bharatānāṃ pitāmahaḥ / dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ ca viṃśatyā kaikeyaṃ cāpi pañcabhiḥ / tāṃś ca sarvān maheṣvāsān pitā devavratas tava / vārayitvā śarair ghoraiḥ śvetam evābhidudruve / tataḥ śaraṃ mṛtyusamaṃ bhārasādhanam uttamam / vikṛṣya balavān bhīṣmaḥ samādhatta durāsadam / brahmāstreṇa susaṃyuktaṃ taṃ śaraṃ lomavāhinam / dadṛśur devagandharvāḥ piśācoragarākṣasāḥ / sa tasya kavacaṃ bhittvā hṛdayaṃ cāmitaujasaḥ / jagāma dharaṇīṃ bāṇo mahāśanir iva jvalan / astaṃ gacchan yathādityaḥ prabhām ādāya satvaraḥ / evaṃ jīvitam ādāya śvetadehāj jagāma ha / taṃ bhīṣmeṇa naravyāghraṃ tathā vinihataṃ yudhi / prapatantam apaśyāma gireḥ śṛṅgam iva cyutam / aśocan pāṇḍavās tatra kṣatriyāś ca mahārathāḥ / prahṛṣṭāś ca sutās tubhyaṃ kuravaś cāpi sarvaśaḥ / tato duḥśāsano rājañ śvetaṃ dṛṣṭvā nipātitam / vāditraninadair ghorair nṛtyati sma samantataḥ / tasmin hate maheṣvāse bhīṣmeṇāhavaśobhinā / prāvepanta maheṣvāsāḥ śikhaṇḍipramukhā rathāḥ / tato dhanaṃjayo rājan vārṣṇeyaś cāpi sarvaśaḥ / avahāraṃ śanaiś cakrur nihate vāhinīpatau / tato 'vahāraḥ sainyānāṃ tava teṣāṃ ca bhārata / tāvakānāṃ pareṣāṃ ca nardatāṃ ca muhur muhuḥ / pārthā vimanaso bhūtvā nyaviśanta mahārathāḥ / dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / cintayanto vadhaṃ ghoraṃ dvairathena paraṃtapāḥ / śvete senāpatau tāta saṃgrāme nihate paraiḥ / kim akurvan maheṣvāsāḥ pāñcālāḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha / senāpatiṃ samākarṇya śvetaṃ yudhi nipātitam / tadarthaṃ yatatāṃ cāpi pareṣāṃ prapalāyinām / manaḥ prīṇāti me vākyaṃ jayaṃ saṃjaya śṛṇvataḥ / pratyupāyaṃ cintayantaḥ sajjanāḥ prasravanti me / sa hi vīro 'nuraktaś ca vṛddhaḥ kurupatis tadā / kṛtaṃ vairaṃ sadā tena pituḥ putreṇa dhīmatā / tasyodvegabhayāc cāpi saṃśritaḥ pāṇḍavān purā / sarvaṃ balaṃ parityajya durgaṃ saṃśritya tiṣṭhati / pāṇḍavānāṃ pratāpena durgaṃ deśaṃ niveśya ca / sapatnān satataṃ bādhann āryavṛttim anuṣṭhitaḥ / āścaryaṃ vai sadā teṣāṃ purā rājñāṃ sudurmatiḥ / tato yudhiṣṭhire bhaktaḥ kathaṃ saṃjaya sūditaḥ / prakṣiptaḥ saṃmataḥ kṣudraḥ putro me puruṣādhamaḥ / na yuddhaṃ rocayed bhīṣmo na cācāryaḥ kathaṃ cana / na kṛpo na ca gāndhārī nāhaṃ saṃjaya rocaye / na vāsudevo vārṣṇeyo dharmarājaś ca pāṇḍavaḥ / na bhīmo nārjunaś caiva na yamau puruṣarṣabhau / vāryamāṇo mayā nityaṃ gāndhāryā vidureṇa ca / jāmadagnyena rāmeṇa vyāsena ca mahātmanā / duryodhano yudhyamāno nityam eva hi saṃjaya / karṇasya matam āsthāya saubalasya ca pāpakṛt / duḥśāsanasya ca tathā pāṇḍavān anvasūyata / tasyāhaṃ vyasanaṃ ghoraṃ manye prāptaṃ tu saṃjaya / śvetasya ca vināśena bhīṣmasya vijayena ca / saṃkruddhaḥ kṛṣṇasahitaḥ pārthaḥ kim akarod yudhi / arjunād dhi bhayaṃ bhūyas tan me tāta na śāmyati / sa hi śūraś ca kaunteyaḥ kṣiprakārī ca pāṇḍavaḥ / manye śaraiḥ śarīrāṇi pramathiṣyati vidviṣām / aindrir indrānujasamo mahendrasadṛśo bale / amoghakrodhasaṃkalpaṃ dṛṣṭvā vaḥ kim abhūn manaḥ / tathaiva vedavic chūro jvalanārkasamadyutiḥ / aindrāstravid ameyātmā prapatan samitiṃjayaḥ / vajrasaṃsparśarūpāṇām astrāṇāṃ nyāsakāritā / sa khaḍgākṣepahastas tu ghoṣaṃ cakre mahārathaḥ / sa saṃjaya mahāprājño drupadasyātmajo balī / dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ kim akaroc chvete yudhi nipātite / purā caivāparādhena vadhena ca camūpateḥ / manye manaḥ prajajvāla pāṇḍavānāṃ mahātmanām / teṣāṃ krodhaṃ cintayaṃs tu ahaḥsu ca niśāsu ca / saṃjaya uvāca / na śāntim adhigacchāmi sarvam ācakṣva saṃjaya / gatapūrvāhṇabhūyiṣṭhe tasminn ahani dāruṇe / tāvakānāṃ pareṣāṃ ca punar yuddham avartata / śvetaṃ tu nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā virāṭasya camūpatim / kṛtavarmaṇā ca sahitaṃ dṛṣṭvā śalyam avasthitam / śaṅkhaḥ krodhāt prajajvāla haviṣā havyavāḍ iva

vulgate_text: śokārtaṃ tamatho jñātvā duḥkhopahatacetasam abravīttatra govindo harṣayansarvapāṇḍavān - - amāśuco bharataśreṣṭa na tvaṃ śocitumarhasi yasya te bhrātaraḥ śūrāḥ sarvalokeṣu dhanvinaḥka
ce_text: mā śuco bharataśreṣṭha na tvaṃ śocitum arhasi / yasya te bhrātaraḥ śūrāḥ sarvalokasya dhanvinaḥ

vulgate_text: śikhaṇḍī ca mahābāho bhīṣmasya nidhanaṃ kila etacchrutvā tato dharmo dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ mahāratham / abravītsamitau tasyāṃ vāsudevasya śrṛṇvataḥ
ce_text: etac chrutvā tato rājā dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ mahāratham / abravīt samitau tasyāṃ vāsudevasya śṛṇvataḥ

vulgate_text: mārutā dhenukāścaiva taṃgamāḥ parataṃgaṇāḥ / bāhlikāstittirāścaiva colāḥ pāṇḍyāśca bhārata
ce_text: bāhlikās tittirāś caiva colāḥ pāṇḍyāś ca bhārata / ete janapadā rājan dakṣiṇaṃ pakṣam āśritāḥ

vulgate_text: ete janapadā rājandakṣiṇaṃ pakṣamāśritāḥ / agniveśāstudduṇḍāśca mālavā dānabhārayaḥ
ce_text: bāhlikās tittirāś caiva colāḥ pāṇḍyāś ca bhārata / ete janapadā rājan dakṣiṇaṃ pakṣam āśritāḥ

vulgate_text: tathā vyūḍheṣvanīkeṣu sannaddharuciradhvajāḥ tāvakāḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ sārdhaṃ yathā'yudhyanta tacchṛṇu / apāramiva saṃdṛśya sāgarapratimaṃ balam
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / samaṃ vyūḍheṣv anīkeṣu saṃnaddhā ruciradhvajāḥ / apāram iva saṃdṛśya sāgarapratimaṃ balam

vulgate_text: prāyāccharaṇadaḥ śīghraṃ suhṛdāṃ harṣavardhanaḥ / tamāpatantaṃ vegena prabhinnamiva vāraṇam
ce_text: tam āpatantaṃ vegena prabhinnam iva vāraṇam / trāsayānaṃ raṇe śūrān pātayantaṃ ca sāyakaiḥ

vulgate_text: tato bhīṣmo mahārāja sarvalokamahārathaḥ / arjunaṃ saptatasaptatyā nārācānāṃ samācinot
ce_text: tato bhīṣmo mahārāja kauravāṇāṃ pitāmahaḥ / arjunaṃ saptasaptatyā nārācānāṃ samāvṛṇot

vulgate_text: tato'rjuno bhṛśaṃ kruddho nirviddhaṃ prekṣya mādhavam / sārathiṃ kuruvṛddhasya nirbibheda śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
ce_text: tato 'rjuno bhṛśaṃ kruddho nirviddhaṃ prekṣya mādhavam / gāṅgeyasārathiṃ saṃkhye nirbibheda tribhiḥ śaraiḥ

vulgate_text: ālokādapi yuddhaṃ hi samametadbhaviṣyati iti sma vāco'śrūyanta proccarantyakastatastataḥ / gāṅgeyārjunayoḥ saṅkhye stavayuktā viśāṃpate
ce_text: iti sma vācaḥ śrūyante proccarantyas tatas tataḥ / gāṅgeyārjunayoḥ saṃkhye stavayuktā viśāṃ pate

vulgate_text: ādade ca śaraṃ ghoraṃ pārṣatāntacikīrṣakayā / śakrāśanisamasparśaṃ kāladaṇḍamivāparam
ce_text: ādade ca śaraṃ ghoraṃ pārṣatasya vadhaṃ prati / śakrāśanisamasparśaṃ mṛtyudaṇḍam ivāparam

vulgate_text: nivāritastu droṇena dhṛṣṭadyumno mahārathaḥ / nyāvārayaccharaughāṃstāṃścarmaṇā kṛtahastavat
ce_text: tatra sthitam apaśyāma dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ mahāratham / vārayāṇaṃ śaraughāṃś ca carmaṇā kṛtahastavat

vulgate_text: babhūva sumahāñśabdaḥ sāgarasyeva garjataḥ / anyonyaṃ sma tadā yodhā vikarṣanto viśāṃpate
ce_text: tasya sainyasya saṃgrāme yudhyamānasya bhārata / babhūva sumahāñ śabdaḥ sāgarasyeva garjataḥ

vulgate_text: aśvāñjaghāna samare bhīmasenasya sāyakaiḥ / taṃ dṛṣṭvā virathaṃ tatra bhīmasenamarindamam
ce_text: śakradevas tu samare visṛjan sāyakān bahūn / aśvāñ jaghāna samare bhīmasenasya sāyakaiḥ / vavarṣa śaravarṣāṇi tapānte jalado yathā

vulgate_text: rathairanekasāhasrairbhīmasyāvārayaddiśaḥ ayutena gajānāṃ ca niṣādaiḥ parivāritaḥ / tato bhīmo mahāvegāṃ tyaktvā gurvī mahāgadāṃ
ce_text: tato bhīmo mahābāhur gurvīṃ tyaktvā mahāgadām / udbabarhātha nistriṃśaṃ cikīrṣuḥ karma dāruṇam

vulgate_text: tato mumoca kāliṅgaḥ śaktiṃ tāmakaroddvīdhā / khaṅgena pṛthunā madhye bhānumantamathācchinat
ce_text: āruroha tato madhyaṃ nāgarājasya māriṣa / khaḍgena pṛthunā madhye bhānumantam athācchinat

vulgate_text: tūṇīrānatha yantrāṇi dhanūṃṣi ca / bhindipālāni śubhrāṇi totrāṇi cāṅkuśaiḥ saha
ce_text: graiveyāṇy atha śaktīś ca patākāḥ kaṇapāṃs tathā / tūṇīrāṇy atha yantrāṇi vicitrāṇi dhanūṃṣi ca

vulgate_text: samāhato mahārāja kaliṅgena mahātmanā / saṃcukruśe bhṛśaṃ bhīmo daṇḍāhata ivoragaḥ
ce_text: sa kārmukavarotsṛṣṭair navabhir niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ / samāhato bhṛśaṃ rājan kaliṅgena mahāyaśāḥ / saṃcukrudhe bhṛśaṃ bhīmo daṇḍāhata ivoragaḥ

vulgate_text: tato bhīmo mahābāhuḥ khaṅgahasto mahābhujaḥka / saṃprahṛṣṭo mahāghoṣaṃ śaṅkhaṃ prādhmāpayadbalī
ce_text: tato bhīmo mahābāhuḥ śaṅkhaṃ prādhmāpayad balī / sarvakāliṅgasainyānāṃ manāṃsi samakampayat

vulgate_text: senāpativacaḥ śrutvā śikhaṇḍipramukhā gaṇāḥ bhīmamevābhyavartanta rathānīkaiḥ prahāribhiḥ - - adharmarājaśca tānsarvānupajagrāha pāṇḍavaḥ mahatā meghavarṇena nāgānīkena pṛṣṭhataḥ
ce_text: senāpativacaḥ śrutvā śikhaṇḍipramukhā gaṇāḥ / bhīmam evābhyavartanta rathānīkaiḥ prahāribhiḥ

vulgate_text: sa kṛtkavā dāruṇaṃ karma pragṛhītaśarāsanaḥ / āsthito raudramātmānaṃ kaliṅgānanvavaikṣata
ce_text: sa kṛtvā kadanaṃ tatra pragṛhītaśarāsanaḥ / āsthito raudram ātmānaṃ jaghāna samare parān

vulgate_text: svabāhubalavīryeṇa nāgāśvarathasaṃkulaḥ / mahāpuruṣabhūyiṣṭho dhīrayodhaniṣevitaḥ
ce_text: svabāhubalavīryeṇa nāgāśvarathasaṃkulaḥ / mahāvyūhaḥ kaliṅgānām ekena mṛditas tvayā

vulgate_text: kākaruśā vikuñcāśca muṇḍāḥ kuṇḍīvṛṣāstathā / bṛhadvalena sahitā vāmaṃ pārśvamavasthitāḥ
ce_text: kānanāś ca vikuñjāś ca muktāḥ puṇḍrāviṣas tathā / bṛhadbalena sahitā vāmaṃ pakṣam upāśritāḥ

vulgate_text: bhaimasenistato rājankekayāśca mahārathāḥ / ete sarve mahārāja vāmaṃ pārśvamupāśritāḥ
ce_text: abhimanyus tatas tūrṇam irāvāṃś ca tataḥ param / bhaimasenis tato rājan kekayāś ca mahārathāḥ

vulgate_text: sarvasya jagato goptā goptā yasya janārdanaḥ tatrānurathināṃ śreṣṭho vāmaśrṛṅge vyavasthitaḥ / evametaṃ mahāvyūhaṃ pratyavyūhanta pāṇḍavāḥ
ce_text: tato 'bhūd dvipadāṃ śreṣṭho vāmaṃ pārśvam upāśritaḥ / sarvasya jagato goptā goptā yasya janārdanaḥ

vulgate_text: saṃpatanto vyadṛśyanta nighnantaste parasparam / dhāvatāṃ ca rathoghānāṃ nighnatāṃ ca pṛthak pṛthak
ce_text: hayaughāś ca rathaughāś ca tatra tatra viśāṃ pate / saṃpatantaḥ sma dṛśyante nighnamānāḥ parasparam

vulgate_text: udatiṣṭhadrajo bhaumaṃ chādayānaṃ divākaram / na diśaḥ pradiśo vāpi jajñire'tra samāgatāḥ
ce_text: udatiṣṭhad rajo bhaumaṃ chādayānaṃ divākaram / diśaḥ pratidiśo vāpi tatra jajñuḥ kathaṃ cana

vulgate_text: tato rathasahasreṇa putro duryodhanastava abhyayātpāṇḍavaṃ yuddhe rākṣasaṃ ca ghaṭotkacam - - atathaiva pāṇḍavāḥ sarve mahatyā senayā saha droṇabhīṣmau raṇe yattau pratyudyayurarindamau
ce_text: tato rathasahasreṇa putro duryodhanas tava / abhyayāt pāṇḍavān yuddhe rākṣasaṃ ca ghaṭotkacam

vulgate_text: nāśaknutāṃ vārayituṃ bhīṣmadroṇau mahārathau / vāryamāṇaṃ ca bhīṣmeṇa droṇena ca mahātmanā
ce_text: dravamāṇaṃ tu tat sainyaṃ tava putrasya saṃyuge / nāśaknutāṃ vārayituṃ bhīṣmadroṇau mahārathau

vulgate_text: yatra yatra hi putraṃ te ye ye paśyanti bhārata / tatra tatra nyavartanta kṣatriyāṇāṃ maharathāḥ
ce_text: yatra yatra sutaṃ tubhyaṃ yo yaḥ paśyati bhārata / tatra tatra nyavartanta kṣatriyāṇāṃ mahārathāḥ

vulgate_text: anugrāhyāḥ pāṇḍusutāstava nūnaṃ pitāmaha yathemāṃ kṣamase vīra vadhyamānāṃ varūthinīm - - aso'smi vācyastvayā rājanpūrvameva samāgame na yotsye pāṇḍavānsaṅkhye nāpi pārṣatasātyakī
ce_text: so 'smi vācyas tvayā rājan pūrvam eva samāgame / na yotsye pāṇḍavān saṃkhye nāpi pārṣatasātyakī

vulgate_text: gatapūrvāhṇabhūyiṣṭhe tasminnahani bhārata / paścimāṃ diśamāsthāya sthite cāpi divākare
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / gatapūrvāhṇabhūyiṣṭhe tasminn ahani bhārata / jayaṃ prāpteṣu hṛṣṭeṣu pāṇḍaveṣu mahātmasu

vulgate_text: gajaṃ kaṃkaṭasannaddhaṃ vajreṇeva śiloccayam / dvau trīnapi gajārohānpiṇḍitānvarmitānapi
ce_text: dvau trīn api gajārohān piṇḍitān varmitān api / nārācena sutīkṣṇena nijaghāna pitā tava

vulgate_text: dadṛśe pāṇḍuputrasya sainyamārtasvaraṃ tadā / prabhajyamānaṃ sainyaṃ tu dṛṣṭvā yādavanandanaḥ
ce_text: tad gokulam ivodbhrāntam udbhrāntarathayūthapam / dadṛśe pāṇḍuputrasya sainyam ārtasvaraṃ tadā

vulgate_text: praharasva naravyāghra na cenmohādvimuhyase yattvayā kathitaṃ vīra purā rājñāṃ samāgame
ce_text: ayaṃ sa kālaḥ saṃprāptaḥ pārtha yaḥ kāṅkṣitas tvayā / praharāsmai naravyāghra na cen mohād vimuhyase

vulgate_text: bhayārtāḥ prapalāyante siṃhātkṣudramṛgā iva / evamuktaḥ pratyuvāca vāsudevaṃ dhanaṃjayaḥ
ce_text: evam uktaḥ pratyuvāca vāsudevaṃ dhanaṃjayaḥ / codayāśvān yato bhīṣmo vigāhyaitad balārṇavam

vulgate_text: nodayāśvānyato bhīṣmo vigāhe tadvalārṇavam / pātayiṣyāmi durdharṣaṃ vṛddhaṃ kurupitāmaham / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tatas te pārthivāḥ kruddhāḥ phalgunaṃ vīkṣya saṃyuge / rathair anekasāhasraiḥ samantāt paryavārayan

vulgate_text: śuśubhāte naravyāghrau tau bhīṣmaśaravikṣatau / govṛṣāviva saṃrabdhau viṣāṇollekhanāṅktitau
ce_text: śuśubhāte naravyāghrau tau bhīṣmaśaravikṣatau / govṛṣāv iva nardantau viṣāṇollikhitāṅkitau

vulgate_text: punaścāpi susaṃrabdhaḥ śaraiḥ śatasahasraśaḥ kṛṣṇayoryudhi saṃrabdho bhīṣmāḥ prācchādayaddiśaḥ / pārtho'pi samare kruddho bhīṣmasyāvārayaddiśaḥ
ce_text: punaś cāpi susaṃkruddhaḥ śaraiḥ saṃnataparvabhiḥ / kṛṣṇayor yudhi saṃrabdho bhīṣmo vyāvārayad diśaḥ

vulgate_text: taccakrapadmaṃ pragṛhītamājau rarāja nārāyaṇabāhunālam / yathādipadmaṃ taruṇārkavarṇaṃ rarāja nārāyaṇanābhijātamak
ce_text: sudarśanaṃ cāsya rarāja śaures; tac cakrapadmaṃ subhujorunālam / yathādipadmaṃ taruṇārkavarṇaṃ; rarāja nārāyaṇanābhijātam

vulgate_text: pragṛhya śaṅkhaṃ dviṣatākaṃ nihantā sa tānabhūṣūnpunarādadānaḥ / bhīṣmaṃ śaraiḥ saṃparivārya saṅkhye ciccheda bhūriśravasaśca cāpam
ce_text: sa tān abhīṣūn punar ādadānaḥ; pragṛhya śaṅkhaṃ dviṣatāṃ nihantā / vinādayām āsa tato diśaś ca; sa pāñcajanyasya raveṇa śauriḥ

vulgate_text: śalyaṃ ca viddhvā navabhiḥ pṛṣatkai- rduryodhaṃ vakṣasi nirbibheda / vinādayāmāsa tato diśaśca sa pāñcajanyasya raveṇa śauriḥ
ce_text: sa tān abhīṣūn punar ādadānaḥ; pragṛhya śaṅkhaṃ dviṣatāṃ nihantā / vinādayām āsa tato diśaś ca; sa pāñcajanyasya raveṇa śauriḥ

vulgate_text: vegena sā'tīva pṛthupravāhā paretanāgāśvaśarīrarodhāḥ / narendramañjocchritamāṃsapaṅkāḥ prabhūtarakṣogaṇabhūtasevitā
ce_text: vegena sātīva pṛthupravāhā; prasusrutā bhairavārāvarūpā / paretanāgāśvaśarīrarodhā; narāntramajjābhṛtamāṃsapaṅkā

vulgate_text: pravartitāmarjunabāṇasaṅghai- rmedovasāsṛkapravahāṃ subhīmām / hatapravīrāṃ ca tathaiva dṛṣṭvā senāṃ kurūṇāmatha phalgunena
ce_text: upetakūlāṃ dadṛśuḥ samantāt; krūrāṃ mahāvaitaraṇīprakāśām / pravartitām arjunabāṇasaṃghair; medovasāsṛkpravahāṃ subhīmām

vulgate_text: te cedipāñcālakarūṣamatsyāḥ pārthāśca sarve sahitāḥ praṇeduḥ / jayapragalbhāḥka puruṣapravīrāḥ saṃtrāsayantaḥ kuruvīrayodhān
ce_text: te cedipāñcālakarūṣamatsyāḥ; pārthāś ca sarve sahitāḥ praṇeduḥ / vitrāsya senāṃ dhvajinīpatīnāṃ; siṃho mṛgāṇām iva yūthasaṃghān / vinedatus tāv atiharṣayuktau; gāṇḍīvadhanvā ca janārdanaś ca

vulgate_text: hatapravīrāṇi balāni dṛṣṭvā kirīṭinā śatrubhayāvahena / vitrāsya senāṃ dhvajinīpatīnāṃ siṃho mṛgāṇāmiva yūthasaṅghān
ce_text: te cedipāñcālakarūṣamatsyāḥ; pārthāś ca sarve sahitāḥ praṇeduḥ / vitrāsya senāṃ dhvajinīpatīnāṃ; siṃho mṛgāṇām iva yūthasaṃghān / vinedatus tāv atiharṣayuktau; gāṇḍīvadhanvā ca janārdanaś ca

vulgate_text: droṇaḥ kṛpaḥ saindhavabāhlikau ca bhūriśravāḥ śalyaśalau ca rājan / anye ca yodhāḥ śataśaḥ sametāḥ kruddhena pārthena raṇasya madhye
ce_text: śrutāyur ambaṣṭhapatiś ca rājā; tathaiva durmarṣaṇacitrasenau / droṇaḥ kṛpaḥ saindhavabāhlikau ca; bhūriśravāḥ śalyaśalau ca rājan / svabāhuvīryeṇa jitāḥ sabhīṣmāḥ; kirīṭinā lokamahārathena

vulgate_text: viniryayau ketumatā rathena nararṣabhaḥ śvetahayena kāle / jaye dhṛtaḥ śatruvarūthinīnāṃ yathā surendro'suravāhinīnām
ce_text: sa niryayau ketumatā rathena; nararṣabhaḥ śvetahayena vīraḥ / varūthinā sainyamukhe mahātmā; vadhe dhṛtaḥ sarvasapatnayūnām

vulgate_text: yathaiva pūrve'hani dharmarājñā vyūhaḥ kṛtaḥ kauravasattamena / yathā na bhūto bhuvi mānuṣeṣu na dṛṣṭapūrvo na ca saṃśrutaśca
ce_text: yathā hi pūrve 'hani dharmarājñā; vyūhaḥ kṛtaḥ kauravanandanena / tathā tathoddeśam upetya tasthuḥ; pāñcālamukhyaiḥ saha cedimukhyāḥ

vulgate_text: śaṅkhasvanāstūryaravāḥ praṇeduḥ sarveṣvanīkeṣu sasiṃhanādāḥ / tataḥ sabāṇāni mahāsvanāni visphāryamāṇāni dhanūṃṣi vīraiḥ
ce_text: tataḥ sabāṇāni mahāsvanāni; visphāryamāṇāni dhanūṃṣi vīraiḥ / kṣaṇena bherīpaṇavapraṇādān; antardadhuḥ śaṅkhamahāsvanāś ca

vulgate_text: jagāma saubhadramatītya bhīṣmo mahārathaṃ pārthamadīnasatvaḥ / tataḥ prahasyādbhutavikrameṇa gāṇḍīvamuktena śilāśitena
ce_text: tataḥ sa tūrṇaṃ rudhirodaphenāṃ; kṛtvā nadīṃ vaiśasane ripūṇām / jagāma saubhadram atītya bhīṣmo; mahārathaṃ pārtham adīnasattvaḥ

vulgate_text: bhīṣmaṃ mahātmā'bhivavarṣa tūrṇaṃ śaraughajālairvimalaiśca bhallaiḥ / tathaiva bhīṣmāhatamantarikṣe mahāstrajālaṃ kapirājaketoḥ
ce_text: tam uttamaṃ sarvadhanurdharāṇām; asaktakarmā kapirājaketuḥ / bhīṣmaṃ mahātmābhivavarṣa tūrṇaṃ; śaraughajālair vimalaiś ca bhallaiḥ

vulgate_text: pārāvatāśvaḥ sa rathamāsthāya paravīrahā dhanurviṣphārya saṃkruddho nodayitvā ca vāhinīm / yayau taṃ madrakānīkaṃ kekayāṃśca paraṃtapa
ce_text: dhanur visphārya saṃkruddhaś codayitvā varūthinīm / yayau tan madrakānīkaṃ kekayāṃś ca paraṃtapaḥ

vulgate_text: sa pragṛhya mahāghoraṃ nistriṃśavaramāyasam / padātistūrṇamānarcchadrathasyaṃ puruṣarṣabhaḥ
ce_text: sa saṃgṛhya mahāghoraṃ nistriṃśavaram āyasam / padātis tūrṇam abhyarchad rathasthaṃ drupadātmajam

vulgate_text: nāntaraṃ dṛśyate tatra tayośca rathinostadā / muhūrtamiva tadyuddhaṃ tayoḥ samamivābhavat
ce_text: nāntaraṃ dadṛśe kaś cit tayoḥ saṃrabdhayo raṇe / muhūrtam iva tad yuddhaṃ tayoḥ samam ivābhavat

vulgate_text: dhārtarāṣṭrāndaśa rathāndaśaiva pratyavārayan / nānārūpāṇi śastrāṇi visṛjanto viśāṃpate
ce_text: nānārūpāṇi śastrāṇi visṛjanto viśāṃ pate / abhyavartanta saṃhṛṣṭāḥ parasparavadhaiṣiṇaḥ / te vai samīyuḥ saṃgrāme rājan durmantrite tava

vulgate_text: te tadā jātasaṃrambhāḥ sarve'nyonyaṃ jighāṃsavaḥ / anyonyamabhimardantaḥ spardhamānāḥ parasparam
ce_text: te yattā jātasaṃrambhāḥ sarve 'nyonyaṃ jighāṃsavaḥ / mahāstrāṇi vimuñcantaḥ samāpetur amarṣaṇāḥ

vulgate_text: anyonyaspardhayā rājañjñātayaḥ saṃgatā mithaḥ / mahāsrāṇi vimuñcantaḥ samāpeturamarṣiṇaḥ
ce_text: te yattā jātasaṃrambhāḥ sarve 'nyonyaṃ jighāṃsavaḥ / mahāstrāṇi vimuñcantaḥ samāpetur amarṣaṇāḥ

vulgate_text: avidhyetāṃ śaraistīkṣṇaistadadbhutamivābhavat / tataḥ śalyo mahārāja svastrīyau rathināṃ varau
ce_text: tataḥ śalyo mahārāja svasrīyau rathināṃ varau / śarair bahubhir ānarchat kṛtapratikṛtaiṣiṇau / chādyamānau tatas tau tu mādrīputrau na celatuḥ

vulgate_text: gajānīkena sahitastena rājā suyodhanāḥ / māgadhaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā bhīmasenaṃ samabhyayāt
ce_text: duryodhanas tu saṃkruddho māgadhaṃ samacodayat / anīkaṃ daśasāhasraṃ kuñjarāṇāṃ tarasvinām / māgadhaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā bhīmasenaṃ samabhyayāt

vulgate_text: nākulistu śatānīkaḥ samare śatrupūgahā kṣuraiḥ kṣuraprairbhallaiśca pītaiścāñjalikaiḥ śitaiḥ / nyahanaccottamāṅgāni pāṇḍavo gajayodhinām
ce_text: kṣuraiḥ kṣuraprair bhallaiś ca pītair añjalikair api / pātayantottamāṅgāni pāṇḍavā gajayodhinām

vulgate_text: bhīmasenasya mārgeṣu patitānparvatopamān / apaśyaṃ nihatānnāgānrājanniṣṭhīvatoparān
ce_text: bhīmasenasya mārgeṣu gatāsūn parvatopamān / apaśyāma hatān nāgān niṣṭanantas tathāpare

vulgate_text: rathanāgāśvakalilaṃ śaṅkhadundubhināditam / anantarathapādātaṃ rajasā sarvato vṛtam
ce_text: rathanāgāśvakalilaṃ śaṅkhadundubhināditam / athānantam apāraṃ ca narendrastimitahradam

vulgate_text: tadāścaryamapaśyāma pāṇḍavasya mahātmanaḥ / bhīmasenasya samare rājankarmātimānuṣam
ce_text: tad āścaryam apaśyāma śraddheyam api cādbhutam / bhīmasenasya samare rājan karmātimānuṣam

vulgate_text: udīrṇānpārthivānsarvānsāśvānsarathakuñjarān / asaṃbhramaṃ bhīmaseno gadayā samavārayat
ce_text: udīrṇāṃ pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ sāśvāṃ sarathakuñjarām / asaṃbhramaṃ bhīmaseno gadayā samatāḍayat

vulgate_text: poyayanrathabṛndāni vājibṛndani cābhibhūḥ / karṣayanrathavṛndāni bāhuvegena pāṇḍavaḥ
ce_text: tataḥ śaikyāyasīṃ gurvīṃ pragṛhya mahatīṃ gadām / avadhīt tāvakān yodhān daṇḍapāṇir ivāntakaḥ / pothayan rathavṛndāni vājivṛndāni cābhibhūḥ

vulgate_text: vinidhranyacatatsaṅkhye yugānte kālavidvibhuḥ / ūruvegena saṃkarṣanrathajālāni pāṇḍavaḥ
ce_text: ūruvegena saṃkarṣan rathajālāni pāṇḍavaḥ / pramardayan gajān sarvān naḍvalānīva kuñjaraḥ

vulgate_text: balāni saṃmamardāśu naḍvalānīva kuñjaraḥ / mṛdganrathebhyo rathino gajebhyo gajayodhinaḥ
ce_text: mṛdnan rathebhyo rathino gajebhyo gajayodhinaḥ / sādinaś cāśvapṛṣṭhebhyo bhūmau caiva padātinaḥ

vulgate_text: sādinaścāśvapṛṣṭhebhyo bhūmau vāpi padātinaḥ / gadayā vyavamatsarvānvāto vṛkṣānivaujasā
ce_text: mṛdnan rathebhyo rathino gajebhyo gajayodhinaḥ / sādinaś cāśvapṛṣṭhebhyo bhūmau caiva padātinaḥ

vulgate_text: adṛśyata mahāraudrā gadā nāgāśvapātanī / tatratatra hataiścāpi manuṣyagajavājibhiḥ
ce_text: tatra tatra hataiś cāpi manuṣyagajavājibhiḥ / raṇāṅgaṇaṃ tad abhavan mṛtyor āghātasaṃnibham

vulgate_text: avidhyadenaṃ daśabhiḥ pṛṣatkaiḥ- ralambuso rākṣaso'sau tadānīm / śaraiścaturbhiḥ pratividdhya taṃ ca naptā śinerabhyapatadrathena
ce_text: avidhyad enaṃ niśitaiḥ śarāgrair; alambuso rājavarārśyaśṛṅgiḥ / taṃ vai caturbhiḥ pratividhya vīro; naptā śiner abhyapatad rathena

vulgate_text: na tatra kaścinnaviṣaṇṇa āsī- dṛte rājansomadattasya putrāt / sa vai samādāya dhanurmahātmā bhiriśravā bhārata saumadattiḥ
ce_text: nāśaknuvan vārayituṃ variṣṭhaṃ; madhyaṃdine sūryam ivātapantam / na tatra kaś cinn aviṣaṇṇa āsīd; ṛte rājan somadattasya putrāt

vulgate_text: vivyādha viśikhaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ kaṅkapatraiḥ śilāśitaiḥ / duryodhanastadā rājanbhīmasenaṃ mahāratham
ce_text: rathair anekasāhasraiḥ krodhāmarṣasamanvitaḥ / nandakas tava putras tu bhīmasenaṃ mahābalam / vivyādha niśitaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ kaṅkapatraiḥ śilāśitaiḥ

vulgate_text: māmeva bhṛśasaṃkruddhā hantumabhyudyatā yudhi / manorathadrumo'smākaṃ cintito bahuvārṣikaḥ
ce_text: ete mahārathāḥ śūrā dhārtarāṣṭrā mahābalāḥ / mām eva bhṛśasaṃkruddhā hantum abhyudyatā yudhi

vulgate_text: bhrātaraścāsya sannaddhāḥ kulaputrā madotkaṭāḥ / etānadya haniṣyāmi paśyataste na saṃśayaḥ
ce_text: etān adya haniṣyāmi paśyatas te na saṃśayaḥ / tasmān mamāśvān saṃgrāme yattaḥ saṃyaccha sārathe

vulgate_text: tasmānmamāśvānsaṃgrame yattaḥ saṃyaccha sārathe / evamuktvā tataḥ pārthastava putraṃ viśāṃpate
ce_text: etān adya haniṣyāmi paśyatas te na saṃśayaḥ / tasmān mamāśvān saṃgrāme yattaḥ saṃyaccha sārathe

vulgate_text: so'paviddhya dhanuśchinnaṃ putraste krodhamūrcchitaḥ / anyatkārmukamādatta satvaraṃ vegavattaram
ce_text: so 'pavidhya dhanuś chinnaṃ krodhena prajvalann iva / anyat kārmukam ādatta satvaraṃ vegavattaram

vulgate_text: abhipatya mahābāhurgarutmāniva vegitaḥ / senāpateḥ kṣurapreṇa śiraściccheda pāṇḍavaḥ
ce_text: putrāṃs tu tava saṃprekṣya bhīmaseno mahābalaḥ / sṛkkiṇī vilihan vīraḥ paśumadhye vṛko yathā / senāpateḥ kṣurapreṇa śiraś ciccheda pāṇḍavaḥ

vulgate_text: saṃprahasya ca hṛṣṭātmā tribhirbāṇairmahābhujaḥ / jalasandhaṃ vinirbhidya so'nayadyamasādanam
ce_text: jalasaṃdhaṃ vinirbhidya so 'nayad yamasādanam / suṣeṇaṃ ca tato hatvā preṣayām āsa mṛtyave

vulgate_text: nināya samare vīraḥ paralokāya pāṇḍavaḥ / bhīmaṃ bhīmarathaṃ cobhau bhīmaseno hasanniva
ce_text: bhīmaṃ bhīmarathaṃ cobhau bhīmaseno hasann iva / bhrātarau rabhasau rājann anayad yamasādanam

vulgate_text: putrau te durmadau rājannanayadyamasādanam / tataḥ sulocanaṃ bhīmaḥ kṣurapreṇa mahāmṛdhe
ce_text: tataḥ sulocanaṃ bhīmaḥ kṣurapreṇa mahāmṛdhe / miṣatāṃ sarvasainyānām anayad yamasādanam

vulgate_text: sa śastravṛṣṭyā'bhihataḥ samastaistairmahārathaiḥ / prāgjyotiṣagajo rājannānāliṅgaiḥ sutejanaiḥ
ce_text: sa śastravṛṣṭyābhihataḥ prādravad dviguṇaṃ padam / prāgjyotiṣagajo rājan nānāliṅgaiḥ sutejanaiḥ

vulgate_text: ājaghāna mahārāja śareṇānataparvaṇā so'tividdho maheṣvāsastena rājñā mahārathaḥ
ce_text: so 'tividdho maheṣvāsas tena rājñā mahārathaḥ / mūrchayābhiparītāṅgo dhvajayaṣṭim upāśritaḥ

vulgate_text: mūrcchayā'bhiparītātmā dhvajayaṣṭiṃ samāśrayat / tāṃstu bhītānsamālakṣya bhīmasenaṃ ca mūrcchitam
ce_text: tāṃs tu bhītān samālakṣya bhīmasenaṃ ca mūrchitam / nanāda balavan nādaṃ bhagadattaḥ pratāpavān

vulgate_text: adṛśyata nimeṣārdhāddhorarūpaṃ samāsthitaḥ / airāvataṃ samārūḍhaḥ sa vai māyākṛtaṃ svayam
ce_text: sa kṛtvā dāruṇāṃ māyāṃ bhīrūṇāṃ bhayavardhinīm / adṛśyata nimeṣārdhād ghorarūpaṃ samāśritaḥ

vulgate_text: bhīṣmasya tadvacaḥ śrutvā sarva eva mahārathāḥ / droṇabhīṣmau puraskṛtya bhagadattaparīpsayā
ce_text: bhīṣmasya tad vacaḥ śrutvā bhāradvājapurogamāḥ / sahitāḥ sarvarājāno bhagadattaparīpsayā / uttamaṃ javam āsthāya prayayur yatra so 'bhavat

vulgate_text: idānīṃ yudhi nirjetuṃ na śakyo'sau sa rākṣasaḥ astamabhyeti savitā rātrau yoddhuṃ kana śakyate / avahāramataḥ kurmaḥ śvo yotsyāmaḥ parai saha
ce_text: tan na me rocate yuddhaṃ pāṇḍavair jitakāśibhiḥ / ghuṣyatām avahāro 'dya śvo yotsyāmaḥ paraiḥ saha

vulgate_text: kauraveṣu nivṛtteṣu pāṇḍavā jitakāśinaḥ / siṃhanādānbhṛśaṃ cakruḥ śaṅkhāndadhmuśca bhārata
ce_text: kauraveṣu nivṛtteṣu pāṇḍavā jitakāśinaḥ / siṃhanādam akurvanta śaṅkhaveṇusvanaiḥ saha

vulgate_text: dharmeṇa sarvakāryāṇi jīvitādīni bhārata / ārabhante sadā pārthāḥ prārthayānā mahadyaśaḥ
ce_text: yudhyanti te yathānyāyaṃ śaktimantaś ca saṃyuge / dharmeṇa sarvakāryāṇi kīrtitānīti bhārata / ārabhante sadā pārthāḥ prārthayānā mahad yaśaḥ

vulgate_text: tasya pāpasya satataṃ kriyamāṇasya karmaṇaḥ / sāṃprataṃ sumahaddhoraṃ phalaṃ prāptaṃ janeśvara
ce_text: tasya pāpasya satataṃ kriyamāṇasya karmaṇaḥ / saṃprāptaṃ sumahad ghoraṃ phalaṃ kiṃpākasaṃnibham / sa tad bhuṅkṣva mahārāja saputraḥ sasuhṛjjanaḥ

vulgate_text: tasyāhamagrajaḥ putraḥ sarvasya jagataḥ prabhuḥ / vāsudevo'rcanīyo vaḥ sarvalokamaheśvaraḥ
ce_text: tasyāham ātmajo brahmā sarvasya jagataḥ patiḥ / vāsudevo 'rcanīyo vaḥ sarvalokamaheśvaraḥ

vulgate_text: apsu vai śayanaṃ cakre mahātmā puruṣottamaḥ / sarvadevamayo devaḥ śayānaḥ śayane sukham
ce_text: sa sṛṣṭvā pṛthivīṃ devaḥ sarvalokeśvaraḥ prabhuḥ / apsu vai śayanaṃ cakre mahātmā puruṣottamaḥ / sarvatoyamayo devo yogāt suṣvāpa tatra ha

vulgate_text: tamugramugrakarmāṇamugrāṃ buddhaiṃ samāsthitam harantaṃ brahmaṇo vedāñjaghāna brahmaṇaḥ pitā / brahmaṇopacitiṃ kurvanmahātmā puruṣottamaḥ
ce_text: karṇasrotodbhavaṃ cāpi madhuṃ nāma mahāsuram / tam ugram ugrakarmāṇam ugrāṃ buddhiṃ samāsthitam / brahmaṇo 'pacitiṃ kurvañ jaghāna puruṣottamaḥ

vulgate_text: bhīṣma uvāca / stavaṃ vai brahmasaṃyuktaṃ śṛṇu kṛṣṇasya bhārata / brahmarṣibhiśca devaiśca yaḥ purā kathito bhuvi
ce_text: bhīṣma uvāca / vāsudevo mahad bhūtaṃ saṃbhūtaṃ saha daivataiḥ / na paraṃ puṇḍarīkākṣād dṛśyate bharatarṣabha / mārkaṇḍeyaś ca govindaṃ kathayaty adbhutaṃ mahat

vulgate_text: devānāmapi devaṃ ca tvāmāha bhagavānbhṛguḥ / purāṇāṃ caiva paramaṃ viṣṇo rūpaṃ taveti ca
ce_text: yajñānāṃ caiva yajñaṃ tvāṃ tapaś ca tapasām api / devānām api devaṃ ca tvām āha bhagavān bhṛguḥ / purāṇe bhairavaṃ rūpaṃ viṣṇo bhūtapateti vai

vulgate_text: tāndṛṣṭvā'bhyudyatānsaṅkhye pāṇḍavā hi yaśasvinaḥ / śyenavyūhena saṃvyūhya samanahyanta saṃyuge
ce_text: tān dṛṣṭvā prodyatān saṃkhye pāṇḍavāś ca yaśasvinaḥ / śyenena vyūharājena tenājayyena saṃyuge

vulgate_text: kimu pāṇḍusutākanyuddhe hīnavīryaparākramān / sa tathā kuru bhadraṃ te yathā vadhyanti pāṇḍavāḥ
ce_text: devān api raṇe jetuṃ prārthayāmo na saṃśayaḥ / kim u pāṇḍusutān yuddhe hīnavīryaparākramān

vulgate_text: evamuktastato droṇastava putreṇa māriṣa / tatra saṃprekṣya rājanaṃ saṃkruddha iva niścasan
ce_text: evam uktas tato droṇas tava putreṇa māriṣa / abhinat pāṇḍavānīkaṃ prekṣamāṇasya sātyakeḥ

vulgate_text: yathābalaṃ yathāvīryaṃ karma kuryāmahaṃ hi te ityuktavā te sutaṃ rājannabhyapadyata vāhinīm / abhinatpāṇḍavānīkaṃ prekṣamāṇasya sātyakeḥ
ce_text: evam uktas tato droṇas tava putreṇa māriṣa / abhinat pāṇḍavānīkaṃ prekṣamāṇasya sātyakeḥ

vulgate_text: sātyakistu tato drauṇaṃ vārayāmāta bhārata / tayoḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ ghorarūpaṃ bhayāvaham
ce_text: sātyakis tu tadā droṇaṃ vārayām āsa bhārata / tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ tumulaṃ lomaharṣaṇam

vulgate_text: tadyuddhamabhavaddhoraṃ devānāṃ dānavairiva / jayamākāṅkṣatāṃ saṅkṣye yaśaśca sumahādbhutam
ce_text: tad yuddham abhavad ghoraṃ devānāṃ dānavair iva / jayaṃ ca kāṅkṣatāṃ nityaṃ yaśaś ca paramādbhutam

vulgate_text: babhramuḥ kuñjarāścātra śarairviddhā niraṅkuśāḥ / aśvāśca paryadhāvanta hatārohā diśo daśa
ce_text: krośanti kuñjarās tatra śaravarṣapratāpitāḥ / tāvakānāṃ pareṣāṃ ca saṃyuge bharatottama / aśvāś ca paryadhāvanta hatārohā diśo daśa

vulgate_text: patitaiḥ pātyamānaiśca viceṣṭadbhiśca bhūtale / ghoramāyodhanaṃ jajñe tatratatra janeśvara
ce_text: rathibhir vāraṇair aśvaiḥ padātaiś ca samīritam / ghoram āyodhanaṃ jajñe mahābhrasadṛśaṃ rajaḥ

vulgate_text: siṃhalāṅgūlamākāśe jvalantamiva parvatam / asañjamānaṃ vṛkṣeṣu dhūmaketumivotthitam
ce_text: asajjamānaṃ vṛkṣeṣu dhūmaketum ivotthitam / bahuvarṇaṃ ca citraṃ ca divyaṃ vānaralakṣaṇam / apaśyāma mahārāja dhvajaṃ gāṇḍivadhanvanaḥ

vulgate_text: atha kāmbhojaijaraśvairmahadbhiḥ śīghragāmibhiḥ / gopānāṃ bahusāhastrairbālairgāpāyanairvṛtaḥ
ce_text: atha kāmbojamukhyais tu bṛhadbhiḥ śīghragāmibhiḥ / gopānāṃ bahusāhasrair balair govāsano vṛtaḥ

vulgate_text: vapurbhiśca narendrāṇāṃ candrasūryasamaprabhaiḥ / virarāja tadā rājaṃstatratatra raṇāṅgaṇam
ce_text: kavacānāṃ vicitrāṇāṃ bhūṣaṇānāṃ prabhās tathā / khaṃ diśaḥ pradiśaś caiva bhāsayām āsur ojasā / virarāja tadā rājaṃs tatra tatra raṇāṅgaṇam

vulgate_text: nyahanatpāṇḍavīṃ senāmāsurīmiva vṛtrāhā te vadhyamānā bhīṣmeṇa pāñcālāḥ somakaiḥ saha / sthirāṃ yuddhe matiṃ kṛtvā bhīṣmamevābhidudruvuḥ
ce_text: te vadhyamānā bhīṣmeṇa pāñcālāḥ somakaiḥ saha / āryāṃ yuddhe matiṃ kṛtvā bhīṣmam evābhidudruvuḥ

vulgate_text: yattatsakhyustu pūrveṇa arjunādupaśikṣitam pragāḍhaṃ laghu citraṃ ca darśayanhastalāghavam / prāmuñcatpuṅkhasaṃyuktāñśarānāśīviṣopamān
ce_text: prāmuñcat puṅkhasaṃyuktāñ śarān āśīviṣopamān / prakāśaṃ laghu citraṃ ca darśayann astralāghavam

vulgate_text: samadattistataḥ kruddhasteṣāṃ cāpāni bhārata / ciccheda samare rājanyudhyamāno mahārathaiḥ
ce_text: saumadattis tataḥ kruddhas teṣāṃ cāpāni bhārata / ciccheda daśabhir bāṇair nimeṣeṇa mahārathaḥ

vulgate_text: sātyakirdharmarājaśca vyūhagrīvāṃ samāsthitāḥ pṛṣṭhamāsīnmahārāja virāṭo vāhinīpatiḥ - - adhṛṣṭadyumno mahārāja mahatyā senayā vṛtaḥ kekayā bhrātaraḥ pañca vāmapārśvaṃ samāśritāḥ
ce_text: pṛṣṭham āsīn mahārāja virāṭo vāhinīpatiḥ / dhṛṣṭadyumnena sahito mahatyā senayā vṛtaḥ

vulgate_text: kampaneṣu ca cāpeṣu kaṇapeṣu ca sarvaśaḥ / kṣeṇaṇīyeṣu citreṣu muṣṭayuddheṣu ca kṣamam
ce_text: kampaneṣu ca cāpeṣu kaṇapeṣu ca sarvaśaḥ / kṣepaṇīṣu ca citrāsu muṣṭiyuddheṣu kovidam

vulgate_text: dhvajabhūṣaṇasaṃbādhaṃ ratnapaṭṭasusaṃcitam / paridhāvadbhiraśvaiśca vāyuvegavikampitam
ce_text: dhvajabhūṣaṇasaṃbādhaṃ ratnapaṭṭena saṃcitam / vāhanaiḥ parisarpadbhir vāyuvegavikampitam

vulgate_text: guptaṃ pravīrairlaukaiśca sāravadbhirmahātmabhiḥ / yadahanyata sainyaṃ me diṣṭamatra parāyaṇam
ce_text: guptaṃ pravīrair lokasya sāravadbhir mahātmabhiḥ / yad ahanyata saṃgrāme diṣṭam etat purātanam

vulgate_text: ukto'pi vidureṇāhaṃ hitaṃ pathyaṃ ca nityaśaḥ / na ca jagrāha tanmandaḥ putro duryodhano mama
ce_text: ukto hi vidureṇeha hitaṃ pathyaṃ ca saṃjaya / na ca gṛhṇāti tan mandaḥ putro duryodhano mama

vulgate_text: athālokya praviṣṭaṃ tamūcuste sarva eva tu / jīvagrāhaṃ nigṛhṇīmo vayamenaṃ narādhipāḥ
ce_text: athāhvayanta te 'nyonyam ayaṃ prāpto vṛkodaraḥ / jīvagrāhaṃ nigṛhṇīmo vayam enaṃ narādhipāḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ śatasahasrāṇi rathināṃ sarvaśaḥ prabho / udyatāni śaraistīvraistamekaṃ parivavrire
ce_text: tataḥ śatasahasrāṇi rathināṃ sarvaśaḥ prabho / chādayānaṃ śarair ghorais tam ekam anuvavrire

vulgate_text: tato rathaṃ samutsṛjya gadāmādāya pāṇḍavaḥ / uvāca sārathiṃ bhīmaṃ sthīyatāmiti bhārata
ce_text: tato rathaṃ samutsṛjya gadām ādāya pāṇḍavaḥ / jaghāna dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ taṃ balaughamahārṇavam

vulgate_text: yāvadetānhaniṣyāmi dhārtarāṣṭrānsahānugān ityuktvā bhīmasenastu praviśya mahatīṃ camūm / jaghāna dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ tadbalaughamahārṇavam
ce_text: tato rathaṃ samutsṛjya gadām ādāya pāṇḍavaḥ / jaghāna dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ taṃ balaughamahārṇavam

vulgate_text: punaryuddhāya samare pratyudyātā jigīṣavaḥ / tato yudhiṣṭhiraḥ prāha samāhūya svasainikān
ce_text: tato yudhiṣṭhiraḥ prāha samāhūya svasainikān / gacchantu padavīṃ śaktyā bhīmapārṣatayor yudhi

vulgate_text: pravṛttimadhigacchantu na hi śuddhyati me manaḥ / pravṛttirbhimasenasya pārṣatasya ca saṃyuge
ce_text: saubhadrapramukhā vīrā rathā dvādaśa daṃśitāḥ / pravṛttim adhigacchantu na hi śudhyati me manaḥ

vulgate_text: droṇamiṣvastrakuśalaṃ sarvavidyāsu pāragam dṛṣṭvā tu sahasāyāntaṃ pāñcālyo gurumātmanaḥ / nāśaṃsata vadhaṃ vīraḥ putrāṇāṃ tava pārṣataḥ
ce_text: dṛṣṭvā ca sahasāyāntaṃ pāñcālyo gurum ātmanaḥ / nāśaṃsata vadhaṃ vīraḥ putrāṇāṃ tava pārṣataḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ saṃprekṣya putraiste bhīmasenaṃ samāvṛtam / abhimanyuprabhṛtayaste dvadaśa mahārathāḥ
ce_text: tataḥ saṃsthāpya samare svāny anīkāni sarvaśaḥ / abhimanyuprabhṛtayas te dvādaśa mahārathāḥ

vulgate_text: athābhimanyuḥ samare bhīmasenena saṃgataḥ / pārṣatena ca te sarve kaikayā draupadīsutāḥ
ce_text: athābhimanyuṃ samare bhīmasenena saṃgatam / pārṣatena ca saṃprekṣya tava sainye mahārathāḥ

vulgate_text: sa gāḍhaviddho vyathito bhīmasenena saṃyuge / niṣasāda rathopasthe mūrcchābhihatacetanaḥ
ce_text: sa gāḍhaviddho vyathito bhīmasenena saṃyuge / niṣasāda rathopasthe rājā duryodhanas tadā

vulgate_text: tataḥ sa rājā sindhūnāṃ rathaśreṣṭho mahābalaḥ / duryodhanasya jagrāha pārṣṇiṃ svapuruṣairvṛtaḥ
ce_text: tatas tu rājā sindhūnāṃ rathaśreṣṭho jayadrathaḥ / duryodhanasya jagrāha pārṣṇiṃ satpuruṣocitām

vulgate_text: kṛpaśca rathināṃ śreṣṭhastava putramacetanam / āropayadrathaṃ rājanduryodhanamamarṣaṇam
ce_text: kṛpaś ca rathināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ kauravyam amitaujasam / āropayad rathaṃ rājan duryodhanam amarṣaṇam

vulgate_text: sa tairvikarṇasya rathātpātayāmāsa vīryavān / dhvajaṃ sūtaṃ hayāṃścaiva nṛtyamāna ivāhave
ce_text: vikarṇasya tato bhallān preṣayām āsa bhārata / caturdaśa rathaśreṣṭho ghorān āśīviṣopamān / dhvajaṃ sūtaṃ hayāṃś cāsya chittvā nṛtyann ivāhave

vulgate_text: vivyādha daśabhistūrṇaṃ jayatsenaṃ śilīmukhaiḥ / nanāda sumahānādaṃ prabhinna iva vāraṇaḥ
ce_text: śatānīkas tu samare dṛḍhaṃ visphārya kārmukam / vivyādha daśabhis tūrṇaṃ jayatsenaṃ śilīmukhaiḥ

vulgate_text: sa papāta tato bhūmau vajrāhata iva drumaḥ / duṣkarṇaṃ vyathitaṃ dṛṣṭvā pañca rājanmahārathāḥ
ce_text: duṣkarṇaṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā pañca rājan mahārathāḥ / jighāṃsantaḥ śatānīkaṃ sarvataḥ paryavārayan

vulgate_text: nāśayāmāsaturvīrau dhṛṣṭadyumnavṛkodarau / karavāṇāmanīkāni śaraiḥ sannataparvabhiḥ
ce_text: ājaghāna tatas tūrṇam abhimanyur mahāmanāḥ / ekaikaṃ pañcabhir viddhvā śaraiḥ saṃnataparvabhiḥ / vajramṛtyupratīkāśair vicitrāyudhaniḥsṛtaiḥ

vulgate_text: raṇe tavārthāya mahānubhāva na jīvitaṃ rakṣitavyaṃ mamādya / sarvāṃstavārthāya sadevadaityām̐- llokāndaheyaṃ kimu śatrusenām - - atānpāṇḍavānyodhayiṣyāmi rājan priyaṃ ca te sarvamahaṃ kariṣye / sañjaya uvāca / śrutvā pituste vacanaṃ pratīto duryodhanaḥ prītamanā babhūva
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tato duryodhano rājā lohitāyati bhāskare / saṃgrāmarabhaso bhīmaṃ hantukāmo 'bhyadhāvata

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvā duryodhano rājā raṇe pārthasya vikramam tvaramāṇaḥ samabhyetya sarvāṃstānabravīnnṛpān - - ateṣāṃ tu pramukhe śūraṃ suśarmāṇaṃ mahābalam madhye sarvasya sainyasya bhṛśaṃ saṃharṣayanniva
ce_text: dṛṣṭvā duryodhano rājan raṇe pārthasya vikramam / tvaramāṇaḥ samabhyetya sarvāṃs tān abravīn nṛpān

vulgate_text: ........ māghavatā jitvā bhārata sātyakiḥ / śaineyaḥ prāṇadajjitvā yodhānāṃ tava paśyatām
ce_text: tam ajeyaṃ rākṣasendraṃ saṃkhye maghavatā api / śaineyaḥ prāṇadaj jitvā yodhānāṃ tava paśyatām

vulgate_text: teṣāṃ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ samuhadroṇaharṣaṇam / yudhāmanyuḥ susaṃkruddho bhrātarau devarūpiṇau
ce_text: irāvāṃs tu susaṃkruddho bhrātarau devarūpiṇau / vivyādha niśitais tūrṇaṃ śaraiḥ saṃnataparvabhiḥ / tāv enaṃ pratyavidhyetāṃ samare citrayodhinau

vulgate_text: tataḥ prahasya samare nakulasya mahārathaḥ / dhvajaṃ ciccheda bāṇena dhanuścaikena māriṣa
ce_text: tataḥ prahasya samare nakulasya mahārathaḥ / aśvān vai caturo rājaṃś caturbhiḥ sāyakottamaiḥ / preṣayām āsa samare yamasya sadanaṃ prati

vulgate_text: tatastu tvarito rājañśrutāyuṣamarindaman / nijaghne sāyakaistīkṣṇairnavabhirnataparvabhiḥka
ce_text: abhyadhāvat tato rājā śrutāyuṣam ariṃdamam / vinighnan sāyakais tīkṣṇair navabhir nataparvabhiḥ

vulgate_text: āryāṃ yuddhe matiṃ kṛtvā na tyajanti sma saṃyugam / yathotsāhaṃ tu samare nijaghnustāvakā raṇe
ce_text: te hanyamānāḥ samare tāvakāḥ puruṣarṣabha / āryāṃ yuddhe matiṃ kṛtvā na tyajanti sma saṃyugam / yathotsāhaṃ ca samare jaghnur lokaṃ mahārathāḥ

vulgate_text: paśya vyūhaṃ maheṣvāsa nirmitaṃ sāgaropamam / prativyūhaṃ raṇe śūra kuru kṣipraṃ mahāratha
ce_text: paśya vyūhaṃ maheṣvāsa nirmitaṃ sāgaropamam / prativyūhaṃ tvam api hi kuru pārṣata māciram

vulgate_text: tataḥ śūrāḥ samāsādya samare te parasparama netrairanimiṣai rājannavaikṣanta parasparam - - amanobhiste manuṣyendra yuddhaṃ yodhāḥ pracakrire punarāhūya te'nyonyaṃ śarīrairapi cakrire
ce_text: tataḥ śūrāḥ samāsādya samare te parasparam / netrair animiṣai rājann avaikṣanta prakopitāḥ

vulgate_text: kekayā dhṛṣṭaketuśca kuntibhojaśca daṃśitaḥ / śuktānīkā mahārāja bhīṣmameva samabhyayuḥ
ce_text: dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ śikhaṇḍī ca sātyakiś ca mahārathaḥ / yuktānīkā mahārāja bhīṣmam eva samabhyayuḥ

vulgate_text: arjuno draupadaścaiva kuntibhojaśca daṃśitaḥ / duryodhanasamādiṣṭānrājñaḥ sarvānsamabhyayuḥ
ce_text: arjuno draupadeyāś ca cekitānaś ca saṃyuge / duryodhanasamādiṣṭān rājñaḥ sarvān samabhyayuḥ

vulgate_text: vanāyujānāṃ śubhrāṇāṃ tathā parvatavāsinām / vājināṃ bahubhiḥ saṅkhye samantātparivārayan
ce_text: vanāyujānāṃ śubhrāṇāṃ tathā parvatavāsinām / ye cāpare tittirajā javanā vātaraṃhasaḥ

vulgate_text: khamutpatya mahārāja nāgarāṭ satyavikramaḥ / indralokaṃ jagāmāśu śrutvā tatrārjunaṃ gatam
ce_text: rūpavān vīryasaṃpanno guṇavān satyavikramaḥ / indralokaṃ jagāmāśu śrutvā tatrārjunaṃ gatam

vulgate_text: nyavedayata cātmānamarjunasya mahātmanaḥ / irāvānasmi bhadraṃ te putraścāhaṃ tava prabho
ce_text: so 'bhigamya mahātmānaṃ pitaraṃ satyavikramam / abhyavādayad avyagro vinayena kṛtāñjaliḥ / irāvān asmi bhadraṃ te putraś cāhaṃ tavābhibho

vulgate_text: yuddhakāle tu sāhāyyaṃ dātavyaṃ no bhavediti / bāḍhamityevamuktvā tu yuddhakāla ihāgataḥ
ce_text: bāḍham ity evam uktvā ca yuddhakāla upāgataḥ / kāmavarṇajavair aśvaiḥ saṃvṛto bahubhir nṛpa

vulgate_text: kāmavarṇajavairaśvaiḥ sarvataḥ śuśubhe vṛtaḥ / te hayāḥ kāñcanāpīḍā nānāvarṇā manojavāḥ
ce_text: te hayāḥ kāñcanāpīḍā nānāvarṇā manojavāḥ / utpetuḥ sahasā rājan haṃsā iva mahodadhau

vulgate_text: abravītsamare yodhānsvānvicitrahayasthitān / yathaite dhārtarāṣṭrasya yodhāḥ sānugavāhanāḥ
ce_text: yathaite dhārtarāṣṭrasya yodhāḥ sānugavāhanāḥ / hanyante samare sarve tathā nītir vidhīyatām

vulgate_text: irāvānapi khaṅgena darśayanpāṇilāghavam / abhyavartata devāṃśca mānuṣāṃścaiva saṃyuge
ce_text: irāvān api khaḍgena darśayan pāṇilāghavam / abhyavartata tān sarvān saubalān baladarpitaḥ

vulgate_text: bhūmiṣṭhamatha taṃ sahkhye hyantarikṣādavaplutam / parivārya bhṛśaṃ sarve grahītumupacakramuḥ
ce_text: bhūmiṣṭham atha taṃ saṃkhye saṃpradṛśya tataḥ punaḥ / parivārya bhṛśaṃ sarve grahītum upacakramuḥ

vulgate_text: [hataśeṣairmahārāja dvisāhastrairhayottamaiḥ] nihantukāmaḥ samare irāvantaṃ mahābalam
ce_text: svārūḍhair yuddhakuśalair vimalaprāsayodhibhiḥ / vīraiḥ prahāribhir yuktaḥ svair anīkaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ / nihantukāmaḥ samare irāvantaṃ mahābalam

vulgate_text: paraśvathena tīkṣṇena ciccheda ca punaḥ punaḥ sa tena balinā vīraśchidyamāna iva drumaḥ - - arākṣaso vyanadaddhoraṃ sa śabdastumulo'bhavat paraśvathakṣataṃ rakṣaḥ susrāva bahuśoṇitam
ce_text: sa tena balinā vīraś chidyamāna iva drumaḥ / rākṣaso vyanadad ghoraṃ sa śabdas tumulo 'bhavat

vulgate_text: kṛtvā ghoraṃ mahadrūpaṃ grahītumupacakrame / arjunasya sutaṃ vīramirāvantaṃ yaśasvinam
ce_text: ārśyaśṛṅgis tato dṛṣṭvā samare śatrum ūrjitam / kṛtvā ghoraṃ mahad rūpaṃ grahītum upacakrame / saṃgrāmaśiraso madhye sarveṣāṃ tatra paśyatām

vulgate_text: na sma paśyāmahe kaṃcitprāṇānyaḥ parirakṣati / daivāsurābhe samare tasminyodhā narādhipa
ce_text: na sma paśyāmahe kaṃ cid yaḥ prāṇān parirakṣati / saṃgrāme daityasaṃkāśe tasmin yoddhā narādhipa

vulgate_text: antarikṣaṃ diśaścaiva sarvāśca pradiśastathā celuśca sahasā tatra tena nādena nāditāḥ
ce_text: nadatas tasya śabdena pṛthivī sāgarāmbarā / saparvatavanā rājaṃś cacāla subhṛśaṃ tadā / antarikṣaṃ diśaś caiva sarvāś ca pradiśas tathā

vulgate_text: na vivyathe mahārāja putro duryodhanastava / athainamabravītkruddhaḥ krūraḥ saṃraktalocanaḥ / ghaṭotkaca uvāca
ce_text: tam āpatantam udvīkṣya kālasṛṣṭam ivāntakam / na vivyathe mahārāja putro duryodhanas tava

vulgate_text: adyānṛṇyaṃ gamiṣyāmi pitṝṇāṃ mātureva ca / ye tvayā sunṛśaṃsena dīrghakālaṃ pravāsitāḥ
ce_text: athainam abravīt kruddhaḥ krūraḥ saṃraktalocanaḥ / ye tvayā sunṛśaṃsena dīrghakālaṃ pravāsitāḥ / yac ca te pāṇḍavā rājaṃś chaladyūte parājitāḥ

vulgate_text: bhūyaśca ninanādoṣaṃ krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ / trāsayāmāsa raunyāni yugante jalado yathā
ce_text: bhūya eva nanādograḥ krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ / trāsayan sarvabhūtāni yugānte jalado yathā

vulgate_text: droṇaśca somadattaśca bāhlīko'tha jayadrathaḥ / kṛpo bhiriśravāḥ śalya āvantyaḥ sa bṛhadbalaḥ
ce_text: droṇaś ca somadattaś ca bāhlikaś ca jayadrathaḥ / kṛpo bhūriśravāḥ śalyaś citraseno viviṃśatiḥ

vulgate_text: aśvatthāmā vikarṇaśca citraseno viviṃśatiḥ / rathāścānekasāhasrā ye teṣāmanuyāyinaḥ
ce_text: aśvatthāmā vikarṇaś ca āvantyaś ca bṛhadbalaḥ / rathāś cānekasāhasrā ye teṣām anuyāyinaḥ / abhidrutaṃ parīpsantaḥ putraṃ duryodhanaṃ tava

vulgate_text: bhūriśravasi saṃkruddhaḥ prāhiṇodbharatarṣabha / te varma bhittvā tasyāśu viviśurdharaṇītalam
ce_text: tataḥ punar ameyātmā nārācān daśa pañca ca / bhūriśravasi saṃkruddhaḥ prāhiṇod bharatarṣabha / te varma bhittvā tasyāśu prāviśan medinītalam

vulgate_text: atibhāraṃ ca paśyāmi tasminrākṣasapuṅgave / pitāmahaśca saṃkruddhaḥ pāñcālānhantumudyataḥ
ce_text: pitāmahaś ca saṃkruddhaḥ pāñcālān hantum udyataḥ / teṣāṃ ca rakṣaṇārthāya yudhyate phalgunaḥ paraiḥ

vulgate_text: hayā hayaiḥ samājagmuḥ pādātāśca padātibhiḥ rathā rathaiḥ samāgacchannāgā nāgaiśca saṃyuge / anyonyaṃ samare rājanprārthayānāḥ samabhyayuḥ
ce_text: hayā gajaiḥ samājagmuḥ pādātā rathibhiḥ saha / anyonyaṃ samare rājan prārthayānā mahad yaśaḥ

vulgate_text: yena lokatrayaṃ krodhātrāsitaṃ svena tejasāka - - bsa rudreṇa jitaḥ pūrvaṃ nihato mātariśvanā / tathā nīlena nirbhinnaḥ samyaṅbhuktena patriṇā
ce_text: vipracittiṃ durādharṣaṃ devatānāṃ bhayaṃkaram / yena lokatrayaṃ krodhāt trāsitaṃ svena tejasā

vulgate_text: jaghāna caturo vāhānpātayāmāsa ca dhvajam sūtaṃ caikena bhallena rathanīḍādapāharat / saptamena ca bhallena nīlaṃ vivyādha vakṣasi
ce_text: tataḥ saṃdhāya vimalān bhallān karmārapāyitān / jaghāna caturo vāhān pātayām āsa ca dhvajam

vulgate_text: ghaṭotkaco'bhisaṃkruddho jñātibhiḥ parivāritaḥ abhidudrāva vegena drauṇimāhavaśobhinam / tathetare cābhyadhāvanrākṣasā yuddhadurmadāḥ - - a bhīmaseno mahābāhurnīlaṃ nīlāñjanaprabham āropya svarathaṃ vīro duryodhanamapādravat
ce_text: abhidudrāva vegena drauṇim āhavaśobhinam / tathetare abhyadhāvan rākṣasā yuddhadurmadāḥ

vulgate_text: anyonyaṃ samapaśyanta nikṛttā medinītale / viceṣṭamānāḥ kṛpaṇāḥ śoṇitena pariplutāḥ
ce_text: tatas te tāvakāḥ sarve māyayā vimukhīkṛtāḥ / anyonyaṃ samapaśyanta nikṛttān medinītale / viceṣṭamānān kṛpaṇāñ śoṇitena samukṣitān

vulgate_text: ghaṭotkacena sahitāḥ siṃhanādānpracakrire / śaṅkhadundubhinirghoṣaiḥ samantānnedire bhṛśam
ce_text: tāṃś ca pradravato dṛṣṭvā jayaṃ prāptāś ca pāṇḍavāḥ / ghaṭotkacena sahitāḥ siṃhanādān pracakrire / śaṅkhadundubhighoṣāś ca samantāt sasvanur bhṛśam

vulgate_text: bhavantaṃ samupāśritya droṇaṃ caiva pitāmaha / pāṇḍavairvigraho ghoraḥ samārabdho mayā prabho
ce_text: bhavantaṃ samupāśritya vāsudevaṃ yathā paraiḥ / pāṇḍavair vigraho ghoraḥ samārabdho mayā prabho

vulgate_text: arjunena yamābhyāṃ vā bhīmasenena vā punaḥ / anyairvā pṛthivīpālai rājā rājānamṛcchati
ce_text: arjunena yamābhyāṃ vā bhīmasenena vā punaḥ / rājadharmaṃ puraskṛtya rājā rājānam ṛcchati

vulgate_text: na tu kāryastvayā rājanhaiḍimbena durātmā ahaṃ droṇaḥ kṛpo drauṇiḥ kṛtavarmā ca sātvataḥ / śalyaśca vṛṣasenaśca vikarṇaśca mahārathaḥ
ce_text: ahaṃ droṇaḥ kṛpo drauṇiḥ kṛtavarmā ca sātvataḥ / śalyaś ca saumadattiś ca vikarṇaś ca mahārathaḥ

vulgate_text: sa bhīmaṃ śaradhārābhistājayāmāsa pārthivaḥ / parvataṃ vāridhārābhistapānte jalado yathā
ce_text: sa bhīmaṃ śaradhārābhis tāḍayām āsa pārthivaḥ / parvataṃ vāridhārābhiḥ prāvṛṣīva balāhakaḥ

vulgate_text: cedipo dhṛṣṭaketuśca saṃrabdhāḥ sarva eva te / uttamāstrāṇi divyāni darśayanto mahābalāḥ
ce_text: uttamāstrāṇi divyāni darśayanto mahābalāḥ / tam ekaṃ kuñjaraṃ kruddhāḥ samantāt paryavārayan

vulgate_text: sādhusādhviti sainyāni tvadīyānyabhyapūjayan / tataḥ prāgjyotiṣaḥ kruddhastomarānvai caturdaśa
ce_text: tataḥ prāgjyotiṣaḥ kruddhas tomarān vai caturdaśa / prāhiṇot tasya nāgasya pramukhe nṛpasattama

vulgate_text: tamāpatantaṃ sahasā dṛṣṭvā prāgjyotiṣo nṛpaḥ / cikṣepa ruciraṃ tīkṣṇamardhacandraṃ sudāruṇam
ce_text: tam āpatantaṃ sahasā dṛṣṭvā jvālākulaṃ raṇe / cikṣepa ruciraṃ tīkṣṇam ardhacandraṃ sa pārthivaḥ / ciccheda sumahac chūlaṃ tena bāṇena vegavat

vulgate_text: abhimanyuṃ tribhiścaiva kekayānpañca pañcabhiḥ / pūrṇāyatavisṛṣṭena śareṇānataparvaṇā
ce_text: bhīmam ekena vivyādha rākṣasaṃ navabhiḥ śaraiḥ / abhimanyuṃ tribhiś caiva kekayān pañcabhis tathā

vulgate_text: etadarthaṃ mayā yuddhaṃ rocitaṃ madhusūdana / saṃcodaya hayāñśīghraṃ dhārtarāṣṭracamūṃ prati
ce_text: saṃcodaya hayān kṣipraṃ dhārtarāṣṭracamūṃ prati / pratariṣye mahāpāraṃ bhujābhyāṃ samarodadhim / nāyaṃ klībayituṃ kālo vidyate mādhava kva cit

vulgate_text: vyūḍhoraskastato bhīmaḥ pothayāmāsa pārthivam / kṣurapreṇa sutīkṣṇena sumuktena mahāraṇe
ce_text: vyūḍhoraskaṃ tato bhīmaḥ pātayām āsa pārthiva / kṣurapreṇa sutīkṣṇena so 'bhavad gatajīvitaḥ

vulgate_text: tāḍayāmāsa saṃkruddhaḥ so'bhavadvyathitendriyaḥ apareṇa tu bhallena pītena niśitena tu / apātayatkuṇḍalitaṃ siṃhaḥ kṣudramṛgaṃ yathā
ce_text: apareṇa tu bhallena pītena niśitena ca / apātayat kuṇḍalinaṃ siṃhaḥ kṣudramṛgaṃ yathā

vulgate_text: khaṅgāśca dāntatsaravo jātarūpapariṣkṛtāḥ / carmāṇi cāpaviddhāni rukmacitrāṇi dhanvināṃ
ce_text: hastidantatsarūn khaḍgāñ jātarūpapariṣkṛtān / carmāṇi cāpaviddhāni rukmapṛṣṭhāni dhanvinām

vulgate_text: rathaiśca sarvato bhagnaiḥ kiṅkiṇījālabhūṣitaiḥ / vājibhiśca hatairbāṇaiḥ srastajihvaiḥ saśoṇitaiḥ
ce_text: rathaiś ca bahubhir bhagnaiḥ kiṅkiṇījālamālibhiḥ / vājibhiś ca hataiḥ kīrṇaiḥ srastajihvaiḥ saśoṇitaiḥ

vulgate_text: yantraiśca bahudhā cchinnaistomaraiścāpi kāñcanaiḥ rarāja subhṛśaṃ bhūmistatratatra viśāṃpate / aśvānāṃ reṇukapilai rukmacchannairuraśchadaiḥ
ce_text: aśvānāṃ reṇukapilai rukmacchannair uraśchadaiḥ / sādināṃ ca bhujaiś chinnaiḥ patitaiḥ sāṅgadais tathā

vulgate_text: ghore niśāmukhe raudre vartamāne mahābhaye avahāraṃ tataḥ kṛtvā sahitāḥ kurupāṇaḍvāḥ / nyaviśanta niśākāle gatvā svaśibiraṃ tadā
ce_text: tato 'vahāraṃ sainyānāṃ pracakruḥ kurupāṇḍavāḥ / ghore niśāmukhe raudre vartamāne sudāruṇe

vulgate_text: āgamiṣye tataḥ kṣipraṃ tvatsakāśamarindama / apakrānte tato bhīṣme prahariṣyasi saṃyuge
ce_text: āgamiṣye tataḥ kṣipraṃ tvatsakāśam ariṃdama / tatas tvaṃ puruṣavyāghra prakariṣyasi saṃyugam

vulgate_text: udvṛtya cakṣuṣī lopānnirdahanniva bhārata / sadevāsuragandharvaṃ lokaṃ kāla ivāparaḥ
ce_text: udvṛtya cakṣuṣī kopān nirdahann iva bhārata / sadevāsuragandharvaṃ lokaṃ lokavidāṃ varaḥ / abravīt tava putraṃ tu sāmapūrvam idaṃ vacaḥ

vulgate_text: abravīttava putraṃ ca sāmapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ / kiṃ tvaṃ duryodhanaivaṃ māṃ vākśalyairapakṛntasi
ce_text: udvṛtya cakṣuṣī kopān nirdahann iva bhārata / sadevāsuragandharvaṃ lokaṃ lokavidāṃ varaḥ / abravīt tava putraṃ tu sāmapūrvam idaṃ vacaḥ

vulgate_text: tathā drauṇiṃ maheṣvāsaṃ śāradvatamathāpi ca / gograhe jitavānpūrvaṃ paryāptaṃ tannidarśanam
ce_text: droṇaṃ ca yudhi saṃrabdhaṃ māṃ ca nirjitya saṃyuge / karṇaṃ ca tvāṃ ca drauṇiṃ ca kṛpaṃ ca sumahāratham / vāsāṃsi sa samādatta paryāptaṃ tan nidarśanam

vulgate_text: vijitya ca yadā karṇaṃ sadā puruṣamāninam / uttarāyai dadau vastraṃ paryāptaṃ tannidarśanam
ce_text: yadā tu pāṇḍavaḥ śūraḥ khāṇḍave 'gnim atarpayat / parājitya raṇe śakraṃ paryāptaṃ tan nidarśanam

vulgate_text: ko hi śakto raṇe jetuṃ pāṇḍavaṃ rabhasaṃ tadā / yasya goptā jagadgoptā śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ
ce_text: ko hi śakto raṇe jetuṃ pāṇḍavaṃ rabhasaṃ raṇe / tvaṃ tu mohān na jānīṣe vācyāvācyaṃ suyodhana

vulgate_text: ukto'sti bahuśo rājannāradādyairmaharṣibhiḥ / tvaṃ tu mohānna jānīṣe vācyāvācyaṃ suyodhana
ce_text: ko hi śakto raṇe jetuṃ pāṇḍavaṃ rabhasaṃ raṇe / tvaṃ tu mohān na jānīṣe vācyāvācyaṃ suyodhana

vulgate_text: abhimanyurmaheṣvāso drupadaśca mahābalaḥ / yuyudhāno maheṣvāso yudhāmanyuśca vīryavān
ce_text: abhimanyur maheṣvāso drupadaś ca mahārathaḥ / kekayā bhrātaraḥ pañca sthitā yuddhāya daṃśitāḥ

vulgate_text: bhīṣmaṃ yoddhumabhīpsantaḥ saṃgrāme vijayaiṣiṇaḥ / kṣvelāḥ kilakilāḥ śaṅkhānkrakacāngoviṣāṇikāḥ
ce_text: kṣveḍāḥ kilikilāśabdān krakacān goviṣāṇikāḥ / bherīmṛdaṅgapaṇavān nādayantaś ca puṣkarān / pāṇḍavā abhyadhāvanta nadanto bhairavān ravān

vulgate_text: sarathānrathinastūrṇaṃ hayāṃścaiva sasādinaḥ / gajārohāṃśca sagajāndārayāmāsa phālguniḥ
ce_text: rathinaṃ ca rathāt tūrṇaṃ hayapṛṣṭhāc ca sādinam / gajārohāṃś ca sagajān pātayām āsa phālguniḥ

vulgate_text: tāṃ vadhyamānāṃ ca tathā pāṇḍavānāṃ mahācamūm / pratyadyayau raṇe rakṣo devasenāṃ yathā balaḥ
ce_text: sā vadhyamānā samare pāṇḍavānāṃ mahācamūḥ / pratyudyayau raṇe rakṣo devasenā yathā balim

vulgate_text: parasparamavekṣetāṃ kālānalasamau yudhi āśīviṣāviva kruddhau netrābhyāmitaretaram / tayoḥ samāgamo ghoro babhūva kaṭukodayaḥ
ce_text: tayoḥ samāgamo ghoro babhūva kaṭukodayaḥ / yathā devāsure yuddhe śakraśambarayor iva

vulgate_text: abhidudrāva vegena tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti cābravīt / abhimanyuśca vegena siṃhavadvinadanmuhuḥ
