ce_text: alambusas tu samare abhimanyuṃ mahāratham / vinadya sumahānādaṃ tarjayitvā muhur muhuḥ / abhidudrāva vegena tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti cābravīt

vulgate_text: abhimanyustataḥ kruddho navabhirnataparvabhiḥ / bibheda niśisairbāṇai rākṣasendraṃ mahorasi
ce_text: abhimanyus tataḥ kruddho navatiṃ nataparvaṇām / cikṣepa niśitān bāṇān rākṣasasya mahorasi

vulgate_text: puṣpitaiḥ kiṃśukai rājansaṃstīrṇa iva parvataḥ / sa saṃdadhānaśca śarānhemapuṅkhānmahābalaḥ
ce_text: te tasya viviśus tūrṇaṃ kāyaṃ nirbhidya marmaṇi / sa tair vibhinnasarvāṅgaḥ śuśubhe rākṣasottamaḥ / puṣpitaiḥ kiṃśukai rājan saṃstīrṇa iva parvataḥ

vulgate_text: prāduścakre mahāmāyāṃ tāmasīmarighātinīm / tataste tamasā sarve vṛtāścāsanmahīpate
ce_text: vimukhaṃ ca tato rakṣo vadhyamānaṃ raṇe 'riṇā / prāduścakre mahāmāyāṃ tāmasīṃ paratāpanaḥ

vulgate_text: śaineyo'pi tataḥ kruddhaścāpamānamya vegavān / gautamāntakaraṃ tūrṇaṃ samādhatta śilīmukham
ce_text: śaineyo 'pi tataḥ kruddho bhṛśaṃ viddho mahārathaḥ / gautamāntakaraṃ ghoraṃ samādatta śilīmukham

vulgate_text: viṣāṇollikhitairgātraurviṣāṇābhihato bhṛśam / viṣāṇe dantinaṃ gṛhya nirviṣāṇamathākarot
ce_text: viṣāṇe dantinaṃ gṛhya nirviṣāṇam athākarot / viṣāṇena ca tenaiva kumbhe 'bhyāhatya dantinam / pātayām āsa samare daṇḍahasta ivāntakaḥ

vulgate_text: saṃmamarda ca tatsainyaṃ pitā devavratastava / mardayecca yathā rājansiṃhaḥ prāpya mṛgavrajam
ce_text: saṃmamarda ca tat sainyaṃ pitā devavratas tava / dhānyānām iva lūnānāṃ prakaraṃ gogaṇā iva

vulgate_text: so'tividdho mahārāja śoṇitaughapariplutaḥ / vasante puṣpaśabalo raktāśoka ivābabhau
ce_text: so 'tividdho mahārāja bhīṣmaḥ saṃkhye mahātmabhiḥ / vasante puṣpaśabalo raktāśoka ivābabhau

vulgate_text: abhyadravanta gāṅgeyaṃ yudhiṣṭhirasamājñayā / prati rakṣaṇakāryārthaṃ dhṛṣṭadyumnamukhānraṇe
ce_text: abhyadravanta gāṅgeyaṃ yudhiṣṭhirahitepsayā / rirakṣiṣantaḥ pāñcālyaṃ dhṛṣṭadyumnamukhan raṇe

vulgate_text: carmabhiścāmaraiścitraiḥ patākābhiśca māriṣa / chatraiḥ sitairhemadaṇḍaiścāmaraiśca samantataḥ
ce_text: varmabhiś cāmaraiś chatraiḥ patākābhiś ca māriṣa / kakṣyābhir atha tottraiś ca ghaṇṭābhis tomarais tathā

vulgate_text: rathāścaiva samāsādya patitāṃsturagānbhuvi / vyamṛdgansamare rājaṃsturagāṃśca narānrame
ce_text: vyamṛdnāt samare rājaṃs turagāṃś ca narān raṇe / evaṃ te bahudhā rājan pramṛdnantaḥ parasparam

vulgate_text: evaṃ te bahudhā rājanpratyamṛdganparasparam dṛśyantesma mahābāho tatratatra mahābalāḥ
ce_text: vyamṛdnāt samare rājaṃs turagāṃś ca narān raṇe / evaṃ te bahudhā rājan pramṛdnantaḥ parasparam

vulgate_text: etasmātkāraṇāddhoro vartate svajanakṣayaḥ daivādvā puruṣavyāghra tava cāpanayānnṛpa iti śrāmanmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi navamadivasayuddhe tryadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
ce_text: etasmāt kāraṇād ghoro vartate sma janakṣayaḥ / daivād vā puruṣavyāghra tava cāpanayān nṛpa

vulgate_text: ārjuniścitrasenena viddho bahubhiraśugaiḥ atiṣṭhadāhave śūraḥ kiranbāṇānsahasraśaḥ / citrasenaṃ tribhirbāṇairvivyādha samare bhṛśam
ce_text: ārjuniś citrasenena viddho bahubhir āśugaiḥ / citrasenaṃ tribhir bāṇair vivyādha hṛdaye bhṛśam

vulgate_text: heṣatāṃ caiva śabdena na prājñāyata kiṃcana antardadhe mahāñśabdastena śabdena mohitaḥ
ce_text: vegavadbhir hayais tais tu kṣobhitaṃ pāṇḍavaṃ balam / nipatadbhir mahāvegair haṃsair iva mahat saraḥ / heṣatāṃ caiva śabdena na prājñāyata kiṃ cana

vulgate_text: samādino hayā rājaṃstatratatra niṣūditāḥ / patitāḥ pātyamānāśca pratyadṛśyanta sarvaśaḥ
ce_text: sasādino hayā rājaṃs tatra tatra niṣūditāḥ / patitāḥ pātyamānāś ca śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ

vulgate_text: eṣa pāṇḍusuto jyeṣṭho yamābhyāṃ sahito raṇe / paśyatāṃ vo mahābāho senāṃ drāvayati prabho
ce_text: eṣa pāṇḍusuto jyeṣṭho jitvā mātula māmakān / paśyatāṃ no mahābāho senāṃ drāvayate balī

vulgate_text: gāṅgeyastvabravītpārthaṃ dhanviśreṣṭhamariṃdama / sādhusādhu mahābāho sādhu kuntīsuteti ca
ce_text: tasya tat pūjayām āsa lāghavaṃ śaṃtanoḥ sutaḥ / sādhu pārtha mahābāho sādhu kuntīsuteti ca

vulgate_text: utsṛjya rajataprakhyānhayānpārthasya māriṣa / vāsudevastato yogī pracaskanda mahārathāt
ce_text: utsṛjya rajataprakhyān hayān pārthasya māriṣa / kruddho nāma mahāyogī pracaskanda mahārathāt / abhidudrāva bhīṣmaṃ sa bhujapraharaṇo balī

vulgate_text: tvayā hi deva saṃgrāme hatasyāpi mamānagha / śreya eva paraṃ kṛṣṇa loke bhavati sarvataḥ
ce_text: tvayā hi deva saṃgrāme hatasyāpi mamānagha / śreya eva paraṃ kṛṣṇa loke 'muṣminn ihaiva ca / saṃbhāvito 'smi govinda trailokyenādya saṃyuge

vulgate_text: saṃbhāvito'smi govinda trailokyenādya saṃyuge / praharasva yatheṣṭaṃ vai dāso'smi tava cānagha / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / dṛṣṭvā bhīṣmaṃ raṇe kruddhaṃ pāṇḍavair abhisaṃvṛtam / yathā meghair mahārāja tapānte divi bhāskaram

vulgate_text: kurvāṇaṃ samare karmāṇyatimānuṣavikramam / vīkṣāṃcakrurmahārāja pāṇḍavā bhayapīḍitāḥ
ce_text: te vadhyamānā bhīṣmeṇa kāleneva yugakṣaye / vīkṣāṃ cakrur mahārāja pāṇḍavā bhayapīḍitāḥ

vulgate_text: vimṛdgatastasya tu pāṇḍusenā- mastaṃ jagāmātha sahasraraśmiḥ / tato hi bhīṣmaḥ sabalānsasainyā- nnyavārayatpāṇḍusutāñśaraughaiḥ
ce_text: vimṛdnatas tasya tu pāṇḍusenām; astaṃ jagāmātha sahasraraśmiḥ / tato balānāṃ śramakarśitānāṃ; mano 'vahāraṃ prati saṃbabhūva

vulgate_text: jaghāna caitānsubhṛśaṃ mahābalo mahāvrataḥ pāṇḍusutānmahāstraiḥ / raṇe karūṇādhipacedipairbalai- rvṛtānsadā cakradharasya paśyataḥ tato balānāṃ śramakarśitānāṃ / mano'vahāraṃ prati saṃbabhūva
ce_text: vimṛdnatas tasya tu pāṇḍusenām; astaṃ jagāmātha sahasraraśmiḥ / tato balānāṃ śramakarśitānāṃ; mano 'vahāraṃ prati saṃbabhūva

vulgate_text: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā sandhyāṃ saṃdṛśya bhārata / vadhyamānaṃ ca bhīṣmeṇa tyaktāstraṃ bhayavihvalam
ce_text: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā saṃdhyāṃ saṃdṛśya bhārata / vadhyamānaṃ balaṃ cāpi bhīṣmeṇāmitraghātinā

vulgate_text: somakāṃśca jitāndṛṣṭvā nirutsāhānmahārathān niśāmukhaṃ ca saṃprekṣya ghorarūpaṃ bhayānakam / cintayitvā tato rājñāmapahāramakārayat
ce_text: somakāṃś ca jitān dṛṣṭvā nirutsāhān mahārathān / cintayitvā ciraṃ dhyātvā avahāram arocayat

vulgate_text: samayastu kṛtaḥ kaścinmama bhīṣmeṇa saṃyuge / mantrayiṣye tavārthāya na tu yotsye kathaṃcana
ce_text: samayas tu kṛtaḥ kaś cid bhīṣmeṇa mama mādhava / mantrayiṣye tavārthāya na tu yotsye kathaṃ cana / duryodhanārthe yotsyāmi satyam etad iti prabho

vulgate_text: gatvā śāntanavaṃ vṛddhaṃ mantraṃ pṛcchāma bhārata / sa no dāsyati mantraṃ yaṃ tena yotsyāmahe parān / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tataḥ pitā tava kruddho niśitaiḥ sāyakottamaiḥ / ājaghāna raṇe pārthān sahasenān samantataḥ

vulgate_text: yuddhādanyatra he vatsāḥ prīyantāṃ mā viśaṅkatha sarvātmanāpi kartāsmi yadapi syātsaduṣkaram / tathā bruvāṇaṃ gāṅgeyaṃ prītiyuktaṃ punaḥpunaḥ
ce_text: tathā bruvāṇaṃ gāṅgeyaṃ prītiyuktaṃ punaḥ punaḥ / uvāca vākyaṃ dīnātmā dharmaputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ

vulgate_text: uvāca rājā dīnātmā prītiyuktamidaṃ vacaḥ / kathaṃ jayema sarvajña kathaṃ rājyaṃ labhemahi
ce_text: kathaṃ jayema dharmajña kathaṃ rājyaṃ labhemahi / prajānāṃ saṃkṣayo na syāt kathaṃ tan me vadābhibho

vulgate_text: ko'thavotsahate jetuṃ vāṃ pumānbharatarṣabha / varṣatā śaravarṣāṇi mahānti puruṣarṣabha
ce_text: narāśvarathanāgānāṃ hantāraṃ paravīrahan / ka ivotsahate hantuṃ tvāṃ pumān bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: mama sainyasya ca kṣemaṃ tanme brūhi pitāmaha - - ḷsañjaya uvāca tato'bravīcchāntanavaḥ pāṇḍavānpāṇḍupūrvaja
ce_text: yathā yudhi jayeyaṃ tvāṃ yathā rājyaṃ bhaven mama / bhavet sainyasya vā śāntis tan me brūhi pitāmaha

vulgate_text: na kathaṃcana kaunteya mayi jīvati saṃyuge / jayo bhavati sarvajña satyametadbravīmi te
ce_text: tato 'bravīc chāṃtanavaḥ pāṇḍavān pāṇḍupūrvaja / na kathaṃ cana kaunteya mayi jīvati saṃyuge / yuṣmāsu dṛśyate vṛddhiḥ satyam etad bravīmi vaḥ

vulgate_text: nirjite mayi yuddhena raṇe jeṣyatha pāṇḍavāḥ / kṣipraṃ mayi praharata yadīcchatha raṇe jayam
ce_text: nirjite mayi yuddhe tu dhruvaṃ jeṣyatha kauravān / kṣipraṃ mayi praharata yadīcchatha raṇe jayam / anujānāmi vaḥ pārthāḥ praharadhvaṃ yathāsukham

vulgate_text: anujānāmi vaḥ pārthāḥ praharadhvaṃ yathāsukham evaṃ hi sukṛtaṃ manye bhavatāṃ vidito hyaham / hate mayi hataṃ sarvaṃ tasmādevaṃ vidhīyatām / yudhiṣṭhira uvāca
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca / evam etan mahābāho yathā vadasi mādhava / sarve hy ete na paryāptās tava veganivāraṇe

vulgate_text: nāhaṃ jetuṃ raṇe śakyaḥ sendrairapi surāsuraiḥ āttaśastro raṇe yatto gṛhītavarakārmukaḥ / tato māṃ nyastaśastraṃ tu ete hanyurmahārathāḥ
ce_text: āttaśastro raṇe yatto gṛhītavarakārmukaḥ / nyastaśastraṃ tu māṃ rājan hanyur yudhi mahārathāḥ

vulgate_text: strījite strīpradhāne ca strīpradhāyini dharmaja striyāṃ strīnāmadheye ca vikale caikaputriṇi / aprasūte ca ṣaṇḍe ca na yuddhaṃ rocate mama
ce_text: striyāṃ strīnāmadheye ca vikale caikaputrake / aprasūte ca duṣprekṣye na yuddhaṃ rocate mama

vulgate_text: pārṣataṃ tu purodhāya klībamadya mamāgrataḥ āttaśastro raṇe yatto gṛhītavarakārmukaḥ / māṃ pātayatu bībhatsurevaṃ tava jayo dhruvam
ce_text: eṣa tasmāt purodhāya kaṃ cid anyaṃ mamāgrataḥ / māṃ pātayatu bībhatsur evaṃ te vijayo bhavet

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭametatpurā devairbhaviṣyatyavaśasya te / yaddṛṣṭaṃ hi purā pārtha tattathā na tadanyathā
ce_text: diṣṭam etat purā devair bhaviṣyaty avaśasya te / hantā bhīṣmasya pūrvendra iti tan na tad anyathā

vulgate_text: jyāyāṃsamapi cedvṛddhaṃ guṇairapi samanvitam / ātatāyinamāyāntaṃ hanyāddhātakamātmanaḥ
ce_text: jyāyāṃsam api cec chakra guṇair api samanvitam / ātatāyinam āmantrya hanyād ghātakam āgatam

vulgate_text: āttaśastro raṇe yatnādvārayāmāsa sāyakaiḥ / nānāśastrāstravarṣaistānvīryāmarṣapraveritaiḥ
ce_text: sa pāṇḍavānāṃ pravarān pañca rājan mahārathān / āttaśastrān raṇe yattān vārayām āsa sāyakaiḥ / nārācair vatsadantaiś ca śitair añjalikais tathā

vulgate_text: ahamāvārayiṣyāmi veleva makarālayam kurūṃśca sahitānsarvānyudhyamānānmahābalān / nivārayiṣyāmi raṇe sādhayasva pitāmaham
ce_text: kurūṃś ca sahitān sarvān ye caiṣāṃ sainikāḥ sthitāḥ / nivārayiṣyāmi raṇe sādhayasva pitāmaham

vulgate_text: saṃgrāmādapayāsyāmi hyetatkarma samāhitam / iti tatkṛtavāṃścāhaṃ yathoktaṃ bharatarṣabha
ce_text: hatvā daśa sahasrāṇi kṣatriyāṇāṃ mahātmanām / saṃgrāmād vyapayātavyam etat karma mamāhnikam / iti tat kṛtavāṃś cāhaṃ yathoktaṃ bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: abhyadravata mābhaiṣṭa bhīṣmo hi prāpsyate na vaḥ / arjunaṃ samare yoddhuṃ notsahetāpi vāsavaḥ
ce_text: arjunaṃ samare yoddhuṃ notsahetāpi vāsavaḥ / kim u bhīṣmo raṇe vīrā gatasattvo 'lpajīvitaḥ

vulgate_text: bhīṣmasya jīvitākāṅkṣī dhanañjayamupādravat - - btathaiva pāṇḍavāḥ śūrā gāṅgeyasya rathaṃ prati
ce_text: duḥśāsano mahārāja bhayaṃ tyaktvā mahārathaḥ / bhīṣmasya jīvitākāṅkṣī dhanaṃjayam upādravat

vulgate_text: yamadaṇḍopamāṃ ghorāṃ cikṣepa paramāhave / tāmāpatantīṃ sahasā tasya bāhubaleritām
ce_text: tām āpatantīṃ sahasā tasya bāhor baleritām / sātyakiḥ samare rājaṃs tridhā ciccheda sāyakaiḥ / sā papāta tadā bhūmau maholkeva hataprabhā

vulgate_text: drupadaśca tribhirbāṇairvivyādha niśitaistadā / guruputraṃ samāsādya praharantau mahābalau
ce_text: drupadaś ca tribhir bāṇair vivyādha niśitais tathā / guruputraṃ samāsādya bhīṣmasya purataḥ sthitam

vulgate_text: haiḍimbastu raṇe rājandurmukhaṃ śatrutāpanam / ājaghānorasi kruddhaḥ śareṇānataparvaṇā
ce_text: haiḍimbas tu tato rājan durmukhaṃ śatrutāpanam / ājaghānorasi kruddho navatyā niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ

vulgate_text: ājaghāna mahābāhuḥ pārṣataṃ taṃ mahāratham / taṃ caiva pārṣato rājanhārdikyaṃ navabhiḥ śaraiḥ
ce_text: tathaiva pārṣato rājan hārdikyaṃ navabhiḥ śaraiḥ / vivyādha niśitais tīkṣṇaiḥ kaṅkapatraparicchadaiḥ

vulgate_text: vidhunvāno naraśreṣṭho drāvayāṇo varūthinīm / pṛtanāṃ pāṇḍaveyānāṃ gāhamāno mahābalaḥ
ce_text: vidhunvāno dhanuḥ śreṣṭhaṃ drāvayāṇo mahārathān / pṛtanāṃ pāṇḍaveyānāṃ pātayāno mahārathaḥ

vulgate_text: asaṃkalpadhvajaścaiva yājñasenirmahābalaḥ / na cāmaṅgalike tasminpraharedāpagāsutaḥ
ce_text: amaṅgalyadhvajaś caiva yājñasenir mahārathaḥ / na cāmaṅgalaketoḥ sa prahared āpagāsutaḥ

vulgate_text: paśyādyaitanmahāghore saṃyuge vaiśasaṃ mahat / hemacitrāṇi śūraṇāṃ mahānti ca śubhāni ca
ce_text: paśya caitan mahābāho vaiśasaṃ samupasthitam / hemacitrāṇi śūrāṇāṃ mahānti ca śubhāni ca

vulgate_text: ko hi necchetpriyaṃ putraṃ jīvantaṃ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ / kṣatradharmaṃ tu saṃprekṣya tatastvāṃ niyunajmyaham
ce_text: ko hi necchet priyaṃ putraṃ jīvantaṃ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ / kṣatradharmaṃ puraskṛtya tatas tvā viniyujmahe

vulgate_text: pravīrānsarvalokasya dhārtarāṣṭrānmahārathān / jaghāna samare vīraḥ pāṇḍavaḥ paravīrahā
ce_text: sa tān sarvān mahārāja bhrājamānān pṛthak pṛthak / pravīrān sarvalokasya dhārtarāṣṭrān mahārathān / vivyādha bahubhir bāṇair bhīmaseno mahābalaḥ

vulgate_text: saptabhiḥ śalyamāvidhyatkṛtavarmāṇamaṣṭabhiḥ / kṛpasya saśaraṃ cāpaṃ madhye ciccheda bhārata
ce_text: śalyaṃ pañcāśatā viddhvā kṛtavarmāṇam aṣṭabhiḥ / kṛpasya saśaraṃ cāpaṃ madhye ciccheda bhārata / athainaṃ chinnadhanvānaṃ punar vivyādha pañcabhiḥ

vulgate_text: apīḍayetāṃ samare trigartānāṃ mahadbalam / suśarmāṇi raṇe pārthaṃ śarairnavabhirāśugaiḥ
ce_text: tau tatra rathināṃ śreṣṭhau kaunteyau bharatarṣabhau / apīḍayetāṃ samare trigartānāṃ mahad balam

vulgate_text: nanāda balavannādaṃ trāsayāno mahadbalam / anye ca rathinaḥ śūrā bhīmasenadhanañjayau
ce_text: anye ca rathinaḥ śūrā bhīmasenadhanaṃjayau / vivyadhur niśitair bāṇai rukmapuṅkhair ajihmagaiḥ

vulgate_text: vivyadhurniśitairbāṇai rukmapuṅkhairajihmagaiḥ / teṣāṃ ca rathināṃ madhye kaunteyau bharatarṣabhau
ce_text: anye ca rathinaḥ śūrā bhīmasenadhanaṃjayau / vivyadhur niśitair bāṇai rukmapuṅkhair ajihmagaiḥ

vulgate_text: droṇaśca vivaraṃ dṛṣṭvā bhīmasenaṃ śilīmukhaiḥ / vivyādha bāṇairniśitaiḥ pañcaṣaṣṭibhirāyasaiḥ
ce_text: droṇas tu vivaraṃ labdhvā bhīmasenaṃ śilīmukhaiḥ / vivyādha bāṇaiḥ suśitaiḥ pañcaṣaṣṭyā tam āyasaiḥ

vulgate_text: pārthahetoḥ parākrānto bhīṣmasya nidhanaṃ prati / ārjuniṃ kosalendrastu viddhvā pañcabhirāyasaiḥ
ce_text: saubhadro rājaputraṃ tu bṛhadbalam ayodhayat / ārjuniṃ kosalendras tu viddhvā pañcabhir āyasaiḥ / punar vivyādha viṃśatyā śaraiḥ saṃnataparvabhiḥ

vulgate_text: tāñcharāñcharaghātena ciccheda sa mahārathaḥ / droṇo drupadaputrāya prāhiṇotpañca sāyakān
ce_text: tāñ śarāñ śarasaṃghais tu saṃnivārya mahārathaḥ / droṇo drupadaputrāya prāhiṇot pañca sāyakān

vulgate_text: arjunastu mahārāja śikhaṇḍinamabhāṣata / abhitvarasvāsya vadhe śikhaṇḍinrathasattama
ce_text: arjunas tu mahārāja śikhaṇḍinam abhāṣata / abhitvarasva tvarito jahi cainaṃ pitāmaham

vulgate_text: vidrutaṃ dikṣu sarvāsu śarairbalamadṛśyata / atha pārtho mahārāja drāvayitvā varūthinīm
ce_text: atha pārtho mahābāhur drāvayitvā varūthinīm / duḥśāsanāya samare preṣayām āsa sāyakān

vulgate_text: saṃprādravanta samare nirjitāḥ savyasācinā / pūrvāhṇe bharataśreṣṭha parājitya mahārathān
ce_text: evaṃ te virathāḥ pañca kṛpaḥ śalyaś ca māriṣa / duḥśāsano vikarṇaś ca tathaiva ca viviṃśatiḥ / saṃprādravanta samare nirjitāḥ savyasācinā

vulgate_text: icchanto nidhanaṃ yuddhe svargalokaparāyaṇāḥ / pāṇḍavānabhyavartanta tāvakā yuddhadurmadāḥ
ce_text: icchanto nidhanaṃ yuddhe svargaṃ kṛtvā parāyaṇam / pāṇḍavān abhyavartanta tasmin vīravarakṣaye

vulgate_text: senāpatistu samare prāha senāṃ mahārathaḥ / abhyadravata gāṅgeyaṃ sainikāḥ kiṃ kṛtena vaḥ
ce_text: senāpatis tu samare prāha senāṃ mahārathaḥ / abhidravata gāṅgeyaṃ somakāḥ sṛñjayaiḥ saha

vulgate_text: ca hyanīkamanīkeṣu samasañjata saṃkale / rathā na rathibhiḥ sārdhaṃ pādātā na padātibhiḥ
ce_text: na hy anīkam anīkena samasajjata saṃkule / na rathā rathibhiḥ sārdhaṃ na padātāḥ padātibhiḥ

vulgate_text: aśvā nāśvairayudhyanta gajā na gajayodhibhiḥ / unmattavanmahārāja yudhyante tatra bhārata
ce_text: aśvā nāśvair ayudhyanta na gajā gajayodhibhiḥ / mahān vyatikaro raudraḥ senayoḥ samapadyata

vulgate_text: abhyavartanta te putrāḥ sarve sainyapuraskṛtāḥ / icchanto nidhanaṃ yuddhe svargaṃ kṛtvā parāyaṇam
ce_text: icchanto nidhanaṃ yuddhe svargaṃ kṛtvā parāyaṇam / pāṇḍavān abhyavartanta tasmin vīravarakṣaye

vulgate_text: sahasrāṇi mahārāja rājñāṃ bhallairapātayat / udvignāḥ samare yodhā vikrośanti dhanañjayam
ce_text: śatānīkaṃ ca samare hatvā bhīṣmaḥ pratāpavān / sahasrāṇi mahārāja rājñāṃ bhallair nyapātayat

vulgate_text: matsyapāñcālacedīnāṃ tamekamabhidhāvatām / te narāśvarathavrātairmārgaṇaiśca paraṃtapa
ce_text: tataḥ kilakilāśabdaḥ kṣaṇena samapadyata / matsyapāñcālacedīnāṃ tam ekam abhidhāvatām

vulgate_text: ṣaḍetānniśitairbhīṣmaḥ pravivyādhottakaiḥ śaraiḥ / tasya te niśitānbāṇātsannivārya mahārathāḥ
ce_text: tasya te niśitān bāṇān saṃnivārya mahārathāḥ / daśabhir daśabhir bhīṣmam ardayām āsur ojasā

vulgate_text: uddhūtānāṃ yathā śabdaḥ samudrāṇāṃ yugakṣaye / ghnata tvarata gṛhṇīta viddhyadhvamavakartata
ce_text: teṣām āpatatāṃ śabdaḥ śuśruve phalgunaṃ prati / udvṛttānāṃ yathā śabdaḥ samudrāṇāṃ yugakṣaye

vulgate_text: yadyeṣāṃ na bhavedgoptā viṣvakseno mahābalaḥ ajayyaścaiva sarveṣāṃ lokānāmiti me matiḥ / kāraṇadvayamāsthāya nāhaṃ yotsyāmi pāṇḍavān
ce_text: śakto 'haṃ dhanuṣaikena nihantuṃ sarvapāṇḍavān / yady eṣāṃ na bhaved goptā viṣvakseno mahābalaḥ

vulgate_text: yatte vyavasitaṃ tāta tadasmākamapi priyam / tatkuruṣva mahārāja yuddhe buddhiṃ nivartaya
ce_text: yat te vyavasitaṃ vīra asmākaṃ sumahat priyam / tat kuruṣva maheṣvāsa yuddhād buddhiṃ nivartaya

vulgate_text: sarvagātreṣu saṃkruddhastathā marmasvatāḍayat / evamanyairapi bhṛśaṃ viddhyamānaḥ sahasraśaḥ
ce_text: punaḥ śaraśatenainaṃ tvaramāṇo dhanaṃjayaḥ / sarvagātreṣu saṃkruddhaḥ sarvamarmasv atāḍayat

vulgate_text: nivārayāmāsa śaraiḥ samaṃ sannataparvabhiḥ / śikhaṇḍī tu raṇe bāṇānyānmumoca mahārathaḥ
ce_text: śikhaṇḍī tu raṇe bāṇān yān mumoca mahāvrate / te bhīṣmaṃ viviśus tūrṇaṃ svarṇapuṅkhāḥ śilāśitāḥ

vulgate_text: tadapyasya śitairbhallaistridhā tribhiraghātayat / nimeṣārdhena kaunteya āttamāttaṃ mahāraṇe
ce_text: so 'nyat kārmukam ādatta gāṅgeyo balavattaram / tad apy asya śitair bhallais tridhā tribhir upānudat / nimeṣāntaramātreṇa āttam āttaṃ mahāraṇe

vulgate_text: māṃ cāpi śaktā nirjetuṃ kimu martyā mahārathāḥ - - bṛte'rjunaṃ susaṃkruddhametatsatyaṃ bravīmi te
ce_text: na caiṣa śakyaḥ samare jetuṃ vajrabhṛtā api / na cāpi sahitā vīrā devadānavarākṣasāḥ / māṃ caiva śaktā nirjetuṃ kim u martyāḥ sudurbalāḥ

vulgate_text: tato duḥśāsanaṃ bhīṣmaḥ smayamāna ivābravīt / ardito niśitairbāṇairbhṛśaṃ gāṇḍīvadhanvanā
ce_text: tato duḥśāsanaṃ bhūyaḥ smayamāno 'bhyabhāṣata / atividdhaḥ śitair bāṇair bhṛśaṃ gāṇḍīvadhanvanā

vulgate_text: iti bruvañchāntanavo didhakṣuriva pāṇḍavam / śaktiṃ bhīṣmaḥ sa pārthāya tataścikṣepa bhārata
ce_text: iti bruvañ śāṃtanavo didhakṣur iva pāṇḍavam / saviṣphuliṅgāṃ dīptāgrāṃ śaktiṃ cikṣepa bhārata

vulgate_text: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā svānyanīkānyacodayat / abhidravata gāṅgeyaṃ mā vo'stu bhayamaṇvapi
ce_text: vinadyoccaiḥ siṃha iva svāny anīkāny acodayat / abhidravata gāṅgeyaṃ māṃ vo 'stu bhayam aṇv api

vulgate_text: nihatya samare rājañśataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ / na tasyāsīdanirbhinnaṃ gātre dvyaṅgulamantaram
ce_text: abhihatya śaraughais taṃ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ / na tasyāsīd anirbhinnaṃ gātreṣv aṅgulamātrakam

vulgate_text: indradhvaja ivotsṛṣṭaḥ ketuḥ sarvadhanuṣmatām / dharaṇīṃ na sa pasparśa śarasaṅghaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ
ce_text: sa papāta mahābāhur vasudhām anunādayan / indradhvaja ivotsṛṣṭaḥ ketuḥ sarvadhanuṣmatām / dharaṇīṃ nāspṛśac cāpi śarasaṃghaiḥ samācitaḥ

vulgate_text: sthito'smīti ca gāṅgeyastacchrutvā vākyamabravīt / dhārayiṣyāmyahaṃ prāṇānpatiti'pi mahītale
ce_text: sthito 'smīti ca gāṅgeyas tac chrutvā vākyam abravīt / dhārayām āsa ca prāṇān patito 'pi hi bhūtale / uttarāyaṇam anvicchan bhīṣmaḥ kurupitāmahaḥ

vulgate_text: uttarāyaṇamanvicchansugatipratikāṅkṣayā / tasya tanmatamājñāya gahgā himavataḥ sutāḥ
ce_text: tasya tan matam ājñāya gaṅgā himavataḥ sutā / maharṣīn haṃsarūpeṇa preṣayām āsa tatra vai

vulgate_text: dhārayiṣyāmyahaṃ prāṇānuttarāyaṇakāṅkṣayā / prāṇānāṃ ca samutsarga aiśvaryaṃ niyataṃ mama
ce_text: dhārayiṣyāmy ahaṃ prāṇān uttarāyaṇakāṅkṣayā / aiśvaryabhūtaḥ prāṇānām utsarge niyato hy aham / tasmāt prāṇān dhārayiṣye mumūrṣur udagāyane

vulgate_text: chandataste bhavenmṛtyuriti tatsatyamastu me / dhārayiṣye tataḥ prāṇānutsarge niyate sati
ce_text: dhārayiṣye tataḥ prāṇān utsarge niyate sati / ity uktvā tāṃs tadā haṃsān aśeta śaratalpagaḥ

vulgate_text: avadhye śantanoḥ putre hate bhīṣme mahaujasi duḥkhārtāste tato rājankurūṇāṃ patayo'bhavan / abhāva sahasā rājankururājasya tarkitaḥ
ce_text: avadhye śaṃtanoḥ putre hate bhīṣme mahaujasi / abhāvaḥ sumahān rājan kurūn āgād atandritaḥ

vulgate_text: āsphoṭayāmāsa bhṛśaṃ bhīmaseno nanāda ca / senayorubhayoścāpi gāṅgeye nihate vibhau
ce_text: tatas tūryasahasreṣu nadatsu sumahābalaḥ / āsphoṭayām āsa bhṛśaṃ bhīmaseno nanarta ca

vulgate_text: yadanyannihatenājau bhīṣmeṇa jayamicchatā / ceṣṭitaṃ kurusiṃhena tanme kathaya suvrata
ce_text: yad adya nihatenājau bhīṣmeṇa jayam icchatā / ceṣṭitaṃ narasiṃhena tan me kathaya saṃjaya

vulgate_text: sa hato draupadeyena pāñcālyena śikhaṇḍinā / sañjaya uvāca / sāyāhne nyapatadbhūmau dhārtarāṣṭrānviṣādayan
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / evaṃ te paṇḍavāḥ sarve puraskṛtya śikhaṇḍinam / vivyadhuḥ samare bhīṣmaṃ parivārya samantataḥ

vulgate_text: pāñcālānharṣayaṃścaiva bhīṣmaḥ kurupitāmahaḥ / sa śete śaratalpastho medinīmaspṛśaṃstadā
ce_text: sa śete śaratalpastho medinīm aspṛśaṃs tadā / bhīṣmo rathāt prapatitaḥ pracyuto dharaṇītale

vulgate_text: bhīṣmo rathātprapatitaḥ saṃchinno bahubhiḥ śaraiḥ / hāheti tumulaḥ śabdo bhūtānāṃ samapadyata
ce_text: hā heti tumulaḥ śabdo bhūtānāṃ samapadyata / sīmāvṛkṣe nipatite kurūṇāṃ samitikṣaye

vulgate_text: iti sma śaratalpasthaṃ bharatānāṃ pitāmaham / ṛṣayastvabhyabhāṣanta sahitāḥ siddhacāraṇaiḥ
ce_text: iti sma śaratalpasthaṃ bharatānām amadhyamam / ṛṣayaḥ paryadhāvanta sahitāḥ siddhacāraṇaiḥ

vulgate_text: harṣāttūryasahasreṣu vādyamāneṣu cānagha / apaśyāma mahārāja bhīmasenaṃ mahābalam
ce_text: bhṛśaṃ tūryaninādeṣu vādyamāneṣu cānagha / apaśyāma raṇe rājan bhīmasenaṃ mahābalam / ākrīḍamānaṃ kaunteyaṃ harṣeṇa mahatā yutam

vulgate_text: kṣatradharmasya vettā ca buddhisatvaguṇānvitaḥ / phalguno'pi tathetyuktvā vyavasāyaṃ paraṃjayaḥ
ce_text: tvaṃ hi pārtha mahābāho śreṣṭhaḥ sarvadhanuṣmatām / kṣatradharmasya vettā ca buddhisattvaguṇānvitaḥ

vulgate_text: prāha sarvānsamudvīkṣya bharatānbhārataṃ prati / kuntīputraṃ yudhāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ suhṛdāṃ prītivardhanam
ce_text: upadhānena dattena pratyanandad dhanaṃjayam / kuntīputraṃ yudhāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ suhṛdāṃ prītivardhanam

vulgate_text: paśyadhvamupadhānaṃ me pāṇaḍavenābhisandhitam / śayeyamasyāṃ śayyāyāṃ yāvadāvartanaṃ raveḥ
ce_text: śayeyam asyāṃ śayyāyāṃ yāvad āvartanaṃ raveḥ / ye tadā pārayiṣyanti te māṃ drakṣyanti vai nṛpāḥ

vulgate_text: ye tadā dhārayiṣyanti te ca prekṣyanti māṃ nṛpāḥ / diśaṃ vaiśravaṇākrāntāṃ yadā gantā divākaraḥ
ce_text: diśaṃ vaiśravaṇākrāntāṃ yadā gantā divākaraḥ / arciṣmān pratapaṃl lokān rathenottamatejasā / vimokṣye 'haṃ tadā prāṇān suhṛdaḥ supriyān api

vulgate_text: nūnaṃ saptāśvayuktena rathenottamatejasā / rakṣye'haṃ vai mama prāṇānsuhṛdaḥ supriyāniva
ce_text: diśaṃ vaiśravaṇākrāntāṃ yadā gantā divākaraḥ / arciṣmān pratapaṃl lokān rathenottamatejasā / vimokṣye 'haṃ tadā prāṇān suhṛdaḥ supriyān api

vulgate_text: kanyāścandanacūrṇaiśca lājairmālyaiśca sarvaśaḥ / avākirañchāntanavaṃ tatra gatvā sahasraśaḥ
ce_text: kanyāś candanacūrṇaiś ca lājair mālyaiś ca sarvaśaḥ / striyo bālās tathā vṛddhāḥ prekṣakāś ca pṛthagjanāḥ / samabhyayuḥ śāṃtanavaṃ bhūtānīva tamonudam

vulgate_text: tūryāṇi śatasaṅkhyāni tathaiva naṭanartakāḥ / śilpinaśca tathā''jagmuḥ kuruvṛddhaṃ pitāmaham
ce_text: tūryāṇi gaṇikā vārās tathaiva naṭanartakāḥ / upānṛtyañ jaguś caiva vṛddhaṃ kurupitāmaham

vulgate_text: śarābhitaptakāyo hi śastrasaṃpātamūrcchitaḥ / pānīyamita saṃprekṣya rājñastānpratyabhāṣata
ce_text: śarābhitaptakāyo 'haṃ śarasaṃtāpamūrchitaḥ / pānīyam abhikāṅkṣe 'haṃ rājñas tān pratyabhāṣata

vulgate_text: upānītaṃ tu pānīyaṃ dṛṣṭvā śāntanavo'bravīt / na me'dya sevituṃ yogyā bhogāḥ kevalamānuṣāḥ
ce_text: upanītaṃ ca tad dṛṣṭvā bhīṣmaḥ śāṃtanavo 'bravīt / nādya tāta mayā śakyaṃ bhogān kāṃś cana mānuṣān

vulgate_text: evamuktvā śāntanavo nindanvākyena pārthivān / arjunaṃ draṣṭumicchāmītyabhyabhāṣata bhārata
ce_text: evam uktvā śāṃtanavo dīnavāk sarvapārthivān / dhanaṃjayaṃ mahābāhum abhyabhāṣata bhārata

vulgate_text: dahyatīva śarīra me saṃvṛtasya taveṣubhiḥ / marmāṇi paridūyante mukhaṃ ca pariśuṣyati
ce_text: dahyate 'daḥ śarīraṃ me saṃsyūto 'smi maheṣubhiḥ / marmāṇi paridūyante vadanaṃ mama śuṣyati

vulgate_text: aindraṃ pāśupataṃ brahmaṃ pārameṣṭhyaṃ prajāpateḥ / dhātustvaṣṭuśca saviturvaivasvatamathāpi vā
ce_text: āgneyaṃ vāruṇaṃ saumyaṃ vāyavyam atha vaiṣṇavam / aindraṃ pāśupataṃ brāhmaṃ pārameṣṭhyaṃ prajāpateḥ / dhātus tvaṣṭuś ca savitur divyāny astrāṇi sarvaśaḥ

vulgate_text: tena satvavatā saṅkhye śūreṇāhavaśobhinā / jiṣṇunā samare rājansaṃdhirbhavatu mā ciram
ce_text: amānuṣāṇi karmāṇi yasyaitāni mahātmanaḥ / tena sattvavatā saṃkhye śūreṇāhavaśobhinā / kṛtinā samare rājan saṃdhis te tāta yujyatām

vulgate_text: tāvatte pāṇḍavairvīraiḥ sauhārdaṃ mama rocate / yuddhaṃ madantamevāstu tāta saṃśāmya pāṇḍavaiḥ
ce_text: yuddhaṃ madantam evāstu tāta saṃśāmya pāṇḍavaiḥ / etat te rocatāṃ vākyaṃ yad ukto 'si mayānagha / etat kṣemam ahaṃ manye tava caiva kulasya ca

vulgate_text: na vipriyaṃ mamaiveha yatspardhethā mayā saha / yadi māṃ nādhigacchethā na te śreyo dhruvaṃ bhavet
ce_text: ehy ehi me vipratīpa spardhase tvaṃ mayā saha / yadi māṃ nābhigacchethā na te śreyo bhaved dhruvam

vulgate_text: kaunteyastvaṃ na rādheyo na tavādhirathaḥ pitā / sūryajastvaṃ mahābāho vidito nāradānmayā
ce_text: kaunteyas tvaṃ na rādheyo vidito nāradān mama / kṛṣṇadvaipāyanāc caiva keśavāc ca na saṃśayaḥ

vulgate_text: yenāsi bahuśo rājñā coditaḥ sūtanandana / jāto'si dharmalopena tataste buddhirīdṛśī
ce_text: akasmāt pāṇḍavān hi tvaṃ dviṣasīti matir mama / yenāsi bahuśo rūkṣaṃ coditaḥ sūryanandana

vulgate_text: brahmaṇyaḥ sattvayodhī ca tejasā ca balena ca / devagarbhasamaḥ saṅkhye manuṣyairadhiko yudhi
ce_text: brahmaṇyaḥ satyavādī ca tejasārka ivāparaḥ / devagarbho 'jitaḥ saṃkhye manuṣyair adhiko bhuvi

vulgate_text: sarvaṃ duryodhanasyārthe tyaktaṃ me bhūridakṣiṇa / mā caitadvyādhimaraṇaṃ kṣatraṃ syāditi kaurava
ce_text: vasu caiva śarīraṃ ca yad udāraṃ tathā yaśaḥ / sarvaṃ duryodhanasyārthe tyaktaṃ me bhūridakṣiṇa / kopitāḥ pāṇḍavā nityaṃ mayāśritya suyodhanam

vulgate_text: ajeyāḥ puruṣairanyairiti taṃścotsahāmahe / vijayiṣye raṇe pāṇḍūniti me niścitaḥ manaḥ
ce_text: pāṇḍavā vāsudevaś ca viditā mama sarvaśaḥ / ajeyāḥ puruṣair anyair iti tāṃś cotsahāmahe

vulgate_text: na ca śakyamavasraṣṭuṃ vairametatsudāruṇam / dhanaṃjayena yotsye'haṃ svadharmaprītamānasaḥ
ce_text: bhīṣma uvāca / na cec chakyam athotsraṣṭuṃ vairam etat sudāruṇam / anujānāmi karṇa tvāṃ yudhyasva svargakāmyayā

vulgate_text: ityuktavati gāṅgeye abhivādyopamantrya ca / rādheyo rathamāruhya prāyāttava sutaṃ prati / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / evaṃ bruvantaṃ gāṅgeyam abhivādya prasādya ca / rādheyo ratham āruhya prāyāt tava sutaṃ prati

vulgate_text: śrīvedavyāsāya namaḥ / nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam / devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet / janamejaya uvāca / tamapratimasatvaujobalavīryaparākramam hataṃ devavrataṃ śrutvā pāñcālyena śikhaṇḍinā
ce_text: janamejaya uvāca / tam apratimasattvaujobalavīryaparākramam / hataṃ devavrataṃ śrutvā pāñcālyena śikhaṇḍinā

vulgate_text: rathātirakṣasaṅkhyāyāṃ yo'graṇīḥ śūrasambhataḥ / sāsurānapi deveśānraṇe yo yoddhumṛtsahet
ce_text: rathātirathasaṃkhyāyāṃ yo 'graṇīḥ śūrasaṃmataḥ / pitṛvittāmbudeveśān api yo yoddhum utsahet

vulgate_text: hate vā tvayi pārthaistu yudhi svargamupeyuṣi / hantāsmyekarathenaiva kṛtsnānvānmanyase rathā
ce_text: pāṇḍavair vā hate bhīṣme tvayi svargam upeyuṣi / hantāsmy ekarathenaiva kṛtsnān yān manyase rathān

vulgate_text: evamuktvā mahābāhurdaśāhānyeka eva sa / nāyudhyata tataḥ karṇaḥ putrasya tava saṃyate
ce_text: evam uktvā mahārāja daśāhāni mahāyaśāḥ / nāyudhyata tataḥ karṇaḥ putrasya tava saṃmate

vulgate_text: tatkhaṇḍaṃ pūrayankarṇaḥ pareṣāmādadhadbhayam / sa hi vai puruṣavyāghro loke sañjaya kathyate
ce_text: tat khaṇḍaṃ pūrayām āsa pareṣām ādadhad bhayam / kṛtavān mama putrāṇāṃ jayāśāṃ saphalām api

vulgate_text: ārtānāṃ bāndhavānāṃ ca krandatāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ parityajya raṇe prāṇāṃstattrāṇārthaṃ ca śarma ca / kṛtavānmama putrāṇāṃ jayāśāṃ saphalāmapi
ce_text: tat khaṇḍaṃ pūrayām āsa pareṣām ādadhad bhayam / kṛtavān mama putrāṇāṃ jayāśāṃ saphalām api

vulgate_text: sammṛjya divyaṃ dhanurātatajyaṃ sa rāmadattaṃ ripusaṅghahantā bāṇāṃśca kālānalavāyukalpānullālayanvākyamidaṃ babhāṣe / karṇa uvāca / yasmindhṛtirbuddhiparākramaujaḥ satyaṃ smṛtirvīraguṇāśca sarve astrāṇi divyānyatha saṃnatihrīḥ priyā ca vāganasūyā ca bhīṣme
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tathā karṇaṃ yudhi varaṃ kīrtayantaṃ punaḥ punaḥ / āśīviṣavad ucchvasya dhṛtarāṣṭro 'bravīd idam

vulgate_text: sadā kṛtajñe dvijaśatrughātake sanātanaṃ candramasīva lakṣmīḥ / sa cetpraśāntaḥ paravīrahantā manye hatāneva ca sarvavīrān
ce_text: brahmadviṣaghne satataṃ kṛtajñe; sanātanaṃ candramasīva lakṣma / sa cet praśāntaḥ paravīrahantā; manye hatān eva hi sarvayodhān

ce_text: etāṃ raukmīṃ nāgakakṣyāṃ ca jaitrīṃ; jaitraṃ ca me dhvajam indīvarābham / ślakṣṇair vastrair vipramṛjyānayasva; citrāṃ mālāṃ cātra baddhvā sajālām

ce_text: tam adyāhaṃ pāṇḍavaṃ yuddhaśauṇḍam; amṛṣyamāṇo bhavatānuśiṣṭaḥ / āśīviṣaṃ dṛṣṭiharaṃ sughoram; iyāṃ puraskṛtya vadhaṃ jayaṃ vā

vulgate_text: mānahā bhava śatrūṇāṃ mitrāṇāṃ nandivardhanaḥ / kauravāṇāṃ bhava gatiryathā viṣṇurdivaukasām
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tasya lālapyataḥ śrutvā vṛddhaḥ kurupitāmahaḥ / deśakālocitaṃ vākyam abravīt prītamānasaḥ / rahitaṃ dhiṣṇyam ālokya samutsārya ca rakṣiṇaḥ / piteva putraṃ gāṅgeyaḥ pariṣvajyaikabāhunā / ehy ehi bho spardhase tvaṃ mayā sārdhaṃ hi sūtaja / yadi māṃ nādhigacchethā na te śreyo bhaved dhruvam / kaunteyas tvaṃ na rādheyo na tavādhirathaḥ pitā / sūryatas tvaṃ mahābāho vidito nāradān mama / kṛṣṇadvaipāyanāc caiva keśavāc ca na saṃśayaḥ / mānahā bhava śatrūṇāṃ mitrāṇāṃ śokahā bhava / kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaś caiva tejasā ca na saṃśayaḥ / na ca dveṣo 'sti me karṇa tvayi satyaṃ bravīmi te / tejovadhanimittaṃ tu paruṣaṃ cāham abruvam / akasmāt pāṇḍavān hi tvaṃ dviṣasīti matir mama / tenāsi bahuśo rūkṣaṃ śrāvitaḥ kurusaṃsadi / hantāsi samare vīrāñ śatrupakṣakṣayaṃkara / brahmaṇyatā ca śauryaṃ ca dāne vā paramo nidhiḥ / kulabhedabhayāc cāhaṃ sadā paruṣam abruvam / iṣvastre vīra saṃdhāne lāghave 'strabale 'pi ca / sadṛśaḥ phalgunasyāpi kṛṣṇasya ca samo bale

ce_text: yaunāt saṃbandhakāl loke viśiṣṭaṃ saṃgataṃ satām / sadbhiḥ saha naraśreṣṭha pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ

vulgate_text: yathā ca kuravo yuddhe yodhayanti sma pāṇḍavān / tathā karṇa tvayā kāryaṃ duryodhanahitaiṣiṇā
ce_text: tatra tatra ca saṃgrāme duryodhanahitaiṣiṇā / bahavaś ca jitā vīrās tvayā karṇa mahaujasā / brahmaṇyaḥ satyavādī ca tejasārko na saṃśayaḥ / devagarbho 'jitaḥ saṃkhye manuṣyebhyo 'dhiko yudhi / vyapanīto 'dya me manyur yas tvāṃ prati purā kṛtaḥ / daivaṃ puruṣakāreṇa na śakyam ativartitum / saudaryāḥ pāṇḍavā vīra bhrātaras te 'risūdana / gacchaikatvaṃ mahābāho mama ced icchasi priyam / mayā bhavatu nirvṛttaṃ vairam ādityanandana / pṛthivyāṃ sarvarājāno bhavantv adya nirāmayāḥ / karṇa uvāca / jānāmy etan mahābāho kaunteyo 'smi na sūtajaḥ / parityaktas tv ahaṃ kuntyā sūtena ca vivardhitaḥ / bhuktvā duryodhanaiśvaryaṃ na mithyā kartum utsahe / vasu caiva śarīraṃ ca putradārāṃs tathā yaśaḥ / sarvaṃ duryodhanasyārthe tyaktaṃ me bhūridakṣiṇa / neṣyati vyādhimaraṇaṃ kṣatriyasyeti kaurava / kopitāḥ pāṇḍavā nityaṃ mayāśritya suyodhanam / aparāvartino ye 'rthās te na śakyā nivartitum / daivaṃ puruṣakāreṇa ko nivartitum utsahet / pṛthivīkṣayaṃ śaṃsanti nimittānīha bhārata / bhavadbhir hi purā dṛṣṭvā kathitāni ca saṃsadi / ajeyāḥ puruṣair anyair iti tāṃś cotsahāmahe / anujānīhi māṃ tāta yuddhāya prītimānasam / anujñātas tvayā vīra yudhyeyam iti me matiḥ / duruktāni ca vākyāni saṃrambhāc cāpalād api / yan mayā te kṛtaṃ kiṃ cit tyaja tad bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: nakṣatrāṇāmiva śaśī ditijānāmivośanāḥ / sarveṣāmiva lokānāṃ viśvasya ca yathā kṣayaḥ

ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / rathasthaṃ puruṣavyāghraṃ dṛṣṭvā karṇam avasthitam / hṛṣṭo duryodhano rājann idaṃ vacanam abravīt

vulgate_text: athābhiṣiṣicurdroṇaṃ duryodhanamukhā nṛpāḥ svastivādaravaiścānyaiḥ ślakṣṇaiścānyairmanoramaiḥ / saināpatye yathā skandaṃ purā śakramukhāḥ surāḥ
ce_text: athābhiṣiṣicur droṇaṃ duryodhanamukhā nṛpāḥ / senāpatye yathā skandaṃ purā śakramukhāḥ surāḥ

vulgate_text: dīpyandṛśyeta hi tathā ketuḥ sarvatra dhīmataḥ / yodhānāmarjunaḥ śreṣṭho gāṇḍīvaṃ dhanuṣāṃ varam
ce_text: asyatām arjunaḥ śreṣṭho gāṇḍīvaṃ dhanuṣāṃ varam / vāsudevaś ca bhūtānāṃ cakrāṇāṃ ca sudarśanam

ce_text: tatrainam arjunaś caiva pārṣataś ca sahānugaḥ / paryagṛhṇaṃs tataḥ sarve samāyāntaṃ mahārathāḥ

ce_text: śatamāyas tu śakuniḥ sahadevaṃ samādravat / saniyantṛdhvajarathaṃ vivyādha niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ

vulgate_text: yuddhaṃ yodhavarau loke saumadattiśikhaṇḍinau / bhūtānāṃ trāsajananaṃ cakrāte'straviśāradau
ce_text: drupadas tu svayaṃ rājā bhagadattena saṃgataḥ / tayor yuddhaṃ mahārāja citrarūpam ivābhavat / bhūtānāṃ trāsajananaṃ cakrāte 'straviśāradau

vulgate_text: taṃ tu sandhitamājñāya sāyakaṃ ghoradarśanam / dvābhyāṃ śarābhyāṃ hārdikyaściccheda saśaraṃ dhanuḥ
ce_text: dvābhyāṃ śarābhyāṃ hārdikyaś cakarta saśaraṃ dhanuḥ / tad utsṛjya dhanuś chinnaṃ saubhadraḥ paravīrahā / udbabarha sitaṃ khaḍgam ādadānaḥ śarāvaram

vulgate_text: taṃ śūramāryavratinaṃ mantrāstreṣu kṛtaścamam / cakrarakṣataṃ parāmṛdrātkumāraṃ dvijapuṅgavaḥ
ce_text: taṃ śūram āryavratinam astrārthakṛtaniśramam / cakrarakṣam apāmṛdnāt kumāraṃ dvijasattamaḥ

vulgate_text: taṃ vijitya mahātejā bhāradvājo mahāmanāḥ / abhyavartata samprepsuḥ kuntīputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram
ce_text: vyakṣobhayad raṇe yodhān yathāmukhyān abhidravan / abhyavartata saṃprepsuḥ kuntīputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram

vulgate_text: asminmahūrte droṇastu pāṇḍavaṃ gṛhya harṣitaḥ / āgamiṣyati no nūnaṃ dhārtarāṣṭrasya saṃyuge
ce_text: abruvan sainikās tatra dṛṣṭvā droṇasya vikramam / adya rājā dhārtarāṣṭraḥ kṛtārtho vai bhaviṣyati / āgamiṣyati no nūnaṃ dhārtarāṣṭrasya saṃyuge

vulgate_text: arjunena parityakto na cettrāsātpalāyate / māmupāyāntamālokya gṛhītaṃ viddhi pāṇḍavam
ce_text: arjunena vihīnas tu yadi notsṛjate raṇam / mām upāyāntam ālokya gṛhītam iti viddhi tam

vulgate_text: svabhāryāmṛtukāleṣu mohādvai nābhigacchatām / śrāddhamaithunikānāṃ ca ye cāpyātmāpahāriṇām
ce_text: jāyāṃ ca ṛtukāle vai ye mohād abhigacchatām / śrāddhasaṃgatikānāṃ ca ye cāpy ātmāpahāriṇām

vulgate_text: athavā harṣakālo'yaṃ traigartānāmasaṃśayam kunarairduravāpānhi lokānprāpsyanti saṃyuge / mayā hatā hiṃ saṅgrāme lokānprāpsyanti puṣkalān evamuktvā mahābāhurhṛṣīkeśaṃ tato'rjunaḥ āsasāda raṇe vyūḍhāṃ trigartānāmanīkinīm
ce_text: evam uktvā mahābāhur hṛṣīkeśaṃ tato 'rjunaḥ / āsasāda raṇe vyūḍhāṃ traigartānām anīkinīm

vulgate_text: jahāra pārthaḥ sainyeṣu sahasre dve ca yodhinām / tasminnipatite vīre trastāstasya padānugāḥ
ce_text: tasmiṃs tu patite vīre trastās tasya padānugāḥ / vyadravanta bhayād bhītā yena dauryodhanaṃ balam

vulgate_text: bhūyiṣṭhaṃ pratiruddhā ye hatairyodhairyaśasvinaḥ / vyadravanta bhayādbhītā yatra dauryodhanaṃ balam
ce_text: tasmiṃs tu patite vīre trastās tasya padānugāḥ / vyadravanta bhayād bhītā yena dauryodhanaṃ balam

vulgate_text: anyonyaṃ samare jaghnustāvakā bharatarṣabha / mohitāḥ paramāstreṇa kṣayaṃ jagmuḥ parasparam
ce_text: mohitāḥ paramāstreṇa kṣayaṃ jagmuḥ parasparam / aśobhanta raṇe yodhāḥ puṣpitā iva kiṃśukāḥ

vulgate_text: rudhirokṣitagātrāste prekṣamāṇaḥ parasparam / aśobhanta raṇe yodhāḥ puṣpitā iva kiṃśukāḥ
ce_text: mohitāḥ paramāstreṇa kṣayaṃ jagmuḥ parasparam / aśobhanta raṇe yodhāḥ puṣpitā iva kiṃśukāḥ

vulgate_text: tasya tadbhāṣitaṃ śrutvā tvaramāṇo dhanañjayaḥ / vāyavyāstreṇa tairastāṃ śaravṛṣṭimapāharat
ce_text: tasya taṃ mānuṣaṃ bhāvaṃ bhāvajño ''jñāya pāṇḍavaḥ / vāyavyāstreṇa tair astāṃ śaravṛṣṭim apāharat

vulgate_text: rajaśca cāpyabhavaddurgā kabandhaśatasaṅkulā tadbabhau raudrabībhatsaṃ bībhatsoryānamāhave
ce_text: tad babhau raudrabībhatsaṃ bībhatsor yānam āhave / ākrīḍa iva rudrasya ghnataḥ kālātyaye paśūn

vulgate_text: tamevābhimukhāḥ kṣīṇāḥ śakrasyātithitāṃ gatāḥ sā bhūmīrbharataśreṣṭha nihataistairmahārathaiḥ
ce_text: te vadhyamānāḥ pārthena vyākulāśvarathadvipāḥ / tam evābhimukhāḥ kṣīṇāḥ śakrasyātithitāṃ gatāḥ

vulgate_text: āstīrṇā sambabhau sarvā pretībhūtaiḥ samantataḥ etasminnantare caiva pramatte savyasācini
ce_text: sā bhūmir bharataśreṣṭha nihatais tair mahārathaiḥ / āstīrṇā saṃbabhau sarvā pretībhūtaiḥ samantataḥ

vulgate_text: vidhāya goptṝnpārthasya saṃśaptakagaṇaiḥ saha / niṣkrānte ca tadā pārthe saṃśaptakavadhaṃ prati
ce_text: vidhāya yogaṃ pārthena saṃśaptakagaṇaiḥ saha / niṣkrānte ca raṇāt pārthe saṃśaptakavadhaṃ prati

vulgate_text: śakā yavanakāmbhojāstathā haṃsapathāśca ye grīvāyāṃ śūrasenāśca darandā madrakekayāḥ / gajāśvarathapattyoghāstasthuḥ paramadaṃśitāḥ
ce_text: kaliṅgāḥ siṃhalāḥ prācyāḥ śūrābhīrā daśerakāḥ / śakā yavanakāmbojās tathā haṃsapadāś ca ye

vulgate_text: sa śīghrataramādāya dhanuranyatpratāpavān / droṇamabyahanadrājaṃstriṃśatā kaṅkapatribhiḥ
ce_text: sa śīghrataram ādāya dhanur anyat pratāpavān / droṇaṃ so 'bhijaghānāśu viṃśadbhiḥ kaṅkapatribhiḥ

vulgate_text: samareṣu tu nirdiṣṭāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ kṛṣṇabāndhavāḥ / pāñcālāḥ kekayā mātsyāḥ pāṇḍaveyāśca sarvaśaḥ
ce_text: tam ete cānuvartante sātyakipramukhā rathāḥ / pāñcālāḥ kekayā matsyāḥ pāṇḍavāś ca viśeṣataḥ

vulgate_text: śūrāśca balavantaśca vikrāntāśca mahārathāḥ / hīmantaḥ śatrumaraṇe nipuṇāḥ puṇyalakṣaṇāḥ
ce_text: śūrāś ca balavantaś ca vikrāntāś ca mahārathāḥ / viśeṣataś ca bhīmena saṃrabdhenābhicoditāḥ

vulgate_text: dūyate me manastāta droṇaṃ prati parantapam / śrutvā bhīṣmasya nidhanaṃ tadvadetadbhaviṣyati / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tān dṛṣṭvā calitān saṃkhye praṇunnān droṇasāyakaiḥ / pāñcālān pāṇḍavān matsyān sṛñjayāṃś cedikekayān

vulgate_text: dantavarṇāstu rājānaṃ kālavālā yudhiṣṭhiram / bhīmavegā naravyāghramavahanvātaraṃhasaḥ
ce_text: kṛṣṇās tu meghasaṃkāśāḥ sahadevam udāyudham / bhīmavegā naravyāghram avahan vātaraṃhasaḥ

vulgate_text: āmapātranikāśāstu pāñcālyamamitaujasam / dattāstumburuṇā divyāḥ śikhaṇḍinamudāvahan
ce_text: āmapātranibhākārāḥ pāñcālyam amitaujasam / dāntās tāmrāruṇā yuktāḥ śikhaṇḍinam udāvahan

vulgate_text: sutasomaṃ tu yodhāgryaṃ bhīmaputraṃ mahābalam / māṣapuṣpasavarṇāstamavahanvājino raṇe
ce_text: sutasomaṃ tu yaṃ dhaumyāt pārthaḥ putram ayācata / māṣapuṣpasavarṇās tam avahan vājino raṇe

vulgate_text: varṇairuccāvacairanyaiḥ sadaśvānāṃ prabhadrakāḥ / sannyavartanta yuddhāya bahavo devarūpiṇaḥ
ce_text: suvarṇavarṇā dharmajñam anīkasthaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram / rājaśreṣṭhaṃ hayaśreṣṭhāḥ sarvataḥ pṛṣṭhato 'nvayuḥ / varṇaiś coccāvacair divyaiḥ sadaśvānāṃ prabhadrakāḥ

vulgate_text: kathaṃ ca vo manastāta nivṛtteṣvabhavattadā / māmakānāṃ ca ye śūrāḥ ke kāṃstatra nyavārayan
ce_text: yathāsīc ca nivṛtteṣu pāṇḍaveṣu ca saṃjaya / mama sainyāvaśeṣasya saṃnipātaḥ sudāruṇaḥ / māmakānāṃ ca ye śūrāḥ kāṃs tatra samavārayan

vulgate_text: yena nāgena maghavānajayaddaityadānavān / tadanvayena nāgena bhīmasenamupādravat
ce_text: yena nāgena maghavān ajayad daityadānavān / sa nāgapravaro bhīmaṃ sahasā samupādravat

vulgate_text: vyāvṛttanayanaḥ krudvaḥ pramathanniva pāṇḍavam / vṛkodararathaṃ sāśvamaviśeṣamacūrṇayat
ce_text: śravaṇābhyām atho padbhyāṃ saṃhatena kareṇa ca / vyāvṛttanayanaḥ kruddhaḥ pradahann iva pāṇḍavam

vulgate_text: so'dhiṣṭhāya padā vāhānyuyutsoḥ sūtamārujat / yuyutsustu rathādrājannapākrāmattvarānvitaḥ
ce_text: so 'dhiṣṭhāya padā vāhān yuyutsoḥ sūtam ārujat / putras tu tava saṃbhrāntaḥ saubhadrasyāpluto ratham

vulgate_text: tataḥ pāṇḍavayodhāste nāgarājaṃ śarairdrutam / siṣicurbhairavānnādānvinadanto jighāṃsavaḥ
ce_text: ta enaṃ śaradhārābhir dhārābhir iva toyadāḥ / siṣicur bhairavān nādān vinadanto jighāṃsavaḥ

vulgate_text: sa tu dolāyamāno'būddvaidhībhāvena pāṇḍavaḥ / vadhena tu narāgryāṇāmakarottāṃ mṛṣā tadā
ce_text: sa tu saṃvartayām āsa dvaidhībhāvena pāṇḍavaḥ / rathena tu rathāgryāṇām akarot tāṃ mṛṣā tadā

vulgate_text: tataḥ prāgjyotiṣo rājā śaravarṣe nivārite / saṃraktanayano roṣātpārthaṃ punaravākirat
ce_text: tataḥ prāgjyotiṣo rājā śaravarṣaṃ nivārya tat / śarair jaghne mahābāhuṃ pārthaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca bhārata

vulgate_text: sa tathā śaravarṣeṇa pārthaṃ samabhihatya vai / codayāmāsa taṃ nāgaṃ vadhāyācyutapārthayoḥ
ce_text: tataḥ sa śarajālena mahatābhyavakīrya tau / codayām āsa taṃ nāgaṃ vadhāyācyutapārthayoḥ

vulgate_text: tato nāgasya tadvarma vyadhamatpākaśāsaniḥ / śarajālena mahatā tadvyaśīryata bhūtale
ce_text: tato nāgasya tad varma vyadhamat pākaśāsaniḥ / śarajālena sa babhau vyabhraḥ parvatarāḍ iva

vulgate_text: vaijayantyabhavanmālā tadastraṃ keśavorasi / padmakośavicitrā sā sarvartukusumotkarā
ce_text: vaijayanty abhavan mālā tad astraṃ keśavorasi / tato 'rjunaḥ klāntamanāḥ keśavaṃ pratyabhāṣata

vulgate_text: śuśubhe'bhyadhikaṃ śauriratasīpuṣpasannibhaḥ / tato'rjunaḥ klāntamanāḥ keśavaṃ pratyabhāṣata
ce_text: vaijayanty abhavan mālā tad astraṃ keśavorasi / tato 'rjunaḥ klāntamanāḥ keśavaṃ pratyabhāṣata

vulgate_text: nāsyāvadhyo'sti loke'sminmadanyaḥ kaścidarjuna / tasmānmayā kṛtaṃ hyetanmā bhūtte buddhiranyathā / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / yiyāsatas tataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pārthasyāśvān manojavān / apraiṣīd dhemasaṃchannān droṇānīkāya pāṇḍurān

vulgate_text: tamomayaṃ jaganmene bhagadattaḥ pratāpavān / tataścandrārdhabimbena bāṇena nataparvaṇā
ce_text: tataś candrārdhabimbena śareṇa nataparvaṇā / bibheda hṛdayaṃ rājño bhagadattasya pāṇḍavaḥ

vulgate_text: śarāsanaṃ śarāṃścaiva gatāsuḥ pramumoca ha śirasastasya vibhraṣṭaṃ papāta ca varāṃśukam / nālatāḍanavibhraṣṭaṃ palāśaṃ nalinādiva
ce_text: śirasas tasya vibhraṣṭaḥ papāta ca varāṅkuśaḥ / nālatāḍanavibhraṣṭaṃ palāśaṃ nalinād iva

vulgate_text: tattamo bhairavaṃ ghoraṃ bhayakartṛ mahāhave / uttamāstreṇa mahatā jyautiṣeṇārjuno'vadhīt
ce_text: tat tamo 'streṇa mahatā jyotiṣeṇārjuno 'vadhīt / hate tasmiñ jalaughās tu prādurāsan bhayānakāḥ

vulgate_text: yaṃyaṃ pramathate droṇaḥ pāñcālānāṃ rathavrajam / tatratatra tu pāñcālyo dhṛṣṭadyumno'bhyavartata
ce_text: yaṃ yaṃ sma bhajate droṇaḥ pāñcālānāṃ rathavrajam / tatra tatra sma pāñcālyo dhṛṣṭadyumno 'tha dhīyate

vulgate_text: teṣāṃ bhāgyaviparyāsaiḥ saṅgrāme bhairave sati / vīrāḥ samāsadanvīrānkurvanto bhairavaṃ ravam
ce_text: yathābhāgaviparyāse saṃgrāme bhairave sati / vīrāḥ samāsadan vīrān agacchan bhīravaḥ parān

vulgate_text: nānusmaranti saṅgrāmamapi vṛddhāstathāvidham / ye pūrvadevairdevānāmapaśyanyuddhamadbhutam
ce_text: na tu smaranti saṃgrāmam api vṛddhās tathāvidham / dṛṣṭapūrvaṃ mahārāja śrutapūrvam athāpi vā

vulgate_text: ghūrṇato'pi balaughasya divaṃ stabdhveva niḥsvanaḥ / ajātaśatrostatsainyamāviveśa subhairavaḥ
ce_text: ghūrṇato hi balaughasya divaṃ stabdhveva nisvanaḥ / ajātaśatroḥ kruddhasya putrasya tava cābhavat

vulgate_text: ānantaryamabhiprepsuḥ ṣaḍviṃśatyā śamārpayat / karṇo dvādaśabhirbāṇairaśvatthāmā ca saptabhiḥ
ce_text: karṇo dvādaśabhir bāṇair aśvatthāmā ca saptabhiḥ / ṣaḍbhir duryodhano rājā tata enam avākirat

vulgate_text: asiśaktyṛṣṭisaṅghātairyuddhamāsītparaśvathaiḥ / prakṛṣṭamasiyuddhaṃ ca babhūva kaṭukodayam
ce_text: nikṛṣṭam asiyuddhaṃ ca babhūva kaṭukodayam / kuñjarāṇāṃ ca saṃghātair yuddham āsīt sudāruṇam

vulgate_text: śiraḥ pradhvaṃsayāmāsa vakṣasyākramya kuñjaraḥ / aparāṃścāpare'mṛdranvāraṇāḥ patitānnarān
ce_text: tatrānyasya ca saṃmarde patitasya vivarmaṇaḥ / śiraḥ pradhvaṃsayām āsa vakṣasy ākramya kuñjaraḥ

vulgate_text: hīmantaḥ kālasamparkātsuduḥsvānyanuśerate / hanti smātra pitā putraṃ rathenābhyetya saṃyuge
ce_text: hanti smātra pitā putraṃ rathenābhyativartate / putraś ca pitaraṃ mohān nirmaryādam avartata

vulgate_text: hā tāta hā putra sakhe kvāsi tiṣṭha kva dhāvasi praharāhara jahmenaṃ smitaśveḍitagarjitaiḥ / ityevamuccairatyarthaṃ śrūyante vividhā giraḥ
ce_text: praharāhara jahy enaṃ smitakṣveḍitagarjitaiḥ / ity evam uccarantyaḥ sma śrūyante vividhā giraḥ

vulgate_text: tasya dīptaśaraughasya dīptacāpadharasya ca vāruṇena tadastreṇa vidhūyātha dhanañjayaḥ / śaraughāñśarajālena vidudhāva dhanañjayaḥ
ce_text: tasya dīptaśaraughasya dīptacāpadharasya ca / śaraughāñ śarajālena vidudhāva dhanaṃjayaḥ / astram astreṇa saṃvārya prāṇadad visṛjañ śarān

vulgate_text: tathaivādhirathistasya bāṇājjvalitatejasaḥ / astramastreṇa saṃvārya prāṇadadvisṛjañśarān
ce_text: tasya dīptaśaraughasya dīptacāpadharasya ca / śaraughāñ śarajālena vidudhāva dhanaṃjayaḥ / astram astreṇa saṃvārya prāṇadad visṛjañ śarān

vulgate_text: sa kṛtvā duṣkaraṃ karma hatvā vīrānsahasraśaḥ / rājaputraśataṃ hatvā kausalyaṃ ca bṛhadbalam
ce_text: sa kṛtvā duṣkaraṃ karma hatvā vīrān sahasraśaḥ / ṣaṭsu vīreṣu saṃsakto dauḥśāsanivaśaṃ gataḥ

vulgate_text: mahārathaṃ śalyaputraṃ pautraṃ te lakṣmaṇaṃ tathā ṣaṭsu vīreṣu saṃsakto dauḥśāsanivaśaṃ gataḥ / saubhadraḥ pṛthivīpāla jahau prāṇānparantapa
ce_text: sa kṛtvā duṣkaraṃ karma hatvā vīrān sahasraśaḥ / ṣaṭsu vīreṣu saṃsakto dauḥśāsanivaśaṃ gataḥ

vulgate_text: śaśvatkarmānvayairbuddhyā prakṛtyā yaśasā śriyā / na bhūto bhavitā vāpi kṛṣṇasya sadṛśaḥ pumān
ce_text: sattvakarmānvayair buddhyā prakṛtyā yaśasā śriyā / naiva bhūto na bhavitā kṛṣṇatulyaguṇaḥ pumān

vulgate_text: abhimanyuṃ dvijaśreṣṭha saubhadramaparājitam / śrotumicchāmi kārtsnyena kathamāyodhane hataḥ / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / abhimanyum ahaṃ sūta saubhadram aparājitam / śrotum icchāmi kārtsnyena katham āyodhane hataḥ

vulgate_text: abhimanyuṃ hataṃ śrutvā dhṛtarāṣṭro janādhipaḥ / vistareṇa mahārāja paryapṛcchatsa sañjayam / dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / putraṃ puruṣasiṃhasya saṃjayāprāptayauvanam / raṇe vinihataṃ śrutvā bhṛśaṃ me dīryate manaḥ

vulgate_text: vikrīḍitaṃ kumāreṇa yathānīkaṃ bibhitsatā / ārugṇāśca yathā vīrā duḥsādhyāścāpi vipluve
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / yan māṃ pṛcchasi rājendra saubhadrasya nipātanam / tat te kārtsnyena vakṣyāmi śṛṇu rājan samāhitaḥ / vikrīḍitaṃ kumāreṇa yathānīkaṃ bibhitsatā

vulgate_text: sañjaya uvāca / sthiro bhava mahārāja śokaṃ dhāraya durdharam / mahāntaṃ bandhunāśaṃ te kathayiṣyāmi tacchṛśu
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / pūrvam asmāsu bhagneṣu phalgunenāmitaujasā / droṇe ca moghasaṃkalpe rakṣite ca yudhiṣṭhire

vulgate_text: sarve raktapatākāśca sarve vai hemamālinaḥ / candanāgurudigdhāṅgāḥ sragviṇaḥ sūkṣmavāsasaḥ
ce_text: raktāmbaradharāḥ sarve sarve raktavibhūṣaṇāḥ / sarve raktapatākāś ca sarve vai hemamālinaḥ

vulgate_text: sahitāḥ paryadhāvanta kārṣṇi pratiyuyutsavaḥ / teṣāṃ daśasahasrāṇi babhūvurdṛḍhadhanvinām
ce_text: teṣāṃ daśasahasrāṇi babhūvur dṛḍhadhanvinām / pautraṃ tava puraskṛtya lakṣmaṇaṃ priyadarśanam

vulgate_text: anyonyaṃ spardhamānāśca anyonyasya hite ratāḥ / duryodhanastu rājendra sainyamadhye vyavasthitaḥ
ce_text: anyonyasamaduḥkhās te anyonyasamasāhasāḥ / anyonyaṃ spardhamānāś ca anyonyasya hite ratāḥ

vulgate_text: śarairagnisamasparśairākarṇasamacoditaiḥ sa gāḍhaviddho vyathito rathopastha upāviśat duḥśāsano mahārāja kaśmalaṃ cāviśanmahat / sārathistvaramāṇastu duḥśāsanamacetanam raṇamadhyādapovāha saubhadraśarapīḍitam
ce_text: sa gāḍhaviddho vyathito rathopastha upāviśat / duḥśāsano mahārāja kaśmalaṃ cāviśan mahat

ce_text: pautraṃ tu tava durdharṣaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ priyadarśanam / pituḥ samīpe tiṣṭhantaṃ śūram udyatakārmukam

vulgate_text: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca / enaṃ jitvā kṛpaṃ śalyaṃ rājānaṃ ca suyodhanam / drom̐ṇaṃ drauṇiṃ maheṣvāsaṃ tathaivānyānmahārathān
ce_text: na me jayaḥ prītikaro na rājyaṃ; na cāmaratvaṃ na suraiḥ salokatā / imaṃ samīkṣyāprativīryapauruṣaṃ; nipātitaṃ devavarātmajātmajam / saṃjaya uvāca / evaṃ vilapamāne tu kuntīputre yudhiṣṭhire / kṛṣṇadvaipāyanas tatra ājagāma mahān ṛṣiḥ / tam arcitvā yathānyāyam upaviṣṭaṃ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / abravīc chokasaṃtapto bhrātuḥ putravadhena saḥ / adharmayuktair bahubhiḥ parivārya mahārathaiḥ / yudhyamāno maheṣvāsaiḥ saubhadro nihato raṇe / bālaś cābālabuddhiś ca saubhadraḥ paravīrahā / anupāyena saṃgrāme yudhyamāno vināśitaḥ / mayā proktaḥ sa saṃgrāme dvāraṃ saṃjanayasva naḥ / praviṣṭe ca parāṃs tasmin saindhavena sma vāritāḥ / nanu nāma samaṃ yuddham eṣṭavyaṃ yuddhajīvibhiḥ / idaṃ caivāsamaṃ yuddham īdṛśaṃ prakṛtaṃ paraiḥ / tenāsmi bhṛśasaṃtaptaḥ śokabāṣpasamākulaḥ / śamaṃ naivādhigacchāmi cintayānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ / taṃ tathā vilapantaṃ vai śokabāṣpasamākulam / uvāca bhagavān vyāso yudhiṣṭhiram idaṃ vacaḥ / yudhiṣṭhira mahāprājña sarvaśāstraviśārada / vyasaneṣu na muhyanti tvādṛśā bharatarṣabha / svargam eṣa gataḥ śūraḥ śatrūn hatvā bahūn raṇe / abālasadṛśaṃ karma kṛtvā vai puruṣottamaḥ / anatikramaṇīyo vai vidhir eṣa yudhiṣṭhira / devadānavagandharvān mṛtyur harati bhārata / yudhiṣṭhira uvāca / ime vai pṛthivīpālāḥ śerate pṛthivītale / nihatāḥ pṛtanāmadhye mṛtasaṃjñā mahābalāḥ / nāgāyutabalāś cānye vāyuvegabalās tathā / naiṣāṃ paśyāmi hantāraṃ prāṇināṃ saṃyuge kva cit / vikrameṇopapannā hi tejobalasamanvitāḥ / atha ceme hatāḥ prājñāḥ śerate vigatāyuṣaḥ / mṛtā iti ca śabdo 'yaṃ vartate ca gatārthavat / ime mṛtā mahīpālāḥ prāyaśo bhīmavikramāḥ / rājaputrāś ca saṃrabdhā vaiśvānaramukhaṃ gatāḥ / atra me saṃśayaḥ prāptaḥ kutaḥ saṃjñā mṛtā iti / kasya mṛtyuḥ kuto mṛtyuḥ kena mṛtyur imāḥ prajāḥ / saṃjaya uvāca / haraty amarasaṃkāśa tan me brūhi pitāmaha / taṃ tathā paripṛcchantaṃ kuntīputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram / āśvāsanam idaṃ vākyam uvāca bhagavān ṛṣiḥ / atrāpy udāharantīmam itihāsaṃ purātanam / akampanasya kathitaṃ nāradena purā nṛpa / sa cāpi rājā rājendra putravyasanam uttamam / aprasahyatamaṃ loke prāptavān iti me matiḥ / tad ahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi mṛtyoḥ prabhavam uttamam / tatas tvaṃ mokṣyase duḥkhāt snehabaṃdhanasaṃśrayāt / purā vṛttam idaṃ tāta śṛṇu kīrtayato mama / dhanyam ākhyānam āyuṣyaṃ śokaghnaṃ puṣṭivardhanam / purā kṛtayuge tāta āsīd rājā hy akampanaḥ / sa śatruvaśam āpanno madhye saṃgrāmamūrdhani / tasya putro harir nāma nārāyaṇasamadyutiḥ / śrīmān kṛtāstro medhāvī yudhi śakrasamo balī / sa śatrubhiḥ parivṛto bahudhā raṇamūrdhani / vyasyan bāṇasahasrāṇi yodheṣu ca gajeṣu ca / sa karma duṣkaraṃ kṛtvā saṃgrāme śatrutāpanaḥ / śatrubhir nihataḥ saṃkhye pṛtanāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira / sa rājā pretakṛtyāni tasya kṛtvā śucānvitaḥ / śocann ahani rātrau ca nālabhat sukham ātmanaḥ / tasya śokaṃ viditvā tu putravyasanasaṃbhavam / athājagāma devarṣir nārado 'sya samīpataḥ / sa tu rājā mahābhāgo dṛṣṭvā devarṣisattamam / pūjayitvā yathānyāyaṃ kathām akathayat tadā / tasya sarvaṃ samācaṣṭa yathā vṛttaṃ nareśvara / śatrubhir vijayaṃ saṃkhye putrasya ca vadhaṃ tathā / mama putro mahāvīrya indraviṣṇusamadyutiḥ / śatrubhir bahubhiḥ saṃkhye parākramya hato balī / ka eṣa mṛtyur bhagavan kiṃvīryabalapauruṣaḥ / etad icchāmi tattvena śrotuṃ matimatāṃ vara / tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā nārado varadaḥ prabhuḥ / ākhyānam idam ācaṣṭa putraśokāpahaṃ mahat / nārada uvāca / śṛṇu rājan mahābāho ākhyānaṃ bahuvistaram / yathā vṛttaṃ śrutaṃ caiva mayāpi vasudhādhipa / prajāḥ sṛṣṭvā tadā brahmā ādisarge pitāmahaḥ / asaṃhṛtaṃ mahātejā dṛṣṭvā jagad idaṃ prabhuḥ / tasya cintā samutpannā saṃhāraṃ prati pārthiva / cintayan na hy asau veda saṃhāraṃ vasudhādhipa / tasya roṣān mahārāja khebhyo 'gnir udatiṣṭhata / tena sarvā diśo vyāptāḥ sāntardeśā didhakṣatā / tato divaṃ bhuvaṃ khaṃ ca jvālāmālāsamāvṛtam / carācaraṃ jagat sarvaṃ dadāha bhagavān prabhuḥ / tato hatāni bhūtāni carāṇi sthāvarāṇi ca / mahatā krodhavegena trāsayann iva vīryavān / tato haro jaṭī sthāṇur niśācarapatiḥ śivaḥ / jagāma śaraṇaṃ devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam / tasminn āpatite sthāṇau prajānāṃ hitakāmyayā / abravīt paramo devo jvalann iva mahāmuniḥ / kiṃ kurma kāmaṃ kāmārha kāmāj jāto 'si putraka / sthāṇur uvāca / kariṣyāmi priyaṃ sarvaṃ brūhi sthāṇo yad icchasi / prajāsarganimittaṃ hi kṛto yatnas tvayā vibho / tvayā sṛṣṭāś ca vṛddhāś ca bhūtagrāmāḥ pṛthagvidhāḥ / tās taveha punaḥ krodhāt prajā dahyanti sarvaśaḥ / brahmovāca / tā dṛṣṭvā mama kāruṇyaṃ prasīda bhagavan prabho / na krudhye na ca me kāma etad evaṃ bhaved iti / pṛthivyā hitakāmāt tu tato māṃ manyur āviśat / iyaṃ hi māṃ sadā devī bhārārtā samacūcudat / saṃhārārthaṃ mahādeva bhāreṇābhihatā satī / tato 'haṃ nādhigacchāmi tapye bahuvidhaṃ tadā / sthāṇur uvāca / saṃhāram aprameyasya tato māṃ manyur āviśat / saṃhārārthaṃ prasīdasva mā ruṣo vibudhādhipa / mā prajāḥ sthāvarāś caiva jaṅgamāś ca vyanīnaśan / tava prasādād bhagavann idaṃ vartet tridhā jagat / anāgatam atītaṃ ca yac ca saṃprati vartate / bhagavān krodhasaṃdīptaḥ krodhād agniṃ samāsṛjat / sa dahaty aśmakūṭāni drumāṃś ca saritas tathā / palvalāni ca sarvāṇi sarve caiva tṛṇolapāḥ / sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva niḥśeṣaṃ kurute jagat / tad etad bhasmasād bhūtaṃ sarvaṃ jagad dogdhā viśvaruciḥ prabhuḥ / svadhāṃ rajatapātre tu duduhuḥ pitaraś ca tām / vatso 'tra vatsaras teṣāṃ yamo dogdhā tathāntakaḥ / evaṃ nikāyais tair dugdhā payo 'bhīṣṭaṃ hi sā virāṭ / yair vartayanti te brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prāyacchad aśvamedhe mahāmakhe / ṣaṣṭināgasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭināgaśatāni ca / sauvarṇān akarod rājā brāhmaṇebhyaś ca tāṃ dadau / imāṃ ca pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ maṇiratnavibhūṣitām / sauvarṇīm akarod mahātapāḥ śūro vīralokanamaskṛtaḥ / jāmadagnyo 'py atiyaśā avitṛpto mariṣyati / yasyābhram anuparyeti bhūmiṃ kurvan vipāṃsulām / na cāsīd vikriyā yasya prāpya śriyam anuttamām / yaḥ kṣatriyaiḥ parāmṛṣṭe vatse pitari cukrudhe / tato 'vadhīt kārtavīryam ajitaṃ samare paraiḥ / kṣatriyāṇāṃ catuḥṣaṣṭim ayutāni sahasraśaḥ / tadā mṛtyoḥ sametāni ekaikaṃ dhanuṣājayat / brahmadviṣāṃ cātha tasmin sahasrāṇi caturdaśa / punar anyāni jagrāha dantakrūre jaghāna ha / sahasraṃ musalenāghnan sahasram asināvadhīt / udbandhanāt sahasraṃ ca haihayāḥ samare hatāḥ / sarathāśvagajā vīrā nihatās tatra śerate / pitur vadhāmarṣitena jāmadagnyena dhīmatā / nijaghne daśasāhasrān rāmaḥ paraśunā tadā / na hy amṛśyata tā vāco yās tair bhṛśam udīritāḥ / bhṛgo rāmābhidhāveti yadākrandan dvijottamāḥ / tataḥ kāśmīradaradān kuntikṣudrakamālavān / aṅgavaṅgakaliṅgāṃś ca videhāṃs tāmraliptakān / rakṣovāhān vītihotrāṃs trigartān mārtikāvatān / śibīn anyāṃś ca rājanyān deśe deśe sahasraśaḥ / nijaghāna śitair bāṇair jāmadagnyaḥ pratāpavān / koṭīśatasahasrāṇi kṣatriyāṇāṃ sahasraśaḥ / indragopakavarṇasya bandhujīvanibhasya ca / rudhirasya parīvāhaiḥ pūrayitvā sarāṃsi ca / sarvān aṣṭādaśa dvīpān vaśam ānīya bhārgavaḥ / īje kratuśataiḥ puṇyaiḥ samāptavaradakṣiṇaiḥ / vedīm aṣṭanavotsedhāṃ sauvarṇāṃ vidhinirmitām / sarvaratnaśataiḥ pūrṇāṃ patākāśatamālinīm / grāmyāraṇyaiḥ paśugaṇaiḥ saṃpūrṇāṃ ca mahīm imām / rāmasya jāmadagnyasya pratijagrāha kaśyapaḥ / tataḥ śatasahasrāṇi dvipendrān hemabhūṣaṇān / nirdasyuṃ pṛthivīṃ kṛtvā śiṣṭeṣṭajanasaṃkulām / kaśyapāya dadau rāmo hayamedhe mahāmakhe / triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ pṛthivīṃ kṛtvā niḥkṣatriyāṃ prabhuḥ / iṣṭvā kratuśatair vīro brāhmaṇebhyo hy amanyata / sa kaśyapasya vacanāt protsārya saritāṃ patim / iṣupāte yudhāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ kurvan brāhmaṇaśāsanam / adhyāvasad giriśreṣṭhaṃ mahendraṃ parvatottamam / evaṃ guṇaśatair juṣṭo bhṛgūṇāṃ kīrtivardhanaḥ / jāmadagnyo 'py atiyaśā mariṣyati mahādyutiḥ / tvayā caturbhadrataraḥ putrāt puṇyataras tava / ayajvānam adākṣiṇyaṃ mā putram anutapyathāḥ / ete caturbhadratarās tvayā bhadraśatādhikāḥ / vyāsa uvāca / mṛtā naravaraśreṣṭhā mariṣyanti ca sṛñjaya / puṇyam ākhyānam āyuṣyaṃ śrutvā ṣoḍaśarājakam / avyāharan narapatis tūṣṇīm āsīt sa sṛñjayaḥ / tam abravīt tathāsīnaṃ nārado bhagavān ṛṣiḥ / śrutaṃ kīrtayato mahyaṃ gṛhītaṃ te mahādyute / āho svid antato naṣṭaṃ śrāddhaṃ śūdrāpatāv iva / sa evam uktaḥ pratyāha prāñjaliḥ sṛñjayas tadā / putraśokāpahaṃ śrutvā dhanyam ākhyānam uttamam / rājarṣīṇāṃ purāṇānāṃ yajvanāṃ dakṣiṇāvatām / vismayena hate śoke tamasīvārkatejasā / nārada uvāca / vipāpmāsmy avyathopeto brūhi kiṃ karavāṇy aham / diṣṭyāpahataśokas tvaṃ vṛṇīṣveha yad icchasi / sṛñjaya uvāca / tat tat prapatsyase sarvaṃ na mṛṣāvādino vayam / etenaiva pratīto 'haṃ prasanno yad bhavān mama / nārada uvāca / prasanno yasya bhagavān na tasyāstīha durlabham / punar dadāmi te putraṃ dasyubhir nihataṃ vṛthā / vyāsa uvāca / uddhṛtya narakāt kaṣṭāt paśum aprokṣitaṃ yathā / prādur āsīt tataḥ putraḥ sṛñjayasyādbhutaprabhaḥ / prasannenarṣiṇā dattaḥ kuberatanayopamaḥ / tataḥ saṃgamya putreṇa prītimān abhavan nṛpaḥ / īje ca kratubhir mukhyaiḥ samāptavaradakṣiṇaiḥ / akṛtāstraś ca bhītaś ca na ca sāṃnāhiko hataḥ / ayajvā cānapatyaś ca tato 'sau jīvitaḥ punaḥ / śūro vīraḥ kṛtāstraś ca pramathyārīn sahasraśaḥ / abhimanyur gataḥ svargaṃ pṛtanābhimukho hataḥ / brahmacaryeṇa yān kāṃś cit prajñayā ca śrutena ca / iṣṭaiś ca kratubhir yānti tāṃs te putro 'kṣayān gataḥ / vidvāṃsaḥ karmabhiḥ puṇyaiḥ svargam īhanti nityaśaḥ / na tu svargād ayaṃ lokaḥ kāmyate svargavāsibhiḥ / tasmāt svargagataṃ putram arjunasya hataṃ raṇe / nehānayituṃ śakyaṃ hi kiṃ cid aprāpyam īśitum / evaṃ jñātvā sthiro bhūtvā mā śuco dhairyam āpnuhi / jīvanta eva naḥ śocyā na tu svargagatānagha / śocato hi mahārāja agham evābhivardhate / tasmāc chokaṃ parityajya śreyase prayated budhaḥ / praharṣam abhimānaṃ ca sukhaprāptiṃ ca cintayan / etad āhur budhāḥ śreyo na śokaḥ śoka ucyate / evaṃ vidvan samuttiṣṭha prayato bhava mā śucaḥ / śrutas te saṃbhavo mṛtyos tapāṃsy anupamāni ca / sarvabhūtasamatvaṃ ca cañcalāś ca vibhūtayaḥ / sṛñjayasya tu taṃ putraṃ mṛtaṃ saṃjīvitaṃ punaḥ / saṃjaya uvāca / evaṃ vidvan mahārāja mā śucaḥ sādhayāmy aham / etāvad uktvā bhagavāṃs tatraivāntaradhīyata / vāgīśāne bhagavati vyāse vyabhranabhaḥprabhe / gate matimatāṃ śreṣṭhe samāśvāsya yudhiṣṭhiram / pūrveṣāṃ pārthivendrāṇāṃ mahendrapratimaujasām / nyāyādhigatavittānāṃ tāṃ śrutvā yajñasaṃpadam / saṃpūjya manasā vidvān viśoko 'bhūd yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / punaś cācintayad dīnaḥ kiṃ svid vakṣye dhanaṃjayam

vulgate_text: kiṃ tu me hṛdayaṃ trastaṃ vākva sajjati keśava / syandane nāvatiṣṭhāmi gātraiḥ sīdāmi cācyuta

vulgate_text: vyaktaṃ śivaṃ sahabhrāturdharmarājasya pāṇḍava / mā śucaḥkiñcidevānyattatrāniṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyati / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tasmiṃs tu nihate vīre saubhadre rathayūthape / vimuktarathasaṃnāhāḥ sarve nikṣiptakārmukāḥ

vulgate_text: pradyumnasya priyaṃ nityaṃ keśavasya mamaiva ca / yadi putraṃ na paśyāmi yāsyāmi yamasādanam
ce_text: subhadrāyāḥ priyaṃ nityaṃ draupadyāḥ keśavasya ca / yadi putraṃ na paśyāmi yāsyāmi yamasādanam

vulgate_text: subhadrāmanuśocāmi yā putramapalāyinam / raṇe vinihataṃ śrutvā śokārtā vai vinaṅkṣati
ce_text: raṇe vinihataṃ śrutvā śokārtā vai vinaṃkṣyati / subhadrā vakṣyate kiṃ mām abhimanyum apaśyatī / draupadī caiva duḥkhārte te ca vakṣyāmi kiṃ nv aham

vulgate_text: subhadrā vakṣyate kiṃ māmabimanyumapaśyatī / draupadīṃ caiva duḥkhārtāṃ kiṃ vā vakṣyāmi tāmaham
ce_text: raṇe vinihataṃ śrutvā śokārtā vai vinaṃkṣyati / subhadrā vakṣyate kiṃ mām abhimanyum apaśyatī / draupadī caiva duḥkhārte te ca vakṣyāmi kiṃ nv aham

vulgate_text: aśaknuvantaḥ pārthasya bālaṃ hatvā mahābalam / kiṃ na lajjantyadharmajñāḥ pārthivā dṛśyatāṃ balam
ce_text: aśaknuvanto bībhatsuṃ bālaṃ hatvā mahārathāḥ / kiṃ nadadhvam adharmajñāḥ pārthe vai dṛśyatāṃ balam

vulgate_text: sanāgasyandanahayānsaṅgrāme nihatānmayā / kṣipraṃ drakṣyanti te nūnaṃ mama putraṃ nihatya vai
ce_text: sanāgasyandanahayān drakṣyadhvaṃ nihatān mayā / saṃgrāme sānubandhāṃs tān mama putrasya vairiṇaḥ

vulgate_text: yadyevamahamajñāsyamaśaktānrakṣaṇe mama / sūnoḥ pāṇḍavapāñcālānagopsyaṃ taṃ mahāraṇe

vulgate_text: vyūḍhānīkaṃ tato droṇaṃ yatamānaṃ mahāmṛdhe / prativyūhya sahānīkāḥ pratyarudhma vayaṃ balāt
ce_text: vyāḍhānīkaṃ vayaṃ droṇaṃ varayāmaḥ sma sarvaśaḥ / prativyūhya rathānīkaṃ yatamānaṃ tathā raṇe

vulgate_text: tato dauḥśāsaniḥ kṣipraṃ tathā tairvirathīkṛtam saṃśayaṃ paramaṃ prāptaṃ padātinamavasthitam / gadāhasto'bhyayāttūrṇaṃ jighāṃsuraparājitam
ce_text: tato dauḥśāsaniḥ kṣipraṃ tathā tair virathīkṛtam / saṃśayaṃ paramaṃ prāpya diṣṭāntenābhyayojayat

vulgate_text: bṛhadbalaṃ ca rājānaṃ svargeṇa samayojayat / gataḥ sukṛtināṃ lokānye ca svargajitāṃ śubhāḥ
ce_text: bṛhadbalaṃ ca rājānaṃ svargeṇājau prayojya ha / tataḥ paramadharmātmā diṣṭāntam upajagmivān

vulgate_text: pāṇiṃ pāṇau viniṣpiṣya dantānkaṭakaṭāyya ca triśikhāṃ bhrukuṭīṃ kṛtvā krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ / unmatta iva viprekṣannidaṃ vacanamabravīt / arjuna uvāca
ce_text: pāṇiṃ pāṇau viniṣpiṣya śvasamāno 'śrunetravān / unmatta iva viprekṣann idaṃ vacanam abravīt

vulgate_text: brāhmaṇasya pratiśrutya yo vai lobhāddadāti na / teṣāṃ gatiṃ gamiṣyāmi śvo na hanyāṃ jayadratham
ce_text: dharmād apetā ye cānye mayā nātrānukīrtitāḥ / ye cānukīrtitāḥ kṣipraṃ teṣāṃ gatim avāpnuyām / yadi vyuṣṭām imāṃ rātriṃ śvo na hanyāṃ jayadratham

vulgate_text: atha mṛditatamāgryadāmamālyaṃ tava sutaśokamayaṃ ca roṣajātam / vyapanudati mahāprabhāvasena-- nnaravara vākyamidaṃ mahārthamiṣṭam / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tasminn ahani nirvṛtte ghore prāṇabhṛtāṃ kṣaye / āditye 'staṃgate śrīmān saṃdhyākāla upasthite

vulgate_text: upasaṅgṛhya caraṇau droṇāya sa viśāmpatiḥ / upopaviśya praṇataḥ paryapṛcchadidaṃ vacaḥ
ce_text: upasaṃgrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā droṇāya sa viśāṃ pate / upopaviśya praṇataḥ paryapṛcchad idaṃ tadā

vulgate_text: vidyāviśeṣamicchāmi jñātumācārya tattvataḥ / arjunasyātmanaścaiva yāthātathyaṃ pracakṣva me / droṇa uvāca
ce_text: vidyāviśeṣam icchāmi jñātum ācārya tattvataḥ / mamārjunasya ca vibho yathātattvaṃ pracakṣva me

vulgate_text: śakrādbhīṣmātkṛpāddroṇāddevādrudrācca yanmayā / upāttamastraṃ ghoraṃ taddaṣṭāro'tra narā yudhi

vulgate_text: gāṇḍīvaṃ ca dhanurdivyaṃ yoddhāraṃ ca dhanañjam / yantāraṃ ca hṛṣīkeśaṃ ko'tivarteta saṃyuge
ce_text: gāṇḍīvaṃ ca dhanur divyaṃ yoddhā cāhaṃ nararṣabha / tvaṃ ca yantā hṛṣīkeśa kiṃ nu syād ajitaṃ mayā

vulgate_text: śvaḥ śiraḥ pādamūlaṃ te saindhavasyāhṛtaṃ dhruvam / paddhyāṃ pramathitāsi tvaṃ viśokā bhava mā rudaḥ

vulgate_text: dhikkekayāṃstathā cedīnmatsyāṃścaivātha sṛñjayān / ye tvāṃ raṇagataṃ vīraṃ na śekurabhirakṣitum
ce_text: dhik kekayāṃs tathā cedīn matsyāṃś caivātha sṛñjayān / ye tvā raṇe gataṃ vīraṃ na jānanti nipātitam

vulgate_text: imāṃ te taruṇīṃ bhāryāṃ tavādhibhirabhiplutām / uttarāmuttamāṃ jātyā suśīlāṃ priya bhāṣiṇīm
ce_text: imāṃ te taruṇīṃ bhāryāṃ tvadādhibhir abhiplutām / kathaṃ saṃdhārayiṣyāmi vivatsām iva dhenukām

vulgate_text: tvayā vinā kathaṃ putra jīrṇāṃ patitamānasām / imāṃ sandhārayiṣyāmi vṛṣabhādiva dhenukām
ce_text: imāṃ te taruṇīṃ bhāryāṃ tvadādhibhir abhiplutām / kathaṃ saṃdhārayiṣyāmi vivatsām iva dhenukām

vulgate_text: brāhmaṇebhyaḥ śaraṇyebhyo nidhiṃ nidadhatāṃ ca yā / yā cāpi nyastadaṇḍānāṃ tāṃ gatiṃ vraja putraka
ce_text: dīnānukampināṃ yā ca satataṃ saṃvibhāginām / paiśunyāc ca nivṛttānāṃ tāṃ gatiṃ vraja putraka

vulgate_text: mātāpitrośca śuśrūṣāṃ kalpayantīha ye sadā / svadāraniratānāṃ ca yā gatistāmavāpnuhi

vulgate_text: bhavitā nu kathaṃ kṛtyamidamityabruvañjanāḥ / śvo'hatvā sindhurājaṃ vai dhūmaketuṃ pravekṣyati

vulgate_text: ahaṃ vijitya tānsarvānsahasā sahayadvipān / arjunārthe haniṣyāmi sakarṇānsasuyodhanān

vulgate_text: pāñcajanyasya nirghoṣaṃ parjanyaninadopamam / śrutvā ca bhairavaṃ nādamupeyāstvaṃ javena mām
ce_text: pāñcajanyasya nirghoṣam ārṣabheṇaiva pūritam / śrutvā tu bhairavaṃ nādam upayāyā javena mām

vulgate_text: yasyayasya ca bībhatsurvadhe yatnaṃ kariṣyati / āśaṃse'haṃ raṇe tantaṃ tatratatra haniṣyati / dāruka uvāca
ce_text: yasya yasya ca bībhatsur vadhe yatnaṃ kariṣyati / āśaṃse sārathe tatra bhavitāsya dhruvo jayaḥ

vulgate_text: daśa caikā ca tāḥ kṛṣṇa akṣauhiṇyaḥ sudurjayāḥ / hatāvaśeṣāstatremā hanta mādhava saṅkhyayā
ce_text: daśa caikā ca tāḥ kṛṣṇa akṣauhiṇyaḥ sudurjayāḥ / pratijñāyāṃ ca hīnāyāṃ kathaṃ jīveta madvidhaḥ

ce_text: daśa caikā ca tāḥ kṛṣṇa akṣauhiṇyaḥ sudurjayāḥ / pratijñāyāṃ ca hīnāyāṃ kathaṃ jīveta madvidhaḥ

vulgate_text: tatastāvāgatau dṛṣṭvā naranārāyaṇāvubhau / suprasannamanāḥ śarvaḥ provāca prahasanniva

vulgate_text: kumāragurave tubhyaṃ nīlagrīvāya vedhase / pinākine haviṣyāya satyāya vibhave sadā
ce_text: kumāragurave nityaṃ nīlagrīvāya vedhase / vilohitāya dhūmrāya vyādhāyānaparājite

vulgate_text: abhigamyāya kāmyāya stutyāyāryāya sarvadā namo'stu devadevāya mahābhūtadharāya ca / namo viśvasya pataye pattīnāṃ pataye namaḥ
ce_text: namo 'stu vācaspataye prajānāṃ pataye namaḥ / namo viśvasya pataye mahatāṃ pataye namaḥ

vulgate_text: sañjaya uvāca / tataḥ pārthaḥ prasannātmā prāñjalirvṛṣabhadhvajam / dadarśotphullanayanaḥ samastaṃ tejasāṃ nidhim
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tato 'rjunasya bhavanaṃ praviśyāpratimaṃ vibhuḥ / spṛṣṭvāmbhaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ sthaṇḍile śubhalakṣaṇe / saṃtastāra śubhāṃ śayyāṃ darbhair vaiḍūryasaṃnibhaiḥ

ce_text: tatas tāv āgatau śarvaḥ provāca prahasann iva / svāgataṃ vāṃ naraśreṣṭhāv uttiṣṭhetāṃ gataklamau / kiṃ ca vām īpsitaṃ vīrau manasaḥ kṣipram ucyatām

vulgate_text: tataḥ pāśupataṃ divyamavāpya punarīśvarāt / saṃhṛṣṭaromā durdharṣaḥ kṛtaṃ kāryamamanyata
ce_text: saṃhṛṣṭaromā durdharṣaḥ kṛtaṃ kāryam amanyata / vavandatuś ca saṃhṛṣṭau śirobhyāṃ tau maheśvaram

ce_text: saṃhṛṣṭaromā durdharṣaḥ kṛtaṃ kāryam amanyata / vavandatuś ca saṃhṛṣṭau śirobhyāṃ tau maheśvaram

ce_text: tataḥ praveśya vārṣṇeyam upaveśya varāsane / satkṛtya satkṛtas tena paryapṛcchad yudhiṣṭhiraḥ

vulgate_text: vāsudevo'pi tadyuktaṃ pratyuvāca yudhiṣṭhiram / darśanādeva te saumya na kiñcidaśubhaṃ mama / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tayoḥ saṃvadator eva kṛṣṇadārukayos tadā / sātyagād rajanī rājann atha rājānvabudhyata

ce_text: anujñātaś ca rājñā sa prāveśayata taṃ janam / virāṭaṃ bhīmasenaṃ ca dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ ca sātyakim

ce_text: vāsudeva uvāca / sāmareṣv api lokeṣu sarveṣu na tathāvidhaḥ / śarāsanadharaḥ kaś cid yathā pārtho dhanaṃjayaḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ puruṣaśārdūlaḥ sajjaṃ sarvaṃ nyavedayat / rathaṃ puruṣasiṃhasya sadhvajaṃ supatākinam
