vulgate_text: tato'rjuno mahārāja mahātmā mahatāṃ patiḥ / mahārathasamākhyāto maheṣvāso vyavasthitaḥ
ce_text: evaṃ bruvan mahārāja mahātmā sa mahāmatiḥ / maheṣvāsair vṛto rājan maheṣvāso vyavasthitaḥ

vulgate_text: śūlapāṇirivākṣobhyo varuṇaḥ pāśavāniva / yugāntāgnirivārciṣmāndidhakṣuḥ sthāsnujaṅgamam
ce_text: śūlapāṇir ivākṣobhyo varuṇaḥ pāśavān iva / yugāntāgnir ivārciṣmān pradhakṣyan vai punaḥ prajāḥ

vulgate_text: kabandha utthitaḥ kaścidviṣphārya saśaraṃ dhanuḥ kiñcitkhaṅgaṃ viniṣkṛṣya bhujenodyamya tiṣṭhati / gṛhītvā'nyasya keśeṣu śiro nṛtyati cāparaḥ
ce_text: tataḥ kabandhaḥ kaś cit tu dhanur ālambya tiṣṭhati / kaś cit khaḍgaṃ viniṣkṛṣya bhujenodyamya tiṣṭhati

vulgate_text: patitāni na jānanti śirāṃsi puruṣarṣabhāḥ / amṛṣyamāṇāḥ saṅgrāme kaunteyaṃ jayagṛddhinaḥ
ce_text: nājānanta śirāṃsy urvyāṃ patitāni nararṣabhāḥ / amṛṣyamāṇāḥ kaunteyaṃ saṃgrāme jayagṛddhinaḥ

vulgate_text: ayaṃ pārthaḥ kutaḥ pārthaḥ pārtho'yamiti sarvaśaḥ tiṣṭha pārthehi māṃ pārtha kva yāsīti ca jalpatām / tava sainyeṣu yodhānāṃ pārthabhūtamivābhavat
ce_text: ayaṃ pārthaḥ kutaḥ pārtha eṣa pārtha iti prabho / tava sainyeṣu yodhānāṃ pārthabhūtam ivābhavat

vulgate_text: nānāvāditraśabdena pāñcajanyasvanena ca devadattasya ghoṣeṇa gāṇḍīvaninadena ca / mandavegā narā nāgā babhūvuste vicetasaḥ
ce_text: khuraśabdena cāśvānāṃ nemighoṣeṇa tena ca / tena cotkruṣṭaśabdena jyāninādena tena ca / devadattasya ghoṣeṇa gāṇḍīvaninadena ca

vulgate_text: śarairāśīviṣasparśairnirbhinnāḥ savyasācinā / te gajāḥ samasīdanta magnāḥ paṅkārṇaveṣviva
ce_text: mandavegatarā nāgā babhūvus te vicetasaḥ / śarair āśīviṣasparśair nirbhinnāḥ savyasācinā

vulgate_text: pārthapārtha mahābāho na naḥ kālātyayo bhavet / droṇamutsṛjya gacchāmo brāhmaṇo'sau gataklamaḥ / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tathārjunena saṃbhagne tasmiṃs tava bale tadā / hatavīre hatotsāhe palāyanakṛtakṣaṇe

vulgate_text: jaghāna cāsthitaṃ vīraṃ śrutāyudhamamarṣaṇam sa papāta hato bhūmau viśirā vibhujo balī / sambhagna iva vātena bahuśākho vanaspatiḥ
ce_text: patamānas tu sa babhau parṇāśāyāḥ priyaḥ sutaḥ / saṃbhagna iva vātena bahuśākho vanaspatiḥ

vulgate_text: sā visphurantī jvalitā vajravegasamā gadā / hatvā śrutāyudhaṃ vīraṃ dharaṇīmanvapadyata
ce_text: jaghāna cāsthitaṃ vīraṃ śrutāyudham amarṣaṇam / hatvā śrutāyudhaṃ vīraṃ jagatīm anvapadyata

vulgate_text: śete sma nihato bhūmau kāmbhojāstaraṇocitaḥ / mahārhābharaṇopetaḥ sānumāniva parvataḥ
ce_text: śete sma nihato bhūmau kāmbojāstaraṇocitaḥ / sudarśanīyas tāmrākṣaḥ karṇinā sa sudakṣiṇaḥ / putraḥ kāmbojarājasya pārthena vinipātitaḥ

vulgate_text: yavanāḥ pāradāścaiva śakāśca saha bāhlikaiḥ / kākavarṇā durācārāḥ strīlolāḥ kalahapriyāḥ
ce_text: vidanty asuramāyāṃ ye sughorā ghoracakṣuṣaḥ / yavanāḥ pāradāś caiva śakāś ca sunikaiḥ saha

vulgate_text: drāviḍāstatra yudhyante mattamātaṅgavikramāḥ / goyoniprabhavā mlecchāḥ kālakalpāḥ prahāriṇaḥ
ce_text: goyoniprabhavā mlecchāḥ kālakalpāḥ prahāriṇaḥ / dārvābhisārā daradāḥ puṇḍrāś ca saha bāhlikaiḥ

vulgate_text: dārvātisārā daradāḥ puṇḍrāścaiva sahasraśaḥ / te na śakyāḥ sma saṅkhyātuṃ vrātāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ
ce_text: na te sma śakyāḥ saṃkhyātuṃ vrātāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ / vṛṣṭis tathāvidhā hy āsīc chalabhānām ivāyatiḥ

vulgate_text: teṣāmapi sasarjāśu śaravṛṣṭiṃ dhanañjayaḥ / sṛṣṭistathāvidhā hyāsīcchalabhānāmivāyatiḥ
ce_text: na te sma śakyāḥ saṃkhyātuṃ vrātāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ / vṛṣṭis tathāvidhā hy āsīc chalabhānām ivāyatiḥ

vulgate_text: chinnāṅgulīkṣudramatsyāṃ yugānte kālasannibhām / prākarodgajasambādhāṃ nadīmuttaraśoṇitām
ce_text: śirastrāṇakṣudramatsyāṃ yugānte kālasaṃbhṛtām / akarod gajasaṃbādhāṃ nadīm uttaraśoṇitām / dehebhyo rājaputrāṇāṃ nāgāśvarathasādinām

vulgate_text: tataḥ prāvartata nadī śoṇitaughataraṅgiṇī / narāśvadvipakāyebhyaḥ parvatebhya ivāpagā
ce_text: pattyaśvarathanāgaiś ca pracchannakṛtasaṃkramām / śaravarṣaplavāṃ ghorāṃ keśaśaivalaśāḍvalām / prāvartayan nadīm ugrāṃ śoṇitaughataraṅgiṇīm

vulgate_text: rudrasyākrīḍasadṛśīṃ bhūmiṃ kurvanvibhīṣaṇām / prāviśadbhāratīṃ senāṃ saṅkruddho vai dhanañjayaḥ
ce_text: vajrakalpaiḥ śarair bhūmiṃ kurvann uttaraśoṇitām / prāviśad bhāratīṃ senāṃ saṃkruddho vai dhanaṃjayaḥ / taṃ śrutāyus tathāmbaṣṭho vrajamānaṃ nyavārayat

vulgate_text: karotu svasti te brahmā svasti kurvantu brāhmaṇāḥ / sarīsṛpāśca ye śreṣṭhāstebhyaste svasti bhārata
ce_text: droṇa uvāca / karotu svasti te brahmā svasti cāpi dvijātayaḥ / sarīsṛpāś ca ye śreṣṭhās tebhyas te svasti bhārata

vulgate_text: diggajāścaiva catvāraḥ kṣitiśca gaganaṃ grahāḥ diśaśca vidiśaścaiva siddhā lokahite ratāḥ / svasti kurvantu te nityaṃ mantreṇānena rastutāḥ
ce_text: vivasvān bhagavān svasti karotu tava sarvaśaḥ / diggajāś caiva catvāraḥ kṣitiḥ khaṃ gaganaṃ grahāḥ

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvā jeṣyatha vṛtraṃ taṃ kṣipraṃ gacchata mandaram / yatrāste tapasāṃ yonirdakṣayajñavināśanaḥ
ce_text: dṛṣṭvā haniṣyatha ripuṃ kṣipraṃ gacchata mandaram / yatrāste tapasāṃ yonir dakṣayajñavināśanaḥ / pinākī sarvabhūteśo bhaganetranipātanaḥ

vulgate_text: badhānānena mantreṇa mānasena sureśvara / vadhāyāsuramukhyasya vṛtrasya suraghātinaḥ
ce_text: avaśyaṃ tu mayā kāryaṃ sāhyaṃ sarvadivaukasām / mamedaṃ gātrajaṃ śakra kavacaṃ gṛhya bhāsvaram / badhānānena mantreṇa mānasena sureśvara

vulgate_text: sa sannaddho mahābāhurācāryeṇa mahātmanā / prasthitaḥ sahasā rājanyatra yāto dhanañjayaḥ
ce_text: sa saṃnaddho mahābāhur ācāryeṇa mahātmanā / rathānāṃ ca sahasreṇa trigartānāṃ prahāriṇām

vulgate_text: tapanīyatanutrāṇāḥ saṃsiktā rudhireṇa ca kovidārā ivābhānti puṣpitāstatra bhārata / tāvakāḥ samare yodhāḥ pāṇḍaveyāśca vikṣatāḥ
ce_text: tapanīyavicitrāṅgāḥ saṃsiktā rudhireṇa ca / saṃsaktā iva dṛśyante meghasaṃghāḥ savidyutaḥ

vulgate_text: na sma sūryastadā bhāti na vavau ca samīraṇaḥ / haṣujālāvṛtaṃ ghoramandhakāraṃ samantataḥ
ce_text: iṣujālāvṛtaṃ ghoram andhakāram anantaram / anādhṛṣyam ivānyeṣāṃ śūrāṇām abhavat tadā

vulgate_text: anādhṛṣyamivānyeṣāṃ śūrāṇāmabhavattadā / andhakārīkṛte loke droṇaśaineyayoḥ śaraiḥ
ce_text: iṣujālāvṛtaṃ ghoram andhakāram anantaram / anādhṛṣyam ivānyeṣāṃ śūrāṇām abhavat tadā

vulgate_text: ubhayoḥ patite chatre tathaiva patitau dhvajau / nikṛntatoḥ śaraistīkṣṇairdroṇasātyakayo raṇe
ce_text: ubhayoḥ patite chatre tathaiva patitau dhvajau / ubhau rudhirasiktāṅgāv ubhau ca vijayaiṣiṇau

vulgate_text: sainyena rajasā dhvaste nirmaryādamavartata tenāntareṇa pārthastu raṇe jitvā mahāripūn
ce_text: sarvam āvignam abhavan na prājñāyata kiṃ cana / sainyena rajasā dhvaste nirmaryādam avartata

vulgate_text: tayostu dhanuṣī muṣṭau bhallābhyāṃ śvetavāhanaḥ ciccheda samare tūrṇaṃ bhūya eva dhanañjayaḥ / athānyairviśikhaistūrṇaṃ dhvajau ca kanakojjvalau
ce_text: tayos tu dhanuṣī citre bhallābhyāṃ śvetavāhanaḥ / ciccheda samare tūrṇaṃ dhvajau ca kanakojjvalau

vulgate_text: tathānyairviśikhaistūrṇaṃ rukmapuṅkhaiḥ śilāśitaiḥ / jaghānāśvāṃstathā sūtau pārṣṇī ca sapadānugau
ce_text: tathānyair viśikhais tūrṇaṃ hemapuṅkhaiḥ śilāśitaiḥ / jaghānāśvān sapadātāṃs tathobhau pārṣṇisārathī

vulgate_text: arjune dharaṇīṃ prāpte hayahaste ca keśave / etadantaramāsādya kathaṃ pārtho na ghātitaḥ / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / saṃpradrutaḥ krodhaviṣo vyāditāsyaśarāsanaḥ / tīkṣṇadhāreṣudaśanaḥ śitanārācadaṃṣṭravān

vulgate_text: bhayaṃ vipulamasmāsu tāvadhattāṃ narottamau tejo vidadhatuścograṃ yatsainyaṃ tāvakaṃ vibho / dadhāraiko raṇe pārtho velevodvṛttamarṇavam
ce_text: bhayaṃ vipulam asmāsu tāv adhattāṃ narottamau / tejo vidadhatuś cograṃ visrabdhau raṇamūrdhani

vulgate_text: upāvṛttyotthitānaśvānpāṇibhyāṃ puṣkarekṣaṇaḥ / sammārjayanraṇe rājanpaśyatāṃ sarvayodhinām
ce_text: upāvartayad avyagras tān aśvān puṣkarekṣaṇaḥ / miṣatāṃ sarvasainyānāṃ tvadīyānāṃ viśāṃ pate

vulgate_text: sainyeṣu viprayāteṣu dhiṣṭhitaṃ puruṣarṣabham / duryodhano'tvayātpārthaṃ tvaramāṇo mahāhave
ce_text: apanīyatsu śalyeṣu dhiṣṭhitaṃ puruṣarṣabham / duryodhanas tv agāt pārthaṃ tvaramāṇo mahāhave

vulgate_text: droṇena niyataṃ kṛṣṇa dhārtarāṣṭre nidarśitam / ante vihitamastrāṇāmetatkavacadhāraṇam
ce_text: arjuna uvāca / droṇenaiṣā matiḥ kṛṣṇa dhārtarāṣṭre niveśitā / ante vihitam astrāṇām etat kavacadhāraṇam

vulgate_text: idamaṅgirase prādāddeveśo varma bhāsvaram / tasmādvṛhaspatiḥ prāpa tataḥ prāpa purandaraḥ
ce_text: idam aṅgirase prādād deveśo varma bhāsvaram / punar dadau surapatir mahyaṃ varma sasaṃgraham

vulgate_text: punardadau surapatirmahyaṃ varma sasaṅgraham daivaṃ yadyasya varmaitadbrahmaṇā vā svayaṃ kṛtam / nainaṃ gopsyati durbuddhimadya bāṇahataṃ mayā / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / taṃ tathety abravīt pārthaḥ kṛtyarūpam idaṃ mama / sarvam anyad anādṛtya gaccha yatra suyodhanaḥ

vulgate_text: evamuktvā'rjuno bāṇānabhimantrya vyakarṣayat / mānavāstreṇa mānārhastīkṣṇāvaraṇabhedinā
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / evam uktvārjuno bāṇān abhimantrya vyakarṣayat / vikṛṣyamāṇāṃs tenaivaṃ dhanurmadhyagatāñ śarān / tān asyāstreṇa ciccheda drauṇiḥ sarvāstraghātinā

vulgate_text: sañjaya uvāca / tāvakāstvabhisamprekṣya vṛṣṇyandhakarūdvahau / satvarāstau jighāṃsantastathaiva vijayaḥ parān
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / evam uktvārjunaṃ rājā tribhir marmātigaiḥ śaraiḥ / pratyavidhyan mahāvegaiś caturbhiś caturo hayān

vulgate_text: amṛṣyamāṇāstaṃ śabdaṃ kruddhāḥ paramadhanvinaḥ / karṇādayo maheṣvāsāstvatsainyaparirakṣiṇaḥ
ce_text: mahārathasamākhyātā duryodhanahitaiṣiṇaḥ / amṛṣyamāṇās taṃ śabdaṃ kruddhāḥ paramadhanvinaḥ / nānādeśyā mahīpālāḥ svasainyaparirakṣiṇaḥ

vulgate_text: tatprahṛṣṭajanābādhaṃ bherīśaṅkhanināditam / babhūva bhṛśamudvignaṃ nirghātairiva saṃvṛtam
ce_text: tat prayuktam ivākāśaṃ śūraiḥ śaṅkhanināditam / babhūva bhṛśam udvignaṃ nirghātair iva nāditam

vulgate_text: anekavarṇā vividhā dhvajāḥ paramaśobhanāḥ te dhvajāḥ saṃvṛtāsteṣāṃ patākābhiḥ samantataḥ / nānāvarṇavirāṇābhiḥ śuśubhuḥ sarvato vṛtāḥ
ce_text: te dhvajāḥ saṃvṛtās teṣāṃ patākābhiḥ samantataḥ / nānāvarṇavirāgābhir vibabhuḥ sarvato vṛtāḥ

vulgate_text: siṃhalāṅgūla ugrāsyo dhvajo vānaralakṣaṇaḥ / dhanañjayasya saṅgrāme pratyadṛśyata bhārata
ce_text: siṃhalāṅgūlam ugrāsyaṃ dhajaṃ vānaralakṣaṇam / dhanaṃjayasya saṃgrāme pratyapaśyāma bhairavam

vulgate_text: tatrārjuno naravyāghraḥ śarairmuktaiḥ sahasraśaḥ / adṛśyāṃstāvakānyodhānpracakre śatrutāpanaḥ
ce_text: tatrārjuno mahārāja śarair muktaiḥ sahasraśaḥ / adṛśyān akarod yodhāṃs tāvakāñ śatrutāpanaḥ

vulgate_text: adṛśyaṃ samare cakre rājānaṃ sāyakottamaiḥ / sāśvasūtadhvajaṃ droṇaḥ paśyatāṃ sarvadhanvinām
ce_text: bhūya eva tu viṃśatyā sāyakānāṃ samācinot / sāśvasūtadhvajaṃ droṇaḥ paśyatāṃ sarvadhanvinām

vulgate_text: tiṣṭhedānīṃ raṇe pārtha paśya me'dya parākramam bāko nāma sudurbuddhe rākṣasapravaro balī
ce_text: ghoraṃ rūpam atho kṛtvā bhīmasenam abhāṣata / tiṣṭhedānīṃ raṇe pārtha paśya me 'dya parākramam

vulgate_text: uccāvacāni rūpāṇi cakāra subahūni ca / aṇurbṛhatpunaḥ sthūlo nādānmuñcannivāmbudaḥ
ce_text: uccāvacāni rūpāṇi cakāra subahūni ca / uccāvacās tathā vāco vyājahāra samantataḥ

vulgate_text: tayoryuddhaṃ samabhavadrakṣogrāmaṇimukhyayoḥ / yādṛgeva purā vṛttaṃ rāmarāvaṇayoḥ prabho
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / kirantaṃ śaravarṣāṇi roṣād droṇaṃ mahāmṛdhe / vitrāsayantaṃ tāṃ senāṃ kaunteyānāṃ mahīpate / dṛṣṭvā tato maheṣvāso nighnantaṃ ca rathān bhṛśam / ghaṭotkaco mahābāhū raṇāyābhijagāma ha / piśācavadanair yuktaṃ rathaṃ kāñcanabhūṣitam / samāsthāya mahārāja nānāpraharaṇair vṛtam / daṃśitas tapanīyena kavacena suvarcasā / bhūṣaṇair ācitāṅgaś ca nadann iva ca toyadaḥ / haiḍimbeyaḥ susaṃkruddho droṇam abhyadravad balī / tam abhyadhāvad āyāntaṃ kruddharūpam alambusaḥ / ṛkṣacarmaparikṣiptaṃ ratham āsthāya daṃśitaḥ / raktoṣṭhaḥ sadhanuḥ prāṃśuḥ kalpavṛkṣa iva sthitaḥ / kṣipañ chataghnīṃ vipulāṃ musalopalatomarān / musaṇṭhīr bahulāś caiva triśūlān api paṭṭasān / karpaṇāñ śatadhārāṃś ca pinākān vividhāṃs tathā / cakrāṇi ca kṣuraprāṇi kṣepaṇīś ca kaṭaṃkaṭān / nārācān vividhān asyan sakaṅkolūkavāyasaḥ / cikṣepa dhanur ādāya ninadan bhairavān ravān / taṃ raudraṃ krūram āyāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā kālam ivāgatam / prādravad bhayasaṃvignā sā rājan pāṇḍuvāhinī / satyakas tu naravyāghro dṛṣṭvā taṃ rākṣasaṃ yudhi / abhyayād amaraprakhyo bhrāmayitvā mahad dhanuḥ / abhyadravac ca tad rakṣas tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti cābravīt / alambusaṃ rākṣasendraṃ so 'stravarṣair avākirat / tataḥ pāṇḍavasainyāni vidrutāny atha bhārata / nirīkṣyābhyadravat tūrṇaṃ tvaramāṇo ghaṭotkacaḥ / cikṣepa ca gadāśaktīs tomarān atha paṭṭasān / hemacitratsarūn ugrān khaḍgān ākāśasaprabhān / anyonyam ārād ālokya rākṣasau tau mahābalau / bhairavaṃ nadatur nādān satoyāv iva toyadau / tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ ghoraṃ rākṣasasiṃhayoḥ / yādṛg eva purā vṛttaṃ rāmarāvaṇayor mṛdhe / tau śaktīś ca pinākāṃś ca vajrān khaḍgān paraṣvadhān / anyonyam abhisaṃkruddhau tadā vyasṛjatām ubhau / ākṛṣyamāṇe dhanuṣī tayor bāhubalena ca / yantreṇeva tadā rājan bhṛśaṃ nādān pracakratuḥ / alambusas tataś cakraṃ kṛtāntajvalanaprabham / ghaṭotkacāya cikṣepa yatnam āsthāya vīryavān / tad bhaimaseniḥ saṃprekṣya cakraṃ vegavad antare / gadayā tāḍayām āsa tad dīrṇaṃ śatadhābhavat / tato 'gnicūrṇaiḥ sahasā cakraghātaviniḥsṛtaiḥ / daṃśakair iva sā senā patadbhir bhṛśasaṃkulā / tataḥ pratihate cakre sa vīro roṣasaṃkulaḥ / prāhiṇot tarasā śūlaṃ śaktīr daśaśatās tadā / jvalantīr vikirantīś ca jvālāmālāḥ sahasraśaḥ / yugāntolkānibhās tīkṣṇā hemadaṇḍā mahāsvanāḥ / tāś cāpatantīḥ saṃprekṣya rākṣasasya ghaṭotkacaḥ / ardhacandraiḥ praciccheda nārācaiḥ kaṅkapatribhiḥ / tato roṣaparītāṅgaḥ pramumoca sa rākṣasaḥ / śaravarṣaṃ mahāghoraṃ ghaṭotkacarathaṃ prati / alambusaṃ tathā yuddhe vicarantam abhītavat / haiḍimbaḥ prayayau tūrṇaṃ vivyādha ca śitaiḥ śaraiḥ

vulgate_text: te śaऱā nataparvāṇo bhaimasenivinirbhidaḥ / ruṣitāḥ pannagā yadvadyodhamukhyānupāgaman
ce_text: te śarā nataparvāṇo viviśū rākṣasaṃ tadā / ruṣitāḥ pannagā yadvad girim ugrā mahābalāḥ

vulgate_text: sa vidhyamānaḥ samare pāṇḍavairjitakāśibhiḥ / *nābhyapadyata kartavyamārśyaśṛṅgirmahābalaḥ
ce_text: sa vadhyamānaḥ samare pāṇḍavair jitakāśibhiḥ / ghaṭotkaco 'py asaṃbhrāntaḥ śaravarṣaṃ mahattaram / alambusavadhaprepsur mumocāgnir iva jvalan / alambusarathāc cogrād ghaṭotkacarathād api / śarāḥ prādurbhavanti sma dvirephā iva khād diśaḥ / abhracchāyeva racitā bāṇais tatra nareśvara / na sma vijñāyate kiṃ cid andhakāre kṛte śaraiḥ / tata ākarṇamuktena bhallena ca ghaṭotkacaḥ / alambusasya ciccheda śiro yantur mahābalaḥ / tato 'parair vegavadbhiḥ kṣurais tasya ghaṭotkacaḥ / akṣamīṣāṃ yugaṃ caiva ciccheda yudhi tāḍayan / avaskandya rathāt tūrṇaṃ kairmīriḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ / tasmin māyāmayaṃ ghoram astravarṣaṃ vavarṣa ha / ghaṭotkaco 'pyāśu rathāt praskandya sa tam eva ca / māyāstreṇaiva māyāstraṃ vyadhamat samare ripoḥ / haiḍimbenārdyamānas tu yudhi so 'lambuso dṛḍham / antarhito mahārāja ghaṭotkacam ayodhayat / antardhānagataṃ dṛṣṭvā tatra tatra ghaṭotkacaḥ / gadayā tāḍayām āsa vegavatyā mahābalaḥ / utpapāta tato vyomni prahāraparipīḍitaḥ / alambuso rākṣasendraḥ sahasā pakṣirāḍ iva / ghaṭotkaco 'py asaṃbhrāntaḥ khaḍgapāṇir athotpatat / tato vegena mahatā vivarṣiṣur ivāmbudaḥ / tam āpatantaṃ saṃprekṣya kairmīrī rākṣasottamaḥ / abhidudrāva vegena siṃhaḥ siṃham iva sthitam / dakṣiṇenāsim udyamya vakṣaḥ pracchādya varmaṇā / abhidudrāva vegena vegavantaṃ ghaṭotkacaḥ / tāv ubhau vegasaṃrabdhāv alambusaghaṭotkacau / anyonyasya tathaivorū samājaghnatur añjasā / anyonyasyābhighātena tayo rākṣasasiṃhayoḥ / śailenābhihatasyaiva śailasyābhūn mahāsvanaḥ / tatopasṛtya sahasā punar āpetatur bhṛśam / carantāv asimārgāṃs tān vividhān rākṣasottamau / tayor gātreṣu patitāv asī bhinnau nipetatuḥ / vegotsṛṣṭe maghavatā vajre śailataṭeṣv iva / tataḥ sainyāni dadṛśus tad yuddham atidāruṇam / yuddhaṃ tayo rākṣasayor āmiṣe śyenayor iva / tato lohitaraktākṣāv ubhau tau rākṣasottamau / adṛśyetāṃ tu śārdūlau sandhyāraktāv ivāmbudau / cakrāte śyenavac caiva maṇḍalāni sahasraśaḥ / ubhau nistriṃśahastau tau sapakṣāv iva pakṣiṇau / tato bhrāmya tu taṃ khaḍgaṃ pāṇḍoḥ kirmīranandanaḥ / cikṣepāsya śiro hartuṃ sa ca tasya ghaṭotkacaḥ / tāv asī yugapad dīptau sametya vipulau bhuvi / patitau tau tu bāhubhyāṃ rākṣasau samasajjatām / śīrṣaghātāṃsaghātaiś ca parasparam athāhatau / punar vimiśritau vīrau vyāyudhyete muhur muhuḥ / dagdhādrikūṭaśṛṅgābhaṃ bhinnāñjanacayopamam

vulgate_text: haiḍimbenārdyamānastu yudhi so'lambuso'dravat / antarhito mahārāja ghaṭotkacamayodhayat
ce_text: tatas te pāṇḍavā rājan samantān niśitāñ śarān / preṣayām āsur udvignā haiḍimbaś ca ghaṭotkacaḥ

vulgate_text: pūrite vāsudevena śaṅkharāje mahātmanā / yudhyamāneṣu vīreṣu saindhavasyābhirakṣiṣu
ce_text: pūrito vāsudevena śaṅkharāṭ svanate bhṛśam / yudhyamāneṣu vīreṣu saindhavasyābhirakṣiṣu / nadatsu dhārtarāṣṭreṣu vijayasya rathaṃ prati

vulgate_text: kauravāśca yathā hṛṣṭā vinadanti muhurmuhuḥ / vyaktamadya vinaśyanti sarvalokamahārathāḥ
ce_text: na nūnaṃ svasti pārthasya yathā nadati śaṅkharāṭ / kauravāś ca yathā hṛṣṭā vinadanti muhur muhuḥ

vulgate_text: sarvathā samanuprāptaḥ sukṛcchraṃ tvayi jīvati / śyāmo yuvā guḍākeśo darśanīyaśca pāṇḍavaḥ
ce_text: śyāmo yuvā guḍākeśo darśanīyaś ca pāṇḍavaḥ / laghvastraś citrayodhī ca praviṣṭas tāta bhāratīm

vulgate_text: sadevāsuragandharvānsakinnaramahoragān / yodhayecca jagatsarvaṃ vijayeta ripūnbahūn
ce_text: udyuktā pṛthivī sarvā sasurāsuramānuṣā / sarākṣasagaṇā rājan sakiṃnaramahoragā

vulgate_text: iti bruvanti lokeṣu janāstava guṇāṃstathā samāgameṣu sarveṣu pṛthageva ca sarvadā / nāśakyaṃ vidyate loke sātyakeriti mādhava
ce_text: nāsādhyaṃ vidyate loke sātyaker iti mādhava / tat tvāṃ yad abhivakṣyāmi tat kuruṣva mahābala

vulgate_text: niścitya bahudhaivaṃ sa sātyakiryuddhadurmadaḥ / nātivyaktamivābhāṣya dharmarājaṃ mahāyaśāḥ
ce_text: niścitya bahudhaivaṃ sa sātyakir yuddhadurmadaḥ / dharmarājam idaṃ vākyam abravīt puruṣarṣabha

vulgate_text: sāgarapratimaṃ sainyaṃ garjantamiva sāgaram halaśaktigadāprāsacarmakhaṅgarṣṭitomaram / iṣvastravarasambādhaṃ kṣobhayitvā vrajāmyaham
ce_text: huḍaśaktigadāprāsakhaḍgacarmarṣṭitomaram / iṣvastravarasaṃbādhaṃ kṣobhayiṣye balārṇavam

vulgate_text: āsthitā dasyubhistīkṣṇaiḥ śūrairuttamapārvataiḥ / karkaśaiḥ pravarairyodhaiḥ kāṣṇāryasatanucchadaiḥ
ce_text: uttarāt parvatād ete tīkṣṇair dasyubhir āsthitāḥ / karkaśaiḥ pravarair yodhaiḥ kārṣṇāyasatanucchadaiḥ

vulgate_text: tena mūrdhanyupāghrātaḥ kṛtasvasyayano'pi ca āśiṣo vividhāḥ śrutvā dharmarājamukheritāḥ / harṣeṇa mahatā yukta āruroha mahāratham
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhirasya caraṇāv abhivādya kṛtāñjaliḥ / tena mūrdhany upāghrāta āruroha mahāratham

vulgate_text: nihate saindhave pāpe pāṇḍavena mahātmanā pariṣvajiṣye rājānaṃ dharmātmānaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram / apramādaśca te kāryo droṇaṃ prati mahāratham / sañcaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / prītiyuktaṃ ca hṛdyaṃ ca madhurākṣaram eva ca / kālayuktaṃ ca citraṃ ca svatayā cābhibhāṣitam

vulgate_text: tataḥ pāñcālarājasya putraḥ samaradurmadaḥ / prayāte mādhave rājannidaṃ vacanamabravīt
ce_text: tataḥ pāñcālarājasya putraḥ samaradurmadaḥ / prākrośat pāṇḍavānīke vasudānaś ca pārthivaḥ

vulgate_text: vayaṃ pratijigīṣantastatra tānsamabhidrutāḥ / bāṇaśaṅkharavānkṛtvā vimiśrānvādyanisvanaiḥ
ce_text: vayaṃ pratijigīṣantas tatra tān samabhidrutāḥ / tataḥ śabdo mahān āsīd yuyudhānarathaṃ prati

vulgate_text: yuyudhānarathaṃ dṛṣṭvā tāvakā abhidudruvuḥ / tataḥ śabdo mahānāsīdyuyudhānarathaṃ prati
ce_text: vayaṃ pratijigīṣantas tatra tān samabhidrutāḥ / tataḥ śabdo mahān āsīd yuyudhānarathaṃ prati

vulgate_text: ācāryānugato mārgaḥ śiṣyairanvāsyate sadā / tasmādeva vrajāmyāśu yathā me sa gururgataḥ / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / dharmarājasya tad vākyaṃ niśamya śinipuṃgavaḥ / pārthāc ca bhayam āśaṅkan parityāgān mahīpateḥ

vulgate_text: madhyato yāhi yatrograṃ karṇasya sumahadbalam yatraite paramakruddhā dākṣiṇātyā mahārathāḥ / etānvijitya saṅgrāme tato yāmo dhanañjayam / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: etāvad uktvā yantāraṃ brahmāṇaṃ parivarjayan / sa vyatīyāya yatrograṃ karṇasya sumahad balam

vulgate_text: sa ca sainyaṃ mahadbhittvā dākṣiṇātyabalaṃ ca tat / karṇasya sainyaṃ sumahadabhihatya śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
ce_text: karṇasya sainyaṃ sumahad abhihatya śitaiḥ śaraiḥ / prāviśad bhāratīṃ senām aparyantāṃ sa sātyakiḥ

vulgate_text: prāviśadbhāratīṃ senāmaparyantāṃ sa sātyakiḥ / sātyako hi tataḥ sainyaṃ drāvayansa samantataḥ
ce_text: karṇasya sainyaṃ sumahad abhihatya śitaiḥ śaraiḥ / prāviśad bhāratīṃ senām aparyantāṃ sa sātyakiḥ

vulgate_text: mahānāgānvidravato dṛṣṭvā'rjunaśarāhatān / patitānpatataścānyānmanye śocanti putrakāḥ
ce_text: vyaśvanāgarathān dṛṣṭvā tatra vīrān sahasraśaḥ / dhāvamānān raṇe vyagrān manye śocanti putrakāḥ

vulgate_text: hayaughānnihatāndṛṣṭvā dravamāṇāṃstatastataḥ / raṇe mādhavapārthābhyāṃ manye śocanti putrakāḥ
ce_text: vivīrāṃś ca kṛtān aśvān virathāṃś ca kṛtān narān / tatra sātyakipārthābhyāṃ manye śocanti putrakāḥ

vulgate_text: baddhavairāstato droṇe dhanañjayajayaiṣiṇaḥ / bhāradvājasutasteṣu dṛḍhavairo mahārathaḥ
ce_text: baddhavairās tathā droṇe dharmarājajayaiṣiṇaḥ / bhāradvājas tathā teṣu kṛtavairo mahārathaḥ

vulgate_text: ātmāparādhātsumahānprāptaste vipulaḥ kṣayaḥ / nainaṃ duryodhane doṣaṃ kartumarhasi mānada
ce_text: ātmāparādhāt sumahān prāptas te vipulaḥ kṣayaḥ / na hi te sukṛtaṃ kiṃ cid ādau madhye ca bhārata / dṛśyate pṛṣṭhataś caiva tvanmūlo hi parājayaḥ

vulgate_text: abhajyatātha pṛtanā śaineyaśarapīḍitā palāyanakṛtotsāhā bhramantī tatratatra ha / tataḥ prāyātsa tvaritaḥ sātyakiḥ satyavikramaḥ
ce_text: sābhajyatātha pṛtanā śaineyaśarapīḍitā / tataḥ prāyād vai tvaritaḥ sātyakiḥ satyavikramaḥ

vulgate_text: rājaputrā maheṣvāsāḥ sarve vikrāntayodhinaḥ / na cājitvā raṇe hyetāñśakyaḥ prāptuṃ jayadrathaḥ
ce_text: ete hi bahavaḥ sūta durnivāryāś ca saṃyuge / duryodhanasamādiṣṭā madarthe tyaktajīvitāḥ / rājaputrā maheṣvāsāḥ sarve vikrāntayodhinaḥ

vulgate_text: ruvanto vividhānnādāñjaladopamaniḥsvanāḥ / nāracairvatsadantaiśca bhallairañjalikaistathā
ce_text: ruvanto vividhān rāvāñ jaladopamanisvanāḥ / nārācair vatsadantaiś ca sātvatena vidāritāḥ

vulgate_text: athānyaddhanurādāya sarvakāyāvadāraṇam / jalasandhamabhiprekṣya utsmayitvā ca mādhavaḥ
ce_text: athānyad dhanur ādāya sarvakāyāvadāraṇam / śālaskandhapratīkāśam indrāśanisamasvanam / visphārya vivyadhe kruddho jalasaṃdhaṃ śareṇa ha

vulgate_text: etasminnantare rājandroṇaḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / sannyasya bhāraṃ sumahatkṛtavarmaṇi bhārata
ce_text: etasminn antare rājan droṇaḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / abhyayāj javanair aśvair yuyudhānaṃ mahāratham

vulgate_text: abhyayājjavanairaśvairyuyudhānaṃ mahāratham / sa hi pārthānraṇe yattāndadhāraiko mahābalaḥ
ce_text: etasminn antare rājan droṇaḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / abhyayāj javanair aśvair yuyudhānaṃ mahāratham

vulgate_text: sañjaya uvāca / sātvatasya raṇe karma dṛṣṭvā yoddhuṃ mahārathāḥ / amṛṣyamāṇāḥ saṃyattāḥ śaineyaṃ samupādravan
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / śṛṇuṣvaikamanā rājan yan māṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi / drāvyamāṇe bale tasmin hārdikyena mahātmanā

vulgate_text: sarvataḥ pratividdhastu tava putrairmahārathaiḥ / sa tudyamānaśca tadā sarvataḥ kurupuṅgavaiḥ
ce_text: sarvataḥ pratividdhas tu tava putrair mahārathaiḥ / tān pratyavidhyac chaineyaḥ pṛthak pṛthag ajihmagaiḥ

vulgate_text: tānpratyavidhyadvārṣṇeyaḥ pṛthakpṛthagajihmagaiḥ / sātyakiḥ puṇḍarīkākṣo hyastreṣu pariniṣṭhitaḥ
ce_text: sarvataḥ pratividdhas tu tava putrair mahārathaiḥ / tān pratyavidhyac chaineyaḥ pṛthak pṛthag ajihmagaiḥ

vulgate_text: tato gabhastimatprakhyau jvalitāviva pāvakau / sameyātāṃ naravyāghrau vyāghrāviva tarasvinau
ce_text: tataḥ paramasaṃkruddhau jvalantāv iva pāvakau / sameyātāṃ naravyāghrau vyāghrāv iva tarasvinau

vulgate_text: sañjaya uvāca / nirjitya kṛtavarmāṇaṃ bhāradvājaṃ ca saṃyuge / sa sātyakiḥ satyadhṛtirmahātmā śinipuṅgavaḥ
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / droṇaṃ sa jitvā puruṣapravīras; tathaiva hārdikyamukhāṃs tvadīyān / prahasya sūtaṃ vacanaṃ babhāṣe; śinipravīraḥ kurupuṃgavāgrya

vulgate_text: prāṇāpahāriṇaṃ raudraṃ vāditroddhuṣṭanāditam śūrāṇāṃ sukhasaṃsparśamaspṛśyamatha bhīruṇām / tīrṇāḥ sma dustaraṃ tāta droṇānīkamahārṇavam
ce_text: prāṇāpahāriṇaṃ raudraṃ vāditrotkruṣṭanāditam / yodhānām asukhasparśaṃ durdharṣam ajayaiṣiṇām

vulgate_text: abhyāśasthamahaṃ manye saindhavasya kirīṭinam / tādṛśaḥ śrūyate śabdaḥ sainyānāṃ sāgaropamaḥ
ce_text: abhyāśastham ahaṃ manye śvetāśvaṃ kṛṣṇasārathim / sa eṣa śrūyate śabdo gāṇḍīvasyāmitaujasaḥ

vulgate_text: śaravāṇāsanadharā yavanāśca prahāriṇaḥ śakāḥ kirātā daradā barbarāstāmraliptakāḥ / anye ca bahavo mlecchā vividhāyudhapāṇayaḥ
ce_text: śakāḥ kirātā daradā barbarās tāmraliptakāḥ / anye ca bahavo mlecchā vividhāyudhapāṇayaḥ / mām evābhimukhāḥ sarve tiṣṭhanti samarārthinaḥ

vulgate_text: āyuṣmankatareṇa tvāṃ prāpayāmi dhanañjayam / kebhyaḥ kruddho'si vārṣṇeya kānsvinmṛtyurupasthitaḥ
ce_text: āyuṣman katareṇa tvā prāpayāmi dhanaṃjayam / keṣāṃ kruddho 'si vārṣṇeya keṣāṃ mṛtyur upasthitaḥ / keṣāṃ saṃyamanīm adya gantum utsahate manaḥ

vulgate_text: keṣāṃ saṅghamanīkasya hantumutsahate manaḥ / ketvāṃ yudhi parākrāntaṃ kālāntakayamopamam
ce_text: ke tvāṃ yudhi parākrāntaṃ kālāntakayamopamam / dṛṣṭvā vikramasaṃpannaṃ vidraviṣyanti saṃyuge / keṣāṃ vaivasvato rājā smarate 'dya mahābhuja

vulgate_text: balaṃ vīryaṃ kṛtajñatvaṃ mama jñāsyanti kauravāḥ / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / droṇaṃ sa jitvā puruṣapravīras; tathaiva hārdikyamukhāṃs tvadīyān / prahasya sūtaṃ vacanaṃ babhāṣe; śinipravīraḥ kurupuṃgavāgrya

vulgate_text: vyādhā iva jighāṃsantastvadīyāḥ samupādravan / sātyakiṃ samare rājanparivavrustavātmajāḥ
ce_text: mattadviradasaṃkāśaṃ mattadviradagāminam / prabhinnam iva mātaṅgaṃ yūthamadhye vyavasthitam / vyāghrā iva jighāṃsantas tvadīyābhyadravan raṇe

vulgate_text: pṛthivīṃ cāntarikṣaṃ ca kampayansāgarānapi etadbalārṇavaṃ sūta vārayiṣye mahāraṇe / paurṇamāsyāmivoddhūtaṃ veleva makarālayam
ce_text: etad balārṇavaṃ tāta vārayiṣye mahāraṇe / paurṇamāsyām ivoddhūtaṃ veleva salilāśayam

vulgate_text: atyarjunaṃ śineḥ pautro yudhyate puruṣarṣabhaḥ / vītabhīrlāghavopetaḥ kṛtitvaṃ sampradarśayan
ce_text: na tādṛk kadanaṃ rājan kṛtavāṃs tatra phalgunaḥ / yādṛk kṣayam anīkānām akarot sātyakir nṛpa / atyarjunaṃ śineḥ pautro yudhyate bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: kulindāstaṅkaṇāmbaṣṭhāḥ paiśācāśca sabarbarāḥ pārvatīyāśca rājendra kruddhāḥ pāṣāṇapāṇayaḥ / abhyadravanta śaineyaṃ śalabhāḥ pāvakaṃ yathā
ce_text: kuṇindās taṅgaṇāmbaṣṭhāḥ paiśācāś ca samandarāḥ / abhyadravanta śaineyaṃ śalabhāḥ pāvakaṃ yathā

vulgate_text: te pārvatīyā rājānaḥ sarve pāṣāṇayodhinaḥ / abhyadravanta śaineyaṃ rājānamiva mantriṇaḥ
ce_text: yuktāś ca pārvatīyānāṃ rathāḥ pāṣāṇayodhinām / śūrāḥ pañcaśatā rājañ śaineyaṃ samupādravan

vulgate_text: tato gajaśiraḥprakhyairupalaiḥ śailavāsinaḥ / udyatairyuyudhānasya puratastasthurāhave
ce_text: tato gajaśiśuprakhyair upalaiḥ śailavāsinaḥ / udyatair yuyudhānasya sthitā maraṇakāṅkṣiṇaḥ

vulgate_text: te hanyamānāḥ samare sātvatena mahātmanā / aśmavṛṣṭiṃ mahāghorāṃ pātayanti sma sātvate
ce_text: viparītam ahaṃ manye mandabhāgyān sutān prati / yatrāvadhyanta samare sātvatena mahātmanā

vulgate_text: lambakaiśca kuṇindaiśca kṣiptāḥ kṣiptāśca sātyakiḥ / nārācaiḥ praticiccheda pratipattiviśāradaḥ
ce_text: ambaṣṭhaiś ca kuṇindaiś ca kṣiptāṃ kṣiptāṃ sa sātyakiḥ / nārācaiḥ prativivyādha prekṣamāṇo mahābalaḥ

vulgate_text: ityetadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhāradvājasya sārathiḥ / pratyuvāca tato droṇaṃ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varam
ce_text: ity evaṃ bruvato rājan bhāradvājasya dhīmataḥ / pratyuvāca tato yantā droṇaṃ śastrabhṛtāṃ varam

vulgate_text: sa vadhyamāno bahudhā rājaputrairmahārathaiḥ / krodhamāhārayatteṣāmabhāvāya dvijarṣabhaḥ
ce_text: sa vadhyamāno bahudhā rājaputrair mahārathaiḥ / vyaśvasūtarathāṃś cakre kumārān kupito raṇe

vulgate_text: tānvimūḍhānraṇe droṇaḥ prahasanniva bhārata / vyaśvasūtarathāṃścakre kumārānkupito raṇe
ce_text: sa vadhyamāno bahudhā rājaputrair mahārathaiḥ / vyaśvasūtarathāṃś cakre kumārān kupito raṇe

vulgate_text: pratyāśvastastato droṇo dhanurgṛhya mahāravam / āsannamāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ jighāṃsayā
ce_text: pratyāśvastas tato droṇo dhanur gṛhya mahābalaḥ / śarair vaitastikai rājan nityam āsannayodhibhiḥ / yodhayām āsa samare dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ mahāratham

vulgate_text: śarairvaitastikai rājanvivyādhāsannavedhibhiḥ / yodhayāmāsa samare dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ mahāratham
ce_text: pratyāśvastas tato droṇo dhanur gṛhya mahābalaḥ / śarair vaitastikai rājan nityam āsannayodhibhiḥ / yodhayām āsa samare dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ mahāratham

vulgate_text: taṃ tu duḥśāsanaḥ śūraḥ sāyakairāvṛṇodbhṛśam / rathavrātena mahatā nānādeśodbhavena ca
ce_text: sa tu duḥśāsanaṃ vīraḥ sāyakair āvṛṇod bhṛśam / maśakaṃ samanuprāptam ūrṇanābhir ivorṇayā

vulgate_text: athavā śūnyamāsīttadyena yātaḥ sa sātyakiḥ / hatabhūyiṣṭhamathavā yena yātaḥ sa sātyakiḥ
ce_text: atha vā śūnyam āsīt tad yena yātaḥ sa sātyakiḥ / eko vai bahulāḥ senāḥ pramṛdnan puruṣarṣabhaḥ

vulgate_text: na santi tasmātputrā me yathā sañjaya bhāṣase / eko vai bahulāḥ senāḥ prāmṛdgātsatyavikramaḥ
ce_text: atha vā śūnyam āsīt tad yena yātaḥ sa sātyakiḥ / eko vai bahulāḥ senāḥ pramṛdnan puruṣarṣabhaḥ

vulgate_text: tatra rājanmahānāsītsaṅgrāmo bhītivardhanaḥ / pāṇḍavasya mahābāho tāvakānāṃ ca dāruṇaḥ
ce_text: tatra rājan mahān āsīt saṃgrāmo bhūrivardhanaḥ / rudrasyākrīḍasaṃkāśaḥ saṃhāraḥ sarvadehinām

vulgate_text: rudrasyākrīḍasaṅkāśaḥ saṃhāraḥ sarvadehinām / tataḥ śabdo mahānāsītprāyādyatra dhanañcayaḥ
ce_text: tatra rājan mahān āsīt saṃgrāmo bhūrivardhanaḥ / rudrasyākrīḍasaṃkāśaḥ saṃhāraḥ sarvadehinām

vulgate_text: tathā prayatamānānāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ mahātmanām / duryodhano mahārājanvyagāhata mahadbalam
ce_text: tathā prayatamāneṣu pāṇḍaveyeṣu nirbhayaḥ / duryodhano mahārāja vyagāhata mahad balam

vulgate_text: duryodhanena samare pṛtanā pāṇḍavī raṇe / nalinī dvarideneva samantātpratiloḍitā
ce_text: duryodhanena sahasā pāṇḍavī pṛtanā raṇe / nalinī dviradeneva samantād vipraloḍitā

vulgate_text: tatastāṃ prahatāṃ senāṃ dṛṣṭvā putreṇa te nṛpa / bhīmasenapurogāstaṃ pāñcālāḥ samupādruvan
ce_text: tathā senāṃ kṛtāṃ dṛṣṭvā tava putreṇa kaurava / bhīmasenapurogās taṃ pāñcālāḥ samupādravan

vulgate_text: tasya tānnighnataḥ śatrūnhemapṛṣṭhaṃ mahaddhanuḥ / ajasraṃ maṇḍalībhūtaṃ dadṛśuḥ samare janāḥ
ce_text: tasya tān nighnataḥ śatrūn hemapṛṣṭhaṃ mahad dhanuḥ / bhallābhyāṃ pāṇḍavo jyeṣṭhas tridhā ciccheda māriṣa

vulgate_text: vivyādha cainaṃ daśabhiḥ samyagastaiḥ śarottamaiḥ / varma cāśu samāsādya te bhittvā kṣitimāviśan
ce_text: vivyādha cainaṃ bahubhiḥ samyag astaiḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ / varmāṇy āśu samāsādya te bhagnāḥ kṣitim āviśan

vulgate_text: tato'nyaddhanurādāya tava putraḥ pratāpavān / tiṣṭhetiṣṭheti rājānaṃ bruvanpāṇḍavamabhyayāt
ce_text: atha duryodhano rājā dṛḍham ādāya kārmukam / tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti rājānaṃ bruvan pāṇḍavam abhyayāt

vulgate_text: tamāyāntamabhiprekṣya tava putraṃ mahāmṛdhe / pratyudyayuḥ samuditāḥ pāñcālā jayagṛddhinaḥ
ce_text: taṃ tathā vādinaṃ rājaṃs tava putraṃ mahāratham / pratyudyayuḥ pramuditāḥ pāñcālā jayagṛddhinaḥ

vulgate_text: tatra rājanmahānāsītsaṅgrāmo romaharṣaṇaḥ / pāṇḍavānāṃ mahābāho tāvakānāṃ ca saṃyuge
ce_text: tatra rājan mahān āsīt saṃgrāmo bhūrivardhanaḥ / rudrasyākrīḍasaṃkāśaḥ saṃhāraḥ sarvadehinām

vulgate_text: tāṃstu droṇavinirmuktānkruṃddhāśīviṣasannibhān / ekaikaṃ pañcabhirbāṇairyudhi ciccheda hṛṣṭavat
ce_text: tāṃs tu droṇadhanurmuktān ghorān āśīviṣopamān / ekaikaṃ daśabhir bāṇair yudhi ciccheda hṛṣṭavat

vulgate_text: tato'stre nihate brāhme bṛhatkṣatrastu bhārata / vivyādha brāhmaṇaṃ ṣaṣṭyā svarṇapuṅkhaiḥ śilāśitaiḥ
ce_text: pratihanya tad astraṃ tu bhāradvājasya saṃyuge / vivyādha brāhmaṇaṃ ṣaṣṭyā svarṇapuṅkhaiḥ śilāśitaiḥ

vulgate_text: vyākulīkṛtya taṃ droṇo bṛhatkṣatraṃ mahāratham / aśvāṃścaturbhiranyavadhīccaturo'sya patattribhiḥ
ce_text: vyākulīkṛtya taṃ droṇo bṛhatkṣatraṃ mahāratham / vyasṛjat sāyakaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ kekayaṃ prati bhārata

vulgate_text: tasya droṇo dhanurmadhye kṣurapreṇa śitena ca / cakarta gārdhrapatreṇa yatamānasya śuṣmiṇaḥ
ce_text: tasya droṇo dhanurmadhye kṣurapreṇa śitena ha / ciccheda rājño balino yatamānasya saṃyuge

vulgate_text: tāmāpatantīmālokya kālarātrimivodyatām aśmasāramayīṃ gurvīṃ tapanīyavibhūṣitām / śarairanekasāhasrairbhādvājo'cchinacchitaiḥ
ce_text: tām āpatantīṃ sahasā ghorarūpāṃ bhayāvahām / aśmasāramayīṃ gurvīṃ tapanīyavibhūṣitām / śarair anekasāhasrair bhāradvājo nyapātayat

vulgate_text: sā chinnā bahubhirbāṇaibhāradvājena māriṣa / gadā papāta kauravya nādayantī dharātalam
ce_text: sā papāta gadā bhūmau bhāradvājena sāditā / raktamālyāmbaradharā tāreva nabhasas talāt

vulgate_text: sa tu droṇaṃ mahābāhuḥ śaradhārābhirāhave / adṛśyamakarottūrṇaṃ jalado bhāskaraṃ yathā
ce_text: sa tu droṇaṃ mahārāja chādayan sāyakaiḥ śitaiḥ / adṛśyam akarot tūrṇaṃ jalado bhāskaraṃ yathā

vulgate_text: te tu nāmāṅkitā bāṇā droṇenāstāḥ śilāśitāḥ / narānnāgānhayāṃścaiva nijaghnuḥ śataśo mṛdhe
ce_text: tato droṇāṅkitā bāṇāḥ svarṇapuṅkhāḥ śilāśitāḥ / narān nāgān hayāṃś caiva nijaghnuḥ sarvato raṇe

vulgate_text: bruvantaśca raṇe'nyonyaṃ cedipāñcālasṛñjayāḥ / hata droṇaṃ hata droṇamiti te droṇamabhyayuḥ
ce_text: hata droṇaṃ hata droṇam iti te droṇam abhyayuḥ / yatantaḥ puruṣavyāghrāḥ sarvaśaktyā mahādyutim / ninīṣanto raṇe droṇaṃ yamasya sadanaṃ prati

vulgate_text: anyatkārmukamādāya bhāsvaraṃ vegavattaram / tatrādhāya śaraṃ tīkṣṇaṃ parānīkaviśātanam
ce_text: sa saṃrabdhataro bhūtvā droṇaḥ kṣatriyamardanaḥ / anyat kārmukam ādāya bhāsvaraṃ vegavattaram

vulgate_text: caturbhiḥ sārathiṃ cāsya caturbhiścaturo hayān / tamācāryastribhirbāṇairbāhvorurasi cārdayat
ce_text: sa droṇaṃ daśabhir bāṇaiḥ pratyavidhyat stanāntare / caturbhiḥ sārathiṃ cāsya caturbhiś caturo hayān

vulgate_text: dhvajaṃ saptabhirunmathya yantāramavadhīttribhiḥ / tasya sūte hate te'śvā rathamādāya vidrutāḥ
ce_text: tasya sūte hate te 'śvā ratham ādāya vidrutāḥ / samare śarasaṃvītā bhāradvājena māriṣa

vulgate_text: abravīdvacanaṃ rājankuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ yaḥ sadevānsagandharvāndaityāṃścaikaratho'jayat
ce_text: yaḥ sadevān sagandharvān daityāṃś caikaratho 'jayat / tasya lakṣma na paśyāmi bhīmasenānujasya te

vulgate_text: cakoranetrastāmrāsyo dviṣatāṃ bhayavardhanaḥ / mama priyahitārthaṃ ca śakralokādihāgataḥ
ce_text: vyūḍhorasko mahāskandho mattadviradavikramaḥ / cakoranetras tāmrākṣo dviṣatām aghavardhanaḥ

vulgate_text: tasyābhigamanaṃ jāne bhīma nāvartanaṃ punaḥ / tadidaṃ mama bhadraṃ te śokasthānamarindama
ce_text: tad idaṃ mama bhadraṃ te śokasthānam ariṃdama / arjunārthaṃ mahābāho sātvatasya ca kāraṇāt

vulgate_text: sahayo nāsya vai kaścittena vindāmi kaśmalam / tasmātkṛṣṇo raṇe nūnaṃ yudhyate yuddhakovidaḥ
ce_text: tasmāt kṛṣṇo raṇe nūnaṃ yudhyate yuddhakovidaḥ / yasya vīryavato vīryam upajīvanti pāṇḍavāḥ

vulgate_text: na hi me śudhyate bhāvastayoreva parantapa / sa tatra gaccha kaunteya yatra yāto dhanañjayaḥ
ce_text: sa tatra gaccha kaunteya yatra yāto dhanaṃjayaḥ / sātyakiś ca mahāvīryaḥ kartavyaṃ yadi manyase / vacanaṃ mama dharmajña jyeṣṭho bhrātā bhavāmi te

vulgate_text: dharmarājasya vacane sthātavyamaviśaṅkayā / yāsyāmi padavīṃ bhrātuḥ sātvatasya ca dhīmataḥ
ce_text: evam ukto 'smi pārthena prativaktuṃ sma notsahe / prayāsye tatra yatrāsau mumūrṣuḥ saindhavaḥ sthitaḥ / dharmarājasya vacane sthātavyam aviśaṅkayā

vulgate_text: bhīmaseno mahābāhuḥ kavacī śubhakuṇḍalī sagadaḥ satalatrāṇaḥ saśarī rathināṃ varaḥ / rathamāruhya niryuktaṃ sarvopakaraṇānvitam
ce_text: bhīmaseno mahābāhuḥ kavacī śubhakuṇḍalī / sāṅgadaḥ satanutrāṇaḥ saśarī rathināṃ varaḥ

vulgate_text: baddhagodhāṅgulitrāṇaḥ pragṛhītaśarāsanaḥ / jyeṣṭhena prahito bhrātrā bhrātā bhrātuḥ priyaṅkaraḥ
ce_text: gaccha gaccheti ca punar bhīmasenam abhāṣata / bhṛśaṃ sa prahito bhrātrā bhrātā bhrātuḥ priyaṃkaraḥ / āhatya dundubhiṃ bhīmaḥ śaṅkhaṃ pradhmāya cāsakṛt

vulgate_text: tena śabdena vīrāṇāṃ pātayitvā manāṃsyuta / darśayanghoramātmānamamitrānsahasā'bhyayāt
ce_text: vinadya siṃhanādaṃ ca jyāṃ vikarṣan punaḥ punaḥ / darśayan ghoram ātmānam amitrān sahasābhyayāt

vulgate_text: *mahāntaṃ talaśabdaṃ ca kṛtvā droṇāntikaṃ yayau / tamāvārayadācāryo velevodvṛttamarṇavam
ce_text: punaś cātītya vegena droṇānīkam upādravat / tam avārayad ācāryo velevodvṛttam arṇavam

vulgate_text: tasya droṇo rathaṃ rājañchādayāmāsa saṃyuge / sāśvasūtadhvajaṃ tūrṇaṃ tadadbhutamivābhavat
ce_text: tasmin kṣaṇe tasya yantā tūrṇam aśvān acodayat / bhīmasenasya kauravya tad adbhutam ivābhavat

vulgate_text: sāśvasūtadhvajaṃ yānaṃ droṇasyāpothayattadā / tadadbhutamapaśyāma pāṇḍaveyasya vikramam
ce_text: sāśvasūtadhvajaṃ yānaṃ droṇasyāpothayat tadā / prāmṛdnāc ca bahūn yodhān vāyur vṛkṣān ivaujasā

vulgate_text: droṇaṃ tu virathaṃ kṛtvā bhīmaseno mahābalaḥ / abhyavartata sainyāni tāvakāni samantataḥ
ce_text: tataḥ svaratham āsthāya bhīmaseno mahābalaḥ / abhyavartata vegena tava putrasya vāhinīm

vulgate_text: sa mṛdraṃstarasā yodhānvāyurvṛkṣānivaujasā / vicacāra raṇe rājanvāyutulyaparākramaḥ
ce_text: sāśvasūtadhvajaṃ yānaṃ droṇasyāpothayat tadā / prāmṛdnāc ca bahūn yodhān vāyur vṛkṣān ivaujasā

vulgate_text: nirjitastu tadā tena pāṇḍavena mahātmanā / anyaṃ tu rathamātiṣṭhaddroṇaḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ
ce_text: taṃ punaḥ parivavrus te tava putrā rathottamam / anyaṃ ca ratham āsthāya droṇaḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ

vulgate_text: sañjaya uvāca / samuttīrṇaṃ rathānīkaṃ pāṇḍavaṃ vihasanraṇe / vivārayiṣurācāryaḥ śaravarṣairavākirat
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / vyūheṣv āloḍyamāneṣu pāṇḍavānāṃ tatas tataḥ / sudūram anvayuḥ pārthāḥ pāñcālāḥ saha somakaiḥ

vulgate_text: sa taistu saṃvṛto bhīmaḥ krodhena pradahanniva udyacchansa gadāṃ tebhyaḥ sughorāṃ siṃhavannadan / avāsṛjacca vegena śatrupakṣavināśinīm
ce_text: sa tathā saṃvṛto bhīmaḥ prahasann iva bhārata / udayacchad gadāṃ tebhyo ghorāṃ tāṃ siṃhavan nadan / avāsṛjac ca vegena teṣu tān pramathad balī

vulgate_text: indrāśanirivendreṇa praviddhā saṃhatātmanā / prāmathnātsā mahārāja sainikāṃstava saṃyuge
ce_text: sendrāśanir ivendreṇa praviddhā saṃhatātmanā / ghoṣeṇa mahatā rājan pūrayitveva medinīm / jvalantī tejasā bhīmā trāsayām āsa te sutān

vulgate_text: siṃhanādamasahyaṃ hi śrutvā bhīmasya saṃyuge / prāpatanmunujāstrastā rathebhyo rathinastadā
ce_text: taṃ ca śabdam asaṃsahyaṃ tasyāḥ saṃlakṣya māriṣa / prāpatan manujās tatra rathebhyo rathinas tadā

vulgate_text: droṇastu satvaro rājankṣipto bhīmena saṃyuge dadṛśe tāvakairyodhairvismayotphullalocanaiḥ / parihṛtya rathaṃ droṇaścūrṇitaṃ taṃ mahītale
ce_text: droṇas tu satvaro rājan kṣipto bhīmena saṃyuge / ratham anyaṃ samāsthāya vyūhadvāram upāyayau

vulgate_text: rathamanyaṃ samāruhya vyūhadvāraṃ yayau punaḥ / tamāyāntaṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā bhagnotsāhaṃ guruṃ tadā
ce_text: droṇas tu satvaro rājan kṣipto bhīmena saṃyuge / ratham anyaṃ samāsthāya vyūhadvāram upāyayau

vulgate_text: bhojānīkaṃ samāsādya hārdikyenābhirakṣitam / pramathya tarasā vīrastadapyatibalo'bhyayāt
ce_text: bhojānīkaṃ samāsādya hārdikyenābhirakṣitam / pramathya bahudhā rājan bhīmasenaḥ samabhyayāt

vulgate_text: taṃ tasya ninadaṃ ghoraṃ pārthaḥ śuśrāva nardataḥ / vāsudevaśca kauravya bhīmasenasya saṃyuge
ce_text: arjunaṃ tatra dṛṣṭvātha cukrośa mahato ravān / taṃ tu tasya mahānādaṃ pārthaḥ śuśrāva nardataḥ

vulgate_text: śeṣasya rakṣaṇārthaṃ ca sandhāsyati suyodhanaḥ evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ tasya rājñaścintayatastadā
ce_text: kaccid bhīṣmeṇa no vairam ekenaiva praśāmyati / śeṣasya rakṣaṇārthaṃ ca saṃdhāsyati suyodhanaḥ

vulgate_text: gadāṃ yuyutsamānasya kālasyeveha sañcaya / na hi paśyāmyahaṃ yuddhe yastiṣṭhedagrataḥ pumān
ce_text: gadām udyacchamānasya kālasyeva mahāmṛdhe / na hi paśyāmy ahaṃ tāta yas tiṣṭheta raṇājire

vulgate_text: tatastu sarvayodhānāṃ yatanāṃ prekṣatāṃ tadā / prāvepanniva gātrāṇi karṇabhīmasamāgame
ce_text: prāvepann iva gātrāṇi karṇabhīmasamāgame / rathināṃ sādināṃ caiva tayoḥ śrutvā talasvanam

vulgate_text: samare sarvayodhānāṃ dhanūṃṣyabhyapatankṣitau / śastrāṇi nyapatandorbhyaḥ keṣāñciccāsavo'dravan
ce_text: punar ghoreṇa nādena pāṇḍavasya mahātmanaḥ / samare sarvayodhānāṃ dhanūṃṣy abhyapatan kṣitau

vulgate_text: prādurāsannimittāni ghorāṇi subahūnyuta / gṛdhrakaṅkabalaiścāsīdantarikṣaṃ samāvṛtam
ce_text: prādurāsan nimittāni ghorāṇi ca bahūni ca / tasmiṃs tu tumule rājan bhīmakarṇasamāgame

vulgate_text: kiñcidvicalitaḥ karṇaḥ suprahārābhipīḍitaḥ / ākarṇapūrṇamākṛṣya bhīmaṃ vivyādha sāyakaiḥ
ce_text: kiṃ cid vicalitaḥ karṇaḥ suprahārābhipīḍitaḥ / sasāyakaṃ dhanuḥ kṛtvā bhīmaṃ vivyādha māriṣa / cikṣepa ca punar bāṇāñ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ

vulgate_text: cikṣepa ca punarbāṇāñśataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ sa śarairarditastena karṇena dṛḍhadhanvinā / dhanurjyāmacchinattūrṇaṃ bhīmastasya kṣureṇa ha
ce_text: sa chādyamānaḥ sahasā karṇena dṛḍhadhanvinā / dhanurjyām acchinat tūrṇam utsmayan pāṇḍunandanaḥ

vulgate_text: sārathiṃ cāsya bhallena rathanīḍādapātayat / vāhāṃśca caturastasya vyasūṃścakre mahārathaḥ
ce_text: sārathiṃ cāsya bhallena prāhiṇod yamasādanam / vāhāṃś ca caturaḥ saṃkhye vyasūṃś cakre mahārathaḥ

vulgate_text: sa śaṅkhabāṇaninadairharṣādrājā svavāhinīm / cakre yudhiṣṭhiraḥ saṅkhye harṣanādaiśca saṅkulām / gāṇḍīvaṃ vyākṣipatpārthaḥ kṛṣṇo'pyabjamavādayat
ce_text: samantāc chaṅkhaninadaṃ pāṇḍusenākarot tadā / śatrusenādhvaniṃ śrutvā tāvakā hy api nānadan / gāṇḍīvaṃ prākṣipat pārthaḥ kṛṣṇo 'py abjam avādayat

vulgate_text: tamantardhāya ninadaṃ bhīmasya nadato dhvaniḥ / aśrūyata tadā rājansarvasainyeṣu dāruṇaḥ
ce_text: tam antardhāya ninadaṃ dhvanir bhīmasya nardataḥ / aśrūyata mahārāja sarvasainyeṣu bhārata

vulgate_text: duśśalaṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā bhīmasenena māriṣa / tasyaiva dhanurādāya karṇo vivyādha pāṇḍavam
ce_text: tathaiva bhīmasenena lokaḥ saṃvadate bhṛśam / kathaṃ droṇo jitaḥ saṃkhye dhanurvedasya pāragaḥ

vulgate_text: kathaṃ droṇo jitaḥ saṅkhye dhanurvedasya pāragaḥ / ityevaṃ bruvate yodhā aśraddheyamidaṃ tava
ce_text: tathaiva bhīmasenena lokaḥ saṃvadate bhṛśam / kathaṃ droṇo jitaḥ saṃkhye dhanurvedasya pāragaḥ

vulgate_text: yatkṛtyaṃ sindhurājasya prāptakālamanantaram / tatsaṃvidhīyatāṃ kṣipraṃ sādhu sañcintya no dvija / droṇa uvāca
ce_text: yat kṛtyaṃ sindhurājasya prāptakālam anantaram / tad bravītu bhavān kṣipraṃ sādhu tat saṃvidhīyatām

vulgate_text: cintyaṃ bahuvidhaṃ tāta yatkṛtyaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva me / trayo hi samatikrāntāḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ mahārathāḥ
ce_text: droṇa uvāca / cintyaṃ bahu mahārāja kṛtyaṃ yat tatra me śṛṇu / trayo hi samatikrāntāḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ mahārathāḥ / yāvad eva bhayaṃ paścāt tāvad eṣāṃ puraḥsaram

vulgate_text: samprāptaṃ tadidaṃ dyūtaṃ yattacchakunibuddhijam na sabhāyāṃ jayo vṛtto nāpi tatra parājayaḥ / iha no glahamānānāmadya tāvajjayājayau
ce_text: na sabhāyāṃ jayo vṛtto nāpi tatra parājayaḥ / iha no glahamānānām adya tāta jayājayau

vulgate_text: saindhave tu mahaddyūṃta samāsaktaṃ paraiḥ saha / atra te dhruvamāyatto jayo vā'jaya eva vā
ce_text: glahaṃ ca saindhavaṃ rājann atra dyūtasya niścayaḥ / saindhave hi mahādyūtaṃ samāsaktaṃ paraiḥ saha

vulgate_text: tathottamaujāḥ saṅkruddhaḥ śarairhemavibhūṣitaiḥ / avidhyatsārathiṃ cāsya prāhiṇodyamasādanam
ce_text: sārathiṃ cāsya bhallena prāhiṇod yamasādanam / vāhāṃś ca caturaḥ saṃkhye vyasūṃś cakre mahārathaḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ sa hemacitraṃ taṃ gadayā syandanaṃ gatī / saṅkruddhaḥ pothayāmāsa sāśvasūtadhvajaṃ nṛpa
ce_text: tataḥ sa hemacitraṃ taṃ syandanapravaraṃ gadī / gadayā pothayām āsa sāśvasūtadhvajaṃ raṇe

vulgate_text: pāñcālānāṃ tato mukhyau rājaputrau mahārathau / rathāvanyau samāruhya bībhatsumabhijagmutaḥ
ce_text: pāñcālānāṃ tu mukhyau tau rājaputrau mahābalau / ratham anyaṃ samāruhya dhanaṃjayam abhīyatuḥ

vulgate_text: sañjaya uvāca / vartamāne mahārāja saṅgrāme romaharṣaṇe / vyākuleṣu ca sarveṣu pīḍyamāneṣu sarvaśaḥ
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tasmin vilulite sainye saindhavāyārjune gate / sātvate bhīmasene ca putras te droṇam abhyayāt / tvarann ekarathenaiva bahukṛtyaṃ vicintayan

vulgate_text: tato vyāyacchatāmastraiḥ pṛthakpṛthagarindamau / mṛdupūrvaṃ ca rādheyo dṛḍhapūrvaṃ ca pāṇḍavaḥ / dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / yau tau karṇaś ca bhīmaś ca saṃprayuddhau mahābalau / arjunasya rathopānte kīdṛśaḥ so 'bhavad raṇaḥ

vulgate_text: bhayādyasya mahābāho na śete bahulāḥ samāḥ cintayannityaśo vīryaṃ rādheyasya mahātmanaḥ / taṃ kathaṃ sūtaputraṃ tu bhīmo'yodhayatāhave
ce_text: bhayān na śete satataṃ cintayan vai mahāratham / taṃ kathaṃ sūtaputraṃ hi bhīmo 'yudhyata saṃyuge

vulgate_text: yau tau samīyaturvīrau vaikartanavṛkodarau / kathaṃ tāvatra yudhyetāṃ mahābalaparākramau
ce_text: yau tau samīyatur vīrāv arjunasya rathaṃ prati / kathaṃ nu tāv ayudhyetāṃ sūtaputravṛkodarau

vulgate_text: hatvā tasyānugāṃstaṃ ca hantukāmo mahābalaḥ tasmai vyasṛjadugrāṇi vividhāni parantapaḥ / amarṣātpāṇḍavaḥ kruddhaḥ śaravarṣāṇi māriṣa
ce_text: tasmai prāsṛjad ugrāṇi vividhāni paraṃtapaḥ / amarṣī pāṇḍavaḥ kruddhaḥ śaravarṣāṇi māriṣa

vulgate_text: yudhyamānaṃ tu saṃrambhādbhīmasenaṃ hasanniva / abhyapadyata kaunteyaṃ karṇo rājanvṛkodaram
ce_text: saṃrambheṇa tu yudhyantaṃ bhīmasenaṃ smayann iva / abhyapadyata rādheyas tam amarṣī vṛkodaram

vulgate_text: hemapuṅkhā mahāvegā bhīmasenadhanuścyutāḥ / prācchādayaṃste rādheyaṃ śalabhā iva pāvakam
ce_text: hemapuṅkhā mahārāja bhīmasenadhanuścyutāḥ / abhyadravaṃs te rādheyaṃ vṛkāḥ kṣudramṛgaṃ yathā

vulgate_text: rudhirokṣitasarvāṅgo bhīmaseno vyarājata / samṛddhakusumāpīḍo vasante'śokavṛkṣavat
ce_text: rudhirokṣitasarvāṅgo bhīmaseno vyarocata / tapanīyanibhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ palāśa iva kānane

vulgate_text: tattu bhīmo mahābāhoḥ karṇasya caritaṃ raṇe / nāmṛṣyata mahābāhuḥ krodhādudvṛttalocanaḥ
ce_text: tat tu bhīmo mahārāja karṇasya caritaṃ raṇe / nāmṛṣyata maheṣvāsaḥ krodhād udvṛtya cakṣuṣī

vulgate_text: punaranyena bāṇena bhīmasenaḥ pratāpavān / ciccheda kārmukaṃ tūrṇaṃ karṇasya prahasanniva
ce_text: tataḥ karṇasya saṃkruddho bhīmasenaḥ pratāpavān / ciccheda kārmukaṃ tūrṇaṃ sarvopakaraṇāni ca

vulgate_text: te jagmurdharaṇīmāśu karṇaṃ nirbhidya patriṇaḥ / yathā jaladharaṃ bhittvā divākaramarīcayaḥ
ce_text: te jagmur dharaṇīṃ sarve karṇaṃ nirbhidya māriṣa / yathā hi jaladaṃ bhittvā rājan sūryasya raśmayaḥ

vulgate_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / [svayaṃ śiṣyo maheśasya bhṛgūttamadhanurdharaḥ / śiṣyatvaṃ prāptavānkarṇastasya tulyo'stravidyayā
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / yau tau karṇaś ca bhīmaś ca saṃprayuddhau mahābalau / arjunasya rathopānte kīdṛśaḥ so 'bhavad raṇaḥ

vulgate_text: krodharakrekṣaṇau tīvrau niḥśvasantāvivoragau / śūrāvanyonyamāsādya tatakṣaturarindamau
ce_text: krodharaktekṣaṇau kruddhau niḥśvasantau mahārathau / yuddhe 'nyonyaṃ samāsādya tatakṣatur ariṃdamau

vulgate_text: tābhyāṃ muktāḥ śarā rājangārdhrapatrāścakāśire / śreṇyaḥ śaradi mattānāṃ sārasanāmivāmbare
ce_text: tābhyāṃ muktā vyakāśanta kaṅkabarhiṇavāsasaḥ / paṅktyaḥ śaradi mattānāṃ sārasānām ivāmbare

vulgate_text: śamakāmaḥ sasodaryo dīrghaprekṣī yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / aśakta iti matvā tu mama putrairnirākṛtaḥ
ce_text: śamakāmaḥ sadā pārtho dīrghaprekṣī yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / aśakta iti manvānaiḥ putrair mama nirākṛtaḥ

vulgate_text: atha karṇaḥ śaravrātairbhīmasenaṃ samārpayat / nanāda ca mahānādaṃ punarvivyādha corasi
ce_text: atha karṇaḥ śaravrātair bhīmaṃ balavad ardayat / nanāda balavan nādaṃ punar vivyādha corasi

vulgate_text: karṇastu navabhirbhīmaṃ bhittvā rājaṃstanāntare / dhvajamekena vivyādha viśokaṃ ca tribhiḥ śaraiḥ
ce_text: karṇas tu navabhir bhīmaṃ viddhvā rājan stanāntare / dhvajam ekena vivyādha sāyakena śitena ha

vulgate_text: tato bhīmo mahābāhuḥ krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ vajrakalpāṃ catuṣkiṣkuṃ gurvī rukmāṅgadāṃ gadām / prāhiṇotmūtaputrāya ṣaḍasrāmavicārayan
ce_text: sarvaśaikyāṃ catuṣkiṣkuṃ gurvīṃ rukmāṅgadāṃ gadām / prāhiṇot sūtaputrāya ṣaḍasrām avicārayan

vulgate_text: aho mama sutānāṃ hi vipannaṃ sūta jīvitam / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / sa tathā virathaḥ karṇaḥ punar bhīmena nirjitaḥ / ratham anyaṃ samāsthāya sadyo vivyādha pāṇḍavam

vulgate_text: āgaskṛtamivātmānaṃ mene cādhirathistadā / yatpratyakṣaṃ tava sutā bhīmena nihatā raṇe
ce_text: āgaskṛtam ivātmānaṃ mene cādhirathis tadā / bhīmasenaṃ tataḥ kruddhaḥ samādravata saṃbhramāt

vulgate_text: avicintyātha tānbāṇānkarṇenāstānvṛkodaraḥ / raṇe vivyādha rādheyaṃ śareṇānataparvaṇā
ce_text: avahāsaṃ tu taṃ pārtho nāmṛṣyata vṛkodaraḥ / tato vivyādha rādheyaṃ śatena nataparvaṇām

vulgate_text: tāmāpatantīmālakṣya bhīmaseno mahāgadām / śarairavārayadrājansarvasainyasya paśyataḥ
ce_text: tām āpatantīṃ sahasā gadāṃ dṛṣṭvā vṛkodaraḥ / śarair avārayad rājan sarvasainyasya paśyataḥ

vulgate_text: taṃ parāṅmukhamālokya padātiṃ sūtanandanam / kaunteyaśarasañchannaṃ rājā duryodhano'bravīt
ce_text: rādheyaṃ tu raṇe dṛṣṭvā padātinam avasthitam / bhīmasenena saṃrabdhaṃ rājā duryodhano 'bravīt / tvaradhvaṃ sarvato yattā rādheyasya rathaṃ prati

vulgate_text: citrāyudhaścitravarmā samare citrayodhinaḥ / tānāpatata evāśu bhīmaseno mahārathaḥ
ce_text: citropacitraś citrākṣaś cārucitraḥ śarāsanaḥ / citrāyudhaś citravarmā samare citrayodhinaḥ

vulgate_text: ekaikena śareṇājau pātayāmāsa te sutān / te hatā nyapatanbhūmau vātarūgṇā iva drumāḥ
ce_text: āgacchatas tān sahasā bhīmo rājan mahārathaḥ / sāśvasūtadhvajān yattān pātayām āsa saṃyuge / te hatā nyapatan bhūmau vātanunnā iva drumāḥ

vulgate_text: tāvanyonyaṃ śarairbhittvā svarṇapuṅkhaiḥ śilāśitaiḥ / vyabhrājetāṃ yathā meghau saṃsyūtau sūryaraśmibhiḥ
ce_text: tāv anyonyaṃ śarair viddhvā svarṇapuṅkhaiḥ śilāśitaiḥ / vyabhrājetāṃ mahārāja puṣpitāv iva kiṃśukau

vulgate_text: krodhāgnitejasā diptau saṃrambhādraktalocanau / vyabhrājetāṃ mahārāja vidhūmāviva pāvakau
ce_text: tāv anyonyaṃ śarair viddhvā svarṇapuṅkhaiḥ śilāśitaiḥ / vyabhrājetāṃ mahārāja puṣpitāv iva kiṃśukau

vulgate_text: vyāghrāviva naravyāghrau daṃṣṭrābhiritaretaram / śaradhārāsṛjau vīrau meghāviva vavarṣatuḥ
ce_text: vyāghrāv iva naravyāghrau daṃṣṭrābhir itaretaram / śaradaṃṣṭrā vidhunvānau tatakṣatur ariṃdamau

vulgate_text: tato bhīmo mahābāhurbāhubhyāṃ vikṣipandhanuḥ / vyarājata raṇe rājansavidyudiva toyadaḥ
ce_text: sahastābharaṇābhyāṃ tu bhujābhyāṃ vikṣipan dhanuḥ / vyarocata raṇe bhīmaḥ savidyud iva toyadaḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ śarasahasreṇa samyagastena bhārata / pāṇḍavo vyakiratkarṇaṃ bhīmo bhīmaparākramaḥ
ce_text: tataḥ śarasahasreṇa dhanurmuktena bhārata / pāṇḍavo vyakirat karṇaṃ ghano 'drim iva vṛṣṭibhiḥ

vulgate_text: sañjaya uvāca / tataḥ karṇo mahārāja bhīmaṃ viddhā tribhiḥ śūraiḥ punaśca ṣaḍbhistīkṣṇāgrairavidhyatkaṅkapatribhiḥ / mumoca śaravarṣāṇi vicitrāṇi bahūni ca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / karṇabhīmau mahārāja parākrāntau mahāhave / bāṇavarṣāṇy avarṣetāṃ vṛṣṭimantāv ivāmbudau

vulgate_text: sa karṇaṃ karṇinā karṇe pītena niśitena ca / vivyādha subhṛśaṃ saṅkhye tailadhautena māriṣa
ce_text: sa karṇaṃ karṇinā karṇe pītena niśitena ca / vivyādha yudhi rājendra bhīmasenaḥ patatriṇā

vulgate_text: athāpareṇa bhallena sūtaputraṃ stanāntare / ājaghāna bhṛśaṃ kruddho hasanniva vṛkodaraḥ
ce_text: athāpareṇa bhallena sūtaputraṃ stanāntare / ājaghāna bhṛśaṃ bhīmaḥ smayann iva mahābalaḥ

vulgate_text: punarasya tvaranbhīpo nārācāndaśa bhārata / raṇe praiṣīnmahābāhurnirmuktāśīviṣopamān
ce_text: punar asya tvaran bhīmo nārācān daśa bhārata / raṇe praiṣīn mahāvegān yamadaṇḍopamāṃs tathā

vulgate_text: tāvubhau naraśārdūlau śārdūlāviva daṃṣṭriṇau śaradaṃṣṭrau samāsādya tatakṣaturarindamau / jimūtāviva cānyonyaṃ pravavarṣaturāhave
ce_text: jīmūtāv iva cānyonyaṃ tau vavarṣatur āhave / talaśabdaravaiś caiva trāsayantau parasparam

vulgate_text: anyatkārmukamādatta bhāraghnaṃ vegavattaram / tadapyatha nimeṣārdhāccicchedāsya vṛkodaraḥ
ce_text: tataḥ prahasyādhirathir anyad ādatta kārmukam / śatrughnaṃ samare kruddho dṛḍhajyaṃ vegavattaram

vulgate_text: te tu cāpabaloddhūtāḥ śātakumbhavibhūṣitāḥ / ajasramapatanbāṇā bhīmasenarathaṃ prati
ce_text: te tu cāpabaloddhūtāḥ śātakumbhavibhūṣitāḥ / ajasram anvakīryanta śarāḥ pārtharathaṃ prati

vulgate_text: cāpādādhirathermuktāḥ prapatantaścakāśire / eko dīrgha ivātyarthamākāśe saṃsthitaḥ śaraḥ
ce_text: cāpād ādhirather muktāḥ prapatantaḥ sma sāyakāḥ / eko dīrgha iva prāṃśuḥ prabhavan dṛśyate śaraḥ

vulgate_text: tatra bhārata bhīmasya balaṃ vīryaṃ parākramam / vyavasāyaṃ ca putrāste dadṛśuḥ sahasainikāḥ
ce_text: tatra bhārata bhīmasya balavīryaparākramam / vyavasāyaṃ ca putrās te praikṣanta kurubhiḥ saha

vulgate_text: tāvadbhiratha tānbhīmo vyomni ciccheda patribhiḥ / nārācānsūta putrasya tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti cābravīt
ce_text: tān antarikṣe viśikhais tridhaikaikam aśātayat / viśeṣayan sūtaputraṃ bhīmas tiṣṭheti cābravīt

vulgate_text: tasyāśvāṃśca punarhatvā sūtaṃ vivyādha pañcabhiḥ / sopasṛtya drutaṃ sūto yudhāmanyo rathaṃ yayau
ce_text: athāsyāśvān punar hatvā tribhir vivyādha sārathim / so 'vaplutya drutaṃ sūto yuyudhānarathaṃ yayau

vulgate_text: vihasanniva bhīmasya kruddhaḥ kālānaladyutiḥ / dhvajaṃ ciccheda rādheyaḥ patākāṃ ca vyapātayat
ce_text: utsmayann iva bhīmasya kruddhaḥ kālānalaprabhaḥ / dhvajaṃ ciccheda rādheyaḥ patākāś ca nyapātayat

vulgate_text: sā'pataddṛśadhā chinnā karṇasya niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ / asyataḥ sūtaputrasya mitrārthe citrayodhinaḥ
ce_text: sāpatad daśadhā rājan nikṛttā karṇasāyakaiḥ / asyataḥ sūtaputrasya mitrārthe citrayodhinaḥ

vulgate_text: sa carmādatta kaunteyo jātarūpapariṣkṛtam / khaṅgaṃ cānyataraprepsurjayaṃ maraṇameva vā
ce_text: sa carmādatta kaunteyo jātarūpapariṣkṛtam / khaḍgaṃ cānyataraprepsur mṛtyor agre jayasya vā / tad asya sahasā karṇo vyadhamat prahasann iva

vulgate_text: sa dhanuḥ sūtaputrasya sajyaṃ chittvā mahānasiḥ / papāta bhuvi rājendra kruddhaḥ sarpa ivāmbarāt
ce_text: sa dhanuḥ sūtaputrasya chittvā jyāṃ ca susaṃśitaḥ / apatad bhuvi nistriṃśaś cyutaḥ sarpa ivāmbarāt

vulgate_text: sa vadhyamāno balavānkarṇacāpacyutaiḥ śaraiḥ / vaihāyasaṃ prākramaddhai karṇasya rathamāviśat
ce_text: sa bhīmasenaḥ kupito balavān satyavikramaḥ / vihāyasaṃ prākramad vai karṇasya vyathayan manaḥ

vulgate_text: mahauṣadhisamāyuktaṃ hanūmāniva parvatam / tamasya viśikhaiḥ karṇo vyadhamatkuñjaraṃ punaḥ
ce_text: tam asya viśikhaiḥ karṇo vyadhamat kuñjaraṃ punaḥ / hastyaṅgāny atha karṇāya prāhiṇot pāṇḍavo nadan

vulgate_text: tato dṛṣṭvā mahārāja vāsudevo mahādyutiḥ / arjunārjuna paśyemaṃ bhīmaṃ karṇena bādhitam / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / karṇabhīmau mahārāja parākrāntau mahāhave / bāṇavarṣāṇy avarṣetāṃ vṛṣṭimantāv ivāmbudau

vulgate_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / dātavyamadya manye'haṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ svakaṃ punaḥ / na vigraho hi balinā śreyase syādyathātathā
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / ahany ahani me dīptaṃ yaśaḥ patati saṃjaya / hatā me bahavo yodhā manye kālasya paryayam

vulgate_text: apriyaṃ sumahatkṛtvā sindhurājaḥ kirīṭinaḥ kruddhasya devarājasya śakrasyeva mahādyuteḥ / cakṣurviṣayamāpannaḥ kathaṃ jīvitamāpnuyāt
ce_text: apriyaṃ sumahat kṛtvā sindhurājaḥ kirīṭinaḥ / cakṣurviṣayam āpannaḥ kathaṃ mucyeta jīvitaḥ

vulgate_text: udīcīṃ dakṣiṇāṃ prācīṃ pratīcīṃ vidiśastathā / punarmadhyagato vīra āhave yuddhadurmadaḥ
ce_text: udīcīṃ dakṣiṇāṃ prācīṃ pratīcīṃ prasṛtas tathā / nṛtyann ivācarac chūro yathā rathaśataṃ tathā

vulgate_text: ekaḥ paryacaranraṅge bahudhā sa mahābalaḥ / nṛtyannivācaracchūro yathā rathaśataṃ tathā
ce_text: udīcīṃ dakṣiṇāṃ prācīṃ pratīcīṃ prasṛtas tathā / nṛtyann ivācarac chūro yathā rathaśataṃ tathā

vulgate_text: tairvyavāharadāryātmā muhūrtādeva sātyakiḥ / tataḥ kaliṅgairyuyudhe so'cintyabalavikramaḥ
ce_text: tān nyavārayad āyastān muhūrtam iva sātyakiḥ / tataḥ kaliṅgair yuyudhe so 'cintyabalavikramaḥ

vulgate_text: tataste sarvasenāsu janāḥ kṛṣṇadhanañjayau / garhayāmāsurapyetau śaśaṃsurbhūridakṣiṇam
ce_text: tataḥ sa sarvasenāyāṃ janaḥ kṛṣṇadhanaṃjayau / garhayām āsa taṃ cāpi śaśaṃsa puruṣarṣabham

vulgate_text: nyastaśastrasya bālasya virathasya vivarmaṇaḥ / nābhimanyorvadhaṃ yūyaṃ garhayadhvaṃ kutastadā
ce_text: nyastaśastrasya bālasya virathasya vivarmaṇaḥ / abhimanyor vadhaṃ tāta dhārmikaḥ ko na pūjayet / duryodhanasya kṣudrasya na pramāṇe ca tiṣṭhataḥ / saumadatter ayaṃ sādhu sarvasāhāyyakāriṇaḥ / asmadīyā mayā rakṣyāḥ prāṇabādha upasthite / ye me pratyakṣato vīrā hanyerann iti me matiḥ / satyakaś ca vaśaṃ nītaḥ kauraveṇa mahātmanā / saṃjaya uvāca / tato mayaitac caritaṃ pratijñārakṣaṇaṃ prati / punaś ca kṛpayāviṣṭo bahu tat tad vicintayan / uvāca cainaṃ kauravyam arjunaḥ śokapīḍitaḥ / dhig astu kṣatradharmaṃ tu yatra tvaṃ puruṣeśvaraḥ / avasthām īdṛśīṃ prāptaḥ śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇapradaḥ / nātibhāraḥ kṛtāntasya vidyate kurunandana / yatra tvaṃ puruṣavyāghraḥ prāptaḥ pāpām imāṃ daśām / nātmanaḥ sukṛtasyāsya phalaṃ vai nṛpasattama / yatra tvaṃ kuruśārdūla prāptaḥ pāpām imāṃ daśām / rauravaṃ narakaṃ bhīmaṃ gamiṣyati suyodhanaḥ / yatkṛte naraśārdūlaḥ prāptaḥ pāpām imāṃ daśām / ko hi nāma pumāṃl loke mādṛśaḥ puruṣottama / praharet tvadvidhe tv adya pratijñā yadi no bhavet

vulgate_text: ye lokā mama vimalāḥ sakṛdvibhātā brahmādyaiḥ suravṛṣabhairapīṣyamāṇāḥ / tānkṣipraṃ vraja satatāgnihotrayāji-- nmattulyo bhava garuḍottamāṅgayānaḥ / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tam āpatantaṃ saṃprekṣya sātvataṃ yuddhadurmadam / krodhād bhūriśravā rājan sahasā samupādravat

vulgate_text: martavyameva sarveṇa caramaṃ pūrvameva vā / manyadhvaṃ mṛta ityeṣa mābhūdvo buddhilāghavam
ce_text: ceṣṭamānaṃ pratīghāte sabhujaṃ māṃ sacakṣuṣaḥ / manyadhvaṃ mṛtam ity evam etad vo buddhilāghavam / yukto hy asya pratīghātaḥ kṛto me kurupuṃgavāḥ

vulgate_text: anye na yuktamityeva bhavitavyaṃ tatheti ca / kecidāsanvimanasaḥ kecidduḥkhasamanvitāḥ / sātyakiruvāca
ce_text: sātyakir uvāca / na hantavyo na hantavya iti yan māṃ prabhāṣatha / dharmavādair adharmiṣṭhā dharmakañcukam āsthitāḥ

vulgate_text: api cāpaṃ purā gītaḥ śloko vālmīkinā bhuvi / na hantavyāḥ striya iti yadbravīṣi plavaṅgama
ce_text: api cāyaṃ purā gītaḥ śloko vālmīkinā bhuvi / pīḍākaram amitrāṇāṃ yat syāt kartavyam eva tat

vulgate_text: sarvakālaṃ manuṣyeṇa vyavasāyavatā sadā pīḍākaramamitrāṇāṃ yatsyātkartavyameva tat / anuṣṭhitaṃ mayā tacca kasmādgarhatha mūḍhavat / sañcaya uvāca
ce_text: api cāyaṃ purā gītaḥ śloko vālmīkinā bhuvi / pīḍākaram amitrāṇāṃ yat syāt kartavyam eva tat

vulgate_text: brahmaṇastvabhavatputro mānaso'trirmahātapāḥ / atreḥ putro'bhavatsomaḥ somasya tu budhaḥ smṛtaḥ
ce_text: atreḥ putro 'bhavat somaḥ somasya tu budhaḥ smṛtaḥ / budhasyāsīn mahendrābhaḥ putra ekaḥ purūravāḥ

vulgate_text: budhasyailo mahābāhuḥ putra āsītpurūravāḥ / purūravasa āyustu āyuṣo nahuṣaḥ sutaḥ
ce_text: purūravasa āyus tu āyuṣo nahuṣaḥ smṛtaḥ / nahuṣasya yayātis tu rājarṣir devasaṃmitaḥ

vulgate_text: tayoryuddhamabhūdrājandinārdhaṃ citramudbhatam / bāhuyuddhaṃ subalinoḥ prasaktaṃ puruṣarṣabhaḥ
ce_text: tayor yuddham abhūd rājan dinārdhaṃ citram adbhutam / bāhuyuddhaṃ subalinoḥ śakraprahrādayor iva

vulgate_text: apātayacca samare saumadattiḥ śineḥ sutam / paśyatāṃ sarvasainyānāṃ padā cainamatāḍayat
ce_text: sa tena varadānena labdhavān bhūridakṣiṇam / nyapātayac ca samare saumadattiḥ śineḥ sutam

vulgate_text: yatrainaṃ viśikhaistīkṣṇaiḥ pātayiṣyasi bhūtale / tadā gantāsi pārtha tvaṃ tena yoddhuṃ durātmanā / dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / tasmin vinihate vīre saindhave savyasācinā / māmakā yad akurvanta tan mamācakṣva saṃjaya

vulgate_text: yo'sau karṇena vīrasya vārṣṇeyasya samāgamaḥ / hate tu bhūriśravasi tadyuddhamabhavatkatham
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / yo 'sau karṇena vīreṇa vārṣṇeyasya samāgamaḥ / hate tu bhūriśravasi saindhave ca nipātite

vulgate_text: hanta te kathayiṣyāmi yathāvṛttaṃ mahāraṇe paśyatāṃ sarvasainyānāṃ keśavāryunayorapi / śuśrūṣasva sthiro bhūtvā durācaritamātmanaḥ
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / hanta te varṇayiṣyāmi yathāvṛttaṃ mahāraṇe / śuśrūṣasva sthiro bhūtvā durācaritam ātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: ratho me yujyatāṃ kalyamiti rājanmahābālaḥ na hi devā na gandharvā na yakṣoragarākṣasāḥ / mānavā vā'pi jetāraḥ kṛṣṇayoḥ santi kecana
ce_text: na hi devā na gandharvā na yakṣoragarākṣasāḥ / mānavā vā vijetāraḥ kṛṣṇayoḥ santi ke cana

vulgate_text: taṃ tu sakrodhamālokya sātyakiḥ pratyayudhyata / mahatā śaravarṣeṇa gajaṃ pratigajo yathā
ce_text: taṃ tu saṃprekṣya saṃkruddhaṃ sātyakiḥ pratyavidhyata / mahatā śaravarṣeṇa gajaḥ pratigajaṃ yathā

vulgate_text: tathā tu virathaṃ karṇaṃ putrāṃśca paripālayan / duḥśāsanamukhānvīrānnāvadhītsātyakirvaśī
ce_text: tathā tu virathe karṇe putrān vai tava pārthiva / duḥśāsanamukhāñ śūrān nāvadhīt sātyakir vaśī

vulgate_text: kṛṣṇayoḥ sadṛśo vīrye sātyakiḥ śatrutāpanaḥ / jitavānsarvasainyāni tāvakāni hasanniva
ce_text: kṛṣṇayoḥ sadṛśo vīrye sātyakiḥ śatrukarśanaḥ / kṛṣṇo vāpi bhavel loke pārtho vāpi dhanurdharaḥ / śaineyo vā naravyāghraś caturtho nopalabhyate

vulgate_text: kṛṣṇo vā'pi bhavelloke pārtho bā'pi dhanurdharaḥ / śaineyo vā naravyāghra caturthastu na vidyate / dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / tasmin vinihate vīre saindhave savyasācinā / māmakā yad akurvanta tan mamācakṣva saṃjaya

vulgate_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / tathā gateṣu śūreṣu teṣāṃ mama ca sañjaya / kiṃsvidbhīmārjunau caiva sātyakiścākarottadā / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / ajito droṇarādheyavikarṇakṛtavarmabhiḥ / tīrṇaḥ sainyārṇavaṃ vīraḥ pratiśrutya yudhiṣṭhire

vulgate_text: tattathā prayatiṣye'haṃ paraṃ śaktyāḷḷḷḷsuyodhana / yathā pāṇḍavamukhyo'sau na haniṣyāti saindhavam
ce_text: yotsyāmi tu tathā rājañ śaktyāhaṃ parayā raṇe / yathā pāṇḍavamukhyo 'sau na haniṣyati saindhavam

vulgate_text: saindhavārthe paraṃ yatnaṃ kariṣyāmyadya saṃyuge / tvatpriyārthaṃ mahārāja jayo daive pratiṣṭhitaḥ
ce_text: adya yotsye 'rjunam ahaṃ pauruṣaṃ svaṃ vyapāśritaḥ / tvadarthaṃ puruṣavyāghra jayo daive pratiṣṭhitaḥ

vulgate_text: ciccheda niśitairbāṇaiḥ śūrāṇāmanivartinām
ce_text: ciccheda tīkṣṇāgramukhaiḥ śūrāṇām anivartinām / bhujān parighasaṃkāśān hastihastopamān raṇe

vulgate_text: hastihastāndvipaskandhānrathākṣāṃśca samantataḥ / śoṇitāktānhayārohāngṛhītaprāsatomarān
ce_text: śoṇitāktān hayārohān gṛhītaprāsatomarān / kṣuraiś ciccheda bībhatsur dvidhaikaikaṃ tridhaiva ca

vulgate_text: kṣuraiściccheda bībhatsurdvidhaikaikaṃ tridhaiva ca hayānvāraṇamukhyāṃśca padātīṃśca samantataḥ / dhvajāṃśchatrāṇi cāpāni cāmarāṇi śirāṃsi ca
ce_text: hayavāraṇamukhyāś ca prāpatanta sahasraśaḥ / dhvajāś chatrāṇi cāpāni cāmarāṇi śirāṃsi ca

vulgate_text: athānyaddhanurādāya sūtaputraḥ pratāpavān / sāyakairaṣṭasāhasraiśchādayāmāsa pāṇḍavam
ce_text: athānyad dhanur ādāya sūtaputraḥ pratāpavān / karṇo 'pi dviṣatāṃ hantā chādayām āsa phalgunam / sāyakair bahusāhasraiḥ kṛtapratikṛtepsayā

vulgate_text: yatnādrakṣata rādheyaṃ nāhatvā samare'rjunam / nivartiṣyati rādheyo na vā'jitvā'dya phalgunaṃ
ce_text: tato duryodhano rājaṃs tāvakān abhyabhāṣata / yattā rakṣata rādheyaṃ nāhatvā samare 'rjunam / nivartiṣyati rādheya iti mām uktavān vṛṣaḥ

vulgate_text: madrarājaśca kaunteyamavidhyattriṃśatā śaraiḥ / āvavre'rjunamārgaṃ ca śarajālena bhārata
ce_text: madrarājas tu kaunteyam avidhyat triṃśatā śaraiḥ / śāradvatas tu viṃśatyā vāsudevaṃ samārpayat / dhanaṃjayaṃ dvādaśabhir ājaghāna śilīmukhaiḥ

vulgate_text: sañjaya uvāca / śrutvā ninādaṃ dhanuṣaśca tasya vispaṣṛmutkaṣṭamivāntakasya / śakrāśanisphoṭasamaṃ sughoraṃ vikṛṣyamāṇasya dhanañjayena
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / bhūriśravasi saṃkrānte paralokāya bhārata / vāsudevaṃ mahābāhur arjunaḥ samacūcudat

vulgate_text: ādadānaṃ mahārāja sandadhānaṃ ca pāṇḍavam / utkarṣantaṃ sṛjantaṃ ca na sma paśyāma lāghavāt
ce_text: ādadānaṃ maheṣvāsaṃ saṃdadhānaṃ ca pāṇḍavam / visṛjantaṃ ca kaunteyaṃ nānupaśyāmahe tadā

vulgate_text: evaṃ tattava rājendra caturaṅgabalaṃ tadā / vyākulīkṛtya kaunteyo jayadrathamupādravat
ce_text: tathā sarvā diśo rājan sarvāṃś ca rathino raṇe / ākulīkṛtya kaunteyo jayadratham upādravat / vivyādha ca catuḥṣaṣṭyā śarāṇāṃ nataparvaṇām

vulgate_text: ākarṇapūrṇāṃścikṣepa phalgunasya rathaṃ prati / tribhistu vidvā govindaṃ nārācaiḥ ṣaḍbhirarjunam
ce_text: tribhis tu viddhvā gāṇḍīvaṃ nārācaiḥ ṣaḍbhir arjunam / aṣṭābhir vājino 'vidhyad dhvajaṃ caikena patriṇā

vulgate_text: aṣṭabhirvājino'vidhyaddhvajaṃ caikena patriṇā / bhūyaścaivārjunaṃ saṅkhye śaravarṣairavākirat
ce_text: tribhis tu viddhvā gāṇḍīvaṃ nārācaiḥ ṣaḍbhir arjunam / aṣṭābhir vājino 'vidhyad dhvajaṃ caikena patriṇā

ce_text: sa chinnayaṣṭiḥ sumahāñ śīryamāṇaḥ śarāhataḥ / varāhaḥ sindhurājasya papātāgniśikhopamaḥ

vulgate_text: etasminneva kāle tu prahartavyaṃ dhanañjaya / jayadrathasya kṣudrasya savidurdarśanārthinaḥ / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / bhūriśravasi saṃkrānte paralokāya bhārata / vāsudevaṃ mahābāhur arjunaḥ samacūcudat

vulgate_text: evaṃ tūṇīśayaṃ ghoramindrāśanisamaprabham varmabhedinamatyarthaṃ gandhamālyārcitaṃ sadā / visasarja tatastūrṇaṃ saindhavasya rathaṃ prati
ce_text: sarvabhārasahaṃ śaśvadgandhamālyārcitaṃ śaram / visasarjārjunas tūrṇaṃ saindhavasya vadhe vṛtaḥ

vulgate_text: śrutvā tu vacanaṃ tasya tvaramāṇo'stramāyayā tathā'haracchirastasya śarairūrdhvaṃ dhanañjayaḥ / durhṛdāmapaharṣāya suhṛdāṃ harṣaṇāya ca
ce_text: aharat tat punaś caiva śarair ūrdhvaṃ dhanaṃjayaḥ / durhṛdām apraharṣāya suhṛdāṃ harṣaṇāya ca

vulgate_text: śaraiḥ kandukavatkṛtvā tasyālokāya pāṇḍavaḥ / syamantapañcakādbāhye śirastadaharaccharaiḥ
ce_text: śaraiḥ kadambakīkṛtya kāle tasmiṃś ca pāṇḍavaḥ / samantapañcakād bāhyaṃ śiras tad vyaharat tataḥ

vulgate_text: tasyāpi śatadhā mūrdhā phaliṣyati na saṃśayaḥ / yadi cedasti me lābhastapaso vā damasya vā
ce_text: saṃgrāme yudhyamānasya vahato mahatīṃ dhuram / dharaṇyāṃ mama putrasya pātayiṣyati yaḥ śiraḥ / tasyāpi śatadhā mūrdhā phaliṣyati na saṃśayaḥ

vulgate_text: yathaitatsaindhavaśiraḥ śaraireva dhanañjaya / vṛddhakṣatre patatyeva tathā nītirvidhīyatām / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / bhūriśravasi saṃkrānte paralokāya bhārata / vāsudevaṃ mahābāhur arjunaḥ samacūcudat

vulgate_text: tataḥ sumahadāścaryaṃ tatrāpaśyāma bhārata / syamantapañcakādbāhyaṃ śiro yadvyaharattataḥ
ce_text: śaraiḥ kadambakīkṛtya kāle tasmiṃś ca pāṇḍavaḥ / samantapañcakād bāhyaṃ śiras tad vyaharat tataḥ

vulgate_text: tato dṛṣṭvā vinihataṃ sindhurājaṃ jayadratham / karmaṇā tena pārthasya vismitāḥ sarvadevatāḥ
ce_text: tato dṛṣṭvā vinihataṃ sindhurājaṃ jayadratham / putrāṇāṃ tava netrebhyo duḥkhād bahv apataj jalam

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvā tu nihataṃ saṅkhye sindhurājaṃ mahāratham / putrāṇāṃ tava netrebhyo duḥkhādāsraṃ pravartata
ce_text: tato dṛṣṭvā vinihataṃ sindhurājaṃ jayadratham / putrāṇāṃ tava netrebhyo duḥkhād bahv apataj jalam

vulgate_text: paśyatāṃ sarvasainyānāṃ māmakānāṃ mahāraṇe / ahanyata kathaṃ yuddhe saindhavaḥ savyasācinā
ce_text: paśyatāṃ sarvasainyānāṃ keśavasya mamaiva ca / viratho bhīmasenena kṛto 'si bahuśo raṇe / na ca tvāṃ paruṣaṃ kiṃ cid uktavān paṇḍunandanaḥ

vulgate_text: tasminhate maheṣvāse mandātmā sa suyodhanaḥ / bhrātṛbiḥ sahitaḥ sūta kimakārṣīdanantaram / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / sa raṇe vyacarat pārthaḥ prekṣaṇīyo dhanaṃjayaḥ / yugapad dikṣu sarvāsu citrāṇy astrāṇi darśayan / tataḥ kruddho mahābāhur aindram astraṃ durāsadam / prāduś cakre mahārāja trāsayan sarvabhāratān / tataḥ śarāḥ prādur āsan divyāstrapratimantritāḥ / pradīptāś ca śikhimukhāḥ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ / ākarṇapūrṇanirmuktair agnyarkāṃśunibhaiḥ śaraiḥ / nabho 'bhavat tad duṣprekṣyam ulkābhir iva saṃvṛtam / tataḥ śastrāndhakāraṃ tat kauravaiḥ samudīritam / aśakyaṃ manasāpy anyaiḥ pāṇḍavaḥ saṃbhramann iva / nāśayām āsa vikramya śarair divyāstramantritaiḥ / naiśaṃ tamo 'ṃśubhiḥ kṣipraṃ dinādāv iva bhāskaraḥ / tatas tu tāvakaṃ sainyaṃ dīptaiḥ śaragabhastibhiḥ / ākṣipat palvalāmbūni nidāghārka iva prabhuḥ / tato divyāstraviduṣā prahitāḥ sāyakāṃśavaḥ / samāplavan dviṣatsainyaṃ lokaṃ bhānor ivāṃśavaḥ / tathāpare samutsṛṣṭā viśikhās tigmatejasaḥ / hṛdayāny āśu vīrāṇāṃ viviśuḥ priyabandhuvat / ya enam īyuḥ samare tvadyodhāḥ śūramāninaḥ / śalabhā iva te dīptā agniṃ prāpya yayuḥ kṣayam / evaṃ sa mṛdnañ śatrūṇāṃ jīvitāni yaśāṃsi ca / pārthaś cacāra saṃgrāme mṛtyur vigrahavān iva / sakirīṭāni vastrāṇi sāṅgadān vipulān bhujān / sakuṇḍalayugān karṇān keṣāṃ cid aharac charaiḥ / satomarān gajasthānāṃ saprāsān hayasādinām / sacarmaṇaḥ padātīnāṃ rathināṃ ca sadhanvanaḥ / sapratodān niyantṝṇāṃ bāhūṃś ciccheda pāṇḍavaḥ / pradīptograśarārciṣmān babhau tatra dhanaṃjayaḥ / savisphuliṅgāgraśikho jvalann iva hutāśanaḥ / taṃ devarājapratimaṃ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varam / yugapad dikṣu sarvāsu rathasthaṃ puruṣarṣabham / darśayantaṃ mahāstrāṇi prekṣaṇīyaṃ dhanaṃjayam / nṛtyantaṃ rathamārgeṣu dhanurjyātalanādinam / nirīkṣituṃ na śekus te yatnavanto 'pi pārthivāḥ / madhyaṃdinagataṃ sūryaṃ pratapantam ivāmbare / dīptograsaṃbhṛtaśaraḥ kirīṭī virarāja ha / varṣāsv ivodīrṇajalaḥ sendradhanvāmbudo mahān / mahāstrasaṃplave tasmiñ jiṣṇunā saṃpravartite / sudustare mahāghore mamajjur yodhapuṃgavāḥ / utkṛttavadanair dehaiḥ śarīraiḥ kṛttabāhubhiḥ / bhujaiś ca pāṇinirmuktaiḥ pāṇibhir vyaṅgulīkṛtaiḥ / kṛttāgrahastaiḥ karibhiḥ kṛttadantair madotkaṭaiḥ / hayaiś chinnakhuragrīvai rathaiś ca śakalīkṛtaiḥ / nikṛttāntraiḥ kṛttapādais tathānyaiḥ kṛttasaṃdhibhiḥ / niśceṣṭair visphuradbhiś ca kūjadbhiś ca sahasraśaḥ / mṛtyor āghātalalitaṃ tat pārthāyodhanaṃ mahat / apaśyāma mahīpāla bhīrūṇāṃ bhayavardhanam / ākrīḍam iva rudrasya purābhyardayataḥ paśūn / gajānāṃ kṣuranirmuktaiḥ karaiḥ sabhujageva bhūḥ / kva cid babhau sragviṇīva vakrapadmaiḥ samācitā / vicitroṣṇīṣamukuṭaiḥ keyūrāṅgadakuṇḍalaiḥ / svarṇacitratanutraiś ca bhāṇḍaiś ca gajavājinām / kirīṭaśatasaṃkīrṇā tatra tatra samācitā / virarāja bhṛśaṃ citrā mahī navavadhūr iva / majjāmedaḥkardaminīṃ śoṇitaughataraṅgiṇīm / marmāsthibhir agādhāṃ ca keśaśaivalaśādvalām / śirobāhūpalataṭāṃ rugṇakroḍāsthisaṃkaṭām / citradhvajapatākāḍhyāṃ chattracāpormimālinīm / vigatāsumahākāyāṃ gajadehābhisaṃkulām / rathoḍupaśatākīrṇāṃ hayasaṃghātarodhasam / rathacakrayugeṣākṣakūbarair atidurgamām / prāsāsiśaktiparaśuviśikhāhidurāsadām / balakaṅkamahānakrāṃ gomāyumakarotkaṭām / gṛdhrodagramahāgrāhāṃ śivāvirutabhairavām / nṛtyatpretapiśācādyair bhūtaiḥ kīrṇāṃ sahasraśaḥ / gatāsuyodhaniśceṣṭaśarīraśatavāhinīm / mahāpratibhayāṃ raudrāṃ ghorāṃ vaitaraṇīm iva / nadīṃ pravartayām āsa bhīrūṇāṃ bhayavardhinīm / taṃ dṛṣṭvā tasya vikrāntam antakasyeva rūpiṇaḥ / abhūtapūrvaṃ kuruṣu bhayam āgād raṇājire / tata ādāya vīrāṇām astrair astrāṇi pāṇḍavaḥ / ātmānaṃ raudram ācaṣṭa raudrakarmaṇi niṣṭhitaḥ / tato rathavarān rājann abhyatikrāmad arjunaḥ

vulgate_text: tena nātibhṛśaṃ trastau viśikhairbhṛśapīḍitau / bahutvāttu parāmārtiṃ śarāṇāṃ tāvagacchatām
ce_text: te nātibhṛśam abhyaghnan viśikhā jayacoditāḥ / bahutvāt tu parām ārtiṃ śarāṇāṃ tāv agacchatām

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvā śāradvataṃ pārtho mūrcchitaṃ śarapīḍitam dhigdhiṅmāmiti caivoktvā kṛpaṇaṃ paryadevayat / aśrupūrṇamukho dīno vacanaṃ cedamabravīt
ce_text: dṛṣṭvā śāradvataṃ pārtho mūrchitaṃ śarapīḍitam / ratha eva maheṣvāsaḥ kṛpaṇaṃ paryadevayat

vulgate_text: putraśokābhitaptena śarairabhyarditena ca / abhyasto bahubhirbāṇairdaśadharmagatena vai
ce_text: śarārditena hi mayā prekṣaṇīyo mahādyutiḥ / pratyasto bahubhir bāṇair daśadharmagatena vai

vulgate_text: śarārditaḥ sa hi mayā prekṣamāṇo mahādyutiḥ śocayatyeṣa niyataṃ bhūyaḥ putravadhāddhi mām / kṛpaṇaṃ svarathe sannaṃ paśya kṛṣṇa yathāgatam
ce_text: śocayaty eṣa nipatan bhūyaḥ putravadhād dhi mām / kṛpaṇaṃ svarathe sannaṃ paśya kṛṣṇa yathā gatam

vulgate_text: sañjaya uvāca / tato rājānamabhyetya dharmaputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram / vavande samprahṛṣṭātmā hate pārthena saindhave
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / viratho bhīmaseno vai karṇavākśalyapīḍitaḥ / amarṣavaśam āpannaḥ phalgunaṃ vākyam abravīt

vulgate_text: purāṇaṃ paramaṃ devaṃ devadevaṃ sanātanam / ye prapannāḥ suraguruṃ na te muhyanti karhicit
ce_text: sraṣṭāraṃ sarvalokānāṃ paramātmānam acyutam / ye prapannā hṛṣīkeśaṃ na te muhyanti karhi cit

vulgate_text: gāyanti caturo vedā yaśca deveṣu gīyate / taṃ prapadya mahātmānaṃ bhūtimaśnāmyanuttamām
ce_text: yo 'gāta caturo vedān yaś ca vedeṣu gīyate / taṃ prapadya mahātmānaṃ bhūtim āpnoty anuttamām

vulgate_text: anādinidhanaṃ devaṃ viśvasyeśaṃ jagatpate / dhātāramajamavyaktamāhurvedavido janāḥ
ce_text: dhanaṃjayasakhā yaś ca dhanaṃjayahitaś ca yaḥ / taṃ dhanaṃjayagoptāraṃ prapadya sukham edhate / saṃhṛṣṭendriyacittātmā nāśakad vaktum ojasā / muhūrtam iva harṣeṇa tūṣṇīṃ bhūtvā mahāmatiḥ / tato harṣānvito rājā harṣāśruplutalocanaḥ / uvāca paramaprītaḥ sagadgadam idaṃ vacaḥ / priyam etad upaśrutya tvattaḥ puṣkaralocana / nāntaṃ gacchāmi harṣasya titīrṣur udadher iva / atyadbhutam idaṃ kṛṣṇa kṛtaṃ pārthena dhīmatā / tvayā guptena govinda ghnatā pāpaṃ jayadratham / kiṃ tu nātyadbhutaṃ teṣāṃ yeṣāṃ nas tvaṃ samāśrayaḥ / sthitaḥ sarvātmanā nityaṃ priyeṣu ca hiteṣu ca / tvaṃ caivāsmābhir āśritya kṛtaḥ śastrasamudyamaḥ / surair ivāsuravadhe śakraṃ śakrānujāhave / asaṃbhāvyam idaṃ karma devair api janārdana / tvadbuddhibalavīryeṇa kṛtavān eṣa phalgunaḥ / bālyāt prabhṛti te kṛṣṇa karmāṇi śrutavān aham / amānuṣāṇi divyāni mahānti ca bahūni ca / yadaivānugṛhītāḥ sma tvayā snehānurāgataḥ / tadaivājñāsiṣaṃ śatrūn hatān prāptāṃ ca medinīm / mārkaṇḍeyaḥ purāṇarṣiś caritajñas tavānagha / māhātmyam anubhāvaṃ ca purā kīrtitavān muniḥ / asito devalaś caiva nāradaś ca mahātapāḥ / pitāmahaś ca me vyāsas tvām āhur vidhim uttamam / tvaṃ tejas tvaṃ paraṃ brahma tvaṃ satyaṃ tvaṃ mahat tapaḥ / tvaṃ śreyas tvaṃ yaśaś cāgryaṃ kāraṇaṃ jagatas tathā / tvayā sṛṣṭam idaṃ sarvaṃ jagat sthāvarajaṅgamam / pralaye samanuprāpte tvāṃ vai niviśate punaḥ / anādinidhanaṃ devaṃ viśvam īśaṃ prajāpatim / dhātāram ajam avyaktam āhur vedavido janāḥ / bhūtātmānaṃ mahātmānam anantaṃ viśvatomukham / api devā na jānanti guhyam ādyaṃ jagatpatim / nārāyaṇaṃ paraṃ devaṃ paramātmānam aīśvaram / jñānayoniṃ hariṃ viṣṇuṃ mumukṣūṇāṃ parāyaṇam / paraṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇānāṃ paraṃ ca yat / evamādiguṇānāṃ te karmaṇāṃ divi ceha ca / atītabhūtabhavyānāṃ saṃkhyātātra na vidyate / sarvato rakṣaṇīyāḥ sma saśakrāṇāṃ divaukasām / yais tvaṃ sarvaguṇopetaḥ suhṛn na upapāditaḥ / ity evaṃ dharmarājena harir ukto mahāyaśāḥ / anurūpam idaṃ vākyaṃ pratyuvāca janārdanaḥ / bhavatas tapasogreṇa dharmeṇa parameṇa ca / sādhutvād ārjavāc caiva hataḥ pāpo jayadrathaḥ / ayaṃ ca puruṣavyāghra tvadanudhyānabṛṃhitaḥ / hatvā yodhasahasrāṇi nyahañ jiṣṇur jayadratham / kṛtitve bāhuvīrye ca tathaivāsaṃbhrame 'pi ca / śīghratāmoghavedhitve nāsti pārthasamaḥ kva cit / tad ayaṃ bharataśreṣṭha bhrātā te pāṇḍavārjunaḥ / sainyakṣayaṃ raṇe kṛtvā sindhurājaśiro 'harat / tato dharmasuto jiṣṇuṃ pariṣvajya viśāṃ pate / pramṛjya vadanaṃ cāsya paryāśvāsayata prabhuḥ / atīva sumahat karma kṛtavān asi phalguna / asahyaṃ cāviṣahyaṃ ca devair api savāsavaiḥ / diṣṭyā nistīrṇabhāro 'si hatāriś cāsi śatruhan / diṣṭyā satyā pratijñeyaṃ kṛtā hatvā jayadratham / evam uktvā guḍākeśaṃ dharmarājo mahāyaśāḥ / pasparśa puṇyagandhena pṛṣṭhe hastena pārthivaḥ

vulgate_text: durlabho vijayasteṣāṃ samprāme ripughātinām / yātā mṛtyuvaśaṃ te vai yeṣāṃ kruddho'pi mādhava
ce_text: durlabho hi jayas teṣāṃ saṃgrāme ripusūdana / yātā mṛtyuvaśaṃ te vai yeṣāṃ kruddho 'si pāṇḍava

vulgate_text: diṣṭyā droṇo jitaḥ saṅkhye hārdikyaśca mahābalaḥ / diṣṭyā vikarṇibhiḥ karṇoraṇe nītaḥ parābhavam
ce_text: yuvāṃ vijayinau cāpi diṣṭyā paśyāmi saṃyuge / diṣṭyā droṇo jitaḥ saṃkhye hārdikyaś ca mahābalaḥ

vulgate_text: mama vākyakarau vīrau mama gauravayantritau / sainyārṇavaṃ samuttīrṇau diṣṭyā paśyāmi vāmaham
ce_text: sainyārṇavaṃ samuttīrṇau diṣṭyā paśyāmi cānaghau / samaraślāghinau vīrau samareṣv apalāyinau / mama prāṇasamau caiva diṣṭyā paśyāmi vām aham

vulgate_text: durmanā niḥśvasanduṣṭo bhagnadaṃṣṭra ivoragaḥ / āgaskṛtsarvalokasya putraste'rtiṃ parāmagāt
ce_text: evaṃ klāntamanā rājann upāyād droṇam īkṣitum / āgaskṛt sarvalokasya putras te bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: so'haṃ tatra gamiṣyāmi yatra te puruṣarṣabhāḥ hatā madarthe saṅgrāme yudhyamānāḥ kirīṭinā - - na hīdānīṃ sahāyā me parīpsantyanupaskṛtāḥ śreyo hi pāṇḍūnmanyante na tathāsmānmahābhuja
ce_text: na hīdānīṃ sahāyā me parīpsanty anupaskṛtāḥ / śreyo hi pāṇḍūn manyante na tathāsmān mahābhuja

vulgate_text: akṣāṃstu manyase bāṇāñchobhamānāñchitāñśarān ta ete ghnanti nastāta viśikhāḥ pārthacoditāḥ / tāṃstadā''khyāyamānastvaṃ vidureṇa na buddhavān
ce_text: ta ete ghnanti nas tāta viśikhā jayacoditāḥ / yāṃs tadā khyāpyamānāṃs tvaṃ vidureṇa na budhyase

vulgate_text: anicchataḥ kathaṃ vīra droṇasya yudhi pāṇḍavaḥ / bhindyātsudurbhidaṃ vyṛhaṃ yatamānasya śupmiṇaḥ
ce_text: kathaṃ hy anicchamānasya droṇasya yudhi phalgunaḥ / bhindyāt sudurbhidaṃ vyūhaṃ yatamāno 'pi saṃyuge

vulgate_text: dayitaḥ phalguno nityamācāryasya mahātmanaḥ / tato'sya dattavāndvāramayuddhenaiva śatruhan
ce_text: priyo hi phalguno nityam ācāryasya mahātmanaḥ / tato 'sya dattavān dvāraṃ nayuddhenārimardana

vulgate_text: yadyadāsyadanujñāṃ vai pūrvameva gṛhānprati / pramthātuṃ sindhurājasya na bhavejjīvitakṣayaḥ
ce_text: yady adāsyam anujñāṃ vai pūrvam eva gṛhān prati / sindhurājasya samare nābhaviṣyaj janakṣayaḥ

vulgate_text: ācāryaṃ mā vigarhasva śaktyā'sau yudhyate dvijaḥ / yathābalaṃ yathotsāhaṃ tyaktvā jīvitamātmanaḥ
ce_text: karṇa uvāca / ācāryaṃ mā vigarhasva śaktyā yudhyaty asau dvijaḥ / ajayyān pāṇḍavān manye droṇenāstravidā mṛdhe

vulgate_text: yadyenaṃ samatikramya praviṣṭaḥ śvetavāhanaḥ / nātra sūkṣmo'pi doṣaḥsyādācāryasya kathañcana
ce_text: tathā hy enam atikramya praviṣṭaḥ śvetavāhanaḥ / daivadṛṣṭo 'nyathābhāvo na manye vidyate kva cit

vulgate_text: tataḥ parivṛtā yodhāḥ parivavruryudhiṣṭhiram / vṛtreṇa saha yudhyantaṃ yadvaddevāḥ śatakratum
ce_text: tataḥ pramuditā yodhāḥ parivavrur yudhiṣṭhiram / vṛtrahatyai yathā devāḥ parivavruḥ puraṃdaram

vulgate_text: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā tava putrasya māriṣa śaraṃ ca sūryaraśmyābhamatyugramanivāraṇam / hā hato'sīti rājānamuktvā'muñcadyudhiṣṭhiraḥ
ce_text: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā tava putrasya māriṣa / śaraṃ paramadurvāraṃ preṣayām āsa saṃyuge / sa tena bhṛśasaṃviddho niṣasāda rathottame

vulgate_text: yatprāviśanmaheṣvāsaḥ pāñcālānaparājitaḥ / nṛtyansa rathamārgeṣu sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
ce_text: nṛtyan sa rathamārgeṣu sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / dhūmaketur iva kruddhaḥ kathaṃ mṛtyum upeyivān

vulgate_text: nirdahansarvasainyāni pāñcālānāṃ ratharṣabhaḥ / dhūmaketuriva kruddhaḥ kathaṃ mṛtyumupeyivān / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tad udīrṇagajāśvaughaṃ balaṃ tava janādhipa / pāṇḍusenām abhidrutya yodhayām āsa sarvataḥ

vulgate_text: hatāṃścaiva viṣaktāṃśca parābhūtāṃśca śaṃsasi rathino virathāṃścaiva kṛtānyuddheṣu māmakān - - teṣāṃ saṃloḍyamānānāṃ pāṇḍavairhatacetasām andhe tamasi magnānāmabhavatkā matistadā
ce_text: hatāṃś caiva viṣaktāṃś ca parābhūtāṃś ca śaṃsasi / rathino virathāṃś caiva kṛtān yuddheṣu māmakān

vulgate_text: tathā cūrṇamabhūttatra karṇabhrātā drumastathā / sa tadā pāṇḍuputreṇa balinā'bhihato'patat
ce_text: tataḥ śatrurathaṃ tyaktvā bhīmo dhruvarathaṃ gataḥ / dhruvaṃ cāsyantam aniśaṃ muṣṭinā samapothayat / sa tathā pāṇḍuputreṇa balinā nihato 'patat

vulgate_text: tamāyāntaṃ jighāṃsantaṃ bhīmaṃ kruddhamivāntakam nyavārayanmahābāhuṃ tava putrā viśāmpate / mahatā śaravarṣeṇa cchādayanto mahārathāḥ
ce_text: tatas tava sutā rājan bhīmasya ratham āvrajan / mahatā śaravarṣeṇa chādayanto vṛkodaram

vulgate_text: durmadastu tato yānaṃ duṣkarṇasyāvacakrame tāvekarathamārūḍhau bhrātarau paratāpanau
ce_text: durmadasya tato bhīmaḥ prahasann iva saṃyuge / sārathiṃ ca hayāṃś caiva śarair ninye yamakṣayam / durmadas tu tato yānaṃ duṣkarṇasyāvapupluve

vulgate_text: dhṛṣṭadyumno'bhyayātkruddhaḥ pragṛhya mahatīṃ camūm / abhyarakṣanmahābāhuḥ sātvataṃ satyavikramam
ce_text: rakṣyamāṇaś ca balibhiś chādayām āsa sātyakim / taṃ chādyamānaṃ viśikhair dṛṣṭvā saṃnataparvabhiḥ / dhṛṣṭadyumno 'bhyayāt kruddhaḥ pragṛhya mahatīṃ camūm

vulgate_text: saumadattivadhātkruddho dṛṣṭvā sātyakimāhave / drauṇirabhyadravadrājanvadhāya kṛtaniścayaḥ
ce_text: taṃ visaṃjñaṃ samālokya yuyudhānaśarārditam / abhyadhāvat tato droṇo yaduvīrajighāṃsayā / tam āyāntam abhiprekṣya yudhiṣṭhirapurogamāḥ / parivavrur mahātmānaṃ parīpsanto yadūdvaham / tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ droṇasya saha pāṇḍavaiḥ / baler iva suraiḥ pūrvaṃ trailokyajayakāṅkṣayā / tataḥ sāyakajālena pāṇḍavānīkam āvṛṇot / bhāradvājo mahātejā vivyādha ca yudhiṣṭhiram / sātyakiṃ daśabhir bāṇair viṃśatyā pārṣataṃ śaraiḥ / bhīmasenaṃ ca navabhir nakulaṃ pañcabhis tathā / sahadevaṃ tathāṣṭābhiḥ śatena ca śikhaṇḍinam / draupadeyān mahābāhuḥ pañcabhiḥ pañcabhiḥ śaraiḥ / virāṭaṃ matsyam aṣṭābhir drupadaṃ daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ / yudhāmanyuṃ tribhiḥ ṣaḍbhir uttamaujasam āhave / anyāṃś ca sainikān viddhvā yudhiṣṭhiram upādravat / te vadhyamānā droṇena pāṇḍuputrasya sainikāḥ / prādravan vai bhayād rājan sārtanādā diśo daśa / kālyamānaṃ tu tat sainyaṃ dṛṣṭvā droṇena phalgunaḥ / kiṃ cid āgatasaṃrambho guruṃ pārtho 'bhyayād drutam / dṛṣṭvā droṇas tu bībhatsum abhidhāvantam āhave / saṃnyavartata tat sainyaṃ punar yaudhiṣṭhiraṃ nṛpa / tato yuddham abhūd bhūyo bhāradvājasya pāṇḍavaiḥ / droṇas tava sutai rājan sarvataḥ parivāritaḥ / vyadhamat pāṇḍusainyāni tūlarāśim ivānalaḥ / taṃ jvalantam ivādityaṃ dīptānalasamadyutim / rājann aniśam atyantaṃ dṛṣṭvā droṇaṃ śarārciṣam / maṇḍalīkṛtadhanvānaṃ tapantam iva bhāskaram / dahantam ahitān sainye nainaṃ kaś cid avārayat / yo yo hi pramukhe tasya tasthau droṇasya pūruṣaḥ / tasya tasya śiraś chittvā yayau droṇaśaraḥ kṣitim / evaṃ sā pāṇḍavī senā vadhyamānā mahātmanā / pradudrāva punar bhītā paśyataḥ savyasācinaḥ / saṃprabhagnaṃ
