balaṃ dṛṣṭvā droṇena niśi bhārata / govindam abravīj jiṣṇur gaccha droṇarathaṃ prati / tato rajatagokṣīrakundendusadṛśaprabhān / codayām āsa dāśārho hayān droṇarathaṃ prati / bhīmaseno 'pi taṃ dṛṣṭvā yāntaṃ droṇāya phalgunam / svasārathim uvācedaṃ droṇānīkāya māṃ vaha / so 'pi tasya vacaḥ śrutvā viśoko vāhayad dhayān / pṛṣṭhataḥ satyasandhasya jiṣṇor bharatasattama / tau dṛṣṭvā bhrātarau yattau droṇānīkam abhidrutau / pāñcālāḥ sṛñjayā matsyāś cedikārūṣakośalāḥ / anvagacchan mahārāja kekayāś ca mahārathāḥ / tato rājann abhūd ghoraḥ saṃgrāmo lomaharṣaṇaḥ / bībhatsur dakṣiṇaṃ pārśvam uttaraṃ ca vṛkodaraḥ / mahadbhyāṃ rathavṛndābhyāṃ balaṃ jagṛhatus tava / tau dṛṣṭvā puruṣavyāghrau bhīmasenadhanaṃjayau / dhṛṣṭadyumno 'bhyayād rājan sātyakiś ca mahābalaḥ / caṇḍavātābhipannānām udadhīnām iva svanaḥ / āsīd rājan balaughānāṃ tadānyonyam abhighnatām / saumadattivadhāt kruddho dṛṣṭvā sātyakim āhave / drauṇir abhyadravat kruddhaḥ sātvataṃ raṇamūrdhani

vulgate_text: vikṣiptayantrasannāhaṃ mahāmeghaughaniḥsvanam / yuktaṃ gajanibhairvāhairna hayairnāpi vāraṇaiḥ
ce_text: kārṣṇāyasamayaṃ ghoram ṛkṣacarmāvṛtaṃ mahat / yuktaṃ gajanibhair vāhair na hayair nāpi vā gajaiḥ

vulgate_text: kimahaṃ kātaro drauṇe pṛthagjana ivāhave / yanmāṃ bhīṣayase vāgbhirasadetadvacastava
ce_text: kim ahaṃ kātaro drauṇe pṛthagjana ivāhave / bhīmāt khalv aham utpannaḥ kurūṇāṃ vipule kule

vulgate_text: sva sūtamabravītkruddho droṇaputrāya māṃ vaha / sa yayau ghorarūpeṇa supatākena bhāsvatā
ce_text: sa punar bharataśreṣṭha krodhād raktāntalocanaḥ / talaṃ talena saṃhatya saṃdaśya daśanacchadam / svasūtam abravīt kruddho droṇaputrāya māṃ vaha

vulgate_text: dvairathaṃ droṇaputreṇa punarapyarisūdanaḥ / sa vinadya mahānādaṃ siṃhavadbhīmavikramaḥ
ce_text: sa yayau ghorarūpeṇa tena jaitrapatākinā / dvairathaṃ droṇaputreṇa punar apy arisūdanaḥ

vulgate_text: kaṅkagṛghramahāgrāhāṃ naikāyudhajhaṣākulām / vistīrṇagajapāṣāṇāṃ hatāśvamakarākulām
ce_text: kaṅkagṛdhramahāgrāhāṃ naikāyudhajhaṣākulām / rathakṣiptamahāvaprāṃ patākāruciradrumām

vulgate_text: yodhārtaravanirghoṣāṃ kṣatajormisamākulām / prayāntīṃ sumahāghorāṃ yamarāṣṭramahodadhim
ce_text: śoṇitaughamahāvegāṃ drauṇiḥ prāvartayan nadīm / yodhārtaravanirghoṣāṃ kṣatajormisamākulām

vulgate_text: punaḥ śatruñjayaṃ nāma drupadasyātmajaṃ raṇe / balānīkaṃ jayānīkaṃ jayāśvaṃ cābhijaghnivān
ce_text: balānīkaṃ jayānīkaṃ jayāśvaṃ cābhijaghnivān / śrutāhvayaṃ ca rājendra drauṇir ninye yamakṣayam

vulgate_text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā samupāyāntaṃ rukmapuṅkhaiḥ śilāśitaiḥ / daśabhiḥ sātvatasyārthe bhīmo vivyādha sāyakaiḥ
ce_text: daśabhiḥ sātvatasyārthe bhīmo vivyādha kauravam / somadatto 'pi taṃ vīraṃ śatena pratyavidhyata

vulgate_text: vṛddhaṃ vṛddhaguṇairyuktaṃ yayātimiva nāhuṣam vivyādha daśabhistīkṣṇaiḥ śarairvajranipātanaiḥ / śaktyā cainaṃ vinirbhidya punarvivyādha saptabhiḥ
ce_text: vivyādha daśabhis tīkṣṇaiḥ śarair vajranipātibhiḥ / śaktyā cainam athāhatya punar vivyādha saptabhiḥ

vulgate_text: subhago bhānudattaśca śūrāḥ pañca mahārathāḥ / abhidrutya śaraistīkṣṇairbhīmasenamatāḍayan
ce_text: amarṣayanto nihataṃ śatacandraṃ mahāratham / śakuner bhrātaro vīrā gajākṣaḥ śarabho vibhuḥ / abhidrutya śarais tīkṣṇair bhīmasenam atāḍayan

vulgate_text: tataḥ paramasaṅkruddhaḥ siṃho mattamiva dvipam / prekṣataḥ kururājasya drauṇiḥ karṇaṃ samabhyayāt / aśvatthāmovāca
ce_text: aśvatthāmovāca / karṇa paśya sudurbuddhe tiṣṭhedānīṃ narādhama / eṣa te 'dya śiraḥ kāyād uddharāmi sudurmate

vulgate_text: tataḥ kṛpo'pyuvācedamācāryaḥ sumahāmanāḥ / saumyasvabhāvādrājanendra kṣipramāgatamārdavaḥ / kṛpa uvāca
ce_text: kṛpa uvāca / manorathapralāpo me na grāhyas tava sūtaja / yadā kṣipasi vai kṛṣṇau dharmarājaṃ ca pāṇḍavam

vulgate_text: tataste pāṇḍavā rājanpāñcālāśca yaśasvinaḥ / ājagmuḥ sahitāḥ karṇaṃ tarjayantaḥ samantataḥ
ce_text: tatas te pāṇḍavā rājan pāñcālāś ca yaśasvinaḥ / dṛṣṭvā karṇaṃ mahābāhum uccaiḥ śabdam athānadan

vulgate_text: bībhatsurapi rājendra pāñcālairabhisaṃvṛtaḥ / pratyudyayau tadā karṇaṃ yathā vṛtraṃ śatakratuḥ / dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / saṃrabdhaṃ phalgunaṃ dṛṣṭvā kālāntakayamopamam / karṇo vaikartanaḥ sūta pratyapadyat kim uttaram

vulgate_text: tamāpatantaṃ vegena vaikartanamajihmagaiḥ / chādayāmāsa pārtho'tha karṇastu vijayaṃ śaraiḥ
ce_text: tam āpatantaṃ vegena vaikartanam ajihmagaiḥ / vārayām āsa tejasvī pāṇḍavaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ

vulgate_text: sa karṇaṃ śarajālena cchādayāmāsa pāṇḍavaḥ / tataḥ karṇaḥ susaṃrabdhaḥ śaraistribhiravidhyata
ce_text: taṃ karṇaḥ śarajālena chādayām āsa māriṣa / vivyādha ca susaṃkruddhaḥ śarais tribhir ajihmagaiḥ

vulgate_text: aśvatthāmaṃstvarāyukto yāhi śīghramarindama / ādau vā yadi vā paścāttavedaṃ karma māriṣa
ce_text: ādau vā yadi vā paścāt tavedaṃ karma māriṣa / tvam utpanno mahābāho pāñcālānāṃ vadhaṃ prati

vulgate_text: evaṃ siddhā'bruvanvāco bhaviṣyati ca tattathā / tasmāttvaṃ puruṣavyāghra pāñcālāñjahi sānugān
ce_text: kariṣyasi jagat sarvam apāñcālaṃ kilācyuta / evaṃ siddhābruvan vāco bhaviṣyati ca tat tathā

vulgate_text: gacchagaccha mahābāho na naḥ kālātyayo bhavet / iyaṃ hi dravate senā pārtasāyakapīḍitā
ce_text: yudhyate 'sau raṇe karṇo daṃśitaḥ sarvapārthivaiḥ / paśyaitāṃ dravatīṃ senāṃ karṇasāyakapīḍitām / kārttikeyena vidhvastām āsurīṃ pṛtanām iva

vulgate_text: sañjaya uvāca / duryodhanenaivamukto drauṇirāhavadurmadaḥ cakārārivadhe yatnamindro daityavadhe yathā / pratyuvāca mahābāhustava putramidaṃ vacaḥ
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tathā paruṣitaṃ dṛṣṭvā sūtaputreṇa mātulam / khaḍgam udyamya vegena drauṇir abhyapatad drutam

vulgate_text: yudhyāma pāṇḍavācchaktyā te cāpyasmānyathābalam / tejastejaḥ samāsādya praśamaṃ yātu bhārata
ce_text: yudhyatāṃ pāṇḍavāñ śaktyā teṣāṃ cāsmān yuyutsatām / tejas tu teja āsādya praśamaṃ yāti bhārata

vulgate_text: tataḥ suniśitairbāṇaiḥ pārthaṃ vivyādha saptabhiḥ / yudhiṣṭhiro'pi saṅkruddhaḥ prativivyādha pañcabhiḥ
ce_text: tataḥ suniśitair bāṇaiḥ pārthaṃ vivyādha saptabhiḥ / so 'tividdho mahābāhuḥ sṛkkiṇī parisaṃlihan / yudhiṣṭhirasya ciccheda dhvajaṃ kārmukam eva ca

vulgate_text: yāvanmātreṇa ca mayā sahāyena dhanañjayaḥ / bhīmaśca rathaśārdūlo yudhyate kauravaiḥ saha
ce_text: parivarjya guruṃ yāhi yatra rājā suyodhanaḥ / bhīmaś ca rathaśārdūlo yudhyate kauravaiḥ saha

vulgate_text: droṇo'pi pāṇḍupāñcālānvyadhamadrajanīmukhe / nādayaṃstalaghoṣeṇa tava sainyāni māriṣa
ce_text: bhīmasya nighnataḥ śatrūn pārṣṇiṃ jagrāha pāṇḍavaḥ / droṇo 'pi pāṇḍupāñcālān vyadhamad rajanīmukhe

vulgate_text: sarveṣu sainyeṣu padātisaṅghā vimiśritā hastirathāśvabṛndaiḥ / vyadīpayaṃste dhvajinīṃ pradīptā-- stathā balaṃ pāṇḍaveyābhiguptam
ce_text: sarveṣu sainyeṣu padātisaṃghā; vyāmiśritā hastirathāśvavṛndaiḥ / madhye tathānye jvalitāgnihastā; vyadīpayan pāṇḍusutasya senām

vulgate_text: pradīpānāṃ sahasraiśca dīpyamānaiḥ samantataḥ / ratnācitaiḥ svarṇadaṇḍairgandhatailāvasiñcitaiḥ
ce_text: pradīpānāṃ sahasraiś ca dīpyamānaiḥ samantataḥ / virarāja tadā bhūmir dyaur grahair iva bhārata

vulgate_text: devagandharvadīpādyaiḥ prabhābhiradhikojjvalaiḥ / virarāja tadā bhūmirgrahairdyauriva bhārata
ce_text: pradīpānāṃ sahasraiś ca dīpyamānaiḥ samantataḥ / virarāja tadā bhūmir dyaur grahair iva bhārata

vulgate_text: tasminrātrimukhe ghore tava putrasya śāsanāt / caturaṅgasya sainyasya sampātaśca mahāranabhūt
ce_text: rathā rathavarair eva samājagmur mudānvitāḥ / tasmin rātrimukhe ghore putrasya tava śāsanāt

vulgate_text: ke cainaṃ samare vīraṃ pratyudyayurarindamāḥ / droṇaṃ ca ke vyarakṣanta praviṣṭe śvetavāhane
ce_text: ke cainaṃ samare vīraṃ pratyudyayur ariṃdamam / ke 'rakṣan dakṣiṇaṃ cakraṃ ke ca droṇasya savyataḥ

vulgate_text: ke'rakṣandakṣiṇaṃ cakraṃ ke ca droṇasya savyataḥ ke pṛṣṭhataścāpyabhavanvīrā vīrānvinighnataḥ / ke purastādagacchanta nighnantaḥ śāstravānraṇe
ce_text: ke pṛṣṭhato 'sya hy abhavan vīrā vīrasya yudhyataḥ / ke purastād agacchanta nighnataḥ śātravān raṇe

vulgate_text: avyagrāneva hi parānkathayasyaparājitān / hṛṣṭānudīrṇānsaṅgrāme na tathā sūta māmakān
ce_text: avyagrān eva hi parān kathayasy aparājitān / hatāṃś caiva viṣaṇṇāṃś ca viprakīrṇāṃś ca śaṃsasi / rathino virathāṃś caiva kṛtān yuddheṣu māmakān

vulgate_text: pāṇḍavīyeṣu sainyeṣu na taṃ paśyāma kañcana / yo yodhayedraṇe droṇaṃ dhṛṣṭadyumnādṛte pumān
ce_text: pāṇḍaveyeṣu sainyeṣu yodhaṃ paśyāmy ahaṃ na tam / yo jayeta raṇe droṇaṃ dhṛṣṭadyumnād ṛte nṛpāḥ

vulgate_text: tathā'rjunaṃ ca rādheyo haniṣyati mahārathaḥ bhīmasenamahaṃ cāpi yuddhejeṣyāmi dīkṣitaḥ / śeṣāṃśca pāṇḍavānyodhāḥ prasabhaṃ hīnatejasaḥ
ce_text: tathārjunaṃ raṇe karṇo vijeṣyati mahārathaḥ / bhīmasenam ahaṃ cāpi yuddhe jeṣyāmi daṃśitaḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ rātrau bharatasattama / ubhayoḥ senayorghoraṃ parasparajigīṣayā
ce_text: tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ rātrau tad bharatarṣabha / ubhayoḥ senayor ghoraṃ vijayaṃ prati kāṅkṣiṇoḥ

vulgate_text: bhaimasenimathāyāntaṃ māyāśataviśāradam / aśvatthāmā mahārāja rākṣasaṃ pratyaṣedhayat
ce_text: bhaimasenim athāyāntaṃ māyāśataviśāradam / aśvatthāmā pitur mānaṃ kurvāṇaḥ pratyaṣedhayat

vulgate_text: tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti cābhāṣya śaineyaṃ sa narādhipa / abhyavarṣaccharaugheṇa meruṃ vṛṣṭyā yathāmbudaḥ
ce_text: taṃ tu dṛṣṭvā hataṃ śūram aśvatthāmā mahārathaḥ / abhyadhāvata vegena śaineyaṃ prati saṃyuge / abhyavarṣac charaugheṇa meruṃ vṛṣṭyā yathāmbudaḥ

vulgate_text: yuddhaśraddhāmahaṃ te'dya vineṣyāmi raṇājire ityuktvā krodhatāmrākṣo rākṣasaḥ paravīrahā / droṇimabhyadravatkruddho gajendramiva kesarī
ce_text: ity uktvā roṣatāmrākṣo rākṣasaḥ paravīrahā / drauṇim abhyadravat kruddho gajendram iva kesarī

vulgate_text: tato duryodhanaḥ kruddho bhanuranyanmahattaram gṛhītvā bharataśreṣṭho bhīmasenaṃ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ / apīḍayadraṇamukhe paśyatāṃ sarvadhanvinām
ce_text: tato duryodhanaḥ kruddho bhīmasenasya māriṣa / cikṣepa sa śarān rājan paśyatāṃ sarvadhanvinām

vulgate_text: putrastu tava rājendra bhīmādbhītaḥ praṇaśya ca / āruroha rathaṃ cānyaṃ nandakasya mahātmanaḥ
ce_text: putras tu tava rājendra rathād dhemapariṣkṛtāt / āplutaḥ sahasā yānaṃ nandakasya mahātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: rathacakraṃ pragṛhyājau mumocādhirathaṃ prati tadāpatadvai sahasā kālacakramivodyatam / śarairanekasāhasrairācchinatsūtanandanaḥ
ce_text: tam āpatantaṃ sahasā kālacakram ivodyatam / śarair anekasāhasrair acchinat sūtanandanaḥ

vulgate_text: sa nirāyudhamātmānaṃ jñātvā mādravatīsutaḥ / vāryamāṇastu viśikhaiḥ sahadevo raṇaṃ jahau
ce_text: tasmiṃs tu vitathe cakre kṛte tena mahātmanā / vāryamāṇaś ca viśikhaiḥ sahadevo raṇaṃ jahau

vulgate_text: atitīvraṃ mahādyuddhaṃ nararākṣasayostadā draṣṭṝṇāṃ prītijananaṃ sarveṣāṃ tatra bhārata / gṛdhrakākabalolūkakaṅkagomāyuharṣaṇam
ce_text: atitīvram abhūd yuddhaṃ nararākṣasayor mṛdhe / draṣṭṝṇāṃ prītijananaṃ sarveṣāṃ bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: punaḥ sajyaṃ kṛtaṃ cāpaṃ tadapyasya dvidhā'cchinat / virathasyodyataṃ khaṅgaṃ śareṇāsya dvidhā'karot
ce_text: sārathiṃ ca tribhir bāṇais tribhir eva triveṇukam / dhanur ekena ciccheda caturbhiś caturo hayān / virathasyodyataṃ khaḍgaṃ śareṇāsya dvidhācchinat

vulgate_text: nākuliścitrasenaṃ tu viddhvā pañcabhirāśugaiḥ / sa tu taṃ prativivyādha daśabhirniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
ce_text: nākuliś citrasenaṃ tu nārācenārdayad bhṛśam / sa ca taṃ prativivyādha daśabhir niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ

vulgate_text: so'tividdho mahārāja rathopastha upāviśat / dhvajayaṣṭiṃ parikliśya kāmukaḥ kāminīṃ yathā
ce_text: so 'tividdho mahārāja rathopastha upāviśat / taṃ visaṃjñaṃ nipatitaṃ dṛṣṭvā syālaṃ tavānagha / apovāha rathenāśu sārathir dhvajinīmukhāt

vulgate_text: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā mādrīputrasya sārathiḥ / prāyāttena tadā rājanyatra droṇo vyavasthitaḥ
ce_text: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā mādrīputrasya dhīmataḥ / prāyāt tena raṇe rājan yena droṇo 'nvayudhyata

vulgate_text: tasminkolāhale yuddhe vartamāne niśāmukhe / na kiñcidvidurātmānamayamasmīti bhārata
ce_text: tasmin kolāhale yuddhe vartamāne niśāmukhe / avadhīt samare putraṃ pitā bharatasattama

vulgate_text: avadhītsamare putraṃ pitā bharatasattama putraśca pitaraṃ mohātsakhāyaṃ ca sakhā tathā / svasrīyaṃ mātulaścāpi svasrīyaścāpi mātulam
ce_text: putraś ca pitaraṃ mohāt sakhāyaṃ ca sakhā tathā / saṃbandhinaṃ ca saṃbandhī svasrīyaṃ cāpi mātulaḥ

vulgate_text: sa cchinno bahudhā rājansūtaputreṇa dhanvinā / nipapāta śarastūrṇaṃ nirviṣo bhujago yathā
ce_text: sa chinno bahudhā rājan sūtaputreṇa māriṣa / nipapāta śaras tūrṇaṃ nikṛttaḥ karṇasāyakaiḥ

vulgate_text: eṣa sarvāṃ camūṃ hatvā mukhyāṃścaiva nararṣabhān / pauravāṃśca maheṣvāso vikṣipannuttamaṃ dhanuḥ
ce_text: eṣa sarvāñ śibīn hatvā mukhyaśaś ca nararṣabhān / pauravāṃś ca maheṣvāsān gāṇḍīvaninado mahān

vulgate_text: pārtho vijayate tatra gāṇḍīvaninado mahān / śrūyate rathaghoṣaśca vāsavasyeva nardataḥ
ce_text: śrūyate rathaghoṣaś ca vāsavasyeva nardataḥ / karoti pāṇḍavo vyaktaṃ karmaupayikam ātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: śṛṇu dundubhinirghoṣamarjunasya rathaṃ prati / niśīthe rājaśārdūla stanayitnorivāmbare
ce_text: dravatāṃ yodhamukhyānāṃ gāṇḍīvapreṣitaiḥ śaraiḥ / viddhānāṃ śataśo rājañ śrūyate ninado mahān / niśīthe rājaśārdūla stanayitnor ivāmbare

vulgate_text: te tvaradhvaṃ tathā śūrāḥ śarāṇāṃ mokṣaṇe bhṛśam yathā tviha vrajatyeṣa paralokāya mādhavaḥ / tathā kuru mahārāja sunītyā suprayuktayā
ce_text: te tvaradhvaṃ yathā śūrāḥ śarāṇāṃ mokṣaṇe bhṛśam / yathā tūrṇaṃ vrajaty eṣa paralokāya mādhavaḥ

vulgate_text: bhāradvājastato gatvā dhṛṣṭadyumnarathaṃ prati mahadyuddhaṃ tadāsīttuṃ droṇasya niśi bhārata / dhṛṣṭadyumnena vīreṇa pāñcālaiśca sahādbhutam
ce_text: mahad yuddhaṃ tadāsīt tu droṇasya niśi bhārata / dhṛṣṭadyumnena śūreṇa pāñcālaiś ca mahātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: kṛtvā tatkarma bībhatsurugramugraparākramaḥ / vivyādha śakuniṃ bhūyaḥ pañcabhirnataparvabhiḥ
ce_text: sa viddhvā śakuniṃ bhūyaḥ pañcabhir nataparvabhiḥ / ulūkaṃ tribhir ājaghne tribhir eva mahāyasaiḥ

vulgate_text: atāḍayadulūkaṃ ca tribhireva tathā śaraiḥ / ulūkaṃ punarājaghne tribhireva mahāyaśāḥ
ce_text: sa viddhvā śakuniṃ bhūyaḥ pañcabhir nataparvabhiḥ / ulūkaṃ tribhir ājaghne tribhir eva mahāyasaiḥ

vulgate_text: arjunaḥ śakuneścāpaṃ sāyakairacchinadraṇe / ninye ca caturo vāhānyamasya sadanaṃ prati
ce_text: arjunas tu drutaṃ gatvā śakuner dhanur ācchinat / ninye ca caturo vāhān yamasya sadanaṃ prati

vulgate_text: tadaivāhaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā bhavaddhyāmanusampatam / nākariṣyamidaṃ pārthairvairaṃ yodhavināśanam
ce_text: tadaivāhaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā bhavadbhyām anusaṃmatam / kṛtavān pāṇḍavaiḥ sārdhaṃ vairaṃ yodhavināśanam

vulgate_text: punarevābravīdrājanharṣayanniva pāṇḍavam eṣa bhīmo raṇaślāghī vṛtaḥ somakapāṇḍavaiḥ
ce_text: vṛkodaraṃ tathāyāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā tatra janārdanaḥ / punar evābravīd rājan harṣayann iva pāṇḍavam

vulgate_text: abhyavartata vegena droṇakarṇau mahārathau etena sahito yuddhya pāñcālaiśca mahārathaiḥ
ce_text: etena sahito yudhya pāñcālaiś ca mahārathaiḥ / āśvāsanārthaṃ sarveṣāṃ sainyānāṃ pāṇḍunandana

vulgate_text: āśvāsanārthaṃ sainyānāṃ sarveṣāṃ pāṇḍunandana tatastau puruṣavyāghrāvubhau mādhavapāṇḍavau
ce_text: tatas tau puruṣavyāghrāv ubhau mādhavapāṇḍavau / droṇakarṇau samāsādya dhiṣṭhitau raṇamūrdhani

vulgate_text: āruroha rathaṃ cāpi sahadevasya māriṣa / prayātukāmaḥ karṇāya vārito dharmasūnunā
ce_text: viddhaś ca bahubhis tena śarair āśīviṣopamaiḥ / tato yudhiṣṭhirānīkaṃ padbhyām evānvavartata / āruroha rathaṃ cāpi sahadevasya māriṣa

vulgate_text: rakṣyate śaktireṣā hi raudrāṃ rūpaṃ bibharti ca / ghaṭotkacastu rādheyaṃ pratyudyātu mahābalaḥ
ce_text: ghaṭotkacas tu rādheyaṃ pratyudyātu mahābalaḥ / sa hi bhīmena balinā jātaḥ suraparākramaḥ

vulgate_text: yāvanti ca tavāstrāṇi santi māyāśca rākṣasīḥ / adyaiva samayasteṣāṃ māyānāṃ caiva rākṣasa
ce_text: sa bhavān majjamānānāṃ bandhūnāṃ tvaṃ plavo yathā / vividhāni tavāstrāṇi santi māyā ca rākṣasī

vulgate_text: paśya karṇena haiḍimbe pāṇḍavānāmanīkinīm / kālyamānāṃ raṇe tāta siṃhanevetarānmṛgān
ce_text: paśya karṇena haiḍimba pāṇḍavānām anīkinī / kālyamānā yathā gāvaḥ pālena raṇamūrdhani

vulgate_text: tamāpatantaṃ saṅkruddhaṃ dīptāsyaṃ dīptamūrdhajam / prahasanpuruṣavyāghraḥ pratijagrāha sūtajaḥ
ce_text: tam āpatantaṃ saṃkruddhaṃ dīptāsyam iva pannagam / abhyasyan parameṣvāsaḥ pratijagrāha sūtajaḥ

vulgate_text: rakṣa karṇaṃ raṇe yatto vṛtaḥ sainyena mānada / mā karṇaṃ rākṣaso ghoraḥ pramādānnāśayiṣyati
ce_text: karṇo vaikartano yuddhe rākṣasena yuyutsati / rakṣa karṇaṃ raṇe yatto vṛtaḥ sainyena mānada

vulgate_text: tvaṃ tu gaccha mayā''jñapto jahi yuddhe ghaṭotkacam / rākṣasaṃ krūrakarmāṇaṃ rakṣomānuṣasambhavam
ce_text: tam abravīt tato rājā prīyamāṇaḥ punaḥ punaḥ / droṇakarṇādibhiḥ sārdhaṃ paryāpto 'haṃ dviṣadvadhe / tvaṃ tu gaccha mayājñapto jahi yuddhaṃ ghaṭotkacam

vulgate_text: śirastaccāpi saṅgṛhya keśeṣu rudhirokṣitam / yayau ghaṭotkacastūrṇaṃ duryodhanarathaṃ prati
ce_text: tacchiro rudhirābhyaktaṃ gṛhya keśeṣu rākṣasaḥ / ghaṭotkaco yayāv āśu duryodhanarathaṃ prati

vulgate_text: droṇakarṇakṛpānyodhānatītya sumahābalaḥ / abhyetya ca mahābāhuḥ smayamānaḥ sa rākṣasaḥ
ce_text: abhyetya ca mahābāhuḥ smayamānaḥ sa rākṣasaḥ / rathe 'sya nikṣipya śiro vikṛtānanamūrdhajam / prāṇadad bhairavaṃ nādaṃ prāvṛṣīva balāhakaḥ

vulgate_text: svadharmamarthaṃ kāmaṃ ca tritayaṃ yo'bhivāñchati riktapāṇirna paśyeta rājānaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ striyam / tiṣṭhasva tāvatsuprīto yāvatkarṇaṃ vadhāmyaham / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tataḥ karṇo raṇe dṛṣṭvā pārṣataṃ paravīrahā / ājaghānorasi śarair daśabhir marmabhedibhiḥ

vulgate_text: evamuktvā tataḥ prāyātkarṇaṃ prati nareśvaraḥ / kirañcharagaṇāṃstīkṣṇānruṣito raṇamūrdhani
ce_text: evam uktvā tataḥ prāyāt karṇaṃ prati janeśvara / kirañ śaraśatāṃs tīkṣṇān vimuñcan karṇamūrdhani

vulgate_text: kīdṛśaṃ cābhavadrūpaṃ tasya ghorasya rakṣasaḥ / yena vaikartanaḥ karṇaḥ saṅgrāme tena nirjitaḥ
ce_text: kīdṛśaṃ cābhavad yuddhaṃ tasya ghorasya rakṣasaḥ / rathaś ca kīdṛśas tasya māyāḥ sarvāyudhāni ca

vulgate_text: mattamātaṅgasaṅkāśā lohitākṣā vibhīpaṇāḥ / kālavarṇāsamāyuktā balavantaḥ śataṃ hayāḥ
ce_text: tatra mātaṅgasaṃkāśā lohitākṣā vibhīṣaṇāḥ / kāmavarṇajavā yuktā balavanto 'vahan hayāḥ

vulgate_text: rākṣaso'sya virūpākṣaḥ sūto dīptāsyakuṇḍalaḥ ghorarūpo mahākāyaḥ karālo vikṛtānanaḥ / raśmibhiḥ sūryaraśmyāhvaiḥ sañjagrāha hayānraṇe
ce_text: rākṣaso 'sya virūpākṣaḥ sūto dīptāsyakuṇḍalaḥ / raśmibhiḥ sūryaraśmyābhaiḥ saṃjagrāha hayān raṇe / sa tena sahitas tasthāv aruṇena yathā raviḥ

vulgate_text: sañchindantau ca gātrāṇi sandadhānau ca sāyakān / dahantau ca śarolkābhirduṣprekṣyau ca babhūvatuḥ
ce_text: saṃchindantau hi gātrāṇi saṃdadhānau ca sāyakān / dhakṣyamāṇau śaravrātair nodīkṣitum aśaknutām

vulgate_text: rākṣasāśca piśācāśca yātudhānāstathaiva ca / śālāvṛkāśca bahavo vṛkāśca vikṛtānanāḥ
ce_text: rākṣasāś ca piśācāś ca yātudhānāḥ śalāvṛkāḥ / te karṇaṃ bhakṣayiṣyantaḥ sarvataḥ samupādravan / athainaṃ vāgbhir ugrābhis trāsayāṃ cakrire tadā

vulgate_text: tasyāpi rathanirghopo mahāmegharavopamaḥ / syāpi sumahaccāpaṃ dṛḍhajyaṃ kanakojjvalam / tasyāpyakṣasamā bāṇā rukma puṅkhāḥ śilāśitāḥ so'pi vīro mahābāhuryathaiva sa ghaṭotkacaḥ
ce_text: tasyāpi rathanirghoṣo mahāmegharavopamaḥ / tasyāpi sumahac cāpaṃ dṛḍhajyaṃ balavattaram

vulgate_text: tayoḥ sutumulaṃ yuddhaṃ babhūva niśi rakṣasoḥ / alāyudhasya caivograṃ heḍimbeścāpi bhārata
ce_text: sa vārṣṇeyavacaḥ śrutvā karṇam utsṛjya vīryavān / yuyudhe rākṣasendreṇa bakabhrātrā ghaṭotkacaḥ / tayoḥ sutumulaṃ yuddhaṃ babhūva niśi rakṣasoḥ

vulgate_text: tau yuddhvā vividhairghorairāyudhairviśikhaistathā / utsṛjya ca śitau khaṅkhāgavanyomabhipetatuḥ
ce_text: tau yuddhvā vividhair ghorair āyudhair viśikhais tathā / pragṛhya niśitau khaḍgāv anyonyam abhijaghnatuḥ

vulgate_text: tenāstreṇāvadhīttasya rathaṃ sahayasārathim / virathaścāpi haiḍimbiḥ kṣipramantaradhīyata / dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca
ce_text: tenāstreṇa hayān pūrvaṃ hatvā karṇasya rākṣasaḥ / sārathiṃ caiva haiḍimbaḥ kṣipram antaradhīyata

vulgate_text: vikīrṇāntrā vihatairuttamāṅgaiḥ sambhagnāṅgaḥ śiśyire tatra śūrāḥ / chinnā hayāḥ kuñjarāścāpi bhagnā na mucyante yācamānāḥ subhītāḥ
ce_text: niṣkīrṇāntrā vihatair uttamāṅgaiḥ; saṃbhagnāṅgāḥ śerate tatra śūrāḥ / bhinnā hayāḥ kuñjarāś cāvabhagnāḥ; saṃcūrṇitāś caiva rathāḥ śilābhiḥ

vulgate_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / tasminhate mahāmāye mahātejasi rākṣase / amarṣitāḥ pāṇḍaveyāḥ kimakurvanmahāraṇe
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / tathā hy antarhite tasmin kūṭayodhini rākṣase / māmakaiḥ pratipannaṃ yat tan mamācakṣva saṃjaya

vulgate_text: haiḍimbiṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā viśīrṇamiva parvatam / babhūvuḥ pāṇḍavāḥ sarve śokabāṣpākulekṣaṇāḥ
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / haiḍimbaṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā vikīrṇam iva parvatam / pāṇḍavā dīnamanasaḥ sarve bāṣpākulekṣaṇāḥ

vulgate_text: hataṃ ghaṭotkacaṃ jñātvā vāsudevaḥ pratāpavān / vinadya ca mahānādaṃ paryaṣvajata phalgunam
ce_text: vāsudevas tu harṣeṇa mahatābhipariplutaḥ / nanāda siṃhavan nādaṃ vyathayann iva bhārata / vinadya ca mahānādaṃ paryaṣvajata phalgunam

vulgate_text: samudrasyeva saṃśoṣaṃ meroriva visarpaṇam / tathaitadadya manye'haṃ tava karma janārdana / vāsudeva uvāca
ce_text: samudrasyeva saṃkṣobho meror iva visarpaṇam / tathaital lāghavaṃ manye tava karma janārdana

vulgate_text: kavacena vihīnaśca kuṇḍalābhyāṃ ca pāṇḍava / so'dya mānuṣatāṃ prāpto vimuktaḥ śakradattayā
ce_text: tapānte toyado yadvac charadhārāḥ kṣaraty asau / divyāstrajaladaḥ karṇaḥ parjanya iva vṛṣṭimān / so 'dya mānuṣatāṃ prāpto vimuktaḥ śakradattayā

vulgate_text: saviśeṣaṃ tvameyātmā kṛṣṇo rakṣenna phalgunam / hanyātkṣipraṃ hi kaunteyaṃ śaktirvṛkṣamivāśaniḥ / dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / ekavīravadhe moghā śaktiḥ sūtātmaje yadā / kasmāt sarvān samutsṛjya sa tāṃ pārthe na muktavān

vulgate_text: paricintya tu paśyāmi cakrāyudhamarindamam / na so'sti triṣu lokeṣu yo jayeta janārdanam / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / etac cikīrṣitaṃ jñātvā karṇe madhunihā nṛpa / niyojayām āsa tadā dvairathe rākṣaseśvaram

vulgate_text: phalgunasya hi sā mṛtyuriti cintayato'niśam / na nidrā na ca me hārṣo manaso'sti yudhāṃvara
ce_text: phalgunasya hi tāṃ mṛtyum avagamya yuyutsataḥ / na nidrā na ca me harṣo manaso 'sti yudhāṃ vara

vulgate_text: tato bherīḥ samājaghnuḥ paṇavānakagomukhān śahkhaśabdaravāṃścaiva pāṇiśabdāṃśca daṃśitāḥ / pāñcālāḥ pāṇḍavāścaiva yudhiṣṭhirapurogamāḥ
ce_text: tato bherīḥ samājaghnuḥ śaṅkhān dadhmuś ca daṃśitāḥ / pāñcālāḥ pāṇḍavāś caiva yudhiṣṭhirapurogamāḥ

vulgate_text: sañjaya uvāca / vyāsenaivamathoktastu dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / svayaṃ karṇavadhādvīro nivṛtto bharatarṣabha
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / saṃgrāmād vinivṛttānāṃ sarveṣāṃ no viśāṃ pate / rātrau kurukulaśreṣṭha mantro 'yaṃ samajāyata

vulgate_text: asmākaṃ ca mahārāja parebhyo bahavo janāḥ / yoddhavyamiti tiṣṭhanto nidāsaṃraktalocanāḥ
ce_text: nānāvāco vimuñcanto nidrāndhās te mahāraṇe / yoddhavyam iti tiṣṭhanto nidrāsaṃsaktalocanāḥ

vulgate_text: saṃsarpanto raṇe kecinnidrāndhāste tathāparān / jaghruḥ śūrā raṇe śūrāṃstasmiṃstamasi dāruṇe
ce_text: saṃmardyānye raṇe ke cin nidrāndhāś ca parasparam / jaghnuḥ śūrā raṇe rājaṃs tasmiṃs tamasi dāruṇe

vulgate_text: tattathā nidrayā bhagnaṃ tadbabhau niḥsvanaṃ balam / kuśalaiḥ śilpibhirnyastaṃ paṭe citramivādbhutam
ce_text: tat tathā nidrayā bhagnam avācam asvapad balam / kuśalair iva vinyastaṃ paṭe citram ivādbhutam

vulgate_text: sa bhavānmarṣayatyenāṃstava tulyānavetya ca / śiṣyatvaṃ vā puraskṛtya mama vā mandabhāgyatām / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / ghaṭotkace tu nihate sūtaputreṇa tāṃ niśām / duḥkhāmarṣavaśaṃ prāpto dharmaputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ

vulgate_text: rathā rathairibhairnāgāstathaiva bharatarṣabha / saṃsaktāśca viyuktāśca yodhāḥ sannyapatanraṇe
ce_text: rathair hayā hayair nāgāḥ pādātāś cāpi kuñjaraiḥ / hayā hayaiḥ samājagmuḥ pādātāś ca padātibhiḥ / saṃsaktāś ca viyuktāś ca yodhāḥ saṃnyapatan raṇe

vulgate_text: taddhoraṃ mahadāścaryaṃ yuddhaṃ daivāsuropamam / ratharṣabhāṇāmugrāṇāṃ sannipātamamānuṣam
ce_text: tad ghoraṃ mahad āścaryaṃ sarve praikṣan samantataḥ / ratharṣabhāṇām ugrāṇāṃ saṃnipātam amānuṣam

vulgate_text: apasavyaṃ kṛtaṃ saṅkhye bhrātṛvyenātyamarṣiṇā nāmṛṣyata tamapyājau praticakre parantapaḥ / putrastava mahārāja rājā duryodhano drutam
ce_text: apasavyaṃ kṛtaḥ saṃkhye bhrātṛvyenātyamarṣiṇā / so 'marṣitas tam apy ājau praticakre 'pasavyataḥ

vulgate_text: sa nivṛttastataḥ karṇaḥ saṅghaṭṭita ivoragaḥ bhīmamāvārayāmāsa vikiranniśitāñcharān / tato'bhūttumulaṃ yuddhaṃ bhīmarādheyayostadā
ce_text: saṃnyavartata taṃ karṇaḥ saṃghaṭṭita ivoragaḥ / tad abhūt tumulaṃ yuddhaṃ bhīmarādheyayos tadā

vulgate_text: tato bhīmaḥ punargurvīṃ cikṣepādhirathergadām / tāṃ gadāṃ bahubhiḥ karṇaḥ supuṅkhaiḥ supravejitaiḥ
ce_text: tato bhīmaḥ punar gurvīṃ cikṣepādhirather gadām / tāṃ śarair daśabhiḥ karṇaḥ supuṅkhaiḥ susamāhitaiḥ / pratyavidhyat punaś cānyaiḥ sā bhīmaṃ punar āvrajat

vulgate_text: pratyavidhyatpunaścānyaiḥ sā bhīmaṃ punarāvrajat / vyālīva mantrābhihatā karṇabāṇairabhidrutā
ce_text: tato bhīmaḥ punar gurvīṃ cikṣepādhirather gadām / tāṃ śarair daśabhiḥ karṇaḥ supuṅkhaiḥ susamāhitaiḥ / pratyavidhyat punaś cānyaiḥ sā bhīmaṃ punar āvrajat

vulgate_text: sa karṇaṃ sāyakānaṣṭau vyasṛjatkrodhamūrcchitaḥ / taistasya niśitaistīkṣṇairbhīmaseno mahābalaḥ
ce_text: sa karṇe sāyakān aṣṭau vyasṛjat krodhamūrchitaḥ / dhvaje śarāsane caiva śarāvāpe ca bhārata

vulgate_text: karṇo'pyanyaddhanurgṛhya hemapṛṣṭhaṃ durāsadam tataḥ punastu rādheyo hayānasya ratheṣubhiḥ / ṛkṣavarṇāñjaghānāśu tathobhau pārṣṇisārathī
ce_text: tataḥ punas tu rādheyo hayān asya ratheṣubhiḥ / ṛṣyavarṇāñ jaghānāśu tathobhau pārṣṇisārathī

vulgate_text: tatrāsmāntarhitā vāco vyacaranta punaḥ punaḥ / droṇapārthastavopetā vyaśrūyanta narādhipa
ce_text: tatra smāntarhitā vāco vyacaranta punaḥ punaḥ / droṇasya stavasaṃyuktāḥ pārthasya ca mahātmanaḥ / visṛjyamāneṣv astreṣu jvālayatsu diśo daśa

vulgate_text: visṛjyamāneṣvastreṣu jvālayastu diśo daśa / abruvaṃstatra siddhāśca ṛṣayaśca samāgatāḥ
ce_text: tatra smāntarhitā vāco vyacaranta punaḥ punaḥ / droṇasya stavasaṃyuktāḥ pārthasya ca mahātmanaḥ / visṛjyamāneṣv astreṣu jvālayatsu diśo daśa

vulgate_text: yadā droṇaṃ mahārāja viśeṣayati pāṇḍavaḥ / tato droṇo brāhmamastraṃ prāduścakre mahāmatiḥ
ce_text: tato droṇo brāhmam astraṃ prāduścakre mahāmatiḥ / saṃtāpayan raṇe pārthaṃ bhūtāny antarhitāni ca

vulgate_text: tadastraṃ saṃhitaṃ rājandhorarūpaṃ mahāhave / santāpayadraṇe pārthaṃ bhūtānyantarhitāni ca
ce_text: tato droṇo brāhmam astraṃ prāduścakre mahāmatiḥ / saṃtāpayan raṇe pārthaṃ bhūtāny antarhitāni ca

vulgate_text: ityevaṃ vyaktamābhāṣya pratibhāṣya ca sātyakiḥ / abhyayāttūrṇamavyagro dayāṃ nākurutātmani
ce_text: ity evaṃ vyaktam ābhāṣya pratibhāṣya ca sātyakiḥ / abhyayāt tūrṇam avyagro nirapekṣo viśāṃ pate

vulgate_text: bhīmasenastu saṅkruddhaḥ sūtaputramayodhayat tasmiṃstathā vartamāne kruddho dharmasuto'bravīt / pāñcālānāṃ naravyāghrānmātsyāṃśca puruṣarṣabhān
ce_text: saṃkule vartamāne tu rājā dharmasuto 'bravīt / pāñcālānāṃ naravyāghrān matsyānāṃ ca nararṣabhān

vulgate_text: naiṣa yuddhena saṅgrāme jetuṃ śakyaḥ kathañcana / sadhanurdhanvināṃ śreṣṭho devairapi savāsavaiḥ
ce_text: naiṣa yuddhena saṃgrāme jetuṃ śakyaḥ kathaṃ cana / api vṛtrahaṇā yuddhe rathayūthapayūthapaḥ

vulgate_text: nyastaśastrastu saṅgārame śakyo hantuṃ bhavennṛbhiḥ āsthīyatāṃ jaye yogo dharmamutsṛjya pāṇḍavāḥ / yathā na saṃyuge sarvānnihanyādrukmavāhanaḥ
ce_text: āsthīyatāṃ jaye yogo dharmam utsṛjya pāṇḍava / yathā vaḥ saṃyuge sarvān na hanyād rukmavāhanaḥ

vulgate_text: vidhūya tānbāṇagaṇānpāñcālānāṃ mahārathaḥ / prāduścakre tato droṇo brāhmamastraṃ parantapaḥ
ce_text: tato droṇo brāhmam astraṃ prāduścakre mahāmatiḥ / saṃtāpayan raṇe pārthaṃ bhūtāny antarhitāni ca

vulgate_text: utsraṣṭukāmaḥ śastrāṇi ṛṣivākyapracoditaḥ / tejasā pūryamāṇaśca yuyudhe na yathā purā
ce_text: utsraṣṭukāmaḥ śastrāṇi vipravākyābhicoditaḥ / tejasā preryamāṇaś ca yuyudhe so 'timānuṣam

vulgate_text: yaccāsya bāṇavikṛtaṃ dhanūṃṣi ca viśāmpate / sarvaṃ ciccheda durdharṣo gadāṃ khaṅgaṃ ca varjayan
ce_text: yac cāsya bāṇaṃ vikṛtaṃ dhanūṃṣi ca viśāṃ pate / sarvaṃ saṃchidya durdharṣo gadāṃ khaḍgam athāpi ca

vulgate_text: dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ ca vivyādha navabhirniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ / jīvitāntakaraiḥ kruddhaḥ śilādhautaiḥ parantapaḥ
ce_text: dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ tato 'vidhyan navabhir niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ / jīvitāntakaraiḥ kruddhaḥ kruddharūpaṃ paraṃtapaḥ

vulgate_text: sa cchinnadhanvā pāñcālyo nikṛttadhvajasārathiḥ / uttamāmāpadaṃ prāpya gadāṃ vīraḥ parāmṛśat
ce_text: sa chinnadhanvā viratho hatāśvo hatasārathiḥ / uttamām āpadaṃ prāpya gadāṃ vīraḥ parāmṛśat

vulgate_text: tasya pārāvatānaśvānrathaśaktyā parābhinat / sarvānekaikaśo droṇo raktānaśvānvivarjayan
ce_text: tasyāśvān rathaśaktyāsau tadā kruddhaḥ parākramī / sarvān ekaikaśo droṇaḥ kapotābhān ajīghanat

vulgate_text: sa tadā vividhānmargānpravarāṃścaikaviṃśatim / darśayāmāsa kauravya pārṣato vicaranraṇe
ce_text: so 'carad vividhān mārgān prakārān ekaviṃśatim / bhrāntam udbhrāntam āviddham āplutaṃ prasṛtaṃ sṛtam

vulgate_text: sampātaṃ samudīrṇaṃ ca darśayāmāsa pārṣataḥ bhārataṃ kauśikaṃ caiva sātvataṃ caiva śikṣayā
ce_text: parivṛttaṃ nivṛttaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ carma ca dhārayan / saṃpātaṃ samudīrṇaṃ ca darśayām āsa pārṣataḥ

vulgate_text: sañcaya uvāca / [sātvatasya* tu tatkarma dṛṣṭvā duryodhanādayaḥ / śaineyaṃ sarvataḥ kruddhā vārayāmāsurañjasā
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tasmiṃs tathā vartamāne narāśvagajasaṃkṣaye / duḥśāsano mahārāja dhṛṣṭadyumnam ayodhayat

vulgate_text: hastānāmuttamāṅgānāṃ kārmukāṇāṃ ca bhārata chatrāṇāṃ cāpaviddhānāṃ cāmarāṇāṃ ca sañcayaiḥ / rāśayaḥ sma vyadṛśyanta tatratatra raṇājire
ce_text: hastānām uttamāṅgānāṃ kārmukāṇāṃ ca bhārata / chatrāṇāṃ cāpaviddhānāṃ cāmarāṇāṃ ca saṃyuge

vulgate_text: adya droṇaṃ raṇe kruddho ghātayiṣyati pārpataḥ te yūyaṃ sahitā bhūtvā yudhyadhvaṃ kumbhasambhavam
ce_text: yādṛśāni hi rūpāṇi dṛśyante no mahāraṇe / adya droṇaṃ raṇe kruddhaḥ pātayiṣyati pārṣataḥ / te yūyaṃ sahitā bhūtvā kumbhayoniṃ parīpsata

vulgate_text: papāta mahatī colkā ādityānniścarantyuta / dīpayantī ubhe sene śaṃsantīva mahadbhayam
ce_text: papāta mahatī colkā ādityān nirgateva ha / dīpayantīva tāpena śaṃsantīva mahad bhayam

vulgate_text: hataujā iva cāpyāsīdbhāradvājo mahārathaḥ / prāsphurannayanaṃ cāsya vāmabāhustathaiva ca
ce_text: hataujā iva cāpy āsīd bhāradvājo mahārathaḥ / ṛṣīṇāṃ brahmavādānāṃ svargasya gamanaṃ prati / suyuddhena tataḥ prāṇān utsraṣṭum upacakrame

vulgate_text: śvapākavanmlecchagaṇānhatvā cānyānpṛthagvidhān / bharanti hi sutāndārāṃstadvadajñānamohitāḥ
ce_text: śvapākavan mlecchagaṇān hatvā cānyān pṛthagvidhān / ajñānān mūḍhavad brahman putradāradhanepsayā

vulgate_text: sa vai ca nihataḥ śete tava putraḥ sumandadhīḥ / dharmarājasya tadvākyaṃ nābhiśaṅkitumarhasi
ce_text: sa cādya patitaḥ śete pṛṣṭenāveditas tava / dharmarājena tad vākyaṃ nātiśaṅkitum arhasi

vulgate_text: evamuktastato droṇo bhīmenotsṛjya tadvanuḥ sannyāsāya śarīrasya yokṣyamāṇaḥ sa vai dvijaḥ / sarvāṇyastrāṇi dharmātmā hātukāmo'bhyabhāpata
ce_text: evam uktas tato droṇo bhīmenotsṛjya tad dhanuḥ / sarvāṇy astrāṇi dharmātmā hātukāmo 'bhyabhāṣata / karṇa karṇa maheṣvāsa kṛpa duryodhaneti ca

vulgate_text: karṇaṃ duryodhanaṃ rājaṃstvaramāṇaḥ parākramam / karṇakarṇa maheṣvāsa kṛpa duryodhaneti ca
ce_text: evam uktas tato droṇo bhīmenotsṛjya tad dhanuḥ / sarvāṇy astrāṇi dharmātmā hātukāmo 'bhyabhāṣata / karṇa karṇa maheṣvāsa kṛpa duryodhaneti ca

vulgate_text: tasya tacchidranājñāya dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ pratāpavān saśaraṃ tadvanurghoraṃ sannyasyātha rathe tataḥ / khaṅgī rathādavaplutya sahasā droṇamabhyayāt
ce_text: tasya tac chidram ājñāya dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ samutthitaḥ / khaḍgī rathād avaplutya sahasā droṇam abhyayāt

vulgate_text: pradrute tvatha droṇāya dhṛṣṭadyumne mahārathe / hāhākṛtāni bhūtāni mānuṣāṇītarāṇi ca
ce_text: hāhākṛtāni bhūtāni mānuṣāṇītarāṇi ca / droṇaṃ tathāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā dhṛṣṭadyumnavaśaṃ gatam

vulgate_text: smaritvā devadeveśamakṣaraṃ paramaṃ prabhum / divamākrāmadācāryaḥ sākṣātsadbhirdurākramām
ce_text: tathoktvā yogam āsthāya jyotirbhūto mahātapāḥ / divam ākrāmad ācāryaḥ sadbhiḥ saha durākramam

vulgate_text: samapadyata colkābhaṃ droṇasya nidhane tadā / nimeṣamātreṇa ca tajjyotirantaradhīyata
ce_text: nimeṣamātreṇa ca taj jyotir antaradhīyata / āsīt kilakilāśabdaḥ prahṛṣṭānāṃ divaukasām / brahmalokaṃ gate droṇe dhṛṣṭadyumne ca mohite

vulgate_text: anye tu sarve nāpaśyanbhāradvājasya dhīmataḥ mahimānaṃ mahārāja yogayuktasya gacchataḥ / brahmalokaṃ mahaddivyaṃ devaguhyaṃ hi tatparam
ce_text: anye tu sarve nāpaśyan bhāradvājasya dhīmataḥ / mahimānaṃ mahārāja yogamuktasya gacchataḥ

vulgate_text: vitunnāṅgaṃ śaravrātairanyastāyudhamasṛkkṣaram vikṛṣya pārṣataḥ khaṅgaṃ krodhāmarṣavaśaṃ gataḥ / dṛśyamānaḥ sarvabhūtaiḥ keśapakṣe parāmṛśat
ce_text: vitunnāṅgaṃ śaraśatair nyastāyudham asṛkkṣaram / dhikkṛtaḥ pārṣatas taṃ tu sarvabhūtaiḥ parāmṛśat

vulgate_text: saṃśaptakagaṇādgṛhya hataśeṣānkirīṭinā / suśarmā prādrāvadrājandṛṣṭvā droṇaṃ nipātitam
ce_text: padātigaṇasaṃyuktas trasto rājan bhayārditaḥ / ulūkaḥ prādravat tatra dṛṣṭvā droṇaṃ nipātitam

vulgate_text: gajānrathānsamāruhya vyudasya ca hayāñjanāḥ / prādravansarvataḥ saṅkhye dṛṣṭvā rukmarathaṃ hatam
ce_text: gajān rathān samāruhya parasyāpi hayāñ janāḥ / prakīrṇakeśā vidhvastā na dvāv ekatra dhāvataḥ

vulgate_text: tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti na ca te svayaṃ tatrāvatasthire dhuryānunmucya ca rathāddhatasūtātsvalaṅkṛtān / adhiruhya hayānyodhāḥ kṣipraṃ padbhiracodayan
ce_text: dhuryān pramucya tu rathād dhatasūtān svalaṃkṛtān / adhiruhya hayān yodhāḥ kṣipraṃ padbhir acodayan

vulgate_text: tamatathyabhaye magno jaye sakto yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / aśvatthāmānamāyodhe hataṃ dṛṣṭvā mahāgajam
ce_text: tam atathyabhaye magno jaye sakto yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / avyaktam abravīd rājan hataḥ kuñjara ity uta

vulgate_text: jānannapyanṛtasyātha doṣānsa dvijasattamam / avyaktamabravīdrājā hataḥ kuñjara ityuta
ce_text: tam atathyabhaye magno jaye sakto yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / avyaktam abravīd rājan hataḥ kuñjara ity uta

vulgate_text: sa tvāṃ nihatamākrande śrutvā santāpatāpitaḥ / niyamya divyānyastrāṇi nāyudhyata yathā purā
ce_text: tac chrutvā vimanās tatra ācāryo mahad apriyam / niyamya divyāny astrāṇi nāyudhyata yathā purā

vulgate_text: bhṛśamiṣvasanādadya matprayuktā mahāhave / darśayantaḥ śarā vīryaṃ pramathiṣyanti pāṇḍavān
ce_text: kṛśāśvatanayā hy adya matprayuktā mahāmṛdhe / darśayanto ''tmano vīryaṃ pramathiṣyanti pāṇḍavān

vulgate_text: paraśvathāṃśca niśitānutsrakṣye'hamasaṃśayam
ce_text: yatheṣṭam aśmavarṣeṇa pravarṣiṣye raṇe sthitaḥ / ayomukhaiś ca vihagair drāvayiṣye mahārathān / paraśvadhāṃś ca vividhān prasakṣye 'ham asaṃśayam

vulgate_text: hayapṛṣṭhagatāścānye kṛṣyante'rdhacyutāsanāḥ / gajaskandheṣu saṃsyūtā nārācaiścalitāsanāḥ
ce_text: gajaskandheṣu saṃsyūtā nārācaiś calitāsanāḥ / śarārtair vidrutair nāgair hṛtāḥ ke cid diśo daśa

vulgate_text: jalena kledayantyanye vimucya kavacanānyapi / palāyanaparāścānye yodhāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ
ce_text: putrān pitṝn sakhīn bhrātṝn samāropya dṛḍhakṣatān / jalena kledayanty anye vimucya kavacāny api

vulgate_text: hīmantaṃ taṃ mahābāhuṃ mattadviradagāminam / indraviṣmusamaṃ vīrye kope'ntakamiva sthitam
ce_text: hrīmantaṃ taṃ mahābāhuṃ mattadviradagāminam / vyākhyāsyāmy ugrakarmāṇaṃ kurūṇām abhayaṃkaram

vulgate_text: bṛhaspatisamaṃ buddhyā nītimantaṃ mahāratham / ākhyāsyāmyugrakarmāṇaṃ kurūṇāmabhayaṅkaram
ce_text: hrīmantaṃ taṃ mahābāhuṃ mattadviradagāminam / vyākhyāsyāmy ugrakarmāṇaṃ kurūṇām abhayaṃkaram

vulgate_text: vāsudeve sthite cāpi droṇaputraṃ praśaṃsasi / yaḥ kalāṃ ṣoḍaśīṃ pūrṇāṃ dhanañjaya na te'rhati
ce_text: adharmam etad vipulaṃ dhārmikaḥ san na budhyase / yat tvam ātmānam asmāṃś ca praśaṃsyān na praśaṃsasi / yaḥ kalāṃ ṣoḍaśīṃ tvatto nārhate taṃ praśaṃsasi

vulgate_text: mama nāgāyutaṃ pārtha balaṃ bāhvorvidhīyate / dārayeyaṃ mahīṃ krodhādvikireyaṃ ca parvatān
ce_text: svayam evātmano vaktuṃ na yuktaṃ guṇasaṃstavam / dārayeyaṃ mahīṃ krodhād vikireyaṃ ca parvatān

vulgate_text: nānṛtī pāṇḍavo jyeṣṭho nāhaṃ vā'dhārmiko'rjuna / na kṣatriya iti prāhuryo na hanti raṇājire
ce_text: nānṛtaḥ pāṇḍavo jyeṣṭho nāhaṃ vādhārmiko 'rjuna / śiṣyadhruṅ nihataḥ pāpo yudhyasva vijayas tava

vulgate_text: yaḥ kṣatriyasuto hanyātpitaraṃ vā guruṃ ca vā aniṣṭaṃ kṣatriyo hanyātsa vai kṣatriya ucyate / śiṣyadrohī hataḥ pāpo yudhyasva vijayastava
ce_text: nānṛtaḥ pāṇḍavo jyeṣṭho nāhaṃ vādhārmiko 'rjuna / śiṣyadhruṅ nihataḥ pāpo yudhyasva vijayas tava

vulgate_text: tasminnākruśyati droṇe samakṣaṃ pāpakarmaṇā / nīcaṃ karma kṛtaṃ tena kṣudreṇa gurughātinā
ce_text: tasminn ākruśyati droṇe maharṣitanaye tadā / nīcātmanā nṛśaṃsena kṣudreṇa gurughātinā

vulgate_text: adharmeṇāpakṛṣṭaśca madrarājaḥ parairitaḥ / adharmeṇa tathā bālaḥ saubhadro vinipātitaḥ
ce_text: adharmeṇāpakṛṣṭaś ca madrarājaḥ parair itaḥ / ito 'py adharmeṇa hato bhīṣmaḥ kurupitāmahaḥ / bhūriśravā hy adharmeṇa tvayā dharmavidā hataḥ

vulgate_text: ito'pyadharmeṇa hato bhīṣmaḥ parapurañjayaḥ / bhūriśravā hyadharmeṇa tvayā dharmavidā hataḥ
ce_text: adharmeṇāpakṛṣṭaś ca madrarājaḥ parair itaḥ / ito 'py adharmeṇa hato bhīṣmaḥ kurupitāmahaḥ / bhūriśravā hy adharmeṇa tvayā dharmavidā hataḥ

vulgate_text: catuścakrā dvicakrāśca śataghno bahulā gadāḥ / cakrāṇi ca kṣurāntāni maṇḍalānīva bhāsvataḥ
ce_text: caturdiśaṃ vicitrāś ca śataghnyo 'tha hutāśadāḥ / cakrāṇi ca kṣurāntāni maṇḍalānīva bhāsvataḥ

vulgate_text: vāsudevo'pi dharmātmā kariṣyatyātmanaḥ kṣamam / śreyo hyupadiśatyeṣa lokasya kimutātmanaḥ
ce_text: vāsudevo 'pi dharmātmā kariṣyaty ātmanaḥ kṣamam / upadeṣṭuṃ samartho 'yaṃ lokasya kim utātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: pravavuśca śivā vātāḥ praśāntā mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ / vāhanāni ca hṛṣṭāni praśānte'stre sudurjaye
ce_text: pravavuś ca śivā vātāḥ praśāntā mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ / vāhanāni ca hṛṣṭāni yodhāś ca manujeśvara

vulgate_text: eṣa cāstrapratīghātaṃ vāsudevaḥ prayuktavān / asya tu hyeṣa vai dātā mānuṣeṣu na vidyate
ce_text: eṣa cāstrapratīghātaṃ vāsudevaḥ prayuktavān / anyathā vihitaḥ saṃkhye vadhaḥ śatror janādhipa

vulgate_text: tvayi śastrāṇi divyāni tryambake cāmitaujasi ghnataitānsumahāvīrya śātravānyudvakovidaḥ / icchato na hi te mucyetsaṅkruddho hi purandaraḥ / dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca
ce_text: tvayi hy astrāṇi divyāni yathā syus tryambake tathā / icchato na hi te mucyet kruddhasyāpi puraṃdaraḥ

vulgate_text: te viṃśatipade yattā guruputramamarṣaṇam / pañcabhiḥ pañcabhirbāṇairabhyaghnansarvataḥ samam
ce_text: kirīṭī bhīmasenaś ca vṛddhakṣatraś ca pauravaḥ / yuvarājaś ca cedīnāṃ mālavaś ca sudarśanaḥ / pañcabhiḥ pañcabhir bāṇair abhyaghnan sarvataḥ samam

vulgate_text: sūtaṃ vidvvāḥ bhīmasenasya ṣaḍbhi-- rdvābhyāṃ vidvvā kārmukaṃ ca dhvajaṃ ca / punaḥ pārthaṃ śaravarṣeṇa vidvvā drauṇirghoraṃ siṃhanādaṃ nanāda
ce_text: tato 'rjunaṃ ṣaḍbhir athājaghāna; drauṇāyanir daśabhir vāsudevam / bhīmaṃ daśārdhair yuvarājaṃ caturbhir; dvābhyāṃ chittvā kārmukaṃ ca dhvajaṃ ca / punaḥ pārthaṃ śaravarṣeṇa viddhvā; drauṇir ghoraṃ siṃhanādaṃ nanāda

vulgate_text: te vadhyamānāḥ samare droṇaputreṇa pārthivāḥ / droṇaputrabhayādrājandiśaḥ sarvāśca bhejire
ce_text: te vadhyamānāḥ samare droṇaputreṇa kṣatriyāḥ / droṇaputraṃ bhayād rājan dikṣu sarvāsu menire

vulgate_text: yacca bhūyo'sti tejaste tatsarvaṃ mayi darśaya / sa eva droṇahantā te darpaṃ chetsyati pārṣataḥ
ce_text: sa eva droṇahantā te darpaṃ bhetsyati pārṣataḥ / kālānalasamaprakhyo dviṣatām antako yudhi / samāsādaya pāñcālyaṃ māṃ cāpi sahakeśavam

vulgate_text: kālānalasamaprakhyaṃ dviṣāmantakopamam samāsādaya pāñcālyaṃ māṃ cāpi sahakeśavam / darpaṃ nāśayitāsmyadya tavodvṛttasya saṃyuge / dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / tasminn astre pratihate droṇe copadhinā hate / tathā duryodhanenokto drauṇiḥ kim akarot punaḥ

vulgate_text: tatastumulamākāśe śaravarṣamajāyata / pāvakārciparītaṃ tatpārthamevābhipupluve
ce_text: tatas tumulam ākāśe śaravarṣam ajāyata / vavuś ca śiśirā vātāḥ sūryo naiva tatāpa ca

vulgate_text: rakṣāṃsi ca piśācāśca vineduratisaṅgatāḥ / vavuścāśiśirā vātāḥ sūryo naiva tatāpa ca
ce_text: tatas tumulam ākāśe śaravarṣam ajāyata / vavuś ca śiśirā vātāḥ sūryo naiva tatāpa ca

vulgate_text: vāyasāścāpi cākrandandikṣu sarvāsu bhairavam / rudhiraṃ cāpi varṣanto ninedustoyadā divi
ce_text: cukruśur dānavāś cāpi dikṣu sarvāsu bhairavam / rudhiraṃ cāpi varṣanto vinedus toyadāmbare

vulgate_text: digbhyaḥ pradigbhyaḥ khādbhūmeḥ sarvataḥ śaravṛṣṭayaḥ / uccāvacā nipeturvai garuḍānilaraṃhasaḥ
ce_text: diśaḥ khaṃ pradiśaś caiva bhuvaṃ ca śaravṛṣṭayaḥ / uccāvacā nipetur vai garuḍānilaraṃhasaḥ

vulgate_text: apare pradrutā nāgā bhayatrastā viśāmpate / tresurdiśo yathā pūrvaṃ vane dāvāgnisaṃvṛtāḥ
ce_text: apare pradrutās tatra dahyamānā mahāgajāḥ / tresus tathāpare ghore vane dāvāgnisaṃvṛtāḥ

vulgate_text: sarvaghāni mayā muktamastraṃ paramadāruṇam / kenemau martyadharmāṇau nādhākṣītkeśavārjunau
ce_text: kenemau martyadharmāṇau nāvadhīt keśavārjunau / etat prabrūhi bhagavan mayā pṛṣṭo yathātatham

vulgate_text: etatprabrūhi bhagavanmayā pṛṣṭo yathātatham / śrotumicchāmi tattvena sarvametanmahāmune / vyāsa uvāca
ce_text: kenemau martyadharmāṇau nāvadhīt keśavārjunau / etat prabrūhi bhagavan mayā pṛṣṭo yathātatham

vulgate_text: yo'sau nārāyaṇo nāma pūrveṣāmapi pūrvajaḥ / ādidevo jagannātho lokakartā svayaṃ prabhuḥ
ce_text: yo 'sau nārāyaṇo nāma pūrveṣām api pūrvajaḥ / ajāyata ca kāryārthaṃ putro dharmasya viśvakṛt

vulgate_text: devānāṃ hitakāmārthaṃ lokānāṃ caiva sattamaḥ / ajāyata ca kāryārthaṃ putro dharmasya viśvakṛt
ce_text: yo 'sau nārāyaṇo nāma pūrveṣām api pūrvajaḥ / ajāyata ca kāryārthaṃ putro dharmasya viśvakṛt

vulgate_text: aṇīyāṃsamaṇubhyaśca bṛhadbhyaśca bṛhattamam / rudramīśānavṛṣabhaṃ haraṃ śaṃbhuṃ kapardinam
ce_text: dadarśa bhṛśadurdarśaṃ sarvadevair apīśvaram / aṇīyasām aṇīyāṃsaṃ bṛhadbhyaś ca bṛhattaram

vulgate_text: cekitānaṃ parāṃ yoniṃ tiṣṭhato gacchataśca ha durvāraṇaṃ sudurdharṣaṃ durnirīkṣyaṃ durāsadam / atimanyuṃ mahātmānaṃ sarvabhūtapracetasam
ce_text: durvāraṇaṃ durdṛśaṃ tigmamanyuṃ; mahātmānaṃ sarvaharaṃ pracetasam / divyaṃ cāpam iṣudhī cādadānaṃ; hiraṇyavarmāṇam anantavīryam

vulgate_text: varadaṃ pṛthucārvaṅgyā pārvatyā sahitaṃ prabhum / krīḍamānaṃ mahātmānaṃ bhūtasaṅghagaṇairvṛtam
ce_text: varadaṃ pṛthucārvaṅgyā pārvatyā sahitaṃ prabhum / ajam īśānam avyagraṃ kāraṇātmānam acyutam

vulgate_text: divyāmṛtau mānasau dvau suparṇā-- vavākśākhaḥ pippalaḥ saptagoptaḥ / vācaścārthā devatāḥ lokapālā lokānanye ye purā dhārayitvā gatā hi tebhyaḥ paramaṃ tatparaṃ ca tvatsambhūtāste ca tebhyaḥ parastvam
ce_text: divyāvṛtau mānasau dvau suparṇāv; avākśākhaḥ pippalaḥ sapta gopāḥ / daśāpy anye ye puraṃ dhārayanti; tvayā sṛṣṭās te hi tebhyaḥ paras tvam / bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhavitā cāpy adhṛṣyaṃ; tvatsaṃbhūtā bhuvanānīha viśvā

vulgate_text: bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhavitā cāpradhṛṣyaṃ tvatsambhūtā bhuvanānīha viśvā / bhaktaṃ ca māṃ bhajamānaṃ bhajasva prītyā māṃ vai lokapitāmaheśa
ce_text: divyāvṛtau mānasau dvau suparṇāv; avākśākhaḥ pippalaḥ sapta gopāḥ / daśāpy anye ye puraṃ dhārayanti; tvayā sṛṣṭās te hi tebhyaḥ paras tvam / bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhavitā cāpy adhṛṣyaṃ; tvatsaṃbhūtā bhuvanānīha viśvā

vulgate_text: tasmai varānacintyātmā devadevaḥ pinākadhṛt / viṣṇave devamukhyāya prāyacchadṛṣisaṃstutaḥ / śrībhagavānuvāca
ce_text: tasmai varān acintyātmā nīlakaṇṭhaḥ pinākadhṛk / arhate devamukhyāya prāyacchad ṛṣisaṃstutaḥ

vulgate_text: evamādīnvarām̐llabdhvā prasādādatha śūlinaḥ / sa eṣa devaścarati māyayā mohayañjagat
ce_text: vyāsa uvāca / evam ete varā labdhāḥ purastād viddhi śauriṇā / sa eṣa devaś carati māyayā mohayañ jagat

vulgate_text: haṣṭaromā ca vaśyātmā so'bhivādya maharṣaye / varūthinīmabhiprekṣya hyavahāramakārayat
ce_text: hṛṣṭalomā ca vaśyātmā namaskṛtya maharṣaye / varūthinīm abhipretya avahāram akārayat

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvā sumahadāścaryamātmano vijayāvaham muniṃ snigdhāmbudābhāsaṃ vedavyāsamakalmaṣam / yadṛcchayā''gataṃ vyāsaṃ papraccha bharatarṣabha / arjuna uvāca
ce_text: dṛṣṭvā sumahad āścaryam ātmano vijayāvaham / yadṛcchayāgataṃ vyāsaṃ papraccha bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: mahādevaṃ haraṃ sthāṇuṃ varadaṃ bhuvaneśvaram / jagatpradhānamajitaṃ jagatprītimadhīśvaram
ce_text: īśānaṃ varadaṃ pārtha dṛṣṭavān asi śaṃkaram / taṃ gaccha śaraṇaṃ devaṃ sarvādiṃ bhuvaneśvaram

vulgate_text: jñānātmānaṃ jñānagamyaṃ jñānaśreṣṭhaṃ sudurvidam / dātāraṃ caiva bhaktānāṃ prasādavihitānvarān
ce_text: mahādevaṃ mahātmānam īśānaṃ jaṭilaṃ śivam / tryakṣaṃ mahābhujaṃ rudraṃ śikhinaṃ cīravāsasam / dātāraṃ caiva bhaktānāṃ prasādavihitān varān

vulgate_text: ye bhaktā varadaṃ deva śivaṃ rudramumāpatim / ananyabhāvena sadā sarveśaṃ samupāsate
ce_text: ye bhaktā varadaṃ devaṃ śivaṃ rudram umāpatim / iha loke sukhaṃ prāpya te yānti paramāṃ gatim

vulgate_text: saṅgrāmeṣu jayaṃ prāpya pālayanti mahīmimām / iha loke sukhaṃ prāpya te yānti paramāṃ gatim
ce_text: ye bhaktā varadaṃ devaṃ śivaṃ rudram umāpatim / iha loke sukhaṃ prāpya te yānti paramāṃ gatim

vulgate_text: namo vṛkṣāya senānye madhyamāya namonamaḥ harikeśāya muṇḍāya kṛśāyottāraṇāya ca / bhāskāraya sutīrthāya devadevāya raṃhase
ce_text: kāmyāya harinetrāya sthāṇave puruṣāya ca / harikeśāya muṇḍāya kṛśāyottaraṇāya ca

vulgate_text: bahurūpāya viśvasya pataye muñcavāsase sahasraśirase caiva sahasracaraṇāya ca / sahasrabāhave caiva sahasravadanāya ca
ce_text: sahasraśirase caiva sahasranayanāya ca / sahasrabāhave caiva sahasracaraṇāya ca

vulgate_text: dhanurdharāya devāya priyadhanvāya dhanvine / dhanvantarāya dhanuṣe dhanvācāryāya te namaḥ
ce_text: sruvahastāya devāya sukhadhanvāya dhanvine / dhanvantarāya dhanuṣe dhanvācāryāya dhanvine

vulgate_text: vanaspatīnāṃ pataye narāṇāṃ pataye namaḥ / mātṝṇāṃ pataye caiva gaṇānāṃ pataye namaḥ
ce_text: vanaspatīnāṃ pataye narāṇāṃ pataye namaḥ / apāṃ ca pataye nityaṃ yajñānāṃ pataye namaḥ

vulgate_text: dakṣasya yajamānasya vidhivatsaṃbhṛtaṃ purā vivyādha kupito yajñaṃ nirdayastvabhavattadā / dhanuṣā bāṇamutsṛjya saghoṣaṃ vinanāda ca
ce_text: vivyādha kupito yajñaṃ nirbhayas tu bhavas tadā / dhanuṣā bāṇam utsṛjya saghoṣaṃ vinanāda ca

vulgate_text: punaśca sandadhe dīptāndevānāṃ niśitāñśarān / sadhūmānsasphuliṅgāṃśca vidyuttoyadasannibhān
ce_text: tato niścakramur devā vepamānā natāḥ sma tam / punaś ca saṃdadhe dīptaṃ devānāṃ niśitaṃ śaram

vulgate_text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā tu surāḥ sarve praṇipatya maheśvaram / rudrasya yajñabhāgaṃ ca viśiṣṭaṃ te tvakalpayan
ce_text: rudrasya yajñabhāgaṃ ca viśiṣṭaṃ te nv akalpayan / bhayena tridaśā rājañ śaraṇaṃ ca prapedire

vulgate_text: bhayena tridaśā rājañcharaṇaṃ ca prapedire tena caivātikopena sa yajñaḥ sandhitastadā / bhagnāścāpi surā āsanbhītāścādyāpi taṃ prati
ce_text: tena caivātikopena sa yajñaḥ saṃdhitas tadā / yattāś cāpi surā āsan yattāś cādyāpi taṃ prati

vulgate_text: sauvarṇaṃ kamalākṣasya tārakākṣasya rājatam tṛtīyaṃ tu puraṃ teṣāṃ vidyunmālina āyasam / na śaktastāni maghavānbhettuṃ sarvāyudhairapi
ce_text: āyasaṃ tārakākṣasya kamalākṣasya rājatam / sauvarṇaṃ paramaṃ hy āsīd vidyunmālina eva ca

vulgate_text: te mayā sahitā yūyaṃ prāpadyadhvaṃ tameva hi] / sa eṣa bhagavāndevaḥ sarvalokeśvaraḥ prabhuḥ
ce_text: bāhuṃ savajraṃ śakrasya kruddhasyāstambhayat prabhuḥ / sa eṣa bhagavān devaḥ sarvalokeśvaraḥ prabhuḥ

vulgate_text: bhagavanbhūtabhavyeśa lokanātha jagatpate / prasādaṃ kuru śakrasya tvayā krodhārditasya vai / vyāsa uvāca
ce_text: vyāsa uvāca / mahāntam etam arthaṃ māṃ yaṃ tvaṃ pṛcchasi vismayāt / tat pravakṣyāmi te sarvaṃ samādhāya manaḥ śṛṇu

vulgate_text: api varṣasahasreṇa satataṃ pāṇḍunandana / sarvairgrahairgṛhītānvai sarvapāpasamanvitān
ce_text: sarvair grahair gṛhītān vai sarvapāpasamanvitān / sa mocayati suprītaḥ śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇāgatān

vulgate_text: tasya devasya yadvaktraṃ samudre tadadhiṣṭhitam / baḍabāmukheti vikhyātaṃ pibattoyamayaṃ haviḥ
ce_text: bahubhir bahudhā rūpair viśvaṃ vyāpnoti vai jagat / asya devasya yad vaktraṃ samudre tad atiṣṭhata

vulgate_text: śrīvedavyāsāya namaḥ / nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam / devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet / vaiśampāyana uvāca / śibirāddhāstinapuraṃ prāpya bhārata sañjayaḥ praviveśa mahābāhurdhṛtarāṣṭraniveśanam
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / etac chrutvā mahārāja dhṛtarāṣṭro 'mbikāsutaḥ / śokasyāntam apaśyan vai hataṃ matvā suyodhanam / vihvalaḥ patito bhūmau naṣṭacetā iva dvipaḥ

vulgate_text: upasthāya ca rājānaṃ viniśvasya ca sūtajaḥ / nātihṛṣṭamanā rājannidaṃ vacanamabravīt / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / hate droṇe maheṣvāse tava putrā mahārathāḥ / babhūvur āśvastamukhā viṣaṇṇā gatacetasaḥ

vulgate_text: nirāśānpāṇḍavānkṛtvā dṛḍhaṃ rājansasātyakān / pāñcālānāṃ rathāṃścaiva vinihatya sahasraśaḥ
ce_text: sa pīḍayitvā pāñcālān pāṇḍavāṃś ca tarasvinaḥ / hatvā sahasraśo yodhān arjunena nipātitaḥ

vulgate_text: putrāṇāṃ rājyakāmena tvayā rājanhitaiṣiṇā / caritānyahitānyeva teṣāṃ te phalamāgatam
ce_text: putrāṇāṃ rājyakāmānāṃ tvayā rājan hitaiṣiṇā / ahitānīva cīrṇāni teṣāṃ te phalam āgatam

vulgate_text: pītaṃ ca kṣatajaṃ tasya dhārtarāṣṭrasya saṃyuge / pāṇḍavena mahārāja karma kṛtvā suduṣkaram* / vaiśampāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / etac chrutvā mahārāja dhṛtarāṣṭro 'mbikāsutaḥ / śokasyāntam apaśyan vai hataṃ matvā suyodhanam / vihvalaḥ patito bhūmau naṣṭacetā iva dvipaḥ

vulgate_text: śokārṇave mahāghore nimagnā bharatastriyaḥ / rurudurduḥkhaśokārtā bhṛśamudvignacetasaḥ
ce_text: sa śabdaḥ pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ pūrayām āsa sarvaśaḥ / śokārṇave mahāghore nimagnā bharatastriyaḥ

vulgate_text: kaccidduryodhanaḥ sūta na gato vai yamakṣayam jaye nirāśaḥ putro me satataṃ jayakāmukaḥ / brūhi sañjaya tattvena punaruktāṃ kathāmimām / vaiśampāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / etac chrutvā mahārāja dhṛtarāṣṭro 'mbikāsutaḥ / śokasyāntam apaśyan vai hataṃ matvā suyodhanam / vihvalaḥ patito bhūmau naṣṭacetā iva dvipaḥ

vulgate_text: etacchrutvā mahārāja dhṛtarāṣṭro'mbikāsutaḥ dahyamāno'bravītsūtaṃ muhūrtaṃ tiṣṭha sañjaya / vyākulaṃ me manastāta mā tāvatkiṃciducyatām
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / etac chrutvā mahārāja dhṛtarāṣṭro 'mbikāsutaḥ / abravīt saṃjayaṃ sūtaṃ śokavyākulacetanaḥ

vulgate_text: rājāpi nābravītkiñcitsañjayo vidurastathā / tūṣṇīmbhūtastadā so'tha babhūva jagatīpatiḥ
ce_text: muhyamāno 'bravīc cāpi muhūrtaṃ tiṣṭha saṃjaya / vyākulaṃ me manas tāta śrutvā sumahad apriyam / naṣṭacittas tataḥ so 'tha babhūva jagatīpatiḥ

vulgate_text: ācakṣva pāṇḍaveyānāṃ māmakānāṃ ca vikramam / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / hataḥ śāṃtanavo rājan durādharṣaḥ pratāpavān / hatvā pāṇḍavayodhānām arbudaṃ daśabhir dinaiḥ

vulgate_text: pitāmahastava tathā bāhlīkaḥ saha bāhlikaiḥ / nihato bhīmasenena mahābālaparākramaḥ
ce_text: pitāmahas tava tathā bāhlikaḥ saha bāhlikaiḥ / bhīmasenena vikramya gamito yamasādanam

vulgate_text: ubhau kaliṅgavṛṣakau bhrātarau yuddhadurmadau / kṛtvā cāsukaraṃ karma gatau vaivasvatakṣayam
ce_text: vindānuvindāv āvantyau rājaputrau mahābalau / kṛtvā nasukaraṃ karma gatau vaivasvatakṣayam

vulgate_text: gokule nityasaṃvṛddhā yuddhe paramakopanāḥ / gopālāḥ kṛtavīrāste nihatāḥ savyasācinā
ce_text: gokule nityasaṃvṛddhā yuddhe paramakovidāḥ / śreṇayo bahusāhasrāḥ saṃśaptakagaṇāś ca ye / te sarve pārtham āsādya gatā vaivasvatakṣayam

vulgate_text: yathā kṛṣṇena narako muruśca nihato raṇe / kārtavīryaśca rāmeṇa bhārgaveṇa yathā hataḥ
ce_text: mahendreṇa yathā vṛtro yathā rāmeṇa rāvaṇaḥ / yathā kṛṣṇena nihato muro raṇanipātitaḥ / kārtavīryaś ca rāmeṇa bhārgaveṇa hato yathā

vulgate_text: yathā skandena mahiṣo yathā rudreṇa cāndhakaḥ / tathā'rjunena sa hato dvairathe yuddhadurmadaḥ
ce_text: tathārjunena nihato dvairathe yuddhadurmadaḥ / sāmātyabāndhavo rājan karṇaḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ

vulgate_text: na kṛtaṃ ca tvayā pūrvaṃ daivena vidhinā balāt / tadidaṃ samanuprāptaṃ vyasanaṃ sumahātyayam
ce_text: ucyamāno mahārāja bandhubhir hitakāṅkṣibhiḥ / tad idaṃ samanuprāptaṃ vyasanaṃ tvāṃ mahātyayam

vulgate_text: droṇaputrasya vikrāntaṃ rādheyasyaiva cobhayoḥ / paśyantu pāṇḍuputrāste viṣṇuvāsavayoriva
ce_text: droṇaputrasya vikrāntaṃ rādheyasyaiva cobhayoḥ / pāṇḍupāñcālasainyeṣu drakṣyathāpi mahātmanoḥ

vulgate_text: sarva eva bhavantaśca śaktāḥ pratyekaśo'pi vā pāṇḍuputrānraṇe hantuṃ sasainyānkisu saṃhatāḥ / vīryavantaḥ kṛtāstrāśca drakṣyathādya parasparam / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / pāṇḍaveyair hi yad vṛttaṃ kauraveyeṣu māriṣa / tac chrutvā mā vyathāṃ kārṣīd iṣṭe na vyathate manaḥ

vulgate_text: saināpatyamathāvāpya karṇo rājanmahārathaḥ / siṃhanādaṃ vinadyoccaiḥ prāyudhyata raṇotkaṭaḥ
ce_text: evam ukte mahārāja karṇo vaikartano nṛpaḥ / siṃhanādaṃ vinadyoccaiḥ prāyudhyata mahābalaḥ

vulgate_text: hatapravarasainyaṃ me yathā śaṃsasi sañjaya / ahatānapi me śaṃsa ye'tra jīvanti kecana
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / hatapravīre sainye 'smin māmake vadatāṃ vara / ahatāñ śaṃsa me sūta ye 'tra jīvanti ke cana

vulgate_text: eteṣu hi mṛteṣvadya ye tvayā parikīrtitāḥ / ye'pi jīvanti te sarve mṛtā iti matirmama / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / hataḥ śāṃtanavo rājan durādharṣaḥ pratāpavān / hatvā pāṇḍavayodhānām arbudaṃ daśabhir dinaiḥ

vulgate_text: gāndhārarājaḥ sasutaśca rāja-- ndurdyūtadevī kalahapriyaśca / gāndhāramukhyairyavanaiśca rāja-- nvyavasthito yodvukāmastvadarthe
ce_text: ājāneyaiḥ saindhavaiḥ pārvatīyair; nadījakāmbojavanāyubāhlikaiḥ / gāndhārarājaḥ svabalena yukto; vyavasthito yoddhukāmas tvadarthe

vulgate_text: duryodhano nāgakulasya madhye vyavasthitaḥ siṃha ivābabhāse / rathena jāmbūnadabhūṣaṇena vyavasthitaḥ samare yotsyamānaḥ
ce_text: duryodhano nāgakulasya madhye; mahāvīryaḥ saha sainyapravīraiḥ / rathena jāmbūnadabhūṣaṇena; vyavasthitaḥ samare yoddhukāmaḥ

vulgate_text: hīniṣevo bhāratarājaputra ugrāyudhaḥ śrutavarmā jayaśca / śalaśca satyavrataduḥśalau ca vyavasthitāḥ sahasainyā narāgryāḥ
ce_text: hrīniṣedhā bharatā rājaputrāś; citrāyudhaḥ śrutakarmā jayaś ca / śalaś ca satyavrataduḥśalau ca; vyavasthitā balino yoddhukāmāḥ

vulgate_text: athāparau karṇasutau varāstrau vyavasthitau laghuhastau narendra / bale mahatyulbaṇasatvavīryau samāsthitau yodvukāmau tvadarthe
ce_text: karṇātmajaḥ satyaseno mahātmā; vyavasthitaḥ samare yoddhukāmaḥ / athāparau karṇasutau varārhau; vyavasthitau laghuhastau narendra / balaṃ mahad durbhidam alpadhairyaiḥ; samāśritau yotsyamānau tvadarthe

vulgate_text: ākhyātā jīvamānā ye pare sainyā yathāyatham / itīdamavagacchāmi vyaktamarthābhipattitaḥ / vaiśampāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / etac chrutvā mahārāja dhṛtarāṣṭro 'mbikāsutaḥ / śokasyāntam apaśyan vai hataṃ matvā suyodhanam / vihvalaḥ patito bhūmau naṣṭacetā iva dvipaḥ

vulgate_text: vyākulaṃ me manastāta śrutvā sumahadapriyam mano muhyati cāṅgāni na ca śaknomi dhāvitum / ityevamuktvā vacanaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭro'mbikāsutaḥ bhrāntacittastataḥ so'tha babhūva jagatīpatiḥ
ce_text: muhyamāno 'bravīc cāpi muhūrtaṃ tiṣṭha saṃjaya / vyākulaṃ me manas tāta śrutvā sumahad apriyam / naṣṭacittas tataḥ so 'tha babhūva jagatīpatiḥ

vulgate_text: yo'jayatsarvakāmbhojānāvantyānkekayaiḥ saha gāndhārānmadrakānmātsyāṃstrigartāṃstaṅkaṇāñśakān
ce_text: yaś cājaiṣīd atibalān amitrān api durjayān / gāndhārān madrakān matsyāṃs trigartāṃs taṅgaṇāñ śakān

vulgate_text: vatsānkaliṅgāndaradānaśmakānṛṣikānapi / śabarānhārahūṇāṃśca praghūṇānsaralānapi
ce_text: vatsān kaliṅgāṃs taralān aśmakān ṛṣikāṃs tathā / yo jitvā samare vīraś cakre balibhṛtaḥ purā

vulgate_text: senāgopaśca sa kathaṃ śatrubhiḥ paramāstravit / ghātitaḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ śūraiḥ samare vīryaśālibhiḥ
ce_text: duryodhanasya vṛddhyarthaṃ pṛthivīṃ yo 'jayat prabhuḥ / sa jitaḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ śūraiḥ samarthair vīryaśālibhiḥ

vulgate_text: yo'jitaḥ pārthivaiḥ śūraiḥ samarthairvīryaśālibhiḥ / duryodhanasya vṛddhyarthaṃ kṛtsnāmurvīmathājayat
ce_text: duryodhanasya vṛddhyarthaṃ pṛthivīṃ yo 'jayat prabhuḥ / sa jitaḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ śūraiḥ samarthair vīryaśālibhiḥ

vulgate_text: taṃ vṛṣaṃ nihataṃ śrutvā dvairathe rathināṃ varam / śokārṇave nimagno'hamapluvaḥ sāgare yathā
ce_text: taṃ śrutvā nihataṃ karṇaṃ dvairathe savyasācinā / śokārṇave nimagno 'ham aplavaḥ sāgare yathā

vulgate_text: śokasyāntaṃ na paśyāmi pāraṃ jalanidheriva / cintā me vardhate'tīva mumūrṣā cāpi jāyate
ce_text: śokasyāntaṃ na paśyāmi samudrasyeva viplukāḥ / cintā me vardhate tīvrā mumūrṣā cāpi jāyate

vulgate_text: duḥkhādduḥkhataraṃ bhanye prāptavānasmi sañjaya / bhīṣmadroṇavadhenaiva karṇasya ca mahātmanaḥ
ce_text: tasmād bhīṣmavadhe caiva droṇasya ca mahātmanaḥ / nātra śeṣaṃ prapaśyāmi sūtaputre hate yudhi

vulgate_text: paṅgorivādhvagamanaṃ daridrasyeva kāmitam / duryodhanasya lobhaśca samānyetāni sañjaya
ce_text: paṅgor ivādhvagamanaṃ daridrasyeva kāmitam / duryodhanasya cākūtaṃ tṛṣitasyeva piplukāḥ

vulgate_text: ityevaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭro'tha vilapya bahuduḥkhitaḥ / provāca sañjayaṃ bhūyaḥ sokavyākulamānasaḥ / dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / ākhyātā māmakās tāta nihatā yudhi pāṇḍavaiḥ / nihatān pāṇḍaveyānāṃ māmakair brūhi saṃjaya

vulgate_text: tathā draupadinā droṇo nyastasarvāyudho yudhi / dharmarājavacaḥ śrutvā aśvatthāmā hatastviti
ce_text: tathā draupadinā droṇo nyastasarvāyudho yudhi / yuktayogo maheṣvāsaḥ śarair bahubhir ācitaḥ / nihataḥ khaḍgam udyamya dhṛṣṭadyumnena saṃjaya

vulgate_text: yaśca māyāsahasrāṇi vikurvāṇaṃ jayaiṣiṇam / ghaṭotkacaṃ rākṣasendraṃ śakraśaktyā nijaghnivān
ce_text: yaś ca māyāsahasrāṇi dhvaṃsayitvā raṇotkaṭam / ghaṭotkacaṃ rākṣasendraṃ śakraśaktyābhijaghnivān

vulgate_text: madrarājo maheṣvāsaḥ śalyaḥ samitiśobhanaḥ dṛṣṭvā vinihataṃ karṇaṃ sārathye rathināṃ varaḥ / kimabhāṣata sauvīro madrāṇāmadhipo balī
ce_text: madrarājo maheṣvāsaḥ śalyaḥ samitiśobhanaḥ / diṣṭaṃ tena hi tat sarvaṃ yathā karṇo nipātitaḥ

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvā vinihataṃ sarve yodhā vāraṇadurjayāḥ ye ca kena rājānaḥ pṛthivyāṃ yodvumāgatāḥ / vaikartanaṃ hataṃ dṛṣṭavā kānyabhāṣanta sañjaya
ce_text: ye ca ke cana rājānaḥ pṛthivyāṃ yoddhum āgatāḥ / vaikartanaṃ hataṃ dṛṣṭvā kim abhāṣanta saṃjaya

vulgate_text: punaḥ punarna mṛṣyāmi vadhaṃ karṇasya pāṇḍavaiḥ / yasya bāhvorbalaṃ tulyaṃ kuñjarāṇāṃ śataṃ śatam
ce_text: na mṛṣyāmi ca rādheyaṃ hatam āhavaśobhinam / yasya bāhvor balaṃ tulyaṃ kuñjarāṇāṃ śataṃ śatam

vulgate_text: te vayaṃ pravaraṃ nṝṇāṃ sarvairyodhaguṇairyutam / karṇamevābhiṣebhyāmaḥ saināpatyena bhārata
ce_text: te vayaṃ pravaraṃ nṝṇāṃ sarvair guṇagaṇair yutam / karṇaṃ senāpatiṃ kṛtvā pramathiṣyāmahe ripūn

vulgate_text: etadācāryatanayācchrutvā rājaṃstavātmajaḥ / duryodhano mahārāja bhṛśaṃ prītamanāstadā
ce_text: svaṃ manaḥ samavasthāpya bāhuvīryam upāśritaḥ / duryodhano mahārāja rādheyam idam abravīt

vulgate_text: jahi śatrugaṇānsarvānmahendro dānavāniva avasthitaṃ rame dṛṣṭvā pāṇḍavāstvāṃ mahārathāḥ / draviṣyanti ca pāñcālā viṣṇuṃ dṛṣṭveva dānavāḥ
ce_text: avasthitaṃ raṇe jñātvā pāṇḍavās tvāṃ mahāratham / draviṣyanti sapāñcālā viṣṇuṃ dṛṣṭveva dānavāḥ / tasmāt tvaṃ puruṣavyāghra prakarṣethā mahācamūm

vulgate_text: evamuktastu rādheyo rājñā duryodhanena ha rājñāṃ madhye mahābāhuḥ prītātmā sa mahābalaḥ / harṣayannabravītkarṇo duryodhanamidaṃ vacaḥ / karṇa uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / śrutvā karṇasya nidhanam aśraddheyam ivādbhutam / bhūtasaṃmohanaṃ bhīmaṃ meroḥ paryasanaṃ yathā

vulgate_text: hitaśca priyakāmaśca mama putrasya nityaśaḥ / akarotkiṃ mahāprājñastanmamācakṣva sañjaya / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / hate droṇe maheṣvāse tasminn ahani bhārata / kṛte ca moghasaṃkalpe droṇaputre mahārathe

vulgate_text: mahatyapararātre ca tava sainyasya māriṣa / yogo yoga iti hyāśu prādurāsīnmahāsvanaḥ
ce_text: mahaty apararātre tu tava putrasya māriṣa / yogo yogeti sahasā prādurāsīn mahāsvanaḥ

vulgate_text: dhmāpayanvārijaṃ rājanhemajālavibhūṣintam / vidhrunvāno mahaccāpaṃ kārtasvaravibhūṣitam
ce_text: dhamantaṃ vārijaṃ tāta hemajālavibhūṣitam / vidhunvānaṃ mahac cāpaṃ kārtasvaravibhūṣitam

vulgate_text: tataḥ śaṅkhāśca bheryaśca paṇavānakagomukhāḥ / ḍiṇḍimāścāpyahanyanta jharjharāśca samantataḥ
ce_text: tataḥ śaṅkhāś ca bheryaś ca paṇavānakagomukhāḥ / sahasaivābhyahanyanta saśabdāś ca samantataḥ

vulgate_text: ubhe sainye mahārāja prahṛṣṭanarasaṅkule / yodvukāme sthite rājanhantumanyonyamojasā
ce_text: ubhe sene mahāsattve prahṛṣṭanarakuñjare / yoddhukāme sthite rājan hantum anyonyam añjasā

vulgate_text: vijaye jātasaṃrambhe dṛṣṭvā'nyonyaṃ vyavasthite / anīkamadhye rājendra ceratuḥ karṇapāṇḍavau
ce_text: tatra yattau susaṃrabdhau dṛṣṭvānyonyaṃ vyavasthitau / anīkamadhye rājendra rejatuḥ karṇapāṇḍavau

vulgate_text: nṛtyantyāviva te sene sameyātāṃ parasparam / tayoḥ pakṣaprapakṣebhyo niryayuryudvalipsavaḥ
ce_text: nṛtyamāne tu te sene sameyātāṃ parasparam / tayoḥ pakṣaiḥ prapakṣaiś ca nirjagmur vai yuyutsavaḥ

vulgate_text: tato nānārathāśvebhāḥ pattayaścogravikramāḥ / samprahārānbhṛśaṃ cakrurdehapāpmavināśanān
ce_text: tato gajā rathāś cāśvāḥ pattayaś ca mahāhave / saṃprahāraṃ paraṃ cakrur dehapāpmapraṇāśanam

vulgate_text: vyāyatāyatabāhūnāṃ vyāyatāyatabāhubhiḥ / vāhavaḥ pātitā rejurdharaṇyāṃ sāyudhāṅgadaiḥ
ce_text: vyāyatāyatabāhūnāṃ vyāyatāyatabāhubhiḥ / vyāyatā bāhavaḥ petuś chinnamuṣṭyāyudhāṅgadāḥ

vulgate_text: sa papāta mahānāgo bhīmasenasya bhārata / purā nāgasya patanādavaplutya sthito mahīm
ce_text: purā nāgasya patanād avaplutya sthito mahīm / bhīmaseno ripor nāgaṃ gadayā samapothayat

vulgate_text: uddhṛtya svaṅgaṃ niśitamabhyadhāvatsa pāṇḍavam / udyatāyudhamāyāntaṃ sadayā'hanvṛkodaraḥ
ce_text: tasmāt pramathitān nāgāt kṣemadhūrtim avadrutam / udyatāsim upāyāntaṃ gadayāhan vṛkodaraḥ

vulgate_text: kṣurapreṇa sutīkṣṇena hyanuvindaśiro'harat / apatattacchiro rājankuṇḍalopacitaṃ mahat
ce_text: tataḥ kruddho mahārāja sātvato yuddhadurmadaḥ / dhanur anyat samādāya sajyaṃ kṛtvā ca saṃyuge / kṣurapreṇa sutīkṣṇena anuvindaśiro 'harat

vulgate_text: sātyakiṃ ca tatastūrṇaṃ kekayānāṃ mahārathaḥ / śarairanekasāhasrairbāhvorurasi cārpayat
ce_text: sa sātyakiṃ punaḥ kruddhaḥ kekayānāṃ mahārathaḥ / śarair agniśikhākārair bāhvor urasi cārdayat

vulgate_text: sa śaraiḥ kṣatasarvāṅgaḥ sātyakiḥ satyavikramaḥ / rarāja samare rājansapuṣpa iva kiṃśukaḥ
ce_text: tataḥ sa rudhirāktāṅgo rudhireṇa kṛtacchaviḥ / rarāja samare rājan sapuṣpa iva kiṃśukaḥ

vulgate_text: virathāvasiyuddhāya samājagmaturāhave / śatacandracite gṛhya carmaṇī subhujau tathā
ce_text: śatacandracite gṛhya carmaṇī subhujau tu tau / vyarocetāṃ mahāraṅge nistriṃśavaradhāriṇau / yathā devāsure yuddhe jambhaśakrau mahābalau

vulgate_text: anyonyasya vadhe caiva cakraturyatnamuttamam / kaikeyasya dvidhā carma tataściccheda sātvataḥ
ce_text: kekayasya tataś carma dvidhā ciccheda sātvataḥ / sātyakeś ca tathaivāsau carma ciccheda pārthivaḥ

vulgate_text: sa śaraiścitrito rājā citramālyadharo yuvā / aśobhata mahāraṅge śvāvicchalalo yathā
ce_text: sa śaraiś citrito rājaṃś citramālyadharo yuvā / yuveva samaśobhat sa goṣṭhīmadhye svalaṃkṛtaḥ

vulgate_text: śrutakarmāṇi samare nārācena samarpitaḥ / susrāva rudhiraṃ tatra gairikāmbu yathā'calaḥ
ce_text: śrutakarmāpi samare nārācena samarditaḥ / susrāva rudhiraṃ bhūri gairikāmbha ivācalaḥ

vulgate_text: athainaṃ chinnadhanvānaṃ nārācānāṃ śataistribhiḥ / chādayansamare rājanvivyādha ca supatribhiḥ
ce_text: athainaṃ chinnadhanvānaṃ nārācānāṃ tribhiḥ śataiḥ / vivyādha bharataśreṣṭha śrutakarmā mahāyaśāḥ

vulgate_text: tāṃstu vidravato dṛṣṭvā nirutsāhāndviṣajjaye / drāvayanniṣubhistīkṣṇaiḥ śrutakarmā vyarocata
ce_text: tataḥ kruddho maheṣvāsas tat sainyaṃ prādravac charaiḥ / antakāle yathā kruddhaḥ sarvabhūtāni pretarāṭ / drāvayann iṣubhis tūrṇaṃ śrutakarmā vyarocata

vulgate_text: tataḥ śaktiṃ mahārāja svarṇaghaṇṭāṃ durāsadām / prāhiṇotprativindhyāya vicinvantīmasūniva
ce_text: tataḥ śaktiṃ mahārāja hemadaṇḍāṃ durāsadām / prāhiṇot tava putrāya ghorām agniśikhām iva

vulgate_text: tataḥ pravikṛte yatnaṃ kurvāṇau tau mahāraṇe / kṛtapratikṛte yattau śarasaṅghairabhītavat
ce_text: kṛtapratikṛte yatnaṃ kurvāṇau ca mahāraṇe / kṛtapratikṛte yatnaṃ cakrāte tāv abhītavat

vulgate_text: cakāśete muhūrtena tatastāvapyarindamau / vimuktāvabhrajālena aṅgārakabudhāviva
ce_text: prakāśau ca muhūrtena tatraivāstām ariṃdamau / vimuktau meghajālena śaśisūryau yathā divi

vulgate_text: atha tatraiva saṅgrame vartamāne sudāruṇe / apasavyaṃ tataścakre drauṇistatra vṛkodaram
ce_text: apasavyaṃ tataś cakre drauṇis tatra vṛkodaram / kirañ śaraśatair ugrair dhārābhir iva parvatam

vulgate_text: babhūva tumulaṃ yuddhaṃ tayoḥ puruṣasiṃhayoḥ / caritvā vividhānmārgānmaṇḍalasthānameva ca
ce_text: caritvā vividhān mārgān maṇḍalaṃ sthānam eva ca / śaraiḥ pūrṇāyatotsṛṣṭair anyonyam abhijaghnatuḥ

vulgate_text: śaraiḥ pūrṇāyatotsṛṣṭairanyonyamabhijaghnatuḥ / anyonyasya vadhe caiva cakraturyatnamuttamam
ce_text: caritvā vividhān mārgān maṇḍalaṃ sthānam eva ca / śaraiḥ pūrṇāyatotsṛṣṭair anyonyam abhijaghnatuḥ

vulgate_text: yuddhānāmati sarveṣāṃ yuddhametaditi prabho / sarvayuddhāni caitasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm
ce_text: sarvayuddhāni caitasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm / naitādṛśaṃ punar yuddhaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati

vulgate_text: aho śauryeṇa sampannāvubhau cograparākramau / aho bhīmabalo bhīma etasya ca kṛtāstratā
ce_text: aho jñānena saṃyuktāv ubhau cograparākramau / aho bhīme balaṃ bhīmam etayoś ca kṛtāstratā

vulgate_text: adbhutaṃ cāpyacintyaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā karma tayo raṇe / sidvacāraṇasaṅghānāṃ vismayaḥ samapadyata
ce_text: śrūyante sma tadā vācaḥ siddhānāṃ vai muhur muhuḥ / siṃhanādaś ca saṃjajñe sametānāṃ divaukasām / adbhutaṃ cāpy acintyaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā karma tayor mṛdhe

vulgate_text: sahadevastu saṅkruddhaḥ khaṅgaṃ gṛhya mahāhave / āvidhya prāsṛjattūrṇaṃ tava putrathaṃ prati
ce_text: sahadevas tataḥ kruddhaḥ khaḍgaṃ gṛhya mahāhave / vyāvidhyata yudhāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ śrīmāṃs tava sutaṃ prati

vulgate_text: sannivārya mahābāṇānsahadevaḥ pratāpavān / athāsmai subahūnbāṇānpreṣayāmāsa saṃyuge
ce_text: sa nivārya mahābāṇāṃs tava putreṇa preṣitān / athāsmai subahūn bāṇān mādrīputraḥ samācinot

vulgate_text: parājitya raṇe taṃ tu kauravyaṃ pāṇḍunandanaḥ / duryodhanabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā pramamātha samantataḥ
ce_text: parājitya raṇe taṃ tu pāṇḍavaḥ pāṇḍupūrvaja / duryodhanabalaṃ hṛṣṭaḥ prāmathad vai samantataḥ

vulgate_text: te śarā hemavikṛtāḥ sampantau muhurmuhuḥ / śreṇīkṛtā vyakāśānta krauñcāḥ śreṇīkṛtā iva
ce_text: te śarā hemavikṛtāḥ saṃpatanto muhur muhuḥ / śreṇīkṛtā abhāsanta haṃsāḥ śreṇīgatā iva

vulgate_text: bāṇajālavṛte vyomni cchādite ca divākare / na sma sampatate bhūtaṃ kiñcidapyantarikṣagam
ce_text: bāṇajālāvṛte vyomni chādite ca divākare / samasarpat tato bhūtaṃ kiṃ cid eva viśāṃ pate

vulgate_text: te sene hanyamāne tu tābhyāṃ divyairmahāśaraiḥ / śarapātamapākramya tasthatuḥ prekṣike tadā
ce_text: te sene vadhyamāne tu tābhyāṃ divyair mahāśaraiḥ / śarapātam apakramya tataḥ prekṣakavat sthite

vulgate_text: śaraveśmapraviṣṭau tau dadṛśāte na kaiścana / sūryācandramasau rājañchādyamānau ghanairiva
ce_text: śaraveśmapraviṣṭau tau dadṛśāte na kaiś cana / candrasūryau yathā rājaṃś chādyamānau jalāgame

vulgate_text: śatacandraṃ ca taccarma sarvāpakaraṇāni ca / suvarṇavikṛtaṃ tacca dhanuḥ śaramāhave
ce_text: athāsya taṃ rathaṃ tūrṇaṃ tilaśo vyadhamac charaiḥ / patākāṃ cakrarakṣau ca dhvajaṃ khaḍgaṃ ca māriṣa / śatacandraṃ tataś carma sarvopakaraṇāni ca

vulgate_text: yathaiva cāsito meghaḥ śakracāpena śobhitaḥ / aśobhata mahārāja pāṇḍuputrastathā raṇe
ce_text: tataḥ sa śuśubhe rājan kaṇṭhāsaktamahādhanuḥ / pariveṣam anuprāpto yathā syād vyomni candramāḥ / yathaiva ca sito meghaḥ śakracāpena śobhitaḥ

vulgate_text: vadhaprāptaṃ tu taṃ śūro nāhanadvarmavittadā / smṛtvā kuntyā vaco rājaṃstata enaṃ vyasarjayat
ce_text: evam uktvā mahārāja vyasarjayata taṃ tataḥ / vadhaprāptaṃ tu taṃ rājan nāvadhīt sūtanandanaḥ / smṛtvā kuntyā vaco rājaṃs tata enaṃ vyasarjayat

vulgate_text: prāsaiḥ khaṅgaiśca rahitānṛṣṭibhiścāpi bhārata / hayasādīnapaśyāma kañcukoṣṇīṣadhāriṇaḥ
ce_text: prāsaiḥ khaḍgaiś ca saṃsyūtān ṛṣṭibhiś ca narādhipa / hayayodhān apaśyāma kañcukoṣṇīṣadhāriṇaḥ

vulgate_text: vihīnānrathinastatra dhāvamānāṃstatastataḥ / sūtaputraśaraistīkṣṇairhanyamānānviśāmpate
ce_text: vihīnān rathinas tatra dhāvamānān samantataḥ / sūryaputraśarais trastān apaśyāma viśāṃ pate

vulgate_text: viśastrāṃśca tathaivānyānsaśastrāṃśca hatānbahūn / tārakājālasañchannānvaraghaṇṭāviśobhitān
ce_text: viśastrāṃś ca tathaivānyān saśastrāṃś ca bahūn hatān / tāvakāñ jālasaṃchannān uroghaṇṭāvibhūṣitān

vulgate_text: sutamomaṃ tu śakunirvidvvā tu niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ / nākampayata saṅkrudvo vāryogha iva parvatam
ce_text: sutasomas tu śakuniṃ vivyādha niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ / nākampayata saṃrabdho vāryogha iva parvatam

vulgate_text: nākampayata saṅkruddho vāryogha iva parvatam tasyāśvānketanaṃ sūtaṃ tilaśo vyadhamaccharaiḥ / śyālastava mahārāja tata uccukruśurjanāḥ
ce_text: tasyāśvān ketanaṃ sūtaṃ tilaśo vyadhamac charaiḥ / syālas tava mahāvīryas tatas te cukruśur janāḥ

vulgate_text: vyasṛjatsāyakāṃścaiva svarṇapuṅkhāñśilāśitān chādayāmāsuratha te tava śyālasya taṃ ratham / śaḻabhānāmiva vrātāḥ śaravrātā mahāratham
ce_text: chādayām āsur atha te tava syālasya taṃ ratham / pataṃgānām iva vrātāḥ śaravrātā mahāratham

vulgate_text: sañchādyamāno'pi dṛḍhaṃ vivyathe naiva saubalaḥ / pramamātha śarāṃstasya śaravrātairmahāyaśāḥ
ce_text: rathopasthān samīkṣyāpi vivyathe naiva saubalaḥ / pramṛdnaṃś ca śarāṃs tāṃs tāñ śaravrātair mahāyaśāḥ

vulgate_text: sa cchinnadhanvā virathaḥ khaṅgamudyamya cānadat / vaidūryotpalavarṇābhaṃ dantidantamayatsarum
ce_text: sa cchinnadhanvā samare khaḍgam udyamya nānadan / vaiḍūryotpalavarṇābhaṃ hastidantamayatsarum

vulgate_text: ciccheda tāṃstu khaṅgena śikṣayā ca balena ca / darśayam̐llāghavaṃ yuddhe tārkṣyatulyaparākramaḥ
ce_text: ciccheda tāṃś ca khaḍgena śikṣayā ca balena ca / darśayaṃl lāghavaṃ yuddhe tārkṣyavīryasamadyutiḥ

vulgate_text: sa cchinnaḥ sahasā bhūmau nipapāta mahānasiḥ / adharmasya sthitaṃ haste sutsarostatra bhārata
ce_text: sa cchinnaḥ sahasā bhūmau nipapāta mahān asiḥ / avaśasya sthitaṃ haste taṃ khaḍgaṃ satsaruṃ tadā

vulgate_text: tadā jalpanti pāṇḍūnāṃ rathinaḥ sādinastathā / droṇasya nidhanānnūnaṃ saṅkrudvo dvipadāṃ varaḥ
ce_text: tatrāvocan vimanaso rathinaḥ sādinas tathā / droṇasya nidhane nūnaṃ saṃkruddho dvipadāṃ varaḥ

vulgate_text: pārṣataśca mahāyudve vimukho'dyābhilakṣyate ityevaṃ vividhā vācastāvakānāṃ paraiḥ saha / vyaśrūyanta mahārāja tayostatra samāgame
ce_text: pārṣataś ca bhṛśaṃ yuddhe vimukho 'dyāpi lakṣyate / ity evaṃ vividhā vācas tāvakānāṃ paraiḥ saha

vulgate_text: śaṅkhaṃ ca pūrayāmāsa muhurmuhurarindamaḥ / pārṣataṃ trāsayāmāsa mahendro namuciṃ yathā
ce_text: śaṅkhaṃ ca pūrayām āsa muhur muhur ariṃdamaḥ / pārṣataṃ prādravad yantaṃ mahendra iva śambaram

vulgate_text: kṛtavarmā tu saṅkruddho mārgaṇaiḥ kṣatavikṣataḥ / vavāma rudhiraṃ gātraiḥ kumbhavakrādivodakam
ce_text: kṛtavarmā tu saṃkruddho mārgaṇaiḥ kṛtavikṣataḥ / dhanur anyat samādāya samārgaṇagaṇaṃ prabho / śikhaṇḍinaṃ bāṇavaraiḥ skandhadeśe 'bhyatāḍayat

vulgate_text: skandhadeśasthitairbāṇaiḥ śikhaṇḍī tu vyarājata / śākhāpraśākhāvipulaḥ sumahānpādapo yathā
ce_text: skandhadeśe sthitair bāṇaiḥ śikhaṇḍī ca rarāja ha / śākhāpratānair vimalaiḥ sumahān sa yathā drumaḥ

vulgate_text: tāvubhau śaravanunnāṅgau parasparaśarakṣatau / anyonyaśṛṅgābhihatau rejaturvṛṣabhāviva
ce_text: tāv anyonyaṃ bhṛśaṃ viddhvā rudhireṇa samukṣitau / anyonyaśṛṅgābhihatau rejatur vṛṣabhāv iva

vulgate_text: pratyudyayustrigartāstaṃ śibayaḥ kauravaiḥ saha / vasātayo'tha sālvāśca gopālāśca yaśasvinaḥ
ce_text: pratyudyayus trigartās taṃ śibayaḥ kauravaiḥ saha / śālvāḥ saṃśaptakāś caiva nārāyaṇabalaṃ ca yat

vulgate_text: te hanyamānāḥ samare na jahuḥ pāṇḍavaṃ raṇe / hanyamānā mahārāja śalabhā iva pāvakam
ce_text: te vadhyamānāḥ samare nājahuḥ pāṇḍavaṃ tadā / dahyamānā yathā rājañ śalabhā iva pāvakam

vulgate_text: navabhirmitravarmāṇaṃ suśarmāṇaṃ tathā'ṣṭabhiḥ / śrutañjayaṃ ca rājānaṃ hatvā tatra śilāśitaiḥ
ce_text: śatruṃjayaṃ ca rājānaṃ hatvā tatra śilāśitaiḥ / sauśruteḥ saśirastrāṇaṃ śiraḥ kāyād apāharat / tvaritaś candradevaṃ ca śarair ninye yamakṣayam

vulgate_text: pratodaṃ gṛhya so'nyattu raśmīnsaṅgṛhya ca drutam / vāhayāmāsa tānaśvānsatyadevarathaṃ prati
ce_text: sa pratodaṃ punar gṛhya raśmīṃś caiva mahāyaśāḥ / vāhayām āsa tān aśvān satyasenarathaṃ prati

vulgate_text: viṣvaksenaṃ sunirvidvaṃ dṛṣṭvā pārtho dhanañjayaḥ / satyadevaṃ śaraistīkṣṇairvārayitvā mahārathaḥ
ce_text: viṣvaksenaṃ tu nirbhinnaṃ prekṣya pārtho dhanaṃjayaḥ / satyasenaṃ śarais tīkṣṇair dārayitvā mahābalaḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ śarasahasrāṇi prādurāsanviśāmpate / kārmukātpāṇḍuputrasya pārthasyāmitatejasaḥ
ce_text: abhyarditas tu tair jiṣṇuḥ śakratulyaparākramaḥ / aindram astram ameyātmā prāduścakre mahārathaḥ / tataḥ śarasahasrāṇi prādurāsan viśāṃ pate

vulgate_text: tatastu cchidyamānānāṃ dhvajānāṃ dhanuṣāṃ tathā / rathānāṃ sapatākānāṃ tūṇīrāṇāṃ yugaiḥ saha
ce_text: dhvajānāṃ chidyamānānāṃ kārmukāṇāṃ ca saṃyuge / rathānāṃ sapatākānāṃ tūṇīrāṇāṃ śaraiḥ saha

vulgate_text: hārāṇāmatha niṣkāṇāṃ tanutrāṇāṃ ca bhārata chatrāṇāṃ vyajanānāṃ ca śirasāṃ kumuṭaiḥ saha / rāśayaścātra dṛśyante patitānāṃ mahītale
ce_text: hārāṇām atha niṣkāṇāṃ tanutrāṇāṃ ca bhārata / chatrāṇāṃ vyajanānāṃ ca śirasāṃ mukuṭaiḥ saha / aśrūyata mahāñ śabdas tatra tatra viśāṃ pate

vulgate_text: nihatai rājaputraiśca kṣatriyaiśca mahābalaiḥ / arjunena mahārāja tatratatra mahāraṇe
ce_text: nihatai rājaputraiś ca kṣatriyaiś ca mahābalaiḥ / hastibhiḥ patitaiś caiva turagaiś cābhavan mahī / agamyamārgā samare viśīrṇair iva parvataiḥ

vulgate_text: te śūrāḥ samare sarve citraṃ laghu ca suṣṭhu ca / ayudhyanta mahāvegāḥ parasparavadhaiṣiṇaḥ
ce_text: ayudhyanta mahāvegāḥ parasparavadhaiṣiṇaḥ / anyonyaṃ samare jaghnur yodhavratam anuṣṭhitāḥ / na hi te samaraṃ cakruḥ pṛṣṭhato vai kathaṃ cana

vulgate_text: sāśvārohāṃśca turagānviṣāmairvivyadhū ruṣā / apare cikṣipurvegātpragṛhyātibalāstadā
ce_text: sāśvārohāṃś ca turagān viṣāṇair bibhidū raṇe / aparāṃś cikṣipur vegāt pragṛhyātibalās tathā

vulgate_text: sahayāḥ sādinastatra tomareṇa mahāmṛdhe / bhūmāvamṛdranvegena sacarmāṇaṃ padātinam
ce_text: sarathaṃ sādinaṃ tatra apare tu mahāgajāḥ / bhūmāv amṛdnan vegena savarmāṇaṃ patākinam

vulgate_text: cachā sāvaraṇānkāṃścittatratatra viśāmpate rathānnāgāḥ samāsādya parigṛhya ca māriṣa / vyākṣipansahasā tatra ghorarūpe bhayānake
ce_text: rathaṃ nāgāḥ samāsādya dhuri gṛhya ca māriṣa / vyākṣipan sahasā tatra ghorarūpe mahāmṛdhe

vulgate_text: patataścāparo rājanvijahārāsinā śiraḥ / mṛtamanyo mahārāja padā tāḍitavāṃstadā
ce_text: mṛtam anyo mahārāja padbhyāṃ tāḍitavāṃs tadā / jīvataś ca tathaivānyaḥ śastraṃ kāye nyamajjayat

vulgate_text: jīvataśca tathaivānyaḥ śastraṃ kāye nyamajjayat muṣṭiyuddhaṃ mahaccāsīdyodhānāṃ tatra bhārata / tathā keśagrahaścogro bāhuyuddhaṃ ca bhairavam
ce_text: muṣṭiyuddhaṃ mahac cāsīd yodhānāṃ tatra bhārata / tathā keśagrahaś cogro bāhuyuddhaṃ ca kevalam

vulgate_text: agamyarūpā pṛthivī kṣaṇena samapadyata / kṣaṇenāsīnmahīpāla kṣatajaughapravartinī
ce_text: agamyarūpā pṛthivī māṃsaśoṇitakardamā / kṣaṇenāsīn mahārāja kṣatajaughapravartinī

vulgate_text: evameṣa kṣayo vṛttaḥ kurupāṇḍavasenayoḥ / aparāhṇe gate sūrye kāṅkṣatāṃ vipulaṃ yaśaḥ
ce_text: evam eṣa kṣayo vṛttaḥ kurupāṇḍavasenayoḥ / aparāhṇe mahārāja kāṅkṣantyor vipulaṃ jayam

vulgate_text: yathā tvaṃ me kathayase yathā yudvamavartata / na santi sūta kauravyā iti me niścitā matiḥ
ce_text: tathā tu me kathayase yathā yuddhaṃ tu vartate / na santi sūta kauravyā iti me naiṣṭhikī matiḥ

vulgate_text: dīpyamānāṃ mahāvegāṃ maholkāṃ jvalitāmiva / yamadaṇḍanibhāṃ ghorāṃ kālarātrimivāparām
ce_text: tam ālakṣyodyatagadaṃ daṇḍahastam ivāntakam / dharmarājo mahāśaktiṃ prāhiṇot tava sūnave / dīpyamānāṃ mahāvegāṃ maholkāṃ jvalitām iva

vulgate_text: evaṃ tadabhavadyuddhaṃ tvadīyānāṃ paraiḥ saha / aparāhṇe mahārāja kāṅkṣatāṃ vijayaṃ yudhi
ce_text: bhīmo 'pi mahatīṃ gṛhya gadāṃ hemapariṣkṛtām / abhidudrāva vegena kṛtavarmāṇam āhave / evaṃ tad abhavad yuddhaṃ tvadīyānāṃ paraiḥ saha

vulgate_text: na te nindyāḥ praśasyāste yatte cakrurbravīhi tat / tato duryodhanaḥ sūta paścātkimakarottadā / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tataḥ karṇaṃ puraskṛtya tvadīyā yuddhadurmadāḥ / punar āvṛtya saṃgrāmaṃ cakrur devāsuropamam

vulgate_text: evamuktastathetyuktvā so'nujajñe nṛpottamān / te'nujñātā nṛpāḥ sarve svāni veśmāni bhejire
ce_text: evam uktas tathety uktvā so 'nujajñe nṛpottamān / sukhoṣitās te rajanīṃ hṛṣṭā yuddhāya niryayuḥ

vulgate_text: sarveṣāṃ caiva sainyānāṃ karṇamevāgamanmanaḥ / sūtaputraṃ maheṣvāsaṃ bandhumātyayikeṣviva / dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / svena cchandena naḥ sarvān nāvadhīd vyaktam arjunaḥ / na hy asya samare mucyetāntako 'py ātatāyinaḥ

vulgate_text: tato duryodhanaḥ sūta paścātkimakarottadā / yadvo'gamanmano mandāḥ karṇaṃ vaikartanaṃ prati
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / yad vo 'gaman mano mandāḥ karṇaṃ vaikartanaṃ tadā / apy adrākṣata taṃ yūyaṃ śītārtā iva bhāskaram

vulgate_text: apyapaśyata rādheyaṃ śītārtā iva bhāskaram / kṛte'vahāre sainyānāṃ pravṛtte ca raṇe punaḥ
ce_text: kṛte 'vahāre sainyānāṃ pravṛtte ca raṇe punaḥ / kathaṃ vaikartanaḥ karṇas tatrāyudhyata saṃjaya / kathaṃ ca pāṇḍavāḥ sarve yuyudhus tatra sūtajam

vulgate_text: duryodhanaṃ ca tatrājau pāṇḍavena bhṛśārditam / parākrāntānpāṇḍusutāndṛṣṭvā'pi bhṛśārditam
ce_text: duryodhanaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā pāṇḍavena bhṛśārditam / parākrāntān pāṇḍusutān dṛṣṭvā cāpi mahāhave

vulgate_text: yaḥ saubalaṃ tathā tāta nītimāniti manyate / karṇaṃ cāgratimaṃ yudve devairapi durutsaham
ce_text: saubalaṃ ca tathā tāta nītimān iti manyate

vulgate_text: saubalaṃ ca tadā tāta nītimāniti manyate / karṇaśca rabhaso nityaṃ rājā ta cāpyanuvrataḥ
ce_text: saubalaṃ ca tathā tāta nītimān iti manyate

vulgate_text: yadevaṃ vartamāneṣu mahāyudveṣu sañjaya / aśrauṣaṃ nihatānputrānnityameva vinirjitān
ce_text: yuddheṣu nāma divyeṣu vartamāneṣu saṃjaya / aśrauṣaṃ nihatān putrān nityam eva ca nirjitān

vulgate_text: ukto'si bahudhā rājñanmā yudhyasveti pāṇḍavaiḥ / na ca tattvagrahīrdveṣātpāṇḍaveṣu viśāmpate
ce_text: ukto 'si bahudhā rājan mā yudhyasveti pāṇḍavaiḥ / gṛhṇīṣe na ca tan mohāt pāṇḍaveṣu viśāṃ pate

vulgate_text: prāṇe śaurye'tha vijñāne vikrame cāpi bhārata / nimittajñānayoge ca savyasācī na matsamaḥ
ce_text: kāyasya mahato bhede lāghave dūrapātane / sauṣṭhave cāstrayoge ca savyasācī na matsamaḥ

vulgate_text: tena yotsye mahābāhumarjunaṃ jayatāṃ varam yathendraḥ samare sarvāndaiteyānvai samāgatān / nijaghāna tathā sarvāñjeṣyāmi yudhi pāṇḍavān
ce_text: tad divyaṃ bhārgavo mahyam adadād dhanur uttamam / yena yotsye mahābāhum arjunaṃ jayatāṃ varam / yathendraḥ samare sarvān daiteyān vai samāgatān

vulgate_text: jyā tasya dhanuṣo divyā tathā'kṣayye maheṣudhī / sārathistasya govindo mama tādṛṅga vidyate
ce_text: jyā tasya dhanuṣo divyā tathākṣayyau maheṣudhī / tasya divyaṃ dhanuḥ śreṣṭhaṃ gāṇḍīvam ajaraṃ yudhi

vulgate_text: samudyātuṃ na śakṣyanti devā api savāsavāḥ / etatkṛtaṃ mahārāja tvayecchāmi parantapa
ce_text: etat kṛtaṃ mahārāja tvayecchāmi paraṃtapa / evaṃ kṛte kṛtaṃ mahyaṃ sarvakāmair bhaviṣyati

vulgate_text: kriyatāmeṣa kāmo me mā vaḥ kālo'tyagādayam / evaṃ kṛte kṛtaṃ mahyaṃ tvayā sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati
