vulgate_text: tasmātpaśupatiścokto bhavatvācca bhaveti vai ardhamādāya sarveṣāṃ tejasā prajvalanniva
ce_text: duryodhana uvāca / tatas tatheti deveśas tair ukto rājasattama / ardham ādāya sarvebhyas tejasābhyadhiko 'bhavat

vulgate_text: sinīvālīmanumatiṃ kuhūṃ rākāṃ ca suprabhām yoktāṇi cakre cāśvānāṃ kūśmāṇḍāṃścāpi pannagān
ce_text: surāmbupretavittānāṃ patīṃl lokeśvarān hayān / sinīvālīm anumatiṃ kuhūṃ rākāṃ ca suvratām / yoktrāṇi cakrur vāhānāṃ rohakāṃś cāpi kaṇṭhakam

vulgate_text: kālo hi bhagavānrudrastacca saṃvatsaraṃ dhanuḥ / tasmādraudrī kālarātrī jyā kṛtā dhanuṣo jarā
ce_text: vicitram ṛtubhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ kṛtvā saṃvatsaraṃ dhanuḥ / tasmān nṝṇāṃ kālarātrir jyā kṛtā dhanuṣo 'jarā

vulgate_text: agnīṣomātmakaṃ kṛtsnamucyate vaiṣṇavaṃ jagat / viṣṇurātmā bhagavato bhavasyāmitatejasaḥ
ce_text: viṣṇuś cātmā bhagavato bhavasyāmitatejasaḥ / tasmād dhanurjyāsaṃsparśaṃ na viṣehur harasya te

vulgate_text: tasmāddhanurjyāsaṃsparśaṃ sa viṣehe śarasya vai / tasmiñśare tīkṣṇamanyumamuñcadduḥsahaṃ prabhuḥ
ce_text: viṣṇuś cātmā bhagavato bhavasyāmitatejasaḥ / tasmād dhanurjyāsaṃsparśaṃ na viṣehur harasya te

vulgate_text: ādityāyutasaṅkāśastejojvālāvṛto bhavaḥ / duścaryacyāvako jetā hantā brahmadviṣāṃ varaḥ
ce_text: sa nīlalohito dhūmraḥ kṛttivāsā bhayaṃkaraḥ / ādityāyutasaṃkāśas tejojvālāvṛto jvalan

vulgate_text: etacchrutvā vaco devāḥ sarve gatvā pitāmaham / praṇipatyocurekāgrāḥ prasādyainaṃ maharṣibhiḥ
ce_text: etac chrutvā tato devā vākyam uktaṃ mahātmanā / gatvā pitāmahaṃ devaṃ prasādyaivaṃ vaco 'bruvan

vulgate_text: taṃ praviṣṭā rathaṃ devā rathayodvārameva ca / kavacāni ca śastrāṇi kārmukaṃ ca pitāmaha
ce_text: tatra sārathir eṣṭavyaḥ sarvair etair viśeṣavān / tatpratiṣṭho ratho deva hayā yoddhā tathaiva ca / kavacāni ca śastrāṇi kārmukaṃ ca pitāmaha

vulgate_text: sarvathā rathinaḥ śreyānkartavyo rathasārathiḥ tasmādetadyathātattvaṃ jñātvā yuṣmāṃśca saṅgatān / saṃyacchāmi hayāneṣa vibudhāya kapardine / duryodhana uvāca
ce_text: duryodhana uvāca / bhūya eva tu madreśa yat te vakṣyāmi tac chṛṇu / yathā purā vṛttam idaṃ yuddhe devāsure vibho

vulgate_text: sārathau kalpite devairīśānasya mahātmanaḥ tasminnārohati rathaṃ kalpitaṃ lokasambhṛtam / śirobhiḥ patitā bhūmau turagā vedasambhṛtāḥ
ce_text: tataḥ sa bhagavān devo lokasraṣṭā pitāmahaḥ / sārathye kalpito devair īśānasya mahātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: tato'dhirūḍhe varade rathaṃ paśupatistadā / sādhusādhviti deveśaṃ smayamāno'bhyabhāṣata
ce_text: tato 'dhirūḍhe varade prayāte cāsurān prati / sādhu sādhv iti viśveśaḥ smayamāno 'bhyabhāṣata

vulgate_text: tato'śvāṃścodayāmāsa manomārutaraṃhasaḥ / purāṇyuddiśya khasthāni dānavānāṃ tarasvinām
ce_text: abhīśūn hi trilokeśaḥ saṃgṛhya prapitāmahaḥ / tān aśvāṃś codayām āsa manomārutaraṃhasaḥ / tata utthāpya bhagavāṃs tān hayān anilopamān / babhāṣe ca tadā sthāṇum āroheti surottamaḥ / tatas tam iṣum ādāya viṣṇusomāgnisaṃbhavam / āruroha tadā sthāṇur dhanuṣā kampayan parān / tam ārūḍhaṃ tu deveśaṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ paramarṣayaḥ / gandharvā devasaṃghāś ca tathaivāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ / sa śobhamāno varadaḥ khaḍgī bāṇī śarāsanī / pradīpayan rathe tasthau trīṃl lokān svena tejasā / tato bhūyo 'bravīd devo devān indrapurogamān / na hanyād iti kartavyo na śoko vaḥ kathaṃ cana / hatān ity eva jānīta bāṇenānena cāsurān / te devāḥ satyam ity āhur nihatā iti cābruvan / na ca tad vacanaṃ mithyā yad āha bhagavān prabhuḥ / iti saṃcintya vai devāḥ parāṃ tuṣṭim avāpnuvan / tataḥ prayāto deveśaḥ sarvair devagaṇair vṛtaḥ / rathena mahatā rājann upamā nāsti yasya ha / svaiś ca pāriṣadair devaḥ pūjyamāno mahāyaśāḥ / nṛtyadbhir aparaiś caiva māṃsabhakṣair durāsadaiḥ / dhāvamānaiḥ samantāc ca tarjamānaiḥ parasparam / ṛṣayaś ca mahābhāgās tapoyuktā mahāguṇāḥ / āśaṃsur vai jayaṃ devā mahādevasya sarvaśaḥ / evaṃ prayāte deveśe lokānām abhayaṃkare / tuṣṭam āsīj jagat sarvaṃ devatāś ca narottama / ṛṣayas tatra deveśaṃ stuvanto bahubhiḥ stavaiḥ / tejaś cāsmai vardhayanto rājann āsan punaḥ punaḥ / gandharvāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi prayutāny arbudāni ca / vādayanti prayāṇe 'sya vādyāni vividhāni ca

vulgate_text: tasminsthite tato rājanrudre sajjitakārmuke / purāṇi tena kālena jagmurekatvamāśu vai
ce_text: tasmin sthite tadā rājan kruddhe vidhṛtakārmuke / purāṇi tāni kālena jagmur ekatvatāṃ tadā

vulgate_text: trīṇi dṛṣṭvaiva saṃsthāni purāṇyatha pinākadhṛt sa tadvikṛṣya bhagavāndivyaṃ lokeśvaro dhanuḥ / trailokyasāraṃ tamiṣuṃ mumoca tripuraṃ prati
ce_text: sa tad vikṛṣya bhagavān divyaṃ lokeśvaro dhanuḥ / trailokyasāraṃ tam iṣuṃ mumoca tripuraṃ prati / tat sāsuragaṇaṃ dagdhvā prākṣipat paścimārṇave

vulgate_text: bāṇatejognidagdhaṃ tadviprakīrṇaṃ sahasradhā mahadārtasvaraṃ kṛtvā nāvaśeṣamupāgatam / madreśa sāsuragaṇaṃ prāpatatpaścimārṇave
ce_text: sa tad vikṛṣya bhagavān divyaṃ lokeśvaro dhanuḥ / trailokyasāraṃ tam iṣuṃ mumoca tripuraṃ prati / tat sāsuragaṇaṃ dagdhvā prākṣipat paścimārṇave

vulgate_text: sa cātmakrodhajo vihnirdahetyukto nivāritaḥ / trailokyamaviśeṣeṇa punardagdhuṃ pracakrame
ce_text: sa cātmakrodhajo vahnir hāhety uktvā nivāritaḥ / mā kārṣīr bhasmasāl lokān iti tryakṣo 'bravīc ca tam

vulgate_text: kālāgnimiva nirdagdhumutthitaṃ taṃ punaḥ punaḥ / mākārṣīrbhasmāsāllokāniti tryakṣo'bravīdvacaḥ
ce_text: sa cātmakrodhajo vahnir hāhety uktvā nivāritaḥ / mā kārṣīr bhasmasāl lokān iti tryakṣo 'bravīc ca tam

vulgate_text: tataḥ prakṛtimāpannā delokāstatharṣayaḥ / tuṣṭuvurvāgbhiragryābhiḥ sthāṇuṃ tripuravairiṇam
ce_text: tataḥ prakṛtim āpannā devā lokās tatharṣayaḥ / tuṣṭuvur vāgbhir arthyābhiḥ sthāṇum apratimaujasam

vulgate_text: evaṃ rudrasya kṛtavānsārathyaṃ tu pitāmahaḥ / saṃyaccha turagānasya rādheyasya mahātmanaḥ
ce_text: yathaiva bhagavān brahmā lokadhātā pitāmahaḥ / saṃyaccha tvaṃ hayān asya rādheyasya mahātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: tvaṃ hi kṛṣṇācca karṇācca phalgunācca guṇādhikaḥ / balato rūpato yogādastrasampada eva ca
ce_text: tvaṃ hi kṛṣṇāc ca karṇāc ca phalgunāc ca viśeṣataḥ / viśiṣṭo rājaśārdūla nāsti tatra vicāraṇā

vulgate_text: vṛjinaṃ na bhavetkiñcidasya karṇasya pārthiva / sūtena vardhito nityaṃ na sūto nṛpa eva saḥ
ce_text: vṛjinaṃ hi bhavet kiṃ cid yadi karṇasya pārthiva / nāsmai hy astrāṇi divyāni prādāsyad bhṛgunandanaḥ

vulgate_text: viśuddhayoniṃ vijñāya divyānyastrāṇyadādbhṛguḥ nāpi sūtakule jātaṃ manye karṇaṃ kathañcana / devaputramadaṃ manye kṣatriyāṇāṃ kulodbhavam
ce_text: nāpi sūtakule jātaṃ karṇaṃ manye kathaṃ cana / devaputram ahaṃ manye kṣatriyāṇāṃ kulodbhavam

ce_text: sakuṇḍalaṃ sakavacaṃ dīrghabāhuṃ mahāratham / katham ādityasadṛśaṃ mṛgī vyāghraṃ janiṣyati

vulgate_text: tato duryodhano bhūyo madrarājaṃ tarasvinam / uvāca rājansaṅgrāme'dhyuṣite paryupasthite
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tato duryodhano bhūyo madrarājaṃ tarasvinam / uvāca rājan saṃgrāme saṃyacchantaṃ hayottamān

vulgate_text: karṇasya yaccha saṅgrāme madrarāja hayottamān / tvayā'bhigupto rādheyo vijeṣyati dhanañjayam
ce_text: tvayābhigupto rādheyo vijeṣyati dhanaṃjayam / ity ukto ratham āsthāya tatheti prāha bhārata

vulgate_text: etacchrutvā vacastasya śalyaḥ karṇaṃ vaco'bravīt / kathaṃ nu tānmahāvīryānpāṇḍavānavamanyase
ce_text: śalya uvāca / sūtaputra kathaṃ nu tvaṃ pāṇḍavān avamanyase / sarvāstrajñān maheṣvāsān sarvān eva mahārathān

vulgate_text: asyataḥ kṣiṇvataścārīm̐llaghuhastāndurāsadān / pārthivāgapi cānyāṃstvaṃ tadā naivaṃ vadiṣyasi / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: rathinābhyadhiko vīraḥ kartavyo rathasārathiḥ / tasmāt tvaṃ puruṣavyāghra niyaccha turagān yudhi / yathā devagaṇais tatra vṛto yatnāt pitāmahaḥ / tathāsmābhir bhavān yatnāt karṇād abhyadhiko vṛtaḥ / yathā devair mahārāja īśvarād adhiko vṛtaḥ / tathā bhavān api kṣipraṃ rudrasyeva pitāmahaḥ / śalya uvāca / niyaccha turagān yuddhe rādheyasya mahādyute / mayāpy etan naraśreṣṭha bahuśo narasiṃhayoḥ / kathyamānaṃ śrutaṃ divyam ākhyānam atimānuṣam / yathā ca cakre sārathyaṃ bhavasya prapitāmahaḥ / yathāsurāś ca nihatā iṣuṇaikena bhārata / kṛṣṇasya cāpi viditaṃ sarvam etat purā hy abhūt / yathā pitāmaho jajñe bhagavān sārathis tadā / anāgatam atikrāntaṃ veda kṛṣṇo 'pi tattvataḥ / etadarthaṃ viditvāpi sārathyam upajagmivān / svayaṃbhūr iva rudrasya kṛṣṇaḥ pārthasya bhārata / yadi hanyāc ca kaunteyaṃ sūtaputraḥ kathaṃ cana / dṛṣṭvā pārthaṃ hi nihataṃ svayaṃ yotsyati keśavaḥ / śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇir dhakṣyate tava vāhinīm / na cāpi tasya kruddhasya vārṣṇeyasya mahātmanaḥ / saṃjaya uvāca / sthāsyate pratyanīkeṣu kaś cid atra nṛpas tava / taṃ tathā bhāṣamāṇaṃ tu madrarājam ariṃdamaḥ / pratyuvāca mahābāhur adīnātmā sutas tava / māvamaṃsthā mahābāho karṇaṃ vaikartanaṃ raṇe / sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvaśāstrārthapāragam / yasya jyātalanirghoṣaṃ śrutvā bhayaṃkaraṃ mahat / pāṇḍaveyāni sainyāni vidravanti diśo daśa / pratyakṣaṃ te mahābāho yathā rātrau ghaṭotkacaḥ / māyāśatāni kurvāṇo hato māyāpuraskṛtaḥ / na cātiṣṭhata bībhatsuḥ pratyanīke kathaṃ cana / etāṃś ca divasān sarvān bhayena mahatā vṛtaḥ / bhīmasenaś ca balavān dhanuṣkoṭyābhicoditaḥ / uktaś ca saṃjñayā rājan mūḍha audariko yathā / mādrīputrau tathā śūrau yena jitvā mahāraṇe / kam apy arthaṃ puraskṛtya na hatau yudhi māriṣa / yena vṛṣṇipravīras tu sātyakiḥ sātvatāṃ varaḥ / nirjitya samare śūro virathaś ca balātkṛtaḥ / sṛñjayāś cetare sarve dhṛṣṭadyumnapurogamāḥ / asakṛn nirjitāḥ saṃkhye smayamānena saṃyuge / taṃ kathaṃ pāṇḍavā yuddhe vijeṣyanti mahāratham / yo hanyāt samare kruddho vajrahastaṃ puraṃdaram / tvaṃ ca sarvāstravid vīraḥ sarvavidyāstrapāragaḥ / bāhuvīryeṇa te tulyaḥ pṛthivyāṃ nāsti kaś cana / tvaṃ śalyabhūtaḥ śatrūṇām aviṣahyaḥ parākrame / tatas tvam ucyase rājañ śalya ity arisūdana / tava bāhubalaṃ prāpya na śekuḥ sarvasātvatāḥ / tava bāhubalād rājan kiṃ nu kṛṣṇo balādhikaḥ / yathā hi kṛṣṇena balaṃ dhāryaṃ vai phalgune hate / tathā karṇātyayībhāve tvayā dhāryaṃ mahad balam / kimarthaṃ samare sainyaṃ vāsudevo nyavārayat / kimarthaṃ ca bhavān sainyaṃ na haniṣyati māriṣa / tvatkṛte padavīṃ gantum iccheyaṃ yudhi māriṣa / śalya uvāca / sodarāṇāṃ ca vīrāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ ca mahīkṣitām / yan māṃ bravīṣi gāndhāre agre sainyasya mānada / viśiṣṭaṃ devakīputrāt prītimān asmy ahaṃ tvayi / eṣa sārathyam ātiṣṭhe rādheyasya yaśasvinaḥ / yudhyataḥ pāṇḍavāgryeṇa yathā tvāṃ vīra manyase / samayaś ca hi me vīra kaś cid vaikartanaṃ prati / saṃjaya uvāca / utsṛjeyaṃ yathāśraddham ahaṃ vāco 'sya saṃnidhau / tatheti rājan putras te saha karṇena māriṣa / abravīn madrarājānaṃ sarvakṣatrasya saṃnidhau / sārathyasyābhyupagamāc chalyenāśvāsitas tadā / duryodhanas tadā hṛṣṭaḥ karṇaṃ tam abhiṣasvaje / abravīc ca punaḥ karṇaṃ stūyamānaḥ sutas tava / jahi pārthān raṇe sarvān mahendro dānavān iva / sa śalyenābhyupagate hayānāṃ saṃniyacchane / karṇo hṛṣṭamanā bhūyo duryodhanam abhāṣata / nātihṛṣṭamanā hy eṣa madrarājo 'bhibhāṣate / rājan madhurayā vācā punar enaṃ bravīhi vai / tato rājā mahāprājñaḥ sarvāstrakuśalo balī / duryodhano 'bravīc chalyaṃ madrarājaṃ mahīpatim / pūrayann iva ghoṣeṇa meghagambhīrayā girā / śalya karṇo 'rjunenādya yoddhavyam iti vulgate_text: kṛtaghnatā paravittāpahāro madyapānaṃ gurudārāvamardaḥ / vākpāruṣyaṃ govadho rātricaryā bahirgehaṃ paravastropabhogaḥ
ce_text: kṛtaghnatā paravittāpahāraḥ; surāpānaṃ gurudārāvamarśaḥ / yeṣāṃ dharmas tān prati nāsty adharma; āraṭṭakān pāñcanadān dhig astu

vulgate_text: iṅgita āśca magadhāḥ prekṣitajñāśca kosalāḥ / ardhoktāḥ kurupāñcālāḥ sarvoktā dākṣiṇāpathāḥ
ce_text: iṅgitajñāś ca magadhāḥ prekṣitajñāś ca kosalāḥ / ardhoktāḥ kurupāñcālāḥ śālvāḥ kṛtsnānuśāsanāḥ / pārvatīyāś ca viṣamā yathaiva girayas tathā

vulgate_text: evaṃ jñātvā joṣamāssva pratīpaṃ mā sma kruddhaḥ pāpabhṛtāṃ variṣṭha / pūrvaṃ hatvā tvāṃ saputraṃ balaiśca paścāddhaṃsye vāsudevārjunau ca / śalya uvāca
ce_text: etaj jñātvā joṣam āssva pratīpaṃ mā sma vai kṛthāḥ / sa tvāṃ pūrvam ahaṃ hatvā haniṣye keśavārjunau

vulgate_text: na karṇa deśasāmānyātsarvaḥ pāpaṃ niṣevate / yādṛśāḥ svasvabhāvena deśāṃstāṃstādṛśānviduḥ / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / madrādhipasyādhirathis tadaivaṃ; vaco niśamyāpriyam apratītaḥ / uvāca śalyaṃ viditaṃ mamaitad; yathāvidhāv arjunavāsudevau

vulgate_text: paśya karṇa mahāghoraṃ bhayaṃ vai romaharṣaṇam / arkaṃ jīmūtasaṅkāśaḥ kabandho vārya tiṣṭhati
ce_text: paśya karṇa mahāghoraṃ bhayadaṃ lomaharṣaṇam / kabandhaṃ meghasaṃkāśaṃ bhānum āvṛtya saṃsthitam

vulgate_text: paśya yūthaṃ mṛgaśataṃ mṛgāṇāṃ sarvatodiśam / rarāsa dīptalāṅgūlamādityāmabhi saṃsthitam
ce_text: paśya yūthair bahuvidhair mṛgāṇāṃ sarvatodiśam / balibhir dṛptaśārdūlair ādityo 'bhinirīkṣyate

vulgate_text: paśya kākāṃśca gṛdhrāṃśca samavetānsahasraśaḥ / ādityamabhivīkṣante hyaśivāḥ karṇa sasvarāḥ
ce_text: paśya kaṅkāṃś ca gṛdhrāṃś ca samavetān sahasraśaḥ / sthitān abhimukhān ghorān anyonyam abhibhāṣataḥ

vulgate_text: gajāśvarathapattyoghāṃstāvakānyudhi nighnataḥ / dhvajāgraṃ dṛśyate tasya jyāśabdaścaiva śrūyate
ce_text: nāgāśvarathapattyaughāṃs tāvakān samabhighnataḥ / dhvajāgraṃ dṛśyate tv asya jyāśabdaś cāpi śrūyate

vulgate_text: ete tiṣṭhanti kārṣṇeyāḥ pañca pañcācalā iva / yotsyamānā mahāvīryā bhīmārjunasamā yudhi
ce_text: dṛśyanta ete kārṣṇeyāḥ pañca pañcācalā iva / vyavasthitā yotsyamānāḥ sarve 'rjunasamā yudhi

vulgate_text: teṣāṃ padātā nāgānāṃ pādarakṣāḥ samantataḥ / paṭṭasāsidharāḥ śūrāścāpabāṇamusuṇṭhinaḥ
ce_text: teṣāṃ padātināgānāṃ pādarakṣāḥ sahasraśaḥ / paṭṭiśāsidharāḥ śūrā babhūvur anivartinaḥ

vulgate_text: bhiṇḍipāladharāścaiva śūralahastāḥ sucakriṇaḥ / teṣāṃ samāgamo ghoro devāsuraraṇopamaḥ / dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ uvāca
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / kathaṃ saṃjaya rādheyaḥ pratyavyūhata pāṇḍavān / dhṛṣṭadyumnamukhān vīrān bhīmasenābhirakṣitān

vulgate_text: kathaṃ sañjaya rādheyaḥ pratyavyūhata pāṇḍavān dhṛṣṭadyumnamukhānsaṅkhye bhīmasenābhirakṣitān / sarvāneva maheṣvāsānajayyānamarairapi
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / kathaṃ saṃjaya rādheyaḥ pratyavyūhata pāṇḍavān / dhṛṣṭadyumnamukhān vīrān bhīmasenābhirakṣitān

vulgate_text: tatsamīpagataṃ hyetatpratyamitraṃ mahadbūlam / yathā nābhibhavatyasmāṃstathā nītirvidhīyatām / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tataḥ punar mahārāja madrarājam ariṃdamam / abhyabhāṣata rādheyaḥ saṃnivāryottaraṃ vacaḥ

vulgate_text: yathā yathā bhavānāha tattathā na tadanyathā yattasya vihitaṃ kāryaṃ tatkariṣyāmi suvrata / pradhānamatha caivāsya vināśaṃ ca karomyaham
ce_text: yas tv asya vihito ghātas taṃ kariṣyāmi bhārata / pradhānavadha evāsya vināśas taṃ karomy aham

vulgate_text: tatsaṃsthimatho dṛṣṭvā pratyamitraṃ mahadbalam / pratyavyūhattataḥ karṇo hitārthaṃ tanayasya te
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tat sthāne samavasthāpya pratyamitraṃ mahābalam / avyūhatārjuno vyūhaṃ putrasya tava durnaye

vulgate_text: tadaśvasaṅghabahulaṃ pattināgarathākulam / udīryamāṇaṃ saṃrabdhaṃ dhanañjayamabhidravat
ce_text: tad aśvasaṃghabahulaṃ mattanāgarathākulam / pattimac chūravīraughair drutam arjunam ādravat

vulgate_text: sa purastādarīnhatvā punaruttarato'vadhīt / dakṣiṇena ca paścācca kruddho rudraḥ paśūniva
ce_text: sa purastād arīn hatvā paścārdhenottareṇa ca / dakṣiṇena ca bībhatsuḥ kruddho rudraḥ paśūn iva

vulgate_text: jagrāheṣuvarānvīraḥ śīghraṃ vai daśa pañca ca / sātyakirvṛṣasenasya sūtaṃ hatvā tribhiḥ śaraiḥ
ce_text: sātyakir vṛṣasenasya hatvā sūtaṃ tribhiḥ śaraiḥ / dhanuś ciccheda bhallena jaghānāśvāṃś ca saptabhiḥ / dhvajam ekeṣuṇonmathya tribhis taṃ hṛdy atāḍayat

vulgate_text: athāvasannaḥ svarathe muhūrtātpunarutthitaḥ sa raṇe yuyudhānena visūtāśvarathadhvajaḥ / kṛto jighāṃsuḥ śaineyaṃ khaṅgacarmadhṛgabhyayāt
ce_text: athāvasannaḥ svarathe muhūrtāt punar utthitaḥ / atho jighāṃsuḥ śaineyaṃ khaḍgacarmabhṛd abhyayāt

vulgate_text: śikhaṇḍinaṃ ca daśabhirdharmarājaṃ śatena ca / etāṃścānyāṃśca rājendra pravīrāñcayagṛddhinaḥ
ce_text: ete cānye ca rājendra pravīrā jayagṛddhinaḥ / abhyardayan maheṣvāsaṃ sūtaputraṃ mahāmṛdhe

vulgate_text: abhyardayanmaheṣvāsaḥ karṇaputro viśāmpate / karṇasya yudhi durdharṣastataḥ pṛṣṭhamapālayat
ce_text: athānyaṃ ratham āsthāya vṛṣaseno mahārathaḥ / karṇasya yudhi durdharṣaḥ punaḥ pṛṣṭham apālayat

vulgate_text: tataste tu pare rājañchikhaṇḍī ca sasātyakiḥ rādheyātparirakṣanto rājānaṃ paryavārayan / muñcanto vividhānbāṇānsvarṇapuṅkhāñśilāśitān
ce_text: tatas te pāṇḍavā rājañ śikhaṇḍī ca sasātyakiḥ / rādheyāt parirakṣanto rājānaṃ paryavārayan

vulgate_text: tato yudhiṣṭhiraḥ karṇamadūrasthaṃ nivāritam / tairyodhapramukhairvīraṃ dṛṣṭvā vivyādha sāyakaiḥ
ce_text: tato yudhiṣṭhiraḥ karṇam adūrasthaṃ nivāritam / abravīt paravīraghnaḥ krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ kṣurābhyāṃ pāñcālyau cakrarakṣau mahātmanaḥ / jaghāna candradevaṃ ca daṇḍadhāraṃ ca saṃyuge
ce_text: tataḥ kṣurābhyāṃ pāñcālyau cakrarakṣau mahātmanaḥ / jaghāna samare śūraḥ śaraiḥ saṃnataparvabhiḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ prahasyādhirathiḥ ṣaṣṭhyā rājañśitaiḥ śaraiḥ / viddhvā yudhiṣṭhiraṃ saṅkhye nanādātirathastadā
ce_text: tataḥ prahasyādhirathir vidhunvānaḥ sa kārmukam / bhittvā bhallena rājānaṃ viddhvā ṣaṣṭyānadan mudā

vulgate_text: sa pāṇḍavānāṃ pravaraiḥ sarvataḥ samabhidrutaḥ / chādyamānaḥ śitatairghoraiḥ svasvanāmāṅkitaiḥ śaraiḥ
ce_text: sa pāṇḍavānāṃ pravaraiḥ sarvataḥ samabhidrutaḥ / udairayad brāhmam astraṃ śaraiḥ saṃpūrayan diśaḥ

vulgate_text: tadvarma hemavikṛtaṃ ratnacitraṃ babhau patat / savidyudabhraṃ savituḥ śliṣṭaṃ vātahataṃ yathā
ce_text: tad varma hemavikṛtaṃ rarāja nipatat tadā / savidyudabhraṃ savituḥ śiṣṭaṃ vātahataṃ yathā

vulgate_text: bhinnavarmā śaraiḥ pārtho rudhireṇa samukṣitaḥ / babhāse puruṣaśreṣṭha udyanniva divākaraḥ
ce_text: sa vivarmā śaraiḥ pārtho rudhireṇa samukṣitaḥ / kruddhaḥ sarvāyasīṃ śaktiṃ cikṣepādhirathiṃ prati

vulgate_text: tāṃ jvalantīmivākāśe śaktiṃ śaptabhirāśugaiḥ / bhallaiściccheda rādheyaḥ sā tvaśīryata vai raṇe
ce_text: tāṃ jvalantīm ivākāśe śaraiś ciccheda saptabhiḥ / sā chinnā bhūmim apatan maheṣvāsasya sāyakaiḥ

vulgate_text: udbhinnarudhiraḥ karṇaḥ krudvaḥ sarpa iva śvasan / jaghāna sūtaṃ pārthasya pārṣṭhiṃ ca navabhiḥ śaraiḥ
ce_text: udbhinnarudhiraḥ karṇaḥ kruddhaḥ sarpa iva śvasan / dhvajaṃ ciccheda bhallena tribhir vivyādha pāṇḍavam / iṣudhī cāsya ciccheda rathaṃ ca tilaśo 'cchinat / etasminn antare śūrāḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ mahārathāḥ / vavarṣuḥ śaravarṣāṇi rādheyaṃ prati bhārata / sātyakiḥ pañcaviṃśatyā śikhaṇḍī navabhiḥ śaraiḥ / avarṣatāṃ mahārāja rādheyaṃ śatrukarśanam / śaineyaṃ tu tataḥ kruddhaḥ karṇaḥ pañcabhir āyasaiḥ / vivyādha samare rājaṃs tribhiś cānyaiḥ śilīmukhaiḥ / dakṣiṇaṃ tu bhujaṃ tasya tribhiḥ karṇo 'py avidhyata / savyaṃ ṣoḍaśabhir bāṇair yantāraṃ cāsya saptabhiḥ / athāsya caturo vāhāṃś caturbhir niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ / sūtaputro 'nayat kṣipraṃ yamasya sadanaṃ prati / apareṇātha bhallena dhanuś chittvā mahārathaḥ / sāratheḥ saśirastrāṇaṃ śiraḥ kāyād apāharat / hatāśvasūte tu rathe sthitaḥ sa śinipuṃgavaḥ / śaktiṃ cikṣepa karṇāya vaiḍūryamaṇibhūṣitām / tām āpatantīṃ sahasā dvidhā ciccheda bhārata / karṇo vai dhanvināṃ śreṣṭhas tāṃś ca sarvān avārayat / tatas tān niśitair bāṇaiḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ mahārathān / nyavārayad ameyātmā śikṣayā ca balena ca / ardayitvā śarais tāṃs tu siṃhaḥ kṣudramṛgān iva / pīḍayan dharmarājānaṃ śaraiḥ saṃnataparvabhiḥ / abhyadravata rādheyo dharmaputraṃ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ pārṣo hyapāsāsīdvatāśvo hatasārathiḥ / aśaknuvanmukhe sthātuṃ tataḥ karṇasya durmanāḥ
ce_text: evaṃ pārtho vyapāyāt sa nihataprārṣṭisārathiḥ / aśaknuvan pramukhataḥ sthātuṃ karṇasya durmanāḥ

vulgate_text: mā sma yudhyasva kaunteya mā sma vīrānsamāsadaḥ / mā caivaṃ vipriyaṃ brūhi mā ca tvaṃ bhaja saṃyugam
ce_text: mā sma yudhyasva kaunteya mā ca vīrān samāsadaḥ / mā cainān apriyaṃ brūhi mā ca vraja mahāraṇam

vulgate_text: svagṛhaṃ gaccha kaunteya yatra vā keśavārjunau / na hi tvāṃ samare rājanhanyātkarṇaḥ kathañcana / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tat sthāne samavasthāpya pratyamitraṃ mahābalam / avyūhatārjuno vyūhaṃ putrasya tava durnaye

vulgate_text: kālyamānaṃ balaṃ dṛṣṭvā sūtaputreṇa māriṣa / svānyodhānabravītkrudvo nighnataitānkimāsata
ce_text: kālyamānaṃ balaṃ dṛṣṭvā dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / tān yodhān abravīt kruddho hatainaṃ vai sahasraśaḥ

vulgate_text: āgacchata praharata kṣipraṃ viparidhāvata / iti bruvāṇā hyanyonyaṃ jaghnuryodhā mahāraṇe
ce_text: uttiṣṭhata praharata praitābhipatateti ca / iti bruvāṇā anyonyaṃ jaghnur yodhā raṇājire

vulgate_text: vipatākadhvajacchatrā vyaśvasūtarathāyudhāḥ vyaṅgāṅgāvayavāḥ petuḥ kṣitau kṣīṇāḥ kṣitīśvarāḥ / śikharāṇīva śelānāṃ vajrabhinnāni māniṣa
ce_text: vipatākādhvajacchatrā vyaśvasūtāyudhā raṇe / vyaṅgāṅgāvayavāḥ petuḥ kṣitau kṣīṇā hateśvarāḥ

vulgate_text: sārohā nihatāḥ peturdvipā bhinnā mahītale / chinnabhinnaviparyastavarmālaṅkāravigrahāḥ
ce_text: chinnabhinnaviparyastair varmālaṃkāravigrahaiḥ / sārohās turagāḥ petur hatavīrāḥ sahasraśaḥ

vulgate_text: lohitodā mahāghorā māṃsaśoṇitakardamā / narāśvagajadehānvai vahantī bhīrubhīṣaṇā
ce_text: narāśvagajasaṃbādhe narāśvagajasādinām / lohitodā mahāghorā nadī lohitakardamā / narāśvagajadehān sā vahantī bhīrubhīṣaṇī

vulgate_text: trailokyasya samastasya śaktaḥ kruddho nivāraṇe / bibharti sadṛśaṃ rūpaṃ yugāntāgnisamaprabham / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / vidārya karṇas tāṃ senāṃ dharmarājam upādravat / rathahastyaśvapattīnāṃ sahasraiḥ parivāritaḥ

vulgate_text: abhiyāhi mahābāho bhīmasenaṃ mahābalam / nirapekṣaśca yudhyasva śaktiṃ svāṃ sampradarśayan
ce_text: abhiyāsi mahābāho bhīmasenaṃ mahābalam / nirasya bhīmasenaṃ tu tataḥ prāpsyasi phalgunam

vulgate_text: evamukte tataḥ karṇaḥ śalyaṃ punarabhāṣata / hantā'hamenaṃ saṃrabdhaṃ māṃ vā hantā vṛkodaraḥ
ce_text: evam ukte tataḥ karṇaḥ śalyaṃ punar abhāṣata / hantāham arjunaṃ saṃkhye māṃ vā hantā dhanaṃjayaḥ / yuddhe manaḥ samādhāya yāhi yāhīty acodayat

vulgate_text: evamuktvā mahārāja rādheyo rathināṃ varaḥ / yuddhe manaḥ samādhāya yāhi yāhītyacodayat
ce_text: evam ukte tataḥ karṇaḥ śalyaṃ punar abhāṣata / hantāham arjunaṃ saṃkhye māṃ vā hantā dhanaṃjayaḥ / yuddhe manaḥ samādhāya yāhi yāhīty acodayat

vulgate_text: tato muhūrtādrājendra nātikṛcchrāddhasanniva / bhīmaseno mahābāhuḥ karṇaṃ prepsurabhidravat
ce_text: tato muhūrtād rājendra nātikṛcchrād dhasann iva / virathaṃ bhīmakarmāṇaṃ bhīmaṃ karṇaś cakāra ha

vulgate_text: sa bhīmasenābhihataḥ sūtaputraḥ kurūdvaha niṣasāda rathopasthe visaṃjñaḥ pṛtanāpatiḥ / rudhireṇāvasiktāṅgo gatāsuvadarindamaḥ
ce_text: sa bhīmasenābhihato sūtaputraḥ kurūdvaha / niṣasāda rathopasthe visaṃjñaḥ pṛtanāpatiḥ / etasminn antare dṛṣṭvā madrarājo vṛkodaram / jihvāṃ chettuṃ samāyāntaṃ sāntvayann idam abravīt / bhīmasena mahābāho yat tvā vakṣyāmi tac chṛṇu / vacanaṃ hetusaṃpannaṃ śrutvā caitat tathā kuru / arjunena pratijñāto vadhaḥ karṇasya śuṣmiṇaḥ / bhīma uvāca / tāṃ tathā kuru bhadraṃ te pratijñāṃ savyasācinaḥ / dṛḍhavratatvaṃ pārthasya jānāmi nṛpasattama / rājñas tu dharṣaṇaṃ pāpaḥ kṛtavān mama saṃnidhau / tataḥ krodhābhibhūtena śeṣaṃ na gaṇitaṃ mayā / patite cāpi rādheye na me manyuḥ śamaṃ gataḥ / jihvoddharaṇam evāsya prāptakālaṃ mataṃ mama / anena tu nṛśaṃsena samaveteṣu rājasu / asmākaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ kṛṣṇā yāni vākyāni mātula / asahyāni ca nīcena bahūni śrāvitāni bhoḥ / nūnaṃ te tat parijñātaṃ dūrasthasyāpi pārthiva / chedanaṃ cāsya jihvāyās tad evākāṅkṣitaṃ mayā / rājñas tu priyakāmena kālo 'yaṃ paripālitaḥ / bhavatā tu yad ukto 'smi vākyaṃ hetvarthasaṃhitam / tad gṛhītaṃ mahārāja kaṭukastham ivauṣadham / hīnapratijño bībhatsur na hi jīveta karhi cit / asmin vinaṣṭe naṣṭāḥ smaḥ sarva eva sakeśavāḥ / adya caiva nṛśaṃsātmā pāpaḥ pāpakṛtāṃ varaḥ / gamiṣyati parābhāvaṃ dṛṣṭamātraḥ kirīṭinā / yudhiṣṭhirasya kopena pūrvaṃ dagdho nṛśaṃsakṛt / tvayā saṃrakṣitas tv adya matsamīpād upāyataḥ

vulgate_text: etasminnantare dṛṣṭvā madrarājo vṛkodaram / jighāṃsuṃ chettumāyāntaṃ sādhayannidamabravīt
ce_text: sa bhīmasenābhihato sūtaputraḥ kurūdvaha / niṣasāda rathopasthe visaṃjñaḥ pṛtanāpatiḥ / etasminn antare dṛṣṭvā madrarājo vṛkodaram / jihvāṃ chettuṃ samāyāntaṃ sāntvayann idam abravīt / bhīmasena mahābāho yat tvā vakṣyāmi tac chṛṇu / vacanaṃ hetusaṃpannaṃ śrutvā caitat tathā kuru / arjunena pratijñāto vadhaḥ karṇasya śuṣmiṇaḥ / bhīma uvāca / tāṃ tathā kuru bhadraṃ te pratijñāṃ savyasācinaḥ / dṛḍhavratatvaṃ pārthasya jānāmi nṛpasattama / rājñas tu dharṣaṇaṃ pāpaḥ kṛtavān mama saṃnidhau / tataḥ krodhābhibhūtena śeṣaṃ na gaṇitaṃ mayā / patite cāpi rādheye na me manyuḥ śamaṃ gataḥ / jihvoddharaṇam evāsya prāptakālaṃ mataṃ mama / anena tu nṛśaṃsena samaveteṣu rājasu / asmākaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ kṛṣṇā yāni vākyāni mātula / asahyāni ca nīcena bahūni śrāvitāni bhoḥ / nūnaṃ te tat parijñātaṃ dūrasthasyāpi pārthiva / chedanaṃ cāsya jihvāyās tad evākāṅkṣitaṃ mayā / rājñas tu priyakāmena kālo 'yaṃ paripālitaḥ / bhavatā tu yad ukto 'smi vākyaṃ hetvarthasaṃhitam / tad gṛhītaṃ mahārāja kaṭukastham ivauṣadham / hīnapratijño bībhatsur na hi jīveta karhi cit / asmin vinaṣṭe naṣṭāḥ smaḥ sarva eva sakeśavāḥ / adya caiva nṛśaṃsātmā pāpaḥ pāpakṛtāṃ varaḥ / gamiṣyati parābhāvaṃ dṛṣṭamātraḥ kirīṭinā / yudhiṣṭhirasya kopena pūrvaṃ dagdho nṛśaṃsakṛt / tvayā saṃrakṣitas tv adya matsamīpād upāyataḥ

vulgate_text: parājite tataḥ karṇe dhārtarāṣṭrī mahācamūḥ / vyapāyātsarvato bhagnā hāhābhūtā samantataḥ
ce_text: tataḥ parājite karṇe dhārtarāṣṭrīṃ mahācamūm / vyadrāvayad bhīmaseno yathendro dānavīṃ camūm

vulgate_text: vimukhaṃ prekṣya rādheyaṃ sūtaputraṃ mahāhave / putrastava mahārāja sodaryānidamabravīt
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / vibhrāntaṃ prekṣya rādheyaṃ sūtaputraṃ mahāhave / mahatyā senayā rājan sodaryān samabhāṣata

vulgate_text: vivitsostu tataḥ kruddho bhallenāpāharacchiraḥ / bhīmaseno mahārāja tatpapāta hataṃ bhuvi
ce_text: vivitsos tu tataḥ kruddho bhallenāpāharac chiraḥ / sakuṇḍalaśirastrāṇaṃ pūrṇacandropamaṃ tadā / bhīmena ca mahārāja sa papāta hato bhuvi

vulgate_text: sakuṇḍalaśirastrāṇaṃ pūrṇacandropamaṃ tathā / aśobhata mahārāja pūrṇacandra ivāmbare
ce_text: vivitsos tu tataḥ kruddho bhallenāpāharac chiraḥ / sakuṇḍalaśirastrāṇaṃ pūrṇacandropamaṃ tadā / bhīmena ca mahārāja sa papāta hato bhuvi

vulgate_text: dantaveṣṭeṣu netreṣu kumbheṣu ca kaṭeṣu ca / marmasvapi ca marmajñastānnāgānavadhīdbalī
ce_text: dantaveṣṭeṣu netreṣu kambheṣu sa kaṭeṣu ca / marmasv api ca marmajño ninadan vyadhamad bhṛśam

vulgate_text: arditā bhīmasenena vinadanto bhṛśāturāḥ tataste prādravanbhītāḥ prahatāśca punaḥpunaḥ / mahāmātrāstamāvavrurmeghā iva divākaram
ce_text: tatas te prādravan bhītāḥ pratīpaṃ prahitāḥ punaḥ / mahāmātrais tam āvavrur meghā iva divākaram

vulgate_text: tataste pāṇḍavā rājankauravāśca mahārathāḥ / tatakṣuḥ sāyakaistūrṇamanyonyaṃ vijayaiṣiṇaḥ
ce_text: tatas te pāṇḍavā rājan kauravāś ca mahārathāḥ / tatakṣuḥ sāyakais tīkṣṇair nighnanto hi parasparam

vulgate_text: gadānāṃ parighāṇāṃ ca śaktīnāṃ ca parasparam / prāsānāṃ bhiṇḍipālānāṃ musuṇṭhīnāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ
ce_text: gadānāṃ parighāṇāṃ ca kaṇapānāṃ ca sarpatām / prāsānāṃ bhiṇḍipālānāṃ bhuśuṇḍīnāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ

vulgate_text: syandamānā yathā bhānti parvatā dhātumaṇḍitāḥ / tathā rejū raṇe nāgā rudhireṇa samāplutāḥ
ce_text: rudhireṇāvasiktāṅgā gairikaprasravā iva / yathā bhrājanti syandantaḥ parvatā dhātumaṇḍitāḥ

vulgate_text: tomarānsādibhirmuktānpratimānasthitānbahūn / hastairuddhṛtya tānnāgā babhañjuścāpare raṇe
ce_text: tomarān gajibhir muktān pratīpān āsthitān bahūn / hastair vicerus te nāgā babhañjuś cāpare tathā

vulgate_text: kecidabhyāhatā nāgairnāgā nagavaropamāḥ / na celuḥ samarāttasmācchinnapakṣā ivādrayaḥ
ce_text: ke cid abhyāhatā nāgā nāgair naganibhā bhuvi / nipetuḥ samare tasmin pakṣavanta ivādrayaḥ

vulgate_text: śīrṣapāṣāṇasañchannāḥ keśaśaivalaśādvalāḥ / asthimīnasamākīrṇā dhanuḥśaragadoḍupāḥ
ce_text: śīrṣapāṣāṇasaṃchannāḥ keśaśaivalaśādvalāḥ / asthisaṃghātasaṃkīrṇā dhanuḥśaravarottamāḥ

vulgate_text: māṃsaśoṇitapaṅkinyo ghorarūpāḥ sudāruṇāḥ / nadīḥ pravartayāmāsuḥ soṇitaughavivardhinīḥ
ce_text: māṃsakardamapaṅkāś ca śoṇitaughāḥ sudāruṇāḥ / nadīḥ pravartayām āsur yamarāṣṭravivardhanīḥ

vulgate_text: bhīruvitrāsakāriṇyaḥ śūrāṇāṃ harṣavardhanāḥ / tā nadyo ghorarūpāstu nayantyo yamasādanam
ce_text: tā nadyo ghorarūpāś ca nayantyo yamasādanam / avagāḍhā majjayantyaḥ kṣatrasyājanayan bhayam

vulgate_text: tato'pareṇa bhallena ketuṃ pārthasya māriṣa / vivyādha samare rājansuśarmā krodhamūrcchitaḥ
ce_text: suśarmā tu tataḥ pārthaṃ viddhvā navabhir āśugaiḥ / janārdanaṃ tribhir bāṇair abhyahan dakṣiṇe bhuje / tato 'pareṇa bhallena ketuṃ vivyādha māriṣa

vulgate_text: tataḥ pārtho mahābāhuḥ saṃvṛtaḥ stairmahārathaiḥ / nigṛhītaṃ rathaṃ dṛṣṭvā tāṃścāpyādravato bahūn
ce_text: tataḥ kruddho raṇe pārthaḥ saṃvṛtas tair mahārathaiḥ / nigṛhītaṃ rathaṃ dṛṣṭvā keśavaṃ cāpy abhidrutam / rathārūḍhāṃś ca subahūn padātīṃś cāpy apātayat

vulgate_text: rathārūḍhāṃśca subahūnpadā''kṣipya nyapātayat / apātayadasambhrāntaḥ śarairāsannayodhibhiḥ
ce_text: tataḥ kruddho raṇe pārthaḥ saṃvṛtas tair mahārathaiḥ / nigṛhītaṃ rathaṃ dṛṣṭvā keśavaṃ cāpy abhidrutam / rathārūḍhāṃś ca subahūn padātīṃś cāpy apātayat

vulgate_text: paśya kṛṣṇa mahābāho saṃśaptakagaṇānbahūn / kurvato'sukaraṃ karma mumūrṣūnkālacoditān
ce_text: paśya kṛṣṇa mahābāho saṃśaptakagaṇān mayā / kurvāṇān dāruṇaṃ karma vadhyamānān sahasraśaḥ

vulgate_text: rathabandhamimaṃ prāpya pṛthivyāṃ nāsti kaścana / yaḥ saheta pumām̐lloke madanyaḥ kṣatriyarṣabhaḥ
ce_text: rathabandham imaṃ ghoraṃ pṛthivyāṃ nāsti kaś cana / yaḥ saheta pumāṃl loke mad anyo yadupuṃgava

vulgate_text: devadattasvanaṃ śrutvā keśavo'pi mahāyaśāḥ / pāñcajanyasvanaṃ cakre pūrayanniva rodasī
ce_text: ity evam uktvā bībhatsur devadattam athādhamat / pāñcajanyaṃ ca kṛṣṇo 'pi pūrayann iva rodasī

vulgate_text: nāgamastraṃ tataḥ pārthaḥ prāduścakre hasanniva / pādabandhaṃ sa teṣāṃ vai cakre tena mahāstravit
ce_text: padabandhaṃ tataś cakre pāṇḍavaḥ paravīrahā / nāgam astraṃ mahārāja saṃprodīrya muhur muhuḥ

vulgate_text: yānuddiśya raṇe pārthaḥ pādabandhaṃ cakāra ha / te baddhāḥ pādabandhena yodhāḥ saṃśaptakāstadā
ce_text: yān uddiśya raṇe pārthaḥ padabandhaṃ cakāra ha / te baddhāḥ padabandhena pāṇḍavena mahātmanā / niśceṣṭā abhavan rājann aśmasāramayā iva

vulgate_text: sa gāḍhaviddho vyathito rathopastha upāviśatat / tata uccukruśuḥ sarve hataḥ pārtha iti bruvan
ce_text: suśarmā tu tato rājan bāṇenānataparvaṇā / arjunaṃ hṛdaye viddhvā vivyādhānyais tribhiḥ śaraiḥ / sa gāḍhaviddho vyathito rathopastha upāviśat

vulgate_text: vimukhīkṛtya samare suśarmāṇaṃ dhanañjayaḥ / aindramastramameyātmā prāduścakre hasanniva
ce_text: pratilabhya tataḥ saṃjñāṃ śvetāśvaḥ kṛṣṇasārathiḥ / aindram astram ameyātmā prāduścakre tvarānvitaḥ / tato bāṇasahasrāṇi samutpannāni māriṣa

vulgate_text: hayānpattīṃśca samare śastraiḥ śatasahasraśaḥ / rarāja samare rājañśakro nighnannivāsurān
ce_text: sarvadikṣu vyadṛśyanta sūdayanto nṛpa dvipān / hayān rathāṃś ca samare śastraiḥ śatasahasraśaḥ

vulgate_text: vadhyamāne tataḥ sainye bhayaṃ sumahadāviśat / saṃśaptakagaṇānāṃ ca gopālānāṃ ca bhārata
ce_text: vadhyamāne tataḥ sainye vipulā bhīḥ samāviśat / saṃśaptakagaṇānāṃ ca gopālānāṃ ca bhārata / na hi kaś cit pumāṃs tatra yo 'rjunaṃ pratyayudhyata

vulgate_text: na hi tatra pumānkaścidyo'rjunaṃ pratibudhyate / paśyatāṃ tatra vīrāṇāmahanyata balaṃ tava
ce_text: vadhyamāne tataḥ sainye vipulā bhīḥ samāviśat / saṃśaptakagaṇānāṃ ca gopālānāṃ ca bhārata / na hi kaś cit pumāṃs tatra yo 'rjunaṃ pratyayudhyata

vulgate_text: hanyamānaṃ ca tadabhūnniśceṣṭaṃ ca parākrame
ce_text: paśyatāṃ tatra vīrāṇām ahanyata mahad balam / hanyamānam apaśyaṃś ca niśceṣṭāḥ sma parākrame

vulgate_text: tatra yuddhaṃ mahaccāsīttāvakānāṃ viśāmpate śūreṇa balinā sārdhaṃ pāṇḍavena kirīṭinā / jitvā tānnyahanatpārthaḥ śatrūñśakra ivāsurān
ce_text: tatra yuddhaṃ mahad dhy āsīt tāvakānāṃ viśāṃ pate / śūreṇa balinā sārdhaṃ pāṇḍavena kirīṭinā

vulgate_text: tataḥ kṛpaḥ śaraistīkṣṇaiḥ so'tividdho mahārathaḥ tataḥ suniśitaistīkṣṇaiḥ kṣuraprairhemabhūṣitaiḥ / vyaśvasūtarathaṃ cakre śikhaṇḍinamatho dvijaḥ
ce_text: tataḥ kṛpaḥ śarais tīkṣṇaiḥ so 'tividdho mahārathaḥ / vyaśvasūtarathaṃ cakre pārṣataṃ tu dvijottamaḥ

vulgate_text: śikhaṇḍine tato bāṇānkṛpaḥ śāradvato yudhi / prāhiṇottavarayā yukto bībhatsoratha sannidhau
ce_text: śikhaṇḍinas tato bāṇān kṛpaḥ śāradvato yudhi / prāhiṇot tvarayā yukto didhakṣur iva māriṣa

vulgate_text: sa vicarmā mahārāja khaṅgapāṇirupādravat / kṛpastaṃ śarasaṅghātairādravantamapīḍayat
ce_text: sa vicarmā mahārāja khaḍgapāṇir upādravat / kṛpasya vaśam āpanno mṛtyor āsyam ivāturaḥ

vulgate_text: bhāradvājaśaraiśchannaṃ na prājñāyata kiñcana / bāṇabhūtamabhūtsarvamāyodhanaśiro mahat
ce_text: drauṇāyaniśaracchannaṃ na prājñāyata kiṃ cana / bāṇabhūtam abhūt sarvam āyodhanaśiro hi tat

vulgate_text: tena cchanne raṇe rājanbāṇajālena bhāsvatā / abhracchāyeva sajajñe hṛtaraśmistamonudaḥ
ce_text: tena channe raṇe rājan bāṇajālena bhāsvatā / abhracchāyeva saṃjajñe bāṇaruddhe nabhastale

vulgate_text: tadadbhutamapaśyāma bāṇabhūte nabhasthale / na sma sampatate bhūtaṃ drauṇerdṛṣṭvā parākramam
ce_text: tatrāścaryam apaśyāma bāṇabhūte tathāvidhe / na sma saṃpatate bhūmau dṛṣṭvā drauṇeḥ parākramam

vulgate_text: tato dharmasuto rājanpragṛhyānyanmahaddhanuḥ / droṇaputraṃ tripaṣṭaḷḷ tatu bāhvorurasi cārpayayat
ce_text: tato dharmasuto rājan pragṛhyānyan mahad dhanuḥ / drauṇiṃ vivyādha saptatyā bāhvor urasi cārdayat

vulgate_text: sahasā patatastānvai krudvarūpānparantapaḥ / prahasanpratijagrāha droṇaputro mahāraṇe
ce_text: āgacchamānāṃs tān dṛṣṭvā raudrarūpān paraṃtapaḥ / prahasan pratijagrāha droṇaputro mahāraṇe

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvā caiva mahārāja droṇaputraparākramam / sarvānduryodhanaḥ pārthānhatānyudve'bhyamanyata
ce_text: dṛṣṭvā te ca mahārāja droṇaputraparākramam / nihatān menire sarvān pāṇḍūn droṇasutena vai

vulgate_text: tato'parābhyāṃ bhallābyāṃ dhanuṣī samakṛntata / yamayoḥ prasabhaṃ vīro vivyādhāśu tribhistribhiḥ
ce_text: tato 'parābhyāṃ bhallābhyāṃ dhanuṣī samakṛntata / yamayoḥ prahasan rājan vivyādhaiva ca saptabhiḥ

vulgate_text: tasya sāyakasañchannau mādreyau na virejatuḥ / meghacchannau yathā vyomni candrasūryau gataprabhau
ce_text: tasya sāyakasaṃchannau cakāśetāṃ ca pāṇḍavau / meghacchannau yathā vyomni candrasūryau hataprabhau

vulgate_text: tathāsya saśaraṃ cāpaṃ muṣṭideśe viśāmpate / kṣurapreṇa sutīkṣṇena rājā ciccheda saṃyuge
ce_text: athāsya saśaraṃ cāpaṃ hastāvāpaṃ ca māriṣa / kṣurapreṇa sutīkṣṇena rājā ciccheda saṃyuge

vulgate_text: so'tividdho mahārāja putraste'tivyarājata / vasantakāle sumahānpraphulla iva kiṃśukaḥ
ce_text: so 'tividdho mahārāja putras te 'tivyarājata / vasante puṣpaśabalaḥ sapuṣpa iva kiṃśukaḥ

vulgate_text: duryodhanaṃ tu virathaṃ chinnavarmāyudhadhvajam / bhrātaraṃ samudaikṣanta sodarā bharatarṣabha
ce_text: duryodhanaṃ tu virathaṃ chinnasarvāyudhaṃ raṇe / bhrātaraḥ paryarakṣanta sodaryā bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: karṇastu sātyakiṃ hitvā rājagṛghnuramarṣaṇaḥ / dromahantāramugreṣuṃ sasārābhimukho raṇe
ce_text: karṇas tu sātyakiṃ jitvā rājagṛddhī mahābalaḥ / droṇahantāram ugreṣuṃ sasārābhimukhaṃ raṇe

vulgate_text: sa bhāratapurogānāṃ rājñāṃ ca sumahātmanām / karṇapārṣatayoryudve saṅkraddhānāṃ mahāraṇe

vulgate_text: vyāghraketuḥ suśarmā ca śukraścitrāyudhaḥ kratuḥ durjayo rocamānaśca siṃhasenastathā'ṣṭamaḥ / mahatā rathavaṃśena parivavrurnarottamam

ce_text: yudhyamānāṃs tu tāñ śūrān manujendraḥ pratāpavān / aṣṭābhir aṣṭau rādheyo nyahanan niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ

vulgate_text: vaiśvānaramukhaṃ prāpya dahyante śalabhā yathā / karṇāgriṃ samare prāpya dagdhā bhārata sṛñjayaḥ
ce_text: vaiśvānaraṃ yathā dīptaṃ dahyante prāpya vai janāḥ / karṇāgninā raṇe tadvad dagdhā bhārata sṛñjayāḥ

vulgate_text: dīryate ca mahatsainyaṃ sṛñjayānāṃ mahāraṇe / kuravaścābhidhāvanti bhīmasenabhayārditāḥ
ce_text: dīryate ca mahat sainyaṃ sṛñjayānāṃ mahāraṇe / hastikakṣyo hy asau kṛṣṇa ketuḥ karṇasya dhīmataḥ / dṛśyate rājasainyasya madhye vicarato muhuḥ

vulgate_text: tatra yāhi yataḥ karṇo drāvayatyeṣa no balam trigartānvarjayanyāhi sūtaputraṃ mahāratham / etanme rocate kṛṣṇa yathā vā tava rocate
ce_text: varjayitvā raṇe yāhi sūtaputraṃ mahāratham / śramo mā bādhate kṛṣṇa yathā vā tava rocate

vulgate_text: tatastava mahāsainyaṃ govindapreritā hayāḥ / haṃsavarṇā viśaṃstūrṇaṃ vahanto'rjunamāhave
ce_text: tatas tava mahat sainyaṃ govindapreritā hayāḥ / haṃsavarṇāḥ praviviśur vahantaḥ kṛṣṇapāṇḍavau

vulgate_text: śaravarṣairmahārāja sarvataḥ pāṇḍunandanam / sa cchādyamānaḥ samare śaraiḥ parabalārdanaḥ
ce_text: sa chādyamānaḥ samare śaraiḥ parabalārdanaḥ / darśayan raudram ātmānaṃ pāśahasta ivāntakaḥ / nighnan saṃśaptakān pārthaḥ prekṣaṇīyataro 'bhavat

vulgate_text: saṃśaptakāṃstu kaunteyaḥ kurūṃścāpi vṛkodaraḥ / sūtaputrastu pāñcālāṃstrayo'ghnaṃstvaritāḥ śaraiḥ
ce_text: saṃśaptakāṃś ca kaunteyaḥ kurūṃś cāpi vṛkodaraḥ / vasuṣeṇaṃ ca pāñcālaḥ kṛtsnena vyadhamad raṇe / saṃjayaḥ / duryodhanas tataḥ karṇam upetya bharatarṣabha / abravīn madrarājaṃ ca tathaivānyān mahārathān / yadṛcchayopasaṃprāptaṃ svargadvāram apāvṛtam / sukhinaḥ kṣatriyāḥ karṇa labhante yuddham īdṛśam / sadṛśaiḥ kṣatriyaiḥ śūraiḥ śūrāṇāṃ yudhyatāṃ yudhi / iṣṭaṃ bhavati rādheya tad idaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ / tataḥ pramudite tasmin duryodhanabale tadā / harṣayaṃs tāvakān yodhān drauṇir vacanam abravīt / pratyakṣaṃ sarvasainyānāṃ bhavatāṃ cāpi paśyatām / nyastaśastro mama pitā dhṛṣṭadyumnena saṃnipāto rathayūthapānāṃ / mahātmanāṃ bhārata mohanīyaḥ / janakṣayaḥ kālayugāntakalpaḥ / prāvartatāgre kurusṛñjayānām / tataḥ pravṛtte yudhi saṃprahāre / bhūtāni sarvāṇi sadaivatāni / āsan sametāni samīraṇas tāṃś ca niṣevya gandhān / siṣeva sarvān api yodhamukhyān / niṣevyamāṇās tv anilena yodhāḥ / parasparaghnā dharaṇīṃ nipetuḥ / sā divyapuṣpair avakīryamāṇā / suvarṇapuṅkhaiś ca śarair caivaṃ kitavaḥ saubalaś ca / gajānīkaiḥ sarvato bhīmasenaṃ / tathā viṣaktaṃ sahasaivābhyagacchan / tam āpatantaṃ saṃprekṣya gajānīkaṃ vṛkodaraḥ / duryodhanaṃ mahābāhuḥ śaravarṣair avākirat / duryodhanaṃ tathā bhīmaḥ sāyakaiḥ śataśaḥ śitaiḥ / pāṇḍavo vimukhīkṛtya gajān abhyadravad balī / tataḥ pāvakasaṃkāśair bhīmo bāṇair avakragaiḥ / śalabhair iva nāgāṃs tān ardayām āsa pāṇḍavaḥ / tataḥ kuñjarayūthāni bhīmaseno mahābalaḥ / vyadhaman niśitair bāṇair mahābhrāṇīva mārutaḥ / anvayus tad rathānīkaṃ maṇijālaiś ca kuñjarāḥ / rūpyajāmbūnadābhāsāḥ kṣuramālyābhyalaṃkṛtāḥ / vadhyamānāḥ śarai rājan bhīmasenena te gajāḥ / vibhinnahṛdayāḥ ke cit tatraivābhyapatan bhuvi / nipatadbhir mahāvegair hemabhāṇḍavibhūṣitaiḥ / aśobhata mahārāja dhātucitrair ivācalaiḥ / dīptābharaṇavadbhiś ca gajapṛṣṭhān nipātitaiḥ / sa raṇaḥ śuśubhe rājan kṣīṇapuṇyair ivāmaraiḥ / mahāparighasaṃkāśau candanāgarurūṣitau / apaśyan bhīmasenasya dhanur vikṣipato bhujau / tasya jyātalanirghoṣam asyataḥ savyadakṣiṇam / śrutvā hy abhyadravan nāgā bhīmasenaṃ bhayārditāḥ / tasya bhīmasya tat karma rājann ekasya dhīmataḥ / apaśyāma mahārāja tad adbhutam ivābhavat / saṃjaya uvāca / evam eṣa mahān āsīt saṃgrāmaḥ pṛthivīkṣitām / kruddhe 'rjune tathā karṇe bhīmasene ca pāṇḍave / droṇaputraṃ parājitya jitvā cānyān mahārathān / abravīd arjuno rājan vāsudevam idaṃ vacaḥ / paśya kṛṣṇa mahābāho dravantīṃ pāṇḍavīṃ camūm / karṇaṃ paśya ca saṃgrāme kālayantaṃ mahārathān / na ca paśyāmi dāśārha dharmarājaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram / nāpi ketur yudhāṃ śreṣṭha dharmarājasya dṛśyate / tribhāgaś cāvaśiṣṭo 'yaṃ divasasya janārdana / na ca māṃ dhārtarāṣṭreṣu kaś cid yudhyati saṃyuge / tasmāt tvaṃ matpriyaṃ kurvan yāhi yatra yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / dṛṣṭvā kuśalinaṃ yuddhe dharmaputraṃ sahānujam / punar yoddhāsmi vārṣṇeya śatrubhiḥ saha saṃyuge / tataḥ prāyād rathenāśu bībhatsor vacanād dhariḥ / yato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā sṛñjayāś ca mahārathāḥ / ayudhyaṃs tāvakaiḥ sārdhaṃ mṛtyuṃ kṛtvā nivartanam

vulgate_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / kathaṃ saṃśaptakaiḥ sārdhamarjunasyābhavadraṇaḥ / sūtaputrasya pāñcālaiḥ kathaṃ yuddhaṃ pravartitam

ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / bhīmasenaṃ tato drauṇī rājan vivyādha patriṇā / tvarayā parayā yukto darśayann astralāghavam

vulgate_text: divyaṃ dhanurathādhijyaṃ kṛtvā drauṇiramitrahā / prekṣya cāśu rathe yuktānnarairanyānhayottamān
ce_text: vijyaṃ dhanur athādhijyaṃ kṛtvā drauṇir amitrahā / tataḥ śarasahasrāṇi preṣayām āsa pāṇḍyataḥ / iṣusaṃbādham ākāśam akarod diśa eva ca

vulgate_text: hateśvaro dantivaraḥ sukalpita-- satvarābhisṛṣṭaḥ pratiśabdago balī / tamādravaddrauṇiśarāhatastvaran javena kṛtvā pratihastigarjitam
ce_text: hateśvaro dantivaraḥ sukalpitas; tvarābhisṛṣṭaḥ pratiśarmago balī / tam adhyatiṣṭhan malayeśvaro mahān; yathādriśṛṅgaṃ harir unnadaṃs tathā

vulgate_text: taṃ vāraṇaṃ vāraṇayuddhakovido dvipottamaṃ parvatasānusannibham / sambhyatiṣṭhanmalayadhvajastvara-- nyathā'driśṛṅgaṃ harirunnadaṃstathā
ce_text: hateśvaro dantivaraḥ sukalpitas; tvarābhisṛṣṭaḥ pratiśarmago balī / tam adhyatiṣṭhan malayeśvaro mahān; yathādriśṛṅgaṃ harir unnadaṃs tathā

vulgate_text: dṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / pāṇḍye hate kimakarodarjuno jayatāṃvaraḥ / ekavīreṇa karṇena drāvite ca yudhiṣṭhire
ce_text: asau gacchati kauravya drauṇir astrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / tam eṣa pradrutaḥ saṃkhye dhṛṣṭadyumno mahārathaḥ

vulgate_text: ta ime nānuvartante dhṛṣṭadyumnapurogamāḥ / pāñcālāḥ sṛñjayāścaiva pāṇḍavānāṃ camūmukham
ce_text: tam ete 'nu nivartante dhṛṣṭadyumnapurogamāḥ / pāñcālānāṃ sṛñjayānāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ ca yan mukham / nivṛttaiś ca tathā pārthair bhagnaṃ śatrubalaṃ mahat

vulgate_text: tameṣa pradrutaḥ saṅkhye dhṛṣṭadyumno mahārathaḥ / aśvatthāmnā hatāḥ saṅkhye sarve kaunteya sṛñjayāḥ
ce_text: asau gacchati kauravya drauṇir astrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / tam eṣa pradrutaḥ saṃkhye dhṛṣṭadyumno mahārathaḥ

vulgate_text: rathāśvanaranāgānāṃ kṛtaṃ ca kadanaṃ mahat / ityetatsarvamācaṣṭa vāsudevaḥ kirīṭine
ce_text: sarvaṃ vyācaṣṭa durdharṣo vāsudevaḥ kirīṭine / tato rājan prādurāsīn mahāghoro mahāraṇaḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ pravavṛte yūddhaṃ ghorarūpaṃ viśāmpate / karṇasya pāṇḍavānāṃ ca yamarāṣṭravivardhanam
ce_text: tataḥ pravavṛte bhīmaḥ saṃgrāmo lomaharṣaṇaḥ / karṇasya pāṇḍavānāṃ ca yamarāṣṭravivardhanaḥ

vulgate_text: tayorāsīnmahārāja saṅgrāmo ghoradarśanaḥ / pravṛddhayormahāraṅge balinorvijigīṣatoḥ
ce_text: tam āsādya tu te karṇaṃ vyaśīryanta mahārathāḥ / yathācalaṃ samāsādya jalaughāḥ sarvatodiśam / tayor āsīn mahārāja saṃgrāmo lomaharṣaṇaḥ

vulgate_text: vavarṣa śaravarṣāṇi toyavarṣānivāmbudaḥ / chādayāmāsa saṅkruddhaḥ pārṣataṃ navabhiḥ śaraiḥ
ce_text: vijayaṃ tu dhanuḥśreṣṭhaṃ vidhunvāno mahārathaḥ / pārṣatasya dhanuś chittvā śarān āśīviṣopamān / tāḍayām āsa saṃkruddhaḥ pārṣataṃ navabhiḥ śaraiḥ

vulgate_text: tadapāsya dhanuśchinnaṃ dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ pratāpavān tato'nyaddhanurādāya sāravadbhārasādhanam / karṇaṃ vivyādha saptatyā śaraiḥ sannataparvabhiḥ
ce_text: tad apāsya dhanuś chinnaṃ dhṛṣṭadyumno mahārathaḥ / anyad dhanur upādāya śarāṃś cāśīviṣopamān / karṇaṃ vivyādha saptatyā śaraiḥ saṃnataparvabhiḥ

vulgate_text: pārṣataḥ śaravarṣeṇa samantātparyavārayat / vivyādha cainaṃ tvarito nārācaiḥ saptabhistadā
ce_text: dṛṣṭvā vinihitaṃ bāṇaṃ śaraiḥ karṇo viśāṃ pate / sātyakiṃ śaravarṣeṇa samantāt paryavārayat

vulgate_text: taṃ pratyavidhyaddaśabhiḥ śarairhemavibhūṣitaiḥ / tayoryuddhaṃ samabhavaddṛṣṭiśrotramanoharam
ce_text: vivyādha cainaṃ samare nārācais tatra saptabhiḥ / taṃ pratyavidhyac chaineyaḥ śarair hemavibhūṣitaiḥ

vulgate_text: tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti brahmaghna na me jīvanvimokṣyase ityuktvā subhṛśaṃ vīraḥ śīghrakṛnniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ / chādayāmāsa samare yatamāno mahārathaḥ
ce_text: ity uktvā subhṛśaṃ vīraḥ śīghrakṛn niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ / pārṣataṃ chādayām āsa ghorarūpaiḥ sutejanaiḥ / yatamānaṃ paraṃ śaktyā yatamāno mahārathaḥ

vulgate_text: yathā hi samare drauṇiḥ pārṣataṃ dṛśyata māriṣa / nātihṛṣṭamanā hyāsīnmanvāno mṛtyumātmanaḥ
ce_text: yathā hi samare drauṇiḥ pārṣataṃ vīkṣya māriṣa / tathā drauṇiṃ raṇe dṛṣṭvā pārṣataḥ paravīrahā / nātihṛṣṭamanā bhūtvā manyate mṛtyum ātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: tāvanyonyaṃ tu dṛṣṭvaiva saṃrambhaṃ jagmatuḥ param / pragṛhya mahatī cāpe śarāsanasamanvite
ce_text: drauṇis tu dṛṣṭvā rājendra dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ raṇe sthitam / krodhena niḥśvasan vīraḥ pārṣataṃ samupādravat / tāv anyonyaṃ tu dṛṣṭvaiva saṃrambhaṃ jagmatuḥ param

vulgate_text: adya tvaṃ prāpsyase tadvai yathā hyakuśalastathā arakṣyamāṇaḥ pārthena yadi tiṣṭhasi saṃyuge / nāpakrāmasi vā mohātsatyametadbravīmi te
ce_text: arakṣyamāṇaḥ pārthena yadi tiṣṭhasi saṃyuge / nāpakramasi vā mūḍha satyam etad bravīmi te

vulgate_text: sañjaya uvāca / evamuktaḥ pratyuvāca dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ pratāpavān / āśiṣaṃ tāṃ pravaktavyāṃ māmako dāsyate tava
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tvaramāṇaḥ punaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pārtham abhyavadac chanaiḥ / paśya kauravya rājānam apayātāṃś ca pāṇḍavān

vulgate_text: yenaiva te piturdattā yatamānasya saṃyuge eṣa te prativākyaṃ vai asirdāsyati māmakaḥ / yena kṛttaṃ tava pituryatamānasya tacchiraḥ
ce_text: evam uktaḥ pratyuvāca dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ pratāpavān / prativākyaṃ sa evāsir māmako dāsyate tava / yenaiva te pitur dattaṃ yatamānasya saṃyuge

vulgate_text: evamuktvā mahātejāḥ senāpatirarindamaḥ / sutīkṣṇenātha bhallena drauṇiṃ vivyādha pārṣataḥ
ce_text: evam uktvā mahārāja senāpatir amarṣaṇaḥ / niśitenātha bāṇena drauṇiṃ vivyādha pārṣataḥ

vulgate_text: rādheyo'pi mahārāja pāñcālānsaha pāṇḍavaiḥ / draupadeyā yudhāmanyumuttamaujasameva ca
ce_text: rādheyo 'pi mahārāja pāñcālān saha pāṇḍavaiḥ / draupadeyān yudhāmanyuṃ sātyakiṃ ca mahāratham / ekaḥ sa vārayām āsa prekṣaṇīyaḥ samantataḥ

vulgate_text: sātyakiśca mahārāja yodhāṃścānyānsahasraśaḥ / ekastānvārayāmāsa prekṣaṇīyaḥ samantataḥ
ce_text: rādheyo 'pi mahārāja pāñcālān saha pāṇḍavaiḥ / draupadeyān yudhāmanyuṃ sātyakiṃ ca mahāratham / ekaḥ sa vārayām āsa prekṣaṇīyaḥ samantataḥ

vulgate_text: dhṛṣṭadyumnastu samare drauṇeściccheda kārmukam / kṣurapreṇa sutīkṣṇena paśyatāṃ sarvayodhinām
ce_text: dhṛṣṭadyumno 'pi samare drauṇeś ciccheda kārmukam / tad apāsya dhanuś chinnam anyad ādatta kārmukam / vegavat samare ghoraṃ śarāṃś cāśīviṣopamān

vulgate_text: tasyāntamiṣubhī rājanyadā drauṇirna gacchati atha tyaktvā rathaṃ vīraḥ pārṣataṃ tvarito'nvagāt / pragṛhya vipulaṃ khahgaṃ jātarūpapariṣkṛtam
ce_text: tasyāntam iṣubhī rājan yadā drauṇir na jagmivān / atha tyaktvā dhanur vīraḥ pārṣataṃ tvarito 'nvagāt

vulgate_text: trāyasvainaṃ mahābāho pārṣataṃ yuddhadurmadam / drauṇerāsyagataṃ vīra mṛtyorāsyagataṃ yathā
ce_text: taṃ mocaya mahābāho pārṣataṃ śatrutāpanam / drauṇer āsyam anuprāptaṃ mṛtyor āsyagataṃ yathā

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvā drauṇirmahārāja vāsudevadhanaṃjayau / dhṛṣṭadyumnavadhe rājaṃścakre yatnaṃ mahābalaḥ
ce_text: dṛṣṭvāyāntau mahāvīryāv ubhau kṛṣṇadhanaṃjayau / dhṛṣṭadyumnavadhe rājaṃś cakre yatnaṃ mahābalaḥ

vulgate_text: viddhastu taiḥ śarairghoraidroṇaputraḥ pratāpavān / utsṛjya samare rājanpāñcālamamitaujasam
ce_text: sa vidhvastaiḥ śarair ghorair droṇaputraḥ pratāpavān / ratham āruruhe vīro dhanaṃjayaśarārditaḥ / pragṛhya ca dhanuḥ śreṣṭhaṃ pārthaṃ vivyādha sāyakaiḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ karṇo mahārāja vyākṣipadvijayaṃ dhanuḥ dṛṣṭvārjunaṃ raṇe kruddhaḥ prekṣate ca muhurmuhuḥ / dvairathaṃ cāpi pārthena gantukāmo mahādyutiḥ
ce_text: tataḥ karṇo mahārāja vyākṣipad vijayaṃ dhanuḥ / arjunaṃ samare kruddhaḥ prekṣamāṇo muhur muhuḥ / dvairathaṃ cāpi pārthena kāmayāno mahāraṇe

vulgate_text: jyātalatradhanuḥśabdāñśastrāṇāṃ ca nipātyatām / tāḍitānāṃ ca patatā ninādāṃśca padātinām
ce_text: jyātalatradhanuḥśabdāḥ kuñjarāṇāṃ ca bṛṃhitam / tāḍitānāṃ ca patatāṃ ninādaḥ sumahān abhūt

vulgate_text: varma vā carma vā'śritya nipātamapi dehinaḥ / viṣehurnāsya saṃsparśaṃ dvitīyasya patattriṇaḥ
ce_text: carmavarmāṇi saṃchindya nirvāpam iva dehinām / viṣehur nāsya saṃparkaṃ dvitīyasya patatriṇaḥ

vulgate_text: varmayukteṣu deheṣu dhanuṣo'syañśitāñśarān / maurvyā talatre nyahanatkaśayā vājino yathā
ce_text: varmadehāsumathanair dhanuṣaḥ pracyutaiḥ śaraiḥ / maurvyā talatrair nyavadhīt kaśayā vājino yathā

vulgate_text: teṣu vyāyacchamāneṣu kurupāñcālapāṇḍuṣu / priyānasūnraṇe tyaktvā yodhā jaghnuḥ parasparam
ce_text: vyāyacchamānāḥ subhṛśaṃ kurupāṇḍavasṛñjayāḥ / priyān asūn raṇe tyaktvā yodhā jagmuḥ parasparam

vulgate_text: kṣurairbhallārdhacandraiśca cchinnāḥ peturmahītale / narāśvebharathānāṃ hinarāśvebharathaistathā
ce_text: dhvajāḥ śirāṃsi cchatrāṇi dvipahastā nṛṇāṃ bhujāḥ / kṣurair bhallārdhacandraiś ca chinnāḥ śastrāṇi tatyajuḥ

vulgate_text: pracchādyamānaṃ dviradairmeghairiva divākaram / paryayuḥ pāṇḍupāñcālā nadanto hyāttakārmukāḥ
ce_text: ekaikaṃ daśabhiḥ ṣaḍbhir aṣṭābhir api bhārata / dviradān abhivivyādha kṣiptair girinibhāñ śaraiḥ / pracchādyamāno dviradair meghair iva divākaraḥ

vulgate_text: tānnāgānabhivarṣanto jyātalatravinādinaḥ vīranṛtyaṃ pranṛtyantaḥ śūratālapracoditaiḥ / nakulaḥ sahadevaśca draupadeyāḥ prabhadrakāḥ
ce_text: paryāsuḥ pāṇḍupāñcālā nadanto niśitāyudhāḥ / tān nāgān abhivarṣanto jyātantrīśaranāditaiḥ

vulgate_text: sātyakiśca śikhaṇḍī ca cekitānaśca vīryavān / samantātsiṣicurvīrā meghāstoyairivācalān
ce_text: nakulaḥ sahadevaś ca draupadeyāḥ prabhadrakāḥ / sātyakiś ca śikhaṇḍī ca cekitānaś ca vīryavān

vulgate_text: sañjaya uvāca / teṣāṃ pravṛtte saṅgrāme vipule śoṇitodake / rarāja lohitenorvī saṃsiktā bahudhā bhṛśam
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tataḥ punaḥ samājagmur abhītāḥ kurusṛñjayāḥ / yudhiṣṭhiramukhāḥ pārthā vaikartanamukhā vayam

vulgate_text: tato rajasi saṃśānte prakāśaḥ sarvato'bhavat etasminnantare pārthaṃ kṛṣṇo vacanamabravīt / darśayanniva kaunteyaṃ dharmarājaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / etasminn antare kṛṣṇaḥ pārthaṃ vacanam abravīt / darśayann iva kaunteyaṃ dharmarājaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram

vulgate_text: tamanvageva pāñcālāścedimātsyāśca bhārata / anuyānti mahātmānaṃ parīpsanto mahājavāḥ
ce_text: tathānuyānti saṃrabdhāḥ pāñcālā yuddhadurmadāḥ / yudhiṣṭhiraṃ mahātmānaṃ parīpsanto mahājavāḥ

vulgate_text: nadadbhiḥ siṃhanādāṃśca dhamadbhiścāpi vārijān / balavadbhirmaheṣvāsairvidhūnvānairdhanūṃṣi ca
ce_text: nadantaḥ siṃhanādāṃś ca dhamantaś cāpi vārijān / balavanto maheṣvāsā vidhunvanto dhanūṃṣi ca

vulgate_text: karṇena ca kṛto rājā vimukho'dya tu dṛśyate
ce_text: karṇena ca kṛto rājā vimukhaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ / balavāṃl laghuhastaś ca kṛtī yuddhaviśāradaḥ

vulgate_text: balavām̐llughuhastaśca kṛtī yuddhaviśāradaḥ rādheyaḥ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭhaṃ śaktaḥ pīḍayituṃ raṇe / sahito dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putraiḥ śūrairmahābalaiḥ
ce_text: rādheyaḥ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭhaṃ śaktaḥ pīḍayituṃ raṇe / sahito dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putraiḥ śūro mahātmabhiḥ

vulgate_text: śrībhagavānuvāca / āturo me mato rājā avipahyaśca bhārata / yathainamanuvartante pañcālāḥ saha pāṇḍavaiḥ
ce_text: sthūṇākarṇendrajālena pārtha pāśupatena ca / pracchādayanto rājānam anuyānti mahārathāḥ / āturo me mato rājā saṃniṣevyaś ca bhārata

vulgate_text: ete naśyanti pāñcālā drāvyamāṇā mahātmanā / śakreṇeva yathā daityā drāvyamāṇā mahātmanā
ce_text: etān paśya ca pāñcālān drāvyamāṇān mahātmanā / śakreṇeva yathā daityān hanyamānān mahāhave

vulgate_text: eṣa karṇo dhanuḥśreṣṭhaṃ vidhūnvanbahuśobhate / śatruṃ jitvā yathā śakro devasaṅkhaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ
ce_text: paśya pārtha dhanuḥ śreṣṭhaṃ vikarṣan sādhu śobhate / śatrūñ jitvā yathā śakro devasaṃghaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ

vulgate_text: abhidravata bhadraṃ vo drutaṃ dravata kauravāḥ / yathā na jīvavānkaścinmucyeta yudhi sṛñjayaḥ
ce_text: abhidravata gacchadhvaṃ drutaṃ dravata kauravāḥ / yathā jīvan na vaḥ kaś cin mucyate yudhi sṛñjayaḥ

vulgate_text: paśya karṇaṃ raṇe pārtha śvetacchatravirājitam / udayaṃ parvataṃ yadvacchaśāṅkenābhiśobhitam
ce_text: paśya karṇaṃ raṇe pārtha śvetacchavivirājitam / udayaṃ parvataṃ yadvac chobhayan vai divākaraḥ

vulgate_text: asau nivṛtto rādheyo dṛṣṭvā te vānaradhvajam prārthayansamaraṃ pārtha tvayā saha parantapa / vadhāya hyātmano'bhyeti pāvakaṃ śalabho yathā
ce_text: asau nivṛtto rādheyo dṛśyate vānaradhvaja / vadhāya cātmano 'bhyeti dīpasya śalabho yathā

vulgate_text: karṇamekākinaṃ dṛṣṭvā dhārtarāṣṭro raṇājire / tvāṃ ca pārthābhisaṃrabdhaṃ karṇaṃ prati mahāratham
ce_text: karṇam ekākinaṃ dṛṣṭvā rathānīkena bhārata / rirakṣiṣuḥ susaṃyatto dhārtarāṣṭro 'bhivartate

vulgate_text: asau duryodhanaḥ kruddho rathānīkena bhārata / rirakṣiṣuḥ susaṃvṛtto dhārtarāṣṭro nivartate
ce_text: karṇam ekākinaṃ dṛṣṭvā rathānīkena bhārata / rirakṣiṣuḥ susaṃyatto dhārtarāṣṭro 'bhivartate

vulgate_text: ḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷ vīra balaṃ tāmabhivartate / dromaputraṃ puraskṛtya tacchīghraṃ sanniṣūdaya
ce_text: pañca nāgasahasrāṇi dviguṇā vājinas tathā / abhisaṃhatya kaunteya padātiprayutāni ca / anyonyarakṣitaṃ vīra balaṃ tvām abhivartate

vulgate_text: nikṛttyaitadrathānīkaṃ balinaṃ lokaviśrutam / sūtaputre maheṣvāse darśayātmānamātmanā
ce_text: sūtaputre maheṣvāse darśayātmānam ātmanā / uttamaṃ yatnam āsthāya pratyehi bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: ācacakṣe priyaṃ pārtha tavedaṃ bharatarṣabha / rājāsau kuśalī śrīmāndharmaputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
ce_text: ācakṣe te priyaṃ pārtha tad evaṃ bharatarṣabha / rājā jīvati kauravyo dharmaputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ

vulgate_text: senā hi dhārtarāṣṭrasya vimukhā vyadravadraṇāt / vegena bhīmasenasya vihatā vividhaiḥ śaraiḥ
ce_text: senā hi dhārtarāṣṭrasya vimukhā cābhavad raṇāt / vipradhāvati vegena bhīmasya nihatā śaraiḥ

vulgate_text: ete nardinti pāñcālā dhmāpayanti ca vārijān / abhidravanti ca raṇe mṛdrantaḥ sāyakaiḥ parān
ce_text: ete nadanti pāñcālā dhamanty api ca vārijān / abhidravanti ca raṇe nighnantaḥ sāyakaiḥ parān

vulgate_text: paśya svargasya māhātmyaṃ pāñcālā hi parākramāt / dhārtarāṣṭrānvinighnanto viśantyete rathottamān
ce_text: paśya svargasya māhātmyaṃ pāñcālā hi paraṃtapa / dhārtarāṣṭrān vinighnanti kruddhāḥ siṃhā iva dvipān

vulgate_text: sarvataścābhipannaiṣā dhārtarāṣṭrī mahācamūḥ / tyaktvā prāṇānmaheṣvāsaiḥ pāñcālaiḥ paripātyate
ce_text: sarvataś cābhipannaiṣā dhārtarāṣṭrī mahācamūḥ / pāñcālair mānasād etya haṃsair gaṅgeva vegitaiḥ

vulgate_text: suhṛdaśca parākrāntāḥ kṛpakarṇādayo vibho / nivāraṇe maheṣvāsāḥ pāñcālānāṃ parantapa
ce_text: subhṛśaṃ ca parākrāntāḥ pāñcālānāṃ nivāraṇe / kṛpakarṇādayo vīrā ṛṣabhāṇām ivarṣabhāḥ

vulgate_text: anivṛttāṃśca bhītāṃstāndhārtarāṣṭrānparantapa / dhṛṣṭadyumnamukhā vīrā ghnanti śatrūnsahasraśaḥ
ce_text: sunimagnāṃś ca bhīmāstrair dhārtarāṣṭrān mahārathān / dhṛṣṭadyumnamukhā vīrā ghnanti śatrūn sahasraśaḥ / viṣaṇṇabhūyiṣṭharathā dhārtarāṣṭrī mahācamūḥ

vulgate_text: rathāśca vividhāḥ sarve nivṛtte bharatarṣabhe / vivarṇamukhabhūyiṣṭhā dhārtarāṣṭrī mahācamūḥ
ce_text: sunimagnāṃś ca bhīmāstrair dhārtarāṣṭrān mahārathān / dhṛṣṭadyumnamukhā vīrā ghnanti śatrūn sahasraśaḥ / viṣaṇṇabhūyiṣṭharathā dhārtarāṣṭrī mahācamūḥ

vulgate_text: abhijānāmi bhīmasya siṃhanādaṃ punaḥpunaḥ / nadataḥ pāṇḍaveyasya saṅgrāme jitakāśinaḥ
ce_text: nābhijānāsi bhīmasya siṃhanādaṃ durutsaham / nadato 'rjuna saṃgrāme vīrasya jitakāśinaḥ

vulgate_text: tasya caiva bhujau chinnau bhīmasenena garjataḥ / nāgaśca krakaraprakhyairnārācairdaśabhirhataḥ
ce_text: satomarāv asya bhujau chinnau bhīmena garjataḥ / tīkṣṇair agniśikhāprakhyair nārācair daśabhir hataḥ

vulgate_text: śaktitomarasaṅghatairvinighnanto vṛkodaram saptasapta ca nāgasthā vaijayantyaśca sadhvajāḥ / navatyā niśitairbāṇaiśchinnāḥ pārthāgrajena te
ce_text: sapta sapta ca nāgāṃs tān vaijayantīś ca sadhvajāḥ / nihatya niśitair bāṇaiś chinnāḥ pārthāgrajena te / daśabhir daśabhiś caiko nārācair nihato gajaḥ

vulgate_text: rādheyo bahubhiḥ sārdhamasau gacchati vegitaḥ vardhayitvā tu bhīruṃ taṃ pārśvato hyānayaddhanuḥ / taṃ pālayanmahārājaṃ dhārtarāṣṭraṃ balānvitaḥ / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tataḥ punaḥ samājagmur abhītāḥ kurusṛñjayāḥ / yudhiṣṭhiramukhāḥ pārthā vaikartanamukhā vayam

vulgate_text: etacchrutvā mahābāhurvāsudevāddhanañjayaḥ bhīmasenena tatkarma kṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā suduṣkaram / arjuno vyadhamacchiṣṭānsaṃśaptakagaṇānbahūn
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / bhīmasenena tat karma kṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā suduṣkaram / arjuno vyadhamac chiṣṭān ahitān niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ

vulgate_text: dravamāṇe balaughe ca nirākrande muhurmuhuḥ / avaśeṣaṃ na paśyāmi mama sainyeṣu sañjaya
ce_text: dravamāṇe balaughe ca nirākrande muhur muhuḥ / kim akurvanta kuravas tan mamācakṣva saṃjaya

vulgate_text: sañjaya uvāca / tataḥ sarathanāgāśvāḥ pāñcālāḥ pāṇḍusṛñjayāḥ / senāpatiṃ parīpsanto rurudhustanayaṃ tava
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / etasminn antare kṛṣṇaḥ pārthaṃ vacanam abravīt / darśayann iva kaunteyaṃ dharmarājaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram

vulgate_text: nakulaṃ tu tataḥ śūro vṛṣaseno hasanniva / nārācena sutīkṣṇena vivyādha hṛdaye bhṛśam
ce_text: nakulas tu tataḥ kruddho vṛṣasenaṃ smayann iva / nārācena sutīkṣṇena vivyādha hṛdaye dṛḍham

vulgate_text: etasminnantare yuddhaṃ kaṣṭamāsīdviśāmpate / nivṛtte tu tataḥ sainye nakulaḥ kauravānyayau
ce_text: dṛṣṭvā tu pradrutāṃ senāṃ dhārtarāṣṭrasya sūtajaḥ / nivārayām āsa balād anupatya viśāṃ pate / nivṛtte tu tataḥ karṇe nakulaḥ kauravān yayau

vulgate_text: ulūkastu raṇe kruddhaḥ sahadevena māriṣa / nivāritaḥ śaraśataiḥ kruddhena raṇamūrdhani
ce_text: ulūkas tu raṇe kruddhaḥ sahadevena vāritaḥ / tasyāśvāṃś caturo hatvā sahadevaḥ pratāpavān / sārathiṃ preṣayām āsa yamasya sadanaṃ prati

vulgate_text: tato'rjuno rathānsarvānhatvā tasya padānugān cakāra samare bhūmiṃ śoṇitaughapariplutām / [sarbalokavahāṃ raudrāṃ paralokavahāṃ nadīm]
ce_text: tato 'rjuno hayān hatvā sarvāṃs tasya mahātmanaḥ / cakāra samare bhūmiṃ śoṇitaughataraṅgiṇīm

vulgate_text: tayostu vyākule yuddhe drauṇeḥ pārthasya dāruṇe / amaryādaṃ yodhayantaḥ paryadhāvanta pṛṣṭhataḥ
ce_text: sārathis tam apovāha rathena rathināṃ varam / tatas tu satvaraṃ rājan pāṇḍusainyam upādravat / duḥśāsanaḥ saubalaś ca gajānīkena pāṇḍavam / mahatā parivāryaiva kṣudrakair abhyatāḍayat / tato bhīmaḥ śaraśatair duryodhanam amarṣaṇam / vimukhīkṛtya tarasā gajānīkam upādravat / tam āpatantaṃ sahasā gajānīkaṃ vṛkodaraḥ / dṛṣṭvaiva subhṛśaṃ kruddho divyam astram udairayat / gajair gajān abhyahanad vajreṇendra ivāsurān / tato 'ntarikṣaṃ bāṇaughaiḥ śalabhair iva pādapam / chādayām āsa samare gajān nighnan vṛkodaraḥ / tataḥ kuñjarayūthāni sametāni sahasraśaḥ / vyadhamat tarasā bhīmo meghasaṃghān ivānilaḥ / suvarṇajālāpihitā maṇijālaiś ca kuñjarāḥ / rejur abhyadhikaṃ saṃkhye vidyutvanta ivāmbudāḥ / te vadhyamānā bhīmena gajā rājan vidudruvuḥ / ke cid vibhinnahṛdayāḥ kuñjarā nyapatan bhuvi / patitair nipatadbhiś ca gajair hemavibhūṣitaiḥ / aśobhata mahī tatra viśīrṇair iva parvataiḥ / dīptābhai ratnavadbhiś ca patitair gajayodhibhiḥ / rarāja bhūmiḥ patitaiḥ kṣīṇapuṇyair iva grahaiḥ / tato bhinnakaṭā nāgā bhinnakumbhakarās tathā / dudruvuḥ śataśaḥ saṃkhye bhīmasenaśarāhatāḥ / ke cid vamanto rudhiraṃ bhayārtāḥ parvatopamāḥ / vyadravañ śaraviddhāṅgā dhātucitrā ivācalāḥ / mahābhujagasaṃkāśau candanāgarurūṣitau / apaśyaṃ bhīmasenasya dhanur vikṣipato bhujau / tasya jyātalanirghoṣaṃ śrutvāśanisamasvanam / vimuñcantaḥ śakṛnmūtraṃ gajāḥ prādudruvur bhṛśam / bhīmasenasya tat karma rājann ekasya dhīmataḥ / nighnataḥ sarvabhūtāni rudrasyeva ca nirbabhau / saṃjaya uvāca / tataḥ śvetāśvasaṃyukte nārāyaṇasamāhite / tiṣṭhan rathavare śrīmān arjunaḥ samapadyata / tad balaṃ nṛpatiśreṣṭha tāvakaṃ vijayo raṇe / vyakṣobhayad udīrṇāśvaṃ mahodadhim ivānalaḥ / duryodhanas tava sutaḥ pramatte śvetavāhane / abhyetya sahasā kruddhaḥ sainyārdhenābhisaṃvṛtaḥ / paryavārayad āyāntaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram amarṣaṇam / kṣuraprāṇāṃ trisaptatyā tato 'vidhyata pāṇḍavam / akrudhyata bhṛśaṃ tatra kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / sa bhallāṃs triṃśatas tūrṇaṃ tava putre nyaveśayat / tato 'dhāvanta kauravyā jighṛkṣanto yudhiṣṭhiram / duṣṭabhāvān parāñ jñātvā samavetā mahārathāḥ / ājagmus taṃ parīpsaṃtaḥ kuntīputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram / nakulaḥ sahadevaś ca dhṛṣṭadyumnaś ca pārṣataḥ / akṣauhiṇyā parivṛtās te 'bhyadhāvan yudhiṣṭhiram / bhīmasenaś ca samare mṛdnaṃs tava mahārathān / abhyadhāvad abhiprepsū rājānaṃ śatrubhir vṛtam / tāṃs tu sarvān maheṣvāsān karṇo vaikartano nṛpa / śaravarṣeṇa mahatā pratyavārayad āgatān / śaraughān visṛjantas te prerayantaś ca tomarān / na śekur yatnavanto 'pi rādheyaṃ prativīkṣitum / tāṃś ca sarvān maheṣvāsān sarvaśastrāstrapāragaḥ / mahatā śaravarṣeṇa rādheyaḥ pratyavārayat / duryodhanaṃ tu viṃśatyā śīghram astram udīrayan / avidhyat tūrṇam abhyetya sahadevo mahāmanāḥ / sa viddhaḥ sahadevena rarājācalasaṃnibhaḥ / prabhinna iva mātaṅgo rudhireṇa pariplutaḥ / dṛṣṭvā tava sutaṃ tatra gāḍhaviddhaṃ sutejanaiḥ / abhyadhāvad dṛḍhaṃ kruddho rādheyo rathināṃ varaḥ / duryodhanaṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā śīghram astram udīrya saḥ / tena yaudhiṣṭhiraṃ sainyam avadhīt pārṣataṃ tathā / tato yaudhiṣṭhiraṃ sainyaṃ vadhyamānaṃ mahātmanā / sahasā prādravad rājan sūtaputraśarārditam / vividhā viśikhās tatra saṃpatantaḥ parasparam / phalaiḥ puṅkhān samājaghnuḥ sūtaputradhanuścyutāḥ / antarikṣe śaraughāṇāṃ patatāṃ ca parasparam / saṃgharṣeṇa mahārāja pāvakaḥ samajāyata / tato daśa diśaḥ karṇaḥ śalabhair iva yāyibhiḥ / abhyaghnaṃs tarasā rājañ śaraiḥ paraśarīragaiḥ / raktacandanasaṃdigdhau maṇihemavibhūṣitau / bāhū vyatyakṣipat karṇaḥ paramāstraṃ vidarśayan / tataḥ sarvā diśo rājan sāyakair vipramohayan / apīḍayad bhṛśaṃ karṇo dharmarājaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram / tataḥ kruddho mahārāja dharmaputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / niśitair iṣubhiḥ karṇaṃ pañcāśadbhiḥ samārpayat / bāṇāndhakāram abhavat tad yuddhaṃ ghoradarśanam / hāhākāro mahān āsīt tāvakānāṃ viśāṃ pate / vadhyamāne tadā sainye dharmaputreṇa māriṣa / sāyakair vividhais tīkṣṇaiḥ kaṅkapatraiḥ śilāśitaiḥ / bhallair anekair vividhaiḥ śaktyṛṣṭimusalair api / yatra yatra sa dharmātmā duṣṭāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ vyasarjayat / tatra tatra vyaśīryanta tāvakā bharatarṣabha / karṇo 'pi bhṛśasaṃkruddho dharmarājaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram / nārācair ardhacandraiś ca vatsadantaiś ca saṃyuge / amarṣī krodhanaś caiva roṣaprasphuritānanaḥ / sāyakair aprameyātmā yudhiṣṭhiram abhidravat / yudhiṣṭhiraś cāpi śataṃ svarṇapuṅkhaiḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ / prahasann iva taṃ karṇaḥ kaṅkapatraiḥ śilāśitaiḥ / urasy avidhyad rājānaṃ tribhir bhallaiś ca pāṇḍavam / sa pīḍito bhṛśaṃ tena dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / upaviśya rathopasthe sūtaṃ yāhīty acodayat / prākrośanta tataḥ sarve dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ sarājakāḥ / gṛhīdhvam iti rājānam abhyadhāvanta sarvaśaḥ / tataḥ śatāḥ saptadaśa kekayānāṃ prahāriṇām / pāñcālaiḥ sahitā rājan dhārtarāṣṭrān nyavārayan / tasmin sutumule yuddhe vartamāne janakṣaye / duryodhanaś ca bhīmaś ca sameyātāṃ mahābalau / karṇo 'tha śarajālena kekayānāṃ mahārathān / vyadhamat parameṣvāsān agrataḥ paryavasthitān / teṣāṃ prayatamānānāṃ rādheyasya nivāraṇe / rathān pañcaśatān karṇaḥ prāhiṇod yamasādanam / aviṣahyaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā rādheyaṃ yudhi yodhinaḥ / bhīmasenam upāgacchan karṇabāṇaprapīḍitāḥ / rathānīkaṃ vidāryaiva śarajālair anekadhā / karṇa ekarathenaiva yudhiṣṭhiram upādravat / senāniveśam ārchantaṃ mārgaṇaiḥ kṣatavikṣatam / yamayor madhyagaṃ vīraṃ śanair yāntaṃ vicetasam / samāsādya tu rājānaṃ duryodhanahitepsayā / sūtaputras tribhis tīkṣṇair vivyādha parameṣubhiḥ / tathaiva rājā rādheyaṃ pratyavidhyat stanāntare / śarais tribhiś ca yantāraṃ caturbhiś caturo hayān / cakrarakṣau tu pārthasya mādrīputrau paraṃtapau / tāv apy adhāvatāṃ karṇaṃ rājānaṃ mā vadhīr iti / tau pṛthak śaravarṣābhyāṃ rādheyam abhyavarṣatām / nakulaḥ sahadevaś ca paramaṃ yatnam āsthitau / tathaiva tau pratyavidhyat sūtaputraḥ pratāpavān / bhallābhyāṃ śitadhārābhyāṃ mahātmānāv ariṃdamau / dantavarṇāṃs tu rādheyo nijaghāna manojavān / yudhiṣṭhirasya saṃgrāme kālavālān hayottamān / tato 'pareṇa bhallena śirastrāṇam apātayat / kaunteyasya maheṣvāsaḥ prahasann iva sūtajaḥ / tathaiva nakulasyāpi hayān hatvā pratāpavān / īṣāṃ dhanuś ca ciccheda mādrīputrasya dhīmataḥ / tau hatāśvau hatarathau pāṇḍavau bhṛśavikṣatau / bhrātarāv āruruhatuḥ sahadevarathaṃ tadā / tau dṛṣṭvā mātulas tatra virathau paravīrahā / abhyabhāṣata rādheyaṃ madrarājo 'nukampayā / yoddhavyam adya pārthena phalgunena tvayā saha / kimarthaṃ dharmarājena yudhayse bhṛśaroṣitaḥ / kṣīṇaśastrāstrakavacaḥ kṣīṇabāṇo vibāṇadhiḥ / śrāntasārathivāhaś ca channo 'strair aribhis tathā / pārtham āsādya rādheya upahāsyo bhaviṣyasi / evam ukto 'pi karṇas tu madrarājena saṃyuge / tathaiva karṇaḥ saṃrabdho yudhiṣṭhiram atāḍayat / śarais tīkṣṇaiḥ parāvidhya mādrīputrau ca pāṇḍavau / prahasya samare karṇaś cakāra vimukhaṃ śaraiḥ / tataḥ śalyaḥ prahasyedaṃ karṇaṃ punar uvāca ha / rathastham atisaṃrabdhaṃ yudhiṣṭhiravadhe dhṛtam / yadarthaṃ dhārtarāṣṭreṇa satataṃ mānito bhavān / taṃ pārthaṃ jahi rādheya kiṃ te hatvā yudhiṣṭhiram / śaṅkhayor dhmāyatoḥ śabdaḥ sumahān eṣa kṛṣṇayoḥ / śrūyate cāpaghoṣo 'yaṃ prāvṛṣīvāmbudasya ha / asau nighnan rathodārān arjunaḥ śaravṛṣṭibhiḥ / sarvāṃ grasati naḥ senāṃ karṇa paśyainam āhave / pṛṣṭharakṣau ca śūrasya yudhāmanyūttamaujasau / uttaraṃ cāsya vai śūraś cakraṃ rakṣati sātyakiḥ / dhṛṣṭadyumnas tathā cāsya cakraṃ rakṣati dakṣiṇam / bhīmasenaś ca vai rājñā dhārtarāṣṭreṇa yudhyate / yathā na hanyāt taṃ bhīmaḥ sarveṣāṃ no 'dya paśyatām / tathā rādheya kriyatāṃ rājā mucyeta no yathā / paśyainaṃ bhīmasenena grastam āhavaśobhinam / yadi tv āsādya mucyeta vismayaḥ sumahān bhavet / paritrāhy enam abhyetya saṃśayaṃ paramaṃ gatam / kiṃ nu mādrīsutau hatvā rājānaṃ ca yudhiṣṭhiram / iti śalyavacaḥ śrutvā rādheyaḥ pṛthivīpate / dṛṣṭvā duryodhanaṃ caiva bhīmagrastaṃ mahāhave / rājagṛddhī bhṛśaṃ caiva śalyavākyapracoditaḥ / ajātaśatrum utsṛjya mādrīputrau ca pāṇḍavau / tava putraṃ paritrātum abhyadhāvata vīryavān / madrarājapraṇuditair aśvair ākāśagair iva / gate karṇe tu kaunteyaḥ pāṇḍuputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / apāyāj javanair aśvaiḥ sahadevasya māriṣa / tābhyāṃ sa sahitas tūrṇaṃ vrīḍann iva nareśvaraḥ / prāpya senāniveśaṃ ca mārgaṇaiḥ kṣatavikṣataḥ / avatīrṇo rathāt tūrṇam āviśac chayanaṃ śubham / apanītaśalyaḥ subhṛśaṃ hṛcchalyābhinipīḍitaḥ / so 'bravīd bhrātarau rājā mādrīputrau mahārathau / anīkaṃ bhīmasenasya pāṇḍavāv āśu gacchatām / jīmūta iva nardaṃs tu yudhyate sa vṛkodaraḥ / tato 'nyaṃ ratham āsthāya nakulo rathapuṃgavaḥ / sahadevaś ca tejasvī bhrātarau śatrukarśanau / turagair agryaraṃhobhir yātvā bhīmasya śuṣmiṇau / anīkaṃ sahitau tatra bhrātarau paryavasthitau

vulgate_text: pārthena samare rājankṛto ghoro janakṣayaḥ nihatā rathinaḥ petuḥ pārthacāpacyutaiḥ śaraiḥ ]
ce_text: nihatā rathinaḥ petuḥ pārthacāpacyutaiḥ śaraiḥ / hayāś ca paryadhāvanta muktayoktrās tatas tataḥ

vulgate_text: vakṣodeśe bhṛśaṃ pārthaṃ tāḍayāmāsa nirdayam / so'tividdho raṇe tena droṇaputreṇa bhārata
ce_text: so 'tividdho raṇe tena droṇaputreṇa bhārata / ādatta parighaṃ ghoraṃ drauṇeś cainam avākṣipat

vulgate_text: tamāpantataṃ parighaṃ jāmbūnadapariṣkṛtam / ciccheda sahasā rājanprahasanniva pāṇḍavaḥ
ce_text: tam āpatantaṃ parighaṃ kārtasvaravibhūṣitam / drauṇiś ciccheda sahasā tata uccukruśur janāḥ

vulgate_text: sa papāta tadā bhūmau nikṛttaḥ pārthasāyakaiḥ / vikīrṇaḥ parvato rājanyathā vajreṇa tāḍitaḥ
ce_text: so 'nekadhāpatad bhūmau bhāradvājasya sāyakaiḥ / viśīrṇaḥ parvato rājan yathā syān mātariśvanā

vulgate_text: tataḥ kruddho mahārāja droṇaputro mahārathaḥ / aindreṇa cāstravegena bībhatsuṃ samavākirat
ce_text: tataḥ kruddho mahārāja droṇaputraḥ pratāpavān / arjunaṃ vāsudevaṃ ca chādayām āsa patribhiḥ

vulgate_text: sa viddhvā marmasu drauṇiṃ pāṇḍavaḥ paravīrahā / sārathiṃ cāsya bhallena rathanīḍādapātayat
ce_text: tato 'rjuno raṇe drauṇiṃ vivyādha daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ / sārathiṃ cāsya bhallena rathanīḍād apāharat

vulgate_text: tadā prahasya bībhasturdroṇaputrasya saṃyuge / kṣipraṃ raśmīnathāśvānāṃ kṣurapraiścicchide jayaḥ
ce_text: yadā tv agrasyata raṇe droṇaputreṇa phalgunaḥ / tato raśmīn rathāśvānāṃ kṣurapraiś cicchide jayaḥ

vulgate_text: tāvakī caturaṅgaiṣā pāṇḍavaistu mahācamūḥ / punaḥpunaratho vīraiḥ prabhagnā jitakāśibhiḥ
ce_text: pāṇḍavais tu mahārāja dhārtarāṣṭrī mahācamūḥ / punaḥ punar atho vīrair abhajyata jayoddhataiḥ

vulgate_text: vāhayāśvānnaravyāghra madrādhipa na saṃśayaḥ / evamuktvā mahārāja sūtaputraḥ pratāpavān
ce_text: evam uktvā mahārāja sūtaputraḥ pratāpavān / pragṛhya vijayaṃ vīro dhanuḥśreṣṭhaṃ purātanam / sajyaṃ kṛtvā mahārāja saṃmṛjya ca punaḥ punaḥ

vulgate_text: dhāvatāṃ ca tato rājaṃstrastānāṃ ca samantataḥ / ārtanādo babhūvātra bhūtānāmiva sampluve
ce_text: teṣāṃ tu krośatāṃ śrutvā bhītānāṃ raṇamūrdhani / dhāvatāṃ ca diśo rājan vitrastānāṃ samantataḥ / ārtanādo mahāṃs tatra pretānām iva saṃplave

vulgate_text: abhīkṣṇaṃ codayannaśvānprekṣate māṃ muhurmuhuḥ / naca śakṣyāmi karṇasya saṃyuge'haṃ palāyitum
ce_text: sutīkṣṇaṃ codayann aśvān prekṣate māṃ muhur muhuḥ / na ca paśyāmi samare karṇasya prapalāyitam

vulgate_text: sañjaya uvāca / tato janārdanaḥ śrutvā tasya vākyaṃ viśāmpate / rathenāpayayau kṣipraṃ saṅgrāmāditi bhārata
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / dṛṣṭvā bhīmaṃ mahābāhuṃ sūtaputraḥ pratāpavān / krodharaktekṣaṇo rājan bhīmasenam upādravat

vulgate_text: rājānaṃ prati vārṣṇeya dūyate me dṛḍhaṃ manaḥ codayāśvānhṛṣīkeśa vihāyaitadbalārṇavam / ajātaśatruṃ rājānaṃ draṣṭumicchāmi keśava / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / dṛṣṭvā bhīmaṃ mahābāhuṃ sūtaputraḥ pratāpavān / krodharaktekṣaṇo rājan bhīmasenam upādravat

vulgate_text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā puruṣavyāghraṃ kṣemiṇaṃ puruṣarṣabham / mudābhyanandatāṃ kṛṣṇāvaśvināviva vāsavam
ce_text: tau dṛṣṭvā puruṣavyāghrau kṣemiṇau puruṣarṣabha / mudābhyupagatau kṛṣṇāv aśvināv iva vāsavam

vulgate_text: manyamāno hataṃ karṇaṃ prītaḥ parapurañjayaḥ sa bhūtvā puruṣavyāghro rājā tatra yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / harṣagadgadayā vācā prītaḥ prāha parantapaḥ
ce_text: manyamāno hataṃ karṇaṃ dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / harṣagadgadayā vācā prītaḥ prāha paraṃtapau

vulgate_text: sañjaya uvāca / [athopayātau pṛthulohitākṣau śarācitāṅgau rudhirapradigdhau / samīkṣya senāgranarapravīrau yudhiṣṭhiro vākyamidaṃ babhāṣe ]
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / drauṇis tu rathavaṃśena mahatā parivāritaḥ / āpatat sahasā rājan yatra rājā vyavasthitaḥ

vulgate_text: svāgataṃ devakīputra svāgataṃ te dhanañjaya / priyaṃ me darśanaṃ vāḍhaṃ yuvayornarasiṃhayoḥ
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca / svāgataṃ devakīputra svāgataṃ te dhanaṃjaya / priyaṃ me darśanaṃ bāḍhaṃ yuvayor acyutārjunau

vulgate_text: ariṣṭayorakṣatayoḥ karṇaṃ hatvā mahāratham / āśīvipasamaṃ yuddhe sarvaśastraviśāradam
ce_text: akṣatābhyām ariṣṭābhyāṃ kathaṃ yudhya mahāratham / āśīviṣasamaṃ yuddhe sarvaśastraviśāradam

vulgate_text: anujñātaṃ mahāvīryaṃ rāmeṇāstre sudurjayam / agryaṃ sarvasya lokasya rathinaṃ lokaviśrutam
ce_text: anujñātaṃ mahāvīryaṃ rameṇāstreṣu durjayam / trātāraṃ dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ gantāraṃ vāhinīmukhe

vulgate_text: tena yuddhamabhītena mayā'dyāpyacyutārjunau kṛtaṃ ghoraṃ mahābāhū dhṛṣṭadyumnasya paśyataḥ / antakeneva kruddhena prajāḥ sarvā jighāṃsatā
ce_text: tena yuddham adīnena mayā hy adyācyutārjunau / kupitenāntakeneva prajāḥ sarvā jighāṃsatā

vulgate_text: ko nu me jīvitenārtho rājyenārtho bhavetpunaḥ / mamaivaṃ vikṣatasyādya karṇenāhavaśobhinā
ce_text: ko nu me jīvitenārtho rājyenārtho 'tha vā punaḥ / mamaivaṃ dhikkṛtasyeha karṇenāhavaśobhinā

vulgate_text: sarvā diśaḥ paryapatattvadarthaṃ tvāṃ sūtaputraḥ samare parīpsan / ditsannṛṇāṃ śakaṭaṃ ratnapūrṇaṃ kathaṃ tvayāsau nihato'dya karṇaḥ
ce_text: yaḥ paryupāsīt pradiśo diśaś ca; tvāṃ sūtaputraḥ samare parīpsan / ditsuḥ karṇaḥ samare hastipūgaṃ; sa hīdānīṃ kaṅkapatraiḥ sutīkṣṇaiḥ

vulgate_text: yo'sau sadā ślāghate rājamadhye duryodhanaṃ harṣayandarpayuktaḥ / hantā'smi sarvāniti pāṇḍuputrā-- nahaṃ hantā phalgunasyeti mohāt
ce_text: yo 'sau sadā ślāghate rājamadhye; duryodhanaṃ harṣayan darpapūrṇaḥ / ahaṃ hantā phalgunasyeti mohāt; kaccid dhatas tasya na vai tathā rathaḥ

vulgate_text: savyena vā yadi vā dakṣiṇena na jñāyate katareṇāsyatīti / ācāryavatsamare paryavarta-- nmahaccitraṃ darśayansarvataḥ sma
ce_text: naivādadānaṃ na ca saṃdadhānaṃ; jānīmahe katareṇāsyatīti / vāmena vā yadi vā dakṣiṇena; sa droṇaputraḥ samare paryavartat

vulgate_text: āvidhyanmāṃ pañcabhidroṇaputraḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ pañcabhirvāsudevam / abhyaghnaṃ bāṇaistamahaṃ sudhārai-- rnimeṣamātreṇa suvarṇapuṅkhaiḥ
ce_text: avidhyan māṃ pañcabhir droṇaputraḥ; śitaiḥ śaraiḥ pañcabhir vāsudevam / ahaṃ tu taṃ triṃśatā vajrakalpaiḥ; samārdayaṃ nimiṣasyāntareṇa

vulgate_text: sa nirviddho viratho droṇaputro rathānīkaṃ cādhiratherviveśa / mayābhibhūtānsvarathaprabarhā-- nastraṃ ca paśyanrudhirapradigdham
ce_text: sa vikṣaran rudhiraṃ sarvagātrai; rathānīkaṃ sūtasūnor viveśa / mayābhibhūtaḥ sainikānāṃ prabarhān; asāv apaśyan rudhireṇa pradigdhān

vulgate_text: mṛtyorāsyaṃ vyāttamivābhipadya prabhadrakāḥ karṇamāsādya sarve / yāsyāmi tāṃstārayiṣyanbalaughā-- ddiṣṭyā bhavānsvastimānpārtha dṛṣṭaḥ
ce_text: mahājhaṣasyeva mukhaṃ prapannāḥ; prabhadrakāḥ karṇam abhi dravanti / mṛtyor āsyaṃ vyāttam ivānvapadyan; prabhadrakāḥ karṇam āsādya rājan / rathāṃs tu tān saptaśatān nimagnāṃs / tadā karṇaḥ prāhiṇon mṛtyusadma / na cāpy abhūt klāntamanāḥ sa rājan / yāvan nāsmān dṛṣṭavān sūtaputraḥ / śrutvā tu tvāṃ tena dṛṣṭaṃ sametam / aśvatthāmnā pūrvataraṃ kṣataṃ ca / manye kālam apayānasya rājan / krūrāt karṇāt te 'ham acintyakarman / na me karṇasyāstram idaṃ purastād / yuddhe dṛṣṭaṃ pāṇḍava citrarūpam / na hy anyayoddhā vidyate sṛñjayānāṃ / mahārathaṃ yo 'dya saheta karṇam / śaineyo me sātyakiś cakrarakṣau / dhṛṣṭadyumnaś cāpi tathaiva rājan / yudhāmanyuś cottamaujāś ca śūrau / pṛṣṭhato māṃ rakṣatāṃ rājaputrau / rathapravīreṇa mahānubhāva / dviṣatsainye vartatā dustareṇa

vulgate_text: sañjaya uvāca / vaikartanaṃ kuśalinaṃ niśamya kruddhaḥ pārthaḥ phalgūnasyāmitaujāḥ / dhanañjayaṃ vākyamuvāca rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ karṇaśarābhitaptaḥ
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tad dharmaśīlasya vaco niśamya; rājñaḥ kruddhasyādhirathau mahātmā / uvāca durdharṣam adīnasattvaṃ; yudhiṣṭhiraṃ jiṣṇur anantavīryaḥ

vulgate_text: ityevamuktvā bībhatsuṃ roṣātsaṃraktalocanaḥ / abravītpunarevātra dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
ce_text: ity evam uktvā punar āha pārtho; yudhiṣṭhiraṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭham / apy aputrā tena rādhā bhavitrī; kuntī mayā vā tad ṛtaṃ viddhi rājan / prasīda rājan kṣama yan mayoktaṃ; kāle bhavān vetsyati tan namas te

vulgate_text: idaṃ yadi dvaitavane tu sūktaṃ karṇaṃ niyoddhuṃ na sahe nṛpeti / vayaṃ tataḥ prāptakālaṃ yathāva-- tkṛtvā'bhyupekṣāma tathaiva rājyam
ce_text: idaṃ yadi dvaitavane hy avakṣyaḥ; karṇaṃ yoddhuṃ na prasahe nṛpeti / vayaṃ tadā prāptakālāni sarve; vṛttāny upaiṣyāma tadaiva pārtha

vulgate_text: yattadvṛthā vāguvācāntarikṣe saptāhni jāte tvayi mandabuddhau / apāpīyānvāsavātkuntijāto bahūnsaṅgrāmānayameva jetā
ce_text: yat tat pṛthāṃ vāg uvācāntarikṣe; saptāhajāte tvayi mandabuddhau / jātaḥ putro vāsavavikramo 'yaṃ; sarvāñ śūrāñ śātravāñ jeṣyatīti

vulgate_text: ayaṃ jetā pāṇḍavo devasaṅghān sarvāṇi bhūtānyapi cottamaujāḥ / ayaṃ jetā madrakaliṅgajātā-- ndaityāṃśca rakṣāṃsi samāgatāni
ce_text: ayaṃ jetā khāṇḍave devasaṃghān; sarvāṇi bhūtāny api cottamaujāḥ / ayaṃ jetā madrakaliṅgakekayān; ayaṃ kurūn hanti ca rājamadhye

vulgate_text: mamaiva bhāgyāni purā kṛtāni pāpāni nūnaṃ phalavanti yuddhe / tṛṇaṃ ca kṛtvā samare bhavantaṃ tato'hamevaṃ nikṛto durātmanā vaikartanenaiva tathā kṛto'haṃ yathā hyaśaktaḥ kriyate tvabāndhavaḥ
ce_text: tvaṣṭrā kṛtaṃ vāham akūjanākṣaṃ; śubhaṃ samāsthāya kapidhvajaṃ tvam / khaḍgaṃ gṛhītvā hemacitraṃ samiddhaṃ; dhanuś cedaṃ gāṇḍivaṃ tālamātram / sa keśavenohyamānaḥ kathaṃ nu; karṇād bhīto vyapayāto 'si pārtha / pūrvaṃ yad uktaṃ hi suyodhanena / na phalgunaḥ pramukhe sthāsyatīti / karṇasya yuddhe hi mahābalasya / maurkhyāt tu tan nāvabuddhaṃ mayāsīt / tenādya tapsye bhṛśam aprameyaṃ / yan mitravargo narakaṃ praviṣṭaḥ / tadaiva vācyo 'smi nanu tvayāhaṃ / na yotsye 'haṃ sūtaputraṃ kathaṃ cit / tato nāhaṃ sṛñjayān kekayāṃś ca / samānayeyaṃ suhṛdo raṇāya / evaṃ gate kiṃ ca mayādya śakyaṃ / kāryaṃ kartuṃ nigrahe sūtajasya / tathaiva rājñaś ca suyodhanasya / ye cāpi māṃ yoddhukāmāḥ sametāḥ / dhig astu majjīvitam adya kṛṣṇa / yo 'haṃ vaśaṃ sūtaputrasya yātaḥ / madhye kurūṇāṃ sasuyodhanānāṃ / ye cāpy anye yoddhukāmāḥ sametāḥ / ekas tu me bhīmaseno 'dya nātho / yenābhipanno 'smi raṇe mahābhaye / vimocya māṃ cāpi ruṣānvitas tataḥ / śareṇa tīkṣṇena bibheda karṇam / tyaktvā prāṇān samare bhīmasenaś / cakre yuddhaṃ kurumukhyaiḥ sametaiḥ / gadāgrahasto rudhirokṣitāṅgaś / caran raṇe kāla ivāntakāle / asau hi bhīmasya mahān ninādo / muhur muhuḥ śrūyate dhārtarāṣṭraiḥ / yadi sma jīvet samare nihantā / mahārathānāṃ pravaro narottamaḥ / tavābhimanyus tanayo 'dya pārtha / na cāsmi gantā samare parābhavam / athāpi jīvet samare ghaṭotkacas / tathāpi nāhaṃ samare parāṅmukhaḥ / bhīmasya putraḥ samarāgrayāyī / mahāstravic cāpi tavānurūpaḥ / yatnaṃ samāsādya ripor balaṃ no / nimīlitākṣaṃ bhayaviplutaṃ bhavet / cakāra yo 'sau niśi yuddham ekas / tyaktvā raṇaṃ yasya bhayād dravante / sa cet samāsādya mahānubhāvaḥ / karṇaṃ raṇe bāṇagaṇaiḥ pramohya / dhairye sthitenāpi ca sūtajena / śaktyā hato vāsavadattayā tayā / mamaiva bhāgyāni purā kṛtāni / pāpāni nūnaṃ phalavanti yuddhe / tṛṇaṃ ca kṛtvā samare bhavantaṃ / tato 'ham evaṃ nikṛto durātmanā / vaikartaneneha tathā kṛto 'haṃ / yathā hy aśaktaḥ kriyate hy abāndhavaḥ / āpadgataṃ yaś ca naraṃ vimokṣayet / sa bāndhavaḥ snehayutaḥ suhṛd vai / evaṃ purāṇā ṛṣayo vadanti / dharmaḥ sadā sadbhir anuṣṭhitaś ca

vulgate_text: sa gāṇḍīvaṃ keśavāya pradāya yantā bhavestvaṃ yadi keśavasya / tatastaretkeśavaḥ karṇamugraṃ marutsasvo vṛtramivāttavajraḥ
ce_text: dhanuś caitat keśavāya pradāya; yantābhaviṣyas tvaṃ raṇe ced durātman / tato 'haniṣyat keśavaḥ karṇam ugraṃ; marutpatir vṛtram ivāttavajraḥ

vulgate_text: māse'patiṣyo yadi pañcame tvaṃ na vā garbho yadyabhavaḥ pṛthāyāḥ / mattaḥ śreyānrājaputro'bhaviṣya-- nna te yaśaḥ phalguna ityapeyāt
ce_text: māse 'patiṣyaḥ pañcame tvaṃ prakṛcchre; na vā garbho 'py abhaviṣyaḥ pṛthāyāḥ / tat te śramo rājaputrābhaviṣyan; na saṃgrāmād apayātuṃ durātman

vulgate_text: tasya kopaṃ samājñāya cittajñaḥ keśavastadā / uvāca kimidaṃ khaṅgaṃ gṛhṇāsyarjuna śaṃma me
ce_text: tasya kopaṃ samudvīkṣya cittajñaḥ keśavas tadā / uvāca kim idaṃ pārtha gṛhītaḥ khaḍga ity uta

vulgate_text: na taṃ paśyāmi kaunteya yaste vadhyo bhavediha / prahartumicchase kasmātkiṃ vā te cittavibhramaḥ
ce_text: na taṃ paśyāmi kaunteya yas te vadhyo bhaved iha / kasmād bhavān mahākhaḍgaṃ parigṛhṇāti satvaram

vulgate_text: anyasmai dehi gāṇḍīvamiti māṃ yaḥ pracodayet bhindyāmahaṃ tasya śira ityupāṃśu vrataṃ mama / yudhiṣṭhireṇa tenāhamuktaścāsmi janārdana
ce_text: dada gāṇḍīvam anyasmā iti māṃ yo 'bhicodayet / chindyām ahaṃ śiras tasya ity upāṃśuvrataṃ mama

vulgate_text: yadukto'hamadīnārthaṃ rājñā'nena yaśasvinā / samakṣaṃ tava govinda na tatkṣantumihotsahe
ce_text: tad ukto 'ham adīnātman rājñāmitaparākrama / samakṣaṃ tava govinda na tat kṣantum ihotsahe

vulgate_text: jātastvatto hi dharmaścādharmaśceti parā śrutiḥ / tattathā prakariṣyāmi yathā māṃ vakṣyate bhavān / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / śrutvā karṇaṃ kalyam udāravīryaṃ; kruddhaḥ pārthaḥ phalgunasyāmitaujāḥ / dhanaṃjayaṃ vākyam uvāca cedaṃ; yudhiṣṭhiraḥ karṇaśarābhitaptaḥ

vulgate_text: dhigdhigityeva govindaḥ pārthamuktvābravītpunaḥ / kṛṣṇa uvāca
ce_text: kṛṣṇa uvāca / idānīṃ pārtha jānāmi na vṛddhāḥ sevitās tvayā / akāle puruṣavyāghra saṃrambhakriyayānayā / na hi dharmavibhāgajñaḥ kuryād evaṃ dhanaṃjaya

vulgate_text: na hi dharmavigajñairevaṃ kāryaṃ dhanañjaya / yathā tvaṃ pāṇḍavādyeha dharmabhīruraṇḍitaḥ
ce_text: kṛṣṇa uvāca / idānīṃ pārtha jānāmi na vṛddhāḥ sevitās tvayā / akāle puruṣavyāghra saṃrambhakriyayānayā / na hi dharmavibhāgajñaḥ kuryād evaṃ dhanaṃjaya

vulgate_text: yo'kāryāṇāṃ kriyāyāśca saṃyogaṃ nāvabudhyate / kāryāṇāmakriyāyāśca sa pārtha puruṣādhamaḥ
ce_text: akāryāṇāṃ ca kāryāṇāṃ saṃyogaṃ yaḥ karoti vai / kāryāṇām akriyāṇāṃ ca sa pārtha puruṣādhamaḥ

vulgate_text: prāṇināṃ hi vadhāttāta vṛthā dharmo mato mama / anṛtaṃ tu bhavedvācyaṃ na tu hiṃsā kadācana
ce_text: prāṇinām avadhas tāta sarvajyāyān mato mama / anṛtaṃ tu bhaved vācyaṃ na ca hiṃsyāt kathaṃ cana

vulgate_text: ayudhyamānasya gurostathā'śatrośca mānada / parāṅmukhasya dravataḥ śaraṇaṃ cāpi gacchataḥ
ce_text: ayudhyamānasya vadhas tathāśastrasya bhārata / parāṅmukhasya dravataḥ śaraṇaṃ vābhigacchataḥ / kṛtāñjaleḥ prapannasya na vadhaḥ pūjyate budhaiḥ

vulgate_text: kṛtāñjaleḥ prapannasya pramattasya tathaiva ca / na vadhaḥ pūjyate sadbhistacca sarvaṃ gurau tava
ce_text: ayudhyamānasya vadhas tathāśastrasya bhārata / parāṅmukhasya dravataḥ śaraṇaṃ vābhigacchataḥ / kṛtāñjaleḥ prapannasya na vadhaḥ pūjyate budhaiḥ

vulgate_text: svaguruṃ pārtha kasmāttvaṃ hantukāmo'bhidhāvasi / asampradhārya dharmāṇāṃ gatiṃ sūkṣmāṃ duratyayām
ce_text: sa guruṃ pārtha kasmāt tvaṃ hanyā dharmam anusmaran / asaṃpradhārya dharmāṇāṃ gatiṃ sūkṣmāṃ duranvayām

vulgate_text: viduro vā punaḥ kṣattā gāndhārī vā yaśasvinī kuntī vā bharataśreṣṭha draupadī vā yaśasvinī / tatte vakṣyāmi tattvena nibodhaitaddhanañjaya
ce_text: viduro vā tathā kṣattā kuntī vāpi yaśasvinī / tat te vakṣyāmi tattvena tan nibodha dhanaṃjaya

vulgate_text: satyasyaṃ vacanaṃ sādhu na satyādvidyate param / sudurvidaṃ hi tattvena tatsatyamiti me satiḥ
ce_text: satyasya vacanaṃ sādhu na satyād vidyate param / tattvenaitat sudurjñeyaṃ yasya satyam anuṣṭhitam

vulgate_text: sa kadācinmṛgaprepsurnānvavindanmṛgaṃ kvacit / athāpaśyatsa pīvānaṃ śvāpadaṃ ghrāṇacakṣuṣam
ce_text: sa kadā cin mṛgāṃl lipsur nānvavindat prayatnavān / athāpaśyat sa pītodaṃ śvāpadaṃ ghrāṇacakṣuṣam

vulgate_text: taddhatvā sarvabhūtānāmabhāvakṛtaniścayam / balāko'gātsvargalokamevaṃ dharmaḥ sudurvidaḥ
ce_text: tad dhatvā sarvabhūtānām abhāvakṛtaniścayam / tato balākaḥ svaragād evaṃ dharmaḥ sudurvidaḥ

vulgate_text: atha dasyubhayātkecittadā tadvanamāviśan / tatrāpi dasyavaḥ kruddhāstānamārganta yatnataḥ
ce_text: atha dasyubhayāt ke cit tadā tad vanam āviśan / dasyavo 'pi gatāḥ krūrā vyamārganta prayatnataḥ
