vulgate_text: gataḥ sukaṣṭaṃ nirayaṃ dharmasūkṣmeṣvatattvavit / dṛṣṭapūrvaśruto mūḍho dharmāṇāmaviśāradaḥ
ce_text: tenādharmeṇa mahatā vāgduruktena kauśikaḥ / gataḥ sukaṣṭaṃ narakaṃ sūkṣmadharmeṣv akovidaḥ / aprabhūtaśruto mūḍho dharmāṇām avibhāgavit

vulgate_text: tatra te lakṣaṇoddeśaḥ kaścideva bhaviṣyati / duṣkaraṃ pratisaṃkhyānaṃ kārtsnyenātra vyavasthitiḥ
ce_text: vṛddhān apṛṣṭvā saṃdehaṃ mahac chvabhram ito 'rhati / tatra te lakṣaṇoddeśaḥ kaś cid eva bhaviṣyati

vulgate_text: satyaṃ dharma iti hyeke vadanti bahavo janāḥ / na ca pārthābhyasūyāmi naitatsarvatra śiṣyate
ce_text: duṣkaraṃ paramajñānaṃ tarkeṇātra vyavasyati / śrutir dharma iti hy eke vadanti bahavo janāḥ

vulgate_text: yatsyādahiṃsāsaṃyuktaṃ sa dharma iti niścayaḥ ahiṃsārthāya hiṃsrāṇāṃ dharmapravacanaṃ kṛtam / dhāraṇāddharmamityāhurdharmo dhārayate prajāḥ
ce_text: dhāraṇād dharmam ity āhur dharmo dhārayati prajāḥ / yaḥ syād dhāraṇasaṃyuktaḥ sa dharma iti niścayaḥ

vulgate_text: ye'nyāyena jigīṣanto dharmaṃ pṛcchanti mānavāḥ / akūjanena cenmokṣo nātra kūjetkathañcana
ce_text: ye 'nyāyena jihīrṣanto janā icchanti karhi cit / akūjanena cen mokṣo nātra kūjet kathaṃ cana

vulgate_text: avaśyaṃ kūjitavye ha śaṅkeranvāpyakūjanāt ye'nyāyena jihīrṣanto dharmaṃ pṛcchanti kasyacit / śreyastatrānṛtaṃ vaktuṃ satyāditi viniścitm
ce_text: avaśyaṃ kūjitavyaṃ vā śaṅkeran vāpy akūjataḥ / śreyas tatrānṛtaṃ vaktuṃ satyād iti vicāritam

vulgate_text: suhṛdbrūyādyathā'smākaṃ tathoktaṃ vacanaṃ tvayā bhavānmātṛsamo'smākaṃ bhavānpitṛsamo'pi ca / gatiśca paramā kṛṣṇa tvameva ca parāyaṇam
ce_text: bhavān mātṛsamo 'smākaṃ tathā pitṛsamo 'pi ca / gatiś ca paramā kṛṣṇa tena te vākyam adbhutam

vulgate_text: taṃ hanyāṃ cetkeśava jīvaloke sthātā nāhaṃ kālamapyalpamātram / dhyātvā nūnaṃ hyenasā cāpi mukto vadhaṃ rājño bhraṣṭavīryo vicetāḥ
ce_text: taṃ hatvā cet keśava jīvaloke; sthātā kālaṃ nāham apy alpamātram / sā ca pratijñā mama lokaprabuddhā; bhavet satyā dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭha / yathā jīvet pāṇḍavo 'haṃ ca kṛṣṇa; tathā buddhiṃ dātum adyārhasi tvam

vulgate_text: rājā śrānto vikṣato duḥkhitaśca karṇena sahkhye niśitairbāṇasaṅghaiḥ / yaścāniśaṃ sūtaputreṇa vīra śarairbhṛśaṃ tāḍito yudhyamānaḥ
ce_text: vāsudeva uvāca / rājā śrānto jagato vikṣataś ca; karṇena saṃkhye niśitair bāṇasaṃghaiḥ / tasmāt pārtha tvāṃ paruṣāṇy avocat; karṇe dyūtaṃ hy adya raṇe nibaddham

vulgate_text: nityodyukte satataṃ cāprasahye karṇe dyūtaṃ hyadya raṇe nibaddham / tasminhate kuravo nirjitāḥ syu-- revaṃ buddhiḥ pārthive dharmaputre
ce_text: tasmin hate kuravo nirjitāḥ syur; evaṃbuddhiḥ pārthivo dharmaputraḥ / yadāvamānaṃ labhate mahāntaṃ; tadā jīvan mṛta ity ucyate saḥ

vulgate_text: yadā mānaṃ labhate mānanārha-- stadā sa vai jīvati jīvaloke / yadā'vamānaṃ labhate mahāntaṃ tadā jīvanmṛta ityucyate saḥ
ce_text: tasmin hate kuravo nirjitāḥ syur; evaṃbuddhiḥ pārthivo dharmaputraḥ / yadāvamānaṃ labhate mahāntaṃ; tadā jīvan mṛta ity ucyate saḥ

vulgate_text: yadā hyaṃ pāṇḍava dharmarāja-- satvatto'yuktaṃ lapsyate caiva sādhu / tato'sya pādāvabhivādya paścā-- cchreyo brūyātsāntvayuktaṃ hitaṃ ca
ce_text: vadho hy ayaṃ pāṇḍava dharmarājñas; tvatto yukto vetsyate caivam eṣaḥ / tato 'sya pādāv abhivādya paścāc; chamaṃ brūyāḥ sāntvapūrvaṃ ca pārtham

vulgate_text: bhrātā prājñastava kopaṃ na jātu kuryādrājā dharmamārgānusārī / mukto'nṛtādvātṛvadhācca pāpā-- ddhṛṣṭaḥ karṇaṃ tvaṃ jahi pārtha paścāt
ce_text: bhrātā prājñas tava kopaṃ na jātu; kuryād rājā kaṃ cana pāṇḍaveyaḥ / mukto 'nṛtād bhrātṛvadhāc ca pārtha; hṛṣṭaḥ karṇaṃ tvaṃ jahi sūtaputram

vulgate_text: mā tvaṃ rājanvyāharasvādya pāpaṃ tvaṃ tiṣṭhasi krośamātre vyapetya / bhīmastu māmarhati garhaṇāya yo yudhyate sarvalokapravīraiḥ
ce_text: mā tvaṃ rājan vyāhara vyāharatsu; na tiṣṭhase krośamātre raṇārdhe / bhīmas tu mām arhati garhaṇāya; yo yudhyate sarvayodhapravīraḥ

vulgate_text: sa kuñjarāṇāmadhikaṃ sahasraṃ hatvā nadaṃstumulaṃ siṃhanādam / kāmbhojavānāyujapārvatīyā-- nīhāmṛgābhānvinihatya vājinaḥ
ce_text: kāle hi śatrūn pratipīḍya saṃkhye; hatvā ca śūrān pṛthivīpatīṃs tān / yaḥ kuñjarāṇām adhikaṃ sahasraṃ; hatvānadat tumulaṃ siṃhanādam

vulgate_text: mahārathāndaviradāñśailakalpā-- nsaheta yaḥ kuñjarānvadhyamānān / asau bhīmo dhārtarāṣṭreṣu magnaḥ sa māmupālabdhumarindamo'rhati
ce_text: mahārathān nāgavarān hayāṃś ca; padātimukhyān api ca pramathya / eko bhīmo dhārtarāṣṭreṣu magnaḥ; sa mām upālabdhum ariṃdamo 'rhati

vulgate_text: saṃyuktamāsthāya rathaṃ hi kāle dhanurvidhūnvañcharapūrṇamuṣṭiḥ / sṛjecca yo bāṇasaṅghānpareṣu mahābalo megha ivāmbudhārāḥ
ce_text: suyuktam āsthāya rathaṃ hi kāle; dhanur vikarṣañ śarapūrṇamuṣṭiḥ / sṛjaty asau śaravarṣāṇi vīro; mahāhave megha ivāmbudhārāḥ / rathāś ca nāgāś ca hayāś ca rājan / bhīmenājau nihatāḥ saṃghaśo 'dya / rājānaś ca bahavo mahābalāḥ / sa mām upālabdhum ariṃdamo 'rhati / dhṛtarāṣṭraputrā balinaś ca yena / mahābalā nihatāḥ prāyaśo vai / śūro yuddheṣv aprativāryavīryaḥ / sa mām upālabdhum ariṃdamo 'rhati / pratāpayaṃs tad balam ugrarūpaṃ / yo 'sau raṇe dhārtarāṣṭrasya vīraḥ / ekaḥ sahetāpratisahyapauruṣas / tenāsmi vācyo na tvayā vai kadā cit / mahārathā yatra yatraiva yuddhe / bhindanti sainyaṃ tava kāmato 'dya / tatraiva tatraiva raṇe mahātmā / dṛḍhaṃ bhīmaḥ parasaṃghān amṛdnāt / tenāsmi vācyo na tvayāhaṃ kadā cit / mā mā vocaḥ krūram ihādya pārtha / nāsmadvidho vai bhavatā tu vācyo / yathā bhavān sarvalokasya vācyaḥ / evaṃ hi mā te bruvato narendra / kathaṃ na dīryec chatadhādya jihvā / aho batedaṃ sunṛśaṃsarūpaṃ / bhavān api hy atra karṇād bibheti

vulgate_text: dhṛtarāṣṭraputrā balinaśca yena mahābalā nihatāḥ prāyaśo vai / śūro yuddhe hyaprativāryavīryaḥ sa māmupālabdhumarindamo'rhati
ce_text: mahārathān nāgavarān hayāṃś ca; padātimukhyān api ca pramathya / eko bhīmo dhārtarāṣṭreṣu magnaḥ; sa mām upālabdhum ariṃdamo 'rhati

vulgate_text: evaṃ hi mā te bruvato narendra kathaṃ na dīryecchatadhā'dya jihvā / aho batedaṃ sunṛśaṃsarūpaṃ kāmādavocastvamihādya yadvai
ce_text: suyuktam āsthāya rathaṃ hi kāle; dhanur vikarṣañ śarapūrṇamuṣṭiḥ / sṛjaty asau śaravarṣāṇi vīro; mahāhave megha ivāmbudhārāḥ / rathāś ca nāgāś ca hayāś ca rājan / bhīmenājau nihatāḥ saṃghaśo 'dya / rājānaś ca bahavo mahābalāḥ / sa mām upālabdhum ariṃdamo 'rhati / dhṛtarāṣṭraputrā balinaś ca yena / mahābalā nihatāḥ prāyaśo vai / śūro yuddheṣv aprativāryavīryaḥ / sa mām upālabdhum ariṃdamo 'rhati / pratāpayaṃs tad balam ugrarūpaṃ / yo 'sau raṇe dhārtarāṣṭrasya vīraḥ / ekaḥ sahetāpratisahyapauruṣas / tenāsmi vācyo na tvayā vai kadā cit / mahārathā yatra yatraiva yuddhe / bhindanti sainyaṃ tava kāmato 'dya / tatraiva tatraiva raṇe mahātmā / dṛḍhaṃ bhīmaḥ parasaṃghān amṛdnāt / tenāsmi vācyo na tvayāhaṃ kadā cit / mā mā vocaḥ krūram ihādya pārtha / nāsmadvidho vai bhavatā tu vācyo / yathā bhavān sarvalokasya vācyaḥ / evaṃ hi mā te bruvato narendra / kathaṃ na dīryec chatadhādya jihvā / aho batedaṃ sunṛśaṃsarūpaṃ / bhavān api hy atra karṇād bibheti

vulgate_text: balaṃ na vādhiṣṭhitaṃ sattamānāṃ yatkṣatriyāṇāṃ bahulaṃ vadanti / tvaṃ cābalo bhārata niṣṭhuro'si tvameva māṃ vetsi yathāvidho'ham
ce_text: balaṃ tu vāci dvijasattamānāṃ; kṣātraṃ budhā bāhubalaṃ vadanti / tvaṃ vāgbalo bhārata niṣṭhuraś ca; tvam eva māṃ vetsi yathāvidho 'ham / nakulena rājan gajavājiyodhā / hatāś ca śūrāḥ sahasā sametya / tyaktvā prāṇān samare yuddhakāṅkṣī / sa mām upālabdhum ariṃdamo 'rhati / kṛtaṃ karma sahadevena duṣkaraṃ / yo yudhyate parasainyāvamardī / na cābravīt kiṃ cid ihāgato balī / paśyāntaraṃ tasya caivātmanaś ca / dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ sātyakir draupadeyā / yudhāmanyuś cottamaujāḥ śikhaṇḍī / ete 'dya sarve yudhi saṃprapīḍitās / te mām upālabdhum arhanti na tvam / tvanmūlam asmābhir idaṃ hi vairaṃ / prāptaṃ tathā vyasanaṃ cātighoram / dyūte pramattena kṛtaṃ tvayāsakṛt / kasmād upālabdhum ihārhasi tvam / tvam eva rājan satataṃ pramattas / tvam eva mūḍho bhāratānām asādhuḥ / tvāṃ prāpya rājyaṃ ca vinaṣṭam etat / prāptā mahat pāṇḍavāś caiva dāsyam / tvattaḥ kṛte syād vanavāsaduḥkhaṃ / rājyasya nāśo hy abhimanyoś ca ghoraḥ / ātmānam evaṃ sunṛśaṃsarūpaṃ / jñātvā kimarthaṃ garhase mādya vīra / lajjasva rājan yadi te 'sti lajjā / tūṣṇīṃ bhūtaḥ paśya sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ naḥ / bhīmo nityaṃ samarasya kartā / darpasya bhettā punar eva nityam / svayaṃ hy aśaktena narendra yuddhe / nareṇa kāryā satataṃ kṣamaiva

vulgate_text: na yucyate vai divi ceha yaḥ pumā-- nyaste madanyo'priyamārabheta / na cābhinandāmi tathāhi rājyaṃ yatastvamakṣeṣu dṛḍhaṃ prasaktaḥ
ce_text: na cābhinandāmi tavādhirājyaṃ; yatas tvam akṣeṣv ahitāya saktaḥ / svayaṃ kṛtvā pāpam anāryajuṣṭam; ebhir yuddhe tartum icchasy arīṃs tu

vulgate_text: svayaṃ kṛtaṃ pāpamanāryajuṣṭa-- masmābhirājau vyasanaṃ titīrṣasi / akṣeṣu doṣā bahavo vidharmyāḥ śrutāstvayā sahadevo'bravīdyān
ce_text: akṣeṣu doṣā bahavo vidharmāḥ; śrutās tvayā sahadevo 'bravīd yān / tān naiṣi saṃtartum asādhujuṣṭān; yena sma sarve nirayaṃ prapannāḥ

vulgate_text: tānnecchasi tyaktumanāryajuṣṭā-- nghore sma sarve niraye tvayā'stāḥ / tvaṃ devitā tvatkṛte rājyanāśaṃ-- stvatsambhavaṃ vyasanaṃ no narendra
ce_text: tvaṃ devitā tvatkṛte rājyanāśas; tvat saṃbhavaṃ vyasanaṃ no narendra / māsmān krūrair vākpratodais tuda tvaṃ; bhūyo rājan kopayann alpabhāgyān

vulgate_text: etā vācaḥ paruṣāḥ savyasācī sthirapratijñaḥ śrāvayitvā narendram / viniḥ śvasañjyeṣṭhamaniṣṭamuktvā tatastu kośādasimudvabarha
ce_text: etā vācaḥ paruṣāḥ savyasācī; sthiraprajñaṃ śrāvayitvā tatakṣa / tadānutepe surarājaputro; viniḥśvasaṃś cāpy asim udbabarha

vulgate_text: tathā tu kṛṣṇasya vaco niśamya tato'rjunaḥ prāha dhanuḥ pragṛhya / yudhiṣṭhiraṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭhaṃ śṛṇuṣva rājanniti durvacaḥ svayam / arjuna uvāca
ce_text: arjuna uvāca / ācakṣva bhagavann etad yathā vidyām ahaṃ tathā / balākāndhābhisaṃbaddhaṃ nadīnāṃ kauśikasya ca

vulgate_text: pāṇī pṛṣatkālikhitāvimau puna-- rdhanuśca savye vitataṃ sabāṇam / pādau ca me lakṣaṇataḥ praśastau na mādṛśaṃ yuddhagataṃ jayanti
ce_text: pāṇau pṛṣatkā likhitā mameme; dhanuś ca saṃkhye vitataṃ sabāṇam / pādau ca me saśarau sahadhvajau; na mādṛśaṃ yuddhagataṃ jayanti

vulgate_text: śete mayā nihatā śatrusenā chinnairgātrairbhūmitale skhalantī / anastrajñānnaiva nihanmi cāstrai-- stasmānna bhasmaiva karomi lokān
ce_text: śete mayā nihatā bhāratī ca; camū rājan devacamūprakāśā / ye nāstrajñās tān ahaṃ hanmi śastrais; tasmāl lokaṃ neha karomi bhasmasāt

vulgate_text: ityevamuktvā punarāha pārtho yudhiṣṭhiraṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭham / adyāputrā sūtamātā bhavitrī kuntī vātho vā mayā tena vāpi satyaṃ vadāmyadya na karṇamājau śarairahatvā kavacaṃ vimokṣye / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / śrutvā karṇaṃ kalyam udāravīryaṃ; kruddhaḥ pārthaḥ phalgunasyāmitaujāḥ / dhanaṃjayaṃ vākyam uvāca cedaṃ; yudhiṣṭhiraḥ karṇaśarābhitaptaḥ

vulgate_text: ityevamuktvā punareva pārtho yudhiṣṭhiraṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭham / vimucya śastrāṇi dhanurvisṛjya kośe ca khaṅgaṃ vinidhāya tūrṇam
ce_text: ity evam uktvā punar āha pārtho; yudhiṣṭhiraṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭham / apy aputrā tena rādhā bhavitrī; kuntī mayā vā tad ṛtaṃ viddhi rājan / prasīda rājan kṣama yan mayoktaṃ; kāle bhavān vetsyati tan namas te

vulgate_text: sa vrīḍayā namraśirāḥ kirīṭī yudhiṣṭhiraṃ prāñjalirabhyuvāca / prasīda rājankṣama yanmayoktaṃ kāle bhavānvetsyati tannamaste
ce_text: ity evam uktvā punar āha pārtho; yudhiṣṭhiraṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭham / apy aputrā tena rādhā bhavitrī; kuntī mayā vā tad ṛtaṃ viddhi rājan / prasīda rājan kṣama yan mayoktaṃ; kāle bhavān vetsyati tan namas te

vulgate_text: tata āśliṣya taṃ premṇā mūrdhni cāghrāya pāṇḍavaḥ prītyā paramayā yukto vismayaṃśca punaḥpunaḥ / abravīttaṃ maheṣvāsaṃ dharmarājo dhanañjayam
ce_text: tata āśliṣya sa premṇā mūrdhni cāghrāya pāṇḍavam / prītyā paramayā yuktaḥ prasmayaṃś cābravīj jayam

vulgate_text: na cedadya hi taṃ vīraṃ nihaniṣyasi saṃyuge / prāṇāneva parityakṣye jīvitārtho hi ko mama
ce_text: tam adya yadi vai vīra na haniṣyasi sūtajam / prāṇān eva parityakṣye jīvitārtho hi ko mama

vulgate_text: satyena te śape rājaṃstvatpādena tathaiva ca / bhīmena ca naraśreṣṭha yamābhyāṃ ca mahīpate
ce_text: evam uktaḥ pratyuvāca vijayo bharatarṣabha / satyena te śape rājan prasādena tavaiva ca / bhīmena ca naraśreṣṭha yamābhyāṃ ca mahīpate

vulgate_text: upāvṛttāśca turagāḥ śikṣitāścāśvasādibhiḥ / rathopakaraṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ satvaraṃ yātu me rathaḥ
ce_text: upāvṛttāś ca turagāḥ śikṣitāś cāśvasādinaḥ / rathopakaraṇaiḥ sarvair upāyāntu tvarānvitāḥ

vulgate_text: ājñaptastvatha kṛṣṇena dāruko rājasattama yojayāmāsa ca rathaṃ vaiyāghnaṃ śatrutāpanam / sajjaṃ nivedayāmāsa pāṇḍavasya mahātmanaḥ
ce_text: ājñaptas tv atha kṛṣṇena dāruko rājasattama / yojayām āsa sa rathaṃ vaiyāghraṃ śatrutāpanam

vulgate_text: yuktaṃ tu rathamāsthāya dārukeṇa mahātmanā upasthitaṃ rathaṃ dṛṣṭvā padmanābho raṇāntakṛt / bhūyaścovāca matimānmādhavo dharmanandanam
ce_text: bhūyaś covāca matimān mādhavo dharmanandanam / yudhiṣṭhiremaṃ bībhatsuṃ tvaṃ sāntvayitum arhasi / anujñātuṃ ca karṇasya vadhāyādya durātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: sañjaya uvāca / prasādya dharmarājānaṃ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā sampūjya devatāḥ sarva brāhmaṇānsvasti vācya ca / sumaṅgalaṃ svastyayanamāruroha rathottamam
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / yudhiṣṭhireṇaivam uktaḥ kaunteyaḥ śvetavāhanaḥ / asiṃ jagrāha saṃkruddho jighāṃsur bharatarṣabham

vulgate_text: śrutāyuṃ cāśrutāyuṃ ca śatāyuṃ ca mahāratham / pratyudgamya bhavetkṣemī yo na syāttvadvidhaḥ prabhuḥ
ce_text: śrutāyuṣaṃ mahāvīryam acyutāyuṣam eva ca / pratyudgamya bhavet kṣemī yo na syāt tvam iva kṣamī

vulgate_text: ko hi śakto raṇe jetuṃ kauravāṃstāta saṃyuge / anyatra pāṇḍavādyuddhe śvetāśvādvānaradhvajāt
ce_text: ko hi śakto raṇe jetuṃ kauravāṃs tāta saṃgatān / anyatra pāṇḍavān yuddhe tvayā guptān mahārathān

vulgate_text: akṣauhiṇīpatīnugrānsaṃhatānyuddhadurmadān / tvāmṛte puruṣavyāghra jetuṃ śaktaḥ pumāniha
ce_text: vīrān kṛtāstrān samare sarvān evānuvartinaḥ / akṣauhiṇīpatīn ugrān saṃrabdhān yuddhadurmadān

vulgate_text: daśame'hani samprāpte kṛtvā ghoraṃ parākramam / darśayitvā''tmano rūpaṃ rudropendrasamaṃ yudhi
ce_text: darśayitvātmano rūpaṃ rudropendrasamaṃ yudhi / pāṇḍavānām anīkāni pravigāhya vyaśātayat

vulgate_text: tathā carantaṃ samare tapantamiva bhāskaram / padātikoṭisāhasrāḥ pravarāyudhapāṇayaḥ
ce_text: majjantam aplave mandam ujjihīrṣuḥ suyodhanam / tathā carantaṃ samare tapantam iva bhāskaram / na śekuḥ sṛñjayā draṣṭuṃ tathaivānye mahīkṣitaḥ

vulgate_text: kaśca śakto raṇe kartuṃ tvadanyaḥ puruṣabruvaḥ / yādṛśaṃ te kṛtaṃ pārtha jayadrathavadhaṃ prati
ce_text: ka ivānyo raṇe kuryāt tvad anyaḥ kṣatriyo yudhi / yādṛśaṃ te kṛtaṃ pārtha jayadrathavadhaṃ prati

vulgate_text: yaśca yuṣmāsu pāpaṃ vai dhārtarāṣṭraḥ prayuktavān / tasya sarvasya durbuddhiḥ karṇo mūlamihārjuna
ce_text: yac ca yuṣmāsu pāpaṃ vai dhārtarāṣṭraḥ prayuktavān / tatra sarvatra duṣṭātmā karṇaḥ pāpamatir mukham

vulgate_text: sthitā buddhirnarendrāṇāṃ dhārtarāṣṭrasya cobhayoḥ / karṇaḥ pārthānraṇe sarvānnāśayiṣyati sāyakaiḥ
ce_text: sthirā buddhir narendrasya dhārtarāṣṭrasya mānada / karṇaḥ pārthān raṇe sarvān vijeṣyati na saṃśayaḥ

vulgate_text: karṇo jalpati vai nityamahaṃ pārthānsamāgatān vāsudevaṃ ca dāśārhaṃ vijeṣyāmi mahāraṇe / samitau valgate karṇastamadya jahi phalguna
ce_text: karṇo hi bhāṣate nityam ahaṃ pārthān samāgatān / vāsudevaṃ sarājānaṃ vijeṣyāmi mahāraṇe

vulgate_text: yacca yuṣmāsu pāpaṃ vai dhārtarāṣṭraḥ pratāpavān / sabhāyāṃ kṛtavānnityaṃ karṇamāśritya vai purā
ce_text: yac ca yuṣmāsu pāpaṃ vai dhārtarāṣṭraḥ prayuktavān / tatra sarvatra duṣṭātmā karṇaḥ pāpamatir mukham

vulgate_text: yacca taṃ dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ ṣaḍbhiḥ śūrairmahārathaiḥ / paśyatāṃ saṃvṛtaṃ śūraṃ saubhadramaparājitam
ce_text: yac ca tad dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ krūraiḥ ṣaḍbhir mahārathaiḥ / apaśyaṃ nihataṃ vīraṃ saubhadram ṛṣabhekṣaṇam

vulgate_text: nirmanuṣyāśca mātaṅgā virathāśca mahārathāḥ / pradravanti sma samare diśo bhītā'bhimanyave
ce_text: droṇadrauṇikṛpān vīrān kampayanto mahārathān / nirmanuṣyāṃś ca mātaṅgān virathāṃś ca mahārathān

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvā droṇaṃ vadhopāyamabhimanyośca pṛṣṭavān / śrutvā droṇavacaḥ krūraṃ tataściccheda kārmukam
ce_text: atha droṇasya samare tat kālasadṛśaṃ tadā / śrutvā karṇo vacaḥ krūraṃ tataś ciccheda kārmukam

vulgate_text: prahasansa tu duṣṭātmā karṇo rājā ca kauravaḥ yacca karṇo'bravītkṛṣṇāṃ sabhāyāṃ paruṣaṃ vacaḥ / pramukhe pāṇḍaveyānāṃ kurūṇāṃ caiva paśyatām
ce_text: yac ca karṇo 'bravīt kṛṣṇāṃ sabhāyāṃ paruṣaṃ vacaḥ / pramukhe pāṇḍaveyānāṃ kurūṇāṃ ca nṛśaṃsavat

vulgate_text: uktavānsa ca pātātmā tathā paramadurmatiḥ / pāpaḥ pāpavacaḥ karṇaḥ paśyataste dhanañjaya
ce_text: ity uktavān adharmajñas tadā paramadurmatiḥ / pāpaḥ pāpaṃ vacaḥ karṇaḥ śṛṇvatas tava bhārata

vulgate_text: asya pāpasya tadvākyaṃ suvarṇavikṛtāḥ śarāḥ / śamayanti śilādhautā nāśayanto'sya jīvitam
ce_text: tasya pāpasya tad vākyaṃ suvarṇavikṛtāḥ śarāḥ / śamayantu śilādhautās tvayāstā jīvitacchidaḥ / adya karṇaṃ raṇe grastaṃ paśyantu kuravas tvayā / pratapantam ivādityaṃ svargadvāragataṃ yathā / adya te samare vīryaṃ paśyantu kuruyodhinaḥ / sūtaputre hate pārtha jānantu tvāṃ mahāratham / adya kaṅkā valā gṛdhrā vāyasā jambukās tathā / viprakarṣantu gātrāṇi sūtaputrasya bhārata / adyātirathir ākṣipto nihataś ca tvayā raṇe / kurūṇāṃ śokam ādhattāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ mudaṃ tathā / adya tvāṃ pratinandantu pāñcālāḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha / yathā vṛtravadhe vṛtte devāḥ sarve śatakratum / adya karṇaṃ raṇe hatvā prāpya caivottamaṃ yaśaḥ / viśoko vijvaraḥ pārtha bhava bandhupuraskṛtaḥ / nārasiṃhavapuḥ kṛtvā yathā śasto mahāsuraḥ / hiraṇyakaśipur daityo viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā / tathā tvam api rādheyaṃ ghoraṃ kṛtvā mahad vapuḥ / jahi yuddhe mahābāho trāyasva ca bhayāt svakān

vulgate_text: yāni cānyāni duṣṭātmā pāpāni kṛtavāṃstvayi / tānyadya bharataśreṣṭha nāśayantu śarāstava
ce_text: yāni cānyāni duṣṭātmā pāpāni kṛtavāṃs tvayi / tāny adya jīvitaṃ cāsya śamayantu śarās tava

vulgate_text: gāṇḍīvaprasṛtānvāṇānadya gātraspṛśaḥ śarān / yātu karṇo raṇe pārtha śvāvicchalalato yathā
ce_text: gāṇḍīvaprahitān ghorān adya gātraiḥ spṛśañ śarān / karṇaḥ smaratu duṣṭātmā vacanaṃ droṇabhīṣmayoḥ

vulgate_text: tamapyāsādya samare mitrārthe mitravatsala tathā jvalantamastraiśca śūraṃ sarvadhanuṣmatām / nirdahantaṃ samārūḍhaṃ durdharṣaṃ droṇamañjasā
ce_text: tathā jvalantam astrāgniṃ guruṃ sarvadhanuṣmatām / nirdahantaṃ samārohan durdharṣaṃ droṇam ojasā

vulgate_text: tānsamārohataḥ śūrānmitrārthe tyaktajīvitān / nistāraya mahābāho karṇāstrātpāvakopamāt
ce_text: tāṃs tathābhimukhān vīrān mitrārthe tyaktajīvitān / kṣayaṃ nayati rādheyaḥ pāñcālāñ śataśo raṇe

vulgate_text: tāpanaṃ sarvasainyasya ghorarūpaṃ bhayānakam / yamāśritya mahāsenā jvalate svena tejasā
ce_text: tāpanaṃ sarvasainyānāṃ ghorarūpaṃ sudāruṇam / samāvṛtya mahāsenāṃ jvalati svena tejasā

vulgate_text: ete caranti saṅgrāme karṇacāpacyutāḥ śarāḥ / prabhayā iha śatrūṇāṃ ghātayanto janānprabho
ce_text: ete caranti saṃgrāme karṇacāpacyutāḥ śarāḥ / bhramarāṇām iva vrātās tāpayantaḥ sma tāvakān

vulgate_text: ete bhramanti pāñcālā utkrayanti ca māriṣa / karṇāstraṃ samare prāpya durnivāryaṃ mahātmabhiḥ
ce_text: ete caranti pāñcālā dikṣu sarvāsu bhārata / karṇāstraṃ samare prāpya durnivāram anātmabhiḥ

vulgate_text: tvayā nāthena govinda dhruva eva jayo mama / prasanno yasya bhagavānbhūtabhavyabhaviṣyakṛt
ce_text: tvayā nāthena govinda dhruva eṣa jayo mama / prasanno yasya me 'dya tvaṃ bhūtabhavyabhavatprabhuḥ

vulgate_text: ḷḷḷḷḷḷḷṣ pāpasya madhusūdana / ḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷ sannataparvabhiḥ
ce_text: taṃ śikhaṇḍī samāsādya tvayā gupto mahāratham / jaghāna puruṣavyāghraṃ śaraiḥ saṃnataparvabhiḥ

vulgate_text: ḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷ nānyaṃ pṛthivyāmanumanyate / ḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷ sūtaputrasya bhūmiḥ pāsyati śoṇitam
ce_text: yo 'sau raṇe naraṃ nānyaṃ pṛthivyām abhimanyate / tasyādya sūtaputrasya bhūmiḥ pāsyati śoṇitam / gāṇḍīvasṛṣṭā dāsyanti karṇasya paramāṃ gatim

vulgate_text: anṛtaṃ tatkariṣyanti māmakā niśitāḥ śarāḥ / āśīviṣā iva kruddhāstasyapāsyanti śoṇitam
ce_text: ahaṃ vaḥ pāṇḍuputrebhyas trāsyāmīti yad abravīt / anṛtaṃ tat kariṣyanti māmakā niśitāḥ śarāḥ

vulgate_text: mayā hastavatā muktā nārācā vaidyutatviṣaḥ / gāṇḍīvasṛṣṭā dāsyanti karṇasya paramāṃ gatim
ce_text: yo 'sau raṇe naraṃ nānyaṃ pṛthivyām abhimanyate / tasyādya sūtaputrasya bhūmiḥ pāsyati śoṇitam / gāṇḍīvasṛṣṭā dāsyanti karṇasya paramāṃ gatim

vulgate_text: ete ṣaṇḍatilāḥ kṛṣṇe nirvīryā hatavikramāḥ ahaṃ vaḥ pāṇḍaveyebhyo bhayāttrāsyeti cābravīt / hantā'haṃ pāṇḍavānsarvānsaputrāniha bhārata
ce_text: hantāhaṃ pāṇḍavān sarvān saputrān iti yo 'bravīt / tam adya karṇaṃ hantāsmi miṣatāṃ sarvadhanvinām

vulgate_text: na jāne ca kathaṃ prītiḥ śaineyasyādya mādhava ahaṃ hatvā raṇe karṇaṃ putrāṃścāsya jayādhikān / prītiṃ dāsyāmi bhīmasya sātyakeryamayostathā
ce_text: ahaṃ hatvā raṇe karṇaṃ putraṃ cāsya mahāratham / prītiṃ dāsyāmi bhīmasya yamayoḥ sātyaker api

vulgate_text: dhṛṣṭadyumnasya vīrasya tathaiva ca śikhaṇḍinaḥ adyānṛṇyaṃ gamiṣyāmi hatvā karṇaṃ mahāhave / dharmarājasya saṃśrutya vārṣṇeyaśapathaṃ mithaḥ
ce_text: dhṛṣṭadyumnaśikhaṇḍibhyāṃ pāñcālānāṃ ca mādhava / adhyānṛṇyaṃ gamiṣyāmi hatvā karṇaṃ mahāraṇe

vulgate_text: bhavatsamakṣamaṃ vakṣyāmi punarevātmasaṃstavam / ityapyamitrapravaramadyāhaṃ hanmi sūtajam
ce_text: adya paśyantu saṃgrāme dhanaṃjayam amarṣaṇam / yudhyantaṃ kauravān saṃkhye pātayantaṃ ca sūtajam / bhavatsakāśe vakṣye ca punar evātmasaṃstavam

vulgate_text: [dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / samāgame pāṇḍavasṛñjayānāṃ mahābhaye māmakānāmagādhe / dhanañjaye tāta raṇāya yāte karṇena tadyudvamatho'tra kīdṛk ] / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / sa keśavasya bībhatsuḥ śrutvā bhārata bhāṣitam / viśokaḥ saṃprahṛṣṭaś ca kṣaṇena samapadyata

vulgate_text: teṣāmanīkāni mahādhvajāni raṇe samṛddhāni susaṅgatāni / bherīnirādonmukharāṇyaṃgarja-- nmeghā iva prāvṛṣi mārutāstāḥ
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / teṣām anīkāni bṛhaddhvajāni; raṇe samṛddhāni samāgatāni / garjanti bherīninadonmukhāni; meghair yathā meghagaṇās tapānte

vulgate_text: arīnviśokānhi nirīkṣya sarvato mahāṃśca manyuḥ punareti māṃ bhṛśam / rājāturo nāgamadyatkirīṭī bahūni duḥkhānyabhicintayāmi
ce_text: arīn viśokābhinirīkṣya sarvato; manas tu cintā pradunoti me bhṛśam / rājāturo nāgamad yat kirīṭī; bahūni duḥkhāny abhijāto 'smi sūta

vulgate_text: rathe tavāsminniśitāḥ supītā-- stato bhallā dvādaśa vai sahasrāḥ / ṣaṇmārgaṇānāmayutāni vīra kṣurāśca bhallāśca tathāyutākhyāḥ
ce_text: viśoka uvāca / ṣaṇmārgaṇānām ayutāni vīra; kṣurāś ca bhallāś ca tathāyutākhyāḥ / nārācānāṃ dve sahasre tu vīra; trīṇy eva ca pradarāṇāṃ ca pārtha

vulgate_text: etadvidvanmuñca sahasraśo'pi gadāsibāhudraviṇaṃ ca te'sti / prāsāśca mudrarāḥ śaktayastomarāśca mābhaiṣīstvaṃ saṃkṣayādāyudhānām / bhīmasena uvāca
ce_text: asty āyudhaṃ pāṇḍaveyāvaśiṣṭaṃ; na yad vahec chakaṭaṃ ṣaḍgavīyam / etad vidvan muñca sahasraśo 'pi; gadāsibāhudraviṇaṃ ca te 'sti

vulgate_text: sūtādya madbāhuyutaiḥ samastā-- nsamāhanadbhiḥ pārthivānāśuvegaiḥ / cchannaṃ bāṇairāhavaṃ ghorarūpaṃ naṣṭādityaṃ mṛtyulokena tulyam
ce_text: bhīma uvāca / sūtādyemaṃ paśya bhīmapramuktaiḥ; saṃbhindadbhiḥ pārthivān āśuvegaiḥ / ugrair bāṇair āhavaṃ ghorarūpaṃ; naṣṭādityaṃ mṛtyulokena tulyam

vulgate_text: kapirhyasau vīkṣate sarvato vai dhvajāgramāruhya dhanañjayasya / vitrāsayanri pusaṅghānvimarde bibhemyasmādātmanaivābhivīkṣya
ce_text: kapir hy asau vīkṣyate sarvato vai; dhvajāgram āruhya dhanaṃjayasya / divākarābho maṇir eṣa divyo; vibhrājate caiva kirīṭasaṃsthaḥ

vulgate_text: vibhrājate cātimātraṃ kirīṭaṃ vicitrametacca dhanañjayasya / divākarābho maṇireṣa divyo vibhrājate caiva kirīṭasaṃsthaḥ
ce_text: kapir hy asau vīkṣyate sarvato vai; dhvajāgram āruhya dhanaṃjayasya / divākarābho maṇir eṣa divyo; vibhrājate caiva kirīṭasaṃsthaḥ

vulgate_text: taṃ yāntamaśvā himaśaṅkhavarṇāḥ suvarṇamuktāmaṇijālanaddhāḥ / jambhaṃ jighāṃsuṃ pragṛhītavajraṃ hayā yathā tatra yathā vahaṃstadā
ce_text: āyāntam aśvair himaśaṅkhavarṇaiḥ; suvarṇamuktāmaṇijālanaddhaiḥ / jambhaṃ jighāṃsuṃ pragṛhītavajraṃ; jayāya devendram ivogramanyum

vulgate_text: pariveṣī yathā somaḥ paripūrṇo virājate sa rarāja tathā saṅkhye darśanīyo narottamaḥ / nirviśeṣo mahārāja vijayenaiva saṃyuge
ce_text: sa rarāja tathā saṃkhye darśanīyo narottamaḥ / nirviśeṣaṃ mahārāja yathā hi vijayas tathā

vulgate_text: dhanuḥkāśāṃ śarāvāpāṃ gadāparighaketanām / haṃsachatradhvajopetāmuṣṇīṣavaraphenilām
ce_text: dhanuṣkāśāṃ śarāvāpāṃ gadāparighaketanām / yodhavrātavatīṃ saṃkhye vahantīṃ yamasādanam

vulgate_text: yodhagrāhavatīṃ saṅkhye vahantīṃ pitṛsādanam / kṣaṇena puruṣavyāghraḥ prāvartayata nimnagām
ce_text: kṣaṇena puruṣavyāghraḥ prāvartayata nimnagām / yathā vaitaraṇīm ugrāṃ dustarām akṛtātmabhiḥ

vulgate_text: yathā vaitaraṇīmugrāṃ dustarāmakṛtātmabhiḥ / tathā dustaraṇīṃ ghorāṃ bhīrūṇāṃ bhayavardhanīm
ce_text: kṣaṇena puruṣavyāghraḥ prāvartayata nimnagām / yathā vaitaraṇīm ugrāṃ dustarām akṛtātmabhiḥ

vulgate_text: śakuniṃ vihvalaṃ dṛṣṭvā dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ parāṅmukhāḥ / pradudruvurdiśo bhītā bhīmasenabhayātprabho
ce_text: rathasthe tu naravyāghre dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ parāṅmukhāḥ / pradudruvur diśo bhītā bhīmāj jāte mahābhaye

vulgate_text: atyadbhutamahaṃ manye pāṇḍaveyasya vikramam / yadekaḥ samare sarvānyodhayāmāsa māmakān
ce_text: atyadbhutam idaṃ manye pāṇḍaveyasya vikramam / yathāpratijñaṃ yodhānāṃ rādheyaḥ kṛtavān api

vulgate_text: tadbhagraṃ svabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā kaunteyenāmitaujasā / dhanurdarāṇāṃ pravaraḥ karṇaḥ kimakarodyudhi
ce_text: tat prabhagnaṃ balaṃ dṛṣṭvā kaunteyenāmitaujasā / rādheyānām adhirathaḥ karṇaḥ kim akarod yudhi

vulgate_text: sahadevasya bhallena dhvajaṃ ciccheda māriṣa / sārathiṃ ca tribhirbāṇairājaghāna parantapaḥ
ce_text: bhīmasenas tu taṃ kruddho vivyādha triṃśatā śaraiḥ / sārathiṃ ca tribhir bāṇair ājaghāna paraṃtapaḥ

vulgate_text: tāñjaghāna śitairbāṇaiḥ sūtaputro mahārathaḥ te vadhyamānāḥ samare cedimātsyā viśāmpate / prādravanta raṇe bhītāḥ siṃhatrastā mṛgā iva
ce_text: te vadhyamānāḥ samare cedimatsyā viśāṃ pate / karṇam ekam abhidrutya śarasaṃghaiḥ samārdayan / tāñ jaghāna śitair bāṇaiḥ sūtaputro mahārathaḥ

vulgate_text: mṛgasaṅghānyathā kruddhaḥ siṃho drāvayate vane / pañcālānāṃ rathaśreṣṭhāndrāvayañśātravāṃstathā
ce_text: mṛgasaṃghān yathā kruddhaḥ siṃho drāvayate vane / karṇas tu samare yodhāṃs tatra tatra mahāyaśāḥ / kālayām āsa tat sainyaṃ yathā paśugaṇān vṛkaḥ

vulgate_text: karmaputrau tu rājendra bhrātarau satyavikramau / nijaghnāte balaṃ kruddhau pāṇḍavānāmitastataḥ
ce_text: karṇaputrau ca rājendra bhrātarau satyavikramau / anāśayetāṃ balinaḥ pāñcālān vai tatas tataḥ / tatra yuddhaṃ tadā hy āsīt krūraṃ viśasanaṃ mahat

vulgate_text: sañjaya uvāca / hatvā tu phalgunaḥ senāṃ kauravāṇāṃ pṛthakpṛthak / sūtaputrasya saṃrambhaṃ dṛṣṭvā caiva mahāraṇe
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / aparāhṇe mahārāja sūtaputraḥ pratāpavān / jaghāna somakān sarvān bhīmasenasya paśyataḥ / bhīmo 'py atibalaḥ sainyaṃ dhārtarāṣṭraṃ vyapothayat

vulgate_text: nadīṃ prāvartayitvā ca bībhatsuḥ paravīrahā / vāsudevamidaṃ vākyamabravītpuruṣarṣabhaḥ / arjuna uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / arjunas tu mahārāja kṛtvā sainyaṃ pṛthagvidham / sūtaputraṃ susaṃrabdhaṃ dṛṣṭvā caiva mahāraṇe

vulgate_text: mā sma karṇo raṇe pārthānsṛñjayāṃśca mahārathān / niḥśeṣānsamare kuryātpaśyatāṃ no janārdana / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / aparāhṇe mahārāja sūtaputraḥ pratāpavān / jaghāna somakān sarvān bhīmasenasya paśyataḥ / bhīmo 'py atibalaḥ sainyaṃ dhārtarāṣṭraṃ vyapothayat

vulgate_text: sa prayāto rathenāśu kṛṣṇo rājanmahāhave / āśvāsayanraṇe cāśu pāṇḍusainyāni sarvaśaḥ
ce_text: prayātaś ca mahābāhuḥ pāṇḍavānujñayā hariḥ / āśvāsayan rathenaiva pāṇḍusainyāni sarvaśaḥ

vulgate_text: rathaghoṣastatastasya pāṇḍavasya babhūva ha / vāsavāstranipātena parvateṣviva māriṣa
ce_text: rathaghoṣaḥ sa saṃgrāme pāṇḍaveyasya saṃbabhau / vāsavāśanitulyasya mahaughasyeva māriṣa

vulgate_text: tvaṃ hi kṛṣṇau raṇe śakto yoddhumetau parantapau / tavaiva bhāro rādheya pratyudyāhi dhanañjayam
ce_text: tvaṃ hi kṛṣṇau raṇe śaktaḥ saṃsādhayitum āhave / tavaiṣa bhāro rādheya pratyudyāhi dhanaṃjayam

vulgate_text: samāno hyasi bhīṣmeṇa dromadrauṇikṛpeṇa ca / savyasācinamāyāntaṃ nivāraya mahāraṇe
ce_text: tvaṃ kṛto hy eva bhīṣmeṇa droṇadrauṇikṛpair api / savyasācipratirathas taṃ nivartaya pāṇḍavam

vulgate_text: vāsudevaṃ ca vārṣṇeyaṃ prīyamāṇaṃ kirīṭinā / pratyudyāhi mahābāho pauruṣe mahati sthitaḥ / karṇa uvāca
ce_text: tāṃ dhṛtiṃ kuru rādheya tataḥ pratyehi pāṇḍavam / vāsudevaṃ ca vārṣṇeyaṃ prīyamāṇaṃ kirīṭinā

vulgate_text: ajayyamenaṃ pravadanti yuddhe mahārathāḥ karṇa rathapravīram / ekākina kimu kṛṣṇābhiguptaṃ vijetumenaṃ ka ihotsaheta / karṇa uvāca
ce_text: karṇa uvāca / prakṛtistho hi me śalya idānīṃ saṃmatas tathā / pratibhāsi mahābāho vibhīś caiva dhanaṃjayāt

vulgate_text: tamīdṛśaṃ vīryaguṇopapannaṃ kṛṣṇadvitīyaṃ paramaṃ nṛpāṇām / tamāhvayansāhasamuttamaṃ vai jāne svayaṃ sarvalokasya śalya
ce_text: tam īdṛśaṃ vīryaguṇopapannaṃ; kṛṣṇadvitīyaṃ varaye raṇāya / anantavīryeṇa ca keśavena; nārāyaṇenāpratimena guptam

vulgate_text: ubhau hi śūrau balinau dṛḍhāyudhau mahārathau saṃhananopapannau / etau vīrau naravīrau sametau sthānāccyutau devakumārarūpau
ce_text: ubhau hi śūrau kṛtinau dṛḍhāstrau; mahārathau saṃhananopapannau / etādṛśau phalgunavāsudevau; ko 'nyaḥ pratīyān mad ṛte nu śalya

vulgate_text: abhyetya putreṇa tavābhinanditāḥ sametya coktāḥ kuruvīrasattamāḥ / kṛpaśca bhojaśca mahārathāvubhau tathaiva gāndhārapatiḥ sahānujaḥ guroḥ sutastasya tavātmajāstathā padātisaṅghā dviradāstathā tadā
ce_text: abhyetya putreṇa tavābhinanditaḥ; sametya covāca kurupravīrān / kṛpaṃ ca bhojaṃ ca mahābhujāv ubhau; tathaiva gāndhāranṛpaṃ sahānujam / guroḥ sutaṃ cāvarajaṃ tathātmanaḥ; padātino 'tha dvipasādino 'nyān

vulgate_text: tamabhyadhāvadvisṛjankṛpaḥ śarāṃ-- stathaiva bhojastava cātmajaḥ svayam / mahāratho droṇasutaśca sāyakai-- ravākiraṃstoyadharā yathā'calam
ce_text: tam abhyadhāvad visṛjañ śarān kṛpas; tathaiva bhojas tava cātmajaḥ svayam / jighāṃsubhis tān kuśalaiḥ śarottamān; mahāhave saṃjavitān prayatnataḥ / śaraiḥ praciccheda ca pāṇḍavas tvaran; parābhinad vakṣasi ca tribhis tribhiḥ

vulgate_text: jighāṃsubhistānkuśalaiḥ śarottamān mahātmabhiḥ samprahitānprayatnataḥ / śaraiḥ praticcheda sa pāṇḍavastvaran parānvinirbhidya ca tāṃstribhistribhiḥ
ce_text: tam abhyadhāvad visṛjañ śarān kṛpas; tathaiva bhojas tava cātmajaḥ svayam / jighāṃsubhis tān kuśalaiḥ śarottamān; mahāhave saṃjavitān prayatnataḥ / śaraiḥ praciccheda ca pāṇḍavas tvaran; parābhinad vakṣasi ca tribhis tribhiḥ

vulgate_text: kṛpasya pārthaḥ śaraṃ śarāsanaṃ hayāndhvajānsāradhimeva patribhiḥ / [samārpayadvāhusahasravikrama-- stathā yathā vajradharaḥ purā baleḥ
ce_text: kṛpaś ca bhojaś ca tathātmajaś ca te; tamonudaṃ vāridharā ivāpatan / kṛpasya pārthaḥ saśaraṃ śarāsanaṃ; hayān dhvajaṃ sārathim eva patribhiḥ

vulgate_text: savājisūteṣvasanānsaketanā-- ñjayāna nāgāśvarathāṃśca sa tvaran / tataḥ prakīrṇaṃ sumahadvalaṃ tava prapīḍitaṃ saviturivaujasā bhṛśam
ce_text: savājisūteṣv asanān saketanāñ; jaghāna nāgāśvarathāṃs tvaraṃś ca saḥ / tataḥ prakīrṇaṃ sumahad balaṃ tava; pradāritaṃ setur ivāmbhasā yathā / tato 'rjunasyāśu rathena keśavaś; cakāra śatrūn apasavyam āturān

vulgate_text: sañjaya uvāca / ḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷprabarairvalairbhīmamabhidrutam / ḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷ kaunteyamusthihīrṣurdhanañjayaḥ
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / arjunas tu mahārāja kṛtvā sainyaṃ pṛthagvidham / sūtaputraṃ susaṃrabdhaṃ dṛṣṭvā caiva mahāraṇe

vulgate_text: ḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷ senāṃ mārata sāyakaiḥ / ḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷ paravīrāndhanañjayaḥ
ce_text: vimṛdya sūtaputrasya senāṃ bhārata sāyakaiḥ / prāhiṇon mṛtyulokāya paravīrān dhanaṃjayaḥ

vulgate_text: sudurgamā suviṣamā ghorā'tyarthaṃ sudurdṛśā / raṇabhūmirabhūdrājanmahāvaitaraṇī yathā
ce_text: dhanaṃjayaśarābhyastaiḥ syandanāśvanaradvipaiḥ / raṇabhūmir abhūd rājan mahāvaitaraṇī yathā

vulgate_text: samantājjaladaprakhyānvāraṇānmadavarṣiṇaḥ / abhipede'rjunaratho ghanānbhindannivāṃśumān
ce_text: dhanaṃjayaśarābhyastaiḥ stīrṇā bhūr varavāraṇaiḥ / abhipede 'rjunaratho ghanān bhindann ivāṃśumān

vulgate_text: visphāritaṃ ca gāṇḍīvamatyāsīdbhairavasvanam sughoṣaṃ vajraniṣpeṣaṃ stanayanniva toyadaḥ
ce_text: vyasphūrjayac ca gāṇḍīvaṃ sumahad bhairavasvanam / ghoro vajraviniṣpeṣaḥ stanayitnor ivāmbare

vulgate_text: apasavyāṃstu tāṃścakre rathena madhusūdanaḥ / niyuktānhi sa tānmene yamāyāśu kirīṭinā
ce_text: apasavyāṃs tu tāṃś cakre rathena madhusūdanaḥ / tatas te prādravañ śūrāḥ parāṅmukharathe 'rjune

vulgate_text: kṛtvā saṃśaptakā ghoraṃ śapathaṃ pāralaukikam / parivavrurnaravyāghrā naravyāghraṃ raṇe'rjunam
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / taṃ tu yāntaṃ mahāvegair aśvaiḥ kapivaradhvajam / yuddhāyābhyadravan vīrāḥ kurūṇāṃ navatī rathāḥ / parivavrur naravyāghrā naravyāghraṃ raṇe 'rjunam

vulgate_text: tāṃ śastravṛṣṭimatulāṃ dvipasthaiḥ preṣitāṃ prabhuḥ / ciccheda niśitairbhallairardhacandraiśca phalgunaḥ
ce_text: tām astravṛṣṭiṃ prahitāṃ dvipasthair yavanaiḥ smayan / ciccheda niśitair bhallair ardhacandraiś ca phalgunaḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ parāṅmukhībhūtaṃ nirutsāhaṃ balaṃ tava / tadānīṃ tu mahārāja prāyaśaḥ śastraveṣṭitam
ce_text: hataṃ parāṅmukhaprāyaṃ nirutsāhaṃ paraṃ balam / vyālambata mahārāja prāyaśaḥ śastraveṣṭitam

vulgate_text: tataḥ kuruṇāmabhavadārtanādo mahānnṛpa / narāśvanāgāsuhanāndṛṣṭvā bāṇānkirīṭinaḥ
ce_text: tataḥ kurūṇām abhavad ārtanādo mahāmṛdhe / rathāśvanāgāsuharair vadhyatām arjuneṣubhiḥ

vulgate_text: ādīptamiva tatsainyaṃ śaraiśchinnatanucchadam / āsītsvaśoṇitaklinnaṃ raudraṃ naṣṭaṃ viśāmpate
ce_text: ādīptaṃ tava tat sainyaṃ śaraiś chinnatanucchadam / āsīt svaśoṇitaklinnaṃ phullāśokavanaṃ yathā

vulgate_text: tānvidrāvayate pārthaḥ kirañśaraśatānbahūn / harṣayanpāṇḍavīṃ senāṃ rājānaṃ ca yudhiṣṭhiram
ce_text: abhyadravata tān pārthaḥ kirañ śaraśatān bahūn / harṣayan pāṇḍavān yodhān bhīmasenapurogamān

vulgate_text: yathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni mṛtyorbhītāni māriṣa / upalīyanti santrāsāddharmaṃ lokaparāyaṇam
ce_text: yathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni mṛtyor bhītāni bhārata / dharmam evopalīyante karmavanti hi yāni ca

vulgate_text: visphārya sumahaccāpaṃ tataścādhirathirvṛṣaḥ / pāñcālānpunarādhāvatpaśyataḥ savyasācinaḥ
ce_text: saṃbhagnaṃ hi balaṃ dṛṣṭvā balāt pārthena tāvakam / dhanur visphārayan karṇas tasthau śatrujighāṃsayā / pāñcālān punar ādhāvat paśyataḥ savyasācinaḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ kṣaṇena kṣitipāḥ kṣatajapratimekṣaṇāḥ / śaraughaiśchādayāmāsurmahāmeghā ivācalam
ce_text: tataḥ kṣaṇena kṣitipāḥ kṣatajapratimekṣaṇāḥ / karṇaṃ vavarṣur bāṇaughair yathā meghā mahīdharam

vulgate_text: tataḥ śarasahasrāṇi karṇamuktāni māriṣa / pāñcālānāṃ haratprāṇāṃstamāṃsīva tamonudaḥ
ce_text: tataḥ śarasahasrāṇi karṇamuktāni māriṣa / vyayojayanta pāñcālān prāṇaiḥ prāṇabhṛtāṃ vara

vulgate_text: mahadāsīttadā yuddhaṃ pāñcālānāṃ mahāmate / vadhyatāṃ sūtaputreṇa mitrārthe mitragṛddhinā
ce_text: tato raṇo mahān āsīt pāñcālānāṃ viśāṃ pate / vadhyatāṃ sūtaputreṇa mitrārthe 'mitraghātinām

vulgate_text: tamabhyadhāvannihate kumāre senāpatiḥ kaikayo mitravarmā / śarairvidhunvanbhṛśamugravegaiḥ karṇātmajaṃ cāpyahanatsudevam
ce_text: tam abhyadhāvan nihate kumāre; kaikeyasenāpatir ugradhanvā / śarair vibhinnaṃ bhṛśam ugravegaiḥ; karṇātmajaṃ so 'bhyahanat suṣeṇam

vulgate_text: putre hate krodhaparītayetāḥ karṇaḥ śinīnāṃ pravaraṃ jighāṃsuḥ / hato'si he sātyaka ityudīrya vyavāsṛjadbāṇamamitrasāham
ce_text: putre hate krodhaparītacetāḥ; karṇaḥ śinīnām ṛṣabhaṃ jighāṃsuḥ / hato 'si śaineya iti bruvan sa; vyavāsṛjad bāṇam amitrasāham

vulgate_text: tayo rathau sārathisampracoditau samaṃ rathau tau mahasā samīyatuḥ / nānāyudhacchatrapatākikādhvajau divīva pūrvaṃ balaśakrayo raṇe / bhīma uvāca
ce_text: śaraiḥ śarīrāntakaraiḥ sutejanair; nijaghnatus tāv itaretaraṃ bhṛśam / sakṛtprabhinnāv iva vāśitāntare; mahāgajau manmathasaktacetasau / ālokya tau caiva parasparaṃ tataḥ / samaṃ ca śūrau ca sasārathī tadā / bhīmo 'bravīd yāhi duḥśāsanāya / duḥśāsano yāhi vṛkodarāya / tayo rathau sārathibhyāṃ pracoditau / samaṃ rathau tau sahasā samīyatuḥ / nānāyudhau citrapatākinadhvajau / bhīmaḥ / divīva pūrvaṃ balaśakrayo raṇe / diṣṭyāsi duḥśāsana adya dṛṣṭa / ṛṇaṃ pratīccheḥ sahavṛddhimūlam / ciroditaṃ taṃ yan mayā te sabhāyāṃ / kṛṣṇābhimarśena gṛhāṇa mattaḥ / sa evam uktas tu tato mahātmā / duḥśāsano vākyam uvāca vīraḥ / sarvaṃ smare naiva ca vismarāmi / udīryamāṇaṃ śṛṇu bhīmasena / smarāmi cātmaprabhavaṃ cirāya / yaj jātuṣe veśmani rātry ahāni / viśvāsahīnā mṛgayāṃ caranto / vasanti sarvatra nirākṛtās tu / mahad bhayād rātry ahani smarantas / tathopabhogāc ca sukhāc ca hīnāḥ / vaneṣv aṭanto girigahvarāṇi / pāñcālarājasya puraṃ praviṣṭāḥ / māyāṃ yūyaṃ kām api saṃpraviṣṭā / yato vṛtaḥ kṛṣṇayā phalguno vaḥ / saṃbhūya pāpais tad anāryavṛttaṃ / kṛtaṃ tadā mātṛkṛtānurūpam / eko vṛtaḥ pañcabhiḥ sābhipannā / hy alajjamānaiś ca parasparasya / smare sabhāyāṃ subalātmajena / saṃjayaḥ / dāsīkṛtāḥ stha saha kṛṣṇayā tu / tenaivam uktas tu tavātmajena / subālacittena vṛkodaro 'pi / pragṛhya cāpaṃ bhṛkuṭīṃ lalāṭe / kṛtvā tu roṣojjvalatāmranetraḥ

vulgate_text: ekā vṛtā pañcabhiḥ sābhipannā hyalajjamāneśca parasparasya / smare sabhāyāṃ subalātmajena dāsīkṛtā yatsaha kṛṣṇayā ca / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / taṃ tu yāntaṃ mahāvegair aśvaiḥ kapivaradhvajam / yuddhāyābhyadravan vīrāḥ kurūṇāṃ navatī rathāḥ / parivavrur naravyāghrā naravyāghraṃ raṇe 'rjunam

vulgate_text: ityevamuktastu tavātmajena pāṇḍoḥ sutaḥ kopavaśaṃ bhṛśaṃ / dhanuḥ kṣurābhyāṃ dhvajameva cācchinat lalāṭamapyasya bibheda patriṇā
ce_text: tavātmajasyātha vṛkodaras tvaran; dhanuḥ kṣurābhyāṃ dhvajam eva cācchinat / lalāṭam apy asya bibheda patriṇā; śiraś ca kāyāt prajahāra sāratheḥ

vulgate_text: sañjaya uvāca / sara rājaputreṇa samārcchadugra-- duḥśāsanena nikṛto nikṛtyā
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tataḥ karṇaḥ kuruṣu pradruteṣu; varūthinā śvetahayena rājan / pāñcālaputrān vyadhamat sūtaputro; maheṣubhir vāta ivābhrasaṃghān

vulgate_text: ityevamuktvā sahasābhyadhāva-- nnihantukāmo'tibalastarasvī / tathā tu vikramya rame vṛkodaro mahāgajaṃ kesariko yathaiva nigṛhya duḥśāsanamekavīraḥ suyodhanasyādhiratheḥ samakṣam
ce_text: tataḥ smṛtvā bhīmasenas tarasvī; sāpatnakaṃ yat prayuktaṃ sutais te / tasmin sughore tumule vartamāne / pradhānabhūyiṣṭhataraiḥ samantāt / duḥśāsanaṃ tatra samīkṣya rājan / bhīmo mahābāhur acintyakarmā / smṛtvātha keśagrahaṇaṃ ca devyā / vastrāpahāraṃ ca rajasvalāyāḥ / anāgaso bhartṛparāṅmukhāyā / duḥkhāni dattāny api vipracintya / jajvāla krodhāmarṣeṇa bhīma / ājyaprasikto hi yathā hutāśaḥ / tatrāha karṇaṃ ca suyodhanaṃ ca / kṛpaṃ drauṇiṃ kṛtavarmāṇam eva / nihanmi duḥśāsanam adya pāpaṃ / saṃrakṣyatām adya samastayodhāḥ / ity evam uktvā sahasābhyadhāvan / nihantukāmo 'tibalas tarasvī / tathā tu vikramya raṇe vṛkodaro / mahāgajaṃ kesariṇo yathaiva / nigṛhya duḥśāsanam ekavīraḥ / suyodhanasyādhiratheḥ samakṣam / rathād avaplutya gataḥ sa bhūmau; yatnena tasmin praṇidhāya cakṣuḥ

vulgate_text: asiṃ samudyamya sitaṃ sudhāraṃ kaṇṭhe padākramya ca vepamānam / uvāca tadgauriti yadbruvāṇo hṛṣṭo'vadaḥ karṇasuyodhanābhyām
ce_text: asiṃ samuddhṛtya śitaṃ sudhāraṃ; kaṇṭhe samākramya ca vepamānam / ye rājasūyāvabhṛthe pavitrā / jātāḥ kacā yājñasenyā durātman / te pāṇinā katareṇāvakṛṣṭāḥ / prabrūhi tvāṃ pṛcchate bhīmasenaḥ / uktas tathājau sa tadā saroṣaṃ / jagāda bhīmaṃ parivṛtya netre / ayaṃ karikarākāraḥ pīnastanavimardanaḥ / gosahasrapradātā ca kṣatriyāntakaraḥ karaḥ / anena yājñasenyā me bhīma keśā vikarṣitāḥ / paśyatāṃ kurumukhyānāṃ yuṣmākaṃ ca sabhāsadām / evaṃ tv asau rājasutaṃ niśamya / bruvantam ājau vinipīḍya vakṣaḥ / bhīmo balād bāhum udhṛtya dorbhyām / uccair nanādātha samastayodhān / uvāca yasyāsti balaṃ kulaṃ ca / rakṣatv asau me 'dya nirastabāhuḥ / duḥśāsanaṃ jīvitam utsṛjantam / ākṣipya yodhās tarasā mahābalam / kruddho raṇe 'tīva karaṃ kareṇa / utpāṭya vīraḥ sahasaiva rājan / duḥśāsanaṃ tena tu vīramadhye / jaghāna vajrāśanisaṃnibhena / utkṛtya vakṣaḥ patitasya bhūmāv; athāpibac choṇitam asya koṣṇam / āsvādya cāsvādya ca vīkṣamāṇaḥ; kruddho 'tivelaṃ prajagāda vākyam

vulgate_text: evaṃ kruddho bhīmasenaḥ kareṇa utpāṭayāmāsa bhujaṃ mahātmā / duḥśāsanaṃ tena sa vīramadhye jaghāna vajrāśanisannibhena
ce_text: asiṃ samuddhṛtya śitaṃ sudhāraṃ; kaṇṭhe samākramya ca vepamānam / ye rājasūyāvabhṛthe pavitrā / jātāḥ kacā yājñasenyā durātman / te pāṇinā katareṇāvakṛṣṭāḥ / prabrūhi tvāṃ pṛcchate bhīmasenaḥ / uktas tathājau sa tadā saroṣaṃ / jagāda bhīmaṃ parivṛtya netre / ayaṃ karikarākāraḥ pīnastanavimardanaḥ / gosahasrapradātā ca kṣatriyāntakaraḥ karaḥ / anena yājñasenyā me bhīma keśā vikarṣitāḥ / paśyatāṃ kurumukhyānāṃ yuṣmākaṃ ca sabhāsadām / evaṃ tv asau rājasutaṃ niśamya / bruvantam ājau vinipīḍya vakṣaḥ / bhīmo balād bāhum udhṛtya dorbhyām / uccair nanādātha samastayodhān / uvāca yasyāsti balaṃ kulaṃ ca / rakṣatv asau me 'dya nirastabāhuḥ / duḥśāsanaṃ jīvitam utsṛjantam / ākṣipya yodhās tarasā mahābalam / kruddho raṇe 'tīva karaṃ kareṇa / utpāṭya vīraḥ sahasaiva rājan / duḥśāsanaṃ tena tu vīramadhye / jaghāna vajrāśanisaṃnibhena / utkṛtya vakṣaḥ patitasya bhūmāv; athāpibac choṇitam asya koṣṇam / āsvādya cāsvādya ca vīkṣamāṇaḥ; kruddho 'tivelaṃ prajagāda vākyam

vulgate_text: duḥśāsanasya nipuśāsanasya uddhṛtya vakṣaḥ patitasya bhūmau / tato'pibacchoṇitamasya koṣṇa-- māsvādya cāsvādya ca vīkṣamāṇaḥ

ce_text: ye cāpi tatrāpatitā manuṣyās; teṣāṃ karebhyaḥ patitaṃ ca śastram / bhayāc ca saṃcukruśur uccakais te; nimīlitākṣā dadṛśuś ca tan na

vulgate_text: sañjaya uvāca / sa pītvā rudhiraṃ tasya caraṇau gṛhya bhārata / ityuccairvacanaṃ prāha pratinṛtyanvṛkodaraḥ
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tatrākarod duṣkaraṃ rājaputro; duḥśāsanas tumule yudhyamānaḥ / ciccheda bhīmasya dhanuḥ kṣureṇa; ṣaḍbhiḥ śaraiḥ sārathim apy avidhyat

vulgate_text: pramāṇakoṭyāṃ śayane kālakūṭakabhojanam / daṃśanaṃ cāhibhistīkṣṇairdāhaṃ jatugṛhe ca yat
ce_text: pramāṇakoṭyāṃ śayanaṃ kālakūṭasya bhojanam / daśanaṃ cāhibhiḥ kaṣṭaṃ dāhaṃ ca jatuveśmani

vulgate_text: dyūte ca doṣabhūyastvamaraṇye vasatiśca yā / iṣvastrāṇi ca saṅgrāme anilānilaveśmasu
ce_text: dyūtena rājyaharaṇam araṇye vasatiś ca yā / iṣvastrāṇi ca saṃgrāmeṣv asukhāni ca veśmani

vulgate_text: ityuccairvacanaṃ procya jayaṃ prāpya vṛkodaraḥ / punareva mahārāja tava sainyamabhidravat
ce_text: ity uktvā vacanaṃ rājañ jayaṃ prāpya vṛkodaraḥ / punar āha mahārāja smayaṃs tau keśavārjunau

vulgate_text: duḥśāsane yādṛśaṃ saṃśrutaṃ na-- stadavāptaṃ pāṇḍavaiḥ sarvameva / atraivamāpsyāmyaparaṃ dvitīyaṃ duryodhanaṃ yajñapaśuṃ viśasya
ce_text: duḥśāsane yad raṇe saṃśrutaṃ me; tad vai sarvaṃ kṛtam adyeha vīrau / adyaiva dāsyāmy aparaṃ dvitīyaṃ; duryodhanaṃ yajñapaśuṃ viśasya / śiro mṛditvā ca padā durātmanaḥ; śāntiṃ lapsye kauravāṇāṃ samakṣam

vulgate_text: śiro mṛditvā'sya punaśca śāntiṃ yāsyāmyahaṃ kauravāṇāṃ samakṣam / yā sā'patiḥ sā sapatirhi jātā yāstāḥ sapatyo'patayastu jātāḥ

vulgate_text: niṣaṅgī kavacī khaṅgī daṇḍadhāro dhanurdharaḥ / alamburjalasandhaśca vātavegasuvarcasau
ce_text: kavacī niṣaṅgī pāśī daṇḍadhāro dhanurdharaḥ / alolupaḥ śalaḥ saṃdho vātavegasuvarcasau

vulgate_text: upāsate tvāmete hi parivārya mahārathāḥ / kṛpaprabhṛtayaḥ karṇa hataśeṣāḥ sahodarāḥ
ce_text: duryodhanam upāsante parivārya samantataḥ / kṛpaprabhṛtayaḥ karṇa hataśeṣāś ca sodarāḥ

vulgate_text: jaye syādvipulā kīrtirdhruvaḥ svargaḥ parājaye vṛṣasenaśca rādheya saṅkruddhastanayastava / tvayi mohaṃ samāpanne pāṇḍavānabhidhāvati / sañjaya uvāca

vulgate_text: tataḥ kruddho vṛṣaseno'bhyadhāva-- dbhīmaṃ samāyāntamamitrasāham / bāṇaiḥ kirantaṃ pratiyāti cograṃ vyāttānanaṃ kālamivāpatantam
ce_text: tataḥ kruddho vṛṣaseno 'bhyadhāvad; ātasthivāṃsaṃ svarathaṃ hatārim / vṛkodaraṃ kālam ivāttadaṇḍaṃ; gadāhastaṃ pothamānaṃ tvadīyān

vulgate_text: tataḥ kruddho nakulaḥ karṇaputraṃ śarairmaholkābhirivābhyapīḍayat / sa karṇaputro nakulasya rāja-- nsarvānastrānvārayaduttamāstraiḥ
ce_text: tataḥ kruddho nakulas taṃ mahātmā; śarair maholkāpratimair avidhyat / divyair astrair abhyavidhyac ca so 'pi; karṇasya putro nakulaṃ kṛtāstraḥ

vulgate_text: vanāyujānsukumārānsuśubhrā-- nalaṅkṛtāñjātarūpeṇa citrān / jaghāna cāśvānnakulasya vīro raṇājire sūtaputrasya putraḥ
ce_text: karṇasya putro nakulasya rājan; sarvān aśvān akṣiṇod uttamāstraiḥ / vanāyujān sukumārasya śubhrān; alaṃkṛtāñ jātarūpeṇa śīghrān

vulgate_text: tato hatāśvādavaruhya yānā-- ccarmā''dade ruciraṃ barhicitram / ākāśasaṅkāśamasiṃ pragṛhya prakāśamānaḥ khagavaccacāra
ce_text: tato hatāśvād avaruhya yānād; ādāya carma ruciraṃ cāṣṭacandram / ākāśasaṃkāśam asiṃ gṛhītvā; poplūyamānaḥ khagavac cacāra

vulgate_text: tato'sya pakṣānanayadyamāya dvisāhasrānnakulaḥ kṣiprakārī / te prāpatannasinā vai viśastā yathā'śvamedhe paśavaḥ śamitrā
ce_text: tato 'ntarikṣe nṛvarāśvanāgāṃś; ciccheda mārgān vicaran vicitrān / te prāpatann asinā gāṃ viśastā; yathāśvamedhe paśavaḥ śamitrā

vulgate_text: bhūmau carantaṃ nakulaṃ rathaughāḥ samantataḥ sāyakaiḥ pratyagṛhṇan / sa tudyamāno nakulo vihaṅgai-- ścacāra saṅkhye dviṣato vinighnan
ce_text: tam āpatantaṃ nakulaṃ so 'bhipatya; samantataḥ sāyakair abhyavidhyat / sa tudyamāno nakulaḥ pṛṣatkair; vivyādha vīraṃ sa cukopa viddhaḥ

vulgate_text: tasyātha kāṃsyaṃ suśitaṃ supīta-- masipravīraṃ gurubhārāsāham / dviṣaccharīrāpaharaṃ sughora-- mādhūnvataḥ sarpamivāttakośam
ce_text: tasyāyasaṃ niśitaṃ tīkṣṇadhāram; asiṃ vikośaṃ gurubhārasāham / dviṣaccharīrāpaharaṃ sughoram; ādhunvataḥ sarpam ivograrūpam

vulgate_text: kuṇindarājasya suto'parastadā sa cāpi śūraḥ sahasā samarpitaḥ / papāta bāṇaiḥ subalasya sūnunā viṣāṇapucchāparagātrapātinā
ce_text: sa nāgarājaḥ saniyantṛko 'patat; parāhato babhrusuteṣubhir bhṛśam / sa cāpi devāvṛdhasūnur arditaḥ; papāta nunnaḥ sahadevasūnunā

vulgate_text: gajena vāhāñśakuneḥ kuṇindajo nināya vaivasvatamandiraṃ raṇe / rathaṃ ca saṃkṣubhya nanāda nardata-- stato'sya gāndhārapatiḥ śiro'harat
ce_text: kuṇindaputrāvarajas tu tomarair; divākarāṃśupratimair ayasmayaiḥ / rathaṃ ca vikṣobhya nanāda nardatas; tato 'sya gāndhārapatiḥ śiro 'harat

vulgate_text: tato drutaṃ caikaśareṇa pārthaṃ śitena viddhvā yudhi karṇaputraḥ / nanāda nādaṃ sumahānubhāvo viddhveva śakraṃ namuciḥ sa vīraḥ
ce_text: tato 'dbhutenaikaśatena pārthaṃ; śarair viddhvā sūtaputrasya putraḥ / nanāda nādaṃ sumahānubhāvo; viddhveva śakraṃ namuciḥ purā vai

ce_text: tataḥ kirīṭī raṇamūrdhni kopāt; kṛtvā triśākhāṃ bhrukuṭiṃ lalāṭe / mumoca tūrṇaṃ viśikhān mahātmā / vadhe dhṛtaḥ karṇasutasya saṃkhye / āraktanetro 'ntakaśatruhantā / uvāca karṇaṃ bhṛśam utsmayaṃs tadā / duryodhanaṃ drauṇimukhāṃś ca sarvān / ahaṃ raṇe vṛṣasenaṃ tam ugram / saṃpaśyataḥ karṇa tavādya saṃkhye / nayāmi lokaṃ niśitaiḥ pṛṣatkaiḥ / yamasya yāvad dhi janā vadanti / bhavadbhiḥ sarvair mama sūnur hato 'sau / eko ratho madvihīnas tarasvī / ahaṃ haniṣye bhavatāṃ samakṣam / saṃrakṣyatāṃ rathasaṃsthāḥ suto 'yam / ahaṃ haniṣye vṛṣasenam enam / paścād vadhiṣye tvām api saṃpramūḍham / ahaṃ haniṣye 'rjuna ājimadhye / tam adya mūlaṃ kalahasya saṃkhye / duryodhanāpāśrayajātadarpam / tvām adya hantāsmi raṇe prasahya / asyaiva hantā yudhi bhīmasenaḥ / duryodhanasyādhamapūruṣasya / yasyānayād eṣa mahān kṣayo 'bhavat / sa evam uktvā vinimṛjya cāpaṃ / lakṣyaṃ hi kṛtvā vṛṣasenam ājau / mumoca bāṇān viśikhān mahātmā; vadhāya rājan sūtaputrasya saṃkhye

ce_text: sa pārthabāṇābhihataḥ papāta; rathād vibāhur viśirā dharāyām / supuṣpitaḥ parṇadharo 'tikāyo; vāteritaḥ śāla ivādriśṛṅgāt

ce_text: śrutvā tu dvairathaṃ tābhyāṃ tatra yodhāḥ samantataḥ / cakrur bāhuvalaṃ caiva tathā celavalaṃ mahat

ce_text: tathaiva pāṇḍavā hṛṣṭā dhṛṣṭadyumnapurogamāḥ / parivavrur mahātmānaṃ pārtham apratimaṃ yudhi

ce_text: dyaur āsīt karṇato vyagrā sanakṣatrā viśāṃ pate / bhūmir viśālā pārthasya mātā putrasya bhārata

ce_text: saritaḥ sāgarāś caiva girayaś ca narottama / vṛkṣāś cauṣadhayas tatra vyāśrayanta kirīṭinam

ce_text: vāsukiś citrasenaś ca takṣakaś copatakṣakaḥ / parvatāś ca tathā sarve kādraveyāś ca sānvayāḥ / viṣavanto mahāroṣā nāgāś cārjunato 'bhavan

ce_text: īhāmṛgā vyāḍamṛgā maṅgalyāś ca mṛgadvijāḥ / pārthasya vijayaṃ rājan sarva evābhisaṃśritāḥ

ce_text: devās tu pitṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ sagaṇārjunato 'bhavan / yamo vaiśravaṇaś caiva varuṇaś ca yato 'rjunaḥ

vulgate_text: īhāmṛgavyālamṛgairdipāśvarathapaṅktibhiḥ ūhyamānāḥ pare meghairvāyunā ca manīṣiṇaḥ / didṛkṣavaḥ samājagmuḥ karṇārjunasamāgamam
ce_text: prāveyāḥ saha mauneyair gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ / sahāpsarobhiḥ śubhrābhir devadūtāś ca guhyakāḥ / kirīṭinaṃ saṃśritāḥ sma puṇyagandhā manoramāḥ / amanojñāś ca ye gandhās te sarve karṇam āśritāḥ / viparītāny aniṣṭāni bhavanti vinaśiṣyatām / yāny antakāle puruṣaṃ viparītam upadrutam / praviśanti naraṃ kṣipraṃ mṛtyukāle 'bhyupāgate / te bhāvāḥ sahitāḥ karṇaṃ praviṣṭāḥ sūtanandanam / ojas tejaś ca siddhiś ca praharṣaḥ satyavikramau / manastuṣṭir jayaś cāpi tathānando nṛpottama / īdṛśāś ca naravyāghra tasmin saṃgrāmasāgare / nimittāni ca śubhrāṇi viviśur jiṣṇum āhave / ṛṣayo brāhmaṇaiḥ sārdham abhajanta kirīṭinam / tato devagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ siddhāś ca saha cāraṇaiḥ / dvidhā bhūtā mahārāja vyāśrayanta narottamau / vimānāni vicitrāṇi guṇavanti ca sarvataḥ / samāruhya samājagmur dvairathaṃ karṇapārthayoḥ / didṛkṣavaḥ samājagmuḥ karṇārjunasamāgamam / antarikṣe mahārāja devagandharvarākṣasāḥ / evaṃ sarveṣu bhūteṣu dvidhābhūteṣu bhārata / āśaṃsamāneṣu jayaṃ rādheyasyārjunasya ca / vimānāyutasaṃbādham ākāśam abhavat tadā / īhāmṛgavyāḍamṛgair dvipāś ca rathapattibhiḥ

vulgate_text: brahmā brahmarṣibhiḥ sārdhaṃ prajāpatibhireva ca / āsthito yānamākāśe divyaṃ tejaḥ samāgatāḥ
ce_text: brahmā brahmarṣibhiḥ sārdhaṃ prajāpatibhir eva ca / bhavenāvasthito yānaṃ divyaṃ taṃ deśam abhyayāt

vulgate_text: sañjaya uvāca / prajāpatistu taṃ dṛṣṭvā devabhāgaṃ samāgatam / abravīttu tato rājanpaśyato vai svayaṃbhuvaḥ
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / duḥśāsane tu nihate putrās tava mahārathāḥ / mahākrodhaviṣā vīrāḥ samareṣv apalāyinaḥ / daśa rājan mahāvīryo bhīmaṃ prācchādayañ śaraiḥ

vulgate_text: prajāpatirathoktvaivaṃ svayambhuvamacodayat / samo'stu vijayaḥ kāmamubhayornarasiṃhayoḥ
ce_text: dṛṣṭvā prajāpatiṃ devāḥ svayaṃbhuvam upāgaman / samo 'stu deva vijaya etayor narasiṃhayoḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ prajāpatiṃ tatra sahasrākṣo'bhyacodayat / vijayo dhruva evāstu pāṇḍavasya mahātmanaḥ
ce_text: brahmeśānāv atho vākyam ūcatus tridaśeśvaram / vijayo dhruva evāstu vijayasya mahātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: sraṣṭārau jagataścaitau tataśca puruṣarṣabhau / naranārāyaṇāvetau purāṇāvṛṣisattamau
ce_text: naranārāyaṇāv etau purāṇāv ṛṣisattamau / aniyattau niyantārāv abhītau sma paraṃtapau

vulgate_text: pūrvaṃ bhagavatā proktaḥ kṛṣṇayorvijayo dhruvaḥ / tattathāstu namaste'stu pramo brūhi pitāmaha
ce_text: svayaṃbho brūhi tad vākyaṃ samo 'stu vijayo 'nayoḥ / tat tathāstu namas te 'stu prasīda bhagavan mama

vulgate_text: manasvī jayatāṃ śūraḥ kṛtavidyastapodhanaḥ / bibharti ca mahātejā dhanurvedamaśeṣataḥ
ce_text: manasvī balavāñ śūraḥ kṛtāstraś ca tapodhanaḥ / bibharti ca mahātejā dhanurvedam aśeṣataḥ

vulgate_text: atikrāmecca māhātmyāddiṣṭamapyavicārayan / atikrame ca lokānāmabhāvo niyato bhavet
ce_text: atikramec ca māhātmyād diṣṭam etasya paryayāt / atikrānte ca lokānām abhāvo niyato bhavet

vulgate_text: kāmaṃ tu sukṛtām̐llokānprāpnotveṣa parantapaḥ / karṇo vaikartanaḥ śūro vijayastu nare dhruvaḥ
ce_text: karṇo lokān ayaṃ mukhyān prāpnotu puruṣarṣabhaḥ / vīro vaikartanaḥ śūro vijayas tv astu kṛṣṇayoḥ

vulgate_text: śrutaṃ bhavadbhiryatproktaṃ bhagavadbhyāṃ jagaddhitam / tattathā vyetu te rogaḥ śamāpnuta vimanyavaḥ
ce_text: śrutaṃ bhavadbhir yat proktaṃ bhagavadbhyāṃ jagaddhitam / tat tathā nānyathā tad dhi tiṣṭhadhvaṃ gatamanyavaḥ

vulgate_text: didṛkṣavaścāpratimaṃ dvairathaṃ narasiṃhayoḥ / vismayotphullanayanā nānyā bubudhire kriyāḥ
ce_text: didṛkṣavaś cāpratimaṃ dvairathaṃ narasiṃhayoḥ / devadānavagandharvāḥ sarva evāvatasthire / rathau ca tau śvetahayau yuktaketū mahāsvanau

vulgate_text: sañjaya uvāca / rathau tayoḥ śvetahayau divyau yuktau mahāsvanau samāsthitau lokavīrau śaṅkhāndadhmuḥ pṛthakpṛthakam / vāsudevārjunau vīrau karṇaśalyau ca bhārata
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / duḥśāsane tu nihate putrās tava mahārathāḥ / mahākrodhaviṣā vīrāḥ samareṣv apalāyinaḥ / daśa rājan mahāvīryo bhīmaṃ prācchādayañ śaraiḥ

vulgate_text: tayordhvajau hi vimalau śuśubhāte rathe sthitau / rāhuketū yathā''kāśe uditau jagataḥ kṣaye
ce_text: tayor dhvajau vītamālau śuśubhāte rathasthitau / pṛthagrūpau samārchantau krodhaṃ yuddhe parasparam

vulgate_text: sā kiṅkiṇīkābharaṇā kālapāśopamā tadā / abhyadravatsusaṃrabdhā hastikakṣyā'tha taṃ kapim
ce_text: sukiṅkiṇīkābharaṇā kālapāśopamāyasī / abhyadravat susaṃkruddhā nāgakakṣyā mahākapim

vulgate_text: tayorghoratare yuddhe dvairathe dyūta āhite / prākurvatāṃ dhvajau yuddhaṃ pūrvaṃ pūrvataraṃ tadā
ce_text: ubhayor uttame yuddhe dvairathe dyūta āhṛte / prakurvāte dhvajau yuddhaṃ pratyaheṣan hayān hayāḥ

vulgate_text: yadi pārtho raṇe hanyādadya māmiha karhicit / kiṃ kariṣyasi saṅghāme śalya satyamathocyatām / śalya uvāca
ce_text: athābravīt sūtaputraḥ śalyam ābhāṣya sasmitam / yadi pārtho raṇe hanyād adya mām iha karhi cit / kim uttaraṃ tadā te syāt sakhe satyaṃ bravīhi me

vulgate_text: adyaiva sarathaṃ sāśvaṃ saśaktikavacāyudham / sañcūrṇitamivāraṇye vṛkṣaṃ paśyādya dantinā
ce_text: draṣṭāsy adya śaraiḥ karṇaṃ raṇe kṛttam anekadhā / adyainaṃ sarathaṃ sāśvaṃ saśaktikavacāyudham / na hi me śāmyate vairaṃ kṛṣṇāṃ yat prāhasat purā

vulgate_text: draṣṭāsi dhruvamadyaiva vidhavāḥ karṇayoṣitaḥ / na hi me śāmyate manyuryadanena purā kṛtam
ce_text: draṣṭāsy adya śaraiḥ karṇaṃ raṇe kṛttam anekadhā / adyainaṃ sarathaṃ sāśvaṃ saśaktikavacāyudham / na hi me śāmyate vairaṃ kṛṣṇāṃ yat prāhasat purā

vulgate_text: adya tā madhurā vācaḥ śrotāsi madhusūdana / diṣṭyā jayasi vārṣṇeya iti karṇe nipātite
ce_text: adya tā madhurā vācaḥ śrotāsi madhusūdana / adyābhimanyujananīm anṛṇaḥ sāntvayiṣyasi / kuntīṃ pitṛṣvasāraṃ ca saṃprahṛṣṭo janārdana

vulgate_text: [babhūva yuddhaṃ kurupāṇḍavānāṃ yathā surāṇāmasuraiḥ sahābhavat ] / tathā pravṛte tumule sudāruṇe dhanañjayaścādhirathiśca sāyakaiḥ diśaśca sainyaṃ ca śitairajihmagaiḥ parasparaṃ prāvṛṇutāṃ sudaṃśitau
ce_text: tathā pravṛtte 'strabhṛtāṃ parābhave; dhanaṃjayaś cādhirathiś ca sāyakaiḥ / diśaś ca sainyaṃ ca śitair ajihmagaiḥ; parasparaṃ prorṇuvatuḥ sma daṃśitau

vulgate_text: tatastvadīyāśca pare ca sāyakaiḥ kṛte'ndhakāre dadṛśurna kiñcana / bhayāturā ekarathau samāśrayaṃ-- stato'bhavattvadbhutameva sarvataḥ
ce_text: tatas tvadīyāś ca pare ca sāyakaiḥ; kṛte 'ndhakāre vividur na kiṃ cana / bhayāt tu tāv eva rathau samāśrayaṃs; tamonudau khe prasṛtā ivāṃśavaḥ

vulgate_text: mṛdaṅgabherīpaṇavānakasvanai-- rninādite vāhanaśaṅkhanisvanaiḥ / tau siṃhanādairbabhaturnarottamau pataṅgacandrāviva duḥsahāvubhau
ce_text: mṛdaṅgabherīpaṇavānakasvanair; ninādite bhārata śaṅkhanisvanaiḥ / sasiṃhanādau babhatur narottamau; śaśāṅkasūryāv iva meghasaṃplave

vulgate_text: tatastu duryodhanabhojasaubalāḥ kṛpo guroścāpi suto mahāhave / mahārathāḥ pañca dhanañjayācyutau śaraiḥ śarīrārtikarairatāḍayan
ce_text: tatas tu duryodhanabhojasaubalāḥ; kṛpaś ca śāradvatasūnunā saha / mahārathāḥ pañca dhanaṃjayācyutau; śaraiḥ śarīrāntakarair atāḍayan

vulgate_text: tvayā tu pārthaiśca kṛte ca saṃvide prajāḥ śivaṃ prāpnuyuricchayā tava / vrajantu śeṣāḥ svapurāṇi pārthivā nivṛttavairāśca bhavantu sainikāḥ na cedvacaḥ śroṣyasi me narādhipa dhruvaṃ hi tapto'si hato'ribhiryudhi
ce_text: tvayā ca pārthaiś ca paraspareṇa; prajāḥ śivaṃ prāpnuyur icchati tvayi / vrajantu śeṣāḥ svapurāṇi pārthivā; nivṛttavairāś ca bhavantu sainikāḥ

vulgate_text: ato'pi bhūyānsvaguṇairdhanañjayo na cātivartiṣyati me vaco'khilam / tavānuyātrāṃ ca sadā kariṣyati prasīda rājendra śamaṃ tvamāpnuhi
ce_text: ato 'pi bhūyāṃś ca guṇair dhanaṃjayaḥ; sa cābhipatsyaty akhilaṃ vaco mama / tavānuyātrāṃ ca tathā kariṣyati; prasīda rājañ jagataḥ śamāya vai

vulgate_text: mamābhimānaḥ paramaḥ sadā tvayi bravīmyatastvāṃ paramācca sauhṛdāt / nivārayiṣyāmi ca karṇamāhave mahānhi me'sti praṇayo'tha sūtaje
ce_text: mamāpi mānaḥ paramaḥ sadā tvayi; bravīmy atas tvāṃ paramāc ca sauhṛdāt / nivārayiṣyāmi hi karṇam apy ahaṃ; yadā bhavān sapraṇayo bhaviṣyati

vulgate_text: nisargataste tava vīra bāndhavāḥ punaśca sāmnā hitamāpnuyuḥ prabho / tvayi prasanne yadi mitratāṃ gate hitaṃ kṛtaṃ syājjagatastvayā'tulam
ce_text: nisargatas te tava vīra bāndhavāḥ; punaś ca sāmnā ca samāpnuhi sthiram / tvayi prasanne yadi mitratām iyur; dhruvaṃ narendrendra tathā tvam ācara

vulgate_text: sa sannipāto rathayormahānabhū-- tsureśavairocanayoryathā purā / śarairvinunnāśvaniyantṛdehayoḥ suduḥsahāstraiḥ paribhinnadehayoḥ
ce_text: sa saṃnipātas tu tayor mahān abhūt; sureśavairocanayor yathā purā / śarair vibhugnāṅganiyantṛvāhanaḥ; suduḥsaho 'nyaiḥ paṭuśoṇitodakaḥ

vulgate_text: punaśca karṇastvarito'pi pārthaṃ ratheṣubhistaṃ daśabhirjaghāna / taṃ cāpi pārtho daśabhiḥ śitāgraiḥ kakṣyāntare tīkṣṇamukhairavidhyat
ce_text: tataḥ karṇaḥ prathamaṃ tatra pārthaṃ; maheṣubhir daśabhiḥ paryavidhyat / tam arjunaḥ pratyavidhyac chitāgraiḥ; kakṣāntare daśabhir atīva kruddhaḥ

vulgate_text: karṇo'pi pārthaṃ saha vāsudevaṃ samācinodbhārata vatsadantaiḥ / parasparaṃ tau viśikhaiḥ pramuktai-- statakṣatuḥ sūtaputro'rjunaśca
ce_text: parasparaṃ tau viśikhaiḥ sutīkṣṇais; tatakṣatuḥ sūtaputro 'rjunaś ca / parasparasyāntarepsū vimarde; subhīmam abhyāyayatuḥ prahṛṣṭau

vulgate_text: parasparaṃ chidradidṛkṣayā ca subhīmamabhyāyayatuḥ praruṣṭau
ce_text: parasparaṃ tau viśikhaiḥ sutīkṣṇais; tatakṣatuḥ sūtaputro 'rjunaś ca / parasparasyāntarepsū vimarde; subhīmam abhyāyayatuḥ prahṛṣṭau

vulgate_text: dhṛtyā tayā sūtaputraṃ jahi tva-- mahaṃ vainaṃ gadayā pothayiṣye / sametya pārthaṃ sunṛśaṃsavādī jīvannāyaṃ yāsyati kālapakvaḥ
ce_text: yayā dhṛtyā sarvabhūtāny ajaiṣīr; grāsaṃ dadad vahnaye khāṇḍave tvam / tayā dhṛtyā sūtaputraṃ jahi tvam; ahaṃ vainaṃ gadayā pothayiṣye

vulgate_text: sañjaya uvāca / athābravīccakradharo'pi pārthaṃ dṛṣṭvā ratheṣūnpratihanyamānān / amūmuṣatpaśyata eva te'dya hyastrāṇi karṇo'stragaṇaiḥ kirīṭin
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tad devanāgāsurasiddhasaṃghair; gandharvayakṣāpsarasāṃ ca saṃghaiḥ / brahmarṣirājarṣisuparṇajuṣṭaṃ; babhau viyad vismayanīyarūpam

vulgate_text: sa pārtha kiṃ muhyasi vetsi caiva tā-- ndṛṣṭvā sametānnadataḥ kurūstvam / karṇaṃ puraskṛtya vidurhi sarve tavāstramastrairvinihanyamānam
ce_text: sa vīra kiṃ muhyasi nāvadhīyase; nadanty ete kuravaḥ saṃprahṛṣṭāḥ / karṇaṃ puraskṛtya vidur hi sarve; tvadastram astrair vinipātyamānam

vulgate_text: yayā dhṛtyā tāmasaṃ jaghnivāṃstvaṃ tatsaṃyuge tāmasāṃścātighorān / dambhodbhavaṃ cāsuramāhave tvaṃ darpotsiktaṃ vīryavantaṃ kirīṭin tayā dhṛtyā tvaṃ jahi karṇamadya pārthāhave tyaktumastraṃ samarthaḥ
ce_text: yayā dhṛtyā nihataṃ tāmasāstraṃ; yuge yuge rākṣasāś cāpi ghorāḥ / dambhodbhavāś cāsurāś cāhaveṣu; tayā dhṛtyā tvaṃ jahi sūtaputram

vulgate_text: karṇaṃ puraskṛtya nadantiṃ sarve tavāstramagryaṃ pratihatya vīrāḥ / kuru prayatnaṃ bharatapravīra dravantyamī sṛñjayāḥ somakāśca dṛṣṭvātha karṇaṃ samare prahṛṣṭaṃ tvāṃ cāpi dṛṣṭvā parihīyamānam / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tad devanāgāsurasiddhasaṃghair; gandharvayakṣāpsarasāṃ ca saṃghaiḥ / brahmarṣirājarṣisuparṇajuṣṭaṃ; babhau viyad vismayanīyarūpam

vulgate_text: iti smoktvā pāṇḍavaḥ savyasācī namaskṛtvā brahmaṇe so'mitātmā / anuttamaṃ brāhmamasahyamastraṃ prāduścakre manasā yadvidheyam
ce_text: ity ūcivān brāhmam asahyam astraṃ; prāduścakre manasā saṃvidheyam / tato diśaś ca pradiśaś ca sarvāḥ; samāvṛṇot sāyakair bhūritejāḥ / sasarja bāṇān bharatarṣabho 'pi; śataṃśatān ekavad āśuvegān

vulgate_text: tato diśaśca pradiśaśca sarvāḥ samāvṛṇotsāyakairbhūritejāḥ / gāṇḍīvamuktairbhujagairivograi-- rdivākarāṃśupratimairjvaladbhiḥ
ce_text: ity ūcivān brāhmam asahyam astraṃ; prāduścakre manasā saṃvidheyam / tato diśaś ca pradiśaś ca sarvāḥ; samāvṛṇot sāyakair bhūritejāḥ / sasarja bāṇān bharatarṣabho 'pi; śataṃśatān ekavad āśuvegān

vulgate_text: tataḥ sa kṛṣṇaṃ ca kirīṭinaṃ ca vṛkodaraṃ cāpratimaprabhāvaḥ / tribhistribhirbhīmabalo nihatya nanāda ghoraṃ mahatā svanena
ce_text: sa bhīmasenaṃ ca janārdanaṃ ca; kirīṭinaṃ cāpy amanuṣyakarmā / tribhis tribhir bhīmabalo nihatya; nanāda ghoraṃ mahatā svareṇa

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvā tu mukhyāvatividhyamānau vareṣubhiḥ śūravarāvarighnau / karṇaṃ ca pārthaṃ ca niyamya vāhā- nsarve variṣṭhāśca tato'vatasthuḥ
ce_text: dṛṣṭvājimukhyāv atha yudhyamānau; didṛkṣavaḥ śūravarāv arighnau / karṇaṃ ca pārthaṃ ca niyamya vāhān; khasthā mahīsthāś ca janāvatasthuḥ

vulgate_text: pracchādayāmāsa tataḥ pṛṣatkaiḥ saghoṣamācchidya ca gāṇḍivajyām / asminkṣaṇe phalgunaṃ sūtaputraḥ samācinotkṣudrakāṇāṃ śatena
ce_text: tato dhanurjyā sahasātikṛṣṭā; sughoṣam ācchidyata pāṇḍavasya / tasmin kṣaṇe sūtaputras tu pārthaṃ; samācinot kṣudrakāṇāṃ śatena

vulgate_text: pārtho'pi tāṃ jyāmavadhāya tūrṇaṃ śarāsanajyāmādhirathervihatya / susaṃrabdhaḥ karṇaśaraiḥ kṣatāṅgo raṇe yodhāṃstāvakānpratyagṛhṇāt
ce_text: tato dhanurjyām avadhamya śīghraṃ; śarān astān ādhirather vidhamya / susaṃrabdhaḥ karṇaśarakṣatāṅgo; raṇe pārthaḥ somakān pratyagṛhṇāt / na pakṣiṇaḥ saṃpatanty antarikṣe; kṣepīyasāstreṇa kṛte 'ndhakāre

vulgate_text: suvarṇacitraṃ puruṣottamasya varmātha bhittvābhyapatansupuṅkhāḥ / vegena gāṃ te viviśuśca rāja-- nsnātvā karṇā'bhimukhāḥ pratīyuḥ
ce_text: te varma bhittvā puruṣottamasya; suvarṇacitraṃ nyapatan sumuktāḥ / vegena gām āviviśuḥ suvegāḥ; snātvā ca karṇābhimukhāḥ pratīyuḥ

vulgate_text: tato'rjuno vai bharatapravīro mahānubhāvaḥ samare nihantā / suyodhanenānumatānvinighna-- nsamucchritānsarathānsārabhūtān
ce_text: sa cakrarakṣān atha pādarakṣān; puraḥsarān pṛṣṭhagopāṃś ca sarvān / duryodhanenānumatān arighnān; samuccitān surathān sārabhūtān

vulgate_text: bhayāvadīrṇaḥ kurubhirvihīnaḥ pārtheṣubhiḥ samparitapyamānaḥ / na vivyadhe bhārata tatra karṇaḥ / pratīpamevārjunamabhyadhāvat
ce_text: sa sarvataḥ prekṣya diśo viśūnyā; bhayāvadīrṇaiḥ kurubhir vihīnaḥ / na vivyathe bhārata tatra karṇaḥ; pratīpam evārjunam abhyadhāvat

vulgate_text: tato'grasatsūtaputro'rjunasya viyadgataṃ ghorataraṃ śaraistat / kruddhena pārthena śaraṃ visṛṣṭaṃ vadhāya karṇasya mahāvimarde
ce_text: tad arjunāstraṃ grasate sma vīrān; viyat tathākāśam anantaghoṣam / kruddhena pārthena tadāśu sṛṣṭaṃ; vadhāya karṇasya mahāvimarde

vulgate_text: tato'strasaṅghātasamāvṛtaṃ tadā babhūva rājaṃstumulaṃ raṇājiram / yatkarṇapārthau śaravṛṣṭisaṅghai-- rnirantaraṃ cakraturambaraṃ tadā
