vulgate_text: sadārcitaṃ candanacūrṇaśāyitaṃ suvarṇatūṇīraśayaṃ mahārciṣam / ākarṇapūrṇaṃ vicakarṣa karṇo vimoktukāmaḥ śaramugravegam
ce_text: sadārcitaṃ candanacūrṇaśāyinaṃ; suvarṇanālīśayanaṃ mahāviṣam / pradīptam airāvatavaṃśasaṃbhavaṃ; śiro jihīrṣur yudhi phalgunasya

vulgate_text: pradīptamairāvatavaṃśasambhavaṃ śiro jihīrṣuryudhi savyasācinaḥ / tataḥ prajajvāla diśo nabhaśca ulkāśca ghorāḥ śataśaḥ prapetuḥ
ce_text: sadārcitaṃ candanacūrṇaśāyinaṃ; suvarṇanālīśayanaṃ mahāviṣam / pradīptam airāvatavaṃśasaṃbhavaṃ; śiro jihīrṣur yudhi phalgunasya

vulgate_text: tato'bravīnmadrarājo mahātmā dṛṣṭvā karṇaṃ prahiteṣu tamugram / grīvāyataḥ karṇa na saṃhito'yaṃ samīkṣya sandhatsva śaraṃ paraghnam
ce_text: tam abravīn madrarājo mahātmā; vaikartanaṃ prekṣya hi saṃhiteṣum / na karṇa grīvām iṣur eṣa prāpsyate; saṃlakṣya saṃdhatsva śaraṃ śiroghnam

vulgate_text: athābravītkrodhasaṃraktanetro madrādhipaṃ sūtaputro manasvī / na sandhatte dviḥ śaraṃ śalya karṇo na mādṛśā jihmayudvā bhavanti
ce_text: athābravīt krodhasaṃraktanetraḥ; karṇaḥ śalyaṃ saṃdhiteṣuḥ prasahya / na saṃdhatte dviḥ śaraṃ śalya karṇo; na mādṛśāḥ śāṭhyayuktā bhavanti

vulgate_text: itīdamuktvā visasarja taṃ śaraṃ prayatnato varṣagaṇābhipūjitam / hatosi re phalguna ityadhikṣipa-- nnuvāca coccairniramūrjitāṃ vṛṣaḥ
ce_text: tathaivam uktvā visasarja taṃ śaraṃ; balāhakaṃ varṣaghanābhipūjitam / hato 'si vai phalguna ity avocat; tatas tvarann ūrjitam utsasarja

vulgate_text: tato'rjunasyottamagātrabhūṣaṇaṃ suvarṇamuktāmaṇivajracitritam / dharāviyaddyosalileṣu viśrutaṃ balaṃ nisargottamamanyudhiḥ sadā
ce_text: athārjunasyottamagātrabhūṣaṇaṃ; dharāviyaddyosalileṣu viśrutam / balāstrasargottamayatnamanyubhiḥ; śareṇa mūrdhnaḥ sa jahāra sūtajaḥ

vulgate_text: śareṇa mūrdhni prajahāra sūtajo divākarendujvalanagrahatviṣam / suvarṇamuktāmaṇivajrabhūṣaṇaṃ purandarārthaṃ tapasā prayatnataḥ
ce_text: divākarendujvalanagrahatviṣaṃ; suvarṇamuktāmaṇijālabhūṣitam / puraṃdarārthaṃ tapasā prayatnataḥ; svayaṃ kṛtaṃ yad bhuvanasya sūnunā

vulgate_text: svayaṃ kṛtaṃ yadvidhinā svayambhuvā mahārharūpaṃ dviṣatāṃ bhayaṅkaram / nijaghnate devaripūnsureśvaraḥ svayaṃ dadau yaddhi mudā'rjunāya
ce_text: mahārharūpaṃ dviṣatāṃ bhayaṃkaraṃ; vibhāti cātyarthasukhaṃ sugandhi tat / nijaghnuṣe devaripūn sureśvaraḥ; svayaṃ dadau yat sumanāḥ kirīṭine

vulgate_text: mahīviyaddyosalilāni vāyunā prasahya rugṇāni vighūrṇitāni vā / itīva śabdaṃ bhuvaneṣu tattathā janā vyavasyanti diśaśca vihvalāḥ
ce_text: mahī viyad dyauḥ salilāni vāyunā; yathā vibhinnāni vibhānti bhārata / tathaiva śabdo bhuvaneṣv abhūt tadā; janā vyavasyan vyathitāś ca caskhaluḥ

vulgate_text: sa eṣa tadvairamanusmaranvai tvāṃ prārthayatyātmavadhāya nūnam / nabhaścutāṃ prajvalitāmivolkāṃ paśyainamāyāntamamitrasāha / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tau śaṅkhabherīninade samṛddhe; samīyatuḥ śvetahayau narāgryau / vaikartanaḥ sūtaputro 'rjunaś ca; durmantrite tava putrasya rājan

vulgate_text: tataḥ śarāvāpamapāsya sūtajo dhanuśca tacchakraśarāsanopamam / tato rathasthaḥ sa mumoha ca skhalan praśīrṇamuṣṭiḥ subhṛśāhataḥ prabho
ce_text: tataḥ samudgrathya sitena vāsasā; svamūrdhajānavyathitaḥ sthito 'rjunaḥ / vibhāti saṃpūrṇamarīcibhāsvatā; śirogatenodayaparvato yathā / tato 'rjunaḥ karṇam avakragair navaiḥ / suvarṇapuṅkhaiḥ sudṛḍhair ayasmayaiḥ / yamāgnidaṇḍapratimaiḥ stanāntare / parābhinat krauñcam ivādrim agnijaḥ / tataḥ śarāvāpam apāsya sūtajo / dhanuś ca tac chakraśarāsanopamam / tatāpa tasthau na mumoha caskhale / dṛḍhāhataḥ saṃś ca punas tatas tataḥ / na hy arjunas taṃ vyasane tadeyivān / nihantum āryaḥ puruṣavrate sthitaḥ / tatas tam indrāvarajo 'pi saṃbhramād / uvāca kiṃ pāṇḍava he pramādyasi / naivāhitānāṃ satataṃ vipaścitaḥ / kṣaṇaṃ pratīkṣanty api durbalīyasām / viśeṣato 'rīn vyasaneṣu paṇḍito / nihatya dharmaṃ ca yaśaś ca vindati / tam ekavīraṃ tava cāhitaṃ sadā / tvarasva karṇaṃ sahasābhimarditum / purā samarthaḥ samupaiti sūtajo / vidhya tvam enaṃ namuciṃ yathā hariḥ / tathāstu devety abhipūjya satvaraṃ / janārdanaṃ karṇam avidhyad arjunaḥ / śarottamaiḥ sarvakurūttamas tvaraṃs / tathā yathā śambaram ambarādhipaḥ

vulgate_text: [tataścakramapatattasya bhūmau sa vihvalaḥ samare sūtaputraḥ / savedikaścaitya ivātimātraḥ supuṣpito bhūmitale nimagnaḥ]
ce_text: tataś cakramapatat tasya bhūmau; sa vihvalaḥ samare sūtaputraḥ / ghūrṇe rathe brāhmaṇasyābhiśāpād; rāmād upātte 'pratibhāti cāstre

vulgate_text: magne rathe brāhmaṇaśāpamūḍho hyastraṃ ca taṃ moghamiṣu ca sarpam / amṛṣyamāṇo vyasanāni tāni hastau vidhunvanvijagarha dharmam
ce_text: amṛṣyamāṇo vyasanāni tāni; hastau vidhunvan sa vigarhamāṇaḥ / dharmapradhānān abhipāti dharma; ity abruvan dharmavidaḥ sadaiva / mamāpi nimno 'dya na pāti bhaktān; manye na nityaṃ paripāti dharmaḥ

vulgate_text: dharmapradhānaṃ kila pāti dharma ityabruvandharmavidaḥ sadaiva / vayaṃ ca dharme prayatāma nityaṃ cartuṃ yathāśakti yathāśrutaṃ ca sa cāpi nighnāti na pāti bhaktān manye na nityaṃ paripāti dharmaḥ
ce_text: amṛṣyamāṇo vyasanāni tāni; hastau vidhunvan sa vigarhamāṇaḥ / dharmapradhānān abhipāti dharma; ity abruvan dharmavidaḥ sadaiva / mamāpi nimno 'dya na pāti bhaktān; manye na nityaṃ paripāti dharmaḥ

vulgate_text: sa karṇo'grasadasyāstraṃ kurvanmokṣaṃ mahārathaḥ tato'bravīdvṛṣṇivīrastasminnastre vināśite / visṛjāstraṃ paraṃ pārtha rādheyo grasate śarān
ce_text: tān karṇas tv agrato 'bhyastān moghāṃś cakre mahārathaḥ / tato 'bravīd vṛṣṇivīras tasminn astre vināśite

vulgate_text: tato brahmāstramatyugraṃ sammantrya samayojayat / chādayitvā tato bāṇaiḥ karṇaṃ pratyasyadarjunaḥ
ce_text: visṛjāstraṃ paraṃ pārtha rādheyo grasate śarān / brahmāstram arjunaś cāpi saṃmantryātha prayojayat

vulgate_text: tato jyāṃ vinidhāyānyāmabhimantrya ca pāṇḍavaḥ / śarairavākiratkarṇaṃ dīpyamānairivāhibhiḥ
ce_text: tato jyām avadhāyānyām anumṛjya ca pāṇḍavaḥ / śarair avākirat karṇaṃ dīpyamānaiḥ sahasraśaḥ

vulgate_text: tato'gnisadṛśaṃ ghoraṃ śaraṃ sarpaviṣopamam aśmasāramaṃ divyamabhimantryaṃ parantapaḥ / raudramastraṃ samādhāya kṣeptukāmaḥ kirīṭine
ce_text: tato 'nyam agnisadṛśaṃ śaraṃ sarpaviṣopamam / aśmasāramayaṃ divyam anumantrya dhanaṃjayaḥ

vulgate_text: grastacakrastu rādheyaḥ krodhādaśrūṇyavartayat / arjunaṃ vīkṣya saṃrabdhamidaṃ vacanamabravīt
ce_text: grastacakras tu rādheyaḥ kopād aśrūṇy avartayat / so 'bravīd arjunaṃ cāpi muhūrtaṃ kṣama pāṇḍava

vulgate_text: abāṇe bhraṣṭakavace bhraṣṭabhagnāyudhe tathā / na vimuñcanti śastrāṇi śūrāḥ sādhuvrate sthitāḥ
ce_text: abāṇe bhraṣṭakavace bhraṣṭabhagnāyudhe tathā / na śūrāḥ praharanty ājau na rājñe pārthivās tathā / tvaṃ ca śūro 'si kaunteya tasmāt kṣama muhūrtakam

vulgate_text: tvaṃ hi kṣatriyadāyādo mahālakulavivardhanaḥ / atastvāṃ prabavīmyeṣa muhūrtaṃ kṣama pāṇḍava
ce_text: tvaṃ hi kṣatriyadāyādo mahākulavivardhanaḥ / smṛtvā dharmopadeśaṃ tvaṃ muhūrtaṃ kṣama pāṇḍava

vulgate_text: sañjaya uvāca / athābravīdvāsudevo mahātmā rādheya diṣṭyā smarasīha dharmam / dharme hi baddhā satataṃ hi pārthā-- stebhyastato vṛddhisau dadāti
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tato 'payātāḥ śarapātamātram; avasthitāḥ kuravo bhinnasenāḥ / vidyutprakāśaṃ dadṛśuḥ samantād; dhanaṃjayāstraṃ samudīryamāṇam

vulgate_text: dharmādapetāḥ paripanthinaste tasmādgatā vai kuravo vināśam / prāyeṇa nīcā vyasaneṣu magnā nindanti daivaṃ na tu duṣkṛtaṃ svam
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / athābravīd vāsudevo rathastho; rādheya diṣṭyā smarasīha dharmam / prāyeṇa nīcā vyasaneṣu magnā; nindanti daivaṃ kukṛtaṃ na tat tat

vulgate_text: kṛṣṇāṃ sabhāṃ karṇa yadekavastrā-- mānītavāṃstvaṃ ca suyodhanaśca / duḥśāsanaḥ śakuniḥ saubalaśca dharmastadā te rucito na kasmāt
ce_text: yad draupadīm ekavastrāṃ sabhāyām; ānāyya tvaṃ caiva suyodhanaś ca / duḥśāsanaḥ śakuniḥ saubalaś ca; na te karṇa pratyabhāt tatra dharmaḥ

vulgate_text: yadā sabhāyāṃ rājānamanakṣajñaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram / ānīya jitavanto vai kva te dharmastadā gataḥ
ce_text: yadā sabhāyāṃ kaunteyam anakṣajñaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram / akṣajñaḥ śakunir jetā tadā dharmaḥ kva te gataḥ

vulgate_text: yadanāryaiḥ purā kṛṣṇāṃ kliśyamānāmanāgasam / upaprekṣasi rādheya kva te dharmastadā gataḥ
ce_text: yadā rajasvalāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ duḥśāsanavaśe sthitām / sabhāyāṃ prāhasaḥ karṇa kva te dharmas tadā gataḥ

vulgate_text: nihatya śatrūnsamare pravṛddhā-- nsasomakā rājyamavāpnuyuste / tathā gatā dhārtarāṣṭrā vināśaṃ dharmābhiguptaiḥ satataṃ nṛsiṃhaiḥ] / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tato 'payātāḥ śarapātamātram; avasthitāḥ kuravo bhinnasenāḥ / vidyutprakāśaṃ dadṛśuḥ samantād; dhanaṃjayāstraṃ samudīryamāṇam

vulgate_text: evamuktastu devena krodhamāgāttadā'rjunaḥ / manyumabhyāviśaddhoraṃ smṛtvā tattu dhanañjayaḥ
ce_text: evam ukte tu rādheye vāsudevena pāṇḍavam / manyur abhyāviśat tīvraḥ smṛtvā tat tad dhanaṃjayam

vulgate_text: brahmāstreṇava taṃ pārtho kavarṣa śaravṛṣṭibhiḥ / tadastramastreṇāvārya prajahāra ca pāṇḍavaḥ
ce_text: taṃ samīkṣya tataḥ karṇo brahmāstreṇa dhanaṃjayam / abhyavarṣat punar yatnam akarod rathasarjane / tad astram astreṇāvārya prajahārāsya pāṇḍavaḥ

vulgate_text: chindhyasya mūrdhānamareḥ śareṇa na yāvadārohati vai rathaṃ vṛṣaḥ / tathaiva sampūjya sa tadvacaḥ prabho-- stataḥ śaraṃ prajvalitaṃ pragṛhya jaghāna kakṣāmamalārkavarṇāṃ mahārathe rathacakre vimagne
ce_text: pāṇḍaveyas tv asaṃbhrānto vāyavyāstreṇa vīryavān / apovāha tadābhrāṇi rādheyasya prapaśyataḥ / tataḥ śaraṃ mahāghoraṃ jvalantam iva pāvakam / ādade pāṇḍuputrasya sūtaputro jighāṃsayā / yojyamāne tatas tasmin bāṇe dhanuṣi pūjite / cacāla pṛthivī rājan saśailavanakānanā / vavau saśarkaro vāyur diśaś ca rajasā vṛtāḥ / hāhākāraś ca saṃjajñe surāṇāṃ divi bhārata / tam iṣuṃ saṃdhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā sūtaputreṇa māriṣa / viṣādaṃ paramaṃ jagmuḥ pāṇḍavā dīnacetasaḥ / sa sāyakaḥ karṇabhujapramuktaḥ / śakrāśaniprakhyaruciḥ śitāgraḥ / bhujāntaraṃ prāpya dhanaṃjayasya / viveśa valmīkam ivoragottamaḥ / sa gāḍhaviddhaḥ samare mahātmā / vighūrṇamānaḥ ślathahastagāṇḍivaḥ / cacāla bībhatsur amitramardanaḥ / kṣiteḥ prakampe ca yathācalottamaḥ / tadantaraṃ prāpya vṛṣo mahāratho / rathāṅgam urvīgatam ujjihīrṣuḥ / rathād avaplutya nigṛhya dorbhyāṃ / śaśāka daivān na mahābalo 'pi / tataḥ kirīṭī pratilabhya saṃjñāṃ / jagrāha bāṇaṃ yamadaṇḍakalpam / dīpto 'rjunaḥ prāñjalikaṃ mahātmā / tato 'bravīd vāsudevo 'pi pārtham / chindhy asya mūrdhānam areḥ śareṇa / na yāvad ārohati vai rathaṃ vṛṣaḥ / tathaiva saṃpūjya sa tad vacaḥ prabhos / tataḥ kṣuraṃ prajvalitaṃ pragṛhya / jaghāna kakṣām amalārkavarṇāṃ / mahārathe rathacakre vimagne

vulgate_text: taṃ hastikakṣāpravaraṃ suketuṃ suvarṇamuktāmaṇivajrajuṣṭam / kalāprakṛṣṭottamaśilpiyatnaiḥ kṛtaṃ surūpaṃ tapanīyacitram
ce_text: taṃ hastikakṣyāpravaraṃ ca bāṇaiḥ; suvarṇamuktāmaṇivajramṛṣṭam / kālaprayatnottamaśilpiyatnaiḥ; kṛtaṃ surūpaṃ vitamaskam uccaiḥ

vulgate_text: tatastu taṃ vai śaramaprameyaṃ gāṇḍīvadhanvā dhanuṣi vyayojayat / yuktvā mahāstreṇa pareṇa cāpaṃ vikṛṣya gāṇḍīvamuvāca satvaram
ce_text: yuktvā mahāstreṇa pareṇa mantravid; vikṛṣya gāṇḍīvam uvāca sasvanam / ayaṃ mahāstro 'pratimo dhṛtaḥ śaraḥ; śarīrabhic cāsuharaś ca durhṛdaḥ

vulgate_text: jighāṃsurarkendusamaprabhāvaḥ karṇaṃ vaśī pāṇḍavaḥ kṣiprakārī / tato vimukto balinā maheṣuḥ prajvālayāmāsa nabho diśaśca
ce_text: bruvan kirīṭī tam atiprahṛṣṭo; ayaṃ śaro me vijayāvaho 'stu / jighāṃsur arkendusamaprabhāvaḥ; karṇaṃ samāptiṃ nayatāṃ yamāya

vulgate_text: tato'sya dehaṃ satataṃ sukhaidhitaṃ surūpamatyarthasukhaṃ sugandhi ca / pareṇa kṛcchreṇa śiraḥ samatyaja-- dgṛhaṃ mahardhīnnivasanniveśvaraḥ
ce_text: tad asya dehī satataṃ sukhoditaṃ; svarūpam atyartham udārakarmaṇaḥ / pareṇa kṛcchreṇa śarīram atyajad; gṛhaṃ maharddhīva sasaṅgam īśvaraḥ

vulgate_text: dehācca karṇasya nipātitasya tejaḥ sūryaṃ khaṃ vitatyāviveśa / tadadbhutaṃ sarvamanuṣyayodhāḥ saṃdṛṣṭavanto nihate sma karṇe
ce_text: dehāt tu karṇasya nipātitasya; tejo dīptaṃ khaṃ vigāhyācireṇa / tad adbhutaṃ sarvamanuṣyayodhāḥ; paśyanti rājan nihate sma karṇe

vulgate_text: taṃ somakāḥ prekṣya hataṃ śayānaṃ sainyaiḥ sārdhaṃ siṃhanādānpracakruḥ / tūryāṇi sañjaghnuratīva hṛṣṭā vāsāṃsi caivādudhuvurbhujāṃśca
ce_text: taṃ somakāḥ prekṣya hataṃ śayānaṃ; prītā nādaṃ saha sainyair akurvan / tūryāṇi cājaghnur atīva hṛṣṭā; vāsāṃsi caivādudhuvur bhujāṃś ca / balānvitāś cāpy apare hy anṛtyann; anyonyam āśliṣya nadanta ūcuḥ

vulgate_text: saṃvardhayantaśca narendra yodhāḥ pārthaṃ samājagmuratīva hṛṣṭāḥ / balānvitāścāpare hyapyanṛtya-- nnanyonyamāśliṣya nadanta ūcuḥ
ce_text: taṃ somakāḥ prekṣya hataṃ śayānaṃ; prītā nādaṃ saha sainyair akurvan / tūryāṇi cājaghnur atīva hṛṣṭā; vāsāṃsi caivādudhuvur bhujāṃś ca / balānvitāś cāpy apare hy anṛtyann; anyonyam āśliṣya nadanta ūcuḥ

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvā tu karṇaṃ bhuvi vā vipannaṃ kṛttaṃ rathātsāyakairarjunasya / mahānilenādrimivāpavidvaṃ yajñāvasāne'gnimiva praśāntam
ce_text: dṛṣṭvā tu karṇaṃ bhuvi niṣṭanantaṃ; hataṃ rathāt sāyakenāvabhinnam / mahānilenāgnim ivāpaviddhaṃ; yajñāvasāne śayane niśānte

vulgate_text: uparyupari sainyānāṃ vinighnannitarāñjanān / śiraḥ karṇasya so'tsedhamiṣuḥ sopyaharaddrutam
ce_text: upary upari sainyānāṃ tasya śatros tad añjasā / śiraḥ karṇasya sotsedham iṣuḥ so 'pāharad drutam

vulgate_text: prahṛṣṭavitrastaviṣaṇṇavismitā-- stathā'pare śokasamanvitā'bhavan / pare tvadīyāśca raṇe viśāmpate yathāyatheṣṭaṃ pṛtanā tathā gatā
ce_text: prahṛṣṭavitrastaviṣaṇṇavismṛtās; tathāpare śokagatā ivābhavan / pare tvadīyāś ca paraspareṇa; yathā yathaiṣāṃ prakṛtis tathābhavan

vulgate_text: karṇe hate pārthabhayātpradudruvu-- rvaikartane dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ saśalyāḥ / avekṣamāṇā muhurarjunasya ketuṃ mahāntaṃ yaśasā jvalantam
ce_text: taṃ droṇaputrapramukhā narendrāḥ; sarve samāśvāsya saha prayānti / nirīkṣamāṇā muhur arjunasya; dhvajaṃ mahāntaṃ yaśasā jvalantam

vulgate_text: śalyastu karṇārjunayorvimarde balāni dṛṣṭvā mṛditadhvajāni / yayau sa tenaiva rathena tūrṇaṃ helīkṛtaḥ sṛñjayasomakaiśca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / śalyas tu karṇārjunayor vimarde; balāni dṛṣṭvā mṛditāni bāṇaiḥ / duryodhanaṃ yāntam avekṣamāṇo; saṃdarśayad bhārata yuddhabhūmim

vulgate_text: nipātitasyandanavājināgaṃ balaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā hatasūtaputram / bhīmastu bhīmena tadā svareṇa samunnadadrodasī kampayaṃśca
ce_text: nipātitasyandanavājināgaṃ; dṛṣṭvā balaṃ tad dhatasūtaputram / duryodhano 'śrupratipūrṇanetro; muhur muhur nyaśvasad ārtarūpaḥ

vulgate_text: parasparaṃ kṣatriyā hṛṣṭarūpāḥ sūtātmaje vai nihate tadānīm / duryodhano'śrupratipūrṇanetro dīno muhurniśvasannārtarūpaḥ
ce_text: nipātitasyandanavājināgaṃ; dṛṣṭvā balaṃ tad dhatasūtaputram / duryodhano 'śrupratipūrṇanetro; muhur muhur nyaśvasad ārtarūpaḥ

vulgate_text: madrādhipaścāpi vimūḍhacetā-- stūrṇaṃ dhvajenāpahṛtena tena / rathena duryodhanametya tūrṇaṃ paśyansuduḥkhāttamuvāca rājan
ce_text: madrādhipaś cāpi vimūḍhacetās; tūrṇaṃ rathenāpahṛtadhvajena / duryodhanasyāntikam etya śīghraṃ; saṃbhāṣya duḥkhārtam uvāca vākyam

vulgate_text: kuberavaivasvatavāsavānāṃ tulyaprabhāvā varuṇasya cāpi / vīryeṇa śauryeṇa parākrameṇa taiścāpi yuktā vimalairguṇaughaiḥ
ce_text: kuberavaivasvatavāsavānāṃ; tulyaprabhāvāmbupateś ca vīrāḥ / vīryeṇa śauryeṇa balena caiva; tais taiś ca yuktā vipulair guṇaughaiḥ

vulgate_text: tathā'pavidvairgajavājiyūthai-- rmandāsubhiścāpi gatāsubhiśca / rathaiśca nāgaisturagaiśca nunnai-- rmahī mahāvaitaraṇīva bhāti
ce_text: tathāpaviddhair gajavājiyodhair; mandāsubhiś caiva gatāsubhiś ca / narāśvanāgaiś ca rathaiś ca marditair; mahī mahāvaitaraṇīva durdṛśā

vulgate_text: rathairmaheṣūnmathitaiḥ sukalpitaiḥ sanāgayodhāśvavarāyudhadhvajaiḥ / viśīrṇayoktrairvinikīrṇabandhanai-- rnikṛttacakrākṣayugatriveṇubhiḥ
ce_text: rathair vareṣūn mathitaiś ca yodhaiḥ; saṃsyūtasūtāśvavarāyudhadhvajaiḥ / viśīrṇaśastrair vinikṛttabandhurair; nikṛttacakrākṣayugatriveṇubhiḥ

vulgate_text: vimuktayoktraiśca rathairupaskaraiḥ kṛtābhiṣaṅgairvinibadvakūbaraiḥ / prabhagnanīḍairmaṇihemabhūṣitai-- rvṛtā mahī dyauriva śāradairghanaiḥ
ce_text: vimuktayantrair nihatair ayasmayair; hatānuṣaṅgair viniṣaṅgabandhuraiḥ / prabhagnanīḍair maṇihemamaṇḍitaiḥ; stṛtā mahī dyaur iva śāradair ghanaiḥ

vulgate_text: sahemapṛṣṭhāḥ saparaśvathāyudhāḥ śitāśca śūlā musalāḥ samudgarāḥ / citrāśca khaṅgā vimalāśca kośā gajāśca jāmbūnadapaṭṭanaddhāḥ
ce_text: sahemapaṭṭāḥ parighāḥ paraśvadhāḥ; kaḍaṅgarāyomusalāni paṭṭiśāḥ / petuś ca khaḍgā vimalā vikośā; gadāś ca jāmbūnadapaṭṭabaddhāḥ

vulgate_text: śubhrāṇi vālavyajanāni śaṅkhā-- śchinnāvaruddhā virucaḥ srajaśca / kuthāḥ patākāmbaraveṣṭanāni kirīṭamālā makuṭāśca śubhrāḥ
ce_text: chatrāṇi vālavyajanāni śaṅkhāḥ; srajaś ca puṣpottamahemacitrāḥ / kuthāḥ patākāmbaraveṣṭitāś ca; kirīṭamālā mukuṭāś ca śubhrāḥ

vulgate_text: nivarta duryodhana yāntu sainikā vrajasva rājañśibirāṇi mānada / divākaro'pyeṣa vilambate prabho punastvamevātra narendra kāraṇam / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / athābravīd vāsudevo rathastho; rādheya diṣṭyā smarasīha dharmam / prāyeṇa nīcā vyasaneṣu magnā; nindanti daivaṃ kukṛtaṃ na tat tat

vulgate_text: etāvaduktvā virarāma śalyo duryodhanaṃ caiva nivartayitvā / yuddhāya rājanviniviṣṭabuddhi-- rhā karṇa hā karṇa iti bruvāṇam
ce_text: ity evam uktvā virarāma śalyo; duryodhanaḥ śokaparītacetāḥ / hā karṇa hā karṇa iti bruvāṇa; ārto visaṃjño bhṛśam aśrunetraḥ

vulgate_text: gāṇḍīvamuktaistu suvarṇapuṅkhaiḥ śilāśitaiḥ śoṇitadigdhavājaiḥ / śaraiścitāṅgo'pi rarāja karṇo hato'pi dīptāṃśurivāṃśujālaiḥ
ce_text: gāṇḍīvamuktais tu suvarṇapuṅkhaiḥ; śitaiḥ śaraiḥ śoṇitadigdhavājaiḥ / śaraiś citāṅgo bhuvi bhāti karṇo; hato 'pi san sūrya ivāṃśumālī

vulgate_text: karṇasya dehaṃ rudhirāmbusiktaṃ putrānakumpī bhagavānvivasvān / spṛṣṭvā karāgraiḥ kṣatajānurūpaiḥ snātuṃ tadā'gādaparaṃ samudram
ce_text: karṇasya dehaṃ rudhirāvasiktaṃ; bhaktānukampī bhagavān vivasvān / spṛṣṭvā karair lohitaraktarūpaḥ; siṣṇāsur abhyeti paraṃ samudram

vulgate_text: tadadbhutaṃ prāṇabhṛtāṃ bhayaṅkaraṃ niśāmya yuddhaṃ kuruvīramukhyayoḥ / samācitau karṇaśaraiṛ parantapau tathaiva saṃrejaturacyutārjunau
ce_text: tad adbhutaṃ prāṇabhṛtāṃ bhayaṃkaraṃ; niśamya yuddhaṃ kuruvīramukhyayoḥ / dhanaṃjayasyādhiratheś ca vismitāḥ; praśaṃsamānāḥ prayayus tadā janāḥ

vulgate_text: sukhapraviṣṭau sukhadau virejatuḥ sadasyacintyāviva viṣṇuvāsavau / sadevagandharvamanuṣyacāraṇai-- rmaharṣibhiryakṣamahoragairapi jayābhivṛddhyā parayā'bhipūjitau nihatya karṇaṃ paramāhave tadā
ce_text: sa devagandharvamanuṣyapūjitaṃ; nihatya karṇaṃ ripum āhave 'rjunaḥ / rarāja pārthaḥ parameṇa tejasā; vṛtraṃ nihatyeva sahasralocanaḥ

vulgate_text: alpaṃ ca balameteṣāṃ kṛṣṇau ca bhṛśavikṣatau / adya sarvānhaniṣyāmidhruvo hi vijayo bhavet
ce_text: etad vaco madrapater niśamya; svaṃ cāpanītaṃ manasā nirīkṣya / duryodhano dīnamanā visaṃjñaḥ; punaḥ punar nyaśvasad ārtarūpaḥ / dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / tasmiṃs tu karṇārjunayor vimarde / dagdhasya raudre 'hani vidrutasya / babhūva rūpaṃ kurusṛñjayānāṃ / saṃjaya uvāca / balasya bāṇonmathitasya kīdṛk / śṛṇu rājann avahito yathā vṛtto mahākṣayaḥ / ghoro manuṣyadehānām ājau naravarakṣayaḥ / yatra karṇe hate pārthaḥ siṃhanādam athākarot / tadā tava sutān rājann āviveśa mahad bhayam / na saṃdhātum anīkāni na caivātha parākrame / āsīd buddhir hate karṇe tava yodhasya kasya cit / vaṇijo nāvi bhinnāyām agādhe hy aplavā yathā / apāre pāram icchanto hate dvīpe kirīṭinā / sūtaputre hate rājan vitrastāḥ śaravikṣatāḥ / anāthā nātham icchanto mṛgāḥ siṃhair ivārditāḥ / bhagnaśṛṅgā iva vṛṣā bhagnadaṣṭrā ivoragāḥ / pratyapāyāma sāyāhne nirjitāḥ savyasācinā / hatapravīrā vidhvastā nikṛttā niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ / sūtaputre hate rājan putrās te vyadravan bhayāt / viśastrakavacāḥ sarve kāṃdiśīkā vicetasaḥ / anyonyam avamṛdnanto vīkṣyamāṇā bhayārditāḥ / mām eva tūrṇaṃ bībhatsur mām eva ca vṛkodaraḥ / abhiyātīti manvānāḥ petur mamluś ca saṃbhramāt / hayān anye rathān anye gajān anye mahārathāḥ / āhatya javasaṃpannāḥ pādātāḥ prādravan bhayāt / kuñjaraiḥ syandanāḥ kṣuṇṇāḥ sādinaś ca mahārathaiḥ / padātisaṃghāś cāśvaughaiḥ palāyadbhir bhayārditāḥ / vyālataskarasaṃkīrṇe sārthahīnā yathā vane / tathā tvadīyā nihate sūtaputre tadābhavan / hatārohās tathā nāgāś chinnahastās tathā narāḥ / sarvaṃ pārthamayaṃ lokaṃ saṃpaśyanto bhayāturāḥ / tān prekṣya dravataḥ sarvān bhīmasenabhayārditān / duryodhano 'tha svaṃ sūtaṃ vāhety uktvedam abravīt / nātikramiṣyate pārtho dhanuṣpāṇir vyavasthitaḥ / jaghanya eva sainyānāṃ śanair aśvān acodayat / jaghanye yudhyamānaṃ hi kaunteyo māṃ na saṃśayaḥ / notsaheta vyatikrāntuṃ velām iva mahodadhiḥ / adyārjunaṃ sagovindaṃ māninaṃ ca vṛkodaram / nihatya śiṣṭāñ śatrūṃś ca karṇasyānṛṇyam āpnuyām / tac chrutvā kururājasya śūrārthasadṛśaṃ vacaḥ / sūto hemaparicchannāñ śanair aśvān acodayat / rathāśvagajahīnās tu pādātās tava māriṣa / pañcaviṃśatisāhasrā yuddhāyaiva vyavasthitāḥ / tān bhīmasenaḥ saṃkruddho dhṛṣṭadyumnaś ca pārṣataḥ / balena caturaṅgeṇa parikṣipya nijaghnatuḥ / pratyayudhyanta te sarve bhīmasenaṃ sapārṣatam / pārthapārṣatayoś cānye jagṛhus tatra nāmanī / akrudhyata tadā bhīmas tai raṇe pratyupasthitaiḥ / so 'vatīrya rathāt tūrṇaṃ gadāpāṇir ayudhyata / na tān rathastho bhūmiṣṭhān dharmāpekṣī vṛkodaraḥ / yodhayām āsa kaunteyo bhujavīryam upāśritaḥ / jātarūpaparicchannāṃ pragṛhya mahatīṃ gadām / avadhīt tāvakān sarvān daṇḍapāṇir ivāntakaḥ / padātino 'pi saṃrabdhās tyaktvā jīvitam ātmanaḥ / bhīmam abhyadravan saṃkhye pataṃgā iva pāvakam / āsādya bhīmasenaṃ tu saṃrabdhā yuddhadurmadāḥ / vineśuḥ sahasā dṛṣṭvā bhūtagrāmā ivāntakam / śyenavad vyacarad bhīmo gadāhasto mahābalaḥ / pañcaviṃśatisāhasrāṃs tāvakānām apothayat / hatvā tat puruṣānīkaṃ bhīmaḥ satyaparākramaḥ / dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ puraskṛtya punas tasthau mahābalaḥ / dhṛṣṭadyumno 'pi ca mahān amitragaṇamardanaḥ / putraḥ pāñcālarājasya dhanurdharavaro yudhi / vipralīnān rathāśvena padātīyān samantataḥ / pañcaviṃśatisāhasrān avadhīn niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ / śarair nikṛttāḥ samare dhṛṣṭadyumnena tāvakāḥ / pañcaviṃśatisāhasrāḥ kālam ārchan padātayaḥ / hatvā tat puruṣānīkaṃ dhṛṣṭadyumno mahābalaḥ / bhīmasenaṃ puraskṛtya na cirāt pratyadṛśyata / taṃ pārāvatavarṇāśvaṃ kruddhaṃ kruddhāntakopamam / dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ raṇe dṛṣṭvā tvadīyāḥ prādravan bhayāt / dhanaṃjayo rathānīkam abhyavartata vīryavān / mādrīputrau tu śakuniṃ sātyakiś ca mahārathaḥ / javenābhyapatan hṛṣṭā nighnantaḥ saubalaṃ balam / tasyāśvavārān subahūn vinihatya śitaiḥ śaraiḥ / tam abhyadhāvaṃs tvaritās tato yuddham abhūt tadā / dhanaṃjayo 'pi cābhyetya rathānīkaṃ tava prabho / viśrutaṃ triṣu lokeṣu vyākṣipad gāṇḍivaṃ dhanuḥ / kṛṣṇasārathim āyāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā śvetahayaṃ ratham / arjunaṃ cāpi yoddhāraṃ tvadīyāḥ prādravan bhayāt / viprahīnā rathāśvena gajaiś ca parivarjitāḥ / pañcaviṃśatisāhasrāḥ kālam ārchan padātayaḥ / hatvā tat puruṣānīkaṃ pāñcālānāṃ mahārathaḥ / putraḥ pāñcālarājasya dhṛṣṭadyumno mahārathaḥ / bhīmasenaṃ puraskṛtya na cirāt pratyadṛśyata / mahādhanurdharaḥ śrīmān amitragaṇasūdanaḥ / pārāvatasavarṇāśvaṃ kovidāramahādhvajam / dhṛṣṭadyumnarathaṃ dṛṣṭvā prādravanta bhayād bhṛśam / gāndhārarājaṃ śīghrāstram anusṛtya yaśasvinau / na cirāt pratyadṛśyetāṃ mādrīputrau sasātyakī / cekitānaḥ śikhaṇḍī ca draupadeyāś ca māriṣa / hatvā tvadīyaṃ sumahat sainyaṃ śaṅkhān athādhaman / te sarve tāvakān prekṣya dravamāṇān parāṅmukhān / abhyadravañ jighāṃsanto vṛṣāñ jitvā yathā vṛṣāḥ / senāvaśeṣaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā tava sainyaṃ parāṅmukham / vyavasthitaṃ savyasācī cukrodha balavat tadā / dhanaṃjayo rathānīkam abhyavartata vīryavān / viśrutaṃ triṣu lokeṣu vyākṣipad gāṇḍivaṃ dhanuḥ / tata etāñ śarai rājan sahasrān samavārayan / rajasā coddhatenātha na sma kiṃ cid vyadṛśyata / anyakārīkṛte loke śarabhūte mahītale / diśaḥ sarvā mahārāja tāvakāḥ prādravan bhayāt / bhajyamāneṣu sainyeṣu kururājo viśāṃ pate / parān abhimukhāṃś caiva sutas te samupādravat / tato duryodhanaḥ sarvān ājuhāvātha pāṇḍavān / yuddhāya bharataśreṣṭha devān iva purā baliḥ / ta enam abhivartanta sahitāḥ samupādravan / nānāśastrasṛjaḥ sarve bhartsayanto muhur muhuḥ / duryodhano 'py asaṃbhrāntas tān arīn niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ / vyadhamad yudhi rājendra ghorarūpo viśāṃ pate / tatrādbhutam apaśyāma tava putrasya pauruṣam / yad enaṃ pāṇḍavāḥ sarve na śekur ativartitum / nātidūrāpayātaṃ tu kṛtabuddhiṃ palāyane / duryodhanaḥ svakaṃ sainyam apaśyac charavikṣatam / tato 'vasthāpya rājendra kṛtabuddhis tavātmajaḥ / harṣayann iva tān yodhān idaṃ vacanam abravīt / na taṃ deśaṃ prapaśyāmi pṛthivyāṃ parvateṣu ca / yatra yātān na vo hanyuḥ pāṇḍavāḥ kiṃ sṛtena vaḥ / alpaṃ ca balam eteṣāṃ kṛṣṇau ca bhṛśavikṣatau / yadi sarve 'tra tiṣṭhāmo dhruvo no vijayo bhavet / viprayātāṃś ca no bhinnān pāṇḍavāḥ kṛtakilbiṣāḥ / anusṛtya vadhiṣyanti śreyān naḥ samare vadhaḥ / sukhaṃ sāṃgrāmiko mṛtyuḥ kṣatradharmeṇa yudhyatām / mṛto duḥkhaṃ na jānīte pretya cānantyam aśnute / śṛṇudhvaṃ kṣatriyāḥ sarve yāvantaḥ stha samāgatāḥ / yadā śūraṃ ca bhīruṃ ca mārayaty antako yamaḥ / ko nu mūḍho na yudhyeta mādṛśaḥ kṣatriyavrataḥ / dviṣato bhīmasenasya kruddhasya vaśam eṣyatha / pitāmahair ācaritaṃ na dharmaṃ hātum arhatha / na hi dharmo 'sti pāpīyān kṣatriyasya palāyanāt / na yuddhadharmāc chreyo 'nyaḥ panthāḥ svargasya kauravāḥ / acireṇa hatā lokaṃ sarve yodhāḥ samāpnuta / evaṃ bruvati te putre sainikā bhṛśavikṣatāḥ / anavekṣyaiva tad vākyaṃ prādravan sarvatomukham

vulgate_text: na yuddhadharmācchreyo hi panthāḥ svargasya kauravāḥ / acireṇa hatā lokānsadyo yodhāḥ samaśnuta / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / athābravīd vāsudevo rathastho; rādheya diṣṭyā smarasīha dharmam / prāyeṇa nīcā vyasaneṣu magnā; nindanti daivaṃ kukṛtaṃ na tat tat

vulgate_text: sañjaya uvāca / śarasaṅkṛttavarmāṇaṃ rudhirokṣitavakṣasam / gatāsumapi rādheyaṃ naiva lakṣmīrvimuñcati
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / athābravīd vāsudevo rathastho; rādheya diṣṭyā smarasīha dharmam / prāyeṇa nīcā vyasaneṣu magnā; nindanti daivaṃ kukṛtaṃ na tat tat

vulgate_text: āhṛtya sa yaśo dīptaṃ suyuddhenātmano bhuvi / saputraḥ samare karṇaḥ praśāntaḥ pārthatejasā
ce_text: kanakottamasaṃkāśaḥ pradīpta iva pāvakaḥ / saputraḥ puruṣavyāghraḥ saṃśāntaḥ pārthatejasā / pratāpya pāṇḍavān rājan pāñcālāṃś cāstratejasā

vulgate_text: varṣitvā śaravarṣāṇi pratāpya ripuvāhinīm śrīmāniva sahasrāṃśurjvalansarvānpratāpya ca / hato vaikartanaḥ karṇaḥ pādapo'ṅkuravāniva
ce_text: nānābharaṇavān rājan mṛṣṭajāmbūnadāṅgadaḥ / hato vaikartanaḥ śete pādapo 'ṅkuravān iva

vulgate_text: yamāśrityākarodvairaṃ sutaste sa gato divam / ādāya tava putrāṇāṃ jayāśāṃ sarma varma ca
ce_text: sadā nṝṇāṃ priyo dātā priyadāno divaṃ gataḥ / ādāya tava putrāṇāṃ jayāśāṃ śarma varma ca

vulgate_text: nabhaścacālātha nanāda corvī vavuśca vātāḥ paruṣāśca ghorāḥ / diśo babhūvurjvalitāḥ sadhūmā mahārṇavāḥ sasvanuścukṣubhuśca
ce_text: nabhaḥ paphālātha nanāda corvī; vavuś ca vātāḥ paruṣātivelam / diśaḥ sadhūmāś ca bhṛśaṃ prajajvalur; mahārṇavāś cukṣubhire ca sasvanāḥ

vulgate_text: sakānanāścādrivarāścakampire pravivyathurbhūtagaṇāśca māriṣa / bṛhaspatiḥ samparivārya rohiṇīṃ babhūva candrārkasamo viśāmpate
ce_text: sakānanāḥ sādricayāś cakampuḥ; pravivyathur bhūtagaṇāś ca māriṣa / bṛhaspatī rohiṇīṃ saṃprapīḍya; babhūva candrārkasamānavarṇaḥ

vulgate_text: śaśiprakāśānanamarjuno yadā jahāra karṇasya śiraḥ śareṇa / tato'ntarikṣe sahasaiva śabdo babhūva hāheti surairvimuktaḥ
ce_text: śaśiprakāśānanam arjuno yadā; kṣureṇa karṇasya śiro nyapātayat / athāntarikṣe divi ceha cāsakṛd; babhūva hāheti janasya nisvanaḥ

vulgate_text: patākinā bhīmaninādaketunā rathena śaṅkhasphaṭikāvabhāsinā / mahendravāhapratimena tāvubhau mahendravīryapratimānapauruṣau
ce_text: tato rathenāmbudavṛndanādinā; śarannabhomadhyagabhāskaratviṣā / patākinā bhīmaninādaketunā; himenduśaṅkhasphaṭikāvabhāsinā / suvarṇamuktāmaṇivajravidrumair; alaṃkṛtenāpratimānaraṃhasā

vulgate_text: suvarṇamuktāmaṇivajravidrumai-- ralaṅkṛtenāpratimena raṃhasā / narottamau yādavapāṇḍunandanau divākarau dīptahutāśanāviva raṇājire vītabhayau virejatuḥ samānayogāviva viṣṇuvāsavaiḥ
ce_text: narottamau pāṇḍavakeśimardanāv; udāhitāv agnidivākaropamau / raṇājire vītabhayau virejatuḥ; samānayānāv iva viṣṇuvāsavau

vulgate_text: tato rathenāmbudabṛndanādinā śaradvaharmadhyadivākaratviṣā / dhanañjayasyādhiratheśca vismitāḥ praśaṃsamānāḥ prayayustadā'rjunam
ce_text: tad adbhutaṃ prāṇabhṛtāṃ bhayaṃkaraṃ; niśamya yuddhaṃ kuruvīramukhyayoḥ / dhanaṃjayasyādhiratheś ca vismitāḥ; praśaṃsamānāḥ prayayus tadā janāḥ

vulgate_text: tato mahāravaṃ cakruryodhā rājansamantataḥ / vāryamāṇā bhṛśodvignāstava putreṇa bhārata
ce_text: sadevagandharvamanuṣyacāraṇair; maharṣibhir yakṣamahoragair api / jayābhivṛddhyā parayābhipūjitau; nihatya karṇaṃ paramāhave tadā / saṃjaya uvāca / hate vaikartane karṇe kuravo bhayapīḍitāḥ / vīkṣamāṇā diśaḥ sarvāḥ palāyante sma sarvataḥ / vīraṃ tu nihataṃ śrutvā śatrubhiḥ paramāhave / sarve diśo 'nvakīryanta tāvakā bhayamohitāḥ / tato 'vahāraṃ cakrus te rājan yodhāḥ samantataḥ / vāryamāṇā bhayodvignās tava putreṇa bhārata / teṣāṃ tu matam ājñāya putras te bharatarṣabha / avahāraṃ tataś cakre śalyasyānumate nṛpa / yodhair mahārathaiḥ sārdhaṃ vṛto bhārata tāvakaiḥ / hatāvaśeṣais tvaritaḥ śibirāyaiva dudruve / gāndhārāṇāṃ sahasreṇa śakuniḥ parivāritaḥ / hatam ādhirathiṃ dṛṣṭvā śibirāyaiva dudruve / kṛpaḥ śāradvato rājan nāgānīkena saṃvṛtaḥ / mahatā meghakalpena śibirāyaiva dudruve / aśvatthāmā tataḥ śūro viniḥśvasya muhur muhuḥ / pāṇḍavānāṃ jayaṃ dṛṣṭvā śibirāyaiva dudruve / saṃśaptakāvaśeṣeṇa balena mahatā vṛtaḥ / suśarmāpi yayau rājan vīkṣamāṇo bhayāturān / duryodhano 'pi nṛpatir hatasarvasva āturaḥ / yayau śokasamāviṣṭaś cintayan vimanā bahu / chinnadhvajena śalyas tu rathena rathināṃ varaḥ / prayayau śibirāyaiva vīkṣamāṇo diśo daśa / tato 'pare subahavo bhāratānāṃ mahārathāḥ / prādravanta raṇaṃ hitvā bhayāviṣṭā vicetasaḥ / aśrukaṇṭhā bhayodvignā vepamānāḥ suvihvalāḥ / kuravaḥ pradrutāḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā karṇaṃ nipātitam / praśaṃsanto 'rjunaṃ ke cit ke cit karṇaṃ mahārathāḥ / vyadravanta diśo bhītāḥ kuravaḥ kurusattama / teṣāṃ yodhasahasrāṇāṃ tāvakānāṃ mahāmṛdhe / nāsīt tatra pumān kaś cid yo yuddhāya mano dadhe / hate karṇe mahārāja nirāśāḥ kuravo 'bhavan / jīviteṣv atha rājyeṣu dāreṣu ca dhaneṣu ca / tān samānīya putras te yatnena mahatā vibho / niveśāya mano dadhre duḥkhaśokasamanvitaḥ / tasyājñāṃ śirasā te 'pi pratigṛhya viśāṃ pate / vivarṇavadanā dīnā nyaviśanta mahārathāḥ

vulgate_text: dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ śikhaṇḍī ca pāṇḍavānāṃ ca ye rathāḥ / vardhayante sma rājānaṃ nihate sūtanandane

ce_text: āsthāya puruṣavyāghraḥ svabalenābhisaṃvṛtaḥ / kṛṣṇārjunābhyāṃ vīrābhyām anumanya tataḥ priyam

vulgate_text: adya rājā'smi sarvasyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ madhusūdana / diṣṭyā jayasi govinda diṣṭyāśatrurnipātitaḥ

vulgate_text: evaṃ subahuśo rājanpraśaśaṃsa janārdanam / arjunaṃ ca kuruśreṣṭho dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
ce_text: evaṃ sa bahuśo hṛṣṭaḥ praśaśaṃsa janārdanam / arjunaṃ cāpi rājendra dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ

vulgate_text: sametya ca kuruśreṣṭhaṃ kuntīputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram / vardhayanti sma rājāno harṣayuktā mahārathāḥ / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / śalyas tu karṇārjunayor vimarde; balāni dṛṣṭvā mṛditāni bāṇaiḥ / duryodhanaṃ yāntam avekṣamāṇo; saṃdarśayad bhārata yuddhabhūmim

vulgate_text: evameṣa kṣayo vṛttaḥ sumahānromaharṣaṇaḥ / tava durmantrite rājandiṣṭyā tvamanuśocasi / vaiśampāyana uvāca

vulgate_text: tatastūrṇaṃ tu vidurastaṃ nṛpaṃ sañjayastathā / paryāśvāsayatāṃ caitāvubhāveva tu bhūmipam

vulgate_text: sa daivaṃ paramaṃ mene bhavitavyaṃ ca bhārata / tābhyāmāśvāsito rājā tūṣṇīmāste viśāmpate
ce_text: tathaivotthāpayām āsur gāndhārīṃ rājayoṣitaḥ / tābhyām āśvāsito rājā tūṣṇīm āsīd vicetanaḥ

vulgate_text: śrīvedavyāsāya namaḥ / nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam / devīṃ sarasvatīṃ caiva tato jayamudīrayet / janamejaya uvāca
ce_text: janamejaya uvāca / evaṃ nipātite karṇe samare savyasācinā / alpāvaśiṣṭāḥ kuravaḥ kim akurvata vai dvija

vulgate_text: sa samāśvāsyamāno'pi hetubhiḥ śāstraniścitaiḥ / rājanvibhūtimicchadbhiḥ sūtaputramanusmaran
ce_text: sa samāśvāsyamāno 'pi hetubhiḥ śāstraniścitaiḥ / rājabhir nālabhac charma sūtaputravadhaṃ smaran

vulgate_text: sa daivaṃ balavanmatvā prabhāte vimale sati / saṅgrāme niścayaṃ kṛtvā punaryudvāya niryayau
ce_text: sa daivaṃ balavan matvā bhavitavyaṃ ca pārthivaḥ / saṃgrāme niścayaṃ kṛtvā punar yuddhāya niryayau

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvaiva ca narāñśīghraṃ vyājahārātiduḥkhitaḥ / aho bata vipanno'smi nidhanena mahātmanaḥ
ce_text: ruroda ca naravyāghra hā rājann iti duḥkhitaḥ / aho bata vivignāḥ sma nidhanena mahātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: ete śeṣā mahārāja rathino nṛpasattama / akṣauhiṇīnāmaṣṭānāṃ daśānāṃ ca na saṃśayaḥ
ce_text: tavāpy ete mahārāja rathino nṛpasattama / akṣauhiṇīnāṃ sarvāsāṃ sametānāṃ janeśvara / ete śeṣā mahārāja sarve 'nye nidhanaṃ gatāḥ

vulgate_text: ete śeṣā mahārāja sarve'nye nidhanaṃ gatāḥ kālena nihataṃ sarvaṃ jagadvai bharatarṣabha / duryodhanaṃ vai purataḥ kṛtvā sarve narā hatāḥ / vaiśampāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tataḥ karṇe hate rājan dhārtarāṣṭraḥ suyodhanaḥ / bhṛśaṃ śokārṇave magno nirāśaḥ sarvato 'bhavat

vulgate_text: tato narapatistatra labdhvā saṃjñāṃ parantapaḥ gatirme ko bhavedadya iti cintāsamākulaḥ / apṛcchatsañjayaṃ tatra rodamānaṃ bhṛśāturam
ce_text: tato narapatiṃ tatra labdhasaṃjñaṃ paraṃtapa / avekṣya saṃjayo dīno rodamānaṃ bhṛśāturam

vulgate_text: rājānaṃ śocamānastu taṃ śocantaṃ muhurmuhuḥ / samāśvāsayata kṣattā vacasā madhureṇa ca

vulgate_text: sadhūmamiva niḥśvasya karau dhunvanpunaḥpunaḥ / bahu sañcintayitvā tu sañjayaṃ vākyamabravīt / dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / visṛṣṭāsv atha nārīṣu dhṛtarāṣṭro 'mbikāsutaḥ / vilalāpa mahārāja duḥkhād duḥkhataraṃ gataḥ

vulgate_text: ete cānye ca bahavo rājāno rājasattama / madarthaṃ prahariṣyanti prāṇāṃstyaktvā dhanāni ca
ce_text: ete cānye ca bahavo rājāno rājasattama / madartham udyatāḥ sarve prāṇāṃs tyaktvā raṇe prabho

vulgate_text: karṇaśca nihataḥ saṅkhye divyāstrajño mahābalaḥ bhūriśravā hato patra somadattaśca saṃyuge / bāhlikaśca mahārāja kimanyadbhāgadheyataḥ
ce_text: bhūriśravā hato yatra somadattaś ca saṃyuge / bāhlīkaś ca mahārāja kim anyad bhāgadheyataḥ

vulgate_text: bhagadatto hato yatra gajayuddhaviśāradaḥ / jayadrathaśca nihataḥ kimanyadbhāgadheyataḥ
ce_text: bhūriśravā hato yatra somadattaś ca saṃyuge / bāhlīkaś ca mahārāja kim anyad bhāgadheyataḥ

vulgate_text: mahābalastathā pāṇḍyaḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / nihataḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ saṅkhye kimanyadbhāgadheyataḥ
ce_text: droṇaś ca brāhmaṇo yatra sarvaśastrāstrapāragaḥ / nihataḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ saṃkhye kim anyad bhāgadheyataḥ

vulgate_text: bṛhadbalo hato yatra māgadhaśca mahābalaḥ / ugrāyudhaśca vikrāntaḥ pratimānaṃ dhanuṣmatām
ce_text: bṛhadbalo hato yatra māgadhaś ca mahābalaḥ / āvantyo nihato yatra trigartaś ca janādhipaḥ / saṃśaptakāś ca bahavaḥ kim anyad bhāgadheyataḥ

vulgate_text: nihate sūtaputre ca phalgunena mahātmanā / vidruteṣu ca sainyeṣu samānīteṣu cāsakṛt
ce_text: nihate sūtaputre tu pāṇḍavena mahātmanā / vidruteṣu ca sainyeṣu samānīteṣu cāsakṛt / ghore manuṣyadehānām ājau gajavarakṣaye / yat tat karṇe hate pārthaḥ siṃhanādam athākarot / tadā tava sutān rājan prāviśat sumahad bhayam / na saṃdhātum anīkāni na caivātha parākrame / āsīd buddhir hate karṇe tava yodhasya kasya cit / vaṇijo nāvi bhinnāyām agādhe viplavā iva / apāre pāram icchanto hate dvīpe kirīṭinā / sūtaputre hate rājan vitrastāḥ śaravikṣatāḥ / anāthā nātham icchanto mṛgāḥ siṃhārditā iva / bhagnaśṛṅgā iva vṛṣāḥ śīrṇadaṃṣṭrā ivoragāḥ / pratyupāyāma sāyāhne nirjitāḥ savyasācinā / hatapravīrā vidhvastā nikṛttā niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ / sūtaputre hate rājan putrās te prādravan bhayāt / viśastrakavacāḥ sarve kāṃdiśīkā vicetasaḥ / anyonyam abhinighnanto vīkṣamāṇā bhayārditāḥ / mām eva nūnaṃ bībhatsur mām eva ca vṛkodaraḥ / abhiyātīti manvānāḥ petur mamluś ca bhārata / hayān anye gajān anye rathān anye mahārathāḥ / āruhya javasaṃpannān pādātān prajahur bhayāt / kuñjaraiḥ syandanā bhagnāḥ sādinaś ca mahārathaiḥ / padātisaṃghāś cāśvaughaiḥ palāyadbhir bhṛśaṃ hatāḥ / vyālataskarasaṃkīrṇe sārthahīnā yathā vane / tathā tvadīyā nihate sūtaputre tadābhavan / hatārohās tathā nāgāś chinnahastās tathāpare / sarvaṃ pārthamayaṃ lokam apaśyan vai bhayārditāḥ / tān prekṣya dravataḥ sarvān bhīmasenabhayārditān / duryodhano 'tha svaṃ sūtaṃ hāhākṛtvedam abravīt / nātikramiṣyate pārtho dhanuṣpāṇim avasthitam / jaghane yudhyamānaṃ māṃ tūrṇam aśvān pracodaya / samare yudhyamānaṃ hi kaunteyo māṃ dhanaṃjayaḥ / notsahetābhyatikrāntuṃ velām iva mahārṇavaḥ / adyārjunaṃ sagovindaṃ māninaṃ ca vṛkodaram / nihatya śiṣṭāñ śatrūṃś ca karṇasyānṛṇyam āpnuyām / tac chrutvā kururājasya śūrāryasadṛśaṃ vacaḥ / sūto hemaparicchannāñ śanair aśvān acodayat / gajāśvarathahīnās tu pādātāś caiva māriṣa / pañcaviṃśatisāhasrāḥ prādravañ śanakair iva / tān bhīmasenaḥ saṃkruddho dhṛṣṭadyumnaś ca pārṣataḥ / balena caturaṅgeṇa parikṣipyāhanac charaiḥ / pratyayudhyanta te sarve bhīmasenaṃ sapārṣatam / pārthapārṣatayoś cānye jagṛhus tatra nāmanī / akrudhyata raṇe bhīmas tair mṛdhe pratyavasthitaiḥ / so 'vatīrya rathāt tūrṇaṃ gadāpāṇir ayudhyata / na tān rathastho bhūmiṣṭhān dharmāpekṣī vṛkodaraḥ / yodhayām āsa kaunteyo bhujavīryaṃ samāśritaḥ / jātarūpaparicchannāṃ pragṛhya mahatīṃ gadām / nyavadhīt tāvakān sarvān daṇḍapāṇir ivāntakaḥ / padātayo hi saṃrabdhās tyaktajīvitabāndhavāḥ / bhīmam abhyadravan saṃkhye pataṃgā jvalanaṃ yathā / āsādya bhīmasenaṃ te saṃrabdhā yuddhadurmadāḥ / vineśuḥ sahasā dṛṣṭvā bhūtagrāmā ivāntakam / śyenavad vyacarad bhīmaḥ khaḍgena gadayā tathā / pañcaviṃśatisāhasrāṃs tāvakānām apothayat / hatvā tat puruṣānīkaṃ bhīmaḥ satyaparākramaḥ / dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ puraskṛtya punas tasthau mahābalaḥ / dhanaṃjayo rathānīkam anvapadyata vīryavān / mādrīputrau ca śakuniṃ sātyakiś ca mahābalaḥ / javenābhyapatan hṛṣṭā ghnanto dauryodhanaṃ balam / tasyāśvavārān subahūṃs te nihatya śitaiḥ śaraiḥ / tam anvadhāvaṃs tvaritās tatra yuddham avartata / tato dhanaṃjayo rājan rathānīkam agāhata / viśrutaṃ triṣu lokeṣu gāṇḍīvaṃ vyākṣipan dhanuḥ / kṛṣṇasārathim āyāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā śvetahayaṃ ratham / arjunaṃ cāpi yoddhāraṃ tvadīyāḥ prādravan bhayāt / viprahīnarathāśvāś ca śaraiś ca parivāritāḥ / pañcaviṃśatisāhasrāḥ pārtham ārchan padātayaḥ / hatvā tat puruṣānīkaṃ pāñcālānāṃ mahārathaḥ / bhīmasenaṃ puraskṛtya na cirāt pratyadṛśyata / mahādhanurdharaḥ śrīmān amitragaṇamardanaḥ / putraḥ pāñcālarājasya dhṛṣṭadyumno mahāyaśāḥ / pārāvatasavarṇāśvaṃ kovidāravaradhvajam / dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ raṇe dṛṣṭvā tvadīyāḥ prādravan bhayāt / gāndhārarājaṃ śīghrāstram anusṛtya yaśasvinau / nacirāt pratyadṛśyetāṃ mādrīputrau sasātyakī / cekitānaḥ śikhaṇḍī ca draupadeyāś ca māriṣa / hatvā tvadīyaṃ sumahat sainyaṃ śaṅkhān athādhaman / te sarve tāvakān prekṣya dravato vai parāṅmukhān / abhyadhāvanta nighnanto vṛṣāñ jitvā vṛṣā iva / senāvaśeṣaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā tava putrasya pāṇḍavaḥ / vyavasthitaṃ savyasācī cukrodha balavan nṛpa / tata enaṃ śarai rājan sahasā samavākirat / rajasā codgatenātha na sma kiṃ cana dṛśyate / andhakārīkṛte loke śarībhūte mahītale / diśaḥ sarvā mahārāja tāvakāḥ prādravan bhayāt / bhajyamāneṣu sainyeṣu kururājo viśāṃ pate / pareṣām ātmanaś caiva samantāt samupādravat / tato duryodhanaḥ sarvān ājuhāvātha pāṇḍavān / yuddhāya bharataśreṣṭha devān iva purā baliḥ / ta enam abhigarjantaṃ sahitāḥ samupādravan / nānāśastrasṛjaḥ kruddhā bhartsayanto muhur muhuḥ / duryodhano 'py asaṃbhrāntas tān arīn vyadhamac charaiḥ / tatrādbhutam apaśyāma tava putrasya pauruṣam / yad enaṃ pāṇḍavāḥ sarve na śekur ativartitum / nātidūrāpayātaṃ tu kṛtabuddhiṃ palāyane / duryodhanaḥ svakaṃ sainyam apaśyad bhṛśavikṣatam / tato 'vasthāpya rājendra kṛtabuddhis tavātmajaḥ / harṣayann iva tān yodhān idaṃ vacanam abravīt / na taṃ deśaṃ prapaśyāmi pṛthivyāṃ parvateṣu ca / yatra yātān na vo hanyuḥ pāṇḍavāḥ kiṃ sṛtena vaḥ / svalpaṃ caiva balaṃ teṣāṃ kṛṣṇau ca bhṛśavikṣatau / yadi sarve 'tra tiṣṭhāmo dhruvo no vijayo bhavet / viprayātāṃs tu vo bhinnān pāṇḍavāḥ kṛtakilbiṣān / anusṛtya haniṣyanti śreyo naḥ samare vadhaḥ / sukhaḥ sāṃgrāmiko mṛtyuḥ kṣatradharmeṇa yudhyataḥ / mṛto duḥkhaṃ na jānīte pretya cānantyam aśnute / śṛṇvantu kṣatriyāḥ sarve yāvanto vai samāgatāḥ / dviṣato bhīmasenasya kruddhasya vaśam eṣy atha / pitāmahair ācaritaṃ na dharmaṃ hātum arhatha / na hi karmāsti pāpīyaḥ kṣatriyasya palāyanāt / na yuddhadharmāc chreyān hi panthāḥ svargasya kauravāḥ / sucireṇārjitāṃl lokān sadyo yodhaḥ samaśnute / tasya tad vacanaṃ rājñaḥ pūjayitvā mahārathāḥ / punar evābhyavartanta kṣatriyāḥ pāṇḍavān prati / parājayam amṛṣyantaḥ kṛtacittāś ca vikrame / tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ punar eva sudāruṇam / tāvakānāṃ pareṣāṃ ca devāsuraraṇopamam / yudhiṣṭhirapurogāṃś ca sarvasainyena pāṇḍavān / anvadhāvan mahārāja putro duryodhanas tava

vulgate_text: kṛpāviṣṭaḥ kṛpo dṛṣṭvā vayaḥ śīlasamanvitaḥ abravīttatra tejasvī so'bhisṛtya janādhipam / duryodhanamanukrośādvākyaṃ vākyaviśāradaḥ
ce_text: abravīt tatra tejasvī so 'bhisṛtya janādhipam / duryodhanaṃ manyuvaśād vacanaṃ vacanakṣamaḥ

vulgate_text: vāyuneva vidhūtāni eva sainyāni gacchatā / śaradambhodajālāni viśīryante samantataḥ
ce_text: vāyuneva vidhūtāni tavānīkāni sarvaśaḥ / śaradambhodajālāni vyaśīryanta samantataḥ

vulgate_text: bhṛtyā me subhṛtāstāta dīnaścābhyudvṛto janaḥ / notsāhe'dya dvijaśreṣṭha pāṇḍavānvaktumīdṛśam
ce_text: bhṛtyā me subhṛtās tāta dīnaś cābhyuddhṛto janaḥ / yātāni pararāṣṭrāṇi svarāṣṭram anupālitam

vulgate_text: pitṝṇāṃ gatamānṛṇyaṃ kṣatradharmasya cobhayoḥ na dhruvaṃ sukhamastīha kuto rāṣṭraṃ kuto yaśaḥ / iha kīrtirvicetavyā sā ca yudvena nānyathā
ce_text: na dhruvaṃ sukham astīha kuto rājyaṃ kuto yaśaḥ / iha kīrtir vidhātavyā sā ca yuddhena nānyathā

vulgate_text: bhṛtyā me subhṛtāstāta dīnaścābhyṛdbhṛto janaḥ / notsahe'dya dvijaśreṣṭha pāṇḍavānvaktumīdṛśam
ce_text: bhṛtyā me subhṛtās tāta dīnaś cābhyuddhṛto janaḥ / yātāni pararāṣṭrāṇi svarāṣṭram anupālitam

vulgate_text: jitāni pararāṣṭrāṇi svarāṣṭramanupālitam bhuktāśca vividhā bhogāstrivargaḥ sevito mayā ==
ce_text: bhuktāś ca vividhā bhogās trivargaḥ sevito mayā / pitṝṇāṃ gatam ānṛṇyaṃ kṣatradharmasya cobhayoḥ

vulgate_text: sa tvameko hi loke'sminnānyastvattaḥ pumānbhavet / madrarājaṃ raṇe kruddhaṃ yo hanyātkurunandana
ce_text: sadevaloke kṛtsne 'smin nānyas tvattaḥ pumān bhavet / madrarājaṃ raṇe kruddhaṃ yo hanyāt kurunandana / ahany ahani yudhyantaṃ kṣobhayantaṃ balaṃ tava

vulgate_text: tasminhate hataṃ sarvaṃ dhārtarāṣṭrabalaṃ mahat etacchrutvā mahārāja vacanaṃ mama sāmpratam
ce_text: tavaiva hi jayo nūnaṃ hate madreśvare yudhi / tasmin hate hataṃ sarvaṃ dhārtarāṣṭrabalaṃ mahat

vulgate_text: vāditrāṇāṃ ca ninadaḥ prādurāsīdviśāmpate / yodhānāṃ sainyamukhyānāmanyonyaṃ pratigarjatām
ce_text: vāditrāṇāṃ ca ninadaḥ prādurāsīd viśāṃ pate / bodhanārthaṃ hi yodhānāṃ sainyānāṃ cāpy udīryatām

vulgate_text: adyācāryasuto drauṇirnaiko yudhyeta śatrubhiḥ / na na ekena yoddhavyaṃ kathañcidapi pāṇḍavaiḥ
ce_text: anye ca pārthivāḥ śeṣāḥ samayaṃ cakrire tadā / na na ekena yoddhavyaṃ kathaṃ cid api pāṇḍavaiḥ

vulgate_text: dhanvinaḥ puruṣāḥ kecitparivārya mahārathān / ekaṃ bahava āsādya praiṣayanyamasādanam
ce_text: dhanvinaḥ puruṣāḥ ke cit saṃnivārya mahārathān / ekaṃ bahava āsādya preṣayeyur yamakṣayam

vulgate_text: vadhyamānā camūḥ sā tu putrāṇāṃ prekṣatāṃ tava / bheje daśa diśo rājanpraṇunnā śaravṛṣṭibhiḥ
ce_text: vadhyamānā camūḥ sā tu putrāṇāṃ prekṣatāṃ tava / bheje diśo mahārāja praṇunnā dṛḍhadhanvibhiḥ / hāhākāro mahāñ jajñe yodhānāṃ tava bhārata

vulgate_text: tāvabhyetya mahābāhū dvāvapyatimahārathau / śarauṣānsamyagasyantau jīmūtau salilaṃ yathā
ce_text: tāv abhyadhāvatāṃ tīkṣṇau dvāv apy enaṃ mahāratham / śaraughān samyag asyantau jīmūtau salilaṃ yathā

vulgate_text: sā tasya hṛdayaṃ gatyā vibheda śatadhā nṛpa / sa pavāta rathādbhūmiṃ yatasatvo'lpattetanaḥ
ce_text: sā tasya hṛdayaṃ saṃkhye bibheda śatadhā nṛpa / sa papāta rathād bhūmau gatasattvo 'lpacetanaḥ

vulgate_text: ḷḷḷḷḷḷ vyavasyāpya ca vāhinīm / ḷḷḷḷḷḷḷ bhūśaṃ kṛtvā dhanuḥśabdaṃ ca dāruṇam
ce_text: vibhīs tasthau mahārāja vyavasthāpya ca vāhinīm / siṃhanādaṃ bhṛśaṃ kṛtvā dhanuḥśabdaṃ ca dāruṇam

vulgate_text: ḷḷḷḷḷḷ sagare rājanrāṃkṣetā dṛḍhadhanvanā / pratyudyayuśca tāṃste tu samantādvigatavyathāḥ
ce_text: tāvakāḥ samare rājan rakṣitā dṛḍhadhanvanā / pratyudyayur arātīṃs te samantād vigatavyathāḥ

vulgate_text: abhyaghnatkauravo rājā pāṇḍavānāmanīkinīm / śalyastu śaravarṣeṇa varṣanniva sahasradṛk
ce_text: śalyas tu śaravarṣeṇa varṣann iva sahasradṛk / abhyavarṣad adīnātmā kuntīputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram

vulgate_text: [punaśca bhīmasenasya jaghānāśvāṃstathā''have / so'vatīrya rathāttūrṇaṃ hatāśvaḥ pāṇḍunandanaḥ
ce_text: ṛśyavarṇāñ jaghānāśvān bhojo bhīmasya saṃyuge / so 'vatīrya rathopasthād dhatāśvaḥ pāṇḍunandanaḥ / kālo daṇḍam ivodyamya gadāpāṇir ayudhyata

vulgate_text: dantairiva mahānāgau śṛṅgairiva maharṣabhau / tau virejaturanyonyaṃ gadāgrābhyāṃ parikṣatau
ce_text: dantair iva mahānāgau śṛṅgair iva maharṣabhau / tottrair iva tadānyonyaṃ gadāgrābhyāṃ nijaghnatuḥ

vulgate_text: abhyudyatagadau vīrau saśṛṅgāviva parvatau / tāvājaghnaturanyonyaṃ maṇḍalāni viceratuḥ
ce_text: athodyamya gade ghore saśṛṅgāv iva parvatau / tāv ājaghnatur anyonyaṃ yathā bhūmicale 'calau

vulgate_text: yugapatpetaturvīrāvubhāvindrabalī iva / ubhayaḥ senayoryodhāstadā hāhākṛtābhavan
ce_text: tau parasparavegāc ca gadābhyāṃ ca bhṛśāhatau / yugapat petatur vīrāv ubhāv indradhvajāv iva

vulgate_text: tānāpatata evāśu pañcānāṃ vai bhujacyutān / vārayāmāsa samare śastrasaṅghaiḥ sa madrarāṭ
ce_text: tān āpatata evāśu pañcānāṃ vai bhujacyutān / sātyakiprahitaṃ śalyo bhallaiś ciccheda tomaram

vulgate_text: sātyakiprahitaṃ śalyo bhallaiściccheda tomaram / prahitaṃ bhīmasenena śaraṃ kanakabhūṣaṇam
ce_text: tān āpatata evāśu pañcānāṃ vai bhujacyutān / sātyakiprahitaṃ śalyo bhallaiś ciccheda tomaram

vulgate_text: ahaṃ maddhātaraścaiva sātyakiśca mahārathaḥ / pāñcālāḥ sṛñjayāścaiva na śaktāsma hi madrapam
ce_text: nakulaḥ sahadevaś ca sātyakiś ca mahārathaḥ / parivārya tadā śalyaṃ samantād vyakirañ śaraiḥ

vulgate_text: drauṇiṃ vivyādha samare tribhireva śilīmukhaiḥ tathetarānmaheṣvāsāndvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ dhanañjayaḥ / bhūyaścaiva mahārāja śaravarṣairavākirat
ce_text: tathetarān maheṣvāsān dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ dhanaṃjayaḥ / bhūyaś caiva mahābāhuḥ śaravarṣair avākirat

vulgate_text: arjunaṃ rathavaṃśena droṇaputrapurogamāḥ / parivārya mudā yuktā yodhayantaścakāśire
ce_text: te 'rjunaṃ rathavaṃśena droṇaputrapurogamāḥ / ayodhayanta samare parivārya mahārathāḥ

vulgate_text: tathā kṛṣṇau maheṣvāsau vṛṣabhau sarvadhanvinām / vivyadhuśca śarairghoraiḥ prahṛṣṭā yuddhadurmadāḥ
ce_text: tathā kṛṣṇau maheṣvāsau vṛṣabhau sarvadhanvinām / śarair vīkṣya vitunnāṅgau prahṛṣṭau yuddhadurmadau

vulgate_text: vyaśvasūtarathaṃ cakre savyasācī parantapaḥ / mṛdupūrvaṃ tataścainaṃ punaḥpunaratāḍayat
ce_text: vyaśvasūtarathaṃ cakre savyasācī mahārathaḥ / mṛdupūrvaṃ tataś cainaṃ tribhir vivyādha sāyakaiḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ sa patito bhūmau nārācena samāhataḥ / vajreṇa ca yathā śṛṅgaṃ parvatasyeva dīryataḥ
ce_text: tatas taṃ patitaṃ bhūmau nārācena samāhatam / vajreṇeva yathā śṛṅgaṃ parvatasya mahādhanam

vulgate_text: te vadhyamānāḥ samare pāṇḍavā nāvatasthire / kṣaṇenaiva mahārāja paśyatoḥ kṛṣṇapārthayoḥ
ce_text: te vadhyamānāḥ kurubhiḥ pāṇḍavā nāvatasthire / nivāryamāṇā bhīmena paśyatoḥ kṛṣṇapārthayoḥ

vulgate_text: dīvyamānau mahātmānau prāṇadyūtena durmadau / dṛṣṭvā sarvāṇi sainyāni nādhyavasyaṃstayorjayam
ce_text: dṛṣṭvā sarvāṇi sainyāni nādhyavasyaṃs tayor jayam / hatvā madrādhipaṃ pārtho bhokṣyate 'dya vasuṃdharām

vulgate_text: tāṃstānanyānmaheṣvāsānsāśvānsarathakūbarān / ardayāmāsa viśikhairulkābhiriva kuñjarān
ce_text: tāṃs tān anyān maheṣvāsān sāśvān sarathakuñjarān / kuñjarān kuñjarārohān aśvān aśvaprayāyinaḥ / rathāṃś ca rathibhiḥ sārdhaṃ jaghāna rathināṃ varaḥ

vulgate_text: adya jānāti bībhatsuṃ samarthaṃ svadhanvinām / adyātmānaṃ ca durmedhā garhayiṣyati pāpakṛt
ce_text: adya jānātu kaunteyaṃ samarthaṃ sarvadhanvinām / adyātmānaṃ ca durmedhā garhayiṣyati pāpakṛt / adya kṣattur vacaḥ satyaṃ smaratāṃ bruvato hitam

vulgate_text: attrāṇāṃ ca balaṃ sarvaṃ bāhvośca balamāhave / putrāṇāṃ ca vadhaṃ ghoraṃ bhīmena śroṣyate nṛpaḥ
ce_text: astrāṇāṃ ca balaṃ sarvaṃ bāhvoś ca balam āhave / adya jñāsyati bhīmasya balaṃ ghoraṃ mahātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: siṃhanādāṃśca samudbhūtaṃ paśya cainaṃ samantataḥ / tasmādyāhi śanaiḥ sūta jaghanaṃ paripālaya
ce_text: siṃhanādāṃś ca bahuśaḥ śṛṇu ghorān bhayānakān / tasmād yāhi śanaiḥ sūta jaghanaṃ paripālaya

vulgate_text: yudhyataḥ kṣatradharmeṇa mṛtyureṣa sanātanaḥ / hatveha sukhamāpnoti hataḥ pretya mahatphalam
ce_text: śreyo no bhīmasenasya kruddhasya pramukhe sthitam / sukhaḥ sāṃgrāmiko mṛtyuḥ kṣatradharmeṇa yudhyatām / jitveha sukham āpnoti hataḥ pretya mahat phalam

vulgate_text: sañjarā uvāca / sannivṛtteṣu sainyeṣu sālvo mlecchagaṇādhipaḥ / abhyadravatsusaṅkruddhaḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ mahadbalam
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / pātite yudhi durdharṣe madrarāje mahārathe / tāvakās tava putrāś ca prāyaśo vimukhābhavan

vulgate_text: airāvataṃ daityagaṇānvimṛdra-- ñśakro yathā sañjanayanbhayāni / tamāsthito rājavaro babhūva yathodayasthaḥ savitā kṣapānte
ce_text: tam āsthito rājavaro babhūva; yathodayasthaḥ savitā kṣapānte / sa tena nāgapravareṇa rājann; abhyudyayau pāṇḍusutān samantāt / śitaiḥ pṛṣatkair vidadāra cāpi; mahendravajrapratimaiḥ sughoraiḥ

vulgate_text: trāsayantau diśaḥ sarvā jyākṣepakaṭhinatvacau / śakunistu raṇe vīro yudhiṣṭhiramapīḍayat
ce_text: śakunis tu raṇe vīro yudhiṣṭhiram apīḍayat / tasyāśvāṃś caturo hatvā subalasya suto vibhuḥ / nādaṃ cakāra balavān sarvasainyāni kampayan

vulgate_text: varmaṇāṃ tatra rājendra vyadṛśyantojjvalāḥ prabhāḥ śabdaśca tumulaḥ saṅkhye śarāṇāṃ patatāmabhūt / mahāveṇuvanasyeva dahyamānasya parvate
ce_text: śabdaḥ sutumulaḥ saṃkhye śarāṇāṃ patatām abhūt / mahāveṇuvanasyeva dahyamānasya sarvataḥ

vulgate_text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā dharmarājānaṃ kauraveyaistathāvṛtam / nāmṛṣyanta susaṃrabdhāḥ śikhaṇḍipramukhā rathāḥ
ce_text: nāmṛṣyanta susaṃrabdhāḥ śikhaṇḍipramukhā rathāḥ / rathair agryajavair yuktaiḥ kiṅkiṇījālasaṃvṛtaiḥ / ājagmur abhirakṣantaḥ kuntīputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram

vulgate_text: śiro gṛhītvā keśeṣu kabandhaḥ sa pradṛśyate / udyamya ca śitaṃ khaṅgaṃ rudhireṇa pariplutam
ce_text: śiro gṛhītvā keśeṣu kabandhaḥ samadṛśyata / udyamya niśitaṃ khaḍgaṃ rudhireṇa samukṣitam

vulgate_text: sañjaya uvāca / alpāvaśiṣṭe sainye tu pāṇḍavairnihate bale / aśvaiḥ saptasahasraistu upāvartata saubalaḥ
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / vartamāne tathā yuddhe ghorarūpe bhayānake / abhajyata balaṃ tatra tava putrasya pāṇḍavaiḥ

vulgate_text: sa yātvā vāhinīṃ tūrṇaṃ codayānaḥ svakānyudhi / yudhyadhvamiti saṃhṛṣṭāḥ punaḥpunararindamāḥ
ce_text: sa yātvā vāhinīṃ tūrṇam abravīt tvarayan yudhi / yudhyadhvam iti saṃhṛṣṭāḥ punaḥ punar ariṃdamaḥ / apṛcchat kṣatriyāṃs tatra kva nu rājā mahārathaḥ

vulgate_text: badvanistriṃśahastāśca pragṛhītaśarāsanāḥ / śarāsanāni dhūnvānāḥ siṃhanādānpracakrire
ce_text: sarve vivṛtatūṇīrāḥ pragṛhītaśarāsanāḥ / śarāsanāni dhunvānāḥ siṃhanādaṃ pracakrire

vulgate_text: hate bhīṣme dhīrmamāsīcchamaḥ syāditi mādhava / na ca tatkṛtavānmūḍho dhārtarāṣṭraḥ subāliśaḥ
ce_text: hate bhīṣme ca saṃdadhyāc chivaṃ syād iha mādhava / na ca tat kṛtavān mūḍho dhārtarāṣṭraḥ subāliśaḥ

vulgate_text: hatapravīrāṃ vidhvastāṃ dṛṣṭvā cemāṃ camūṃ raṇe / alambale ca nihate naiva śāmyati vaiśasam
ce_text: bhagadatte hate śūre kāmboje ca sudakṣiṇe / duḥśāsane ca nihate naivāśāmyata vaiśasam

vulgate_text: bhrātṝnvinihatāndṛṣṭvā vayasyānmātulānapi / putrānvinihatāndṛṣṭvā naiva śāmyati vaiśasam
ce_text: dṛṣṭvā ca nihatāñ śūrān pṛthaṅ māṇḍalikān nṛpān / balinaś ca raṇe kṛṣṇa naivāśāmyata vaiśasam

vulgate_text: tasmādyāhi camūṃ vīra yāvadvanmi śitaiḥ śaraiḥ / duryodhanaṃ mahābāho vāhinīṃ cāsya saṃyuge
ce_text: saṃyāhi bhāratīṃ vīra yāvad dhanmi śitaiḥ śaraiḥ / duryodhanaṃ durātmānaṃ vāhinīṃ cāsya saṃyuge

vulgate_text: te dahyamānāḥ pārthena pāvakeneva kuñjarāḥ / pārthaṃ na prājahurghārā vadhyamānāḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
ce_text: te dahyamānāḥ pārthena pāvakeneva kuñjarāḥ / samāsīdanta kauravyā vadhyamānāḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ patantaṃ samare abhivīkṣya sutaṃ tava / bhallena pātayāmāsa bhīmo durvipahaṃ raṇe
ce_text: tato yatantam aparam abhivīkṣya sutaṃ tava / bhallena yudhi vivyādha bhīmo durviṣahaṃ raṇe / sa papāta hato vāhāt paśyatāṃ sarvadhanvinām

vulgate_text: tayostatra śitairguktairyamadaṇḍanibhaiḥ śaraiḥ / samācchakādhārā sarvā tvaṃ diśo vidiśastathā
ce_text: tayos tatra śarair muktair yamadaṇḍanibhaiḥ śubhaiḥ / samācchannā dharā sarvā khaṃ ca sarvā diśas tathā

vulgate_text: śakṛniśca mahārāja bhīmaṃ viddhvā tribhiḥ śaraiḥ / navatyā niśitairbāṇaiḥ sahadevamavākirat
ce_text: śakunis tu mahārāja bhīmaṃ viddhvā tribhiḥ śaraiḥ / sāyakānāṃ navatyā vai sahadevam avākirat

vulgate_text: ṛṣṭibhiḥ śaktibhiścaiva sāsiprāsaparaśvathaiḥ / sañchannā pṛthivī jajñe kusumaiḥ śabalā iva
ce_text: nihatānāṃ hayānāṃ ca sahaiva hayayodhibhiḥ / varmabhir vinikṛttaiś ca prāsaiś chinnaiś ca māriṣa / saṃchannā pṛthivī jajñe kusumaiḥ śabalā iva

vulgate_text: kṣatradharme sthiro bhūtvā yudhyasva puruṣo bhava yattadā bhāṣase mūḍha gṛhṇannakṣānsabhātale / phalamadya prapadyasva karmaṇastasya durmate
ce_text: yat tadā hṛṣyase mūḍha glahann akṣaiḥ sabhātale / phalam adya prapadyasva karmaṇas tasya durmate

vulgate_text: etanme pṛcchato brūhi kuśalo hyasi sañjaya yacca duryodhano mānī kṛtavāṃstanayo mama / valakṣayaṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā sa ekaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tasmin pravṛtte saṃgrāme naravājigajakṣaye / śakuniḥ saubalo rājan sahadevaṃ samabhyayāt

vulgate_text: taṃ hadaṃ vipulaṃ prekṣya karuṇaṃ paryadevayat aho dhiksa na jānāti jīvato'smānnarādhipa / paryāptā hi vayaṃ tena saha yodhayituṃ parān
ce_text: aho dhiṅ na sa jānāti jīvato 'smān narādhipaḥ / paryāptā hi vayaṃ tena saha yodhayituṃ parān

vulgate_text: vidrutāni ca sarvāṇi śibirādvai samantataḥ / [itastataḥ palāyante hatanāthā hataujasaḥ
ce_text: aham eko vimuktas tu bhāgyayogād yadṛcchayā / vidrutāni ca sarvāṇi śibirāṇi samantataḥ

vulgate_text: yudhiṣṭhiramanujñāya vāsūdevaṃ tathaiva ca / etamarthaṃ mahābāhurubhayoḥ sannyavedayat
ce_text: prāptakālam ahaṃ manye praveśaṃ taiḥ sahābhibho / yudhiṣṭhiram anujñāpya bhīmasenaṃ tathaiva ca

vulgate_text: diṣṭyā kurukṣaye vṛtte asmiṃstvaṃ putra jīvasi vinā rājñaḥ parveśārdvai kimasi tvamihāgataḥ / etadvai kāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ vistareṇa nivedaya / yuyutsuruvāca
ce_text: vinā rājñaḥ praveśād vai kim asi tvam ihāgataḥ / etan me kāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ vistareṇa nivedaya

vulgate_text: prāptakālamidaṃ sarvaṃ bruvatā bharatakṣaye / [rakṣitaḥ kuladharmaśca sānukrośatayā tvayā
ce_text: prāptakālam idaṃ sarvaṃ bhavato bharatakṣaye / adya tvam iha viśrāntaḥ śvo 'bhigantā yudhiṣṭhiram

vulgate_text: adya tvamiha viśrāntaḥ śvo'bhigantā yudhiṣṭhiram etāvaduktvā vacanaṃ viduraḥ sāśrulocanaḥ / yuyutsuṃ samanujñāpya praviveśa nṛpakṣayam
ce_text: etāvad uktvā vacanaṃ viduraḥ sarvadharmavit / yuyutsuṃ samanujñāpya praviveśa nṛpakṣayam / yuyutsur api tāṃ rātriṃ svagṛhe nyavasat tadā

vulgate_text: yuyutsurapi tāṃ rātriṃ svagṛhe nyavasattadā vandyamānaḥ svakaiścāpi nābhyanandatsuduḥkhitaḥ / cintayānaḥ kṣayaṃ tīvraṃ bharatānāṃ parasparam
ce_text: etāvad uktvā vacanaṃ viduraḥ sarvadharmavit / yuyutsuṃ samanujñāpya praviveśa nṛpakṣayam / yuyutsur api tāṃ rātriṃ svagṛhe nyavasat tadā

vulgate_text: sañjaya uvāca / muhūrtādiva rājendra sarvaṃ śūnyamadṛśyata / mattavāraṇasaṃghuṣṭaṃ śibiraṃ vidrute bale
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tataḥ kruddhā mahārāja saubalasya padānugāḥ / tyaktvā jīvitam ākrande pāṇḍavān paryavārayan

vulgate_text: yatra śabdena mahatā nānvabudhyanmahārathāḥ / tatra śabdaṃ na śṛṇumo manuṣyasyāpi kasyacit / dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / nihate māmake sainye niḥśeṣe śibire kṛte / pāṇḍavānāṃ balaṃ sūta kiṃ nu śeṣam abhūt tadā / etan me pṛcchato brūhi kuśalo hy asi saṃjaya

vulgate_text: yadā duryodhano yuddhaṃ tyaktvā padbhyāṃ parākramamat / taṃ hadaṃ prāviśaccāpi viṣṭabhyāpaḥ svamāyayā
ce_text: sa hi tīvreṇa vegena gadāpāṇir apākramat / taṃ hradaṃ prāviśac cāpi viṣṭabhyāpaḥ svamāyayā

vulgate_text: siṃhanādāṃstataścakruḥ kṣveḍāśca bharatarṣabha / tvaritāḥ kṣatriyā rājannudakrośanparasparam
ce_text: siṃhanādāṃs tataś cakruḥ kṣveḍāṃś ca bharatarṣabha / tvaritāḥ kṣatriyā rājañ jagmur dvaipāyanaṃ hradam

vulgate_text: nikṛtyā nikṛtiprajño na me jīvanvimokṣyate yadyasya samare sāhyaṃ kurute vajrabhṛtsvayam / tathāpyenaṃ hataṃ yuddhe lokā drakṣyanti mādhava / vāsudeva uvāca
ce_text: yady asya samare sāhyaṃ kurute vajrabhṛt svayam / tathāpy enaṃ hataṃ yuddhe loko drakṣyati mādhava

vulgate_text: vṛtraśca nihato rājankriyayaiva mahābalaḥ tathā paulastyatanayo rāvaṇo nāma rākṣasaḥ / rāmeṇa nihato rājansānubandhaḥ sahānugaḥ
ce_text: tathā paulastyatanayo rāvaṇo nāma rākṣasaḥ / rāmeṇa nihato rājan sānubandhaḥ sahānugaḥ / kriyayā yogam āsthāya tathā tvam api vikrama

vulgate_text: eṣa te paramo dharmaḥ sṛṣṭo dhātrā mahātmanā / taṃ kuruṣva yathātathyaṃ pauruṣe sva vyavasthitaḥ / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / saṃprādravatsu dāreṣu kṣatriyāṇāṃ mahātmanām / vidrute śibire śūnye bhṛśodvignās trayo rathāḥ

vulgate_text: duryodhanaṃ tava sutaṃ salilasthaṃ mahāyaśāḥ śrutvā tu karuṇaṃ vākyamabhāṣata yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ] / yudhiṣṭhira uvāca
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca / āśvastā eva sarve sma ciraṃ tvāṃ mṛgayāmahe / tad idānīṃ samuttiṣṭha yudhyasveha suyodhana

vulgate_text: jīvitaṃ tvayi duṣprāpaṃ mayi yatparivartate / jīvayeyamahaṃ kāmaṃ na tu tvaṃ jīvituṃ kṣamaḥ
ce_text: jīvitaṃ tava duṣprajña mayi saṃprati vartate / jīvayeyaṃ tv ahaṃ kāmaṃ na tu tvaṃ jīvituṃ kṣamaḥ

vulgate_text: apriyāṇāṃ ca vacanairdraupadyāḥ karṣaṇena ca / etasmātkāraṇātpāpa jīvitaṃ na vidyate
ce_text: etasmāt kāraṇāt pāpa jīvitaṃ te na vidyate / uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha yudhyasva tat te śreyo bhaviṣyati

vulgate_text: yamābhyāṃ yuyudhānādvā ye cānye tava sainikāḥ / ekaḥ sarvānahaṃ kruddho vārayiṣye yudhi sthitaḥ
ce_text: yamābhyāṃ yuyudhānād vā ye cānye tava sainikāḥ / ekaḥ sarvān ahaṃ kruddho na tān yoddhum ihotsahe

vulgate_text: ahamutthāya sarvānvai pratiyotsyāmi saṃyuge / anvabhyāśaṃ gatānsarvānnihaniṣyāmi bhārata
ce_text: aham utthāya vaḥ sarvān pratiyotsyāmi saṃyuge / anvaṃśābhyāgatān sarvān ṛtūn saṃvatsaro yathā

vulgate_text: etāvaduktvā vacanaṃ virarāma janādhipaḥ salilāntargataḥ śrīmānputro duryodhanastava / yudhiṣṭhira uvāca
ce_text: ānṛṇyam adya gacchāmi hatvā tvāṃ bhrātṛbhiḥ saha / etāvad uktvā vacanaṃ virarāma janādhipaḥ

vulgate_text: ekaścedyodbhumākrande varo'dya mama dīyatām / āyudhānāmiyaṃ cāpi matā me sataṃ gadā
ce_text: duryodhana uvāca / ekaś ced yoddhum ākrande varo 'dya mama dīyate / āyudhānām iyaṃ cāpi vṛtā tvatsaṃmate gadā

vulgate_text: [avaśyameva yodvavyaṃ sarvaireva mayā saha / yuktaṃ tvayuktamityetadvetsi tvaṃ caiva sarvadā] / yudhiṣṭhira uvāca
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca / āśvastā eva sarve sma ciraṃ tvāṃ mṛgayāmahe / tad idānīṃ samuttiṣṭha yudhyasveha suyodhana

vulgate_text: asminmahūrte satyaṃ vā mithyā vai tadbhaviṣyati ] gṛhṇātu ca gadāṃ yo vai yotsyate'dya mayā saha
ce_text: gadāyuddhe na me kaś cit sadṛśo 'stīti cintaya / gadayā vo haniṣyāmi sarvān eva samāgatān / gṛhṇātu sa gadāṃ yo vai yudhyate 'dya mayā saha

vulgate_text: ko'nu sarvānvinirjitya śatrūnekena vairiṇā [kṛcchraprāptena ca tathā hārayedrājyamāgatam ] / pātitaścaikabāṇena śocayedevamāhave
ce_text: ko nu sarvān vinirjitya śatrūn ekena vairiṇā / paṇitvā caikapāṇena rocayed evam āhavam

vulgate_text: na hi paśyāmi taṃ loke yo'dya duryodhanaṃ raṇe / gadāhastaṃ vijetuṃ vai śaktaḥ syādamaropi hi
ce_text: na hi paśyāmi taṃ loke gadāhastaṃ narottamam / yudhyed duryodhanaṃ saṃkhye kṛtitvād dhi viśeṣayet

vulgate_text: draupadī ca parāmṛṣṭā samāmadhye rajasvalā / dyūte ca vañcito rājā śakūnerbuddhilāghavāt
ce_text: draupadī ca parikliṣṭā sabhāmadhye rajasvalā / dyūte yad vijito rājā śakuner buddhiniścayāt

vulgate_text: pūjayitvā tataḥ paścādidaṃ vacanamabruvan / śiṣyayoḥ kauśalaṃ yuddhe paśya rāmeti pārthiva
ce_text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā paramaprītāḥ pūjayitvā narādhipāḥ / śiṣyayoḥ kauśalaṃ yuddhe paśya rāmeti cābruvan

vulgate_text: śamaṃ prati mahābāho hitārthaṃ sarvadehinām sa gatvā hāstinapuraṃ dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ sametya ca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / upaplavye niviṣṭeṣu pāṇḍaveṣu mahātmasu / preṣito dhṛtarāṣṭrasya samīpaṃ madhusūdanaḥ / śamaṃ prati mahābāho hitārthaṃ sarvadehinām

vulgate_text: tataḥ pratyāgataḥ kṛṣṇo dhārtarāṣṭravisarjitaḥ ājagāma naravyāghraḥ pāṇḍavānāmanīkinīm / yathoktaṃ ca yathāvṛttaṃ gatvā pāṇḍavamabravīt
ce_text: tataḥ pratyāgataḥ kṛṣṇo dhārtarāṣṭravisarjitaḥ / akriyāyāṃ naravyāghra pāṇḍavān idam abravīt

vulgate_text: sarasvatyāḥ pratisrotaḥ samudrādabhijagmivāna / rāmo yadūttamaḥ śrīmāṃstīrthayātrāmanusmaran
ce_text: evaṃ saṃdiśya tu preṣyān baladevo mahābalaḥ / tīrthayātrāṃ yayau rājan kurūṇāṃ vaiśase tadā / sarasvatīṃ pratisrotaḥ samudrād abhijagmivān

vulgate_text: śrāntānāṃ klāntabapuṣāṃ śiśūnāṃ vipulāyuṣām / deśedeśe tu deyāni dānāni vividhāni ca
ce_text: śrāntānāṃ klāntavapuṣāṃ śiśūnāṃ vipulāyuṣām / tāni yānāni deśeṣu pratīkṣyante sma bhārata / bubhukṣitānām arthāya kḷptam annaṃ samantataḥ

vulgate_text: arcāyai cārthināṃ rājanklṛptāni bahuśastathā / tāni yānīha deśeṣu pratīkṣanti sma bhārata
ce_text: śrāntānāṃ klāntavapuṣāṃ śiśūnāṃ vipulāyuṣām / tāni yānāni deśeṣu pratīkṣyante sma bhārata / bubhukṣitānām arthāya kḷptam annaṃ samantataḥ

vulgate_text: yatra yaḥ svapate vipro yo vā jāgarti bhārata / tatratatraiva sarvasya klṛptaṃ sarvamapaśyata
ce_text: yatra yaḥ svapate vipraḥ kṣatriyo vāpi bhārata / tatra tatra tu tasyaiva sarvaṃ kḷptam adṛśyata

vulgate_text: tatastāḥ kupitāḥ sarvā nakṣatrākhyā mahātmanaḥ / tā gatvā pitaraṃ prāhuḥ prajāpatimatandritāḥ
ce_text: tā gatvā pitaraṃ prāhuḥ prajāpatim atandritāḥ / somo vasati nāsmāsu rohiṇīṃ bhajate sadā

vulgate_text: rohiṇyāmeva bhagavānsadā vasati candramāḥ / na tvadvaco gaṇayati nāsmāsu snehamicchati
ce_text: rohiṇyām eva bhagavan sadā vasati candramāḥ / tasmān nas trāhi sarvā vai yathā naḥ soma āviśet

vulgate_text: kūpe kathaṃ ca hitvainaṃ bhrātarau jagmaturgṛhān kathaṃ ca yājayāmāsa papau somaṃ ca vai katham / etadācakṣva me brahmanśrotavyaṃ yadi manyase / vaiśampāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / upaplavye niviṣṭeṣu pāṇḍaveṣu mahātmasu / preṣito dhṛtarāṣṭrasya samīpaṃ madhusūdanaḥ / śamaṃ prati mahābāho hitārthaṃ sarvadehinām

vulgate_text: tathā sarve mahābhāgā munayaḥ puṇyalakṣaṇāḥ / apūjayanmahābhāgaṃ yathāsya pitaraṃ tathā
ce_text: taṃ sma sarve mahābhāgā munayaḥ puṇyalakṣaṇāḥ / apūjayan mahābhāgaṃ tathā vidvattayaiva tu

vulgate_text: cakruścaivaṃ tathā rājanbhrātarastraya eva ca yathā te tu parikramya yājyānsarvānpaśūnprati / yājayitvā tato yājyām̐llabdhvā tu subahūnpaśūn
ce_text: tathā tu te parikramya yājyān sarvān paśūn prati / yājayitvā tato yājyāṃl labdhvā ca subahūn paśūn

vulgate_text: tayościntā samabhavadekatasya dvitasya ca / kathaṃ ca syurimā gāva āvābhyāṃ hi vinā tritam
ce_text: tayoś cintā samabhavad dṛṣṭvā paśugaṇaṃ mahat / kathaṃ na syur imā gāva āvābhyāṃ vai vinā tritam

vulgate_text: tato hyacintayatprājño mṛtabhūto hyasomapaḥ / somaḥ kathaṃ tu pātavya ihasthena mayā bhavet
ce_text: buddhyā hy agaṇayat prājño mṛtyor bhīto hy asomapaḥ / somaḥ kathaṃ nu pātavya ihasthena mayā bhavet

vulgate_text: somasyābhiṣavasyāgre pravṛttastumulo dhvaniḥ / sa cāviśaddivaṃ rājansvaraścaiva tritasta vai
ce_text: sa cāviśad divaṃ rājan svaraḥ śaikṣas tritasya vai / samavāpa ca taṃ yajñaṃ yathoktaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ

vulgate_text: ṛṣiṇāṃ hi sahasrāṇi tatra nityaṃ caturdaśa yatra devāḥ samāgamya vāsukiṃ pannagottamam / sarvapannagarājānamabhyaṣiñcanyathāvidhi
ce_text: yatra devāḥ samāgamya vāsukiṃ pannagottamam / sarvapannagarājānam abhyaṣiñcan yathāvidhi / pannagebhyo bhayaṃ tatra vidyate na sma kaurava

vulgate_text: dattvā vasu dvijāgryebhyo nirjagāma mahābalaḥ / tatrasthānṛṣisaṅghāṃstānabhivādya halāyudhaḥ
ce_text: tatrasthān ṛṣisaṃghāṃs tān abhivādya halāyudhaḥ / tato rāmo 'gamat tīrtham ṛṣibhiḥ sevitaṃ mahat

vulgate_text: kasmiṃścitkāraṇe tatra vismito yadunandanaḥ / nivṛttā hetunā kena kathameva saridvarā / vaiśampāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tasmān nadīgataṃ cāpi udapānaṃ yaśasvinaḥ / tritasya ca mahārāja jagāmātha halāyudhaḥ

vulgate_text: tato yajñopavītaiḥ svaistatra kṛtvā sarasvatīm / juhuvuścāgnihotrāṃśca cakruśca vividhāḥ kriyāḥ
ce_text: tato yajñopavītais te tat tīrthaṃ nirmimāya vai / juhuvuś cāgnihotrāṇi cakruś ca vividhāḥ kriyāḥ

vulgate_text: bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ kaca vividhaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradāya ca / tataḥ prāyādbalo rājanpūjyamāno dvijātibhiḥ
ce_text: tataḥ prāyād balo rājan pūjyamāno dvijātibhiḥ / sarasvatītīrthavaraṃ nānādvijagaṇāyutam

vulgate_text: sarasvatītīrthavaraṃ nānādvijagaṇāyutam / badareṅgudaśyāmākāplukṣāśvatthabibhītakaiḥ
ce_text: tataḥ prāyād balo rājan pūjyamāno dvijātibhiḥ / sarasvatītīrthavaraṃ nānādvijagaṇāyutam

vulgate_text: kaṅkolaiśca palāścaiśca karīraiḥ pīlubhistathā / sarasvatītīrtharuhaistarubhirvividhaistathā
ce_text: badareṅgudakāśmaryaplakṣāśvatthavibhītakaiḥ / panasaiś ca palāśaiś ca karīraiḥ pīlubhis tathā

vulgate_text: kasya vaṃśe samutpannaḥ kiṃ cādhītaṃ dvijottama / etanme sarvamācakṣva yathātattvaṃ mahāmune / vaiśampāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tato vinaśanaṃ rājann ājagāma halāyudhaḥ / śūdrābhīrān prati dveṣād yatra naṣṭā sarasvatī

vulgate_text: dakṣeṇa yajatā cāpi gaṅgādvāre sarasvatī / suveṇiriti vikhyātā prasrutā śīghragāminī
ce_text: dakṣeṇa yajatā cāpi gaṅgādvāre sarasvatī / vimalodā bhagavatī brahmaṇā yajatā punaḥ / samāhūtā yayau tatra puṇye haimavate girau

vulgate_text: sarasvatyāṃ mahārāja caskande vīryamambhasi tadretaḥ sa tu jagrāha kalaśe vai mahātapāḥ
ce_text: dṛṣṭvā yadṛcchayā tatra striyam ambhasi bhārata / snāyantīṃ rucirāpāṅgīṃ digvāsasam aninditām / sarasvatyāṃ mahārāja caskande vīryam ambhasi

vulgate_text: tatrarṣayaḥ sapta jātā jajñire marutāṃ gaṇāḥ vāyuvego vāyubalo vāyuhā vāyumaṇḍalaḥ
ce_text: tad retaḥ sa tu jagrāha kalaśe vai mahātapāḥ / saptadhā pravibhāgaṃ tu kalaśasthaṃ jagāma ha / tatrarṣayaḥ sapta jātā jajñire marutāṃ gaṇāḥ

vulgate_text: bhobho brāhmaṇa dharmajña kimarthaṃ nṛtyate bhavān harṣasthānaṃ kimarthaṃ ca tavedamadhikaṃ mune / tapasvino dharmapathe sthitasya dvijasattama / ṛṣiruvāca
ce_text: bho bho brāhmaṇa dharmajña kimarthaṃ narinartsi vai / harṣasthānaṃ kimarthaṃ vai tavedaṃ munisattama / tapasvino dharmapathe sthitasya dvijasattama

vulgate_text: taddṛṣṭvā vrīḍito rājansa muniḥ pādayorgataḥ / mene devaṃ mahādevamidaṃ covāca vismitaḥ
ce_text: tato bhasma kṣatād rājan nirgataṃ himasaṃnibham / tad dṛṣṭvā vrīḍito rājan sa muniḥ pādayor gataḥ

vulgate_text: tvāmupāsanta varadaṃ devā brahmādayo'nagha / sarvastvamasi devānāṃ kartā kārayitā ca ha
ce_text: sarvas tvam asi devānāṃ kartā kārayitā ca ha / tvatprasādāt surāḥ sarve modantīhākutobhayāḥ

vulgate_text: tvatprasādātsurāḥ sarve modantīhākutobhayāḥ / tvaṃ prabhuḥ paramaiśvaryādadhikaṃ bhāsi śaṅkaraḥ
ce_text: sarvas tvam asi devānāṃ kartā kārayitā ca ha / tvatprasādāt surāḥ sarve modantīhākutobhayāḥ

vulgate_text: prapadye śaraṇaṃ śaṃbhuṃ sarvadā sarvataḥ sthitam / karmaṇā manasā vācā tamevābhibhajāmyaham / janamejaya uvāca
ce_text: janamejaya uvāca / kasmāt sarasvatī brahman nivṛttā prāṅmukhī tataḥ / vyākhyātum etad icchāmi sarvam adhvaryusattama

vulgate_text: ityuktvā svāṃ tanuṃ tyaktvā prapede vaiṣṇavaṃ padam tatrāplutya sa dharmātmā upaspṛśya halāyudhaḥ / dattvā caiva būhūndeyānviprāṇāṃ vipravatsalaḥ
ce_text: tatrāplutya sa dharmātmā upaspṛśya halāyudhaḥ / dattvā caiva bahūn dāyān viprāṇāṃ vipravatsalaḥ

vulgate_text: tatreśvaramayācanta dakṣiṇārthaṃ manasvinaḥ tatra te lebhire rājanpāñcālebhyo maharṣayaḥ / balānvitānvatsatarānnirvyādhīnsaptaviṃśatim
ce_text: tatreśvaram ayācanta dakṣiṇārthaṃ manīṣiṇaḥ / balānvitān vatsatarān nirvyādhīn ekaviṃśatim

vulgate_text: chiḷḷḷmānaṃ ḷḷḷḷḷḷ paraśunā vibho ḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷ vyavakīrthamacetanam
ce_text: chidyamānaṃ yathānantaṃ vanaṃ paraśunā vibho / babhūvāpahataṃ tac cāpy avakīrṇam acetanam

vulgate_text: ḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷradyatraṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ sahitaḥ purā / ḷḷḷḷḷgacchattu kṣīyate rāṣṭrameva ca
ce_text: mokṣārtham akarod yatnaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ sahitaḥ purā / athāsau pārthivaḥ khinnas te ca viprās tadā nṛpa

vulgate_text: yadīcchasi mahābāho śāntiṃ rāṣṭrasya bhūmipa apāṃ kuñje sarasvatyāstaṃ prasādaya pārthiva / vaiśampāyana uvāca
ce_text: tena te hūyamānasya rāṣṭrasyāsya kṣayo mahān / tasyaitat tapasaḥ karma yena te hy anayo mahān / apāṃ kuñje sarasvatyās taṃ prasādaya pārthiva

vulgate_text: punastatra ca rājñastu yayāteryajataḥ prabhoḥ audāryaṃ paramaṃ kṛtvā bhaktiṃ cātmani śāśvatīm / dadau kāmānbrāhmaṇebhyo vānyānyo manasecchati
ce_text: yayāter yajamānasya yatra rājan sarasvatī / prasṛtā pradadau kāmān brāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanām

vulgate_text: sāñjaliṃ tu tataḥ kṛtvā puṇḍarīkanibhekṣaṇā / prākampata bhṛśaṃ bhītā vāyunevāhatā latā
ce_text: sāñjaliṃ tu tataḥ kṛtvā puṇḍarīkanibhekṣaṇā / vivyathe suvirūḍheva latā vāyusamīritā

vulgate_text: tathārūpāṃ tu tāṃ dṛṣṭvā munirāha mahānadīm / avicāraṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ tvamānayastvāntikaṃ mama
ce_text: tathāgatāṃ tu tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vepamānāṃ kṛtāñjalim / viśvāmitro 'bravīt kruddho vasiṣṭhaṃ śīghram ānaya

vulgate_text: ārādhya paśubhartāraṃ mahādevaṃ jagatpatim / mokṣayāmāsustāṃ devīṃ saricchreṣṭhāṃ sarasvatīm
ce_text: evam uktvā saricchreṣṭhām ūcus te 'tha parasparam / vimocayāmahe sarve śāpād etāṃ sarasvatīm

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvā toyaṃ sarasvatyā munibhistaistathā kṛtam / tāneva śaraṇaṃ jagmū rākṣasāḥ kṣudhitāstathā
ce_text: dṛṣṭvā toyaṃ sarasvatyā munibhis tais tathā kṛtam / kṛtāñjalīs tato rājan rākṣasāḥ kṣudhayārditāḥ / ūcus tān vai munīn sarvān kṛpāyuktān punaḥ punaḥ

vulgate_text: kṣutaṃ kīṭāvapannaṃ ca yaccocchiṣṭācitaṃ bhavet / sakeśamavadhūtaṃ ca ruditopahataṃ ca yat
ce_text: kṣutakīṭāvapannaṃ ca yac cocchiṣṭāśitaṃ bhavet / keśāvapannam ādhūtam ārugṇam api yad bhavet / śvabhiḥ saṃspṛṣṭam annaṃ ca bhāgo 'sau rakṣasām iha

vulgate_text: tena sīdati tejasvī dīptimānhavyavāhanaḥ / na caivaṃ dhārayāmāsa brahmaṇe uktavānprabhuḥ
ce_text: tenāsīdati tejasvī dīptimān havyavāhanaḥ / na caiva dhārayām āsa garbhaṃ tejomayaṃ tadā

vulgate_text: caturthamasyānucaraṃ khyātaṃ kumudamālinam / tatra sthāṇurmahātejā mahāpāriṣadaṃ prabhuḥ
ce_text: nandiṣeṇaṃ lohitākṣaṃ ghaṇṭākarṇaṃ ca saṃmatam / caturtham asyānucaraṃ khyātaṃ kumudamālinam

vulgate_text: jvālājihvaḥ karālākṣaḥ śitikeśo jaṭī hariḥ / pariśrutaḥ kokanadaḥ kṛṣṇakeśo jaṭādharaḥ
ce_text: ajodaro gajaśirāḥ skandhākṣaḥ śatalocanaḥ / jvālājihvaḥ karālaś ca sitakeśo jaṭī hariḥ

vulgate_text: nānāveṣadharāścaiva nānāmālyānulepanāḥ / nānāvastradharāścaiva carmavāsasa eva ca
ce_text: cīrasaṃvṛtagātrāś ca tathā phalakavāsasaḥ / nānāveṣadharāś caiva carmavāsasa eva ca

vulgate_text: citramālādharāḥ kecitkecidromānanāstathā / vigrahaikarasā nityamajetāḥ surasattamaiḥ
ce_text: citramālyadharāḥ ke cit ke cid romānanās tathā / divyamālyāmbaradharāḥ satataṃ priyavigrahāḥ

vulgate_text: kaṇḍūtiḥ kālikā caiva devamitrā ca bhārata / vasuśrīḥ koṭarā caiva citrasenā tathā'calā
ce_text: dhanadā suprasādā ca bhavadā ca jaleśvarī / eḍī bheḍī sameḍī ca vetālajananī tathā / kaṇḍūtiḥ kālikā caiva devamitrā ca bhārata

vulgate_text: kukkuṭikā śaṅkhalikā tathā śakunikā nṛpa / kuṇḍārikā kaukulikā kumbhikā'tha śatodarī
ce_text: lambasī ketakī caiva citrasenā tathā balā / kukkuṭikā śaṅkhanikā tathā jarjarikā nṛpa

vulgate_text: pratiṣṭhā supratiṣṭhā ca rocamānā surocanā / naukarṇī mukhakarṇī ca viśirā manthinī tathā
ce_text: pratiṣṭhā supratiṣṭhā ca rocamānā surocanā / gokarṇī ca sukarṇī ca sasirā stherikā tathā / ekacakrā megharavā meghamālā virocanā

vulgate_text: vaiṣṇavyaśca tathā sauryo vārāhyaśca mahābalāḥ / rūpeṇāpsarasāṃ tulyā manohāryo manoramāḥ
ce_text: vāyavyaś cātha kaumāryo brāhmyaś ca bharatarṣabha / rūpeṇāpsarasāṃ tulyā jave vāyusamās tathā

vulgate_text: śatruṇāṃ vigrahe nityaṃ bhayadāstā bhavantyuta / kāmarūpadharāścaiva jave vāyusamāstathā
ce_text: vāyavyaś cātha kaumāryo brāhmyaś ca bharatarṣabha / rūpeṇāpsarasāṃ tulyā jave vāyusamās tathā

vulgate_text: acintyabalavīryāśca tathā'cintyaparākramāḥ / vṛkṣacatvaravāsinyaścatuṣpathaniketanāḥ
ce_text: vṛkṣacatvaravāsinyaś catuṣpathaniketanāḥ / guhāśmaśānavāsinyaḥ śailaprasravaṇālayāḥ

vulgate_text: ugrāṃ nānāpraharaṇāṃ tapovīryabalānvitām / ajeyāṃ svagaṇairyuktāṃ nāmnā senāṃ dhanañjayām
ce_text: dadau paśupatis tasmai sarvabhūtamahācamūm / ugrāṃ nānāpraharaṇāṃ tapovīryabalānvitām

vulgate_text: tataḥ pāriṣadaiścaiva mātṛbhiśca samanvitaḥ / yayau detyavināśāya hlādayansurapuṅgavān
ce_text: senāpatyam anuprāpya skando devagaṇasya ha / śuśubhe jvalito 'rciṣmān dvitīya iva pāvakaḥ / tataḥ pāriṣadaiś caiva mātṛbhiś ca samanvitaḥ

vulgate_text: sa tayā bhīmayā devaḥ śulamudgarahastayā / jvalitālātadhāriṇyā citrābharaṇavarmayā
ce_text: sa tayā bhīmayā devaḥ śūlamudgarahastayā / gadāmusalanārācaśaktitomarahastayā / dṛptasiṃhaninādinyā vinadya prayayau guhaḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ prīto mahāseno jaghāna bhagavānprabhuḥ / daityendraṃ tārakaṃ nāma mahābalaparākramam
ce_text: sa śaktyastreṇa saṃgrāme jaghāna bhagavān prabhuḥ / daityendraṃ tārakaṃ nāma mahābalaparākramam / vṛtaṃ daityāyutair vīrair balibhir daśabhir nṛpa

vulgate_text: kumārānucarā rājanpūrayanto diśo daśa / nanṛtuśca vavalguśca jahasuśca mudānvitāḥ
ce_text: tatrākurvanta vipulaṃ nādaṃ vadhyatsu śatruṣu / kumārānucarā rājan pūrayanto diśo daśa

vulgate_text: śaktyastrasya tu rājendra tato'rcirbhiḥ samantataḥ / trailokyaṃ trāsitaṃ sarvaṃ jṛmbhamāṇābhireva ca
ce_text: śaktyastrasya tu rājendra tato 'rcirbhiḥ samantataḥ / dagdhāḥ sahasraśo daityā nādaiḥ skandasya cāpare

vulgate_text: tānnijaghnuratikramya kumārājucarā mṛdhe / sa caiva bhagavānkruddho daityendrasya sutaṃ tadā
ce_text: tān nijaghnur atikramya kumārānucarā mṛdhe / bibheda śaktyā krauñcaṃ ca pāvakiḥ paravīrahā

vulgate_text: sahānujaṃ jaghānāśu vṛtraṃ devapatiryathā / bibheda krauñcaṃ śaktyā ca pāvakiḥ paravīrahā
ce_text: tān nijaghnur atikramya kumārānucarā mṛdhe / bibheda śaktyā krauñcaṃ ca pāvakiḥ paravīrahā

vulgate_text: evamprabhāvo bhagavāṃste bhūyaśca pāvakiḥ / śauryāddviguṇayogena tejasā yaśasā śriyā
ce_text: evaṃprabhāvo bhagavān ato bhūyaś ca pāvakiḥ / krauñcas tena vinirbhinno daityāś ca śataśo hatāḥ

vulgate_text: yathā'bhiṣikto bhagavānskando devaiḥ samāgataiḥ / senānīśca kṛto rājanbāla eva mahābalaḥ
ce_text: etat te sarvam ākhyātaṃ yan māṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi / yathābhiṣikto bhagavān skando devaiḥ samāgataiḥ

vulgate_text: agniḥ pranaṣṭo bhagavānkāraṇaṃ ca na vidmahe / sarvabhūtakṣayo rājansampādaya vibho'nalam / janamejaya uvāca
ce_text: janamejaya uvāca / atyadbhutam idaṃ brahmañ śrutavān asmi tattvataḥ / abhiṣekaṃ kumārasya vistareṇa yathāvidhi

vulgate_text: tacca tīrthaṃ mahārāja yatra japyaṃ jajāpa saḥ / indratīrthetivikhyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu mānada
ce_text: āmantrya tāṃ tu kalyāṇīṃ tato japyaṃ jajāpa saḥ / avidūre tatas tasmād āśramāt tīrtha uttame / indratīrthe mahārāja triṣu lokeṣu viśrute

vulgate_text: prāpnuyādupavāsena phalaṃ dvādaśavārṣikam / evamastviti tāṃ devaḥ pratyuvāca tapasvinīm
ce_text: tathāsmin devadeveśa trirātram uṣitaḥ śuciḥ / prāpnuyād upavāsena phalaṃ dvādaśavārṣikam / evam astv iti tāṃ coktvā haro yātas tadā divam
