vulgate_text: tato'sya mūlaṃ kāryāṇāṃ buddhyā niścitya vai budhāḥ / te'tra pṛṣṭā yathā brūyustatkartavyaṃ tathā bhavet
ce_text: muhyatā tu manuṣyeṇa praṣṭavyāḥ suhṛdo budhāḥ / te ca pṛṣṭā yathā brūyus tat kartavyaṃ tathā bhavet

vulgate_text: evaṃ kāryasya yogātpraśamārthamiti prabho / prajñayā ca svayā yuktyā tāṃ ca gṛhṇanti vai budhāḥ
ce_text: evaṃ kāryasya yogārthaṃ buddhiṃ kurvanti mānavāḥ / prajñayā hi svayā yuktās tāṃ ca nindanti mānavāḥ

vulgate_text: tathā vinihataḥ pāpaḥ pāñcālyaḥ paśuvanmayā / śastreṇa vijitām̐llokānnāpnuyāditi me matiḥ
ce_text: kathaṃ ca nihataḥ pāpaḥ pāñcālaḥ paśuvan mayā / śastrāhavajitāṃ lokān prāpnuyād iti me matiḥ

vulgate_text: tadadbhutatamaṃ dṛṣṭvā droṇaputro nirāyudhaḥ / acintayatsusantrastaḥ kṛpabhojavacaḥ smaran
ce_text: tad adbhutatamaṃ dṛṣṭvā droṇaputro nirāyudhaḥ / abravīd abhisaṃtaptaḥ kṛpavākyam anusmaran

vulgate_text: manasā hyanucintyainaṃ duṣkareṇālpacetasā / adya bhūtopahāreṇa yakṣye tripurāghātinam
ce_text: manasāpy asucintyena duṣkareṇālpacetasā / so 'ham ātmopahāreṇa yakṣye tripuraghātinam

vulgate_text: jvālākeśāśca rājendra jvaladromacaturbhujāḥ / meṣavaktrāstathaivānye tathā chāgamukhā nṛpa
ce_text: pradīptanetrajihvāś ca jvālāvaktrās tathaiva ca / meṣavaktrās tathaivānye tathā chāgamukhā nṛpa

vulgate_text: mahāsarpāṅgadadharāścitrābharaṇadhāriṇaḥ rajodhvajāḥ paṅkadigdhāḥ sarve citrāmbarasrajaḥ / nīlāṅgāḥ piṅgalāṅgāśca muṇḍavaktāstathaiva ca
ce_text: rajodhvastāḥ paṅkadigdhāḥ sarve śuklāmbarasrajaḥ / nīlāṅgāḥ kamalāṅgāś ca muṇḍavaktrās tathaiva ca

vulgate_text: gāyamānāstathaivānye saṃhṛṣṭāḥ puruṣarṣabhāḥ / laṅghayantaḥ pluvantaśca valgantaśca mahārathāḥ
ce_text: gāyamānās tathaivānye nṛtyamānās tathāpare / laṅghayantaḥ plavantaś ca valgantaś ca mahābalāḥ

vulgate_text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā tāni bhūtāni rakṣāṃsi ca samādravan abhitaḥ śibiraṃ yāntaṃ droṇaputraṃ mahāratham / devadevaṃ haraṃ sthāuṃ yāntaṃ sākṣādiveśvaram
ce_text: tam adṛśyāni bhūtāni rakṣāṃsi ca samādravan / abhitaḥ śatruśibiraṃ yāntaṃ sākṣād iveśvaram

vulgate_text: kaccidunmathya śibiraṃ hatvā somakapāṇḍavān / kṛtā pratijñā saphalā kaccitsañjaya sā niśi
ce_text: kaccit pramathya śibiraṃ hatvā somakapāṇḍavān / duryodhanasya padavīṃ gatau paramikāṃ raṇe

vulgate_text: duryodhanasya padavīṃ kaccitparamikāṃ raṇe / gatvātiṣṭhadasau drauṇiḥ kṛtvā karma suduṣkaram
ce_text: kaccit pramathya śibiraṃ hatvā somakapāṇḍavān / duryodhanasya padavīṃ gatau paramikāṃ raṇe

vulgate_text: sa vāryamāṇastarasā balādbalavatā balī / tudannakhaistu sa drauṇiṃ nātivyaktamudāharat
ce_text: tudan nakhais tu sa drauṇiṃ nātivyaktam udāharat / ācāryaputra śastreṇa jahi mā mā ciraṃ kṛthāḥ / tvatkṛte sukṛtāṃl lokān gaccheyaṃ dvipadāṃ vara

vulgate_text: gadāprahārābhihato nācaladdrauṇirāhave / tamabhidrutya vegena kṣitau cainamapātayat
ce_text: tam abhidrutya jagrāha kṣitau cainam apātayat / visphurantaṃ ca paśuvat tathaivainam amārayat

vulgate_text: saṃsuptāneva rājendra tatra tatra mahārathān pāñcālavīrānākramya kruddho nyahanadantike / sphurato vepamānāṃśca śamiteva paśūnmakhe
ce_text: tathā sa vīro hatvā taṃ tato 'nyān samupādravat / saṃsuptān eva rājendra tatra tatra mahārathān / sphurato vepamānāṃś ca śamiteva paśūn makhe

vulgate_text: ye tvajāgranta kauravya te'pi śabdena mohitāḥ / vīkṣamāṇāstu te tatra drauṇiṃ dṛṣṭvā pravivyathuḥ
ce_text: ye tv ajāgrata kauravya te 'pi śabdena mohitāḥ / nirīkṣyamāṇā anyonyaṃ drauṇiṃ dṛṣṭvā pravivyathuḥ

vulgate_text: śrutakarmā tu parighaṃ ghoraṃ gṛhya durāsadam / atāḍayatsamudyamya vegena drauṇimutsmayan
ce_text: śrutakarmā tu parighaṃ gṛhītvā samatāḍayat / abhidrutya tato drauṇiṃ savye sa phalake bhṛśam

vulgate_text: vahantīṃ vividhānpretānpāśabadvānvimūrdhajān / tathaiva ca sadā rājannyastaśastrānmahārathān
ce_text: dadṛśuḥ kālarātriṃ te smayamānām avasthitām / narāśvakuñjarān pāśair baddhvā ghoraiḥ pratasthuṣīm / harantīṃ vividhān pretān pāśabaddhān vimūrdhajān

vulgate_text: tatastacchastravitrastā bhayādabhyapatannarāḥ / nidrāndhā naṣṭasaṃjñāśca tatratatra nipetire
ce_text: tatas tacchastravitrastā utpatanto bhayāturāḥ / nidrāndhā naṣṭasaṃjñāś ca tatra tatra nililyire

vulgate_text: evaṃ hi bahubhiḥ śastrairghnato'pi balavattarān / tamasā rajanī ghorā babhau dāruṇadarśanā
ce_text: evaṃ vicaratas tasya nighnataḥ subahūn narān / tamasā rajanī ghorā babhau dāruṇadarśanā

vulgate_text: kecidūcurna tatkruddhairdhārtarāṣṭraiḥ kṛtaṃ raṇe yatkṛtaṃ naḥ prasuptānāṃ rakṣobhiḥ krūgkarmabhiḥ / asānnidhyādvi pārthānāmidaṃ vaḥ kadanaṃ kṛtam
ce_text: yat kṛtaṃ naḥ prasuptānāṃ rakṣobhiḥ krūrakarmabhiḥ / asāṃnidhyād dhi pārthānām idaṃ naḥ kadanaṃ kṛtam

vulgate_text: pañcādaṅgulayo rūkṣā virūpā bhairavasvanāḥ / gajānanāśca hasvāśca nīlavarṇā bibhīṣaṇāḥ
ce_text: paścād aṅgulayo rūkṣā virūpā bhairavasvanāḥ / ghaṭajānavo 'tihrasvāś ca nīlakaṇṭhā vibhīṣaṇāḥ

vulgate_text: yamupāsannṛpāḥ pūrvamarthahetormahīpatim / upātpate ca taṃ hyadya kravyādā māṃsagṛddhinaḥ / sañjaya uvāca
ce_text: saṃjaya uvāca / tasmin prayāte śibiraṃ droṇaputre mahātmani / kṛpaś ca kṛtavarmā ca śibiradvāry atiṣṭhatām

vulgate_text: dvāvanāthau kṛtau vīra tvayā nāthena vardhitau / bhikṣukau vicariṣyete śocantau pṛthivīmimām
ce_text: duryodhana na śocāmi tvām ahaṃ puruṣarṣabha / hataputrāṃ tu śocāmi gāndhārīṃ pitaraṃ ca te / bhikṣukau vicariṣyete śocantau pṛthivīm imām

vulgate_text: prāṇānupāsṛjadvīraḥ suhṛdāṃ duḥkhamādadhat / apākrāmaddivaṃ puṇyāṃ śarīraṃ kṣitimāviśat
ce_text: svasti prāpnuta bhadraṃ vaḥ svarge naḥ saṃgamaḥ punaḥ / ity evam uktvā tūṣṇīṃ sa kururājo mahāmanāḥ / prāṇān udasṛjad vīraḥ suhṛdāṃ śokam ādadhat

vulgate_text: etairnaragajāśvānāṃ prāsaśaktiparaśvayaiḥ / sahasrāmi vikṛndbhirniḥ śeṣaṃ śibiraṃ kṛtam
ce_text: etair naragajāśvānāṃ prāsaśaktiparaśvadhaiḥ / sahasrāṇi nikṛntadbhir niḥśeṣaṃ te balaṃ kṛtam

vulgate_text: ḷḷḷḷḷḷvihagaphalabhāranatasya ha ḷḷḷḷḷḷḷmahato vanasyeva paraśvathaiḥ / ḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷ sumahāñśabdo balasya tava bhārata
ce_text: chidyamānasya mahato vanasyeva paraśvadhaiḥ / śuśruve sumahāñ śabdo balasya tava bhārata

vulgate_text: tacchokajaṃ duḥkhamapārayantī kathaṃ bhaviṣyatyucitā sukhānām / rorūyate jñātivadhābhitaptā pradahvamāneva hutāśanena
ce_text: tac chokajaṃ duḥkham apārayantī; kathaṃ bhaviṣyaty ucitā sukhānām / putrakṣayabhrātṛvadhapraṇunnā; pradahyamāneva hutāśanena

vulgate_text: tasminmuhūrte javanairvājibhirhemamālibhiḥ / nakulaḥ kṛṣṇayā sārdhamupāyātparamārtayā
ce_text: tatas tasmin kṣaṇe kālye rathenādityavarcasā / nakulaḥ kṛṣṇayā sārdham upāyāt paramārtayā

vulgate_text: na babhau vadanaṃ tasyā rudantyāḥ śokakarśitam / phullapadmapalāśākṣyā meghāvṛta ivoḍurāṭ
ce_text: babhūva vadanaṃ tasyāḥ sahasā śokakarśitam / phullapadmapalāśākṣyās tamodhvasta ivāṃśumān

vulgate_text: sā samāśvāsitā tena bhīmasenena bhāminī / rudatī pāṇḍavajyeṣṭhamidaṃ vacanamabravīt
ce_text: sā samāśvāsitā tena bhīmasenena bhāminī / rudatī pāṇḍavaṃ kṛṣṇā sahabhrātaram abravīt

vulgate_text: diṣṭyā sarvāstrakuśalaṃ mattamātaṅgāminam / avāpya pṛthivīṃ kṛtsnāṃ saubhadraṃ na smariṣyasi
ce_text: diṣṭyā tvaṃ pārtha kuśalī mattamātaṅgagāminam / rājan rājyaṃ pradāya tvam anujānāṃ mayā saha / vanaṃ vraja parityajya kaṣṭāṃ rājyaspṛhāṃ vibho / evaṃvidhaṃ phalaṃ kaṣṭaṃ rājyasya kaṭukodayam / yatra jñātivadhaṃ kṛtvā rājyena sukham īpsyate / yadartham iṣyate rājyaṃ bhogāś cārthā dhanāni ca / drauṇirūpeṇa daivena hatāḥ paśuvad eva te / nūnaṃ vajreṇa ghaṭitaṃ hṛdayaṃ tava pārthiva / tathā hi mandabhāgyāyā mama duḥkhāni sarvadā / paśyantyā lokanāthebhyo bhartṛbhyaḥ surasaṃmite / smṛtvā teṣāṃ sukhaṃ cādya yauvanaṃ ca narādhipa / ceṣṭāś ca vividhās teṣāṃ vayaḥkālānurūpikāḥ / kathaṃ śakṣyasi rājendra muhūrtam api jīvitum / bhrātaro mama rājendra bhṛtyā iva vaśe tava / tān apaśyan kathaṃ rājan bhaviṣyasi vicintya vai / katham āsthāya kāle tvaṃ ratiṃ prāpsyasi pārthiva / putrapautrair vihīno hi śyālair bandhubhir eva ca / bāndhavaiḥ kṛtakṛtyaiś ca suhṛdbhir jñātibhis tathā / atha vā rājyalabdhastho bhogecchaḥ kṛpaṇo 'si cet / kāmaṃ te 'stu yathājoṣam ahaṃ tyakṣyāmi jīvitam / citāṃ kuruta me kṣipraṃ pravekṣyāmi hutāśanam / na kariṣyatha me jātu vacanaṃ hy etad eva hi / viṣeṇa rajjvā pātena parityakṣyāmi jīvitam / tasya pāpakṛto drauṇer jīvato jīvitaṃ na me / nimeṣam api ca sthātuṃ kathaṃ yuktaṃ nareśvara / ihaiva prāyam āsiṣye darbhān saṃstara vā śubhe / vajrapātopamaṃ duḥkhaṃ sāhaṃ śakṣye kathaṃ tv aham / hā heti paridevantyāḥ smṛtvā putrāṃs tathāgatān / maraṇaṃ sarvathā śreṣṭhaṃ na tu me jīvitaṃ kṣamam / yena me niśi suptasya bhrātṛvargasya pārthiva / jīvitaṃ dū[hṛ]tam eveha paśūnām iva tasya tu / jīvato jīvituṃ nāhaṃ dhārayiṣye muhūrtakam / eṣā tyajāmy ahaṃ prāya āsthāyedaṃ tavāgrataḥ / avāpya pṛthivīṃ kṛtsnāṃ saubhadraṃ na smariṣyasi

vulgate_text: ātmajānkṣatradharmeṇa śrutvā śūrānnipātitān / sthito rājye mayā sārdhaṃ viharanna smariṣyasi
ce_text: ātmajāṃs tena dharmeṇa śrutvā śūrān nipātitān / upaplavye mayā sārdhaṃ diṣṭyā tvaṃ na smariṣyasi

vulgate_text: prasuptānāṃ vadhaṃ śrutvā drauṇinā pāpakarmaṇā / śoko māṃ dahate gāḍho hutāśana ivāśrayam
ce_text: prasuptānāṃ vadhaṃ śrutvā drauṇinā pāpakarmaṇā / śokas tapati māṃ pārtha hutāśana ivāśayam

vulgate_text: te hayāḥ puruṣavyāghra dīpyamānāḥ svatejasā / vahantaḥ sahasā jagmurharayaḥ śīghragāminaḥ
ce_text: te hayāḥ puruṣavyāghra coditā vātaraṃhasaḥ / vegena tvaritā jagmur harayaḥ śīghragāminaḥ

vulgate_text: sarvayatnena tenāpi gṛhya nainamakampayat
ce_text: atha tad dakṣiṇenāpi grahītum upacakrame / sarvayatnena tenāpi gṛhṇann etad akalpayat

vulgate_text: yuktaṃ paramakāmbhojaisturagairhemamālibhiḥ / uditādityasaṅkāśaṃ sarvaratnavibhūṣitam
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / evam uktvā yudhāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ sarvayādavanandanaḥ / sarvāyudhavaropetam āruroha mahāratham / yuktaṃ paramakāmbojais turagair hemamālibhiḥ

vulgate_text: dakṣiṇe hyāvahacchaibyaḥ sugrīvaḥ savyato dhuram / ṇarṣṇivāhau tu tasyāstāṃ meghapuṣpabalāhakau
ce_text: ādityodayavarṇasya dhuraṃ rathavarasya tu / dakṣiṇām avahat sainyaḥ sugrīvaḥ savyato 'vahat / pārṣṇivāhau tu tasyāstāṃ meghapuṣpabalāhakau

vulgate_text: te samarthā mahābāhuṃ kṣaṇena bharatarṣabha / bhīmasenaṃ maheṣvāsamanusasruḥ suvegitāḥ
ce_text: te samārchan naravyāghrāḥ kṣaṇena bharatarṣabha / bhīmasenaṃ maheṣvāsaṃ samanudrutya vegitāḥ

vulgate_text: sa tāmāpadamāsādya divyamastramudairayat amṛṣyamāṇastāñchūrāndivyāyudhadharānsthitān / apāṇḍavāyeti ruṣā vācamutsṛjya dāruṇam
ce_text: amṛṣyamāṇas tāñ śūrān divyāyudhadharān sthitān / apāṇḍavāyeti ruṣā vyasṛjad dāruṇaṃ vacaḥ

vulgate_text: mahāstraviduṣaḥ pūrve ye'pyatītā mahārathāḥ naitadasraṃ manuṣyeṣu taiḥ prayuktaṃ kathañcana / kimidaṃ sāhasaṃ vīrau kṛtavantau mahātyayam
ce_text: ṛṣī ūcatuḥ / nānāśastravidaḥ pūrve ye 'py atītā mahārathāḥ / naitad astraṃ manuṣyeṣu taiḥ prayuktaṃ kathaṃ cana

vulgate_text: yattu me bhagavānāha tanme kāryamanantaram ayaṃ maṇirayaṃ cāhamiṣīkā tu patiṣyati / garbheṣu pāṇḍuputrāṇāmutrāyāstathodare / vaiśampāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / iṅgitenaiva dāśārhas tam abhiprāyam āditaḥ / drauṇer buddhvā mahābāhur arjunaṃ pratyabhāṣata

vulgate_text: evaṃ kuru na cānyā te buddhiḥ kāryā kathañcana / āgarbhātpāṇḍaveyānāṃ kṛtvā pātaṃ vinaṅkṣyati
ce_text: vyāsa uvāca / evaṃ kuru na cānyā te buddhiḥ kāryā kadā cana / garbheṣu pāṇḍaveyānāṃ visṛjyaitad upārama

vulgate_text: evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ govindaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ sarvasātvatām / drauṇiḥ paramasaṅkruddhaḥ pratyuvācedamuttaram
ce_text: evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ govindaṃ sātvatapravaraṃ tadā / drauṇiḥ paramasaṃrabdhaḥ pratyuvācedam uttaram

vulgate_text: amoghaḥ paramāstrasya pātastvadya bhaviṣyati / abhimanyoḥ sṛjaiṣīkāṃ garbhasthaḥ śāmyatāṃ śiśuḥ
ce_text: vāsudeva uvāca / amoghaḥ paramāstrasya pātas tasya bhaviṣyati / sa tu garbho mṛto jāto dīrgham āyur avāpsyati

vulgate_text: ahamenaṃ mṛtaṃ jātaṃ jīvayiṣyāmi bālakam / sa tu garbho mṛto jāto dīrghamāyuravāpsyati
ce_text: vāsudeva uvāca / amoghaḥ paramāstrasya pātas tasya bhaviṣyati / sa tu garbho mṛto jāto dīrgham āyur avāpsyati

vulgate_text: tataḥ paramamastraṃ tu drauṇirudyatamāhave / dvaipāyanamanādṛtya garbheṣu pramumoca ha
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tataḥ paramam astraṃ tad aśvatthāmā bhṛśāturaḥ / dvaipāyanavacaḥ śrutvā garbheṣu pramumoca ha

vulgate_text: bhavitrī na hi te kṣudra janamadhyeṣu saṃsthitiḥ pūyaśoṇigandhī ca durgakāntārasaṃśrayaḥ
ce_text: nirjanān asahāyas tvaṃ deśān pravicariṣyasi / bhavitrī na hi te kṣudra janamadhyeṣu saṃsthitiḥ

vulgate_text: ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣāmi dharmātmā vasudhāṃ pālayiṣyati itaścordhvaṃ mahābāhuḥ kururājo bhaviṣyati
ce_text: viditvā paramāstrāṇi kṣatradharmavrate sthitaḥ / ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣāṇi dharmātmā vasudhāṃ pālayiṣyati

vulgate_text: parikṣinnāma nṛpatirmiṣataste sudurmate [ahaṃ taṃ jīvayiṣyāmi dagdhaṃ śastrāgnitejasā]
ce_text: itaś cordhvaṃ mahābāhuḥ kururājo bhaviṣyati / parikṣin nāma nṛpatir miṣatas te sudurmate / paśya me tapaso vīryaṃ satyasya ca narādhama

vulgate_text: paśya me tapaso vīryaṃ satyasya ca narādhama / vyāsa uvāca / yasmādanādṛtya kṛtaṃ tvayā'smānkarma dāruṇam / brāhmaṇasya sataścedaṃ vṛttamanyāyavartinaḥ
ce_text: vyāsa uvāca / astraṃ brahmaśiras tāta vidvān pārtho dhanaṃjayaḥ / utsṛṣṭavān na roṣeṇa na vadhāya tavāhave

vulgate_text: pāṇḍavāśca sadāśārhāstānṛṣīnabhivādya ca / kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ caiva nāradaṃ caiva parvatam
ce_text: pāṇḍavāś cāpi govindaṃ puraskṛtya hatadviṣaḥ / kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ caiva nāradaṃ ca mahāmunim

vulgate_text: kevalānṛṇyamāptā'smi guruputro gururmama / śirasyetaṃ maṇiṃ rājā grahītumanagho'rhati
ce_text: draupady uvāca / kevalānṛṇyam āptāsmi guruputro gurur mama / śirasy etaṃ maṇiṃ rājā pratibadhnātu bhārata

vulgate_text: bhūtagrāme vivṛdve tu sṛṣṭe devāsure tadā / udatiṣṭhajjalājjyeṣṭhaḥ prajāścemā dadarśa saḥ
ce_text: bhūtagrāme vivṛddhe tu tuṣṭe lokagurāv api / udatiṣṭhaj jalāj jyeṣṭhaḥ prajāś cemā dadarśa saḥ

ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / vidurasya tu tad vākyaṃ niśamya kurusattamaḥ / putraśokābhisaṃtaptaḥ papāta bhuvi mūrchitaḥ

vulgate_text: nātibhāro'sti daivasya dhruvaṃ mādhava kaścana yadime nihatāḥ śūrāḥ kṣatriyaiḥ kṣatriyarṣabhāḥ / śūrāśca kṛtavidyāśca mama putrā manasvinaḥ
ce_text: ta ime nihatāḥ saṃkhye paśya kālasya paryayam / nātibhāro 'sti daivasya dhruvaṃ mādhava kaś cana / yad ime nihatāḥ śūrāḥ kṣatriyaiḥ kṣatriyarṣabhāḥ

vulgate_text: anāthavadavijñāto lokeṣvanabhilakṣitaḥ / kutsitenābhyupāyena nidhanaṃ samavāpsyasi
ce_text: tvam apy upasthite varṣe ṣaṭtriṃśe madhusūdana / hatajñātir hatāmātyo hataputro vanecaraḥ / kutsitenābhyupāyena nidhanaṃ samavāpsyasi

vulgate_text: jāne'hametadapyevaṃ cīrṇaṃ carasi kṣatriye / daivādeva vinaśyanti vṛṣṇayo nātra saṃśayaḥ
ce_text: saṃhartā vṛṣṇicakrasya nānyo mad vidyate śubhe / jāne 'ham etad apy evaṃ cīrṇaṃ carasi kṣatriye

vulgate_text: ye tvatra nihatā rājannantarāyodhanaṃ prati / yathākathañcitpuruṣāste gatā hyuttarāṃ gatim / dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / yudhiṣṭhira gatiṃ kāṃ te gatāḥ puruṣasattamāḥ / ācakṣva me mahābāho sarvajño hy asi me mataḥ

vulgate_text: ye tvanāthā janāstāta nāthavantaśca pāṇḍava / kaccitteṣāṃ śarīrāṇi dhakṣyanti vidhipūrvakam / yudhiṣṭhira uvāca
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca / daśāyutānām ayutaṃ sahasrāṇi ca viṃśatiḥ / koṭyaḥ ṣaṣṭiś ca ṣaṭ caiva ye 'smin rājamṛdhe hatāḥ

vulgate_text: yānsuparṇāśca gudhrāśca vikarṣanti tatastataḥ / teṣāṃ saṅkarṣaṇā lokā bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ / vaiśampāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / ity uktvā nyapatad bhūmau gāndhārī śokakarśitā / duḥkhopahatavijñānā dhairyam utsṛjya bhārata

vulgate_text: citvā dārubhiravyagraiḥ prabhūtaiḥ snehapācitaiḥ / dāhayāmāsa tānsarvānviduro rājaśāsanāt
ce_text: citvā dārubhir avyagraḥ prabhūtaiḥ snehatāpitaiḥ / dāhayām āsa viduro dharmarājasya śāsanāt

vulgate_text: bhūṣaṇānyuttarīyāṇi veṣṭanānyavamucya ca / kavacāni vicitrāṇi gaṅgāmavajagāhire
ce_text: bhūṣaṇāny uttarīyāṇi veṣṭanāny avamucya ca / tataḥ pitṝṇāṃ pautrāṇāṃ bhrātṝṇāṃ svajanasya ca

vulgate_text: yasya nāsti samo vīrye pṛthivyāmapi kaścana / yo vṛṇīta yaśaḥ śūraḥ prāṇairapi sadā bhuvi
ce_text: yasya nāsti samo vīrye pṛthivyām api kaś cana / satyasaṃdhasya śūrasya saṃgrāmeṣv apalāyinaḥ

vulgate_text: bhūmipānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ balaṃ balavatāṃ varaḥ / nānyaḥ kuntīsutātkarṇādagṛhṇādrathino rathī
ce_text: nānyaḥ kuntīsutāt karṇād agṛhṇād rathināṃ rathī / sa naḥ prathamajo bhrātā sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / asūta taṃ bhavaty agre katham adbhutavikramam

vulgate_text: sa tābhiḥ saha dharmātmā pretakṛtyamanantaram / sarvaṃ cakāra karṇasya vidhivadbhūridakṣiṇam
ce_text: sa tābhiḥ saha dharmātmā pretakṛtyam anantaram / kṛtvottatāra gaṅgāyāḥ salilād ākulendriyaḥ

vulgate_text: śrīvedavyāsāya namaḥ / nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam / devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / kṛtvodakaṃ te suhṛdāṃ sarveṣāṃ pāṇḍunandanāḥ viduro dhṛtarāṣṭraśca sarvāśca bharatastriyaḥ
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / kṛtodakās te suhṛdāṃ sarveṣāṃ pāṇḍunandanāḥ / viduro dhṛtarāṣṭraś ca sarvāś ca bharatastriyaḥ

vulgate_text: nāradastvavravītkāle dharmaputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram / saṃbhāṣya munibhiḥ sārdhaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanādibhiḥ / nārada uvāca
ce_text: nāradas tv abravīt kāle dharmātmānaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram / vicārya munibhiḥ sārdhaṃ tatkālasadṛśaṃ vacaḥ

vulgate_text: yaḥ sa nāgāyutaprāṇo loke'pratiratho raṇe / siṃhavikrāntagāmī ca jitakāśī yatavrataḥ

vulgate_text: mañjūṣāyāṃ samādhāya gaṅgāsrotasyamajjayat / yaṃ sūtaputraṃ loko'yaṃ rādheyaṃ cābhyamanyata
ce_text: yaṃ sūtaputraṃ loko 'yaṃ rādheyaṃ cāpy amanyata / sa jyeṣṭhaputraḥ kuntyā vai bhrātāsmākaṃ ca mātṛjaḥ

vulgate_text: pṛthāyā na kṛtaḥ kāmastena cāpi mahātmanā / atīvānucitaṃ mātaravoca iti so'bravīt
ce_text: pṛthāyā na kṛtaḥ kāmas tena cāpi mahātmanā / atipaścād idaṃ mātary avocad iti naḥ śrutam

vulgate_text: pañcaiva hi sutā devi bhaviṣyanti tava dhruvāḥ / sārjunā vā hate karṇe sakarṇā vā hate'rjune
ce_text: pañcaiva hi sutā mātar bhaviṣyanti hi te dhruvam / sakarṇā vā hate pārthe sārjunā vā hate mayi

vulgate_text: nedamavyāhṛtaṃ kuryādbrahmaloke'pi kevalam / gaccha vā tiṣṭha vā yadvā kāryaṃ yattatsamācara

vulgate_text: tatastasmai mahātejā brahmāstraṃ sanivartanam / provāca sumahāprajñaḥ sa tapasvī tapasvine
ce_text: tasmai sa vidhivat kṛtsnaṃ brahmāstraṃ sanivartanam / provācākhilam avyagraṃ tapasvī sutapasvine

vulgate_text: yadā sa rudhireṇāṅge parispṛṣṭo'bhavadguruḥ / tadā'budhyata tejasvī saṃrabdhaścainamabravīt
ce_text: yadā tu rudhireṇāṅge parispṛṣṭo bhṛgūdvahaḥ / tadābudhyata tejasvī saṃtaptaś cedam abravīt

vulgate_text: tataḥ svayaṃvare tasminnānādeśyā mahārathāḥ / samājagmurnṛpatayaḥ kanyārthe nṛpasattama

vulgate_text: na tairbhukteyamavanirna nāryo gītavāditam nāmātyasuhṛdāṃ vākyaṃ na ca śrutavatāṃ śrutam / na ratnāni parārdhyāni na bhūrna draviṇāgamaḥ
ce_text: nāmātyasamitau kathyaṃ na ca śrutavatāṃ śrutam / na ratnāni parārdhyāni na bhūr na draviṇāgamaḥ

vulgate_text: na ca dharmyānimām̐llokānprapadyāma svakarmabhiḥ vayamevāsya lokasya vināśe kāraṇaṃ smṛtāḥ / dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putreṇa nikṛtiprītisaṃyutāḥ
ce_text: vayam evāsya lokasya vināśe kāraṇaṃ smṛtāḥ / dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putreṇa nikṛtyā pratyapatsmahi

vulgate_text: yaśasaḥ patito dīptāddhātayitvā sahodarān imau hi vṛddhau śokāgnau prakṣipya sa suyodhanaḥ / asmatpradveṣasaṃtaptaḥ pāpabuddhiḥ sadaiva ha
ce_text: imau vṛddhau ca śokāgnau prakṣipya sa suyodhanaḥ / asmatpradveṣasaṃyuktaḥ pāpabuddhiḥ sadaiva hi

vulgate_text: ko hi bandhuḥ kulīnaḥ saṃstathā brūyātsuhṛjjane / yathā'sāvavadadvākyaṃ yuyutsuḥ kṛṣṇasannidhau
ce_text: ko hi bandhuḥ kulīnaḥ saṃs tathā brūyāt suhṛjjane / yathāsāv uktavān kṣudro yuyutsur vṛṣṇisaṃnidhau

vulgate_text: dhanañjaya kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ kalyāṇenopahanyate [khyāpanenānutāpena dānena tapasā'pi vā / nivṛttyā tīrthagamanācchutismṛtijapena vā ]
ce_text: dhanaṃjaya kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ kalyāṇenopahanyate / tyāgavāṃś ca punaḥ pāpaṃ nālaṃ kartum iti śrutiḥ

vulgate_text: drohāddevairavāptāni divi sthānāni sarvaśaḥ / drohātkimanyajjñātīnāṃ gṛdhyante yena devatāḥ
ce_text: drohād devair avāptāni divi sthānāni sarvaśaḥ / iti devā vyavasitā vedavādāś ca śāśvatāḥ

vulgate_text: rājarṣayo'pi te svargyā dharmo hyeṣāṃ nirucyate

vulgate_text: ekakālaṃ caranbhaikṣaṃ trīnatha dve ca pañca vā / snehapāśaṃ vimucyāhaṃ cariṣyāmi mahīmimām
ce_text: ekakālaṃ caran bhaikṣyaṃ gṛhe dve caiva pañca ca / spṛhāpāśān vimucyāhaṃ cariṣyāmi mahīm imām

vulgate_text: māsārdhamāsā ṛtava ādityaśaśitārakam / grasante karma bhūtāni tadidaṃ karmaśaṃsinām

ce_text: eteṣāṃ yatamānānām utpadyante tu saṃpadaḥ / tvaṃ tu sarvāṃ mahīṃ labdhvā kuruṣe svayam āpadam

ce_text: teṣām anyatamotseke vidhānam upadiṣyate / uṣṇena bādhyate śītaṃ śītenoṣṇaṃ prabādhyate

ce_text: teṣām anyatamotseke vidhānam upadiṣyate / uṣṇena bādhyate śītaṃ śītenoṣṇaṃ prabādhyate

ce_text: tasmād adyaiva gantavyaṃ yuddhasya bharatarṣabha / etaj jitvā mahārāja kṛtakṛtyo bhaviṣyasi

vulgate_text: ātmodarakṛte'prājñaḥ karoti viśasaṃ bahu / jayodaraṃ pṛthivyā te śreyo nirjitayā jitam

vulgate_text: devatātithibhūtānāṃ nirvapanto yathāvidhi / sthānamiṣṭamavāpsyāmo brahmaṇyāḥ satyavādinaḥ

ce_text: tasmāt pārtha mahāyajñair yajasva bahudakṣiṇaiḥ / svādhyāyayajñā ṛṣayo jñānayajñās tathāpare

ce_text: kṛcchrāc ca dravyasaṃhāraṃ kurvanti dhanakāraṇāt / dhanena tṛṣito 'buddhyā bhrūṇahatyāṃ na budhyate

vulgate_text: tapo yajñastathā vidyā bhaikṣyamindriyasaṃyamaḥ dhyānaṃ vidyā samutthānaṃ saṃtoṣaśca śriyaṃ prati / tathā hyekāntaśīlatvaṃ tuṣṭirdānaṃ ca śaktitaḥ

ce_text: śaṅkha uvāca / na kupye tava dharmajña na ca dūṣayase mama / dharmas tu te vyatikrāntas tatas te niṣkṛtiḥ kṛtā

vulgate_text: vijhaste puruṣavyāghra vacanaṃ kurusattama / śṛṇuṣvaivaṃ yathā kurvanna dharmāccyavase nṛpa

vulgate_text: vyavāhareṣu dharmeṣu yoktavyāśca bahuśrutāḥ / pramāṇajñā mahīpāla nyāyaśāstrāvalambinaḥ

ce_text: sukhaṃ ca duḥkhaṃ ca bhavābhavau ca; lābhālābhau maraṇaṃ jīvitaṃ ca / paryāyaśaḥ sarvam iha spṛśanti; tasmād dhīro naiva hṛṣyen na kupyet

ce_text: prāṅmukhaṃ sīdamānaṃ ca rathād apacyutaṃ śaraiḥ / ghūrṇamānaṃ yathā śailaṃ tadā me kaśmalo 'bhavat

vulgate_text: viśvaṃ hi brahma sumahaccarau tava samāhitam / kṣatravīryaṃ ca sakalaṃ tava mātre samarpitam
ce_text: janiṣyate hi te bhrātā brahmabhūtas tapodhanaḥ / viśvaṃ hi brahma tapasā mayā tatra samarpitam

vulgate_text: iccham̐llokānapi mune sṛjethāḥ kiṃ punaḥ sutam / śamātmakamṛjuṃ putraṃ dātumarhasi me prabho / ṛcīka uvāca
ce_text: ṛcīka uvāca / naiṣa saṃkalpitaḥ kāmo mayā bhadre tathā tvayi / ugrakarmā bhavet putraś carur mātā ca kāraṇam

vulgate_text: [dṛṣṭametatpurā bhadre jñātaṃ ca tapasā mayā brahmabhūtaṃ hi sakalaṃ pitustava kulaṃ bhavet ] / satyavatyuvāca
ce_text: satyavaty uvāca / icchaṃl lokān api mune sṛjethāḥ kiṃ punar mama / śamātmakam ṛjuṃ putraṃ labheyaṃ japatāṃ vara

vulgate_text: kāmamevaṃ bhavetpautro māmaivaṃ tanayaḥ prabho / śamātmakamṛjuṃ putraṃ labheyaṃ japatāṃ vara / ṛcīka uvāca
ce_text: ṛcīka uvāca / naiṣa saṃkalpitaḥ kāmo mayā bhadre tathā tvayi / ugrakarmā bhavet putraś carur mātā ca kāraṇam

vulgate_text: dadau sa pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ saptadvīpāṃ saparvatām / sabāhvastrabalenājau jitvā paramadharmavit
ce_text: dadāha pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ saptadvīpāṃ sapattanām / svabāhvastrabalenājau dharmeṇa parameṇa ca

vulgate_text: samitkuśārthaṃ rāmasya niryātasya yaśasvinaḥ / pratyakṣaṃ rāmamātuśca tathaivāśramavāsinām
ce_text: apātayanta bhallāgraiḥ śiraḥ kāyān narādhipa / samitkuśārthaṃ rāmasya nirgatasya mahātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: sa haihayasahasrāṇi hatvā paramamanyumān / mahīṃ sāgaraparyantāṃ cakāra rudhirokṣitām
ce_text: sa haihayasahasrāṇi hatvā paramamanyumān / cakāra bhārgavo rājan mahīṃ śoṇitakardamām

vulgate_text: ete kṣatriyadāyādāstatratatra pariśrutāḥ / vyokārahemakārādijātiṃ nityaṃ samāśritāḥ
ce_text: ete kṣatriyadāyādās tatra tatra pariśrutāḥ / samyaṅ mām abhirakṣantu tataḥ sthāsyāmi niścalā

vulgate_text: na hyahaṃ kāmaye nityamatikrāntena rakṣaṇam / vartamānena varteyaṃ tatkṣipraṃ saṃvidhīyatām / vāsudeva uvāca
ce_text: vāsudeva uvāca / śṛṇu kaunteya rāmasya mayā yāvat pariśrutam / maharṣīṇāṃ kathayatāṃ kāraṇaṃ tasya janma ca

vulgate_text: ahaṃ ca tvā'bhijānāmi svayaṃ puruṣasattama / tridaśeṣvapi vikhyātastvaṃ śaktyā puruṣottamaḥ
ce_text: ahaṃ hi tvābhijānāmi yas tvaṃ puruṣasattama / tridaśeṣv api vikhyātaḥ svaśaktyā sumahābalaḥ

vulgate_text: tapasā hi bhavāñśaktaḥ sraṣṭuṃ lokāṃścarācarān / kiṃpunaścātmano lokānuttamānuttamairguṇaiḥ
ce_text: tvaṃ hi sarvair guṇai rājan devān apy atiricyase / tapasā hi bhavāñ śaktaḥ sraṣṭuṃ lokāṃś carācarān

vulgate_text: balaṃ me prajahātīva prāṇāḥ satvarayanti ca / marmāṇi paritapyanti bhrāntacittastathā hyaham

vulgate_text: evamuktaḥ pratyuvāca dharmaputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / yujyatāṃ me rathavaraḥ phalgunāpratimadyute
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca / yujyatāṃ me rathavaraḥ phalgunāpratimadyute / na sainikaiś ca yātavyaṃ yāsyāmo vayam eva hi

vulgate_text: ataḥ puraḥsarāścāpi nivartantu dhanañjaya adyaprabhṛti gāṅgeyaḥ paraṃ guhyaṃ pravakṣyati / ato necchāmi kaunteya pṛthagjanasamāgamam / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tataḥ kṛṣṇasya tad vākyaṃ dharmārthasahitaṃ hitam / śrutvā śāṃtanavo bhīṣmaḥ pratyuvāca kṛtāñjaliḥ

vulgate_text: tava prasādādgovinda bhūtātmā hyasi śāśvataḥ yudhiṣṭhirastu dharmātmā māṃ dharmānanupṛcchatu / evaṃ prīto bhaviṣyāmi dharmānvakṣyāmi cākhilān
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhiras tu māṃ rājā dharmān samanupṛcchatu / evaṃ prīto bhaviṣyāmi dharmān vakṣyāmi cānagha

vulgate_text: evaṃ caiva naravyāghra lokayātrāvighātakāḥ / nigrāhyā eva bāhubhyāṃ brāhmaṇāste nareśvara

vulgate_text: kṛtapāpastvasau rājā ya etānna niyacchati tathā kṛtasya dharmasya caturbhāgamupāśnute
ce_text: prabhur niyamane rājā ya etān na niyacchati / bhuṅkte sa tasya pāpasya caturbhāgam iti śrutiḥ / tathā kṛtasya dharmasya caturbhāgam upāśnute

vulgate_text: eṣā te rāṣṭravṛttiśca rājñāṃ guptiśca bhārata / proktoddiśyaitamevārthaṃ bhūyo vakṣyāmi pā--va
ce_text: eṣā te rāṣṭravṛttiś ca rāṣṭraguptiś ca bhārata / etam evārtham āśritya bhūyo vakṣyāmi pāṇḍava

vulgate_text: mattātpramattātpaugaṇḍādunmattācca viśeṣataḥ / ninditāccāsadācārāddurhṛdāṃ cāpi sevanāt
ce_text: mattāt pramattāt pogaṇḍād unmattāc ca viśeṣataḥ / tadabhyāsād upāvartād ahitānāṃ ca sevanāt

vulgate_text: agnitretā trayī vidyā yajñāśca sahadakṣiṇāḥ / sarva eva pramuhyante yadā rājā pramādyati
ce_text: cāturvarṇyaṃ tathā vedāś cāturāśramyam eva ca / sarvaṃ pramuhyate hy etad yadā rājā pramādyati

vulgate_text: mā sma tāta balasthastvaṃ bhuñjīthā durbalaṃ janam / mā tvāṃ durbalacakṣūṃṣi dahantvagnirivāśayam
ce_text: mā sma tāta bale stheyā bādhiṣṭhā māpi durbalam / mā tvā durbalacakṣūṃṣi dhakṣyanty agnir ivāśrayam

vulgate_text: saṃvibhajya yadā bhuṅkte nṛpatirdurbalānnarān / tadā bhavanti balinaḥ sa rājño dharma ucyate
ce_text: saṃvibhajya yadā bhuṅkte na cānyān avamanyate / nihanti balinaṃ dṛptaṃ sa rājño dharma ucyate

vulgate_text: pāpamācarato yatra karmaṇā vyāhṛtena vā / priyasyāpi na mṛṣyeta sa rājño dharma ucyate
ce_text: trāyate hi yadā sarvaṃ vācā kāyena karmaṇā / putrasyāpi na mṛṣyec ca sa rājño dharma ucyate

vulgate_text: evametairguṇairyukto yo'nurajyati bhūmipam / bharturartheṣvapramattaṃ niyuñjyādarthakarmaṇi
ce_text: evam eva guṇair yukto yo na rajyati bhūmipam / bhartur artheṣv asūyantaṃ na taṃ yuñjīta karmaṇi

vulgate_text: agrāmyacaritāṃ vṛttiṃ yo na seveta nityadā / jitānāmajitānāṃ ca kṣatradharmādapaiti saḥ
ce_text: yo 'tyantācaritāṃ vṛttiṃ kṣatriyo nānuvartate / jitānām ajitānāṃ ca kṣatradharmād apaiti saḥ

vulgate_text: yaḥ kalyāṇaguṇāñjñātīnpradveṣānno bubhūṣati / adṛḍhātmā dṛḍhakrodhaḥ nāsyārtho vasate'ntike
ce_text: yaḥ kalyāṇaguṇāñ jñātīn dveṣān naivābhimanyate / adṛḍhātmā dṛḍhakrodho nāsyārtho ramate 'ntike

vulgate_text: yasya yodhāḥ susaṃtuṣṭāḥ svanuraktāḥ supūjitāḥ / alpenāpi sa daṇḍena mahīṃ jayati pārthivaḥ
ce_text: yasya yodhāḥ susaṃtuṣṭāḥ sāntvitāḥ sūpadhāsthitāḥ / alpenāpi sa daṇḍena mahīṃ jayati bhūmipaḥ / daṇḍo hi balavān yatra tatra sāma prayujyate / pradānaṃ sāmapūrvaṃ ca bhedamūlaṃ praśasyate / trayāṇāṃ viphalaṃ karma yadā paśyeta bhūmipaḥ / randhraṃ jñātvā tato daṇḍaṃ prayuñjītāvicārayan / abhibhūto yadā śatruḥ śatrubhir balavattaraiḥ / upekṣā tatra kartavyā vadhyatāṃ balināṃ balam / durbalo hi mahīpālo yadā bhavati bhārata / upekṣā tatra kartavyā caturṇām avirodhinī / upāyaḥ pañcamaḥ so 'pi sarveṣāṃ balavattaraḥ / bhārgaveṇa ca gītānāṃ ślokānāṃ kausalādhipa / vijñāya tattvaṃ tattvajña tattvatas tat kariṣyasi / yadi rakṣaḥ piśācena hanyate yatra kutra cit / upekṣā tatra kartavyā vadhyatāṃ balināṃ baliḥ / durbalo hi mahīpālaḥ śatrūṇāṃ śatrum uddharet / pādalagnaṃ karasthena kaṇṭakenaiva kaṇṭakam / śaṭhānāṃ sacivānāṃ ca mlecchānāṃ ca mahīpate / eṣa ukta upāyānām upekṣā balavattamā / aśmanā nāśayel lohaṃ lohenāśmānam eva ca / bilvānīvāparair bilvair mlecchān mlecchaiḥ prasādayet / dāsānāṃ ca pradṛptānām etad eveha kārayet / caṇḍālamlecchajātīnāṃ daṇḍena ca nivāraṇam / śaṭhānāṃ durvinītaiś ca pūrvam uktaṃ samācaret / anyāḥ śaṭhāś ca sacivās tathā kubrāhmaṇādayaḥ / upāyaiḥ pañcabhiḥ sādhyāś caturvargavirodhinaḥ

vulgate_text: paurajānapadā yasya svanuraktā apīḍitāḥ / rāṣṭrakarmakarā hyete rāṣṭrasya ca virodhinaḥ
ce_text: paurajānapadā yasya svanuraktāḥ supūjitāḥ / sadhanā dhānyavantaś ca dṛḍhamūlaḥ sa pārthivaḥ

vulgate_text: maryādāṃ śāśvatīṃ bhindyādbrāhmaṇaṃ yo'bhilaṅghayet atha cellaṅghayedeva maryādāṃ kṣatriyabruvaḥ / asaṅkhyepatadūrdhvaṃ syādanādeyaśca saṃsadi
ce_text: atha cel laṅghayed enāṃ maryādāṃ kṣatriyabruvaḥ / apraśasyas tad ūrdhvaṃ syād anādeyaś ca saṃsadi

vulgate_text: raṇeṣu kadanaṃ kṛtvā suhṛdbhiḥ pratipūjita / tīkṣṇaiḥ śastrairabhikliṣṭaḥ kṣatriyo mutyumarhati
ce_text: raṇeṣu kadanaṃ kṛtvā jñātibhiḥ parivāritaḥ / tīkṣṇaiḥ śastraiḥ suvikliṣṭaḥ kṣatriyo mṛtyum arhati

vulgate_text: sarvatejomayaṃ divyaṃ vimānavaramāsthitam / u---gacchantaṃ sthānaṃ senāpatiṃ śubham
ce_text: sarvatejomayaṃ divyaṃ vimānavaram āsthitam / upary upari gacchantaṃ svaṃ vai senāpatiṃ prabhum

vulgate_text: sa daṣṭvāpari gacchantaṃ senāpatimudāradhīḥ śūrasthānamanuprāptaṃ sudevaṃ nāma nāmataḥ / ṛddhiṃ dṛṣṭvā sudevasya vismitaḥ prāha vāsavam / ambarīpa uvāca
ce_text: sa dṛṣṭvopari gacchantaṃ senāpatim udāradhīḥ / ṛddhiṃ dṛṣṭvā sudevasya vismitaḥ prāha vāsavam

vulgate_text: de--ja sudevo'yaṃ mama senāpatiḥ purā āsādyodhaḥ praśāntātmā so'yaṃ kasmādatīva mām / vimānaṃ sūryasaṅkāśamāsthito modate divi
ce_text: devarāja sudevo 'yaṃ mama senāpatiḥ purā / āsīd yodhaḥ praśāntātmā so 'yaṃ kasmād atīva mām / śakra uvāca / aiśvaryam īdṛśaṃ prāptaḥ sarvadevaiḥ sudurlabham / yad anena kṛtaṃ karma pratyakṣaṃ te mahīpate / purā pālayataḥ samyak pṛthivīṃ dharmato nṛpa / śatravo nirjitāḥ sarve ye tavāhitakāriṇaḥ / saṃdhamo vidhamaś caiva sudhamaś ca mahābalaḥ / rākṣasā durjayā loke trayas te yuddhadurmadāḥ / putrās te śataśṛṅgasya rākṣasasya mahīpateḥ / atha tasmiñ śubhe kāle tava yajñaṃ vitanvataḥ / aśvamedhaṃ mahāyāgaṃ devānāṃ hitakāmyayā / tasya te khalu vighnārtham āgatā rākṣasās trayaḥ / koṭīśataparīvārāṃ rākṣasānāṃ mahācamūm / parigṛhya tataḥ sarvāḥ prajā bandīkṛtās tava / vihvalāś ca prajāḥ sarvāḥ sarve ca tava sainikāḥ / nirākṛtas tvayā cāsīt sudevaḥ sainyanāyakaḥ / tatrāmātyavacaḥ śrutvā nirastaḥ sarvakarmasu / śrutvā teṣāṃ vaco bhūyaḥ sopadhaṃ vasudhādhipa / sarvasainyasamāyuktaḥ sudevaḥ preritas tvayā / rākṣasānāṃ vadhārthāya durjayānāṃ narādhipa / nājitvā rākṣasīṃ senāṃ punarāgamanaṃ tava / bandīmokṣam akṛtvā ca na cāgamanam iṣyate / sudevas tad vacaḥ śrutvā prasthānam akaron nṛpa / saṃprāptaś ca sa taṃ deśaṃ yatra bandīkṛtāḥ prajāḥ / paśyati sma mahāghorāṃ rākṣasānāṃ mahācamūm / dṛṣṭvā saṃcintayām āsa sudevo vāhinīpatiḥ / neyaṃ śakyā camūr jetum api sendraiḥ surāsuraiḥ / nāmbarīṣaḥ kalām ekām eṣāṃ kṣapayituṃ kṣamaḥ / divyāstrabalabhūyiṣṭhaḥ kim ahaṃ punar īdṛśaḥ / tataḥ senāṃ punaḥ sarvāṃ preṣayām āsa pārthiva / yatra tvaṃ sahitaḥ sarvair mantribhiḥ sopadhair nṛpa / tato rudraṃ mahādevaṃ prapanno jagataḥ patim / śmaśānanilayaṃ devaṃ tuṣṭāva vṛṣabhadhvajam / stutvā śastraṃ samādāya svaśiraś chettum udyataḥ / kāruṇyād devadevena gṛhītas tasya dakṣiṇaḥ / sa pāṇiḥ saha śastreṇa dṛṣṭvā cedam uvāca ha / kim idaṃ sāhasaṃ putra kartukāmo vadasva me / sa uvāca mahādevaṃ śirasā tv avanīṃ gataḥ / bhagavan vāhinīm enāṃ rākṣasānāṃ sureśvara / aśakto 'haṃ raṇe jetuṃ tasmāt tyakṣyāmi jīvitam / gatir bhava mahādeva mamārtasya jagatpate / nāgantavyam ajitvā ca mām āha jagatīpatiḥ / ambarīṣo mahādeva kṣāritaḥ sacivaiḥ saha / tam uvāca mahādevaḥ sudevaṃ patitaṃ kṣitau / adhomukhaṃ mahātmānaṃ sattvānāṃ hitakāmyayā / dhanurvedaṃ samāhūya sagaṇaṃ sahavigraham / rathanāgāśvakalilaṃ divyāstrasamalaṃkṛtam / rathaṃ ca sumahābhāgaṃ yena tat tripuraṃ hatam / dhanuḥ pinākaṃ khaḍgaṃ ca raudram astraṃ ca śaṃkaraḥ / nijaghānāsurān sarvān yena devas triyambakaḥ / uvāca ca mahādevaḥ sudevaṃ vāhinīpatim / rathād asmāt sudeva tvaṃ durjayas tu surāsuraiḥ / māyayā mohito bhūmau na padaṃ kartum arhasi / atrasthas tridaśān sarvāñ jeṣyase sarvadānavān / rākṣasāś ca piśācāś ca na śaktā draṣṭum īdṛśam / rathaṃ sūryasahasrābhaṃ kim u yoddhuṃ tvayā saha / sa jitvā rākṣasān sarvān kṛtvā bandīvimokṣaṇam / ghātayitvā ca tān sarvān bāhuyuddhe tv ayaṃ hataḥ / vidhamaṃ prāpya bhūpāla vidhamaś ca nipātitaḥ

vulgate_text: [saṅkhyāsamayavistīrṇamabhijātodbhavaṃ bahu ] āvedhādyacca rudhiraṃ saṃgrāme sravate bhuvi / sā'sya pūrṇāhutirhotraiḥ samṛddhā sarvakāmadhuk
ce_text: āvegād yat tu rudhiraṃ saṃgrāme syandate bhuvi / sāsya pūrṇāhutir hotre samṛddhā sarvakāmadhuk

vulgate_text: udgātā tatra saṃgrāme trisāmā dundubhirnṛpa brahmasve hriyamāṇe tu tyaktvā yuddhe priyāṃ tanum / ātmānaṃ yūpamucchritya sa yajño'nantadakṣiṇaḥ
ce_text: brāhmaṇārthe samutpanne yo 'bhiniḥsṛtya yudhyate / ātmānaṃ yūpam ucchritya sa yajño 'nantadakṣiṇaḥ

vulgate_text: yasya bhayato vyūhe bhavatyākāśamagrataḥ / sāsya vedistadā yajñairnityaṃ vyūhāstrayo'gnayaḥ
ce_text: yadā tūbhayato vyūho bhavaty ākāśam agrataḥ / sāsya vedī tathā yajñe nityaṃ vedās trayo 'gnayaḥ

vulgate_text: [agrataḥ puruṣānīkaṃ śaktaṃ cāpi kulodbhavam ] āvāsastoyavānmārgaḥ paryākāśaḥ praśasyate
ce_text: āvāsas toyavān durgaḥ paryākāśaḥ praśasyate / pareṣām upasarpāṇāṃ pratiṣedhas tathā bhavet

vulgate_text: bahubhirguṇajātaiśca ye yuddhakuśalā janāḥ [upanyāso bhavettatra balānāṃ nātidūrataḥ ]
ce_text: ākāśaṃ tu vanābhyāśe manyante guṇavattaram / bahubhir guṇajātais tu ye yuddhakuśalā janāḥ

vulgate_text: [na sannipāte pradaraṃ vadhaṃ vā kuryurīdṛśāḥ ] ātmānaṃ ca svapakṣaṃ ca pālayanhanti saṃyuge
ce_text: ātmānaṃ ca svapakṣaṃ ca palāyan hanti saṃyuge / dravyanāśo vadho 'kīrtir ayaśaś ca palāyane

vulgate_text: pratidhvastoṣṭhadantasya nyastasarvāyudhasya ca hitvā palāyamānasya sahāyānprāṇasaṃśaye / amitrairavaruddhasya dviṣatāmastu naḥ sadā
ce_text: hitvā palāyamānasya sahāyān prāṇasaṃśaye / amitrair anubaddhasya dviṣatām astu nas tathā

vulgate_text: udbandhā iva sugrīvā vinatāvihagā iva / piṇḍaśīrṣātivakrāśca pṛṣadaṃśamukhāstathā
ce_text: udvṛttāś caiva sugrīvā vinatā vihagā iva / piṇḍaśīrṣāhivaktrāś ca vṛṣadaṃśamukhā iva

vulgate_text: jayinyā yāni rūpāṇi bhavanti bharatarṣabha / pṛtanāyāḥ praśastāni tāni vakṣyāmi sarvaśaḥ
ce_text: bhīṣma uvāca / jaitryā vā yāni rūpāṇi bhavanti puruṣarṣabha / pṛtanāyāḥ praśastāni tāni vakṣyāmi sarvaśaḥ

vulgate_text: saṃsarpeṇa hi senāyā bhayaṃ bhīrūnprabādhate / vajrādiya prajvalitādiyaṃ svitkṣapayiṣyati
ce_text: saṃsarpaṇād dhi senāyā bhayaṃ bhīrūn prabādhate / vajrād iva prajvalitād iyaṃ kva nu patiṣyati

vulgate_text: na me priyā ye sma hatāḥ saṃprahṛṣṭāḥ pare'pi ca / na ca katthanamevāgryamucyamānaṃ punaḥ punaḥ
ce_text: na me priyaṃ yat sa hataḥ saṃprāhaivaṃ puro vacaḥ / na cakartha ca me vākyam ucyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ

vulgate_text: saṃpradhārya sahāmātyairmantravidbhirmahātmabhiḥ upekṣyamāṇo vijñāto hṛdayenāparājitaḥ / athāsya praharetkāle vidhervittalito yadā
ce_text: saṃpradhārya sahāmātyair mantravidbhir mahātmabhiḥ / upekṣamāṇo 'vajñāte hṛdayenāparājitaḥ

vulgate_text: dīrghakālamapīkṣetta nigrāhyā eva śatravaḥ / kālakāṅgī ca yuktaḥ sannupāsīta śacīpate
ce_text: dīrghakālam api kṣāntvā vihanyād eva śātravān / kālākāṅkṣī yāmayec ca yathā visrambham āpnuyuḥ

vulgate_text: tathā priyaṃ ca vaktavyaṃ yathā visrambhamāpnuyāt na sadyo'rīnvihanyācca draṣṭavyo vijayo dhruvaḥ / bhūyaḥ śalyaṃ ghaṭayati navaṃ ca kurute vraṇam
ce_text: na sadyo 'rīn vinirhanyād dṛṣṭasya vijayo 'jvaraḥ / na yaḥ śalyaṃ ghaṭṭayati navaṃ ca kurute vraṇam

vulgate_text: aujasyaṃ janayedeva saṃgṛhṇansādhusaṃmatam / kālena sādhayetkṛtyamaprāpto na hi pīḍayet

vulgate_text: tāṃ buddhimanuvijñāya tvamevainānparityaja / anarthāścārtharūpeṇa hyarthāścānartharūpiṇaḥ
ce_text: tāṃ buddhim upajijñāsus tvam evainān parityaja / anarthāṃś cārtharūpeṇa arthāṃś cānartharūpataḥ

vulgate_text: bravītu bhagavānnītimabhipanno'smyadhīhi bho / amogha eva me'dyāstu tvayā saha samāgamaḥ / muniruvāca
ce_text: munir uvāca / anāgatam atītaṃ ca yathā tathyaviniścayāt / nānuśocasi kausalya sarvārtheṣu tathā bhava

vulgate_text: dātumarhati te vittaṃ vaidehaḥ satyavikramaḥ / pramāṇaṃ sarvabhūteṣu pragrahaṃ ca gamiṣyasi
ce_text: pramāṇaṃ sarvabhūteṣu pragrahaṃ ca gamiṣyasi / tataḥ sahāyān sotsāhāṃl lapsyase 'vyasanāñ śucīn

vulgate_text: yadyevaṃ pratiṣeddhavyo yadyupekṣaṇamarhati sadaiva rājaśārdūla viduṣā hitamicchatā / na jātu vivṛtaḥ kāryaḥ śatruḥ sunayamicchatā
ce_text: yady eva pratiṣeddhavyo yady upekṣaṇam arhati / na jātu vivṛtaḥ kāryaḥ śatrur vinayam icchatā

vulgate_text: vasasva puramāmitraṃ viṣaye mitrasaṃmataḥ / bhajasva śvetakākīyairmitradharmamanathaikaiḥ
ce_text: vasasva paramāmitraviṣaye prājñasaṃmate / bhajasva śvetakākīyair mitrādhamam anarthakaiḥ

vulgate_text: dharmātmanāṃ kvacilloke nānyāsti gatirīdṛśī tadā rājaputro'yaṃ satāṃ mārgamanuṣṭhitaḥ / asaṃgṛhītastvevaiṣa tvayā dharmapurogamaḥ
ce_text: kṛtātmā rājaputro 'yaṃ satāṃ mārgam anuṣṭhitaḥ / susaṃgṛhītas tv evaiṣa tvayā dharmapurogamaḥ / saṃsevyamānaḥ śatrūṃs te gṛhṇīyān mahato gaṇān

vulgate_text: bhede gaṇā vinaśyurhi bhinnāstu sujayāḥ paraiḥ / tasmātsaṃghātayogena prayaterangaṇāḥ sadā
ce_text: bhedād gaṇā vinaśyanti bhinnāḥ sūpajapāḥ paraiḥ / tasmāt saṃghātayogeṣu prayateran gaṇāḥ sadā

vulgate_text: yena prīṇanti pitarastena prītaḥ prajāpatiḥ / prīṇāti jananīyena pṛthivī tena pūjitā
ce_text: yena prītāś ca pitaras tena prītaḥ pitāmahaḥ / prīṇāti mātaraṃ yena pṛthivī tena pūjitā

vulgate_text: ṛṣayaśca hi devāśca prīyante pitṛbhiḥ saha / pūjyamāneṣu guruṣu tasmātpūjyatamo guruḥ
ce_text: yena prīṇāty upādhyāyaṃ tena syād brahma pūjitam / mātṛtaḥ pitṛtaś caiva tasmāt pūjyatamo guruḥ / ṛṣayaś ca hi devāś ca prīyante pitṛbhiḥ saha

vulgate_text: bhṛto bhartāraṃ yo na vibhirti putraḥ svayonijaḥ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca / tasya pāpaṃ bhrūṇahatyāviṣiṣṭaṃ tasmānnānyaḥ pāpakṛdasti loke
ce_text: upādhyāyaṃ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca; ye 'bhidruhyanti manasā karmaṇā vā / teṣāṃ pāpaṃ bhrūṇahatyāviśiṣṭaṃ; tasmān nānyaḥ pāpakṛd asti loke

vulgate_text: śrutiṃ dharmaṃ vadantyanye mānānyāhuḥ pare janāḥ / na ca taṃ svabhyasūyāmo na hi sarvaṃ vidhīyate
ce_text: śrutidharma iti hy eke nety āhur apare janāḥ / na tu tat pratyasūyāmo na hi sarvaṃ vidhīyate

vulgate_text: ye'nye vā'pyanṛtaṃ kuryuḥ kuryādeva vicāraṇam / śreyastatrānṛtaṃ vaktuṃ satyāditi vicāritam
ce_text: śreyas tatrānṛtaṃ vaktuṃ satyād iti vicāritam / yaḥ pāpaiḥ saha saṃbandhān mucyate śapathād iti

vulgate_text: yaḥ pāpaiḥ saha saṃbandhānmucyate śapathādapi na ca tebhyo dhanaṃ dadyācchakye sati kathaṃcana / pāpebhyo hi dhanaṃ dattaṃ dātāramapi pīḍayet
ce_text: na ca tebhyo dhanaṃ deyaṃ śakye sati kathaṃ cana / pāpebhyo hi dhanaṃ dattaṃ dātāram api pīḍayet

vulgate_text: yaḥ kaściddharmasamayātpracyuto dharmajīvanaḥ / daṇḍenaiva sa hantavyastaṃ panthānaṃ samāśritaḥ
ce_text: pratiśrutya tu dātavyaṃ śvaḥkāryas tu balātkṛtaḥ / yaḥ kaś cid dharmasamayāt pracyuto 'dharmam āsthitaḥ

vulgate_text: cyutaḥ sadaiva dharmebhyo dhanavāndharmamāśritaḥ / kathaṃ svadharmamutsṛjya tamicchedupajīvitum
ce_text: śaṭhaḥ svadharmam utsṛjya tam icched upajīvitum / sarvopāyair nihantavyaḥ pāpo nikṛtijīvanaḥ

vulgate_text: avivāhyā hyasaṃbhojyā nikṛtyā nirayaṃ gatāḥ cyutā devamanuṣyebhyo yathā pretāstathaiva te / [niryajñāstapasā hīnā mā sma taiḥ saha saṃgamaḥ ]
ce_text: cyutā devamanuṣyebhyo yathā pretās tathaiva te / dhanādānād duḥkhataraṃ jīvitād viprayojanam

vulgate_text: pratyāhurnocyamānā ye na hiṃsanti ca hiṃsitāḥ / prayacchanti na yācante durgāṇyatitaranti te
ce_text: ye na mānitam icchanti mānayanti ca ye param / mānyamānā na manyante durgāṇy atitaranti te

vulgate_text: lokarakṣārthamutpannamadityāṃ kaśyapātmajam / devamindraṃ namasyanti durgāṇyatitaranti te
ce_text: sarvān devān namasyanti sarvān dharmāṃś ca śṛṇvate / ye śraddadhānā dāntāś ca durgāṇy atitaranti te

vulgate_text: tīkṣṇā iti vayaṃ khyātā bhavantaṃ jñāpayāmahe / mṛdupūrvaṃ praśādhi tvaṃ śreyaścādhigamiṣyasi / bhīṣma uvāca
ce_text: tīkṣṇā vayam iti khyātā bhavato jñāpayāmahe / mṛdupūrvaṃ ghātinas te śreyaś cādhigamiṣyati

vulgate_text: idaṃ tasyedṛśaṃ karma kiṃ tena na kṛtaṃ bhavet / śrutaśca svāminā pūrvaṃ yādṛśo naiva tādṛśaḥ
ce_text: idaṃ cāsyedṛśaṃ karma vāllabhyena tu rakṣyate / śrutaś ca svāminā pūrvaṃ yādṛśo naiṣa tādṛśaḥ

vulgate_text: kāryārthaṃ bhojanādyeṣu vrateṣu kṛtavāñśramam / yadi vipratyayo hyeṣa tadidaṃ darśayām te

vulgate_text: sa hatvā bhakṣayitvā ca tamuṣṭraṃ jambukastadā / vigate vātavarpe tu niścakrāma guhodarāt

ce_text: aruṣyan kruśyamānasya sukṛtaṃ nāma vindati / duṣkṛtaṃ cātmano marṣī ruṣyaty evāpamārṣṭi vai

ce_text: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca / pitāmaha mahāprājña saṃśayo me mahān ayam / sa cchettavyas tvayā rājan bhavān kulakaro hi naḥ

vulgate_text: sa munistasya vijñāya bhāvajño bhayakāraṇam rutajñaḥ sarvasatvānāṃ tamaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ ] / muniruvāca

vulgate_text: pra--karaṭaḥ prāṃśuḥ pajhī vitatakumbhakaḥ / su--ṇo mahākāyo meghagambhīraniḥ svanaḥ

ce_text: tato rudhiratarṣeṇa balinā śarabho 'nvitaḥ / iyeṣa taṃ muniṃ hantum akṛtajñaḥ śvayonijaḥ

ce_text: siṃho 'tibalasaṃyukto bhūyaḥ śarabhatāṃ gataḥ / mayā snehaparītena na vimṛṣṭaḥ kulānvayaḥ

vulgate_text: nāticchettā svayaṃkārī śraddhāluḥ sukhadarśanaḥ / ārtahastaprado nityamāptāmātyo naye rataḥ

ce_text: tasmād rājā pragṛhītaḥ pareṣu; mūlaṃ lakṣmyāḥ sarvato 'bhyādadīta / dīrghaṃ kālam api saṃpīḍyamāno; vidyutsaṃpātam iva mānorjitaḥ syāt

vulgate_text: sunītijaṃ yasya vidhānajaṃ sukhaṃ dharmapraṇītaṃ vidhivatprasiddhyati / na nindyate tasya gatirmahīpate sa vindate rājyasukhaṃ hyanuttamam

ce_text: atra sādhv anukampāṃ vai kartum arhasi kevalam / saṃkaro na bhaved atra yathā vai tad vidhīyatām

ce_text: atra sādhv anukampāṃ vai kartum arhasi kevalam / saṃkaro na bhaved atra yathā vai tad vidhīyatām

ce_text: bhūyaḥ sa bhagavān dhyātvā ciraṃ śūlavarāyudhaḥ / tasya tasya nikāyasya cakāraikaikam īśaram

vulgate_text: brahmaviṣṇvindrasahitaḥ sarvaiśca sasurāsuraiḥ lokasandhāraṇārthaṃ ca lokasaṃkaranāśanam / ātmānamātmānā daṇḍaṃ sasṛje devasattamaḥ
ce_text: tataḥ sa bhagavān dhyātvā ciraṃ śūlajaṭādharaḥ / ātmānam ātmanā daṇḍam asṛjad devasattamaḥ

ce_text: vyaṅgatvaṃ ca śarīrasya vadho vā nālpakāraṇāt / śarīrapīḍās tās tās tu dehatyāgo vivāsanam

vulgate_text: ityeṣa daṇḍo vyākhyātastathauṣadhyastathāpare / bhūmipālo yathānyāyaṃ vartetānena dharmavit / bhīṣma uvāca
ce_text: bhīṣma uvāca / śṛṇu kauravya yo daṇḍo vyavahāryo yathā ca saḥ / yasmin hi sarvam āyattaṃ sa daṇḍa iha kevalaḥ

vulgate_text: itīdaṃ vasuhomasya yo''tmavāñśṛṇuyānmatam / śrutvā samyakpravarteta sa lokānāpnuyānnṛpaḥ
ce_text: bhīṣma uvāca / itīdaṃ vasuhomasya śṛṇuyād yo mataṃ naraḥ / śrutvā ca samyag varteta sa kāmān āpnuyān nṛpaḥ

ce_text: śreṣṭhabuddhis trivargasya yad ayaṃ prāpnuyāt kṣaṇāt / buddhyā budhyed ihārthe na tad ahnā tu nikṛṣṭayā

ce_text: adharmo dharma iti ha yo 'jñānād ācared iha / taṃ cāpi prathitaṃ loke kathaṃ rājā nivartayet

ce_text: kathaṃ nu prāpyate śīlaṃ śrotum icchāmi bhārata / kiṃlakṣaṇaṃ ca tat proktaṃ brūhi me vadatāṃ vara

vulgate_text: brāhmaṇastvabravīdrājanyasminkāle kṣaṇo bhavet / tadopādeṣṭumicchāmi yadi kāryāntaraṃ bhavet

ce_text: te visrabdhāḥ prabhāṣante saṃyacchanti ca māṃ sadā / te mā kavyapade saktaṃ śuśrūṣum anasūyakam

ce_text: uṣitāsmi sukhaṃ vīra tvayi satyaparākrame / tvayā tyaktā gamiṣyāmi balaṃ yatra tato hy aham

ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / yadīcchasi śriyaṃ tāta yādṛśīṃ tāṃ yudhiṣṭhire / viśiṣṭāṃ vā naravyāghra śīlavān bhava putraka

ce_text: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca / nāmṛtasyeva paryāptir mamāsti bruvati tvayi / tasmāt kathaya bhūyas tvaṃ dharmam eva pitāmaha

vulgate_text: pravaktuṃ notsahe pṛṣṭo dharmametaṃ yudhiṣṭhira dharmo hyaṇīyānvacanādvuddheśca bharatarṣabha / śrutvaupamyaṃ sadācāraiḥ sādhurbhavati sa kvacit

vulgate_text: nārada uvāca / bandhutvādathavā sakhyācchālmale nātra saṃśayaḥ / kasmāttvāṃ rakṣate nityaṃ bhīmaḥ sarvatrago'nilaḥ
ce_text: bandhutvād atha vā sakhyāc chalmale nātra saṃśayaḥ / pālayaty eva satataṃ bhīmaḥ sarvatrago 'nilaḥ

vulgate_text: na me vāyuḥ sakhā brahmanna bandhurmama nārada / ciraṃ me prīyate naiva yena māṃ rakṣate'nilaḥ
ce_text: śalmalir uvāca / na me vāyuḥ sakhā brahman na bandhur na ca me suhṛt / parameṣṭhī tathā naiva yena rakṣati mānilaḥ

vulgate_text: āgacchanparuṣo vāyurmayā viṣṭambhito balāt / bhañjandrumānparvatāṃśca yaccānyatsthāṇujaṅgamam
ce_text: āgacchan paramo vāyur mayā viṣṭambhito balāt / rujan drumān parvatāṃś ca yac cānyad api kiṃ cana

vulgate_text: te'pi jānanti vāyośca balamātmana eva ca / tasmātte nāvamanyante śvasanaṃ tarusattamāḥ
ce_text: taiś cāpi naivaṃ durbuddhe kṣipto vāyuḥ kṛtātmabhiḥ / te hi jānanti vāyoś ca balam ātmana eva ca

vulgate_text: tvaṃ tu mohānna jānīpe vāyorbalamanantakam / evaṃ tasmādgamiṣyāmi sakāśaṃ mātariśvanaḥ
ce_text: tasmāt te vai namasyanti śvasanaṃ drumasattamāḥ / tvaṃ tu mohān na jānīṣe vāyor balam anantakam

vulgate_text: jānāmi tvāmahaṃ vāyo sarvaprāṇabhṛtāṃ varam / variṣṭhaṃ ca gariṣṭhaṃ ca sarvalokeśvaraṃ prabhum / bhīṣma uvāca
ce_text: bhīṣma uvāca / atrāpy udāharantīmam itihāsaṃ purātanam / saṃvādaṃ bharataśreṣṭha śalmaleḥ pavanasya ca

vulgate_text: tasya viśramaṇādeva prasādau matkṛtastava / abhūttasya prasādāttvāṃ na bhajyāmi drumādham
ce_text: tasya viśramaṇād eva prasādo yaḥ kṛtas tava / rakṣyase tena durbuddhe nātmavīryād drumādhama

vulgate_text: dharmavaitaṃsikāḥ kṣudrā muṣṇanti dhvajino jagat kurvate ca bahūnmārgāṃstānhetubalamāśritāḥ / sarvamārgānvilumpanti lobhajñāneṣvavasthitāḥ
ce_text: kurvate ca bahūn mārgāṃs tāṃs tān hetubalāśritāḥ / sarvaṃ mārgaṃ vilumpanti lobhājñāneṣu niṣṭhitāḥ

vulgate_text: na trāsino na capalā na raudrāḥ satpathe sthitāḥ / te sevyāḥ sādhubhirnityamasādhūṃśca vivarjayet
ce_text: na teṣāṃ bhidyate vṛttaṃ yat purā sādhubhiḥ kṛtam / na trāsino na capalā na raudrāḥ satpathe sthitāḥ

vulgate_text: etasya vā pravṛtteśca vṛddhyādīnyāṃśca pṛcchasi / vistareṇa mahārāja śṛṇu tacca viśeṣataḥ
ce_text: etayā yā pravṛttiś ca vṛddhyādīn yāṃś ca pṛcchasi / vistareṇa mahābāho śṛṇu tac ca viśāṃ pate

vulgate_text: kāmaṃ krādhaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca darpaṃ stambhaṃ vikatthanam / roṣamīrṣyāvamānaṃ ca naiva dānto niṣevate
ce_text: kāmaḥ krodhaś ca lobhaś ca darpaḥ stambho vikatthanam / moha īrṣyāvamānaś cety etad dānto na sevate

vulgate_text: śakunīnāmivākāśe matsyānāṃmiva codake / yathā gatirna dṛśyeta tathā tasya sa saṃśayaḥ
ce_text: śakunīnām ivākāśe jale vāricarasya vā / yathā gatir na dṛśyeta tathā tasya na saṃśayaḥ

vulgate_text: tapasaiva sasarjānnaṃ phalamūlāni yāni ca / trīm̐llokāṃstapasā siddhāḥ paśyanti susamāhitāḥ
ce_text: tapaso hy ānupūrvyeṇa phalamūlānilāśanāḥ / trīṃl lokāṃs tapasā siddhāḥ paśyanti susamāhitāḥ

vulgate_text: yaddurāpaṃ durārādhyaṃ durādharṣaṃ durutsaham tatsarvaṃ tapasā śakyaṃ tapo hi duratikramam / aiśvaryamṛṣayaḥ prāptāstapasaiva na saṃśayaḥ
ce_text: yad durāpaṃ durāmnāyaṃ durādharṣaṃ durutsaham / sarvaṃ tat tapasā śakyaṃ tapo hi duratikramam

vulgate_text: indriyāṇīha rakṣanti viprarṣipitṛdevatāḥ / tasmādarthe ca dharme ca tapo nānaśanātparam
ce_text: indriyāṇīha rakṣanti dhanadhānyābhiguptaye / tasmād arthe ca dharme ca tapo nānaśanāt param

vulgate_text: prāpyate ca yathā satyaṃ tacca vettumihārhasi / satyaṃ trayodaśāvadhaṃ sarvalokeṣu bhārata
ce_text: prāpyate hi yathā satyaṃ tac ca śrotuṃ tvam arhasi / satyaṃ trayodaśavidhaṃ sarvalokeṣu bhārata

vulgate_text: kalyāṇaṃ rute bāḍhaṃ dhīmānna glāyate kvacit / praśāntavāṅbhanā nityaṃ hrīstu dharmādavāpyate
ce_text: kalyāṇaṃ kurute gāḍhaṃ hrīmān na ślāghate kva cit / praśāntavāṅmanā nityaṃ hrīs tu dharmād avāpyate

vulgate_text: dhyānaṃ ca śāṭhyamityuktaṃ maunenaitadavāpyate āryatā nāma bhūtānāṃ yaḥ karoti prayatnataḥ / śubhaṃ karma nirākāro vītarāgastathaiva ca
ce_text: āryatā nāma bhūtānāṃ yaḥ karoti prayatnataḥ / śubhaṃ karma nirākāro vītarāgatvam eva ca

vulgate_text: eteṣāmudayaṃ sthānaṃ kṣayaṃ ca pṛthivīpate hanta te kathayiṣyāmi krodhasyotpattimāditaḥ / yathātattvaṃ kṣitipate tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu
ce_text: eteṣām udayaṃ sthānaṃ kṣayaṃ ca puruṣottama / hanta te vartayiṣyāmi tan me nigadataḥ śṛṇu

vulgate_text: saṃkalpājjāyate kāmaḥ sevyamāno vivardhate / yadā prājño viramate tadā sadyaḥ praṇaśyati
ce_text: saṃkalpāj jāyate kāmaḥ sevyamāno vivardhate / avadyadarśanād vyeti tattvajñānāc ca dhīmatām

vulgate_text: [parāmūyā krodhalobhāvantarā pratimucyate dayayā sarvabhūtānāṃ nirvedādvinivartate ] / avadyadarśanādeti tattvajñānācca naśyati
ce_text: saṃkalpāj jāyate kāmaḥ sevyamāno vivardhate / avadyadarśanād vyeti tattvajñānāc ca dhīmatām

vulgate_text: viruddhānīha śāstrāṇi ye paśyanti kurūdvaha / vidhitsā jāyate teṣāṃ tattvajñānānnivartate
ce_text: viruddhāni hi śāstrāṇi paśyantīhālpabuddhayaḥ / vivitsā jāyate tatra tattvajñānān nivartate

vulgate_text: anyebhyo vimalācārā yajante guṇataḥ sadā yasya traivārpikaṃ bhaktaṃ paryāptaṃ bhṛtyavṛttaye / adhikaṃ cāpi vidyeta sa somaṃ pātumarhati
ce_text: yasya traivārṣikaṃ bhaktaṃ paryāptaṃ bhṛtyavṛttaye / adhikaṃ vāpi vidyeta sa somaṃ pātum arhati

vulgate_text: adātṛbhyo haredvittaṃ vikhyāpya nṛpatiḥ sadā / tathaivācarato dharmo nṛpateḥ syādathākhilaḥ
ce_text: adātṛbhyo haren nityaṃ vyākhyāpya nṛpatiḥ prabho / tathā hy ācarato dharmo nṛpateḥ syād athākhilaḥ

vulgate_text: prabhuḥ prathamakalpasya yo'nukalpena vartate / sa nāpnoti phalaṃ tasya pretya ceha ca durmatiḥ
ce_text: prabhuḥ prathamakalpasya yo 'nukalpena vartate / na sāṃparāyikaṃ tasya durmater vidyate phalam

vulgate_text: na brāhmaṇo vedayīta kiṃcidrājani dharmavit avidyāvedanādvidyātsvavīryaṃ vīryavattaram / tasmādrājñaḥ sadā tejo duḥsahaṃ brahmavādinām
ce_text: tasmād rājñā sadā tejo duḥsahaṃ brahmavādinām / mantā śāstā vidhātā ca brāhmaṇo deva ucyate / tasmin nākuśalaṃ brūyān na śuktām īrayed giram

vulgate_text: narake nipatantyete juhvānāḥ savanasya tat / tasmādvaitānakuśalo hotā syādvedapāragaḥ
ce_text: na vai kanyā na yuvatir nāmantro na ca bāliśaḥ / pariveṣṭāgnihotrasya bhaven nāsaṃskṛtas tathā / narake nipatanty ete juhvānāḥ sa ca yasya tat

vulgate_text: abhāryī śayane vibhracchūdraṃ vṛddhaṃ ca vai dvijaḥ abrāhmaṇaṃ bhanyamānastṛṇeṣvāsīta pṛṣṭhataḥ / tathā saṃśudhyate rājañśṛṇu cātra vaco mama
ce_text: anāryāṃ śayane bibhrad ujjhan bibhrac ca yo dvijām / abrāhmaṇo manyamānas tṛṇeṣv āsīta pṛṣṭhataḥ / tathā sa śudhyate rājañ śṛṇu cātra vaco mama

vulgate_text: na narmayuktamatṛtaṃ hinasti na strīṣu rājanna vivāhakāle / prāṇātyaye sarvadhanāpahāre pañcānṛtānyāhurapātakāni
ce_text: na narmayuktaṃ vacanaṃ hinasti; na strīṣu rājan na vivāhakāle / na gurvarthe nātmano jīvitārthe; pañcānṛtāny āhur apātakāni

vulgate_text: gobrāhmaṇahitārthaṃ ca varṇānāṃ saṃkareṣu ca / vaiśyo gṛhṇīta śastrāṇi paritrāṇārthamātmanaḥ
ce_text: gobrāhmaṇahitārthaṃ ca varṇānāṃ saṃkareṣu ca / gṛhṇīyāt tu dhanur vaiśyaḥ paritrāṇāya cātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: surāpo brahmahā caiva gurutalpagatastathā / acireṇa mahārāja patito vai bhavatyuta
ce_text: patitaiḥ saṃprayogāc ca brāhmaṇair yonitas tathā / acireṇa mahārāja tādṛśo vai bhavaty uta

vulgate_text: astenaṃ stena ityuktvā dviguṇaṃ pāpamāpnuyāt tribhāgaṃ brahmahatyāyāḥ kanyāṃ prāpnoti duṣyati / yastu dūṣayitā tasyāḥ śeṣaṃ prāpnoti pāpmanaḥ
ce_text: tribhāgaṃ brahmahatyāyāḥ kanyā prāpnoti duṣyatī / yas tu dūṣayitā tasyāḥ śeṣaṃ prāpnoti kilbiṣam

vulgate_text: aśvamedhena vā'pīṣṭvā athavā gosavena vā / marutsomena vā samyagiha pretya ca pūjyate
ce_text: brāhmaṇārthe 'pi vā prāṇān saṃtyajet tena śudhyati / aśvamedhena vāpīṣṭvā gomedhenāpi vā punaḥ / agniṣṭomena vā samyag iha pretya ca pūyate

vulgate_text: tathaiva dvādaśasamāḥ kāpotaṃ dharmamācaret / ekakālaṃ caredbhaikṣaṃ svakarmodāharañjane
ce_text: tathaiva dvādaśa samāḥ kapālī brahmahā bhavet / brahmacārī cared bhaikṣaṃ svakarmodāharan muniḥ

vulgate_text: evaṃ vā tapasā yukto brahmahā savanī bhavet / evaṃ garbhamavijñātamātreyīṃ vā nipātayet
ce_text: evaṃ vā tapasā yukto brahmahā savanī bhavet / evaṃ vā garbham ajñātā cātreyīṃ yo 'bhigacchati / dviguṇā brahmahatyā vai ātreyīvyasane bhavet

vulgate_text: uktaḥ paśuvadhe doṣo rājanprāṇinipātanāt anasthikeṣu gomūtraṃ pānamekaṃ pracakṣate / prāyaścittānyathānyāni pravakṣyāmyanupūrvaśaḥ
ce_text: uktaḥ paśusamo dharmo rājan prāṇinipātanāt / prāyaścittāny athānyāni pravakṣyāmy anupūrvaśaḥ

vulgate_text: apakhyahaṃ pibeduṣṇāḥ saṃyatātmā jitendriyaḥ / apaḥ pītvā tu sa punarvāyubhakṣo bhaventryaham
ce_text: brāhmaṇasya surāpasya gandham āghrāya somapaḥ / apas tryahaṃ pibed uṣṇās tryaham uṣṇaṃ payaḥ pibet / tryaham uṣṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ pītvā vāyubhakṣo bhavet tryaham

vulgate_text: chinne ca kārmuke rājanprakṣīṇeṣu śareṣu ca / khaṅgena śakyate yoddhumātmānaṃ parirakṣitum
ce_text: viśīrṇe kārmuke rājan prakṣīṇeṣu ca vājiṣu / khaḍgena śakyate yuddhe sādhv ātmā parirakṣitum

vulgate_text: marīciṃ bhṛgumatriṃ ca pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum / vasiṣṭhāṅgirasau cobhau bharadvājaṃ tathaiva ca
ce_text: marīcim ṛṣim atriṃ ca pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum / vasiṣṭhāṅgirasau cobhau rudraṃ ca prabhum īśvaram

vulgate_text: na jagmuḥ saṃvidaṃ taiśca darpādasurasattamāḥ / atha vai bhagavānbrahmā sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ
ce_text: na priyaṃ nāpy anukrośaṃ cakrur bhūteṣu bhārata / trīn upāyān atikramya daṇḍena rurudhuḥ prajāḥ / na jagmuḥ saṃvidaṃ taiś ca darpād asurasattamāḥ

vulgate_text: lonītpalasavarṇābhaṃ tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraṃ kṛśodaram / prāṃśumuddharṣaṇaṃ cāpi tathaiva hyamitaujasam
ce_text: nīlotpalasavarṇābhaṃ tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraṃ kṛśodaram / prāṃśu durdarśanaṃ caivāpy atitejas tathaiva ca

vulgate_text: asminnutpadyamāne ca pracacāsa vasuṃdharā / mahormikalilāvartaśrukṣubhe sa mahodadhiḥ
ce_text: tasminn utpatamāne ca pracacāla vasuṃdharā / tatrormikalilāvartaś cukṣubhe ca mahārṇavaḥ

vulgate_text: tatastu dānavānīkaṃ saṃpraṇetṛkamapyuta / khaṅgaṃ dṛṣṭvā balādhūtaṃ pramumoha cacāla ca
ce_text: tatas tad dānavānīkaṃ saṃpraṇetāram acyutam / rudrakhaḍgabaloddhūtaṃ pracacāla mumoha ca

vulgate_text: tasminmahati saṃvṛtte samare bhṛśadāruṇe / babhūva bhūḥ pratibhayā māṃsaśoṇitakardamā
ce_text: tasmin mahati saṃvṛtte samare bhṛśadāruṇe / babhau bhūmiḥ pratibhayā tadā rudhirakardamā

vulgate_text: tatastvailabilāllebhe dhundhumāro nareśvaraḥ / dhundhumārācca kāmbhojo mucukundastato'bhajat
ce_text: tataś caiḍabiḍāl lebhe dhundhumāro janeśvaraḥ / dhundhumārāc ca kāmbojo mucukundas tato 'labhat

vulgate_text: agryaḥ praharaṇānāṃ ca khaṅgo bhuvi pariśrutaḥ maheśvarapraṇītaśca purāṇe niścayaṃ gataḥ / etāni caiva nāmāni purāṇe niścitāni vai
ce_text: agryaḥ praharaṇānāṃ ca khaḍgo mādravatīsuta / maheśvarapraṇītaś ca purāṇe niścayaṃ gataḥ

vulgate_text: ityeṣa prathamaḥ kalpo mayā te kathitaḥ punaḥ / evamevāsisargo'yaṃ yathāvadbharatarṣabha
ce_text: ity eṣa prathamaḥ kalpo vyākhyātas te suvistaraḥ / aser utpattisaṃsargo yathāvad bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: tasmāddharmapradhānena bhavitavyaṃ yatātmanā / tathā ca sarvabhūteṣu vartitavyaṃ yatātmanā / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / kathāntaram athāsādya khaḍgayuddhaviśāradaḥ / nakulaḥ śaratalpastham idam āha pitāmaham

vulgate_text: samāptavacane tasminbhīmakarmā dhanañjayaḥ / tato'rthagatitattvajño jagau vākyaṃ pracoditaḥ
ce_text: samāptavacane tasminn arthaśāstraviśāradaḥ / pārtho vākyārthatattvajño jagau vākyam atandritaḥ

vulgate_text: duḥśīlo'thākṛtātmā ca nṛśaṃsaḥ kitavastathā / mitrairapakṛtirnityamaṭate'rthaṃ dhanepsayā
ce_text: duḥśīlo 'thākṛtātmā ca nṛśaṃsaḥ kitavas tathā / mitrair arthakṛtī nityam icchaty arthaparaś ca yaḥ

vulgate_text: dadataśca yathāśakti yo na tuṣyati mandadhīḥ / adhairyamapi yo yuṅkte sadā mitraṃ narādhamaḥ
ce_text: vahataś ca yathāśakti yo na tuṣyati mandadhīḥ / amitram iva yo bhuṅkte sadā mitraṃ nararṣabha

vulgate_text: alpe'pyapakṛte mūḍhe na saṃsmarani yatkṛtam kāryasevī ca mitreṣu mitradveṣī narādhipa
ce_text: alpe 'py apakṛte mūḍhas tathājñānāt kṛte 'pi ca / kāryopasevī mitreṣu mitradveṣī narādhipa

vulgate_text: kuṭusbārthaṃ ca dasyośca sāhāyyaṃ cāpyathākarot / so'vasadvarṣamekaṃ vai samṛddhe śabarālaye
ce_text: kuṭumbārtheṣu dasyoḥ sa sāhāyyaṃ cāpy athākarot / tatrāvasat so 'tha varṣāḥ samṛddhe śabarālaye / bāṇavedhye paraṃ yatnam akaroc caiva gautamaḥ

vulgate_text: bāṇavedhe paraṃ yatnamakaroccaiva gautamaḥ cakrāṅgānsa ca nityaṃ vai sarvato vanagocarān / jaghāna gautamo rājanyathā dasyugaṇāstathā
ce_text: vakrāṅgāṃs tu sa nityaṃ vai sarvato bāṇagocare / jaghāna gautamo rājan yathā dasyugaṇas tathā

vulgate_text: vinīto vedaśāstreṣu vedāntānāṃ ca pāragaḥ adṛśyata tatastatra sakhā tasyaiva tu dvijaḥ / taṃ dasyugrāmamagamadyatrāsau gautamo'bhavat
ce_text: vinīto niyatāhāro brahmaṇyo vedapāragaḥ / sabrahmacārī taddeśyaḥ sakhā tasyaiva supriyam / taṃ dasyugrāmam agamad yatrāsau gautamo 'bhavat

vulgate_text: tvaddarśanāttu viprendra kṛtārtho'smyadya vai dvija / adhvānaṃ saha yāsyāvaḥ śvo vasasvādya śarvarīm
ce_text: tvaddarśanāt tu viprarṣe kṛtārthaṃ vedmy ahaṃ dvija / ātmānaṃ saha yāsyāvaḥ śvo vasādyeha śarvarīm

vulgate_text: sa kathaṃcidbhayāttasmādvimukto prāyaśo'bhavat / kāṃdigbhūto jīvitārthī pradudrāvottarāṃ diśam
ce_text: sa kathaṃ cit tatas tasmāt sārthān mukto dvijas tadā / kāṃdigbhūto jīvitārthī pradudrāvottarāṃ diśam

vulgate_text: caturvidhā hyarthagatirbṛhaspatimataṃ yathā / mitraṃ vidyā hiraṇyaṃ ca buddhiśceti budhepsitā
ce_text: caturvidhā hy arthagatir bṛhaspatimataṃ yathā / pāraṃparyaṃ tathā daivaṃ karma mitram iti prabho

vulgate_text: pṛṣṭaśca gotracaraṇaṃ svādhyāyaṃ brahmacārikam / pṛṣṭo rājñā sa nājñāsīdgotramātramathābravīt
ce_text: pṛṣṭaś ca gotracaraṇaṃ svādhyāyaṃ brahmacārikam / na tatra vyājahārānyad gotramātrād ṛte dvijaḥ

vulgate_text: tāsu te pūjitā rājñā nipaṇṇā dvijasattamāḥ / niladarbhodakenātha arcitā vidhivaddvijāḥ
ce_text: tāsu te pūjitā rājñā niṣaṇṇā dvijasattamāḥ / vyarājanta mahārāja nakṣatrapatayo yathā

vulgate_text: viśvedevāḥ sapitaraḥ sāgnayaścopakalpitāḥ viliptāḥ puṣpavantaśca supracārāḥ supūjitāḥ / vyarājanta mahārāja nakṣatrapatayo yathā
ce_text: tāsu te pūjitā rājñā niṣaṇṇā dvijasattamāḥ / vyarājanta mahārāja nakṣatrapatayo yathā

vulgate_text: ratnavanti ca pātrāṇi dakṣiṇārthaṃ sa bhārata / dattvā prāha dvijaśreṣṭhānvirūpākṣo mahāyaśāḥ
ce_text: ratnarāśīn vinikṣipya dakṣiṇārthe sa bhārata / tataḥ prāha dvijaśreṣṭhān virūpākṣo mahāyaśāḥ

vulgate_text: tatastānrākṣasendrastu dvijānāha punarvacaḥ / nānā deśāgatānrājā brāhmaṇānanumanya vai
ce_text: tatas tān rākṣasendraś ca dvijān āha punar vacaḥ / nānādigāgatān rājan rākṣasān pratiṣidhya vai

vulgate_text: gautamaścintayāmāsa rātrau tasya samīpataḥ / hāṭakasyābhirūpasya bhāro'yaṃ sumahānmayā
ce_text: sa bhuktavān suviśrānto gautamo 'cintayat tadā / hāṭakasyābhirūpasya bhāro 'yaṃ sumahān mayā / gṛhīto lobhamohād vai dūraṃ ca gamanaṃ mama

vulgate_text: gṛhīto lobhamohābhyāṃ dūraṃ ca gamanaṃ mama na cāsti pathi bhoktavyaṃ prāṇasaṃdhāraṇaṃ mama / kiṃ kṛtvā sukṛtaṃ hi syāditi cintāparo'bhavat
ce_text: na cāsti pathi bhoktavyaṃ prāṇasaṃdhāraṇaṃ mama / kiṃ kṛtvā dhārayeyaṃ vai prāṇān ity abhyacintayat

vulgate_text: ayaṃ bakapatiḥ pārśve māṃsarāśicito mahān / imaṃ hatvā gṛhītvā'sya māṃsaṃ yāsya iti prabho
ce_text: ayaṃ bakapatiḥ pārśve māṃsarāśiḥ sthito mama / imaṃ hatvā gṛhītvā ca yāsye 'haṃ samabhidrutam

vulgate_text: ruditvā bahuśastasmai vilapya ca sa rākṣasaḥ / gato roṣasamāviṣṭo gautamagrahaṇāya vai
ce_text: sa rudann agamat putro rākṣasendrasya dhīmataḥ / tvaramāṇaḥ paraṃ śaktyā gautamagrahaṇāya vai

vulgate_text: rājā caivābravītputraṃ pāpo'yaṃ vadhyatāmiti / rākṣamā ūcuḥ
ce_text: sastrīkumāraṃ ca puraṃ babhūvāsvasthamānasam / athābravīn nṛpaḥ putraṃ pāpo 'yaṃ vadhyatām iti

vulgate_text: kṛtaghnaṃ pāpakarmāṇāṃ na bhakṣayitumutsahe / dāsebhyo dīyatāmepa mitradhrukpurupādhamaḥ / bhīṣma uvāca
ce_text: bhīṣma uvāca / tataḥ sa vidito rājñaḥ praviśya gṛham uttamam / pūjito rākṣasendreṇa niṣasādāsanottame

vulgate_text: śirobhiścāgatā bhūmiṃ mahārāja tato balāt / mānārthaṃ jātu nirbandhaṃ kilviṣaṃ dātumarhasi
ce_text: śirobhiś ca gatā bhūmim ūcū rakṣogaṇādhipam / na dātum arhasi tvaṃ no bhakṣaṇāyāsya kilbiṣam

vulgate_text: kravyādāstvapi rājendra necchanti piśitāśanāḥ / mṛtānapi hi kravyādāḥ kṛtaghnānnopabhuñjate
ce_text: dasyavaś cāpi naicchanta tam attuṃ pāpakāriṇam / kravyādā api rājendra kṛtaghnaṃ nopabhuñjate

vulgate_text: brahmasvaharaṇe core brahmaghne gurutalpage / niṣkṛtirvihitā sadbhiḥ kṛtaghne nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ
ce_text: brahmaghne ca surāpe ca core bhagnavrate tathā / niṣkṛtir vihitā rājan kṛtaghne nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ

vulgate_text: bhīṣma uvāca / vidvānsaṃskārayāmāsa pārthivo rājadharmaṇaḥ / gandhairbahubhiravyagro dāhayāmāsa pūjitam
ce_text: bhīṣma uvāca / atha tatra mahārciṣmān analo vātasārathiḥ / tasyāvidūre rakṣārthaṃ khagendreṇa kṛto 'bhavat

vulgate_text: tasya devasya vacanādindrasya bakarāḍiha / tenaivāmṛtasiktāśca punaḥ saṃjīvito bakaḥ
ce_text: tadāyaṃ tasya vacanān nihato gautamena vai / tenaivāmṛtasiktaś ca punaḥ saṃjīvito bakaḥ

vulgate_text: rājadharmā'pi taṃ prāha sahasrākṣamariṃdamam / gautamo brāhmaṇaḥ kvā'sau mucyatāṃ matpriyaḥ sakhā / bhīṣma uvāca
ce_text: bhīṣma uvāca / atha tatra mahārciṣmān analo vātasārathiḥ / tasyāvidūre rakṣārthaṃ khagendreṇa kṛto 'bhavat

vulgate_text: tasyā vakrāccyutaḥ pheno dugdhamātrastadā'nagha / samīraṇāhṛto yātaścitāṃ tāṃ rājadharmaṇaḥ
ce_text: tasyā vaktrāc cyutaḥ phenaḥ kṣīramiśras tadānagha / so 'patad vai tatas tasyāṃ citāyāṃ rājadharmaṇaḥ

vulgate_text: virūpākṣamuvācedamīśvaraḥ pākaśāsanaḥ / brahmaṇā vyāhṛto roṣādrājadharmā kadācana
ce_text: śrāvayām āsa cendras taṃ virūpākṣaṃ purātanam / yathā śāpaḥ purā datto brahmaṇā rājadharmaṇaḥ

vulgate_text: yadā nihantā mokṣaste tadā bhāvītyuvāca tam / tasmādeṣa gato lokaṃ brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ / bhīṣma uvāca
ce_text: bhīṣma uvāca / atha tatra mahārciṣmān analo vātasārathiḥ / tasyāvidūre rakṣārthaṃ khagendreṇa kṛto 'bhavat

vulgate_text: kṛtajñamanasā bhāvyaṃ mitrabhāvena cānagha / mitrātprabhavate sarvaṃ mitraṃ dhanyataraṃ smṛtam
ce_text: kṛtajñena sadā bhāvyaṃ mitrakāmena cānagha / mitrāt prabhavate satyaṃ mitrāt prabhavate balam / satkārair uttamair mitraṃ pūjayeta vicakṣaṇaḥ

vulgate_text: eṣā sajjanasāṃnidhye prajñā proktā mayā'nagha / mitraduhi kṛtaghne ca kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi / vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca
ce_text: eṣa dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭha proktaḥ pāpo mayā tava / mitradrohī kṛtaghno vai kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotum icchasi

vulgate_text: paśya bhūtāni duḥkhena vyatiṣiktāni sarvaśaḥ / uttamādhamamadhyāni teṣu teṣviha karmasu
ce_text: brāhmaṇa uvāca / paśya bhūtāni duḥkhena vyatiṣaktāni sarvaśaḥ / ātmāpi cāyaṃ na mama sarvā vā pṛthivī mama

vulgate_text: sukhasyānantaraṃ duḥkhaṃ duḥkhasyānantaraṃ sukham / sukhaduḥkhe manuṣyāṇāṃ cakravatparivartataḥ
ce_text: tṛṣṇārtiprabhavaṃ duḥkhaṃ duḥkhārtiprabhavaṃ sukham / sukhāt saṃjāyate duḥkham evam etat punaḥ punaḥ / sukhasyānantaraṃ duḥkhaṃ duḥkhasyānantaraṃ sukham

vulgate_text: etāṃ buddhiṃ samāsthāya śuddhacittaścaredbudhaḥ śuklakṛṣṇagatijñaṃ taṃ devāsuravinirgamam / udayāstamayajñaṃ hi na śokaḥ spraṣṭumarhati
ce_text: etāṃ buddhiṃ samāsthāya guptacittaś cared budhaḥ / udayāstamayajñaṃ hi na śokaḥ spraṣṭum arhati

vulgate_text: yannimatto bhavecchokasrāso vā krodha eva vā / āyāso vā yato mūlaṃ tadekāṅgamapi tyajet
ce_text: yannimittaṃ bhavec chokas trāso vā duḥkham eva vā / āyāso vā yatomūlas tad ekāṅgam api tyajet

vulgate_text: etāṃ buddhiṃ samāsthāya nāvasīdedguṇānvitaḥ / sarvānkāmāñjugupsena kopaṃ kurvīta pṛṣṭhataḥ
ce_text: tad evaṃ buddhim āsthāya sukhaṃ jīved guṇānvitaḥ / sarvān kāmāñ jugupseta saṅgān kurvīta pṛṣṭhataḥ / vṛtta eṣa hṛdi prauḍho mṛtyur eṣa manomayaḥ

vulgate_text: vṛtta eva hṛdi prauḍho mṛtyurepa manobhavaḥ / krodho nāma śarīrastho dehināṃ procyate budhaiḥ
ce_text: tad evaṃ buddhim āsthāya sukhaṃ jīved guṇānvitaḥ / sarvān kāmāñ jugupseta saṅgān kurvīta pṛṣṭhataḥ / vṛtta eṣa hṛdi prauḍho mṛtyur eṣa manomayaḥ

vulgate_text: atra piṅgalayā gītā gāthā śṛṇu narādhipa / yathā sā kṛcchrakāle'pi lebhe śarma sanātanam
ce_text: atra piṅgalayā gītā gāthāḥ śrūyanti pārthiva / yathā sā kṛcchrakāle 'pi lebhe dharmaṃ sanātanam

vulgate_text: durbalaṃ balavantaṃ ca śūraṃ bhīruṃ jaḍaṃ kavim / aprāptaṃ sarvakāmārthānmṛtyurādāya gacchati
ce_text: buddhimantaṃ ca mūḍhaṃ ca śūraṃ bhīruṃ jaḍaṃ kavim / durbalaṃ balavantaṃ ca bhāginaṃ bhajate sukham

vulgate_text: naivāsyāgnirna cādityo na mṛtyurna ca dasyavaḥ / prabhavanti dhanaṃ hartumitare syuḥ kutaḥ punaḥ
ce_text: naivāsyāgnir na cādityo na mṛtyur na ca dasyavaḥ / prabhavanti dhanajyāninirmuktasya nirāśiṣaḥ

vulgate_text: pūrvamaryairvihīnasya yuktasyāpyutiṣṭhataḥ / imaṃ paśyata saṃgatyā mama daivamupaplavam
ce_text: kṛtasya pūrvaṃ cānarthair yuktasyāpy anutiṣṭhataḥ / imaṃ paśyata saṃgatyā mama daivam upaplavam

vulgate_text: apāṇitvādvayaṃ brahmankaṇṭakaṃ noddharāmahe / jantūnuccāvacānaṅge daśato na kaṣāma vā
ce_text: na pāṇilābhād adhiko lābhaḥ kaś cana vidyate / apāṇitvād vayaṃ brahman kaṇṭakān noddharāmahe

vulgate_text: icchantaste vihārāya sukhaṃ mahadavāpnuyuḥ ye'nujātāḥ sunakṣatre sutithau sumuhūrtake / yajñadānaprajehāyāṃ yatante śaktipūrvakam
ce_text: icchantas te vihārāya sukhaṃ mahad avāpnuyuḥ / uta jātāḥ sunakṣatre sutīrthāḥ sumuhūrtajāḥ

vulgate_text: saṃklinnamagrato vastraṃ paścācchudhyati vāriṇā / duṣkarmāpi tathā paścātpūyate puṇyakarmaṇā
ce_text: samunnam agrato vastraṃ paścāc chudhyati karmaṇā / upavāsaiḥ prataptānāṃ dīrghaṃ sukham anantakam

vulgate_text: tapasā tapyate dehastapasā vindate mahat upavāsaiḥ prataptānāṃ dīrghaṃ sukhamanantaram
ce_text: samunnam agrato vastraṃ paścāc chudhyati karmaṇā / upavāsaiḥ prataptānāṃ dīrghaṃ sukham anantakam

vulgate_text: adṛśyatvādagamyatvātkaḥ pramāṇamudāharet siddhānāṃ devatānāṃ ca yadā parimitā gatiḥ / tadā gauṇamanantasya nāmānanteti viśrutam
ce_text: siddhānāṃ devatānāṃ ca yadā parimitā gatiḥ / tadā gauṇam anantasya nāmānanteti viśrutam / nāmadheyānurūpasya mānasasya mahātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: bharadvāja uvāca / merumadhye sthito brahmā kathaṃ sa sasṛje prajāḥ / etanme sarvamācakṣva yāthātathyena pṛcchataḥ / bhṛguruvāca
ce_text: bharadvāja uvāca / gaganasya diśāṃ caiva bhūtalasyānilasya ca / kāny atra parimāṇāni saṃśayaṃ chindhi me 'rthataḥ

vulgate_text: bhūmergandhaguṇānvetti rasaṃ cādbhyaḥ śarīravān jyoteḥ paśyati rūpāṇi sparśaṃ vetti ca vāyutaḥ / śabdaṃ śṛṇoti ca tadaivākāśāttu śarīravān
ce_text: bhūmer gandhaguṇān vetti rasaṃ cādbhyaḥ śarīravān / jyotiḥ paśyati cakṣurbhyāṃ sparśaṃ vetti ca vāyunā

vulgate_text: gandhaḥ sparśo raso rūpaṃ śabdaścātra guṇāḥ smṛtāḥ / tasya gandhasya vakṣyāmi vistarābhihitānguṇān
ce_text: tasya gandhasya vakṣyāmi vistarābhihitān guṇān / iṣṭaś cāniṣṭagandhaś ca madhuraḥ kaṭur eva ca

vulgate_text: śuklaḥ kṛṣṇastathā raktaḥ pīto nīlāruṇastathā kaṭhinaścikkaṇaḥ ślakṣṇaḥ picchilo mṛdudāruṇaḥ / evaṃ dvādaśavistāro jyotīrūpaguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ
ce_text: hrasvo dīrghas tathā sthūlaś caturasro 'ṇu vṛttavān / śuklaḥ kṛṣṇas tathā rakto nīlaḥ pīto 'ruṇas tathā / evaṃ dvādaśavistāro jyotīrūpaguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ

vulgate_text: uṣṇaḥ śītaḥ sukho duḥkhaḥ snigdho viśada eva ca tathā kharo mṛdū rūkṣo laghurgurutaro'pi ca / evaṃ dvādaśadhā sparśo vyāvyo guṇa ucyate
ce_text: kaṭhinaś cikkaṇaḥ ślakṣṇaḥ picchalo mṛdudāruṇaḥ / uṣṇaḥ śītaḥ sukho duḥkhaḥ snigdho viśada eva ca / evaṃ dvādaśavistāro vāyavyo guṇa ucyate

vulgate_text: evaṃ bahuvidhākāraḥ śabda ākāśasaṃbhavaḥ ākāśajaṃ śabdamāhurebhirvāyuguṇaiḥ saha ]
ce_text: ākāśajaṃ śabdam āhur ebhir vāyuguṇaiḥ saha / avyāhataiś cetayate na vetti viṣamāgataiḥ

vulgate_text: āpo'gnirmārutaścaiva nityaṃ jāgrati dehiṣu / mūlamete śarīrasya vyāpya prāṇāniha sthitā
ce_text: āpyāyante ca te nityaṃ dhātavas tais tu dhātubhiḥ / āpo 'gnir mārutaś caiva nityaṃ jāgrati dehiṣu

vulgate_text: śleṣmaṃ vā yadi vā jīvaḥ saha tena praṇaśyati / mahārṇavaviyuktatvādanyatsalilabhājanam
ce_text: śleṣo yadi ca vātena yadi tasmāt praṇaśyati / mahārṇavavimuktatvād anyat salilabhājanam

vulgate_text: yatkṣipetsalilaṃ kūpe pradīpaṃ vā hutāśane / tannaśyatyubhayaṃ tadvajjīvo vātānalātmakaḥ
ce_text: kūpe vā salilaṃ dadyāt pradīpaṃ vā hutāśane / prakṣiptaṃ naśyati kṣipraṃ yathā naśyaty asau tathā

vulgate_text: brahma vaiva paraṃ sṛṣṭaṃ ye tu jānanti te dvijāḥ / teṣāṃ bahuvidhāstvanye tatratatra dvijātayaḥ
ce_text: brahma caitat purā sṛṣṭaṃ ye na jānanty atadvidaḥ / teṣāṃ bahuvidhās tv anyās tatra tatra hi jātayaḥ

vulgate_text: ahiṃsraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ maitrāyaṇagatiścaret parigrahānparityajya bhavedbuddhyā jitendriyaḥ / acalaṃ sthānamātiṣṭhediha cāmutra cobhayoḥ
ce_text: parigrahān parityajya bhaved buddhyā jitendriyaḥ / aśokaṃ sthānam ātiṣṭhed iha cāmutra cābhayam

vulgate_text: yadetaccāturāśramyaṃ brahmarṣivihitaṃ purā / tasya svaṃsvaṃ samācāraṃ yathāvadvaktumarhasi / bhṛguruvāca
ce_text: bhṛgur uvāca / satyaṃ brahma tapaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ sṛjati ca prajāḥ / satyena dhāryate lokaḥ svargaṃ satyena gacchati

vulgate_text: iha cintā bahuvidhā dharmādharmasya karmaṇaḥ karmabhūmiriyaṃ loke iha kṛtvā śubhāśubham / śubhaiḥ śubhamavāpnoti kartā'śubhamathānyathā
ce_text: karmabhūmir iyaṃ loka iha kṛtvā śubhāśubham / śubhaiḥ śubham avāpnoti kṛtvāśubham ato 'nyathā

vulgate_text: sāyaṃ prātaśca viprāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ ca yathāvidhi paṇyānāṃ śobhate paṇyaṃ kṛṣīṇāmṛddhyatāṃ kṛṣiḥ / bahukāraṃ ca sasyānāṃ vāhye vāho gavāṃ tathā
ce_text: paṇyānāṃ śobhanaṃ paṇyaṃ kṛṣīṇāṃ bādyate kṛṣiḥ / bahukāraṃ ca sasyānāṃ vāhye vāhyaṃ tathā gavām

vulgate_text: kutaḥ sṛṣṭamidaṃ sarvaṃ brahmansthāvarajaṅgamam / pralaye ca kamabhyeti tanme vaktumihārhasi / bhīṣma uvāca
ce_text: bhīṣma uvāca / durācārā durviceṣṭā duṣprajñāḥ priyasāhasāḥ / asanto hy abhivikhyātāḥ santaś cācāralakṣaṇāḥ

vulgate_text: śabdaḥ śrotraṃ tathā khāni trayamākāśasaṃbhavam / vāyoḥ sparśastathā ceṣṭā tvakcaiva tritayaṃ smṛtam
ce_text: śabdaḥ śrotraṃ tathā khāni trayam ākāśayonijam / vāyos tvaksparśaceṣṭāś ca vāg ity etac catuṣṭayam

vulgate_text: indriyāṇi hi sarvāṇi pravartayati sā tadā / tataḥ satvaṃ tamo bhāvaḥ prātiyogātpravartate
ce_text: indriyāṇi hi sarvāṇi pradarśayati sā sadā / prītiḥ sattvaṃ rajaḥ śokas tamo mohaś ca te trayaḥ

vulgate_text: mahānadyā hi pārajñastapyate na tadanyathā / na tu tapyati tattvajñaḥ phale jñāte taratyuta
ce_text: mahānadīṃ hi pārajñas tapyate na taran yathā / evaṃ ye vidur adhyātmaṃ kaivalyaṃ jñānam uttamam

vulgate_text: etadbuddhā bhavedbuddhaḥ kimanyadbuddhilakṣaṇam / pratigṛhya ca nihnoti hyanyathā ca pradṛśyate
ce_text: etad buddhvā bhaved buddhaḥ kim anyad buddhalakṣaṇam / vijñāya tad dhi manyante kṛtakṛtyā manīṣiṇaḥ

vulgate_text: prapadya tacchrutāhnāni cinmayaṃ svīkṛtaṃ vinā / vijñāya taddhi manyante kṛtakṛtyā manīṣiṇaḥ
ce_text: etad buddhvā bhaved buddhaḥ kim anyad buddhalakṣaṇam / vijñāya tad dhi manyante kṛtakṛtyā manīṣiṇaḥ

vulgate_text: tatra dhyānena saṃśliṣṭamekāgre dhārayenmanaḥ / tatra ca dhyānasaṃrodhādatha jñānī bhavatyuta
ce_text: tatra svādhyāyasaṃśliṣṭam ekāgraṃ dhārayen manaḥ / piṇḍīkṛtyendriyagrāmam āsīnaḥ kāṣṭhavan muniḥ

vulgate_text: caturvidheṣu bhāveṣu yo'rthasaktaḥ sadaiva hi tajjñātvā vāstavaṃ teṣāmartheṣu parivartate / piṇḍīkṛtyendriyagrāmamāsīnaḥ kāṣṭhavanmuniḥ
ce_text: tatra svādhyāyasaṃśliṣṭam ekāgraṃ dhārayen manaḥ / piṇḍīkṛtyendriyagrāmam āsīnaḥ kāṣṭhavan muniḥ

vulgate_text: ikṣvākoścaiva mṛtyośca vivāde dharmakāraṇāt saṃnyāsa eva vedānte vartate japanaṃ prati / vedavādāṅganirvṛttāḥ śāntā brahmaṇyavasthitāḥ
ce_text: saṃnyāsa eva vedānte vartate japanaṃ prati / vedavādābhinirvṛttā śāntir brahmaṇy avasthitau / mārgau tāv apy ubhāv etau saṃśritau na ca saṃśritau

vulgate_text: sāṅkhyayogau tu yāvuktau munibhiḥ samadarśibhiḥ / mārgau tāvapyubhāvetau saṃśritau na ca saṃśritau
ce_text: saṃnyāsa eva vedānte vartate japanaṃ prati / vedavādābhinirvṛttā śāntir brahmaṇy avasthitau / mārgau tāv apy ubhāv etau saṃśritau na ca saṃśritau

vulgate_text: yathā saṃśrūyate rājankāraṇaṃ cātra vakṣyate / krameṇa caiva vihito japayajñavidhirnṛpa
ce_text: yathā saṃśrūyate rājan kāraṇaṃ cātra vakṣyate / manaḥsamādhir atrāpi tathendriyajayaḥ smṛtaḥ

vulgate_text: yadanyaducitaṃ śuddhaṃ vedasmṛtyupapāditam etatsarvamaśeṣeṇa yathoktaṃ parivartayet

vulgate_text: dvividaṃ mārgamāsādya vyaktāvyaktamanāmayam kuśoccayaniṣaṣṇaḥ sankuśahastaḥ kuśaiḥ śikha / kuśaiḥ parivṛtastasminmadhye channaḥ kuśaistathā

vulgate_text: dhyānamutpādayatyatra saṃhitābalasaṃśrayāt / athābhimatamantreṇa praṇavādyaṃ japetkṛtī

ce_text: dharma uvāca / dvijāte paśya māṃ dharmam ahaṃ tvāṃ draṣṭum āgataḥ / japyasya ca phalaṃ yat te saṃprāptaṃ tac ca me śṛṇu

ce_text: brāhmaṇa uvāca / kṛtaṃ lokair hi me dharma gaccha ca tvaṃ yathāsukham / bahuduḥkhasukhaṃ dehaṃ notsṛjeyam ahaṃ vibho

vulgate_text: sarve gacchāma yatra svānsvām̐llokāṃśca tathā vayam gaccha lokāñjitānsvena karmaṇā yatra vāñchasi

ce_text: gandharvaś citrasenaś ca parivāragaṇair yutaḥ / nāgāḥ siddhāś ca munayo devadevaḥ prajāpatiḥ / viṣṇuḥ sahasraśīrṣaś ca devo 'cintyaḥ samāgamat

vulgate_text: upasthitakṛtau tau ca nāsikāgramadho bhruvoḥ / bhrukuṭyākṣṇośca manasā śanairdhārayatastadā

vulgate_text: uṣyatāṃ mayi cetyuktvā vyādade sa tato mukham / athāsyaṃ praviveśāsya brāhmaṇo vigatajvaraḥ

vulgate_text: sa me bhavāñśaṃsatu sarvameta tsāmānyaśabdaiśca viśeṣaṇaiśca / sa me bhavāñśaṃsatu tāvadeta jjñāne phalaṃ karmaṇi vā yadasti
ce_text: sa me bhavāñ śaṃsatu sarvam etaj; jñāne phalaṃ karmaṇi vā yad asti / yathā ca dehāc cyavate śarīrī; punaḥ śarīraṃ ca yathābhyupaiti

ce_text: manur uvāca / yad yat priyaṃ yasya sukhaṃ tad āhus; tad eva duḥkhaṃ pravadanty aniṣṭam / iṣṭaṃ ca me syād itarac ca na syād; etatkṛte karmavidhiḥ pravṛttaḥ / iṣṭaṃ tv aniṣṭaṃ ca na māṃ bhajetety; etatkṛte jñānavidhiḥ pravṛttaḥ

vulgate_text: ebhirvimuktaḥ paramāviveśa etatkṛte karmavidhiḥ pravṛttaḥ / [kāmātmakāṃśchandati karmayoga ebhirvimuktaḥ paramādadīta ]
ce_text: kāmātmakāś chandasi karmayogā; ebhir vimuktaḥ param aśnuvīta / nānāvidhe karmapathe sukhārthī; naraḥ pravṛtto na paraṃ prayāti / paraṃ hi tat karmapathād apetaṃ; nirāśiṣaṃ brahmaparaṃ hy avaśyam

vulgate_text: sa evāstamupāgacchaṃstadevātmani yacchati ādatte sarvabhūtānāṃ rasabhūtaṃ vikāsavān

ce_text: avyaktāt prasṛtaṃ jñānaṃ tato buddhis tato manaḥ / manaḥ śrotrādibhir yuktaṃ śabdādīn sādhu paśyati

vulgate_text: tadevamiṣyate brahma saṃkhyānādvinibhidyate jñānānāṃ ca phalānāṃ ca jñeyānāṃ karmaṇāṃ tathā / kṣayānte yatphalaṃ vidyājjñānaṃ jñeyapratiṣṭhitam

ce_text: bhīṣma uvāca / ity evam uktvā vacanaṃ brahmarṣiḥ sumahātapāḥ / prātiṣṭhata śukaḥ siddhiṃ hitvā lokāṃś caturvidhān

śaiśiras tu yathā dhūmaḥ sūkṣmaṃ saṃśrayate nabhaḥ / tathā dehād vimuktasya pūrvarūpaṃ tad apy uta / atha dhūmasya virame dvitīyaṃ rūpadarśanam / jalarūpam ivākāśaṃ tatraivātmani paśyati / aparaṃ vyatikramec cāpi vahnirūpaṃ prakāśate / tasminn uparate vāsya vāyavyaṃ sūkṣmam apy atha / rūpaṃ prakāśate tatra pītavarṇavad apy ajaḥ / tasminn uparate rūpam ākāśasya prakāśate / ūhyā savarṇarūpaṃ tat tasya rūpaṃ prakāśate / tasminn uparate vāsya buddhirūpaṃ prakāśate / suśuklaṃ cetasaḥ samyag avyakte brāhmaṇasya vai / eteṣv apīha jāteṣu phalajātāni me śṛṇu / jātasya pārthivaiśvaryaiḥ sṛṣṭir eṣā vidhīyate / prajāpatir ivākṣobhyaḥ śarīrāt sṛjati prajāḥ / varṇato gṛhyate vāpsu nāyaṃ pibati cāśayāḥ / snācāsya (sic) tejasā rūpaṃ dahyate śāmyate tathā / aṅgulyāṅguṣṭhamātreṇa vastapāṭenavat tathā (sic) / pṛthivīṃ kampayanty ete guṇāpāyād iti smṛtaḥ / ākāśabhūtaś cākāśe svarṇastvān na ca dṛśyate / ahaṃkārasya vijaye pañca te syur vaśānugāḥ / ṣaṇṇām ātmani buddhau tu nitāyaṃ (sic) prabhavaty uta / nirdoṣaprabhavā hy eṣā kṛtsnā samabhivartate / tathaiva vyaktam ātmānam avyaktaṃ pratipadyate / yato niḥsarate loko bhavati vyaktasaṃjñakaḥ / tatrāsannamayīṃ vyākhyāṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ vistareṇa vai / tathā vyaktamayīṃ caiva vyākhyāṃ pūrvaṃ nibodha me / pañcaviṃśatitattvāni tulyāny ubhayataḥ samam / yoge sāṃkhye 'pi ca tathā viśeṣāṃs tatra me śṛṇu / proktaṃ tad vyartham ity eva jāyate vartate ca yat / jīvate mriyate caiva caturbhir lakṣaṇair yutam / viparītam ato yat tad avyaktaṃ samudāhṛtam / pāpātmānau ca deveṣu siddhānteṣv apy udāhṛtau / caturlakṣaṇajantur yaś caturvargaḥ pracakṣate / vyaktam avyaktajaṃ caiva tathā buddhir athetarat / sattvaṃ kṣetrajña ity etad dvayam avyaktadarśanam / dvāv ātmānau ca deveṣu viṣayeṣu ca rājataḥ / viṣayān pratisaṃhāraḥ sālokaṃ siddhilakṣaṇam / nirmamaś cānahaṃkāro nirdvaṃdvaś chinnasaṃśayaḥ / naiva krudhyati na dveṣṭi nātmatā bhavato giraḥ / ākruṣṭas tāḍitaś cāpi maitraṃ dhyāyati nāśubham / vāṅmanaḥkāyadaṇḍānāṃ trayāṇāṃ ca nivartakam / samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu brahmāṇam ativartate / naivecchati na cānicchan yātrāmātravyavasthitaḥ / alolupo 'py atho dānto nākṛtir na nirākṛtiḥ / nāsyendriyamanaḥprāṇabuddhayaḥ sarvasākṣiṇaḥ / akrudhyann aprahṛṣyaṃś ca nityaṃ vigatamatsaraḥ

vulgate_text: tato drakṣyasi sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ prabhavāpyayau enaṃ vai sarvabhūtebhyo viśiṣṭaṃ menire budhāḥ / dharmaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhā munayastattvadarśinaḥ
ce_text: evaṃ vai sarvadharmebhyo viśiṣṭaṃ menire budhāḥ / dharmaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭha munayas tattvadarśinaḥ

vulgate_text: āpūryamāṇamacalapratiṣṭhaṃ samudramāpaḥ praviśanti yadvat / tadvatkāmā yaṃ praviśanti sarve sa śāntimāpnoti na kāmakāmaḥ
ce_text: āpūryamāṇam acalapratiṣṭhaṃ; samudram āpaḥ praviśanti yadvat / sa kāmakānto na tu kāmakāmaḥ; sa vai lokāt svargam upaiti dehī

ce_text: śāstrayogaparā bhūtvā svam ātmānaṃ parīpsavaḥ / anucchvāsāny amūrtīni yāni vajropamāny api

ce_text: yadarthaṃ buddhir adhyāste na so 'rthaḥ pariṣīdati / yadarthaṃ pṛthag adhyāste manas tat pariṣīdati

ce_text: api hy uktāni karmāṇi vyavasyanty uttarāvare / lokayātrārtham eveha dharmasya niyamaḥ kṛtaḥ / ubhayatra sukhodarka iha caiva paratra ca

vulgate_text: na ca pāpakṛtaḥ pāpānmucyante kecidāpadi apāpavādī bhavati yathā bhavati dharmavit / dharmasya niṣṭhā svācārastamevāśritya cāvaset
ce_text: apāpavādī bhavati yadā bhavati dharmavit / dharmasya niṣṭhā svācāras tam evāśritya bhotsyase

vulgate_text: kiṃ kṛtaṃ duṣkaraṃ tāta karma jājalinā purā / yena siddhiṃ parāṃ prāptastanme vyākhyātumarhasi / bhīṣma uvāca

ce_text: bhīṣma uvāca / atrāpy udāharantīmam itihāsaṃ purātanam / tulādhārasya vākyāni dharme jājalinā saha
