ce_text: ādityaś candramā vāyur bhūmir āpo 'mbaraṃ diśaḥ / sarve brāhmaṇam āviśya sadānnam upabhuñjate

vulgate_text: mahārathaśca rājanya eṣṭavyaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ / iti māṃ nāradaḥ prāha satataṃ sarvabhūtaye
ce_text: jāyatāṃ brahmavarcasvī rāṣṭre vai brāhmaṇaḥ śuciḥ / mahārathaś ca rājanya eṣṭavyaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ

vulgate_text: mekalā drāviḍā lāṭāḥ pauṇḍrāḥ kānvaśirāstathā / śauṇḍikā daradā dārvāścorāḥ śabarabarbarāḥ
ce_text: mekalā dramiḍāḥ kāśāḥ pauṇḍrāḥ kollagirās tathā / śauṇḍikā daradā darvāś caurāḥ śabarabarbarāḥ

vulgate_text: anṛtaṃ satyamityāhuḥ satyaṃ cāpi tathā'nṛtam iti yāstāḥ kathaṃ vīra saṃrakṣyāḥ puruṣairiha / doṣāspade'śucau dehe hyāsāṃ saktāstvaho narāḥ
ce_text: anṛtaṃ satyam ity āhuḥ satyaṃ cāpi tathānṛtam / iti yās tāḥ kathaṃ vīra saṃrakṣyāḥ puruṣair iha

vulgate_text: satkṛtāsatkṛtāścāpi vikurvanti manaḥ sadā / kastāḥ śakto rakṣituṃ syāditi me saṃśayo mahān
ce_text: kas tāḥ śakto rakṣituṃ syād iti me saṃśayo mahān / tan me brūhi mahābāho kurūṇāṃ vaṃśavardhana

vulgate_text: tathā brūhi mahābhāga kurūṇāṃ vaṃśavardhana yadi śakyā kuruśreṣṭha rakṣā tāsāṃ kadācana
ce_text: kas tāḥ śakto rakṣituṃ syād iti me saṃśayo mahān / tan me brūhi mahābāho kurūṇāṃ vaṃśavardhana

vulgate_text: pratinandya ca dharmātmā śiṣyaṃ dharmaparāyaṇam / vareṇa cchandayāmāsa devaśarmā mahāmatiḥ
ce_text: pratinandya ca dharmātmā śiṣyaṃ dharmaparāyaṇam / vareṇa cchandayām āsa sa tasmād guruvatsalaḥ / anujñātaś ca guruṇā cacārānuttamaṃ tapaḥ

vulgate_text: sthitiṃ ca dharme jagrāha sa tasmādguruvatsalaḥ / anujñātaśca guruṇā cacārānuttamaṃ tapaḥ
ce_text: pratinandya ca dharmātmā śiṣyaṃ dharmaparāyaṇam / vareṇa cchandayām āsa sa tasmād guruvatsalaḥ / anujñātaś ca guruṇā cacārānuttamaṃ tapaḥ

vulgate_text: kiṃ tvayā mithunaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tasmiñśiṣya mahāvane / te tvāṃ jānanti nipuṇā ātmā ca rucireva ca / vipula uvāca
ce_text: devaśarmovāca / kiṃ te vipula dṛṣṭaṃ vai tasminn adya mahāvane / te tvā jānanti nipuṇa ātmā ca rucir eva ca

vulgate_text: brahmarṣe mithunaṃ kintatke ca ṣaṭpuruṣā vibho / ye māṃ jānanti tattvena yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi / devaśarmovāca
ce_text: devaśarmovāca / kiṃ te vipula dṛṣṭaṃ vai tasminn adya mahāvane / te tvā jānanti nipuṇa ātmā ca rucir eva ca

vulgate_text: alaṅkṛtvā vahasveti yo dadyādanukūlataḥ yacca tāṃ ca dadatyevaṃ na śulkaṃ vikrayo na saḥ / pratigṛhya bhaveddemeva dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ
ce_text: tac ca tāṃ ca dadāty eva na śulkaṃ vikrayo na saḥ / pratigṛhya bhaved deyam eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ

vulgate_text: gṛhītapāṇirekā''sītprāptaśulkā'parā'bhavat kanyā'gṛhītā tatraiva visarjyā iti me pitā / abravīditarāṃ kanyāmāvaheti sa kauravaḥ
ce_text: pāṇau gṛhītā tatraiva visṛjyā iti me pitā / abravīd itarāṃ kanyām āvahat sa tu kauravaḥ

vulgate_text: pūjyā lālayitavyāśca striyo nityaṃ janādhipa / striyo yatra ca pūjyante ramante tatra devatāḥ
ce_text: pūjyā lālayitavyāś ca striyo nityaṃ janādhipa / apūjitāś ca yatraitāḥ sarvās tatrāphalāḥ kriyāḥ / tadaiva tat kulaṃ nāsti yadā śocanti jāmayaḥ

vulgate_text: sā hi putrasamā rājanvihitā kurunandana evameva samuddiṣṭo dharmo vai bharatarṣabha / evaṃ dharmamanusmṛtya na vṛthā sādhayeddhanam / yudhiṣṭhira uvāca
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca / sarvaśāstravidhānajña rājadharmārthavittama / atīva saṃśayacchettā bhavān vai prathitaḥ kṣitau

vulgate_text: vaiśyāputrastu bhāgāṃstrīñśūdrāputrastathāṣṭamam ekaiva hi bhavedbhāryā vaiśyasya kurunandana
ce_text: ekaiva hi bhaved bhāryā vaiśyasya kurunandana / dvitīyā vā bhavec chūdrā na tu dṛṣṭāntataḥ smṛtā

vulgate_text: śūdrāyāṃ cāpi kaunteya tayorviniyamaḥ smṛtaḥ pañcadhā tu bhavetkāryaṃ vaiśyasvaṃ bharatarṣabha
ce_text: vaiśyasya vartamānasya vaiśyāyāṃ bharatarṣabha / śūdrāyāṃ caiva kaunteya tayor viniyamaḥ smṛtaḥ

vulgate_text: tayorapatye vakṣyāmi vibhāgaṃ ca janādhipa vaiśyāputreṇa hartavyāścatvāroṃśāḥ piturdhanāt
ce_text: vaiśyāputreṇa hartavyāś catvāro 'ṃśāḥ pitur dhanāt / pañcamas tu bhaved bhāgaḥ śūdrāputrāya bhārata

vulgate_text: ānṛśaṃsyamanukrośaḥ satyavākyaṃ tathā kṣamā svaśarīrairapi trāṇaṃ bāhyānāṃ siddhikāraṇam / bhavanti manujavyāghra tatra me nāsti saṃśayaḥ
ce_text: svaśarīraiḥ paritrāṇaṃ bāhyānāṃ siddhikārakam / manujavyāghra bhavati tatra me nāsti saṃśayaḥ

vulgate_text: retajo vā bhavetputraḥ putro vā kṣatrejo bhavet / adhyūḍhaḥ samayaṃ bhittvetyetadeva nibodha me / yudhiṣṭhira uvāca
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca / arthāśrayād vā kāmād vā varṇānāṃ vāpy aniścayāt / ajñānād vāpi varṇānāṃ jāyate varṇasaṃkaraḥ

vulgate_text: mātāpitṛbhyāṃ yastyaktaḥ pathi yastaṃ prakalpayet / na cāsya mātāpitarau jñāyetāṃ sa hi kṛtrimaḥ
ce_text: bhīṣma uvāca / mātāpitṛbhyāṃ saṃtyaktaṃ pathi yaṃ tu pralakṣayet / na cāsya mātāpitarau jñāyete sa hi kṛtrimaḥ

vulgate_text: svaṃ janme mātṛgotreṇa saṃskāraṃ brāhmaṇādayaḥ dharmaśāstreṣu varṇānāṃ niścayo'yaṃ padṛśyate
ce_text: dharmaśāstreṣu varṇānāṃ niścayo 'yaṃ pradṛśyate / etat te sarvam ākhyātaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotum icchasi

vulgate_text: jālaṃ te yojayāmāsurnavasūtrakṛtaṃ dṛḍham / matsyoddharaṇamākarṣastadā bharatasattama
ce_text: jālaṃ ca yojayām āsur viśeṣeṇa janādhipa / matsyodakaṃ samāsādya tadā bharatasattama

vulgate_text: karavāṇi priyaṃ kiṃ te tanme brūhi dvijottama / sarvaṃ kartā'smi bhagavanyadyapi syātsuduṣkaram / cyavana uvāca
ce_text: nahuṣa uvāca / karavāṇi priyaṃ kiṃ te tan me vyākhyātum arhasi / sarvaṃ kartāsmi bhagavan yady api syāt suduṣkaram

vulgate_text: atyantāpadi śaktānāṃ paritrāṇaṃ hi kurvatām / yā gatirviditā tvadya narake śaraṇaṃ bhavān / cyavana uvāca
ce_text: cyavana uvāca / śrameṇa mahatā yuktāḥ kaivartā matsyajīvinaḥ / mama mūlyaṃ prayacchaibhyo matsyānāṃ vikrayaiḥ saha

vulgate_text: brāhme bale supūrṇānāmeteṣāṃ cyavanādinām kathameṣa samutpanno rāmaḥ satyaparākramaḥ / kathaṃ brahmarṣivaṃśo'yaṃ kṣatradharmā vyajāyata
ce_text: katham eṣa samutpanno rāmaḥ satyaparākramaḥ / kathaṃ brahmarṣivaṃśe ca kṣatradharmā vyajāyata

vulgate_text: kathaṃ putrānatikramya teṣāṃ naptṛṣvathābhavat / eṣa doṣo mahāprājña tattvaṃ vyākhyātumarhasi / bhīṣma uvāca
ce_text: bhīṣma uvāca / nahuṣas tu tataḥ śrutvā cyavanaṃ taṃ tathāgatam / tvaritaḥ prayayau tatra sahāmātyapurohitaḥ

vulgate_text: pautraste bhavitā viprastapasvī pāvakadyutiḥ jamadagnau mahābhāga tapasā bhāvitātmani
ce_text: vaṃśas te pārthivaśreṣṭha bhṛgūṇām eva tejasā / pautras te bhavitā vipra tapasvī pāvakadyutiḥ

vulgate_text: tapasā dīpyamānāste daheyuḥ pṛthivīmapi / apūjyamānāḥ kauravya pūjārhāstu tathāvidhāḥ
ce_text: tapasā dīpyamānās te daheyuḥ pṛthivīm api / pūjyā hi jñānavijñānatapoyogasamanvitāḥ

vulgate_text: raudraṃ karma kṣatriyasya satataṃ tāta vartate / nāsya vaitānikaphalaṃ vinā dānaṃ supāvanam
ce_text: bhīṣma uvāca / raudraṃ karma kṣatriyasya satataṃ tāta vartate / tasya vaitānikaṃ karma dānaṃ caiveha pāvanam

vulgate_text: brāhmaṇāṃstarpayandravyaiḥ sa vai yajño'nupadravaḥ / maitrānsādhūnvedavidaḥ śīlavṛttataporjitān
ce_text: brāhmaṇāṃs tarpayed dravyais tato yajñe yatavrataḥ / maitrān sādhūn vedavidaḥ śīlavṛttataponvitān

vulgate_text: punaścāsau janiṃ prāpya rājavatsyānna saṃśayaḥ / tasmātprāpyaiva pṛthivīṃ dadyādviprāya pārthivaḥ
ce_text: nāmāsyāḥ priyadatteti guhyaṃ devyāḥ sanātanam / dānaṃ vāpy atha vā jñānaṃ nāmno 'syāḥ paramaṃ priyam / tasmāt prāpyaiva pṛthivīṃ dadyād viprāya pārthivaḥ

vulgate_text: yathā dhāvati gaurvatsaṃ sravantī vatsalā payaḥ / evameva mahābhāga bhūmirbharati bhūmidam
ce_text: yathā dhāvati gaur vatsaṃ kṣīram abhyutsṛjanty uta / evam eva mahābhāga bhūmir bhavati bhūmidam

vulgate_text: sunirmitāṃ suvikrītāṃ subhṛtāṃ sthāpayennṛpa ikṣubhiḥ santatāṃ bhūmiṃ yavagodhūmasālinīm
ce_text: ikṣubhiḥ saṃtatāṃ bhūmiṃ yavagodhūmasaṃkulām / gośvavāhanasaṃpūrṇāṃ bāhuvīryasamārjitām

vulgate_text: sarveṣāmiti dānānāṃ tiladānaṃ viśiṣyate / akṣayaṃ sarvadānānāṃ tiladānamihocyate
ce_text: sarveṣām eva dānānāṃ tiladānaṃ paraṃ smṛtam / akṣayaṃ sarvadānānāṃ tiladānam ihocyate

vulgate_text: na vadhārthaṃ pradātavyā na kīnāśe na nāstike gojīvine na dātavyā tathā gaurbharatarṣabha / gorasānāṃ na vikretū rasaṃ ca yajanasya ca
ce_text: na vadhārthaṃ pradātavyā na kīnāśe na nāstike / gojīvine na dātavyā tathā gauḥ puruṣarṣabha

vulgate_text: gavāṃ romapramāṇena svargabhogamupāśnute / jalabindupramāṇena tadetānyupavartaya / bhīṣma uvāca
ce_text: bhīṣma uvāca / hanta te vartayiṣyāmi yathāvad bharatarṣabha / gadatas tan mamādyeha śṛṇu satyaparākrama / pānīyadānāt prabhṛti sarvaṃ vakṣyāmi te 'nagha

vulgate_text: santāḍyā na tu pādena gavāṃ madhye na ca vrajet / maṅgalāyatanaṃ devyastasmātpūjyāḥ sadaiva gāḥ
ce_text: vṛddhim ākāṅkṣatā nityaṃ gāvaḥ kāryāḥ pradakṣiṇāḥ / maṅgalāyatanaṃ devyas tasmāt pūjyāḥ sadaiva hi

vulgate_text: vṛddhe glāne sambhrame vā mahārthe kṛṣyarthaṃ vā haumyahetoḥ pramūtyām / gurvarthaṃ vā yajñasamāptaye vā gāṃ vai dātuṃ deśakālo'viśiṣṭaḥ / nāciketa uvāca
ce_text: goṣu kṣāntaṃ gośaraṇyaṃ kṛtajñaṃ; vṛttiglānaṃ tādṛśaṃ pātram āhuḥ / vṛttiglāne saṃbhrame vā mahārthe; kṛṣyarthe vā homahetoḥ prasūtyām

vulgate_text: yaścātmāvekrayaṃ kṛtvā gāḥ krītvā samprayacchati / yāvatsaṃdarśayedgāṃ vai sa tāvatphalamaśnute
ce_text: yaś cātmavikrayaṃ kṛtvā gāḥ krītvā saṃprayacchati / yāvatīḥ sparśayed gā vai tāvat tu phalam aśnute / lomni lomni mahābhāga lokāś cāsyākṣayāḥ smṛtāḥ

vulgate_text: mama loke vasati sa loke vā yatra cecchati
ce_text: akāmaṃ tena vastavyaṃ muditena śatakrato / mama loke suraiḥ sārdhaṃ loke yatrāpi cecchati

vulgate_text: dānāddamo viśiṣṭo hi dadatkiñciddvijātaye / dātā kupyati no dāntastasmāddānātparaṃdamaḥ / yastu dadyādakupyanhi tasya lokāḥ sanātanāḥ krodho hanti hi yaddānaṃ tasmāddānādvaro damaḥ
ce_text: dānair yajñaiś ca vividhair yathā dāntāḥ kṣamānvitāḥ / dātā kupyati no dāntas tasmād dānāt paro damaḥ

vulgate_text: vidyādānādvaraṃ nāsti vedavidyā mahāphalāḥ adhyāpakaḥ parikleśādakṣayaṃ phalamaśnute
ce_text: adhyāpakaḥ parikleśād akṣayaṃ phalam aśnute / vidhivat pāvakaṃ hutvā brahmaloke narādhipa

vulgate_text: vidhivatpāvakaṃ hutvā brahmaloke narādhipa adhītyāpi hi yo vedānnyāyavidbhyaḥ prayacchati / gurukarmapraśaṃsī tu sopi svarge mahīyate
ce_text: adhītyāpi hi yo vedān nyāyavidbhyaḥ prayacchati / gurukarmapraśaṃsī ca so 'pi svarge mahīyate

vulgate_text: buddhiśūrāstathaivānye kṣamāśūrāstathā pare sāṅkhyaśūrāśca bahavo yogaśūrāstathā pare / araṇye gṛhavāse ca tyāge śūrāstathā pare
ce_text: sāṃkhyaśūrāś ca bahavo yogaśūrās tathāpare / araṇye gṛhavāse ca śūrāś cātithipūjane / sarve yānti parāṃl lokān svakarmaphalanirjitān

vulgate_text: satyena devāḥ prīyante pitaro brāhmaṇāstathā / satyamāhuḥ paro dharmastasmātsatyaṃ na lopayet
ce_text: satyena devān prīṇāti pitṝn vai brāhmaṇāṃs tathā / satyam āhuḥ paraṃ dharmaṃ tasmāt satyaṃ na laṅghayet

vulgate_text: asaṃśayaṃ vinītātmā sa vai svarge mahīyate / brahmacaryasya ca guṇaṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ vasudhādhipa
ce_text: damaḥ satyaphalāvāptir uktā sarvātmanā mayā / asaṃśayaṃ vinītātmā sarvaḥ svarge mahīyate

vulgate_text: vidhiṃ gavāṃ paraṃ śrotumicchāmi nṛpa tattvataḥ / yena tāñśāśvatām̐llokānarthināṃ prāpnuyādiha / bhīṣma uvāca
ce_text: bhīṣma uvāca / yo vrataṃ vai yathoddiṣṭaṃ tathā saṃpratipadyate / akhaṇḍaṃ samyag ārabdhaṃ tasya lokāḥ sanātanāḥ

vulgate_text: dvijānāmantrya satkṛtya proktaṃ kālamupoṣya ca / godānārthe prayuñjīta rohiṇīṃ niyatavrataḥ
ce_text: dvijātim abhisatkṛtya śvaḥ kālam abhivedya ca / pradānārthe niyuñjīta rohiṇīṃ niyatavrataḥ

vulgate_text: pītodakāṃ jagdhatṛṇāṃ naṣṭakṣīrāṃ nirindriyām jarārogopasampannāṃ jīrṇāṃ vāpīmivājalām / dattvā tamaḥ praviśati dvijaṃ kleśena yojayet
ce_text: jarogrām upayuktārthāṃ jīrṇāṃ kūpam ivājalam / dattvā tamaḥ praviśati dvijaṃ kleśena yojayet

vulgate_text: vṛddhānāṃ bruvatāṃ śrutvā kapilānāmathodbhavam / vakṣyāmi tadaśeṣeṇa rohiṇyo nirmitā yathā
ce_text: bhīṣma uvāca / vṛddhānāṃ bruvatāṃ tāta śrutaṃ me yat prabhāṣase / vakṣyāmi tad aśeṣeṇa rohiṇyo nirmitā yathā

vulgate_text: mukhajā sā'sṛjaddhātuḥ surabhirlokamātaram / darśanīyarasaṃ vṛttiṃ surabhiṃ mukhajāṃ sutām
ce_text: sa gatas tasya tṛptiṃ tu gandhaṃ surabhim udgiran / dadarśodgārasaṃvṛttāṃ surabhiṃ mukhajāṃ sutām

vulgate_text: gāvo yajñasya hi phalaṃ goṣu yajñāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ / gāvo bhaviṣyaṃ bhūtaṃ ca goṣu yajñāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ
ce_text: svāhākāravaṣaṭkārau goṣu nityaṃ pratiṣṭhitau / gāvo yajñasya hi phalaṃ goṣu yajñāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ

vulgate_text: asmatpurīṣasnānena janaḥ puyeta sarvadā / śakṛtā ca pavitrārthaṃ kurvīrandevamānuṣāḥṭha
ce_text: sa eva cetasā tena hato lipyeta sarvadā / śakṛtā ca pavitrārthaṃ kurvīran devamānuṣāḥ

vulgate_text: kiñca yajñasya yajñatvaṃ kva ca yajñaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ dānānāmuttamaṃ kiñca kiñca satramitaḥ param / pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ ca yattadbrūhi mahāmune
ce_text: dānānām uttamaṃ kiṃ ca kiṃ ca satram ataḥ param / pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ ca yat tad brūhi mamānagha

vulgate_text: yena devāḥ pavitreṇa svargalokamito gatāḥ / tatpavitraṃ pavitrāṇāṃ mama mūrdhni pratiṣṭhitam
ce_text: yena devāḥ pavitreṇa bhuñjate lokam uttamam / yat pavitraṃ pavitrāṇāṃ tad ghṛtaṃ śirasā vahet

vulgate_text: mayā'bhipannā devāśca modante śāśvatīḥ samāḥ / indro vivasvānsomaśca viṣṇurāpo'gnireva ca
ce_text: indro vivasvān somaś ca viṣṇur āpo 'gnir eva ca / mayābhipannā ṛdhyante ṛṣayo devatās tathā

vulgate_text: dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca mayā juṣṭāḥ sukhānvitāḥ / evaṃprabhāvāṃ māṃ gāvo vijānīta sukhapradām
ce_text: evaṃprabhāvāṃ māṃ gāvo vijānīta sukhapradām / icchāmi cāpi yuṣmāsu vastuṃ sarvāsu nityadā / āgatā prārthayānāhaṃ śrījuṣṭā bhavatānaghāḥ

vulgate_text: na vo'sti kutsitaṃ kiñcidaṅgeṣvālakṣyate'naghāḥ puṇyāḥ pavitrāḥ subhagā avāgdeśaṃ prayacchatha / vaseyaṃ yatra vo dehe tanme vyākhyātumarhatha
ce_text: puṇyāḥ pavitrāḥ subhagā mamādeśaṃ prayacchata / vaseyaṃ yatra cāṅge 'haṃ tan me vyākhyātum arhatha

vulgate_text: brahmacaryeṇa tapasā satyena ca damena ca / dānaiśca vividhaiḥ puṇyaistathā tīrthānusevanāt
ce_text: vrataiś ca vividhaiḥ puṇyais tathā tīrthānusevanāt / tapasā mahatā caiva sukṛtena ca karmaṇā / śakyaḥ samāsādayituṃ golokaḥ puṣkarekṣaṇa

vulgate_text: yadi vo'nugrahakṛtā buddhirmāṃ prati sattamāḥ / prabūta pāvanaṃ kiṃ me bhavediti tapodhanāḥ / ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
ce_text: devā ūcuḥ / pratīpayā jihvayāpi sarvāhārān kariṣyatha / vācaṃ coccārayiṣyadhvam uccair avyañjitākṣaram / ity uktvā punar evāgnim anusasrur divaukasaḥ

vulgate_text: suvarṇameva sarvāsu dakṣiṇāsu vidhīyate / suvarṇaṃ ye prayacchanti sarvadāste bhavantyuta
ce_text: vasiṣṭha uvāca / devatās te prayacchanti suvarṇaṃ ye dadaty uta / agnir hi devatāḥ sarvāḥ suvarṇaṃ ca tad ātmakam

vulgate_text: prasādya śirasā sarve rudramūcurbhṛgūdvaha ayaṃ samāgamo deva devyā saha tavānagha
ce_text: te mahādevam āsīnaṃ devīṃ ca varadām umām / prasādya śirasā sarve rudram ūcur bhṛgūdvaha

vulgate_text: apatyārthaṃ nigṛhṇīṣva tejaḥ paramakaṃ vibho / [trailokyasārau hi yuvāṃ lokaṃ santāpayiṣyatha
ce_text: tad ebhyaḥ praṇatebhyas tvaṃ devebhyaḥ pṛthulocana / varaṃ prayaccha lokeśa trailokyahitakāmyayā / apatyārthaṃ nigṛhṇīṣva tejo jvalitam uttamam

vulgate_text: tasmātprasādaṃ bhagavankartumarhasi naḥ prabho na devyāṃ sambhavetputro bhavataḥ surasattama / dhairyādeva nigṛhṇīṣva tejo jvalitamuttamam
ce_text: tad ebhyaḥ praṇatebhyas tvaṃ devebhyaḥ pṛthulocana / varaṃ prayaccha lokeśa trailokyahitakāmyayā / apatyārthaṃ nigṛhṇīṣva tejo jvalitam uttamam

vulgate_text: taṃ vai saṃyujya śāpena maṇḍūkaṃ tvarito yayau / anyatra vāsāya vibhurna cātmānamadarśayat
ce_text: taṃ sa saṃyujya śāpena maṇḍūkaṃ pāvako yayau / anyatra vāsāya vibhur na ca devān adarśayat

vulgate_text: visaṃjñā nāśakadgarbhaṃ voḍhumātmānameva ca / sā tu tejaḥparītāṅgī kampamānā ca jāhnavī
ce_text: sā tu tejaḥparītāṅgī kampamānā ca jāhnavī / uvāca vacanaṃ vipra tadā garbhabaloddhatā / na te śaktāsmi bhagavaṃs tejaso 'sya vidhāraṇe

vulgate_text: vimūḍhā'smi kṛtā'nena na me svāsdhyaṃ yathā purā vihvalā cāsmi bhagavaṃśceto naṣṭaṃ ca me'nagha
ce_text: vimūḍhāsmi kṛtānena tathāsvāsthyaṃ kṛtaṃ param / vihvalā cāsmi bhagavaṃs tejo naṣṭaṃ ca me 'nagha

vulgate_text: evamuktā tu sā devī tatraivāntaradhīyata pāvakaścāpi tejasvī kṛtvā kāryaṃ divaukasām / jagāmeṣṭaṃ tadā deśaṃ tato bhārgavanandana
ce_text: pāvakaś cāpi tejasvī kṛtvā kāryaṃ divaukasām / jagāmeṣṭaṃ tato deśaṃ tadā bhārgavanandana

vulgate_text: saṃjuhāvātmanā''tmānaṃ svayameva tadā prabho / yajñaṃ ca śobhayāmāsa bahurūpaṃ pinākadhṛt
ce_text: vedāś ca sopaniṣado vidyā sāvitry athāpi ca / bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyac ca dadhāra bhagavāñ śivaḥ / juhvac cātmany athātmānaṃ svayam eva tadā prabho

vulgate_text: aśruto'sya samutpannāvaśvinau rūpasammatau śeṣāḥ prajānāṃ patayaḥ srotobhyastasya jajñire / ṛṣayo romakūpebhyaḥ svedācchando balānmanaḥ
ce_text: śeṣāḥ prajānāṃ patayaḥ srotobhyas tasya jajñire / ṛṣayo lomakūpebhyaḥ svedāc chando malātmakam

vulgate_text: devapakṣacarāḥ saumyāḥ prājāpatyā maharṣayaḥ / anantaṃ brahma satyaṃ ca tapaśca paramaṃ bhuvi
ce_text: devapakṣadharāḥ saumyāḥ prājāpatyā maharṣayaḥ / āpnuvanti tapaś caiva brahmacaryaṃ paraṃ tathā

vulgate_text: kuśastambe juhotyagniṃ suvarṇe tatra ca sthite / valmīkasya vapāyāṃ ca karṇe vājasya dakṣiṇe
ce_text: kuśastambe juhoty agniṃ suvarṇaṃ tatra saṃsthitam / hute prītikarīm ṛddhiṃ bhagavāṃs tatra manyate

vulgate_text: śakaṭorvyā parasyāpsu brāhmaṇasya kare tathā / hute prītikarīmṛddhiṃ bhagavāṃstatra manyate
ce_text: kuśastambe juhoty agniṃ suvarṇaṃ tatra saṃsthitam / hute prītikarīm ṛddhiṃ bhagavāṃs tatra manyate

vulgate_text: suvarṇadāne ca mayā kathitāste guṇā vibho / tasmātsuvarṇaṃ viprebhyaḥ prayaccha tadatāṃvara / bhīṣma uvāca
ce_text: bhīṣma uvāca / ity uktaḥ sa vasiṣṭhena jāmadagnyaḥ pratāpavān / dadau suvarṇaṃ viprebhyo vyamucyata ca kilbiṣāt

vulgate_text: uktaṃ sa daivatānāṃ hi avadhya iti pārthiva / kathaṃ tasyābhavanmṛtyurvistareṇa prakīrtaya
ce_text: uktaḥ sa devatānāṃ hi avadhya iti pārthiva / na ca tasyeha te mṛtyur vistareṇa prakīrtitaḥ

vulgate_text: sarveṣvahaḥsu prīyante kṛte śrāddhe pitāmahāḥ piṇḍānvāhāryakaṃ śrāddhaṃ kuryānmāsānumāsikam / pitṛyajñaṃ tu nirvartya vipraścandrakṣaye'gnimān
ce_text: sarveṣv ahaḥsu prīyante kṛtaiḥ śrāddhaiḥ pitāmahāḥ / pravakṣyāmi tu te sarvāṃs tithyāṃ tithyāṃ guṇāguṇān

vulgate_text: kiṃsviddattaṃ pitṛbhyo vai bhavatyakṣayamīśvaraḥ / kiṃsvidvahuphalaṃ proktaṃ kimānantyāya kalpate / bhīṣma uvāca
ce_text: bhīṣma uvāca / śṛṇuṣvāvahito rājañ śrāddhakalpam imaṃ śubham / dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ putrīyaṃ pitṛyajñaṃ paraṃtapa

vulgate_text: kuśīlavo devalako nakṣatrairyaśca jīvatī īdṛśairbrāhmaṇairbhuktamapāṅkteyairyudhiṣṭhira
ce_text: śvabhir yaś ca parikrāmed yaḥ śunā daṣṭa eva ca / parivittiś ca yaś ca syād duścarmā gurutalpagaḥ / kuśīlavo devalako nakṣatrair yaś ca jīvati

vulgate_text: tilairvirahitaṃ śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ krodhavaśena ca / yātudhānāḥ piśācāśca vipralumpanti taddhaviḥ
ce_text: tilādāne ca kravyādā ye ca krodhavaśā gaṇāḥ / yātudhānāḥ piśācāś ca vipralumpanti tad dhaviḥ

vulgate_text: vidyāvedavratasnātā brāhmaṇāḥ sarva eva hi / sadācāraparāścaiva vijñeyāḥ sarvapāvanāḥ
ce_text: vedavidyāvratasnātā brāhmaṇāḥ sarva eva hi / pāṅkteyān yāṃs tu vakṣyāmi jñeyās te paṅktipāvanāḥ

vulgate_text: yatayo mokṣadharmajñā yoginaścaritavratāḥ / pañcarātravido mukhyāstathā bhāgavatāḥ pare
ce_text: ime pare mahārāja vijñeyāḥ paṅktipāvanāḥ / yatayo mokṣadharmajñā yogāḥ sucaritavratāḥ

vulgate_text: vaikhānasāḥ kulaśreṣṭhā vaidikācāracāriṇaḥ ye cetihāsaṃ prayatāḥ śrāvayanti dvijottamān
ce_text: ye cetihāsaṃ prayatāḥ śrāvayanti dvijottamān / ye ca bhāṣyavidaḥ ke cid ye ca vyākaraṇe ratāḥ

vulgate_text: yena saṅkalpitaṃ caiva tanme brūhi pitāmaha kāni śrāddheṣu varjyāni kāni mūlaphalāni ca / dhānyajātyaśca kā varjyāstanme brūhi pitāmaha / bhīṣma uvāca
ce_text: bhīṣma uvāca / brāhmaṇān na parīkṣeta kṣatriyo dānadharmavit / daive karmaṇi pitrye tu nyāyyam āhuḥ parīkṣaṇam

vulgate_text: srajo vajrīvarī caiva viśvedevāḥ sanātanāḥ / vidyudvarcāḥ somavarcāḥ sūryaśrīśceti nāmataḥ
ce_text: srajī vajrī varī caiva viśvedevāḥ sanātanāḥ / kīrtitās te mahābhāgāḥ kālasya gatigocarāḥ

vulgate_text: rakṣāṃsi nābhivardhante sthite deve hutāśane / pūrvaṃ piṇḍaṃ piturdadyāttato dadyātpitāmahe
ce_text: pūrvaṃ piṇḍaṃ pitur dadyāt tato dadyāt pitāmahe / prapitāmahāya ca tata eṣa śrāddhavidhiḥ smṛtaḥ

vulgate_text: ete kurukulaśreṣṭha mahāyogeśvarāḥ smṛtāḥ ete ca pitaro rājanneṣa śrāddhavidhiḥ paraḥ
ce_text: pitāmahaḥ pulastyaś ca vasiṣṭhaḥ pulahas tathā / aṅgirāś ca kratuś caiva kaśyapaś ca mahān ṛṣiḥ / ete kurukulaśreṣṭha mahāyogeśvarāḥ smṛtāḥ

vulgate_text: pretāstu piṇḍasambandhānmucyante tena karmaṇā ityeṣā puruṣaśreṣṭha śrāddhotpattiryathāgamam
ce_text: ete ca pitaro rājann eṣa śrāddhavidhiḥ paraḥ / pretās tu piṇḍasaṃbandhān mucyante tena karmaṇā

vulgate_text: devebhyaśca pitṛbhyaśca saṃśritebhyastathaiva ca / avaśiṣṭāni yo bhuṅkte tamāhurvighasāśinam
ce_text: devebhyaś ca pitṛbhyaś ca bhṛtyebhyo 'tithibhiḥ saha / avaśiṣṭāni yo bhuṅkte tam āhur vighasāśinam

vulgate_text: pratigraho brāhmaṇānāṃ sṛṣṭā vṛttiraninditā tasmāddadāmi vo vittaṃ tadvṛṇudhvaṃ tapodhanāḥ
ce_text: vṛṣādarbhir uvāca / pratigrahas tārayati puṣṭir vai pratigṛhṇatām / mayi yad vidyate vittaṃ tac chṛṇudhvaṃ tapodhanāḥ

vulgate_text: aśvāṃstathā śīghragāñśvetarūpāṃ- nmanojavānpradadāmyarbudāni / kulambharānanaḍuhaḥ śataṃ śatā- ndhuryāñśvetānsarvaśo'haṃ dadāmi praṣṭhauhīnāṃ pīvarāṇāṃ ca tāva- dagryā gṛṣṭīrdhenavaḥ suvratāśca
ce_text: kulaṃbharān anaḍuhaḥ śataṃśatān; dhuryāñ śubhān sarvaśo 'haṃ dadāni / pṛthvīvāhān pīvarāṃś caiva tāvad; agryā gṛṣṭyo dhenavaḥ suvratāś ca

vulgate_text: gurūṇīti viditvā'tha na grāhyāṇyatrirabravīt / nāsmeha mandavijñānā nāsma mānuṣabuddhayaḥ
ce_text: gurūṇīti viditvātha na grāhyāṇy atrir abravīt / na sma he mūḍhavijñānā na sma he mandabuddhayaḥ / haimānīmāni jānīmaḥ pratibuddhāḥ sma jāgṛmaḥ

vulgate_text: haimānīmāni jānīmaḥ pratibuddhāḥ sma jāgṛma iha hyetadupāvṛttaṃ pretya syātkaṭukodayam / apratigrāhyamevaitatpretyeha ca sukhepsunā / vasiṣṭha uvāca
ce_text: iha hy etad upādattaṃ pretya syāt kaṭukodayam / apratigrāhyam evaitat pretya ceha sukhepsunā

vulgate_text: na jātu kāmaḥ kāmānāmupabhogena śāmyati haviṣā kṛṣṇavartmeva bhūya evābhivardhate / jamadagniruvāca
ce_text: jamadagnir uvāca / pratigrahe saṃyamo vai tapo dhārayate dhruvam / tad dhanaṃ brāhmaṇasyeha lubhyamānasya visravet

vulgate_text: yadvai dharmātparaṃ nāsti tādṛśaṃ brāhmaṇā viduḥ / vinayātsādhu vidvāṃsamupāseyaṃ yathātatham / ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
ce_text: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ / rājan pratigraho rājño madhvāsvādo viṣopamaḥ / taj jānamānaḥ kasmāt tvaṃ kuruṣe naḥ pralobhanam

vulgate_text: atha te mantriṇaḥ sarve rājānamidamabruvan upadhiṃ śaṅkamānāste hitvā tāni phalāni vai / tato'nyatraiva gacchanti viditaṃ te'stu pārthiva
ce_text: mantriṇaḥ ūcuḥ / upadhiṃ śaṅkamānās te hitvemāni phalāni vai / tato 'nyenaiva gacchanti viditaṃ te 'stu pārthiva

vulgate_text: yathodāhṛtametatte tvayā nāma mahādyute / durdhāryametanmanasā gacchā'vatara padminīm / vasiṣṭha uvāca
ce_text: vasiṣṭha uvāca / śatena niṣkaṃ gaṇitaṃ sahasreṇa ca saṃmitam / yathā bahu pratīcchan hi pāpiṣṭhāṃ labhate gatim

vulgate_text: godamo damato'dhūmo'damaste samadarśanāt viddhi māṃ gotamaṃ kṛtye yātudhāni nibodha māṃ / yātudhānyuvāca
ce_text: gautama uvāca / godamo damago 'dhūmo damo durdarśanaś ca te / viddhi māṃ gautamaṃ kṛtye yātudhāni nibodha me

vulgate_text: jājamadyajajāne'haṃ jijāhīha jijāyiṣi / jamadagniriti khyātaṃ tato māṃ viddhi śobhane / yātudhānyuvāca
ce_text: yātudhāny uvāca / yāsmi sāsmy anuyogo me na kartavyaḥ kathaṃ cana / ārakṣiṇīṃ māṃ padminyā vitta sarve tapodhanāḥ

vulgate_text: vaktraikadeśe gaṇḍeti dhātumetaṃ pracakṣate / tenonnatena gaṇḍeti viddhi mā'nalasambhave / yātudhānyuvāca
ce_text: yātudhāny uvāca / yāsmi sāsmy anuyogo me na kartavyaḥ kathaṃ cana / ārakṣiṇīṃ māṃ padminyā vitta sarve tapodhanāḥ

vulgate_text: paśūnyañjāmi dṛṣṭvā'haṃ paśūnāṃ ca sadā sakhā / gauṇaṃ paśusakhetyevaṃ viddhi māmagnisambhave / yātudhānyuvāca
ce_text: yātudhāny uvāca / yāsmi sāsmy anuyogo me na kartavyaḥ kathaṃ cana / ārakṣiṇīṃ māṃ padminyā vitta sarve tapodhanāḥ

vulgate_text: anṛtau vrataniyatāyāṃ bhāryāyāṃ sa prajāyatu / nirākarotu vedāṃśca yaste harati puṣkaram / nahuṣa uvāca
ce_text: yayātir uvāca / anṛtau jaṭī vratinyāṃ vai bhāryāyāṃ saṃprajāyatu / nirākarotu vedāṃś ca yas te harati puṣkaram

vulgate_text: bahuṣvapi nimitteṣu puṇyamāśritya dīyate / etadvistarato brahmañśrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ / bhīṣma uvāca
ce_text: bhīṣma uvāca / atraivodāharantīmam itihāsaṃ purātanam / yad vṛttaṃ tīrthayātrāyāṃ śapathaṃ prati tac chṛṇu

vulgate_text: etasmātkāraṇādbrahmaṃścirāyaitatkṛtaṃ mayā / etacchrutvā mama vibho mā krudhastvaṃ patodhana / jamadagniruvāca
ce_text: jamadagnir uvāca / anadhyāyeṣv adhīyīta mitraṃ śrāddhe ca bhojayet / śrāddhe śūdrasya cāśnīyād yas te harati puṣkaram

vulgate_text: upānahau ca yo dadyācchlakṣṇau snehasamanvitau / snātakāya mahābāho saṃśitāya dvijātaye
ce_text: dahyamānāya viprāya yaḥ prayacchaty upānahau / snātakāya mahābāho saṃśitāya dvijātaye

vulgate_text: ke ca śuśrūṣayā lokā vihitā bharatarṣabha / śudrāṇāṃ bharataśreṣṭha brūhi me dharmalakṣaṇam / bhīṣma uvāca
ce_text: bhīṣma uvāca / karmabhiḥ pārtha nānātvaṃ lokānāṃ yānti mānavāḥ / puṇyān puṇyakṛto yānti pāpān pāpakṛto janāḥ

vulgate_text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam / śūdrāṇāmanukampārthaṃ yaduktaṃ brahmavādinā
ce_text: atrāpy udāharantīmam itihāsaṃ purātanam / gautamasya munes tāta saṃvādaṃ vāsavasya ca

vulgate_text: parīkṣya bhūmiṃ mūtrārthī tata āsīta vāgyataḥ / udaṅmukho divā kuryādrātrau ceddakṣiṇāmukhaḥ
ce_text: ubhe mūtrapurīṣe tu divā kuryād udaṅmukhaḥ / dakṣiṇābhimukho rātrau tathāsyāyur na riṣyate

vulgate_text: sadā yajñena devāṃśca sadā''tithyena mānuṣān / chandatastarpaṇenāpi pitṝnyuñjanti nityaśaḥ
ce_text: sadā yajñena devāṃś ca ātithyena ca mānavān / chandataś ca yathānityam arhān yuñjīta nityaśaḥ / tena hy ṛṣigaṇāḥ prītā bhavanti madhusūdana

vulgate_text: tena hyṛṣigaṇāḥ prītā brahmacayeṇi cānagha / nityamagniṃ paricaredabhuktvā balikarma ca
ce_text: nityam agniṃ paricared abhuktvā balikarma ca / kuryāt tathaiva devā vai prīyante madhusūdana

vulgate_text: manuṣyebhya iti prāhurbaliṃ dvāri gṛhasya vai / marudbhyo daivatebhyaśca balimantargṛhe haret
ce_text: dhanvantareḥ prāg udīcyāṃ prācyāṃ śakrāya mādhava / manor vai iti ca prāhur baliṃ dvāre gṛhasya vai / marudbhyo devatābhyaś ca balim antargṛhe haret

vulgate_text: tatastau satyasaṃkalpau merau kāñcanaparvate / devarṣibhiḥ sadā juṣṭe sahitau saṃnyaṣīdatām
ce_text: tatas tau siddhasaṃkalpau merau kāñcanaparvate / ramaṇīye śilāpṛṣṭhe sahitau saṃnyaṣīdatām

vulgate_text: sumanogandhadhūpādyairijyante daivatāni ca / kimetatkathamutpannaṃ phalaṃ yogaṃ ca śaṃsa me / manuruvāca
ce_text: sumanobhir yad ijyante daivatāni prajeśvara / kim etat katham utpannaṃ phalayogaṃ ca śaṃsa me

vulgate_text: agnīṣomādisṛṣṭau tu viṣṇoḥ sarvātmanaḥ prabhoḥ / tapaḥ pūrvaṃ samutpannaṃ dharmastasmādanantaram
ce_text: śukra uvāca / tapaḥ pūrvaṃ samutpannaṃ dharmas tasmād anantaram / etasminn antare caiva vīrudoṣadhya eva ca

vulgate_text: devatābhyaḥ sumanaso yo dadāti naraḥ śuciḥ / tasmai sumanaso devāstasmātsumanasaḥ smṛtāḥ
ce_text: devatābhyaḥ sumanaso yo dadāti naraḥ śuciḥ / tasmāt sumanasaḥ proktā yasmāt tuṣyanti devatāḥ

vulgate_text: devālaye sabhāyāṃ ca girau caityacatuṣpathe / dīpadātā bhavennityaṃ ya icchedbhūtimātmanaḥ
ce_text: giriprapāte gahane caityasthāne catuṣpathe / dīpadātā bhaven nityaṃ ya icched bhūtim ātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: tatra yatprāptakālaṃ nastadbrū vadatāṃvara / bhavāṃścāpi yathā brūyāttatkartāsmi na saṃśayaḥ / bhṛguruvāca
ce_text: atra yat prāptakālaṃ nas tad brūhi vadatāṃ vara / bhavāṃś cāpi yathā brūyāt kurvīmahi tathā vayam

vulgate_text: pitaraśca mahābhāgā ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ / gṛhyāśca devatāḥ sarvāḥ prīyante vidhinā'rcitāḥ
ce_text: snānenādbhiś ca yat karma kriyate vai vipaścitā / namaskāraprayuktena tena prīyanti devatāḥ / gṛhyāś ca devatāḥ sarvāḥ prīyante vidhinārcitāḥ

vulgate_text: na cukopa tadā'gastyo yukto'pi nahuṣeṇa vai taṃ tu rājā padaikena codayāmāsa bhārata / śrutiḥ smṛtiḥ pramāṇaṃ vā netivādena devarāṭ
ce_text: na cukopa sa cāgastyo yukto 'pi nahuṣeṇa vai / taṃ tu rājā pratodena codayām āsa bhārata

vulgate_text: tasmāddharenna viprasvaṃ kadācidapi kiñcana / na paśyennānumodecca na hartuṃ kiñcidāharet
ce_text: tasmād dharen na viprasvaṃ kadā cid api kiṃ cana / brahmasvarajasā dhvastaṃ bhuktvā māṃ paśya yādṛśam

vulgate_text: etaddhi dhanamutkṛṣṭaṃ dvijānāmaviśeṣataḥ / vikrayaṃ tviha somasya garhayanti manīṣiṇaḥ
ce_text: tasmāt somo 'py avikreyaḥ puruṣeṇa vipaścitā / vikrayaṃ hīha somasya garhayanti manīṣiṇaḥ

vulgate_text: narakaṃ triṃśataṃ prāpya svaviṣṭhāmupajīvati brahmasvahārī narakānyātanāścānubhūya tu / maleṣu ca kṛmirbhūtvā śvaviṣṭhāmupajīvatī
ce_text: somaṃ tu rajasā dhvastaṃ vikrīyād buddhipūrvakam / śrotriyo vārdhuṣī bhūtvā cirarātrāya naśyati / narakaṃ triṃśataṃ prāpya śvaviṣṭhām upajīvati

vulgate_text: so'haṃ vai viditaḥ sarvairdūrago vanino vane sādhūnāṃ paribhāvepsurviprāṇāṃ garvito dhanaiḥ / imāmavasthāṃ samprāptaḥ paśya kālasya paryayam
ce_text: so 'haṃ tena ca vṛttena bhojanena ca tena vai / imām avasthāṃ saṃprāptaḥ paśya kālasya paryayam

vulgate_text: eko lokastu kṛtināṃ svarge loke pitāmaha / uta tatrāpi nānātvaṃ sarvaṃ brūhi pitāmaha / bhīṣma uvāca
ce_text: bhīṣma uvāca / atrāpy udāharantīmam itihāsaṃ purātanam / caṇḍālasya ca saṃvādaṃ kṣatrabandhoś ca bhārata

vulgate_text: śvetaṃ kareṇuṃ mama putraṃ hi nāgaṃ priyaṃ tu me ṣaṣṭivarṣaṃ tu bālam / yo me vane vasato'bhūddvitīya- stameva me dehi surendra nāgam / śatakraturuvāca
ce_text: budhyāmi tvāṃ vṛtrahaṇaṃ śatakratuṃ; vyatikramantaṃ bhuvanāni viśvā / kaccin na vācā vṛjinaṃ kadā cid; akārṣaṃ te manaso 'bhiṣaṅgāt

vulgate_text: tapasaḥ prakṣayo yāvattālloko yudhiṣṭhira / mataṃ mamātra kaunteya tapo nānaśanātparam
ce_text: bhīṣma uvāca / tapaḥ pracakṣate yāvat tāval lokā yudhiṣṭhira / mataṃ mama tu kaunteya tapo nānaśanāt param

vulgate_text: sahasraṃ niṣkakaṇṭhānāmadadaṃ dakṣiṇāmaham vijitya bhūpatīnsarvānarthairiṣṭvā pitāmaha / aṣṭabhyo rājasūyebhyo na ca tenāhamāgataḥ
ce_text: vijitya nṛpatīn sarvān makhair iṣṭvā pitāmaha / aṣṭabhyo rājasūyebhyo na ca tenāham āgataḥ

vulgate_text: tapasvī niyatāhāraḥ śamamāsthāya vāgyataḥ / dīrghakālaṃ himavati gaṅgārthamacaraṃ tapaḥ
ce_text: vājināṃ ca sahasre dve suvarṇaśatabhūṣite / varaṃ grāmaśataṃ cāham ekaikasya tridhādadam / tapasvī niyatāhāraḥ śamam āsthāya vāgyataḥ

vulgate_text: mūrdhnā haraṃ mahādevaṃ praṇamyābhyarcayannṛpaḥ / na tenāpyahamāgacchaṃ phaleneha pitāmaha
ce_text: dīrghakālaṃ himavati gaṅgāyāś ca durutsahām / mūrdhnā dhārāṃ mahādevaḥ śirasā yām adhārayat / na tenāpy aham āgacchaṃ phaleneha pitāmaha

vulgate_text: nekṣetādityamudyantaṃ nāstaṃ yantaṃ kadācana / nopasṛṣṭaṃ na vāristhaṃ na madhyaṃ nabhaso gatam
ce_text: evam evāparāṃ saṃdhyāṃ samupāsīta vāgyataḥ / nekṣetādityam udyantaṃ nāstaṃ yāntaṃ kadā cana

vulgate_text: sadarbhapāṇistatkurvanvāgyatastanmanāḥ śuciḥ tasmāttiṣṭhetsadā pūrvāṃ paścimāṃ caiva vāgyataḥ
ce_text: ṛṣayo dīrghasaṃdhyatvād dīrgham āyur avāpnuvan / tasmāt tiṣṭhet sadā pūrvāṃ paścimāṃ caiva vāgyataḥ

vulgate_text: yādṛśaṃ puruṣasyeha paradāropasevanam / tādṛśaṃ vidyate kiñcidanāyuṣyaṃ nṛṇāmiha
ce_text: paradārā na gantavyāḥ sarvavarṇeṣu karhi cit / na hīdṛśam anāyuṣyaṃ loke kiṃ cana vidyate / yādṛśaṃ puruṣasyeha paradāropasevanam

vulgate_text: purīṣamūtre nodīkṣennādhitiṣṭhetkadācana nātikalyaṃ nātisāyaṃ na ca madhyaṃdine sthite / nājñātaiḥ saha gaccheta naiko na vṛṣalaiḥ saha
ce_text: nātikalpaṃ nātisāyaṃ na ca madhyaṃdine sthite / nājñātaiḥ saha gaccheta naiko na vṛṣalaiḥ saha

vulgate_text: pradakṣiṇaṃ ca kurvīta parijñātānvanaspatīn / catuṣpadānmaṅgalāṃśca mānyānvṛddhāndvijānapi
ce_text: pradakṣiṇaṃ ca kurvīta parijñātān vanaspatīn / catuṣpathān prakurvīta sarvān eva pradakṣiṇān

vulgate_text: nityamagniṃ paricaredbhikṣāṃ dadyācca nityadā / dantakāṣṭhe ca sandhyāyāṃ malotsarge ca maunagaḥ
ce_text: nityam agniṃ paricared bhikṣāṃ dadyāc ca nityadā / vāgyato dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca nityam eva samācaret / na cābhyuditaśāyī syāt prāyaścittī tathā bhavet

vulgate_text: na cābhyuditasāyī syātprāyaścittī tathā bhavet mātāpitaramutthāya pūrvamevābhivādayet / ācāryamathavā'pyantaṃ tathā''yurvidante mahat
ce_text: mātāpitaram utthāya pūrvam evābhivādayet / ācāryam atha vāpy enaṃ tathāyur vindate mahat

vulgate_text: keśagrahaṃ prahārāṃśca sirasyetānvivarjayet na saṃhātābhyāṃ pāṇibhyāṃ kaṇḍūyedātmanaḥ śiraḥ / na cābhīkṣṇaṃ śiraḥsnāyāttathā syāyurna riṣyate
ce_text: na pāṇibhyām ubhābhyāṃ ca kaṇḍūyej jātu vai śiraḥ / na cābhīkṣṇaṃ śiraḥ snāyāt tathāsyāyur na riṣyate

vulgate_text: śiraḥsnātastu tailaiśca nāṅgaṃ kiñcidapi spṛśet / tilapiṣṭaṃ na cāśnīyādgatasarvarasaṃ tathā
ce_text: śiraḥsnātaś ca tailena nāṅgaṃ kiṃ cid upaspṛśet / tilapiṣṭaṃ na cāśnīyāt tathāyur vindate mahat

vulgate_text: tasya vedaḥ praṇaśyeta āyuści parihīyate / tasmādyukto hyanadhyāye nādhīyīta kadācana
ce_text: ya ucchiṣṭaḥ pravadati svādhyāyaṃ cādhigacchati / yaś cānadhyāyakāle 'pi mohād abhyasyati dvijaḥ / tasmād yukto 'py anadhyāye nādhīyīta kadā cana

vulgate_text: parvakāleṣu sarveṣu brahmacārī sadā bhavet / samānamekapātre tu bhuñjennānnaṃ janeśvara
ce_text: upavāsaṃ ca kurvīta snātaḥ śucir alaṃkṛtaḥ / parvakāleṣu sarveṣu brahmacārī sadā bhavet

vulgate_text: nāvalīḍhamavajñātamāghrātuṃ bhakṣayedapi / tathā noddhṛtasārāṇi prekṣatāmapradāya ca
ce_text: nālīḍhayā parihataṃ bhakṣayīta kadā cana / tathā noddhṛtasārāṇi prekṣatāṃ nāpradāya ca

vulgate_text: na pāṇau lavaṇaṃ vidvānprāśnīyānna ca rātriṣu / dadhisaktūnna doṣāyāṃ pibenmadhu ca nityaśaḥ
ce_text: na pāṇau lavaṇaṃ vidvān prāśnīyān na ca rātriṣu / dadhisaktūn na bhuñjīta vṛthāmāṃsaṃ ca varjayet

vulgate_text: vṛddho jñātistathā mitramanāthā ca svasā guruḥ kulīnaḥ paṇḍita iti rakṣyā niḥsvaḥ svaśaktitaḥ / gṛhe vāsayitavyāste dhanyamāyuṣyameva ca
ce_text: vṛddho jñātis tathā mitraṃ daridro yo bhaved api / gṛhe vāsayitavyās te dhanyam āyuṣyam eva ca

vulgate_text: gṛhe pārāvatā dhāryāḥ śukāśca sahaśārikāḥ / devatāpratimā''darśaścandanāḥ puṣpavallikāḥ
ce_text: gṛhe pārāvatā dhanyāḥ śukāś ca sahasārikāḥ / gṛheṣv ete na pāpāya tathā vai tailapāyikāḥ

vulgate_text: śuddhaṃ jalaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca rajataṃ gṛhamaṅgalam gṛheṣvete na pāpāya yathā vai tailapāyikāḥ
ce_text: gṛhe pārāvatā dhanyāḥ śukāś ca sahasārikāḥ / gṛheṣv ete na pāpāya tathā vai tailapāyikāḥ

vulgate_text: sauhityaṃ na ca kartavyaṃ rātrau na ca samācaret na bhuktvā maithunaṃ gacchenna dhāvennātihāsakam / dvijacchedaṃ na kurvīta bhuktvā na ca samācaret
ce_text: sauhityaṃ ca na kartavyaṃ rātrau naiva samācaret / dvijacchedaṃ na kurvīta bhuktvā na ca samācaret

vulgate_text: tailaṃ janmadine'ṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ ca parvasu nakṣatre na ca kurvīta yasmiñjāto bhavennaraḥ / na proṣṭhapadayoḥ kāryaṃ tathā''gneye ca bhārata
ce_text: śiraḥsnāto 'tha kurvīta daivaṃ pitryam athāpi ca / nakṣatre na ca kurvīta yasmiñ jāto bhaven naraḥ / na proṣṭhapadayoḥ kāryaṃ tathāgneye ca bhārata

vulgate_text: na caikena parivrajyaṃ na gantavyaṃ tathā niśi / nānāpadi parasyānnamanimantritamāharet
ce_text: na caikena parivrājyaṃ na gantavyaṃ tathā niśi / anāgatāyāṃ saṃdhyāyāṃ paścimāyāṃ gṛhe vaset

vulgate_text: na gurāvakṛtaprajñe śakyaṃ śiṣyeṇa vartitum / gurau hi sadṛśī vṛttiryathā śiṣyasya bhārata
ce_text: na gurāv akṛtaprajñe śakyaṃ śiṣyeṇa vartitum / guror hi dīrghadarśitvaṃ yat tac chiṣyasya bhārata

vulgate_text: na jyeṣṭho vā'vamanyeta duṣkṛtaḥ sukṛto'pi vā / gurūṇāmaparādho hi śakyaḥ kṣantavya eva ca
ce_text: na jyeṣṭhān avamanyeta duṣkṛtaḥ sukṛto 'pi vā / yadi strī yady avarajaḥ śreyaḥ paśyet tathācaret / dharmaṃ hi śreya ity āhur iti dharmavido viduḥ

vulgate_text: yadi strī yadyavaraja śreyaḥ paśyettadācaret / dharmārthaḥ śreya ityāhustrayo jñātā vidhāyakāḥ
ce_text: na jyeṣṭhān avamanyeta duṣkṛtaḥ sukṛto 'pi vā / yadi strī yady avarajaḥ śreyaḥ paśyet tathācaret / dharmaṃ hi śreya ity āhur iti dharmavido viduḥ

vulgate_text: pañcamyāṃ vā'pi ṣaṣṭhyāṃ ca paurṇamāsyāṃ ca bhārata / upoṣya ekabhaktena niyatātmā jitendriyaḥ
ce_text: pañcamyāṃ caiva ṣaṣṭhyāṃ ca paurṇamāsyāṃ ca bhārata / kṣamāvān rūpasaṃpannaḥ śrutavāṃś caiva jāyate

vulgate_text: yajiṣṇuḥ pañcamīṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ kule bhojayate dvijān aṣṭamīmatha kauravya kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśīm / upoṣya vyādhirahito vīryavānabhijāyate
ce_text: aṣṭamīm atha kaunteya śuklapakṣe caturdaśīm / upoṣya vyādhirahito vīryavān abhijāyate

vulgate_text: pitṛbhakto māghamāsaṃ yaḥ kṣipedekabhojanaḥ / śrīmatkule jñātimadhye subhagatvaṃ prapadyate

vulgate_text: adhivāse sopsarasāṃ nṛtyagītavinādite / ramate strīsahasrāḍhye sukutī virajā naraḥ
ce_text: adhivāse so 'psarasāṃ nṛtyagītavinādite / taptakāñcanavarṇābhaṃ vimānam adhirohati

vulgate_text: duḥkhitasyārtapūrvasya dravyāṇāṃ pratipādanam / na caitadrocate teṣāṃ ye dhanaiḥ sukhamedhitāḥ
ce_text: duḥkhitasyārthamānābhyāṃ dravyāṇāṃ pratipādanam / na caite svargakāmasya rocante sukhamedhasaḥ

vulgate_text: agnikāryaparo nityaṃ nityaṃ kalyaprabodhanaḥ / agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ
ce_text: ṣaḍbhiḥ sa varṣair nṛpate sidhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ / agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ

vulgate_text: haṃsasārasayuktaṃ ca vimānaṃ labhate naraḥ / indraloke ca vasate varastrībhiḥ samāvṛtaḥ
ce_text: ṣaḍbhir eva tu varṣaiḥ sa sidhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ / taptakāñcanavarṇaṃ ca vimānaṃ labhate naraḥ

vulgate_text: agnikāryaparo nityaṃ nityaṃ kalyaprabodhanaḥ / atirātrasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam
ce_text: atirātrasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoty anuttamam / mayūrahaṃsasaṃyuktaṃ vimānaṃ labhate naraḥ

vulgate_text: niyamena samāyuktaḥ sarvamedhaphalaṃ labheta / ādityairdvādaśaistasya vimānaṃ saṃvidhīyate
ce_text: ādityair dvādaśais tasya vimānaṃ saṃvidhīyate / maṇimuktāpravālaiś ca mahārhair upaśobhitam

vulgate_text: kāmacārī kāmagamaḥ pūjyamāno'psarogaṇaiḥ anekayugaparyantaṃ vimānavaramāsthitaḥ / ramate devakanyābhirdivyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ
ce_text: kāmacārī sudhāhāro vimānavaram āsthitaḥ / ramate devakanyābhir divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ

ce_text: gandharvair apsarobhiś ca pūjyamānaḥ pramodate / dve yugānāṃ sahasre tu divye divyena tejasā

vulgate_text: vimānaṃ sūryacandrābhaṃ divyaṃ samadhigacchati jātarūpamayaṃ yuktaṃ sarvaratnasamanvitam / apsarogaṇasaṅkīrṇaṃ gandharvairabhināditam
ce_text: jātarūpamayaṃ yuktaṃ sarvaratnavibhūṣitam / apsarogaṇasaṃpūrṇaṃ gandharvair abhināditam

vulgate_text: vimāne gaganākāre sūryavaiḍūryasannibhe / pṛṣṭhataḥ somasaṅkaro udarke cābhrasannibhe
ce_text: vimāne nagarākāre sūryavat sūryasaṃnibhe / pṛṣṭhataḥ somasaṃkāśe udak caivābhrasaṃnibhe

vulgate_text: bahubhirniyamairevaṃ śuciraśnāti yo naraḥ / abhrāvakāśaśīlaśca tasya bhānoriva tviṣaḥ

vulgate_text: nirmamā nirahaṅkārā nirdvandvā niṣparigrahāḥ / yoginastīrthabhūtāste tīrthaṃ paramamucyate
ce_text: nirmamā nirahaṃkārā nirdvaṃdvā niṣparigrahāḥ / śucayas tīrthabhūtās te ye bhaikṣam upabhuñjate

vulgate_text: nārāyaṇe'tha rudre vā bhaktistīrthaṃ paraṃ matam / śaucalakṣaṇametatte sarvatraivānvavekṣataḥ
ce_text: tattvavit tv anahaṃbuddhis tīrthaṃ paramam ucyate / śaucalakṣaṇam etat te sarvatraivānvavekṣaṇam

vulgate_text: rajastamaḥsatvamatho yeṣāṃ nirdhūtamātmanā tīrthamācāraśuddhiśca svamārgaparimārgaṇam
ce_text: rajas tamaḥ sattvam atho yeṣāṃ nirdhautam ātmanaḥ / śaucāśauce na te saktāḥ svakāryaparimārgiṇaḥ

vulgate_text: sarvatyāgeṣvabhiratāḥ sarvajñāḥ samadarśinaḥ / śaucaṣveteṣvabhiratāste tīrthaśucayo'pi ca
ce_text: sarvatyāgeṣv abhiratāḥ sarvajñāḥ sarvadarśinaḥ / śaucena vṛttaśaucārthās te tīrthāḥ śucayaś ca te

ce_text: prārthanāc caiva tīrthasya snānāc ca pitṛtarpaṇāt / dhunanti pāpaṃ tīrtheṣu pūtā yānti divaṃ sukham

vulgate_text: ekaḥ prasūyate rājanneka eva vinaśyati / ekastarati durgāṇi gacchatyekastu durgatim
ce_text: bṛhaspatir uvāca / ekaḥ prasūto rājendra jantur eko vinaśyati / ekas tarati durgāṇi gacchaty ekaś ca durgatim

vulgate_text: tato garbhaḥ sambhavati śleṣātstrīpuṃsayornṛpa etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ bhūyaḥ kiṃ śrotumicchasi yudhiṣṭhira uvāca
ce_text: tato garbhaḥ saṃbhavati strīpuṃsoḥ pārtha saṃgame / etat te sarvam ākhyātaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotum icchasi

vulgate_text: tvagasthimāṃsamutsṛjya taiśca bhūtairvivarjitaḥ jīvaḥ saha vasankṛtsnaṃ sukhaduḥkhasahaḥ prabho bṛhaspatiruvāca
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca / tvagasthimāṃsam utsṛjya taiś ca bhūtair vivarjitaḥ / jīvaḥ sa bhagavan kvasthaḥ sukhaduḥkhe samaśnute

vulgate_text: kukkuṭaḥ pañcavarṣāṇi pañcavarṣāṇi jambukaḥ / śvā varṣamekaṃ bhavati tato jāyeta mānavaḥ

vulgate_text: asūyakaḥ kutsitaśca caṇḍālo duḥkhamaśnute / viśvāsahartā tu naro mīno jāyati durmatiḥ

vulgate_text: sūkaraḥ pañcavarṣāṇi daśavarṣāṇi śvāvidhaḥ / biḍālaḥ pañcavarṣāṇi daśavarṣāṇi kukkuṭaḥ

vulgate_text: itihāsamimaṃ divyaṃ pavitraṃ paramaṃ śubham / sāyaṃ prātaḥ sadā samyak śrotavyaṃ ca bubhūṣatā / bhīṣma uvāca
ce_text: bhīṣma uvāca / sāmnā prasādyate kaś cid dānena ca tathāparaḥ / puruṣaḥ prakṛtiṃ jñātvā tayor ekataraṃ bhajet

vulgate_text: tato nārāyaṇo devaḥ saṃkliṣṭo vratacaryayā / vahnirviniḥsṛto vaktrātkṛṣṇasyādbhutadarśanaḥ
ce_text: tato nārāyaṇaṃ tejo vratacaryendhanotthitam / vaktrān niḥsṛtya kṛṣṇasya vahnir adbhutakarmaṇaḥ

vulgate_text: keśavasya vacaḥ śrutvā tuṣṭuvurmunipuṅgavāḥ bhavānsṛjati vai lokānbhavānsaṃharati prajāḥ / bhavāñśītaṃ bhavānuṣṇaṃ bhavānsatyaṃ bhavānkratuḥ
ce_text: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ / bhavān visṛjate lokān bhavān saṃharate punaḥ / bhavāñ śītaṃ bhavān uṣṇaṃ bhavān eva pravarṣati

vulgate_text: tvattaḥ sarvamidaṃ tāta lokacakraṃ pravartate / tvamevārhasi tadvaktuṃ mukhādagnivinirgamam
ce_text: etan no vismayakaraṃ praśaṃsa madhusūdana / tvam evārhasi kalyāṇa vaktuṃ vahner vinirgamam

vulgate_text: evaṃ me vaiṣṇavaṃ tejo mama vaktrādviniḥsṛtam / tattejasā nirmathitaḥ purato'yaṃ giriḥ sthitaḥ
ce_text: vāsudeva uvāca / etat tad vaiṣṇavaṃ tejo mama vaktrād viniḥsṛtam / kṛṣṇavartmā yugāntābho yenāyaṃ mathito giriḥ

vulgate_text: tasmādbhavadbhiryatkiṃcidṛṣṭaṃ vā'pyathavā śrutam / āścaryabhūtaṃ lokeṣu tadbhavanto bruvantu me
ce_text: yac chrutaṃ yac ca vo dṛṣṭaṃ divi vā yadi vā bhuvi / āścaryaṃ paramaṃ kiṃ cit tad bhavanto bruvantu me

vulgate_text: yuṣmābhiḥ kathitaṃ yatsyāttapasā bhāvitātmabhiḥ tasyādamṛtasaṃkāśaṃ vāṅmadhuśravaṇe spṛhā
ce_text: tasyāmṛtanikāśasya vāṅmadhor asti me spṛhā / bhavadbhiḥ kathitasyeha tapovananivāsibhiḥ

vulgate_text: ahaṃ mānuṣayonisthaḥ sāmprataṃ munipuṅgavāḥ tasmānmānuṣavadvīryaṃ mama jānīta suvratāḥ / bhavadbhiḥ kathyamānaṃ ca apūrvamiva tadbhavet / bhīṣma uvāca
ce_text: bhīṣma uvāca / sāmnā prasādyate kaś cid dānena ca tathāparaḥ / puruṣaḥ prakṛtiṃ jñātvā tayor ekataraṃ bhajet

vulgate_text: tatastvṛṣigaṇāḥ sarve nāradaṃ devadarśanam / amanyanta budhā buddhyā samarthaṃ tannibodhane
ce_text: tato munigaṇāḥ sarve nāradaṃ devadarśanam / tadā niyojayām āsur vacane vākyakovidam

vulgate_text: bhavatā tīrthayātrārthaṃ caratā himavadgirau / dṛṣṭaṃ vai yattadāścaryaṃ śrotṝṇāṃ paramaṃ priyam
ce_text: yad āścaryam acintyaṃ ca girau himavati prabho / anubhūtaṃ munigaṇais tīrthayātrāparāyaṇaiḥ

vulgate_text: atastvamaviśeṣeṇa hitārthaṃ sarvamāditaḥ / priyārthaṃ keśavasyāsya sa bhavānvaktumarhati
ce_text: tad bhavān ṛṣisaṃghasya hitārthaṃ sarvacoditaḥ / yathādṛṣṭaṃ hṛṣīkeśe sarvam ākhyātum arhati

vulgate_text: mṛdaṅgamurajoddhuṣṭaṃ śaṅkhavīṇābhināditam / nṛtyadbhirbhūtasaṅghaiśca sarvatastvabhiśobhitam
ce_text: mṛdaṅgapaṇavodghuṣṭaṃ śaṅkhabherīnināditam / nṛtyadbhir bhūtasaṃghaiś ca barhiṇaiś ca samantataḥ

vulgate_text: pranṛttāpsarasaṃ divyaṃ devagandharvanāditam / prathame varṣarātre tu meghasaṅghanināditam
ce_text: pranṛttāpsarasaṃ divyaṃ divyastrīgaṇasevitam / dṛṣṭikāntam anirdeśyaṃ divyam adbhutadarśanam

vulgate_text: ye codhvaretasaḥ siddhāstatratatra samāgatāḥ / mārtāṇḍaraśmisañcārā viśvedevagaṇāstathā
ce_text: munayaś ca mahābhāgāḥ siddhāś caivordhvaretasaḥ / maruto vasavaḥ sādhyā viśvedevāḥ sanātanāḥ

vulgate_text: tathā nāgāstathā divyā lokapālā hutāśanāḥ / vātāśca sarve cāyānti divyapuṣpasamākulāḥ
ce_text: yakṣā nāgāḥ piśācāś ca lokapālā hutāśanāḥ / bhāvāś ca sarve nyagbhūtās tatraivāsan samāgatāḥ

vulgate_text: kirantaḥ sarvapuṣpāṇi kiranto'dbhutadarśanāḥ / oṣadhyaḥ prajvalantyaśca dyotayantyo diśo daśa
ce_text: ṛtavaḥ sarvapuṣpaiś ca vyakiranta mahādbhutaiḥ / oṣadhyo jvalamānāś ca dyotayanti sma tad vanam

vulgate_text: vihagāśca mudā yuktā nṛtyanti ca nadanti ca / tataḥ samantatastatra divyā divyajanapriyāḥ
ce_text: vihagāś ca mudā yuktāḥ prānṛtyan vyanadaṃś ca ha / giripṛṣṭheṣu ramyeṣu vyāharanto janapriyāḥ

vulgate_text: vyāghracarmaparīdhāno gajacarmottaracchadaḥ / vyālayajñopavītaśca lohitāntravibhūṣitaḥ
ce_text: vyāghracarmāmbaradharaḥ siṃhacarmottaracchadaḥ / vyālayajñopavītī ca lohitāṅgadabhūṣaṇaḥ

vulgate_text: hariśmaśrujaṭo bhīmo bhayakartā'maradviṣām / bhayaheturabhaktānāṃ bhaktānāmabhayaṅkaraḥ
ce_text: hariśmaśrur jaṭī bhīmo bhayakartā suradviṣām / abhayaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ bhaktānāṃ vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ

vulgate_text: kinnarairdevagandharvaiḥ stūyamānastatastataḥ / ṛṣibhiścāpsarobhiśca sarvataścaiva śobhitaḥ
ce_text: ulūkavadanair bhīmaiḥ śyenabhāsamukhais tathā / nānāvarṇamṛgaprakhyaiḥ sarvajātisamanvayaiḥ / kiṃnarair devagandharvair yakṣabhūtagaṇais tathā

vulgate_text: mahoragasamākīrṇaṃ sarveṣāṃ romaharṣaṇam / bhīmarūpamanirdeśyamapradhṛṣyatamaṃ vibhoḥ
ce_text: tasya bhūtapateḥ sthānaṃ bhīmarūpadharaṃ babhau / apradhṛṣyataraṃ caiva mahoragasamākulam

vulgate_text: kāñcanaṃ kalaśaṃ gṛhya sarvatīrthāmbupūritam / puṣpavṛṣṭyā'bhivarṣantī divyagandhasamāvṛtā
ce_text: puṣpavṛṣṭyābhivarṣantī gandhair bahuvidhais tathā / sevantī himavatpārśvaṃ harapārśvam upāgamat

vulgate_text: devyā cāndhīkṛte deve kaśmalaṃ samapadyata / nimīlite bhūtapatau naṣṭacandrārkatārakam
ce_text: janaś ca vimanāḥ sarvo bhayatrāsasamanvitaḥ / nimīlite bhūtapatau naṣṭasūrya ivābhavat

vulgate_text: tṛtīyaṃ cāsya sambhūtaṃ lalāṭe netramāyatam / dvādaśādityasaṅkāśaṃ lokānbhāsā'vabhāsayat
ce_text: tṛtīyaṃ cāsya saṃbhūtaṃ netram ādityasaṃnibham / yugāntasadṛśaṃ dīptaṃ yenāsau mathito giriḥ

vulgate_text: dahyamāne girau tasminmṛgapakṣisamākule / savidyādharagandharve divyauṣadhasamākule
ce_text: dahyamāne vane tasmin saśālasaraladrume / sacandanavane ramye divyauṣadhividīpite

vulgate_text: hṛṣṭapuṣṭavihaṅgaiśca praphulladrumakānanaḥ / siddhacāraṇasaṅghaiśca prītiyuktaiḥ samākulaḥ
ce_text: tato 'bhavat punaḥ sarvaḥ prakṛtisthaḥ sudarśanaḥ / prahṛṣṭavihagaś caiva prapuṣpitavanadrumaḥ

vulgate_text: bhagavandevadeveśa śūlapāṇe mahādyute / vismayo me mahāñjātastasminnetrāgnisambhave
ce_text: bhagavan sarvabhūteśa śūlapāṇe mahāvrata / saṃśayo me mahāñ jātas taṃ me vyākhyātum arhasi

vulgate_text: kimarthaṃ devadeveśa lalāṭe'sminprakāśate / atisūryāgnisaṅkāśaṃ tṛtīyaṃ netramāyatam
ce_text: kimarthaṃ te lalāṭe vai tṛtīyaṃ netram utthitam / kimarthaṃ ca girir dagdhaḥ sapakṣigaṇakānanaḥ

vulgate_text: eṣa me saṃśayo deva hṛdi me sampravartate / devadeva namastubhyaṃ tanme saṃsitumarhasi / nārada uvāca
ce_text: nārada uvāca / tato munigaṇaḥ sarvas tāṃ devīṃ pratyapūjayat / vāgbhir ṛgbhūṣitārthābhiḥ stavaiś cārthavidāṃ vara

vulgate_text: tṛtīyaṃ locanaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ lokaṃ saṃrakṣituṃ mayā / kathitaṃ saṃśayasthānaṃ nirviśaṅkā bhava priye
ce_text: naṣṭāditye tathā loke tamobhūte nagātmaje / tṛtīyaṃ locanaṃ dīptaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ te rakṣatā prajāḥ

vulgate_text: tapa eva sadā dharmo brāhmaṇasya na saṃśayaḥ / sa tu dharmārthamutpannaḥ pūrvaṃ dhātrā tapobalāt
ce_text: upavāsaḥ sadā dharmo brāhmaṇasya na saṃśayaḥ / sa hi dharmārtham utpanno brahmabhūyāya kalpate

vulgate_text: tasyopanayanaṃ dharmo nityaṃ codakadhāraṇam / śāstrasya śravaṇaṃ dharmo devavrataniṣevaṇam
ce_text: maheśvara uvāca / rahasyaśravaṇaṃ dharmo vedavrataniṣevaṇam / vratacaryāparo dharmo gurupādaprasādanam

vulgate_text: atithipriyatā dharmo dharmastretāgnidhāraṇam / iṣṭirvā paśubandhāśca vidhipūrvaṃ paraṃtapa
ce_text: atithivratatā dharmo dharmas tretāgnidhāraṇam / iṣṭīś ca paśubandhāṃś ca vidhipūrvaṃ samācaret

vulgate_text: dampatyoḥ samaśīlatvaṃ dharmo vai gṛhamedhinām / evaṃ dvijanmano dharmo gārhasthye dharmadhāraṇam
ce_text: daṃpatyoḥ samaśīlatvaṃ dharmaś ca gṛhamedhinām / gṛhyāṇāṃ caiva devānāṃ nityaṃ puṣpabalikriyā

vulgate_text: utsāhaḥ śastrajīvitvaṃ tasya dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ / bhṛtyānāṃ bharaṇaṃ dharmaḥ kṛte karmaṇyamoghatā
ce_text: yajñopavītadhāraṇaṃ yajño dharmakriyās tathā / bhṛtyānāṃ bharaṇaṃ dharmaḥ kṛte karmaṇy amoghatā

vulgate_text: yadi na syustathā vaiśyā na bhaveyustathā pare / teṣāmadhyayanaṃ dānaṃ gajanaṃ dharma ucyate
ce_text: teṣām agnipariṣyandaḥ pitṛdevārcanaṃ tathā / yajñānāṃ cāpi pañcānāṃ yajanaṃ dharma ucyate

vulgate_text: vāṇijyaṃ satpathe sthānamātitheyatvameva ca / viprāṇāṃ svāgatanyāyo vaiśyadharmaḥ sanātanaḥ
ce_text: vāṇijyaṃ satpathasthānam ātithyaṃ praśamo damaḥ / viprāṇāṃ svāgataṃ tyāgo vaiśyadharmaḥ sanātanaḥ

vulgate_text: tilagandharasāścaiva na vikreyāḥ kathañcana / vaṇikpathamupāsadbhirvaiśyairvaiśyapathi sthitaiḥ
ce_text: tilān gandhān rasāṃś caiva na vikrīṇīta vai kva cit / vaṇikpatham upāsīno vaiśyaḥ satpatham āśritaḥ

vulgate_text: sarvātithyaṃ trivargasya yathāśakti divāniśam / evaṃ te vihitā devi lokayātrā svayaṃbhuvā
ce_text: sarvātithyaṃ trivargasya yathāśakti divāniśam / śūdradharmaḥ samākhyātas trivarṇaparicāraṇam

vulgate_text: vārtā ca kārukarmāṇi śilyaṃ nāṭyaṃ tathaiva ca / ahiṃsakaḥ śubhācāro devatadvijavandakaḥ
ce_text: tyaktahiṃsaḥ śubhācāro devatādvijapūjakaḥ / śūdro dharmaphalair iṣṭaiḥ saṃprayujyeta buddhimān

vulgate_text: bhagavandevadeveśa namaste vṛṣabhadhvaja / śrotumicchāmyahaṃ deva dharmamāśramiṇāṃ vibho / maheśvara uvāca
ce_text: maheśvara uvāca / netre me saṃvṛte devi tvayā bālyād anindite / naṣṭālokas tato lokaḥ kṣaṇena samapadyata

vulgate_text: tathaiva vānaprasthasya dharmāḥ proktāḥ sanātanāḥ
ce_text: vedoktaḥ paramo dharmaḥ smṛtiśāstragato 'paraḥ / śiṣṭācīrṇaḥ paraḥ proktas trayo dharmāḥ sanātanāḥ

vulgate_text: teṣu tāvatpravakṣyāmi dharmaṃ śubhaphalodayam / brāhmaṇeṣvabhayo dharmaḥ paramaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ
ce_text: teṣām imaṃ pravakṣyāmi dharmakarmaphalodayam / brāhmaṇeṣu hi yo dharmaḥ sa dharmaḥ paramo mataḥ

vulgate_text: svadāraniratirdharmo nityaṃ japyaṃ tathaiva ca / sarvātithyaṃ trivargasya yathāśakti divāniśam
ce_text: sarvātithyaṃ trivargasya yathāśakti divāniśam / śūdradharmaḥ samākhyātas trivarṇaparicāraṇam

vulgate_text: traividyo brāhmaṇo vṛddho na cādhyayanajīvakaḥ / trivargasya vyatikrāntaṃ tasya dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ
ce_text: traividyo brāhmaṇo vidvān na cādhyayanajīvanaḥ / trikarmā triparikrānto maitra eṣa smṛto dvijaḥ

vulgate_text: ṣaṭ karmāṇi ca proktāni sṛṣṭāni brahmaṇā purā / dharmiṣṭhāni variṣṭhāni tānitāni śṛṇūttame
ce_text: ṣaḍ imāni tu karmāṇi provāca bhuvaneśvaraḥ / vṛttyarthaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ vai śṛṇu tāni samāhitā

vulgate_text: yajanaṃ yājanaṃ caiva dānaṃ pātre pratigrahaḥ / adhyāpanamadhyayanaṃ ṣaṭkarmā dharmabhāgṛjuḥ
ce_text: yajanaṃ yājanaṃ caiva tathā dānapratigrahau / adhyāpanam adhītaṃ ca ṣaṭkarmā dharmabhāg dvijaḥ

vulgate_text: nityaḥ svādhyāyato dharmaḥ nityayajñaḥ sanātanaḥ / dānaṃ praśaṃsate nityaṃ brāhmaṇeṣu trikarmasu
ce_text: nityasvādhyāyatā dharmo dharmo yajñaḥ sanātanaḥ / dānaṃ praśasyate cāsya yathāśakti yathāvidhi

vulgate_text: cakṣuḥśrotramanojihvāsnigdhavarṇapradaḥ sadā / atithyabhyāgatarataḥ śeṣānnakṛtabhojanaḥ
ce_text: amānī ca sadājihmaḥ snigdhavāṇīpradas tathā / atithyabhyāgataratiḥ śeṣānnakṛtabhojanaḥ

vulgate_text: prātarutthāya vai paścādbhojane tu nimantrayet / satkṛtyā'nuvrajedyaśca tasya dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ
ce_text: prātar utthāya cācamya bhojanenopamantrya ca / satkṛtyānuvrajed yaś ca tasya dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ

vulgate_text: pravṛttilakṣaṇo dharmo gṛhastheṣu vidhīyate / tadahaṃ kīrtayiṣyāmi trivargeṣu ca yadyathā
ce_text: pravṛttilakṣaṇo dharmo gṛhastheṣu vidhīyate / tam ahaṃ kīrtayiṣyāmi sarvabhūtahitaṃ śubham

vulgate_text: nivṛttilakṣaṇaḥ puṇyo dharmo mokṣo vidhīyate / tasya vṛttiṃ pravakṣyāmi tāṃ śṛṇuṣva samāhitā
ce_text: nivṛttilakṣaṇas tv anyo dharmo mokṣa iti smṛtaḥ / tasya vṛttiṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu me devi tattvataḥ

vulgate_text: yadyacca parihartavyaṃ gṛhīṇātithiparvasu / tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi kathyamānaṃ tvayā vibho / maheśvara uvāca
ce_text: maheśvara uvāca / tilottamā nāma purā brahmaṇā yoṣid uttamā / tilaṃ tilaṃ samuddhṛtya ratnānāṃ nirmitā śubhā

vulgate_text: mātāpitṛviyuktānāṃ kā caryā gṛhamedhinām / vidhavānāṃ ca nārīṇāṃ bhavāneva bravītu me / maheśvara uvāca
ce_text: maheśvara uvāca / tilottamā nāma purā brahmaṇā yoṣid uttamā / tilaṃ tilaṃ samuddhṛtya ratnānāṃ nirmitā śubhā

vulgate_text: āśāpāśavimokṣaṃ ca vidhidharmamanuttamam / vṛkṣamūlacaro nityaṃ śūnyāgāriniveśanamam
ce_text: vṛkṣamūlaśayo nityaṃ śūnyāgāraniveśanaḥ / nadīpulinaśāyī ca nadītīraratiś ca yaḥ

vulgate_text: nadīpulinaśāyī ca nadītīramanuvrajan vimuktaḥ sarvasaṅgebhyaḥ snehabandhena vai dvijaḥ
ce_text: vimuktaḥ sarvasaṅgeṣu snehabandheṣu ca dvijaḥ / ātmany evātmano bhāvaṃ samāsajyāṭati dvijaḥ

vulgate_text: ātmanyevātmanā bhāvaṃ samāyojyeha tena vai / ātmabhūto yatāhāro mokṣadṛṣṭena karmaṇā
ce_text: sthāṇubhūto nirāhāro mokṣadṛṣṭena karmaṇā / parivrajati yo yuktas tasya dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ

vulgate_text: pavitranityo yuktaśca tasya dharmaḥka sanātanaḥ naikatra ramate sakto na caikagrāmagocaraḥ / yukto'pyaṭati yo yukto na caikapulināśrayaḥ
ce_text: na caikatra cirāsakto na caikagrāmagocaraḥ / yukto hy aṭati nirmukto na caikapulineśayaḥ

vulgate_text: vartamānāḥ kathaṃ sarve prāpnuvantyuttamāṃ gatim / etatsarvaṃ samāsena vaktumarhasi mānadaḥ / maheśvara uvāca
ce_text: kena vṛttena rājendra vartamānā narā yudhi / prāpnuvanty uttamaṃ svargaṃ kathaṃ ca narakaṃ nṛpa

vulgate_text: māṃsasya bhakṣaṇe doṣo yaścāsyābhakṣaṇe guṇaḥ / tadahaṃ kīrtayiṣyāmi tannibodha yathātatham
ce_text: jāto naḥ saṃśayo dharme māṃsasya parivarjane / doṣo bhakṣayataḥ kaḥ syāt kaś cābhakṣayato guṇaḥ

vulgate_text: yastu sarvāṇi māṃsāni yāvajjīvaṃ na bhakṣayet / sa svarge vipulaṃ sthānaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ
ce_text: sarvamāṃsāni yo rājan yāvajjīvaṃ na bhakṣayet / svarge sa vipulaṃ sthānaṃ prāpnuyān nātra saṃśayaḥ

vulgate_text: yattu varṣaśataṃ pūrṇaṃ tapyate paramaṃ tapaḥ / yaccāpi varjayenmāṃsaṃ samametanna vā samam
ce_text: yas tu varṣaśataṃ pūrṇaṃ tapas tapyet sudāruṇam / yaś caikaṃ varjayen māṃsaṃ samam etan mataṃ mama

vulgate_text: annaṃ prāṇo manuṣyāṇāmannadaḥ prāṇado bhavet / tasmākadannaṃ viśeṣeṇa dātumicchati mānavaḥ
ce_text: annena sadṛśaṃ dānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati / tasmād annaṃ viśeṣeṇa dātum icchanti mānavāḥ

vulgate_text: śrāntamadhvapariśrāntamatithiṃ gṛhamāgatam / arcayīta prayatnena sa hi yajño varapradaḥ
ce_text: śrāntam adhvani vartantaṃ vṛddham arham upasthitam / arcayed bhūtim anvicchan gṛhastho gṛham āgatam

vulgate_text: kṛtvā tu pātakaṃ karma yo dadyādannamarthinām / brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣeṇa sopahanti svakaṃ tamaḥ
ce_text: kṛtvāpi pāpakaṃ karma yo dadyād annam arthine / brāhmaṇāya viśeṣeṇa na sa pāpena yujyate

vulgate_text: pitarastasya nandanti suvṛṣṭyā karṣakā iva / putro yasya tu pautro vā śrotriyaṃ bhojayiṣyati
ce_text: āśaṃsante hi pitaraḥ suvṛṣṭim iva karṣakāḥ / asmākam api putro vā pautro vānnaṃ pradāsyati

vulgate_text: annadānācca lokāṃstānsampravakṣyāmyanindite / bhavanāni prakāśante divi teṣāṃ mahātmanām
ce_text: annadānāṃ hi ye lokās tāṃs tvaṃ śṛṇu narādhipa / bhavanāni prakāśante divi teṣāṃ mahātmanām / nānāsaṃsthānarūpāṇi nānāstambhānvitāni ca

vulgate_text: anekaśatabhaumāni sāntarjalavanāni ca / vaiḍūryārciḥprakāśapani hemarūpyamayāni ca
ce_text: anekaśatabhaumāni sāntarjalavanāni ca / vaiḍūryārkaprakāśāni raupyarukmamayāni ca

vulgate_text: nānārūpāṇi saṃsthānāṃ nānāratnamayāni ca / candramaṇḍalaśubhrāṇi kiṅkiṇījālavanti ca
ce_text: candramaṇḍalaśubhrāṇi kiṅkiṇījālavanti ca / taruṇādityavarṇāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca

vulgate_text: taruṇādityavarṇāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca / yatheṣṭabhakṣyabhojyāni śayanāsanavanti ca
ce_text: candramaṇḍalaśubhrāṇi kiṅkiṇījālavanti ca / taruṇādityavarṇāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca

vulgate_text: sarvakāmaphalāścātra vṛkṣā bhavanasaṃsthitāḥ / vāpyo bahvyaśca kūpāśca dīrghikāśca sahasraśaḥ
ce_text: sarvakāmaphalāś cāpi vṛkṣā bhavanasaṃsthitāḥ / vāpyo vīthyaḥ sabhāḥ kūpā dīrghikāś caiva sarvaśaḥ

vulgate_text: tasmādannaṃ viśeṣeṇa dātavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā / sarvakālaṃ ca sarvasya sarvatra ca sadaiva ca
ce_text: ete lokāḥ puṇyakṛtām annadānāṃ mahātmanām / tasmād annaṃ viśeṣeṇa dātavyaṃ mānavair bhuvi

vulgate_text: yatkiñcitkurute pāpaṃ puruṣo vṛttikarśitaḥ / api gokarṇamātreṇa bhūmidānana mucyate
ce_text: yat kiṃ cit puruṣaḥ pāpaṃ kurute vṛttikarśitaḥ / api gocarmamātreṇa bhūmidānena pūyate

vulgate_text: suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vastraṃ maṇimuktāvasūni ca / sarvametanmahābhāge bhūmidāne pratiṣṭhitam
ce_text: suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vastraṃ maṇimuktāvasūni ca / sarvam etan mahāprājña dadāti vasudhāṃ dadat

vulgate_text: brāhmaṇaṃ vṛttasampannamāhitāgniṃ śucivratam / grāhayitvā nijāṃ bhūmiṃ na yānti yamasādanam
ce_text: brāhmaṇaṃ vṛttasaṃpannam āhitāgniṃ śucivratam / naraḥ pratigrāhya mahīṃ na yāti yamasādanam

vulgate_text: māṃsaiḥ prīṇanti pitaro mudgamāṣayavairiha / śaśarauravamāṃsena ṣaṇmāsaṃ tṛptiriṣyate
ce_text: māsān aṣṭau pārṣatena rauraveṇa navaiva tu / gavayasya tu māṃsena tṛptiḥ syād daśamāsikī

vulgate_text: saṃvatsaraṃ ca gavyena haviṣā pāyasena ca / vārdhrīṇasasya māṃsena tṛptirdvādaśavārṣikī
ce_text: yathā gavyaṃ tathā yuktaṃ pāyasaṃ sarpiṣā saha / vādhrīṇasasya māṃsena tṛptir dvādaśavārṣikī

vulgate_text: ānantyāya bhaveddattaṃ khaṅgamāṃsaṃ pitṛkṣaye / pāyasaṃ satilaṃ kṣaudraṃ khaṅgamāṃsena sammitam
ce_text: ānantyāya bhaved dattaṃ khaḍgamāṃsaṃ pitṛkṣaye / kālaśākaṃ ca lauhaṃ cāpy ānantyaṃ chāga ucyate

vulgate_text: anne datte mṛtānāṃ tu kathamāpyāyanaṃ bhavet / evaṃ mayā saṃśayitaṃ bhagavanvaktumarhasi / nārada uvāca
ce_text: kṛṣṇapakṣe daśamyādau varjayitvā caturdaśīm / śrāddhakarmaṇi tithyaḥ syuḥ praśastā na tathetarāḥ

vulgate_text: rohiṇī śaśino bhāryā svāhā cāgneraninditā / kāśyapasyāditiścaiva vasiṣṭhasyāpyarundhatī
ce_text: varuṇasya tato gaurī sūryasya ca suvarcalā / rohiṇī śaśinaḥ sādhvī svāhā caiva vibhāvasoḥ

vulgate_text: strīdharmaṃ śrotumicchāmi tvayaiva samudāhṛtam / sadhramacāriṇī me tvaṃ lokasandhāriṇī tathā
ce_text: tato yayur bhūtagaṇāḥ saritaś ca yathāgatam / gandharvāpsarasaś caiva praṇamya śirasā bhavam / vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ / anuśāsya śubhair vākyair bhīṣmas tv āha mahāmatim / janamejayaḥ / prītyā punaḥ sa śuśrūṣur vacanaṃ yad yudhiṣṭhire / pitāmaho me viprarṣe bhīṣmaṃ kālavaśaṃ gatam / kim apṛcchat tadā rājā sarvasāmāsikaṃ hitam / ubhayor lokayor yuktaṃ puruṣārtham anuttamam / vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ / tan me vada mahāprājña śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me / bhūya eva mahārāja śṛṇu dharmasamuccayam / yad apṛcchat tadā rājā kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / śaratalpagataṃ bhīṣmaṃ sarvapārthivasaṃnidhau / yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / ajātaśatruḥ prītātmā punar evābhyabhāṣata / pitāmaha mahāprājña sarvaśāstraviśārada / śrūyatāṃ me hi vacanam arthitvāt prabravīmy aham / parāvarajño bhūtānāṃ dayāvān sarvajantuṣu / āgamair bahubhiḥ sphīto bhavān naḥ paramaḥ kule / tvādṛśo durlabho loke sāṃprataṃ jñānadarśanaḥ / bhavatā guruṇā caiva dhanyā bata vayaṃ prabho / ayaṃ sa kālaḥ saṃprāpto durlabho jñātibāndhavaiḥ / śāstā nu nāsti naḥ kaś cit tvad ṛte puruṣarṣabha / tasmād dharmārthasaṃyuktam āyatyāṃ ca hitodayam / āścaryaṃ paramaṃ vākyaṃ śrotum icchāmi bhārata / ayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān sarvapārthivasaṃnidhau / bhavantaṃ bahumānāc ca praṇayāc copasevate / asyaiva tu samakṣaṃ naḥ pārthivānāṃ tathaiva ca / itivṛttaṃ purāṇaṃ ca śrotṝṇāṃ paramaṃ hitam / yadi te 'ham anugrāhyo bhrātṛbhiḥ sahito 'nagha / vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ / matpriyārthaṃ tu kauravya snehād bhāṣitum arhasi / tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā snehād āgataviklavaḥ / prapibann iva taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhīṣmo vacanam abravīt / śṛṇu rājan purā vṛttam itihāsaṃ purātanam / etāvad uktvā gāṅgeyaḥ praṇamya śirasā harim / dharmarājaṃ samīkṣyedaṃ punar vaktuṃ samārabhat / ayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān putrārthaṃ vratakāṅkṣayā / dīkṣito 'bhūn mahābāhuḥ purā dvādaśavārṣikam / dīkṣitaṃ keśavaṃ draṣṭum abhijagmur maharṣayaḥ / sevituṃ ca mahātmānaḥ prīyamāṇā janārdanam / nāradaḥ parvataś caiva kṛṣṇadvaipāyanas tathā / devalaḥ kāśyapaś caiva hastikāśyapa eva ca / jamadagniś ca rājendra dhaumyo vālmīkir eva ca / apare 'pi tapaḥsiddhāḥ satyavrataparāyaṇāḥ / śiṣyair anugatāḥ sarve brahmavidbhir akalmaṣaiḥ / keśavas tān abhigatān prītyā saṃpratigṛhya ca / teṣām atithisatkāraṃ pūjanārthaṃ kulocitam / devakītanayo hṛṣṭo devatulyam akalpayat / upaviṣṭeṣu sarveṣu viṣṭareṣu tadānagha / viśvasteṣu hi tuṣṭeṣu keśavārcanayā punaḥ / parasparaṃ kathā divyāḥ prāvartanta manoramāḥ / viṣṇor nārāyaṇasyaiva prasādāt kathayāmi tāḥ / tasyaiva vratacaryāyāṃ munibhir vismitaḥ purā / yaś ca govṛṣabhāṅkasya prabhāvo 'bhūn mahātmanaḥ / yatra devī mahādevam apṛcchat saṃśayān purā / kathayām āsa śarvas tān devyāḥ priyacikīrṣayā / umāpatyoś ca saṃvādaṃ śṛṇu tāta manoramam / varṇāśramāṇāṃ dharmaś ca tatra tāta samāhitaḥ / ṛṣidharmaś ca nikhilo rājadharmaś ca puṣkalaḥ / gṛhasthadharmaś ca śubhaḥ karmapākaphalāni ca / devaguhyaṃ ca vividhaṃ dānadharmavidhis tadā / vidhānam atra saṃproktaṃ yamasya niyamasya ca / yamalokavidhānaṃ ca svargalokavidhis tathā / prāṇamokṣavidhiś caiva tīrthacaryā ca puṣkalā / mokṣadharmavidhānaṃ ca sāṃkhyayogasamanvitam / strīdharmaś ca svayaṃ devyā devadevāya bhāṣitaḥ / evamādi śubhaṃ sarvaṃ tatra tāta samāhitam / rudrāṇyāḥ saṃśayapraśno yatra tāta pravartate / dhanyaṃ yaśasyam āyuṣyaṃ dharmyaṃ ca paramaṃ hitam / puṣṭiyogam idaṃ divyaṃ kathyamānaṃ mayā śṛṇu / itihāsam imaṃ divyaṃ pavitraṃ paramaṃ śubham / sāyaṃ prātaḥ sadā samyak śrotavyaṃ ca bubhūṣatā / tato nārāyaṇo devaḥ saṃkliṣṭo vratacaryayā / vahnir viniḥsṛto vaktrāt kṛṣṇasyādbhutadarśanaḥ / agninā tena mahatā niḥsṛtena mukhād vibhoḥ / paśyatām eva sarveṣāṃ dagdha eva nagottamaḥ / mṛgapakṣisamākīrṇaḥ śvāpadair abhisaṃkulaḥ / vṛkṣagulmalatākīrṇo mathito dīnadarśanaḥ / punaḥ sa dṛṣṭamātreṇa hariṇā saumyacetasā / sa babhūva giriḥ kṣipraṃ praphulladrumakānanaḥ / siddhacāraṇasaṃghaiś ca prasannair upaśobhitaḥ / mattavāraṇasaṃyukto nānāpakṣigaṇair yutaḥ / tad adbhutam acintyaṃ ca sarveṣām abhavad bhṛśam / taṃ dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭaromāṇaḥ sarve munigaṇās tadā / vismitāḥ paramāyastāḥ sādhvasākulalocanāḥ / na kiṃ cid abruvaṃs tatra śubhaṃ vā yadi vetarat / tato nārāyaṇo devo munisaṃghe suvismite / tān samīkṣyaiva madhuraṃ babhāṣe puṣkarekṣaṇaḥ / kimarthaṃ munisaṃghasya vismayo 'yam anuttamaḥ / etaṃ me saṃśayaṃ sarve yāthātathyam aninditāḥ / ṛṣayo vaktum arhanti niścayenārthakovidāḥ / keśavasya vacaḥ śrutvā tuṣṭuvur munipuṃgavāḥ / bhavān sṛjati vai lokān bhavān saṃharati prajāḥ / bhavāñ śītaṃ bhavān uṣṇaṃ bhavān satyaṃ bhavān kratuḥ / bhavān ādir bhavān anto bhavato 'nyan na vidyate / sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ sarvaṃ tvam eva puruṣottama / tvattaḥ sarvam idaṃ tāta lokacakraṃ pravartate / tvam evārhasi tad vaktuṃ mukhād agnivinirgamam / etan no vismayakaraṃ babhūva madhusūdana / tato 'dhigatasaṃtrāsā bhavāma puruṣottama / bhagavān / yad icchet tatra vaktavyaṃ kuto 'smākaṃ niyogataḥ / nityaṃ hitārthaṃ lokānāṃ bhavadbhiḥ kriyate tapaḥ / tasmāl lokahitaṃ guhyaṃ śrūyatāṃ kathayāmi vaḥ / asuraḥ sāṃprataṃ kaś cid ahito lokanāśanaḥ / māyāstrakuśalaś caiva baladarpasamanvitaḥ / babhūva sa mayā vadhyo lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā / putreṇa me vadho dṛṣṭas tasya vai munipuṃgavāḥ / tadarthaṃ putram evāhaṃ sisṛkṣur vanam āgataḥ / ātmanaḥ sadṛśaṃ putram ahaṃ janayituṃ vrataiḥ / evaṃ vrataparītasya tapastīvratayā mama / athātmā mama dehasthaḥ so 'gnir bhūtvā viniḥsṛtaḥ / viniḥsṛtya gato draṣṭuṃ kṣaṇena ca pitāmaham / brahmaṇā manmatho 'naṅgaḥ putratve me prakalpitaḥ / anujñātaś ca tenaiva punar āyān mamāntikam / etan me vaiṣṇavaṃ tejo mama vaktrād viniḥsṛtam / tattejasā nirmathitaḥ purato 'yaṃ giriḥ sthitaḥ / dṛṣṭvā nāśaṃ gires tasya saumyabhāvatayā mama / punaḥ sa dṛṣṭamātreṇa girir āsīd yathāpuram / etad guhyaṃ mayā tathyaṃ kathitaṃ vaḥ samāsataḥ / bhavanto vyathitā yena vismitāś ca tapodhanāḥ / bhagavān / ṛṣīṇām evam uktvā tu tān punaḥ pratyabhāṣata / bhavatāṃ darśanād eva prītir abhyadhikā mama / bhavantas tu tapaḥsiddhā bhavanto devadarśanāḥ / sarvatra gatimantaś ca jñānavijñānabhāvitāḥ / gatāgatajñā lokānāṃ sarve nirdhūtakalmaṣāḥ / tasmād bhavadbhir yat kiṃ cid dṛṣṭaṃ vāpy atha vā śrutam / āścaryabhūtaṃ lokeṣu tad bhavanto bruvantu me / yuṣmābhiḥ kathitaṃ yat syāt tapasā bhāvitātmabhiḥ / tat syād amṛtasaṃkāśaṃ vāṅmadhuśravaṇe spṛhā / rāgadveṣaviyuktānāṃ satataṃ satyavādinām / śraddheyaṃ śravaṇīyaṃ ca vacanaṃ hi satāṃ bhavet / tatsaṃyogaṃ hi tan me 'stu na vṛthā kartum arhatha / bhavatāṃ darśanaṃ tasmāt saphalaṃ tu bhaven mama / tad ahaṃ sajjanamukhān niḥsṛtaṃ janasaṃsadi / kathayiṣyāmy aharaho buddhidīpakaraṃ nṛṇām / tad anye vardhayiṣyanti pūjayiṣyanti vāpare / vākśalyavigatāś cānye praśaṃsanti purātanam / bhīṣmaḥ / evaṃ bruvati govinde śravaṇārthaṃ maharṣayaḥ / vāgbhiḥ sāñjalimālābhir idam ūcur janārdanam / ayuktam asmān evaṃ tvaṃ vācā varada bhāṣitum / tvacchāsanamukhāḥ sarve tvadadhīnapariśramāḥ / evaṃ pūjayituṃ cāsmān na caivārhasi keśava / tad vastv anyan na paśyāmo yal loke te na vidyate / divi vā bhuvi vā kiṃ cit tat sarvaṃ hi tvayā tatam / na vidmahe vayaṃ deva kathyamānaṃ tavāntike / evam ukto hṛṣīkeśaḥ sasmitaṃ cedam abravīt / ahaṃ mānuṣayonisthaḥ sāṃprataṃ munipuṃgavāḥ / tasmān mānuṣavad vīryaṃ mama jānīta suvratāḥ / bhīṣmaḥ / bhavadbhiḥ kathyamānaṃ ca apūrvam iva tad bhavet / evaṃ saṃcoditāḥ sarve keśavena mahātmanā / ṛṣayaś cānuvartante vāsudevasya śāsanam / tatas tv ṛṣigaṇāḥ sarve nāradaṃ devadarśanam / amanyanta budhā buddhyā samarthaṃ tannibodhane / ṛṣir ugratapāś cāyaṃ keśavasya priyo 'dhikam / purāṇajñaś ca vāgmī ca kāraṇais taṃ ca menire / sarve tadarhaṇaṃ kṛtvā nāradaṃ vākyam abruvan / bhavatā tīrthayātrārthaṃ caratā himavadgirau / dṛṣṭaṃ vai yat tad āścaryaṃ śrotṝṇāṃ paramaṃ priyam / tattvaṃ tvam aviśeṣeṇa hitārthaṃ sarvam āditaḥ / bhīṣmaḥ / priyārthaṃ keśavasyāsya sa bhavān vaktum arhati / tadā saṃcoditaḥ sarvair ṛṣibhir nāradas tathā / praṇamya śirasā viṣṇuṃ sarvalokahite ratam / samudvīkṣya hṛṣīkeśaṃ vaktum evopacakrame / tato nārāyaṇasuhṛn nārado vadatāṃ varaḥ / nāradaḥ / śaṃkarasyomayā sārdhaṃ saṃvādam anvabhāṣata / bhagavaṃs tīrthayātrārthaṃ tathaiva caratā mayā / divyam adbhutasaṃkāśaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ haimavataṃ vanam / nānāvṛkṣalatāyuktaṃ nānāpakṣigaṇair yutam / nānāratnasamākīrṇaṃ nānābhāvasamanvitam / divyacandanasaṃyuktaṃ divyadhūpena dhūpitam / divyapuṣpasamākīrṇaṃ divyagandhena mūrchitam / siddhacāraṇasaṃvāsaṃ bhūtasaṃghair niṣevitam / variṣṭhāpsarasākīrṇaṃ nānāgandharvasaṃkulam / mṛdaṅgamurajodghuṣṭaṃ śaṅkhavīṇābhināditam / nṛtyadbhir bhūtasaṃghaiś ca sarvatas tv abhiśobhitam / nānārūpair virūpaiś ca bhīmarūpair bhayānakaiḥ / vyāghrasiṃhoragamukhair biḍālavadanais tathā / kharoṣṭradvīpivadanair gajavaktrais tathaiva ca / ulūkaśyenavadanaiḥ kākagṛdhramukhais tathā / evaṃ bahuvidhākārair bhūtasaṃghair bhṛśākulam / nānadyamānaṃ bahudhā harapāriṣadair bhṛśam / ghorarūpaṃ sudurdarśaṃ rakṣogaṇaśatair vṛtam / samājaṃ tadvane dṛṣṭaṃ mayā bhūtapateḥ purā / pranṛttāpsarasaṃ divyaṃ devagandharvanāditam / ṣaṭpadair upagītaṃ ca prathame māsi mādhave / utkrośatkrauñcakuraraiḥ sārasair jīvajīvakaiḥ / mattābhiḥ parapuṣṭābhiḥ kūjantībhiḥ samākulam / uttamotsavasaṃkāśaṃ bhīmarūpataraṃ tataḥ / draṣṭuṃ bhavati sarvasya dharmabhāgijanasya ca / ye cordhvaretasaḥ siddhās tatra tatra samāgatāḥ / mārtāṇḍaraśmisaṃcārā viśvedevagaṇās tathā / tathā nāgās tathādityā lokapālā hutāśanāḥ / vātāś ca sarve vāyanti divyapuṣpasamākulāḥ / kirantaḥ sarvapuṣpāṇi kiranto 'dbhutadarśanāḥ / oṣadhyaḥ prajvalantyaś ca dyotayantyo diśo daśa / vihagāś ca mudā yuktā nṛtyanti ca nadanti ca / giraḥ sumadhurās tatra divyā divyajanapriyāḥ / tatra devo giritaṭe hemadhātuvibhūṣite / paryaṅka iva babhrāja upaviṣṭo mahādyutiḥ / vyāghracarmaparīdhāno gajacarmottaracchadaḥ / vyālayajñopavītaś ca lohitāntravibhūṣitaḥ / hariśmaśrujaṭo bhīmo bhayakartā suradviṣām / bhayaghnaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ bhaktānām abhayaṃkaraḥ / kiṃnarair devagandharvaiḥ stūyamānaḥ samantataḥ / ṛṣibhiś cāpsarobhiś ca sarvataś cāpi śobhitaḥ / tatra bhūtapateḥ sthānaṃ devadānavasaṃkulam / sarvatejomayaṃ bhūmnā lokapālaniṣevitam / mahoragasamākīrṇaṃ
