ce_text: sa varaiś chanditas tena nṛpo vacanam abravīt / sahasrabāhur bhūyāṃ vai camūmadhye gṛhe 'nyathā

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭavānetadevaṃ hi kathaṃ jāyedajo hi saḥ / sthānamākāśamaṇḍaṃ tu yasmājjātaḥ pitāmahaḥ
ce_text: draṣṭavyaṃ naitad evaṃ hi kathaṃ jyāyastamo hi saḥ / smṛtam ākāśam aṇḍaṃ tu tasmāj jātaḥ pitāmahaḥ

vulgate_text: muñca bhāryāmucathyasya kasmāttvaṃ hṛtavānasi / iti śrutvā vacastasya so'tha taṃ varuṇo'bravīt
ce_text: ity ukto vacanāt tasya nāradena jaleśvaraḥ / muñca bhāryām utathyasyety atha taṃ varuṇo 'bravīt / mamaiṣā supriyā bhāryā nainām utsraṣṭum utsahe

vulgate_text: abhivādya tu taṃ devāḥ pṛṣṭvā kuśalameva ca / idamūcurmahātmānaṃ vākyaṃ kāle janādhipa
ce_text: abhivādya ca taṃ devā dṛṣṭvā ca yaśasā vṛtam / idam ūcur mahātmānaṃ vākyaṃ kāle janādhipa

vulgate_text: evamuktastadātrirvai tamonudabhavacchaśī / apaśyatsaumyabhāvācca somavatpriyadarśanaḥ
ce_text: evam uktas tadātris tu tamonud abhavac chaśī / apaśyat saumyabhāvaṃ ca sūryasya pratidarśanam

vulgate_text: atriṇā tvatha somatvaṃ kṛtamuttamatejasā / dvijenāgnidvitīyeni japatā carmavāsasā
ce_text: udbhāsitaś ca savitā devās trātā hatāsurāḥ / atriṇā tv atha somatvaṃ kṛtam uttamatejasā

vulgate_text: aśvibhyāṃ saha necchāmaḥ somaṃ pātuṃ mahāvrata / yadanyadvakṣyase vipra tatkariṣyāma te vacaḥ / cyavana uvāca
ce_text: aśvibhyāṃ saha necchāmaḥ pātuṃ somaṃ mahāvrata / pibantv anye yathākāmaṃ nāhaṃ pātum ihotsahe

vulgate_text: kriyatāṃ madvaco devā yathā vai samudāhṛtam / etadvaḥ kurvatāṃ śreyo bhavennaitadakurvatām / indra uvāca
ce_text: indra uvāca / asmābhir varjitāv etau bhavetāṃ somapau katham / devair na saṃmitāv etau tasmān maivaṃ vadasva naḥ

vulgate_text: aśvibhyāṃ saha somaṃ vai na pāsyāmi dvijottama / pibantvanye yathākāmaṃ nāhaṃ pātumihotsahe / cyavana uvāca
ce_text: aśvibhyāṃ saha necchāmaḥ pātuṃ somaṃ mahāvrata / pibantv anye yathākāmaṃ nāhaṃ pātum ihotsahe

vulgate_text: sarve ca niyatātmāno bālānāṃ saṃvibhāginaḥ upetya śanakairyānti na sevanti rajasvalām / svargātiṃ caiva gacchanti tathaiva śubhakarmiṇaḥ
ce_text: dīptam agniṃ juhvati ca gurūṇāṃ vacane sthitāḥ / sarve ca niyatātmāno bālānāṃ saṃvibhāginaḥ

vulgate_text: abhuktavatsu nāśnanti garbhiṇīvṛddhakādiṣu / pūrvāhṇeṣu na dīvyanti divā caiva na śerate
ce_text: upetya śakaṭair yānti na sevanti rajasvalām / abhuktavatsu nāśnanti divā caiva na śerate

vulgate_text: nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā prītāḥ sarve divaukasaḥ / praśaśaṃsurdvijāṃścāpi brāhmaṇāṃśca yaśasvinaḥ
ce_text: brahmasṛṣṭā havyabhujaḥ kapān bhuktvā sanātanāḥ / nabhasīva yathābhrāṇi vyarājanta narādhipa / praśaśaṃsur dvijāṃś caiva brahmāṇaṃ ca yaśasvinam

vulgate_text: uktā dharmā ye purāṇe mahānto rājanviprāṇāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ viśāṃ ca / yeye śūdrāṇāṃ dharmamupāsate te tāneva kṛṣṇadupaśikṣasva pārthaḥ
ce_text: uktā dharmā ye purāṇe mahānto; brāhmaṇānāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ viśāṃ ca / paurāṇaṃ ye daṇḍam upāsate ca; śeṣaṃ kṛṣṇād upaśikṣasva pārtha

vulgate_text: asmādvāyuścāntarikṣaṃ divaṃ ca diśaścatasro vidiśaścatasraḥ / sṛṣṭistathaiveyamanuprasūtā sa nirmame viśvamidaṃ purāṇaḥ
ce_text: kṛṣṇaḥ pṛthvīm asṛjat khaṃ divaṃ ca; varāho 'yaṃ bhīmabalaḥ purāṇaḥ / asya cādho 'thāntarikṣaṃ divaṃ ca; diśaś catasraḥ pradiśaś catasraḥ / sṛṣṭis tathaiveyam anuprasūtā; sa nirmame viśvam idaṃ purāṇam

vulgate_text: taṃ ghoṣārthe gīrbhirindrāḥ stuvanti sa cāpīśo bhārataikaḥ paśūnām / tasya bhakṣānvividhānvedayanti tamevājau vāhanaṃ vedayanti
ce_text: tasya bhakṣān vividhān vedayanti; tam evājau vāhanaṃ vedayanti / tasyāntarikṣaṃ pṛthivī divaṃ ca; sarvaṃ vaśe tiṣṭhati śāśvatasya

vulgate_text: hiraṇmayaḥ saptagūḍhaḥ sasaṃvi- ccaturbāhuḥ pannagaḥ padmanābhaḥ / mahātejāḥ sarvagaḥ sarvasiṃhaḥ kṛṣṇo lokāndhārayate yathaikaḥ haṃsaṃ tamoghnaṃ ca tameva vīra kṛṣṇaṃ sadā pārtha kartāramehi
ce_text: sa ekayuk cakram idaṃ trinābhi; saptāśvayuktaṃ vahate vai tridhāmā / mahātejāḥ sarvagaḥ sarvasiṃhaḥ; kṛṣṇo lokān dhārayate tathaikaḥ / aśnann anaśnaṃś ca tathaiva dhīraḥ; kṛṣṇaṃ sadā pārtha kartāram ehi

vulgate_text: dvāravatyāṃ samāsīnaṃ purā māṃ kurunandana / pradyumnaḥ paripapraccha brāhmaṇaiḥ parikopitaḥ
ce_text: pradyumnaḥ paripapraccha brāhmaṇaiḥ parikopitaḥ / kiṃ phalaṃ brāhmaṇeṣv asti pūjāyāṃ madhusūdana / īśvarasya satas tasya iha caiva paratra ca

vulgate_text: kiṃ phalaṃ brāhmaṇeṣvasti pūjāyāṃ madhusūdana / īśvaratvaṃ kutasteṣāmihaiva ca paratra ca
ce_text: pradyumnaḥ paripapraccha brāhmaṇaiḥ parikopitaḥ / kiṃ phalaṃ brāhmaṇeṣv asti pūjāyāṃ madhusūdana / īśvarasya satas tasya iha caiva paratra ca

vulgate_text: roṣaṇaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sūkṣme'pyapakṛte kṛte / paribhāṣāṃ ca me śrutvā ko nu dadyātpratiśrayam
ce_text: durvāsasaṃ vāsayet ko brāhmaṇaṃ satkṛtaṃ gṛhe / paribhāṣāṃ ca me śrutvā ko nu dadyāt pratiśrayam / yo māṃ kaś cid vāsayeta na sa māṃ kopayed iha

vulgate_text: atha svāvasathaṃ gatvā saśayyāstaraṇāni ca / adahatsa mahātejāstataścābhyapatatsvayam
ce_text: so 'smadāvasathaṃ gatvā śayyāś cāstaraṇāni ca / kanyāś cālaṃkṛtā dagdhvā tato vyapagataḥ svayam

vulgate_text: avimṛśyaiva ca tataḥ kṛtavānasmi tattathā / tenocchiṣṭena gātrāṇi śarīraṃ ca samālipam
ce_text: avimṛśyaiva ca tataḥ kṛtavān asmi tat tathā / tenocchiṣṭena gātrāṇi śiraś caivābhyamṛkṣayam

vulgate_text: na tu pādatale lipte tasmātte mṛtyuratra vai / naitanme priyamityevaṃ sa māṃ prīto'bravīttadā
ce_text: na tu pādatale lipte kasmāt te putrakādya vai / naitan me priyam ity eva sa māṃ prīto 'bravīt tadā / ity ukto 'haṃ śarīraṃ svam apaśyaṃ śrīsamāyutam

vulgate_text: durvāsasaḥ prasādātte śaṃkarāṃśasya māghava / avāptamiha vijñānaṃ tanme vyākhyātumarhasi
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca / durvāsasaḥ prasādāt te yat tadā madhusūdana / avāptam iha vijñānaṃ tan me vyākhyātum arhasi

vulgate_text: prayataḥ prātarutthāya yastvadhīyedviśāmpate / prāñjaliḥ śatarudrīyaṃ nāsya kiñcani durlabham
ce_text: prayataḥ prātar utthāya yad adhīye viśāṃ pate / prāñjaliḥ śatarudrīyaṃ tan me nigadataḥ śṛṇu

vulgate_text: śivaḥ sarvakato rudraḥ sraṣṭā yastvaṃ śṛṇuṣva me prajāpatistamasṛjattamaso'nte mahātapāḥ / śaṅkarastvasṛjattāta prajāḥ sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ
ce_text: prajāpatis tat sasṛje tapaso 'nte mahātapāḥ / śaṃkaras tv asṛjat tāta prajāḥ sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ

vulgate_text: tena caiva hi tuṣṭena sa yajñaḥ sandhito'bhavat / yadyaccāpahṛtaṃ tatra tattathaivānvajīvayat
ce_text: tena caivātikopena sa yajñaḥ saṃdhito 'bhavat / yad yac cāpi hataṃ tatra tat tathaiva pradīyate

vulgate_text: sa vai rudraḥ sa ca śivaḥ sogniḥ sarvaḥ sa sarvajit / sa caivendraśca vāyuśca so'svinau sa ca vidyutaḥ
ce_text: sa devendraś ca vāyuś ca so 'śvinau sa ca vidyutaḥ / sa candramāḥ sa ceśānaḥ sa sūryo varuṇaś ca saḥ

vulgate_text: ātmano'rdhaṃ tu tasyāgniḥ somo'rdhaṃ punarucyate / brahmacaryaṃ caratyekā śivā cāsya tanustathā
ce_text: ātmano 'rdhaṃ tu tasyāgnir ucyate bharatarṣabha / brahmacaryaṃ caraty eṣa śivā yāsya tanus tathā

vulgate_text: viśvedevāśca yattasminviśvarūpastataḥ smṛtaḥ sahasrākṣo'yutākṣo vā sarvatokṣimayopi vā / cakṣuṣaḥ prabhavaṃ tejaḥ sarvataścakṣureva tat
ce_text: sahasrākṣo 'yutākṣo vā sarvatokṣimayo 'pi vā / cakṣuṣaḥ prabhavas tejo nāsty anto 'thāsya cakṣuṣām

vulgate_text: nityena brahmacaryeṇa liṅgamasya yadā sthitam bhaktānugrahaṇārthāya gūḍhaliṅgastataḥ smṛtaḥ / mahayatyasya lokaśca priyaṃ hyetanmahātmanaḥ
ce_text: nityena brahmacaryeṇa liṅgam asya yadā sthitam / mahayanty asya lokāś ca maheśvara iti smṛtaḥ

vulgate_text: tadayuktaṃ vyavasyanti bālāḥ paṇḍitamāninaḥ / atha sañcintyamevaikaṃ kāraṇaṃ kiṃ bhavediti
ce_text: pratyakṣaṃ kāraṇaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ hetukāḥ prājñamāninaḥ / nāstīty evaṃ vyavasyanti satyaṃ saṃśayam eva ca / tad ayuktaṃ vyavasyanti bālāḥ paṇḍitamāninaḥ

vulgate_text: jyotiḥ sarvasya lokasya vipulaṃ pratipadyate na tveva gamanaṃ rājanhetuto gamanaṃ tathā / agrāhyamanibaddhaṃ ca vācā samparivarjayet / yudhiṣṭhira uvāca
ce_text: tattvenāgamanaṃ rājan hetvantagamanaṃ tathā / agrāhyam anibaddhaṃ ca vācaḥ saṃparivarjanam

vulgate_text: asādhoḥ kīdṛśaṃ śīlaṃ sādhoścaiva tu kīdṛśam / bravītu me bhavānetatsanto'santaśca kīdṛśāḥ / bhīṣma uvāca
ce_text: bhīṣma uvāca / nāsty atra saṃśayaḥ kaś cid iti me vartate matiḥ / śṛṇu vakṣyāmi te prājña samyak tvam anupṛcchasi

vulgate_text: atithīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ preṣyāṇāṃ svajanasya ca / sāmānyaṃ bhojanaṃ kuryātsvayaṃ nāgryaśanaṃ vrajet
ce_text: atithīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ preṣyāṇāṃ svajanasya ca / tathā śaraṇakāmānāṃ goptā syāt svāgatapradaḥ

vulgate_text: tathā śaraṇakāmānāṃ goptā syātsvāgatapradaḥ sāyaṃ prātarmanuṣyāṇāmaśanaṃ devanirmitam
ce_text: atithīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ preṣyāṇāṃ svajanasya ca / tathā śaraṇakāmānāṃ goptā syāt svāgatapradaḥ

vulgate_text: nāntarā bhojanaṃ dṛṣṭamupavāsavidhirhi saḥ homakāle yathā vahniḥ kāle homaṃ pratīkṣate
ce_text: sāyaṃ prātar manuṣyāṇām aśanaṃ devanirmitam / nāntarā bhojanaṃ dṛṣṭam upavāsavidhir hi saḥ

vulgate_text: ṛtukāle tathā''dhānaṃ pitaraśca pratīkṣate / nānyadā gacchate yastu brahmacaryaṃ ca tatsmṛtam
ce_text: homakāle yathā vahniḥ kālam eva pratīkṣate / ṛtukāle tathā nārī ṛtum eva pratīkṣate / na cānyāṃ gacchate yas tu brahmacaryaṃ hi tat smṛtam

vulgate_text: vṛddhānnābhibhavejjātu na caitānpreṣayediti / nāsīnaḥ syātsthiteṣvevamāyurasya na riṣyate
ce_text: vṛddhān nātivadej jātu na ca saṃpreṣayed api / nāsīnaḥ syāt sthiteṣv evam āyur asya na riṣyate

vulgate_text: tasmātsarvāṇi bhūtāni dharmameva samāsate eka eva careddharmaṃ na dharmadhvajiko bhavet
ce_text: mānasaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ dharmam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ / tasmāt sarvāṇi bhūtāni dharmam eva samāsate

vulgate_text: dharmavāṇijakā hyete ye dharmamupabhuñjate arceddevānadambhena sevetā'māyayā gurūn
ce_text: eka eva cared dharmaṃ na dharmadhvajiko bhavet / dharmavāṇijakā hy ete ye dharmam upabhuñjate

vulgate_text: kṛtayatnāphalāścaiva dṛśyante śataśo narāḥ / ayatnenaidhamānāśca dṛśyante bahavo janāḥ
ce_text: nālābhakāle labhate prayatne 'pi kṛte sati / lābhakāle 'prayatnena labhate vipulaṃ dhanam / kṛtayatnāphalāś caiva dṛśyante śataśo narāḥ

vulgate_text: śaratalpagataṃ bhīṣmaṃ pāṇḍavo'tha kurūdvahaḥ / yudhiṣṭhiro hitaṃ prepsurapṛcchatkalmaṣāpaham / yudhiṣṭhira uvāca
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca / kiṃ śreyaḥ puruṣasyeha kiṃ kurvan sukham edhate / vipāpmā ca bhavet kena kiṃ vā kalmaṣanāśanam

vulgate_text: tasmai śuśrūṣamāṇāya bhūyaḥ śāntanavastadā / daivaṃ vaṃśaṃ yathānyāyamācaṣṭa puruṣarṣabha / bhīṣma uvāca
ce_text: bhīṣma uvāca / kāryate yac ca kriyate sac cāsac ca kṛtaṃ tataḥ / tatrāśvasīta satkṛtvā asatkṛtvā na viśvaset

vulgate_text: atreḥ putraśca dharmātmā tathā sārasvataḥ prabhuḥ uttarāṃ diśamāśritya ya edhante nibodha tān
ce_text: uttarāṃ diśam āśritya ya edhante nibodha tān / atrir vasiṣṭhaḥ śaktiś ca pārāśaryaś ca vīryavān

vulgate_text: hariścandro maruttaśca tathā daḍharatho nṛpaḥ / mahodaryo hyalarkaśca ailaścaiva narādhipaḥ
ce_text: mahodayo hy alarkaś ca ailaś caiva narādhipaḥ / karaṃdhamo naraśreṣṭhaḥ kadhmoraś ca narādhipaḥ

vulgate_text: ādirājaḥ pṛthurvainyo mitrabhānuḥ priyaṅkaraḥ / trasaddasyustathā rājā śveto rājarṣisattamaḥ
ce_text: trasadasyus tathā rājā śveto rājarṣisattamaḥ / mahābhiṣaś ca vikhyāto nimirājas tathāṣṭakaḥ

vulgate_text: havidhraśca pṛṣadhraśca pratīpaḥ śāntanustathā / ajaḥ prācīnabarhiśca tathaikṣvākurmahāyaśāḥ
ce_text: havidhraś ca pṛṣadhraś ca pratīpaḥ śaṃtanus tathā / kakṣasenaś ca rājarṣir ye cānye nānukīrtitāḥ

vulgate_text: anaraṇyo narapatirjānujaṅghastathaiva ca / kakṣasenaśca rājarṣirye cānye cānukīrtitāḥ
ce_text: havidhraś ca pṛṣadhraś ca pratīpaḥ śaṃtanus tathā / kakṣasenaś ca rājarṣir ye cānye nānukīrtitāḥ

vulgate_text: pālaya tvaṃ prajāḥ sarvāḥ śāntātmā tvanuśāsitā / dvaipāyanaḥ svayaṃcakṣuḥ kṛṣṇaste'stu parāyaṇam / vaiśampāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tūṣṇīṃbhūte tadā bhīṣme paṭe citram ivārpitam / muhūrtam iva ca dhyātvā vyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ / nṛpaṃ śayānaṃ gāṅgeyam idam āha vacas tadā

vulgate_text: dānānāṃ ca vidhiṃ śrutvā cchinnadharmārthasaṃśayaḥ / yadanyadakarodvipra tanme śaṃsitumarhasi / vaiśampāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tūṣṇīṃbhūte tadā bhīṣme paṭe citram ivārpitam / muhūrtam iva ca dhyātvā vyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ / nṛpaṃ śayānaṃ gāṅgeyam idam āha vacas tadā

vulgate_text: abhūnmuhūrtaṃ stimitaṃ sarvaṃ tadrājamaṇḍalam / tūṣṇīṃbhūte tatastasminpaṭe citramivārpitam
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tūṣṇīṃbhūte tadā bhīṣme paṭe citram ivārpitam / muhūrtam iva ca dhyātvā vyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ / nṛpaṃ śayānaṃ gāṅgeyam idam āha vacas tadā

vulgate_text: uvāca cainaṃ madhuraṃ nṛpaṃ śāntanavo nṛpaḥ / praviśasva purīṃ rājandharme ca dhriyatāṃ manaḥ
ce_text: uvāca cainaṃ madhuraṃ tataḥ śāṃtanavo nṛpaḥ / praviśasva puraṃ rājan vyetu te mānaso jvaraḥ

vulgate_text: veda śāstrāṇi sūkṣmāṇi dharmāṃśca manujeśvara / vedāṃśca caturaḥ sarvānṣaḍaṅgairupabṛṃhitān
ce_text: vedaśāstrāṇi sarvāṇi dharmāṃś ca manujeśvara / vedāṃś ca caturaḥ sāṅgān nikhilenāvabudhyase

vulgate_text: tvadbhaktaṃ tvadgatiṃ śāntamudāramaparigraham trāyasva puṇḍarīkākṣa puruṣottama nityaśaḥ / anujānīhi māṃ kṛṣṇa vaikuṇṭha puruṣottama
ce_text: anujānīhi māṃ kṛṣṇa vaikuṇṭha puruṣottama / rakṣyāś ca te pāṇḍaveyā bhavān hy eṣāṃ parāyaṇam

vulgate_text: sa māṃ tvamanujānīhi kṛṣṇa mokṣye kalevaram / tvayā'haṃ samanujñāto gaccheyaṃ paramāṃ gatim / vāsudeva uvāca
ce_text: vāsudeva uvāca / anujānāmi bhīṣma tvāṃ vasūn āpnuhi pārthiva / na te 'sti vṛjinaṃ kiṃ cin mayā dṛṣṭaṃ mahādyute

vulgate_text: anujānāmi bhīṣma tvāṃ vasūnprāpnuhi pārthiva / na te'sti vṛjinaṃ kiñcicchuddhātmaiśvaryasaṃyutaḥ
ce_text: vāsudeva uvāca / anujānāmi bhīṣma tvāṃ vasūn āpnuhi pārthiva / na te 'sti vṛjinaṃ kiṃ cin mayā dṛṣṭaṃ mahādyute

vulgate_text: ityuktvā suhṛdaḥ sarvāṃstathā sampūjya caiva ha dhanaṃ bahuvidhaṃ rājandattvā nityaṃ dvijātiṣu / punarevābravīddhīmānyudhiṣṭhiramidaṃ vacaḥ
ce_text: ity uktvā suhṛdaḥ sarvān saṃpariṣvajya caiva ha / punar evābravīd dhīmān yudhiṣṭhiram idaṃ vacaḥ

vulgate_text: yudhiṣṭhiraśca gāṅgeyaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭraśca duḥkhitau / chādayāmāsaturubhau kṣaumermālyaiśca kauravam
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhiras tu gāṅgeyaṃ viduraś ca mahāmatiḥ / chādayām āsatur ubhau kṣaumair mālyaiś ca kauravam

vulgate_text: yudhiṣṭhireṇa sahito dhṛtarāṣṭraśca pādataḥ vṛddhā striyaḥ kauravāṇāṃ bhīṣmaṃ kurukulodvaham / tālavṛntānyupādāya paryavījanta sarvaśaḥ
ce_text: striyaḥ kauravanāthasya bhīṣmaṃ kurukulodbhavam / tālavṛntāny upādāya paryavījan samantataḥ

vulgate_text: nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam / devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet / vaiśampāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / kṛtodakaṃ tu rājānaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / puraskṛtya mahābāhur uttatārākulendriyaḥ

vulgate_text: rājā tu dhṛtarāṣṭrastaṃ tathā dīno mahābhujam / vākyamāha mahābuddhiḥ prajñācakṣurnareśvaram
ce_text: rājā ca dhṛtarāṣṭras tam upāsīno mahābhujaḥ / vākyam āha mahāprājño mahāśokaprapīḍitam

vulgate_text: śocitavyaṃ mayā caiva gāndhāryā ca mahīpate / yayoḥ putraśataṃ naṣṭaṃ svapnalabdhaṃ yathā dhanam
ce_text: śocitavyaṃ mayā caiva gāndhāryā ca viśāṃ pate / putrair vihīno rājyena svapnalabdhadhano yathā

vulgate_text: yadi māmanujānīyādbhavāngantuṃ tapovanam / kṛtakṛtyo bhaviṣyāmi iti me niścitā matiḥ
ce_text: yadi mām anujānīyād bhavān gantuṃ tapovanam / na hi śāntiṃ prapaśyāmi ghātayitvā pitāmaham / karṇaṃ ca puruṣavyāghraṃ saṃgrāmeṣv apalāyinam

vulgate_text: na hi śāntiṃ prapaśyāmi pātayitvā pitāmaham nṛśaṃsaḥ puruṣavyāghraṃ guruṃ vīryabalānvitam / karṇaṃ ca puruṣavyāghnaṃ saṅgrāmeṣvapalāyinam
ce_text: yadi mām anujānīyād bhavān gantuṃ tapovanam / na hi śāntiṃ prapaśyāmi ghātayitvā pitāmaham / karṇaṃ ca puruṣavyāghraṃ saṃgrāmeṣv apalāyinam

vulgate_text: mokṣadharmāśca nikhilā yāthātathyena te śrutāḥ yathā vai kāmajāṃ māyāṃ parityuktaṃ tvamarhasi
ce_text: mokṣadharmāś ca nikhilā yāthātathyena te śrutāḥ / asakṛc caiva saṃdehāś chinnās te kāmajā mayā

vulgate_text: kośaścāpi viśīrṇo'yaṃ paripūrṇo bhaviṣyati / vidyate draviṇaṃ pārtha girau himavati sthitam
ce_text: vidyate draviṇaṃ pārtha girau himavati sthitam / utsṛṣṭaṃ brāhmaṇair yajñe maruttasya mahīpateḥ / tad ānayasva kaunteya paryāptaṃ tad bhaviṣyati

vulgate_text: āsītkṛtayuge tāta manurdaṇḍidharaḥ prabhuḥ / tasya putro mahoṣvāsaḥ prajātirabhavannṛpaḥ
ce_text: vyāsa uvāca / āsīt kṛtayuge pūrvaṃ manur daṇḍadharaḥ prabhuḥ / tasya putro maheṣvāsaḥ prajātir iti viśrutaḥ

vulgate_text: vāhanaṃ yasya yodhāśca mitrāṇi vividhāni ca / śayanāni ca mukhyāni mahārhāṇi ca sarvaśaḥ
ce_text: vāhanaṃ yasya yodhāś ca dravyāṇi vividhāni ca / dhyānād evābhavad rājan mukhavātena sarvaśaḥ

vulgate_text: hiraṇyaretā noṣṇaḥ syātparivarteta medinī / bhāsaṃ tu na raviḥ kuryānna tu satyaṃ calenmayi / vyāsa uvāca
ce_text: vyāsa uvāca / āsīt kṛtayuge pūrvaṃ manur daṇḍadharaḥ prabhuḥ / tasya putro maheṣvāsaḥ prajātir iti viśrutaḥ

vulgate_text: śrutvā tu pārthivasyaitsaṃvartaḥ pramudaṃ gataḥ / etāvadahamapyevaṃ śaknuyāmiti so'bravīt
ce_text: vyāsa uvāca / śrutvā tu pārthivasyaitat saṃvartaḥ parayā mudā / etāvad aham apy enaṃ kuryām iti tadābravīt

vulgate_text: amaraṃ yājyamāsādya yājayiṣye na mānuṣam / śakreṇa pratiṣiddho'haṃ maruttaṃ mā sma yājaye
ce_text: bṛhaspatir uvāca / amartyaṃ yājayitvāhaṃ yājayiṣye na mānuṣam / marutta gaccha vā mā vā nivṛtto 'smy adya yājanāt

vulgate_text: mā cāpi śubhabuddhitvaṃ labheyamiha karhicit / viṣayaiḥ saṅgataṃ cāstu tyajeyaṃ saṅgataṃ yadi / saṃvarta uvāca
ce_text: saṃvarta uvāca / katham asmi tvayā jñātaḥ kena vā kathito 'smi te / etad ācakṣva me tattvam icchase cet priyaṃ mama

vulgate_text: tasmai bhagavate kṛtvā namaḥ śarvāya vedhase ebhistaṃ nāmabhirdevaṃ sarvavidyādharaṃ stuhi
ce_text: tasmai bhagavate kṛtvā namaḥ śarvāya vedhase / rudrāya śitikaṇṭhāya surūpāya suvarcase

vulgate_text: mṛgavyādhāya mahate dhanvine'tha bhavāya ca / varāya somavaktrāya siddhamantrāya cakṣuṣe
ce_text: bilvadaṇḍāya siddhāya sarvadaṇḍadharāya ca / mṛgavyādhāya mahate dhanvine 'tha bhavāya ca

vulgate_text: hiraṇyabāhave rājannugrāya pataye diśām / lelihānāya goṣṭhāya siddhamantrāya vṛṣṇaye
ce_text: varāya saumyavaktrāya paśuhastāya varṣiṇe / hiraṇyabāhave rājann ugrāya pataye diśām

vulgate_text: tathā rudrāya pataye pṛthave kṛttivāsase vilohitāya dīptāya dīptākṣāya mahaujase / vasuretaḥsuvapuṣe pṛthave kṛttivāsase
ce_text: tathā śukrādhipataye pṛthave kṛttivāsase / kapālamāline nityaṃ suvarṇamukuṭāya ca

vulgate_text: namāmi sarvalokasthaṃ vrajāmi śaraṇaṃ śivam evaṃ kṛtvā namastasmai mahādevāya raṃhase / mahātmane kṣitipate tatsuvarṇamavāpsyasi
ce_text: evaṃ kṛtvā namas tasmai mahādevāya raṃhase / mahātmane kṣitipate tat suvarṇam avāpsyasi / suvarṇam āhariṣyantas tatra gacchantu te narāḥ

vulgate_text: mahattaraṃ hi te lābhaṃ hastyaśvoṣṭrādibhiḥ saha suvarṇamāhariṣyantastatra gacchantu te narāḥ / vyāsa uvāca
ce_text: evaṃ kṛtvā namas tasmai mahādevāya raṃhase / mahātmane kṣitipate tat suvarṇam avāpsyasi / suvarṇam āhariṣyantas tatra gacchantu te narāḥ

vulgate_text: ityuktaḥ sa vacastasya cakre kārandhamātmajaḥ / gaṅgādharaṃ namaskṛtya labdhavāndhanamuttamam
ce_text: vyāsa uvāca / ity uktaḥ sa vacas tasya cakre kāraṃdhamātmajaḥ / tato 'timānuṣaṃ sarvaṃ cakre yajñasya saṃvidhim / sauvarṇāni ca bhāṇḍāni saṃcakrus tatra śilpinaḥ

vulgate_text: sauvarṇāni ca bhāṇḍāni saṃcakrustatra śilpinaḥ śālāśca sarvasambhārāṃstatra saṃvartaśāsanāt
ce_text: vyāsa uvāca / ity uktaḥ sa vacas tasya cakre kāraṃdhamātmajaḥ / tato 'timānuṣaṃ sarvaṃ cakre yajñasya saṃvidhim / sauvarṇāni ca bhāṇḍāni saṃcakrus tatra śilpinaḥ

vulgate_text: nagaṇḍikākārayogaṃ kare'ṇuṃ na cārisomaṃ prapibāmi vahne / na kṣīṇaśaktau prahārāmi vajraṃ ko me sukhāya prahareta martyaḥ
ce_text: indra uvāca / na caṇḍikā jaṅgamā no kareṇur; na vārisomaṃ prapibāmi vahne / na durbale vai visṛjāmi vajraṃ; ko me 'sukhāya praharen manuṣyaḥ

vulgate_text: tvaṃ caivaitadvettha purandaraśca viśvedevā vasavaścāśvinau ca / mitradrohe niṣkṛtirnāsti loke mahatpāpaṃ brahmahatyāsamaṃ tat
ce_text: marutta uvāca / tvaṃ caivaitad vettha puraṃdaraś ca; viśvedevā vasavaś cāśvinau ca / mitradrohe niṣkṛtir vai yathaiva; nāstīti lokeṣu sadaiva vādaḥ

vulgate_text: śarīre jāyate vyādhiḥ śarīraḥ sa nigadyate / mānase jāyate vyādhirmānasastu nigadyate
ce_text: śarīre jāyate vyādhiḥ śārīro nātra saṃśayaḥ / mānaso jāyate vyādhir manasy eveti niścayaḥ

vulgate_text: kāmātmānaṃ na praśaṃsanti loke nehākāmā kācidasti pravṛttiḥ / sarve kāmā manaso'ṅga prabhūtā yānpaṇḍitaḥ saṃharate vicintya bhūyobhūyo janmano'bhyāsayogā- dyogī yogaṃ sāramārgaṃ vicintya
ce_text: kāmātmānaṃ na praśaṃsanti loke; na cākāmāt kā cid asti pravṛttiḥ / dānaṃ hi vedādhyayanaṃ tapaś ca; kāmena karmāṇi ca vaidikāni

vulgate_text: tathaiva svargalokeṣu sabhoddeśeṣu kaurava / ramaṇīyeṣu puṣṇeṣu sahitasya tvayā'nadha
ce_text: tathaiva svargakalpeṣu sabhoddeśeṣu bhārata / ramaṇīyeṣu puṇyeṣu sahitasya tvayānagha

vulgate_text: abuddhyā yanna gṛhṇītāstanme sumahadapriyam / na ca sā'dya punarbhūyaḥ smṛtirme sambhaviṣyati
ce_text: abuddhvā yan na gṛhṇīthās tan me sumahad apriyam / nūnam aśraddadhāno 'si durmedhāś cāsi pāṇḍava

vulgate_text: nūnamaśraddadhāno'si durmedhā hyasi pāṇḍava / na ca śakyaṃ punarvaktumaśeṣeṇa dhanaṃjaya
ce_text: abuddhvā yan na gṛhṇīthās tan me sumahad apriyam / nūnam aśraddadhāno 'si durmedhāś cāsi pāṇḍava

vulgate_text: upapannaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ śrutacāritrasaṃyutam / bhaumenātoṣayaccainaṃ guruvṛttiṃ samāsthitaḥ
ce_text: prītātmā copapannaś ca śrutacāritrasaṃyutaḥ / bhāvena toṣayac cainaṃ guruvṛttyā paraṃtapaḥ

vulgate_text: loke'sminnanubhūyāhamimaṃ mārgamanuṣṭhitaḥ tataḥ siddhiriyaṃ prāptā prasādādātmano mayā / nāhaṃ punarihāgantā lokānālokayāmyaham
ce_text: nāhaṃ punar ihāgantā lokān ālokayāmy aham / ā siddher ā prajāsargād ātmano me gatiḥ śubhā

vulgate_text: duṣṭānnāmiṣapānaṃ ca yadanyonyavirodhi ca / guru cāpyamitaṃ bhuṅkte nātijīrṇe divā punaḥ
ce_text: duṣṭānnaṃ viṣamānnaṃ ca so 'nyonyena virodhi ca / guru vāpi samaṃ bhuṅkte nātijīrṇe 'pi vā punaḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ sacetano janturnābhijānāti kiñcana tamasā saṃvṛtajñānaḥ saṃvṛteṣveva marmasu / sa jīvo niradiṣṭhānaścālyate mātariśvanā
ce_text: tamasā saṃvṛtajñānaḥ saṃvṛteṣv atha marmasu / sa jīvo niradhiṣṭhānaś cāvyate mātariśvanā

vulgate_text: ihaivāśubhakarmāṇaḥ karmabhirnirayaṃ gatāḥ avāggatiriyaṃ kaṣṭā yatra pacyanti mānavāḥ / tasmātsudurlabho mokṣo rakṣyaścātmā tato bhṛśam
ce_text: ihaivāśubhakarmā tu karmabhir nirayaṃ gataḥ / avāk sa niraye pāpo mānavaḥ pacyate bhṛśam / tasmāt sudurlabho mokṣa ātmā rakṣyo bhṛśaṃ tataḥ

vulgate_text: indriyāṇi tu saṃhṛtya mana ātmani dhārayet / tīvraṃ taptvā tapaḥ pūrvaṃ mokṣayogaṃ samācaret
ce_text: indriyāṇi tu saṃhṛtya mana ātmani dhārayet / tīvraṃ taptvā tapaḥ pūrvaṃ tato yoktum upakramet

vulgate_text: iṣīkāṃ ca yathā muñjātkaścinniṣkṛṣya darśayet / yogī niṣkṛṣya cātmānaṃ tathā paśyati dehataḥ
ce_text: iṣīkāṃ vā yathā muñjāt kaś cin nirhṛtya darśayet / yogī niṣkṛṣṭam ātmānaṃ tathā saṃpaśyate tanau

vulgate_text: samyagyuktvā sa ātmānamātmanyeva pratiṣṭhite / vinivṛttajarāduḥkhaḥ sukhaṃ svapiti cāpi saḥ
ce_text: samyag yuktvā yadātmānam ātmany eva prapaśyati / tadaiva na spṛhayate sākṣād api śatakratoḥ

vulgate_text: dehānyatheṣṭamabhyeti hitvemāṃ mānuṣīṃ tanum / nirvedastu na kartavyo bhuñjānena kathañcana
ce_text: nirvedas tu na gantavyo yuñjānena kathaṃ cana / yogam ekāntaśīlas tu yathā yuñjīta tac chṛṇu

vulgate_text: sarvataḥ pāṇipādāntaḥ sarvatokṣiśiromukhaḥ / sarvataḥ śrutimām̐lloke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati
ce_text: sarvataḥpāṇipādaṃ taṃ sarvatokṣiśiromukham / jīvo niṣkrāntam ātmānaṃ śarīrāt saṃprapaśyati

vulgate_text: ātmānamālokayati manasā prahasanniva / tadevamāśrayaṃ kṛtvā mokṣaṃ yāti tato mayi
ce_text: sa tad utsṛjya dehaṃ svaṃ dhārayan brahma kevalam / ātmānam ālokayati manasā prahasann iva

vulgate_text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam / daṃpatyoḥ pārtha saṃvādo yo'bhakavadbharatarṣabha
ce_text: vāsudeva uvāca / atrāpy udāharantīmam itihāsaṃ purātanam / daṃpatyoḥ pārtha saṃvādam abhayaṃ nāma nāmataḥ

vulgate_text: ghreye peye ca dṛśye ca spṛśye śrāvye tathaiva ca / mantavye'pyatha boddhavye subhage paśya sarvadā
ce_text: ghreye peye ca dṛśye ca spṛśye śravye tathaiva ca / havīṃṣy agniṣu hotāraḥ saptadhā sapta saptasu / samyak prakṣipya vidvāṃso janayanti svayoniṣu

vulgate_text: tanmanasthaḥ patirbhūtvā tasmātprehannivāyati / tāṃ matiṃ manasaḥ prāhurmanastasmādapekṣate
ce_text: brāhmaṇa uvāca / tām apānaḥ patir bhūtvā tasmāt preṣyaty apānatām / tāṃ matiṃ manasaḥ prāhur manas tasmād avekṣate

vulgate_text: tasmādbhavitumarhāmi svayamabhyetya śobhane / tasmāducchvāsamāsādya pravakṣyāmi sarasvati
ce_text: yasmād asi ca mā vocaḥ svayam abhyetya śobhane / tasmād ucchvāsam āsādya na vakṣyasi sarasvati

vulgate_text: tatastānabravītsarvānsmayamānaḥ prajāpatiḥ / sarve śreṣṭhā na ca śreṣṭhāḥ sarve cānyonyakāṅkṣiṇaḥ
ce_text: tatas tān abravīd brahmā samavetān prajāpatiḥ / sarve śreṣṭhā na vā śreṣṭhāḥ sarve cānyonyadharmiṇaḥ / sarve svaviṣaye śreṣṭhāḥ sarve cānyonyarakṣiṇaḥ

vulgate_text: svaguṇānbhakṣayantyete guṇavantaḥ śubhāśubhān / asanto nirguṇāścaite saptaite mokṣahetavaḥ
ce_text: svaguṇaṃ bhakṣayanty ete guṇavantaḥ śubhāśubham / ahaṃ ca nirguṇo 'treti saptaite mokṣahetavaḥ

vulgate_text: adanhavīṃṣi cānnāni mamatvena vihanyate ātmārthe pācayannannaṃ mamatvenopahanyate
ce_text: adan hy avidvān annāni mamatvenopapadyate / ātmārthaṃ pācayan nityaṃ mamatvenopahanyate

vulgate_text: naitadasti pṛthagbhāvaḥ kiñcinadyattataḥ sukham / naitadastyapṛthagbhāvaḥ kiñcidduḥkhataraṃ tataḥ
ce_text: brāhmaṇa uvāca / na tad asti pṛthagbhāve kiṃ cid anyat tataḥ samam / na tad asty apṛthagbhāve kiṃ cid dūrataraṃ tataḥ

vulgate_text: anu tvāṃ manyate mātā anu tvāṃ manyate pitā / mantravijñānamunnīya parivarte viśeṣataḥ
ce_text: anu tvā manyatāṃ mātā pitā bhrātā sakhāpi ca / mantrayasvainam unnīya paravantaṃ viśeṣataḥ

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvā rūpāṇi bahuśastānyeva pratigṛdhyati / tasmāccakṣurhaniṣyāmi niśitaiḥ sāyakairaham / cakṣuruvāca
ce_text: alarka uvāca / dṛṣṭvā vai vividhān bhāvāṃs tān eva pratigṛdhyati / tasmāc cakṣuḥ prati śarān pratimokṣyāmy ahaṃ śitān

vulgate_text: tato'larkastapo ghoraṃ tatraivāsthāya duṣkaram / nādhyagacchatparaṃ śaktyā bāṇameteṣu saptasu
ce_text: pitara ūcuḥ / tato 'larkas tapo ghoram āsthāyātha suduṣkaram / nādhyagacchat paraṃ śaktyā bāṇam eteṣu saptasu / susamāhitacetās tu tato 'cintayata prabhuḥ

vulgate_text: aho kaṣṭaṃ yadasmābhiḥ sarvaṃ bāhyamanuṣṭhitam bhogatṛṣṇāsamāyuktaiḥ pūrvaṃ rājyamupāsitam / iti paścānmayā jñātaṃ yogānnāsti paraṃ sukham
ce_text: vismitaś cāpi rājarṣir imāṃ gāthāṃ jagāda ha / aho kaṣṭaṃ yad asmābhiḥ pūrvaṃ rājyam anuṣṭhitam / iti paścān mayā jñātaṃ yogān nāsti paraṃ sukham

vulgate_text: ityuktaḥ pitṛbhiḥ sotha tapo ghoraṃ samāsthitaḥ / jāmadagnyo mahābhāge siddhiṃ ca paramāṃ gataḥ
ce_text: brāhmaṇa uvāca / ity uktaḥ sa tapo ghoraṃ jāmadagnyaḥ pitāmahaiḥ / āsthitaḥ sumahābhāgo yayau siddhiṃ ca durgamām

vulgate_text: yathā mama tathā'nyeṣāmiti manye dvijottama / uṣyatāṃ yāvadutsāho bhujyatāṃ yāvadiṣyate / brāhmaṇa uvāca
ce_text: brāhmaṇa uvāca / trayo vai ripavo loke nava vai guṇataḥ smṛtāḥ / harṣaḥ stambho 'bhimānaś ca trayas te sāttvikā guṇāḥ

vulgate_text: samyagapyupadiṣṭasya hyamṛtasyeva tṛpyase karmabuddhirabuddhitvājjñānaliṅgānnipātitaḥ
ce_text: samyag apy upadiṣṭaś ca bhramarair iva lakṣyate / karmabuddhir abuddhitvāj jñānaliṅgair ivāśritam

vulgate_text: vaktumarhasi viprarṣe yathāvadiha tattvataḥ / tvadanyaḥ kaśca na praśnānetānvaktumihārhati
ce_text: etān me bhagavan praśnān yāthātathyena sattama / vaktum arhasi viprarṣe yathāvad iha tattvataḥ

vulgate_text: sarvasaṃśayasaṃcchettā tvadanyo na ca vidyate / saṃsārabhīravaścaiva mokṣakāmāstathā vayam / vāsudeva uvāca
ce_text: vāsudeva uvāca / tatas tu tasyā brāhmaṇyā matiḥ kṣetrajñasaṃkṣaye / kṣetrajñād eva parataḥ kṣetrajño 'nyaḥ pravartate

vulgate_text: kau cobhau karmaṇāṃ mārgau prāpnuyurdakṣiṇottarau / nirayaṃ cāpavargaṃ ca bhūtānāṃ prabhavāpyayau
ce_text: kenobhau karmapanthānau mahattvaṃ kena vindati / pralayaṃ cāpavargaṃ ca bhūtānāṃ prabhavāpyayau

vulgate_text: vānaprasthaṃ dvijātīnāṃ trayāṇāmupadiśyate / sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ gṛhastho'yaṃ viśiṣyate
ce_text: phalamūlānilabhujāṃ munīnāṃ vasatāṃ vane / vānaprasthaṃ dvijātīnāṃ trayāṇām upadiśyate

vulgate_text: śraddhālakṣaṇamityekaṃ dharmaṃ dhīrāḥ pracakṣate naiṣṭhiko'tha yatirvā'pi virakto brahmadarśanaḥ
ce_text: sarveṣām eva varṇānāṃ gārhasthyaṃ tad vidhīyate / śraddhālakṣaṇam ity evaṃ dharmaṃ dhīrāḥ pracakṣate

vulgate_text: dānaṃ pratigrahaścaiva prāyaścittāni maṅgalam / idaṃ me syādidaṃ me syātsneho guṇasamudbhavaḥ
ce_text: idaṃ me syād idaṃ me syāt sneho guṇasamudbhavaḥ / abhidrohas tathā māyā nikṛtir māna eva ca

vulgate_text: paryāyeṇa pravartante tatratatra tathātathā / yatkiñcidiha loke'sminsarvamete trayo guṇāḥ
ce_text: evaṃ jyotiḥṣu sarveṣu vivartante guṇās trayaḥ / paryāyeṇa ca vartante tatra tatra tathā tathā

vulgate_text: ahaṅkārastathā'dhyātmaṃ sarvasaṃsārakāraṇam / abhimāno'dhibhūtaṃ ca rudrastatrādhidaivatam
ce_text: dvitīyaṃ māruto bhūtaṃ tvag adhyātmaṃ ca viśrutam / spraṣṭavyam adhibhūtaṃ ca vidyut tatrādhidaivatam

vulgate_text: agnī rūpaṃ rasaṃ sroto vāyuḥ sparśanameva ca mahī gandhadharā ghrāṇamākāśaḥ śravaṇaṃ tathā / dṛśyamādityamevāhuradhyātmaviduṣo janāḥ
ce_text: agnī rūpaṃ payaḥ sroto vāyuḥ sparśanam eva ca / mahī paṅkadharaṃ ghoram ākāśaṃ śravaṇaṃ tathā

vulgate_text: pañcendriyamahākūlāṃ manaḥsrotobhayāvahām / nadīṃ mohahradāṃ tīrtvā kāmakrodhāvubhau jayet
ce_text: kāmakūlām apārāntāṃ manaḥsrotobhayāvahām / nadīṃ durgahradāṃ tīrṇaḥ kāmakrodhāv ubhau jayet

vulgate_text: nirāśīrnirguṇaḥ śānto nirāsakto nirāśrayaḥ / ātmasaṅgī ca tattvajño mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
ce_text: nirāśīḥ sarvabhūteṣu nirāsaṅgo nirāśrayaḥ / sarvajñaḥ sarvato mukto mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ

vulgate_text: agandhamarasasparśamarūpāśabdameva ca / anugamyamanāsaktamamāṃsamapi caiva yat
ce_text: agandharasam asparśam arūpāśabdam eva ca / atvagasthy atha vāmajjam amāṃsam api caiva ha

vulgate_text: yatra jñānavatāṃ prāptiliṅgagrahaṇā smṛtā / tasmādaliṅgadharmajño dharmatattvamupācaret
ce_text: na tatra kramate buddhir nendriyāṇi na devatāḥ / vedā yajñāś ca lokāś ca na tapo na parākramaḥ / yatra jñānavatāṃ prāptir aliṅgagrahaṇā smṛtā

vulgate_text: yathainamavamanyeranpare satatameva hi / tathāvṛttaścarecchāntaḥ satāṃ dharmānakutsayan
ce_text: amūḍho mūḍharūpeṇa cared dharmam adūṣayan / yathainam avamanyeran pare satatam eva hi

vulgate_text: mano buddhirahaṅkāramavyaktaṃ puruṣaṃ tathā / etatsarvaṃ prasaṅkhyāya yathāvattattvaniścayāt
ce_text: indriyāṇīndriyārthāṃś ca mahābhūtāni pañca ca / manobuddhir athātmānam avyaktaṃ puruṣaṃ tathā

vulgate_text: kṣīṇakośo nirātaṅkastathedaṃ prāpnuyātparam
ce_text: nirmuktaḥ sarvasaṅgebhyo vāyur ākāśago yathā / kṣīṇakośo nirātaṅkaḥ prāpnoti paramaṃ padam

vulgate_text: ājīvyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ brahmavṛkṣaḥ sanātanaḥ / enaṃ chittvā ca bhittvā ca tattvajñānāsinā budhaḥ
ce_text: mahābhūtaviśākhaś ca viśeṣapratiśākhavān / sadāparṇaḥ sadāpuṣpaḥ śubhāśubhaphalodayaḥ / ājīvaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ brahmavṛkṣaḥ sanātanaḥ

vulgate_text: hitvā saṅgamayānpāśānmṛtyujanmajarodayān / nirmamo nirahaṅkāro mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
ce_text: pradhānaguṇatattvajñaḥ sarvabhūtavidhānavit / nirmamo nirahaṃkāro mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ

vulgate_text: dvāvimau pakṣiṇau nityau saṃkṣepau cāpyacetanau / etābhyāṃ tu paro yonyaścetanāvānsa ucyate
ce_text: dvāv etau pakṣiṇau nityau sakhāyau cāpy acetanau / etābhyāṃ tu paro yasya cetanāvān iti smṛtaḥ

vulgate_text: ko vā svidiha dharmāṇāmanuṣṭheyatamo mataḥ / vyāhatāmiva paśyāmo dharmasya vividhāṃ gatim
ce_text: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ / kiṃ svid eveha dharmāṇām anuṣṭheyatamaṃ smṛtam / vyāhatām iva paśyāmo dharmasya vividhāṃ gatim

vulgate_text: anityaṃ nityamityeke nāstyastītyapi cāpare / tridhetyeke dvidhetyeke vyākīrṇamiti cāpare
ce_text: anityaṃ nityam ity eke nāsty astīty api cāpare / ekarūpaṃ dvidhety eke vyāmiśram iti cāpare / ekam eke pṛthak cānye bahutvam iti cāpare

vulgate_text: kecinmokṣaṃ praśaṃsanti kecidbhogānpṛthagvidhān dhanāni kecidicchanti nirdhanatvamathāpare / upāsya sādhanaṃ tveke naitadastīti cāpare
ce_text: dhanāni ke cid icchanti nirdhanatvaṃ tathāpare / upāsyasādhanaṃ tv eke naitad astīti cāpare

vulgate_text: evaṃ vyutthāpite dharme bahudhā viprabodhite / niścayaṃ nādhigacchāmaḥ śreyaḥ kimiti sattama
ce_text: evaṃ vyutthāpite dharme bahudhā vipradhāvati / niścayaṃ nādhigacchāmaḥ saṃmūḍhāḥ surasattama

vulgate_text: hanta vaḥ samprakṣyāmi yanmāṃ pṛcchatha sattamāḥ / guruṇā śiṣyamāsādya yaduktaṃ tannibodhata
ce_text: brahmovāca / hanta vaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi yan māṃ pṛcchatha sattamāḥ / samastam iha tac chrutvā samyag evāvadhāryatām

vulgate_text: etatpadamanudvignaṃ variṣṭhaṃ dharmalakṣaṇam jñānaṃ niḥśreya ityāhurvṛddhā niścitadarśinaḥ / tasmājjñānena śuddhena mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ
ce_text: jñānaṃ niḥśreya ity āhur vṛddhā niścayadarśinaḥ / tasmāj jñānena śuddhena mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ

vulgate_text: samaḥ saṃjñānugaścaiva sa sarvatra vyavasthitaḥ / na sajjate sadā satvamāpaḥ puṣkaraparṇavat
ce_text: samaḥ saṃjñāgatas tv evaṃ yadā sarvatra dṛśyate / upabhuṅkte sadā sattvam āpaḥ puṣkaraparṇavat

vulgate_text: yathā dravyaṃ ca kartā ca saṃyogo'pyanayostathā yathā pradīpamādāya kaścittamasi gacchati / tathā sattvapradīpena gacchanti paramarṣayaḥ
ce_text: yathā pradīpam ādāya kaś cit tamasi gacchati / tathā sattvapradīpena gacchanti paramaiṣiṇaḥ

vulgate_text: evaṃ gacchati medhāvī tattvayogavidhānavit / parijñāya guṇajñaśca uttarāduttarottaram
ce_text: evaṃ gacchati medhāvī tattvayogavidhānavit / samājñāya mahābuddhir uttarād uttarottaram

vulgate_text: nāvā cāpi yathā prājño vibhāgajñaḥ svaritrayā / aśrāntaḥ salilaṃ gahācchīdhraṃ saṃtarate hradam
ce_text: nāvā cāpi yathā prājño vibhāgajñas taritrayā / aklāntaḥ salilaṃ gāhet kṣipraṃ saṃtarati dhruvam

vulgate_text: parāvarajño bhūtānāṃ vidhijñaḥ sarvakarmaṇām / sarvabhūtātmabhūtātmā yaṃ prāpyānantyamaśnute
ce_text: tasmāt tu param avyaktam avyaktāt puruṣaḥ paraḥ / parāvarajño bhūtānāṃ yaṃ prāpyānantyam aśnute

vulgate_text: tatastvaṃ samyagācīrṇo dharme'sminnarikarśana / sarvapāpavinirmukto mokṣaṃ prāpsyasi kevalam
ce_text: tatas tvaṃ samyag ācīrṇe dharme 'smin kurunandana / sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā mokṣaṃ prāpsyasi kevalam

vulgate_text: ityuktavacanaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pratyuvāca dhanaṃjayaḥ / yadiṣṭaṃ kuru sarveṣāmīśvaro'smānprapālaya
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / ity uktavacanaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pratyuvāca dhanaṃjayaḥ / gacchāvo nagaraṃ kṛṣṇa gajasāhvayam adya vai

vulgate_text: yadi gantuṃ kṛtā buddhirvāsudeva namostu te gacchāvo nagaraṃ kṛṣṇa gajasāhvayamadya vai
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / ity uktavacanaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pratyuvāca dhanaṃjayaḥ / gacchāvo nagaraṃ kṛṣṇa gajasāhvayam adya vai

vulgate_text: tau praviśya mahātmānau tadgṛhaṃ paramārcitam / dharmarājaṃ dadṛśaturdevarājamivāśvinau
ce_text: tatas tau tat praviśyātha dadṛśāte mahābalau / dharmarājānam āsīnaṃ devarājam ivāśvinau

vulgate_text: iyaṃ ca vasudhā kṛtsnā prasādāttava keśava / asmānupāgatā vīra nihatāścāpi śatravaḥ
ce_text: iyaṃ hi vasudhā sarvā prasādāt tava mādhava / asmān upagatā vīra nihatāś cāpi śatravaḥ

vulgate_text: kṛto yatno mayā pūrvaṃ sauśāmye kauravānprati nāśakyanta yadā sāmye te sthāpayitumañjasā
ce_text: vāsudeva uvāca / kṛto yatno mayā brahman saubhrātre kauravān prati / na cāśakyanta saṃdhātuṃ te 'dharmarucayo mayā

vulgate_text: tvayā śaktena hi satā mithyācāreṇi mādhava / te parītāḥ kuruśreṣṭhā naśyantaḥ sma hyupekṣitāḥ / vāsudeva uvāca
ce_text: vāsudeva uvāca / kṛto yatno mayā brahman saubhrātre kauravān prati / na cāśakyanta saṃdhātuṃ te 'dharmarucayo mayā

vulgate_text: tamo rajaśca satvaṃ ca viddhi bhāvānmadāśrayān / sthitisṛṣṭilayādhyakṣo viṣṇubrahmeśasaṃjñitaḥ
ce_text: vāsudeva uvāca / tamo rajaś ca sattvaṃ ca viddhi bhāvān madāśrayān / tathā rudrān vasūṃś cāpi viddhi matprabhavān dvija

vulgate_text: praṇavātmā ca śabdādīṃstriguṇātmā carācaram tathā rudrānvasūnvā'pi viddhi matprabhavāndvija
ce_text: vāsudeva uvāca / tamo rajaś ca sattvaṃ ca viddhi bhāvān madāśrayān / tathā rudrān vasūṃś cāpi viddhi matprabhavān dvija

vulgate_text: taddṛṣṭvā paramaṃ rūpaṃ viṣṇorvaiṣṇavamadbhutam / vismayaṃ ca yayau viprastaṃ dṛṣṭvā parameśvaram / udaṅka uvāca
ce_text: uttaṅka uvāca / abhijānāmi jagataḥ kartāraṃ tvāṃ janārdana / nūnaṃ bhavatprasādo 'yam iti me nāsti saṃśayaḥ

vulgate_text: viśvakarmannamaste'stu viśvātmanviśvakasambhava / padmyāṃ te pṛthivī vyāptā śirasā cāvṛtaṃ nabhaḥ
ce_text: uttaṅka uvāca / viśvakarman namas te 'stu yasya te rūpam īdṛśam / padbhyāṃ te pṛthivī vyāptā śirasā cāvṛtaṃ nabhaḥ

vulgate_text: udaṅkaḥ kena tapasā saṃyukto vai mahāmanāḥ / yaḥ śāpaṃ dātukāmo'bhūdviṣṇave prabhaviṣvave / vaiśampāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tataḥ sa tasmai prītātmā darśayām āsa tad vapuḥ / śāśvataṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ dhīmān dadṛśe yad dhanaṃjayaḥ

vulgate_text: yuvā ṣoḍaśavarṣo hi yadyadya bhavitā bhavān dadāni patnīṃ kanyāṃ ca svāṃ te duhitaraṃ dvija / etāmṛte'ṅganā nānyā tvattejo'rhati sevitum
ce_text: dadāmi patnīṃ kanyāṃ ca svāṃ te duhitaraṃ dvija / etām ṛte hi nānyā vai tvattejo 'rhati sevitum

vulgate_text: parituṣṭā'smi te vipra nityaṃ bhaktyā tavānagha / paryāptametadbhadraṃ te gaccha tāta yathepsitam / vaiśampāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tataḥ sa tasmai prītātmā darśayām āsa tad vapuḥ / śāśvataṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ dhīmān dadṛśe yad dhanaṃjayaḥ

vulgate_text: yadi mattastavāyatto gurvarthaḥ kṛta eva saḥ / yadi cāsti pratigrāhyaṃ sāmprataṃ tadvadasva me / udaṅka uvāca
ce_text: uttaṅka uvāca / bhavadgatena manasā bhavatpriyacikīrṣayā / bhavadbhaktigateneha bhavadbhāvānugena ca

vulgate_text: chidreṣveteṣvime nityaṃ hriyate dvijasattama / devarākṣasanāgānāmapramatteni dhāryate
ce_text: chidreṣv eteṣu hi sadā hy adhṛṣyeṣu dvijarṣabha / devarākṣasanāgānām apramattena dhāryate

vulgate_text: na cānyāmapi paśyāmi gatiṃ gatimatāṃvara / svargadvārasya gamane sthāne ceha dvijottama
ce_text: so 'haṃ dvijebhyaḥ praṇato viprād doṣam avāptavān / gatim anyāṃ na paśyāmi madayantīsahāyavān / svargadvārasya gamane sthāne ceha dvijottama

vulgate_text: śākhāsvāsajya tasyaiva kṛṣṇājinamariṃdama / pātayāmāsa bilvāni tadā sa dvijapuṅgavaḥ
ce_text: śākhāsv āsajya tasyaiva kṛṣṇājinam ariṃdama / yasmiṃs te kuṇḍale baddhe tadā dvijavareṇa vai

vulgate_text: yasmiṃste kuṇḍale baddhe tadā dvijavareṇa vai / bilvaprahāraistasyātha vyaśīryadbandhanaṃ tataḥ
ce_text: śākhāsv āsajya tasyaiva kṛṣṇājinam ariṃdama / yasmiṃs te kuṇḍale baddhe tadā dvijavareṇa vai

vulgate_text: sakuṇḍalaṃ tadajinaṃ papāta sahasā taroḥ / viśīrṇabandhane tasmingate kṛṣṇājine mahīm
ce_text: viśīrṇabandhane tasmin gate kṛṣṇājine mahīm / apaśyad bhujagaḥ kaś cit te tatra maṇikuṇḍale

vulgate_text: vāsukipramukānāṃ ca nāgānāṃ janamejaya / sarvaṃ śaśaṃsa gureva yathāvaddvijasattamaḥ
ce_text: hāhākṛtam abhūt sarvam airāvataniveśanam / vāsukipramukhānāṃ ca nāgānāṃ janamejaya

vulgate_text: sa nānāveśmasaṃkīrṇo devaloka ivābabhau / tadā ca kṛṣṇasānnidhyānmudā devagaṇairyutaḥ
ce_text: puṇyāvasathavān vīra puṇyakṛdbhir niṣevitaḥ / vihāro vṛṣṇivīrāṇāṃ mahe raivatakasya ha / sa nago veśmasaṃkīrṇo devaloka ivābabhau

vulgate_text: iti stute mānuṣaiśca pūjite devakīsute śakrasadmapratīkāśo babhūva sa hi śailarāṭ
ce_text: tadā ca kṛṣṇasāṃnidhyam āsādya bharatarṣabha / śakrasadmapratīkāśo babhūva sa hi śailarāṭ

vulgate_text: dhiyamāṇe tu tasmiṃstu garbhe kukṣistha eva ca / ājagāma tato vyāso jñātvā divyena cakṣuṣā
ce_text: ājagāma tato vyāso jñātvā divyena cakṣuṣā / āgamya cābravīd dhīmān pṛthāṃ pṛthulalocanām / uttarāṃ ca mahātejāḥ śokaḥ saṃtyajyatām ayam

vulgate_text: kṛsareṇa ca māṃsena nivāpaistilasaṃyutaiḥ / odanaṃ kumbhaśaḥ kṛtvā purodhāḥ samupāharat
ce_text: kṛsareṇa samāṃsena nivāpais tilasaṃyutaiḥ / śuśubhe sthānam atyarthaṃ devadevasya pārthiva

vulgate_text: dhūpagandhaniruddhaṃ tatsumanobhiśca saṃvṛtam / śuśubhe sthānamatyarthaṃ devadevasya pārthivaḥ
ce_text: kṛsareṇa samāṃsena nivāpais tilasaṃyutaiḥ / śuśubhe sthānam atyarthaṃ devadevasya pārthiva

vulgate_text: kuruvaṃśastavākhyābhirāśīrbhirbharatarṣabha sabhājayata saṃhṛṣṭo mahārāja mahājanaḥ
ce_text: tatra mallā naṭā jhallā granthikāḥ saukhaśāyikāḥ / sūtamāgadhasaṃghāś cāpy astuvan vai janārdanam / kuruvaṃśas tavākhyābhir āśīrbhir bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: tatastasyai dadau prīto bahuratnaṃ viśeṣataḥ tathaiva vṛṣṇiśārdūlo nāma cāsyākarotprabhuḥ / pitustava mahārāja satyasandho janārdanaḥ
ce_text: tathānye vṛṣṇiśārdūlā nāma cāsyākarot prabhuḥ / pitus tava mahārāja satyasaṃdho janārdanaḥ

vulgate_text: dīkṣayasva tvamātmānaṃ tvaṃ hi naḥ paramo guruḥ / tvayīṣṭavati dāśārha vipāpmā bhavitā hyaham
ce_text: dīkṣayasva tvam ātmānaṃ tvaṃ naḥ paramako guruḥ / tvayīṣṭavati dharmajña vipāpmā syām ahaṃ vibho / tvaṃ hi yajño 'kṣaraḥ sarvas tvaṃ dharmas tvaṃ prajāpatiḥ

vulgate_text: tvaṃ cādyi kuruvīrāṇāṃ dharmeṇa hi virājase guṇībhūtāḥ sma te rājaṃstvaṃ no rājangururmataḥ / yajasva madanujñātaḥ prāpya eṣa kratustvayā
ce_text: tvaṃ cādya kuruvīrāṇāṃ dharmeṇābhivirājase / guṇabhūtāḥ sma te rājaṃs tvaṃ no rājan mato guruḥ

vulgate_text: dhanuṣaḥ patatastasya savyasācikarādvibho / babhūva sadṛśaṃ rūpaṃ śakracāpasya bhārata
ce_text: dhanuṣaḥ patatas tasya savyasācikarād vibho / indrasyevāyudhasyāsīd rūpaṃ bharatasattama

vulgate_text: hatāvaśiṣṭā hi parāḥ pārthaṃ dṛṣṭaparākramāḥ tamūcuḥ puruṣavyāghraṃ saṃśaptakaniṣūdanam
ce_text: ta ūcuḥ puruṣavyāghraṃ saṃśaptakaniṣūdanam / tava sma kiṃkarāḥ sarve sarve ca vaśagās tava

vulgate_text: agrahastasumuktena śīkareṇa sa nāgarāṭ / samaukṣati guḍākeśaṃ śailaṃ nīla ivāmbudaḥ
ce_text: agrahastapramuktena śīkareṇa sa phalgunam / samukṣata mahārāja śailaṃ nīla ivāmbudaḥ

vulgate_text: tato rathasahasreṇa gajānāmayutena ca / ***ṣṭhakīkṛtya bībhatsuṃ prahṛṣṭamanaso'bhavan
ce_text: tato rathasahasreṇa hayānām ayutena ca / koṣṭhakīkṛtya kaunteyaṃ saṃprahṛṣṭam ayodhayan

vulgate_text: śaśaṃ cāśu vinirbhidya maṇḍalaṃ śaśino'patan / viparītā diśaścāpi sarvā dhūmākulāstathā
ce_text: śaśaś cāśu vinirbhidya maṇḍalaṃ śaśino 'patat / viparītas tadā rājaṃs tasminn utpātalakṣaṇe

vulgate_text: atvarāvānasambhrāntaḥ saṃkruddhairvijigīṣubhiḥ / śataṃ śatasahasrāṇi śarāṇāṃ nataparvaṇām
ce_text: evam uktvā tu tān vīrān yuyudhe kurupuṃgavaḥ / atvarāvān asaṃrabdhaḥ saṃrabdhair vijigīṣubhiḥ

vulgate_text: evaṃ nirjitya tānvīrānsaindhavānsa dhanaṃjayaḥ / anvadhāvata dhāvantaṃ hayaṃ kāmavicāriṇam
ce_text: tataḥ saindhavakān yodhān vinirjitya nararṣabhaḥ / punar evānvadhāvat sa taṃ hayaṃ kāmacāriṇam

vulgate_text: tato mṛgamivākāśe yathā devaḥ pinākadhṛk / sasāra taṃ tathā vīro vidhivadyajñiyaṃ hayam
ce_text: sasāra yajñiyaṃ vīro vidhivat sa viśāṃ pate / tārāmṛgam ivākāśe devadevaḥ pinākadhṛk

vulgate_text: vyāyamya saṃyuge rājā dṛṣṭvā ca pitaraṃ hatam pūrvameva sa bāṇaurghargāḍhaviddho'rjunena ha / papāta sopi dharaṇīmāliṅgya raṇamūrdhani
ce_text: vyāyamya saṃyuge rājā dṛṣṭvā ca pitaraṃ hatam / pūrvam eva ca bāṇaughair gāḍhaviddho 'rjunena saḥ

vulgate_text: tato bahutaraṃ bhīrarvilapya kamalekṣaṇā / mumoha duḥkhasaṃtaptā papāta ca mahītale
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tato bahuvidhaṃ bhīrur vilapya kamalekṣaṇā / mumoha duḥkhād durdharṣā nipapāta ca bhūtale

vulgate_text: ulūpi sādhu paśyemaṃ patiṃ nipatitaṃ bhuvi / putraṃ cemaṃ samutsādya ghātayitvā na śocasi
ce_text: ulūpi sādhu saṃpaśya bhartāraṃ nihataṃ raṇe / putraṃ cainaṃ samutsāhya ghātayitvā na śocasi

vulgate_text: durmaraṃ puruṣeṇeha manye kāle hyanāgate / yatra nāhaṃ na me mātā na viyuktau svajīvitāt
ce_text: durmaraṃ puruṣeṇeha manye hy adhvany anāgate / yatra nāhaṃ na me mātā viprayujyeta jīvitāt

vulgate_text: enamasyorasi tvaṃ ca sthāpayasva pituḥ prabho / saṃjīvitaṃ tadā pārthaṃ sa tvaṃ draṣṭāsi pāṇḍavam
ce_text: etam asyorasi tvaṃ tu sthāpayasva pituḥ prabho / saṃjīvitaṃ punaḥ putra tato draṣṭāsi pāṇḍavam

vulgate_text: yathākāmaṃ vrajatyeṣa yajñiyāśvo nararṣabha / svasti te'stu gamiṣyāmi na sthānaṃ vidyate mama / vaiśampāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / prāyopaviṣṭe nṛpatau maṇipūreśvare tadā / pitṛśokasamāviṣṭe saha mātrā paraṃtapa

vulgate_text: tato gāṇḍīvadhanvā tu māgadhena bhṛśāhataḥ / babhau vasantasamaye palāsaḥ puṣpito yathā
ce_text: tato gāṇḍīvabhṛc chūro māgadhena samāhataḥ / babhau vāsantika iva palāśaḥ puṣpito mahān

vulgate_text: sā gadā śakalībhūtā viśīrṇimaṇibandhanā / vyālī vimucyamānena papāta dharaṇītale
ce_text: sā gadā śakalībhūtā viśīrṇamaṇibandhanā / vyālī nirmucyamāneva papātāsya sahasradhā

vulgate_text: tāṃścāpi vijayo jitvā nātitīvreṇa karmaṇā turaṅgamavaśenātha surāṣṭrānabhito yayau / gokarṇamatha cāsādya prabhāsamapi jagmivān
ce_text: turagasya vaśenātha surāṣṭrān abhito yayau / gokarṇam api cāsādya prabhāsam api jagmivān

vulgate_text: vitudyamānastaiścāpi gāndhāraiḥ pāṇḍunandanaḥ / ādisyādiśya tejasvī parānetānavārayat
ce_text: vitudyamānas taiś cāpi gāndhāraiḥ pāṇḍavarṣabhaḥ / ādiśyādiśya tejasvī śirāṃsy eṣāṃ nyapātayat

vulgate_text: alaṃ yuddhena te vīra na te'stvadya parājayaḥ ityuktastadanādṛtya vākyamajñānamohitaḥ / sa śakrasamakarmāṇaṃ samāvākiradāśugaiḥ
ce_text: ity uktas tad anādṛtya vākyam ajñānamohitaḥ / sa śakrasamakarmāṇam avākirata sāyakaiḥ

vulgate_text: ityuktvā'nuyayau pārtho hayaṃ taṃ kāmacāriṇam / te nyavartanta gāndhārā hataśiṣṭāḥ svakaṃ puram
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / ity uktvānuyayau pārtho hayaṃ taṃ kāmacāriṇam / nyavartata tato vājī yena nāgāhvayaṃ puram

vulgate_text: ityuktaḥ sa tu taccakre bhīmo nṛpatiśāsanam / hṛṣṭaḥ śrutvā guḍokeśamāyāntaṃ puruṣarṣabham
ce_text: ity uktaḥ sa tu tac cakre bhīmo nṛpatiśāsanam / hṛṣṭaḥ śrutvā narapater āyāntaṃ savyasācinam

vulgate_text: taṃ sasālacayaṃ śrīmatsapratolīsughaṭṭitam / māpayāmāsa kauravyo yajñavāṭaṃ yatāvidhi
ce_text: taṃ saśālacayagrāmaṃ saṃpratolīviṭaṅkinam / māpayām āsa kauravyo yajñavāṭaṃ yathāvidhi

vulgate_text: prāsādaśatasambandhaṃ maṇipravarakuṭṭimam sadaḥ sa patnīsadanaṃ sāgnīdhramapi cottaram / kārayāmāsa vidivaddhemaratnavibhūṣitam
ce_text: sadaḥ sapatnīsadanaṃ sāgnīdhram api cottaram / kārayām āsa vidhivan maṇihemavibhūṣitam

vulgate_text: brāhmaṇānāṃ na veśmāni nānādeśasamīyuṣām / kārayāmāsa kaunteyo vidhivattānyanekaśaḥ
ce_text: brāhmaṇānāṃ ca veśmāni nānādeśasameyuṣām / kārayām āsa bhīmaḥ sa vividhāni hy anekaśaḥ

vulgate_text: teṣāṃ nirviśatāṃ teṣu śibireṣu mahātmanām / nardataḥ sāgarasyeva divaspṛgabhavatsvanaḥ
ce_text: teṣāṃ niviśatāṃ teṣu śibireṣu sahasraśaḥ / nardataḥ sāgarasyeva śabdo divam ivāspṛśat

vulgate_text: aniśaṃ dīyate ca sma tatra bhojyaṃ pṛthagvidham brāhmaṇānāṃ viśāṃ caiva bahumṛṣṭānnamṛddhimat
ce_text: evaṃ pramuditaṃ sarvaṃ paśugodhanadhānyataḥ / yajñavāṭaṃ nṛpā dṛṣṭvā paraṃ vismayam āgaman / brāhmaṇānāṃ viśāṃ caiva bahumṛṣṭānnam ṛddhimat

vulgate_text: evaṃ sa vavṛte yajño dharmarājasya dhīmataḥ annasya subahūnrājannutsargānparvatopamān / dadhikulyāśaaca dadṛśuḥ sarpiṣaśca hradāñjanāḥ
ce_text: annasya bahavo rājann utsargāḥ parvatopamāḥ / dadhikulyāś ca dadṛśuḥ sarpiṣaś ca hradāñjanāḥ

vulgate_text: āgamiṣyanti rājānaḥ sarve vai kauravarṣabha / prāptānāṃ mahatāṃ pūjā kāryā hyetatkṣamaṃ hi naḥ
ce_text: āgamiṣyanti rājānaḥ sarvataḥ kauravān prati / teṣām ekaikaśaḥ pūjā kāryety etat kṣamaṃ hi naḥ

vulgate_text: saṃcintayāmi kaunteyaṃ raho jiṣṇuṃ janārdana / atīva duḥkhabhāgī sa satataṃ pāṇḍunandanaḥ
ce_text: atīva duḥkhabhāgī sa satataṃ kuntinandanaḥ / na ca paśyāmi bībhatsor nindyaṃ gātreṣu kiṃ cana / śrotavyaṃ cen mayaitad vai tan me vyākhyātum arhasi

vulgate_text: tatra bhīmādayaste tu karavo yājakāśca ye / remuḥ śrutvā vicitrāṃ tāṃ dhanaṃjayakathāṃ śubhām
ce_text: tatra bhīmādayas te tu kuravo yādavās tathā / remuḥ śrutvā vicitrārthā dhanaṃjayakathā vibho

vulgate_text: tatra vṛddhānyathāvatsa kurūnanyāṃśca pārthivān abhivādya mahābāhustaiścāpi pratinanditaḥ / praviveśa pitāmahyāḥ kuntyā bhavanamuttamam
ce_text: sa sametya kurūn sarvān sarvais tair abhinanditaḥ / praviveśa pitāmahyāḥ kuntyā bhavanam uttamam

vulgate_text: dharmarājaśca bhīmaśca phalgunaśca yamau tathā / pṛthakpṛthak ca te cainaṃ mānārthābhyāmayojayan
ce_text: dharmarājaś ca bhīmaś ca yamajau phalgunas tathā / pṛthak pṛthag atīvainaṃ mānārhaṃ samapūjayan

vulgate_text: evamatra mahārāja dakṣiṇābhirguṇīkura / śrīstvāṃ vrajatu te rājanbrāhmaṇā hyatra kāraṇam
ce_text: evam eva mahārāja dakṣiṇāṃ triguṇāṃ kuru / tritvaṃ vrajatu te rājan brāhmaṇā hy atra kāraṇam

vulgate_text: tatra vedavido rājaṃścakruḥ karmāṇi yājakāḥ / parikrāmanti śāstrajñā yatāvaddvijasattamāḥ
ce_text: tatra vedavido rājaṃś cakruḥ karmāṇi yājakāḥ / parikramantaḥ śāstrajñā vidhivat sādhuśikṣitāḥ

vulgate_text: te vyarājanta rājarṣe vāsobhirupaśobhitāḥ / mahendrānugatā devā yathā saptarṣibhirdivi
ce_text: te vyarājanta rājarṣe vāsobhir upaśobhitāḥ / narendrābhigatā devān yathā saptarṣayo divi

vulgate_text: nāhamādātumicchāmi brahmasvaṃ dvijasattamāḥ / idaṃ nityaṃ mano viprā bhrātṝṇāṃ caiva me sadā
ce_text: nāham ādātum icchāmi brahmasvaṃ munisattamāḥ / idaṃ hi me mataṃ nityaṃ bhrātṝṇāṃ ca mamānaghāḥ

vulgate_text: duḥśalāyāśca taṃ pautraṃ bālakaṃ bharatarṣabha / svarājye'tha piturdhāmānsvasuḥ prītyā nvayeśayat
ce_text: duḥśalāyāś ca taṃ pautraṃ bālakaṃ pārthivarṣabha / svarājye pitṛbhir gupte prītyā samabhiṣecayat

vulgate_text: bhakṣyakhāṇḍavarāgāṇāṃ kriyatāṃ bhujyatāṃ tathā / paśūnāṃ vadhyatāṃ caiva nāntaṃ dadṛśire janāḥ
ce_text: bhakṣyaṣāṇḍavarāgāṇāṃ kriyatāṃ bhujyatām iti / paśūnāṃ vadhyatāṃ cāpi nāntas tatra sma dṛśyate

vulgate_text: dīyatāṃ bhujyatāṃ cāpi tatra śabdo mahānabhūt / dīyatāṃ dīyatāṃ ceti divārātramavāritam
ce_text: dīyatāṃ bhujyatāṃ ceti divārātram avāritam / taṃ mahotsavasaṃkāśam atihṛṣṭajanākulam / kathayanti sma puruṣā nānādeśanivāsinaḥ

vulgate_text: uṣṇārtaśca kṣudhārtaśca viprastapasi saṃsthitaḥ / uñchamaprāptavāneva brāhmaṇaḥ kṣucchramānvitaḥ
ce_text: uñchaṃs tadā śuklapakṣe madhyaṃ tapati bhāskare / uṣṇārtaś ca kṣudhārtaś ca sa vipras tapasi sthitaḥ / uñcham aprāptavān eva sārdhaṃ parijanena ha

vulgate_text: iti bruvantīṃ tāṃ sādhvīṃ bhāryāṃ sa dvijasattamaḥ / kṣaudhāparigatāṃ jñātvā tānsaktūnnābhyanandata
ce_text: iti bruvantīṃ tāṃ sādhvīṃ dharmātmā sa dvijarṣabhaḥ / kṣudhāparigatāṃ jñātvā saktūṃs tān nābhyanandata

vulgate_text: bhavānhi paripālyo me sarvadaiva prayatnataḥ / sādhūnāṃ kāṅkṣitaṃ yasmātpiturvṛddhasya pālanam
ce_text: bhavān hi paripālyo me sarvayatnair dvijottama / sādhūnāṃ kāṅkṣitaṃ hy etat pitur vṛddhasya poṣaṇam

vulgate_text: bhuktvā tānapi saktūnsa naiva tuṣṭo babhūva ha / ucchavṛttistu dharmātmā vrīḍāmanujagāma ha
ce_text: bhuktvā tān api saktūn sa naiva tuṣṭo babhūva ha / uñchavṛttis tu savrīḍo babhūva dvijasattamaḥ

vulgate_text: sarvametaddhi yasmātte dattaṃ śuddhena cetasā / kṛcchrakāle tataḥ svargo vijitaḥ karmaṇā tvayā
ce_text: sarvasvam etad yasmāt te tyaktaṃ śuddhena cetasā / kṛcchrakāle tataḥ svargo jito 'yaṃ tava karmaṇā

vulgate_text: ityuktavākye dharme tu yānamārudya sa dvijaḥ / sadāraḥ sasutaścaiva sasnuṣaśca divaṃ gataḥ
ce_text: ity uktavākyo dharmeṇa yānam āruhya sa dvijaḥ / sabhāryaḥ sasutaś cāpi sasnuṣaś ca divaṃ yayau

vulgate_text: dharmasaṃśayamāpannānsatyaṃ brūhi mahāmate mahābhāga kathaṃ yajñeṣvāgamo nṛpasattama / yaṣṭavyaṃ paśubhirmedhyairatho bījairajairiti
ce_text: mahābhāga kathaṃ yajñeṣv āgamo nṛpate smṛtaḥ / yaṣṭavyaṃ paśubhir medhyair atho bījair ajair api

vulgate_text: api saṃcayabuddhirhi lobhamohavaśaṃ gataḥ / yajñaṃ karoti bhūtāni pāpenāśuddhabuddhinā
ce_text: api saṃcayabuddhir hi lobhamohavaśaṃgataḥ / udvejayati bhūtāni hiṃsayā pāpacetanaḥ

vulgate_text: yathāśaktyā bhagavatā tadannaṃ samupārjitam / tasminsatre tu yadvṛttaṃ yadyogyaṃ ca tadā'bhavat
ce_text: yathāśaktyā bhagavatā tad annaṃ samupārjitam / tasmin satre tu yat kiṃ cid ayogyaṃ tatra nābhavat / tathā hy anekair munibhir mahāntaḥ kratavaḥ kṛtāḥ

vulgate_text: tathā hyanekairmunibhirmahāntaḥ kratavaḥ kṛtāḥ evaṃvidhe tvagastyasya vartamāne tathā'dhvare / na vavarṣa sahasrākṣastadā bharatasattama
ce_text: evaṃvidhes tv agastyasya vartamāne mahādhvare / na vavarṣa sahasrākṣas tadā bharatasattama

vulgate_text: tataste munayo hṛṣṭā dadṛśustapaso balam / vismitā vacanaṃ prāhuridaṃ sarve mahārthavat
ce_text: ity ukte sarvam evaitad abhavat tasya dhīmataḥ / tatas te munayo dṛṣṭvā munes tasya tapobalam / vismitā vacanaṃ prāhur idaṃ sarve mahārthavat

vulgate_text: tatpayaḥ sthapayāmāsa nave bhāṇḍe dṛḍhe śucau / krodho nakularūpeṇa piṭharaṃ paryakarṣayat
ce_text: tat kṣīraṃ sthāpayām āsa nave bhāṇḍe dṛḍhe śucau / tac ca krodhaḥ svarūpeṇa piṭharaṃ paryavartayat

vulgate_text: tamājñāya muniḥ krodhaṃ naivāsya sa cukopa ha / sa tu krodhastato rājanbrāhmaṇīṃ mūrtimāsthitaḥ
ce_text: tam ājñāya muniḥ krodhaṃ naivāsya cukupe tataḥ / sa tu krodhas tam āhedaṃ prāñjalir mūrtimān sthitaḥ

vulgate_text: sākṣāddṛṣṭosi me kradha gaccha tvaṃ vigatajvaraḥ / na tvayāpakṛtaṃ me'dya na ca me manyurasti vai
ce_text: janamejaya uvāca / sākṣād dṛṣṭo 'si me krodha gaccha tvaṃ vigatajvaraḥ / na mamāpakṛtaṃ te 'dya na manyur vidyate mama

vulgate_text: sa tānprasādayāmāsa śāpasyānto bhavediti / taiścāpyuktaḥ kṣipandharmaṃ sāpasyāntamavāpsyati
ce_text: sa tān prasādayām āsa śāpasyānto bhaved iti / taiś cāpy ukto yadā dharmaṃ kṣepsyase mokṣyase tadā

vulgate_text: śrīvedavyāsāya namaḥ / nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam / devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet / janamejaya uvāca / prāpya paitāmahaṃ rājyaṃ mama pūrvapitāmahāḥ / kathamāsanmahārāje dhṛtarāṣṭre mahātmani
ce_text: janamejaya uvāca / prāpya rājyaṃ mahābhāgāḥ pāṇḍavā me pitāmahāḥ / katham āsan mahārāje dhṛtarāṣṭre mahātmani

vulgate_text: vihārayātrāsu punaḥ kururājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / sarvānkāmānupasthāpya dhṛtarāṣṭre nyavedayat
ce_text: vihārayātrāsu punaḥ kururājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / sarvān kāmān mahātejāḥ pradadāv ambikāsute

vulgate_text: dhṛṣṭaketośca bhaginī jarāsandhasutā tathā etāścānyāśca bahvyo vai yoṣitaḥ puruṣarṣabha / kiṃkarāḥ paryupātiṣṭhansarvāḥ subalajāṃ tathā
ce_text: dhṛṣṭaketoś ca bhaginī jarāsaṃdhasya cātmajā / kiṃkarāḥ smopatiṣṭhanti sarvāḥ subalajāṃ tathā

vulgate_text: parivṛtteṣu cāhaḥsu putrāṇāṃ śrāddhakarmaṇi / dadau ca rājā vittāni yāvadasya cikīrṣitam
ce_text: paridṛṣṭeṣu cāhaḥsu putrāṇāṃ śrāddhakarmaṇi / dadātu rājā sarveṣāṃ yāvad asya cikīrṣitam

vulgate_text: yāvaddhi kuruvīrasya jīvatputrasya vai sukham / tāvatsukhamavāpnoti bhogāṃścaiva vyavasthitān
ce_text: yāvad dhi kurumukhyasya jīvatputrasya vai sukham / babhūva tad avāpnotu bhogāṃś ceti vyavasthitāḥ

vulgate_text: dhṛtarāṣṭraśca tānsarvānvinītānniyame sthitān / śiṣyavṛttiṃ samāpannānguruvatpratyapadyata
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭraś ca tān vīrān vinītān vinaye sthitān / śiṣyavṛttau sthitān nityaṃ guruvat paryapaśyata

vulgate_text: brāhmaṇānsvastivācyātha hutvā caiva hutāśanam / āyūṃṣi pāṇḍuputrāṇāmāśaṃsata narādhipaḥ
ce_text: brāhmaṇān vācayitvā ca hutvā caiva hutāśanam / āyuṣyaṃ pāṇḍuputrāṇām āśāste sa narādhipaḥ

vulgate_text: saṃjayaṃ ca mahātmānaṃ kṛpaṃ cāpi mahāratham / anunetumihecchāmi bhavadbhirvasudhādhipam
ce_text: saṃjayaṃ ca mahāmātraṃ kṛpaṃ cāpi mahāratham / anunetum ihecchāmi bhavadbhiḥ pṛthivīpatim

vulgate_text: taṃ tu dṛṣṭvā samāsīnaṃ visaṃjñamiva kauravam / ārtiṃ rājā'gamattīvrāṃ kaunteyaḥ paravīrahā / yudhiṣṭhira uvāca
ce_text: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca / na māṃ prīṇayate rājyaṃ tvayy evaṃ duḥkhite nṛpa / dhiṅ mām astu sudurbuddhiṃ rājyasaktaṃ pramādinam

vulgate_text: spṛśantaṃ pāṇinā bhūyaḥ pariṣyajya ca pāṇḍavam uvāca rājā dharmajño dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ śubhaṃ vacaḥ
ce_text: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca / spṛśa māṃ pāṇinā bhūyaḥ pariṣvaja ca pāṇḍava / jīvāmīva hi saṃsparśāt tava rājīvalocana

vulgate_text: jīvāmīvātisaṃsparśāttava rājīvalocana mūrdhānaṃ ca tavāghrātumicchāmi manujādhipa / pāṇibhyāṃ hi parispraṣṭuṃ prāṇānāṃ hitamātmani
ce_text: mūrdhānaṃ ca tavāghrātum icchāmi manujādhipa / pāṇibhyāṃ ca parispraṣṭuṃ prāṇā hi na jahur mama

vulgate_text: tato'bravīnmahātejā dhṛtarāṣṭro yudhiṣṭhiram / anujñātastvayā putra bhuñjīyāmiti kāmaye
ce_text: tato 'bravīn mahātejā dharmaputraṃ sa pārthivaḥ / anujñātas tvayā putra bhuñjīyām iti kāmaye

vulgate_text: svastho bhavatvayaṃ dhīmānvaneṣu madhugandhiṣu rājarṣīṇāṃ purāṇānāmanuyātu gatiṃ nṛpaḥ rājarṣīṇāṃ hi sarveṣāmante vanamupāśrayaḥ / vaiśampāyana uvāca
ce_text: rājarṣīṇāṃ purāṇānām anuyātu gatiṃ nṛpaḥ / rājarṣīṇāṃ hi sarveṣām ante vanam upāśrayaḥ

vulgate_text: cakravattāta kāryāṇāṃ paryāyo dṛśyate sadā kośasya nicaye yatnaṃ kurvīthā nyāyataḥ sadā / vividhasya mahārāja viparītaṃ vivarjayeḥ
ce_text: kośasya saṃcaye yatnaṃ kurvīthā nyāyataḥ sadā / dvividhasya mahārāja viparītaṃ vivarjayeḥ

vulgate_text: deśajāścaiva puruṣā vikrāntāḥ sveṣu karmasu / yātrābhiranurūpābhiranugrāhyā hitāstvayā
ce_text: deśāntarasthāś ca narā vikrāntāḥ sarvakarmasu / mātrābhir anurūpābhir anugrāhyā hitās tvayā

vulgate_text: guṇārthināṃ guṇaḥ kāryo viduṣā vai janādhipa / avicāryāśca te te syuracalā iva nityaśaḥ
ce_text: guṇārthināṃ guṇaḥ kāryo viduṣāṃ te janādhipa / avicālyāś ca te te syur yathā merur mahāgiriḥ

vulgate_text: kaunteya taddhitaṃ te syātpṛthivīṃ vijigīṣataḥ / guṇānāṃ bhedane yogamīpsethāḥ saha mantribhiḥ
ce_text: gaṇānāṃ bhedane yogaṃ gacchethāḥ saha mantribhiḥ / sādhusaṃgrahaṇāc caiva pāpanigrahaṇāt tathā

vulgate_text: sādhusaṅgrahaṇāccaiva pāpanigrahaṇāttathā ātmasātkaraṇe nityaṃ pālanāni gṛhe tathā / durbalāścaiva satataṃ nānveṣṭavyā balīyasā
ce_text: gaṇānāṃ bhedane yogaṃ gacchethāḥ saha mantribhiḥ / sādhusaṃgrahaṇāc caiva pāpanigrahaṇāt tathā

vulgate_text: tiṣṭhethā rājaśārdūla vaitasīṃ vṛttimāsthitaḥ yadyenamabhiyāyācca balavāndurbala nṛpaḥ
ce_text: durbalāś cāpi satataṃ nāvaṣṭabhyā balīyasā / tiṣṭhethā rājaśārdūla vaitasīṃ vṛttim āsthitaḥ

vulgate_text: kośena paurairdaṇḍena ye cāsya priyakāriṇaḥ asambhave tu sarvasya yathā mukhyena niṣpatet / krameṇānena mokṣaḥ syāccharīraṃ prati kevalam
ce_text: asaṃbhave tu sarvasya yathāmukhyena niṣpatet / krameṇānena mokṣaḥ syāc charīram api kevalam

vulgate_text: samavetāṃśca tānsarvānpaurāñjānapadāṃstathā / tānāgatānabhiprekṣya samastaṃ ca suhṛñjanam
ce_text: tato niṣkramya nṛpatis tasmād antaḥpurāt tadā / sarvaṃ suhṛjjanaṃ caiva sarvāś ca prakṛtīs tathā / samavetāṃś ca tān sarvān paurajānapadān atha

vulgate_text: brāhmaṇāṃśca mahīpāla nānādeśasamāgatān / uvāca matimānrājā dhṛtarāṣṭro'mbikāsutaḥ
ce_text: brāhmaṇāṃś ca mahīpālān nānādeśasamāgatān / tataḥ prāha mahātejā dhṛtarāṣṭro mahīpatiḥ

vulgate_text: evameva mahābāhurbhīmārjunayamairvṛtaḥ yudhiṣṭhiro mahātejā bhavataḥ pālayiṣyati
ce_text: brahmeva bhagavān eṣa sarvabhūtajagatpatiḥ / yudhiṣṭhiro mahātejā bhavataḥ pālayiṣyati

vulgate_text: priyāṇi kurvansarveṣāmanuvṛttyarthamudyataḥ yathā bravīti dharmātmā muniḥ satyavatīsutaḥ / tathā kuru mahārāja sa hi naḥ paramo guruḥ
ce_text: yathā bravīti dharmajño muniḥ satyavatīsutaḥ / tathā kuru mahārāja sa hi naḥ paramo guruḥ

vulgate_text: na sa rājñāṃ vadhe sūnuḥ kāraṇaṃ te mahātmanām / na bhavānna ca te bhṛtyā na karṇo na ca saubalaḥ
ce_text: na sa rājāparādhnoti putras tava mahāmanāḥ / na bhavān na ca te bhṛtyā na karṇo na ca saubalaḥ

vulgate_text: prāpsyate ca bhavānpuṇyaṃ dharme ca satataṃ sthitaḥ / veda dharmaṃ mahābāho laukyaṃ vaidikameva ca
ce_text: prāpsyate ca bhavān puṇyaṃ dharme ca paramāṃ sthitim / veda puṇyaṃ ca kārtsnyena samyag bharatasattama

vulgate_text: tato viveśa bhavanaṃ gāndhāryā sahito nijam / āgatāyāṃ ca śarvaryāṃ sukhaṃ śete narādhipaḥ
ce_text: tato viveśa bhuvanaṃ gāndhāryā sahito nṛpaḥ / vyuṣṭāyāṃ caiva śarvaryāṃ yac cakāra nibodha tat

vulgate_text: kva tadā droṇabhiṣmau tau somadattopi vā'bhavat yatra dvādaśa varṣāṇi vane vanyena jīvatha / na tadā tvāṃ pitā jyeṣṭhaḥ pitṛtvenābhivīkṣate
ce_text: yatra trayodaśa samā vane vanyena jīvasi / na tadā tvā pitā jyeṣṭhaḥ pitṛtvenābhivīkṣate

vulgate_text: samādheyāstvayā rājaṃstvayyadya kuladhūrgatā śvaśrūśvaśurayoḥ pādāñśuśrūṣantī vane tvaham / gāndhārīsahitā vatsye tāpasī malapaṅkinī / vaiśampāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tataḥ prabhāte rājā sa dhṛtarāṣṭro 'mbikāsutaḥ / āhūya pāṇḍavān vīrān vanavāsakṛtakṣaṇaḥ

vulgate_text: vyacodayaḥ purā'smākamutsāhaṃ śubhadarśane / vidulāyā vacobhistvaṃ nāsmānsaṃtyaktumarhasi
ce_text: vyarocayaḥ purā hy asmān utsāhya priyadarśane / vidurāyā vacobhis tvam asmān na tyaktum arhasi

vulgate_text: kva sā buddhiriyaṃ cādya bhavatyā yā śrutā mayā / kṣatradharme sthitaṃ tyaktvā na prayātumihārhasi
ce_text: kva sā buddhir iyaṃ cādya bhavatyā yā śrutā mayā / kṣatradharme sthitiṃ hy uktvā tasyāś calitum icchasi

vulgate_text: apekṣatāmeva vo bhīma vepantīṃ kadalīmiva / strīdharmiṇīmariṣṭāṅgīṃ tathā dyūtaparājitām
ce_text: prekṣantyā me tadā hīmāṃ vepantīṃ kadalīm iva / strīdharmiṇīm anindyāṅgīṃ tathā dyūtaparājitām

vulgate_text: rājyasthayā tapastaptuṃ kartuṃ dānavrataṃ mahat / anayā śakyamevādya śrūyatāṃ ca vaco mama
ce_text: rājyasthayā tapas taptaṃ dānaṃ dattaṃ vrataṃ kṛtam / anayā śakyam adyeha śrūyatāṃ ca vaco mama

vulgate_text: sthānamapyasya nṛpateḥ śrotumicchāmyahaṃ vibho / tvattaḥ kīdṛkkadā ceti tanmamākhyāhi tattvataḥ
ce_text: sthānam asya kṣitipateḥ śrotum icchāmy ahaṃ vibho / tvattaḥ kīdṛk kadā veti tan mamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ

vulgate_text: acintayaṃśca jananīṃ tataste pāṇḍunandanāḥ / kathaṃ nu vṛddhamithunaṃ vahatyatikṛśā pṛthā
ce_text: anusmaranto jananīṃ tatas te kurunandanāḥ / kathaṃ nu vṛddhamithunaṃ vahaty adya pṛthā kṛśā

vulgate_text: kecidyānairnarā jagmuḥ kecidaśvairmahājavaiḥ / kāñcanaiśca rathaiḥ kecijjvalitajvalanopamaiḥ
ce_text: ke cid yānair narā jagmuḥ ke cid aśvair manojavaiḥ / rathaiś ca nagarākāraiḥ pradīptajvalanopamaiḥ

vulgate_text: susvaraṃ rurude dhīmānmātuḥ pādāvupaspṛśan / sā ca bāṣpākulamukhī dadarśaka dayitaṃ sutam
ce_text: sasvanaṃ prarudan dhīmān mātuḥ pādāv upaspṛśan / sā ca bāṣpāvilamukhī pradadarśa priyaṃ sutam

vulgate_text: kaccitte'pi nirātaṅkā vasanti viṣaye tava / kaccidvartasi paurāṇīṃ vṛttiṃ rājarṣisevitām
ce_text: kaccid vartasi paurāṇīṃ vṛttiṃ rājarṣisevitām / kaccid dāyān anucchidya kośas te 'bhiprapūryate

vulgate_text: dūrādālakṣitaḥ kṣattā tatrākhyāto mahīpateḥ kavidurastveṣa dharmātmā janaṃ dṛṣṭvā nivartate
ce_text: dūrād ālakṣitaḥ kṣattā tatrākhyāto mahīpateḥ / nivartamānaḥ sahasā janaṃ dṛṣṭvāśramaṃ prati

vulgate_text: loko vaikartano nāma bhaviṣyatyasya bhārata / yatidharmamavāptosau naiṣa śocyaḥ paraṃtapa
ce_text: lokāḥ saṃtānakā nāma bhaviṣyanty asya pārthiva / yatidharmam avāpto 'sau naiva śocyaḥ paraṃtapa

vulgate_text: kaccitte na ca mohosti vanavāsena bhārata / svadatte vanyamannaṃ vā upavāsopi vā bhavet
ce_text: kaccit te nānutāpo 'sti vanavāsena bhārata / svadate vanyam annaṃ vā munivāsāṃsi vā vibho

vulgate_text: sarvagaścaiva rājendra sarvaṃ vyāpya carācaram / dṛśyate devadevaiḥ sa siddhairnirmuktakalmaṣaiḥ
ce_text: sarvagaś caiva kauravya sarvaṃ vyāpya carācaram / dṛśyate devadevaḥ sa siddhair nirdagdhakilbiṣaiḥ

vulgate_text: kimicchasi mahīpāla mattaḥ prāptumabhīpsitam / draṣṭruṃ spraṣṭumatha śrotuṃ tatkartāsmi tavānagha
ce_text: kim icchasi mahīpāla mattaḥ prāptum amānuṣam / draṣṭuṃ spraṣṭum atha śrotuṃ vada kartāsmi tat tathā

vulgate_text: kimāhārāśca te tatra sasainyā nyavasanprabho / sāntaḥpurā mahātmāna etadicchāmi veditum / vaiśampāyana uvāca
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / tathā samupaviṣṭeṣu pāṇḍaveṣu mahātmasu / vyāsaḥ satyavatīputraḥ provācāmantrya pārthivam

vulgate_text: te'nujñātāstadā rājankururājena pāṇḍavāḥ / vividhānyannapānāni śayyāścaivābhajanvane
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / te 'nujñātās tadā rājan kururājena pāṇḍavāḥ / vividhāny annapānāni viśrāmyānubhavanti te

vulgate_text: ete madarthe putrāṃśca dārāṃśca manasaḥ priyān bhogāṃśca vividhāṃstāta iṣṭāpurtāṃstathaiva ca / parityajya gatāḥ śūrāḥ pretarājaniveśanam
ce_text: ye te putrāṃś ca dārāś ca prāṇāṃś ca manasaḥ priyān / parityajya gatāḥ śūrāḥ pretarājaniveśanam

vulgate_text: iyaṃ ca bhūriśravaso bhāryā paramasammatā / bhartṛvyasanaśokārtā bhṛśaṃ śocati bhāminī
ce_text: iyaṃ ca bhūriśravaso bhāryā paramaduḥkhitā / bhartṛvyasanaśokārtā na śete vasatīḥ prabho

vulgate_text: sa prīto varado me'bhūtkṛtakṛtyo mahāmuniḥ / avaśyaṃ te grahītavyamiti māṃ sobravīdvacaḥ
ce_text: sa me varam adāt prītaḥ kṛtam ity aham abruvam / avaśyaṃ te grahītavyam iti māṃ so 'bravīd vacaḥ

vulgate_text: yaḥ sa vairārthamudbhūtaḥ saṃgharṣajananaskatathā / taṃ karṇaṃ viddhi kalyāṇi bhāskaraṃ śubhadarśane
ce_text: dvidhā kṛtvātmano deham ādityaṃ tapatāṃ varam / lokāṃś ca tāpayānaṃ vai viddhi karṇaṃ ca śobhane / yaś ca vairārtham udbhūtaḥ saṃgharṣajananas tathā

vulgate_text: yasy vīrasya yo veṣo yo dhvajo yacca vāhanam / yadvarma yatpraharaṇaṃ tena tena sa dṛśyate
ce_text: yasya vīrasya yo veṣo yo dhvajo yac ca vāhanam / tena tena vyadṛśyanta samupetā narādhipāḥ

vulgate_text: parasparaṃ samāgamya yodhāste bharatarṣabha / muneḥ prasādātte hyevaṃ kṣatriyā naṣṭamanyavaḥ
ce_text: nātra śoko bhayaṃ trāso nāratir nāyaśo 'bhavat / parasparaṃ samāgamya yodhānāṃ bharatarṣabha

vulgate_text: putraiśca puruṣavyāghrāḥ kuravo'nye ca pārthivāḥ / tāṃ rātrimakilāmevaṃ vihṛtya prītamānasāḥ
ce_text: evaṃ samāgatāḥ sarve gurubhir bāndhavais tathā / putraiś ca puruṣavyāghrāḥ kuravo 'nye ca mānavāḥ

vulgate_text: tāḥ śīlaguṇasampannā vimānasthā gataklumāḥ / sarvāḥ sarvaguṇopetāḥ svasthānaṃ pratipedire
ce_text: tāḥ śīlasattvasaṃpannā vitamaskā gataklamāḥ / sarvāḥ sarvaguṇair yuktāḥ svaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ prapedire

vulgate_text: ṛjavaḥ śucayaḥ śāntā hiṃsānṛtavivarjitāḥ āstikāḥ śraddadhānāśca dhṛtimantaśca mānavāḥ / śrutvā''ścaryamidaṃ parva hyavāpsyanti parāṃ gatim
ce_text: svādhyāyayuktāḥ puruṣāḥ kriyāyuktāś ca bhārata / adhyātmayogayuktāś ca dhṛtimantaś ca mānavāḥ / śrutvā parva tv idaṃ nityam avāpsyanti parāṃ gatim

vulgate_text: yāvanna kṣīyate karma tāvattasya svarūpatā / kṣīṇakarmā naro loke rūpānyatvamupāśnute
ce_text: yāvan na kṣīyate karma tāvad asya svarūpatā / saṃkṣīṇakarmā puruṣo rūpānyatvaṃ niyacchati

vulgate_text: parīkṣidapi tatraiva babhūva sa tirohitaḥ snātvā sa nṛpatirvipramāstīkamidamabravīt / yāyāvarakulotpannaṃ jaratkārusutaṃ tadā
ce_text: snātvā ca bharataśreṣṭhaḥ so ''stīkam idam abravīt / yāyāvarakulotpannaṃ jaratkārusutaṃ tadā

vulgate_text: tamāśramagataṃ dhīmānbrahmarṣirlokapūjitaḥ / dvaipāyano'bhyupāgamya rājānamidamnabravīt
ce_text: tam āśramagataṃ dhīmān brahmarṣir lokapūjitaḥ / muniḥ satyavatīputro dhṛtarāṣṭram abhāṣata

vulgate_text: ityuktaḥ sa tu gāndhāryā kuntīmidamabhāṣata / snehabāṣpākule netre parimṛjya vinītavat
ce_text: ity uktaḥ sa tu gāndhāryā kuntīm idam uvāca ha / snehabāṣpākule netre pramṛjya rudatīṃ vacaḥ

vulgate_text: sarve hi bhasmāsānnītāste droṇena raṇājire avaśiṣṭāśca nihatā droṇaputreṇa vai niśi / cedayaścaiva matsyāśca dṛṣṭapūrvāstathaiva naḥ
ce_text: sarve hi bhasmasān nītā droṇenaikena saṃyuge / avaśeṣās tu nihatā droṇaputreṇa vai niśi

vulgate_text: draupadīpramukhāścaiva sarvāḥ kauravayoṣitaḥ / nyāyataḥ śvaśure vṛttiṃ prayujya prayayustataḥ
ce_text: nyāyataḥ śvaśure vṛttiṃ prayujya prayayus tataḥ / śvaśrūbhyāṃ samanujñātāḥ pariṣvajyābhinanditāḥ / saṃdiṣṭāś cetikartavyaṃ prayayur bhartṛbhiḥ saha

vulgate_text: bhīmasenapurogāśca bhrātaraḥ sarva eva te / rurudurduḥkhasaṃtaptā varṇayantaḥ pṛthāṃ tadā
ce_text: aho dhig iti rājā tu vikruśya bhṛśaduḥkhitaḥ / ūrdhvabāhuḥ smaran mātuḥ praruroda yudhiṣṭhiraḥ / bhīmasenapurogāś ca bhrātaraḥ sarva eva te

vulgate_text: śrīvedavyāsāya namaḥ / nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam / devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet / vaiśampāyana uvāca / ṣaṭtriṃśe tvath saṃprāpte varṣe kauravandanaḥ / dadarśa viparītāni nimittāni yudhiṣṭiraḥ
ce_text: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca / ṣaṭtriṃśe tv atha saṃprāpte varṣe kauravanandanaḥ / dadarśa viparītāni nimittāni yudhiṣṭhiraḥ

vulgate_text: ete cānye ca bahava utpātā bhayasaṃsinaḥ / dṛśyante jagato nātha divamāroḍhumicchati
ce_text: ete cānye ca bahava utpātā bhayaśaṃsinaḥ / dṛśyante 'har aho rājan hṛdayodvegakārakāḥ

vulgate_text: śvobhūte'tha tataḥ sāṃbo musalaṃ tadasūkata vai / yena vṛṣṇandhakakule puruṣā bhasmasātkṛtāḥ
ce_text: śvobhūte 'tha tataḥ sāmbo musalaṃ tad asūta vai / vṛṣṇyandhakavināśāya kiṃkarapratimaṃ mahat

vulgate_text: viṣaṇṇarūpastadrājā sūkṣmaṃ cūrṇamakārayat / taccūrṇaṃ sāgare cāpi prākṣipanpuruṣā nṛpa
ce_text: prasūtaṃ śāpajaṃ ghoraṃ tac ca rājñe nyavedayan / viṣaṇṇarūpas tad rājā sūkṣmaṃ cūrṇam akārayat

vulgate_text: aghoṣayaṃśca nagare vacanādāhukasya te / janārdanasya rāmasya babhroścaiva mahātmanaḥ
ce_text: prākṣipan sāgare tac ca puruṣā rājaśāsanāt / aghoṣayaṃś ca nagare vacanād āhukasya ca

vulgate_text: vivṛddhamūṣikā rathyā vibhinnamaṇikāstathā / keśā nakhāśca suptānāmadyante mūṣikairniśi
ce_text: vivṛddhamūṣakā rathyā vibhinnamaṇikās tathā / cīcīkūcīti vāśyantyaḥ sārikā vṛṣṇiveśmasu / nopaśāmyati śabdaś ca sa divārātram eva hi

vulgate_text: tato manoharā hṛṣṭāḥka peyaṃ māṃsaṃ madhūni ca / bahu nānāvidhaṃ cakrustvaritāḥ kālacoditāḥ
ce_text: tato bhojyaṃ ca bhakṣyaṃ ca peyaṃ cāndhakavṛṣṇayaḥ / bahu nānāvidhaṃ cakrur madyaṃ māṃsam anekaśaḥ

vulgate_text: samāptamāyurasyādya yaśaścaiva sumadhyate ityevamuktvā khaṅgena keśavasya samīpataḥ / abhidrutya śiraḥ kruddhaściccheda kṛtavarmaṇaḥ
ce_text: itīdam uktvā khaḍgena keśavasya samīpataḥ / abhidrutya śiraḥ kruddhaś ciccheda kṛtavarmaṇaḥ

vulgate_text: bhagavannihatāḥ sarve tvayā bhūyiṣṭhaśo narāḥ / rāmasya padamanviccha tatra gacchāma yatra saḥ
ce_text: bhagavan saṃhṛtaṃ sarvaṃ tvayā bhūyiṣṭham acyuta / rāmasya padam anviccha tatra gacchāma yatra saḥ

vulgate_text: saṃdṛśyantaṃ sāgarāntaṃ viśantaṃ samyaktadā sāgaraḥ pratyagṛhṇāt / nāgā divyāḥ saritaścaiva puṇyāḥ karkoṭako vāsukistakṣakaśca
ce_text: sahasraśīrṣaḥ parvatābhogavarṣmā; raktānanaḥ svāṃ tanuṃ tāṃ vimucya / samyak ca taṃ sāgaraḥ pratyagṛhṇān; nāgā divyāḥ saritaś caiva puṇyāḥ

vulgate_text: athāpaśyatpuruṣaṃ yogayuktaṃ pītāṃbaraṃ lubdhako'nekabāhum / matvā''tmānaṃ tvaparāddhaṃ sa tasya pādau jaro jagṛhe śaṅkitātmā
ce_text: sa keśavaṃ yogayuktaṃ śayānaṃ; mṛgāśaṅkī lubdhakaḥ sāyakena / jarāvidhyat pādatale tvarāvāṃs; taṃ cābhitas taj jighṛkṣur jagāma / athāpaśyat puruṣaṃ yogayuktaṃ; pītāmbaraṃ lubdhako 'nekabāhum

vulgate_text: tau sadā kuruśārdūla kṛṣṇasya priyabhājanau / tāvubhau vṛṣṇināśasya mukhamāstāṃ dhanaṃjaya
ce_text: nityaṃ tvaṃ kuruśārdūla kṛṣṇaś ca mama putrakaḥ / tāv ubhau vṛṣṇināśasya mukham āstāṃ dhanaṃjaya

vulgate_text: ahaṃ deśe tu kasmiṃścitpuṇye niyamamāsthitaḥ / kālaṃ kāṅkṣe sadya eva rāmeṇa sahito vane
ce_text: ahaṃ hi deśe kasmiṃś cit puṇye niyamam āsthitaḥ / kālaṃ kartā sadya eva rāmeṇa saha dhīmatā

vulgate_text: tāndīnamanasaḥ sarvānvimūḍhāngatacetasaḥ / uvācedaṃ vacaḥ kāle pārtho dīnatarastathā
ce_text: tān dīnamanasaḥ sarvān nibhṛtān gatacetasaḥ / uvācedaṃ vacaḥ pārthaḥ svayaṃ dīnataras tadā

vulgate_text: tamanvayustatratatraṃ duḥkhasokasamanvitāḥ / dvārakāvāsinaḥ sarve paurajānapadā hitāḥ
ce_text: tam anvayus tatra tatra duḥkhaśokasamāhatāḥ / dvārakāvāsinaḥ paurāḥ sarva eva nararṣabha

vulgate_text: yudhiṣṭhirasyānumate vaṃśakartṝnkumārakān / nyaveśayata kauravyastatratatra dhanaṃjayaḥ

vulgate_text: hārdikyatanayaṃ pārtho nagare mṛttikāvate aśvapatiṃ khāṇḍavāraṇye rājye tatra nyevaśayat / bhojarājakalatraṃ ca hṛtaśeṣaṃ narottamaḥ

dattāni nityaśaḥ / dhenūnāṃ śatadānāni parvatānāṃ tathaiva ca / lokadānaṃ tathā dattaṃ brahmāṇḍasya ca saṃtatiḥ / kṛtā dattaṃ bhavet tena śrutaṃ yenaitad uttamam / śrutvā jayaṃ cetihāsaṃ dvijāya /
